1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: You have known about those among you who desecrated the Sabbath— we said to them, “Be you despicable apes.”

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهَا نَكَٰلًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فجعلناها نكالا لما بين يديها وما خلفها وموعظة للمتقين
verses.transliterated: fajaʿalnāhā nakālan limā bayna yadayhā wamā khalfahā wamawʿiẓatan lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: We set them up as an example for their generation, as well as subsequent generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.

1981.english: We thus made them an example for their generation, as well as subsequent generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: We rendered them a lesson for their generation, as well as subsequent generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا۟ بَقَرَةً قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًا قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قال موسى لقومه إن الله يأمركم أن تذبحوا بقرة ۖ قالوا أتتخذنا هزوا ۖ قال أعوذ بالله أن أكون من الجاهلين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi inna l-laha yamurukum an tadhbaḥū baqaratan qālū atattakhidhunā huzuwan qāla aʿūdhu bil-lahi an akūna mina l-jāhilīn
verses.english: Moses said to his people, "GOD commands you to sacrifice a heifer." They said, "Are you mocking us?" He said, "GOD forbid, that I should behave like the ignorant ones."
verses.subtitle: The Heifer
verses.footnote: Although this sura contains important laws and commandments, including the contact prayers, fasting, Hajj pilgrimage, and the laws of marriage, divorce, etc., the name given to the sura is "The Heifer." This reflects the crucial importance of submission to God and immediate, unwavering obedience to our Creator. Such submission proves our belief in God's omnipotence and absolute authority. See also the Bible's Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1981.english: When Moses said to his people, “God commands you to sacrifice a heifer,” they said, “Are you kidding us?” He said, “God forbid that I should be so foolish.”
1981.subtitle: The Heifer
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: When Moses said to his people, “GOD commands you to sacrifice a heifer,” they said, “Are you mocking us?” He said, “GOD forbid that I should be so ignorant.”
1989.subtitle: The Heifer
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌۢ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ فَٱفْعَلُوا۟ مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما هي ۚ قال إنه يقول إنها بقرة لا فارض ولا بكر عوان بين ذلك ۖ فافعلوا ما تؤمرون
verses.transliterated: qālū ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin lanā mā hiya qāla innahu yaqūlu innahā baqaratun lā fāriḍun walā bik'run ʿawānun bayna dhālika fa-if'ʿalū mā tu'marūn
verses.english: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us which one." He said, "He says that she is a heifer that is neither too old, nor too young; of an intermediate age. Now, carry out what you are commanded to do."

1981.english: They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us which one.” He said, “He says that she should be a heifer that is neither too old, nor too young; of an intermediate age. This is the command you shall carry out.”
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us which one.” He said, “He says that she is a heifer that is neither too old, nor too young; of an intermediate age. Now you should carry out this command.”
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوْنُهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفْرَآءُ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما لونها ۚ قال إنه يقول إنها بقرة صفراء فاقع لونها تسر الناظرين
verses.transliterated: qālū ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin lanā mā lawnuhā qāla innahu yaqūlu innahā baqaratun ṣafrāu fāqiʿun lawnuhā tasurru l-nāẓirīn
verses.english: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us her color." He said, "He says that she is a yellow heifer, bright colored, pleases the beholders."

1981.english: They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us her color.” He said, “He says that she shall be a yellow heifer; bright colored; pleases the beholders.”
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us her color.” He said, “He says that she is a yellow heifer, bright colored, pleases the beholders.”
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ إِنَّ ٱلْبَقَرَ تَشَٰبَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ادع لنا ربك يبين لنا ما هي إن البقر تشابه علينا وإنا إن شاء الله لمهتدون
verses.transliterated: qālū ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin lanā mā hiya inna l-baqara tashābaha ʿalaynā wa-innā in shāa l-lahu lamuh'tadūn
verses.english: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us which one. The heifers look alike to us and, GOD willing, we will be guided."

1981.english: They said, “Call upon your Lord to point her out for us. The heifers look alike to us, and with God’s help we will find her.”
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: They said, “Call upon your Lord to show us which one. The heifers look alike to us, and, GOD willing, we will be guided.”
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُولٌ تُثِيرُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِى ٱلْحَرْثَ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا قَالُوا۟ ٱلْـَٰٔنَ جِئْتَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إنه يقول إنها بقرة لا ذلول تثير الأرض ولا تسقي الحرث مسلمة لا شية فيها ۚ قالوا الآن جئت بالحق ۚ فذبحوها وما كادوا يفعلون
verses.transliterated: qāla innahu yaqūlu innahā baqaratun lā dhalūlun tuthīru l-arḍa walā tasqī l-ḥartha musallamatun lā shiyata fīhā qālū l-āna ji'ta bil-ḥaqi fadhabaḥūhā wamā kādū yafʿalūn
verses.english: He said, "He says that she is a heifer that was never humiliated in plowing the land or watering the crops; free from any blemish." They said, "Now you have brought the truth." They finally sacrificed her, after this lengthy reluctance.

1981.english: He said, “He says that she shall be a heifer that was never humiliated in plowing the soil, or watering the crops; perfectly safe from any blemish.” They said, “Now you are telling the truth.” They finally sacrificed her, though with great reluctance.
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: He said, “He says that she is a heifer that was never humiliated in plowing the land or watering the crops; free from any blemish.” They said, “Now you have brought the truth.” They finally sacrificed her, after this lengthy reluctance.
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًا فَٱدَّٰرَءْتُمْ فِيهَا وَٱللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قتلتم نفسا فادارأتم فيها ۖ والله مخرج ما كنتم تكتمون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qataltum nafsan fa-iddāratum fīhā wal-lahu mukh'rijun mā kuntum taktumūn
verses.english: You had killed a person, then disputed among yourselves. GOD was to expose what you tried to conceal.
verses.subtitle: Purpose of the Heifer

1981.english: You murdered someone and disputed among yourselves, then God revealed what you tried to conceal.
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: You had killed a soul, then disputed among yourselves. GOD was to expose what you tried to conceal.
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فقلنا اضربوه ببعضها ۚ كذلك يحيي الله الموتى ويريكم آياته لعلكم تعقلون
verses.transliterated: faqul'nā iḍ'ribūhu bibaʿḍihā kadhālika yuḥ'yī l-lahu l-mawtā wayurīkum āyātihi laʿallakum taʿqilūn
verses.english: We said, "Strike (the victim) with part (of the heifer)." That is when GOD brought the victim back to life, and showed you His signs, that you may understand.

1981.english: Thus, we said, “Strike the murder victim with part of the heifer.” God thus resurrects the dead, and shows you His signs, that you may understand.
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: Thus, we said, “Strike (the victim) with part (of the heifer).” GOD then revived the dead, and showed you His signs, that you may understand.
1989.footnote: See the story of the heifer in the Bible’s Book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلْحِجَارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمَآءُ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم قست قلوبكم من بعد ذلك فهي كالحجارة أو أشد قسوة ۚ وإن من الحجارة لما يتفجر منه الأنهار ۚ وإن منها لما يشقق فيخرج منه الماء ۚ وإن منها لما يهبط من خشية الله ۗ وما الله بغافل عما تعملون
verses.transliterated: thumma qasat qulūbukum min baʿdi dhālika fahiya kal-ḥijārati aw ashaddu qaswatan wa-inna mina l-ḥijārati lamā yatafajjaru min'hu l-anhāru wa-inna min'hā lamā yashaqqaqu fayakhruju min'hu l-māu wa-inna min'hā lamā yahbiṭu min khashyati l-lahi wamā l-lahu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Despite this, your hearts hardened like rocks, or even harder. For there are rocks from which rivers gush out. Others crack and release gentle streams, and other rocks cringe out of reverence for GOD. GOD is never unaware of anything you do.

1981.english: Yet, your hearts hardened thereafter and became like rocks, or even harder. For there are rocks from which streams gush out; others crack and release water; while others even cringe out of reverence for God. God is never unaware of anything you do.
1981.footnote: See the Bible’s book of Numbers, Chapter 19.

1989.english: Yet, your hearts hardened thereafter and became like rocks, or even harder. For there are rocks from which rivers gush out. Other rocks crack and gently release water. Some rocks cringe out of reverence for GOD. GOD is never unaware of anything you do.

verses.arabic: أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفتطمعون أن يؤمنوا لكم وقد كان فريق منهم يسمعون كلام الله ثم يحرفونه من بعد ما عقلوه وهم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: afataṭmaʿūna an yu'minū lakum waqad kāna farīqun min'hum yasmaʿūna kalāma l-lahi thumma yuḥarrifūnahu min baʿdi mā ʿaqalūhu wahum yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Do you expect them to believe as you do, when some of them used to hear the word of GOD, then distort it, with full understanding thereof, and deliberately?
verses.subtitle: Distorting the Word of God

1981.english: Do you expect them to believe as you do, even though some of them distort the word of God after hearing it, with full understanding thereof, and maliciously?
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Do you expect them to believe as you do, when some of them used to hear the word of GOD, then distort it after full understanding thereof, and knowingly?
1989.subtitle: Tampering with the Word of God

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا لقوا الذين آمنوا قالوا آمنا وإذا خلا بعضهم إلى بعض قالوا أتحدثونهم بما فتح الله عليكم ليحاجوكم به عند ربكم ۚ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: qālū ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin lanā mā lawnuhā qāla innahu yaqūlu innahā baqaratun ṣafrāu fāqiʿun lawnuhā tasurru l-nāẓirīn
verses.english: And when they meet the believers, they say, "We believe," but when they get together with each other, they say, "Do not inform (the believers) of the information given to you by GOD, lest you provide them with support for their argument concerning your Lord. Do you not understand?"
verses.subtitle: Concealing the Word of God

1981.english: When they meet the believers they say, “We believe.” But when alone with each other they say, “Do you tell them of God’s revelations to you, and thus provide them with support for their argument? Do you not understand?”
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: When they meet the believers, they say, “We believe.” Then, when they get together with each other, they say, “Do not tell (the believers) of GOD’s revelations to you, lest you provide them with support for their argument concerning your Lord. Do you not understand?”

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولا يعلمون أن الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
verses.transliterated: awalā yaʿlamūna anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūn
verses.english: Do they not know that GOD knows everything they conceal, and everything they declare?

1981.english: Do they not realize that God knows everything they conceal and everything they declare?
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Do they not know that GOD knows everything they conceal, as well as everything they declare?

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّآ أَمَانِىَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم أميون لا يعلمون الكتاب إلا أماني وإن هم إلا يظنون
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum ummiyyūna lā yaʿlamūna l-kitāba illā amāniyya wa-in hum illā yaẓunnūn
verses.english: Among them are gentiles who do not know the scripture, except through hearsay, then assume that they know it.

1981.english: Among them are illiterates who do not know the scripture except through hearsay and conjecture.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Among them are gentiles who did not receive any scripture. They hear of it only through hearsay, then assume that they know it.

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فويل للذين يكتبون الكتاب بأيديهم ثم يقولون هذا من عند الله ليشتروا به ثمنا قليلا ۖ فويل لهم مما كتبت أيديهم وويل لهم مما يكسبون
verses.transliterated: fawaylun lilladhīna yaktubūna l-kitāba bi-aydīhim thumma yaqūlūna hādhā min ʿindi l-lahi liyashtarū bihi thamanan qalīlan fawaylun lahum mimmā katabat aydīhim wawaylun lahum mimmā yaksibūn
verses.english: Therefore, woe to those who distort the scripture with their own hands, then say, "This is what GOD has revealed," seeking a cheap material gain. Woe to them for such distortion, and woe to them for their illicit gains.

1981.english: Therefore, woe to those who distort the scripture with their own hands then say, “This is from God,” seeking a cheap gain. Woe to them for distorting the scripture, and woe to them for their illicit earnings.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Therefore, woe to those who distort the scripture with their own hands, then say, “This is what GOD sent,” seeking a cheap material gain. Woe to them for such distortion, and woe to them for their illicit gains.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَةً قُلْ أَتَّخَذْتُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَهْدًا فَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ عَهْدَهُۥٓ أَمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لن تمسنا النار إلا أياما معدودة ۚ قل أتخذتم عند الله عهدا فلن يخلف الله عهده ۖ أم تقولون على الله ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: waqālū lan tamassanā l-nāru illā ayyāman maʿdūdatan qul attakhadhtum ʿinda l-lahi ʿahdan falan yukh'lifa l-lahu ʿahdahu am taqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: Some have said, "Hell will not touch us, except for a limited number of days." Say, "Have you taken such a pledge from GOD—GOD never breaks His pledge—or, are you saying about GOD what you do not know?"
verses.subtitle: Eternity of Heaven and Hell
verses.footnote: It is an established belief among corrupted Muslims that they will suffer in Hell only in proportion to the number of sins they had committed, then they will get out of Hell and go to Heaven. They also believe that Muhammad will intercede on their behalf, and will take them out of Hell. Such beliefs are contrary to the Quran (Appendix 8).

1981.english: They said, “We will not suffer in hell, except for a few days.” Say, “Did you take such a promise from God, and God never breaks His promise; or do you say about God what you do not know?”
1981.subtitle: Heaven and Hell are Eternal
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: They said, “Hell will not touch us, except for a limited number of days.” Say, “Have you taken such a pledge from GOD—and GOD never breaks His promise—or, are you saying about GOD what you do not know?”
1989.subtitle: Eternity of Heaven and Hell

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَٰطَتْ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بلى من كسب سيئة وأحاطت به خطيئته فأولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: balā man kasaba sayyi-atan wa-aḥāṭat bihi khaṭīatuhu fa-ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: Indeed, those who earn sins and become surrounded by their evil work will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide in it forever.

1981.english: Indeed, anyone who works evil, and becomes surrounded by his sin, these have deserved hell; they abide therein forever.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Indeed, those who earn evil works, and become surrounded by their sins, will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات أولئك أصحاب الجنة ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: As for those who believe, and lead a righteous life, they will be the dwellers of Paradise; they abide in it forever.

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, they have deserved heaven; they abide therein forever.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ لَا تَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَقُولُوا۟ لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنكُمْ وَأَنتُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذنا ميثاق بني إسرائيل لا تعبدون إلا الله وبالوالدين إحسانا وذي القربى واليتامى والمساكين وقولوا للناس حسنا وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة ثم توليتم إلا قليلا منكم وأنتم معرضون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadhnā mīthāqa banī is'rāīla lā taʿbudūna illā l-laha wabil-wālidayni iḥ'sānan wadhī l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni waqūlū lilnnāsi ḥus'nan wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata thumma tawallaytum illā qalīlan minkum wa-antum muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: We made a covenant with the Children of Israel: "You shall not worship except GOD. You shall honor your parents and regard the relatives, the orphans, and the poor. You shall treat the people amicably. You shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat)." But you turned away, except a few of you, and you became averse.
verses.subtitle: The Commandments

1981.english: We made a covenant with the children of Israel; you shall not worship except God; you shall regard the parents, the relatives, the orphans, and the poor; you shall speak amicably to the people; you shall observe the **salat** prayers and the **zakat** charity. But you turned away, except a few of you, and you became averse.
1981.subtitle: The Children of Israel Rebel
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: We made a covenant with the Children of Israel: You shall not worship except GOD. You shall regard the parents, the relatives, the orphans, and the poor. You shall treat the people amicably. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). But you turned away, except a few of you, and you became averse.
1989.subtitle: Covenant with Israel

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمْ لَا تَسْفِكُونَ دِمَآءَكُمْ وَلَا تُخْرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذنا ميثاقكم لا تسفكون دماءكم ولا تخرجون أنفسكم من دياركم ثم أقررتم وأنتم تشهدون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadhnā mīthāqakum lā tasfikūna dimāakum walā tukh'rijūna anfusakum min diyārikum thumma aqrartum wa-antum tashhadūn
verses.english: We made a covenant with you, that you shall not shed your blood, nor shall you evict each other from your homes. You agreed and bore witness.

1981.english: We made a covenant with you, that you shall not shed each others blood, nor shall you evict each other from your homes. You agreed and bore witness.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: We made a covenant with you, that you shall not shed your blood, nor evict each other from your homes. You agreed and bore witness.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقًا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِهِمْ تَظَٰهَرُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأْتُوكُمْ أُسَٰرَىٰ تُفَٰدُوهُمْ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِخْرَاجُهُمْ أَفَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَتَكْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ إِلَّا خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أنتم هؤلاء تقتلون أنفسكم وتخرجون فريقا منكم من ديارهم تظاهرون عليهم بالإثم والعدوان وإن يأتوكم أسارى تفادوهم وهو محرم عليكم إخراجهم ۚ أفتؤمنون ببعض الكتاب وتكفرون ببعض ۚ فما جزاء من يفعل ذلك منكم إلا خزي في الحياة الدنيا ۖ ويوم القيامة يردون إلى أشد العذاب ۗ وما الله بغافل عما تعملون
verses.transliterated: thumma antum hāulāi taqtulūna anfusakum watukh'rijūna farīqan minkum min diyārihim taẓāharūna ʿalayhim bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wa-in yatūkum usārā tufādūhum wahuwa muḥarramun ʿalaykum ikh'rājuhum afatu'minūna bibaʿḍi l-kitābi watakfurūna bibaʿḍin famā jazāu man yafʿalu dhālika minkum illā khiz'yun fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wayawma l-qiyāmati yuraddūna ilā ashaddi l-ʿadhābi wamā l-lahu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Yet, here you are killing each other, and evicting some of you from their homes, banding against them sinfully and maliciously. Even when they surrendered, you demanded ransom from them. Evicting them was prohibited for you in the first place. Do you believe in part of the scripture and disbelieve in part? What should be the retribution for those among you who do this, except humiliation in this life, and a far worse retribution on the Day of Resurrection? GOD is never unaware of anything you do.

1981.english: Yet, here you are slaying each other, and evicting some of you from their homes, banding against them sinfully and maliciously. When they came to you as captives, you ransomed them, though evicting them was forbidden in the first place. Do you believe in part of the scripture and disbelieve in part? What should be the retribution for those who do this except humiliation in this life, and a harsher retribution on the day of resurrection? God is never unaware of anything you do.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Yet, here you are killing each other, and evicting some of you from their homes, banding against them sinfully and maliciously. Even when they surrendered, you demanded ransom from them. Evicting them was prohibited for you in the first place. Do you believe in part of the scripture and disbelieve in part? What should be the retribution for those among you who do this, except humiliation in this life, and a far worse retribution on the Day of Resurrection? GOD is never unaware of anything you do.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين اشتروا الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة ۖ فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينصرون
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna ish'tarawū l-ḥayata l-dun'yā bil-ākhirati falā yukhaffafu ʿanhumu l-ʿadhābu walā hum yunṣarūn
verses.english: It is they who bought this lowly life at the expense of the Hereafter. Consequently, the retribution is never commuted for them, nor can they be helped.

1981.english: It is they who gave preference to this life over the hereafter, and consequently, their retribution will not be commuted, nor will they find help.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: It is they who bought this life at the expense of the Hereafter. Consequently, the retribution is never commuted for them, nor can they be helped.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ فَفَرِيقًا كَذَّبْتُمْ وَفَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب وقفينا من بعده بالرسل ۖ وآتينا عيسى ابن مريم البينات وأيدناه بروح القدس ۗ أفكلما جاءكم رسول بما لا تهوى أنفسكم استكبرتم ففريقا كذبتم وفريقا تقتلون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba waqaffaynā min baʿdihi bil-rusuli waātaynā ʿīsā ib'na maryama l-bayināti wa-ayyadnāhu birūḥi l-qudusi afakullamā jāakum rasūlun bimā lā tahwā anfusukumu is'takbartum fafarīqan kadhabtum wafarīqan taqtulūn
verses.english: We gave Moses the scripture, and subsequent to him we sent other messengers, and we gave Jesus, son of Mary, profound miracles and supported him with the Holy Spirit. Is it not a fact that every time a messenger went to you with anything you disliked, your ego caused you to be arrogant? Some of them you rejected, and some of them you killed.
verses.subtitle: The Prophets of Israel

1981.english: We gave Moses the scripture, and subsequent to him we sent messengers. And we gave Jesus the son of Mary profound signs, and supported him with the holy spirit. Whenever a messenger came to you with commandments contrary to your wishes you turned arrogant; you rejected some, and killed some.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: We gave Moses the scripture, and subsequent to him we sent messengers. And we gave Jesus, the son of Mary, profound miracles, and supported him with the Holy Spirit. Is it not a fact that whenever a messenger went to you with anything you did not like, you turned arrogant, and either rejected him, or killed him?
1989.subtitle: The Prophets of Israel

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَقَلِيلًا مَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا قلوبنا غلف ۚ بل لعنهم الله بكفرهم فقليلا ما يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: waqālū qulūbunā ghul'fun bal laʿanahumu l-lahu bikuf'rihim faqalīlan mā yu'minūn
verses.english: Some would say, "Our minds are made up!" Instead, it is a curse from GOD, as a consequence of their disbelief, that keeps them from believing, except for a few of them.
verses.subtitle: Tragic Statement: "My mind is made up!"

1981.english: They said, “Our hearts are shielded.” Rather, it is a curse from God, because of their disbelief, that prevents them from ever believing.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: They even said, “Our minds are made up!” Instead, GOD is the One who placed a curse upon them, as a consequence of their disbelief. This causes them to stay in disbelief, excepting a few of them.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ كِتَٰبٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُوا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَلَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما جاءهم كتاب من عند الله مصدق لما معهم وكانوا من قبل يستفتحون على الذين كفروا فلما جاءهم ما عرفوا كفروا به ۚ فلعنة الله على الكافرين
verses.transliterated: walammā jāahum kitābun min ʿindi l-lahi muṣaddiqun limā maʿahum wakānū min qablu yastaftiḥūna ʿalā alladhīna kafarū falammā jāahum mā ʿarafū kafarū bihi falaʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verses.english: When this scripture came to them from GOD, and even though it agrees with, and confirms what they have, and even though they used to prophesy its advent when they talked with the disbelievers, when their own prophecy came to pass, they disbelieved therein. GOD's condemnation thus afflicts the disbelievers.
verses.subtitle: The Quran Consummates All Scriptures

1981.english: Thus, when a scripture came to them from God, and even though it confirms what they have, and even though they used to predict its coming to the idolaters, when their own predictions came true, they disbelieved. Thus does God’s curse affect the disbelievers.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: When a scripture came to them from GOD, confirming what they have, and even though they used to prophesy its advent to the disbelievers, when their own prophecy came to pass, they rejected it. GOD’s condemnation thus afflicts the disbelievers.
1989.subtitle: The Quran Consummates Previous Scriptures

verses.arabic: بِئْسَمَا ٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ أَن يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بَغْيًا أَن يُنَزِّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ فَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ عَلَىٰ غَضَبٍ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: بئسما اشتروا به أنفسهم أن يكفروا بما أنزل الله بغيا أن ينزل الله من فضله على من يشاء من عباده ۖ فباءوا بغضب على غضب ۚ وللكافرين عذاب مهين
verses.transliterated: bi'samā ish'taraw bihi anfusahum an yakfurū bimā anzala l-lahu baghyan an yunazzila l-lahu min faḍlihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi fabāū bighaḍabin ʿalā ghaḍabin walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun muhīnu
verses.english: Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for—rejecting these revelations of GOD out of sheer resentment that GOD should bestow His grace upon whomever He chooses from among His servants. Consequently, they incurred wrath upon wrath. The disbelievers have incurred a humiliating retribution.

1981.english: Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for; rejecting these revelations of God, out of sheer resentment that God should bestow His blessings upon whomever He wills. Consequently, they incurred wrath upon wrath; they will suffer humiliating retribution.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for— disbelieving in GOD’s revelations, out of sheer resentment that GOD should bestow His grace upon whomever He chooses from among His servants. Consequently, they incurred wrath upon wrath. Such disbelievers have deserved humiliating retribution.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ نُؤْمِنُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَيَكْفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ قُلْ فَلِمَ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنۢبِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ مِن قَبْلُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم آمنوا بما أنزل الله قالوا نؤمن بما أنزل علينا ويكفرون بما وراءه وهو الحق مصدقا لما معهم ۗ قل فلم تقتلون أنبياء الله من قبل إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahum āminū bimā anzala l-lahu qālū nu'minu bimā unzila ʿalaynā wayakfurūna bimā warāahu wahuwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā maʿahum qul falima taqtulūna anbiyāa l-lahi min qablu in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: When they are told, "You shall believe in these revelations of GOD," they say, "We believe only in what was sent down to us." Thus, they disbelieve in subsequent revelations, even if it is the truth from their Lord, and even though it confirms what they have! Say, "Why then did you kill GOD's prophets, if you were believers?"

1981.english: When they are told, “Believe in these revelations of God,” they say, “We believe only in what was revealed to us.” They thus reject all subsequent scripture, even though they know it is the truth, and even though it confirms their own scripture. Say, “Why did you slay God’s prophets in the past, if you were really believers?”
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: When they are told, “You shall believe in what GOD has sent down herein,” they say, “We believe only in what was sent down to us.” They reject subsequent revelation, even if it is the truth from their Lord, and even though it confirms what they have. Say, “(If you did believe in the revelations given to you,) why then did you kill GOD’s prophets, if you are truthful?” Lessons from Israel

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جاءكم موسى بالبينات ثم اتخذتم العجل من بعده وأنتم ظالمون
verses.transliterated: walaqad jāakum mūsā bil-bayināti thumma ittakhadhtumu l-ʿij'la min baʿdihi wa-antum ẓālimūn
verses.english: Moses went to you with profound miracles, yet you worshiped the calf in his absence, and you turned wicked.
verses.subtitle: Learning From Israel's History

1981.english: Moses had come to you with profound miracles, yet you idolized the calf in his absence and turned wicked.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Moses went to you with profound miracles, yet you worshiped the calf in his absence, and you turned wicked.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا وَأُشْرِبُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ بِكُفْرِهِمْ قُلْ بِئْسَمَا يَأْمُرُكُم بِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنُكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذنا ميثاقكم ورفعنا فوقكم الطور خذوا ما آتيناكم بقوة واسمعوا ۖ قالوا سمعنا وعصينا وأشربوا في قلوبهم العجل بكفرهم ۚ قل بئسما يأمركم به إيمانكم إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadhnā mīthāqakum warafaʿnā fawqakumu l-ṭūra khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatin wa-is'maʿū qālū samiʿ'nā waʿaṣaynā wa-ush'ribū fī qulūbihimu l-ʿij'la bikuf'rihim qul bi'samā yamurukum bihi īmānukum in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: We made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you, saying, "You shall uphold the commandments we have given you, strongly, and listen." They said, "We hear, but we disobey." Their hearts became filled with adoration for the calf, due to their disbelief. Say, "Miserable indeed is what your faith dictates upon you, if you do have any faith."

1981.english: We made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you. You shall strongly uphold the commandments we gave you, and hearken. They said, “We heard, but we will not obey.” Their hearts were filled with adoration for the calf, as a consequence of their disbelief. Say, “Miserable indeed is what your convictions dictate upon you, if you do have any convictions.”
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Also, we made a covenant with you, as we raised Mount Sinai above you, saying, “You shall uphold the commandments we have given you, strongly, and listen.” But they said, “We hear, but we disobey.” Their hearts became filled with adoration for the calf, due to their disbelief. Say, “Miserable indeed is what your faith dictates upon you, if you do have any faith.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَتْ لَكُمُ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَالِصَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا۟ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن كانت لكم الدار الآخرة عند الله خالصة من دون الناس فتمنوا الموت إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: qul in kānat lakumu l-dāru l-ākhiratu ʿinda l-lahi khāliṣatan min dūni l-nāsi fatamannawū l-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Say, "If the abode of the Hereafter is reserved for you at GOD, to the exclusion of all other people, then you should long for death, if you are truthful."

1981.english: Say, “If the hereafter is reserved for you alone at God, to the exclusion of all others, then you should long for death, if you are truthful.”
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Say, “If the abode of the Hereafter is really reserved for you at GOD, to the exclusion of all other people, then you should long for death, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوْهُ أَبَدًۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولن يتمنوه أبدا بما قدمت أيديهم ۗ والله عليم بالظالمين
verses.transliterated: walan yatamannawhu abadan bimā qaddamat aydīhim wal-lahu ʿalīmun bil-ẓālimīn
verses.english: They never long for it, because of what their hands have sent forth. GOD is fully aware of the wicked.

1981.english: They will never long for it, because of what their hands have committed. God is fully aware of the wicked.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: They never long for it, because of what their hands have sent forth. GOD is fully aware of the wicked.

verses.arabic: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ أَحْرَصَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ حَيَوٰةٍ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ يُعَمَّرُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحْزِحِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَن يُعَمَّرَ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولتجدنهم أحرص الناس على حياة ومن الذين أشركوا ۚ يود أحدهم لو يعمر ألف سنة وما هو بمزحزحه من العذاب أن يعمر ۗ والله بصير بما يعملون
verses.transliterated: walatajidannahum aḥraṣa l-nāsi ʿalā ḥayatin wamina alladhīna ashrakū yawaddu aḥaduhum law yuʿammaru alfa sanatin wamā huwa bimuzaḥziḥihi mina l-ʿadhābi an yuʿammara wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūn
verses.english: In fact, you will find them the most covetous of life; even more so than the idol worshipers. The one of them wishes to live a thousand years. But this will not spare him any retribution, no matter how long he lives. GOD is seer of everything they do.

1981.english: In fact, you will find them the most covetous of life; even more so than the pagans. The one of them wishes to live a thousand years, though this will never spare him the retribution, should he survive. God sees everything they do.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: In fact, you will find them the most covetous of life; even more so than the idol worshipers. The one of them wishes to live a thousand years. But this will not spare them any retribution, no matter how long they live. GOD is seer of everything they do.

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُۥ نَزَّلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل من كان عدوا لجبريل فإنه نزله على قلبك بإذن الله مصدقا لما بين يديه وهدى وبشرى للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: qul man kāna ʿaduwwan lijib'rīla fa-innahu nazzalahu ʿalā qalbika bi-idh'ni l-lahi muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi wahudan wabush'rā lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: Say, "Anyone who opposes Gabriel should know that he has brought down this (Quran) into your heart, in accordance with GOD's will, confirming previous scriptures, and providing guidance and good news for the believers."
verses.subtitle: Gabriel Mediates the Revelation

1981.english: Say, “Anyone who opposes Gabriel should know that he revealed this scripture into your heart with God’s permission, confirming previous scriptures, and providing guidance and good news for the believers.”
1981.subtitle: Gabriel Mediated the Revelation
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Say, “Whoever is an enemy of Gabriel (should know) that he has revealed this into your heart, in accordance with GOD’s will, confirming previous scriptures, and providing guidance and good news for the believers.”
1989.subtitle: Gabriel Mediates the Revelation

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَىٰلَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: من كان عدوا لله وملائكته ورسله وجبريل وميكال فإن الله عدو للكافرين
verses.transliterated: man kāna ʿaduwwan lillahi wamalāikatihi warusulihi wajib'rīla wamīkāla fa-inna l-laha ʿaduwwun lil'kāfirīn
verses.english: Anyone who opposes GOD, and His angels, and His messengers, and Gabriel and Michael, should know that GOD opposes the disbelievers.

1981.english: Anyone who opposes God, His angels, His messengers, Gabriel, and Michael, should know that God opposes the disbelievers.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: If one opposes GOD, His angels, His messengers, Gabriel, and Michael, then GOD opposes the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أنزلنا إليك آيات بينات ۖ وما يكفر بها إلا الفاسقون
verses.transliterated: walaqad anzalnā ilayka āyātin bayyinātin wamā yakfuru bihā illā l-fāsiqūn
verses.english: We have sent down to you such clear revelations, and only the wicked will reject them.

1981.english: We have revealed to you* profound revelations, and only the wicked will disbelieve therein.
1981.footnote: Like all previous scriptures, the Quran addresses all the people in the second person singular, as though all the people were one man. Thus, when God says, “We have revealed to you this Quran,” the word “you” here refers to all the people. See for example 18:27-28. Certain verses are specifically addressed to the prophet to serve as examples and lessons for the rest of us, or to address a specific incident.

1989.english: We have sent down to you clear revelations, and only the wicked will reject them.

verses.arabic: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَٰهَدُوا۟ عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهُۥ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أوكلما عاهدوا عهدا نبذه فريق منهم ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: awakullamā ʿāhadū ʿahdan nabadhahu farīqun min'hum bal aktharuhum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Is it not a fact that when they make a covenant and pledge to keep it, some of them always disregard it? In fact, most of them do not believe.

1981.english: Is it not a fact that whenever they made a covenant, some of them would violate it? Indeed, most of them do not believe.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Is it not a fact that whenever they make a covenant, some of them will violate it? Indeed, most of them do not believe. Proof of Disbelief

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما جاءهم رسول من عند الله مصدق لما معهم نبذ فريق من الذين أوتوا الكتاب كتاب الله وراء ظهورهم كأنهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: walammā jāahum rasūlun min ʿindi l-lahi muṣaddiqun limā maʿahum nabadha farīqun mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba kitāba l-lahi warāa ẓuhūrihim ka-annahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Now that a messenger from GOD has come to them, and even though he proves and confirms their own scripture, some followers of the scripture (Jews, Christians, and Muslims) disregard GOD's scripture behind their backs, as if they never had any scripture.
verses.subtitle: Disregarding God's Scripture
verses.footnote: God's Messenger of the Covenant is prophesied in the Old Testament (Malachi 3:1-3), the New Testament (Luke 17:22-37), and this Final Testament (3:81).

1981.english: And when a messenger came to them from God, confirming their own scripture, some of those who follow previous scripture disregarded this new scripture as if they did not know.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: When a messenger from GOD went to them, confirming what they have, some followers of the scripture disregarded GOD’s scripture behind their backs, as if they never had any scripture.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتْلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِۦ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَٰقٍ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واتبعوا ما تتلو الشياطين على ملك سليمان ۖ وما كفر سليمان ولكن الشياطين كفروا يعلمون الناس السحر وما أنزل على الملكين ببابل هاروت وماروت ۚ وما يعلمان من أحد حتى يقولا إنما نحن فتنة فلا تكفر ۖ فيتعلمون منهما ما يفرقون به بين المرء وزوجه ۚ وما هم بضارين به من أحد إلا بإذن الله ۚ ويتعلمون ما يضرهم ولا ينفعهم ۚ ولقد علموا لمن اشتراه ما له في الآخرة من خلاق ۚ ولبئس ما شروا به أنفسهم ۚ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-ittabaʿū mā tatlū l-shayāṭīnu ʿalā mul'ki sulaymāna wamā kafara sulaymānu walākinna l-shayāṭīna kafarū yuʿallimūna l-nāsa l-siḥ'ra wamā unzila ʿalā l-malakayni bibābila hārūta wamārūta wamā yuʿallimāni min aḥadin ḥattā yaqūlā innamā naḥnu fit'natun falā takfur fayataʿallamūna min'humā mā yufarriqūna bihi bayna l-mari wazawjihi wamā hum biḍārrīna bihi min aḥadin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wayataʿallamūna mā yaḍurruhum walā yanfaʿuhum walaqad ʿalimū lamani ish'tarāhu mā lahu fī l-ākhirati min khalāqin walabi'sa mā sharaw bihi anfusahum law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: They pursued what the devils taught concerning Solomon's kingdom. Solomon, however, was not a disbeliever, but the devils were disbelievers. They taught the people sorcery, and that which was sent down through the two angels of Babel, Haroot and Maroot. These two did not divulge such knowledge without pointing out: "This is a test. You shall not abuse such knowledge." But the people used it in such evil schemes as the breaking up of marriages. They can never harm anyone against the will of GOD. They thus learn what hurts them, not what benefits them, and they know full well that whoever practices witchcraft will have no share in the Hereafter. Miserable indeed is what they sell their souls for, if they only knew.
verses.subtitle: Witchcraft Condemned

1981.english: They also followed what the devils narrated concerning the kingdom of Solomon. Solomon, however, never abused his powers, but the devils did. They taught the people sorcery that was revealed to the world through the two angels Haroot and Maroot. But these two did not teach anyone without pointing out that such knowledge is revealed as a test, and should not be abused. Yet, they practiced such evil schemes as breaking up marriages, though they can never harm anyone against the will of God. They learn from sorcery what harms, not what benefits, and they knew well that anyone who practices sorcery will have no share in the hereafter. Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for, if they only knew.
1981.subtitle: Sorcery Prohibited
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: They pursued what the devils told them concerning the powers of Solomon. Solomon, however, was not a disbeliever, while the devils are disbelievers. Thus, they taught the people witchcraft that was sent down through the two angels of Babel, Haroot and Maroot. These two did not divulge such knowledge without pointing out that: “This is a test. You shall not abuse such knowledge.” But the people used it in such evil schemes as the breaking up of marriages. They can never harm anyone against the will of GOD. They learn only what hurts them, not what benefits them. And they knew full well that whoever practices such evil will have no share in the Hereafter. Miserable indeed is what they sold their souls for, if they only knew.
1989.subtitle: Witchcraft Condemned

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنهم آمنوا واتقوا لمثوبة من عند الله خير ۖ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: walaw annahum āmanū wa-ittaqaw lamathūbatun min ʿindi l-lahi khayrun law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: If they believe and lead a righteous life, the reward from GOD is far better, if they only knew.

1981.english: Had they believed and led a righteous life, the recompense from God would have been better for them, if they only knew.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Had they believed and led a righteous life, the reward from GOD would have been far better, if they only knew.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقُولُوا۟ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُوا۟ ٱنظُرْنَا وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تقولوا راعنا وقولوا انظرنا واسمعوا ۗ وللكافرين عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā taqūlū rāʿinā waqūlū unẓur'nā wa-is'maʿū walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, do not say, "Raa'ena" (be our shepherd). Instead, you should say, "Unzurna" (watch over us), and listen. The disbelievers have incurred a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: Twisting the Words of Supplication
verses.footnote: The word "Raa'ena" was abused by some Hebrew-speaking people, and twisted to sound like a dirty word (see also 4:46).

1981.english: O you who believe, do not say, “Ra’ina* (be our shepherd),” but say, “Unzurna (watch over us),” and hearken. The disbelievers have deserved painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: Playing on Words
1981.footnote: The word Ra’ina sounds like a dirty word in one of the old languages.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not say, “Raa'ena”* (be our shepherd)-, you should say, “Unzurna” (watch over us), and listen. The disbelievers have incurred a painful retribution.
1989.subtitle: Twisting the Words of Supplication
1989.footnote: The word “Raa'ena” was abused by some Hebrew-speaking people who twisted their tongues to make it sound like a dirty word (see also 4:46).

verses.arabic: مَّا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَلَا ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ما يود الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب ولا المشركين أن ينزل عليكم من خير من ربكم ۗ والله يختص برحمته من يشاء ۚ والله ذو الفضل العظيم
verses.transliterated: mā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi walā l-mush'rikīna an yunazzala ʿalaykum min khayrin min rabbikum wal-lahu yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: Neither the disbelievers among the followers of the scripture, nor the idol worshipers, wish to see any blessings come down to you from your Lord. However, GOD showers His blessings upon whomever He chooses. GOD possesses infinite grace.
verses.subtitle: Jealousy Condemned

1981.english: Those who disbelieve among the followers of previous scriptures, as well as the idol-worshipers, dislike to see any blessing come down to you from your Lord. But God chooses for His mercy whomever He wills. God possesses unlimited bounty.
1981.subtitle: Superceding Previous Revelations
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Neither the disbelievers among the followers of the scripture, nor the idol worshipers, wish to see any blessings come your way from your Lord. However, GOD showers His blessings upon whomever He chooses. GOD possesses infinite grace.
1989.subtitle: Jealousy Condemned

verses.arabic: مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَآ أَوْ مِثْلِهَآ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما ننسخ من آية أو ننسها نأت بخير منها أو مثلها ۗ ألم تعلم أن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: mā nansakh min āyatin aw nunsihā nati bikhayrin min'hā aw mith'lihā alam taʿlam anna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: When we abrogate any miracle, or cause it to be forgotten, we produce a better miracle, or at least an equal one. Do you not recognize the fact that GOD is Omnipotent?
verses.subtitle: The Ultimate Miracle: The Quran's Mathematical Code
verses.footnote: The Quran's mathematical miracle is perpetual & greater than previous miracles (34:45, 74:35). Like the Quran itself, it confirms, consummates, and supersedes all previous miracles.

1981.english: Whenever we abrogate any revelation, or cause it to be forgotten, we bring a better one or at least a similar one. Do you not know that God is omnipotent?
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: When we abrogate any miracle, or cause it to be forgotten, we bring a better miracle, or at least an equal one. Do you not know that GOD is Omnipotent?
1989.subtitle: The Ultimate Miracle: The Quran’s Mathematical Code
1989.footnote: As detailed in Appendix One, the Quran’s mathematical miracle is perpetual and is far greater than all previous miracles (see 34:45). Like the Quran itself, it confirms and supersedes all previous miracles (74:35).

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تعلم أن الله له ملك السماوات والأرض ۗ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: alam taʿlam anna l-laha lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: Do you not recognize the fact that GOD possesses the kingship of the heavens and the earth; that you have none besides GOD as your Lord and Master?

1981.english: Do you not know that to God belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and that you have none besides God as master and sustainer?
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Do you not know that GOD possesses the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and you have none besides GOD as your Lord and Master?

verses.arabic: أَمْ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ رَسُولَكُمْ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلْكُفْرَ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
verses.arabicClean: أم تريدون أن تسألوا رسولكم كما سئل موسى من قبل ۗ ومن يتبدل الكفر بالإيمان فقد ضل سواء السبيل
verses.transliterated: am turīdūna an tasalū rasūlakum kamā su-ila mūsā min qablu waman yatabaddali l-kuf'ra bil-īmāni faqad ḍalla sawāa l-sabīl
verses.english: Do you wish to demand of your messenger what was demanded of Moses in the past? Anyone who chooses disbelief, instead of belief, has truly strayed off the right path.

1981.english: Would you demand of your messenger what was demanded of Moses before? Anyone who substitutes disbelief for belief has indeed strayed off the right path.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Do you wish to demand of your messenger what was demanded of Moses before? Anyone who substitutes disbelief for belief has truly strayed off the right path.

verses.arabic: وَدَّ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَوْ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَٰنِكُمْ كُفَّارًا حَسَدًا مِّنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَٱعْفُوا۟ وَٱصْفَحُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ود كثير من أهل الكتاب لو يردونكم من بعد إيمانكم كفارا حسدا من عند أنفسهم من بعد ما تبين لهم الحق ۖ فاعفوا واصفحوا حتى يأتي الله بأمره ۗ إن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: wadda kathīrun min ahli l-kitābi law yaruddūnakum min baʿdi īmānikum kuffāran ḥasadan min ʿindi anfusihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-ḥaqu fa-iʿ'fū wa-iṣ'faḥū ḥattā yatiya l-lahu bi-amrihi inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Many followers of the scripture would rather see you revert to disbelief, now that you have believed. This is due to jealousy on their part, after the truth has become evident to them. You shall pardon them, and leave them alone, until GOD issues His judgment. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Many followers of previous scripture wish to revert you back to paganism, due to jealousy on their part, now that the truth has been manifested to them. You shall forgive and forget them, for God is the one who will judge them. God is omnipotent.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Many followers of the scripture actually wish to revert you, now that you have believed, into disbelievers. This is due to jealousy on their part, after the truth has become evident to them. You shall pardon them, and leave them alone, until GOD issues His judgment. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة ۚ وما تقدموا لأنفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله ۗ إن الله بما تعملون بصير
verses.transliterated: wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wamā tuqaddimū li-anfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda l-lahi inna l-laha bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verses.english: You shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). Any good you send forth on behalf of your souls, you will find it at GOD. GOD is seer of everything you do.

1981.english: You shall observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity. Any righteous work you send forward on behalf of your souls, you will find it at God. God is seer of everything you do.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). Any good you send forth on behalf of your souls, you will find it at GOD. GOD is seer of everything you do.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن يَدْخُلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لن يدخل الجنة إلا من كان هودا أو نصارى ۗ تلك أمانيهم ۗ قل هاتوا برهانكم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: waqālū lan yadkhula l-janata illā man kāna hūdan aw naṣārā til'ka amāniyyuhum qul hātū bur'hānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Some have said, "No one will enter Paradise except Jews or Christians!" Such is their wishful thinking. Say, "Show us your proof, if you are right."
verses.subtitle: All Believers Are Redeemed, Regardless of the Name of Their Religion
verses.footnote: See 2:62 and 5:69.

1981.english: They said, “No one will enter heaven unless he is Jewish, or Christian.” Such is their wishful thinking. Say, “Show us your proof, if you are right.”
1981.subtitle: Submission: Key to Salvation
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: They said, “No one will enter Paradise except those who are Jewish or Christian!” Such is their wishful thinking. Say, “Show us your proof, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بلى من أسلم وجهه لله وهو محسن فله أجره عند ربه ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: balā man aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muḥ'sinun falahu ajruhu ʿinda rabbihi walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: Indeed, those who submit themselves absolutely to GOD alone, while leading a righteous life, will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.subtitle: Submission: The Only Religion

1981.english: Indeed, whoever submits to God, while leading a righteous life, these have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Indeed, those who devote themselves absolutely to GOD, while leading a righteous life, will receive their recompense from their Lord; they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ لَيْسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ لَيْسَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُمْ يَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ فَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالت اليهود ليست النصارى على شيء وقالت النصارى ليست اليهود على شيء وهم يتلون الكتاب ۗ كذلك قال الذين لا يعلمون مثل قولهم ۚ فالله يحكم بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: waqālati l-yahūdu laysati l-naṣārā ʿalā shayin waqālati l-naṣārā laysati l-yahūdu ʿalā shayin wahum yatlūna l-kitāba kadhālika qāla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna mith'la qawlihim fal-lahu yaḥkumu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: The Jews said, "The Christians have no basis," while the Christians said, "The Jews have no basis." Yet, both of them read the scripture. Such are the utterances of those who possess no knowledge. GOD will judge them on the Day of Resurrection, regarding their disputes.

1981.english: And the Jews said, “The Christians have no basis,” while the Christians said, “The Jews have no basis,” though both of them recite the scripture. Those who received no scriptures have uttered similar utterances. God will judge them on the day of resurrection regarding their disputes.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: The Jews said, “The Christians have no basis,” while the Christians said, “The Jews have no basis,” although both of them read the scripture. Those who possessed no knowledge have uttered the same kind of utterances. GOD will judge them all on the Day of Resurrection, regarding their disputes

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ أَن يُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُۥ وَسَعَىٰ فِى خَرَابِهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ أَن يَدْخُلُوهَآ إِلَّا خَآئِفِينَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أظلم ممن منع مساجد الله أن يذكر فيها اسمه وسعى في خرابها ۚ أولئك ما كان لهم أن يدخلوها إلا خائفين ۚ لهم في الدنيا خزي ولهم في الآخرة عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: waman aẓlamu mimman manaʿa masājida l-lahi an yudh'kara fīhā us'muhu wasaʿā fī kharābihā ulāika mā kāna lahum an yadkhulūhā illā khāifīna lahum fī l-dun'yā khiz'yun walahum fī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Who are more evil than those who boycott GOD's masjids, where His name is commemorated, and contribute to their desertion? These ought not to enter therein except fearfully. They will suffer in this life humiliation, and will suffer in the Hereafter a terrible retribution.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Frequent the Masjid

1981.english: Who is more evil than one who forbids others from attending the mosques of God, where His name is commemorated, and seeks to have them deserted? These ought not to enter therein except fearfully. These have deserved humiliation in this life, and terrible retribution in the hereafter.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Who are more evil than those who boycott GOD’s mosques where His name is commemorated, and contribute to their desertion? These ought not to enter therein except fearfully. They have incurred humiliation in tl severe retribution in the Hereafter.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Frequent the Mosques

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولله المشرق والمغرب ۚ فأينما تولوا فثم وجه الله ۚ إن الله واسع عليم
verses.transliterated: walillahi l-mashriqu wal-maghribu fa-aynamā tuwallū fathamma wajhu l-lahi inna l-laha wāsiʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: To GOD belongs the east and the west; wherever you go there will be the presence of GOD. GOD is Omnipresent, Omniscient.

1981.english: To God belong the East and the West; wherever you might be there will be the presence of God. God is omnipresent, omniscient.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the east and the west; wherever you go there will be the face of GOD. GOD is Omnipresent, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ بَل لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا اتخذ الله ولدا ۗ سبحانه ۖ بل له ما في السماوات والأرض ۖ كل له قانتون
verses.transliterated: waqālū ittakhadha l-lahu waladan sub'ḥānahu bal lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kullun lahu qānitūn
verses.english: They said, "GOD has begotten a son!" Be He glorified; never! To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; all are subservient to Him.
verses.subtitle: Gross Blasphemy

1981.english: And they said, “God has begotten a son!” Glory be to Him; nay; to Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; all subservient to Him.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: They said, “GOD has begotten a son!” Be He glorified. Never! To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; all are subservient to Him.
1989.subtitle: Gross Blasphemy

verses.arabic: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.arabicClean: بديع السماوات والأرض ۖ وإذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون
verses.transliterated: badīʿu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verses.english: The Initiator of the heavens and the earth: to have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.

1981.english: He is the initiator of the heavens and the earth; to have anything done He simply says to it, “Be,” and it is.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: He is the Initiator of the heavens and the earth. To have anything done, He simply says to it, “Be,” and it is.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ لَوْلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا ٱللَّهُ أَوْ تَأْتِينَآ ءَايَةٌ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ تَشَٰبَهَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين لا يعلمون لولا يكلمنا الله أو تأتينا آية ۗ كذلك قال الذين من قبلهم مثل قولهم ۘ تشابهت قلوبهم ۗ قد بينا الآيات لقوم يوقنون
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna lawlā yukallimunā l-lahu aw tatīnā āyatun kadhālika qāla alladhīna min qablihim mith'la qawlihim tashābahat qulūbuhum qad bayyannā l-āyāti liqawmin yūqinūn
verses.english: Those who possess no knowledge say, "If only GOD could speak to us, or some miracle could come to us!" Others before them have uttered similar utterances; their minds are similar. We do manifest the miracles for those who have attained certainty.

1981.english: Those who do not know said, “If only God could speak to us, or some profound miracle come to us (we will then believe).” Others before them have uttered similar utterances; their hearts are all the same. We do manifest the signs for those who have attained certainty.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Those who possess no knowledge have said, “If only GOD could speak to us, or some miracle could come to us!” Others before them have uttered the same kind of utterances. Their minds are similar. We do manifest the miracles for those who have attained certainty.*
1989.footnote: When one attains certainty, no miracle can affect his decision to join God’s kingdom. If God permitted anyone who has not attained certainty to witness an ex traordinary miracle, this would constitute divine interference.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُ عَنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إنا أرسلناك بالحق بشيرا ونذيرا ۖ ولا تسأل عن أصحاب الجحيم
verses.transliterated: innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqi bashīran wanadhīran walā tus'alu ʿan aṣḥābi l-jaḥīm
verses.english: We have sent you with the truth as a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. You are not answerable for those who incur Hell.
verses.footnote: It is my obligation to point out that the identity of this messenger is confirmed to be "Rashad Khalifa," God's Messenger of the Covenant. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the gematrical value of "Khalifa" (725), plus the verse number (119), we get 1349, a multiple of 19. See 3:81 and Appendix Two.

1981.english: We have sent you, truthfully, as a bearer of good news as well as a warner, and you are not answerable for those who deserve hell.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: We have sent you* with the truth as a bearer of good news, as well as a warner, and you are not answerable for those who have incurred Hell.
1989.footnote: For the exact identity of this messenger, please see Appendix Two.

verses.arabic: وَلَن تَرْضَىٰ عَنكَ ٱلْيَهُودُ وَلَا ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولن ترضى عنك اليهود ولا النصارى حتى تتبع ملتهم ۗ قل إن هدى الله هو الهدى ۗ ولئن اتبعت أهواءهم بعد الذي جاءك من العلم ۙ ما لك من الله من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: walan tarḍā ʿanka l-yahūdu walā l-naṣārā ḥattā tattabiʿa millatahum qul inna hudā l-lahi huwa l-hudā wala-ini ittabaʿta ahwāahum baʿda alladhī jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi mā laka mina l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: Neither the Jews, nor the Christians, will accept you, unless you follow their religion. Say, "GOD's guidance is the true guidance." If you acquiesce to their wishes, despite the knowledge you have received, you will find no ally or supporter to help you against GOD.

1981.english: Neither the Jews, nor the Christians, will accept you, unless you follow their creed. Say, “God's guidance is the perfect guidance,” and if you ever acquiesce to their wishes despite this knowledge, you will find no one to help you against God.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Neither the Jews, nor the Christians, will accept you, unless you follow their religion. Say, “GOD’s guidance is the real guidance.” If you acquiesce to their wishes, despite the knowledge you have received herein, you will find no ally or supporter to help you against GOD.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَتْلُونَهُۥ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين آتيناهم الكتاب يتلونه حق تلاوته أولئك يؤمنون به ۗ ومن يكفر به فأولئك هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yatlūnahu ḥaqqa tilāwatihi ulāika yu'minūna bihi waman yakfur bihi fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: Those who received the scripture, and know it as it should be known, will believe in this. As for those who disbelieve, they are the losers.

1981.english: Those who received previous scripture, and truly uphold it, will believe in this.* As for those who disbelieve, they are the losers.
1981.footnote: See the Biblical teachings on the inside front cover, and Appendix 19.

1989.english: Those who received the scripture, and know it as it should be known, will believe in this. As for those who disbelieve, they are the losers.

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّى فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني إسرائيل اذكروا نعمتي التي أنعمت عليكم وأني فضلتكم على العالمين
verses.transliterated: yābanī is'rāīla udh'kurū niʿ'matiya allatī anʿamtu ʿalaykum wa-annī faḍḍaltukum ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I bestowed upon you, and that I blessed you more than any other people.

1981.english: O children of Israel, remember the blessings I bestowed upon you, and that I set you apart from all the people.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: O Children of Israel, remember the favors I bestowed upon you, and that I blessed you more than any other people.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا تَنفَعُهَا شَفَٰعَةٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واتقوا يوما لا تجزي نفس عن نفس شيئا ولا يقبل منها عدل ولا تنفعها شفاعة ولا هم ينصرون
