verses.transliterated: wa-ittaqū yawman lā tajzī nafsun ʿan nafsin shayan walā yuq'balu min'hā ʿadlun walā tanfaʿuhā shafāʿatun walā hum yunṣarūn
verses.english: Beware of the day when no soul will help another soul, no ransom will be accepted, no intercession will be useful, and no one will be helped.

1981.english: Beware of the day when no one can benefit another, no ransom will be accepted, no intercession will be useful, and no one can receive help.
1981.footnote: Why are the children of Israel so frequently mentioned throughout the Quran? See footnote 4:153 for the parallel between the followers of Moses and the followers of Muhammad.

1989.english: Beware of the day when no soul can help another soul, no ransom can be paid, no intercession can be useful, and no one can receive any help.

verses.arabic: وَإِذِ ٱبْتَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ رَبُّهُۥ بِكَلِمَٰتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ قَالَ إِنِّى جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًا قَالَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ ابتلى إبراهيم ربه بكلمات فأتمهن ۖ قال إني جاعلك للناس إماما ۖ قال ومن ذريتي ۖ قال لا ينال عهدي الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhi ib'talā ib'rāhīma rabbuhu bikalimātin fa-atammahunna qāla innī jāʿiluka lilnnāsi imāman qāla wamin dhurriyyatī qāla lā yanālu ʿahdī l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Recall that Abraham was put to the test by his Lord, through certain commands, and he fulfilled them. (GOD) said, "I am appointing you an imam for the people." He said, "And also my descendants?" He said, "My covenant does not include the transgressors."
verses.subtitle: Abraham

1981.english: When Abraham was put to the test by his Lord, through certain commandments, he carried them out. God then said, “I am appointing you an imam for the people.” He said, “Will this include my descendants?” God said, “My promise does not include the wicked.”
1981.subtitle: Abraham Passes the Test

1989.english: Abraham was put to the test through certain commands, and he fulfilled them. (God) then said, “I am appointing you an imam for the people.” He said, “And also my descendants?” He said, “My pledge does not include the transgressors.”
1989.subtitle: Abraham

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا ٱلْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْعَٰكِفِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ جعلنا البيت مثابة للناس وأمنا واتخذوا من مقام إبراهيم مصلى ۖ وعهدنا إلى إبراهيم وإسماعيل أن طهرا بيتي للطائفين والعاكفين والركع السجود
verses.transliterated: wa-idh jaʿalnā l-bayta mathābatan lilnnāsi wa-amnan wa-ittakhidhū min maqāmi ib'rāhīma muṣallan waʿahid'nā ilā ib'rāhīma wa-is'māʿīla an ṭahhirā baytiya lilṭṭāifīna wal-ʿākifīna wal-rukaʿi l-sujūd
verses.english: We have rendered the shrine (the Ka'aba) a focal point for the people, and a safe sanctuary. You may use Abraham's shrine as a prayer house. We commissioned Abraham and Ismail: "You shall purify My house for those who visit, those who live there, and those who bow and prostrate."

1981.english: We then designated the shrine (of Mecca) as a focal point for the people, and a sacred sanctuary. You shall use this abode of Abraham as a place of worship. We directed Abraham and Ishmael to sanctify My shrine for those who encircle it, retreat in it, and bow and prostrate.

1989.english: We have rendered the Ka ‘aba shrine a focal point for the people, and a safe sanctuary. You may use Abraham’s station as a prayer house. We commissioned Abraham and Ismail: “The two of you shall purify My house for those who visit it, those who retreat therein, and those who bow and prostrate.”

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ قَالَ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَأُمَتِّعُهُۥ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ أَضْطَرُّهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلنَّارِ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قال إبراهيم رب اجعل هذا بلدا آمنا وارزق أهله من الثمرات من آمن منهم بالله واليوم الآخر ۖ قال ومن كفر فأمتعه قليلا ثم أضطره إلى عذاب النار ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu rabbi ij'ʿal hādhā baladan āminan wa-ur'zuq ahlahu mina l-thamarāti man āmana min'hum bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri qāla waman kafara fa-umattiʿuhu qalīlan thumma aḍṭarruhu ilā ʿadhābi l-nāri wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: Abraham prayed: "My Lord, make this a peaceful land, and provide its people with fruits. Provide for those who believe in GOD and the Last Day." (GOD) said, "I will also provide for those who disbelieve. I will let them enjoy, temporarily, then commit them to the retribution of Hell, and a miserable destiny."

1981.english: Abraham said, “My Lord, make this a peaceful land, and provide its people with fruits; provide for those who believe in God and the last day.” God said, “I will also provide for the disbeliever; I will let him enjoy for awhile, then commit him to the retribution of hell, and a miserable destiny.”

1989.english: Abraham prayed: “My Lord, make this a peaceful land, and provide its people with fruits. Provide for those who believe in GOD and the Last Day.” (God) said, “I will also provide for the one who disbelieves. I will let him enjoy, temporarily, then commit him to the retribution of Hell, and a miserable destiny.”

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ يرفع إبراهيم القواعد من البيت وإسماعيل ربنا تقبل منا ۖ إنك أنت السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: wa-idh yarfaʿu ib'rāhīmu l-qawāʿida mina l-bayti wa-is'māʿīlu rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka anta l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: As Abraham raised the foundations of the shrine, together with Ismail (they prayed): "Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the Hearer, the Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: Abraham Delivered All the Practices of Submission

1981.english: As Abraham raised the foundations of the shrine (of Mecca), together with Ishmael, they prayed, “Our Lord, accept from us, for You are the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: As Abraham raised the foundations of the shrine, together with Ismail, they prayed: “Our Lord, accept from us; you arc the Hearer, the Omniscient.
1989.footnote: When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26. I

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا واجعلنا مسلمين لك ومن ذريتنا أمة مسلمة لك وأرنا مناسكنا وتب علينا ۖ إنك أنت التواب الرحيم
verses.transliterated: rabbanā wa-ij'ʿalnā mus'limayni laka wamin dhurriyyatinā ummatan mus'limatan laka wa-arinā manāsikanā watub ʿalaynā innaka anta l-tawābu l-raḥīm
verses.english: "Our Lord, make us submitters to You, and from our descendants let there be a community of submitters to You. Teach us the rites of our religion, and redeem us. You are the Redeemer, Most Merciful.

1981.english: “Our Lord, make us Muslims (submitters) to You, and from our descendants let there be a Muslim nation (submitting) to You. Teach us how to practice our religious duties,* and redeem us; You are the redeemer, the merciful.
1981.footnote: Many Muslims entertain the erroneous idea that Muhammad was the source of religious practices in Islam, namely, **salat**, **zakat**, fasting, and **hajj** pilgrimage. However, the Quran teaches us that all religious duties were revealed to us through Abraham. See also 2:183, 2:187, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, 22:78, and Appendix 8.

1989.english: “Our Lord, and make us Muslims (submitters) to You, and from our descendants let there be a nation of Muslims. Teach us the rites of our religion, and redeem us. You are the Redeemer, Most Merciful.
1989.footnote: When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26. I

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَٱبْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا وابعث فيهم رسولا منهم يتلو عليهم آياتك ويعلمهم الكتاب والحكمة ويزكيهم ۚ إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: rabbanā wa-ib'ʿath fīhim rasūlan min'hum yatlū ʿalayhim āyātika wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wayuzakkīhim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: "Our Lord, and raise among them a messenger to recite to them Your revelations, teach them the scripture and wisdom, and purify them. You are the Almighty, Most Wise."

1981.english: “Our Lord, and raise among them a messenger who would recite for them Your revelations, and teach them the scripture and wisdom, and sanctify them. You are the Almighty, the wise.”

1989.english: “Our Lord, and raise among them a messenger to recite to them Your revelations, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom, and to purify them. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.”
1989.footnote: When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26. I

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَن مِّلَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ إِلَّا مَن سَفِهَ نَفْسَهُۥ وَلَقَدِ ٱصْطَفَيْنَٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يرغب عن ملة إبراهيم إلا من سفه نفسه ۚ ولقد اصطفيناه في الدنيا ۖ وإنه في الآخرة لمن الصالحين
verses.transliterated: waman yarghabu ʿan millati ib'rāhīma illā man safiha nafsahu walaqadi iṣ'ṭafaynāhu fī l-dun'yā wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: Who would forsake the religion of Abraham, except one who fools his own soul? We have chosen him in this world, and in the Hereafter he will be with the righteous.

1981.english: Thus, who would then forsake the religion of Abraham, except those who fool themselves? We have chosen him in this life, and in the hereafter he will be with the righteous.

1989.english: Who would forsake the religion of Abraham, except one who cheats his own soul? We have chosen him in this world, and in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
1989.footnote: When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26. I

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥٓ أَسْلِمْ قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال له ربه أسلم ۖ قال أسلمت لرب العالمين
verses.transliterated: idh qāla lahu rabbuhu aslim qāla aslamtu lirabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I submit to the Lord of the universe."

1981.english: When his Lord said to him, “Submit,” he said, “I submit to the Lord of the universe.”

1989.english: When his Lord said to him, “Submit,” he said, “I submit to the Lord of the universe.”
1989.footnote: When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26. I

verses.arabic: وَوَصَّىٰ بِهَآ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَٰبَنِىَّ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ووصى بها إبراهيم بنيه ويعقوب يا بني إن الله اصطفى لكم الدين فلا تموتن إلا وأنتم مسلمون
verses.transliterated: wawaṣṣā bihā ib'rāhīmu banīhi wayaʿqūbu yābaniyya inna l-laha iṣ'ṭafā lakumu l-dīna falā tamūtunna illā wa-antum mus'limūn
verses.english: Moreover, Abraham exhorted his children to do the same, and so did Jacob: "O my children, GOD has pointed out the religion for you; do not die except as submitters."

1981.english: Moreover, Abraham exhorted his children to submit to God, and so did Jacob, saying “O my children, God has pointed out the religion for you; you shall not die except as Muslims (submitters).”

1989.english: Moreover, Abraham exhorted his children to submit, and so did Jacob: “O my children, GOD has pointed out the religion for you; do not die except as Muslims.”
1989.footnote: When the Quran was revealed, all rites and duties of the religion were already in existence. Note that the expression: “God has pointed out the religion for you” (2:132) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the word “God” is No. 78, and Verse 78 oi Sura 22 informs us that Abraham is the father of Islam. See 22:78 and App. 9 & 26. I

verses.arabic: أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ ٱلْمَوْتُ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِى قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ ءَابَآئِكَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم كنتم شهداء إذ حضر يعقوب الموت إذ قال لبنيه ما تعبدون من بعدي قالوا نعبد إلهك وإله آبائك إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق إلها واحدا ونحن له مسلمون
verses.transliterated: am kuntum shuhadāa idh ḥaḍara yaʿqūba l-mawtu idh qāla libanīhi mā taʿbudūna min baʿdī qālū naʿbudu ilāhaka wa-ilāha ābāika ib'rāhīma wa-is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa ilāhan wāḥidan wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūn
verses.english: Had you witnessed Jacob on his death bed; he said to his children, "What will you worship after I die?" They said, "We will worship your god; the god of your fathers Abraham, Ismail, and Isaac; the one god. To Him we are submitters."

1981.english: Had you witnessed Jacob on his death bed; he said to his children, “What will you worship after me?” They said, “We will continue to worship your God, and the God of your fathers Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac; the one God; to Him we are Muslims (submitters).”

1989.english: Had you witnessed Jacob on his death bed: he said to his children, “What will you worship after me?” they said, “We worship your god and the god of your fathers Abraham, Ismail, and Isaac; the one god. To Him we are Muslims.”

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك أمة قد خلت ۖ لها ما كسبت ولكم ما كسبتم ۖ ولا تسألون عما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: til'ka ummatun qad khalat lahā mā kasabat walakum mā kasabtum walā tus'alūna ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Such is a community from the past. They are responsible for what they earned, and you are responsible for what you earned. You are not answerable for anything they have done.

1981.english: This is a community from the past. They are responsible for their own works; you are responsible for your own works; and you are not answerable for anything they did.

1989.english: Such is a community from the past. For them is what they earned, for you is what you earned, and you are not answerable for anything they did.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ تَهْتَدُوا۟ قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا كونوا هودا أو نصارى تهتدوا ۗ قل بل ملة إبراهيم حنيفا ۖ وما كان من المشركين
verses.transliterated: waqālū kūnū hūdan aw naṣārā tahtadū qul bal millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: They said, "You have to be Jewish or Christian, to be guided." Say, "We follow the religion of Abraham—monotheism—he never was an idol worshiper."
verses.subtitle: Submission: Abraham's Religion
verses.footnote: The Quran repeatedly informs us that Submission is the religion of Abraham (3:95, 4:125, 6:161, 22:78). Abraham received a practical "scripture," namely, all the duties and practices of Submission (the Contact Prayers (Salat), the obligatory charity (Zakat), the fasting of Ramadan, and the Hajj pilgrimage). Muhammad was a follower of Abraham's religion, as we see in 16:123; he delivered this Final Testament, the Quran. The third messenger of Submission delivered the religion's proof of authenticity (see 3:81 and Appendices 1, 2, 24, & 26).

1981.english: They said, “You have to be Jewish, or Christian, to be guided.” Say, “We follow the religion of Abraham, the monotheist; he never was an idol worshiper.”
1981.subtitle: Islam is the Religion of Abraham
1981.footnote: Those who idolize the prophet Muhammad against his will try to promote the idea that he is the source of all religious guidance in Islam. The Quranic truth teaches us that God Almighty is the source, and that all religious practices in Islam came to us generation after generation through Abraham, not Muhammad. See 2:128.

1989.english: They said, “You have to be Jewish or Christian, in order to be guided.” Say, “Instead, we follow the religion of Abraham— monotheism—he never was an idol worshiper.”

verses.arabic: قُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قولوا آمنا بالله وما أنزل إلينا وما أنزل إلى إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط وما أوتي موسى وعيسى وما أوتي النبيون من ربهم لا نفرق بين أحد منهم ونحن له مسلمون
verses.transliterated: qūlū āmannā bil-lahi wamā unzila ilaynā wamā unzila ilā ib'rāhīma wa-is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭi wamā ūtiya mūsā waʿīsā wamā ūtiya l-nabiyūna min rabbihim lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min'hum wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūn
verses.english: Say, "We believe in GOD, and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs; and in what was given to Moses and Jesus, and all the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. To Him alone we are submitters."
verses.subtitle: No Distinction Among God's Messengers

1981.english: Say, “We believe in God, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs, and in what was given to Moses and Jesus, and in what was given to all the prophets from their Lord; we make no distinction among any of them; we submit to God.”

1989.english: Say, “We believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed to Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs; and in what was given to Moses and Jesus, and all the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. To Him alone we are Muslims (submitters).”
1989.subtitle: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَآ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا هُمْ فِى شِقَاقٍ فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: فإن آمنوا بمثل ما آمنتم به فقد اهتدوا ۖ وإن تولوا فإنما هم في شقاق ۖ فسيكفيكهم الله ۚ وهو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: fa-in āmanū bimith'li mā āmantum bihi faqadi ih'tadaw wa-in tawallaw fa-innamā hum fī shiqāqin fasayakfīkahumu l-lahu wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: If they believe as you do, then they are guided. But if they turn away, then they are in opposition. GOD will spare you their opposition; He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: If they believe as you believe, then they are rightly guided. But if they turn away, then they have joined the opposition. God will spare you their opposition; He is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: If they believe in what you believe in, then they are guided. But if they reject it, then they are in opposition. GOD will suffice yoi against them; He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: صِبْغَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ صِبْغَةً وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ عَٰبِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: صبغة الله ۖ ومن أحسن من الله صبغة ۖ ونحن له عابدون
verses.transliterated: ṣib'ghata l-lahi waman aḥsanu mina l-lahi ṣib'ghatan wanaḥnu lahu ʿābidūn
verses.english: Such is GOD's system, and whose system is better than GOD's? "Him alone we worship."

1981.english: Such is God's mode, and whose mode is better than God's? We worship Him alone.

1989.english: Such is GOD’s system, and whose system is better than GOD’s? “Him alone we worship.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَتُحَآجُّونَنَا فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ وَلَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُخْلِصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أتحاجوننا في الله وهو ربنا وربكم ولنا أعمالنا ولكم أعمالكم ونحن له مخلصون
verses.transliterated: qul atuḥājjūnanā fī l-lahi wahuwa rabbunā warabbukum walanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum wanaḥnu lahu mukh'liṣūn
verses.english: Say, "Do you argue with us about GOD, when He is our Lord and your Lord? We are responsible for our deeds, and you are responsible for your deeds. To Him alone we are devoted."

1981.english: Say, “Do you argue with us concerning God, though He is our Lord and your Lord; and we are responsible for our works, while you are responsible for your works? We are devoted to Him alone.”

1989.english: Say, “Why do you argue with us about GOD, when He is our Lord and your Lord; we are responsible for our deeds, and you are responsible for your deeds. To Him alone we are devoted.”

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطَ كَانُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ قُلْ ءَأَنتُمْ أَعْلَمُ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَتَمَ شَهَٰدَةً عِندَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم تقولون إن إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط كانوا هودا أو نصارى ۗ قل أأنتم أعلم أم الله ۗ ومن أظلم ممن كتم شهادة عنده من الله ۗ وما الله بغافل عما تعملون
verses.transliterated: am taqūlūna inna ib'rāhīma wa-is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭa kānū hūdan aw naṣārā qul a-antum aʿlamu ami l-lahu waman aẓlamu mimman katama shahādatan ʿindahu mina l-lahi wamā l-lahu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Do you say that Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs were Jewish or Christian? Say, "Do you know better than GOD? Who is more evil than one who conceals a testimony he has learned from GOD? GOD is never unaware of anything you do."

1981.english: Would you say that Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs were Jewish or Christian? Say, “Who is more knowledgeable, you or God?” Who is more evil than one who conceals a testimony concerning God? God is never unaware of anything you do.

1989.english: Are you saying that Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs were Jewish or Christian? Say, “Do you know better than GOD? Who is more evil than one who conceals the word of GOD? GOD is never unaware of anything you do.”

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك أمة قد خلت ۖ لها ما كسبت ولكم ما كسبتم ۖ ولا تسألون عما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: til'ka ummatun qad khalat lahā mā kasabat walakum mā kasabtum walā tus'alūna ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: That was a community from the past. They are responsible for what they earned, and you are responsible for what you earned. You are not answerable for anything they did.

1981.english: This is a community from the past. They are responsible for their own works, and you are responsible for your own works. You are not answerable for anything they did.

1989.english: That was a community from the past. They are responsible for what they earned, and you are responsible for what you earned; you are not answerable for anything they have done.

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَا وَلَّىٰهُمْ عَن قِبْلَتِهِمُ ٱلَّتِى كَانُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: سيقول السفهاء من الناس ما ولاهم عن قبلتهم التي كانوا عليها ۚ قل لله المشرق والمغرب ۚ يهدي من يشاء إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: sayaqūlu l-sufahāu mina l-nāsi mā wallāhum ʿan qib'latihimu allatī kānū ʿalayhā qul lillahi l-mashriqu wal-maghribu yahdī man yashāu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: The fools among the people would say, "Why did they change the direction of their Qiblah?" Say, "To GOD belongs the east and the west; He guides whoever wills in a straight path."
verses.subtitle: Abolition of Bigotry and Prejudice
verses.footnote: "Qiblah" is the direction one faces during the Contact Prayers (Salat). When Gabriel conveyed to Muhammad the command to face Jerusalem instead of Mecca, the hypocrites were exposed. The Arabs were strongly prejudiced in favor of the Ka'aba as their "Qiblah." Only the true believers were able to overcome their prejudices; they readily obeyed the messenger.

1981.english: The fools among the people may ask, “Why did they change the direction of **Qiblah** (direction faced during **salat** prayers)?* Say, “To God belong the East and the West. He directs whomever He wills to the right path.”
1981.subtitle: Abolition of Prejudice and Bigotry
1981.footnote: This is another proof that the **salat** prayers were practiced before Muhammad.

1989.english: The fools among the people would say, “Why did they change the direction of their Qiblah’* Say, “To GOD belongs the east and the west; He directs whomever He wills in the right direction.”
1989.subtitle: Abolition of Bigotry and Prejudice
1989.footnote: “Qiblah” is the direction we face during the contact prayers (Salat,). The Arabs were strongly prejudiced in favor of the Ka’aba as their ‘Qiblah.” The true believers were able to overcome their prejudices, and readily obeyed God and His messenger.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِّتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنتَ عَلَيْهَآ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يَتَّبِعُ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِمَّن يَنقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَإِن كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَٰنَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك جعلناكم أمة وسطا لتكونوا شهداء على الناس ويكون الرسول عليكم شهيدا ۗ وما جعلنا القبلة التي كنت عليها إلا لنعلم من يتبع الرسول ممن ينقلب على عقبيه ۚ وإن كانت لكبيرة إلا على الذين هدى الله ۗ وما كان الله ليضيع إيمانكم ۚ إن الله بالناس لرءوف رحيم
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika jaʿalnākum ummatan wasaṭan litakūnū shuhadāa ʿalā l-nāsi wayakūna l-rasūlu ʿalaykum shahīdan wamā jaʿalnā l-qib'lata allatī kunta ʿalayhā illā linaʿlama man yattabiʿu l-rasūla mimman yanqalibu ʿalā ʿaqibayhi wa-in kānat lakabīratan illā ʿalā alladhīna hadā l-lahu wamā kāna l-lahu liyuḍīʿa īmānakum inna l-laha bil-nāsi laraūfun raḥīmu
verses.english: We thus made you an impartial community, that you may serve as witnesses among the people, and the messenger serves as a witness among you. We changed the direction of your original Qiblah only to distinguish those among you who readily follow the messenger from those who would turn back on their heels. It was a difficult test, but not for those who are guided by GOD. GOD never puts your worship to waste. GOD is Compassionate towards the people, Most Merciful.

1981.english: We thus made you an unbiased congregation,* that you may serve as witnesses among the people, just as the messenger serves as witness among you. We only changed the **Qiblah** as a test, in order to distinguish those who would follow the messenger from those who would turn back on their heels. Indeed, it was a difficult test, but not for those guided by God. God never puts your worship to waste (regardless of direction). God is compassionate towards the people, most merciful.
1981.footnote: The Arabs were fanatically prejudiced towards the Ka’ba in Mecca, and when the **Qiblah** was changed towards Jerusalem, many people who had followed Muhammad were overcome with prejudice and reverted to idolatry. The Muslims, however, learned to overcome their traditional bigotry and prejudice, and submitted to the will of God. After the first Muslims learned to abolish bigotry and fanaticism, the Ka’ba was restored as the eternal direction of **Qiblah**.

1989.english: We thus made you an impartial community, that you may serve as witnesses among the people, just as the messenger serves as a witness among you. We changed the direction of your original Qiblah only to distinguish those among you who readily follow the messenger from those who would turn back on their heels. It was a difficult test indeed, but not for those who are guided by GOD. GOD never puts your worship to waste. GOD is Compassionate towards the people, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةً تَرْضَىٰهَا فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنتُمْ فَوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُۥ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قد نرى تقلب وجهك في السماء ۖ فلنولينك قبلة ترضاها ۚ فول وجهك شطر المسجد الحرام ۚ وحيث ما كنتم فولوا وجوهكم شطره ۗ وإن الذين أوتوا الكتاب ليعلمون أنه الحق من ربهم ۗ وما الله بغافل عما يعملون
verses.transliterated: qad narā taqalluba wajhika fī l-samāi falanuwalliyannaka qib'latan tarḍāhā fawalli wajhaka shaṭra l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi waḥaythu mā kuntum fawallū wujūhakum shaṭrahu wa-inna alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba layaʿlamūna annahu l-ḥaqu min rabbihim wamā l-lahu bighāfilin ʿammā yaʿmalūn
verses.english: We have seen you turning your face about the sky (searching for the right direction). We now assign a Qiblah that is pleasing to you. Henceforth, you shall turn your face towards the Sacred Masjid. Wherever you may be, all of you shall turn your faces towards it. Those who received the previous scripture know that this is the truth from their Lord. GOD is never unaware of anything they do.
verses.subtitle: Qiblah Restored to Mecca

1981.english: We have seen your face (O Muhammad) turning about the sky. Therefore, we now appoint for you a **Qiblah** that pleases you. Henceforth, you shall turn your face (during **salat**) towards the sacred mosque (of Mecca). Wherever you may be (O believers), you shall turn your faces towards it. Even those who received previous scripture recognize that this is the truth from their Lord. God is never unaware of anything they do.

1989.english: We have seen your face turn about the sky. Therefore, we now assign a Qiblah that is pleasing to you. Henceforth, you shall turn your face towards the Sacred Mosque. Wherever you may be, all of you shall turn your faces towards it. Indeed, those who received the scripture know that this is the truth from their Lord. GOD is never unaware of anything they do.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَتَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِكُلِّ ءَايَةٍ مَّا تَبِعُوا۟ قِبْلَتَكَ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِتَابِعٍ قِبْلَتَهُمْ وَمَا بَعْضُهُم بِتَابِعٍ قِبْلَةَ بَعْضٍ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِنَّكَ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أتيت الذين أوتوا الكتاب بكل آية ما تبعوا قبلتك ۚ وما أنت بتابع قبلتهم ۚ وما بعضهم بتابع قبلة بعض ۚ ولئن اتبعت أهواءهم من بعد ما جاءك من العلم ۙ إنك إذا لمن الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wala-in atayta alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba bikulli āyatin mā tabiʿū qib'lataka wamā anta bitābiʿin qib'latahum wamā baʿḍuhum bitābiʿin qib'lata baʿḍin wala-ini ittabaʿta ahwāahum min baʿdi mā jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi innaka idhan lamina l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Even if you show the followers of the scripture every kind of miracle, they will not follow your Qiblah. Nor shall you follow their Qiblah. They do not even follow each others' Qiblah. If you acquiesce to their wishes, after the knowledge that has come to you, you will belong with the transgressors.

1981.english: However, even if you show the followers of previous scripture every kind of miracle, they will not follow your **Qiblah**, nor should you follow their **Qiblah**; they do not even follow each others’ **Qiblah**. If you ever acquiesce to their wishes, despite the knowledge you have received herein, you will be a sinner.

1989.english: Even if you show the followers of the scripture any kind of miracle, they will not follow your Qiblah. Nor shall you follow their Qiblah. They do not even follow each others’ Qiblah. If you acquiesce to their wishes, after this knowledge has come to you, you will be a transgressor.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنْهُمْ لَيَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين آتيناهم الكتاب يعرفونه كما يعرفون أبناءهم ۖ وإن فريقا منهم ليكتمون الحق وهم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yaʿrifūnahu kamā yaʿrifūna abnāahum wa-inna farīqan min'hum layaktumūna l-ḥaqa wahum yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Those who received the scripture recognize the truth herein, as they recognize their own children. Yet, some of them conceal the truth, knowingly.
verses.subtitle: Abuse of the Scripture: Selective Emphasis and Concealment

1981.english: Those who received previous scripture recognize this, just as they recognize their own children.* But many of them conceal the truth, knowingly.
1981.footnote: Both the Old testament and the New testament clearly predict the coming of the “final paraclete” to “show you all truth.” See the inside cover of this book, and Appendix 19 entitled, “The Bible’s Preview of Muhammad.”

1989.english: Those who received the scripture recognize the truth herein, just as they recognize their own children. However, some of them conceal the truth, knowingly.
1989.subtitle: Abuse of the Scripture: Selective Emphasis and Concealment

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الحق من ربك ۖ فلا تكونن من الممترين
verses.transliterated: al-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīn
verses.english: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubt.

1981.english: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubts.

1989.english: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubt about it.

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلٍّ وِجْهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيهَا فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ أَيْنَ مَا تَكُونُوا۟ يَأْتِ بِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولكل وجهة هو موليها ۖ فاستبقوا الخيرات ۚ أين ما تكونوا يأت بكم الله جميعا ۚ إن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: walikullin wij'hatun huwa muwallīhā fa-is'tabiqū l-khayrāti ayna mā takūnū yati bikumu l-lahu jamīʿan inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Each of you chooses the direction to follow; you shall race towards righteousness. Wherever you may be, GOD will summon you all. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: To each is his own direction; therefore, you shall race towards righteous works. Wherever you might be, God will bring you all; God is omnipotent.

1989.english: Each of you chooses the direction to follow; you shall race towards righteousness. Wherever you may be, GOD will summon you all. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن حيث خرجت فول وجهك شطر المسجد الحرام ۖ وإنه للحق من ربك ۗ وما الله بغافل عما تعملون
verses.transliterated: wamin ḥaythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shaṭra l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wa-innahu lalḥaqqu min rabbika wamā l-lahu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Wherever you go, you shall turn your face (during Salat) towards the Sacred Masjid. This is the truth from your Lord. GOD is never unaware of anything you all do.
verses.subtitle: Qiblah Restored to Mecca
verses.footnote: A glaring proof of the idolatry committed by today's "Muslims" is the designation of Muhammad's tomb as a "Sacred Masjid." The Quran mentions only one "Sacred Masjid."

1981.english: Wherever you may go, you shall turn your face (in **salat**) towards the sacred mosque (of Mecca). This is the truth from your Lord. God is never unaware of anything you do.

1989.english: Wherever you go, you shall turn your face (during Salat) towards the Sacred Mosque.* This is the truth from your Lord. GOD is never unaware of anything you do.
1989.subtitle: Qiblah Restored to Mecca
1989.footnote: One of the glaring proofs of the idolatry committed by today’s “Muslims” is the establishment of Muhammad’s tomb as another “Sacred Mosque. ” The Quran consis tently talks about one “Sacred Mosque. ”

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنتُمْ فَوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُۥ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيْكُمْ حُجَّةٌ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِى وَلِأُتِمَّ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن حيث خرجت فول وجهك شطر المسجد الحرام ۚ وحيث ما كنتم فولوا وجوهكم شطره لئلا يكون للناس عليكم حجة إلا الذين ظلموا منهم فلا تخشوهم واخشوني ولأتم نعمتي عليكم ولعلكم تهتدون
verses.transliterated: wamin ḥaythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shaṭra l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi waḥaythu mā kuntum fawallū wujūhakum shaṭrahu li-allā yakūna lilnnāsi ʿalaykum ḥujjatun illā alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum falā takhshawhum wa-ikh'shawnī wali-utimma niʿ'matī ʿalaykum walaʿallakum tahtadūn
verses.english: Wherever you go, you shall turn your face (during Salat) towards the Sacred Masjid; wherever you might be, you shall turn your faces (during Salat) towards it. Thus, the people will have no argument against you, except the transgressors among them. Do not fear them, and fear Me instead. I will then perfect My blessings upon you, that you may be guided.

1981.english: Wherever you may go, you shall turn your face (during **salat**) towards the sacred mosque (of Mecca). Wherever you may be, you shall turn your faces towards it. Thus, the people will have no argument against you, except the wicked among them. Do not fear them, and fear Me instead, that I may complete My blessings upon you, that you may be guided.

1989.english: Wherever you go, you shall turn your face (during Salat) towards the Sacred Mosque; wherever you might be, you all shall turn your faces (during Salat) towards it. Now the people have no argument against you, except the transgressor: among them. Do not pay any atten tion to them; you shall devote your attention to Me. I will then perfect My blessings upon you, that you may be guided.

verses.arabic: كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيكُمْ رَسُولًا مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا وَيُزَكِّيكُمْ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كما أرسلنا فيكم رسولا منكم يتلو عليكم آياتنا ويزكيكم ويعلمكم الكتاب والحكمة ويعلمكم ما لم تكونوا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: kamā arsalnā fīkum rasūlan minkum yatlū ʿalaykum āyātinā wayuzakkīkum wayuʿallimukumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wayuʿallimukum mā lam takūnū taʿlamūn
verses.english: (Blessings) such as the sending of a messenger from among you to recite our revelations to you, purify you, teach you the scripture and wisdom, and to teach you what you never knew.

1981.english: Such blessings as the sending of a messenger from among you, to recite for you our revelations, and to sanctify you, and to teach you the scripture and wisdom, and to teach you what you never knew.

1989.english: (Blessings) such as the sending of a messenger from among you, to recite our revelations to you, and to purify you, and to teach you the scripture and wisdom, and to teach you things you never knew.

verses.arabic: فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
verses.arabicClean: فاذكروني أذكركم واشكروا لي ولا تكفرون
verses.transliterated: fa-udh'kurūnī adhkur'kum wa-ush'kurū lī walā takfurūn
verses.english: You shall remember Me, that I may remember you, and be thankful to Me; do not be unappreciative.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall remember Me, that I may remember you, and be thankful to Me; do not be unappreciative.

1989.english: You shall remember Me, that I may remember you. Be thankful to Me; do not be unappreciative.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا استعينوا بالصبر والصلاة ۚ إن الله مع الصابرين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū is'taʿīnū bil-ṣabri wal-ṣalati inna l-laha maʿa l-ṣābirīn
verses.english: O you who believe, seek help through steadfastness and the Contact Prayers (Salat). GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.

1981.english: O you who believe, seek help through steadfastness and **salat**; God is with those who steadfastly persevere.
1981.subtitle: Steadfastness Required

1989.english: O you who believe, seek help through steadfastness and the contact prayers (Salat). GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَن يُقْتَلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَمْوَٰتٌۢ بَلْ أَحْيَآءٌ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقولوا لمن يقتل في سبيل الله أموات ۚ بل أحياء ولكن لا تشعرون
verses.transliterated: walā taqūlū liman yuq'talu fī sabīli l-lahi amwātun bal aḥyāon walākin lā tashʿurūn
verses.english: Do not say of those who are killed in the cause of GOD, "They are dead." They are alive at their Lord, but you do not perceive.
verses.subtitle: Where Do We Go From Here?
verses.footnote: The righteous do not really die; they simply leave their bodies here and go to the same Paradise where Adam and Eve once lived. See Appendix 17 for the proof and the details.

1981.english: Do not say about those who are killed in the cause of God, “They are dead,” for they are alive, but you do not perceive.
1981.footnote: See footnote 3:170.

1989.english: Do not say of those who are killed in the cause of GOD, “They arc dead.” For they are alive and well at their Lord,* but you do not perceive.
1989.footnote: Death is simply another stage. See Footnote 3:169, and Appendix 17.

verses.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُم بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلْخَوْفِ وَٱلْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولنبلونكم بشيء من الخوف والجوع ونقص من الأموال والأنفس والثمرات ۗ وبشر الصابرين
verses.transliterated: walanabluwannakum bishayin mina l-khawfi wal-jūʿi wanaqṣin mina l-amwāli wal-anfusi wal-thamarāti wabashiri l-ṣābirīn
verses.english: We will surely test you through some fear, hunger, and loss of money, lives, and crops. Give good news to the steadfast.
verses.footnote: The test is designed to prove that we worship God alone under all circumstances (29:2).

1981.english: We will surely put you to the test, by means of some fear, hunger, and loss of money, lives, and crops. Give good news to those who steadfastly persevere.

1989.english: We must test you with some fear, hunger, and loss of money, lives, and crops. Give good news to the steadfast,*
1989.footnote: The test is designed to prove that we will worship God ALONE under all circumstances (29:2).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين إذا أصابتهم مصيبة قالوا إنا لله وإنا إليه راجعون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna idhā aṣābathum muṣībatun qālū innā lillahi wa-innā ilayhi rājiʿūn
verses.english: When an affliction befalls them, they say, "We belong to GOD, and to Him we are returning."

1981.english: If a disaster should strike them, they say, “We belong to God, and to Him is our ultimate return.”

1989.english: who say, when an affliction befalls them, “We belong to GOD, and to Him we ultimately return.”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَٰتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك عليهم صلوات من ربهم ورحمة ۖ وأولئك هم المهتدون
verses.transliterated: ulāika ʿalayhim ṣalawātun min rabbihim waraḥmatun wa-ulāika humu l-muh'tadūn
verses.english: These have deserved blessings from their Lord and mercy. These are the guided ones.

1981.english: These have deserved blessings from their Lord, and mercy; they are the guided ones.
1981.footnote: Compare the Arabic text of this verse with 33:43 and 33:56.

1989.english: These deserve blessings from their Lord, and mercy. They are the guided ones

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ ٱلْبَيْتَ أَوِ ٱعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الصفا والمروة من شعائر الله ۖ فمن حج البيت أو اعتمر فلا جناح عليه أن يطوف بهما ۚ ومن تطوع خيرا فإن الله شاكر عليم
verses.transliterated: inna l-ṣafā wal-marwata min shaʿāiri l-lahi faman ḥajja l-bayta awi iʿ'tamara falā junāḥa ʿalayhi an yaṭṭawwafa bihimā waman taṭawwaʿa khayran fa-inna l-laha shākirun ʿalīmu
verses.english: The knolls of Safa and Marwah are among the rites decreed by GOD. Anyone who observes Hajj or 'Umrah commits no error by traversing the distance between them. If one volunteers more righteous works, then GOD is Appreciative, Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: Hajj Pilgrimage

1981.english: The knolls of Safa and Marwah are part of the worship practices decreed by God. Thus, whoever observes the **Hajj** pilgrimage or the **Umrah** pilgrimage commits no error by traversing the distance between them. If one volunteers more righteous works, then God is appreciative, fully aware.
1981.subtitle: Hajj Pilgrimage

1989.english: The knolls of Safa and Marwah are consecrated by GOD. When observing Hajj or ‘Umrah, one may traverse the distance between them. If one volunteers more righteous works, then GOD is Appreciative, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلْهُدَىٰ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا بَيَّنَّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَلْعَنُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَلْعَنُهُمُ ٱللَّٰعِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يكتمون ما أنزلنا من البينات والهدى من بعد ما بيناه للناس في الكتاب ۙ أولئك يلعنهم الله ويلعنهم اللاعنون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yaktumūna mā anzalnā mina l-bayināti wal-hudā min baʿdi mā bayyannāhu lilnnāsi fī l-kitābi ulāika yalʿanuhumu l-lahu wayalʿanuhumu l-lāʿinūn
verses.english: Those who conceal our revelations and guidance, after proclaiming them for the people in the scripture, are condemned by GOD; they are condemned by all the condemners.
verses.subtitle: Gross Offense

1981.english: As for those who conceal what we send down of profound revelations and guidance, after declaring them for the people in this scripture, they have deserved God's curse, and should be cursed by all who curse.

1989.english: Those who conceal our revelations and guidance, after proclaiming them for the people in the scripture, GOD condemns them; they are condemned by all the condemners.
1989.subtitle: Gross Offense

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ وَبَيَّنُوا۟ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَنَا ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين تابوا وأصلحوا وبينوا فأولئك أتوب عليهم ۚ وأنا التواب الرحيم
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna tābū wa-aṣlaḥū wabayyanū fa-ulāika atūbu ʿalayhim wa-anā l-tawābu l-raḥīm
verses.english: As for those who repent, reform, and proclaim, I redeem them. I am the Redeemer, Most Merciful.

1981.english: But those who repent, reform, and clarify, I redeem them; I am the redeemer, the merciful.

1989.english: As for those who repent, reform, and proclaim the scripture, I redeem them. I am the Redeemer, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا وماتوا وهم كفار أولئك عليهم لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū wamātū wahum kuffārun ulāika ʿalayhim laʿnatu l-lahi wal-malāikati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers, have incurred the condemnation of GOD, the angels, and all the people (on the Day of Judgment).

1981.english: Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers have deserved the curse of God, and the angels, and all the people.

1989.english: Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers, have incurred the condemnation of GOD, and the angels, and all the people.

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: خالدين فيها ۖ لا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينظرون
verses.transliterated: khālidīna fīhā lā yukhaffafu ʿanhumu l-ʿadhābu walā hum yunẓarūn
verses.english: Eternally they abide therein. The retribution is never commuted for them, nor are they reprieved.

1981.english: Eternally they will abide therein; their retribution is never commuted, nor are they reprieved.

1989.english: Eternally they abide therein. The retribution is never commuted for them, nor do they receive any reprieve.

verses.arabic: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإلهكم إله واحد ۖ لا إله إلا هو الرحمن الرحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun lā ilāha illā huwa l-raḥmānu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Your god is one god; there is no god but He, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Your God is one God; there is no god except He, the gracious, the merciful.

1989.english: Your god is one god. There is no god besides Him, the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلَّتِى تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن مَّآءٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ وَٱلسَّحَابِ ٱلْمُسَخَّرِ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في خلق السماوات والأرض واختلاف الليل والنهار والفلك التي تجري في البحر بما ينفع الناس وما أنزل الله من السماء من ماء فأحيا به الأرض بعد موتها وبث فيها من كل دابة وتصريف الرياح والسحاب المسخر بين السماء والأرض لآيات لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: inna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wal-ful'ki allatī tajrī fī l-baḥri bimā yanfaʿu l-nāsa wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min māin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wabatha fīhā min kulli dābbatin wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi wal-saḥābi l-musakhari bayna l-samāi wal-arḍi laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: In the creation of the heavens and the earth, the alternation of night and day, the ships that roam the ocean for the benefit of the people, the water that GOD sends down from the sky to revive dead land and to spread in it all kinds of creatures, the manipulation of the winds, and the clouds that are placed between the sky and the earth, there are sufficient proofs for people who understand.
verses.subtitle: Overwhelming Signs of God

1981.english: In the creation of the heavens and the earth, the alternation of night and day, the ships that roam the sea for the benefit of mankind, the water that God sends down to revive dead lands and spread all kinds of creatures therein, the manipulation of the winds, the clouds placed between the heaven and the earth; all these are signs for people who understand.
1981.subtitle: Overwhelming Signs of God

1989.english: In the creation of the heavens and the earth, the alternation of night and day, the ships that roam the ocean for the benefit of mankind, the water that GOD sends down from the sky to revive dead land and to sustain all kinds of creatures therein, the manipulation of the winds, and the clouds hanging between the sky and the earth there are signs for intelligent people.
1989.subtitle: Overwhelming Signs of God

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَندَادًا يُحِبُّونَهُمْ كَحُبِّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَشَدُّ حُبًّا لِّلَّهِ وَلَوْ يَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِذْ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ أَنَّ ٱلْقُوَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الناس من يتخذ من دون الله أندادا يحبونهم كحب الله ۖ والذين آمنوا أشد حبا لله ۗ ولو يرى الذين ظلموا إذ يرون العذاب أن القوة لله جميعا وأن الله شديد العذاب
verses.transliterated: wamina l-nāsi man yattakhidhu min dūni l-lahi andādan yuḥibbūnahum kaḥubbi l-lahi wa-alladhīna āmanū ashaddu ḥubban lillahi walaw yarā alladhīna ẓalamū idh yarawna l-ʿadhāba anna l-quwata lillahi jamīʿan wa-anna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿadhāb
verses.english: Yet, some people set up idols to rival GOD, and love them as if they are GOD. Those who believe love GOD the most. If only the transgressors could see themselves when they see the retribution! They will realize then that all power belongs to GOD alone, and that GOD's retribution is awesome.
verses.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Idolizers
verses.footnote: Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and the saints will disown their idolizers on the Day of Resurrection. See also 16:86, 35:14, 46:6, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:21-23.

1981.english: Yet, some people set up idols besides God and adore them as if they were God. However, the believers love God more than anything else. If only the wrong doers could envision themselves when they face the retribution; they will find out that all power belongs to God alone, and that God is very strict in imposing retribution.
1981.subtitle: The Idol Worshipers Disowned by Their Idols

1989.english: Yet, some people set up idols that rival GOD, and love them as if the} were GOD. Those who believe love< GOD the most. If only the transgressors could see themselves when they face the retribution! They will then realize that all power belongs to GOD alone, and that GOD’s retribution is awesome.
1989.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Tdnlirerx
1989.footnote: Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and the saints will disown their idolizers or the Day of Resurrection. See also 16:86, 46:6, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:21-23.

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَبَرَّأَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتُّبِعُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ وَرَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَتَقَطَّعَتْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَسْبَابُ
verses.arabicClean: إذ تبرأ الذين اتبعوا من الذين اتبعوا ورأوا العذاب وتقطعت بهم الأسباب
verses.transliterated: idh tabarra-a alladhīna ittubiʿū mina alladhīna ittabaʿū wara-awū l-ʿadhāba wataqaṭṭaʿat bihimu l-asbāb
verses.english: Those who were followed will disown those who followed them. They will see the retribution, and all ties among them will be severed.

1981.english: Those who were followed will disown their followers; they will suffer the retribution, and all help to them will be severed.

1989.english: Those who were followed will disown those who followed them.* They will see the retribution, and all ties among them will be severed.
1989.footnote: Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and the saints will disown their idolizers or the Day of Resurrection. See also 16:86, 46:6, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:21-23.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَتَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُمْ كَمَا تَبَرَّءُوا۟ مِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ يُرِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا هُم بِخَٰرِجِينَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين اتبعوا لو أن لنا كرة فنتبرأ منهم كما تبرءوا منا ۗ كذلك يريهم الله أعمالهم حسرات عليهم ۖ وما هم بخارجين من النار
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna ittabaʿū law anna lanā karratan fanatabarra-a min'hum kamā tabarraū minnā kadhālika yurīhimu l-lahu aʿmālahum ḥasarātin ʿalayhim wamā hum bikhārijīna mina l-nār
verses.english: Those who followed will say, "If we can get another chance, we will disown them, as they have disowned us now." GOD thus shows them the consequences of their works as nothing but remorse; they will never exit Hell.

1981.english: The followers will then say, “If we could live our first life again, we will then disown them as they disown us now.” Thus will God show them the consequences of their works as nothing but sorrow; they will never exit from hell.

1989.english: Those who followed will say, “If we could only get another chance, we would then disown then as they have disowned us now.” Thus does GOD show them the consequences of their works as nothing but remorse; they will never exit Hell.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ كُلُوا۟ مِمَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَلَٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس كلوا مما في الأرض حلالا طيبا ولا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان ۚ إنه لكم عدو مبين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu kulū mimmā fī l-arḍi ḥalālan ṭayyiban walā tattabiʿū khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnu
verses.english: O people, eat from the earth's products all that is lawful and good, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your most ardent enemy.
verses.subtitle: Satan Prohibits Lawful Things

1981.english: O people, eat from everything that is lawful and good, and do not follow the steps of satan; he is your ardent enemy.
1981.subtitle: Free Mind Prerequisite for Salvation

1989.english: O people, eat from the earth’s products all that is lawful and good, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your ardent enemy.
1989.subtitle: Satan Prohibits Lawful Things

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَأَن تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يأمركم بالسوء والفحشاء وأن تقولوا على الله ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: innamā yamurukum bil-sūi wal-faḥshāi wa-an taqūlū ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: He only commands you to commit evil and vice, and to say about GOD what you do not know.

1981.english: He directs you towards vice and evil, and to invent lies and attribute them to God.
1981.footnote: Therefore, it must be satan’s work that led many people to invent long lists of prohibitions, then attribute them to God and/or His messenger. The Quran consistently lists four specific dietary prohibitions (see 2:173, 6:145, 16:115). Furthermore, the Quran teaches that those who worship God alone follow the laws decreed by God alone. Specifically, those who follow dietary regulations dictated by other than the Quran are called “idol-worshipers.” See 6:121.

1989.english: He only commands you to commit vice and wickedness, and to attribute to GOD what you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَآ أَلْفَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما أنزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما ألفينا عليه آباءنا ۗ أولو كان آباؤهم لا يعقلون شيئا ولا يهتدون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittabiʿū mā anzala l-lahu qālū bal nattabiʿu mā alfaynā ʿalayhi ābāanā awalaw kāna ābāuhum lā yaʿqilūna shayan walā yahtadūn
verses.english: When they are told, "Follow what GOD has revealed herein," they say, "We follow only what we found our parents doing." What if their parents did not understand, and were not guided?
verses.subtitle: Maintaining the Status Quo: A Human Tragedy

1981.english: Then, when they are told, “Follow only God’s commandments,” they say, “We follow what we found our parents doing.” What if their parents lacked the understanding and guidance?

1989.english: When they are told, “Follow what GOD has revealed herein,” they say, “We follow only what we found our parents doing.” What if their parents lacked understanding, and were not guided?

verses.arabic: وَمَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى يَنْعِقُ بِمَا لَا يَسْمَعُ إِلَّا دُعَآءً وَنِدَآءً صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومثل الذين كفروا كمثل الذي ينعق بما لا يسمع إلا دعاء ونداء ۚ صم بكم عمي فهم لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wamathalu alladhīna kafarū kamathali alladhī yanʿiqu bimā lā yasmaʿu illā duʿāan wanidāan ṣummun buk'mun ʿum'yun fahum lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: The example of such disbelievers is that of parrots who repeat what they hear of sounds and calls, without understanding. Deaf, dumb, and blind; they cannot understand.

1981.english: The example of such disbelievers is that of a parrot; they repeat what they heard without understanding. Deaf, dumb, and blind; they fail to understand.

1989.english: The example of those who disbelieve is like those who parrot what they hear of sounds and calls, without understanding. Deaf, dumb, and blind; they cannot understand.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِلَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم واشكروا لله إن كنتم إياه تعبدون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum wa-ush'kurū lillahi in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūn
verses.english: O you who believe, eat from the good things we provided for you, and be thankful to GOD, if you do worship Him alone.
verses.subtitle: Only Four Meats Prohibited
verses.footnote: Throughout the Quran, only four meats are prohibited (6:145, 16:115, Appendix 16). Dietary prohibitions beyond these four are tantamount to idol worship (6:121,148, 150; 7:32).

1981.english: O you who believe, eat from the good things we provide for you, and be thankful to God, if you do worship Him alone.
1981.subtitle: Dietary Regulations

1989.english: O you who believe, eat from the good things we provide for you, and be thankful to GOD, if you do worship Him alone.
1989.subtitle: Only Four Meats Prohibited
1989.footnote: Throughout the Quran, four meats are prohibited (6:145, 16:115, & Appendix 16). Dietary prohibitions beyond these four are described as tantamount to idol worship (6:121). Prohibitions by other than God represent some other “god."

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ بِهِۦ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنما حرم عليكم الميتة والدم ولحم الخنزير وما أهل به لغير الله ۖ فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فلا إثم عليه ۚ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: innamā ḥarrama ʿalaykumu l-maytata wal-dama walaḥma l-khinzīri wamā uhilla bihi lighayri l-lahi famani uḍ'ṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin falā ith'ma ʿalayhi inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: He only prohibits for you the eating of animals that die of themselves (without human interference), blood, the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being malicious or deliberate, he incurs no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: He only prohibits for you animals that die of themselves, blood, the meat of pigs, and animals sacrificed in any name other than God’s.* However, if one is forced (to eat these), without being malicious or deliberate, then he incurs no sin. God is forgiver, merciful.
1981.footnote: Before sacrificing an animal, we must take permission from the creator.

1989.english: He only enjoins you from eating dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than (their Creator) GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being malicious or deliberate, then he incurs no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.footnote: Throughout the Quran, four meats are prohibited (6:145, 16:115, & Appendix 16). Dietary prohibitions beyond these four are described as tantamount to idol worship (6:121). Prohibitions by other than God represent some other “god."

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَيَشْتَرُونَ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِى بُطُونِهِمْ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يكتمون ما أنزل الله من الكتاب ويشترون به ثمنا قليلا ۙ أولئك ما يأكلون في بطونهم إلا النار ولا يكلمهم الله يوم القيامة ولا يزكيهم ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yaktumūna mā anzala l-lahu mina l-kitābi wayashtarūna bihi thamanan qalīlan ulāika mā yakulūna fī buṭūnihim illā l-nāra walā yukallimuhumu l-lahu yawma l-qiyāmati walā yuzakkīhim walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Those who conceal GOD's revelations in the scripture, in exchange for a cheap material gain, eat but fire into their bellies. GOD will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: Corrupted Religious Leaders Conceal the Quran's Miracle
verses.footnote: Despite their recognition of God's mathematical miracle in the Quran, the corrupted religious leaders tried for many years to conceal this awesome miracle. Many of them admitted that they resented the fact that Rashad Khalifa, not them, was blessed with the miracle.

1981.english: Those who conceal God’s revelations in the scripture, seeking a lowly material gain, are eating fire into their bellies. God will not speak to them on the day of resurrection, nor will He sanctify them. They will suffer painful retribution.

1989.english: Those who conceal what GOD has sent down of the scripture, and sell it for a cheap price, eat but fire into their bellies. GOD will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَٱلْعَذَابَ بِٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ فَمَآ أَصْبَرَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين اشتروا الضلالة بالهدى والعذاب بالمغفرة ۚ فما أصبرهم على النار
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna ish'tarawū l-ḍalālata bil-hudā wal-ʿadhāba bil-maghfirati famā aṣbarahum ʿalā l-nār
verses.english: It is they who chose the straying instead of guidance, and the retribution instead of forgiveness. Consequently, they will have to endure Hell.

1981.english: It is they who chose the straying instead of guidance, and the retribution instead of forgiveness. Consequently, they will have to endure the hellfire.

1989.english: It is they who bought the straying at the expense of guidance, and the retribution at the expense of forgiveness. Therefore, they will have to endure Hell.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الله نزل الكتاب بالحق ۗ وإن الذين اختلفوا في الكتاب لفي شقاق بعيد
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna l-laha nazzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wa-inna alladhīna ikh'talafū fī l-kitābi lafī shiqāqin baʿīdi
verses.english: This is because GOD has revealed this scripture, bearing the truth, and those who dispute the scripture are the most ardent opponents.

1981.english: That is because God has sent down the scripture truthfully, and those who dispute the scripture are in manifest defiance.

1989.english: This is because GOD has revealed this scripture, truthfully, and those who dispute the scripture are the most ardent opponents.

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ ٱلْبِرَّ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْبِرَّ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَءَاتَى ٱلْمَالَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ ذَوِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَٱلسَّآئِلِينَ وَفِى ٱلرِّقَابِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِهِمْ إِذَا عَٰهَدُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ فِى ٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَحِينَ ٱلْبَأْسِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليس البر أن تولوا وجوهكم قبل المشرق والمغرب ولكن البر من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر والملائكة والكتاب والنبيين وآتى المال على حبه ذوي القربى واليتامى والمساكين وابن السبيل والسائلين وفي الرقاب وأقام الصلاة وآتى الزكاة والموفون بعهدهم إذا عاهدوا ۖ والصابرين في البأساء والضراء وحين البأس ۗ أولئك الذين صدقوا ۖ وأولئك هم المتقون
verses.transliterated: laysa l-bira an tuwallū wujūhakum qibala l-mashriqi wal-maghribi walākinna l-bira man āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wal-malāikati wal-kitābi wal-nabiyīna waātā l-māla ʿalā ḥubbihi dhawī l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīna wa-ib'na l-sabīli wal-sāilīna wafī l-riqābi wa-aqāma l-ṣalata waātā l-zakata wal-mūfūna biʿahdihim idhā ʿāhadū wal-ṣābirīna fī l-basāi wal-ḍarāi waḥīna l-basi ulāika alladhīna ṣadaqū wa-ulāika humu l-mutaqūn
verses.english: Righteousness is not turning your faces towards the east or the west. Righteous are those who believe in GOD, the Last Day, the angels, the scripture, and the prophets; and they give the money, cheerfully, to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the traveling alien, the beggars, and to free the slaves; and they observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat); and they keep their word whenever they make a promise; and they steadfastly persevere in the face of persecution, hardship, and war. These are the truthful; these are the righteous.
verses.subtitle: Righteousness Defined

1981.english: Righteousness is not the turning of your faces towards the East or the West. But righteousness is to believe in God, the last day, the angels, the scriptures, and the prophets; and to donate the money despite one’s love thereof to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the alien, the beggars, and to free the slaves, and to observe the **salat** and **zakat**, and to keep the promises that are made, and to remain steadfast in the face of adversity, hardship, and war. These are the truthful; these are the righteous.
1981.subtitle: Righteousness Defined

1989.english: Righteousness is not turning your faces towards the east or the west. Righteous are those who believe in GOD, the Last Day, the angels, the scripture, and the prophets; and they give the money, despite loving it, to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the traveling alien, the beggars, and to free the slaves; and they observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat); and they keep their word whenever they make a promise; and they steadfastly persevere in the face of adversity, hardship, and persecution. These are the truthful; these are the righteous. Equivalence is God’s Law*
1989.subtitle: Righteousness Defined

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِصَاصُ فِى ٱلْقَتْلَى ٱلْحُرُّ بِٱلْحُرِّ وَٱلْعَبْدُ بِٱلْعَبْدِ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ فَمَنْ عُفِىَ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَخِيهِ شَىْءٌ فَٱتِّبَاعٌۢ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَأَدَآءٌ إِلَيْهِ بِإِحْسَٰنٍ ذَٰلِكَ تَخْفِيفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا كتب عليكم القصاص في القتلى ۖ الحر بالحر والعبد بالعبد والأنثى بالأنثى ۚ فمن عفي له من أخيه شيء فاتباع بالمعروف وأداء إليه بإحسان ۗ ذلك تخفيف من ربكم ورحمة ۗ فمن اعتدى بعد ذلك فله عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kutiba ʿalaykumu l-qiṣāṣu fī l-qatlā l-ḥuru bil-ḥuri wal-ʿabdu bil-ʿabdi wal-unthā bil-unthā faman ʿufiya lahu min akhīhi shayon fa-ittibāʿun bil-maʿrūfi wa-adāon ilayhi bi-iḥ'sānin dhālika takhfīfun min rabbikum waraḥmatun famani iʿ'tadā baʿda dhālika falahu ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, equivalence is the law decreed for you when dealing with murder—the free for the free, the slave for the slave, the female for the female. If one is pardoned by the victim's kin, an appreciative response is in order, and an equitable compensation shall be paid. This is an alleviation from your Lord and mercy. Anyone who transgresses beyond this incurs a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: Discouraging Capital Punishment
verses.footnote: The Quran clearly discourages capital punishment. Every kind of excuse is provided to spare lives, including the life of the murderer. The victim's kin may find it better, under certain circumstances, to spare the life of the murderer in exchange for an equitable compensation. Also capital punishment is not applicable if, for example, a woman kills a man, or vice versa.

1981.english: O you who believe, equivalence is decreed herein as the law when dealing with murder; the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the woman for the woman. However, if the guilty is pardoned by the victim’s kin, then a gracious response is in order, and an equitable compensation shall be offered. This is leniency from your Lord and mercy. Whoever transgresses henceforth will suffer painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: Equivalence is the Law

1989.english: O you who believe, equivalence is decreed for you when dealing with murder; the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. If one is pardoned by the victim’s kin, an equitable compensation shall be paid. This is an alleviation from your Lord and mercy. Anyone who transgresses beyond this incurs a painful retribution.
1989.footnote: The Quran clearly discourages capital punishment. Every kind of excuse is provided to spare lives, even the lives of those who commit murder. Often, the victim’s kin may find it better for all concerned, under certain circumstances, to spare the life of the murderer in exchange for an equitable compensation. Additionally, capital punishment is not to be applied, for example, if a woman kills a man, or vice versa.

verses.arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْقِصَاصِ حَيَوٰةٌ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكم في القصاص حياة يا أولي الألباب لعلكم تتقون
verses.transliterated: walakum fī l-qiṣāṣi ḥayatun yāulī l-albābi laʿallakum tattaqūn
verses.english: Equivalence is a life saving law for you, O you who possess intelligence, that you may be righteous.

1981.english: Equivalence shall be a life-saving law. O you who possess intelligence, that you may attain salvation.

1989.english: Equivalence is a life saving law for you, O you who possess intelligence, that you may be saved.

verses.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيْرًا ٱلْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كتب عليكم إذا حضر أحدكم الموت إن ترك خيرا الوصية للوالدين والأقربين بالمعروف ۖ حقا على المتقين
verses.transliterated: kutiba ʿalaykum idhā ḥaḍara aḥadakumu l-mawtu in taraka khayran l-waṣiyatu lil'wālidayni wal-aqrabīna bil-maʿrūfi ḥaqqan ʿalā l-mutaqīn
verses.english: It is decreed that when death approaches, you shall write a will for the benefit of the parents and relatives, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.
verses.subtitle: Write A Will

1981.english: Decreed for you is the dictation of a will when death approaches the one of you, for the benefit of your parents and relatives. This is an incumbent duty upon the righteous.
1981.subtitle: Leave a Will Before Death

1989.english: It is decreed herein that: when death approaches you, you shall write a will for the benefit of your parents and relatives, equitably. This is a duty upon the righteous.
1989.subtitle: Write A Will

verses.arabic: فَمَنۢ بَدَّلَهُۥ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعَهُۥ فَإِنَّمَآ إِثْمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فمن بدله بعد ما سمعه فإنما إثمه على الذين يبدلونه ۚ إن الله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: faman baddalahu baʿdamā samiʿahu fa-innamā ith'muhu ʿalā alladhīna yubaddilūnahu inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: If anyone alters a will he had heard, the sin of altering befalls those responsible for such altering. GOD is Hearer, Knower.

1981.english: If anyone alters a will he had witnessed, he incurs the sin of such distorting. God is hearer, omniscient.

1989.english: If anyone alters a will he had heard, the sin of altering befalls those responsible for such altering. GOD is Hearer, Knower.

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ خَافَ مِن مُّوصٍ جَنَفًا أَوْ إِثْمًا فَأَصْلَحَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَلَآ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فمن خاف من موص جنفا أو إثما فأصلح بينهم فلا إثم عليه ۚ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: faman khāfa min mūṣin janafan aw ith'man fa-aṣlaḥa baynahum falā ith'ma ʿalayhi inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: If one sees gross injustice or bias on the part of a testator, and takes corrective action to restore justice to the will, he commits no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: However, if one senses obviously sinful partiality on the part of a testator, and alters the will to restore justice, then he incurs no sin. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: If one detects gross injustice or unreasonable bias on the part of a testator, and takes corrective action to restore justice to the will, he commits no sin. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا كتب عليكم الصيام كما كتب على الذين من قبلكم لعلكم تتقون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kutiba ʿalaykumu l-ṣiyāmu kamā kutiba ʿalā alladhīna min qablikum laʿallakum tattaqūn
verses.english: O you who believe, fasting is decreed for you, as it was decreed for those before you, that you may attain salvation.
verses.subtitle: Fasting Emphasized and Modified
verses.footnote: Like all duties in Submission, fasting was decreed through Abraham (22:78, Appendices 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule is modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

1981.english: O you who believe, fasting is decreed for you, as it was decreed for those before you, that you may attain salvation.
1981.subtitle: Fasting Reinforced and Revised
1981.footnote: Like all religious practices in Islam, fasting was decreed through Abraham (see 2:128, 3:68, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, 22:78, and Appendix 8). The injunction prohibiting intercourse throughout the month of fasting is revised here to allow intercourse during the nights of fasting.

1989.english: O you who believe, fasting is decreed for you, as it was decreed for those before you, that you may be saved.
1989.subtitle: Fasting Emphasized and Modified
1989.footnote: Like all duties in Islam, fasting came to us through Abraham (22:78, Appendicies 9 & 15). Prior to revelation of the Quran, however, sexual intercourse was prohibited throughout the fasting period. This rule was modified in 2:187 to allow intercourse during the nights of Ramadan.

verses.arabic: أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُۥ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ وَأَن تَصُومُوا۟ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أياما معدودات ۚ فمن كان منكم مريضا أو على سفر فعدة من أيام أخر ۚ وعلى الذين يطيقونه فدية طعام مسكين ۖ فمن تطوع خيرا فهو خير له ۚ وأن تصوموا خير لكم ۖ إن كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: ayyāman maʿdūdātin faman kāna minkum marīḍan aw ʿalā safarin faʿiddatun min ayyāmin ukhara waʿalā alladhīna yuṭīqūnahu fid'yatun ṭaʿāmu mis'kīnin faman taṭawwaʿa khayran fahuwa khayrun lahu wa-an taṣūmū khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn
