verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا تداينتم بدين إلى أجل مسمى فاكتبوه ۚ وليكتب بينكم كاتب بالعدل ۚ ولا يأب كاتب أن يكتب كما علمه الله ۚ فليكتب وليملل الذي عليه الحق وليتق الله ربه ولا يبخس منه شيئا ۚ فإن كان الذي عليه الحق سفيها أو ضعيفا أو لا يستطيع أن يمل هو فليملل وليه بالعدل ۚ واستشهدوا شهيدين من رجالكم ۖ فإن لم يكونا رجلين فرجل وامرأتان ممن ترضون من الشهداء أن تضل إحداهما فتذكر إحداهما الأخرى ۚ ولا يأب الشهداء إذا ما دعوا ۚ ولا تسأموا أن تكتبوه صغيرا أو كبيرا إلى أجله ۚ ذلكم أقسط عند الله وأقوم للشهادة وأدنى ألا ترتابوا ۖ إلا أن تكون تجارة حاضرة تديرونها بينكم فليس عليكم جناح ألا تكتبوها ۗ وأشهدوا إذا تبايعتم ۚ ولا يضار كاتب ولا شهيد ۚ وإن تفعلوا فإنه فسوق بكم ۗ واتقوا الله ۖ ويعلمكم الله ۗ والله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā tadāyantum bidaynin ilā ajalin musamman fa-uk'tubūhu walyaktub baynakum kātibun bil-ʿadli walā yaba kātibun an yaktuba kamā ʿallamahu l-lahu falyaktub walyum'lili alladhī ʿalayhi l-ḥaqu walyattaqi l-laha rabbahu walā yabkhas min'hu shayan fa-in kāna alladhī ʿalayhi l-ḥaqu safīhan aw ḍaʿīfan aw lā yastaṭīʿu an yumilla huwa falyum'lil waliyyuhu bil-ʿadli wa-is'tashhidū shahīdayni min rijālikum fa-in lam yakūnā rajulayni farajulun wa-im'ra-atāni mimman tarḍawna mina l-shuhadāi an taḍilla iḥ'dāhumā fatudhakkira iḥ'dāhumā l-ukh'rā walā yaba l-shuhadāu idhā mā duʿū walā tasamū an taktubūhu ṣaghīran
verses.english: O you who believe, when you transact a loan for any period, you shall write it down. An impartial scribe shall do the writing. No scribe shall refuse to perform this service, according to GOD's teachings. He shall write, while the debtor dictates the terms. He shall observe GOD his Lord and never cheat. If the debtor is mentally incapable, or helpless, or cannot dictate, his guardian shall dictate equitably. Two men shall serve as witnesses; if not two men, then a man and two women whose testimony is acceptable to all. Thus, if one woman becomes biased, the other will remind her. It is the obligation of the witnesses to testify when called upon to do so. Do not tire of writing the details, no matter how long, including the time of repayment. This is equitable in the sight of GOD, assures better witnessing, and eliminates any doubts you may have. Business transactions that you execute on the spot, need not be recorded, but have them witnessed. No scribe or witness shall be harmed on account of his services. If you harm them, it would be wickedness on your part. You shall observe GOD, and GOD will teach you. GOD is Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: Write Down Financial Transactions
verses.footnote: Financial transactions are the ONLY situations where two women may substitute for one man as witness. This is to guard against the real possibility that one witness may marry the other witness, and thus cause her to be biased. It is a recognized fact that women are more emotionally vulnerable than men.

1981.english: O you who believe, when you carry out a loan transaction for any period, you shall write it down. Let a scribe write it down equitably, and no scribe shall refuse to write as God has taught him. Let him write, while the debtor dictates. He shall observe God his Lord, and never cheat. If the debtor were mentally incompetent, or incapable, or for some reason unable to dictate, his agent shall dictate equitably. You shall have two witnesses from among your men, or one man and two women, whom you accept as witnesses. Thus, if one woman is biased, the other would remind her. The witnesses shall not refuse to give their testimony whenever asked. Do not neglect to write down all the details, no matter how small or extensive, including the time of repayment. This is more equitable in the sight of God, it insures the accuracy of testimony, and minimizes your doubts. If the transaction is a trade on the spot, you commit no sin by not writing it down; but you may have witnesses thereof. No hardship shall befall any scribe or witness; if you cause any hardship to them, it would be wicked on your part. If you observe God, God will teach you. God is omniscient.
1981.subtitle: Write Down Monetary Transactions

1989.english: O you who believe, if you transact a loan for any period, you shall write it down. Let an impartial scribe do the writing for you. No scribe shall refuse to perform this service, in accordance with GOD’s teachings. He shall write, while the debtor dictates the terms. He shall observe GOD his Lord, and never cheat. If the debtor is mentally incapable, or helpless, or cannot dictate, his guardian shall dictate equitably. You shall have two witnesses from among your men. If two men are not available, then choose one man and two women* whose testimony is acceptable to all parties. Thus, if one woman becomes biased the other will remind her. The witnesses shall not refuse to testify whenever needed. Do not tire of writing all the details, no matter how long, and write down the time of repayment. This is more equitable at GOD, assures better witnessing, and eliminates any doubts you may have in the future. As for trade transactions that you execute on the spot, you need not record them, but have them witnessed. No scribe or witness shall be harmed on account of his services. If you harm them, it will be wickedness on your part. You shall observe GOD, then GOD will teach you. GOD is Omniscient.
1989.subtitle: Write Down Financial Transactions
1989.footnote: Monetary transactions are the only events where two women substitute for one man. If the witnesses were one man and one woman, the possibility arises that they may marry each other. In this case, the welfare of one party in the transaction may be jeopardized. Oppressive men tend to generalize this verse. m

verses.arabic: وَإِن كُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ وَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ كَاتِبًا فَرِهَٰنٌ مَّقْبُوضَةٌ فَإِنْ أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا فَلْيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِى ٱؤْتُمِنَ أَمَٰنَتَهُۥ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا تَكْتُمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ وَمَن يَكْتُمْهَا فَإِنَّهُۥٓ ءَاثِمٌ قَلْبُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كنتم على سفر ولم تجدوا كاتبا فرهان مقبوضة ۖ فإن أمن بعضكم بعضا فليؤد الذي اؤتمن أمانته وليتق الله ربه ۗ ولا تكتموا الشهادة ۚ ومن يكتمها فإنه آثم قلبه ۗ والله بما تعملون عليم
verses.transliterated: wa-in kuntum ʿalā safarin walam tajidū kātiban farihānun maqbūḍatun fa-in amina baʿḍukum baʿḍan falyu-addi alladhī u'tumina amānatahu walyattaqi l-laha rabbahu walā taktumū l-shahādata waman yaktum'hā fa-innahu āthimun qalbuhu wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmu
verses.english: If you are traveling, and no scribe is available, a bond shall be posted to guarantee repayment. If one is trusted in this manner, he shall return the bond when due, and he shall observe GOD his Lord. Do not withhold any testimony by concealing what you had witnessed. Anyone who withholds a testimony is sinful at heart. GOD is fully aware of everything you do.

1981.english: If you are travelling, and no scribe is available, then a bond shall be posted. If you trust each other in this manner, the one entrusted with the bond shall return it when due, and observe God his Lord. You shall not conceal anything you had witnessed. Anyone who conceals a testimony is guilty at heart. God is fully aware of everything you do.

1989.english: If you are traveling, and no scribe is available, a bond shall be posted to guarantee repayment. If one is trusted in this manner, he shall return the bond when due. He shall observe GOD his Lord. Do not withhold any testimony by concealing what you had witnessed. Anyone who withholds a testimony has a sinful heart. GOD is fully aware of everything you do.

verses.arabic: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِن تُبْدُوا۟ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۗ وإن تبدوا ما في أنفسكم أو تخفوه يحاسبكم به الله ۖ فيغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء ۗ والله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-in tub'dū mā fī anfusikum aw tukh'fūhu yuḥāsib'kum bihi l-lahu fayaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Whether you declare your innermost thoughts, or keep them hidden, GOD holds you responsible for them. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: To God belong everything in the heavens and the earth, and whether you declare your thoughts, or conceal them, God will hold you answerable for them. He will then forgive whomever He wills, and punish whomever He wills. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Whether you declare your innermost thoughts, or keep them hidden, GOD holds you responsible for them. He then forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: آمن الرسول بما أنزل إليه من ربه والمؤمنون ۚ كل آمن بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله لا نفرق بين أحد من رسله ۚ وقالوا سمعنا وأطعنا ۖ غفرانك ربنا وإليك المصير
verses.transliterated: āmana l-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minūna kullun āmana bil-lahi wamalāikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rusulihi waqālū samiʿ'nā wa-aṭaʿnā ghuf'rānaka rabbanā wa-ilayka l-maṣīr
verses.english: The messenger has believed in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so did the believers. They believe in GOD, His angels, His scripture, and His messengers: "We make no distinction among any of His messengers." They say, "We hear, and we obey. Forgive us, our Lord. To You is the ultimate destiny."
verses.subtitle: You Shall Not Make Any Distinction Among God's Messengers
verses.footnote: One of the major commandments is: "You shall not make any distinction among God's messengers" (2:136, 3:84, 4:150). The believers react by saying, "We hear and we obey," while the idol worshipers argue back to justify their insistence upon mentioning Muhammad's name next to God's, to the exclusion of all other messengers. The corrupted Muslims mention Muhammad in their profession of faith (Shahaadah) and during their Contact Prayers (see 72:18).

1981.english: The messenger believes in what was revealed to him from his Lord; and so do the believers. They believe in God, His angels, His scriptures, and His messengers. They say, “We make no distinction among any of His messengers. We hearken, and we obey. Forgive us, our Lord. To You is the ultimate return.”
1981.subtitle: Make No Distinction Among the Prophets

1989.english: The messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. They believe in GOD, His angels, His scripture, and His messengers: “We make no distinction among any of His messengers,” and they proclaim: “We hear, and we obey. Forgive us, our Lord. To You is the ultimate destiny.”
1989.subtitle: Do Not Make Any Distinction Among God's Messengers

verses.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها ۚ لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت ۗ ربنا لا تؤاخذنا إن نسينا أو أخطأنا ۚ ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرا كما حملته على الذين من قبلنا ۚ ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقة لنا به ۖ واعف عنا واغفر لنا وارحمنا ۚ أنت مولانا فانصرنا على القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: lā yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā lahā mā kasabat waʿalayhā mā ik'tasabat rabbanā lā tuākhidh'nā in nasīnā aw akhṭanā rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣ'ran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablinā rabbanā walā tuḥammil'nā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi wa-uʿ'fu ʿannā wa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā anta mawlānā fa-unṣur'nā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
verses.english: GOD never burdens a soul beyond its means: to its credit is what it earns, and against it is what it commits. "Our Lord, do not condemn us if we forget or make mistakes. Our Lord, and protect us from blaspheming against You, like those before us have done. Our Lord, protect us from sinning until it becomes too late for us to repent. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Lord and Master. Grant us victory over the disbelieving people."

1981.english: God never burdens any soul beyond its means. Credit is earned for any righteous work, and discredit is incurred for any sin. Our Lord, do not punish us when we forget or err. Our Lord, and let it not be Your will that we violate the covenant, like those before us who violated the covenant. Our Lord, do not obligate us beyond our abilities; pardon us, forgive us, and shower us with mercy. You are our Lord, so grant us victory against the disbelievers.

1989.english: GOD never burdens any soul beyond its means: to its credit is whatever it earns, and against it is whatever it commits. “Our Lord, do not condemn us if we forget or make mistakes. Our Lord, and protect us from blaspheming against You, like those before us have done. Our Lord, protect us from burdens that are heavy beyond our capacity, pardon us, and forgive us. You are our Lord and Master, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

verses.arabic: الٓمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الم
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-meem
verses.english: A. L. M.
verses.footnote: See Footnote 2:1 and Appendix One.

1981.english: A.L.M.\
1981.footnote: See footnote 2:1 and Apendix 1 for the miraculous significance of these Quranic initials. After 1400 years, the mystery of these letters is now unveiled.

1989.english: A.L.M.*
1989.footnote: See Footnote 2:1 and Appendix One.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
verses.arabicClean: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم
verses.transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayu l-qayūm
verses.english: GOD: there is no god except He; the Living, the Eternal.

1981.english: Allah; the one God; there is no god except He, the living, the eternal.

1989.english: GOD: there is no god except He; the Living, the Eternal.

verses.arabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: نزل عليك الكتاب بالحق مصدقا لما بين يديه وأنزل التوراة والإنجيل
verses.transliterated: nazzala ʿalayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi wa-anzala l-tawrāta wal-injīl
verses.english: He sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, confirming all previous scriptures, and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel

1981.english: He revealed to you this scripture, truthfully, confirming previous scripture, just as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel

1989.english: He sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, confirming all previous scriptures, and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel—

verses.arabic: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.arabicClean: من قبل هدى للناس وأنزل الفرقان ۗ إن الذين كفروا بآيات الله لهم عذاب شديد ۗ والله عزيز ذو انتقام
verses.transliterated: min qablu hudan lilnnāsi wa-anzala l-fur'qāna inna alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wal-lahu ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmi
verses.english: before that, to guide the people, and He sent down the statute book. Those who disbelieve in GOD's revelations incur severe retribution. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.

1981.english: previously, to guide the people. He revealed the statute book. Those who disbelieved in God's revelations have deserved terrible retribution. God is almighty, avenger.

1989.english: before that, to guide the people. He sent down the statute book. Those who disbelieve in GOD’s revelations incur severe retribution. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله لا يخفى عليه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha lā yakhfā ʿalayhi shayon fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samā
verses.english: Nothing is hidden from GOD, on earth, or in the heaven.

1981.english: Nothing is ever concealed from God, on earth or in the heavens.

1989.english: Nothing is hidden from GOD, in the earth, or in the heaven.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي يصوركم في الأرحام كيف يشاء ۚ لا إله إلا هو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī yuṣawwirukum fī l-arḥāmi kayfa yashāu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: He is the One who shapes you in the wombs as He wills. There is no other god besides Him; the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: He is the one who shapes you inside the womb as He wills. There is no god except He, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: He shapes you in the wombs as He wills. There is no god except He; the Almighty, the Most Wise.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَٰتٌ مُّحْكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي أنزل عليك الكتاب منه آيات محكمات هن أم الكتاب وأخر متشابهات ۖ فأما الذين في قلوبهم زيغ فيتبعون ما تشابه منه ابتغاء الفتنة وابتغاء تأويله ۗ وما يعلم تأويله إلا الله ۗ والراسخون في العلم يقولون آمنا به كل من عند ربنا ۗ وما يذكر إلا أولو الألباب
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī anzala ʿalayka l-kitāba min'hu āyātun muḥ'kamātun hunna ummu l-kitābi wa-ukharu mutashābihātun fa-ammā alladhīna fī qulūbihim zayghun fayattabiʿūna mā tashābaha min'hu ib'tighāa l-fit'nati wa-ib'tighāa tawīlihi wamā yaʿlamu tawīlahu illā l-lahu wal-rāsikhūna fī l-ʿil'mi yaqūlūna āmannā bihi kullun min ʿindi rabbinā wamā yadhakkaru illā ulū l-albāb
verses.english: He sent down to you this scripture, containing straightforward verses—which constitute the essence of the scripture—as well as multiple-meaning or allegorical verses. Those who harbor doubts in their hearts will pursue the multiple-meaning verses to create confusion, and to extricate a certain meaning. None knows the true meaning thereof except GOD and those well founded in knowledge. They say, "We believe in this—all of it comes from our Lord." Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

1981.english: He is the one who revealed to you this scripture, with perfect verses that must be taken literally, for they constitute the essence of the scripture. Other verses are allegorical.\* Those who harbor doubts in their hearts dwell on the allegorical verses, to create confusion and misrepresentation thereof. No one knows the correct interpretation thereof except God and those well founded in knowledge. They say, "We believe in all the revelations; they all come from our Lord." Indeed, only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
1981.footnote: Things beyond our imagination and comprehension, such as heaven and hell, are presented in allegorical terms. See Appendix 4.

1989.english: He revealed to you this scripture, consisting of straightforward verses, which are the essence of the scripture, as well as multiple meaning verses. Those who harbor doubt in their hearts will pursue the multiple-meaning verses to create confusion, and to seek different meanings. No one knows their true meaning except GOD and those who possess knowledge. They say, “We believe in this, for it all comes from our Lord.” Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة ۚ إنك أنت الوهاب
verses.transliterated: rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda idh hadaytanā wahab lanā min ladunka raḥmatan innaka anta l-wahāb
verses.english: "Our Lord, let not our hearts waver, now that You have guided us. Shower us with Your mercy; You are the Grantor.

1981.english: "Our Lord, let not our hearts falter after being guided by You, and shower us with Your mercy; You are the grantor.

1989.english: Our Lord, let not our hearts waver after You have guided us, and shower us with Your mercy; You are the Grantor.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا إنك جامع الناس ليوم لا ريب فيه ۚ إن الله لا يخلف الميعاد
verses.transliterated: rabbanā innaka jāmiʿu l-nāsi liyawmin lā rayba fīhi inna l-laha lā yukh'lifu l-mīʿād
verses.english: "Our Lord, You will surely gather the people on a day that is inevitable. GOD never breaks a promise."

1981.english: "Our Lord, you will surely gather all the people on a day that is inevitable, for God never breaks His promise."

1989.english: Our Lord, You will surely summon all the people on a day that is inevitable. GOD never breaks a promise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم أموالهم ولا أولادهم من الله شيئا ۖ وأولئك هم وقود النار
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū lan tugh'niya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum mina l-lahi shayan wa-ulāika hum waqūdu l-nār
verses.english: Those who disbelieve will never be helped by their money, nor by their children, against GOD. They will be fuel for Hell.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve, neither their monies, nor their children, will avail them against God. They will be fuel for hell.

1989.english: Those who disbelieve cannot be helped by their money or children against GOD. TTiey are the fuel of Hell.
1989.subtitle: Disbelievers: Always the Ultimate Losers

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: كدأب آل فرعون والذين من قبلهم ۚ كذبوا بآياتنا فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم ۗ والله شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kadhabū biāyātinā fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wal-lahu shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: Like Pharaoh's people and those before them, they rejected our revelations and, consequently, GOD punished them for their sins. GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.

1981.english: Like the people of Pharaoh and others before them who rejected our revelations; God punished them for their sins. God is strict in enforcing retribution.

1989.english: Like Pharaoh’s people and others before them who rejected our revelations; GOD punished them for their sins. GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.arabicClean: قل للذين كفروا ستغلبون وتحشرون إلى جهنم ۚ وبئس المهاد
verses.transliterated: qul lilladhīna kafarū satugh'labūna watuḥ'sharūna ilā jahannama wabi'sa l-mihād
verses.english: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be defeated, then gathered in Hell; what a miserable abode!"

1981.english: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be defeated, then end up in hell and a miserable abode."

1989.english: Say to those who disbelieve, “You will be defeated, then gathered in Hell; what a miserable abode!”

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا فِئَةٌ تُقَٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verses.arabicClean: قد كان لكم آية في فئتين التقتا ۖ فئة تقاتل في سبيل الله وأخرى كافرة يرونهم مثليهم رأي العين ۚ والله يؤيد بنصره من يشاء ۗ إن في ذلك لعبرة لأولي الأبصار
verses.transliterated: qad kāna lakum āyatun fī fi-atayni l-taqatā fi-atun tuqātilu fī sabīli l-lahi wa-ukh'rā kāfiratun yarawnahum mith'layhim raya l-ʿayni wal-lahu yu-ayyidu binaṣrihi man yashāu inna fī dhālika laʿib'ratan li-ulī l-abṣār
verses.english: An example has been set for you by the two armies who clashed— one army was fighting in the cause of GOD, while the other was disbelieving. They saw with their own eyes that they were twice as many. GOD supports with His victory whomever He wills. This should provide an assurance for those who possess vision.
verses.subtitle: Believers: The Ultimate Victors

1981.english: An example has been set for you by two armies who clashed; one was fighting in the cause of God, while the other consisted of disbelievers. They saw each other twice as many (for different reasons).\* God supports with His victory whomever He wills. This is a lesson for those who can see.
1981.footnote: See also 8:44.

1989.english: An example has been set for you by the two armies who clashed. One army was fighting in the cause of GOD, while the other was disbelieving. They saw them as twice as many with their own eyes. GOD supports with His victory whomever He wills. This should be a lesson for those who possess vision.
1989.subtitle: Believers: The Ultimate Victors

verses.arabic: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ
verses.arabicClean: زين للناس حب الشهوات من النساء والبنين والقناطير المقنطرة من الذهب والفضة والخيل المسومة والأنعام والحرث ۗ ذلك متاع الحياة الدنيا ۖ والله عنده حسن المآب
verses.transliterated: zuyyina lilnnāsi ḥubbu l-shahawāti mina l-nisāi wal-banīna wal-qanāṭīri l-muqanṭarati mina l-dhahabi wal-fiḍati wal-khayli l-musawamati wal-anʿāmi wal-ḥarthi dhālika matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-lahu ʿindahu ḥus'nu l-maāb
verses.english: Adorned for the people are the worldly pleasures, such as the women, having children, piles upon piles of gold and silver, trained horses, livestock, and crops. These are the materials of this world. A far better abode is reserved at GOD.
verses.subtitle: Different Priorities

1981.english: Adorned in the eyes of the people is the love of lusts, such as women, children, the piles upon piles of gold and silver, trained horses, livestock and crops. These are the materials of this world, but the best abode is with God.

1989.english: Adorned for the people are such pleasures as women, children, piles upon piles of gold and silver, trained horses, livestock, and crops. Such are the vanities of this world. GOD possesses a far better abode.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: قل أؤنبئكم بخير من ذلكم ۚ للذين اتقوا عند ربهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها وأزواج مطهرة ورضوان من الله ۗ والله بصير بالعباد
verses.transliterated: qul a-unabbi-ukum bikhayrin min dhālikum lilladhīna ittaqaw ʿinda rabbihim jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wa-azwājun muṭahharatun wariḍ'wānun mina l-lahi wal-lahu baṣīrun bil-ʿibād
verses.english: Say, "Let me inform you of a much better deal: for those who lead a righteous life, reserved at their Lord, are gardens with flowing streams, and pure spouses, and joy in GOD's blessings." GOD is Seer of His worshipers.

1981.english: Say, "Shall I inform you of far better materials? Those who work righteousness will enjoy Paradise at their Lord, with flowing streams. Forever they abide therein, with pure spouses, and blessings from God." God is seer of His true servants.

1989.english: Say, “Let me inform you of something that is far better than that: for those who lead a righteous life, at their Lord, gardens with flowing streams, and pure spouses. They rejoice in GOD’s approval.” GOD is Seer of His worshipers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يقولون ربنا إننا آمنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وقنا عذاب النار
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā innanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā waqinā ʿadhāba l-nār
verses.english: They say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins, and spare us the agony of the hellfire."

1981.english: who say, "Our Lord, we believe; forgive our sins and spare us the agony of hell."

1989.english: They say, “Our Lord, we have believed; forgive us our sins, and spare us the agony of the hellfire.”

verses.arabic: ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ
verses.arabicClean: الصابرين والصادقين والقانتين والمنفقين والمستغفرين بالأسحار
verses.transliterated: al-ṣābirīna wal-ṣādiqīna wal-qānitīna wal-munfiqīna wal-mus'taghfirīna bil-asḥār
verses.english: They are steadfast, truthful, submitting, charitable, and meditators at dawn.

1981.english: They are steadfast, truthful, obedient, charitable, and they pray for forgiveness at dawn.

1989.english: They are steadfast, truthful, submitting, charitable, meditators at dawn. The First Pillar of Islam *

verses.arabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: شهد الله أنه لا إله إلا هو والملائكة وأولو العلم قائما بالقسط ۚ لا إله إلا هو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: shahida l-lahu annahu lā ilāha illā huwa wal-malāikatu wa-ulū l-ʿil'mi qāiman bil-qis'ṭi lā ilāha illā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: GOD bears witness that there is no god except He, and so do the angels and those who possess knowledge. Truthfully and equitably, He is the absolute god; there is no god but He, the Almighty, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: The Most Important Commandment
verses.footnote: The proclamation of faith (Shahaadah) that is decreed by God is: "There is no god except God," in Arabic "La Elaaha Ella Allah" (see also 37:35, 47:19). The corrupted Muslims insist upon adding a second "Shahaadah" proclaiming that Muhammad is God's messenger. This is by definition "Shirk" (idolatry) and a flagrant defiance of God and His messenger. Additionally, it violates the major commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 4:150-152 prohibiting any distinction among God's messengers. By proclaiming that "Muhammad is a messenger of God," and failing to make the same proclamation for other messengers such as Abraham, Moses, Jesus, Saleh, and Jonah, a distinction is committed and a major commandment is violated.

1981.english: God bears witness that there is no god except He, and so do the angels and those who possess knowledge. He is the only master; there is no god except He, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: GOD bears witness that there is no god except He,* and so do the angels and those who possess knowledge. He is the absolute god. There is no god except He,* the Almighty, the Wise. Only One Religion
1989.footnote: The First Pillar of Islam is “Shahaadah,” professing that there is no other god besides God. The words of “Shahaadah” are decreed in this verse by God Himself: “La Elaaha Ella Allah.” Any other “Shahaadah,” proclaiming that Muhammad is God’s messenger is, by definition, idol-worship. It also violates the major commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 4:150-152 prohibiting any distinction among God’s messengers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمُ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الدين عند الله الإسلام ۗ وما اختلف الذين أوتوا الكتاب إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ۗ ومن يكفر بآيات الله فإن الله سريع الحساب
verses.transliterated: inna l-dīna ʿinda l-lahi l-is'lāmu wamā ikh'talafa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum waman yakfur biāyāti l-lahi fa-inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisāb
verses.english: The only religion approved by GOD is "Submission." Ironically, those who have received the scripture are the ones who dispute this fact, despite the knowledge they have received, due to jealousy. For such rejectors of GOD's revelations, GOD is most strict in reckoning.
verses.subtitle: Submission: The Only Religion

1981.english: The only religion in the sight of God is Islam (submission).\* The followers of previous scripture have disputed this Quran, even after realizing that it is divine truth, due to sheer resentment. Those who reject God's revelations have deserved God's severe retribution.
1981.footnote: All God's messengers delivered one and the same message, namely, submission to the one God. Thus, the first commandment in the Bible's Old Testament, the New Testament, as well as the Quran, is "You shall not worship except the one God." See Deuteronomy 6:4, Mark 12:29, and the Quran 21:92.

1989.english: The only religion approved by GOD is Islam. Those who received the scripture dispute this fact, knowingly. This is due to jealousy on their part. For those who reject GOD’s revelations, GOD is most strict in reckoning.

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: فإن حاجوك فقل أسلمت وجهي لله ومن اتبعن ۗ وقل للذين أوتوا الكتاب والأميين أأسلمتم ۚ فإن أسلموا فقد اهتدوا ۖ وإن تولوا فإنما عليك البلاغ ۗ والله بصير بالعباد
verses.transliterated: fa-in ḥājjūka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillahi wamani ittabaʿani waqul lilladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-umiyīna a-aslamtum fa-in aslamū faqadi ih'tadaw wa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu wal-lahu baṣīrun bil-ʿibād
verses.english: If they argue with you, then say, "I have simply submitted myself to GOD; I and those who follow me." You shall proclaim to those who received the scripture, as well as those who did not, "Would you submit?" If they submit, then they have been guided, but if they turn away, your sole mission is to deliver this message. GOD is Seer of all people.

1981.english: If they argue with you, then say, "I have simply submitted to God, and so do my followers." And say to the followers of previous scriptures, as well as the gentiles, "Have you submitted?" If they submit, then they are guided; but if they turn away, then your sole mission is to deliver the message. God is seer of His true servants.

1989.english: If they argue with you, then say, “I have submitted myself to GOD; me and those who follow me.” And say to those who received the scripture, as well as those who did not receive any scripture, “Do you accept Islam as your religion?” If they do accept Islam, then they are guided. If they turn away, then your sole mission is to deliver the message. GOD is Seer of all the people.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يكفرون بآيات الله ويقتلون النبيين بغير حق ويقتلون الذين يأمرون بالقسط من الناس فبشرهم بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yakfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wayaqtulūna l-nabiyīna bighayri ḥaqqin wayaqtulūna alladhīna yamurūna bil-qis'ṭi mina l-nāsi fabashir'hum biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: Those who have rejected GOD's revelations, and killed the prophets unjustly, and killed those who advocated justice among the people, promise them a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who reject God's revelations, and slay the prophets unjustly, and slay those who preach righteousness, promise them painful retribution.

1989.english: Those who reject GOD’s revelations and kill the prophets unjustly, and kill those who advocate justice among the people, promise them painful retribution.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين حبطت أعمالهم في الدنيا والآخرة وما لهم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamā lahum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: Their works have been nullified, both in this life and in the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.

1981.english: It is these whose works have been nullified, in this life and in the hereafter. No one can help them.

1989.english: It is these who nullify their works in this worldly life and in the Hereafter. They will have no helpers.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر إلى الذين أوتوا نصيبا من الكتاب يدعون إلى كتاب الله ليحكم بينهم ثم يتولى فريق منهم وهم معرضون
verses.transliterated: alam tara ilā alladhīna ūtū naṣīban mina l-kitābi yud'ʿawna ilā kitābi l-lahi liyaḥkuma baynahum thumma yatawallā farīqun min'hum wahum muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: Have you noted those who were given part of the scripture, and how they are invited to uphold this scripture of GOD, and apply it to their own lives, then some of them turn away in aversion?

1981.english: Have you noted those who know only part of the scripture, and when invited to adopt God's scripture as their law, they turn away in aversion?
1981.subtitle: The Danger of Ignorance

1989.english: Have you noted those who were given part of the scripture, and were invited to uphold this scripture of GOD? Some of them have turned away in aversion.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم قالوا لن تمسنا النار إلا أياما معدودات ۖ وغرهم في دينهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahum qālū lan tamassanā l-nāru illā ayyāman maʿdūdātin wagharrahum fī dīnihim mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: This is because they said, "The hellfire will not touch us, except for a few days." They were thus deceived in their religion by their own fabrications.

1981.english: That is because they have said, "Hell is not eternal," and thus, they are deceived in their religion by their own inventions.\
1981.footnote: Relying on wishful thinking, Satan succeeded in convincing multitudes of people that hell is not eternal. Many Muslims are conned into believing that the mere utterance of "**La Ilaha Illa Allah** = There is no god except God" will assure them heaven. The Quran states clearly that heaven and hell are eternal, and that the assignment to either place is irreversible (see 2:81-82, 2:167, and Appendix 10).

1989.english: This is because they said, “The hellfire will not afflict us, except for a few days.” They were thus deceived in their religion, by their own fabrications.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فكيف إذا جمعناهم ليوم لا ريب فيه ووفيت كل نفس ما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: fakayfa idhā jamaʿnāhum liyawmin lā rayba fīhi wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: How will it be for them, when we summon them on that inevitable day? Each soul will be paid for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.

1981.english: How terrible will it be for them when we gather them on a day that is inevitable, and each soul is repaid for its works, without the least injustice.

1989.english: How will it be for them when we summon them on that inevitable day? Each soul will then be paid for everything it had earned, and no one will be wronged.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل اللهم مالك الملك تؤتي الملك من تشاء وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء وتعز من تشاء وتذل من تشاء ۖ بيدك الخير ۖ إنك على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: quli l-lahuma mālika l-mul'ki tu'tī l-mul'ka man tashāu watanziʿu l-mul'ka mimman tashāu watuʿizzu man tashāu watudhillu man tashāu biyadika l-khayru innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Say, "Our god: possessor of all sovereignty. You grant sovereignty to whomever You choose, You remove sovereignty from whomever You choose. You grant dignity to whomever You choose, and commit to humiliation whomever You choose. In Your hand are all provisions. You are Omnipotent.
verses.subtitle: Attributes of God

1981.english: Say, "Our God, You are the possessor of all kingship; You grant kingship to whomever You will, and remove kingship from whomever You will. You bestow dignity upon whomever you will, and humiliate whomever You will. All bounty is in Your hand. You are omnipotent."

1989.english: Say, “Our god: King of all kingship. You grant kingship to whomever You will, and remove kingship from whomever You will. You bestow dignity upon whomever You will, and humiliate whomever You will. In Your hand is all bounty. You are Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: تولج الليل في النهار وتولج النهار في الليل ۖ وتخرج الحي من الميت وتخرج الميت من الحي ۖ وترزق من تشاء بغير حساب
verses.transliterated: tūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri watūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli watukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti watukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi watarzuqu man tashāu bighayri ḥisābi
verses.english: "You merge the night into the day, and merge the day into the night. You produce the living from the dead, and produce the dead from the living, and You provide for whomever You choose, without limits."

1981.english: "You merge the night into the day, and merge the day into the night. You evolve the live from the dead, and evolve the dead from the live. You provide for whomever You will without limits."

1989.english: “You merge the night into the day, and merge the day into the night. You produce the living from the dead, and the dead from the living. You provide for whomever You choose, without limits.”

verses.arabic: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةً وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: لا يتخذ المؤمنون الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين ۖ ومن يفعل ذلك فليس من الله في شيء إلا أن تتقوا منهم تقاة ۗ ويحذركم الله نفسه ۗ وإلى الله المصير
verses.transliterated: lā yattakhidhi l-mu'minūna l-kāfirīna awliyāa min dūni l-mu'minīna waman yafʿal dhālika falaysa mina l-lahi fī shayin illā an tattaqū min'hum tuqātan wayuḥadhirukumu l-lahu nafsahu wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīr
verses.english: The believers never ally themselves with the disbelievers, instead of the believers. Whoever does this is exiled from GOD. Exempted are those who are forced to do this to avoid persecution. GOD alerts you that you shall reverence Him alone. To GOD is the ultimate destiny.
verses.subtitle: Choose Your Friends Carefully

1981.english: The believers shall not take disbelievers as friends, instead of believers. Whoever does this is not following God's commandments, unless he is forced to avoid their tyranny. God alerts you that you should fear only Him. To God is the ultimate destiny.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Befriend Disbelievers

1989.english: The believers do riot ally themselves with disbelievers instead of believers. Whoever does this does not belong with GOD, unless you are forced to do this under the scourge of severe persecution. GOD alerts you that you should beware of Him alone. To GOD is the ultimate destiny.
1989.subtitle: Choose Your Friends Carefully

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن تخفوا ما في صدوركم أو تبدوه يعلمه الله ۗ ويعلم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۗ والله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: qul in tukh'fū mā fī ṣudūrikum aw tub'dūhu yaʿlamhu l-lahu wayaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Say, "Whether you conceal your innermost thought, or declare it, GOD is fully aware thereof." He is fully aware of everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Say, "Whether you conceal your innermost thoughts, or declare them, God is fully aware thereof." He is fully aware of everything in the heavens and the earth; God is omnipotent.

1989.english: Say, “Whether you conceal your innermost thoughts, or declare them, GOD is fully aware thereof.” He is fully aware of everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًا وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تجد كل نفس ما عملت من خير محضرا وما عملت من سوء تود لو أن بينها وبينه أمدا بعيدا ۗ ويحذركم الله نفسه ۗ والله رءوف بالعباد
verses.transliterated: yawma tajidu kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat min khayrin muḥ'ḍaran wamā ʿamilat min sūin tawaddu law anna baynahā wabaynahu amadan baʿīdan wayuḥadhirukumu l-lahu nafsahu wal-lahu raūfun bil-ʿibād
verses.english: The day will come when each soul will find all the good works it had done brought forth. As for the evil works, it will wish that they were far, far removed. GOD alerts you that you shall reverence Him alone. GOD is Compassionate towards the people.

1981.english: The day will come when each soul will find everything righteous it had done brought forth; as for the evil works, it will wish if it were sent as far away from it as possible. God alerts you that you should fear Him alone. God is compassionate towards His creature.

1989.english: The day will come when each soul will find everything good it had done brought forth. As for the evil works, it will wish that they were farther removed than the east is from the west. GOD alerts you that you should beware of Him alone. GOD is Compassionate towards the worshipers.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن كنتم تحبون الله فاتبعوني يحببكم الله ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم ۗ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: qul in kuntum tuḥibbūna l-laha fa-ittabiʿūnī yuḥ'bib'kumu l-lahu wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Proclaim: "If you love GOD, you should follow me." GOD will then love you, and forgive your sins. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Say, "If you love God, then follow me; God will then love you, and forgive your sins. God is forgiver, merciful."
1981.subtitle: The Prophet Preaches Quran
1981.footnote: To follow and obey the prophet is to uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see 6:112-116, and Appendix 11).

1989.english: Proclaim (O Quran): “If you love GOD, you should follow me.” GOD will then love you, and forgive your sins. GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أطيعوا الله والرسول ۖ فإن تولوا فإن الله لا يحب الكافرين
verses.transliterated: qul aṭīʿū l-laha wal-rasūla fa-in tawallaw fa-inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Proclaim: "You shall obey GOD and the messenger." If they turn away, GOD does not love the disbelievers.

1981.english: Say, "Obey God and the messenger." If they turn away, then God does not love the disbelievers.

1989.english: Proclaim: “Obey GOD and the messenger.” If they turn away, then GOD dislikes the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله اصطفى آدم ونوحا وآل إبراهيم وآل عمران على العالمين
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha iṣ'ṭafā ādama wanūḥan waāla ib'rāhīma waāla ʿim'rāna ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: GOD has chosen Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the family of Amram (as messengers) to the people.
verses.subtitle: The Birth of Mary

1981.english: God has chosen Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the family of Imran as messengers to all the people.
1981.subtitle: The Family of Imran

1989.english: GOD has chosen (as messengers) Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham, and the Amramites from among the people.
1989.subtitle: The Birth of Mary

verses.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذرية بعضها من بعض ۗ والله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: dhurriyyatan baʿḍuhā min baʿḍin wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: They belong in the same progeny. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

1981.english: They are related to each other. God is hearer, omniscient.

1989.english: They are all related to each other. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قالت امرأت عمران رب إني نذرت لك ما في بطني محررا فتقبل مني ۖ إنك أنت السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: idh qālati im'ra-atu ʿim'rāna rabbi innī nadhartu laka mā fī baṭnī muḥarraran fataqabbal minnī innaka anta l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: The wife of Amram said, "My Lord, I have dedicated (the baby) in my belly to You, totally, so accept from me. You are Hearer, Omniscient."

1981.english: The wife of Imran said, "My Lord, I pledge to You the infant in my womb, so accept from me. You are the hearer, the omniscient."
1981.subtitle: Mary

1989.english: The wife of Amram said, “My Lord, I have dedicated (the baby) in my belly to You, completely, so accept from me. You are Hearer, Omniscient.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فلما وضعتها قالت رب إني وضعتها أنثى والله أعلم بما وضعت وليس الذكر كالأنثى ۖ وإني سميتها مريم وإني أعيذها بك وذريتها من الشيطان الرجيم
verses.transliterated: falammā waḍaʿathā qālat rabbi innī waḍaʿtuhā unthā wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā waḍaʿat walaysa l-dhakaru kal-unthā wa-innī sammaytuhā maryama wa-innī uʿīdhuhā bika wadhurriyyatahā mina l-shayṭāni l-rajīm
verses.english: When she gave birth to her, she said, "My Lord, I have given birth to a girl"—GOD was fully aware of what she bore—"The male is not the same as the female. I have named her Mary and I invoke Your protection for her and her descendants from the rejected devil."

1981.english: Then, when she gave birth to a girl, she said, "My Lord, I have given birth to a girl," and God was fully aware of what she bore. "The boy is not the same as the girl. I have named her Mary, and I invoke Your protection for her and her progeny from Satan the rejected."

1989.english: When she gave birth to her, she said, “My Lord, I have given birth to a girl”—GOD was fully aware of what she bore—“The male is not the same as the female. I have named her Mary, and I invoke Your protection for her and her descendants, from Satan the rejected.”

verses.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا قَالَ يَٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَا قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: فتقبلها ربها بقبول حسن وأنبتها نباتا حسنا وكفلها زكريا ۖ كلما دخل عليها زكريا المحراب وجد عندها رزقا ۖ قال يا مريم أنى لك هذا ۖ قالت هو من عند الله ۖ إن الله يرزق من يشاء بغير حساب
verses.transliterated: fataqabbalahā rabbuhā biqabūlin ḥasanin wa-anbatahā nabātan ḥasanan wakaffalahā zakariyyā kullamā dakhala ʿalayhā zakariyyā l-miḥ'rāba wajada ʿindahā riz'qan qāla yāmaryamu annā laki hādhā qālat huwa min ʿindi l-lahi inna l-laha yarzuqu man yashāu bighayri ḥisābi
verses.english: Her Lord accepted her a gracious acceptance, and brought her up a gracious upbringing, under the guardianship of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah entered her sanctuary he found provisions with her. He would ask, "Mary, where did you get this from?" She would say, "It is from GOD. GOD provides for whomever He chooses, without limits."

1981.english: Her Lord accepted her a gracious acceptance, and brought her up a gracious upbringing. Zachariah cared for her, and whenever Zacariah entered her sanctuary, he found provisions therein. He would say, "O Mary, where did you get this?" She would say, "It is from God. God provides whomever He wills without limits".

1989.english: Her Lord accepted her a gracious acceptance, and brought her up a gracious upbringing, under the guardianship of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah entered her sanctuary, he found provisions with her. He would ask, “Mary, where did you get this from?” She would say, “It is from GOD. GOD provides for whomever He chooses, without limits.”

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verses.arabicClean: هنالك دعا زكريا ربه ۖ قال رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة ۖ إنك سميع الدعاء
verses.transliterated: hunālika daʿā zakariyyā rabbahu qāla rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samīʿu l-duʿā
verses.english: That is when Zachariah implored his Lord: "My Lord, grant me such a good child; You are the Hearer of the prayers."
verses.subtitle: The Birth of John

1981.english: Zachariah then prayed to his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me righteous descendants. You are the hearer of all prayers."
1981.subtitle: John

1989.english: That is when Zachariah implored his Lord: “My Lord, grant me such a good child; You are the Hearer of prayers.”
1989.subtitle: The Birth of John

verses.arabic: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فنادته الملائكة وهو قائم يصلي في المحراب أن الله يبشرك بيحيى مصدقا بكلمة من الله وسيدا وحصورا ونبيا من الصالحين
verses.transliterated: fanādathu l-malāikatu wahuwa qāimun yuṣallī fī l-miḥ'rābi anna l-laha yubashiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqan bikalimatin mina l-lahi wasayyidan waḥaṣūran wanabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: The angels called him when he was praying in the sanctuary: "GOD gives you good news of John; a believer in the word of GOD, honorable, moral, and a righteous prophet."

1981.english: The angels called him as he prayed in the sanctuary, saying, "God gives you good news; a son to be named Yahya (John), believing in the word of God, and honorable and chaste, and a righteous prophet."

1989.english: The angels called him while he was praying in the sanctuary: GOD gives you good news of John; a believer in the word of GOD, honorable, moral, and a righteous prophet.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب أنى يكون لي غلام وقد بلغني الكبر وامرأتي عاقر ۖ قال كذلك الله يفعل ما يشاء
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun waqad balaghaniya l-kibaru wa-im'ra-atī ʿāqirun qāla kadhālika l-lahu yafʿalu mā yashā
verses.english: He said, "How can I have a boy, when I am so old, and my wife is sterile?" He said, "GOD does whatever He wills."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, will I have a son despite my old age, and my wife's sterility?" He was told, "God does whatever He wills."

1989.english: He said, “Will I have a son despite my old age, and my wife’s sterility?” He said, “GOD does whatever He wills.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب اجعل لي آية ۖ قال آيتك ألا تكلم الناس ثلاثة أيام إلا رمزا ۗ واذكر ربك كثيرا وسبح بالعشي والإبكار
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalāthata ayyāmin illā ramzan wa-udh'kur rabbaka kathīran wasabbiḥ bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kār
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, give me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three days, except through signals. Commemorate your Lord frequently; and meditate night and day."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, grant me a sign." He was told, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three days, except by signal. You shall commemorate your Lord frequently, and glorify Him night and day."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you do not speak to the people for three days, except by signals. You shall commemorate your Lord frequently, and meditate night and day.” Jesus

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قالت الملائكة يا مريم إن الله اصطفاك وطهرك واصطفاك على نساء العالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha iṣ'ṭafāki waṭahharaki wa-iṣ'ṭafāki ʿalā nisāi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: The angels said, "O Mary, GOD has chosen you and purified you. He has chosen you from all the women.
verses.subtitle: Mary and Jesus

1981.english: The angels said, "O Mary, God has chosen you, and sanctified you; He has chosen you over all the women.
1981.subtitle: Jesus

1989.english: The angels said, “O Mary, GOD has chosen you; He has purified you, and has chosen you over all the women.

verses.arabic: يَٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا مريم اقنتي لربك واسجدي واركعي مع الراكعين
verses.transliterated: yāmaryamu uq'nutī lirabbiki wa-us'judī wa-ir'kaʿī maʿa l-rākiʿīn
verses.english: "O Mary, you shall submit to your Lord, and prostrate and bow down with those who bow down."

1981.english: "O Mary, obey your Lord, fall prostrate, and bow down with those who bow down."

1989.english: “O Mary, submit to your Lord, fall prostrate, and bow down with those who bow down.”

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك من أنباء الغيب نوحيه إليك ۚ وما كنت لديهم إذ يلقون أقلامهم أيهم يكفل مريم وما كنت لديهم إذ يختصمون
verses.transliterated: dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh yul'qūna aqlāmahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wamā kunta ladayhim idh yakhtaṣimūn
verses.english: This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You were not there when they drew their raffles to select Mary's guardian. You were not present when they argued with one another.

1981.english: This is history from the past that we reveal to you. You were not present when they threw their raffles to decide who cares for Mary. You were not present when they feuded with each other.

1989.english: This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You were not present when they drew their raffles to select Mary’s guardian. You were not present when they feuded among themselves.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قالت الملائكة يا مريم إن الله يبشرك بكلمة منه اسمه المسيح عيسى ابن مريم وجيها في الدنيا والآخرة ومن المقربين
verses.transliterated: idh qālati l-malāikatu yāmaryamu inna l-laha yubashiruki bikalimatin min'hu us'muhu l-masīḥu ʿīsā ub'nu maryama wajīhan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamina l-muqarabīn
verses.english: The angels said, "O Mary, GOD gives you good news: a Word from Him whose name is 'The Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary.' He will be prominent in this life and in the Hereafter, and one of those closest to Me.

1981.english: The angels said, "O Mary, God gives you good news: a word from Him to be called Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary. He will be honorable in this life and in the hereafter, and one of those who are close to God.

1989.english: The angels said, “O Mary, GOD gives you good news of a Word from Him whose name shall be ‘The Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary. He will be prominent in this world and in the Hereafter, and one of those closest to Me.’

verses.arabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويكلم الناس في المهد وكهلا ومن الصالحين
verses.transliterated: wayukallimu l-nāsa fī l-mahdi wakahlan wamina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: "He will speak to the people from the crib, as well as an adult; he will be one of the righteous."

1981.english: "He will speak to the people as an infant, and as a man, and he will be righteous."

1989.english: “He will speak to the people from the crib, and as an adult. He will be among the righteous.”

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.arabicClean: قالت رب أنى يكون لي ولد ولم يمسسني بشر ۖ قال كذلك الله يخلق ما يشاء ۚ إذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون
verses.transliterated: qālat rabbi annā yakūnu lī waladun walam yamsasnī basharun qāla kadhāliki l-lahu yakhluqu mā yashāu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verses.english: She said, "My Lord, how can I have a son, when no man has touched me?" He said, "GOD thus creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He simply says to it, 'Be,' and it is.

1981.english: She said, "My Lord, how could I have a son, when no man has touched me?" She was told, "God thus creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He simply says to it, 'Be,' and it is."

1989.english: She said, “My Lord, how can I have a son, when no man has touched me?” He said, GOD thus creates whatever He wills. To have anything done, He simply says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.

verses.arabic: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: ويعلمه الكتاب والحكمة والتوراة والإنجيل
verses.transliterated: wayuʿallimuhu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wal-tawrāta wal-injīl
verses.english: He will teach him the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel.

1981.english: God endowed him with the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel.

1989.english: “He will teach him the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel.

verses.arabic: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ورسولا إلى بني إسرائيل أني قد جئتكم بآية من ربكم ۖ أني أخلق لكم من الطين كهيئة الطير فأنفخ فيه فيكون طيرا بإذن الله ۖ وأبرئ الأكمه والأبرص وأحيي الموتى بإذن الله ۖ وأنبئكم بما تأكلون وما تدخرون في بيوتكم ۚ إن في ذلك لآية لكم إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: warasūlan ilā banī is'rāīla annī qad ji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum annī akhluqu lakum mina l-ṭīni kahayati l-ṭayri fa-anfukhu fīhi fayakūnu ṭayran bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-ub'ri-u l-akmaha wal-abraṣa wa-uḥ'yī l-mawtā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wa-unabbi-ukum bimā takulūna wamā taddakhirūna fī buyūtikum inna fī dhālika laāyatan lakum in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: As a messenger to the Children of Israel: "I come to you with a sign from your Lord—I create for you from clay the shape of a bird, then I blow into it, and it becomes a live bird by GOD's leave. I restore vision to the blind, heal the leprous, and I revive the dead by GOD's leave. I can tell you what you eat, and what you store in your homes. This should be a proof for you, if you are believers.

1981.english: And He sent him to the children of Israel, saying, "I have come to you with miracles from your Lord: I create from clay the form of a bird, then blow into it, and it becomes a live bird by God's leave. I heal the blind and the leprous, and I revive the dead by God's leave. I can tell you what you ate, and what you left in your homes. These shoud be convincing signs for you, if you are really believers.

1989.english: “As a messenger to the Children of Israel, he will proclaim: ‘I come to you with proof from your Lord; I create for you the shape of a bird, from clay, then I blow into it, and it becomes a live bird, by GOD’s leave. I restore vision to the blind, I heal the leprous, and I revive the dead by GOD’s leave. I can tell you what you ate, and what you store in your homes. These should be sufficient proofs, if you are believers.

verses.arabic: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.arabicClean: ومصدقا لما بين يدي من التوراة ولأحل لكم بعض الذي حرم عليكم ۚ وجئتكم بآية من ربكم فاتقوا الله وأطيعون
verses.transliterated: wamuṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayya mina l-tawrāti wali-uḥilla lakum baʿḍa alladhī ḥurrima ʿalaykum waji'tukum biāyatin min rabbikum fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūn
verses.english: "I confirm previous scripture—the Torah—and I revoke certain prohibitions imposed upon you. I come to you with sufficient proof from your Lord. Therefore, you shall observe GOD, and obey me.

1981.english: "I come to confirm previous scripture, the Torah, and to revoke certain prohibitions. I have come to you with miracles from your Lord; you shall observe God, and obey me.

1989.english: ‘I am here to confirm the previous scripture, the Torah, and to revoke certain prohibitions imposed upon you. I come to you with proof from your Lord. Therefore, you shall observe GOD, and obey me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله ربي وربكم فاعبدوه ۗ هذا صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmu
verses.english: "GOD is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path."
verses.footnote: This is precisely what Jesus is quoted to say throughout the New Testament. See for example the Gospel of John 20:17, and the book "Jesus: Myths and Message" by Lisa Spray, Ch. 4 (Universal Unity, Fremont, California, 1992).

1981.english: "God is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him. This is the right path."\
1981.footnote: See Deuteronomy 6:4, and the Gospel of Mark 12:29-33.

1989.english: ‘GOD is my Lord and your Lord;* you shall worship Him alone. This is a straight path.’ ”
1989.footnote: This is precisely what Jesus is quoted to say throughout the New Testament. See for example the Gospel of John 20:17, and the book “Doctrine Development in Christianity” by Lisa Spray, Ch. 3 (Renaissance Productions, Tucson, Arizona 1989).

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما أحس عيسى منهم الكفر قال من أنصاري إلى الله ۖ قال الحواريون نحن أنصار الله آمنا بالله واشهد بأنا مسلمون
verses.transliterated: falammā aḥassa ʿīsā min'humu l-kuf'ra qāla man anṣārī ilā l-lahi qāla l-ḥawāriyūna naḥnu anṣāru l-lahi āmannā bil-lahi wa-ish'had bi-annā mus'limūn
verses.english: When Jesus sensed their disbelief, he said, "Who are my supporters towards GOD?" The disciples said, "We are GOD's supporters; we believe in GOD, and bear witness that we are submitters.

1981.english: When Jesus sensed disbelief from them, he said, "Who will support me towards God?" The disciples said, "We are the supporters of God. We believe in God, and bear witness that we are Muslims (submitters).

1989.english: When Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who are my supporters towards GOD?” The disciples said, “We are GOD’s supporters; we believe in GOD, and bear witness that we are Muslims.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا آمنا بما أنزلت واتبعنا الرسول فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين
verses.transliterated: rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wa-ittabaʿnā l-rasūla fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīn
verses.english: "Our Lord, we have believed in what You have sent down, and we have followed the messenger; count us among the witnesses."

1981.english: "Our Lord, we have believed in Your revelations, and we have followed the messenger, so count us among the witnesses."

1989.english: “Our Lord, we believe in what You have revealed, and we follow the messenger, so write us among the witnesses.”

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومكروا ومكر الله ۖ والله خير الماكرين
verses.transliterated: wamakarū wamakara l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīn
verses.english: They plotted and schemed, but so did GOD, and GOD is the best schemer.
verses.subtitle: The Death of Jesus
verses.footnote: We learn that Jesus' soul, the real person, was raised, i.e., Jesus' life on earth was terminated, prior to the arrest, torture, and crucifixion of his empty, soulless, but physiologically living body (See the details in Appendix 22).

1981.english: The others plotted and schemed; but so did God. God is the best schemer.

1989.english: They schemed, but so did GOD, and GOD is the best schemer.
1989.subtitle: The Death of Jesus
1989.footnote: We learn that Jesus’ soul, the real person, was raised; i.e., Jesus’ life on earth was terminated, and his enemies crucified his body, an empty shell (See Appendix 22).

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال الله يا عيسى إني متوفيك ورافعك إلي ومطهرك من الذين كفروا وجاعل الذين اتبعوك فوق الذين كفروا إلى يوم القيامة ۖ ثم إلي مرجعكم فأحكم بينكم فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
verses.transliterated: idh qāla l-lahu yāʿīsā innī mutawaffīka warāfiʿuka ilayya wamuṭahhiruka mina alladhīna kafarū wajāʿilu alladhīna ittabaʿūka fawqa alladhīna kafarū ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-aḥkumu baynakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn
verses.english: Thus, GOD said, "O Jesus, I am terminating your life, raising you to Me, and ridding you of the disbelievers. I will exalt those who follow you above those who disbelieve, till the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is the ultimate destiny of all of you, then I will judge among you regarding your disputes.

1981.english: Thus, God said, "O Jesus, I am terminating your life, and raising you to Me, and ridding you of the disbelievers. I will exalt those who follow you above those who disbelieve, until the day of resurrection. To Me is the ultimate return, then I will judge between you concerning your disputes."

1989.english: Thus, GOD said, “O Jesus, I am terminating your life on earth, raising you to Me, and ridding you of the disbelievers. I will raise those who follow you, above those who disbelieve, from now until the Day of Resurrection. To Me is your ultimate return, then I will judge among you regarding everything you disputed.
1989.footnote: We learn that Jesus’ soul, the real person, was raised; i.e., Jesus’ life on earth was terminated, and his enemies crucified his body, an empty shell (See Appendix 22).

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأما الذين كفروا فأعذبهم عذابا شديدا في الدنيا والآخرة وما لهم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā alladhīna kafarū fa-uʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamā lahum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: "As for those who disbelieve, I will commit them to painful retribution in this world, and in the Hereafter. They will have no helpers."

1981.english: Those who disbelieve, I will punish them severely, both in this life and the hereafter, and no one can help them.

1989.english: “As for those who disbelieve, I will commit them to painful retribution in this world, and in the Hereafter. They will have no helpers.”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فيوفيهم أجورهم ۗ والله لا يحب الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ujūrahum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, He will fully recompense them. GOD does not love the unjust.

1981.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, I will recompense them generously. God is never unjust.

1989.english: As for those who believe, and lead a righteous life, He will pay them fully. GOD dislikes the unjust.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك نتلوه عليك من الآيات والذكر الحكيم
verses.transliterated: dhālika natlūhu ʿalayka mina l-āyāti wal-dhik'ri l-ḥakīm
verses.english: These are the revelations that we recite to you, providing a message full of wisdom.

1981.english: These are the revelations and the message of wisdom that we recite to you.

1989.english: We recite for you in these revelations, a message that is full of wisdom.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.arabicClean: إن مثل عيسى عند الله كمثل آدم ۖ خلقه من تراب ثم قال له كن فيكون
verses.transliterated: inna mathala ʿīsā ʿinda l-lahi kamathali ādama khalaqahu min turābin thumma qāla lahu kun fayakūn
verses.english: The example of Jesus, as far as GOD is concerned, is the same as that of Adam; He created him from dust, then said to him, "Be," and he was.
verses.subtitle: Mathematical Confirmation
verses.footnote: The "equality" of the creation of Jesus and Adam is confirmed mathematically; Jesus and Adam are mentioned in the Quran the same number of times; 25 times each.

1981.english: The creation of Jesus, as far as God is concerned, is the same as the creation of Adam. God created Adam from dust, then said to him, "Be" and he was.

1989.english: The example of Jesus, as far as GOD is concerned, is the same as that of Adam; He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was.
1989.subtitle: Mathematical Confirmation
1989.footnote: The similarity between the creation of Jesus and Adam is confirmed mathematically; both men are mentioned in the Quran the same number of times (25 times each).

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الحق من ربك فلا تكن من الممترين
verses.transliterated: al-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takun mina l-mum'tarīn
verses.english: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubts.

1981.english: This is the truth from your Lord; you shall not harbor any doubts.

1989.english: This is the truth from your Lord; do not harbor any doubt about it.

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن حاجك فيه من بعد ما جاءك من العلم فقل تعالوا ندع أبناءنا وأبناءكم ونساءنا ونساءكم وأنفسنا وأنفسكم ثم نبتهل فنجعل لعنت الله على الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: faman ḥājjaka fīhi min baʿdi mā jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi faqul taʿālaw nadʿu abnāanā wa-abnāakum wanisāanā wanisāakum wa-anfusanā wa-anfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajʿal laʿnata l-lahi ʿalā l-kādhibīn
verses.english: If anyone argues with you, despite the knowledge you have received, then say, "Let us summon our children and your children, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then let us invoke GOD's curse upon the liars."
verses.subtitle: Challenging the Disbelievers

1981.english: Should anyone dispute with you, after this knowledge has come to you, then say, "Let us call upon our children and your children, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then let us pray that the curse of God befalls the liars."

1989.english: If anyone argues with you, after this knowledge has come to you, then say, “Let us summon our children and your children, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then let us invoke GOD’s curse upon the liars.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْقَصَصُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا لهو القصص الحق ۚ وما من إله إلا الله ۚ وإن الله لهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā lahuwa l-qaṣaṣu l-ḥaqu wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: Absolutely, this is the narration of the truth. Absolutely, there is no god except GOD. Absolutely, GOD is the Almighty, Most Wise.
