1981.english: Indeed, this is the truthful narration; indeed, there is never any god besides the one God; and indeed, God is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: This narration is the absolute truth. Absolutely, there is no other god besides GOD. Absolutely, GOD is the Almighty, the Most Wise.

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن تولوا فإن الله عليم بالمفسدين
verses.transliterated: fa-in tawallaw fa-inna l-laha ʿalīmun bil-muf'sidīn
verses.english: If they turn away, then GOD is fully aware of the evildoers.

1981.english: If they turn away, then God is fully aware of the wicked.

1989.english: If they dispute these facts, then GOD is fully aware of the evildoers. Call For A Logical, Unifying Agreement

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أهل الكتاب تعالوا إلى كلمة سواء بيننا وبينكم ألا نعبد إلا الله ولا نشرك به شيئا ولا يتخذ بعضنا بعضا أربابا من دون الله ۚ فإن تولوا فقولوا اشهدوا بأنا مسلمون
verses.transliterated: qul yāahla l-kitābi taʿālaw ilā kalimatin sawāin baynanā wabaynakum allā naʿbuda illā l-laha walā nush'rika bihi shayan walā yattakhidha baʿḍunā baʿḍan arbāban min dūni l-lahi fa-in tawallaw faqūlū ish'hadū bi-annā mus'limūn
verses.english: Say, "O followers of the scripture, let us come to a logical agreement between us and you: that we shall not worship except GOD; that we never set up any idols besides Him, nor set up any human beings as lords beside GOD." If they turn away, say, "Bear witness that we are submitters."
verses.subtitle: Invitation to All Believers

1981.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, let us come to a reasonable agreement between us and you: that we shall not worship except God, and shall never set up any idols to rank with Him, nor shall we set up lords from among ourselves." If they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims (submitters)."
1981.subtitle: The Great Commandment: You Shall Not Worship Except God
1981.footnote: This is "the First Commandment" of the Old Testament, the New Testament, and the Quran (see footnote 3:19). It should be noted that this is a "negative" commandment (You shall NOT worship except God), since people can worship God, and still go to hell (see 11:2, 11:26, 23:84-90, 29:61-63, 41:14, and 46:21).

1989.english: Say, “O followers of the scripture, let us come to a logical agreement between us and you: that we do not worship except GOD, that we never set up any idols besides Him, and never set up each other as gods beside GOD.” If they reject such an agreement, then say, “Bear witness that we are Muslims.”

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أهل الكتاب لم تحاجون في إبراهيم وما أنزلت التوراة والإنجيل إلا من بعده ۚ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: yāahla l-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fī ib'rāhīma wamā unzilati l-tawrātu wal-injīlu illā min baʿdihi afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: O followers of the scripture, why do you argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Do you not understand?

1981.english: O people of the scripture, why do you dispute about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Do you not understand?
1981.subtitle: Abraham: The Founder of Islam
1981.footnote: Many people are under the erroneous impression that Muhammad is the founder of Islam. The Quran, however, teaches that Abraham is the founder, and that all religious practices, i.e., **salat**, **zakat**, fasting, and **hajj** pilgrimage, were revealed through Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation. See also 2:135, 2:183, 3:95, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, and 22:78.

1989.english: O followers of the scripture, why do you argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Do you not understand?

verses.arabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ها أنتم هؤلاء حاججتم فيما لكم به علم فلم تحاجون فيما ليس لكم به علم ۚ والله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: hāantum hāulāi ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihi ʿil'mun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: You have argued about things you knew; why do you argue about things you do not know? GOD knows, while you do not know.

1981.english: You have disputed previously about things you knew, but why do you dispute about things you do not know? God knows, while you do not know.
1981.footnote: Many people are under the erroneous impression that Muhammad is the founder of Islam. The Quran, however, teaches that Abraham is the founder, and that all religious practices, i.e., **salat**, **zakat**, fasting, and **hajj** pilgrimage, were revealed through Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation. See also 2:135, 2:183, 3:95, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, and 22:78.

1989.english: You have argued about things you knew, but why do you argue about things you do not know? GOD knows, while you do not know.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان إبراهيم يهوديا ولا نصرانيا ولكن كان حنيفا مسلما وما كان من المشركين
verses.transliterated: mā kāna ib'rāhīmu yahūdiyyan walā naṣrāniyyan walākin kāna ḥanīfan mus'liman wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Abraham was neither Jewish, nor Christian; he was a monotheist submitter. He never was an idol worshiper.

1981.english: Abraham was neither a Jew, nor a Christian; he was a monotheist Muslim, and never an idol-worshiper.
1981.footnote: Many people are under the erroneous impression that Muhammad is the founder of Islam. The Quran, however, teaches that Abraham is the founder, and that all religious practices, i.e., **salat**, **zakat**, fasting, and **hajj** pilgrimage, were revealed through Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation. See also 2:135, 2:183, 3:95, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, and 22:78.

1989.english: Abraham was neither Jewish, nor Christian; he was a monotheist Muslim. He never was an idol worshiper.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن أولى الناس بإبراهيم للذين اتبعوه وهذا النبي والذين آمنوا ۗ والله ولي المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: inna awlā l-nāsi bi-ib'rāhīma lalladhīna ittabaʿūhu wahādhā l-nabiyu wa-alladhīna āmanū wal-lahu waliyyu l-mu'minīn
verses.english: The people most worthy of Abraham are those who followed him, and this prophet, and those who believe. GOD is the Lord and Master of the believers.

1981.english: The people most worthy of Abraham are those who followed him, and this prophet, and the believers in this message. God is the Lord of the believers.
1981.footnote: Many people are under the erroneous impression that Muhammad is the founder of Islam. The Quran, however, teaches that Abraham is the founder, and that all religious practices, i.e., **salat**, **zakat**, fasting, and **hajj** pilgrimage, were revealed through Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation. See also 2:135, 2:183, 3:95, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, and 22:78.

1989.english: The people most worthy of Abraham are those who followed him, and this prophet, and those who believe. GOD is the Lord and Master of the believers.

verses.arabic: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ودت طائفة من أهل الكتاب لو يضلونكم وما يضلون إلا أنفسهم وما يشعرون
verses.transliterated: waddat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi law yuḍillūnakum wamā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūn
verses.english: Some followers of the scripture wish to lead you astray, but they only lead themselves astray, without perceiving.

1981.english: Some followers of the previous scriptures may wish to mislead you, but they only mislead themselves without perceiving.

1989.english: Some followers of the scripture wish to lead you astray, but they only lead themselves astray, without perceiving.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أهل الكتاب لم تكفرون بآيات الله وأنتم تشهدون
verses.transliterated: yāahla l-kitābi lima takfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-antum tashhadūn
verses.english: O followers of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of GOD though you bear witness (that this is the truth)?

1981.english: O people of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of God, even when you bear witness that they are truth.

1989.english: O followers of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of GOD, while you bear witness?

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أهل الكتاب لم تلبسون الحق بالباطل وتكتمون الحق وأنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: yāahla l-kitābi lima talbisūna l-ḥaqa bil-bāṭili wataktumūna l-ḥaqa wa-antum taʿlamūn
verses.english: O followers of the scripture, why do you confound the truth with falsehood, and conceal the truth, knowingly?

1981.english: O people of the scripture, why do you confound the truth with falsehood, and conceal the truth knowingly?

1989.english: O followers of the scripture, why do you confound the truth with falsehood, and conceal the truth, knowingly?

verses.arabic: وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالت طائفة من أهل الكتاب آمنوا بالذي أنزل على الذين آمنوا وجه النهار واكفروا آخره لعلهم يرجعون
verses.transliterated: waqālat ṭāifatun min ahli l-kitābi āminū bi-alladhī unzila ʿalā alladhīna āmanū wajha l-nahāri wa-uk'furū ākhirahu laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.english: Some followers of the scripture say, "Believe in what was sent down to the believers in the morning, and reject it in the evening; maybe someday they will revert.

1981.english: Some among the people of the scripture even said, "Let us pretend that we believe in what was revealed to the Muslims during the day, and disbelieve by the day's end, in order to keep them away.

1989.english: Some followers of the scripture said, “Believe in what was sent down to the believers in the morning, and reject it in the evening. This may discourage them, and may cause them to revert.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤْتَىٰٓ أَحَدٌ مِّثْلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تؤمنوا إلا لمن تبع دينكم قل إن الهدى هدى الله أن يؤتى أحد مثل ما أوتيتم أو يحاجوكم عند ربكم ۗ قل إن الفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء ۗ والله واسع عليم
verses.transliterated: walā tu'minū illā liman tabiʿa dīnakum qul inna l-hudā hudā l-lahi an yu'tā aḥadun mith'la mā ūtītum aw yuḥājjūkum ʿinda rabbikum qul inna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu wāsiʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: "And do not believe except as those who follow your religion." Say, "The true guidance is GOD's guidance." If they claim that they have the same guidance, or argue with you about your Lord, say, "All grace is in GOD's hand; He bestows it upon whomever He wills." GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

1981.english: "Do not trust except those who follow your creed." Say, "God's guidance is the right guidance." If others claim to have similar guidance, or dispute with you about your Lord, then say, "All grace belongs to God, and He endows whomever He wills. God is bounteous, omniscient.

1989.english: “You must believe only those who follow your religion.” Say, “The right guidance is GOD’s guidance.” If they claim that they have equally good guidance, or argue with you about your Lord, then say, “All the blessings are in GOD’s hand; He bestows them upon whomever He wills.” GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: يختص برحمته من يشاء ۗ والله ذو الفضل العظيم
verses.transliterated: yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: He specifies His mercy for whomever He wills; GOD possesses unlimited grace.

1981.english: "He showers His mercy upon whomever He wills; God possesses unlimited grace."

1989.english: He showers His mercy upon whomever He wills; GOD possesses unlimited grace.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًا ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أهل الكتاب من إن تأمنه بقنطار يؤده إليك ومنهم من إن تأمنه بدينار لا يؤده إليك إلا ما دمت عليه قائما ۗ ذلك بأنهم قالوا ليس علينا في الأميين سبيل ويقولون على الله الكذب وهم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wamin ahli l-kitābi man in tamanhu biqinṭārin yu-addihi ilayka wamin'hum man in tamanhu bidīnārin lā yu-addihi ilayka illā mā dum'ta ʿalayhi qāiman dhālika bi-annahum qālū laysa ʿalaynā fī l-umiyīna sabīlun wayaqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Some followers of the scripture can be trusted with a whole lot, and they will give it back to you. Others among them cannot be trusted with a single dinar; they will not repay you unless you keep after them. That is because they say, "We do not have to be honest when dealing with the gentiles!" Thus, they attribute lies to GOD, knowingly.
verses.subtitle: Be Honest With All People
verses.footnote: Prior to the discovery of the Quran's mathematical code, some scholars falsely claimed that Muhammad was an illiterate man who could not write such a great book. They distorted the meaning of the word "Ummy," claiming that it meant "illiterate." This verse proves that "Ummiyyeen" means "gentiles" (See also 62:2 & Appendix 28).

1981.english: Among the people of the scripture there are some you can trust with a whole lot, and they would pay it back. And you may trust others with one Dinar, but they would not pay it back unless you keep after them. That is because they say, "We do not have to observe the commandments when dealing with the Gentiles." Thus, they invent lies about God knowingly.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Act Righteously With All The People

1989.english: Some followers of the scripture can be trusted with a whole lot, and they will repay you. And some of them, if you trust them with a single Dinar, they will not repay it unless you keep after them. That is because they say, “We do not have to be honest when dealing with the gentiles!”* Thus, they attribute lies to GOD, knowingly.
1989.subtitle: Be Honest With All People
1989.footnote: Prior to the discovery of the Quran’s mathematical code, some scholars falsely claimed that Muhammad was an illiterate man who could not write such a great book They distorted the meaning of the word ((Ummy,” claiming that it meant “illiterate.’ This verse proves that “Ummiyyeen” means “gentiles” (Appendix 28).

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بلى من أوفى بعهده واتقى فإن الله يحب المتقين
verses.transliterated: balā man awfā biʿahdihi wa-ittaqā fa-inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīn
verses.english: Indeed, those who fulfill their obligations and lead a righteous life, GOD loves the righteous.

1981.english: In fact, whoever keeps his vows, and leads a righteous life, then God loves the righteous.

1989.english: Indeed, if one fulfills his obligations, and leads a righteous life, then GOD loves the righteous.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَٰقَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنا قليلا أولئك لا خلاق لهم في الآخرة ولا يكلمهم الله ولا ينظر إليهم يوم القيامة ولا يزكيهم ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yashtarūna biʿahdi l-lahi wa-aymānihim thamanan qalīlan ulāika lā khalāqa lahum fī l-ākhirati walā yukallimuhumu l-lahu walā yanẓuru ilayhim yawma l-qiyāmati walā yuzakkīhim walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: As for those who trade away GOD's covenant, and their obligations, for a cheap price, they receive no share in the Hereafter. GOD will not speak to them, nor look at them, on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: As for those who disregard God's covenant, and violate their own vows for a cheap material gain, they will have no share in the hereafter. God will neither speak to them, nor look at them on the day of resurrection, nor will He sanctify them. They have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: As for those who trade away GOD’s covenant and their obligations for a cheap price, they get no share in the Hereafter. GOD will not speak to them, nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًا يَلْوُۥنَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن منهم لفريقا يلوون ألسنتهم بالكتاب لتحسبوه من الكتاب وما هو من الكتاب ويقولون هو من عند الله وما هو من عند الله ويقولون على الله الكذب وهم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-inna min'hum lafarīqan yalwūna alsinatahum bil-kitābi litaḥsabūhu mina l-kitābi wamā huwa mina l-kitābi wayaqūlūna huwa min ʿindi l-lahi wamā huwa min ʿindi l-lahi wayaqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Among them are those who twist their tongues to imitate the scripture, that you may think it is from the scripture, when it is not from the scripture, and they claim that it is from GOD, when it is not from GOD. Thus, they utter lies and attribute them to GOD, knowingly.

1981.english: Some of them even twist their tongues to simulate the scripture, to make you think that it is from the scripture, when it is not from the scripture; and claim that it is from God, when it is not from God. They invent lies and attribute them to God, knowingly.

1989.english: Some of them twist their tongues to imitate the scripture, that you may think it is from the scripture, when it is not from the scripture. They then claim that it is from GOD, when it is not from GOD. They utter lies and attribute them to GOD, knowingly.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُوا۟ عِبَادًا لِّى مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن كُونُوا۟ رَبَّٰنِيِّۦنَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان لبشر أن يؤتيه الله الكتاب والحكم والنبوة ثم يقول للناس كونوا عبادا لي من دون الله ولكن كونوا ربانيين بما كنتم تعلمون الكتاب وبما كنتم تدرسون
verses.transliterated: mā kāna libasharin an yu'tiyahu l-lahu l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata thumma yaqūla lilnnāsi kūnū ʿibādan lī min dūni l-lahi walākin kūnū rabbāniyyīna bimā kuntum tuʿallimūna l-kitāba wabimā kuntum tadrusūn
verses.english: Never would a human being whom GOD blessed with the scripture and prophethood say to the people, "Idolize me beside GOD." Instead, (he would say), "Devote yourselves absolutely to your Lord alone," according to the scripture you preach and the teachings you learn.

1981.english: It is not possible for a human whom God had blessed with the scripture and wisdom, and prophethood, that he should tell the people to idolize him besides God. Rather, he would say, "You shall devote your worship to the Lord, in accordance with the scripture that you study and preach."

1989.english: Never would a human being whom GOD has blessed with the scripture and prophethood say to the people, “Be worshipers of me besides GOD.” Instead, (he would say), “Be devoted to your Lord alone, in accordance with the scripture you received, and learned.”

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ أَرْبَابًا أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يأمركم أن تتخذوا الملائكة والنبيين أربابا ۗ أيأمركم بالكفر بعد إذ أنتم مسلمون
verses.transliterated: walā yamurakum an tattakhidhū l-malāikata wal-nabiyīna arbāban ayamurukum bil-kuf'ri baʿda idh antum mus'limūn
verses.english: Nor would he command you to idolize the angels and the prophets as lords. Would he exhort you to disbelieve after becoming submitters?

1981.english: Nor will he ask you to idolize the angels or the prophets. Would he exhort you to disbelieve, after becoming Muslims?

1989.english: Nor would he command you to set up the angels and the prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelieve after becoming Muslims?

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ لَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُكُم مِّن كِتَٰبٍ وَحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِۦ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُۥ قَالَ ءَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمْ إِصْرِى قَالُوٓا۟ أَقْرَرْنَا قَالَ فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ وَأَنَا۠ مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذ الله ميثاق النبيين لما آتيتكم من كتاب وحكمة ثم جاءكم رسول مصدق لما معكم لتؤمنن به ولتنصرنه ۚ قال أأقررتم وأخذتم على ذلكم إصري ۖ قالوا أقررنا ۚ قال فاشهدوا وأنا معكم من الشاهدين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa l-nabiyīna lamā ātaytukum min kitābin waḥik'matin thumma jāakum rasūlun muṣaddiqun limā maʿakum latu'minunna bihi walatanṣurunnahu qāla a-aqrartum wa-akhadhtum ʿalā dhālikum iṣ'rī qālū aqrarnā qāla fa-ish'hadū wa-anā maʿakum mina l-shāhidīn
verses.english: GOD took a covenant from the prophets, saying, "I will give you the scripture and wisdom. Afterwards, a messenger will come to confirm all existing scriptures. You shall believe in him and support him." He said, "Do you agree with this, and pledge to fulfill this covenant?" They said, "We agree." He said, "You have thus borne witness, and I bear witness along with you."
verses.subtitle: Major Prophecy Fulfilled* God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: This major prophecy has now been fulfilled. God's Messenger of the Covenant, as prophesied in this verse and in the Bible's Malachi 3:1-21, Luke 17:22-36, & Matthew 24:27 is to purify and unify God's messages which were delivered by God's prophets. Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, etc. have been severely corrupted. It is the will of Almighty God to purify them and unify them under the banner of worshiping Him alone. Overwhelming evidence has been provided by God in support of His Messenger of the Covenant, whose name is incontrovertibly specified in the Quran's mathematical code as "Rashad Khalifa."For example, adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus the verse number (81) gives 1311, or 19x69 (see Appendix 2 for the detailed evidence).

1981.english: God has made a covenant with the prophets that He will give them the scripture and wisdom: then, when a messenger comes to you (O people), confirming the scripture, you shall believe in him and support him. God said, "Do you agree and make a covenant with Me?" (The people) said, "We agree." God said, "You have thus borne witness and I bear witness with you."
1981.subtitle: Before Genesis
1981.footnote: This was part of the "pre-creation" pact that God made with all the people (see 7:172). Note the distinction between a "prophet" and a "messenger;" the prophet is one who was given a scripture, while the messenger merely confirms and preaches existing scriptures. Since Quran is the last scripture, Muhammad is the last prophet.

1989.english: GOD took a covenant from the prophets, saying, “After I have given you the scripture and wisdom, a messenger will come to confirm what you have. You shall believe in him and support him.” He said, “Do you agree with this, and pledge to uphold this covenant?” They said, “We agree.” He said, “You have thus borne witness, and I am with you a witness."
1989.subtitle: Major Prophecy Fulfilled* God’s Messenger of the Covenant
1989.footnote: God’s Messenger of the Covenant, as prophesied in the Bible’s Malachi 3:1-21 and the Quran’s 3:81, is to purify and unify God’s messages which were delivered by God’s prophets. Judaism, Christianity, and Islam have been corrupted beyond recogni tion, and it is the will of Almighty God to restore them and unify them under the banner of worshiping Him alone. Overwhelming evidence has been provided by God in support of His Messenger of the Covenant, whose name is specified in the Quran and mathematically coded. See Appendix 2 for the details.

verses.arabic: فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن تولى بعد ذلك فأولئك هم الفاسقون
verses.transliterated: faman tawallā baʿda dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-fāsiqūn
verses.english: Those who reject this (Quranic prophecy) are the evil ones.
verses.subtitle: Rejectors of God's Messenger of the Covenant are Disbelievers

1981.english: If anyone turns away thereafter, then these are the wicked.

1989.english: Those who reject this (Quranic truth) are the evil ones.
1989.subtitle: Rejectors of God’s Messenger of the Covenant No Longer Muslims

verses.arabic: أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفغير دين الله يبغون وله أسلم من في السماوات والأرض طوعا وكرها وإليه يرجعون
verses.transliterated: afaghayra dīni l-lahi yabghūna walahu aslama man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ṭawʿan wakarhan wa-ilayhi yur'jaʿūn
verses.english: Are they seeking other than GOD's religion, when everything in the heavens and the earth has submitted to Him, willingly and unwillingly, and to Him they will be returned?

1981.english: Would they seek other than God's religion, when everything in the heavens and the earth have submitted to Him, willingly or unwillingly? To Him they will all return.

1989.english: Are they seeking other than GOD’s religion, when everything has submitted to Him in the heavens and the earth, willingly and unwillingly, and to Him they will be returned?

verses.arabic: قُلْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل آمنا بالله وما أنزل علينا وما أنزل على إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط وما أوتي موسى وعيسى والنبيون من ربهم لا نفرق بين أحد منهم ونحن له مسلمون
verses.transliterated: qul āmannā bil-lahi wamā unzila ʿalaynā wamā unzila ʿalā ib'rāhīma wa-is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭi wamā ūtiya mūsā waʿīsā wal-nabiyūna min rabbihim lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min'hum wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūn
verses.english: Say, "We believe in GOD, and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs, and in what was given to Moses, Jesus, and the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. To Him alone we are submitters."
verses.subtitle: Make No Distinction Among God's Messengers

1981.english: Say, "We believe in God, and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs, and in what was given to Moses and Jesus, and to all the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. We have submitted to God."
1981.subtitle: Islam Preached By All Messengers

1989.english: Say, “We believe in GOD, and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, and the Patriarchs, and in what was given to Moses, Jesus, and the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction among any of them. To Him alone we are Muslims.” Only One Religion
1989.subtitle: Make No Distinction Among God’s Messengers

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَبْتَغِ غَيْرَ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمِ دِينًا فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يبتغ غير الإسلام دينا فلن يقبل منه وهو في الآخرة من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: waman yabtaghi ghayra l-is'lāmi dīnan falan yuq'bala min'hu wahuwa fī l-ākhirati mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: Anyone who accepts other than Submission as his religion, it will not be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter, he will be with the losers.
verses.subtitle: Only One Religion Approved by God

1981.english: Anyone who seeks other than Islam (submission) as a religion, it will not be accepted from him, and in the hereafter he will be a loser.

1989.english: Anyone who accepts other than Islam as his religion, it will not be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter, he will be with the losers.

verses.arabic: كَيْفَ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ وَشَهِدُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلرَّسُولَ حَقٌّ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كيف يهدي الله قوما كفروا بعد إيمانهم وشهدوا أن الرسول حق وجاءهم البينات ۚ والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: kayfa yahdī l-lahu qawman kafarū baʿda īmānihim washahidū anna l-rasūla ḥaqqun wajāahumu l-bayinātu wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Why should GOD guide people who disbelieved after believing, and after witnessing that the messenger is truth, and after solid proofs have been given to them? GOD does not guide the wicked.
verses.footnote: Verses 3:82-90 inform us that those who reject God's Messenger of the Covenant are no longer submitters (Muslims), since they no longer believe the Quran. The proofs mentioned in 3:86 refer to the Quran's mathematical code, which was revealed through God's Messenger of the Covenant. Both 3:86 and 3:90 talk about "disbelieving after believing."

1981.english: Why should God guide people who disbelieve after having believed, and after bearing witness that the messenger is truthful, and after profound miracles have come to them? God does not guide the wicked people.

1989.english: Why should GOD guide people who disbelieved after believing, and after witnessing that the messenger is truth, and after solid proofs* have been given to them? GOD does not guide the wicked.
1989.footnote: Clearly, verses 3:82-90 are connected with God’s Messenger of the Covenant. We learn from them that those who reject God’s Messenger of the Covenant are no longer Muslims, since they no longer believe the Quran. The proofs mentioned in 3:86 refer to the Quran’s mathematical code, which was revealed through God’s Messenger of the Covenant. Both 3:86and 3:90 talk about “disbelievingafter believing.”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك جزاؤهم أن عليهم لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين
verses.transliterated: ulāika jazāuhum anna ʿalayhim laʿnata l-lahi wal-malāikati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīn
verses.english: These have incurred condemnation by GOD, and the angels, and all the people.

1981.english: They have deserved the curse of God, and the angels, and all the people.

1989.english: These have incurred condemnation from GOD, and from the angels, and from all the people.

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: خالدين فيها لا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينظرون
verses.transliterated: khālidīna fīhā lā yukhaffafu ʿanhumu l-ʿadhābu walā hum yunẓarūn
verses.english: Eternally they abide therein; the retribution is never commuted for them, nor will they be reprieved.

1981.english: Eternally they abide therein; the retribution will never be commuted for them, nor will they be reprieved.

1989.english: Eternally they abide therein; the retribution is never reduced for them, nor will they be reprieved.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا فإن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Exempted are those who repent thereafter, and reform. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: However, those who repent thereafter, and reform, will find God forgiving, merciful.

1989.english: Exempted are those who repent after that, and reform. GOD Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًا لَّن تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا بعد إيمانهم ثم ازدادوا كفرا لن تقبل توبتهم وأولئك هم الضالون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū baʿda īmānihim thumma iz'dādū kuf'ran lan tuq'bala tawbatuhum wa-ulāika humu l-ḍālūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve after believing, then plunge deeper into disbelief, their repentance will not be accepted from them; they are the real strayers.
verses.subtitle: When Repentance is Unacceptable

1981.english: Those who disbelieve after having believed, then plunge deeper into disbelief, their repentance will never be accepted, and they will be the real strayers.

1989.english: Surely, those who disbelieve after believing, then plunge deeper into disbelief, their repentance will not be accepted from them; these are the strayers.
1989.subtitle: When Repentance is Unacceptable

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِم مِّلْءُ ٱلْأَرْضِ ذَهَبًا وَلَوِ ٱفْتَدَىٰ بِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا وماتوا وهم كفار فلن يقبل من أحدهم ملء الأرض ذهبا ولو افتدى به ۗ أولئك لهم عذاب أليم وما لهم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū wamātū wahum kuffārun falan yuq'bala min aḥadihim mil'u l-arḍi dhahaban walawi if'tadā bihi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun wamā lahum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers, an earthful of gold will not be accepted from any of them, even if such a ransom were possible. They have incurred painful retribution; they will have no helpers.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve, and die as disbelievers, an earthful of gold will not be accepted from them as ransom. They have deserved painful retribution, and no one can help them.

1989.english: Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers, an earthful of gold will not be accepted from them, even if such a ransom were possible. These have incurred painful retribution; they will have no helpers.

verses.arabic: لَن تَنَالُوا۟ ٱلْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون ۚ وما تنفقوا من شيء فإن الله به عليم
verses.transliterated: lan tanālū l-bira ḥattā tunfiqū mimmā tuḥibbūna wamā tunfiqū min shayin fa-inna l-laha bihi ʿalīmu
verses.english: You cannot attain righteousness until you give to charity from the possessions you love. Whatever you give to charity, GOD is fully aware thereof.

1981.english: You can never attain righteousness, unless you give to charity from the things you love. Anything you give to charity, God is fully aware thereof.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Be Charitable

1989.english: You cannot attain righteousness until you give from the possessions you love. Whatever you give, GOD is fully aware thereof.

verses.arabic: كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ فَٱتْلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كل الطعام كان حلا لبني إسرائيل إلا ما حرم إسرائيل على نفسه من قبل أن تنزل التوراة ۗ قل فأتوا بالتوراة فاتلوها إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: kullu l-ṭaʿāmi kāna ḥillan libanī is'rāīla illā mā ḥarrama is'rāīlu ʿalā nafsihi min qabli an tunazzala l-tawrātu qul fatū bil-tawrāti fa-it'lūhā in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: All food used to be lawful for the Children of Israel, until Israel imposed certain prohibitions on themselves before the Torah was sent down. Say, "Bring the Torah and read it, if you are truthful."
verses.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit What Is Lawful

1981.english: All food used to be lawful for the children of Israel, until Israel initiated prohibitions against themselves, before the revelation of the Torah. Say, "Bring the Torah, and read it, if you are truthful."
1981.subtitle: Unauthorized Prohibition of Foods Is Wickedness

1989.english: All food used to be lawful for the Children of Israel, until Israel imposed certain prohibitions on themselves, before the Torah was sent down. Say, “Bring the Torah and read it, if you are truthful.”
1989.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit What Is Lawful

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن افترى على الله الكذب من بعد ذلك فأولئك هم الظالمون
verses.transliterated: famani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba min baʿdi dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: Those who fabricate false prohibitions after this, and attribute them to GOD, are truly wicked.

1981.english: Anyone who invents lies about God, after this, these are the wicked.\
1981.footnote: Many Muslims have fallen into Satan's trap, and invented a long list of unauthorized prohibitions, based on the great blasphemy known as "**hadith**" and/or "**sunna**." See 2:173, 5:87, 6:112-116, 6:145, 16:115, 16:116, and Appendix 13.

1989.english: Those who fabricate false prohibitions after this, and attribute them to GOD, are the evil ones.

verses.arabic: قُلْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ فَٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل صدق الله ۗ فاتبعوا ملة إبراهيم حنيفا وما كان من المشركين
verses.transliterated: qul ṣadaqa l-lahu fa-ittabiʿū millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Say, "GOD has proclaimed the truth: You shall follow Abraham's religion—monotheism. He never was an idolator."

1981.english: Say, "The truth has come from God, and you shall follow the religion of Abraham; monotheism; he never was an idol-worshiper."

1989.english: Say, “GOD proclaims the truth: you shall follow Abraham’s religion, monotheism, he never was an idol worshiper.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِى بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكًا وَهُدًى لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن أول بيت وضع للناس للذي ببكة مباركا وهدى للعالمين
verses.transliterated: inna awwala baytin wuḍiʿa lilnnāsi lalladhī bibakkata mubārakan wahudan lil'ʿālamīn
verses.english: The most important shrine established for the people is the one in Becca; a blessed beacon for all the people.
verses.footnote: This is an M-initialed sura, and this peculiar spelling of "Mecca" as "Becca" causes the occurrence of "M" to conform to the Quran's mathematical code. The normal spelling "Mecca" would have increased the frequency of occurrence of "M" (Appendix 1).

1981.english: The first shrine designated for the people is the one in Becca;\* a blessed beacon for all the people.
1981.footnote: There is no doubt that the word "Becca" refers to the famous Arabian city "Mecca." Although the Quran was revealed through a Meccan man, and all the people around him knew the city as "Mecca," the mandatory Quranic spelling came down as "Becca." This deliberate and profound alteration, as it turned out, serves to prove the divine source of Quran, and that every word, indeed every letter, in the Quran has been divinely designed and divinely preserved. The reader will note that this sura is initialed with the letters "A.L.M." (verse 1). Therefore, the count of the letter "M" in this sura must conform to the Quran's secret numerical code (see Appendix 1). Had the word "Becca" been written down as "Mecca", the frequency of occurrence of the letter "M" would have increased by 1, the total will no longer be divisible by 19, and the Quran's secret numerical code would have simply disappeared.

1989.english: The most important shrine established for the people is the one in Becca;* a blessed beacon for all.
1989.footnote: This is an M-initialed sura, and the spelling of “Mecca” as “Becca” causes the occurrence of “M ” to conform to the Quran’s mathematical code. The normal spelling “Mecca” would have increased the frequency of occurrence of “M ” (Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: فِيهِ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنًا وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلْبَيْتِ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فيه آيات بينات مقام إبراهيم ۖ ومن دخله كان آمنا ۗ ولله على الناس حج البيت من استطاع إليه سبيلا ۚ ومن كفر فإن الله غني عن العالمين
verses.transliterated: fīhi āyātun bayyinātun maqāmu ib'rāhīma waman dakhalahu kāna āminan walillahi ʿalā l-nāsi ḥijju l-bayti mani is'taṭāʿa ilayhi sabīlan waman kafara fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿani l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: In it are clear signs: the station of Abraham. Anyone who enters it shall be granted safe passage. The people owe it to GOD that they shall observe Hajj to this shrine, when they can afford it. As for those who disbelieve, GOD does not need anyone.

1981.english: In it, there are profound signs, such as the footprints of Abraham.\* Anyone who enters it shall be guaranteed safety. The people owe it to God, that they shall observe the **Hajj** pilgrimage to the shrine, whenever they can afford it. As for those who disbelieve, God is in no need for anyone.
1981.footnote: Abraham's footprints were miraculously imprinted on a rock, and can be viewed by all visitors of the Sacred Mosque in Mecca.

1989.english: In it are clear signs: the station of Abraham. Anyone who enters it shall be guaranteed safe passage. The people owe it to GOD that they shall observe Hajj to this shrine; those who can afford it. As for those who disbelieve, GOD is in no need of them.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أهل الكتاب لم تكفرون بآيات الله والله شهيد على ما تعملون
verses.transliterated: qul yāahla l-kitābi lima takfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wal-lahu shahīdun ʿalā mā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Say, "O followers of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of GOD, when GOD is witnessing everything you do?"

1981.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of God, knowing that God witnesses everything you do?"

1989.english: Say, “O followers of the scripture, why do you reject these revelations of GOD, when GOD is witnessing everything you do?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ تَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَأَنتُمْ شُهَدَآءُ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أهل الكتاب لم تصدون عن سبيل الله من آمن تبغونها عوجا وأنتم شهداء ۗ وما الله بغافل عما تعملون
verses.transliterated: qul yāahla l-kitābi lima taṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi man āmana tabghūnahā ʿiwajan wa-antum shuhadāu wamā l-lahu bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Say, "O followers of the scripture, why do you repel from the path of GOD those who wish to believe, and seek to distort it, even though you are witnesses?" GOD is never unaware of anything you do.

1981.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, why do you repulse the people from the path of God, and defame it, though you bear witness that it is the truth? God is never unaware of anything you do."

1989.english: Say, “O followers of the scripture, why do you repel from the path of GOD those who wish to believe? Why do you seek to distort it, even though you are witnesses?” GOD is never unaware of anything you do.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن تطيعوا فريقا من الذين أوتوا الكتاب يردوكم بعد إيمانكم كافرين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tuṭīʿū farīqan mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba yaruddūkum baʿda īmānikum kāfirīn
verses.english: O you who believe, if you obey some of those who received the scripture, they will revert you, after having believed, into disbelievers.

1981.english: O you who believe, if you obey some people of the scripture, they would revert you from believers to disbelievers.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you obey some of those who received the scripture, they will turn you, after you have believed, into disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمْ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُۥ وَمَن يَعْتَصِم بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِىَ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وكيف تكفرون وأنتم تتلى عليكم آيات الله وفيكم رسوله ۗ ومن يعتصم بالله فقد هدي إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: wakayfa takfurūna wa-antum tut'lā ʿalaykum āyātu l-lahi wafīkum rasūluhu waman yaʿtaṣim bil-lahi faqad hudiya ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: How can you disbelieve, when these revelations of GOD are being recited to you, and His messenger is in your midst? Whoever holds fast to GOD will be guided in the right path.

1981.english: And how could you revert after God's revelations have been recited to you, and the messenger had come to you? The one who holds fast to God, has been guided in the right path.

1989.english: How could you disbelieve, when GOD’s revelations are being recited to you, and His messenger is in your midst? Whoever holds fast to GOD has been guided in a straight path.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله حق تقاته ولا تموتن إلا وأنتم مسلمون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha ḥaqqa tuqātihi walā tamūtunna illā wa-antum mus'limūn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall observe GOD as He should be observed, and do not die except as Submitters.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall observe God as He should be observed, and do not die except as Muslims (submitters).
1981.subtitle: You Shall Be United

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall observe GOD as He should be observed, and do not die except as Muslims. Unity: A Trait of the Believers

verses.arabic: وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِحَبْلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا۟ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنتُمْ أَعْدَآءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم بِنِعْمَتِهِۦٓ إِخْوَٰنًا وَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنْهَا كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واعتصموا بحبل الله جميعا ولا تفرقوا ۚ واذكروا نعمت الله عليكم إذ كنتم أعداء فألف بين قلوبكم فأصبحتم بنعمته إخوانا وكنتم على شفا حفرة من النار فأنقذكم منها ۗ كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته لعلكم تهتدون
verses.transliterated: wa-iʿ'taṣimū biḥabli l-lahi jamīʿan walā tafarraqū wa-udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh kuntum aʿdāan fa-allafa bayna qulūbikum fa-aṣbaḥtum biniʿ'matihi ikh'wānan wakuntum ʿalā shafā ḥuf'ratin mina l-nāri fa-anqadhakum min'hā kadhālika yubayyinu l-lahu lakum āyātihi laʿallakum tahtadūn
verses.english: You shall hold fast to the rope of GOD, all of you, and do not be divided. Recall GOD's blessings upon you—you used to be enemies and He reconciled your hearts. By His grace, you became brethren. You were at the brink of a pit of fire, and He saved you therefrom. GOD thus explains His revelations for you, that you may be guided.
verses.subtitle: Believers are United

1981.english: You shall hold fast to the rope of God, all together, and do not be divided. Be appreciative of God's favors upon you; you used to be enemies, and He reconciled your hearts. By His grace, you became brethren. God thus explains His revelations for you, that you may be guided.

1989.english: You shall hold fast to the rope of GOD, all of you, and do not be divided. Recall GOD’s blessings upon you—you used to be enemies and He reconciled your hearts. By His grace, you became brethren. You were at the brink of a pit of fire, and He saved you. GOD thus explains His revelations for you, that you may be guided.

verses.arabic: وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولتكن منكم أمة يدعون إلى الخير ويأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ۚ وأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: waltakun minkum ummatun yadʿūna ilā l-khayri wayamurūna bil-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿani l-munkari wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: Let there be a community of you who invite to what is good, advocate righteousness, and forbid evil. These are the winners.

1981.english: Let there be a community among you who preach goodness, advocate righteousness, and forbid evil. These are the winners.

1989.english: Let there be a community of you who invite to goodness, advocate righteousness, and forbid evil. These are the successful ones.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُوا۟ وَٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تكونوا كالذين تفرقوا واختلفوا من بعد ما جاءهم البينات ۚ وأولئك لهم عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: walā takūnū ka-alladhīna tafarraqū wa-ikh'talafū min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-bayinātu wa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Do not be like those who became divided and disputed, despite the clear proofs that were given to them. For these have incurred a terrible retribution.

1981.english: Do not be like those who became divided, and disputed among themselves, despite the profound revelations that had come to them. They have deserved severe retribution.

1989.english: Do not be like those who became divided and disputed after the clear proofs had come to them. These have incurred a terrible retribution—

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ أَكَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تبيض وجوه وتسود وجوه ۚ فأما الذين اسودت وجوههم أكفرتم بعد إيمانكم فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
verses.transliterated: yawma tabyaḍḍu wujūhun wataswaddu wujūhun fa-ammā alladhīna is'waddat wujūhuhum akafartum baʿda īmānikum fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
verses.english: The day will come when some faces will be brightened (with joy), while other faces will be darkened (with misery). As for those whose faces are darkened, they will be asked, "Did you not disbelieve after believing? Therefore, suffer the retribution for your disbelief."

1981.english: The day will come when some faces are brightened (with joy), while other faces are darkened (with misery). Those whose faces are darkened (will be told), "Did you not revert to disbelief, after having believed? Therefore, you have deserved the retribution for your disbelief."

1989.english: on a day when some faces will be brightened with joy, while other faces will be darkened with misery. As for those whose faces are darkened: “Did you not disbelieve after believing? Consequently, taste the retribution for your disbelief.”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِى رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما الذين ابيضت وجوههم ففي رحمة الله هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā alladhīna ib'yaḍḍat wujūhuhum fafī raḥmati l-lahi hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: As for those whose faces are brightened, they will rejoice in GOD's mercy; they abide therein forever.

1981.english: As for those whose faces are brightened, they have deserved God's mercy; they abide therein forever.

1989.english: As for those whose faces are brightened, they will rejoice in GOD’s mercy; they abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك آيات الله نتلوها عليك بالحق ۗ وما الله يريد ظلما للعالمين
verses.transliterated: til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi wamā l-lahu yurīdu ẓul'man lil'ʿālamīn
verses.english: These are GOD's revelations; we recite them to you, truthfully. GOD does not wish any hardship for the people.

1981.english: These are the revelations of God; we recite them to you, truthfully. God does not wish injustice for anyone.

1989.english: These are GOD’s revelations; we recite them to you, truthfully. GOD does not wish any hardship for the people.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.arabicClean: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ وإلى الله ترجع الأمور
verses.transliterated: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūr
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and all matters are controlled by GOD.

1981.english: To God belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. God is in full control of all things.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and everything in the earth, and all matters are controlled by GOD.

verses.arabic: كُنتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَلَوْ ءَامَنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُم مِّنْهُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كنتم خير أمة أخرجت للناس تأمرون بالمعروف وتنهون عن المنكر وتؤمنون بالله ۗ ولو آمن أهل الكتاب لكان خيرا لهم ۚ منهم المؤمنون وأكثرهم الفاسقون
verses.transliterated: kuntum khayra ummatin ukh'rijat lilnnāsi tamurūna bil-maʿrūfi watanhawna ʿani l-munkari watu'minūna bil-lahi walaw āmana ahlu l-kitābi lakāna khayran lahum min'humu l-mu'minūna wa-aktharuhumu l-fāsiqūn
verses.english: You are the best community ever raised among the people: you advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and you believe in GOD. If the followers of the scripture believed, it would be better for them. Some of them do believe, but the majority of them are wicked.
verses.subtitle: The Best Community

1981.english: You are the best congregation ever established on earth; you advocate righteousness, forbid evil, and believe in God. If the people of the scripture believe in this, it will be better for them. Among them are believers, but the majority are wicked.

1989.english: You are the best community ever raised among the people: you advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and you believe in GOD. If the followers of the scripture believe, it will be better for them. Some of them do believe, but the majority are wicked.
1989.subtitle: The Best Community

verses.arabic: لَن يَضُرُّوكُمْ إِلَّآ أَذًى وَإِن يُقَٰتِلُوكُمْ يُوَلُّوكُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لن يضروكم إلا أذى ۖ وإن يقاتلوكم يولوكم الأدبار ثم لا ينصرون
verses.transliterated: lan yaḍurrūkum illā adhan wa-in yuqātilūkum yuwallūkumu l-adbāra thumma lā yunṣarūn
verses.english: They can never harm you, beyond insulting you. If they fight you, they will turn around and flee. They can never win.

1981.english: They can never harm you, beyond insult, and if they fight you, they will turn around and flee; they can never attain victory against you.\
1981.footnote: Historically, for as long as the Muslims upheld the Quran, and nothing but the Quran, they were victorious. When they turned to the invented sources of jurisprudence, such as "**Hadith**" and "**Sunna**," they lost their scientific, social, and military leadership. Compare the history of the first 250 years of Islam, with the Arab-Israeli wars.

1989.english: They can never harm you, except for insults. If they fight you, they will turn around and flee. They can never be victorious.

verses.arabic: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ أَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَحَبْلٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ضربت عليهم الذلة أين ما ثقفوا إلا بحبل من الله وحبل من الناس وباءوا بغضب من الله وضربت عليهم المسكنة ۚ ذلك بأنهم كانوا يكفرون بآيات الله ويقتلون الأنبياء بغير حق ۚ ذلك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون
verses.transliterated: ḍuribat ʿalayhimu l-dhilatu ayna mā thuqifū illā biḥablin mina l-lahi waḥablin mina l-nāsi wabāū bighaḍabin mina l-lahi waḍuribat ʿalayhimu l-maskanatu dhālika bi-annahum kānū yakfurūna biāyāti l-lahi wayaqtulūna l-anbiyāa bighayri ḥaqqin dhālika bimā ʿaṣaw wakānū yaʿtadūn
verses.english: They shall be humiliated whenever you encounter them, unless they uphold GOD's covenant, as well as their peace covenants with you. They have incurred wrath from GOD, and, consequently, they are committed to disgrace. This is because they rejected GOD's revelations, and killed the prophets unjustly. This is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

1981.english: They are condemned to humiliation wherever they are encountered (in war), unless they make a treaty with God and you. They have incurred God's wrath, and they are condemned to disgrace. That is because they used to disregard God's revelations, and slew the prophets unjustly. That is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

1989.english: Humiliation is their lot wherever they go, unless they abide by GOD’s covenant, and the people’s covenant. They incurred wrath from GOD. Consequently, they were committed to disgrace. This is because they rejected GOD’s revelations, and used to kill the prophets unjustly. This is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

verses.arabic: لَيْسُوا۟ سَوَآءً مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أُمَّةٌ قَآئِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليسوا سواء ۗ من أهل الكتاب أمة قائمة يتلون آيات الله آناء الليل وهم يسجدون
verses.transliterated: laysū sawāan min ahli l-kitābi ummatun qāimatun yatlūna āyāti l-lahi ānāa al-layli wahum yasjudūn
verses.english: They are not all the same; among the followers of the scripture, there are those who are righteous. They recite GOD's revelations through the night, and they fall prostrate.
verses.subtitle: Righteous Jews & Christians

1981.english: They are not all alike; among the people of the scripture there are those who are righteous. They recite God's scripture throughout the night, and they fall prostrate.
1981.subtitle: Righteous Jews and Christians

1989.english: They are not all the same; among the followers of the scripture, there are those who are righteous. They recite GOD’s revelations through the night, and they fall prostrate.
1989.subtitle: Righteous Jews & Christians

verses.arabic: يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر ويأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ويسارعون في الخيرات وأولئك من الصالحين
verses.transliterated: yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wayamurūna bil-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿani l-munkari wayusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wa-ulāika mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: They believe in GOD and the Last Day, they advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and they hasten to do righteous works. These are the righteous.

1981.english: They believe in God and the last day; they advocate righteousness and forbid evil; and they are eager to work righteousness; they are pious.

1989.english: They believe in GOD and the Last Day, they advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and they hasten to do righteous works. They are with the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَن يُكْفَرُوهُ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما يفعلوا من خير فلن يكفروه ۗ والله عليم بالمتقين
verses.transliterated: wamā yafʿalū min khayrin falan yuk'farūhu wal-lahu ʿalīmun bil-mutaqīn
verses.english: Any good they do will not go unrewarded. GOD is fully aware of the righteous.

1981.english: Whatever good they do will never go unrewarded. God is fully aware of those who are devout.

1989.english: Any good they do will not go unrewarded. GOD fully aware of who the righteous are.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم أموالهم ولا أولادهم من الله شيئا ۖ وأولئك أصحاب النار ۚ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū lan tugh'niya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum mina l-lahi shayan wa-ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieved can never be helped by their money or their children against GOD. They have incurred Hell, wherein they abide forever.

1981.english: As for those who disbelieve, neither their money, nor their children, will help them against God. They have deserved hell, wherein they abide forever.

1989.english: Surely, those who disbelieve will never be helped by their money or their children against GOD. They have incurred Hell, wherein they abide forever.

verses.arabic: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٍ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَأَهْلَكَتْهُ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنْ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: مثل ما ينفقون في هذه الحياة الدنيا كمثل ريح فيها صر أصابت حرث قوم ظلموا أنفسهم فأهلكته ۚ وما ظلمهم الله ولكن أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: mathalu mā yunfiqūna fī hādhihi l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamathali rīḥin fīhā ṣirrun aṣābat ḥartha qawmin ẓalamū anfusahum fa-ahlakathu wamā ẓalamahumu l-lahu walākin anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: The example of their accomplishments in this life is like a violent wind that hits the harvest of people who have wronged their souls, and wipes it out. GOD never wronged them; it is they who wronged themselves.

1981.english: The parable of their spending in this life is that of a violent storm that hits the harvest of people who had wronged their souls, and wipes it out. God is not the one who wronged them; it is they who wronged themselves.

1989.english: The example of their spending in this world is like a violent wind that hits the harvest of people who wronged their souls, and wipes it out. GOD never wrongs them; it is they who wrong themselves.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ بِطَانَةً مِّن دُونِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًا وَدُّوا۟ مَا عَنِتُّمْ قَدْ بَدَتِ ٱلْبَغْضَآءُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِى صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا بطانة من دونكم لا يألونكم خبالا ودوا ما عنتم قد بدت البغضاء من أفواههم وما تخفي صدورهم أكبر ۚ قد بينا لكم الآيات ۖ إن كنتم تعقلون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū biṭānatan min dūnikum lā yalūnakum khabālan waddū mā ʿanittum qad badati l-baghḍāu min afwāhihim wamā tukh'fī ṣudūruhum akbaru qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti in kuntum taʿqilūn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not befriend outsiders who never cease to wish you harm; they even wish to see you suffer. Hatred flows out of their mouths and what they hide in their chests is far worse. We thus clarify the revelations for you, if you understand.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Befriend Hypocrites

1981.english: O you who believe, do not trust and befriend outsiders who never cease to wish you harm and detriment. Hatred shows through their mouths, and what their hearts conceal is even worse. We thus explain the revelations for you, that you may understand.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not befriend outsiders who never cease to wish you harm, and wish to see you suffer. Hatred shows through their mouths, and what their chests hide is even worse. We have clarified the revelations for you, that you may understand.
1989.subtitle: Do Not Befriend Hypocrites

verses.arabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ عَضُّوا۟ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ قُلْ مُوتُوا۟ بِغَيْظِكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: ها أنتم أولاء تحبونهم ولا يحبونكم وتؤمنون بالكتاب كله وإذا لقوكم قالوا آمنا وإذا خلوا عضوا عليكم الأنامل من الغيظ ۚ قل موتوا بغيظكم ۗ إن الله عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: hāantum ulāi tuḥibbūnahum walā yuḥibbūnakum watu'minūna bil-kitābi kullihi wa-idhā laqūkum qālū āmannā wa-idhā khalaw ʿaḍḍū ʿalaykumu l-anāmila mina l-ghayẓi qul mūtū bighayẓikum inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: Here you are loving them, while they do not love you, and you believe in all the scripture. When they meet you they say, "We believe," but as soon as they leave they bite their fingers out of rage towards you. Say, "Die in your rage." GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1981.english: Here you are loving them, while they do not love you, and you believe in all the scripture. When they meet you, they say, "We believe," but when alone, they bite their fingers, due to rage towards you. Say, "Die in your rage." God is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1989.english: Here you are loving them, while they do not love you, and you believe in all the scripture. When they meet you they say, “We believe,” then as soon as they leave they bite their fingers out of rage towards you. Say, “Die in your rage.” GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: إِن تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَإِن تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَفْرَحُوا۟ بِهَا وَإِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن تمسسكم حسنة تسؤهم وإن تصبكم سيئة يفرحوا بها ۖ وإن تصبروا وتتقوا لا يضركم كيدهم شيئا ۗ إن الله بما يعملون محيط
verses.transliterated: in tamsaskum ḥasanatun tasu'hum wa-in tuṣib'kum sayyi-atun yafraḥū bihā wa-in taṣbirū watattaqū lā yaḍurrukum kayduhum shayan inna l-laha bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭu
verses.english: When anything good comes your way they hurt, and when something bad happens to you they rejoice. If you steadfastly persevere, and maintain righteousness, their schemes will never hurt you. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

1981.english: When you are blessed with something good, they grieve, and when disaster afflicts you, they rejoice. If you steadfastly persevere and maintain righteousness, their schemes will never harm you. God is fully aware of everything they do.

1989.english: When something good touches you they hurt, and when something bad happens to you they rejoice. If you steadfastly persevere, and maintain righteousness, their schemes will never hurt you. GOD controls everything they do.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَٰعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ غدوت من أهلك تبوئ المؤمنين مقاعد للقتال ۗ والله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: wa-idh ghadawta min ahlika tubawwi-u l-mu'minīna maqāʿida lil'qitāli wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: Recall that you (Muhammad) were among your people when you set out to assign to the believers their positions for battle. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: The Battle of Badr

1981.english: Recall that you were preparing the believers for battle, and God is hearer, knower.
1981.subtitle: The Battle of Badr

1989.english: Recall that you (Muhammad) set out to assign to your people their position for battle, and GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
1989.subtitle: The Battle of Badr

verses.arabic: إِذْ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمْ أَن تَفْشَلَا وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ همت طائفتان منكم أن تفشلا والله وليهما ۗ وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون
verses.transliterated: idh hammat ṭāifatāni minkum an tafshalā wal-lahu waliyyuhumā waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūn
verses.english: Two groups among you almost failed, but GOD was their Lord. In GOD the believers shall trust.

1981.english: Two groups among you almost failed, but God supported them. In God the believers shall trust.

1989.english: Two groups of you almost failed, and GOD was their Lord. In GOD the believers shall trust.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد نصركم الله ببدر وأنتم أذلة ۖ فاتقوا الله لعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: walaqad naṣarakumu l-lahu bibadrin wa-antum adhillatun fa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: GOD has granted you victory at Badr, despite your weakness. Therefore, you shall observe GOD, to show your appreciation.

1981.english: Thus, God granted you victory in the battle of Badr, despite your weakness. Therefore, you shall observe God, as a token of your appreciation.

1989.english: Thus, GOD gave you victory at Badr even though you were weak. You shall observe GOD, to show your appreciation.

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَن يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِثَلَٰثَةِ ءَالَٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُنزَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ تقول للمؤمنين ألن يكفيكم أن يمدكم ربكم بثلاثة آلاف من الملائكة منزلين
verses.transliterated: idh taqūlu lil'mu'minīna alan yakfiyakum an yumiddakum rabbukum bithalāthati ālāfin mina l-malāikati munzalīn
verses.english: You told the believers, "Is it not enough that your Lord supports you with three thousand angels, sent down?"
verses.subtitle: God's Angels Help the Believers
verses.footnote: Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran. Their total comes to 162146, 19x8534. This conforms with the Quran's mathematical miracle (See Appendix One).

1981.english: You (Muhammad) had said to the believers, "Is it not enough that God supports you with three thousand angels descending?"

1989.english: You told the believers, “Is it not enough that your Lord supports you with three thousand* angels, descending?”
1989.footnote: Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran. Their total comes to 162146, or 19x8534. This conforms with the Quran’s mathematical miracle.

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ ءَالَٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بلى ۚ إن تصبروا وتتقوا ويأتوكم من فورهم هذا يمددكم ربكم بخمسة آلاف من الملائكة مسومين
verses.transliterated: balā in taṣbirū watattaqū wayatūkum min fawrihim hādhā yum'did'kum rabbukum bikhamsati ālāfin mina l-malāikati musawwimīn
verses.english: Indeed, if you steadfastly persevere and maintain righteousness, then they attack you suddenly, your Lord will support you with five thousand angels, well trained.

1981.english: Indeed, if you steadfastly persevere and work righteousness, then they attack you, your Lord will support you with five thousand well-trained angels.

1989.english: Yes; if you steadfastly persevere and they attack you suddenly, your Lord will supply you with five thousand* angels, well trained.
1989.footnote: Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran. Their total comes to 162146, or 19x8534. This conforms with the Quran’s mathematical miracle.

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ لَكُمْ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: وما جعله الله إلا بشرى لكم ولتطمئن قلوبكم به ۗ وما النصر إلا من عند الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: wamā jaʿalahu l-lahu illā bush'rā lakum walitaṭma-inna qulūbukum bihi wamā l-naṣru illā min ʿindi l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
verses.english: GOD thus informs you, in order to give you good news, and to assure your hearts. Victory comes only from GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: God gave you this good news, in order to reassure your hearts. For victory comes only from God, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: GOD gives you this good news, to reassure your hearts. Victory comes only from GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ فَيَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَآئِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ليقطع طرفا من الذين كفروا أو يكبتهم فينقلبوا خائبين
verses.transliterated: liyaqṭaʿa ṭarafan mina alladhīna kafarū aw yakbitahum fayanqalibū khāibīn
verses.english: He thus annihilates some disbelievers, or neutralizes them; they always end up the losers.

1981.english: God thus eliminates some disbelievers, and confuses the rest, and defeats them.

1989.english: He thus annihilates some disbelievers, or neutralizes them, so they end up in failure.

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليس لك من الأمر شيء أو يتوب عليهم أو يعذبهم فإنهم ظالمون
verses.transliterated: laysa laka mina l-amri shayon aw yatūba ʿalayhim aw yuʿadhibahum fa-innahum ẓālimūn
verses.english: It is not up to you; He may redeem them, or He may punish them for their transgressions.

1981.english: It is not up to you (Muhammad); God may redeem them, or He may punish them if they are wicked.

1989.english: It is not up to you; He may redeem them, or punish them for their sins.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء ۚ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi yaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: To God belongs everything in the heavens and everything in the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟ أَضْعَٰفًا مُّضَٰعَفَةً وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تأكلوا الربا أضعافا مضاعفة ۖ واتقوا الله لعلكم تفلحون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takulū l-riba aḍʿāfan muḍāʿafatan wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall not take usury, compounded over and over. Observe GOD, that you may succeed.
verses.subtitle: Usury Prohibited
verses.footnote: Interest on bank deposits and interest charged on loans are lawful if they are not excessive (5-15%). Banks invest and their profits are passed on to the depositors. Since all parties are happy and no one is victimized, it is perfectly lawful to take interest from the bank (see 2:275).

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall not eat from usury, compounded manyfold, and observe God, that you may succeed.
1981.subtitle: Usury Prohibited

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall not take usury, compounded over and over. You shall observe GOD, that you may succeed.
1989.subtitle: Usury Prohibited
1989.footnote: Banks invest, and their net return on investment is almost invariably positive. The profits are passed on to the depositors. Since all parties are happy and no one is victimized, it is perfectly lawful to take interest from the bank (see Footnote 2:275).

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واتقوا النار التي أعدت للكافرين
verses.transliterated: wa-ittaqū l-nāra allatī uʿiddat lil'kāfirīn
verses.english: Beware of the hellfire that awaits the disbelievers.

1981.english: And beware of hell that awaits the disbelievers.

1989.english: Beware of the hellfire that awaits the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأطيعوا الله والرسول لعلكم ترحمون
verses.transliterated: wa-aṭīʿū l-laha wal-rasūla laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.english: You shall obey GOD and the messenger, that you may attain mercy.

1981.english: You shall obey God and his messenger, that you may attain mercy.
1981.subtitle: Attributes of the Righteous

1989.english: You shall obey GOD and the messenger, that you may attain mercy.

verses.arabic: وَسَارِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وسارعوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم وجنة عرضها السماوات والأرض أعدت للمتقين
verses.transliterated: wasāriʿū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā l-samāwātu wal-arḍu uʿiddat lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: You should eagerly race towards forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise whose width encompasses the heavens and the earth; it awaits the righteous,
verses.subtitle: Attributes of the Righteous

1981.english: And race towards forgiveness from your Lord, and a paradise that encompasses the heavens and the earth; it awaits the righteous.

1989.english: You should eagerly race towards forgiveness from your Lord, and a Paradise whose width encompasses the heavens and the earth; it awaits the righteous—
1989.subtitle: Attributes of the Righteous

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِى ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلْكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين ينفقون في السراء والضراء والكاظمين الغيظ والعافين عن الناس ۗ والله يحب المحسنين
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yunfiqūna fī l-sarāi wal-ḍarāi wal-kāẓimīna l-ghayẓa wal-ʿāfīna ʿani l-nāsi wal-lahu yuḥibbu l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: who give to charity during the good times, as well as the bad times. They are suppressors of anger, and pardoners of the people. GOD loves the charitable.

1981.english: who are charitable during the times of prosperity and the times of hardship. They control their anger, and they pardon the people. God loves those who are charitable.

1989.english: who give to charity during the good times and the bad times. They are suppressors of anger, and pardoners of the people. GOD loves the charitable.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَٰحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين إذا فعلوا فاحشة أو ظلموا أنفسهم ذكروا الله فاستغفروا لذنوبهم ومن يغفر الذنوب إلا الله ولم يصروا على ما فعلوا وهم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna idhā faʿalū fāḥishatan aw ẓalamū anfusahum dhakarū l-laha fa-is'taghfarū lidhunūbihim waman yaghfiru l-dhunūba illā l-lahu walam yuṣirrū ʿalā mā faʿalū wahum yaʿlamūn
