verses.english: If they fall in sin or wrong their souls, they remember GOD and ask forgiveness for their sins—and who forgives the sins except GOD—and they do not persist in sins, knowingly.

1981.english: When they fall into gross sin, or wrong their souls, they remember God and ask forgiveness for their sins; and who forgives the sins except God? They never persist in sinfulness, knowingly.

1989.english: If they fall in sin, or wrong their souls, they remember GOD and ask forgiveness for their sins— and who forgives the sins except GOD —and they do not persist in sinful acts, knowingly.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك جزاؤهم مغفرة من ربهم وجنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ۚ ونعم أجر العاملين
verses.transliterated: ulāika jazāuhum maghfiratun min rabbihim wajannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā waniʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīn
verses.english: Their recompense is forgiveness from their Lord, and gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. What a blessed reward for the workers!

1981.english: Their recompense is forgiveness from their Lord, and gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever; what a beautiful recompense for the workers.

1989.english: Their recompense is forgiveness from their Lord, and gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. What a blessed recompense for the workers!

verses.arabic: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قد خلت من قبلكم سنن فسيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين
verses.transliterated: qad khalat min qablikum sunanun fasīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīn
verses.english: Precedents have been set for you in the past; roam the earth and note the consequences for the unbelievers.
verses.subtitle: Victory for the Righteous

1981.english: Many generations have passed before you, so roam the earth and see the consequences for those who disbelieved.

1989.english: Precedents have been set for you in the past, so roam the earth and see the consequences for the rejectors.
1989.subtitle: Victory for the Righteous

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هذا بيان للناس وهدى وموعظة للمتقين
verses.transliterated: hādhā bayānun lilnnāsi wahudan wamawʿiẓatun lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: This is a proclamation for the people, and a guidance and enlightenment for the righteous.

1981.english: This is a declaration for the people, and a beacon and enlightenment for the righteous.

1989.english: This is a proclamation for the people, a beacon, and enlightenment for the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تهنوا ولا تحزنوا وأنتم الأعلون إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walā tahinū walā taḥzanū wa-antumu l-aʿlawna in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: You shall not waver, nor shall you grieve, for you are the ultimate victors, if you are believers.

1981.english: You shall not waver, nor shall you worry; you are guaranteed victory for as long as you are believers.

1989.english: You shall never waver, nor worry, for you shall be the victors, if you are believers.

verses.arabic: إِن يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ ٱلْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِّثْلُهُۥ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمْ شُهَدَآءَ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن يمسسكم قرح فقد مس القوم قرح مثله ۚ وتلك الأيام نداولها بين الناس وليعلم الله الذين آمنوا ويتخذ منكم شهداء ۗ والله لا يحب الظالمين
verses.transliterated: in yamsaskum qarḥun faqad massa l-qawma qarḥun mith'luhu watil'ka l-ayāmu nudāwiluhā bayna l-nāsi waliyaʿlama l-lahu alladhīna āmanū wayattakhidha minkum shuhadāa wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: If you suffer hardship, the enemy also suffers the same hardship. We alternate the days of victory and defeat among the people. GOD thus distinguishes the true believers, and blesses some of you with martyrdom. GOD dislikes injustice.

1981.english: If hardship afflicts you, your enemies are similarly afflicted. We alternate the days of war and peace among the people, in order to distinguish those who really believe, and to grant martyrdom to some of you. God is never unjust.

1989.english: If you suffer any hardship, the enemy also suffers the same hardship. We alternate the days of victory and defeat among the people. GOD thus distinguishes those who truly believe, and grants martyrdom to some of you. GOD does not love the unjust.

verses.arabic: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَمْحَقَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وليمحص الله الذين آمنوا ويمحق الكافرين
verses.transliterated: waliyumaḥḥiṣa l-lahu alladhīna āmanū wayamḥaqa l-kāfirīn
verses.english: GOD thus toughens those who believe and humiliates the disbelievers.

1981.english: God thus cleanses the believers, and annihilates the disbelievers.

1989.english: GOD thus toughens those who believe, and humiliates the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أم حسبتم أن تدخلوا الجنة ولما يعلم الله الذين جاهدوا منكم ويعلم الصابرين
verses.transliterated: am ḥasib'tum an tadkhulū l-janata walammā yaʿlami l-lahu alladhīna jāhadū minkum wayaʿlama l-ṣābirīn
verses.english: Do you expect to enter Paradise without GOD distinguishing those among you who strive, and without distinguishing those who are steadfast?
verses.subtitle: Our Claims Must Be Tested

1981.english: Did you expect to enter Paradise without God distinguishing those among you who struggle and steadfastly persevere?

1989.english: Do you expect to enter Paradise without GOD distinguishing those among you who strive, and without distinguishing those who steadfastly persevere?
1989.subtitle: Our Claims Must Be Tested

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كُنتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ ٱلْمَوْتَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَلْقَوْهُ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد كنتم تمنون الموت من قبل أن تلقوه فقد رأيتموه وأنتم تنظرون
verses.transliterated: walaqad kuntum tamannawna l-mawta min qabli an talqawhu faqad ra-aytumūhu wa-antum tanẓurūn
verses.english: You used to long for death before you had to face it. Now you have faced it, right before your eyes.

1981.english: You had longed for death before you faced it, and now you have faced it before your eyes.

1989.english: You claimed that you longed for death before you had to face it. Now you have seen it as you looked.

verses.arabic: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ أَفَإِي۟ن مَّاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ ٱنقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ وَمَن يَنقَلِبْ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَن يَضُرَّ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا وَسَيَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما محمد إلا رسول قد خلت من قبله الرسل ۚ أفإن مات أو قتل انقلبتم على أعقابكم ۚ ومن ينقلب على عقبيه فلن يضر الله شيئا ۗ وسيجزي الله الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: wamā muḥammadun illā rasūlun qad khalat min qablihi l-rusulu afa-in māta aw qutila inqalabtum ʿalā aʿqābikum waman yanqalib ʿalā ʿaqibayhi falan yaḍurra l-laha shayan wasayajzī l-lahu l-shākirīn
verses.english: Muhammad was no more than a messenger like the messengers before him. Should he die or get killed, would you turn back on your heels? Anyone who turns back on his heels, does not hurt GOD in the least. GOD rewards those who are appreciative.

1981.english: Muhammad is no more than a messenger like the messengers before him. Should he die or get killed, would you then turn back on your heels? Whoever turns back on his heels never hurts God, while those who are appreciative will be rewarded.

1989.english: Muhammad was no more than a messenger like the messengers before him. Should he die or get killed, would you turn back on your heels? Anyone who turns back on his heels, never hurts GOD in the least. GOD rewards those who are appreciative. Time of Death Predetermined

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تَمُوتَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ كِتَٰبًا مُّؤَجَّلًا وَمَن يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَن يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَسَنَجْزِى ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان لنفس أن تموت إلا بإذن الله كتابا مؤجلا ۗ ومن يرد ثواب الدنيا نؤته منها ومن يرد ثواب الآخرة نؤته منها ۚ وسنجزي الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna linafsin an tamūta illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi kitāban mu-ajjalan waman yurid thawāba l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā waman yurid thawāba l-ākhirati nu'tihi min'hā wasanajzī l-shākirīn
verses.english: No one dies except by GOD's leave, at a predetermined time. Whoever seeks the vanities of this world, we give him therefrom, and whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we bless him therein. We reward those who are appreciative.
verses.subtitle: Time of Death Predetermined

1981.english: No one will die except by God's leave, at a predetermined moment. Thus, whoever seeks the materials of this world, we will give him therefrom, and whoever seeks the rewards of the hereafter, we will give him therefrom. We will generously reward the appreciative.
1981.subtitle: Time of Death Predetermined

1989.english: No one dies except by GOD’s leave, at a predetermined time. Whoever seeks the rewards of this world, we give him therefrom, and whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we give him therefrom. We will reward those who are appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِىٍّ قَٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ فَمَا وَهَنُوا۟ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوا۟ وَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكأين من نبي قاتل معه ربيون كثير فما وهنوا لما أصابهم في سبيل الله وما ضعفوا وما استكانوا ۗ والله يحب الصابرين
verses.transliterated: waka-ayyin min nabiyyin qātala maʿahu ribbiyyūna kathīrun famā wahanū limā aṣābahum fī sabīli l-lahi wamā ḍaʿufū wamā is'takānū wal-lahu yuḥibbu l-ṣābirīn
verses.english: Many a prophet had godly people fight along with him, without ever wavering under pressure in the cause of GOD, nor did they hesitate or become discouraged. GOD loves the steadfast.

1981.english: Many a prophet was supported by devoted people. They never wavered when afflicted in the cause of God, nor did they weaken or falter. God loves the steadfast.

1989.english: Many a prophet had godly people fight with him, and they never wavered because of suffering in the cause of GOD, nor did they hesitate or become discouraged. GOD loves those who are steadfast.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان قولهم إلا أن قالوا ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا وإسرافنا في أمرنا وثبت أقدامنا وانصرنا على القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna qawlahum illā an qālū rabbanā igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wa-is'rāfanā fī amrinā wathabbit aqdāmanā wa-unṣur'nā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Their only utterance was, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins, and our transgressions, strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelievers."

1981.english: Their only utterance was, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins and transgressions, and strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelievers."

1989.english: Their only utterance was to say, “Our Lord, forgive us our sins, and our transgressions, strengthen our foothold, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

verses.arabic: فَـَٔاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَحُسْنَ ثَوَابِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فآتاهم الله ثواب الدنيا وحسن ثواب الآخرة ۗ والله يحب المحسنين
verses.transliterated: faātāhumu l-lahu thawāba l-dun'yā waḥus'na thawābi l-ākhirati wal-lahu yuḥibbu l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Consequently, GOD granted them the rewards of this world, and the better rewards of the Hereafter. GOD loves the good doers.

1981.english: Consequently, God blessed them with the rewards of this world, and the better rewards of the hereafter. God loves the good doers.

1989.english: Consequently, GOD granted them the rewards of this world, and the better rewards of the Hereafter. GOD loves the good doers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن تطيعوا الذين كفروا يردوكم على أعقابكم فتنقلبوا خاسرين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tuṭīʿū alladhīna kafarū yaruddūkum ʿalā aʿqābikum fatanqalibū khāsirīn
verses.english: O you who believe, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, then you end up losers.

1981.english: O you who believe, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, then you become losers.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you obey those who disbelieved, they would turn you back on your heels, then you become losers.

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلنَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بل الله مولاكم ۖ وهو خير الناصرين
verses.transliterated: bali l-lahu mawlākum wahuwa khayru l-nāṣirīn
verses.english: GOD alone is your Lord and Master, and He is the best supporter.

1981.english: God is your Lord; and He is the best supporter.

1989.english: GOD alone is your Lord and Master; He is the best supporter.

verses.arabic: سَنُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ بِمَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: سنلقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب بما أشركوا بالله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا ۖ ومأواهم النار ۚ وبئس مثوى الظالمين
verses.transliterated: sanul'qī fī qulūbi alladhīna kafarū l-ruʿ'ba bimā ashrakū bil-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wamawāhumu l-nāru wabi'sa mathwā l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: We will throw terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, since they set up besides GOD powerless idols. Their destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode for the transgressors!
verses.subtitle: God Controls Your Enemies

1981.english: We will throw terror into the hearts of the disbelievers, because they set up powerless idols to rank with God. Their ultimate destiny is hell, the wicked's miserable abode.
1981.subtitle: The Disbelievers Invariably Lose

1989.english: We will throw terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, because they set up besides GOD powerless idols. Their destiny is Hell. What a miserable abode for the wicked!
1989.subtitle: God Controls Your Enemies

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥٓ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذْنِهِۦ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَرَىٰكُم مَّا تُحِبُّونَ مِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد صدقكم الله وعده إذ تحسونهم بإذنه ۖ حتى إذا فشلتم وتنازعتم في الأمر وعصيتم من بعد ما أراكم ما تحبون ۚ منكم من يريد الدنيا ومنكم من يريد الآخرة ۚ ثم صرفكم عنهم ليبتليكم ۖ ولقد عفا عنكم ۗ والله ذو فضل على المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ṣadaqakumu l-lahu waʿdahu idh taḥussūnahum bi-idh'nihi ḥattā idhā fashil'tum watanāzaʿtum fī l-amri waʿaṣaytum min baʿdi mā arākum mā tuḥibbūna minkum man yurīdu l-dun'yā waminkum man yurīdu l-ākhirata thumma ṣarafakum ʿanhum liyabtaliyakum walaqad ʿafā ʿankum wal-lahu dhū faḍlin ʿalā l-mu'minīn
verses.english: GOD has fulfilled His promise to you, and you defeated them by His leave. But then you wavered, disputed among yourselves, and disobeyed after He had shown you (the victory) you had longed for. But then, some of you became distracted by the spoils of this world, while others were rightly concerned with the Hereafter. He then diverted you from them to test you. He has pardoned you. GOD showers the believers with His grace.
verses.subtitle: The Battle of Uhud

1981.english: God has fulfilled His promise to you, and you defeated them by His leave. Then, when you became negligent, and disputed among yourselves, and disobeyed despite the blessings He had bestowed upon you; some of you seeking this world, while others seeking the hereafter; He diverted you from them as a trial. He has pardoned you, for God is compassionate towards the believers

1989.english: GOD has fulfilled His promise to you, and you defeated them by His leave. But then you wavered, disputed among yourselves, and disobeyed after He had shown you (the victory) that you loved. Some of you became distracted by the spoils of this world, while others were concerned with the Hereafter. He then diverted you from them, to test you, and He has pardoned you. GOD showers His grace upon the believers.
1989.subtitle: The Battle of Uhud

verses.arabic: إِذْ تُصْعِدُونَ وَلَا تَلْوُۥنَ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٍ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ فِىٓ أُخْرَىٰكُمْ فَأَثَٰبَكُمْ غَمًّۢا بِغَمٍّ لِّكَيْلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا مَآ أَصَٰبَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ تصعدون ولا تلوون على أحد والرسول يدعوكم في أخراكم فأثابكم غما بغم لكيلا تحزنوا على ما فاتكم ولا ما أصابكم ۗ والله خبير بما تعملون
verses.transliterated: idh tuṣ'ʿidūna walā talwūna ʿalā aḥadin wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum fī ukh'rākum fa-athābakum ghamman bighammin likaylā taḥzanū ʿalā mā fātakum walā mā aṣābakum wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Recall that you rushed (after the spoils), paying no attention to anyone, even when the messenger was calling from behind you. Consequently, He substituted one misery for another, that you may not grieve over anything you had missed, or agonize over any hardship you had suffered. GOD is Cognizant of everything you do.

1981.english: You then fled, paying no attention to anyone; not even to the messenger who was calling you as you fled. Consequently, God afflicted you with a greater affliction that distracted you from the previous affliction. God is cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: Recall that you rushed (after the spoils), paying no attention to anyone, even when the messenger was calling from behind you. Consequently, He substituted one misery in place of another, that you might not grieve over what you missed, nor agonize over the hardship you suffered. GOD is Cognizant of everything you do.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْغَمِّ أَمَنَةً نُّعَاسًا يَغْشَىٰ طَآئِفَةً مِّنكُمْ وَطَآئِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ ظَنَّ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ يَقُولُونَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ مِن شَىْءٍ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُۥ لِلَّهِ يُخْفُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ مَّا قُتِلْنَا هَٰهُنَا قُل لَّوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَتْلُ إِلَىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ وَلِيَبْتَلِىَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أنزل عليكم من بعد الغم أمنة نعاسا يغشى طائفة منكم ۖ وطائفة قد أهمتهم أنفسهم يظنون بالله غير الحق ظن الجاهلية ۖ يقولون هل لنا من الأمر من شيء ۗ قل إن الأمر كله لله ۗ يخفون في أنفسهم ما لا يبدون لك ۖ يقولون لو كان لنا من الأمر شيء ما قتلنا هاهنا ۗ قل لو كنتم في بيوتكم لبرز الذين كتب عليهم القتل إلى مضاجعهم ۖ وليبتلي الله ما في صدوركم وليمحص ما في قلوبكم ۗ والله عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: thumma anzala ʿalaykum min baʿdi l-ghami amanatan nuʿāsan yaghshā ṭāifatan minkum waṭāifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yaẓunnūna bil-lahi ghayra l-ḥaqi ẓanna l-jāhiliyati yaqūlūna hal lanā mina l-amri min shayin qul inna l-amra kullahu lillahi yukh'fūna fī anfusihim mā lā yub'dūna laka yaqūlūna law kāna lanā mina l-amri shayon mā qutil'nā hāhunā qul law kuntum fī buyūtikum labaraza alladhīna kutiba ʿalayhimu l-qatlu ilā maḍājiʿihim waliyabtaliya l-lahu mā fī ṣudūrikum waliyumaḥḥiṣa mā fī qulūbikum wal-lahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: After the setback, He sent down upon you peaceful slumber that pacified some of you. Others among you were selfishly concerned about themselves. They harbored thoughts about GOD that were not right— the same thoughts they had harbored during the days of ignorance. Thus, they said, "Is anything up to us?" Say, "Everything is up to GOD." They concealed inside themselves what they did not reveal to you. They said, "If it was up to us, none of us would have been killed in this battle." Say, "Had you stayed in your homes, those destined to be killed would have crawled into their death beds." GOD thus puts you to the test to bring out your true convictions, and to test what is in your hearts. GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verses.subtitle: Moment of Death Predetermined

1981.english: After the affliction, He sent down upon you peaceful slumber to pacify some of you. Others, however, were more concerned about their own lives. They harbored thoughts about God that were not right, similar to those of the days of ignorance. They said, "Are we not supposed to control everything?" Say, "Everything is controlled by God." Thus, they harbored wrong thoughts, and concealed them from you. They said, "If it were really up to us, none of us would have been killed here?" Say, "Had you stayed in your homes, those destined to die would have crawled into their own death beds." God thus examines your intentions, and thoroughly exposes your innermost convictions. God is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1989.english: After the setback, He sent down upon you peaceful slumber that pacified some of you. Others were selfishly concerned about themselves. They harbored thoughts about GOD that were not true— the same thoughts they had harbored during the days of ignorance. Thus, they said, “Is anything up to us?” Say, “Everything is up to GOD.” They concealed inside themselves what they did not reveal to you. They said, “If anything were up to us, none of us would have been killed in this battle.” Say, “If you stayed in your homes, those destined to be killed would have crawled into their death beds.” GOD thus puts you to the test to bring out your true convictions, and to unveil what is in your hearts. GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
1989.subtitle: Moment of Death Fixed and Predetermined

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ مِنكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ إِنَّمَا ٱسْتَزَلَّهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين تولوا منكم يوم التقى الجمعان إنما استزلهم الشيطان ببعض ما كسبوا ۖ ولقد عفا الله عنهم ۗ إن الله غفور حليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna tawallaw minkum yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni innamā is'tazallahumu l-shayṭānu bibaʿḍi mā kasabū walaqad ʿafā l-lahu ʿanhum inna l-laha ghafūrun ḥalīmu
verses.english: Surely, those among you who turned back the day the two armies clashed have been duped by the devil. This reflects some of the (evil) works they had committed. GOD has pardoned them. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.

1981.english: Those of you who turned around and fled when the two armies clashed were simply duped by the devil, as a consequence of their sins. God has pardoned them, for God is forgiver, clement.

1989.english: Surely, those among you who turned back the day the two armies clashed have been duped by the devil, due to some (evil) works they had earned. GOD has pardoned them. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقَالُوا۟ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ إِذَا ضَرَبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ كَانُوا۟ غُزًّى لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ عِندَنَا مَا مَاتُوا۟ وَمَا قُتِلُوا۟ لِيَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ حَسْرَةً فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تكونوا كالذين كفروا وقالوا لإخوانهم إذا ضربوا في الأرض أو كانوا غزى لو كانوا عندنا ما ماتوا وما قتلوا ليجعل الله ذلك حسرة في قلوبهم ۗ والله يحيي ويميت ۗ والله بما تعملون بصير
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna kafarū waqālū li-ikh'wānihim idhā ḍarabū fī l-arḍi aw kānū ghuzzan law kānū ʿindanā mā mātū wamā qutilū liyajʿala l-lahu dhālika ḥasratan fī qulūbihim wal-lahu yuḥ'yī wayumītu wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verses.english: O you who believe, do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their kinsmen who traveled or mobilized for war, "Had they stayed with us, they would not have died or gotten killed." GOD renders this a source of grief in their hearts. GOD controls life and death. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their comrades who mobilized for war, "Had they stayed with us, they would not have died or gotten killed." God repaid them with sorrow in their hearts. God is the one who decides life and death, and God is seer of everything you do.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their kinsmen who traveled, or mobilized for war, “Had they stayed with us, they would not have died or gotten killed.” GOD renders this a source of grief in their hearts. GOD controls life and death. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن قُتِلْتُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن قتلتم في سبيل الله أو متم لمغفرة من الله ورحمة خير مما يجمعون
verses.transliterated: wala-in qutil'tum fī sabīli l-lahi aw muttum lamaghfiratun mina l-lahi waraḥmatun khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūn
verses.english: Whether you get killed or die in the cause of GOD, the forgiveness from GOD, and mercy are far better than anything they hoard.

1981.english: Whether you get killed in the cause of God, or die, God's forgiveness and mercy are far better than anything the others can hoard.

1989.english: Whether you get killed or die in the cause of GOD, the forgiveness from GOD, and mercy, are far better than anything they hoard.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن مُّتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن متم أو قتلتم لإلى الله تحشرون
verses.transliterated: wala-in muttum aw qutil'tum la-ilā l-lahi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: Whether you die or get killed, you will be summoned before GOD.

1981.english: Whether you die or get killed, you will ultimately be gathered before God.

1989.english: Whether you die or get killed, you will be summoned before GOD.

verses.arabic: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَٱنفَضُّوا۟ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فبما رحمة من الله لنت لهم ۖ ولو كنت فظا غليظ القلب لانفضوا من حولك ۖ فاعف عنهم واستغفر لهم وشاورهم في الأمر ۖ فإذا عزمت فتوكل على الله ۚ إن الله يحب المتوكلين
verses.transliterated: fabimā raḥmatin mina l-lahi linta lahum walaw kunta faẓẓan ghalīẓa l-qalbi la-infaḍḍū min ḥawlika fa-uʿ'fu ʿanhum wa-is'taghfir lahum washāwir'hum fī l-amri fa-idhā ʿazamta fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutawakilīn
verses.english: It was mercy from GOD that you became compassionate towards them. Had you been harsh and mean-hearted, they would have abandoned you. Therefore, you shall pardon them and ask forgiveness for them, and consult them. Once you make a decision, carry out your plan, and trust in GOD. GOD loves those who trust in Him.
verses.subtitle: The Messenger's Kindness
verses.footnote: The currency of the U.S.A. is the only currency that carries the phrase: "In God we trust." It is a fact that the American dollar has been the strongest currency in the world, and the standard by which all other currencies are measured.

1981.english: It was mercy from God that you (Muhammad) treated them compassionately. Had you been harsh and mean hearted, they would have abandoned you. Therefore, you shall pardon them, ask forgiveness for them, and consult them. Once you reach a decision, then carry it out, putting your trust in God. God loves those who trust in Him.

1989.english: It was mercy from GOD that made you compassionate towards them. Had you been harsh and mean-hearted, they would have abandoned you. Therefore, you shall pardon them, and ask forgiveness for them, and consult them. Once you make up your mind, then carry out whatever you planned to do, putting your trust in GOD. GOD loves those who trust in Him.

verses.arabic: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ وَإِن يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ينصركم الله فلا غالب لكم ۖ وإن يخذلكم فمن ذا الذي ينصركم من بعده ۗ وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون
verses.transliterated: in yanṣur'kumu l-lahu falā ghāliba lakum wa-in yakhdhul'kum faman dhā alladhī yanṣurukum min baʿdihi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūn
verses.english: If GOD supports you, none can defeat you. And if He abandons you, who else can support you? In GOD the believers shall trust.

1981.english: If God supports you, who can defeat you? And if He abandons you, who can support you? In God the believers shall trust.
1981.subtitle: The Believers Never Defeated

1989.english: If GOD supports you, none can defeat you. And if He abandons you, who else can support you? In GOD the believers shall trust.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَغُلَّ وَمَن يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان لنبي أن يغل ۚ ومن يغلل يأت بما غل يوم القيامة ۚ ثم توفى كل نفس ما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna linabiyyin an yaghulla waman yaghlul yati bimā ghalla yawma l-qiyāmati thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsin mā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: Even the prophet cannot take more of the spoils of war than he is entitled to. Anyone who takes more than his rightful share will have to account for it on the Day of Resurrection. That is when each soul is paid for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.
verses.subtitle: No One Above the Law

1981.english: No prophet shall take more than his rightful share of the spoils. Whoever takes more than his rightful share, will be held responsible for such earnings on the day of resurrection. That is when every soul will be repaid for whatever it has done, without the least injustice.

1989.english: Even the prophet cannot take more of the spoils of war than he is entitled to. Anyone who takes more than his rightful share will have to account for it on the Day of Resurrection. That is when each soul is paid for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضْوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَنۢ بَآءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن اتبع رضوان الله كمن باء بسخط من الله ومأواه جهنم ۚ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: afamani ittabaʿa riḍ'wāna l-lahi kaman bāa bisakhaṭin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: Is one who pursues GOD's pleasure the same as one who incurs wrath from GOD and his destiny is Hell, the most miserable abode?

1981.english: Is one who complies with God's wishes, equal to one who incurs God's wrath and his inevitable destiny is hell?

1989.english: Is one who seeks GOD’s approval the same as one who incurs wrath from GOD, and his destiny is Hell and a miserable abode?

verses.arabic: هُمْ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هم درجات عند الله ۗ والله بصير بما يعملون
verses.transliterated: hum darajātun ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūn
verses.english: They certainly occupy different ranks at GOD. GOD is Seer of everything they do.

1981.english: Certainly, they attain different ranks at God. God is seer of everything they do.

1989.english: They certainly occupy different ranks at GOD. GOD is Seer of everything they do.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: لقد من الله على المؤمنين إذ بعث فيهم رسولا من أنفسهم يتلو عليهم آياته ويزكيهم ويعلمهم الكتاب والحكمة وإن كانوا من قبل لفي ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: laqad manna l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna idh baʿatha fīhim rasūlan min anfusihim yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wa-in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: GOD has blessed the believers by raising in their midst a messenger from among them, to recite for them His revelations, and to purify them, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom. Before this, they had gone totally astray.

1981.english: It is a blessing from God upon the believers, that He has sent a messenger from among them, to recite His revelations to them, and sanctify them, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom. Before this, they had gone astray.

1989.english: GOD has blessed the believers by raising in their midst a messenger* from among them, to recite for them His revelations, and to purify them, and to teach them the scripture and wisdom. Before this, they had gone totally astray.
1989.footnote: For the exact identity of this messenger, please see Appendix 2.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمَّآ أَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُم مِّثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّىٰ هَٰذَا قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أولما أصابتكم مصيبة قد أصبتم مثليها قلتم أنى هذا ۖ قل هو من عند أنفسكم ۗ إن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: awalammā aṣābatkum muṣībatun qad aṣabtum mith'layhā qul'tum annā hādhā qul huwa min ʿindi anfusikum inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Now that you have suffered a setback, and even though you inflicted twice as much suffering (upon your enemy), you said, "Why did this happen to us?" Say, "This is a consequence of your own deeds." GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Yet, when a disaster afflicts you, even though you inflicted twice as much upon your enemy, you said, "Why did this happen to us?" Say, "Whatever happens is due to your own actions. God is omnipotent."

1989.english: Now that you have suffered a setback, and even though you have inflicted twice as much suffering {upon your enemy), you say, “Why did this happen to us?” Say, “This is a consequence of your own deeds.” GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أصابكم يوم التقى الجمعان فبإذن الله وليعلم المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wamā aṣābakum yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni fabi-idh'ni l-lahi waliyaʿlama l-mu'minīn
verses.english: What afflicted you the day the two armies clashed was in accordance with GOD's will, and to distinguish the believers.

1981.english: What afflicted you, when the two armies clashed, was in accordance with God's will, in order to distinguish the true believers;

1989.english: What afflicted you the day the two armies clashed was in accordance with GOD’s will, and to distinguish the believers.

verses.arabic: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ قَٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوِ ٱدْفَعُوا۟ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَّٱتَّبَعْنَٰكُمْ هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وليعلم الذين نافقوا ۚ وقيل لهم تعالوا قاتلوا في سبيل الله أو ادفعوا ۖ قالوا لو نعلم قتالا لاتبعناكم ۗ هم للكفر يومئذ أقرب منهم للإيمان ۚ يقولون بأفواههم ما ليس في قلوبهم ۗ والله أعلم بما يكتمون
verses.transliterated: waliyaʿlama alladhīna nāfaqū waqīla lahum taʿālaw qātilū fī sabīli l-lahi awi id'faʿū qālū law naʿlamu qitālan la-ittabaʿnākum hum lil'kuf'ri yawma-idhin aqrabu min'hum lil'īmāni yaqūlūna bi-afwāhihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yaktumūn
verses.english: And to expose the hypocrites who were told, "Come fight in the cause of GOD, or contribute." They said, "If we knew how to fight, we would have joined you." They were closer to disbelief then than they were to belief. They uttered with their mouths what was not in their hearts. GOD knows what they conceal.

1981.english: and to expose the hypocrites. Thus, they were told, "You shall fight for the cause of God, or contribute." But they said, "If we knew how to fight, we would have gone with you." They were closer to paganism then, than they were to belief. They utter with their mouths, what is not in their hearts, and God is fully aware of everything they conceal.

1989.english: And to expose the hypocrites who were told, “Come fight in the cause of GOD, or contribute.” They said, “If we knew how to fight, we would have followed you.” They were closer to disbelief than belief, on that day. They uttered with their mouths what was not in their hearts. GOD knows whatever they conceal.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ وَقَعَدُوا۟ لَوْ أَطَاعُونَا مَا قُتِلُوا۟ قُلْ فَٱدْرَءُوا۟ عَنْ أَنفُسِكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين قالوا لإخوانهم وقعدوا لو أطاعونا ما قتلوا ۗ قل فادرءوا عن أنفسكم الموت إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: alladhīna qālū li-ikh'wānihim waqaʿadū law aṭāʿūnā mā qutilū qul fa-id'raū ʿan anfusikumu l-mawta in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They said of their kinsmen, as they stayed behind, "Had they obeyed us, they would not have been killed." Say, "Then prevent your own death, if you are truthful."

1981.english: It is they who said of their comrades, as they stayed behind, "Had they obeyed us, they would not have been killed." Say, "Then prevent death from coming to you, if you are right."

1989.english: They said of their kinsmen, as they stayed behind, “Had they listened to us, they would not have been killed.” Say, “Then prevent your own death, if you are truthful.” Death: Simply Another Stage*

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَمْوَٰتًۢا بَلْ أَحْيَآءٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تحسبن الذين قتلوا في سبيل الله أمواتا ۚ بل أحياء عند ربهم يرزقون
verses.transliterated: walā taḥsabanna alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi amwātan bal aḥyāon ʿinda rabbihim yur'zaqūn
verses.english: Do not think that those who are killed in the cause of GOD are dead; they are alive at their Lord, enjoying His provisions.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous Do Not Really Die
verses.footnote: We learn from the Quran that the righteous do not really die; they simply leave their worldly bodies and go directly to the same Paradise where Adam and Eve once lived (2:154, 8:24, 16:32, 22:58, 44:56, & 36:26-27; see also Appendix 17).

1981.english: You shall not think of those who are killed in the cause of God as dead. Indeed, they are alive and well at their Lord.
1981.subtitle: Martyrdom: A Great Honor

1989.english: Do not think that those who are killed in the cause of GOD are dead; they are alive at their Lord, being provided for.
1989.footnote: Satan has abused this verse to dupe millions of people into setting up their prophets and saints (dead and powerless human creatures) as idols besides the Al mighty Creator. Please see Appendix 2 regarding the current status of God’s prophets.

verses.arabic: فَرِحِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَيَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَلْحَقُوا۟ بِهِم مِّنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فرحين بما آتاهم الله من فضله ويستبشرون بالذين لم يلحقوا بهم من خلفهم ألا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: fariḥīna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi wayastabshirūna bi-alladhīna lam yalḥaqū bihim min khalfihim allā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: They are rejoicing in GOD's grace, and they have good news for their comrades who did not die with them, that they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

1981.english: They rejoice in what God bestows upon them from His grace, and rejoice as well for their comrades who were not martyred with them; they too have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.\
1981.footnote: The period between death and resurrection passes on each one of us like one night of sleep (see 2:259 & Appendix 14). Since the martyrs occupy a special position in the hereafter, we should not think of them as dead. As pointed out in all the scriptures, the righteous attain eternal life (see Psalm 37:29, Matthew 22:32, Luke 10:25, and John 17:3).

1989.english: They rejoice in GOD’s grace, and they have good news for their comrades who did not die with them, that they have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

verses.arabic: يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يستبشرون بنعمة من الله وفضل وأن الله لا يضيع أجر المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yastabshirūna biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin wa-anna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-mu'minīn
verses.english: They have good news of GOD's blessings and grace, and that GOD never fails to reward the believers.

1981.english: They rejoice in God's blessings and grace, for God never neglects to reward the believers;

1989.english: They have good news of GOD’s blessings and grace, and that GOD never fails to reward the believers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْقَرْحُ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: الذين استجابوا لله والرسول من بعد ما أصابهم القرح ۚ للذين أحسنوا منهم واتقوا أجر عظيم
verses.transliterated: alladhīna is'tajābū lillahi wal-rasūli min baʿdi mā aṣābahumu l-qarḥu lilladhīna aḥsanū min'hum wa-ittaqaw ajrun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: For those who respond to GOD and the messenger, despite the persecution they suffer, and maintain their good works, and lead a righteous life, a great reward.

1981.english: who respond to God and the messenger, despite their afflictions. Those among them who maintained piety and led a righteous life have deserved a great recompense.

1989.english: For those who respond to GOD and the messenger, despite all kinds of hardship, and lead a righteous life, a great reward.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَٰنًا وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
verses.arabicClean: الذين قال لهم الناس إن الناس قد جمعوا لكم فاخشوهم فزادهم إيمانا وقالوا حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل
verses.transliterated: alladhīna qāla lahumu l-nāsu inna l-nāsa qad jamaʿū lakum fa-ikh'shawhum fazādahum īmānan waqālū ḥasbunā l-lahu waniʿ'ma l-wakīl
verses.english: When the people say to them, "People have mobilized against you; you should fear them," this only strengthens their faith and they say, "GOD suffices us; He is the best Protector."

1981.english: When the people tell them, "The people have mobilized to fight you, and you should fear them," their faith becomes even stronger, and they say, "God suffices us, and He is the best protector."

1989.english: When the people say to them, “People have mobilized against you; you should fear them,” this only strengthens their faith, and they say, “GOD suffices us; He is the best Protector.”

verses.arabic: فَٱنقَلَبُوا۟ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَّمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوٓءٌ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فانقلبوا بنعمة من الله وفضل لم يمسسهم سوء واتبعوا رضوان الله ۗ والله ذو فضل عظيم
verses.transliterated: fa-inqalabū biniʿ'matin mina l-lahi wafaḍlin lam yamsashum sūon wa-ittabaʿū riḍ'wāna l-lahi wal-lahu dhū faḍlin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: They have deserved GOD's blessings and grace. No harm ever touches them, for they have attained GOD's approval. GOD possesses infinite grace.

1981.english: Consequently, they were rewarded with blessings from God, and grace. No harm even touched them. They have followed God's commandments. God possesses unlimited grace.

1989.english: In return, they receive blessings from GOD, and grace. No harm touches them. For they have attained GOD’s approval, and GOD possesses infinite grace.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَآءَهُۥ فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما ذلكم الشيطان يخوف أولياءه فلا تخافوهم وخافون إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: innamā dhālikumu l-shayṭānu yukhawwifu awliyāahu falā takhāfūhum wakhāfūni in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: It is the devil's system to instill fear into his subjects. Do not fear them and fear Me instead, if you are believers.
verses.subtitle: Fear: The Devil's Tool

1981.english: It is the devil who instills fear into his friends. Do not fear them, and fear Me instead, if you are really believers.

1989.english: It is the devil’s system to instill fear into his subjects. Do not fear them, and fear Me instead, if you are really believers.
1989.subtitle: Fear: The Devil’s Tool

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَلَّا يَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ حَظًّا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحزنك الذين يسارعون في الكفر ۚ إنهم لن يضروا الله شيئا ۗ يريد الله ألا يجعل لهم حظا في الآخرة ۖ ولهم عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥzunka alladhīna yusāriʿūna fī l-kuf'ri innahum lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan yurīdu l-lahu allā yajʿala lahum ḥaẓẓan fī l-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Do not be saddened by those who hasten to disbelieve. They never hurt GOD in the least. Instead, GOD has willed that they will have no share in the Hereafter. They have incurred a terrible retribution.

1981.english: Do not be saddened by those who rush to disbelief; they can never harm God in the least. Instead, God will deprive them of any share in the hereafter, and they will suffer terrible retribution.

1989.english: Do not be saddened by those who hasten to disbelieve. They never hurt GOD in the least. GOD wills that they have no share in the Hereafter. They have incurred a terrible retribution.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلْكُفْرَ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين اشتروا الكفر بالإيمان لن يضروا الله شيئا ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ish'tarawū l-kuf'ra bil-īmāni lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Those who choose disbelief, instead of belief, do not hurt GOD in the least; they have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who choose disbelief, instead of belief, can never harm God in the least. They have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: Surely, those who buy disbelief at the expense of belief, do not hurt GOD in the least; they have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا نُمْلِى لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِّأَنفُسِهِمْ إِنَّمَا نُمْلِى لَهُمْ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِثْمًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحسبن الذين كفروا أنما نملي لهم خير لأنفسهم ۚ إنما نملي لهم ليزدادوا إثما ۚ ولهم عذاب مهين
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū annamā num'lī lahum khayrun li-anfusihim innamā num'lī lahum liyazdādū ith'man walahum ʿadhābun muhīnu
verses.english: Let not the disbelievers think that we lead them on for their own good. We only lead them on to confirm their sinfulness. They have incurred a humiliating retribution.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve should not think that we respite them because they are good; we only respite them to affirm their sinfulness. They will suffer humiliating retribution.

1989.english: Let not the disbelievers think that we lead them on for their own good. We only lead them on to augment and confirm their sinfulness; they have incurred a humiliating retribution.

verses.arabic: مَّا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّىٰ يَمِيزَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْتَبِى مِن رُّسُلِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان الله ليذر المؤمنين على ما أنتم عليه حتى يميز الخبيث من الطيب ۗ وما كان الله ليطلعكم على الغيب ولكن الله يجتبي من رسله من يشاء ۖ فآمنوا بالله ورسله ۚ وإن تؤمنوا وتتقوا فلكم أجر عظيم
verses.transliterated: mā kāna l-lahu liyadhara l-mu'minīna ʿalā mā antum ʿalayhi ḥattā yamīza l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wamā kāna l-lahu liyuṭ'liʿakum ʿalā l-ghaybi walākinna l-laha yajtabī min rusulihi man yashāu faāminū bil-lahi warusulihi wa-in tu'minū watattaqū falakum ajrun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: GOD is not to leave the believers as you are, without distinguishing the bad from the good. Nor does GOD inform you of the future, but GOD bestows such knowledge upon whomever He chooses from among His messengers. Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messengers. If you believe and lead a righteous life, you receive a great recompense.
verses.footnote: The end of the world is one example of future events revealed to God's Messenger of the Covenant. See Footnote 72:27.

1981.english: God never leaves the believers in the condition you are in, until the bad and the good are distinguished. Nor does God inform you of the future (regarding your ultimate rank), except for those whom He chooses as messengers. Therefore, you shall believe in God and His messengers. If you believe and lead a righteous life, you will merit a great recompense.
1981.subtitle: You Must Be Put To The Test

1989.english: GOD is not to leave the believers without putting them to the test: the bad must be sifted away from the good. Nor does GOD inform you of the future, except for the messengers whom GOD chooses for such knowledge. Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messengers. If you believe and lead a righteous life, you receive a great recompense.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ هُوَ خَيْرًا لَّهُم بَلْ هُوَ شَرٌّ لَّهُمْ سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحسبن الذين يبخلون بما آتاهم الله من فضله هو خيرا لهم ۖ بل هو شر لهم ۖ سيطوقون ما بخلوا به يوم القيامة ۗ ولله ميراث السماوات والأرض ۗ والله بما تعملون خبير
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna yabkhalūna bimā ātāhumu l-lahu min faḍlihi huwa khayran lahum bal huwa sharrun lahum sayuṭawwaqūna mā bakhilū bihi yawma l-qiyāmati walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīru
verses.english: Let not those who withhold and hoard GOD's provisions think that this is good for them; it is bad for them. For they will carry their hoardings around their necks on the Day of Resurrection. GOD is the ultimate inheritor of the heavens and the earth. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

1981.english: The stingy who hoard God's provisions to them should not think that hoarding is good for them. In fact, it is bad for them; for they will carry what they hoard around their necks on the day of resurrection. God is the one who ultimately inherits the heavens and the earth. God is fully cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: Let not those who withhold what GOD has bestowed upon them from His bounty think that it is good for them; it is bad for them. They will carry their hoardings around their necks on the Day of Resurrection. To GOD belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِيَآءُ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَالُوا۟ وَقَتْلَهُمُ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَنَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.arabicClean: لقد سمع الله قول الذين قالوا إن الله فقير ونحن أغنياء ۘ سنكتب ما قالوا وقتلهم الأنبياء بغير حق ونقول ذوقوا عذاب الحريق
verses.transliterated: laqad samiʿa l-lahu qawla alladhīna qālū inna l-laha faqīrun wanaḥnu aghniyāu sanaktubu mā qālū waqatlahumu l-anbiyāa bighayri ḥaqqin wanaqūlu dhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīq
verses.english: GOD has heard the utterances of those who said, "GOD is poor, while we are rich." We will record everything they said, just as we recorded their killing of the prophets unjustly, and we will say, "Suffer the retribution of Hell.
verses.subtitle: Humans Continue to Defy God

1981.english: God has heard the utterances of those who said, "God is poor, while we are rich." We will record everything they say, just as we recorded their killing of the prophets unjustly, and we will say, "Suffer the retribution of hell.

1989.english: GOD has heard the utterance of those who said, GOD is poor, and we are rich.” We record everything they say, just as we recorded their killing of the prophets unjustly. We will then say, “Suffer the agony of Hell.
1989.subtitle: Humans Continue to Defy God

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بما قدمت أيديكم وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد
verses.transliterated: dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīd
verses.english: "This is the consequence of your own works." GOD is never unjust towards the people.

1981.english: "This is the retribution for what your hands have sent forth. God is never unjust towards the creatures."

1989.english: “This is the consequence of your own works.” GOD is never unjust towards the creatures.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَآ أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَنَا بِقُرْبَانٍ تَأْكُلُهُ ٱلنَّارُ قُلْ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِى بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلَّذِى قُلْتُمْ فَلِمَ قَتَلْتُمُوهُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين قالوا إن الله عهد إلينا ألا نؤمن لرسول حتى يأتينا بقربان تأكله النار ۗ قل قد جاءكم رسل من قبلي بالبينات وبالذي قلتم فلم قتلتموهم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: alladhīna qālū inna l-laha ʿahida ilaynā allā nu'mina lirasūlin ḥattā yatiyanā biqur'bānin takuluhu l-nāru qul qad jāakum rusulun min qablī bil-bayināti wabi-alladhī qul'tum falima qataltumūhum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: It is they who said, "GOD has made a covenant with us that we shall not believe in any messenger, unless he produces an offering that gets consumed by fire." Say, "Messengers before me have come to you with clear proofs, including what you just demanded. Why then did you kill them, if you are truthful?"

1981.english: They also said, "God has enjoined us from believing any messenger, unless he shows us an offering consumed by holocaust." Say, "Messengers did come before me with profound signs, including what you just demanded; why did you slay them, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: It is they who said, “GOD has enjoined us from believing any messenger, unless he produces an offering that is consumed by fire.” Say, “Messengers before me did come to you with clear proofs, even with what you asked for, so why did you kill them, if you are truthful?”*
1989.footnote: For the exact identity of this messenger, please see Appendix Two.

verses.arabic: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ جَآءُو بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: فإن كذبوك فقد كذب رسل من قبلك جاءوا بالبينات والزبر والكتاب المنير
verses.transliterated: fa-in kadhabūka faqad kudhiba rusulun min qablika jāū bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wal-kitābi l-munīr
verses.english: If they reject you, messengers before you have been rejected, even though they brought proofs, the Psalms, and the enlightening scripture.

1981.english: If they disbelieve you, the messengers before you have been similarly disbelieved, despite the profound signs they brought, and the Psalms, and the enlightening scripture.

1989.english: If they reject you, messengers before you have been rejected. They brought proofs, the Psalms, and the enlightening scripture.

verses.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَمَن زُحْزِحَ عَنِ ٱلنَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
verses.arabicClean: كل نفس ذائقة الموت ۗ وإنما توفون أجوركم يوم القيامة ۖ فمن زحزح عن النار وأدخل الجنة فقد فاز ۗ وما الحياة الدنيا إلا متاع الغرور
verses.transliterated: kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wa-innamā tuwaffawna ujūrakum yawma l-qiyāmati faman zuḥ'ziḥa ʿani l-nāri wa-ud'khila l-janata faqad fāza wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūr
verses.english: Every person tastes death, then you receive your recompense on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever misses Hell, barely, and makes it to Paradise, has attained a great triumph. The life of this world is no more than an illusion.
verses.subtitle: A Great Triumph

1981.english: Everyone will taste death; then you get paid fully on the day of resurrection. Thus, the one who barely misses hell, and gets admitted into Paradise, has attained a great triumph. This life is no more than temporary illusion.

1989.english: Every soul is destined to taste death, and you receive your recompense on the Day of Resurrection. The one who barely misses Hell, and gets admitted into Paradise, has attained a great triumph. The life of this world is no more than an illusion.
1989.subtitle: A Great Triumph

verses.arabic: لَتُبْلَوُنَّ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ وَلَتَسْمَعُنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَذًى كَثِيرًا وَإِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.arabicClean: لتبلون في أموالكم وأنفسكم ولتسمعن من الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم ومن الذين أشركوا أذى كثيرا ۚ وإن تصبروا وتتقوا فإن ذلك من عزم الأمور
verses.transliterated: latub'lawunna fī amwālikum wa-anfusikum walatasmaʿunna mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wamina alladhīna ashrakū adhan kathīran wa-in taṣbirū watattaqū fa-inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūr
verses.english: You will certainly be tested, through your money and your lives, and you will hear from those who received the scripture, and from the idol worshipers, a lot of insult. If you steadfastly persevere and lead a righteous life, this will prove the strength of your faith.
verses.subtitle: The Inevitable Test
verses.footnote: After passing the admission tests, the proven worshipers of God ALONE enjoy a perfect life, now and forever. See 10:62, 24:55, and 29:2-3.

1981.english: You will have to undergo tests, by means of your properties and your lives, and you will hear from the people of previous scriptures, and from the idol worshipers, a lot of abuse. If you steadfastly persevere, and lead a righteous life, you will prove the strength of your faith.

1989.english: You will certainly be tested, through your money and your lives, and you will hear from those who received the scripture, and from the idol worshipers, a lot of insult. If you steadfastly persevere, and lead a righteous life, this will prove your strength.
1989.subtitle: The Inevitable Test
1989.footnote: After passing the admission tests, the proven worshipers of God ALONE enjoy a perfect life, nowand forever. See 10:62, 24:55, and 29:2-3.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُۥ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَكْتُمُونَهُۥ فَنَبَذُوهُ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذ الله ميثاق الذين أوتوا الكتاب لتبيننه للناس ولا تكتمونه فنبذوه وراء ظهورهم واشتروا به ثمنا قليلا ۖ فبئس ما يشترون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadha l-lahu mīthāqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba latubayyinunnahu lilnnāsi walā taktumūnahu fanabadhūhu warāa ẓuhūrihim wa-ish'taraw bihi thamanan qalīlan fabi'sa mā yashtarūn
verses.english: GOD took a covenant from those who received the scripture: "You shall proclaim it to the people, and never conceal it." But they disregarded it behind their backs, and traded it away for a cheap price. What a miserable trade.

1981.english: God has made a covenant with the people of the scripture, that they shall declare it to the people, and never conceal it. But they disregarded it behind their backs, and traded it away for a cheap price; what a miserable trade.

1989.english: GOD took covenant from those who received the scripture: “You shall proclaim the scripture to the people, and never conceal it.” But they disregarded it behind their backs, and traded it away for a cheap price. Miserable indeed is what they traded it for.

verses.arabic: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَآ أَتَوا۟ وَّيُحِبُّونَ أَن يُحْمَدُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا۟ فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّهُم بِمَفَازَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: لا تحسبن الذين يفرحون بما أتوا ويحبون أن يحمدوا بما لم يفعلوا فلا تحسبنهم بمفازة من العذاب ۖ ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: lā taḥsabanna alladhīna yafraḥūna bimā ataw wayuḥibbūna an yuḥ'madū bimā lam yafʿalū falā taḥsabannahum bimafāzatin mina l-ʿadhābi walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Those who boast about their works, and wish to be praised for something they have not really done, should not think that they can evade the retribution. They have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who are proud because of their charity givings, and wish to be praised for what they did not actually do (God is the one who provided them), will never evade the retribution; they have deserved a painful punishment.

1989.english: Do not think that those who boast about what they give, and wish to be praised for something they have not really done, do not think that they can evade the retribution; they have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولله ملك السماوات والأرض ۗ والله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: God is the one who possesses the dominion of the heavens and the earth. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: إن في خلق السماوات والأرض واختلاف الليل والنهار لآيات لأولي الألباب
verses.transliterated: inna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri laāyātin li-ulī l-albāb
verses.english: In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intelligence.
verses.subtitle: Those Who Possess Intelligence

1981.english: In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intelligence;
1981.subtitle: Overwhelming Signs of God

1989.english: Surely, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intelligence.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلًا سُبْحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يذكرون الله قياما وقعودا وعلى جنوبهم ويتفكرون في خلق السماوات والأرض ربنا ما خلقت هذا باطلا سبحانك فقنا عذاب النار
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yadhkurūna l-laha qiyāman waquʿūdan waʿalā junūbihim wayatafakkarūna fī khalqi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan sub'ḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba l-nār
verses.english: They remember GOD while standing, sitting, and on their sides, and they reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth: "Our Lord, You did not create all this in vain. Be You glorified. Save us from the retribution of Hell.
verses.footnote: Your god is whoever or whatever occupies your mind most of the time. The true believers are those who remember God most of the time. See 23:84-89 and Appendix 27.

1981.english: who commemorate God while standing up, sitting down, and lying on their sides. And they reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth. "Our Lord, You did not create all this in vain; glory be to You; so spare us the agony of hell.

1989.english: They remember GOD* while standing, sitting, and on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth: “Our Lord, You did not create all this in vain. Be You glorified. Spare us the agony of Hell.
1989.footnote: Your god on any given day is whoever or whatever occupies your mind most oi the time. The true believers are those who remember God more than 50% of the day, every day. See 23:84-89 and Appendix 27.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُۥ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا إنك من تدخل النار فقد أخزيته ۖ وما للظالمين من أنصار
verses.transliterated: rabbanā innaka man tud'khili l-nāra faqad akhzaytahu wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣāri
verses.english: "Our Lord, whomever You commit to Hell are the ones You have forsaken. Such transgressors have no helpers.

1981.english: "Our Lord, whomever You commit to hell is the real loser, and no one can help the wicked."

1989.english: “Our Lord, whomever You con demn to Hell, You have forsaken. The wicked have no helpers.

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا إننا سمعنا مناديا ينادي للإيمان أن آمنوا بربكم فآمنا ۚ ربنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وكفر عنا سيئاتنا وتوفنا مع الأبرار
verses.transliterated: rabbanā innanā samiʿ'nā munādiyan yunādī lil'īmāni an āminū birabbikum faāmannā rabbanā fa-igh'fir lanā dhunūbanā wakaffir ʿannā sayyiātinā watawaffanā maʿa l-abrār
verses.english: "Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to faith and proclaiming: 'You shall believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, forgive us our transgressions, remit our sins, and let us die as righteous believers.

1981.english: "Our Lord, we have hearkened to the caller who called to faith, saying, 'You shall believe in your Lord,' and we did believe. Therefore, forgive us our transgressions, our Lord, and remit our sins, and count us among the righteous when we die."

1989.english: “Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to faith, that: ‘You shall believe in your Lord,’ and we have believed. Our Lord, forgive us our transgressions, remit our sins, and let us be among the righteous when we die.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا وآتنا ما وعدتنا على رسلك ولا تخزنا يوم القيامة ۗ إنك لا تخلف الميعاد
verses.transliterated: rabbanā waātinā mā waʿadttanā ʿalā rusulika walā tukh'zinā yawma l-qiyāmati innaka lā tukh'lifu l-mīʿād
verses.english: "Our Lord, shower us with the blessings You promised us through Your messengers, and do not forsake us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break a promise."

1981.english: "Our Lord, grant us what you promised through Your messengers, and do not forsake us on the day of resurrection. Surely, You never break Your promise."

1989.english: “Our Lord, grant us what you promised us through Your messengers, and do not forsake us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break a promise.”

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّى لَآ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَٰمِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ بَعْضُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْضٍ فَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ وَأُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِى وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ وَقُتِلُوا۟ لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ثَوَابًا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلثَّوَابِ
verses.arabicClean: فاستجاب لهم ربهم أني لا أضيع عمل عامل منكم من ذكر أو أنثى ۖ بعضكم من بعض ۖ فالذين هاجروا وأخرجوا من ديارهم وأوذوا في سبيلي وقاتلوا وقتلوا لأكفرن عنهم سيئاتهم ولأدخلنهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار ثوابا من عند الله ۗ والله عنده حسن الثواب
verses.transliterated: fa-is'tajāba lahum rabbuhum annī lā uḍīʿu ʿamala ʿāmilin minkum min dhakarin aw unthā baʿḍukum min baʿḍin fa-alladhīna hājarū wa-ukh'rijū min diyārihim waūdhū fī sabīlī waqātalū waqutilū la-ukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim wala-ud'khilannahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru thawāban min ʿindi l-lahi wal-lahu ʿindahu ḥus'nu l-thawāb
verses.english: Their Lord responded to them: "I never fail to reward any worker among you for any work you do, be you male or female—you are equal to one another. Thus, those who immigrate, and get evicted from their homes, and are persecuted because of Me, and fight and get killed, I will surely remit their sins and admit them into gardens with flowing streams." Such is the reward from GOD. GOD possesses the ultimate reward.
verses.subtitle: God Responds

1981.english: Their Lord responds to these by saying, "I never neglect to recompense any worker among you, male or female; you are equal to each other. Thus, those who leave their homes, and those who are driven out of their homes, and those who suffer because of Me, and those who fought and got killed, I will certainly remit their sins, and admit them into gardens with flowing streams." Such is the reward from God; God possesses the best rewards.
1981.subtitle: Equality of Men and Women

1989.english: Their Lord responded to them: “I never fail to reward any worker among you for your work, be you male or female; you are equal to one another. Therefore, those who immigrate, and those who are evicted from their homes— those who are persecuted because of Me— and those who fight and get killed, I will surely remit their sins and admit them into gardens with flowing streams.” Such is the reward from GOD. GOD possesses the best reward.
1989.subtitle: God Responds

verses.arabic: لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verses.arabicClean: لا يغرنك تقلب الذين كفروا في البلاد
verses.transliterated: lā yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhīna kafarū fī l-bilād
verses.english: Do not be impressed by the apparent success of disbelievers.

1981.english: Do not be deceived by the apparent material successes of the disbelievers.

1989.english: Do not be impressed by the apparent success of disbelievers.

verses.arabic: مَتَٰعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.arabicClean: متاع قليل ثم مأواهم جهنم ۚ وبئس المهاد
verses.transliterated: matāʿun qalīlun thumma mawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-mihād
verses.english: They only enjoy temporarily, then end up in Hell; what a miserable destiny!

1981.english: They only attain a temporary material pleasure, then end up in hell and a miserable abode.

1989.english: They enjoy temporarily, then end up in Hell; a miserable destiny.

verses.arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلْأَبْرَارِ
verses.arabicClean: لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها نزلا من عند الله ۗ وما عند الله خير للأبرار
verses.transliterated: lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā nuzulan min ʿindi l-lahi wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun lil'abrār
verses.english: As for those who observe their Lord, they have deserved gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. Such is the abode given to them by GOD. What GOD possesses is far better for the righteous.

1981.english: As for those who observe their Lord, they have deserved gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever; in a glorious abode from God. God reserves better things for the righteous.

1989.english: But those who observe their Lord have deserved gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. Such is their abode from GOD. What GOD possesses is far better for the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَٰشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وإن من أهل الكتاب لمن يؤمن بالله وما أنزل إليكم وما أنزل إليهم خاشعين لله لا يشترون بآيات الله ثمنا قليلا ۗ أولئك لهم أجرهم عند ربهم ۗ إن الله سريع الحساب
verses.transliterated: wa-inna min ahli l-kitābi laman yu'minu bil-lahi wamā unzila ilaykum wamā unzila ilayhim khāshiʿīna lillahi lā yashtarūna biāyāti l-lahi thamanan qalīlan ulāika lahum ajruhum ʿinda rabbihim inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisāb
verses.english: Surely, some followers of the previous scriptures do believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They reverence GOD, and they never trade away GOD's revelations for a cheap price. These will receive their recompense from their Lord. GOD is the most efficient in reckoning.
verses.subtitle: Righteous Jews and Christians

1981.english: Among the Jews and the Christians, there are those who believe in God, and in this scripture, as well as their own scriptures. They are devoted to God, and they do not forsake the revelations of God for a cheap material gain. They have deserved their full recompense from their Lord, and God is most efficient in reckoning.

1989.english: Surely, some followers of the previous scriptures do believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed to them. They humble themselves before GOD, and they do not trade away GOD’s revelations for a cheap price. These have deserved their recompense at their Lord. GOD is the most efficient in reckoning.
1989.subtitle: Righteous Jews and Christians

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱصْبِرُوا۟ وَصَابِرُوا۟ وَرَابِطُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اصبروا وصابروا ورابطوا واتقوا الله لعلكم تفلحون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū iṣ'birū waṣābirū warābiṭū wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall be steadfast, you shall persevere, you shall be united, you shall observe GOD, that you may succeed.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall be steadfast; you shall persevere; you shall be ready; you shall observe God, that you may succeed.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall be steadfast, you shall persevere, you shall be united, and you shall observe GOD, that you may succeed.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَآءً وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى تَسَآءَلُونَ بِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة وخلق منها زوجها وبث منهما رجالا كثيرا ونساء ۚ واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون به والأرحام ۚ إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakumu alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wakhalaqa min'hā zawjahā wabatha min'humā rijālan kathīran wanisāan wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī tasāalūna bihi wal-arḥāma inna l-laha kāna ʿalaykum raqība
verses.english: O people, observe your Lord; the One who created you from one being, and created from it its mate, then spread from the two many men and women. You shall regard GOD, by whom you swear, and regard the parents. GOD is watching over you.
verses.footnote: This is the second longest sura, and the title indicates that it aims at defending the women's rights. Any interpretation must favor the women's rights, not the other way around.

1981.english: O people, you shall observe your Lord, who created you from one person, then created from him his mate, then from the two of them He spread many men and women. You shall observe God, whom you swear by, and regard the relatives. God is watching over you.

1989.english: O people, observe your Lord; the One who created you from one being and created from it its mate, then spread from the two many men and women. You shall regard GOD, by whom you swear, and regard the parents. GOD is watching over you.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا۟ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بِٱلطَّيِّبِ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حُوبًا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وآتوا اليتامى أموالهم ۖ ولا تتبدلوا الخبيث بالطيب ۖ ولا تأكلوا أموالهم إلى أموالكم ۚ إنه كان حوبا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: waātū l-yatāmā amwālahum walā tatabaddalū l-khabītha bil-ṭayibi walā takulū amwālahum ilā amwālikum innahu kāna ḥūban kabīra
verses.english: You shall hand over to the orphans their rightful properties. Do not substitute the bad for the good, and do not consume their properties by combining them with yours. This would be a gross injustice.
verses.subtitle: Regard the Orphans

1981.english: You shall give the orphans their due properties, and do not substitute the bad for the good, nor shall you consume their money by mixing their properties with yours. This would be a gross injustice.
1981.subtitle: The Orphans

1989.english: You shall hand over to the orphans their rightful properties. Do not substitute the bad for the good, nor shall you consume their properties by combining them with your properties. This is a gross injustice.

verses.arabic: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوا۟ فِى ٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ فَٱنكِحُوا۟ مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ مَثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا۟ فَوَٰحِدَةً أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُمْ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعُولُوا۟
verses.arabicClean: وإن خفتم ألا تقسطوا في اليتامى فانكحوا ما طاب لكم من النساء مثنى وثلاث ورباع ۖ فإن خفتم ألا تعدلوا فواحدة أو ما ملكت أيمانكم ۚ ذلك أدنى ألا تعولوا
verses.transliterated: wa-in khif'tum allā tuq'siṭū fī l-yatāmā fa-inkiḥū mā ṭāba lakum mina l-nisāi mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa fa-in khif'tum allā taʿdilū fawāḥidatan aw mā malakat aymānukum dhālika adnā allā taʿūl
verses.english: If you deem it best for the orphans, you may marry their mothers—you may marry two, three, or four. If you fear lest you become unfair, then you shall be content with only one, or with what you already have. Additionally, you are thus more likely to avoid financial hardship.
verses.subtitle: Grounds For Polygamy
verses.footnote: See Appendix 30 for a detailed discussion of polygamy.

1981.english: If you deem it in the best interest of the orphans (to give them a home), you may marry their mother if you like; you may marry two of them, or three, or four. However, if you feel that you may not be equitable, then one is enough, or be content with what you already have. This may be easier for you to afford.
1981.footnote: This is the only mention of polygamy in Quran, and it has to do with giving orphans a home with two parents. Due to ignorance, misunderstanding, and the invention of "**Hadith**," many Muslims are under the false impression that Islam limits polygamy to four wives. The fact is that the Quran, while recommending only one wife, does not place any limit on polygamy (see 4:3, 129). Ironically, those who claim that Islam, and specifically "**Hadith**," limits polygamy to four, seem to forget that the prophet left nine wives when he died.
