verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا۟ ٱلْأَمَٰنَٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا۟ بِٱلْعَدْلِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يأمركم أن تؤدوا الأمانات إلى أهلها وإذا حكمتم بين الناس أن تحكموا بالعدل ۚ إن الله نعما يعظكم به ۗ إن الله كان سميعا بصيرا
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yamurukum an tu-addū l-amānāti ilā ahlihā wa-idhā ḥakamtum bayna l-nāsi an taḥkumū bil-ʿadli inna l-laha niʿimmā yaʿiẓukum bihi inna l-laha kāna samīʿan baṣīra
verses.english: GOD commands you to give back anything the people have entrusted to you. If you judge among the people, you shall judge equitably. The best enlightenment indeed is what GOD recommends for you. GOD is Hearer, Seer.
verses.subtitle: Honesty & Justice Advocated

1981.english: God orders you to give back anything entrusted to you, and when you judge between the people, you shall judge equitably. Excellent indeed are God's commandments to you. God is hearer, seer.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Be Trustworthy

1989.english: GOD commands you to give back anything the people have entrusted to you. And when you judge among the people, you shall be fair. GOD enlightens you with the best commandments. GOD is Hearer, Seer.
1989.subtitle: Honesty & Justice Advocated

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَمْرِ مِنكُمْ فَإِن تَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى شَىْءٍ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول وأولي الأمر منكم ۖ فإن تنازعتم في شيء فردوه إلى الله والرسول إن كنتم تؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر ۚ ذلك خير وأحسن تأويلا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla wa-ulī l-amri minkum fa-in tanāzaʿtum fī shayin faruddūhu ilā l-lahi wal-rasūli in kuntum tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri dhālika khayrun wa-aḥsanu tawīla
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and you shall obey the messenger, and those in charge among you. If you dispute in any matter, you shall refer it to GOD and the messenger, if you do believe in GOD and the Last Day. This is better for you, and provides you with the best solution.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall obey God, and you shall obey the messenger and those in charge among you.\* If you dispute in any matter, you shall refer it to God and the messenger, if you truly believe in God and the last day. This is better for you, and provides you with the best solution.
1981.footnote: The messenger and those in charge shall be obeyed, because they uphold and apply the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and you shall obey the messenger and those in charge among you. If you dispute in any matter, you shall refer it to GOD and the messenger, if you believe in GOD and the Last Day. This is better for you, and provides you with the best solution.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَحَاكَمُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّٰغُوتِ وَقَدْ أُمِرُوٓا۟ أَن يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَيُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَن يُضِلَّهُمْ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر إلى الذين يزعمون أنهم آمنوا بما أنزل إليك وما أنزل من قبلك يريدون أن يتحاكموا إلى الطاغوت وقد أمروا أن يكفروا به ويريد الشيطان أن يضلهم ضلالا بعيدا
verses.transliterated: alam tara ilā alladhīna yazʿumūna annahum āmanū bimā unzila ilayka wamā unzila min qablika yurīdūna an yataḥākamū ilā l-ṭāghūti waqad umirū an yakfurū bihi wayurīdu l-shayṭānu an yuḍillahum ḍalālan baʿīda
verses.english: Have you noted those who claim that they believe in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed before you, then uphold the unjust laws of their idols? They were commanded to reject such laws. Indeed, it is the devil's wish to lead them far astray.
verses.subtitle: Believers Or Hypocrites?

1981.english: Have you noted those who claim that they believe in what was revealed to you, and what was revealed before you, and then apply the statutes of idols? They were enjoined from idol worship, but the devil misleads them completely.

1989.english: Have you noted those who claim that they believe in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed before you, then uphold the laws of idolatry? They were commanded to reject such laws, but it is the devil’s wish to lead them far astray.
1989.subtitle: Believers Or Hypocrites?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ رَأَيْتَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنكَ صُدُودًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم تعالوا إلى ما أنزل الله وإلى الرسول رأيت المنافقين يصدون عنك صدودا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālaw ilā mā anzala l-lahu wa-ilā l-rasūli ra-ayta l-munāfiqīna yaṣuddūna ʿanka ṣudūda
verses.english: When they are told, "Come to what GOD has revealed, and to the messenger," you see the hypocrites shunning you completely.

1981.english: When they are told, "Come to what God has revealed, and to the messenger," you see the hypocrites snubbing you completely.

1989.english: When they are told, “Come to what GOD has revealed, and to the messenger,” you see the hypocrites shunning you completely.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ جَآءُوكَ يَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَآ إِلَّآ إِحْسَٰنًا وَتَوْفِيقًا
verses.arabicClean: فكيف إذا أصابتهم مصيبة بما قدمت أيديهم ثم جاءوك يحلفون بالله إن أردنا إلا إحسانا وتوفيقا
verses.transliterated: fakayfa idhā aṣābathum muṣībatun bimā qaddamat aydīhim thumma jāūka yaḥlifūna bil-lahi in aradnā illā iḥ'sānan watawfīqa
verses.english: How will it be when a disaster hits them, as a consequence of their own works? They will come to you then and swear by GOD: "Our intentions were good and righteous!"

1981.english: Why then, when a disaster strikes them as a consequence of their own deeds, they come to you swearing by God that they meant well, and intended righteousness?

1989.english: How will it be when a disaster hits them, as a consequence of their own works? They will come to you then and swear by GOD, “Our intentions were honorable and righteous!”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَعِظْهُمْ وَقُل لَّهُمْ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ قَوْلًۢا بَلِيغًا
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين يعلم الله ما في قلوبهم فأعرض عنهم وعظهم وقل لهم في أنفسهم قولا بليغا
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna yaʿlamu l-lahu mā fī qulūbihim fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum waʿiẓ'hum waqul lahum fī anfusihim qawlan balīgha
verses.english: GOD is fully aware of their innermost intentions. You shall ignore them, enlighten them, and give them good advice that may save their souls.

1981.english: God is fully aware of their innermost intentions. You shall disregard them, and enlighten them, and give them valuable advice concerning their souls.

1989.english: GOD is fully aware of their innermost intentions. You shall ignore them, enlighten them, and give them good advice that may save their souls.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ إِذ ظَّلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ جَآءُوكَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ لَوَجَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا من رسول إلا ليطاع بإذن الله ۚ ولو أنهم إذ ظلموا أنفسهم جاءوك فاستغفروا الله واستغفر لهم الرسول لوجدوا الله توابا رحيما
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā min rasūlin illā liyuṭāʿa bi-idh'ni l-lahi walaw annahum idh ẓalamū anfusahum jāūka fa-is'taghfarū l-laha wa-is'taghfara lahumu l-rasūlu lawajadū l-laha tawwāban raḥīma
verses.english: We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed in accordance with GOD's will. Had they, when they wronged their souls, come to you and prayed to GOD for forgiveness, and the messenger prayed for their forgiveness, they would have found GOD Redeemer, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Unquestioning Submission: Quality of the True Believers

1981.english: We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed by God's leave. Had the people come to you when they wronged their souls, and asked God for forgiveness, and the messenger prayed for their forgiveness, they would have found God a merciful redeemer.
1981.subtitle: All Messengers Preached the Word of God
1981.footnote: See Deuteronomy 18:18-19, John 5-24, 8:42, and 13:49.

1989.english: We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed in accordance with GOD’s will. Had they, when they wronged their souls, come to you and prayed to GOD for forgiveness, and the messenger prayed for their forgiveness, they would have found GOD Redeemer, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: Unquestioning Submission: Quality of the True Believers

verses.arabic: فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِّمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: فلا وربك لا يؤمنون حتى يحكموك فيما شجر بينهم ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا مما قضيت ويسلموا تسليما
verses.transliterated: falā warabbika lā yu'minūna ḥattā yuḥakkimūka fīmā shajara baynahum thumma lā yajidū fī anfusihim ḥarajan mimmā qaḍayta wayusallimū taslīma
verses.english: Never indeed, by your Lord; they are not believers unless they come to you to judge in their disputes, then find no hesitation in their hearts whatsoever in accepting your judgment. They must submit a total submission.

1981.english: Never, by your Lord, will they be considered believers, unless they ask you to judge between them, then find no hesitation whatsoever in their hearts regarding your judgment, and unless they submit completely.

1989.english: Never indeed, by your Lord; they are not believers unless they come to you to judge in their disputes, then find no hesitation whatsoever in their hearts in accepting your judgment. They must submit a total submission.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّا كَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنِ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ أَوِ ٱخْرُجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِكُم مَّا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ فَعَلُوا۟ مَا يُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ تَثْبِيتًا
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنا كتبنا عليهم أن اقتلوا أنفسكم أو اخرجوا من دياركم ما فعلوه إلا قليل منهم ۖ ولو أنهم فعلوا ما يوعظون به لكان خيرا لهم وأشد تثبيتا
verses.transliterated: walaw annā katabnā ʿalayhim ani uq'tulū anfusakum awi ukh'rujū min diyārikum mā faʿalūhu illā qalīlun min'hum walaw annahum faʿalū mā yūʿaẓūna bihi lakāna khayran lahum wa-ashadda tathbīta
verses.english: Had we decreed for them: "You must offer your lives," or "Give up your homes," they would not have done it, except for a few of them. (Even if such a command was issued,) had they done what they were commanded to do, it would have been better for them, and would prove the strength of their faith.
verses.subtitle: God's Tests Are Never Unreasonable

1981.english: Had we decreed for them that they shall give their lives, or leave their homes, they would not have done it, except a few of them. Had they done whatever is enjoined upon them, it would have been better for them and more strengthening.
1981.subtitle: Submission Must Be Total

1989.english: Had we decreed for them: “Offer your lives,” or “Give up your homes,” they would not have done it, excepting a few of them. Had they done what they were commanded to do, it would have been better for them, and more strengthening.

verses.arabic: وَإِذًا لَّءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّن لَّدُنَّآ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا لآتيناهم من لدنا أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: wa-idhan laātaynāhum min ladunnā ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: And we would have granted them a great recompense.

1981.english: And we would have blessed them with a great recompense

1989.english: We would have granted them a great recompense.

verses.arabic: وَلَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولهديناهم صراطا مستقيما
verses.transliterated: walahadaynāhum ṣirāṭan mus'taqīma
verses.english: And we would have guided them in the right path.

1981.english: And we would have guided them in the straight path.

1989.english: And we would have guided them in a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ وَحَسُنَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ رَفِيقًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يطع الله والرسول فأولئك مع الذين أنعم الله عليهم من النبيين والصديقين والشهداء والصالحين ۚ وحسن أولئك رفيقا
verses.transliterated: waman yuṭiʿi l-laha wal-rasūla fa-ulāika maʿa alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna wal-ṣidīqīna wal-shuhadāi wal-ṣāliḥīna waḥasuna ulāika rafīqa
verses.english: Those who obey GOD and the messenger belong with those blessed by GOD—the prophets, the saints, the martyrs, and the righteous. These are the best company.
verses.subtitle: Equality of Believers

1981.english: Those who obey God and the messenger have deserved to be with those blessed by God, such as the prophets, the saints, the martyrs, and the righteous; what a great company.\
1981.footnote: Those who idolize the messengers refuse to believe this Quranic statement. They cannot believe that any human being possesses the God-given capability to be equal to, or even better than, any of God's messengers and prophets. They have to be freed from slavery to their idols, and from Satan's influence, before submitting and believing the word of God. By simply obeying God, and upholding His message, anyone of us will be with the prophets, the saints, the martyrs, and the righteous. See 18:65-78.

1989.english: Those who obey GOD and the messenger belong with those blessed< by GOD —the prophets, the saints, the martyrs, and the righteous. These are the best company.
1989.subtitle: Equality of Believers

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَضْلُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ذلك الفضل من الله ۚ وكفى بالله عليما
verses.transliterated: dhālika l-faḍlu mina l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi ʿalīma
verses.english: Such is the blessing from GOD; GOD is the best Knower.

1981.english: This is the real grace from God, and God is the best knower.

1989.english: Such is the blessing from GOD; GOD is the Best Knower.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ خُذُوا۟ حِذْرَكُمْ فَٱنفِرُوا۟ ثُبَاتٍ أَوِ ٱنفِرُوا۟ جَمِيعًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا خذوا حذركم فانفروا ثبات أو انفروا جميعا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū khudhū ḥidh'rakum fa-infirū thubātin awi infirū jamīʿa
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall remain alert, and mobilize as individuals, or mobilize all together.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall be prepared, and mobilize yourselves for war, either in groups, or in one group.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall remain alert, and mobilize as individuals or mobilize all together.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِنكُمْ لَمَن لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ فَإِنْ أَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالَ قَدْ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىَّ إِذْ لَمْ أَكُن مَّعَهُمْ شَهِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: وإن منكم لمن ليبطئن فإن أصابتكم مصيبة قال قد أنعم الله علي إذ لم أكن معهم شهيدا
verses.transliterated: wa-inna minkum laman layubaṭṭi-anna fa-in aṣābatkum muṣībatun qāla qad anʿama l-lahu ʿalayya idh lam akun maʿahum shahīda
verses.english: Surely, there are those among you who would drag their feet, then, if a setback afflicts you, they would say, "GOD has blessed me that I was not martyred with them."

1981.english: Some of you will surely drag their feet. Then, if a disaster afflicts you, they would say, "God has blessed me, that I was not martyred with them."

1989.english: Surely, there is always the one who drags his feet, then, if a setback befalls you, he says, “GOD has blessed me that I was not martyred with them.”

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَصَٰبَكُمْ فَضْلٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لَيَقُولَنَّ كَأَن لَّمْ تَكُنۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُۥ مَوَدَّةٌ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ مَعَهُمْ فَأَفُوزَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أصابكم فضل من الله ليقولن كأن لم تكن بينكم وبينه مودة يا ليتني كنت معهم فأفوز فوزا عظيما
verses.transliterated: wala-in aṣābakum faḍlun mina l-lahi layaqūlanna ka-an lam takun baynakum wabaynahu mawaddatun yālaytanī kuntu maʿahum fa-afūza fawzan ʿaẓīma
verses.english: But if you attain a blessing from GOD, they would say, as if no friendship ever existed between you and them, "I wish I was with them, so I could share in such a great victory."

1981.english: But when victory comes to you from God, he would say, as if no friendship was lost between you and him, "I wish I was with them to share in this great victory."

1989.english: But if you attain a blessing from GOD, he would say, as if no friendship ever existed between you and him, “I wish I were with them, so I could share in such a great victory.”

verses.arabic: فَلْيُقَٰتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَن يُقَٰتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيُقْتَلْ أَوْ يَغْلِبْ فَسَوْفَ نُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: فليقاتل في سبيل الله الذين يشرون الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة ۚ ومن يقاتل في سبيل الله فيقتل أو يغلب فسوف نؤتيه أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: falyuqātil fī sabīli l-lahi alladhīna yashrūna l-ḥayata l-dun'yā bil-ākhirati waman yuqātil fī sabīli l-lahi fayuq'tal aw yaghlib fasawfa nu'tīhi ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Those who readily fight in the cause of GOD are those who forsake this world in favor of the Hereafter. Whoever fights in the cause of GOD, then gets killed, or attains victory, we will surely grant him a great recompense.

1981.english: Let those fight in the cause of God who choose the hereafter in preference to this life. Whoever fights in the cause of God, then either gets killed, or wins, we will certainly bless him with a great recompense.

1989.english: Those who readily fight in the cause of GOD are those who forsake this world in favor of the Hereafter. Whoever fights in the cause of GOD, then gets killed, or attains victory, we will surely grant him a great recompense.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْوِلْدَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَٱجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَٱجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وما لكم لا تقاتلون في سبيل الله والمستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولدان الذين يقولون ربنا أخرجنا من هذه القرية الظالم أهلها واجعل لنا من لدنك وليا واجعل لنا من لدنك نصيرا
verses.transliterated: wamā lakum lā tuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi wal-mus'taḍʿafīna mina l-rijāli wal-nisāi wal-wil'dāni alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā akhrij'nā min hādhihi l-qaryati l-ẓālimi ahluhā wa-ij'ʿal lanā min ladunka waliyyan wa-ij'ʿal lanā min ladunka naṣīra
verses.english: Why should you not fight in the cause of GOD when weak men, women, and children are imploring: "Our Lord, deliver us from this community whose people are oppressive, and be You our Lord and Master."
verses.subtitle: The Believers are Fearless

1981.english: Why should you not fight in the cause of God, when the oppressed men, women, and children are crying out, "Our Lord, deliever us from this community whose people are unjust, and make us worthy of having You as our protector, and make us worthy of having You as our supporter.

1989.english: Why should you not fight in the cause of GOD when weak men, women, and children are imploring: “Our Lord, deliver us from this community whose people are oppressive, and be You our Lord and Master.”
1989.subtitle: The Believers are Fearless

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱلطَّٰغُوتِ فَقَٰتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ إِنَّ كَيْدَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ كَانَ ضَعِيفًا
verses.arabicClean: الذين آمنوا يقاتلون في سبيل الله ۖ والذين كفروا يقاتلون في سبيل الطاغوت فقاتلوا أولياء الشيطان ۖ إن كيد الشيطان كان ضعيفا
verses.transliterated: alladhīna āmanū yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna kafarū yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-ṭāghūti faqātilū awliyāa l-shayṭāni inna kayda l-shayṭāni kāna ḍaʿīfa
verses.english: Those who believe are fighting for the cause of GOD, while those who disbelieve are fighting for the cause of tyranny. Therefore, you shall fight the devil's allies; the devil's power is nil.

1981.english: Those who believe are fighting in the cause of God, while those who disbelieve are fighting in the cause of idols. Therefore, you shall fight the devil's allies, for surely, the devil's power is feeble.

1989.english: Those who believe are fighting for the cause of GOD, while those who disbelieve are fighting for the cause of idolatry. Therefore, fight the devil’s allies; the devil’s power is nil.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ قِيلَ لَهُمْ كُفُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَخْشَوْنَ ٱلنَّاسَ كَخَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَشَدَّ خَشْيَةً وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لِمَ كَتَبْتَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْقِتَالَ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ قُلْ مَتَٰعُ ٱلدُّنْيَا قَلِيلٌ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر إلى الذين قيل لهم كفوا أيديكم وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة فلما كتب عليهم القتال إذا فريق منهم يخشون الناس كخشية الله أو أشد خشية ۚ وقالوا ربنا لم كتبت علينا القتال لولا أخرتنا إلى أجل قريب ۗ قل متاع الدنيا قليل والآخرة خير لمن اتقى ولا تظلمون فتيلا
verses.transliterated: alam tara ilā alladhīna qīla lahum kuffū aydiyakum wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata falammā kutiba ʿalayhimu l-qitālu idhā farīqun min'hum yakhshawna l-nāsa kakhashyati l-lahi aw ashadda khashyatan waqālū rabbanā lima katabta ʿalaynā l-qitāla lawlā akhartanā ilā ajalin qarībin qul matāʿu l-dun'yā qalīlun wal-ākhiratu khayrun limani ittaqā walā tuẓ'lamūna fatīla
verses.english: Have you noted those who were told, "You do not have to fight; all you need to do is observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat)," then, when fighting was decreed for them, they feared the people as much as they feared GOD, or even more? They said, "Our Lord, why did You force this fighting on us? If only You respite us for awhile!" Say, "The materials of this world are nil, while the Hereafter is far better for the righteous, and you never suffer the slightest injustice."

1981.english: Have you noted those who were told, "Do not fight, and observe the **salat** prayers and give the **zakat** charity," then, when fighting was decreed for them, some of them feared the people the same as fearing God, or even more? They said, "Our Lord, why did You decree fighting for us? Would You postpone this to another time?" Say, "The material of this world is nil, while the hereafter is far better for those who lead a righteous life. No one will suffer the least injustice."
1981.subtitle: You Shall Be Courageous

1989.english: Have you noted those who were told, “You do not have to fight; just observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat),” then, when fighting was decreed for them, they feared the people as much as they feared GOD, or even more? They said, “Our Lord, why did You force this fighting on us? If only You respite us for awhile!” Say, “The materials of this world are nil, while the Hereafter is far better for the righteous; you do not incur the slightest injustice.” Death Already Predetermined

verses.arabic: أَيْنَمَا تَكُونُوا۟ يُدْرِككُّمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُرُوجٍ مُّشَيَّدَةٍ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ حَسَنَةٌ يَقُولُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَقُولُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنْ عِندِكَ قُلْ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَالِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلْقَوْمِ لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ حَدِيثًا
verses.arabicClean: أينما تكونوا يدرككم الموت ولو كنتم في بروج مشيدة ۗ وإن تصبهم حسنة يقولوا هذه من عند الله ۖ وإن تصبهم سيئة يقولوا هذه من عندك ۚ قل كل من عند الله ۖ فمال هؤلاء القوم لا يكادون يفقهون حديثا
verses.transliterated: aynamā takūnū yud'rikkumu l-mawtu walaw kuntum fī burūjin mushayyadatin wa-in tuṣib'hum ḥasanatun yaqūlū hādhihi min ʿindi l-lahi wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun yaqūlū hādhihi min ʿindika qul kullun min ʿindi l-lahi famāli hāulāi l-qawmi lā yakādūna yafqahūna ḥadītha
verses.english: Wherever you are, death will catch up with you, even if you live in formidable castles. When something good happens to them, they say, "This is from GOD," and when something bad afflicts them, they blame you. Say, "Everything comes from GOD." Why do these people misunderstand almost everything?
verses.subtitle: God is the Doer of Everything
verses.footnote: Bad things are consequences of our own deeds (42:30, 64:11), though God is the doer of everything (8:17). God created the fire to serve us, but you can decide to put your finger in it. We thus hurt ourselves. It is God's law that if you put your finger in the fire, it will hurt.

1981.english: Wherever you may be, death will catch up with you, even if you are in formidable castles. When something good happens to them, they say, "This is from God," and when something bad happens to them, they say, "This is because of you." Say, "All things come from God." What is wrong with these people, that they can hardly understand any preaching?

1989.english: Wherever you are, death will catch up with you, even if you live in formidable castles. When something good happens to them, they say, “This is from GOD,” and when something bad befalls them, they blame you. Say, “Everything comes from GOD.” Is it not a fact that these people fail to understand any statement?

verses.arabic: مَّآ أَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِن نَّفْسِكَ وَأَرْسَلْنَٰكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولًا وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: ما أصابك من حسنة فمن الله ۖ وما أصابك من سيئة فمن نفسك ۚ وأرسلناك للناس رسولا ۚ وكفى بالله شهيدا
verses.transliterated: mā aṣābaka min ḥasanatin famina l-lahi wamā aṣābaka min sayyi-atin famin nafsika wa-arsalnāka lilnnāsi rasūlan wakafā bil-lahi shahīda
verses.english: Anything good that happens to you is from GOD, and anything bad that happens to you is from you. We have sent you as a messenger to the people, and GOD suffices as witness.
verses.subtitle: Nothing Bad Comes From God
verses.footnote: Muhammad was not given any proof of prophethood. Hence the expression "God suffices as a witness" (29:51-52). The gematrical value of "Muhammad" is 92, and 92 + 79 = 171 = 19 x 9.

1981.english: Whatever good that happens to you, is from God. Whatever bad that happens to you is a consequence of your own work. We have sent you to the people as a messenger. God suffices as witness.

1989.english: Anything good that happens to you is from GOD, and anything bad that happens to you is from you.* We have sent you as a messenger to the people, and GOD suffices as witness.
1989.subtitle: Nothing Bad Comes From God
1989.footnote: Bearing in mind that God is the ultimate doer of everything (4:78 & 8:17), bad things are strictly a consequence of our own deeds (42:30, 64:11).

verses.arabic: مَّن يُطِعِ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ ٱللَّهَ وَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا
verses.arabicClean: من يطع الرسول فقد أطاع الله ۖ ومن تولى فما أرسلناك عليهم حفيظا
verses.transliterated: man yuṭiʿi l-rasūla faqad aṭāʿa l-laha waman tawallā famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓa
verses.english: Whoever obeys the messenger is obeying GOD. As for those who turn away, we did not send you as their guardian.

1981.english: Whoever obeys the messenger is obeying God.\* As for those who turn away, we have not appointed you as their guardian.
1981.footnote: Throughout the Bible and the Quran, we are told that the messengers "do not speak on their own." Thus, when we uphold the message given to us through the messengers (Moses, Jesus, David, Muhammad), we will be upholding the word of God. Muhammad is fully represented by Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran.

1989.english: Whoever obeys the messenger is obeying GOD. As for those who turn away, we did not send you as their guardian.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ طَاعَةٌ فَإِذَا بَرَزُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ بَيَّتَ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى تَقُولُ وَٱللَّهُ يَكْتُبُ مَا يُبَيِّتُونَ فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ويقولون طاعة فإذا برزوا من عندك بيت طائفة منهم غير الذي تقول ۖ والله يكتب ما يبيتون ۖ فأعرض عنهم وتوكل على الله ۚ وكفى بالله وكيلا
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlūna ṭāʿatun fa-idhā barazū min ʿindika bayyata ṭāifatun min'hum ghayra alladhī taqūlu wal-lahu yaktubu mā yubayyitūna fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīla
verses.english: They pledge obedience, but as soon as they leave you, some of them harbor intentions contrary to what they say. GOD records their innermost intentions. You shall disregard them, and put your trust in GOD. GOD suffices as an advocate.

1981.english: They claim obedience, then, as soon as they leave you, some of them harbor intentions contrary to what they say. God records their innermost intentions. Therefore, you shall disregard them, and trust in God; God suffices as trustee.

1989.english: They pledge obedience, but when they leave you, some of them harbor intentions contrary to what they say. GOD records their innermost intentions. Therefore, you shall disregard them, and put your trust in GOD. GOD suffices as an advocate.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ وَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ غَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا۟ فِيهِ ٱخْتِلَٰفًا كَثِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: أفلا يتدبرون القرآن ۚ ولو كان من عند غير الله لوجدوا فيه اختلافا كثيرا
verses.transliterated: afalā yatadabbarūna l-qur'āna walaw kāna min ʿindi ghayri l-lahi lawajadū fīhi ikh'tilāfan kathīra
verses.english: Why do they not study the Quran carefully? If it were from other than GOD, they would have found in it numerous contradictions.
verses.subtitle: Proof of Divine Authorship
verses.footnote: Although the Quran was revealed during the dark ages, you cannot find any nonsense in it; another proof of divine authorship (see the Introduction and App. 1).

1981.english: Why do they not study the Quran carefully? If it were from other than God, they would have found many contradictions therein.
1981.subtitle: Proof Of Divine Revelation

1989.english: Why do they not study the Quran carefully? If it were from other than GOD, they would have found in it many contradictions.*
1989.subtitle: Proof of Divine Authorship
1989.footnote: Although the Quran was revealed during the dark ages, you cannot find any nonsense in it; another proof of divine authorship (see the Introduction and App. 1).

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْنِ أَوِ ٱلْخَوْفِ أَذَاعُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلَوْ رَدُّوهُ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِلَىٰٓ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَمْرِ مِنْهُمْ لَعَلِمَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَنۢبِطُونَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ لَٱتَّبَعْتُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا جاءهم أمر من الأمن أو الخوف أذاعوا به ۖ ولو ردوه إلى الرسول وإلى أولي الأمر منهم لعلمه الذين يستنبطونه منهم ۗ ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته لاتبعتم الشيطان إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā jāahum amrun mina l-amni awi l-khawfi adhāʿū bihi walaw raddūhu ilā l-rasūli wa-ilā ulī l-amri min'hum laʿalimahu alladhīna yastanbiṭūnahu min'hum walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu la-ittabaʿtumu l-shayṭāna illā qalīla
verses.english: When a rumor that affects security comes their way, they spread it. Had they referred it to the messenger, and those in charge among them, those who understand these matters would have informed them. If it were not for GOD's grace towards you, and His mercy, you would have followed the devil, except a few.
verses.subtitle: Beware of the Devil's Rumors

1981.english: When a matter of security or insecurity comes their way, they spread it. Had they first referred it to the messenger and those in charge among them, the knowledgeable among them would have dealt with it. If it were not for God's indulgence towards you, and His mercy, you would have followed the devil, except rarely.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Verify Any Rumors

1989.english: When a rumor related to security comes their way, they spread it. Had they referred it to the messenger, and those in charge among them, those who understand these matters would have dealt with it. If it were not for GOD’s grace towards you, and His mercy, you would have followed the devil, except a few.

verses.arabic: فَقَٰتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُكَلَّفُ إِلَّا نَفْسَكَ وَحَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَكُفَّ بَأْسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ أَشَدُّ بَأْسًا وَأَشَدُّ تَنكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: فقاتل في سبيل الله لا تكلف إلا نفسك ۚ وحرض المؤمنين ۖ عسى الله أن يكف بأس الذين كفروا ۚ والله أشد بأسا وأشد تنكيلا
verses.transliterated: faqātil fī sabīli l-lahi lā tukallafu illā nafsaka waḥarriḍi l-mu'minīna ʿasā l-lahu an yakuffa basa alladhīna kafarū wal-lahu ashaddu basan wa-ashaddu tankīla
verses.english: You shall fight for the cause of GOD; you are responsible only for your own soul, and exhort the believers to do the same. GOD will neutralize the power of those who disbelieve. GOD is much more powerful, and much more effective.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall fight in the cause of God, and although you are answerable only for yourself, you shall exhort the believers to fight. God will then check the disbeliever's power, and God is more powerful, and more forceful.

1989.english: You shall fight for the cause of GOD; you are responsible only for your own soul, and exhort the believers to do the same. GOD will neutralize the power of those who disbelieve. GOD is much more powerful, and much more effective.

verses.arabic: مَّن يَشْفَعْ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةً يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٌ مِّنْهَا وَمَن يَشْفَعْ شَفَٰعَةً سَيِّئَةً يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفْلٌ مِّنْهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقِيتًا
verses.arabicClean: من يشفع شفاعة حسنة يكن له نصيب منها ۖ ومن يشفع شفاعة سيئة يكن له كفل منها ۗ وكان الله على كل شيء مقيتا
verses.transliterated: man yashfaʿ shafāʿatan ḥasanatan yakun lahu naṣībun min'hā waman yashfaʿ shafāʿatan sayyi-atan yakun lahu kif'lun min'hā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin muqīta
verses.english: Whoever mediates a good deed receives a share of the credit thereof, and whoever mediates an evil work, incurs a share thereof. GOD controls all things.
verses.subtitle: Responsibility

1981.english: Whoever mediates a righteous work, receives a share thereof; and whoever mediates an evil work, suffers the consequences thereof. God is counting all things.

1989.english: Whoever mediates a good deed receives a share of the credit thereof, and whoever mediates an evil work, incurs a share thereof. GOD controls all things.
1989.subtitle: Limits of Responsibility

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا حُيِّيتُم بِتَحِيَّةٍ فَحَيُّوا۟ بِأَحْسَنَ مِنْهَآ أَوْ رُدُّوهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَسِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا حييتم بتحية فحيوا بأحسن منها أو ردوها ۗ إن الله كان على كل شيء حسيبا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ḥuyyītum bitaḥiyyatin faḥayyū bi-aḥsana min'hā aw ruddūhā inna l-laha kāna ʿalā kulli shayin ḥasība
verses.english: When greeted with a greeting, you shall respond with a better greeting or at least an equal one. GOD reckons all things.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Be Courteous

1981.english: When you are greeted with a greeting, you shall return a better greeting, or at least an equally courteous one. God takes account of all things.

1989.english: When greeted with a greeting, you shall respond with a better greeting or an equal one. GOD reckons all things.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Be Courteous

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حَدِيثًا
verses.arabicClean: الله لا إله إلا هو ۚ ليجمعنكم إلى يوم القيامة لا ريب فيه ۗ ومن أصدق من الله حديثا
verses.transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa layajmaʿannakum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi waman aṣdaqu mina l-lahi ḥadītha
verses.english: GOD: there is no god except He. He will surely summon you on the Day of Resurrection—the inevitable day. Whose narration is more truthful than GOD's?

1981.english: Allah; the one God; there is no god except He. He will surely gather you on the day of resurrection which is inevitable. Who is more truthful than God?

1989.english: GOD: there is no god except He. He will surely summon you on the Day of Resurrection—an inevitable day. Whose narration is more truthful than GOD’s? Response to Hypocrites

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ وَٱللَّهُ أَرْكَسَهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوٓا۟ أَتُرِيدُونَ أَن تَهْدُوا۟ مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: فما لكم في المنافقين فئتين والله أركسهم بما كسبوا ۚ أتريدون أن تهدوا من أضل الله ۖ ومن يضلل الله فلن تجد له سبيلا
verses.transliterated: famā lakum fī l-munāfiqīna fi-atayni wal-lahu arkasahum bimā kasabū aturīdūna an tahdū man aḍalla l-lahu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu falan tajida lahu sabīla
verses.english: Why should you divide yourselves into two groups regarding hypocrites (among you)? GOD is the one who condemned them because of their own behavior. Do you want to guide those who are sent astray by GOD? Whomever GOD sends astray, you can never find a way to guide them.
verses.subtitle: How to Deal With the Hypocrites

1981.english: Why should you divide yourselves into two groups, and dispute because of the hypocrites? God is the one who cursed them, as a consequence of their work. Do you want to guide those who are misguided by God? Whomever God misguides, you will never find a way to guide him.\
1981.subtitle: The Hypocrites Condemned
1981.footnote: God is fully aware of our innermost intentions, and anyone who harbors disbelief while professing belief is known to God. Such hypocrites are consequently blocked out, and deliberately misguided by God. Even though they look like believers to us, we should not feel sorry for them when all signs point at them as hypocrites, and consequences of their hypocrisy are manifested. God, therefore, guides or misguides, depending on our innermost beliefs. See Appendix 12.

1989.english: Why should you divide yourselves into two groups on account of the hypocrites? GOD has condemned them because of what they earned. Do you want to guide those who are sent astray by GOD? Whomever GOD sends astray, you can never find a way for him.

verses.arabic: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ كَمَا كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَكُونُونَ سَوَآءً فَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَخُذُوهُمْ وَٱقْتُلُوهُمْ حَيْثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمْ وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ودوا لو تكفرون كما كفروا فتكونون سواء ۖ فلا تتخذوا منهم أولياء حتى يهاجروا في سبيل الله ۚ فإن تولوا فخذوهم واقتلوهم حيث وجدتموهم ۖ ولا تتخذوا منهم وليا ولا نصيرا
verses.transliterated: waddū law takfurūna kamā kafarū fatakūnūna sawāan falā tattakhidhū min'hum awliyāa ḥattā yuhājirū fī sabīli l-lahi fa-in tawallaw fakhudhūhum wa-uq'tulūhum ḥaythu wajadttumūhum walā tattakhidhū min'hum waliyyan walā naṣīra
verses.english: They wish that you disbelieve as they have disbelieved, then you become equal. Do not consider them friends, unless they mobilize along with you in the cause of GOD. If they turn against you, you shall fight them, and you may kill them when you encounter them in war. You shall not accept them as friends, or allies.
verses.footnote: The basic rule controlling all fighting is stated in 60:8-9.

1981.english: They wish that you disbelieve, as they have disbelieved, then you become equal. Therefore, do not consider them allies, unless they mobilize in the cause of God. But if they turn away, then capture them, and kill them when you encounter them. You shall not take them as allies or supporters.

1989.english: They wish that you disbelieve as they have disbelieved, then you become equal. Do not consider them friends, unless they mobilize for the cause of GOD. If they turn against you, you may fight them, and you may kill them when you encounter them. You shall not accept them as friends, or allies.*
1989.footnote: The basic rule controlling all fighting is stated in 60:8-9.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌ أَوْ جَآءُوكُمْ حَصِرَتْ صُدُورُهُمْ أَن يُقَٰتِلُوكُمْ أَوْ يُقَٰتِلُوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَسَلَّطَهُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ فَلَقَٰتَلُوكُمْ فَإِنِ ٱعْتَزَلُوكُمْ فَلَمْ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمْ وَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ فَمَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين يصلون إلى قوم بينكم وبينهم ميثاق أو جاءوكم حصرت صدورهم أن يقاتلوكم أو يقاتلوا قومهم ۚ ولو شاء الله لسلطهم عليكم فلقاتلوكم ۚ فإن اعتزلوكم فلم يقاتلوكم وألقوا إليكم السلم فما جعل الله لكم عليهم سبيلا
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna yaṣilūna ilā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun aw jāūkum ḥaṣirat ṣudūruhum an yuqātilūkum aw yuqātilū qawmahum walaw shāa l-lahu lasallaṭahum ʿalaykum falaqātalūkum fa-ini iʿ'tazalūkum falam yuqātilūkum wa-alqaw ilaykumu l-salama famā jaʿala l-lahu lakum ʿalayhim sabīla
verses.english: Exempted are those who join people with whom you have signed a peace treaty, and those who come to you wishing not to fight you, nor fight their relatives. Had GOD willed, He could have permitted them to fight against you. Therefore, if they leave you alone, refrain from fighting you, and offer you peace, then GOD gives you no excuse to fight them.

1981.english: Exempted are those who join people with whom you have a treaty, and those who come to you lacking the heart to fight you, or fight their relatives. Had God willed, He could have set them up against you. Therefore, so long as they leave you alone, refrain from fighting you, and offer you peace, God does not permit you to fight them.

1989.english: Exempted are those who join people with whom you have signed a peace treaty, and those who come to you wishing not to fight you, nor to fight their people. Had GOD willed, He could have permitted them to fight against you. Therefore, if they leave you alone, refrain from fighting you, and offer you peace, then GOD gives you no excuse to fight them.

verses.arabic: سَتَجِدُونَ ءَاخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَأْمَنُوكُمْ وَيَأْمَنُوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ كُلَّ مَا رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْفِتْنَةِ أُرْكِسُوا۟ فِيهَا فَإِن لَّمْ يَعْتَزِلُوكُمْ وَيُلْقُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ وَيَكُفُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَخُذُوهُمْ وَٱقْتُلُوهُمْ حَيْثُ ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ جَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: ستجدون آخرين يريدون أن يأمنوكم ويأمنوا قومهم كل ما ردوا إلى الفتنة أركسوا فيها ۚ فإن لم يعتزلوكم ويلقوا إليكم السلم ويكفوا أيديهم فخذوهم واقتلوهم حيث ثقفتموهم ۚ وأولئكم جعلنا لكم عليهم سلطانا مبينا
verses.transliterated: satajidūna ākharīna yurīdūna an yamanūkum wayamanū qawmahum kulla mā ruddū ilā l-fit'nati ur'kisū fīhā fa-in lam yaʿtazilūkum wayul'qū ilaykumu l-salama wayakuffū aydiyahum fakhudhūhum wa-uq'tulūhum ḥaythu thaqif'tumūhum wa-ulāikum jaʿalnā lakum ʿalayhim sul'ṭānan mubīna
verses.english: You will find others who wish to make peace with you, and also with their people. However, as soon as war erupts, they fight against you. Unless these people leave you alone, offer you peace, and stop fighting you, you may fight them when you encounter them. Against these, we give you a clear authorization.

1981.english: You will find others who want to have peace with you, and peace with their people, but whenever war erupts, they become aggressors. Therefore, unless they leave you alone, and offer you peace, and refrain from aggression, you shall capture them and kill them whenever you encounter them. It is these against whom we give you a definite permission.

1989.english: You will find others who wish to make peace with you, and also with their people. However, as soon as war erupts, they fight against you. Unless they leave you alone, offer you peace, and stop fighting you, you may fight them when you encounter them. Against these, we give you a clear authority.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَن يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَـًٔا وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا خَطَـًٔا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ وَدِيَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَصَّدَّقُوا۟ فَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍ عَدُوٍّ لَّكُمْ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ وَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌ فَدِيَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ وَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ تَوْبَةً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وما كان لمؤمن أن يقتل مؤمنا إلا خطأ ۚ ومن قتل مؤمنا خطأ فتحرير رقبة مؤمنة ودية مسلمة إلى أهله إلا أن يصدقوا ۚ فإن كان من قوم عدو لكم وهو مؤمن فتحرير رقبة مؤمنة ۖ وإن كان من قوم بينكم وبينهم ميثاق فدية مسلمة إلى أهله وتحرير رقبة مؤمنة ۖ فمن لم يجد فصيام شهرين متتابعين توبة من الله ۗ وكان الله عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna limu'minin an yaqtula mu'minan illā khaṭa-an waman qatala mu'minan khaṭa-an fataḥrīru raqabatin mu'minatin wadiyatun musallamatun ilā ahlihi illā an yaṣṣaddaqū fa-in kāna min qawmin ʿaduwwin lakum wahuwa mu'minun fataḥrīru raqabatin mu'minatin wa-in kāna min qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun fadiyatun musallamatun ilā ahlihi wataḥrīru raqabatin mu'minatin faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni tawbatan mina l-lahi wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: No believer shall kill another believer, unless it is an accident. If one kills a believer by accident, he shall atone by freeing a believing slave, and paying a compensation to the victim's family, unless they forfeit such a compensation as a charity. If the victim belonged to people who are at war with you, though he was a believer, you shall atone by freeing a believing slave. If he belonged to people with whom you have signed a peace treaty, you shall pay the compensation in addition to freeing a believing slave. If you cannot find a slave to free, you shall atone by fasting two consecutive months, in order to be redeemed by GOD. GOD is Knower, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Not Kill
verses.footnote: Since slavery does not exist, the offender must atone by fasting two consecutive months.

1981.english: No believer kills another believer, except by mistake. Whoever kills a believer by mistake shall expiate by freeing a believing slave, and paying compensation to the victim's family, unless they forfeit it. If the victim belonged to people who are enemies, though he was a believer, then the expiation shall be by freeing a believing slave. If the victim belonged to people with whom you have a treaty, then you shall pay the compensation, and free a believing slave. Those who cannot afford it may expiate by fasting two consecutive months, as a token of repentance and atonement towards God. God is omniscient, wise.
1981.subtitle: The Grossness of Murder

1989.english: No believer shall kill another believer, unless it is an accident. If one kills a believer by accident, he shall expiate by freeing a believing slave, and paying a compensation to the victim’s family, unless they forfeit such a compensation as a charity. If the victim belonged to people who are at war with you, though he was a believer, you shall expiate by freeing a believing slave. If he belonged to people with whom you have signed a peace treaty, you shall pay the compensation in addition to freeing a believing slave. If you cannot afford it, you shall expiate by fasting two consecutive months, in order to be redeemed by GOD. GOD is Knower, Most Wise.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Not Kill

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ خَٰلِدًا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُۥ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُۥ عَذَابًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يقتل مؤمنا متعمدا فجزاؤه جهنم خالدا فيها وغضب الله عليه ولعنه وأعد له عذابا عظيما
verses.transliterated: waman yaqtul mu'minan mutaʿammidan fajazāuhu jahannamu khālidan fīhā waghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhi walaʿanahu wa-aʿadda lahu ʿadhāban ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Anyone who kills a believer on purpose, his retribution is Hell, wherein he abides forever, GOD is angry with him, and condemns him, and has prepared for him a terrible retribution.
verses.subtitle: An Unforgivable Offense

1981.english: As for the one who kills a believer deliberately, his retribution is hell, wherein he abides forever, and God is angry with him, curses him, and has prepared for him a terrible retribution.

1989.english: Anyone who kills a believer on purpose, his retribution is Hell, wherein he abides forever, GOD is angry with him, and condemns him, and has prepared for him a terrible retribution.
1989.subtitle: An Unforgivable Offense

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَبَيَّنُوا۟ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَنْ أَلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلسَّلَٰمَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا تَبْتَغُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَغَانِمُ كَثِيرَةٌ كَذَٰلِكَ كُنتُم مِّن قَبْلُ فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا ضربتم في سبيل الله فتبينوا ولا تقولوا لمن ألقى إليكم السلام لست مؤمنا تبتغون عرض الحياة الدنيا فعند الله مغانم كثيرة ۚ كذلك كنتم من قبل فمن الله عليكم فتبينوا ۚ إن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā ḍarabtum fī sabīli l-lahi fatabayyanū walā taqūlū liman alqā ilaykumu l-salāma lasta mu'minan tabtaghūna ʿaraḍa l-ḥayati l-dun'yā faʿinda l-lahi maghānimu kathīratun kadhālika kuntum min qablu famanna l-lahu ʿalaykum fatabayyanū inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīra
verses.english: O you who believe, if you strike in the cause of GOD, you shall be absolutely sure. Do not say to one who offers you peace, "You are not a believer," seeking the spoils of this world. For GOD possesses infinite spoils. Remember that you used to be like them, and GOD blessed you. Therefore, you shall be absolutely sure (before you strike). GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall be absolutely sure before you strike in the cause of God. Do not say to one who offers you peace, "You are not a believer," just to capture some material of this world; God possesses far better spoils. Remember that you yourselves used to be disbelievers, and God blessed you. Therefore, you shall be absolutely sure, for God is fully cognizant of what you do.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you strike in the cause of GOD, you shall be absolutely sure. Do not say to one who offers you peace, “You are not a believer,” seeking the spoils of this world. For GOD possesses infinite spoils. Remember that you used to be like them, and GOD blessed you. Therefore, you shall be absolutely sure (before you strike). GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْقَٰعِدُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ غَيْرُ أُو۟لِى ٱلضَّرَرِ وَٱلْمُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ عَلَى ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ دَرَجَةً وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَفَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: لا يستوي القاعدون من المؤمنين غير أولي الضرر والمجاهدون في سبيل الله بأموالهم وأنفسهم ۚ فضل الله المجاهدين بأموالهم وأنفسهم على القاعدين درجة ۚ وكلا وعد الله الحسنى ۚ وفضل الله المجاهدين على القاعدين أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: lā yastawī l-qāʿidūna mina l-mu'minīna ghayru ulī l-ḍarari wal-mujāhidūna fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim faḍḍala l-lahu l-mujāhidīna bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim ʿalā l-qāʿidīna darajatan wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wafaḍḍala l-lahu l-mujāhidīna ʿalā l-qāʿidīna ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Not equal are the sedentary among the believers who are not handicapped, and those who strive in the cause of GOD with their money and their lives. GOD exalts the strivers with their money and their lives above the sedentary. For both, GOD promises salvation, but GOD exalts the strivers over the sedentary with a great recompense.
verses.subtitle: Higher Ranks for the Strivers

1981.english: Not equal are the believers who are not handicapped and stay behind, and those who struggle with their money and their lives in the cause of God. God exalts those who strive with their money and their lives, over those who sit behind, to higher ranks. God promises salvation for all believers; but He distinguishes those who strive, over those who stay behind, with a great recompense.

1989.english: Not equal are the sedentary among the believers who are not handicapped, and those who strive in the cause of GOD with their money and their lives. GOD exalts the strivers with their money and their lives above the sedentary. For each, GOD promises salvation. But GOD exalts the strivers over the sedentary with a great recompense.

verses.arabic: دَرَجَٰتٍ مِّنْهُ وَمَغْفِرَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: درجات منه ومغفرة ورحمة ۚ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: darajātin min'hu wamaghfiratan waraḥmatan wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: The higher ranks come from Him, as well as forgiveness and mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: He bestows upon them higher ranks, and forgiveness, and mercy. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: The higher ranks come from Him, as well as forgiveness and mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ فِيمَ كُنتُمْ قَالُوا۟ كُنَّا مُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ أَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةً فَتُهَاجِرُوا۟ فِيهَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين توفاهم الملائكة ظالمي أنفسهم قالوا فيم كنتم ۖ قالوا كنا مستضعفين في الأرض ۚ قالوا ألم تكن أرض الله واسعة فتهاجروا فيها ۚ فأولئك مأواهم جهنم ۖ وساءت مصيرا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna tawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ẓālimī anfusihim qālū fīma kuntum qālū kunnā mus'taḍʿafīna fī l-arḍi qālū alam takun arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatan fatuhājirū fīhā fa-ulāika mawāhum jahannamu wasāat maṣīra
verses.english: Those whose lives are terminated by the angels, while in a state of wronging their souls, the angels will ask them, "What was the matter with you?" They will say, "We were oppressed on earth." They will say, "Was GOD's earth not spacious enough for you to emigrate therein?" For these, the final abode is Hell, and a miserable destiny.
verses.subtitle: Apathy Condemned

1981.english: Those whose lives are terminated by the angels in a state of unrighteousness, will be asked by the angels, "What was the matter with you?" They would say, "We have been weak and oppressed." The angels would say, "Was not God's earth spacious enough for you to move about?" The destination for these is hell, and a miserable abode.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Yield to Oppression

1989.english: Those whose lives are terminated by the angels, while they are in a state of wronging their souls, the angels will ask them, “What was the matter with you?” They will say, “We were oppressed on earth.” They will say, “Was GOD’s earth not spacious enough for you to emigrate therein?” For these, the final abode is Hell, and a miserable destiny.
1989.subtitle: Apathy Condemned

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْوِلْدَٰنِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةً وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إلا المستضعفين من الرجال والنساء والولدان لا يستطيعون حيلة ولا يهتدون سبيلا
verses.transliterated: illā l-mus'taḍʿafīna mina l-rijāli wal-nisāi wal-wil'dāni lā yastaṭīʿūna ḥīlatan walā yahtadūna sabīla
verses.english: Exempted are the weak men, women, and children who do not possess the strength, nor the means to find a way out.

1981.english: Exempted are the weak men, women, and children who are hopelessly trapped, with no way out.

1989.english: Exempted are the weak men, women, and children who do not possess the means, nor can find a way out.

verses.arabic: فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَعْفُوَ عَنْهُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: فأولئك عسى الله أن يعفو عنهم ۚ وكان الله عفوا غفورا
verses.transliterated: fa-ulāika ʿasā l-lahu an yaʿfuwa ʿanhum wakāna l-lahu ʿafuwwan ghafūra
verses.english: These may be pardoned by GOD. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiver.

1981.english: These are the ones to be pardoned by God; and God is pardoner, forgiver.

1989.english: These are pardoned by GOD. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiver.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يُهَاجِرْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يَجِدْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُرَٰغَمًا كَثِيرًا وَسَعَةً وَمَن يَخْرُجْ مِنۢ بَيْتِهِۦ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ يُدْرِكْهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَقَدْ وَقَعَ أَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يهاجر في سبيل الله يجد في الأرض مراغما كثيرا وسعة ۚ ومن يخرج من بيته مهاجرا إلى الله ورسوله ثم يدركه الموت فقد وقع أجره على الله ۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: waman yuhājir fī sabīli l-lahi yajid fī l-arḍi murāghaman kathīran wasaʿatan waman yakhruj min baytihi muhājiran ilā l-lahi warasūlihi thumma yud'rik'hu l-mawtu faqad waqaʿa ajruhu ʿalā l-lahi wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: Anyone who emigrates in the cause of GOD will find on earth great bounties and richness. Anyone who gives up his home, emigrating to GOD and His messenger, then death catches up with him, his recompense is reserved with GOD. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Whoever emigrates in the cause of God, will find many bounties on earth, and richness. And whoever leaves his home, emigrating in the cause of God and His messenger, then death catches up with him, his recompense has been reserved with God. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Anyone who emigrates in the cause of GOD will find on earth great bounties and richness. Anyone who gives up his home, emigrating to GOD and His messenger, then death catches up with him, his recompense will be granted by GOD. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقْصُرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَن يَفْتِنَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كَانُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا ضربتم في الأرض فليس عليكم جناح أن تقصروا من الصلاة إن خفتم أن يفتنكم الذين كفروا ۚ إن الكافرين كانوا لكم عدوا مبينا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ḍarabtum fī l-arḍi falaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun an taqṣurū mina l-ṣalati in khif'tum an yaftinakumu alladhīna kafarū inna l-kāfirīna kānū lakum ʿaduwwan mubīna
verses.english: When you travel, during war, you commit no error by shortening your Contact Prayers (Salat), if you fear that the disbelievers may attack you. Surely, the disbelievers are your ardent enemies.

1981.english: While you are on the move, you commit no sin by shortening the **salat** prayers, if you fear lest the disbelievers may attack you. Certainly, the disbelievers are your manifest enemies.

1989.english: When you travel, during war, you commit no error by shortening your contact prayers (Salat), if you fear that the disbelievers may attack you. Surely, the disbelievers are your ardent enemies.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا كُنتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُم مَّعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوٓا۟ أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ فَإِذَا سَجَدُوا۟ فَلْيَكُونُوا۟ مِن وَرَآئِكُمْ وَلْتَأْتِ طَآئِفَةٌ أُخْرَىٰ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا۟ فَلْيُصَلُّوا۟ مَعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوا۟ حِذْرَهُمْ وَأَسْلِحَتَهُمْ وَدَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ تَغْفُلُونَ عَنْ أَسْلِحَتِكُمْ وَأَمْتِعَتِكُمْ فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيْكُم مَّيْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوْ كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓا۟ أَسْلِحَتَكُمْ وَخُذُوا۟ حِذْرَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا كنت فيهم فأقمت لهم الصلاة فلتقم طائفة منهم معك وليأخذوا أسلحتهم فإذا سجدوا فليكونوا من ورائكم ولتأت طائفة أخرى لم يصلوا فليصلوا معك وليأخذوا حذرهم وأسلحتهم ۗ ود الذين كفروا لو تغفلون عن أسلحتكم وأمتعتكم فيميلون عليكم ميلة واحدة ۚ ولا جناح عليكم إن كان بكم أذى من مطر أو كنتم مرضى أن تضعوا أسلحتكم ۖ وخذوا حذركم ۗ إن الله أعد للكافرين عذابا مهينا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā kunta fīhim fa-aqamta lahumu l-ṣalata faltaqum ṭāifatun min'hum maʿaka walyakhudhū asliḥatahum fa-idhā sajadū falyakūnū min warāikum waltati ṭāifatun ukh'rā lam yuṣallū falyuṣallū maʿaka walyakhudhū ḥidh'rahum wa-asliḥatahum wadda alladhīna kafarū law taghfulūna ʿan asliḥatikum wa-amtiʿatikum fayamīlūna ʿalaykum maylatan wāḥidatan walā junāḥa ʿalaykum in kāna bikum adhan min maṭarin aw kuntum marḍā an taḍaʿū asliḥatakum wakhudhū ḥidh'rakum inna l-laha aʿadda lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāban muhīna
verses.english: When you are with them, and lead the Contact Prayer (Salat) for them, let some of you stand guard; let them hold their weapons, and let them stand behind you as you prostrate. Then, let the other group that has not prayed take their turn praying with you, while the others stand guard and hold their weapons. Those who disbelieved wish to see you neglect your weapons and your equipment, in order to attack you once and for all. You commit no error, if you are hampered by rain or injury, by putting down your weapons, so long as you remain alert. GOD has prepared for the disbelievers a shameful retribution.
verses.subtitle: War Precautions

1981.english: If you are with them, and lead the **salat** for them, let some of you stand guard, and hold their weapons. Thus, while you are prostrating, they will protect your backs. Then let another group, who did not pray, take their turn praying with you, while the first group stands guard, and hold their weapons. The disbelievers wish that you neglect your weapons and equipment, in order to attack you once and for all. You commit no sin, if you are hampered by rain or illness, by putting down your weapons, so long as you stay alert. God has prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating retribution.

1989.english: If you are with them, and lead the contact prayer (Salat) for them, let some of you stand guard; let them hold their weapons, and let them stand behind you as you prostrate. Then, let the group that has not prayed take their turn praying with you, and let the others stand guard and hold their weapons. Those who disbelieved wish to see you neglect your weapons and your equipment, in order to attack you once and for all. You commit no error, if you are hampered by rain or injury, if you put down your weapons, so long as you remain alert. GOD has prepared for the disbelievers a shameful retribution.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ فَإِذَا ٱطْمَأْنَنتُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَٰبًا مَّوْقُوتًا
verses.arabicClean: فإذا قضيتم الصلاة فاذكروا الله قياما وقعودا وعلى جنوبكم ۚ فإذا اطمأننتم فأقيموا الصلاة ۚ إن الصلاة كانت على المؤمنين كتابا موقوتا
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā qaḍaytumu l-ṣalata fa-udh'kurū l-laha qiyāman waquʿūdan waʿalā junūbikum fa-idhā iṭ'manantum fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata inna l-ṣalata kānat ʿalā l-mu'minīna kitāban mawqūta
verses.english: Once you complete your Contact Prayer (Salat), you shall remember GOD while standing, sitting, or lying down. Once the war is over, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat); the Contact Prayers (Salat) are decreed for the believers at specific times.
verses.subtitle: The Contact Prayers
verses.footnote: Your god is whoever or whatever occupies your mind most of the day. In order to belong in God's kingdom, and enjoy His grace and protection, the Quran exhorts us to remember God "always" (2:152 & 200, 3:191, 33:41-42). This profound fact explains the numerous verses asserting that "most" of those who believe in God are going to Hell (12:106, 23:84-89, 29:61-63, 31:25, 39:38, 43:87). See Footnote 3:191 and Appendix 27.

1981.english: If you observe **salat** under these circumstances, then you may worship God while sitting, standing, or laying on your sides. Once the war is over, you shall observe the regular **salat**. The **salat** prayers are decreed for the believers at specific times.\
1981.subtitle: Salat Decreed at Specific Times
1981.footnote: The five times of **salat** prayers per day, as well as the specific method of carrying out **salat** were revealed to Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation (2:128, 3:67-68, 16:123, 21:73, and 22:78). The Quran instructs us to uphold such revelations (2:4), and ordered us to observe **salat** in one of the first revelations. (73:20).

1989.english: Once you complete your contact prayer (Salat), you shall remember GOD while standing, sitting, or lying down.* Once the war is over, you shall observe the Contact prayers (Salat)-, the contact prayers (Salat) are decreed for the believers at specific times.
1989.footnote: Your god is whoever or whatever preoccupies your mind most of the day. In order to belong in God’s kingdom, and enjoy His grace and protection, the Quran exhorts us to remember God “always” (2:152 & 200, 3:191, 33:41-42). This profound fad explains the numerous verses asserting that “most” of those who do believe in God are going to Hell (12:106, 23:84-89, 29:61-63, 31:25, 39:38, 43:87). See Footnote 3:191 and Appendix 27.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ فِى ٱبْتِغَآءِ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ تَأْلَمُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْلَمُونَ كَمَا تَأْلَمُونَ وَتَرْجُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَرْجُونَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تهنوا في ابتغاء القوم ۖ إن تكونوا تألمون فإنهم يألمون كما تألمون ۖ وترجون من الله ما لا يرجون ۗ وكان الله عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: walā tahinū fī ib'tighāi l-qawmi in takūnū talamūna fa-innahum yalamūna kamā talamūna watarjūna mina l-lahi mā lā yarjūna wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: Do not waver in pursuing the enemy. If you suffer, they also suffer. However, you expect from GOD what they never expect. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: You shall not waver in going after the enemy. If war is painful to you, it is equally painful to them. However, you expect from God what they can never expect. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: Do not waver in pursuing the enemy. If you suffer, they also suffer, except you expect from GOD what they never expect. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِمَآ أَرَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَكُن لِّلْخَآئِنِينَ خَصِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا أنزلنا إليك الكتاب بالحق لتحكم بين الناس بما أراك الله ۚ ولا تكن للخائنين خصيما
verses.transliterated: innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi litaḥkuma bayna l-nāsi bimā arāka l-lahu walā takun lil'khāinīna khaṣīma
verses.english: We have sent down to you the scripture, truthfully, in order to judge among the people in accordance with what GOD has shown you. You shall not side with the betrayers.

1981.english: We have revealed to you this scripture, truthfully, in order that you judge between the people in accordance with God's teachings to you. Do not defend the betrayers.

1989.english: We have sent down to you the scripture, truthfully, in order to judge among the people in accordance with what GOD has shown you. You shall not side with the traitors.

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: واستغفر الله ۖ إن الله كان غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: wa-is'taghfiri l-laha inna l-laha kāna ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: You shall implore GOD for forgiveness. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: And turn to God for forgiveness; God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: You shall implore GOD for forgiveness. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُجَٰدِلْ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ خَوَّانًا أَثِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تجادل عن الذين يختانون أنفسهم ۚ إن الله لا يحب من كان خوانا أثيما
verses.transliterated: walā tujādil ʿani alladhīna yakhtānūna anfusahum inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu man kāna khawwānan athīma
verses.english: Do not argue on behalf of those who have wronged their own souls; GOD does not love any betrayer, guilty.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Defend the Transgressors

1981.english: Do not argue on behalf of those who wrong their own souls, for God loves not any betrayer, guilty.

1989.english: Do not argue on behalf of those who have wronged their souls; GOD does not love any betrayer, guilty.
1989.subtitle: Do Not Defend the Transgressors

verses.arabic: يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مَعَهُمْ إِذْ يُبَيِّتُونَ مَا لَا يَرْضَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطًا
verses.arabicClean: يستخفون من الناس ولا يستخفون من الله وهو معهم إذ يبيتون ما لا يرضى من القول ۚ وكان الله بما يعملون محيطا
verses.transliterated: yastakhfūna mina l-nāsi walā yastakhfūna mina l-lahi wahuwa maʿahum idh yubayyitūna mā lā yarḍā mina l-qawli wakāna l-lahu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭa
verses.english: They hide from the people, and do not care to hide from GOD, though He is with them as they harbor ideas He dislikes. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

1981.english: They hide from the people, and do not care to hide from God, who is with them as they scheme and conspire against His wishes. God is fully aware of everything they do.

1989.english: They hide from the people, and do not even care to hide from GOD, though He is with them as they harbor ideas He dislikes. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

verses.arabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ جَٰدَلْتُمْ عَنْهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَمَن يُجَٰدِلُ ٱللَّهَ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَم مَّن يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ها أنتم هؤلاء جادلتم عنهم في الحياة الدنيا فمن يجادل الله عنهم يوم القيامة أم من يكون عليهم وكيلا
verses.transliterated: hāantum hāulāi jādaltum ʿanhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā faman yujādilu l-laha ʿanhum yawma l-qiyāmati am man yakūnu ʿalayhim wakīla
verses.english: Here you are arguing on their behalf in this world; who is going to argue with GOD on their behalf on the Day of Resurrection? Who is going to be their advocate?
verses.subtitle: You Do Not Help Them by Being "Nice"

1981.english: You may defend them, and argue on their behalf now; but who would defend them before God on the day of resurrection? Who would be their advocate?

1989.english: Here you are arguing on their behalf in this world; who is going to argue with GOD on their behalf on the Day of Resurrection? Who is going to be their advocate?

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يعمل سوءا أو يظلم نفسه ثم يستغفر الله يجد الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: waman yaʿmal sūan aw yaẓlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri l-laha yajidi l-laha ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: Anyone who commits evil, or wrongs his soul, then implores GOD for forgiveness, will find GOD Forgiving, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Anyone who falls in sin, or wrongs his soul, then turns to God for forgiveness, he will find God forgiving, merciful.

1989.english: Anyone who commits evil, or wrongs his soul, then implores GOD for forgiveness, will find GOD Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَكْسِبْ إِثْمًا فَإِنَّمَا يَكْسِبُهُۥ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يكسب إثما فإنما يكسبه على نفسه ۚ وكان الله عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: waman yaksib ith'man fa-innamā yaksibuhu ʿalā nafsihi wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: Anyone who earns a sin, earns it to the detriment of his own soul. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: Anyone who commits sin, commits it against his own soul. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: Anyone who earns a sin, earns it against his own soul. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَكْسِبْ خَطِيٓـَٔةً أَوْ إِثْمًا ثُمَّ يَرْمِ بِهِۦ بَرِيٓـًٔا فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلَ بُهْتَٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يكسب خطيئة أو إثما ثم يرم به بريئا فقد احتمل بهتانا وإثما مبينا
verses.transliterated: waman yaksib khaṭīatan aw ith'man thumma yarmi bihi barīan faqadi iḥ'tamala buh'tānan wa-ith'man mubīna
verses.english: Anyone who earns a sin, then accuses an innocent person thereof, has committed a blasphemy and a gross offense.

1981.english: Anyone who commits a transgression, or a sin, then accuses an innocent person thereof, has incurred a blasphemy, and a profound sin.

1989.english: Anyone who earns a sin, then accuses an innocent person thereof, has committed a blasphemy and a gross offense.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ لَهَمَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُضِلُّوكَ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَضُرُّونَكَ مِن شَىْءٍ وَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَكَ مَا لَمْ تَكُن تَعْلَمُ وَكَانَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولولا فضل الله عليك ورحمته لهمت طائفة منهم أن يضلوك وما يضلون إلا أنفسهم ۖ وما يضرونك من شيء ۚ وأنزل الله عليك الكتاب والحكمة وعلمك ما لم تكن تعلم ۚ وكان فضل الله عليك عظيما
verses.transliterated: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalayka waraḥmatuhu lahammat ṭāifatun min'hum an yuḍillūka wamā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wamā yaḍurrūnaka min shayin wa-anzala l-lahu ʿalayka l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata waʿallamaka mā lam takun taʿlamu wakāna faḍlu l-lahi ʿalayka ʿaẓīma
verses.english: If it were not for GOD's grace towards you, and His mercy, some of them would have misled you. They only mislead themselves, and they can never harm you in the least. GOD has sent down to you the scripture and wisdom, and He has taught you what you never knew. Indeed, GOD's blessings upon you have been great.

1981.english: If it were not for God's grace toward you, and His mercy, some of them would have succeeded in misleading you, though they only mislead themselves. They can never harm you. God has revealed to you the scripture and wisdom, and taught you what you never knew. Indeed, God's grace towards you has been generous.

1989.english: If it were not for GOD’s grace towards you, and His mercy, some of them would have misled you. They only mislead themselves, and they can never harm you in the least. GOD has sent down to you the scripture and wisdom, and He has taught you what you never knew. Indeed, GOD’s blessings upon you have been great.

verses.arabic: لَّا خَيْرَ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّن نَّجْوَىٰهُمْ إِلَّا مَنْ أَمَرَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَوْ مَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ إِصْلَٰحٍۭ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ ٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ فَسَوْفَ نُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: لا خير في كثير من نجواهم إلا من أمر بصدقة أو معروف أو إصلاح بين الناس ۚ ومن يفعل ذلك ابتغاء مرضات الله فسوف نؤتيه أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: lā khayra fī kathīrin min najwāhum illā man amara biṣadaqatin aw maʿrūfin aw iṣ'lāḥin bayna l-nāsi waman yafʿal dhālika ib'tighāa marḍāti l-lahi fasawfa nu'tīhi ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: There is nothing good about their private conferences, except for those who advocate charity, or righteous works, or making peace among the people. Anyone who does this, in response to GOD's teachings, we will grant him a great recompense.

1981.english: There is nothing good in their private discussions, unless they advocate charity, or righteousness, or conciliation among the people. Whoever does this, in compliance with God's wishes, we will endow him with a great recompense.

1989.english: There is nothing good about their private thoughts, unless they advocate charity, or a righteous work, or conciliation among the people. Anyone who does this, seeking GOD’s approval, we will grant him a great recompense.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعْ غَيْرَ سَبِيلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِۦ مَا تَوَلَّىٰ وَنُصْلِهِۦ جَهَنَّمَ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يشاقق الرسول من بعد ما تبين له الهدى ويتبع غير سبيل المؤمنين نوله ما تولى ونصله جهنم ۖ وساءت مصيرا
verses.transliterated: waman yushāqiqi l-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahu l-hudā wayattabiʿ ghayra sabīli l-mu'minīna nuwallihi mā tawallā wanuṣ'lihi jahannama wasāat maṣīra
verses.english: As for him who opposes the messenger, after the guidance has been pointed out to him, and follows other than the believers' way, we will direct him in the direction he has chosen, and commit him to Hell; what a miserable destiny!

1981.english: Anyone who opposes the messenger, after the guidance has been clarified to him, and follows other than the believers' path, we will direct him toward the direction he chose, and burn him in hell; a miserable abode.\
1981.subtitle: You Shall Follow The Messenger, But Do Not Idolize Him
1981.footnote: When you tell the average Christian that Jesus is not God, nor son of God, he will accuse you of opposing Jesus. Similarly, when you tell the average Muslim that Muhammad preached the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran, and that following the inventions of "**Hadith**" and "**Sunna**" is an act of opposing the prophet, he will accuse you of opposing Muhammad. Thus, the Muslims appear to have fallen in the same satanic trap as the Christians; they idolize Muhammad against his will.

1989.english: As for the one who opposes the messenger, after the guidance has been pointed out to him, and follows other than the believers’ way, we will direct him in the direction he has chosen, and commit him to Hell; what a miserable destiny!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الله لا يغفر أن يشرك به ويغفر ما دون ذلك لمن يشاء ۚ ومن يشرك بالله فقد ضل ضلالا بعيدا
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha lā yaghfiru an yush'raka bihi wayaghfiru mā dūna dhālika liman yashāu waman yush'rik bil-lahi faqad ḍalla ḍalālan baʿīda
verses.english: GOD does not forgive idol worship (if maintained until death), and He forgives lesser offenses for whomever He wills. Anyone who idolizes any idol beside GOD has strayed far astray.
verses.subtitle: The Unforgivable Sin
verses.footnote: A simple definition of idolatry: Believing that anything beside God can help you.

1981.english: God does not forgive the idolization of any idols besides Him, and He forgives all lesser offenses for whomever He wills. Anyone who idolizes any idol besides God, has gone far astray.

1989.english: GOD does not forgive idolatry (if maintained until death);* He forgives lesser offenses for whomever He wills. Anyone who sets up any idol besides GOD has strayed far astray.
1989.subtitle: The Unforgivable Sin
1989.footnote: A simple definition of idolatry: Believing that anything beside God can help you.

verses.arabic: إِن يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ إِنَٰثًا وَإِن يَدْعُونَ إِلَّا شَيْطَٰنًا مَّرِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: إن يدعون من دونه إلا إناثا وإن يدعون إلا شيطانا مريدا
verses.transliterated: in yadʿūna min dūnihi illā ināthan wa-in yadʿūna illā shayṭānan marīda
verses.english: They even worship female gods besides Him; as a matter of fact, they only worship a rebellious devil.

1981.english: They even set up female idols, and, in fact, they idolize the rebellious devil.

1989.english: They even worship female gods besides Him; as a matter of fact, they only worship a rebellious devil.

verses.arabic: لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَقَالَ لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبًا مَّفْرُوضًا
