verses.arabicClean: لعنه الله ۘ وقال لأتخذن من عبادك نصيبا مفروضا
verses.transliterated: laʿanahu l-lahu waqāla la-attakhidhanna min ʿibādika naṣīban mafrūḍa
verses.english: GOD has condemned him, and he said, "I will surely recruit a definite share of Your worshipers.
verses.footnote: The majority of believers in God fall into idolatry (12:106).

1981.english: God has cursed him, and he vowed, "I will surely take a definite share of Your creatures.

1989.english: GOD has condemned him, and he said, “I will surely recruit a definite share of Your worshipers.*
1989.footnote: The majority of believers in God fall into idolatry (12:106).

verses.arabic: وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمْ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمْ وَلَءَامُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ ءَاذَانَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ وَلَءَامُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلْقَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ وَلِيًّا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ خَسِرَ خُسْرَانًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: ولأضلنهم ولأمنينهم ولآمرنهم فليبتكن آذان الأنعام ولآمرنهم فليغيرن خلق الله ۚ ومن يتخذ الشيطان وليا من دون الله فقد خسر خسرانا مبينا
verses.transliterated: wala-uḍillannahum wala-umanniyannahum walaāmurannahum falayubattikunna ādhāna l-anʿāmi walaāmurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqa l-lahi waman yattakhidhi l-shayṭāna waliyyan min dūni l-lahi faqad khasira khus'rānan mubīna
verses.english: "I will mislead them, I will entice them, I will command them to (forbid the eating of certain meats by) marking the ears of livestock, and I will command them to distort the creation of GOD." Anyone who accepts the devil as a lord, instead of GOD, has incurred a profound loss.

1981.english: "I will surely mislead them, and entice them, and order them to prohibit certain meats by marking the ears of certain animals, and I will order them to distort the creation of God." Whoever takes the devil as his ally, instead of God, has incurred a profound loss.

1989.english: “I will mislead them; I will entice them; I will command them to (forbid the eating of certain meats by) marking the ears of livestock; I will command them to distort the creation of GOD.” Anyone who accepts the devil as lord, instead of GOD, has incurred a profound loss.

verses.arabic: يَعِدُهُمْ وَيُمَنِّيهِمْ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.arabicClean: يعدهم ويمنيهم ۖ وما يعدهم الشيطان إلا غرورا
verses.transliterated: yaʿiduhum wayumannīhim wamā yaʿiduhumu l-shayṭānu illā ghurūra
verses.english: He promises them and entices them; what the devil promises is no more than an illusion.

1981.english: He promises them, and entices them; whatever the devil promises is an illusion.

1989.english: He promises them and entices them; what the devil promises is no more than an illusion.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ عَنْهَا مَحِيصًا
verses.arabicClean: أولئك مأواهم جهنم ولا يجدون عنها محيصا
verses.transliterated: ulāika mawāhum jahannamu walā yajidūna ʿanhā maḥīṣa
verses.english: These have incurred Hell as their final abode, and can never evade it.

1981.english: The final abode for these will be hell; they can never evade it.

1989.english: The final abode for these is Hell; they can never evade it.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ قِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات سندخلهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا ۖ وعد الله حقا ۚ ومن أصدق من الله قيلا
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sanud'khiluhum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan waman aṣdaqu mina l-lahi qīla
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will admit them into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they live forever. Such is the truthful promise of GOD. Whose utterances are more truthful than GOD's?

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, we will admit them into gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. This is the truthful promise of God, and whose utterance is more truthful than God's?

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will admit them into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they live forever. Such is the truthful promise of GOD. Who is more truthful than GOD?

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ بِأَمَانِيِّكُمْ وَلَآ أَمَانِىِّ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا يُجْزَ بِهِۦ وَلَا يَجِدْ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ليس بأمانيكم ولا أماني أهل الكتاب ۗ من يعمل سوءا يجز به ولا يجد له من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا
verses.transliterated: laysa bi-amāniyyikum walā amāniyyi ahli l-kitābi man yaʿmal sūan yuj'za bihi walā yajid lahu min dūni l-lahi waliyyan walā naṣīra
verses.english: It is not in accordance with your wishes, or the wishes of the people of the scripture: anyone who commits evil pays for it, and will have no helper or supporter, against GOD.
verses.subtitle: The Law

1981.english: It is not according to your wishes, or the wishes of the people of the scripture; anyone who works evil will be punished therefor, and will find no one to protect him, or support him, against God.

1989.english: It is not in accordance with your wishes, or the wishes of the people of the scripture: anyone who commits evil pays for it, and has no helper or supporter, besides GOD.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ نَقِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يعمل من الصالحات من ذكر أو أنثى وهو مؤمن فأولئك يدخلون الجنة ولا يظلمون نقيرا
verses.transliterated: waman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna naqīra
verses.english: As for those who lead a righteous life, male or female, while believing, they enter Paradise; without the slightest injustice.

1981.english: On the other hand, anyone who works righteousness, be it male or female, while being a believer, these will enter Paradise, and never suffer a grain of injustice.

1989.english: As for those who lead a righteous life, male or female, while believing, they enter Paradise, and never suffer the slightest harm.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًا مِّمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ وَٱتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ خَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن أحسن دينا ممن أسلم وجهه لله وهو محسن واتبع ملة إبراهيم حنيفا ۗ واتخذ الله إبراهيم خليلا
verses.transliterated: waman aḥsanu dīnan mimman aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muḥ'sinun wa-ittabaʿa millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wa-ittakhadha l-lahu ib'rāhīma khalīla
verses.english: Who is better guided in his religion than one who submits totally to GOD, leads a righteous life, according to the creed of Abraham: monotheism? GOD has chosen Abraham as a beloved friend.
verses.subtitle: Abraham: Original Messenger of Submission
verses.footnote: All messengers since Adam have preached one and the same religion. Abraham was the original messenger of the creed named "Islam" (22:78, Appendix 26). "Islam" is not a name, but rather a description meaning "Submission."

1981.english: Whose religion is better than one who submits himself to God, works righteousness, and follows the creed of Abraham the monotheist? God has chosen Abraham as a beloved friend.
1981.subtitle: This Is The Religion of Abraham

1989.english: Whose religion is better than one who submits totally to GOD, leads a righteous life, and upholds the creed of Abraham: monotheism? GOD has chosen Abraham as a beloved friend.
1989.subtitle: Abraham: Original Messenger of Islam
1989.footnote: All messengers since Adam have preached one and the same religion. Abraham was the original messenger of the creed named “Islam” (22:78, Appendix 26). “Islam” is not a name, but rather a description meaning “Submission. ”

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطًا
verses.arabicClean: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ وكان الله بكل شيء محيطا
verses.transliterated: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭa
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is in full control of all things.

1981.english: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and God is in full control of all things.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is in full control of all things.

verses.arabic: وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِى ٱلنِّسَآءِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ فِى يَتَٰمَى ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِى لَا تُؤْتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ وَٱلْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنِ وَأَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلْيَتَٰمَىٰ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ويستفتونك في النساء ۖ قل الله يفتيكم فيهن وما يتلى عليكم في الكتاب في يتامى النساء اللاتي لا تؤتونهن ما كتب لهن وترغبون أن تنكحوهن والمستضعفين من الولدان وأن تقوموا لليتامى بالقسط ۚ وما تفعلوا من خير فإن الله كان به عليما
verses.transliterated: wayastaftūnaka fī l-nisāi quli l-lahu yuf'tīkum fīhinna wamā yut'lā ʿalaykum fī l-kitābi fī yatāmā l-nisāi allātī lā tu'tūnahunna mā kutiba lahunna watarghabūna an tankiḥūhunna wal-mus'taḍʿafīna mina l-wil'dāni wa-an taqūmū lil'yatāmā bil-qis'ṭi wamā tafʿalū min khayrin fa-inna l-laha kāna bihi ʿalīma
verses.english: They consult you concerning women: say, "GOD enlightens you regarding them, as recited for you in the scripture. You shall restore the rights of orphaned girls whom you cheat out of their due dowries when you wish to marry them: you shall not take advantage of them. The rights of orphaned boys must also be protected as well. You shall treat the orphans equitably. Whatever good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof."

1981.english: They consult you concerning the women; say, "God instructs you in this scripture about them, and about the orphan girls whom you wish to marry, but refuse to give them their due dowry. God also instructs you about the small children, and that you shall treat the orphans equitably. Whatever good you do, God is fully aware thereof."
1981.subtitle: You Shall Regard The Women And The Orphans

1989.english: They consult you concerning women: say, “GOD enlightens you regarding them, as recited for you in the scripture. You shall restore the rights of orphaned girls whom you deprive of their dowries when you marry them: you shall not take advantage of them. The rights of orphaned boys must be protected as well. You shall treat the orphans equitably. Whatever good you do, GOD is fully aware thereof.”

verses.arabic: وَإِنِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنۢ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ أَن يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًا وَٱلصُّلْحُ خَيْرٌ وَأُحْضِرَتِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ ٱلشُّحَّ وَإِن تُحْسِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وإن امرأة خافت من بعلها نشوزا أو إعراضا فلا جناح عليهما أن يصلحا بينهما صلحا ۚ والصلح خير ۗ وأحضرت الأنفس الشح ۚ وإن تحسنوا وتتقوا فإن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا
verses.transliterated: wa-ini im'ra-atun khāfat min baʿlihā nushūzan aw iʿ'rāḍan falā junāḥa ʿalayhimā an yuṣ'liḥā baynahumā ṣul'ḥan wal-ṣul'ḥu khayrun wa-uḥ'ḍirati l-anfusu l-shuḥa wa-in tuḥ'sinū watattaqū fa-inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīra
verses.english: If a woman senses oppression or desertion from her husband, the couple shall try to reconcile their differences, for conciliation is best for them. Selfishness is a human trait, and if you do good and lead a righteous life, GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
verses.subtitle: Divorce Discouraged

1981.english: And when a woman fears desertion or neglect by her husband, the couple should try to reconcile, for conciliation is better. Since selfishness is a human instinct, if you work righteousness and observe God, then God is fully cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: If a woman senses oppression or desertion from her husband, the couple will do better by reconciling their differences; conciliation is good. Since selfishness is a human trait, if you do good and lead a righteous life, then GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
1989.subtitle: Divorce Discouraged

verses.arabic: وَلَن تَسْتَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتُمْ فَلَا تَمِيلُوا۟ كُلَّ ٱلْمَيْلِ فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلْمُعَلَّقَةِ وَإِن تُصْلِحُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولن تستطيعوا أن تعدلوا بين النساء ولو حرصتم ۖ فلا تميلوا كل الميل فتذروها كالمعلقة ۚ وإن تصلحوا وتتقوا فإن الله كان غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: walan tastaṭīʿū an taʿdilū bayna l-nisāi walaw ḥaraṣtum falā tamīlū kulla l-mayli fatadharūhā kal-muʿalaqati wa-in tuṣ'liḥū watattaqū fa-inna l-laha kāna ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: You can never be equitable in dealing with more than one wife, no matter how hard you try. Therefore, do not be so biased as to leave one of them hanging (neither enjoying marriage, nor left to marry someone else). If you correct this situation and maintain righteousness, GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Polygamy Discouraged
verses.footnote: See Appendix 30, entitled "Polygamy."

1981.english: In polygamy, you can never be equally attentive towards your wives, no matter how hard you try. However, you shall not be so partial that you neglect one wife so completely that she is left hanging, neither married, nor free to marry someone else. If you correct this situation, and observe righteousness, then God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: You can never be equitable in dealing with more than one wife. Therefore, do not be so biased as to leave one of them hanging (neither enjoying marriage, nor left to marry someone else). If you correct this situation and maintain righteousness, GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: Polygamy Discouraged

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغْنِ ٱللَّهُ كُلًّا مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وإن يتفرقا يغن الله كلا من سعته ۚ وكان الله واسعا حكيما
verses.transliterated: wa-in yatafarraqā yugh'ni l-lahu kullan min saʿatihi wakāna l-lahu wāsiʿan ḥakīma
verses.english: If the couple must decide to part, GOD will provide for each of them from His bounties. GOD is Bounteous, Most Wise.

1981.english: If they decide to part, God will enrich them from His bounty, for God is bounteous, wise.

1989.english: If the couple decides to part, GOD will provide for each of them from His bounties. GOD is Bounteous, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنِ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَنِيًّا حَمِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۗ ولقد وصينا الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم وإياكم أن اتقوا الله ۚ وإن تكفروا فإن لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ وكان الله غنيا حميدا
verses.transliterated: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walaqad waṣṣaynā alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wa-iyyākum ani ittaqū l-laha wa-in takfurū fa-inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wakāna l-lahu ghaniyyan ḥamīda
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and we have enjoined on those who received the scripture before you, and enjoined on you, that you shall reverence GOD. If you disbelieve, then to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.

1981.english: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and we have given commandments to those who received previous scriptures, and to you, that you shall observe God. If you disbelieve, then to God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and God is in no need, worthy of all praise.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and we have enjoined on those who received previous scripture, and on you, that you shall reverence GOD. If you disbelieve, then to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ وكفى بالله وكيلا
verses.transliterated: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wakafā bil-lahi wakīla
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and GOD is the only Protector.

1981.english: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and God suffices as guardian.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and GOD suffices as guardian.

verses.arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَيَأْتِ بِـَٔاخَرِينَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ قَدِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن يشأ يذهبكم أيها الناس ويأت بآخرين ۚ وكان الله على ذلك قديرا
verses.transliterated: in yasha yudh'hib'kum ayyuhā l-nāsu wayati biākharīna wakāna l-lahu ʿalā dhālika qadīra
verses.english: If He wills, He can annihilate you, O people, and substitute others in your place. GOD is certainly able to do this.

1981.english: If He wills, He can get rid of you, O people, and substitute others in your place, God is certainly able to do this.

1989.english: If He wills, He can annihilate you, O people, and substitute others in your place. GOD is certainly able to do this.

verses.arabic: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ ثَوَابُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: من كان يريد ثواب الدنيا فعند الله ثواب الدنيا والآخرة ۚ وكان الله سميعا بصيرا
verses.transliterated: man kāna yurīdu thawāba l-dun'yā faʿinda l-lahi thawābu l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wakāna l-lahu samīʿan baṣīra
verses.english: Anyone who seeks the materials of this world should know that GOD possesses both the materials of this world and the Hereafter. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

1981.english: If you want the materials of this world, to God belongs the material of both this world and the hereafter. God is hearer, seer.

1989.english: If one is seeking the materials of this life, GOD possesses both the materials of this world and the Hereafter. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ إِن يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًا فَٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِمَا فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ وَإِن تَلْوُۥٓا۟ أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا كونوا قوامين بالقسط شهداء لله ولو على أنفسكم أو الوالدين والأقربين ۚ إن يكن غنيا أو فقيرا فالله أولى بهما ۖ فلا تتبعوا الهوى أن تعدلوا ۚ وإن تلووا أو تعرضوا فإن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū kūnū qawwāmīna bil-qis'ṭi shuhadāa lillahi walaw ʿalā anfusikum awi l-wālidayni wal-aqrabīna in yakun ghaniyyan aw faqīran fal-lahu awlā bihimā falā tattabiʿū l-hawā an taʿdilū wa-in talwū aw tuʿ'riḍū fa-inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīra
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall be absolutely equitable, and observe GOD, when you serve as witnesses, even against yourselves, or your parents, or your relatives. Whether the accused is rich or poor, GOD takes care of both. Therefore, do not be biased by your personal wishes. If you deviate or disregard (this commandment), then GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Not Bear False Witness

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall be perfectly honest, and observe God, when you serve as witnesses; even if it is against yourselves, your parents, or your relatives. Whether the defendant is rich or poor, God will deal with him equitably. You shall not follow your personal desires, lest you deviate. If you bear false witness, or refuse to testify, then God is fully cognizant of what you do.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Not Bear False Witness

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall be absolutely equitable, and observe GOD, when you serve as witnesses, even against yourselves, or your parents, or your relatives. Whether the accused is rich or poor, GOD takes care of both. Therefore, do not be biased by your personal wishes. If you deviate or disregard (this commandment), then GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Not Bear False Witness

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا آمنوا بالله ورسوله والكتاب الذي نزل على رسوله والكتاب الذي أنزل من قبل ۚ ومن يكفر بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر فقد ضل ضلالا بعيدا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wal-kitābi alladhī nazzala ʿalā rasūlihi wal-kitābi alladhī anzala min qablu waman yakfur bil-lahi wamalāikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri faqad ḍalla ḍalālan baʿīda
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall believe in GOD and His messenger, and the scripture He has revealed through His messenger, and the scripture He has revealed before that. Anyone who refuses to believe in GOD, and His angels, and His scriptures, and His messengers, and the Last Day, has indeed strayed far astray.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall believe in God, and His messenger, and the scripture He revealed through His messenger, and the scriptures He revealed previously. Anyone who disbelieves in God, His angels, His scriptures, His messengers, and the last day, has indeed strayed far away.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall believe in GOD and His messenger, and the scripture He has revealed through His messenger, and the scripture He has revealed before that. Anyone who disbelieves in GOD, and His angels, and His scriptures, and His messengers, and the Last Day, has indeed strayed far astray.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًا لَّمْ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ سَبِيلًۢا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا ثم كفروا ثم آمنوا ثم كفروا ثم ازدادوا كفرا لم يكن الله ليغفر لهم ولا ليهديهم سبيلا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū thumma kafarū thumma āmanū thumma kafarū thumma iz'dādū kuf'ran lam yakuni l-lahu liyaghfira lahum walā liyahdiyahum sabīla
verses.english: Surely, those who believe, then disbelieve, then believe, then disbelieve, then plunge deeper into disbelief, GOD will not forgive them, nor will He guide them in any way.

1981.english: Those who believe, then disbelieve, then believe, then disbelieve, then plunge deeper into disbelief, God will not forgive them, nor will He guide them to any path.
1981.subtitle: The Hypocrites

1989.english: Surely, those who believe, then disbelieve, then believe, then disbelieve, then plunge deeper into disbelief, GOD will not forgive them, nor will He guide them in any way.

verses.arabic: بَشِّرِ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: بشر المنافقين بأن لهم عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: bashiri l-munāfiqīna bi-anna lahum ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: Inform the hypocrites that they have incurred painful retribution.

1981.english: Promise the hypocrites that they will suffer painful retribution.

1989.english: Inform the hypocrites that they have incurred painful retribution.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّخِذُونَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَيَبْتَغُونَ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَإِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا
verses.arabicClean: الذين يتخذون الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين ۚ أيبتغون عندهم العزة فإن العزة لله جميعا
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yattakhidhūna l-kāfirīna awliyāa min dūni l-mu'minīna ayabtaghūna ʿindahumu l-ʿizata fa-inna l-ʿizata lillahi jamīʿa
verses.english: They are the ones who ally themselves with disbelievers instead of believers. Are they seeking dignity with them? All dignity belongs with GOD alone.

1981.english: They are the ones who choose the disbelievers as allies, instead of believers. Are they seeking dignity through them? To God belongs all dignity.

1989.english: They are the ones who ally themselves with disbelievers instead of believers. Are they seeking dignity with them? All dignity belongs with GOD alone.

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنْ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يُكْفَرُ بِهَا وَيُسْتَهْزَأُ بِهَا فَلَا تَقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا مِّثْلُهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ جَامِعُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعًا
verses.arabicClean: وقد نزل عليكم في الكتاب أن إذا سمعتم آيات الله يكفر بها ويستهزأ بها فلا تقعدوا معهم حتى يخوضوا في حديث غيره ۚ إنكم إذا مثلهم ۗ إن الله جامع المنافقين والكافرين في جهنم جميعا
verses.transliterated: waqad nazzala ʿalaykum fī l-kitābi an idhā samiʿ'tum āyāti l-lahi yuk'faru bihā wayus'tahza-u bihā falā taqʿudū maʿahum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrihi innakum idhan mith'luhum inna l-laha jāmiʿu l-munāfiqīna wal-kāfirīna fī jahannama jamīʿa
verses.english: He has instructed you in the scripture that: if you hear GOD's revelations being mocked and ridiculed, you shall not sit with them, unless they delve into another subject. Otherwise, you will be as guilty as they are. GOD will gather the hypocrites and the disbelievers together in Hell.

1981.english: He has revealed to you in the scripture that if you hear the revelations of God being rejected and ridiculed, you shall not sit with them, unless they change the subject. Otherwise, you will be as guilty as they are. God will gather the hypocrites together with the disbelievers in hell.

1989.english: He has instructed you in the scripture that: if you hear GOD’s revelations being mocked or ridiculed, you shall not sit with them, unless they delve into another subject. Otherwise, you will be as guilty as they are. GOD will gather the hypocrites and the disbelievers together in Hell.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمْ فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ فَتْحٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوٓا۟ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ وَإِن كَانَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نَصِيبٌ قَالُوٓا۟ أَلَمْ نَسْتَحْوِذْ عَلَيْكُمْ وَنَمْنَعْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَن يَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: الذين يتربصون بكم فإن كان لكم فتح من الله قالوا ألم نكن معكم وإن كان للكافرين نصيب قالوا ألم نستحوذ عليكم ونمنعكم من المؤمنين ۚ فالله يحكم بينكم يوم القيامة ۗ ولن يجعل الله للكافرين على المؤمنين سبيلا
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yatarabbaṣūna bikum fa-in kāna lakum fatḥun mina l-lahi qālū alam nakun maʿakum wa-in kāna lil'kāfirīna naṣībun qālū alam nastaḥwidh ʿalaykum wanamnaʿkum mina l-mu'minīna fal-lahu yaḥkumu baynakum yawma l-qiyāmati walan yajʿala l-lahu lil'kāfirīna ʿalā l-mu'minīna sabīla
verses.english: They watch you and wait; if you attain victory from GOD, they say (to you), "Were we not with you?" But if the disbelievers get a turn, they say (to them), "Did we not side with you, and protect you from the believers?" GOD will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection. GOD will never permit the disbelievers to prevail over the believers.
verses.subtitle: The Hypocrites

1981.english: They watch you and wait. Then, if God blesses you with victory, they would say, "Were we not with you?" And if the disbelievers win, they would say to them, "Did we not protect you by hindering the believers?" God will judge between you on the day of resurrection, and God will never permit the disbelievers to overcome the believers.

1989.english: They watch you and wait; if you attain victory from GOD, they say (to you), “Were we not with you?” But if the disbelievers get a turn, they say (to them), “Did we not side with you, and protect you from the believers?” GOD will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection, and GOD will never permit the disbelievers to prevail over the believers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَهُوَ خَٰدِعُهُمْ وَإِذَا قَامُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ قَامُوا۟ كُسَالَىٰ يُرَآءُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَلَا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إن المنافقين يخادعون الله وهو خادعهم وإذا قاموا إلى الصلاة قاموا كسالى يراءون الناس ولا يذكرون الله إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: inna l-munāfiqīna yukhādiʿūna l-laha wahuwa khādiʿuhum wa-idhā qāmū ilā l-ṣalati qāmū kusālā yurāūna l-nāsa walā yadhkurūna l-laha illā qalīla
verses.english: The hypocrites think that they are deceiving GOD, but He is the One who leads them on. When they get up for the Contact Prayer (Salat), they get up lazily. That is because they only show off in front of the people, and rarely do they think of GOD.

1981.english: The hypocrites are trying to deceive God, but He is the one who deceives them. When they get up for the **salat** prayers, they get up lazily, for they only do it to show off, and they never think of God but rarely.

1989.english: The hypocrites think that they are deceiving GOD, but He is the One who keeps them deceived. When they get up for the contact prayer (Salat), they get up lazily. That is because they only show off in front of the people, and rarely do they remember GOD.
1989.subtitle: The Hypocrites

verses.arabic: مُّذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَلَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: مذبذبين بين ذلك لا إلى هؤلاء ولا إلى هؤلاء ۚ ومن يضلل الله فلن تجد له سبيلا
verses.transliterated: mudhabdhabīna bayna dhālika lā ilā hāulāi walā ilā hāulāi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu falan tajida lahu sabīla
verses.english: They waver in between, neither belonging to this group, nor that group. Whomever GOD sends astray, you will never find a way to guide him.

1981.english: They waver between this and that; they neither belong to this group, nor to that group. Whomever God misguides, you will find no way to guide him.

1989.english: Wavering in between, they neither belong to these, nor to those. Whomever GOD misleads, you will never find a way for him.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَتُرِيدُونَ أَن تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين ۚ أتريدون أن تجعلوا لله عليكم سلطانا مبينا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū l-kāfirīna awliyāa min dūni l-mu'minīna aturīdūna an tajʿalū lillahi ʿalaykum sul'ṭānan mubīna
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall not ally yourselves with the disbelievers, instead of the believers. Do you wish to provide GOD with a clear proof against you?

1981.english: O you who believe, do not choose the disbelievers as allies, instead of believers. Do you wish to provide God with a manifest proof against you?

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall not ally yourselves with the disbelievers, instead of the believers. Do you wish to provide GOD with a clear proof against you?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ فِى ٱلدَّرْكِ ٱلْأَسْفَلِ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن المنافقين في الدرك الأسفل من النار ولن تجد لهم نصيرا
verses.transliterated: inna l-munāfiqīna fī l-darki l-asfali mina l-nāri walan tajida lahum naṣīra
verses.english: The hypocrites will be committed to the lowest pit of Hell, and you will find no one to help them.
verses.subtitle: They Think That They Are Believers

1981.english: The hypocrites will occupy the lowest pit of hell, and no one can help them.

1989.english: The hypocrites have deserved the lowest pit of Hell, and you will find no one to help them.
1989.subtitle: They Think That They Are Believers

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ وَٱعْتَصَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَأَخْلَصُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لِلَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَسَوْفَ يُؤْتِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين تابوا وأصلحوا واعتصموا بالله وأخلصوا دينهم لله فأولئك مع المؤمنين ۖ وسوف يؤت الله المؤمنين أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna tābū wa-aṣlaḥū wa-iʿ'taṣamū bil-lahi wa-akhlaṣū dīnahum lillahi fa-ulāika maʿa l-mu'minīna wasawfa yu'ti l-lahu l-mu'minīna ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Only those who repent, reform, hold fast to GOD, and devote their religion absolutely to GOD alone, will be counted with the believers. GOD will bless the believers with a great recompense.

1981.english: Only those who repent, reform and hold fast to God, and devote their religion to God, will be counted as believers. God will endow the believers with a great recompense.

1989.english: As for those who repent, reform, and hold fast to GOD, and devote their religion absolutely to GOD alone, these are to be counted with the believers. GOD will bless the believers with a great recompense.

verses.arabic: مَّا يَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابِكُمْ إِن شَكَرْتُمْ وَءَامَنتُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ شَاكِرًا عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ما يفعل الله بعذابكم إن شكرتم وآمنتم ۚ وكان الله شاكرا عليما
verses.transliterated: mā yafʿalu l-lahu biʿadhābikum in shakartum waāmantum wakāna l-lahu shākiran ʿalīma
verses.english: What will GOD gain from punishing you, if you became appreciative and believed? GOD is Appreciative, Omniscient.

1981.english: What will God gain from punishing you, if you are appreciative believers? God is appreciative, omniscient.

1989.english: What will GOD gain from punishing you, if you became appreciative and believed? GOD is Appreciative, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: لَّا يُحِبُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْجَهْرَ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ إِلَّا مَن ظُلِمَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: لا يحب الله الجهر بالسوء من القول إلا من ظلم ۚ وكان الله سميعا عليما
verses.transliterated: lā yuḥibbu l-lahu l-jahra bil-sūi mina l-qawli illā man ẓulima wakāna l-lahu samīʿan ʿalīma
verses.english: GOD does not like the utterance of bad language, unless one is treated with gross injustice. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Use Bad Language

1981.english: God dislikes the utterance of bad language, unless you suffer injustice. God is hearer, knower.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Utter Bad Language

1989.english: GOD does not like the utterance of bad language, unless one is forced by oppression. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Not Use Bad Language

verses.arabic: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ خَيْرًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ أَوْ تَعْفُوا۟ عَن سُوٓءٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا قَدِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن تبدوا خيرا أو تخفوه أو تعفوا عن سوء فإن الله كان عفوا قديرا
verses.transliterated: in tub'dū khayran aw tukh'fūhu aw taʿfū ʿan sūin fa-inna l-laha kāna ʿafuwwan qadīra
verses.english: If you work righteousness—either declared or concealed—or pardon a transgression, GOD is Pardoner, Omnipotent.

1981.english: Whether you declare a righteous work, or conceal it, or pardon an offense, God is pardoner, omnipotent.

1989.english: If you work righteousness—then either declare it or conceal it— or pardon a transgression, GOD is Pardoner, Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يُفَرِّقُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَيَقُولُونَ نُؤْمِنُ بِبَعْضٍ وَنَكْفُرُ بِبَعْضٍ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يكفرون بالله ورسله ويريدون أن يفرقوا بين الله ورسله ويقولون نؤمن ببعض ونكفر ببعض ويريدون أن يتخذوا بين ذلك سبيلا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yakfurūna bil-lahi warusulihi wayurīdūna an yufarriqū bayna l-lahi warusulihi wayaqūlūna nu'minu bibaʿḍin wanakfuru bibaʿḍin wayurīdūna an yattakhidhū bayna dhālika sabīla
verses.english: Those who disbelieve in GOD and His messengers, and seek to make distinction among GOD and His messengers, and say, "We believe in some and reject some," and wish to follow a path in between;
verses.subtitle: You Shall Not Make Any Distinction Among God's Messengers

1981.english: Those who disbelieve in God and His messengers, and make distinctions among God and His messengers, and say, "We believe in some, and reject some," and try to follow an inbetween path;
1981.subtitle: No Distinction Among the Messengers
1981.footnote: A common practice among the Muslims is the description of Muhammad as "the most honorable messenger" or "the imam of the messengers," in defiance of God's commandments.

1989.english: Those who disbelieve in GOD and His messengers, and seek to make distinction among GOD and His messengers, and say, “We believe in some and reject some,” and wish to follow a path in between—
1989.subtitle: You Shall Not Make Any Distinction Among God’s Messengers

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ حَقًّا وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
verses.arabicClean: أولئك هم الكافرون حقا ۚ وأعتدنا للكافرين عذابا مهينا
verses.transliterated: ulāika humu l-kāfirūna ḥaqqan wa-aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāban muhīna
verses.english: these are the real disbelievers. We have prepared for the disbelievers a shameful retribution.

1981.english: these are really disbelievers, and we have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating retribution.
1981.footnote: A common practice among the Muslims is the description of Muhammad as "the most honorable messenger" or "the imam of the messengers," in defiance of God's commandments.

1989.english: these are the real disbelievers. We have prepared for the disbelievers a shameful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ سَوْفَ يُؤْتِيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا بالله ورسله ولم يفرقوا بين أحد منهم أولئك سوف يؤتيهم أجورهم ۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi walam yufarriqū bayna aḥadin min'hum ulāika sawfa yu'tīhim ujūrahum wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: As for those who believe in GOD and His messengers, and make no distinction among them, He will grant them their recompense. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: As for those who believe in God and His messengers, and make no distinction among any of them, God will recompense them. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: As for those who believe in GOD and His messengers, and make no distinction among them, He will grant them their recompense. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُكَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَن تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ كِتَٰبًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَقَدْ سَأَلُوا۟ مُوسَىٰٓ أَكْبَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَرِنَا ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ بِظُلْمِهِمْ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ فَعَفَوْنَا عَن ذَٰلِكَ وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ سُلْطَٰنًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: يسألك أهل الكتاب أن تنزل عليهم كتابا من السماء ۚ فقد سألوا موسى أكبر من ذلك فقالوا أرنا الله جهرة فأخذتهم الصاعقة بظلمهم ۚ ثم اتخذوا العجل من بعد ما جاءتهم البينات فعفونا عن ذلك ۚ وآتينا موسى سلطانا مبينا
verses.transliterated: yasaluka ahlu l-kitābi an tunazzila ʿalayhim kitāban mina l-samāi faqad sa-alū mūsā akbara min dhālika faqālū arinā l-laha jahratan fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu biẓul'mihim thumma ittakhadhū l-ʿij'la min baʿdi mā jāathumu l-bayinātu faʿafawnā ʿan dhālika waātaynā mūsā sul'ṭānan mubīna
verses.english: The people of the scripture challenge you to bring down to them a book from the sky! They have asked Moses for more than that, saying, "Show us GOD, physically." Consequently, the lightning struck them, as a consequence of their audacity. Additionally, they worshiped the calf, after all the miracles they had seen. Yet, we pardoned all this. We supported Moses with profound miracles.
verses.subtitle: Lessons From Israel

1981.english: The people of the scripture ask you to show them a scripture coming down from the sky! They have asked Moses for more than that, saying, "Show us God, physically." The lightning struck them as a consequence of their wickedness. Then, they idolized the calf inspite of the profound miracles they had witnessed, and we still pardoned them. We gave Moses profound authority.
1981.subtitle: Lessons From Israel
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: The people of the scripture challenge you to bring down to them a book from the sky! They have asked Moses for even more than that, saying, “Show us GOD, physically.” Consequently, the lightning struck them, due to their transgression. Then they worshiped the calf, despite all the miracles shown to them. Yet, we pardoned all this. We supported Moses with profound miracles.
1989.subtitle: Lessons From Israel

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَهُمُ ٱلطُّورَ بِمِيثَٰقِهِمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ لَا تَعْدُوا۟ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًا
verses.arabicClean: ورفعنا فوقهم الطور بميثاقهم وقلنا لهم ادخلوا الباب سجدا وقلنا لهم لا تعدوا في السبت وأخذنا منهم ميثاقا غليظا
verses.transliterated: warafaʿnā fawqahumu l-ṭūra bimīthāqihim waqul'nā lahumu ud'khulū l-bāba sujjadan waqul'nā lahum lā taʿdū fī l-sabti wa-akhadhnā min'hum mīthāqan ghalīẓa
verses.english: And we raised Mount Sinai above them, as we took their covenant. And we said to them, "Enter the gate humbly." And we said to them, "Do not desecrate the Sabbath." Indeed, we took from them a solemn covenant.

1981.english: We raised Mount Sinai above them, as we made a covenant with them, and we said to them, "Enter the gate humbly," and we said to them, "Do not desecrate the Sabbath." We took from them a solemn pledge.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: We raised Mount Sinai above them, as we took their covenant, and we said to them, “Enter the gate humbly,” and we said to them, “Do not desecrate the Sabbath;” we took from them a solemn covenant.

verses.arabic: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَٰقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِم بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَقَوْلِهِمْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ بَلْ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: فبما نقضهم ميثاقهم وكفرهم بآيات الله وقتلهم الأنبياء بغير حق وقولهم قلوبنا غلف ۚ بل طبع الله عليها بكفرهم فلا يؤمنون إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: fabimā naqḍihim mīthāqahum wakuf'rihim biāyāti l-lahi waqatlihimu l-anbiyāa bighayri ḥaqqin waqawlihim qulūbunā ghul'fun bal ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalayhā bikuf'rihim falā yu'minūna illā qalīla
verses.english: (They incurred condemnation) for violating their covenant, rejecting GOD's revelations, killing the prophets unjustly, and for saying, "Our minds are made up!" In fact, GOD is the One who sealed their minds, due to their disbelief, and this is why they fail to believe, except rarely.

1981.english: Therefore, because they violated their covenant, and discarded God's scripture, and killed the prophets unjustly; and because they said, "Our hearts are shielded," though God is the one who sealed their hearts, as a consequence of their disbelief. That is why they do not believe, except rarely.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: (They incurred condemnation) for violating their covenant, rejecting GOD’s revelations, killing the prophets unjustly, and for saying, “Our minds are made up!” In fact, GOD is the One who sealed their minds, due to their transgressions. This is why they fail to believe, except rarely.

verses.arabic: وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَٰنًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وبكفرهم وقولهم على مريم بهتانا عظيما
verses.transliterated: wabikuf'rihim waqawlihim ʿalā maryama buh'tānan ʿaẓīma
verses.english: (They are condemned) for disbelieving and uttering about Mary a gross lie.

1981.english: And because of their rebellion, and because of accusing Mary of a terrible falsehood;
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: (They are condemned) for disbelieving and uttering about Mary a gross lie.

verses.arabic: وَقَوْلِهِمْ إِنَّا قَتَلْنَا ٱلْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَٰكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا ٱتِّبَاعَ ٱلظَّنِّ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ يَقِينًۢا
verses.arabicClean: وقولهم إنا قتلنا المسيح عيسى ابن مريم رسول الله وما قتلوه وما صلبوه ولكن شبه لهم ۚ وإن الذين اختلفوا فيه لفي شك منه ۚ ما لهم به من علم إلا اتباع الظن ۚ وما قتلوه يقينا
verses.transliterated: waqawlihim innā qatalnā l-masīḥa ʿīsā ib'na maryama rasūla l-lahi wamā qatalūhu wamā ṣalabūhu walākin shubbiha lahum wa-inna alladhīna ikh'talafū fīhi lafī shakkin min'hu mā lahum bihi min ʿil'min illā ittibāʿa l-ẓani wamā qatalūhu yaqīna
verses.english: And for claiming that they killed the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, the messenger of GOD. In fact, they never killed him, they never crucified him—they were made to think that they did. All factions who are disputing in this matter are full of doubt concerning this issue. They possess no knowledge; they only conjecture. For certain, they never killed him.
verses.subtitle: Crucifying "the Body" of Jesus
verses.footnote: Jesus, the real person, the soul, was raised in the same manner as in the death of any righteous person. Subsequently, his enemies arrested, tortured, and crucified his living, but empty, body. See Appendices 17 & 22, and the book "Jesus: Myths and Message" by Lisa Spray (Universal Unity, Fremont, California, 1992).

1981.english: And because they said, "We killed the Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary," the messenger of God. Indeed, they never killed him; they never crucified him; but they were led to believe that they did. Those who dispute in this matter are doubtful thereof; they have no real knowledge; they follow only conjecture. They never killed him, for certain.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: And for saying, “We killed (the Messiah) Jesus, son of Mary,” the messenger of GOD. They never killed him, they never crucified himthey were made to think that they did. All factions are full of doubt concerning this issue. They possess no knowledge; they only conjecture. For certain, they never killed him.*
1989.subtitle: Crucifying “the Body” of Jesus
1989.footnote: Jesus, the real person, the soul, was raised in the same manner as in the death of any human being. Subsequently, his enemies tortured and crucified his living, but empty, body. See Appendix 22 and the book “Doctrine Development in Christianity” by Lisa Spray (Renaissance Productions, Tucson, Arizona, 1989).

verses.arabic: بَل رَّفَعَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: بل رفعه الله إليه ۚ وكان الله عزيزا حكيما
verses.transliterated: bal rafaʿahu l-lahu ilayhi wakāna l-lahu ʿazīzan ḥakīma
verses.english: Instead, GOD raised him to Him; GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: Instead, God raised him towards Him, and God is almighty, wise.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: Instead, GOD raised him to Him; GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
1989.footnote: Jesus, the real person, the soul, was raised in the same manner as in the death of any human being. Subsequently, his enemies tortured and crucified his living, but empty, body. See Appendix 22 and the book “Doctrine Development in Christianity” by Lisa Spray (Renaissance Productions, Tucson, Arizona, 1989).

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِۦ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: وإن من أهل الكتاب إلا ليؤمنن به قبل موته ۖ ويوم القيامة يكون عليهم شهيدا
verses.transliterated: wa-in min ahli l-kitābi illā layu'minanna bihi qabla mawtihi wayawma l-qiyāmati yakūnu ʿalayhim shahīda
verses.english: Everyone among the people of the scripture was required to believe in him before his death. On the Day of Resurrection, he will be a witness against them.

1981.english: Everyone among the people of the scripture shall believe in him before his death, and on the day of resurrection, he will serve as a witness over them.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: Everyone among the people of the scripture was required to believe in him before his death. On the Day of Resurrection, he will be a witness against them.

verses.arabic: فَبِظُلْمٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ طَيِّبَٰتٍ أُحِلَّتْ لَهُمْ وَبِصَدِّهِمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: فبظلم من الذين هادوا حرمنا عليهم طيبات أحلت لهم وبصدهم عن سبيل الله كثيرا
verses.transliterated: fabiẓul'min mina alladhīna hādū ḥarramnā ʿalayhim ṭayyibātin uḥillat lahum wabiṣaddihim ʿan sabīli l-lahi kathīra
verses.english: Due to their transgressions, we prohibited for the Jews good foods that used to be lawful for them; also for consistently repelling from the path of GOD.

1981.english: Thus, because of all their wicked actions, we prohibited for the Jews good things that were previously permitted for them. Also, because they repulsed many people from the way of God.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: Due to these transgressions, we enjoined the Jews from good foods that used to be lawful for them, and for repelling from GOD’s way.

verses.arabic: وَأَخْذِهِمُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ وَقَدْ نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَكْلِهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وأخذهم الربا وقد نهوا عنه وأكلهم أموال الناس بالباطل ۚ وأعتدنا للكافرين منهم عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: wa-akhdhihimu l-riba waqad nuhū ʿanhu wa-aklihim amwāla l-nāsi bil-bāṭili wa-aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna min'hum ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: And for practicing usury, which was forbidden, and for consuming the people's money illicitly. We have prepared for the disbelievers among them painful retribution.

1981.english: And because they charged usury, though they were forbidden therefrom, and because they cheated the people out of their money. We have prepared for the disbelievers among them a painful retribution.
1981.footnote: The reader will note that the children of Israel are frequently mentioned throughout the Quran. Obviously, God wants to alert us against the pitfalls that Israel fell in. The parallel between the Muslims and Jews is noteworthy. Although God gave the Jews His scripture, the Torah, the Jews eventually invented the **Mishnah** (oral) and the **Gemarah** (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence. Similarly, the Muslims abandoned God's message to them, the Quran, and invented the "**Hadith**" (oral) and "**Sunna**" (traditions), and used them as sources of jurisprudence (See 6:112-116 and 25:30-31).

1989.english: And for practicing usury, which is forbidden, and for consuming the people’s money illicitly. We have prepared for the disbelievers among them painful retribution.

verses.arabic: لَّٰكِنِ ٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ مِنْهُمْ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَٱلْمُقِيمِينَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ سَنُؤْتِيهِمْ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: لكن الراسخون في العلم منهم والمؤمنون يؤمنون بما أنزل إليك وما أنزل من قبلك ۚ والمقيمين الصلاة ۚ والمؤتون الزكاة والمؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر أولئك سنؤتيهم أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: lākini l-rāsikhūna fī l-ʿil'mi min'hum wal-mu'minūna yu'minūna bimā unzila ilayka wamā unzila min qablika wal-muqīmīna l-ṣalata wal-mu'tūna l-zakata wal-mu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri ulāika sanu'tīhim ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: As for those among them who are well founded in knowledge, and the believers, they believe in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed before you. They are observers of the Contact Prayers (Salat), and givers of the obligatory charity (Zakat); they are believers in GOD and the Last Day. We grant these a great recompense.

1981.english: As for those well founded in knowledge among the Jews, as well as the Muslims, they believe in what was revealed to you, and what was revealed before you; they observe the **salat** prayers and give the **zakat** charity; and they believe in God and the last day. We will bestow upon these a great recompense.

1989.english: As for those among them who are well founded in knowledge, and the believers, they believe in what was revealed to you, and in what was revealed before you. They are observers of the contact prayers (Salat), and givers of the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they are believers in GOD and the Last Day. We grant these a great reward.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ كَمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَعِيسَىٰ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَٰرُونَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا أوحينا إليك كما أوحينا إلى نوح والنبيين من بعده ۚ وأوحينا إلى إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط وعيسى وأيوب ويونس وهارون وسليمان ۚ وآتينا داوود زبورا
verses.transliterated: innā awḥaynā ilayka kamā awḥaynā ilā nūḥin wal-nabiyīna min baʿdihi wa-awḥaynā ilā ib'rāhīma wa-is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭi waʿīsā wa-ayyūba wayūnusa wahārūna wasulaymāna waātaynā dāwūda zabūra
verses.english: We have inspired you, as we inspired Noah and the prophets after him. And we inspired Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, the Patriarchs, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon. And we gave David the Psalms.
verses.subtitle: God's Messengers

1981.english: We inspired you, as we inspired Noah and the prophets after him. And we inspired Abraham, Ishmael, Issac, Jacob, the Patriarchs, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon. And we endowed David with the Psalms.
1981.subtitle: No Excuse For Disbelieving

1989.english: We have inspired you, as we inspired Noah and the prophets after him. And we inspired Abraham, Ismail, Isaac, Jacob, the Patriarchs, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon. And we gave David the Psalms.

verses.arabic: وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَٰهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَّمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ وَكَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ورسلا قد قصصناهم عليك من قبل ورسلا لم نقصصهم عليك ۚ وكلم الله موسى تكليما
verses.transliterated: warusulan qad qaṣaṣnāhum ʿalayka min qablu warusulan lam naqṣuṣ'hum ʿalayka wakallama l-lahu mūsā taklīma
verses.english: Messengers we have told you about, and messengers we never told you about. And GOD spoke to Moses directly.

1981.english: We inspired messengers whom we mentioned to you previously, and messengers we never mentioned to you. And God spoke to Moses directly.

1989.english: Messengers we have told you about, and messengers we never told you about. And GOD spoke to Moses directly.

verses.arabic: رُّسُلًا مُّبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ حُجَّةٌۢ بَعْدَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: رسلا مبشرين ومنذرين لئلا يكون للناس على الله حجة بعد الرسل ۚ وكان الله عزيزا حكيما
verses.transliterated: rusulan mubashirīna wamundhirīna li-allā yakūna lilnnāsi ʿalā l-lahi ḥujjatun baʿda l-rusuli wakāna l-lahu ʿazīzan ḥakīma
verses.english: Messengers to deliver good news, as well as warnings. Thus, the people will have no excuse when they face GOD, after all these messengers have come to them. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: Messengers who served as preachers and warners, in order that the people may not protest before God, for lack of messengers. God is almighty, wise.

1989.english: Messengers to deliver good news, as well as warnings. Thus, the people will have no excuse when they face GOD, after all these messengers. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: لَّٰكِنِ ٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكَ أَنزَلَهُۥ بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَشْهَدُونَ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: لكن الله يشهد بما أنزل إليك ۖ أنزله بعلمه ۖ والملائكة يشهدون ۚ وكفى بالله شهيدا
verses.transliterated: lākini l-lahu yashhadu bimā anzala ilayka anzalahu biʿil'mihi wal-malāikatu yashhadūna wakafā bil-lahi shahīda
verses.english: But GOD bears witness concerning what He has revealed to you; He has revealed it with His knowledge. And the angels bear witness as well, but GOD suffices as witness.

1981.english: God bears witness that these revelations are given to you with His knowledge, and so do the angels; God suffices as a witness.

1989.english: But GOD bears witness concerning what He has revealed to you; He has revealed it with His full knowledge. And the angels bear witness as well. GOD suffices as witness.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله قد ضلوا ضلالا بعيدا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi qad ḍallū ḍalālan baʿīda
verses.english: Surely, those who disbelieve and repel from the way of GOD have strayed far astray.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve, and prevent others from believing, have gone totally astray.

1989.english: Surely, those who disbelieve and repel from the way of GOD have indeed strayed far astray.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَظَلَمُوا۟ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ طَرِيقًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا وظلموا لم يكن الله ليغفر لهم ولا ليهديهم طريقا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū waẓalamū lam yakuni l-lahu liyaghfira lahum walā liyahdiyahum ṭarīqa
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and transgress, GOD will not forgive them, nor will He guide them in any way;

1981.english: Those who disbelieve and work evil, God does not forgive them, nor guides them to any path.

1989.english: Surely, those who disbelieve and transgress, GOD will not forgive them, nor will He guide them in any way;

verses.arabic: إِلَّا طَرِيقَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إلا طريق جهنم خالدين فيها أبدا ۚ وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا
verses.transliterated: illā ṭarīqa jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadan wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīra
verses.english: except the way to Hell, wherein they abide forever. This is easy for GOD to do.

1981.english: Except the path to hell. They abide therein forever, and this is easy for God to do.

1989.english: except the way to Hell, wherein they abide forever. This is easy for GOD to do.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس قد جاءكم الرسول بالحق من ربكم فآمنوا خيرا لكم ۚ وإن تكفروا فإن لله ما في السماوات والأرض ۚ وكان الله عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakumu l-rasūlu bil-ḥaqi min rabbikum faāminū khayran lakum wa-in takfurū fa-inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: O people, the messenger has come to you with the truth from your Lord. Therefore, you shall believe for your own good. If you disbelieve, then to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: O people, the messenger has come to you with the truth from your Lord, and you shall believe for your own good. But if you disbelieve, then to God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: O people, the messenger has come to you with the truth from your Lord. Therefore, you shall believe for your own good. If you disbelieve, then to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُۥٓ أَلْقَىٰهَآ إِلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ ثَلَٰثَةٌ ٱنتَهُوا۟ خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ إِنَّمَا ٱللَّهُ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أهل الكتاب لا تغلوا في دينكم ولا تقولوا على الله إلا الحق ۚ إنما المسيح عيسى ابن مريم رسول الله وكلمته ألقاها إلى مريم وروح منه ۖ فآمنوا بالله ورسله ۖ ولا تقولوا ثلاثة ۚ انتهوا خيرا لكم ۚ إنما الله إله واحد ۖ سبحانه أن يكون له ولد ۘ له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۗ وكفى بالله وكيلا
verses.transliterated: yāahla l-kitābi lā taghlū fī dīnikum walā taqūlū ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa innamā l-masīḥu ʿīsā ub'nu maryama rasūlu l-lahi wakalimatuhu alqāhā ilā maryama warūḥun min'hu faāminū bil-lahi warusulihi walā taqūlū thalāthatun intahū khayran lakum innamā l-lahu ilāhun wāḥidun sub'ḥānahu an yakūna lahu waladun lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wakafā bil-lahi wakīla
verses.english: O people of the scripture, do not transgress the limits of your religion, and do not say about GOD except the truth. The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, was a messenger of GOD, and His word that He had sent to Mary, and a revelation from Him. Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messengers. You shall not say, "Trinity." You shall refrain from this for your own good. GOD is only one god. Be He glorified; He is much too glorious to have a son. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. GOD suffices as Lord and Master.
verses.subtitle: Trinity: A False Doctrine

1981.english: O people of the scripture, do not transgress the limits of your religion, and do not say about God other than the truth. The Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary, is no more than a messenger of God, and His word that He threw unto Mary, and a spirit from Him. Therefore, you shall believe in God and His messengers, and do not say, "Trinity." You shall refrain for your own good. God is only one God, much too glorious to have a son. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and God suffices as a guardian.
1981.subtitle: Jesus: A Messenger of God
1981.footnote: See the Bible's Book of Revelation 1:1.

1989.english: O people of the scripture, do not transgress the limits of your religion, and do not say about GOD other than the truth. The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, was a messenger of GOD, and His word that He had sent to Mary, and a spirit from Him. Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messengers, and do not say, “Trinity.” Stop, for your own good. GOD is only one god. Be He glorified, much too high to have a son. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. GOD suffices as Lord and Master.
1989.subtitle: Trinity: A False Doctrine

verses.arabic: لَّن يَسْتَنكِفَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبْدًا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ وَمَن يَسْتَنكِفْ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيَسْتَكْبِرْ فَسَيَحْشُرُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعًا
verses.arabicClean: لن يستنكف المسيح أن يكون عبدا لله ولا الملائكة المقربون ۚ ومن يستنكف عن عبادته ويستكبر فسيحشرهم إليه جميعا
verses.transliterated: lan yastankifa l-masīḥu an yakūna ʿabdan lillahi walā l-malāikatu l-muqarabūna waman yastankif ʿan ʿibādatihi wayastakbir fasayaḥshuruhum ilayhi jamīʿa
verses.english: The Messiah would never disdain from being a servant of GOD, nor would the closest angels. Those who disdain from worshiping Him, and are too arrogant to submit, He will summon them all before Him.

1981.english: Never will the Messiah disdain from being a slave of God, nor will the closest angels. Those who disdain, and are too arrogant to worship Him, God will gather them all before Him.

1989.english: The Messiah would never disdain to be a servant of GOD, nor would the closest angels. If anyone disdains to be His servant, and turns arrogant, then He will summon them all before Him.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَنكَفُوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَيُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: فأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فيوفيهم أجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله ۖ وأما الذين استنكفوا واستكبروا فيعذبهم عذابا أليما ولا يجدون لهم من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ujūrahum wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wa-ammā alladhīna is'tankafū wa-is'takbarū fayuʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban alīman walā yajidūna lahum min dūni l-lahi waliyyan walā naṣīra
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, He will fully recompense them, and shower them with His grace. As for those who disdain and turn arrogant, He will commit them to painful retribution. They will find no lord beside GOD, nor a savior.

1981.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, God will fully recompense them, and shower them with His grace. But those who disdain, and are too arrogant, He will punish them severely, and they will find no one to help them or support them against God.

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, He will pay them fully, and will shower them with His grace. As for those who disdain and turn arrogant, He will commit them to painful retribution. They will find no lord besides GOD, nor a master. The Quran’s Mathematical Code

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُم بُرْهَٰنٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ نُورًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس قد جاءكم برهان من ربكم وأنزلنا إليكم نورا مبينا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakum bur'hānun min rabbikum wa-anzalnā ilaykum nūran mubīna
verses.english: O people, a proof has come to you from your Lord; we have sent down to you a profound beacon.
verses.subtitle: The Quran's Mathematical Code: Tangible, Irrefutable Proof

1981.english: O people, a proof is given to you herein from your Lord, and we have sent down to you a profound beacon.
1981.subtitle: The Proof Is Right Here

1989.english: O people, a proof has come to you from your Lord; we have sent down to you a profound beacon.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱعْتَصَمُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيُدْخِلُهُمْ فِى رَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَيْهِ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: فأما الذين آمنوا بالله واعتصموا به فسيدخلهم في رحمة منه وفضل ويهديهم إليه صراطا مستقيما
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi wa-iʿ'taṣamū bihi fasayud'khiluhum fī raḥmatin min'hu wafaḍlin wayahdīhim ilayhi ṣirāṭan mus'taqīma
verses.english: Those who believe in GOD, and hold fast to Him, He will admit them into mercy from Him, and grace, and will guide them to Him in a straight path.

1981.english: As for those who believe in God, and hold fast to Him, He will admit them into mercy from Him and grace, and will guide them towards Him in a straight path.

1989.english: Those who believe in GOD, and hold fast to Him, He will admit them into mercy from Him, and grace, and will guide them to Him in a straight path.

verses.arabic: يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِى ٱلْكَلَٰلَةِ إِنِ ٱمْرُؤٌا۟ هَلَكَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ وَلَهُۥٓ أُخْتٌ فَلَهَا نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَآ إِن لَّمْ يَكُن لَّهَا وَلَدٌ فَإِن كَانَتَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُمَا ٱلثُّلُثَانِ مِمَّا تَرَكَ وَإِن كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَةً رِّجَالًا وَنِسَآءً فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ أَن تَضِلُّوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: يستفتونك قل الله يفتيكم في الكلالة ۚ إن امرؤ هلك ليس له ولد وله أخت فلها نصف ما ترك ۚ وهو يرثها إن لم يكن لها ولد ۚ فإن كانتا اثنتين فلهما الثلثان مما ترك ۚ وإن كانوا إخوة رجالا ونساء فللذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين ۗ يبين الله لكم أن تضلوا ۗ والله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: yastaftūnaka quli l-lahu yuf'tīkum fī l-kalālati ini im'ru-on halaka laysa lahu waladun walahu ukh'tun falahā niṣ'fu mā taraka wahuwa yarithuhā in lam yakun lahā waladun fa-in kānatā ith'natayni falahumā l-thuluthāni mimmā taraka wa-in kānū ikh'watan rijālan wanisāan falildhakari mith'lu ḥaẓẓi l-unthayayni yubayyinu l-lahu lakum an taḍillū wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: They consult you; say, "GOD advises you concerning the single person. If one dies and leaves no children, and he had a sister, she gets half the inheritance. If she dies first, he inherits from her, if she left no children. If there were two sisters, they get two-thirds of the inheritance. If the siblings are men and women, the male gets twice the share of the female." GOD thus clarifies for you, lest you go astray. GOD is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: They consult you about the lone person who dies; say, "The loner who dies, and leaves no children, his sister inherits half of his estate. And he inherits all her estate, if she leaves no children. If the deceased has two sisters, they share two-thirds of the estate. If he leaves many brothers and sisters, then the male gets the share of two females. God thus explains things for you, lest you go astray, and God is fully aware of all things."
1981.subtitle: More Inheritance Statutes

1989.english: They consult you; say, “GOD decrees for you the inheritance statutes concerning the loner. If one dies and leaves no children, and he had a sister, she gets half the inheritance. If there were two sisters, they get two-thirds of the inheritance. If the siblings are men and women, the male gets a share equal to that of two females.” GOD thus clarifies for you, lest you go astray. GOD is fully aware of all things. >

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعُقُودِ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ٱلصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا أيها الذين آمنوا أوفوا بالعقود ۚ أحلت لكم بهيمة الأنعام إلا ما يتلى عليكم غير محلي الصيد وأنتم حرم ۗ إن الله يحكم ما يريد
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū awfū bil-ʿuqūdi uḥillat lakum bahīmatu l-anʿāmi illā mā yut'lā ʿalaykum ghayra muḥillī l-ṣaydi wa-antum ḥurumun inna l-laha yaḥkumu mā yurīd
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall fulfill your covenants. Permitted for you to eat are the livestock, except those specifically prohibited herein. You shall not permit hunting throughout Hajj pilgrimage. GOD decrees whatever He wills.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall fulfill your covenants. You are permitted to eat the meat of any livestock, except those specified for you. And do not allow hunting while observing **Hajj** pilgrimage. God decrees whatever He wills.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall fulfill your covenants. Permitted for you to eat are the livestock, except those specifically prohibited. You shall not permit hunting throughout Hajj pilgrimage. GOD decrees whatever He wills.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحِلُّوا۟ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا ٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَلَا ٱلْهَدْىَ وَلَا ٱلْقَلَٰٓئِدَ وَلَآ ءَآمِّينَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرِضْوَٰنًا وَإِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَٱصْطَادُوا۟ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ أَن صَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ أَن تَعْتَدُوا۟ وَتَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تحلوا شعائر الله ولا الشهر الحرام ولا الهدي ولا القلائد ولا آمين البيت الحرام يبتغون فضلا من ربهم ورضوانا ۚ وإذا حللتم فاصطادوا ۚ ولا يجرمنكم شنآن قوم أن صدوكم عن المسجد الحرام أن تعتدوا ۘ وتعاونوا على البر والتقوى ۖ ولا تعاونوا على الإثم والعدوان ۚ واتقوا الله ۖ إن الله شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuḥillū shaʿāira l-lahi walā l-shahra l-ḥarāma walā l-hadya walā l-qalāida walā āmmīna l-bayta l-ḥarāma yabtaghūna faḍlan min rabbihim wariḍ'wānan wa-idhā ḥalaltum fa-iṣ'ṭādū walā yajrimannakum shanaānu qawmin an ṣaddūkum ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi an taʿtadū wataʿāwanū ʿalā l-biri wal-taqwā walā taʿāwanū ʿalā l-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: O you who believe, do not violate the rites instituted by GOD, nor the Sacred Months, nor the animals to be offered, nor the garlands marking them, nor the people who head for the Sacred Shrine (Ka'bah) seeking blessings from their Lord and approval. Once you complete the pilgrimage, you may hunt. Do not be provoked into aggression by your hatred of people who once prevented you from going to the Sacred Masjid. You shall cooperate in matters of righteousness and piety; do not cooperate in matters that are sinful and evil. You shall observe GOD. GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.
verses.footnote: Hunting and the cutting of plants are forbidden during pilgrimage for the conservation of natural resources. With thousands of pilgrims converging on Mecca, if hunting were permitted, the land would quickly be stripped of its natural resources. Animal offerings are made part of the pilgrimage to provide for the converging pilgrims, as well as the local population, and to replenish any depleted supplies. See 2:196.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall not violate God's shrines, nor the sacred months, nor the offerings, nor the garlands marking them, nor those who are heading for the Sacred Mosque, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. Once you end the pilgrimage, you may hunt. Do not be provoked by enmity of those who prevent you from reaching the Sacred Mosque into aggression. You shall cooperate with one another in matters of righteousness and piety, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression. You shall observe God, for God's punishment is severe.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not violate the rites instituted by GOD, nor the Sacred Months, nor the animal offerings, nor the garlands marking them, nor the people who head for the Sacred Shrine (Ka‘bah) seeking blessings from their Lord and approval. Once you complete the pilgrimage, you may hunt.* Do not be provoked by your conflicts with people who prevented you from reaching the Sacred Mosque into aggression. You shall cooperate in matters of righteousness and piety; do not cooperate in matters that are sinful and evil. You shall observe GOD. GOD is strict in enforcing retribution.
1989.footnote: Hunting and the cutting of plants are forbidden during pilgrimage for the conservation of natural resources. With thousands of pilgrims converging on Mecca, if hunting were permitted, the land would quickly be stripped of its natural resources. Animal offerings are made part of the pilgrimage to provide for the converging pilgrims, as well as the local population, and to replenish any depleted supplies. See 2:196.
