1981.footnote: A perfect example of applying the laws of the days of ignorance, instead of God's law, is the stoning of adulterers. Although God's law clearly states the punishment for adulterers, stoning has been forced on many Muslims through the invention of "**Hadith**" and "**Sunna**." See 24:1-2.

1989.english: Is it the rules of the days of ignorance that they want? Whose rules are better than GOD’s for those who have attained certainty?

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنْهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا اليهود والنصارى أولياء ۘ بعضهم أولياء بعض ۚ ومن يتولهم منكم فإنه منهم ۗ إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū l-yahūda wal-naṣārā awliyāa baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin waman yatawallahum minkum fa-innahu min'hum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not take certain Jews and Christians as allies; these are allies of one another. Those among you who ally themselves with these belong with them. GOD does not guide the transgressors.
verses.subtitle: Certain Jews and Christians Cannot Be Friends
verses.footnote: Relations with other people are governed by the basic rule in 5:57 & 60:8-9. The Jews and Christians who cannot be friends are specifically mentioned in 5:57; they are the ones who mock and ridicule the believers, or attack them.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not consider the Jews and the Christians as your allies. Instead, they are allies of one another. Anyone of you who allies himself with them is one of them. God does not guide the wicked.
1981.subtitle: Historical Fact of Life

1989.english: O you who believe, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies; they are allies of one another. Those among you who ally themselves with them belong with them. GOD does not guide the transgressors.
1989.subtitle: Certain Jews and Christians Cannot Be Friends
1989.footnote: Relations with other people are governed by the basic rule in 5:57 & 60:8-9. The Jews and Christians who cannot be friends are specifically mentioned in 5:57; they are the ones who mock and ridicule the believers, or attack them.

verses.arabic: فَتَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰٓ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَآئِرَةٌ فَعَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِٱلْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَيُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَسَرُّوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فترى الذين في قلوبهم مرض يسارعون فيهم يقولون نخشى أن تصيبنا دائرة ۚ فعسى الله أن يأتي بالفتح أو أمر من عنده فيصبحوا على ما أسروا في أنفسهم نادمين
verses.transliterated: fatarā alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yusāriʿūna fīhim yaqūlūna nakhshā an tuṣībanā dāiratun faʿasā l-lahu an yatiya bil-fatḥi aw amrin min ʿindihi fayuṣ'biḥū ʿalā mā asarrū fī anfusihim nādimīn
verses.english: You will see those who harbor doubt in their hearts hasten to join them, saying, "We fear lest we may be defeated." May GOD bring victory, or a command from Him, that causes them to regret their secret thoughts.

1981.english: You will see those with disease in their hearts hasten to ally themselves with them, saying, "We fear lest we may be defeated some day." May God bring victory from Him, or certain blessings, then they will regret the ideas they had harbored.

1989.english: You will see those with doubt in their hearts hasten to join them, saying, “We fear lest defeat may be our lot.” May GOD bring victory, or a command from Him, that causes them to regret their secret thoughts.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويقول الذين آمنوا أهؤلاء الذين أقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم ۙ إنهم لمعكم ۚ حبطت أعمالهم فأصبحوا خاسرين
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlu alladhīna āmanū ahāulāi alladhīna aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim innahum lamaʿakum ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum fa-aṣbaḥū khāsirīn
verses.english: The believers will then say, "Are these the same people who swore by GOD solemnly that they were with you?" Their works have been nullified; they are the losers.

1981.english: The believers will then say, "Look at these people who swore by God solemnly that they were with you. Their works have been nullified, and now they are losers."

1989.english: The believers will then say, “Are these the same people who swore by GOD solemnly that they were with you?” Their works are nullified; they are the losers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِى ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُۥٓ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ يُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَآئِمٍ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا من يرتد منكم عن دينه فسوف يأتي الله بقوم يحبهم ويحبونه أذلة على المؤمنين أعزة على الكافرين يجاهدون في سبيل الله ولا يخافون لومة لائم ۚ ذلك فضل الله يؤتيه من يشاء ۚ والله واسع عليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū man yartadda minkum ʿan dīnihi fasawfa yatī l-lahu biqawmin yuḥibbuhum wayuḥibbūnahu adhillatin ʿalā l-mu'minīna aʿizzatin ʿalā l-kāfirīna yujāhidūna fī sabīli l-lahi walā yakhāfūna lawmata lāimin dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu wāsiʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, if you revert from your religion, then GOD will substitute in your place people whom He loves and who love Him. They will be kind with the believers, stern with the disbelievers, and will strive in the cause of GOD without fear of any blame. Such is GOD's blessing; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

1981.english: O you who believe, if any of you reverts from his religion, then God will bring people whom He loves as they love Him; and humble themselves towards the believers, while being stern towards the disbelievers; and strive in the cause of God; and never worry about any blamer who might blame them. Such is God's grace that He bestows upon whomever He wills. God is bounteous, omniscient.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you revert from your religion, GOD will substitute in your place people whom H< loves and they love Him, {people) who are humble with the believers, but stern with the disbelievers, and who strive in the cause of GOD without fear of any blame. Such is GOD’s blessing; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. GOD is Bounteous, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُمْ رَٰكِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما وليكم الله ورسوله والذين آمنوا الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة وهم راكعون
verses.transliterated: innamā waliyyukumu l-lahu warasūluhu wa-alladhīna āmanū alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum rākiʿūn
verses.english: Your real allies are GOD and His messenger, and the believers who observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they bow down.

1981.english: Your true ally is God, and His messenger, and the believers who observe the **salat** and **zakat**, and bow down.

1989.english: Your real allies are GOD and His messenger, and the believers who observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they bow down.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يتول الله ورسوله والذين آمنوا فإن حزب الله هم الغالبون
verses.transliterated: waman yatawalla l-laha warasūlahu wa-alladhīna āmanū fa-inna ḥiz'ba l-lahi humu l-ghālibūn
verses.english: Those who ally themselves with GOD and His messenger, and those who believed, belong in the party of GOD; absolutely, they are the victors.

1981.english: Those who ally themselves with God, and His messenger, and the believers, are the party of God; these are the winners.

1989.english: Anyone who allies himself with GOD and His messenger, and those who believed, then GOD’s party are the victors.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَكُمْ هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَٱلْكُفَّارَ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا الذين اتخذوا دينكم هزوا ولعبا من الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم والكفار أولياء ۚ واتقوا الله إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnakum huzuwan walaʿiban mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wal-kufāra awliyāa wa-ittaqū l-laha in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not befriend those among the recipients of previous scripture who mock and ridicule your religion, nor shall you befriend the disbelievers. You shall reverence GOD, if you are really believers.
verses.subtitle: Which Jews and Christians

1981.english: O you who believe, do not take the people of previous scriptures who mock and ridicule your religion, nor the disbelievers, as allies, and observe God, if you are really believers.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not befriend those among the recipients of previous scripture who mock and ridicule your religion, nor shall you befriend the disbelievers. You shall observe GOD, if you are really believers.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا ناديتم إلى الصلاة اتخذوها هزوا ولعبا ۚ ذلك بأنهم قوم لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā nādaytum ilā l-ṣalati ittakhadhūhā huzuwan walaʿiban dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: When you call to the Contact Prayers (Salat), they mock and ridicule it. This is because they are people who do not understand.
verses.subtitle: Recipients of the Scriptures Transgress

1981.english: When you call for the **salat** prayers, they mock and ridicule. That is because they do not understand.

1989.english: When you call to the contact prayers (Salat), they mock and ridicule it. This is because they are people who do not understand.
1989.subtitle: Recipients of the Scriptures Transgress

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هَلْ تَنقِمُونَ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أهل الكتاب هل تنقمون منا إلا أن آمنا بالله وما أنزل إلينا وما أنزل من قبل وأن أكثركم فاسقون
verses.transliterated: qul yāahla l-kitābi hal tanqimūna minnā illā an āmannā bil-lahi wamā unzila ilaynā wamā unzila min qablu wa-anna aktharakum fāsiqūn
verses.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, do you not hate us because we believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed before us, and because most of you are not righteous?"

1981.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, do you not resent us simply because we have believed in God, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed before, and because most of you are wicked?"

1989.english: Say, “O people of the scripture, do you hate us because we believe in GOD, and in what was revealed to us, and in what was revealed in the past, and because most of you are wicked?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْقِرَدَةَ وَٱلْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
verses.arabicClean: قل هل أنبئكم بشر من ذلك مثوبة عند الله ۚ من لعنه الله وغضب عليه وجعل منهم القردة والخنازير وعبد الطاغوت ۚ أولئك شر مكانا وأضل عن سواء السبيل
verses.transliterated: qul hal unabbi-ukum bisharrin min dhālika mathūbatan ʿinda l-lahi man laʿanahu l-lahu waghaḍiba ʿalayhi wajaʿala min'humu l-qiradata wal-khanāzīra waʿabada l-ṭāghūta ulāika sharrun makānan wa-aḍallu ʿan sawāi l-sabīl
verses.english: Say, "Let me tell you who are worse in the sight of GOD: those who are condemned by GOD after incurring His wrath until He made them (as despicable as) monkeys and pigs, and the idol worshipers. These are far worse, and farther from the right path."

1981.english: Say, "Let me tell you who are really in bad shape. Those who are cursed by God, and displeased Him, until He made them monkeys and pigs, and those who worship idols. It is these who are really evil, and farthest from the right path."

1989.english: Say, “Let me tell you who is worse in the sight of GOD: those who are condemned by GOD after incurring His wrath until He made them (as despicable as) monkeys and pigs, and the idol worshipers as well. These are far worse, and farther from the right path.”

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَقَد دَّخَلُوا۟ بِٱلْكُفْرِ وَهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْتُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا جاءوكم قالوا آمنا وقد دخلوا بالكفر وهم قد خرجوا به ۚ والله أعلم بما كانوا يكتمون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā jāūkum qālū āmannā waqad dakhalū bil-kuf'ri wahum qad kharajū bihi wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā kānū yaktumūn
verses.english: When they come to you, they say, "We believe," even though they were full of disbelief when they entered, and they are full of disbelief when they leave. GOD is fully aware of everything they conceal.

1981.english: When they come to you, they say, "We believe," although they have entered as disbelievers, and left as disbelievers. God is fully aware of everything they conceal.

1989.english: When they come to you, they say, “We believe,” even though they were full of disbelief when they entered, and they were full of disbelief when they left. GOD is fully aware of everything they conceal.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وترى كثيرا منهم يسارعون في الإثم والعدوان وأكلهم السحت ۚ لبئس ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: watarā kathīran min'hum yusāriʿūna fī l-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wa-aklihimu l-suḥ'ta labi'sa mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: You see many of them readily committing evil and transgression, and eating from illicit earnings. Miserable indeed is what they do.

1981.english: You will see many of them hasten into sinfulness and transgression, and earning dishonestly. Evil indeed is what they do.

1989.english: You see many of them readily committing evil and transgressing, and eating from illicit earnings. Miserable indeed is what they used to do.

verses.arabic: لَوْلَا يَنْهَىٰهُمُ ٱلرَّبَّٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ ٱلْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لولا ينهاهم الربانيون والأحبار عن قولهم الإثم وأكلهم السحت ۚ لبئس ما كانوا يصنعون
verses.transliterated: lawlā yanhāhumu l-rabāniyūna wal-aḥbāru ʿan qawlihimu l-ith'ma wa-aklihimu l-suḥ'ta labi'sa mā kānū yaṣnaʿūn
verses.english: If only the rabbis and the priests enjoin them from their sinful utterances and illicit earnings! Miserable indeed is what they commit.

1981.english: If only the rabbis and the priests would enjoin them from sinful utterances and dishonest earnings. Evil indeed is what they commit.

1989.english: If only the rabbis and the priests enjoined them from their sinful utterances and illicit earnings! Miserable indeed is what they used to commit.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا۟ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كُلَّمَآ أَوْقَدُوا۟ نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا ٱللَّهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالت اليهود يد الله مغلولة ۚ غلت أيديهم ولعنوا بما قالوا ۘ بل يداه مبسوطتان ينفق كيف يشاء ۚ وليزيدن كثيرا منهم ما أنزل إليك من ربك طغيانا وكفرا ۚ وألقينا بينهم العداوة والبغضاء إلى يوم القيامة ۚ كلما أوقدوا نارا للحرب أطفأها الله ۚ ويسعون في الأرض فسادا ۚ والله لا يحب المفسدين
verses.transliterated: waqālati l-yahūdu yadu l-lahi maghlūlatun ghullat aydīhim waluʿinū bimā qālū bal yadāhu mabsūṭatāni yunfiqu kayfa yashāu walayazīdanna kathīran min'hum mā unzila ilayka min rabbika ṭugh'yānan wakuf'ran wa-alqaynā baynahumu l-ʿadāwata wal-baghḍāa ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati kullamā awqadū nāran lil'ḥarbi aṭfa-ahā l-lahu wayasʿawna fī l-arḍi fasādan wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: The Jews even said, "GOD's hand is tied down!" It is their hands that are tied down. They are condemned for uttering such a blasphemy. Instead, His hands are wide open, spending as He wills. For certain, your Lord's revelations to you will cause many of them to plunge deeper into transgression and disbelief. Consequently, we have committed them to animosity and hatred among themselves until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they ignite the flames of war, GOD puts them out. They roam the earth wickedly, and GOD dislikes the evildoers.
verses.subtitle: Blaspheming Against God

1981.english: The Jews said, "God's hand is tied down!" It is their hands that are tied down, and they incurred a curse for such utterance. Instead, His hands are wide open, freely providing as He wills. Indeed, most of them plunge deeper into transgression and heathenism, because of resenting the revelation to you from your Lord. We have cast among them enmity and hatred until the day of resurrection. Whenever they ignite the fires of war, God puts it out. They roam the earth corruptingly, and God dislikes the corruptors.

1989.english: The Jews even said, “GOD’s hand is tied down!” It is their hands that are tied down. They are condemned for uttering such a blasphemy. Instead, His hands are wide open, spending as He wills. For certain, your Lord’s revelations to you will cause many of them to plunge deeper into transgression and disbelief. Consequently, we have committed them to animosity and hatred among themselves until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they ignite the flames of war, GOD puts them out. They roam the earth wickedly, and GOD dislikes the evildoers.
1989.subtitle: Blaspheming Against God

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أن أهل الكتاب آمنوا واتقوا لكفرنا عنهم سيئاتهم ولأدخلناهم جنات النعيم
verses.transliterated: walaw anna ahla l-kitābi āmanū wa-ittaqaw lakaffarnā ʿanhum sayyiātihim wala-adkhalnāhum jannāti l-naʿīm
verses.english: If only the people of the scripture believe and lead a righteous life, we will then remit their sins, and admit them into gardens of bliss.
verses.subtitle: Salvation For Jews and Christians

1981.english: If only the people of the scripture believe and work righteousness, we will then remit their sins, and admit them into blissful Paradise.
1981.subtitle: Salvation For Jews and Christians

1989.english: If only the people of the scripture believe and lead a righteous life, we will then remit their sins, and admit them into gardens of bliss.
1989.subtitle: Salvation For Jews and Christians

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَأَكَلُوا۟ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِم مِّنْهُمْ أُمَّةٌ مُّقْتَصِدَةٌ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنهم أقاموا التوراة والإنجيل وما أنزل إليهم من ربهم لأكلوا من فوقهم ومن تحت أرجلهم ۚ منهم أمة مقتصدة ۖ وكثير منهم ساء ما يعملون
verses.transliterated: walaw annahum aqāmū l-tawrāta wal-injīla wamā unzila ilayhim min rabbihim la-akalū min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim min'hum ummatun muq'taṣidatun wakathīrun min'hum sāa mā yaʿmalūn
verses.english: If only they would uphold the Torah and the Gospel, and what is sent down to them herein from their Lord, they would be showered with blessings from above them and from beneath their feet. Some of them are righteous, but many of them are evildoers.
verses.subtitle: They Must Believe in This Quran

1981.english: If they uphold the Torah, the Gospel, and what is revealed herein from their Lord, they would be provided from above them, and from beneath their feet. Some of them are righteous, but most of them are evildoers.

1989.english: If only they would uphold the Torah and the Gospel, and what is sent down to them herein from their Lord, they would be blessed with provisions from above them and from beneath their feet. Some of them are righteous, but many of them are evildoers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الرسول بلغ ما أنزل إليك من ربك ۖ وإن لم تفعل فما بلغت رسالته ۚ والله يعصمك من الناس ۗ إن الله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-rasūlu balligh mā unzila ilayka min rabbika wa-in lam tafʿal famā ballaghta risālatahu wal-lahu yaʿṣimuka mina l-nāsi inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīn
verses.english: O you messenger, deliver what is revealed to you from your Lord— until you do, you have not delivered His message—and GOD will protect you from the people. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
verses.subtitle: The Messenger Must Deliver

1981.english: O messenger, you shall deliver everything revealed to you from your Lord. If you do not, then you have failed in your mission. God will protect you from the people. God does not guide the disbelievers.
1981.subtitle: The Messenger Delivers Everything Revealed to Him
1981.footnote: This verse indicates that the Quran's secret numerical code was not revealed to the prophet Muhammad, since he did not deliver it to us (see Appendix 1).

1989.english: O you messenger, deliver what is revealed to you from your Lord— until you do, you have not delivered His message—and GOD will protect you from the people. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
1989.subtitle: The Messenger Must Deliver

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أهل الكتاب لستم على شيء حتى تقيموا التوراة والإنجيل وما أنزل إليكم من ربكم ۗ وليزيدن كثيرا منهم ما أنزل إليك من ربك طغيانا وكفرا ۖ فلا تأس على القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: qul yāahla l-kitābi lastum ʿalā shayin ḥattā tuqīmū l-tawrāta wal-injīla wamā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum walayazīdanna kathīran min'hum mā unzila ilayka min rabbika ṭugh'yānan wakuf'ran falā tasa ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, you have no basis until you uphold the Torah, and the Gospel, and what is sent down to you herein from your Lord." For sure, these revelations from your Lord will cause many of them to plunge deeper into transgression and disbelief. Therefore, do not feel sorry for the disbelieving people.

1981.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, you have no basis until you uphold the Torah, the Gospel, and what is revealed herein from your Lord." Indeed, many of them will plunge deeper into transgression and heathenism, because of resenting the revelation to you from your Lord. Do not be saddened by the disbelievers.

1989.english: Say, “O people of the scripture, you have no basis until you uphold the Torah, and the Gospel, and what is sent down to you herein from your Lord.” For sure, these revelations from your Lord will only cause many of them to plunge deeper into transgression and disbelief. Therefore, do not feel sorry for the disbelieving people.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّٰبِـُٔونَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والصابئون والنصارى من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وعمل صالحا فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū wa-alladhīna hādū wal-ṣābiūna wal-naṣārā man āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri waʿamila ṣāliḥan falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: Surely, those who believe, those who are Jewish, the converts, and the Christians; any of them who (1) believe in GOD and (2) believe in the Last Day, and (3) lead a righteous life, have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.subtitle: Minimum Requirements For Salvation

1981.english: Surely, the followers of this scripture, and the Jews, and the converts, and the Christians; any of them who believe in the one God, and believe in the last day, and work righteousness, will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1981.subtitle: Three Requirements For Salvation

1989.english: Surely, those who believe, those who are Jewish, the converts, and the Christians; any of them who (1) believe in GOD and (2) the Last Day, and (3) lead a righteous life, will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1989.subtitle: Minimum Requirements For Salvation

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا۟ وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لقد أخذنا ميثاق بني إسرائيل وأرسلنا إليهم رسلا ۖ كلما جاءهم رسول بما لا تهوى أنفسهم فريقا كذبوا وفريقا يقتلون
verses.transliterated: laqad akhadhnā mīthāqa banī is'rāīla wa-arsalnā ilayhim rusulan kullamā jāahum rasūlun bimā lā tahwā anfusuhum farīqan kadhabū wafarīqan yaqtulūn
verses.english: We have taken a covenant from the Children of Israel, and we sent to them messengers. Whenever a messenger went to them with anything they disliked, some of them they rejected, and some they killed.

1981.english: We made a covenant with the children of Israel, and we sent to them messengers; whenever a messenger went to them with commandments they did not like, they either rejected him, or killed him.

1989.english: We have taken a covenant from the Children of Israel, and we sent to them messengers. Whenever a messenger went to them with what they disliked, some of them they rejected, and some they killed.

verses.arabic: وَحَسِبُوٓا۟ أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ فَعَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وحسبوا ألا تكون فتنة فعموا وصموا ثم تاب الله عليهم ثم عموا وصموا كثير منهم ۚ والله بصير بما يعملون
verses.transliterated: waḥasibū allā takūna fit'natun faʿamū waṣammū thumma tāba l-lahu ʿalayhim thumma ʿamū waṣammū kathīrun min'hum wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūn
verses.english: They thought that they would not be tested, so they turned blind and deaf, then GOD redeemed them, but then many of them turned blind and deaf again. GOD is Seer of everything they do.

1981.english: And they expected no retribution. Consequently, they turned blind and deaf, then God redeemed them, but many of them still turned blind and deaf. God fully sees everything they do.

1989.english: They thought that they would not be tested, so they turned blind and deaf, then GOD redeemed them, but then many of them turned blind and deaf again GOD is Seer of everything they do.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَقَالَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
verses.arabicClean: لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله هو المسيح ابن مريم ۖ وقال المسيح يا بني إسرائيل اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم ۖ إنه من يشرك بالله فقد حرم الله عليه الجنة ومأواه النار ۖ وما للظالمين من أنصار
verses.transliterated: laqad kafara alladhīna qālū inna l-laha huwa l-masīḥu ub'nu maryama waqāla l-masīḥu yābanī is'rāīla uʿ'budū l-laha rabbī warabbakum innahu man yush'rik bil-lahi faqad ḥarrama l-lahu ʿalayhi l-janata wamawāhu l-nāru wamā lilẓẓālimīna min anṣāri
verses.english: Pagans indeed are those who say that GOD is the Messiah, son of Mary. The Messiah himself said, "O Children of Israel, you shall worship GOD; my Lord and your Lord." Anyone who sets up any idol beside GOD, GOD has forbidden Paradise for him, and his destiny is Hell. The wicked have no helpers.
verses.subtitle: Today's Christianity Not Jesus' Religion
verses.footnote: In John 20:17, we see that Jesus taught that he was neither God, nor the son of God. Many theologians have concluded, after careful research, that today's Christianity is not the same Christianity taught by Jesus. Two outstanding books on this subject are "The Myth of God Incarnate" (The Westminster Press, Philadelphia, 1977) and "The Mythmaker" (Harper & Row, New York, 1986). On the front jacket of "The Mythmaker" we read the following statement: "...Hyam Maccoby presents new arguments to support the view that Paul, not Jesus, was the founder of Christianity....it was Paul alone who created a new religion through his vision of Jesus as a divine Saviour who died to save humanity."

1981.english: Pagans indeed are those who say that Christ, the son of Mary, is God. Christ himself said, "O children of Israel, you shall worship God, my Lord and your Lord."\* Indeed, if anyone sets up an idol besides God, then God has forbidden him from Paradise, and his inevitable destiny is hell. The wicked will have no helper.
1981.subtitle: The Great Blasphemy
1981.footnote: See the Gospel of Mark 12:29, John 5:24, 8:40-41, 9:4, & 12:49.

1989.english: Pagans indeed are those who say that GOD is the Messiah, son of Mary. The Messiah himself said, “O Children of Israel, you shall worship GOD; my Lord and your Lord.” Anyone who sets up any idol besides fJOTl GOD forbids Paradise for him, and his destiny is Hell. The wicked have no supporters.
1989.subtitle: Today’s Christianity Not Jesus’ Religion
1989.footnote: Many theologians have concluded, after careful research, that today’s Christianity is not the same Christianity taught by Jesus. Two outstanding books on this subject are “The Myth of God Incarnate” (The Westminster Press, Philadelphia, 1977) and The “Mythmaker” (Harper & Row, New York, 1986). On the front jacket of “The Mythmaker” we read the following statement: “...Hyam Maccoby presents new arguments to support the view that Paul, not Jesus, was the founder of Christianity....it was Paul alone who created a new religion through his vision of Jesus as a divine Saviour who died to save humanity.”

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَٰثَةٍ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّآ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا۟ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: لقد كفر الذين قالوا إن الله ثالث ثلاثة ۘ وما من إله إلا إله واحد ۚ وإن لم ينتهوا عما يقولون ليمسن الذين كفروا منهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: laqad kafara alladhīna qālū inna l-laha thālithu thalāthatin wamā min ilāhin illā ilāhun wāḥidun wa-in lam yantahū ʿammā yaqūlūna layamassanna alladhīna kafarū min'hum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Pagans indeed are those who say that GOD is a third in a trinity. There is no god except the one god. Unless they refrain from saying this, those who disbelieve among them will incur a painful retribution.

1981.english: Pagans indeed are those who say that God is one third of a trinity. There is absolutely no god except the one God. Unless they refrain from such utterances, these disbelievers will suffer painful retribution.

1989.english: Pagans indeed are those who say that GOD is a member of a trinity. There is no god except one god. Unless they refrain from saying this, those who disbelieve among them will incur painful retribution.
1989.footnote: Many theologians have concluded, after careful research, that today’s Christianity is not the same Christianity taught by Jesus. Two outstanding books on this subject are “The Myth of God Incarnate” (The Westminster Press, Philadelphia, 1977) and The “Mythmaker” (Harper & Row, New York, 1986). On the front jacket of “The Mythmaker” we read the following statement: “...Hyam Maccoby presents new arguments to support the view that Paul, not Jesus, was the founder of Christianity....it was Paul alone who created a new religion through his vision of Jesus as a divine Saviour who died to save humanity.”

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: أفلا يتوبون إلى الله ويستغفرونه ۚ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: afalā yatūbūna ilā l-lahi wayastaghfirūnahu wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Would they not repent to GOD, and ask His forgiveness? GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Would they not repent to God, and implore for His forgiveness? God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Would they not repent to GOD, and ask His forgiveness? GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.footnote: Many theologians have concluded, after careful research, that today’s Christianity is not the same Christianity taught by Jesus. Two outstanding books on this subject are “The Myth of God Incarnate” (The Westminster Press, Philadelphia, 1977) and The “Mythmaker” (Harper & Row, New York, 1986). On the front jacket of “The Mythmaker” we read the following statement: “...Hyam Maccoby presents new arguments to support the view that Paul, not Jesus, was the founder of Christianity....it was Paul alone who created a new religion through his vision of Jesus as a divine Saviour who died to save humanity.”

verses.arabic: مَّا ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُۥ صِدِّيقَةٌ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ ٱلطَّعَامَ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرْ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما المسيح ابن مريم إلا رسول قد خلت من قبله الرسل وأمه صديقة ۖ كانا يأكلان الطعام ۗ انظر كيف نبين لهم الآيات ثم انظر أنى يؤفكون
verses.transliterated: mā l-masīḥu ub'nu maryama illā rasūlun qad khalat min qablihi l-rusulu wa-ummuhu ṣiddīqatun kānā yakulāni l-ṭaʿāma unẓur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu l-āyāti thumma unẓur annā yu'fakūn
verses.english: The Messiah, son of Mary, is no more than a messenger like the messengers before him, and his mother was a saint. Both of them used to eat the food. Note how we explain the revelations for them, and note how they still deviate!

1981.english: Christ, the son of Mary, was no more than a messenger like the messengers before him, and his mother a saint. Both of them used to eat the food. Note how we explain the revelations for them, then note how they still deviate.

1989.english: The Messiah, son of Mary, is no more than a messenger like the messengers before him, and his mother a saint. Both of them used to eat the food. Note how we explain the revelations for them, and note how they still deviate!
1989.footnote: Many theologians have concluded, after careful research, that today’s Christianity is not the same Christianity taught by Jesus. Two outstanding books on this subject are “The Myth of God Incarnate” (The Westminster Press, Philadelphia, 1977) and The “Mythmaker” (Harper & Row, New York, 1986). On the front jacket of “The Mythmaker” we read the following statement: “...Hyam Maccoby presents new arguments to support the view that Paul, not Jesus, was the founder of Christianity....it was Paul alone who created a new religion through his vision of Jesus as a divine Saviour who died to save humanity.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قل أتعبدون من دون الله ما لا يملك لكم ضرا ولا نفعا ۚ والله هو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: qul ataʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yamliku lakum ḍarran walā nafʿan wal-lahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: Say, "Would you worship beside GOD powerless idols who can neither harm you, nor benefit you? GOD is Hearer, Omniscient."

1981.english: Say, "Would you worship besides God idols who possess no power to harm you or benefit you? God is the one who hears, and knows.\*"
1981.footnote: The fact is that Mary, Jesus, Muhammad, and all the dead saints, are totally unaware of anything at this time (see 16:20-21), while only God hears and sees everything. The blasphemy is obvious when a religious leader proclaims, "May the holy mother protect you!"

1989.english: Say, “Would you worship besides GOD powerless idols who can neither harm you, nor benefit you? GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.”
1989.footnote: Many theologians have concluded, after careful research, that today’s Christianity is not the same Christianity taught by Jesus. Two outstanding books on this subject are “The Myth of God Incarnate” (The Westminster Press, Philadelphia, 1977) and The “Mythmaker” (Harper & Row, New York, 1986). On the front jacket of “The Mythmaker” we read the following statement: “...Hyam Maccoby presents new arguments to support the view that Paul, not Jesus, was the founder of Christianity....it was Paul alone who created a new religion through his vision of Jesus as a divine Saviour who died to save humanity.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَ قَوْمٍ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَضَلُّوا۟ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أهل الكتاب لا تغلوا في دينكم غير الحق ولا تتبعوا أهواء قوم قد ضلوا من قبل وأضلوا كثيرا وضلوا عن سواء السبيل
verses.transliterated: qul yāahla l-kitābi lā taghlū fī dīnikum ghayra l-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿū ahwāa qawmin qad ḍallū min qablu wa-aḍallū kathīran waḍallū ʿan sawāi l-sabīl
verses.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, do not transgress the limits of your religion beyond the truth, and do not follow the opinions of people who have gone astray, and have misled multitudes of people; they are far astray from the right path."
verses.subtitle: Choose Your Friends Carefully

1981.english: Say, "O people of the scripture, do not exceed the limits of your religion beyond the truth, and do not follow the ideas of people who had gone astray, and caused many people to go astray."

1989.english: Say, “O people of the scripture, do not transgress the limits of your religion beyond the truth, and do not follow the opinions of people who have gone astray, who have misled multitudes of people, and are far astray from the right path.”

verses.arabic: لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُۥدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لعن الذين كفروا من بني إسرائيل على لسان داوود وعيسى ابن مريم ۚ ذلك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون
verses.transliterated: luʿina alladhīna kafarū min banī is'rāīla ʿalā lisāni dāwūda waʿīsā ib'ni maryama dhālika bimā ʿaṣaw wakānū yaʿtadūn
verses.english: Condemned are those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel, by the tongue of David and Jesus, the son of Mary. This is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

1981.english: Those who deviated among the children of Israel are cursed by the tongue of David and Jesus the son of Mary. That is because they rebelled and transgressed.

1989.english: Condemned by the tongue of David and of Jesus, son of Mary, are those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel. This is because they disobeyed and transgressed.

verses.arabic: كَانُوا۟ لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ فَعَلُوهُ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كانوا لا يتناهون عن منكر فعلوه ۚ لبئس ما كانوا يفعلون
verses.transliterated: kānū lā yatanāhawna ʿan munkarin faʿalūhu labi'sa mā kānū yafʿalūn
verses.english: They did not enjoin one another from committing evil. Miserable indeed is what they did.
verses.subtitle: Apathy Condemned

1981.english: They did not enjoin one another from evildoing. Wicked indeed is what they did.

1989.english: They did not enjoin one another from committing evil. Miserable indeed is what they used to do.
1989.subtitle: Apathy Condemned

verses.arabic: تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ أَن سَخِطَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِى ٱلْعَذَابِ هُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ترى كثيرا منهم يتولون الذين كفروا ۚ لبئس ما قدمت لهم أنفسهم أن سخط الله عليهم وفي العذاب هم خالدون
verses.transliterated: tarā kathīran min'hum yatawallawna alladhīna kafarū labi'sa mā qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhiṭa l-lahu ʿalayhim wafī l-ʿadhābi hum khālidūn
verses.english: You would see many of them allying themselves with those who disbelieve. Miserable indeed is what their hands have sent forth on behalf of their souls. GOD is angry with them and, consequently, they will abide forever in retribution.

1981.english: You will see many of them allying themselves with those who disbelieve. Evil indeed is what their souls have sent forward. God is displeased with them, and they have deserved eternal retribution.

1989.english: You see many of them befriending those who disbelieved; miserable indeed is what their hands have sent forth on behalf of their souls. GOD is angry with them and, consequently, they will abide forever in retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلنَّبِىِّ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو كانوا يؤمنون بالله والنبي وما أنزل إليه ما اتخذوهم أولياء ولكن كثيرا منهم فاسقون
verses.transliterated: walaw kānū yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-nabiyi wamā unzila ilayhi mā ittakhadhūhum awliyāa walākinna kathīran min'hum fāsiqūn
verses.english: Had they believed in GOD, and the prophet, and in what was revealed to him herein, they would not have befriended them. But many of them are evil.

1981.english: Had they believed in God and the prophet, and the scripture revealed to him, they would not have allied themselves with them. But most of them are wicked.

1989.english: Had they believed in GOD, and the prophet, and in what was revealed to him herein, they would not have befriended them. But many of them are evil.

verses.arabic: لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ ٱلنَّاسِ عَدَٰوَةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَٰرَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لتجدن أشد الناس عداوة للذين آمنوا اليهود والذين أشركوا ۖ ولتجدن أقربهم مودة للذين آمنوا الذين قالوا إنا نصارى ۚ ذلك بأن منهم قسيسين ورهبانا وأنهم لا يستكبرون
verses.transliterated: latajidanna ashadda l-nāsi ʿadāwatan lilladhīna āmanū l-yahūda wa-alladhīna ashrakū walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatan lilladhīna āmanū alladhīna qālū innā naṣārā dhālika bi-anna min'hum qissīsīna waruh'bānan wa-annahum lā yastakbirūn
verses.english: You will find that the worst enemies of the believers are the Jews and the idol worshipers. And you will find that the closest people in friendship to the believers are those who say, "We are Christian." This is because they have priests and monks among them, and they are not arrogant.
verses.subtitle: A Statement of Fact

1981.english: You will find that the most ardent opponents of those who believe are the Jews and the idolaters. And you will find that the closest friends of the believers are those who say, "We are Christians." That is because there are among them priests and monks, and because they are not arrogant.
1981.subtitle: An Historical Fact

1989.english: You will find that the worst enemies of the believers are the Jews and the idol worshipers. And you will find that the closest people in friendship to the believers are those who say, “We are Christian.” This is because they have priests and monks among them, and they are not arrogant.
1989.subtitle: A Statement of Fact

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا سمعوا ما أنزل إلى الرسول ترى أعينهم تفيض من الدمع مما عرفوا من الحق ۖ يقولون ربنا آمنا فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā samiʿū mā unzila ilā l-rasūli tarā aʿyunahum tafīḍu mina l-damʿi mimmā ʿarafū mina l-ḥaqi yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-uk'tub'nā maʿa l-shāhidīn
verses.english: When they hear what was revealed to the messenger, you see their eyes flooding with tears as they recognize the truth therein, and they say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so count us among the witnesses.

1981.english: And when they hear what is revealed to the messenger, you would see tears flooding their eyes, because they recognize the truthfulness thereof. They say, "Our Lord, we believe; so count us among the witnesses.

1989.english: When they hear what was revealed to the messenger, you see their eyes flooded with tears as they recognize the truth therein. They say, “Our Lord, we have believed, so count us among the witnesses.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما لنا لا نؤمن بالله وما جاءنا من الحق ونطمع أن يدخلنا ربنا مع القوم الصالحين
verses.transliterated: wamā lanā lā nu'minu bil-lahi wamā jāanā mina l-ḥaqi wanaṭmaʿu an yud'khilanā rabbunā maʿa l-qawmi l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: Why should we not believe in GOD, and in the truth that has come to us, and hope that our Lord may admit us with the righteous people?

1981.english: "Why should we not believe in God, and in the truth that has come to us, and hope that God may count us among the righteous?"

1989.english: “Why should we not believe in GOD, and in the truth that has come to us, and hope that our Lord may admit us with the righteous people?”

verses.arabic: فَأَثَٰبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأثابهم الله بما قالوا جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ۚ وذلك جزاء المحسنين
verses.transliterated: fa-athābahumu l-lahu bimā qālū jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wadhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: GOD has rewarded them for saying this; He will admit them into gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. Such is the reward for the righteous.

1981.english: Consequently, God has rewarded them with gardens and flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. Such is the reward for the pious.

1989.english: GOD rewards them for saying this, by admitting them into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. Such is the reward for the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا أولئك أصحاب الجحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīm
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve and reject our revelations, they are the dwellers of Hell.

1981.english: As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they have deserved hell.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieve and reject our revelations, they are the dwellers of Hell.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحَرِّمُوا۟ طَيِّبَٰتِ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تحرموا طيبات ما أحل الله لكم ولا تعتدوا ۚ إن الله لا يحب المعتدين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuḥarrimū ṭayyibāti mā aḥalla l-lahu lakum walā taʿtadū inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-muʿ'tadīn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not prohibit good things that are made lawful by GOD, and do not aggress; GOD dislikes the aggressors.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit Lawful Things

1981.english: O you who believe, do not prohibit the good things that God has permitted for you, nor shall you transgress; God dislikes the transgressors.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit Lawful Foods
1981.footnote: Traditions, myths, superstitions, and the inventions of "**Hadith**" and "**Sunna**" have established a long list of dietary prohibitions, beyond the four decreed by God (see 2:173, 5:3, 6:145, 16:115-116, and Appendix 13). Throughout the Quran, God is extremely displeased by those who prohibit lawful food (see 3:93-94, and 10:59).

1989.english: O you who believe, do not prohibit good things that are made lawful by GOD. Do not transgress; GOD dislikes the transgressors.
1989.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit Lawful Things

verses.arabic: وَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكلوا مما رزقكم الله حلالا طيبا ۚ واتقوا الله الذي أنتم به مؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wakulū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī antum bihi mu'minūn
verses.english: And eat from the good and lawful things that GOD has provided for you. You shall reverence GOD, in whom you are believers.

1981.english: You shall eat from God's provisions to you, that which is good and lawful, and observe God, in whom you believe.

1989.english: Eat from the good and lawful things that GOD has provided for you, and observe GOD, in whom you are believers.

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ ٱلْأَيْمَٰنَ فَكَفَّٰرَتُهُۥٓ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَٰكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَٰثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ذَٰلِكَ كَفَّٰرَةُ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ إِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ وَٱحْفَظُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم ولكن يؤاخذكم بما عقدتم الأيمان ۖ فكفارته إطعام عشرة مساكين من أوسط ما تطعمون أهليكم أو كسوتهم أو تحرير رقبة ۖ فمن لم يجد فصيام ثلاثة أيام ۚ ذلك كفارة أيمانكم إذا حلفتم ۚ واحفظوا أيمانكم ۚ كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته لعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: lā yuākhidhukumu l-lahu bil-laghwi fī aymānikum walākin yuākhidhukum bimā ʿaqqadttumu l-aymāna fakaffāratuhu iṭ'ʿāmu ʿasharati masākīna min awsaṭi mā tuṭ'ʿimūna ahlīkum aw kis'watuhum aw taḥrīru raqabatin faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu thalāthati ayyāmin dhālika kaffāratu aymānikum idhā ḥalaftum wa-iḥ'faẓū aymānakum kadhālika yubayyinu l-lahu lakum āyātihi laʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: GOD does not hold you responsible for the mere utterance of oaths; He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. If you violate an oath, you shall atone by feeding ten poor people from the same food you offer to your own family, or clothing them, or by freeing a slave. If you cannot afford this, then you shall fast three days. This is the atonement for violating the oaths that you swore to keep. You shall fulfill your oaths. GOD thus explains His revelations to you, that you may be appreciative.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Take God's Name in Vain

1981.english: God does not hold you responsible for the vain utterances of oaths, but He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. You shall expiate for breaking an oath by feeding ten poor people from the same food that you offer to your family, or clothing them, or by freeing a slave. Those who cannot afford it shall fast three days. This is the expiation for breaking your vows. You shall keep your vows. God thus explains His revelations to you, that you may be appreciative.
1981.subtitle: Keep Your Vows

1989.english: GOD does not hold you responsible for the mere utterance of oaths; He holds you responsible for your actual intentions. If you violate an oath, you shall atone by feeding ten poor people from the good food you offer to your own family, or clothing them, or by freeing a slave. If you cannot afford this, then you shall fast three days. This is the atonement for violating your oaths. You shall fulfill your oaths. GOD thus explains His revelations to you, that you may be appreciative.
1989.subtitle: Do Not Take God’s Name in Vain

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْخَمْرُ وَٱلْمَيْسِرُ وَٱلْأَنصَابُ وَٱلْأَزْلَٰمُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَٱجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إنما الخمر والميسر والأنصاب والأزلام رجس من عمل الشيطان فاجتنبوه لعلكم تفلحون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū innamā l-khamru wal-maysiru wal-anṣābu wal-azlāmu rij'sun min ʿamali l-shayṭāni fa-ij'tanibūhu laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: O you who believe, intoxicants, and gambling, and the altars of idols, and the games of chance are abominations of the devil; you shall avoid them, that you may succeed.
verses.subtitle: Intoxicants and Gambling Prohibited

1981.english: O you who believe, intoxicants, gambling, the dedication of offerings (and candles) to idols, the dividing of meat by throwing arrows, are all satanic abominations. You shall abstain therefrom, that you may succeed.
1981.subtitle: Intoxicants and Gambling Prohibited

1989.english: O you who believe, intoxicants, and gambling, and altars, and games of chance are abominations of the devil; you shall avoid them, that you may succeed.
1989.subtitle: Intoxicants and Gambling Prohibited

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ فِى ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يريد الشيطان أن يوقع بينكم العداوة والبغضاء في الخمر والميسر ويصدكم عن ذكر الله وعن الصلاة ۖ فهل أنتم منتهون
verses.transliterated: innamā yurīdu l-shayṭānu an yūqiʿa baynakumu l-ʿadāwata wal-baghḍāa fī l-khamri wal-maysiri wayaṣuddakum ʿan dhik'ri l-lahi waʿani l-ṣalati fahal antum muntahūn
verses.english: The devil wants to provoke animosity and hatred among you through intoxicants and gambling, and to distract you from remembering GOD, and from observing the Contact Prayers (Salat). Will you then refrain?

1981.english: The devil wants to instill enmity and hatred among you, through intoxicants and gambling, and wants to divert you from remembering God, and from the **salat** prayers. Will you then abstain?

1989.english: The devil wants to provoke animosity and hatred among you through intoxicants and gambling, and to distract you from remembering GOD and from observing the contact prayers (Salat). Will you then refrain?

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَٱحْذَرُوا۟ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وأطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول واحذروا ۚ فإن توليتم فاعلموا أنما على رسولنا البلاغ المبين
verses.transliterated: wa-aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla wa-iḥ'dharū fa-in tawallaytum fa-iʿ'lamū annamā ʿalā rasūlinā l-balāghu l-mubīn
verses.english: You shall obey GOD, and you shall obey the messenger, and beware. If you turn away, then know that the sole duty of our messenger is to deliver the message efficiently.

1981.english: You shall obey God, and obey the messenger, and beware. If you turn away, then you should know that the sole function of our messenger is to deliver the message.
1981.subtitle: Sole Function of the Messenger

1989.english: You shall obey GOD and obey the messenger, and beware. If you turn away, then know that the sole duty of our messenger is to deliver the message efficiently.

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوٓا۟ إِذَا مَا ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّأَحْسَنُوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ليس على الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جناح فيما طعموا إذا ما اتقوا وآمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ثم اتقوا وآمنوا ثم اتقوا وأحسنوا ۗ والله يحب المحسنين
verses.transliterated: laysa ʿalā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti junāḥun fīmā ṭaʿimū idhā mā ittaqaw waāmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti thumma ittaqaw waāmanū thumma ittaqaw wa-aḥsanū wal-lahu yuḥibbu l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life bear no guilt by eating any food, so long as they observe the commandments, believe and lead a righteous life, then maintain their piety and faith, and continue to observe piety and righteousness. GOD loves the righteous.

1981.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life commit no sin by eating any food, so long as they observe righteousness and faith, and work righteousness; then continue to grow in piety, faith, and righteous works. God loves the pious.

1989.english: No sin is committed by those who believe and lead a righteous life when they eat any food, so long as they observe the commandments, believe and lead a righteous life, then maintain their piety and faith, and continue to observe piety and righteousness. GOD loves the righteous.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُۥٓ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ لِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَخَافُهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا ليبلونكم الله بشيء من الصيد تناله أيديكم ورماحكم ليعلم الله من يخافه بالغيب ۚ فمن اعتدى بعد ذلك فله عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū layabluwannakumu l-lahu bishayin mina l-ṣaydi tanāluhu aydīkum warimāḥukum liyaʿlama l-lahu man yakhāfuhu bil-ghaybi famani iʿ'tadā baʿda dhālika falahu ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, GOD will test you with some game within reach of your hands and your arrows (during pilgrimage). GOD thus distinguishes those among you who observe Him in their privacy. Those who transgress after this have incurred a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: Game Conservation

1981.english: O you who believe, God may put you to the test through placing game within reach of your hands and arrows. God thus will distinguish those who reverence Him in their privacy. Anyone who transgresses after this, has deserved painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Hunt During Pilgrimage

1989.english: O you who believe, GOD will test you with some game within reach of your hands and arrows (during pilgrimage). GOD thus distinguishes those among you who observe Him in their privacy. Those who transgress after this incur a painful retribution.
1989.subtitle: Game Conservation

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْدَ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ وَمَن قَتَلَهُۥ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآءٌ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ ٱلنَّعَمِ يَحْكُمُ بِهِۦ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ هَدْيًۢا بَٰلِغَ ٱلْكَعْبَةِ أَوْ كَفَّٰرَةٌ طَعَامُ مَسَٰكِينَ أَوْ عَدْلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامًا لِّيَذُوقَ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِۦ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَيَنتَقِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْهُ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تقتلوا الصيد وأنتم حرم ۚ ومن قتله منكم متعمدا فجزاء مثل ما قتل من النعم يحكم به ذوا عدل منكم هديا بالغ الكعبة أو كفارة طعام مساكين أو عدل ذلك صياما ليذوق وبال أمره ۗ عفا الله عما سلف ۚ ومن عاد فينتقم الله منه ۗ والله عزيز ذو انتقام
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā taqtulū l-ṣayda wa-antum ḥurumun waman qatalahu minkum mutaʿammidan fajazāon mith'lu mā qatala mina l-naʿami yaḥkumu bihi dhawā ʿadlin minkum hadyan bāligha l-kaʿbati aw kaffāratun ṭaʿāmu masākīna aw ʿadlu dhālika ṣiyāman liyadhūqa wabāla amrihi ʿafā l-lahu ʿammā salafa waman ʿāda fayantaqimu l-lahu min'hu wal-lahu ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmi
verses.english: O you who believe, do not kill any game during pilgrimage. Anyone who kills any game on purpose, his fine shall be a number of livestock animals that is equivalent to the game animals he killed. The judgment shall be set by two equitable people among you. They shall make sure that the offerings reach the Ka'bah. Otherwise, he may expiate by feeding poor people, or by an equivalent fast to atone for his offense. GOD has pardoned past offenses. But if anyone returns to such an offense, GOD will avenge it. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not kill any game during pilgrimage. If anyone kills it on purpose, he shall expiate by offering an equivalent livestock, as judged by two equitable people. The offering shall go to the Kaaba.\* Otherwise, the expiation may be by feeding some poor people, or by an equivalent fast as an atonement for his sin. God has pardoned all past offenses, but whoever reverts to this sin, God will avenge from him. God is almighty, avenger.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not kill any game during pilgrimage. Anyone who kills any game on purpose, his fine shall be the same number of livestock as the number of game animals he killed. Let two equitable people among you judge, and make sure that the offerings reach the Ka‘bah. Otherwise, he may atone by feeding poor people, or by an equivalent fast to pay for his offense. GOD has pardoned past offenses. But if anyone returns to such an offense, GOD will avenge it. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.

verses.arabic: أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهُۥ مَتَٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أحل لكم صيد البحر وطعامه متاعا لكم وللسيارة ۖ وحرم عليكم صيد البر ما دمتم حرما ۗ واتقوا الله الذي إليه تحشرون
verses.transliterated: uḥilla lakum ṣaydu l-baḥri waṭaʿāmuhu matāʿan lakum walilssayyārati waḥurrima ʿalaykum ṣaydu l-bari mā dum'tum ḥuruman wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: All fish of the sea are made lawful for you to eat. During pilgrimage, this may provide for you during your journey. You shall not hunt throughout the pilgrimage. You shall reverence GOD, before whom you will be summoned.
verses.subtitle: All Creatures of the Sea Lawful to Eat

1981.english: Permitted for you is fishing the sea, and eating therefrom, as a provision for you and your caravan. But you are forbidden from hunting on land, for as long as you are observing pilgrimage. You shall observe God, before whom you will be gathered.

1989.english: All fish of the sea are made lawful for you to eat. During pilgrimage, this will provide for you during your journey. You shall not hunt throughout the pilgrimage. You shall observe GOD, before whom you will be summoned.
1989.subtitle: All Creatures of the Sea Lawful to Eat

verses.arabic: جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ قِيَٰمًا لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَٱلْهَدْىَ وَٱلْقَلَٰٓئِدَ ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: جعل الله الكعبة البيت الحرام قياما للناس والشهر الحرام والهدي والقلائد ۚ ذلك لتعلموا أن الله يعلم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وأن الله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: jaʿala l-lahu l-kaʿbata l-bayta l-ḥarāma qiyāman lilnnāsi wal-shahra l-ḥarāma wal-hadya wal-qalāida dhālika litaʿlamū anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-anna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: GOD has appointed the Ka'bah, the Sacred Masjid, to be a sanctuary for the people, and also the Sacred Months, the offerings (to the Sacred Masjid), and the garlands marking them. You should know that GOD knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and that GOD is Omniscient.
verses.footnote: The idol-worshiping Muslims have instituted two "Sacred Masjids" by consecrating the Prophet's tomb. The Quran talks only about one Sacred Masjid.

1981.english: God has decreed that the Kaaba shall be sacred for all the people, as well as the holy months, the offerings to Kaaba,\* and the garlands marking them. You should realize that God knows everything in the heavens and the earth. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: GOD has consecrated the Ka'bah, the Sacred Mosque,* for the people. (He has also consecrated) the Sacred Months, the offerings (to the Sacred Mosque), and the garlands marking them. You should know that GOD knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and that GOD is Omniscient.
1989.footnote: The idol-worshiping Muslims have instituted two “Sacred Mosques” by consecrating the Prophet’s tomb. The Quran talks only about one Sacred Mosque.

verses.arabic: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: اعلموا أن الله شديد العقاب وأن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: iʿ'lamū anna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqābi wa-anna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Know that GOD is strict in enforcing retribution, and that GOD is Forgiving, Most Merciful.

1981.english: You should realize that God is strict in enforcing retribution, and that God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Know that GOD is strict in enforcing retribution, and that GOD is Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: مَّا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما على الرسول إلا البلاغ ۗ والله يعلم ما تبدون وما تكتمون
verses.transliterated: mā ʿalā l-rasūli illā l-balāghu wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tub'dūna wamā taktumūn
verses.english: The sole duty of the messenger is to deliver the message, and GOD knows everything you declare and everything you conceal.

1981.english: The sole function of the messenger is to deliver the message, and God knows what you declare, and what you conceal.
1981.subtitle: Sole Function of the Messenger

1989.english: The sole duty of the messenger is to deliver the message, and GOD knows everything you declare and everything you conceal.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْخَبِيثُ وَٱلطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ ٱلْخَبِيثِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا يستوي الخبيث والطيب ولو أعجبك كثرة الخبيث ۚ فاتقوا الله يا أولي الألباب لعلكم تفلحون
verses.transliterated: qul lā yastawī l-khabīthu wal-ṭayibu walaw aʿjabaka kathratu l-khabīthi fa-ittaqū l-laha yāulī l-albābi laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: Proclaim: "The bad and the good are not the same, even if the abundance of the bad may impress you. You shall reverence GOD, (even if you are in the minority,) O you who possess intelligence, that you may succeed."

1981.english: Say, "The bad is never the same as the good, even if you are impressed by the abundance of the bad. Therefore, you shall observe God, O you who possess intelligence, that you may succeed."

1989.english: Proclaim: “The bad and the good are not equal, even if you are impressed by the quantity of the bad. Therefore, you shall observe GOD, (even if you are in the minority,) O you who possess intelligence, that you may succeed.”

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْ أَشْيَآءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ وَإِن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تسألوا عن أشياء إن تبد لكم تسؤكم وإن تسألوا عنها حين ينزل القرآن تبد لكم عفا الله عنها ۗ والله غفور حليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tasalū ʿan ashyāa in tub'da lakum tasu'kum wa-in tasalū ʿanhā ḥīna yunazzalu l-qur'ānu tub'da lakum ʿafā l-lahu ʿanhā wal-lahu ghafūrun ḥalīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, do not ask about matters which, if revealed to you prematurely, would hurt you. If you ask about them in light of the Quran, they will become obvious to you. GOD has deliberately overlooked them. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not ask about things if revealed to you, you will be hurt. If you consider them in light of the Quran, you will realize that God left them out as an alleviation. God is forgiver, clement.\
1981.footnote: God teaches us that we have everything we need in the Quran (see 6:19, 38, 114, and Appendix 15). Anything not mentioned specifically in the Quran is left to our freedom of choice. For example, the Quran does not specify a method for sleeping. Therefore, we can sleep any way we like; on the right side, on the left side, on the back, or on the belly. Similarly, we can eat with our right hand, or the left hand, with or without forks and knives. The idol-worshipers have invented a most unreasonable set of behaviors, and termed them "**Sunna**."

1989.english: O you who believe, do not ask about matters which, if revealed to you, would hurt you. If you ask about them in light of the Quran, they will become obvious to you. GOD has deliberately overlooked them. GOD is Forgiver, Clement.

verses.arabic: قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا۟ بِهَا كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قد سألها قوم من قبلكم ثم أصبحوا بها كافرين
verses.transliterated: qad sa-alahā qawmun min qablikum thumma aṣbaḥū bihā kāfirīn
verses.english: Others before you have asked the same questions, then became disbelievers therein.

1981.english: Others before you have asked similar questions, then rejected the answers given to them.

1989.english: Others before you have asked the same questions, then became disbelievers.

verses.arabic: مَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٍ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٍ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍ وَلَا حَامٍ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما جعل الله من بحيرة ولا سائبة ولا وصيلة ولا حام ۙ ولكن الذين كفروا يفترون على الله الكذب ۖ وأكثرهم لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: mā jaʿala l-lahu min baḥīratin walā sāibatin walā waṣīlatin walā ḥāmin walākinna alladhīna kafarū yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba wa-aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: GOD did not prohibit livestock that begets certain combinations of males and females, nor livestock liberated by an oath, nor the one that begets two males in a row, nor the bull that fathers ten. It is the disbelievers who invented such lies about GOD. Most of them do not understand.

1981.english: God never prohibited the **Baheerah** (female that gives birth to a certain sequence of males), nor the **Saa'ibah** (animal liberated by an oath), nor the **Waseelah** (female that gives birth to consecutive males), nor the **Ham** (male that fathers ten). It is the disbelievers who invented such lies, and most of them do not understand.

1989.english: GOD did not prohibit livestock that begets certain combinations of males and females, nor livestock liberated by an oath, nor the one that begets two males in a row, nor the bull that fathers ten. It is the disbelievers who invented such lies about GOD. Most of them do not understand.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ قَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم تعالوا إلى ما أنزل الله وإلى الرسول قالوا حسبنا ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا ۚ أولو كان آباؤهم لا يعلمون شيئا ولا يهتدون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālaw ilā mā anzala l-lahu wa-ilā l-rasūli qālū ḥasbunā mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā awalaw kāna ābāuhum lā yaʿlamūna shayan walā yahtadūn
verses.english: When they are told, "Come to what GOD has revealed, and to the messenger," they say, "What we found our parents doing is sufficient for us." What if their parents knew nothing, and were not guided?
verses.subtitle: Do Not Follow Your Parents' Religion Blindly

1981.english: When they are told, "Come to what God has revealed, and to the messenger," they say, "Sufficient for us is what we found our parents doing." What if their parents lacked the knowledge, and the guidance?

1989.english: When they are told, “Come to what GOD has revealed, and to the messenger,” they say, “What we found our parents doing is sufficient for us.” What if their parents lcnew nothing, and were not guided?
1989.subtitle: Do Not Follow Your Parents’ Religion Blindly

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ لَا يَضُرُّكُم مَّن ضَلَّ إِذَا ٱهْتَدَيْتُمْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا عليكم أنفسكم ۖ لا يضركم من ضل إذا اهتديتم ۚ إلى الله مرجعكم جميعا فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ʿalaykum anfusakum lā yaḍurrukum man ḍalla idhā ih'tadaytum ilā l-lahi marjiʿukum jamīʿan fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: O you who believe, you should worry only about your own necks. If the others go astray, they cannot hurt you, as long as you are guided. To GOD is your ultimate destiny, all of you, then He will inform you of everything you had done.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall worry only about yourselves; you are not harmed by those who go astray, so long as you are guided. To God is the ultimate return of all of you, then He will inform you of everything you did.

1989.english: O you who believe, you should worry about your own necks. If the others go astray, they cannot hurt you, as long as you are guided. To GOD is your ultimate destiny, all of you, then He will inform you of everything you had done.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ شَهَٰدَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ حِينَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ ٱثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ ءَاخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصَٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِى بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَٰدَةَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْءَاثِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا شهادة بينكم إذا حضر أحدكم الموت حين الوصية اثنان ذوا عدل منكم أو آخران من غيركم إن أنتم ضربتم في الأرض فأصابتكم مصيبة الموت ۚ تحبسونهما من بعد الصلاة فيقسمان بالله إن ارتبتم لا نشتري به ثمنا ولو كان ذا قربى ۙ ولا نكتم شهادة الله إنا إذا لمن الآثمين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū shahādatu baynikum idhā ḥaḍara aḥadakumu l-mawtu ḥīna l-waṣiyati ith'nāni dhawā ʿadlin minkum aw ākharāni min ghayrikum in antum ḍarabtum fī l-arḍi fa-aṣābatkum muṣībatu l-mawti taḥbisūnahumā min baʿdi l-ṣalati fayuq'simāni bil-lahi ini ir'tabtum lā nashtarī bihi thamanan walaw kāna dhā qur'bā walā naktumu shahādata l-lahi innā idhan lamina l-āthimīn
verses.english: O you who believe, witnessing a will when one of you is dying shall be done by two equitable people among you. If you are traveling, then two others may do the witnessing. After observing the Contact Prayer (Salat), let the witnesses swear by GOD, to alleviate your doubts: "We will not use this to attain personal gains, even if the testator is related to us. Nor will we conceal GOD's testimony. Otherwise, we would be sinners."
verses.subtitle: Witnessing A Will

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall have witnesses, to witness the will, when death comes to any of you. You shall appoint two equitable persons from among you or two outsiders if death strikes while you are travelling. Following the **salat** prayer, let the two witnesses swear by God, if you have any doubts, that they will not take advantage and distort the will in their favor, even if the deceased is related to them, nor will they conceal the testimony. Otherwise, they will be sinners.
1981.subtitle: Witnessing a Will

1989.english: O you who believe, witnessing a will when one of you is dying shall be done by two equitable people among you. If you are traveling, then two others may do the witnessing. After observing the contact prayer (Salat), let the witnesses swear by GOD, to alleviate your doubts: “We will not use this to attain personal gains, even if the testator is related to us. Nor will we conceal GOD’s testimony, lest we become guilty.”
1989.subtitle: Witnessing A Will

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنَّهُمَا ٱسْتَحَقَّآ إِثْمًا فَـَٔاخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَوْلَيَٰنِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ لَشَهَٰدَتُنَآ أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَٰدَتِهِمَا وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَآ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن عثر على أنهما استحقا إثما فآخران يقومان مقامهما من الذين استحق عليهم الأوليان فيقسمان بالله لشهادتنا أحق من شهادتهما وما اعتدينا إنا إذا لمن الظالمين
verses.transliterated: fa-in ʿuthira ʿalā annahumā is'taḥaqqā ith'man faākharāni yaqūmāni maqāmahumā mina alladhīna is'taḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-awlayāni fayuq'simāni bil-lahi lashahādatunā aḥaqqu min shahādatihimā wamā iʿ'tadaynā innā idhan lamina l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: If the witnesses are found to be guilty of bias, then two others shall be asked to take their places. Choose two persons who were victimized by the first witnesses, and let them swear by GOD: "Our testimony is more truthful than theirs; we will not be biased. Otherwise, we will be transgressors."

1981.english: If they are found guilty of bias, then appoint two others who suffered injustice by the first two. Let them swear by God that their testimony will be more honest and truthful, and that if they transgress, they will be wicked.

1989.english: If the witnesses are found to be guilty of bias, then two others shall be asked to take their places. Choose two persons who were victimized by the first witnesses, and let them swear by GOD: “Our testimony is more truthful than theirs; we will not deviate. Otherwise, we will be transgressors.”

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهَآ أَوْ يَخَافُوٓا۟ أَن تُرَدَّ أَيْمَٰنٌۢ بَعْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك أدنى أن يأتوا بالشهادة على وجهها أو يخافوا أن ترد أيمان بعد أيمانهم ۗ واتقوا الله واسمعوا ۗ والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين
verses.transliterated: dhālika adnā an yatū bil-shahādati ʿalā wajhihā aw yakhāfū an turadda aymānun baʿda aymānihim wa-ittaqū l-laha wa-is'maʿū wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīn
verses.english: This is more apt to encourage an honest testimony on their part, fearing that their oath may be disregarded like that of the previous witnesses. You shall observe GOD and listen. GOD does not guide the wicked.

1981.english: This will persuade them to give an accurate testimony, and guard against bias and exposure as bearers of false witness. You shall observe God, and hearken, for God does not guide the wicked.

1989.english: This is more apt to encourage an honest testimony on their part, fearing that their oath may be disregarded like that of the previous witnesses. You shall observe GOD and listen. GOD does not guide the wicked.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أُجِبْتُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يجمع الله الرسل فيقول ماذا أجبتم ۖ قالوا لا علم لنا ۖ إنك أنت علام الغيوب
verses.transliterated: yawma yajmaʿu l-lahu l-rusula fayaqūlu mādhā ujib'tum qālū lā ʿil'ma lanā innaka anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb
verses.english: The day will come when GOD will summon the messengers and ask them, "How was the response to you?" They will say, "We have no knowledge. You are the Knower of all secrets."
verses.subtitle: The Dead Messengers Totally Unaware

1981.english: The day will come when God gathers all the messengers and asks them, "How was the response to you?" They will say, "We do not know; You are the knower of all secrets."

1989.english: The day will come when GOD will summon the messengers and ask them, “How was the response to you?” They will say, “We have no knowledge. You are the Knower of all secrets.”
