1989.subtitle: The Dead Messengers Totally Unaware

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ بِإِذْنِى فَتَنفُخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِى وَتُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِى وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِى وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَنكَ إِذْ جِئْتَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال الله يا عيسى ابن مريم اذكر نعمتي عليك وعلى والدتك إذ أيدتك بروح القدس تكلم الناس في المهد وكهلا ۖ وإذ علمتك الكتاب والحكمة والتوراة والإنجيل ۖ وإذ تخلق من الطين كهيئة الطير بإذني فتنفخ فيها فتكون طيرا بإذني ۖ وتبرئ الأكمه والأبرص بإذني ۖ وإذ تخرج الموتى بإذني ۖ وإذ كففت بني إسرائيل عنك إذ جئتهم بالبينات فقال الذين كفروا منهم إن هذا إلا سحر مبين
verses.transliterated: idh qāla l-lahu yāʿīsā ib'na maryama udh'kur niʿ'matī ʿalayka waʿalā wālidatika idh ayyadttuka birūḥi l-qudusi tukallimu l-nāsa fī l-mahdi wakahlan wa-idh ʿallamtuka l-kitāba wal-ḥik'mata wal-tawrāta wal-injīla wa-idh takhluqu mina l-ṭīni kahayati l-ṭayri bi-idh'nī fatanfukhu fīhā fatakūnu ṭayran bi-idh'nī watub'ri-u l-akmaha wal-abraṣa bi-idh'nī wa-idh tukh'riju l-mawtā bi-idh'nī wa-idh kafaftu banī is'rāīla ʿanka idh ji'tahum bil-bayināti faqāla alladhīna kafarū min'hum in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: GOD will say, "O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessings upon you and your mother. I supported you with the Holy Spirit, to enable you to speak to the people from the crib, as well as an adult. I taught you the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel. Recall that you created from clay the shape of a bird by My leave, then blew into it, and it became a live bird by My leave. You healed the blind and the leprous by My leave, and revived the dead by My leave. Recall that I protected you from the Children of Israel who wanted to hurt you, despite the profound miracles you had shown them. The disbelievers among them said, 'This is obviously magic.'

1981.english: That is when God will say, "O Jesus, son of Mary, recall the favors I bestowed upon you and your mother. I supported you with the holy spirit, causing you to speak to the people as an infant, as well as a grown-up, and I taught you the scripture and wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel. And recall that you fashioned birds from clay, then blew into it, and it became a live bird by My leave. You healed the blind and the leprous by My leave, and you revived the dead by My leave. And recall that I protected you from the children of Israel: when you went to them with profound miracles, the disbelievers among them said, 'This is obviously magic.'

1989.english: GOD will say, “O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessings upon you and your mother. I supported you with the Holy Spirit; you thus spoke to the people from the crib, as well as an adult. I taught you the scripture, wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel. You created from clay the shape of a bird by My leave, then blew into it and it became a live bird by My leave. You healed the blind and the leprous by My leave, and revived the dead by My leave. Recall that I protected you from the Children of Israel who wanted to hurt you, even though you showed them profound miracles. The disbelievers among them said, ‘This is obviously magic.’

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحَوَارِيِّۦنَ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِى وَبِرَسُولِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أوحيت إلى الحواريين أن آمنوا بي وبرسولي قالوا آمنا واشهد بأننا مسلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh awḥaytu ilā l-ḥawāriyīna an āminū bī wabirasūlī qālū āmannā wa-ish'had bi-annanā mus'limūn
verses.english: "Recall that I inspired the disciples: 'You shall believe in Me and My messenger.' They said, 'We have believed, and bear witness that we are submitters.' "

1981.english: "And recall that I inspired the disciples, 'Believe in Me and My messengers.' They said, 'We believe, and bear witness that we are Muslims.' "

1989.english: “Recall that I inspired the disciples: ‘You shall believe in Me and My messenger.’ They said, ‘We have believed, and bear witness that we are Muslims.’ ”

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ قَالَ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال الحواريون يا عيسى ابن مريم هل يستطيع ربك أن ينزل علينا مائدة من السماء ۖ قال اتقوا الله إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: idh qāla l-ḥawāriyūna yāʿīsā ib'na maryama hal yastaṭīʿu rabbuka an yunazzila ʿalaynā māidatan mina l-samāi qāla ittaqū l-laha in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: Recall that the disciples said, "O Jesus, son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a feast from the sky?" He said, "You should reverence GOD, if you are believers."
verses.subtitle: The Feast

1981.english: The disciples said, "O Jesus, son of Mary, can your Lord bring down to us a feast from the sky?" He said, "Fear God, if you are really believers."
1981.subtitle: The Feast

1989.english: Recall that the disciples said, “O Jesus, son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a feast from the sky?” He said, “You should reverence GOD, if you are believers.”
1989.subtitle: The Feast

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا نريد أن نأكل منها وتطمئن قلوبنا ونعلم أن قد صدقتنا ونكون عليها من الشاهدين
verses.transliterated: qālū nurīdu an nakula min'hā wataṭma-inna qulūbunā wanaʿlama an qad ṣadaqtanā wanakūna ʿalayhā mina l-shāhidīn
verses.english: They said, "We wish to eat from it, and to reassure our hearts, and to know for sure that you have told us the truth. We will serve as witnesses thereof."

1981.english: They said, "We want to eat therefrom, reassure our hearts, and know that you have told us the truth. We want to see for ourselves."

1989.english: They said, “We wish to eat therefrom, and reassure our hearts, and to know that you have brought us the truth, that we may serve as witnesses thereof.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال عيسى ابن مريم اللهم ربنا أنزل علينا مائدة من السماء تكون لنا عيدا لأولنا وآخرنا وآية منك ۖ وارزقنا وأنت خير الرازقين
verses.transliterated: qāla ʿīsā ub'nu maryama l-lahuma rabbanā anzil ʿalaynā māidatan mina l-samāi takūnu lanā ʿīdan li-awwalinā waākhirinā waāyatan minka wa-ur'zuq'nā wa-anta khayru l-rāziqīn
verses.english: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "Our god, our Lord, send down to us a feast from the sky. Let it bring plenty for each and every one of us, and a sign from You. Provide for us; You are the best Provider."
verses.subtitle: Greater Miracles Bring Greater Responsibility
verses.footnote: The Quran's overwhelming miracle (Appendix 1) is described in 74:35 as "One of the greatest miracles," and brings with it an uncommonly great responsibility.

1981.english: Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O God, our Lord, send down to us a feast from the sky. Let it be a celebration for each and everyone of us, and a sign from You. Provide for us; You are the best provider."

1989.english: Jesus, the son of Mary, said, “Our god, our Lord, send down to us a feast from the sky. Let it be a celebration for each and every one of us, and a sign from You. Provide for us; You are the best Provider.”
1989.subtitle: Greater Miracles Bring Greater Responsibility
1989.footnote: The Quran’s overwhelming miracle (Appendix 1) is described in 74:35 as “One of the greatest miracles, ” and brings with it an uncommonly great responsibility.

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال الله إني منزلها عليكم ۖ فمن يكفر بعد منكم فإني أعذبه عذابا لا أعذبه أحدا من العالمين
verses.transliterated: qāla l-lahu innī munazziluhā ʿalaykum faman yakfur baʿdu minkum fa-innī uʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban lā uʿadhibuhu aḥadan mina l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: GOD said, "I am sending it down. Anyone among you who disbelieves after this, I will punish him as I never punished anyone else."

1981.english: God said, "I am sending it down to you, and if anyone disbelieves thereafter, I will punish him as I never punish anyone else."

1989.english: GOD said, “I am sending it down. Anyone among you who disbelieves after this, I will punish him as I never punished anyone else.”*
1989.footnote: The Quran’s overwhelming miracle (Appendix 1) is described in 74:35 as “One of the greatest miracles, ” and brings with it an uncommonly great responsibility.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِى وَأُمِّىَ إِلَٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِحَقٍّ إِن كُنتُ قُلْتُهُۥ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُۥ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِى وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِكَ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قال الله يا عيسى ابن مريم أأنت قلت للناس اتخذوني وأمي إلهين من دون الله ۖ قال سبحانك ما يكون لي أن أقول ما ليس لي بحق ۚ إن كنت قلته فقد علمته ۚ تعلم ما في نفسي ولا أعلم ما في نفسك ۚ إنك أنت علام الغيوب
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qāla l-lahu yāʿīsā ib'na maryama a-anta qul'ta lilnnāsi ittakhidhūnī wa-ummiya ilāhayni min dūni l-lahi qāla sub'ḥānaka mā yakūnu lī an aqūla mā laysa lī biḥaqqin in kuntu qul'tuhu faqad ʿalim'tahu taʿlamu mā fī nafsī walā aʿlamu mā fī nafsika innaka anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb
verses.english: GOD will say, “O Jesus, son of Mary, did you say to the people, ‘Make me and my mother idols beside GOD’?” He will say, “Be You glorified. I could not utter what was not right. Had I said it, You already would have known it. You know my thoughts, and I do not know Your thoughts. You know all the secrets.
verses.subtitle: On The Day Of Resurrection
verses.footnote: It is noteworthy that the Quran consistently calls Jesus "son of Mary" and the Bible calls him "son of man." God knew that some will blaspheme and call him "son of God"!

1981.english: And God will say, "O Jesus, son of Mary, did you tell the people to consider you and your mother idols besides God?" He will say, "Glory be to you, it is not right for me to say what is not true. Had I said it, You would have known about it. You know my innermost thoughts, while I do not know Your innermost thoughts. You are the knower of all secrets.
1981.subtitle: Jesus Disowns His Worshipers

1989.english: GOD will say, “O Jesus, son of Mary,* did vou sav to the DeoDle. ‘Worship me and my mother beside: GOD?’ ” He will say, “Be You glorified. I could not utter what was not the truth. Had I said it, You would have known it. You know my thoughts, and I do not know Your thoughts. You know all secrets.
1989.subtitle: On The Day Of Resurrection
1989.footnote: It is noteworthy that the Quran consistently calls Jesus “son of Mary” and the Bible calls him “son of man. ” God knew that they will call him “son of God!”

verses.arabic: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرْتَنِى بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِى كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما قلت لهم إلا ما أمرتني به أن اعبدوا الله ربي وربكم ۚ وكنت عليهم شهيدا ما دمت فيهم ۖ فلما توفيتني كنت أنت الرقيب عليهم ۚ وأنت على كل شيء شهيد
verses.transliterated: mā qul'tu lahum illā mā amartanī bihi ani uʿ'budū l-laha rabbī warabbakum wakuntu ʿalayhim shahīdan mā dum'tu fīhim falammā tawaffaytanī kunta anta l-raqība ʿalayhim wa-anta ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
verses.english: "I told them only what You commanded me to say, that: 'You shall worship GOD, my Lord and your Lord.' I was a witness among them for as long as I lived with them. When You terminated my life on earth, You became the Watcher over them. You witness all things.

1981.english: "I did not tell them except what you commanded me to say: that you shall worship God, my Lord and your Lord. I was a witness among them, for as long as I lived with them. When You terminated my life, You became the watcher over them. You are the witness of all things.

1989.english: “I told them only what You commanded me to say, that: ‘You shall worship GOD, my Lord and your Lord.’ I was a witness among them as long as I lived with them. When You put me to death, You became the Watcher over them. You witness all things.

verses.arabic: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إن تعذبهم فإنهم عبادك ۖ وإن تغفر لهم فإنك أنت العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: in tuʿadhib'hum fa-innahum ʿibāduka wa-in taghfir lahum fa-innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: "If You punish them, they are Your constituents. If You forgive them, You are the Almighty, Most Wise."

1981.english: "If You punish them, they are Your servants, and if You forgive them, You are the almighty, the wise."

1989.english: “If You punish them, they are Your creatures. If You forgive them, You are Almighty, Most Wise.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قال الله هذا يوم ينفع الصادقين صدقهم ۚ لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا ۚ رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ۚ ذلك الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: qāla l-lahu hādhā yawmu yanfaʿu l-ṣādiqīna ṣid'quhum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: GOD will proclaim, "This is a day when the truthful will be saved by their truthfulness." They have deserved gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. This is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: It will be said, "This is the day when the truthfulness of the truthful will benefit them. They have deserved gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. This is the great triumph."

1989.english: GOD will proclaim, “This is a day when the truthful will be saved by their truthfulness.” They have deserved gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. GOD i pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. This is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: لله ملك السماوات والأرض وما فيهن ۚ وهو على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā fīhinna wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and everything in them, and He is Omnipotent.

1981.english: To God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and everything in them, and He is omnipotent.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and everything in them, and He is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض وجعل الظلمات والنور ۖ ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون
verses.transliterated: al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wajaʿala l-ẓulumāti wal-nūra thumma alladhīna kafarū birabbihim yaʿdilūn
verses.english: Praise be to GOD, who created the heavens and the earth, and made the darkness and the light. Yet, those who disbelieve in their Lord continue to deviate.

1981.english: Praise be to God, who created the heavens and the earth, and devised the darkness and the light. Yet, the disbelievers set up idols to rank with their Lord.

1989.english: Praise be to GOD, who created the heavens and the earth, and made the darkness and the light. Yet, those who disbelieve in their Lord continue to deviate.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي خلقكم من طين ثم قضى أجلا ۖ وأجل مسمى عنده ۖ ثم أنتم تمترون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī khalaqakum min ṭīnin thumma qaḍā ajalan wa-ajalun musamman ʿindahu thumma antum tamtarūn
verses.english: He is the One who created you from mud, then predetermined your life span, a life span that is known only to Him. Yet, you continue to doubt.

1981.english: He is the one who created you from clay, then appointed the life spans, and a predetermined end that is known only to Him. Yet, you still harbor doubts.

1989.english: He created you from clay and predetermined your life span, a life span that is known only to Him. Yet, you continue to harbor doubts.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الله في السماوات وفي الأرض ۖ يعلم سركم وجهركم ويعلم ما تكسبون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa l-lahu fī l-samāwāti wafī l-arḍi yaʿlamu sirrakum wajahrakum wayaʿlamu mā taksibūn
verses.english: He is the one GOD in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secrets and your declarations, and He knows everything you earn.

1981.english: And He is the one God of the heavens and the earth. He knows your secrets, and your declarations, and He knows everything you earn.

1989.english: He is the one GOD in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secrets and your declarations, and He knows everything you earn.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما تأتيهم من آية من آيات ربهم إلا كانوا عنها معرضين
verses.transliterated: wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīn
verses.english: No matter what kind of proof comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it, in aversion.

1981.english: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away therefrom.
1981.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1989.english: No matter what kind of miracle comes to them from their Lord, they turn away in aversion.

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فقد كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم ۖ فسوف يأتيهم أنباء ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: faqad kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fasawfa yatīhim anbāu mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: Since they rejected the truth when it came to them, they have incurred the consequences of their heedlessness.

1981.english: Because they rejected the truth when it came to them, they have deserved the consequences thereof.

1989.english: Since they rejected the truth when it came to them, they have incurred the consequences of their heedlessness.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يروا كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن مكناهم في الأرض ما لم نمكن لكم وأرسلنا السماء عليهم مدرارا وجعلنا الأنهار تجري من تحتهم فأهلكناهم بذنوبهم وأنشأنا من بعدهم قرنا آخرين
verses.transliterated: alam yaraw kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin makkannāhum fī l-arḍi mā lam numakkin lakum wa-arsalnā l-samāa ʿalayhim mid'rāran wajaʿalnā l-anhāra tajrī min taḥtihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīn
verses.english: Have they not seen how many generations before them we have annihilated? We established them on earth more than we did for you, and we showered them with blessings, generously, and we provided them with flowing streams. We then annihilated them because of their sins, and we substituted another generation in their place.

1981.english: Did they not see how many generations we annihilated before them? We had established them on earth, even more than we did for you, and we sent the sky pouring on them generously, and provided them with flowing rivers. Then, because of their sins, we annihilated them and substituted other generations.

1989.english: Have they not seen the generations before them that we annihilated? We established them on earth, more than we did for you, and we showered them with blessings, generously, and we provided them with flowing streams. But then we annihilated them because of their sins, and we substituted another generation in their place.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًا فِى قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولو نزلنا عليك كتابا في قرطاس فلمسوه بأيديهم لقال الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين
verses.transliterated: walaw nazzalnā ʿalayka kitāban fī qir'ṭāsin falamasūhu bi-aydīhim laqāla alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: Even if we sent down to them a physical book, written on paper, and they touched it with their hands, those who disbelieved would have said, "This is no more than clever magic."

1981.english: Even if we sent down to you a physical book, written on paper, so that they could touch it with their hands, the disbelievers would have said, "This is no more than clever magic."

1989.english: Even if we sent down to them a physical book, written on paper, and they touched it with their hands, those who disbelieved would have said, “This is no more than clever magic.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لولا أنزل عليه ملك ۖ ولو أنزلنا ملكا لقضي الأمر ثم لا ينظرون
verses.transliterated: waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi malakun walaw anzalnā malakan laquḍiya l-amru thumma lā yunẓarūn
verses.english: They also said, "If only an angel could come down with him!" Had we sent an angel, the whole matter would have been terminated, and they would no longer be respited.

1981.english: And they said, "Why does he not have an angel come down with him?" If we send down an angel, the whole matter would be terminated, and no one would be respited.

1989.english: They also said, “If only an angel could come down with him!” Had we sent an angel, the whole matter would have been terminated, and they would not have been respited.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو جعلناه ملكا لجعلناه رجلا وللبسنا عليهم ما يلبسون
verses.transliterated: walaw jaʿalnāhu malakan lajaʿalnāhu rajulan walalabasnā ʿalayhim mā yalbisūn
verses.english: Had we sent an angel, we would have sent him in the form of a man, and we would have kept them just as confused as they are confused now.
verses.subtitle: Requirements of the Test

1981.english: Even if we sent an angel, we would send him as a man, and would confuse them as they are confused.

1989.english: Had we sent an angel, we would have sent him in the form of a man, and we would have kept them confused, as they are confused now.
1989.subtitle: Requirements of the Test

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: walaqadi us'tuh'zi-a birusulin min qablika faḥāqa bi-alladhīna sakhirū min'hum mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: Messengers before you have been ridiculed. It is those who mocked them who suffered the consequences of their ridiculing.

1981.english: Messengers before you have been ridiculed, and those who ridiculed them were subsequently condemned.

1989.english: Messengers before you have been ridiculed. Those who mocked them have incurred the consequences of their ridiculing.

verses.arabic: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل سيروا في الأرض ثم انظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين
verses.transliterated: qul sīrū fī l-arḍi thumma unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīn
verses.english: Say, "Roam the earth and note the consequences for the rejectors."

1981.english: Say, "Roam the earth, and note the consequences for the rejectors."

1989.english: Say, “Roam the earth and note the consequences for the rejectors.”

verses.arabic: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُل لِّلَّهِ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لمن ما في السماوات والأرض ۖ قل لله ۚ كتب على نفسه الرحمة ۚ ليجمعنكم إلى يوم القيامة لا ريب فيه ۚ الذين خسروا أنفسهم فهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: qul liman mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi qul lillahi kataba ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥmata layajmaʿannakum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Say, "To whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth?" Say, "To GOD." He has decreed that mercy is His attribute. He will surely summon you all on the Day of Resurrection, which is inevitable. The ones who lose their souls are those who disbelieve.

1981.english: Say, "To whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth?" Say, "To God." He has decreed mercy as one of His attributes, and He will gather you on the inevitable day of resurrection. It is the disbelievers who lose their souls.
1981.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

1989.english: Say, “To whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth?” Say, “To GOD.” He has decreed mercy as His attribute. He will surely summon you on the Day of Resurrection, which is inevitable. Those who lose their souls are the ones who disbelieve.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وله ما سكن في الليل والنهار ۚ وهو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: walahu mā sakana fī al-layli wal-nahāri wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: To Him belongs everything that dwells in the night and the day. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

1981.english: To Him belongs everything that inhabits the night and the day, and He is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: To Him belongs everything that dwells in the night and the day. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أغير الله أتخذ وليا فاطر السماوات والأرض وهو يطعم ولا يطعم ۗ قل إني أمرت أن أكون أول من أسلم ۖ ولا تكونن من المشركين
verses.transliterated: qul aghayra l-lahi attakhidhu waliyyan fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa yuṭ'ʿimu walā yuṭ'ʿamu qul innī umir'tu an akūna awwala man aslama walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Say, "Shall I accept other than GOD as a Lord and Master, when He is the Initiator of the heavens and the earth, and He feeds but is not fed?" Say, "I am commanded to be the most devoted submitter, and, 'Do not be an idol worshiper.' "

1981.english: Say, "Shall I seek a Lord other than God, when He is the initiator of the heavens and the earth, and He feeds and needs no food?" Say, "I am commanded to be the first to submit, and never to set up any idol."

1989.english: Say, “Shall I accept other than GOD as a Lord, when He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth, and He feeds but is not fed?” Say, “I am commanded to be the most devoted submitter, and, ‘Do not be an idol worshiper.’ ”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: Say, "I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of an awesome day.

1981.english: Say, "I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of a profound day."

1989.english: Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of an awesome day.

verses.arabic: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: من يصرف عنه يومئذ فقد رحمه ۚ وذلك الفوز المبين
verses.transliterated: man yuṣ'raf ʿanhu yawma-idhin faqad raḥimahu wadhālika l-fawzu l-mubīn
verses.english: "Whoever is spared (the retribution), on that day, has attained His mercy. And this is the greatest triumph."

1981.english: Anyone who is spared the retribution on that day, God has showered him with mercy, and this is the great triumph.

1989.english: “Whoever is spared on that day has attained His mercy. This is the most profound triumph.”

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له إلا هو ۖ وإن يمسسك بخير فهو على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: wa-in yamsaska l-lahu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu illā huwa wa-in yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: If GOD touches you with adversity, none can relieve it except He. And if He touches you with a blessing, He is Omnipotent.
verses.subtitle: Only God Controls Happiness

1981.english: If God afflicts you with adversity, there is none who can relieve it except He. And if He blesses you with something good, He is omnipotent.
1981.subtitle: Only God Benefits and Harms

1989.english: If GOD touches you with adversity, none can relieve it except He. And if He touches you with a blessing, He is Omnipotent.
1989.subtitle: Only God Controls Happiness

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وهو القاهر فوق عباده ۚ وهو الحكيم الخبير
verses.transliterated: wahuwa l-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīr
verses.english: He is Supreme over His creatures. He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

1981.english: He is the supreme master over His creatures, and He is the wise, the cognizant.

1989.english: He is Supreme over His creatures. He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَٰدَةً قُلِ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أي شيء أكبر شهادة ۖ قل الله ۖ شهيد بيني وبينكم ۚ وأوحي إلي هذا القرآن لأنذركم به ومن بلغ ۚ أئنكم لتشهدون أن مع الله آلهة أخرى ۚ قل لا أشهد ۚ قل إنما هو إله واحد وإنني بريء مما تشركون
verses.transliterated: qul ayyu shayin akbaru shahādatan quli l-lahu shahīdun baynī wabaynakum waūḥiya ilayya hādhā l-qur'ānu li-undhirakum bihi waman balagha a-innakum latashhadūna anna maʿa l-lahi ālihatan ukh'rā qul lā ashhadu qul innamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun wa-innanī barīon mimmā tush'rikūn
verses.english: Say, "Whose testimony is the greatest?" Say, "GOD's. He is the witness between me and you that this Quran has been inspired to me, to preach it to you and whomever it reaches. Indeed, you bear witness that there are other gods beside GOD." Say, "I do not testify as you do; there is only one god, and I disown your idolatry."
verses.subtitle: Quran, the Whole Quran, and Nothing But the Quran
verses.footnote: This verse proclaims the Quran as the only source of religious guidance. Those who uphold additional sources, such as Hadith & Sunna (lies attributed to the Prophet), are defined as idolators.

1981.english: Say, "Whose testimony is greater?" Say, "God is the witness between me and you. This Quran has been revealed to me in order to preach to you therewith, and whomever it reaches. Indeed, you bear witness that there are other gods besides God." Say, "I do not bear such witness." Say, "There is only one God, and I disown the idols you set up."
1981.subtitle: Quran: The Only Divine Revelation to Muhammad

1989.english: Say, “Whose testimony is the greatest?” Say, “GOD’s. He is the witness between me and you that this Quran* has been inspired to me, to preach it to you and whomever it reaches. Indeed, you set up other gods* besides GOD.” Say, “I do not testify as you do. I disown your idolatry.”
1989.footnote: This verse proclaims the Quran as the only source of religious guidance. Those who uphold additional sources, such as Hadith & Sunna, are defined as idolators.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين آتيناهم الكتاب يعرفونه كما يعرفون أبناءهم ۘ الذين خسروا أنفسهم فهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yaʿrifūnahu kamā yaʿrifūna abnāahumu alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Those to whom we have given the scripture recognize this as they recognize their own children. The ones who lose their souls are those who do not believe.

1981.english: Those who received previous scripture recognize this (Quran), as they recognize their own children. Those who lost their souls are the ones who disbelieve.

1989.english: Those to whom we have given the scripture recognize this as they recognize their own children. Those who lost their souls do not believe.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته ۗ إنه لا يفلح الظالمون
verses.transliterated: waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: Who is more evil than one who lies about GOD, or rejects His revelations? The transgressors never succeed.

1981.english: Who is more wicked than those who invent lies, then attribute them to God, or reject His revelations? Indeed, the wicked never succeed.
1981.subtitle: Hadith and Sunna: Imperceptible Idolatry
1981.footnote: These profound verses identify those who advocate "Hadith" and "Sunna" as idolaters who have set up Muhammad as an idol against his will. They invented lies and claimed that they were divine revelations to the prophet (6:21). They vehemently deny that they idolize the prophet, all the way through the day of judgment, even as they face God almighty (6:22-23). They use their invented lies as sources of jurisprudence, to suit their own traditions and superstitions, in total defiance of God and the prophet (see 6:19). On the day of judgment, Muhammad will disown those who idolize him, just as Jesus and the saints will disown those who idolize them (see 6:24, 16:86, 19:81, 36:74, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:23). The true believers uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. (see 6:114).

1989.english: Who is more evil than one who lies about GOD, or rejects His revelations? The wicked never succeed.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا ثم نقول للذين أشركوا أين شركاؤكم الذين كنتم تزعمون
verses.transliterated: wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū ayna shurakāukumu alladhīna kuntum tazʿumūn
verses.english: On the day when we summon them all, we will ask the idol worshipers, "Where are the idols you set up?"
verses.subtitle: Idol Worshipers Deny Their Idolatry

1981.english: On the day when we gather them all together, we will say to the idol worshipers, "Where are the idols you had fabricated?"
1981.footnote: These profound verses identify those who advocate "Hadith" and "Sunna" as idolaters who have set up Muhammad as an idol against his will. They invented lies and claimed that they were divine revelations to the prophet (6:21). They vehemently deny that they idolize the prophet, all the way through the day of judgment, even as they face God almighty (6:22-23). They use their invented lies as sources of jurisprudence, to suit their own traditions and superstitions, in total defiance of God and the prophet (see 6:19). On the day of judgment, Muhammad will disown those who idolize him, just as Jesus and the saints will disown those who idolize them (see 6:24, 16:86, 19:81, 36:74, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:23). The true believers uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. (see 6:114).

1989.english: On the day when we summon every one, we will ask the idol worshipers, “Where are the idols you set up?”
1989.subtitle: Idol Worshipers Deny Their Idolatry

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم لم تكن فتنتهم إلا أن قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين
verses.transliterated: thumma lam takun fit'natuhum illā an qālū wal-lahi rabbinā mā kunnā mush'rikīn
verses.english: Their disastrous response will be, "By GOD our Lord, we never were idol worshipers."
verses.footnote: Now and forever, the idol worshipers vehemently deny that they are idolators.

1981.english: Their only pretense will be, "By God our Lord, we were not idolaters!"
1981.footnote: These profound verses identify those who advocate "Hadith" and "Sunna" as idolaters who have set up Muhammad as an idol against his will. They invented lies and claimed that they were divine revelations to the prophet (6:21). They vehemently deny that they idolize the prophet, all the way through the day of judgment, even as they face God almighty (6:22-23). They use their invented lies as sources of jurisprudence, to suit their own traditions and superstitions, in total defiance of God and the prophet (see 6:19). On the day of judgment, Muhammad will disown those who idolize him, just as Jesus and the saints will disown those who idolize them (see 6:24, 16:86, 19:81, 36:74, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:23). The true believers uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. (see 6:114).

1989.english: Their only response will be, “By GOD our Lord, we never were idol worshipers.”*
1989.footnote: Now and forever, the idol worshipers vehemently deny that they are idolators.

verses.arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: انظر كيف كذبوا على أنفسهم ۚ وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: unẓur kayfa kadhabū ʿalā anfusihim waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: Note how they lied to themselves, and how the idols they had invented have abandoned them.

1981.english: Note how they lied to themselves, and that the idols they made up abandon them.
1981.footnote: These profound verses identify those who advocate "Hadith" and "Sunna" as idolaters who have set up Muhammad as an idol against his will. They invented lies and claimed that they were divine revelations to the prophet (6:21). They vehemently deny that they idolize the prophet, all the way through the day of judgment, even as they face God almighty (6:22-23). They use their invented lies as sources of jurisprudence, to suit their own traditions and superstitions, in total defiance of God and the prophet (see 6:19). On the day of judgment, Muhammad will disown those who idolize him, just as Jesus and the saints will disown those who idolize them (see 6:24, 16:86, 19:81, 36:74, and the Gospel of Matthew 7:23). The true believers uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. (see 6:114).

1989.english: Note how they lied to themselves, and how their own fabrications have come back to haunt them.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من يستمع إليك ۖ وجعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا ۚ وإن يروا كل آية لا يؤمنوا بها ۚ حتى إذا جاءوك يجادلونك يقول الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yastamiʿu ilayka wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan an yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqran wa-in yaraw kulla āyatin lā yu'minū bihā ḥattā idhā jāūka yujādilūnaka yaqūlu alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.english: Some of them listen to you, but we place veils on their hearts to prevent them from understanding, and deafness in their ears. Thus, no matter what kind of proof they see, they cannot believe. Thus, when they come to argue with you, the disbelievers say, "These are tales from the past."

1981.english: Some of them may listen to you; but we place shields on their hearts to prevent them from understanding (the Quran), and deafness in their ears. Thus, no matter what kind of miracle they see, they will not believe. Then, when these disbelievers come to debate with you, they would say, "These are simply tales from the past."

1989.english: Some of them listen to you. But we place veils on their hearts to prevent them from understanding (Quran), and deafness in their ears. Thus, no matter what kind of miracle they see, they cannot believe. Thus, when they argue with you, the disbelievers say, “These are tales from the past.”

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهم ينهون عنه وينأون عنه ۖ وإن يهلكون إلا أنفسهم وما يشعرون
verses.transliterated: wahum yanhawna ʿanhu wayanawna ʿanhu wa-in yuh'likūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūn
verses.english: They repel others from this (Quran), as they themselves stay away from it, and thus, they only destroy themselves without perceiving.

1981.english: And they divert others from the Quran, as they themselves stay away from it. Thus, they only destroy themselves, without perceiving.

1989.english: They repel others from this (Quran), as they themselves stay away from it, and thus, they only destroy themselves without perceiving.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو ترى إذ وقفوا على النار فقالوا يا ليتنا نرد ولا نكذب بآيات ربنا ونكون من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalā l-nāri faqālū yālaytanā nuraddu walā nukadhiba biāyāti rabbinā wanakūna mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: If only you could see them when they face the hellfire! They would say then, "Woe to us. Oh, we wish if we could go back, and never reject our Lord's revelations, and join the believers."

1981.english: If you could only envision them as they face hell; they would say, "Oh, we wish if we could be sent back, then never reject the revelations of our Lord, and be perfect believers!"

1989.english: If you could only see them when they face the hellfire! They would say, “Woe to us, if we could only go back, we would not reject our Lord’s revelations; we would become believers.”

verses.arabic: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل بدا لهم ما كانوا يخفون من قبل ۖ ولو ردوا لعادوا لما نهوا عنه وإنهم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: bal badā lahum mā kānū yukh'fūna min qablu walaw ruddū laʿādū limā nuhū ʿanhu wa-innahum lakādhibūn
verses.english: As a matter of fact, (they only say this because) their secrets have been exposed. If they go back, they will commit exactly the same crimes. They are liars.
verses.footnote: This is because as soon as we enter into our worldly dimension, we become totally unaware of events in the dimension of souls, where God and His angels, and Heaven and Hell, can be seen. Thus, the guilty will not change their behavior, even after seeing that eternal dimension.

1981.english: However, they will only say this after their true identity has been exposed. If they are given a second chance, they will revert right back to what was forbidden them; they are liars.

1989.english: As a matter of fact, (they only say this because) their secrets have been exposed. If they go back, they will commit exactly the same crimes.* They are liars.
1989.footnote: This is because as soon as we enter into our worldly dimension, we become totally unaware of events in the dimension of souls, where God and His angels, anc Heaven and Hell, can be seen. Thus, the guilty will not change their behavior, even after seeing the eternal dimension.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
verses.transliterated: waqālū in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīn
verses.english: They say (subconsciously), "We live only this life; we will not be resurrected."

1981.english: They had said, "We only live this life, and will not be resurrected."

1989.english: They say, “We live only this life; we will not be resurrected.”

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو ترى إذ وقفوا على ربهم ۚ قال أليس هذا بالحق ۚ قالوا بلى وربنا ۚ قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
verses.transliterated: walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalā rabbihim qāla alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
verses.english: If you could only see them when they stand before their Lord! He would say, "Is this not the truth?" They would say, "Yes, by our Lord." He would say, "You have incurred the retribution by your disbelief."

1981.english: If you could only envision them as they face their Lord; He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They would say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then suffer the consequences of your disbelief."

1989.english: If you could only see them when they stand before their Lord! He would say, “Is this not the truth?” They would say, “Yes, by our Lord.” He would say, “You have incurred the retribution by your disbelief.”

verses.arabic: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا۟ يَٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله ۖ حتى إذا جاءتهم الساعة بغتة قالوا يا حسرتنا على ما فرطنا فيها وهم يحملون أوزارهم على ظهورهم ۚ ألا ساء ما يزرون
verses.transliterated: qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi ḥattā idhā jāathumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan qālū yāḥasratanā ʿalā mā farraṭnā fīhā wahum yaḥmilūna awzārahum ʿalā ẓuhūrihim alā sāa mā yazirūn
verses.english: Losers indeed are those who disbelieve in meeting GOD, until the Hour comes to them suddenly then say, "We deeply regret wasting our lives in this world." They will carry loads of their sins on their backs; what a miserable load!

1981.english: Losers indeed are those who deny the meeting with God, until the hour comes to them suddenly, then say, "What a disaster it was that we wasted the first life." They will carry their sins on their backs; what a miserable load.

1989.english: Losers indeed are those who disbelieve in meeting GOD, until the Hour comes to them suddenly then say, “We deeply regret wasting our lives in this world.” They will carry loads of sins on their backs; what a miserable load!

verses.arabic: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما الحياة الدنيا إلا لعب ولهو ۖ وللدار الآخرة خير للذين يتقون ۗ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā laʿibun walahwun walalddāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: The life of this world is no more than illusion and vanity, while the abode of the Hereafter is far better for the righteous. Do you not understand?!
verses.subtitle: Rearranging Our Priorities

1981.english: This first life is no more than illusions and vanity, while the abode of the hereafter is far better for the righteous, Would you not understand?

1989.english: The life of this world is no more than illusion and vanity, while the abode of the Hereafter is far better for the righteous. Do you not understand?!
1989.subtitle: Rearranging Our Priorities

verses.arabic: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحْزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِى يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قد نعلم إنه ليحزنك الذي يقولون ۖ فإنهم لا يكذبونك ولكن الظالمين بآيات الله يجحدون
verses.transliterated: qad naʿlamu innahu layaḥzunuka alladhī yaqūlūna fa-innahum lā yukadhibūnaka walākinna l-ẓālimīna biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūn
verses.english: We know that you may be saddened by what they say. You should know that it is not you that they reject; it is GOD's revelations that the wicked disregard.

1981.english: We realize that you are saddened by what they say. However, it is not you that they reject; it is God's revelations that the wicked disregard.
1981.subtitle: God's Messengers Persecuted

1989.english: We know that you may be saddened by what they say. You should know that it is not you that they reject; it is GOD’s revelations that the wicked disregard.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا۟ وَأُوذُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِى۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد كذبت رسل من قبلك فصبروا على ما كذبوا وأوذوا حتى أتاهم نصرنا ۚ ولا مبدل لكلمات الله ۚ ولقد جاءك من نبإ المرسلين
verses.transliterated: walaqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika faṣabarū ʿalā mā kudhibū waūdhū ḥattā atāhum naṣrunā walā mubaddila likalimāti l-lahi walaqad jāaka min naba-i l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Messengers before you have been rejected, and they steadfastly persevered in the face of rejection. They were persecuted until our victory came to them. Such is GOD's system that will never change. The history of My messengers thus sets the precedents for you.

1981.english: The messengers before you have been rejected, and they steadfastly persevered in the face of rejection, and they were persecuted until our victory came to them. And this will always be the case; God's system is unchangeable. I have narrated to you some history of the messengers.

1989.english: Messengers before you have been rejected, and they steadfastly persevered in the face of rejection. They were persecuted until our victory came to them. GOD’s system will not change. The history of My messengers has come to you.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كان كبر عليك إعراضهم فإن استطعت أن تبتغي نفقا في الأرض أو سلما في السماء فتأتيهم بآية ۚ ولو شاء الله لجمعهم على الهدى ۚ فلا تكونن من الجاهلين
verses.transliterated: wa-in kāna kabura ʿalayka iʿ'rāḍuhum fa-ini is'taṭaʿta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fī l-arḍi aw sullaman fī l-samāi fatatiyahum biāyatin walaw shāa l-lahu lajamaʿahum ʿalā l-hudā falā takūnanna mina l-jāhilīn
verses.english: If their rejection gets to be too much for you, you should know that even if you dug a tunnel through the earth, or climbed a ladder into the sky, and produced a miracle for them (they still would not believe). Had GOD willed, He could have guided them, unanimously. Therefore, do not behave like the ignorant ones.

1981.english: You may find it too much that they disregard you. However, even if you dig a tunnel through the earth, or erect a ladder into the sky, and produce a miracle for them, (they still will not believe). Had God willed, He could have guided all of them. Therefore, do not be like the ignorant ones.

1989.english: If their rejection is too much for you, you should know that even if you dug a tunnel through the earth, or climbed a ladder into the sky, and produced a miracle for them (they would not believe). Had GOD willed, He could have guided them, unanimously. Do not behave like the ignorant ones.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَٱلْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يستجيب الذين يسمعون ۘ والموتى يبعثهم الله ثم إليه يرجعون
verses.transliterated: innamā yastajību alladhīna yasmaʿūna wal-mawtā yabʿathuhumu l-lahu thumma ilayhi yur'jaʿūn
verses.english: The only ones to respond are those who listen. GOD resurrects the dead; they ultimately return to Him.

1981.english: Only those who can hear will respond. As for the dead, God will resurrect them, and they will be returned to Him.

1989.english: Responding will be those who hear. GOD resurrects the dead, then to Him they are returned. Quran: Complete, Perfect, Fully Detailed.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةً وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لولا نزل عليه آية من ربه ۚ قل إن الله قادر على أن ينزل آية ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: waqālū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi qul inna l-laha qādirun ʿalā an yunazzila āyatan walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: They said, "If only a certain sign could come down to him from his Lord!" Say, "GOD is able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."

1981.english: And they said, "If only a miracle could come down to him from his Lord!" Say, "God is certainly able to send down a miracle." However, the majority do not know.

1989.english: They said, “If only a miracle could come down to him from his Lord!” Say, “GOD is able to send down a miracle, but most of them do not know.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما من دابة في الأرض ولا طائر يطير بجناحيه إلا أمم أمثالكم ۚ ما فرطنا في الكتاب من شيء ۚ ثم إلى ربهم يحشرون
verses.transliterated: wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi walā ṭāirin yaṭīru bijanāḥayhi illā umamun amthālukum mā farraṭnā fī l-kitābi min shayin thumma ilā rabbihim yuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: All the creatures on earth, and all the birds that fly with wings, are communities like you. We did not leave anything out of this book. To their Lord, all these creatures will be summoned.
verses.subtitle: Animals and Birds: Submitting Creatures
verses.footnote:
Animals were among the creatures who took advantage of God's offer to repent after committing the original sin (see the Introduction).

±±6:38 All information relevant to our eternal life of the Hereafter is contained in the Quran. The true believers accept, without hesitation, God's assertion: "We did not leave anything out of this book." The importance of this statement, and similar statements, is reflected in the fact that each of them consists of 19 Arabic letters (Appendix 19).

1981.english: Any creature on earth, and any bird that flies with wings, are all nations like you. We did not leave anything out of this scripture.* To their Lord, they will all be gathered.
1981.subtitle: Quran: All the Commandments We Need
1981.footnote: The connection between the Quran's miraculous numerical code, and the rejection of "Hadith" and "Sunna" as satonic inventions, becomes obvious when we realize that this statement (We have left nothing out of this scripture) consists of 19 Arabic letters, the verse number is 38 (19 × 2), and that verse 19 states that the Quran is the only divine revelation to Muhammad, and that the statement, "He revealed the Quran fully detailed," also consists of 19 letters, and is found in verse 114 (19 × 6) of this sura. See also Appendix 16.

1989.english: All the creatures on earth, and all the birds that fly with wings, are communities like you. We did not leave anything out of this book.* To their Lord, all creatures will be summoned.
1989.footnote: All information relevant to our eternal life of the Hereafter is contained in the Quran. The true believers accept, without hesitation, God’s assertion: “We did not leave anything out of this book. ” The importance of this statement, and similar statements, is reflected in the fact that each of them consists of 19 Arabic letters (App. 19).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كذبوا بآياتنا صم وبكم في الظلمات ۗ من يشإ الله يضلله ومن يشأ يجعله على صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā ṣummun wabuk'mun fī l-ẓulumāti man yasha-i l-lahu yuḍ'lil'hu waman yasha yajʿalhu ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: Those who reject our proofs are deaf and dumb, in total darkness. Whomever GOD wills, He sends astray, and whomever He wills, He leads in a straight path.
verses.subtitle: Overwhelming Miracle of the Quran

1981.english: Those who reject our revelations are deaf, dumb, and in total darkness. Whomever God wills, He sends astray; and whomever He wills, He places on a straight path.

1989.english: Those who reject our miracles are deaf and dumb, in total darkness. Whomever GOD wills, He sends astray, and whomever He wills, He leads in a straight path.
1989.subtitle: Overwhelming Miracle of the Quran

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتكم إن أتاكم عذاب الله أو أتتكم الساعة أغير الله تدعون إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi aw atatkumu l-sāʿatu aghayra l-lahi tadʿūna in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Say, "What if GOD's retribution came to you, or the Hour came to you: would you implore other than GOD, if you are truthful?"

1981.english: Say, "What if God's retribution came to you, or the hour came to you, would you implore other than God, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: Say, “What if GOD’s retribution came to you, or the Hour came to you, would you implore other than GOD?” Be truthful!

verses.arabic: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل إياه تدعون فيكشف ما تدعون إليه إن شاء وتنسون ما تشركون
verses.transliterated: bal iyyāhu tadʿūna fayakshifu mā tadʿūna ilayhi in shāa watansawna mā tush'rikūn
verses.english: The fact is: only Him you implore, and He answers your prayer, if He so wills, and you forget your idols.

1981.english: Indeed, you would implore Him alone, then He relieves your problem, if He wills; you would forget your idols.

1989.english: The fact is: only Him you implore— He answers your prayer, if He so wills—and you forget your idols.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا إلى أمم من قبلك فأخذناهم بالبأساء والضراء لعلهم يتضرعون
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fa-akhadhnāhum bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūn
verses.english: We have sent (messengers) to communities before you, and we put them to the test through adversity and hardship, that they may implore.

1981.english: We have sent to nations before you, and we afflicted them with hardship and adversity, that they may implore.
1981.subtitle: The Standard Method

1989.english: We have sent to communities before you, and we tested them with adversity and hardship, that they may implore.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلولا إذ جاءهم بأسنا تضرعوا ولكن قست قلوبهم وزين لهم الشيطان ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: falawlā idh jāahum basunā taḍarraʿū walākin qasat qulūbuhum wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: If only they implored when our test afflicted them! Instead, their hearts were hardened, and the devil adorned their works in their eyes.

1981.english: If only, when our affliction came to them, they implored. But instead, their hearts were hardened, and the devil adorned their works in their eyes.

1989.english: If only they implored when our test came to them! Instead, their hearts were hardened, and the devil adorned their works in their eyes.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓا۟ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به فتحنا عليهم أبواب كل شيء حتى إذا فرحوا بما أوتوا أخذناهم بغتة فإذا هم مبلسون
verses.transliterated: falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi fataḥnā ʿalayhim abwāba kulli shayin ḥattā idhā fariḥū bimā ūtū akhadhnāhum baghtatan fa-idhā hum mub'lisūn
verses.english: When they thus disregard the message given to them, we open for them the gates of everything. Then, just as they rejoice in what was given to them, we punish them suddenly; they become utterly stunned.
verses.subtitle: The System
verses.footnote: Before the guilty are thrown out the window, they are taken up to a high floor.

1981.english: Consequently, because they discarded the message given to them, we opened for them the gates of everything. Then, just as they rejoiced with such givings, we seized them suddenly, and they became stunned.
1981.footnote: The Muslims of today have abandoned the Quran, and adopted the inventions of "Hadith" and "Sunna" in complete defiance of God and the prophet (see 24:1-2, 25:30, Appendices 7, 11, 13, & 15). Therefore, it appears that the vast oil wealth given to Saudi Arabia, the Arabian Gulf states, Kuwait, Iraq, Iran, Indonesia, and North Africa is in fact a curse that leads to the inevitable retribution predicted in this verse. Before the guilty is thrown out the window, he is taken to the tenth floor.

1989.english: When they disregard the message given to them, we open for them the gates of everything. Then, while rejoicing in what was given to them, we seize them suddenly; they become utterly stunned.
1989.subtitle: The System
1989.footnote: Before the guilty are thrown out the window, they are taken up to a high floor.

verses.arabic: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فقطع دابر القوم الذين ظلموا ۚ والحمد لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: faquṭiʿa dābiru l-qawmi alladhīna ẓalamū wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: The wicked are thus annihilated. Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

1981.english: Thus, the wicked are wiped out, and praise be to God, Lord of the universe.

1989.english: Thus, the wicked are annihilated. Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن أخذ الله سمعكم وأبصاركم وختم على قلوبكم من إله غير الله يأتيكم به ۗ انظر كيف نصرف الآيات ثم هم يصدفون
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in akhadha l-lahu samʿakum wa-abṣārakum wakhatama ʿalā qulūbikum man ilāhun ghayru l-lahi yatīkum bihi unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti thumma hum yaṣdifūn
verses.english: Say, "What if GOD took away your hearing and your eyesight, and sealed your minds; which god, other than GOD, can restore these for you?" Note how we explain the revelations, and note how they still deviate!
verses.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

1981.english: Say, "What if God took away your hearing and your eyesight, and sealed your hearts, which god, other than God, can restore them to you?" Note how we explain the revelations, then they still deviate.
1981.subtitle: God Alone Omnipotent, While the Messengers Powerless

1989.english: Say, “What if GOD took away your hearing and your eyesight, and sealed your minds; which god, other than GOD, can restore these for you?” Note how we explain the revelations, and note how they still deviate!
1989.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتكم إن أتاكم عذاب الله بغتة أو جهرة هل يهلك إلا القوم الظالمون
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytakum in atākum ʿadhābu l-lahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: Say, "What if GOD's retribution came to you suddenly, or after an announcement, is it not the wicked who incur annihilation?"

1981.english: Say, "What if God's retribution came to you suddenly, or after a warning. is it not the wicked who are destroyed?"

1989.english: Say, “What if GOD’s retribution came to you suddenly, or after an announcement, is it not the wicked who incur annihilation?”

verses.arabic: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما نرسل المرسلين إلا مبشرين ومنذرين ۖ فمن آمن وأصلح فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: wamā nur'silu l-mur'salīna illā mubashirīna wamundhirīna faman āmana wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: We do not send the messengers except as deliverers of good news, as well as warners. Those who believe and reform have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.subtitle: Role of the Messengers

1981.english: We do not send the messengers except as preachers and warners. Then, whoever believes and leads a righteous life will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

1989.english: We do not send the messengers except as deliverers of good news, as well as warners. Those who believe and reform have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1989.subtitle: Role of the Messengers

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كذبوا بآياتنا يمسهم العذاب بما كانوا يفسقون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā yamassuhumu l-ʿadhābu bimā kānū yafsuqūn
verses.english: As for those who reject our revelations, they incur the retribution for their wickedness.

1981.english: As for those who reject our revelations, they have deserved the retribution for their wickedness.

1989.english: As for those who reject our revelations, they incur the retribution for their wickedness.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا أقول لكم عندي خزائن الله ولا أعلم الغيب ولا أقول لكم إني ملك ۖ إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي ۚ قل هل يستوي الأعمى والبصير ۚ أفلا تتفكرون
verses.transliterated: qul lā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu lakum innī malakun in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya qul hal yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru afalā tatafakkarūn
verses.english: Say, “I do not say to you that I possess the treasures of GOD. Nor do I know the future. Nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I simply follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind the same as the seer? Do you not reflect?"

1981.english: Say (O Muhammad), "I do not claim that I possess the treasures of God, nor do I know the future, nor do I claim to be an angel. I simply follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind the same as the seer? Can you not reflect?"

1989.english: Say, “I do not say to you that I possess the treasures of GOD. Nor do I know the future. Nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I simply follow what is revealed to me.” Say, “Is the blind the same as the seer? Do you not think?”

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنذر به الذين يخافون أن يحشروا إلى ربهم ۙ ليس لهم من دونه ولي ولا شفيع لعلهم يتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-andhir bihi alladhīna yakhāfūna an yuḥ'sharū ilā rabbihim laysa lahum min dūnihi waliyyun walā shafīʿun laʿallahum yattaqūn
verses.english: And preach with this (Quran) to those who reverence the summoning before their Lord—they have none beside Him as a Lord and Master, nor an intercessor—that they may attain salvation.

1981.english: You shall preach with the Quran to those who reverence the gathering before their Lord. They have none besides Him as Lord; nor do they have an intercessor. Perhaps they will attain salvation.

1989.english: And preach with this (Quran) to those who reverence the summoning before their Lord— they have none besides Him as a Lord and Master, nor an intercessor—that they may be saved.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغداة والعشي يريدون وجهه ۖ ما عليك من حسابهم من شيء وما من حسابك عليهم من شيء فتطردهم فتكون من الظالمين
verses.transliterated: walā taṭrudi alladhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ʿashiyi yurīdūna wajhahu mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim min shayin wamā min ḥisābika ʿalayhim min shayin fataṭrudahum fatakūna mina l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: And do not dismiss those who implore their Lord day and night, devoting themselves to Him alone. You are not responsible for their reckoning, nor are they responsible for your reckoning. If you dismiss them, you will be a transgressor.

1981.english: Do not dismiss those who implore their Lord day and night, seeking only Him. You are not accountable for anything they do, nor are they accountable for anything you do. If you dismiss them, you will be a wrongdoer.
1981.subtitle: First Believers: The Poor and Oppressed

1989.english: And do not dismiss those who implore their Lord day and night, devoting themselves to Him alone. You are not responsible for their reckoning, nor are they responsible for your reckoning. If you dismiss them, you will be a transgressor.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك فتنا بعضهم ببعض ليقولوا أهؤلاء من الله عليهم من بيننا ۗ أليس الله بأعلم بالشاكرين
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika fatannā baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin liyaqūlū ahāulāi manna l-lahu ʿalayhim min bayninā alaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bil-shākirīn
verses.english: We thus test the people by each other, to let them say (mockingly), "Are these the people among us who are blessed by GOD?" Is GOD not aware of the appreciative ones?

1981.english: We thus put the people to the test by each other. Thus, some would say, "Are these the ones blessed by God?" Is God not fully aware of the deserving ones?

1989.english: We test the people by each other. Thus, some of them would say, “Are these the people blessed by GOD?” Is GOD not fully aware of the appreciative?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا جاءك الذين يؤمنون بآياتنا فقل سلام عليكم ۖ كتب ربكم على نفسه الرحمة ۖ أنه من عمل منكم سوءا بجهالة ثم تاب من بعده وأصلح فأنه غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā jāaka alladhīna yu'minūna biāyātinā faqul salāmun ʿalaykum kataba rabbukum ʿalā nafsihi l-raḥmata annahu man ʿamila minkum sūan bijahālatin thumma tāba min baʿdihi wa-aṣlaḥa fa-annahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: When those who believe in our revelations come to you, you shall say, "Salãmun 'Alaykum (Peace be upon you). Your Lord has decreed that mercy is His attribute. Thus, anyone among you who commits a transgression out of ignorance, and repents thereafter and reforms, then He is Forgiving, Most Merciful."

1981.english: Thus, when those who believe in our revelations come to you, you shall say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed mercy as His attribute. Thus, if anyone falls in sin due to ignorance, then repents thereafter, and reforms, then God is forgiver, merciful."

1989.english: And when those who believe in our revelations come to you, say, “Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed mercy as His attribute. Thus, anyone among you who commits a transgression out of ignorance, and repents immediately thereafter and reforms, then He is Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك نفصل الآيات ولتستبين سبيل المجرمين
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walitastabīna sabīlu l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: We thus explain the revelations, and point out the ways of the wicked.

1981.english: We thus explain the revelations, and expose the ways of the wicked.

1989.english: We thus explain the revelations, and point out the ways of the wicked.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَآءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إني نهيت أن أعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله ۚ قل لا أتبع أهواءكم ۙ قد ضللت إذا وما أنا من المهتدين
verses.transliterated: qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qul lā attabiʿu ahwāakum qad ḍalaltu idhan wamā anā mina l-muh'tadīn
verses.english: Say, "I am forbidden from worshiping what you worship besides GOD." Say, "I will not follow your opinions. Otherwise, I will go astray, and not be guided."

1981.english: Say, "I have been stopped from worshiping the idols you had set up besides God."* Say, "I will not follow your ideas, lest I go astray and never find guidance."
1981.footnote: Before being guided and blessed by God, Muhammad worshiped idols like the rest of his pre-Islamic community (see also 40:66 and 93:7).

1989.english: Say, “I am forbidden from worshiping what you worship besides GOD.” Say, “I will not follow your opinions. Otherwise, I will go astray, and not be guided.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰصِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إني على بينة من ربي وكذبتم به ۚ ما عندي ما تستعجلون به ۚ إن الحكم إلا لله ۖ يقص الحق ۖ وهو خير الفاصلين
verses.transliterated: qul innī ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī wakadhabtum bihi mā ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi ini l-ḥuk'mu illā lillahi yaquṣṣu l-ḥaqa wahuwa khayru l-fāṣilīn
verses.english: Say, "I have solid proof from my Lord, and you have rejected it. I do not control the retribution you challenge me to bring. Judgment belongs with GOD alone. He narrates the truth, and He is the best judge."

1981.english: Say, "I have a profound sign from my Lord, and you disbelieve therein. I have no power to afflict you with the doom you challenge me to bring. Judgment is absolutely God's; He exacts the truth, and He is the best judge."

1989.english: Say, “I have proof from my Lord, and you rejected it. I do not have what you challenge me to bring. Judgment belongs with GOD alone. He narrates the truth, and He is the best judge.”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لو أن عندي ما تستعجلون به لقضي الأمر بيني وبينكم ۗ والله أعلم بالظالمين
verses.transliterated: qul law anna ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihi laquḍiya l-amru baynī wabaynakum wal-lahu aʿlamu bil-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Say, "If I controlled the retribution you challenge me to bring, the whole matter would have been terminated long ago. GOD knows best who the wicked are."

1981.english: Say, "If I had the power to bring judgment, the whole matter between me and you would have been finished already. God knows best who the wicked are."

1989.english: Say, “If I had what you challenge me to bring, the whole matter would have been terminated long ago. GOD knows best who the wicked are.”

verses.arabic: وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وعنده مفاتح الغيب لا يعلمها إلا هو ۚ ويعلم ما في البر والبحر ۚ وما تسقط من ورقة إلا يعلمها ولا حبة في ظلمات الأرض ولا رطب ولا يابس إلا في كتاب مبين
verses.transliterated: waʿindahu mafātiḥu l-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā illā huwa wayaʿlamu mā fī l-bari wal-baḥri wamā tasquṭu min waraqatin illā yaʿlamuhā walā ḥabbatin fī ẓulumāti l-arḍi walā raṭbin walā yābisin illā fī kitābin mubīni
verses.english: With Him are the keys to all secrets; none knows them except He. He knows everything on land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls without His knowledge. Nor is there a grain in the depths of the soil. Nor is there anything wet or dry, that is not recorded in a profound record.
verses.subtitle: Almighty God

1981.english: At Him are the keys to all secrets; no one knows them except He. He knows everything on land and in the sea; not a single leaf falls without His knowledge, nor a seed in the darkness of the soil, nor anything that is wet or dry, all in a profound record.

1989.english: With Him are the keys to all secrets; none knows them except He. He knows everything on land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls without His knowledge. Nor is there a grain in the depths of the soil, be it wet or dry, that is not recorded in a profound record.
1989.subtitle: Almighty God

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰٓ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي يتوفاكم بالليل ويعلم ما جرحتم بالنهار ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضى أجل مسمى ۖ ثم إليه مرجعكم ثم ينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yatawaffākum bi-al-layli wayaʿlamu mā jaraḥtum bil-nahāri thumma yabʿathukum fīhi liyuq'ḍā ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marjiʿukum thumma yunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: He is the One who puts you to death during the night, and knows even the smallest of your actions during the day. He resurrects you every morning, until your life span is fulfilled, then to Him is your ultimate return. He will then inform you of everything you had done.
verses.subtitle: Death and Resurrection: Every Day
