verses.footnote: The righteous do not really die; they go straight to the same Paradise where Adam and Eve once lived. The unrighteous die and experience a nightmare that lasts until the Day of Resurrection (see 2:154, 3:169, 8:24, 16:32, 22:58, 36:26-27, 40:46, 44:56, and Appendix 17).

1981.english: And He is the one who puts you to death during the night,* and knows everything you do during the day. He resurrects you therein, until your predetermined life span is fulfilled, then you are returned to Him, then He informs you of everything you have done.
1981.footnote: The period between death and resurrection passes on each one of us like one night of sleep, complete with dreams (see also 2:259, 18:19 & 25, and Appendix 14). Since each one of us did in fact experience the first death (see 2:28 and 40:11), we should know exactly how the second and final death will feel like.

1989.english: He is the One who puts you to death during the night, and knows your slightest actions during the day. He resurrects you every morning, until your life span is fulfilled, then to Him is your ultimate return, then He informs you of everything you had done.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو القاهر فوق عباده ۖ ويرسل عليكم حفظة حتى إذا جاء أحدكم الموت توفته رسلنا وهم لا يفرطون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa l-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi wayur'silu ʿalaykum ḥafaẓatan ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadakumu l-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunā wahum lā yufarriṭūn
verses.english: He is Supreme over His creatures, and He appoints guards to protect you. When the appointed time of death comes to any of you, our messengers put him to death without delay.

1981.english: He is the supreme being above His creatures, and He appoints guards to protect you. Then, when death comes to the one of you, our messengers put him to death without delay.

1989.english: He is Supreme over His creatures, and He appoints guards to protect you. When the appointed time of death comes to any of you, our messengers put him to death without delay.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ ٱلْحَٰسِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم ردوا إلى الله مولاهم الحق ۚ ألا له الحكم وهو أسرع الحاسبين
verses.transliterated: thumma ruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi alā lahu l-ḥuk'mu wahuwa asraʿu l-ḥāsibīn
verses.english: Then everyone is returned to GOD, their rightful Lord and Master. Absolutely, He is the ultimate judge; He is the most accurate reckoner.

1981.english: Then they are returned to God, their true Lord. Indeed, judgment belongs to Him alone, and He is the most efficient reckoner.

1989.english: Then they are returned to GOD, their rightful Lord and Master. He is the ultimate judge; He is the most accurate reckoner.

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَّئِنْ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل من ينجيكم من ظلمات البر والبحر تدعونه تضرعا وخفية لئن أنجانا من هذه لنكونن من الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: qul man yunajjīkum min ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri tadʿūnahu taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan la-in anjānā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīn
verses.english: Say, "Who can save you from the darkness of the land or the sea?" You implore Him loudly and secretly: "If He saves us this time, we will be eternally appreciative."

1981.english: Say, "Who saves you from the darkness of land and sea?" You implore Him publicly and secretly, "If He only saves us from this one, we will be appreciative."

1989.english: Say, “Who can protect you in the darkness of the land or the sea?” You implore Him loudly, as well as secretly: “If He only saves us this time, we will be appreciative.”

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل الله ينجيكم منها ومن كل كرب ثم أنتم تشركون
verses.transliterated: quli l-lahu yunajjīkum min'hā wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tush'rikūn
verses.english: Say, "GOD does save you this time, and other times as well, then you still set up idols besides Him."

1981.english: Say, "God saves you from that one, and from all kinds of disasters, then you set up idols."

1989.english: Say, “GOD does save you this time, and other times as well, then you still set up idols besides Him.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هو القادر على أن يبعث عليكم عذابا من فوقكم أو من تحت أرجلكم أو يلبسكم شيعا ويذيق بعضكم بأس بعض ۗ انظر كيف نصرف الآيات لعلهم يفقهون
verses.transliterated: qul huwa l-qādiru ʿalā an yabʿatha ʿalaykum ʿadhāban min fawqikum aw min taḥti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaʿan wayudhīqa baʿḍakum basa baʿḍin unẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu l-āyāti laʿallahum yafqahūn
verses.english: Say, "He is certainly able to pour upon you retribution from above you, or from beneath your feet. Or He can divide you into factions and have you taste each others' tyranny. Note how we explain the revelations, that they may understand."

1981.english: Say, "He is able to pour upon you retribution from above you, and from beneath your feet. Or He may divide you into sects, and let you suffer the tyranny of one another." Note how we explain the revelations, that they may comprehend.

1989.english: Say, “He is able to pour upon you retribution from above you, or from beneath your feet, or He can divide you into factions and have you taste each others’ tyranny and persecution. Note how we explain the revelations, that they may understand.”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: وكذب به قومك وهو الحق ۚ قل لست عليكم بوكيل
verses.transliterated: wakadhaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa l-ḥaqu qul lastu ʿalaykum biwakīli
verses.english: Your people have rejected this, even though it is the truth. Say, "I am not a guardian over you."

1981.english: Your people have rejected this (Quran), although it is the truth! Say, "I am not your protector.

1989.english: Your people have rejected this, even though it is the truth. Say, “I am not a guardian over you.”

verses.arabic: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لكل نبإ مستقر ۚ وسوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: likulli naba-in mus'taqarrun wasawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Every prophecy herein will come to pass, and you will surely find out.

1981.english: "Everything will be ultimately known, and you will surely find out."

1989.english: Every prophecy herein will come to pass, and you will surely find out.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا رأيت الذين يخوضون في آياتنا فأعرض عنهم حتى يخوضوا في حديث غيره ۚ وإما ينسينك الشيطان فلا تقعد بعد الذكرى مع القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ra-ayta alladhīna yakhūḍūna fī āyātinā fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrihi wa-immā yunsiyannaka l-shayṭānu falā taqʿud baʿda l-dhik'rā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: If you see those who mock our revelations, you shall avoid them until they delve into another subject. If the devil causes you to forget, then, as soon as you remember, do not sit with such evil people.
verses.subtitle: Respect for the Word of God

1981.english: When you see those who mock our revelations, do not stay with them, unless they change their subject. If the devil causes you to forget, then you shall leave the wicked people as soon as you remember.
1981.subtitle: Stay Away From the Wicked

1989.english: If you see those who mock our revelations, you shall avoid them until they delve into another subject. If the devil causes you to forget, then, as soon as you remember, do not sit with such evil people.
1989.subtitle: Respect for the Word of God

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَلَٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما على الذين يتقون من حسابهم من شيء ولكن ذكرى لعلهم يتقون
verses.transliterated: wamā ʿalā alladhīna yattaqūna min ḥisābihim min shayin walākin dhik'rā laʿallahum yattaqūn
verses.english: The righteous are not responsible for the utterances of those people, but it may help to remind them; perhaps they may be saved.

1981.english: Those who maintain righteousness are not accountable for anything those people do, but this may serve as a reminder; perhaps they observe righteousness.

1989.english: The righteous are not responsible for the utterances of such people, but it is good to remind them, that they might be saved.

verses.arabic: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وذر الذين اتخذوا دينهم لعبا ولهوا وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا ۚ وذكر به أن تبسل نفس بما كسبت ليس لها من دون الله ولي ولا شفيع وإن تعدل كل عدل لا يؤخذ منها ۗ أولئك الذين أبسلوا بما كسبوا ۖ لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب أليم بما كانوا يكفرون
verses.transliterated: wadhari alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum laʿiban walahwan wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā wadhakkir bihi an tub'sala nafsun bimā kasabat laysa lahā min dūni l-lahi waliyyun walā shafīʿun wa-in taʿdil kulla ʿadlin lā yu'khadh min'hā ulāika alladhīna ub'silū bimā kasabū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūn
verses.english: You shall disregard those who take their religion in vain, as if it is a social function, and are totally absorbed in this worldly life. Remind with this (Quran), lest a soul may suffer the consequences of its evil earnings. It has none beside GOD as a Lord and Master, nor an intercessor. If it could offer any kind of ransom, it would not be accepted. They suffer the consequences of the evil works they earn; they have incurred hellish drinks, and a painful retribution because of their disbelief.

1981.english: And stay away from those who take their religion in vain and play, and were distracted by this life. Admonish them with the Quran, lest a soul may suffer the retribution, and finds none to protect it from God or intercede therefor. Even if it offered any kind of ransom, it will not be accepted therefrom. They have deserved boiling drinks, and painful retribution for their disbelief.

1989.english: You shall also avoid those who do not take their religion seriously, and are totally absorbed in this worldly life. Remind with this (Quran), lest a soul may suffer the consequences of its evil earnings. It has none besides GOD as a Lord and Master. Nor is there any intercessor. If it could offer any kind of ransom, it would not be accepted. They suffer the consequences of the evil works they earn; they have incurred hellish drinks, and a painful retribution for their disbelief.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَهْوَتْهُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصْحَٰبٌ يَدْعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَى ٱئْتِنَا قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أندعو من دون الله ما لا ينفعنا ولا يضرنا ونرد على أعقابنا بعد إذ هدانا الله كالذي استهوته الشياطين في الأرض حيران له أصحاب يدعونه إلى الهدى ائتنا ۗ قل إن هدى الله هو الهدى ۖ وأمرنا لنسلم لرب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qul anadʿū min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿunā walā yaḍurrunā wanuraddu ʿalā aʿqābinā baʿda idh hadānā l-lahu ka-alladhī is'tahwathu l-shayāṭīnu fī l-arḍi ḥayrāna lahu aṣḥābun yadʿūnahu ilā l-hudā i'tinā qul inna hudā l-lahi huwa l-hudā wa-umir'nā linus'lima lirabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Say, "Shall we implore, beside GOD, what possesses no power to benefit us or hurt us, and turn back on our heels after GOD has guided us? In that case, we would join those possessed by the devils, and rendered utterly confused, while their friends try to save them: 'Stay with us on the right path.'" Say, "GOD's guidance is the right guidance. We are commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: Say, "Shall we idolize besides God what possesses no power to benefit us, or harm us, and turn back on our heels after being guided by God?" That would be like one duped by the devils, and rendered totally perplexed, while his friends plead with him to be guided, saying, "Come along with us." Say, "God's guidance is the true guidance, and we are commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: Say, “Shall we implore, besides GOD, what possesses no power to benefit us or hurt us, and turn back on our heels after GOD has guided us? In that case, we would join those possessed by the devils, and rendered utterly confused, while their friends try to save them: ‘Stay with us on the right path.’ ” Say, “GOD’s guidance is the right guidance. We are commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأن أقيموا الصلاة واتقوه ۚ وهو الذي إليه تحشرون
verses.transliterated: wa-an aqīmū l-ṣalata wa-ittaqūhu wahuwa alladhī ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: "And to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and to reverence Him—He is the One before whom you will be summoned (for the reckoning)."

1981.english: "And we are commanded to observe the salat prayers, and to observe God; He is the one before whom you will be gathered."

1989.english: “And to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and to observe Him—you will be summoned before Him.”

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ قَوْلُهُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق ۖ ويوم يقول كن فيكون ۚ قوله الحق ۚ وله الملك يوم ينفخ في الصور ۚ عالم الغيب والشهادة ۚ وهو الحكيم الخبير
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi wayawma yaqūlu kun fayakūnu qawluhu l-ḥaqu walahu l-mul'ku yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīr
verses.english: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth, truthfully. Whenever He says, "Be," it is. His word is the absolute truth. All sovereignty belongs to Him the day the horn is blown. Knower of all secrets and declarations, He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

1981.english: And He is the one who created the heavens and the earth, truthfully, and whenever He says, "Be," it is. His word is the truth, and absolute kingship belongs to Him on the day the trumpet is blown. He is the knower of all secrets and declarations, and He is the wise, the cognizant.

1989.english: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth, truthfully. Whenever He says, “Be,” it is. His word is the absolute truth. All kingship is His, the day the horn is blown. Knower of all secrets and declarations, He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قال إبراهيم لأبيه آزر أتتخذ أصناما آلهة ۖ إني أراك وقومك في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi āzara atattakhidhu aṣnāman ālihatan innī arāka waqawmaka fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Recall that Abraham said to his father Ãzer, "How could you worship statues as gods? I see that you and your people have gone far astray."
verses.subtitle: Abraham Debates With Idol Worshipers

1981.english: Recall that Abraham said to his father Azar, "How could you consider these statues to be gods? I see that you and your people have gone astray."
1981.subtitle: Abraham Discovers God

1989.english: Recall that Abraham said to his father Azar, “How could you worship statues as gods? I see that you and your people are totally wrong.”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك نري إبراهيم ملكوت السماوات والأرض وليكون من الموقنين
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika nurī ib'rāhīma malakūta l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waliyakūna mina l-mūqinīn
verses.english: We showed Abraham the marvels of the heavens and the earth, and blessed him with certainty:

1981.english: Because of this, we decided to show Abraham the marvels of the heavens and the earth, and to endow him with certainty.

1989.english: We showed Abraham the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and blessed him with certainty:

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْءَافِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جن عليه الليل رأى كوكبا ۖ قال هذا ربي ۖ فلما أفل قال لا أحب الآفلين
verses.transliterated: falammā janna ʿalayhi al-laylu raā kawkaban qāla hādhā rabbī falammā afala qāla lā uḥibbu l-āfilīn
verses.english: When the night fell, he saw a shining planet. "Maybe this is my Lord," he said. When it disappeared, he said, "I do not like (gods) that disappear."

1981.english: Thus, when the night fell, he saw a planet, and said, "This is my Lord." But when it set, he said, "I dislike anything that sets."

1989.english: When the night fell, he saw a planet. “Maybe this is my Lord,” he said. When it disappeared, he said, “I do not like (lords) who disappear.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأى القمر بازغا قال هذا ربي ۖ فلما أفل قال لئن لم يهدني ربي لأكونن من القوم الضالين
verses.transliterated: falammā raā l-qamara bāzighan qāla hādhā rabbī falammā afala qāla la-in lam yahdinī rabbī la-akūnanna mina l-qawmi l-ḍālīn
verses.english: When he saw the moon rising, he said, "Maybe this is my Lord!" When it disappeared, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will be with the strayers."

1981.english: When he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my Lord." Then, when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will be one of the strayers."

1989.english: When he saw the moon rising, he said, “Maybe this is my Lord!” When it disappeared, he said, “Unless my Lord guides me, I will be with the strayers.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى هَٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأى الشمس بازغة قال هذا ربي هذا أكبر ۖ فلما أفلت قال يا قوم إني بريء مما تشركون
verses.transliterated: falammā raā l-shamsa bāzighatan qāla hādhā rabbī hādhā akbaru falammā afalat qāla yāqawmi innī barīon mimmā tush'rikūn
verses.english: When he saw the sun rising, he said, "This must be my Lord. This is the biggest." But when it set, he said, "O my people, I denounce your idolatry.

1981.english: When he saw the sun rising, he said, "This must be my Lord; this is the biggest." But when it set, he said, "O my people, I disown your idolatry.

1989.english: When he saw the sun rising, he said, “This must be my Lord. This is the biggest.” But when it set, he said, “O my people, I denounce your idolatry.

verses.arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السماوات والأرض حنيفا ۖ وما أنا من المشركين
verses.transliterated: innī wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhī faṭara l-samāwāti wal-arḍa ḥanīfan wamā anā mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: "I have devoted myself absolutely to the One who initiated the heavens and the earth; I will never be an idol worshiper."

1981.english: "I have turned my face towards the one who initiated the heavens and the earth, worshiping Him alone, and never worshiping idols."

1989.english: “I have devoted myself absolutely to the One who created the heavens and the earth; I will never be an idol worshiper.”

verses.arabic: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ قَالَ أَتُحَٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًٔا وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وحاجه قومه ۚ قال أتحاجوني في الله وقد هدان ۚ ولا أخاف ما تشركون به إلا أن يشاء ربي شيئا ۗ وسع ربي كل شيء علما ۗ أفلا تتذكرون
verses.transliterated: waḥājjahu qawmuhu qāla atuḥājjūnnī fī l-lahi waqad hadāni walā akhāfu mā tush'rikūna bihi illā an yashāa rabbī shayan wasiʿa rabbī kulla shayin ʿil'man afalā tatadhakkarūn
verses.english: His people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me about GOD, after He has guided me? I have no fear of the idols you set up. Nothing can happen to me, unless my Lord wills it. My Lord's knowledge encompasses all things. Would you not take heed?

1981.english: When his people argued with him, he said, "Do you argue with me about God, after He has guided me? I have no fear from the idols you set up. Only what my Lord wills shall prevail. The knowledge of my Lord encompasses all things. Would you not take heed?

1989.english: His people argued with him. He said, “Do you argue with me about GOD, after He has guided me? I have no fear of the idols you set up. Nothing can happen to me, unless my Lord wills it. My Lord’s knowledge encompasses all things. Would you not take heed?

verses.arabic: وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًا فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكيف أخاف ما أشركتم ولا تخافون أنكم أشركتم بالله ما لم ينزل به عليكم سلطانا ۚ فأي الفريقين أحق بالأمن ۖ إن كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: wakayfa akhāfu mā ashraktum walā takhāfūna annakum ashraktum bil-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi ʿalaykum sul'ṭānan fa-ayyu l-farīqayni aḥaqqu bil-amni in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: "Why should I fear your idols? It is you who should be afraid, since you worship instead of GOD idols that are utterly powerless to help you. Which side is more deserving of security, if you know?"

1981.english: "How could I possibly fear your idols, when you do not fear that you idolize powerless gods. Which side is worthy of security, if you know?"

1989.english: “How could I fear your idols? It is you who should fear that you set up powerless idols besides GOD. Which side is more deserving of security, if you know?”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين آمنوا ولم يلبسوا إيمانهم بظلم أولئك لهم الأمن وهم مهتدون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna āmanū walam yalbisū īmānahum biẓul'min ulāika lahumu l-amnu wahum muh'tadūn
verses.english: Those who believe, and do not pollute their belief with idol worship, have deserved the perfect security, and they are truly guided.
verses.subtitle: Perfect Security for Believers

1981.english: Those who believe, and do not adulterate their belief with wickedness, are worthy of security, and they are guided.

1989.english: Those who believe, and do not ruin their belief with idolatry, have deserved perfect security, and they are guided.
1989.subtitle: Perfect Security for Believers

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وتلك حجتنا آتيناها إبراهيم على قومه ۚ نرفع درجات من نشاء ۗ إن ربك حكيم عليم
verses.transliterated: watil'ka ḥujjatunā ātaynāhā ib'rāhīma ʿalā qawmihi narfaʿu darajātin man nashāu inna rabbaka ḥakīmun ʿalīmu
verses.english: Such was our argument, with which we supported Abraham against his people. We exalt whomever we will to higher ranks. Your Lord is Most Wise, Omniscient.

1981.english: We supported Abraham's argument against his people for we raise whomever we choose to higher ranks. Your Lord is wise, omniscient.

1989.english: Such was our argument, with which we supported Abraham against his people. We exalt whomever we will to higher ranks. Your Lord is Most Wise, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ووهبنا له إسحاق ويعقوب ۚ كلا هدينا ۚ ونوحا هدينا من قبل ۖ ومن ذريته داوود وسليمان وأيوب ويوسف وموسى وهارون ۚ وكذلك نجزي المحسنين
verses.transliterated: wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba kullan hadaynā wanūḥan hadaynā min qablu wamin dhurriyyatihi dāwūda wasulaymāna wa-ayyūba wayūsufa wamūsā wahārūna wakadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: And we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we guided both of them. Similarly, we guided Noah before that, and from his descendants (we guided) David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, and Aaron. We thus reward the righteous.

1981.english: And we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we guided them as we had guided Noah previously. And from his descendants, (we guided) David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, and Aaron. We thus reward the righteous.

1989.english: And we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we guided both of them. And we guided Noah before that, and from his descendants (we guided) David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, and Aaron. We thus reward the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وزكريا ويحيى وعيسى وإلياس ۖ كل من الصالحين
verses.transliterated: wazakariyyā wayaḥyā waʿīsā wa-il'yāsa kullun mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: Also, Zachariah, John, Jesus, and Elias; all were righteous.

1981.english: And Zachariah, John, Jesus, and Elias; they were all pious.

1989.english: Also, Zachariah, John, Jesus, and Elias; all were righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإسماعيل واليسع ويونس ولوطا ۚ وكلا فضلنا على العالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wayūnusa walūṭan wakullan faḍḍalnā ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: And Ismail, Elisha, Jonah, and Lot; each of these we distinguished over all the people.

1981.english: And Ishmael, Elija, Jonah, and Lot; each we set apart from the rest.

1989.english: And Ismail, Elisha, Jonah, and Lot; each of them we distinguished.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ وَٱجْتَبَيْنَٰهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آبائهم وذرياتهم وإخوانهم ۖ واجتبيناهم وهديناهم إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: wamin ābāihim wadhurriyyātihim wa-ikh'wānihim wa-ij'tabaynāhum wahadaynāhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: From among their ancestors, their descendants, and their siblings, we chose many, and we guided them in a straight path.

1981.english: Also others among their ancestors, their descendants, and their siblings; we chose them, and guided them in a straight path.

1989.english: And from their ancestors, their descendants, and their siblings, we chose many, and guided them in a straight path.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك هدى الله يهدي به من يشاء من عباده ۚ ولو أشركوا لحبط عنهم ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi walaw ashrakū laḥabiṭa ʿanhum mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Such is GOD's guidance, with which He guides whomever He chooses from among His servants. Had any of them fallen into idolatry, their works would have been nullified.

1981.english: Such is God's guidance that He bestows upon whomever He wills from among His servants. Had they ever set up any idol besides God, all their works would have been nullified.

1989.english: Such is GOD’s guidance, with which He guides whomever He chooses from among His worshipers. Had any of them fallen into idolatry, their works would have been nullified.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوا۟ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين آتيناهم الكتاب والحكم والنبوة ۚ فإن يكفر بها هؤلاء فقد وكلنا بها قوما ليسوا بها بكافرين
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata fa-in yakfur bihā hāulāi faqad wakkalnā bihā qawman laysū bihā bikāfirīn
verses.english: Those were the ones to whom we have given the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood. If these people disbelieve, we will substitute others in their place, and the new people will not be disbelievers.

1981.english: Those are they to whom we gave the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood. If these people disbelieve therein, we will entrust it to others who would not reject it.

1989.english: These are the ones to whom we have given the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood. If these people disbelieve therein, we will substitute others in their place, and the new people will not be disbelievers.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين هدى الله ۖ فبهداهم اقتده ۗ قل لا أسألكم عليه أجرا ۖ إن هو إلا ذكرى للعالمين
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna hadā l-lahu fabihudāhumu iq'tadih qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran in huwa illā dhik'rā lil'ʿālamīn
verses.english: These are the ones guided by GOD; you shall be guided in their footsteps. Say, "I do not ask you for any wage. This is but a message for all the people."

1981.english: Those are they whom God has guided; you shall follow their guidance. Say, "I do not ask you for any wage. I simply deliver this message for all the people."

1989.english: These are the ones guided by GOD; you shall be guided in their footsteps. Say, “I do not ask you for any wage. This is but a message for all the people.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍ مِّن شَىْءٍ قُلْ مَنْ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورًا وَهُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ تَجْعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبْدُونَهَا وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيرًا وَعُلِّمْتُم مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما قدروا الله حق قدره إذ قالوا ما أنزل الله على بشر من شيء ۗ قل من أنزل الكتاب الذي جاء به موسى نورا وهدى للناس ۖ تجعلونه قراطيس تبدونها وتخفون كثيرا ۖ وعلمتم ما لم تعلموا أنتم ولا آباؤكم ۖ قل الله ۖ ثم ذرهم في خوضهم يلعبون
verses.transliterated: wamā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi idh qālū mā anzala l-lahu ʿalā basharin min shayin qul man anzala l-kitāba alladhī jāa bihi mūsā nūran wahudan lilnnāsi tajʿalūnahu qarāṭīsa tub'dūnahā watukh'fūna kathīran waʿullim'tum mā lam taʿlamū antum walā ābāukum quli l-lahu thumma dharhum fī khawḍihim yalʿabūn
verses.english: They never valued GOD as He should be valued. Thus, they said, "GOD does not reveal anything to any human being." Say, "Who then revealed the scripture that Moses brought, with light and guidance for the people?" You put it down on paper to proclaim it, while concealing a lot of it. You were taught what you never knew—you and your parents. Say, "GOD (is the One who revealed it)," then leave them in their heedlessness, playing.
verses.subtitle: God's Messages to the World

1981.english: They never understood God as He should be when they said, "God does not send down anything to a human being." Say, "Who then sent down the scripture that Moses brought, with light and guidance for the people? You wrote it down on paper, though you concealed much thereof, and you learned things that neither you nor your parents ever knew." Say, "God sent it down," then leave them in their confusion, playing.

1989.english: They never valued GOD as He should be valued when they said, GOD never revealed anything to any human being.” Say, “Who then revealed the scripture that Moses brought, with light and guidance for the people?” You put it down on paper to proclaim it, while concealing a lot of it. You were taught what you never knew—you and your parents. Say, “GOD (is the One who revealed it),” then leave them in their heedlessness, playing.
1989.subtitle: God’s Messages to the World

verses.arabic: وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهذا كتاب أنزلناه مبارك مصدق الذي بين يديه ولتنذر أم القرى ومن حولها ۚ والذين يؤمنون بالآخرة يؤمنون به ۖ وهم على صلاتهم يحافظون
verses.transliterated: wahādhā kitābun anzalnāhu mubārakun muṣaddiqu alladhī bayna yadayhi walitundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā wa-alladhīna yu'minūna bil-ākhirati yu'minūna bihi wahum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūn
verses.english: This too is a blessed scripture that we have revealed, confirming the previous scriptures, that you may warn the most important community and all those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter will believe in this (scripture), and will observe the Contact Prayers (Salat).
verses.footnote: Today's "most important community" is America, where God's message is being restored. When the Quran was revealed, Mecca was the most important community.

1981.english: Similarly, this is a blessed scripture that we reveal, confirming all previous scriptures, and to preach the central community and all around it. Those who truly believe in the hereafter will believe in this, and will observe their salat prayers.
1981.subtitle: True Believers of all Religions Will Accept Quran

1989.english: This too is a blessed scripture that we have revealed, confirming the previous scriptures, for you to warn the most important community* and all those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter will believe in this (scripture), and will observe the contact prayers (Salat).
1989.footnote: Today’s “most important community” is America, where God’s message is being restored. When the Quran was revealed, Mecca was the most important community.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو قال أوحي إلي ولم يوح إليه شيء ومن قال سأنزل مثل ما أنزل الله ۗ ولو ترى إذ الظالمون في غمرات الموت والملائكة باسطو أيديهم أخرجوا أنفسكم ۖ اليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تقولون على الله غير الحق وكنتم عن آياته تستكبرون
verses.transliterated: waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw qāla ūḥiya ilayya walam yūḥa ilayhi shayon waman qāla sa-unzilu mith'la mā anzala l-lahu walaw tarā idhi l-ẓālimūna fī ghamarāti l-mawti wal-malāikatu bāsiṭū aydīhim akhrijū anfusakumu l-yawma tuj'zawna ʿadhāba l-hūni bimā kuntum taqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi ghayra l-ḥaqi wakuntum ʿan āyātihi tastakbirūn
verses.english: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD, or says, "I have received divine inspiration," when no such inspiration was given to him, or says, "I can write the same as GOD's revelations"? If only you could see the transgressors at the time of death! The angels extend their hands to them, saying, "Let go of your souls. Today, you have incurred a shameful retribution for saying about GOD other than the truth, and for being too arrogant to accept His revelations.
verses.subtitle: False Messengers Condemned

1981.english: Who is more evil than one who invents lies then attribute them to God, or claim to have received divine revelations, when nothing has been revealed to him, or say, "I can write the same things as God?" If you could only envision the wicked at the time of death: the angels extend their hands to them, saying, "Let go of your souls. Today you suffer humiliating retribution for uttering untruths about God, and for being too arrogant to accept His revelations.

1989.english: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD, or says, “I have received divine inspiration,” when no such inspiration was given to him, or says, “I can write the same as GOD’s revelations!” If only you could see the transgressors at the time of death! The angels extend their hands to them, saying, “Let go of your souls. Today, you have incurred a shameful retribution for saying about GOD other than the truth, and for being too arrogant to accept His revelations.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جئتمونا فرادى كما خلقناكم أول مرة وتركتم ما خولناكم وراء ظهوركم ۖ وما نرى معكم شفعاءكم الذين زعمتم أنهم فيكم شركاء ۚ لقد تقطع بينكم وضل عنكم ما كنتم تزعمون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ji'tumūnā furādā kamā khalaqnākum awwala marratin wataraktum mā khawwalnākum warāa ẓuhūrikum wamā narā maʿakum shufaʿāakumu alladhīna zaʿamtum annahum fīkum shurakāu laqad taqaṭṭaʿa baynakum waḍalla ʿankum mā kuntum tazʿumūn
verses.english: "You have come back to us as individuals, just as we created you the first time, and you have left behind what we provided for you. We do not see with you the intercessors that you idolized and claimed that they will help you. All ties among you have been severed; the idols you set up have abandoned you."

1981.english: "Now, you come back to us as individuals, just as we created you the first time, and you left behind everything we had provided for you. We do not see any of your intercessors that you invented and idolized. All ties among you are now severed, and the idols you invented have disowned you."

1989.english: “You have come back to us as individuals, just as we created you the first time, and you have left behind what we provided for you. We do not see the intercessors that you claimed will help you. All relations among you have been severed, and all the idols you set up have abandoned you.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلْحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله فالق الحب والنوى ۖ يخرج الحي من الميت ومخرج الميت من الحي ۚ ذلكم الله ۖ فأنى تؤفكون
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha fāliqu l-ḥabi wal-nawā yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wamukh'riju l-mayiti mina l-ḥayi dhālikumu l-lahu fa-annā tu'fakūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who causes the grains and the seeds to crack and germinate. He produces the living from the dead, and the dead from the living. Such is GOD; how could you deviate!
verses.subtitle: Greatness of God

1981.english: God is the one who germinates the grains and the seeds; He produces the live from the dead, and the dead from the live. Such is God; how could you deviate?
1981.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

1989.english: GOD is the One who causes the grains and the seeds to germinate. He produces the living from the dead, and the dead from the living. Such is GOD; how could you deviate!
1989.subtitle: Greatness of God

verses.arabic: فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فالق الإصباح وجعل الليل سكنا والشمس والقمر حسبانا ۚ ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
verses.transliterated: fāliqu l-iṣ'bāḥi wajaʿala al-layla sakanan wal-shamsa wal-qamara ḥus'bānan dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīm
verses.english: At the crack of dawn, He causes the morning to emerge. He made the night still, and He rendered the sun and the moon to serve as calculation devices. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.

1981.english: He generates the morning break, and designed the night for your rest, and the sun and moon as timing devices. Such is the design of the almighty, the omniscient.

1989.english: He causes the morning to crack (as it dawns). He made the night still. He made the sun and the moon to serve as calculation devices. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهَا فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي جعل لكم النجوم لتهتدوا بها في ظلمات البر والبحر ۗ قد فصلنا الآيات لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-nujūma litahtadū bihā fī ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri qad faṣṣalnā l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: And He is the One who made the stars to guide you during the darkness, on land and on sea. We thus clarify the revelations for people who know.

1981.english: And He is the one who designed the stars to guide you through the darkness of land and sea. We have explained the revelations for those who know.

1989.english: He made the stars to guide you during the darkness, on land and on sea. We thus clarify the revelations for people who know.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي أنشأكم من نفس واحدة فمستقر ومستودع ۗ قد فصلنا الآيات لقوم يفقهون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī ansha-akum min nafsin wāḥidatin famus'taqarrun wamus'tawdaʿun qad faṣṣalnā l-āyāti liqawmin yafqahūn
verses.english: He initiated you from one person, and decided your path, as well as your final destiny. We thus clarify the revelations for people who understand.

1981.english: And He is the one who created you from one person, then reproduced you generation after generation. We have explained the revelations for those who comprehend.

1989.english: He initiated you from one person, then reproduced you generation after generation. We thus clarify the revelations for people who understand.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًا نُّخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُّتَرَاكِبًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخْلِ مِن طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَنٌ دَانِيَةٌ وَجَنَّٰتٍ مِّنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشْتَبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ ٱنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَيَنْعِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكُمْ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي أنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به نبات كل شيء فأخرجنا منه خضرا نخرج منه حبا متراكبا ومن النخل من طلعها قنوان دانية وجنات من أعناب والزيتون والرمان مشتبها وغير متشابه ۗ انظروا إلى ثمره إذا أثمر وينعه ۚ إن في ذلكم لآيات لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi nabāta kulli shayin fa-akhrajnā min'hu khaḍiran nukh'riju min'hu ḥabban mutarākiban wamina l-nakhli min ṭalʿihā qin'wānun dāniyatun wajannātin min aʿnābin wal-zaytūna wal-rumāna mush'tabihan waghayra mutashābihin unẓurū ilā thamarihi idhā athmara wayanʿihi inna fī dhālikum laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: He is the One who sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce all kinds of plants. We produce from the green material multitudes of complex grains, palm trees with hanging clusters, and gardens of grapes, olives and pomegranate; fruits that are similar, yet dissimilar. Note their fruits as they grow and ripen. These are signs for people who believe.

1981.english: And He is the one who sends down water from the sky, to produce all kinds of plants, and from the green vegetation we produce compounded grains. From the palm trees, we produce hanging fruit from their sheaths. And we produce gardens of grapes, olives, and pomegranate: fruit that are similar yet dissimilar. Look at the fruits thereof as they develop, and note their freshness. All these are proofs for people who believe.

1989.english: He sends down water from the sky, to produce with it all kinds of plants. We produce from the green material multitudes of grains, palm trees with hanging clusters, and gardens of grapes, olives and pomegranate; fruits that are similar, yet dissimilar. Note their fruits as they grow and ripen. These are signs for people who believe.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ وَخَرَقُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتٍۭ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلوا لله شركاء الجن وخلقهم ۖ وخرقوا له بنين وبنات بغير علم ۚ سبحانه وتعالى عما يصفون
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalū lillahi shurakāa l-jina wakhalaqahum wakharaqū lahu banīna wabanātin bighayri ʿil'min sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.english: Yet, they set up besides GOD idols from among the jinns, though He is the One who created them. They even attribute to Him sons and daughters, without any knowledge. Be He glorified. He is the Most High, far above their claims.

1981.english: They even set up idols from among the jinns, though He created them. And they invented sons and daughters for Him, without knowledge. Most glorified and most exalted He is, over and above anything they describe.

1989.english: Yet, they set up besides GOD idols from among the jinns, though He is the One who created them. They even attributed to Him sons and daughters, without any knowledge. Be He glorified. He is the Most High, far above their claims.

verses.arabic: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٌ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: بديع السماوات والأرض ۖ أنى يكون له ولد ولم تكن له صاحبة ۖ وخلق كل شيء ۖ وهو بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: badīʿu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi annā yakūnu lahu waladun walam takun lahu ṣāḥibatun wakhalaqa kulla shayin wahuwa bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: The Initiator of the heavens and the earth. How can He have a son, when He never had a mate? He created all things, and He is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: He is the designer of the heavens and the earth. How could He need a son? Nor did He need a wife. Instead, He created all things, and He is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: He is the Initiator of the heavens and the earth. How can He have a son, when He never had a mate? He created all things, and He is fully aware of all things.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم الله ربكم ۖ لا إله إلا هو ۖ خالق كل شيء فاعبدوه ۚ وهو على كل شيء وكيل
verses.transliterated: dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lā ilāha illā huwa khāliqu kulli shayin fa-uʿ'budūhu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlu
verses.english: Such is GOD your Lord, there is no god except He, the Creator of all things. You shall worship Him alone. He is in control of all things.
verses.subtitle: God

1981.english: Such is God your Lord. There is no god except He; the creator of all things. Therefore, you shall worship Him Alone. He is in full control of all things.

1989.english: Such is GOD your Lord, there is no god except He, the Creator of all things. You shall worship Him alone. He is in control of all things.

verses.arabic: لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: لا تدركه الأبصار وهو يدرك الأبصار ۖ وهو اللطيف الخبير
verses.transliterated: lā tud'rikuhu l-abṣāru wahuwa yud'riku l-abṣāra wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīr
verses.english: No visions can encompass Him, but He encompasses all visions. He is the Compassionate, the Cognizant.

1981.english: No vision can ever encompass Him, while He encompasses all vision. He is the compassionate, the cognizant.

1989.english: No visions can encompass Him, but He encompasses all visions. He is the Compassionate, the Cognizant.

verses.arabic: قَدْ جَآءَكُم بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ عَمِىَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
verses.arabicClean: قد جاءكم بصائر من ربكم ۖ فمن أبصر فلنفسه ۖ ومن عمي فعليها ۚ وما أنا عليكم بحفيظ
verses.transliterated: qad jāakum baṣāiru min rabbikum faman abṣara falinafsihi waman ʿamiya faʿalayhā wamā anā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓi
verses.english: Enlightenments have come to you from your Lord. As for those who can see, they do so for their own good, and those who turn blind, do so to their own detriment. I am not your guardian.

1981.english: Proofs have come to you from your Lord; if anyone sees, it will be for his own good, and if anyone turns blind, it will be to his detriment. I am not a guardian over you.

1989.english: Enlightenments have come to you from your Lord. The one who sees, does so for his own good, and the one who turns blind, does so to his own detriment. I am not your guardian.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَلِيَقُولُوا۟ دَرَسْتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُۥ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك نصرف الآيات وليقولوا درست ولنبينه لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika nuṣarrifu l-āyāti waliyaqūlū darasta walinubayyinahu liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: We thus explain the revelations, to prove that you have received knowledge, and to clarify them for people who know.

1981.english: We thus explain the revelations to let them realize that you have learned. We clarify the revelations for those who know.

1989.english: We thus explain the revelations, to prove that you have learned, and to clarify them for people who know.

verses.arabic: ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: اتبع ما أوحي إليك من ربك ۖ لا إله إلا هو ۖ وأعرض عن المشركين
verses.transliterated: ittabiʿ mā ūḥiya ilayka min rabbika lā ilāha illā huwa wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord, there is no god except He, and disregard the idol worshipers.

1981.english: You shall follow what is revealed to you from your Lord; there is no god except He; and disregard the idol-worshipers.

1989.english: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord, there is no god except He, and disregard the idol worshipers.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولو شاء الله ما أشركوا ۗ وما جعلناك عليهم حفيظا ۖ وما أنت عليهم بوكيل
verses.transliterated: walaw shāa l-lahu mā ashrakū wamā jaʿalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīli
verses.english: Had GOD willed, they would not have worshiped idols. We did not appoint you as their guardian, nor are you their advocate.

1981.english: Had God willed, they would not have worshiped idols. We did not appoint you as their guardian, nor are you their advocate.

1989.english: Had GOD willed, they would not have worshiped idols. We did not appoint you as their guardian, nor are you their advocate.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَدْوًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ كَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرْجِعُهُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله فيسبوا الله عدوا بغير علم ۗ كذلك زينا لكل أمة عملهم ثم إلى ربهم مرجعهم فينبئهم بما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: walā tasubbū alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi fayasubbū l-laha ʿadwan bighayri ʿil'min kadhālika zayyannā likulli ummatin ʿamalahum thumma ilā rabbihim marjiʿuhum fayunabbi-uhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Do not curse the idols they set up beside GOD, lest they blaspheme and curse GOD, out of ignorance. We have adorned the works of every group in their eyes. Ultimately, they return to their Lord, then He informs them of everything they had done.

1981.english: Do not curse the idols they set up besides God, lest they curse God maliciously due to ignorance. We have adorned for every community their works in their eyes, then they will be returned to their Lord to inform them of everything they did.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Berate Their Idols

1989.english: Do not curse the idols they set up besides GOD, lest they blaspheme and curse GOD due to ignorance. We have adorned the works of every congregation in their eyes. Ultimately, they all return to their Lord, then He informs them of everything they had done.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ لَّيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْءَايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا يُشْعِرُكُمْ أَنَّهَآ إِذَا جَآءَتْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم لئن جاءتهم آية ليؤمنن بها ۚ قل إنما الآيات عند الله ۖ وما يشعركم أنها إذا جاءت لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāathum āyatun layu'minunna bihā qul innamā l-āyātu ʿinda l-lahi wamā yush'ʿirukum annahā idhā jāat lā yu'minūn
verses.english: They swore by GOD, solemnly, that if a miracle came to them, they would surely believe. Say, "Miracles come only from GOD." For all you know, if a miracle did come to them, they would continue to disbelieve.

1981.english: They swore by God solemnly that if a miracle came to them, they would believe. Say, "Miracles come only from God." What makes you think that even if a miracle came to them, they will not continue to disbelieve?

1989.english: They swore by GOD, solemnly, that if a miracle came to them, they would surely believe. Say, “Miracles come only from GOD.” For all you know, if a miracle did come to them, they would continue to disbelieve.

verses.arabic: وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْـِٔدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ونقلب أفئدتهم وأبصارهم كما لم يؤمنوا به أول مرة ونذرهم في طغيانهم يعمهون
verses.transliterated: wanuqallibu afidatahum wa-abṣārahum kamā lam yu'minū bihi awwala marratin wanadharuhum fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūn
verses.english: We control their minds and their hearts. Thus, since their decision is to disbelieve, we leave them in their transgressions, blundering.

1981.english: We control their minds and their visions, as a consequence of their initial decision to disbelieve, and we keep them in their transgression blundering.

1989.english: For we control their minds and their hearts. Since their decision is to disbelieve, we leave them in their transgressions, blundering.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَحَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ قُبُلًا مَّا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَجْهَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أننا نزلنا إليهم الملائكة وكلمهم الموتى وحشرنا عليهم كل شيء قبلا ما كانوا ليؤمنوا إلا أن يشاء الله ولكن أكثرهم يجهلون
verses.transliterated: walaw annanā nazzalnā ilayhimu l-malāikata wakallamahumu l-mawtā waḥasharnā ʿalayhim kulla shayin qubulan mā kānū liyu'minū illā an yashāa l-lahu walākinna aktharahum yajhalūn
verses.english: Even if we sent down the angels to them; even if the dead spoke to them; even if we summoned every miracle before them; they cannot believe unless GOD wills it. Indeed, most of them are ignorant.
verses.subtitle: A Consequence of Their Own Decision

1981.english: Thus, even if we send the angels down to them; even if the dead spoke to them; even if we gather before their eyes all kinds of miracles, they can never believe except in accordance with God's will. Indeed, the majority of people are unaware.

1989.english: Even if we sent down the angels to them, even if the dead spoke to them, even if we summoned every miracle in front of them, they cannot believe unless GOD wills it. But most of them are ignorant.
1989.subtitle: A Consequence of Their Own Decision

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَٰطِينَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلْجِنِّ يُوحِى بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ ٱلْقَوْلِ غُرُورًا وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك جعلنا لكل نبي عدوا شياطين الإنس والجن يوحي بعضهم إلى بعض زخرف القول غرورا ۚ ولو شاء ربك ما فعلوه ۖ فذرهم وما يفترون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwan shayāṭīna l-insi wal-jini yūḥī baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin zukh'rufa l-qawli ghurūran walaw shāa rabbuka mā faʿalūhu fadharhum wamā yaftarūn
verses.english: We have permitted the enemies of every prophet—human and jinn devils—to inspire in each other fancy words, in order to deceive. Had your Lord willed, they would not have done it. You shall disregard them and their fabrications.
verses.subtitle: Hadith & Sunna: Fabrications by the Prophet's Enemies

1981.english: Additionally, we have appointed for every prophet enemies from among the human devils and jinn devils, who invent and narrate to each other fancy words in order to deceive. Had your Lord willed, they would not have done it. You shall disregard them and their inventions.
1981.subtitle: Hadith and Sunna: The Great Test to Distinguish True Muslims From False Muslims

1989.english: We also set up enemies against every prophet, human and jinn devils, who inspire in each other fancy words, in order to deceive. Had your Lord willed, they would not have done it. You shall disregard them and their fabrications.
1989.subtitle: Hadith & Sunna: Fabrications by the Prophet’s Enemies

verses.arabic: وَلِتَصْغَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَفْـِٔدَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلِيَرْضَوْهُ وَلِيَقْتَرِفُوا۟ مَا هُم مُّقْتَرِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولتصغى إليه أفئدة الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة وليرضوه وليقترفوا ما هم مقترفون
verses.transliterated: walitaṣghā ilayhi afidatu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati waliyarḍawhu waliyaqtarifū mā hum muq'tarifūn
verses.english: This is to let the minds of those who do not believe in the Hereafter listen to such fabrications, and accept them, and thus expose their real convictions.
verses.subtitle: Important Criterion
verses.footnote:
"±6:113 The Quran provides criteria that tell us whether we truly believe in the Hereafter or merely give it lip service. These important criteria are stated here and in 17:45-46 and 39:45.

±6:113-115 Upholding any source beside the Quran reflects disbelief in the Quran (Appendix 18)."

1981.english: (This is God's will) in order that the minds of those who do not really believe in the hereafter may listen thereto, and accept it, and to have them commit what they are supposed to commit.
1981.footnote: One may grow up in an environment that equates goodness with belief in God and the hereafter. Consequently, this person may profess belief, in order to be good, while in fact his innermost convictions are contrary. God teaches us in these verses that the inventions of "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" was designed to distinguish the true Muslims from the false Muslims. The true Muslims uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran, as we see in 6:114.

1989.english: This is to let the minds of those who do not believe in the Hereafter listen to such fabrications, and accept them, and thus expose their real convictions.*
1989.footnote: Upholding any source besides the Quran reflects disbelief in the Quran.

verses.arabic: أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْتَغِى حَكَمًا وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مُفَصَّلًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُۥ مُنَزَّلٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أفغير الله أبتغي حكما وهو الذي أنزل إليكم الكتاب مفصلا ۚ والذين آتيناهم الكتاب يعلمون أنه منزل من ربك بالحق ۖ فلا تكونن من الممترين
verses.transliterated: afaghayra l-lahi abtaghī ḥakaman wahuwa alladhī anzala ilaykumu l-kitāba mufaṣṣalan wa-alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yaʿlamūna annahu munazzalun min rabbika bil-ḥaqi falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīn
verses.english: Shall I seek other than GOD as a source of law, when He has revealed to you this book fully detailed? Those who received the scripture recognize that it has been revealed from your Lord, truthfully. You shall not harbor any doubt.
verses.subtitle: Quran: Fully Detailed

1981.english: Shall I seek other than God as a source of law, when He revealed to you this book fully detailed? Even those who received previous scripture recognize that it came down from your Lord, truthfully. Therefore, you shall not harbor any doubt.

1989.english: Shall I seek other than GOD as a source of law, when He has revealed to you this book fully detailed?* Those who received the scripture recognize that it has been revealed from your Lord, truthfully. You shall not harbor any doubt.
1989.subtitle: Quran: Fully Detailed
1989.footnote: Upholding any source besides the Quran reflects disbelief in the Quran.

verses.arabic: وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وتمت كلمت ربك صدقا وعدلا ۚ لا مبدل لكلماته ۚ وهو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: watammat kalimatu rabbika ṣid'qan waʿadlan lā mubaddila likalimātihi wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: The word of your Lord is complete, in truth and justice. Nothing shall abrogate His words. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: The word of your Lord is complete, in truth and justice. Nothing shall abrogate His words. He is the hearer, the knower.

1989.english: The word of your Lord is complete,* in truth and justice. Nothing shall abrogate His words. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
1989.footnote: Upholding any source besides the Quran reflects disbelief in the Quran.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن تطع أكثر من في الأرض يضلوك عن سبيل الله ۚ إن يتبعون إلا الظن وإن هم إلا يخرصون
verses.transliterated: wa-in tuṭiʿ akthara man fī l-arḍi yuḍillūka ʿan sabīli l-lahi in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in hum illā yakhruṣūn
verses.english: If you obey the majority of people on earth, they will divert you from the path of GOD. They follow only conjecture; they only guess.

1981.english: If you obey the majority of people on earth, they will divert you from the path of God. They only follow conjecture, and they only guess.
1981.footnote: Unfortunately, the majority of Muslims have flunked the "Hadith" test. Instead of following the proven revelations of God, they follow what is conjectured to be the prophet's utterances and/or actions. Thus, they disobey God and the prophet by following the "Hadith" guesswork (see Appendix 11).

1989.english: If you obey the majority of people on earth, they will divert you from the path of GOD. They follow only conjecture; they only guess.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربك هو أعلم من يضل عن سبيله ۖ وهو أعلم بالمهتدين
verses.transliterated: inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu man yaḍillu ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīn
verses.english: Your Lord is fully aware of those who stray off His path, and He is fully aware of those who are guided.

1981.english: Indeed, your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who are the guided ones.

1989.english: Your Lord is fully aware of those who stray off His path, and He is fully aware of the guided ones.

verses.arabic: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه إن كنتم بآياته مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: fakulū mimmā dhukira us'mu l-lahi ʿalayhi in kuntum biāyātihi mu'minīn
verses.english: You shall eat from that upon which GOD's name has been pronounced, if you truly believe in His revelations.

1981.english: You shall eat from that upon which the name of God has been pronounced, if you are really believers in His revelations.
1981.subtitle: Permission From the Creator Before Killing Animals

1989.english: You shall eat from that upon which GOD’s name has been pronounced, if you truly believe in His revelations.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِلَّا مَا ٱضْطُرِرْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا لَّيُضِلُّونَ بِأَهْوَآئِهِم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما لكم ألا تأكلوا مما ذكر اسم الله عليه وقد فصل لكم ما حرم عليكم إلا ما اضطررتم إليه ۗ وإن كثيرا ليضلون بأهوائهم بغير علم ۗ إن ربك هو أعلم بالمعتدين
verses.transliterated: wamā lakum allā takulū mimmā dhukira us'mu l-lahi ʿalayhi waqad faṣṣala lakum mā ḥarrama ʿalaykum illā mā uḍ'ṭurir'tum ilayhi wa-inna kathīran layuḍillūna bi-ahwāihim bighayri ʿil'min inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu bil-muʿ'tadīn
verses.english: Why should you not eat from that upon which GOD's name has been mentioned? He has detailed for you what is prohibited for you, unless you are forced. Indeed, many people mislead others with their personal opinions, without knowledge. Your Lord is fully aware of the transgressors.
verses.subtitle: Chance to Remember God: Mention God's Name Before You Eat

1981.english: Why should you not eat from that upon which the name of God has been pronounced? God has detailed for you everything that is prohibited, unless you are forced. Many people mislead others with their own opinions, without knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is fully aware of the transgressors.

1989.english: Why should you not eat from that upon which GOD’s name has been mentioned? He has detailed for you what is prohibited, unless you are forced. Indeed, many people mislead with their opinions, without knowledge. Your Lord is fully aware of the transgressors.
1989.subtitle: Mention God’s Name Before You Eat

verses.arabic: وَذَرُوا۟ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْسِبُونَ ٱلْإِثْمَ سَيُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَقْتَرِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وذروا ظاهر الإثم وباطنه ۚ إن الذين يكسبون الإثم سيجزون بما كانوا يقترفون
verses.transliterated: wadharū ẓāhira l-ith'mi wabāṭinahu inna alladhīna yaksibūna l-ith'ma sayuj'zawna bimā kānū yaqtarifūn
verses.english: You shall avoid obvious sins, as well as the hidden ones. Those who have earned sins will surely pay for their transgressions.

1981.english: You shall forsake both obvious and hidden sins, for those who commit sins will pay for their evil works.

1989.english: You shall avoid obvious sins, as well as the hidden ones. Those who have earned sins will surely pay for their transgressions.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسْقٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِهِمْ لِيُجَٰدِلُوكُمْ وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تأكلوا مما لم يذكر اسم الله عليه وإنه لفسق ۗ وإن الشياطين ليوحون إلى أوليائهم ليجادلوكم ۖ وإن أطعتموهم إنكم لمشركون
verses.transliterated: walā takulū mimmā lam yudh'kari us'mu l-lahi ʿalayhi wa-innahu lafis'qun wa-inna l-shayāṭīna layūḥūna ilā awliyāihim liyujādilūkum wa-in aṭaʿtumūhum innakum lamush'rikūn
verses.english: Do not eat from that upon which the name of GOD has not been mentioned, for it is an abomination. The devils inspire their allies to argue with you; if you obey them, you will be idol worshipers.
verses.footnote: Dietary prohibitions instituted by other than God represent idolatry.

1981.english: Do not eat from that upon which the name of God has not been pronounced, for it is an abomination. The devils will inspire their allies to argue with you, and, if you obey them, you will be idol worshipers.
1981.footnote: Most people underestimate the seriousness of making up lists of prohibitions. We are told here that following the dictates of unauthorized prohibitions, beyond the four Quranic prohibitions, is idolatry. See 5:3, and Appendix 13.

1989.english: Do not eat from that upon which the name of GOD has not been mentioned, for it is evil. The devils inspire their allies to argue with yot and if you obey them, you will be idol worshipers.*
1989.footnote: Dietary prohibitions instituted by other than God represent idolatry.

verses.arabic: أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَٰهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ نُورًا يَمْشِى بِهِۦ فِى ٱلنَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُۥ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أومن كان ميتا فأحييناه وجعلنا له نورا يمشي به في الناس كمن مثله في الظلمات ليس بخارج منها ۚ كذلك زين للكافرين ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: awaman kāna maytan fa-aḥyaynāhu wajaʿalnā lahu nūran yamshī bihi fī l-nāsi kaman mathaluhu fī l-ẓulumāti laysa bikhārijin min'hā kadhālika zuyyina lil'kāfirīna mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Is one who was dead and we granted him life, and provided him with light that enables him to move among the people, equal to one in total darkness from which he can never exit? The works of the disbelievers are thus adorned in their eyes.

1981.english: Is one who used to be dead, then we granted him life, and provided him with a beacon with which he walks among the people; is he equal to one eternally committed to darkness? We have adorned for the disbelievers their works in their eyes.

1989.english: Is one who was dead and we granted him life, and provided him with light with which he moves among the people, equal to one who is in total darkness, and can never exit therefrom? The works of the disbelievers are adorned in their eyes.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ أَكَٰبِرَ مُجْرِمِيهَا لِيَمْكُرُوا۟ فِيهَا وَمَا يَمْكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك جعلنا في كل قرية أكابر مجرميها ليمكروا فيها ۖ وما يمكرون إلا بأنفسهم وما يشعرون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika jaʿalnā fī kulli qaryatin akābira muj'rimīhā liyamkurū fīhā wamā yamkurūna illā bi-anfusihim wamā yashʿurūn
verses.english: We allow the leading criminals of every community to plot and scheme. But they only plot and scheme against their own souls, without perceiving.

1981.english: And we have appointed in every community prominent criminals who plot and scheme therein. However, they plot and scheme against their own souls, without perceiving.

1989.english: We allow the leading criminals of every community to plot and scheme. For they only plot and scheme against themselves, without perceiving.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤْتَىٰ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا جاءتهم آية قالوا لن نؤمن حتى نؤتى مثل ما أوتي رسل الله ۘ الله أعلم حيث يجعل رسالته ۗ سيصيب الذين أجرموا صغار عند الله وعذاب شديد بما كانوا يمكرون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā jāathum āyatun qālū lan nu'mina ḥattā nu'tā mith'la mā ūtiya rusulu l-lahi l-lahu aʿlamu ḥaythu yajʿalu risālatahu sayuṣību alladhīna ajramū ṣaghārun ʿinda l-lahi waʿadhābun shadīdun bimā kānū yamkurūn
verses.english: When a powerful proof comes to them, they say, "We will not believe, unless we are given what is given to GOD's messengers!" GOD knows exactly who is best qualified to deliver His message. Such criminals will suffer debasement at GOD, and terrible retribution as a consequence of their evil scheming.
verses.subtitle: Questioning God's Wisdom
verses.footnote: Jealousy and ego are human traits that provoke some people to question God's wisdom in selecting His messengers. Corrupted Muslim scholars have uttered this same utterance regarding the revelation of the Quran's mathematical code through God's Messenger of the Covenant.

1981.english: And when a revelation comes to them, they say, "We will not believe, unless we are given what is given to God's messengers." God knows best who is worthy of delivering His message. These criminals will suffer debasement at God, and a severe retribution for their scheming.

1989.english: When a miracle comes to them, they say, “We will not believe, unless we are given what is given to GOD’s messengers!” GOD knows exactly who is best qualified to deliver His message.* Such criminals will suffer debasement at GOD, and terrible retribution for their evil scheming.
1989.subtitle: Questioning God’s Wisdom
1989.footnote: Jealousy and ego are human traits that provoke some people to question God’s wisdom in selecting His messengers. Every messenger was ridiculed by the disbelievers (21:36, 25:41, 43:31).

verses.arabic: فَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَهْدِيَهُۥ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ وَمَن يُرِدْ أَن يُضِلَّهُۥ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا كَأَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن يرد الله أن يهديه يشرح صدره للإسلام ۖ ومن يرد أن يضله يجعل صدره ضيقا حرجا كأنما يصعد في السماء ۚ كذلك يجعل الله الرجس على الذين لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: faman yuridi l-lahu an yahdiyahu yashraḥ ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi waman yurid an yuḍillahu yajʿal ṣadrahu ḍayyiqan ḥarajan ka-annamā yaṣṣaʿʿadu fī l-samāi kadhālika yajʿalu l-lahu l-rij'sa ʿalā alladhīna lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Whomever GOD wills to guide, He renders his chest wide open to Submission. And whomever He wills to send astray, He renders his chest intolerant and straitened, like one who climbs towards the sky. GOD thus places a curse upon those who refuse to believe.
verses.subtitle: Quranic Knowledge Far Ahead of Human Progress
verses.footnote: Centuries after the revelation of the Quran, we learned that the proportion of oxygen diminishes as we climb towards the sky, and we gasp for air.

1981.english: When God wants to guide someone, He opens his heart to Islam, and when He wants to send someone astray, He makes his chest straightened, like one who climbs towards the sky. God thus afflicts with unholiness those who do not believe.
1981.subtitle: Scientific Miracle
1981.footnote: At the time of Quran's revelations, no one knew that the proportion of oxygen becomes less and less as we climb towards the sky, causing one to gasp for breath.

1989.english: Whomever GOD wills to guide, He renders his chest wide open to Islam. And whomever He wills to send astray, He renders his chest intolerant and straitened, like one who climbs towards the sky.* GOD thus places a curse upon those who do not believe.
1989.subtitle: Quranic Knowledge Far Ahead of Human Progress
1989.footnote: Centuries after the revelation of the Quran, we learned that the proportion of oxygen diminishes as we climb towards the sky, and our chests gasp for air.

verses.arabic: وَهَٰذَا صِرَٰطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهذا صراط ربك مستقيما ۗ قد فصلنا الآيات لقوم يذكرون
verses.transliterated: wahādhā ṣirāṭu rabbika mus'taqīman qad faṣṣalnā l-āyāti liqawmin yadhakkarūn
verses.english: This is the straight path to your Lord. We have explained the revelations for people who take heed.

1981.english: This is the straight path of your Lord. We have explained the revelations for those who take heed.

1989.english: This is your Lord’s straight path. We have explained the revelations for people who take heed.

verses.arabic: لَهُمْ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لهم دار السلام عند ربهم ۖ وهو وليهم بما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: lahum dāru l-salāmi ʿinda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: They have deserved the abode of peace at their Lord; He is their Lord and Master, as a reward for their works.

1981.english: They have deserved the abode of peace at their Lord, and He is their savior because of their works.

1989.english: They have deserved the abode of peace at their Lord, and He is their Lord and Master in return for their works.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ قَدِ ٱسْتَكْثَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَقَالَ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ رَبَّنَا ٱسْتَمْتَعَ بَعْضُنَا بِبَعْضٍ وَبَلَغْنَآ أَجَلَنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَجَّلْتَ لَنَا قَالَ ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يحشرهم جميعا يا معشر الجن قد استكثرتم من الإنس ۖ وقال أولياؤهم من الإنس ربنا استمتع بعضنا ببعض وبلغنا أجلنا الذي أجلت لنا ۚ قال النار مثواكم خالدين فيها إلا ما شاء الله ۗ إن ربك حكيم عليم
verses.transliterated: wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿan yāmaʿshara l-jini qadi is'takthartum mina l-insi waqāla awliyāuhum mina l-insi rabbanā is'tamtaʿa baʿḍunā bibaʿḍin wabalaghnā ajalanā alladhī ajjalta lanā qāla l-nāru mathwākum khālidīna fīhā illā mā shāa l-lahu inna rabbaka ḥakīmun ʿalīmu
verses.english: The day will come when He summons all of them (and says): "O you jinns, you have claimed multitudes of humans." Their human companions will say, "Our Lord, we enjoyed each others' company until we wasted the life span You had set for us." He will say, "Hell is your destiny." They abide therein forever, in accordance with GOD's will. Your Lord is Wise, Omniscient.

1981.english: On the day when we gather them all, "O you Jinns, you have claimed a majority of the humans." Their followers among the humans will say, "Our Lord, we enjoyed each other, until the life span You had appointed for us came to an end." God will say, "You have deserved hell, wherein you abide forever, in accordance with God's will. Your Lord is wise, omniscient."
1981.subtitle: The Majority of People Heedless

1989.english: The day will come when He summons all of them (and says): “O you jinns, you have claimed multitudes of humans.” Their human allies will say, “Our Lord, we enjoyed each others’ company until we wasted the life span You had set for us.” He will say, “You have incurred Hell as your destiny.” They abide therein forever, in accordance with GOD’s will. Your Lord is Wise, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّى بَعْضَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك نولي بعض الظالمين بعضا بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika nuwallī baʿḍa l-ẓālimīna baʿḍan bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: We thus match the wicked to be companions of each other, as a punishment for their transgressions.

1981.english: We thus match the wicked as friends of each other, and let them suffer the company of each other, because of their deeds.

1989.english: We thus match the wicked to be friends of each other, as a punishment for what they earned.

verses.arabic: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا قَالُوا۟ شَهِدْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَشَهِدُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا معشر الجن والإنس ألم يأتكم رسل منكم يقصون عليكم آياتي وينذرونكم لقاء يومكم هذا ۚ قالوا شهدنا على أنفسنا ۖ وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا وشهدوا على أنفسهم أنهم كانوا كافرين
