verses.transliterated: yāmaʿshara l-jini wal-insi alam yatikum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātī wayundhirūnakum liqāa yawmikum hādhā qālū shahid'nā ʿalā anfusinā wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā washahidū ʿalā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīn
verses.english: O you jinns and humans, did you not receive messengers from among you, who narrated to you My revelations, and warned you about the meeting of this day? They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves." They were totally preoccupied with the worldly life, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

1981.english: O you Jinns and humans, did you not receive messengers from among you, who narrated for you My revelations, and warned you about this day? They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves." They were distracted by this life, and they bore witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

1989.english: O you jinns and humans, did you not receive messengers from among you, who recited for you My revelations, and warned you about this day? They will say, “We bear witness against ourselves.” They were totally absorbed in the worldly life, and they bore witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمْ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك أن لم يكن ربك مهلك القرى بظلم وأهلها غافلون
verses.transliterated: dhālika an lam yakun rabbuka muh'lika l-qurā biẓul'min wa-ahluhā ghāfilūn
verses.english: This is to show that your Lord never annihilates any community unjustly, while its people are unaware.

1981.english: Thus, your Lord never destroys any community unjustly, without forewarning its people (through the messengers).

1989.english: This is to show that your Lord never annihilates any community unjustly, while its people are unaware.

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكل درجات مما عملوا ۚ وما ربك بغافل عما يعملون
verses.transliterated: walikullin darajātun mimmā ʿamilū wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Everyone will attain a rank commensurate with their deeds. Your Lord is never unaware of anything they do.

1981.english: Everyone will be assigned a rank, in accordance with their works, and your Lord is never unaware of anything they do.

1989.english: All will attain ranks in accordance with their deeds. Your Lord is never unaware of anything they do.

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وربك الغني ذو الرحمة ۚ إن يشأ يذهبكم ويستخلف من بعدكم ما يشاء كما أنشأكم من ذرية قوم آخرين
verses.transliterated: warabbuka l-ghaniyu dhū l-raḥmati in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayastakhlif min baʿdikum mā yashāu kamā ansha-akum min dhurriyyati qawmin ākharīn
verses.english: Your Lord is the Rich One; possessor of all mercy. If He wills, He can remove you, and substitute whomever He wills in your place, just as He produced you from the progeny of other people.

1981.english: Your Lord needs no one; He is full of mercy. If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute others, just as He established you from the progeny of other people.

1989.english: Your Lord is the Rich One; possessor of all mercy. If He wills, He can remove you, and substitute whomever He wills in your place, just as He produced you from the progeny of other people.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَءَاتٍ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ما توعدون لآت ۖ وما أنتم بمعجزين
verses.transliterated: inna mā tūʿadūna laātin wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīn
verses.english: What is promised to you will come to pass, and you can never evade it.

1981.english: What is promised to you herein will surely come to pass, and you can never escape.

1989.english: What is promised to you will come to pass, and you cannot evade it.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا قوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إني عامل ۖ فسوف تعلمون من تكون له عاقبة الدار ۗ إنه لا يفلح الظالمون
verses.transliterated: qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūna man takūnu lahu ʿāqibatu l-dāri innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: Say, "O my people, do your best, and so will I. You will surely find out who the ultimate victors are." Certainly, the wicked will never succeed.

1981.english: Say, "O my people, do what you think is right, and I will. You will surely find out who the ultimate winner will be." Surely, the wicked will never succeed.

1989.english: Say, “O my people, do your best, and so will I. You will find out who ultimately succeeds.” Surely, the wicked never succeed.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ ٱلْحَرْثِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ نَصِيبًا فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَهَٰذَا لِشُرَكَآئِنَا فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلَىٰ شُرَكَآئِهِمْ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلوا لله مما ذرأ من الحرث والأنعام نصيبا فقالوا هذا لله بزعمهم وهذا لشركائنا ۖ فما كان لشركائهم فلا يصل إلى الله ۖ وما كان لله فهو يصل إلى شركائهم ۗ ساء ما يحكمون
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalū lillahi mimmā dhara-a mina l-ḥarthi wal-anʿāmi naṣīban faqālū hādhā lillahi bizaʿmihim wahādhā lishurakāinā famā kāna lishurakāihim falā yaṣilu ilā l-lahi wamā kāna lillahi fahuwa yaṣilu ilā shurakāihim sāa mā yaḥkumūn
verses.english: They even set aside a share of GOD's provisions of crops and livestock, saying, "This share belongs to GOD," according to their claims, "and this share belongs to our idols." However, what was set aside for their idols never reached GOD, while the share they set aside for GOD invariably went to their idols. Miserable indeed is their judgment.
verses.subtitle: Abusing God's Provisions

1981.english: They even assigned for God a share of the crops and livestock He has provided for them, saying, "This is for God," according to their claims, "and this is for our idols." However, what was assigned to their idols never reached God, while that assigned to God invariably ended up at their idols. Evil indeed is their judgment.
1981.subtitle: Ancient Traditions

1989.english: They even set aside a share of GOD’s provisions of crops and livestock, saying, “This share belongs to GOD,” according to their claims, “and this share belongs to our idols.” However, what was set aside for their idols never reached GOD, while the share they set aside for GOD invariably went to their idols. Miserable indeed is their judgment.
1989.subtitle: Abusing God’s Provisions

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَٰدِهِمْ شُرَكَآؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك زين لكثير من المشركين قتل أولادهم شركاؤهم ليردوهم وليلبسوا عليهم دينهم ۖ ولو شاء الله ما فعلوه ۖ فذرهم وما يفترون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika zayyana likathīrin mina l-mush'rikīna qatla awlādihim shurakāuhum liyur'dūhum waliyalbisū ʿalayhim dīnahum walaw shāa l-lahu mā faʿalūhu fadharhum wamā yaftarūn
verses.english: Thus were the idol worshipers duped by their idols, to the extent of killing their own children. In fact, their idols inflict great pain upon them, and confuse their religion for them. Had GOD willed, they would not have done it. You shall disregard them and their fabrications.
verses.footnote: A perfect example is the internationally infamous incident of the execution of a Saudi Arabian princess in 1978 for alleged adultery. God's law institutes whipping, not execution, as a punishment for adultery (24:1-2), while the idolatrous laws stipulate execution. As pointed out in 42:21, the traditionalists follow a religion that is not authorized by God.

1981.english: Additionally, many idol worshipers were duped by their idols into killing their own children. Thus, they cause disasters, and confuse their religion for them. Had God willed, they would not have done it. You shall disregard them and their inventions.

1989.english: Thus were the idol worshipers misled by their idols, to the extent of killing their own children.* Thus, their idols inflict great pain upon them, and confuse their religion for them. Had GOD willed, they would not have done it. You shall avoid them and their fabrications.
1989.footnote: A perfect example is the internationally infamous incident of the execution of a Saudi Arabian princess in 1978 for alleged adultery. God’s law institutes whipping; not execution, as a punishment for adultery (24:1-2), while the idolatrous laws stipulate execution. As pointed out in 42:21, the traditionalists follow a religion that is not authorized by God.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَنْعَٰمٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَآ إِلَّا مَن نَّشَآءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَأَنْعَٰمٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنْعَٰمٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَيْهِ سَيَجْزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا هذه أنعام وحرث حجر لا يطعمها إلا من نشاء بزعمهم وأنعام حرمت ظهورها وأنعام لا يذكرون اسم الله عليها افتراء عليه ۚ سيجزيهم بما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: waqālū hādhihi anʿāmun waḥarthun ḥij'run lā yaṭʿamuhā illā man nashāu bizaʿmihim wa-anʿāmun ḥurrimat ẓuhūruhā wa-anʿāmun lā yadhkurūna is'ma l-lahi ʿalayhā if'tirāan ʿalayhi sayajzīhim bimā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: They said, "These are livestock and crops that are prohibited; no one shall eat them except whomever we permit," so they claimed. They also prohibited the riding of certain livestock. Even the livestock they ate, they never pronounced GOD's name as they sacrificed them. Such are innovations attributed to Him. He will surely requite them for their innovations.
verses.subtitle: Religious Innovations Condemned

1981.english: They said, "These livestock and crops are prohibited; no one shall eat them, except whomever we will," according to their claims. Other livestock were forbidden from work, while others they did not pronounce God's name on them. All these are blasphemies against God, and He will punish them for such fabrications.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit Lawful Things

1989.english: They said, “These are livestock and crops that are prohibited; no one shall eat them except whomever we choose,” according to their claims. They also prohibited riding certain livestock. As for the livestock they eat, they never pronounced GOD’s name as they sacrificed them. Such are innovations attributed to Him. He will make them pay for their innovations.
1989.subtitle: Religious Innovations Condemned

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا فِى بُطُونِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَإِن يَكُن مَّيْتَةً فَهُمْ فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ سَيَجْزِيهِمْ وَصْفَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا ما في بطون هذه الأنعام خالصة لذكورنا ومحرم على أزواجنا ۖ وإن يكن ميتة فهم فيه شركاء ۚ سيجزيهم وصفهم ۚ إنه حكيم عليم
verses.transliterated: waqālū mā fī buṭūni hādhihi l-anʿāmi khāliṣatun lidhukūrinā wamuḥarramun ʿalā azwājinā wa-in yakun maytatan fahum fīhi shurakāu sayajzīhim waṣfahum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmu
verses.english: They also said, "What is in the bellies of these livestock is reserved exclusively for the males among us, and prohibited for our wives." But if it was a stillbirth, they permitted their wives to share therein. He will certainly requite them for their innovations. He is Most Wise, Omniscient.

1981.english: And they said, "What is in the wombs of these animals shall be reserved for our men, and prohibited for our women." However, if born still, they all shared therein. God will punish them for their claims. He is wise, omniscient.

1989.english: They also said, “What is in the bellies of these livestock is reserved exclusively for the males, and prohibited for our wives.” But if it was a stillbirth, they permitted the wives to share therein. He will make them pay for their innovations. He is Most Wise, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَهُمْ سَفَهًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا۟ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قد خسر الذين قتلوا أولادهم سفها بغير علم وحرموا ما رزقهم الله افتراء على الله ۚ قد ضلوا وما كانوا مهتدين
verses.transliterated: qad khasira alladhīna qatalū awlādahum safahan bighayri ʿil'min waḥarramū mā razaqahumu l-lahu if'tirāan ʿalā l-lahi qad ḍallū wamā kānū muh'tadīn
verses.english: Losers indeed are those who killed their children foolishly, due to their lack of knowledge, and prohibited what GOD has provided for them, and followed innovations attributed to GOD. They have gone astray; they are not guided.

1981.english: Losers indeed are those who killed their own children foolishly,* due to ignorance, and those who prohibited God's provisions to them. They have gone astray, and were never guided.

1989.english: Losers are those who killed their children foolishly, due to their lack of knowledge, and prohibited what GOD has provided for them, and followed innovations attributed to GOD. They have gone astray; they are not guided.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّٰتٍ مَّعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَٱلنَّخْلَ وَٱلزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ كُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَءَاتُوا۟ حَقَّهُۥ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِۦ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي أنشأ جنات معروشات وغير معروشات والنخل والزرع مختلفا أكله والزيتون والرمان متشابها وغير متشابه ۚ كلوا من ثمره إذا أثمر وآتوا حقه يوم حصاده ۖ ولا تسرفوا ۚ إنه لا يحب المسرفين
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī ansha-a jannātin maʿrūshātin waghayra maʿrūshātin wal-nakhla wal-zarʿa mukh'talifan ukuluhu wal-zaytūna wal-rumāna mutashābihan waghayra mutashābihin kulū min thamarihi idhā athmara waātū ḥaqqahu yawma ḥaṣādihi walā tus'rifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'rifīn
verses.english: He is the One who established gardens, trellised and untrellised, and palm trees, and crops with different tastes, and olives, and pomegranate —fruits that are similar, yet dissimilar. Eat from their fruits, and give the due alms on the day of harvest, and do not waste anything. He does not love the wasters.
verses.subtitle: Zakat Must Be Given "On The Day Of Harvest"
verses.footnote: Zakat charity is so important, the Most Merciful has restricted His mercy to those who give it (7:156). Yet, the corrupted Muslims have lost this most important commandment; they give Zakat only once a year. We see here that Zakat must be given away "On the day we receive income." The proportion that came to us through Abraham is 2.5% of our net income.

1981.english: God is the one who created gardens, trellised and untrellised, and palm trees, and vegetations of various tastes, and olives, and pomegranate; fruits that are similar yet dissimilar. Eat from the fruits thereof, and give the due proportion thereof to charity, on the day of harvest. And do not be wasteful, for God is displeased with the wasteful
1981.subtitle: Follow the Teachings of God Alone

1989.english: He established gardens, trellised anc untrellised, palm trees, crops with different tastes, and olives, and pomegranate—fruits that are similar, yet dissimilar. Eat from these fruits, and give the due alms on the day of harvest.* Do not waste anything; He does not love the wasters.
1989.subtitle: Zakat Must Be Given “On The Day Of Harvest”
1989.footnote: Zakat charity is so important, the Most Merciful has restricted His mercy to those who give it (7:156). Yet, the Muslim world has lost this commandment; they give Zakat only once a year. We see here that Zakat must be given away “the day we receive income.” The proportion that came to us through Abraham is 2.5% of our net income.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ حَمُولَةً وَفَرْشًا كُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الأنعام حمولة وفرشا ۚ كلوا مما رزقكم الله ولا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان ۚ إنه لكم عدو مبين
verses.transliterated: wamina l-anʿāmi ḥamūlatan wafarshan kulū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu walā tattabiʿū khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnu
verses.english: Some livestock supply you with transportation, as well as bedding materials. Eat from GOD's provisions to you, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your most ardent enemy.

1981.english: And (He created) the livestock to carry your loads, and to provide clothes. Eat from God's provisions, and do not follow the steps of Satan, for he is your ardent enemy.

1989.english: Some livestock supply you with transportation, as well as bedding materials. Eat from GOD’s provisions to you, and do not follow the steps of Satan; he is your most ardent enemy.

verses.arabic: ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ نَبِّـُٔونِى بِعِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثمانية أزواج ۖ من الضأن اثنين ومن المعز اثنين ۗ قل آلذكرين حرم أم الأنثيين أما اشتملت عليه أرحام الأنثيين ۖ نبئوني بعلم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: thamāniyata azwājin mina l-ḍani ith'nayni wamina l-maʿzi ith'nayni qul āldhakarayni ḥarrama ami l-unthayayni ammā ish'tamalat ʿalayhi arḥāmu l-unthayayni nabbiūnī biʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Eight kinds of livestock: regarding the two kinds of sheep, and the two kinds of goats, say, "Is it the two males that He prohibited, or the two females, or the contents of the wombs of the two females? Tell me what you know, if you are truthful."
verses.subtitle: Innovated Dietary Prohibitions Condemned

1981.english: (He created) eight kinds of livestock, two kinds of sheep, and two kinds of goats. Say, "Is it the two males that He prohibited, or the two females, or the contents of the wombs of the two females? Inform me, knowledgeably, if you are truthful."

1989.english: Eight kinds of livestock—two kinds of sheep, and two kinds of goats—say, “Is it the two males that He prohibited, or the two females, or the contents of the wombs of the two females? Tell me what you know, if you are truthful.”
1989.subtitle: Innovated Dietary Prohibitions Condemned

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلْإِبِلِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ وَصَّىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا لِّيُضِلَّ ٱلنَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الإبل اثنين ومن البقر اثنين ۗ قل آلذكرين حرم أم الأنثيين أما اشتملت عليه أرحام الأنثيين ۖ أم كنتم شهداء إذ وصاكم الله بهذا ۚ فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا ليضل الناس بغير علم ۗ إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wamina l-ibili ith'nayni wamina l-baqari ith'nayni qul āldhakarayni ḥarrama ami l-unthayayni ammā ish'tamalat ʿalayhi arḥāmu l-unthayayni am kuntum shuhadāa idh waṣṣākumu l-lahu bihādhā faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban liyuḍilla l-nāsa bighayri ʿil'min inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Regarding the two kinds of camels, and the two kinds of cattle, say, "Is it the two males that He prohibited, or the two females, or the contents of the wombs of the two females? Were you witnesses when GOD decreed such prohibitions for you? Who is more evil than those who invent such lies and attribute them to GOD? They thus mislead the people without knowledge. GOD does not guide such evil people."

1981.english: And two kinds of camels, and two kinds of cattle. Say, "Is it the two males that He prohibited, or the two females, or the contents of the wombs of the two females? Did you witness God as He issued such prohibitions?" Who is more evil than one who invents lies, then attribute them to God, causing many people to stray without knowledge? Indeed, God never guides the wicked people.

1989.english: And two kinds of camels, and two kinds of cattle: say, “Is it the two males that He prohibited, or the two females, or the contents of the wombs of the two females? Were you witnesses when GOD decreed such prohibitions? Who is more evil than one who invent such lies and attributes them to GOD and thus misleads the people without knowledge? GOD does not guide such evil people.”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِى مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيْتَةً أَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوحًا أَوْ لَحْمَ خِنزِيرٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجْسٌ أَوْ فِسْقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا أجد في ما أوحي إلي محرما على طاعم يطعمه إلا أن يكون ميتة أو دما مسفوحا أو لحم خنزير فإنه رجس أو فسقا أهل لغير الله به ۚ فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فإن ربك غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: qul lā ajidu fī mā ūḥiya ilayya muḥarraman ʿalā ṭāʿimin yaṭʿamuhu illā an yakūna maytatan aw daman masfūḥan aw laḥma khinzīrin fa-innahu rij'sun aw fis'qan uhilla lighayri l-lahi bihi famani uḍ'ṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna rabbaka ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Say, "I do not find in the revelations given to me any food that is prohibited for any eater except: (1) carrion, (2) running blood, (3) the meat of pigs, for it is contaminated, and (4) the meat of animals blasphemously dedicated to other than GOD." If one is forced (to eat these), without being deliberate or malicious, then your Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: The Only Dietary Prohibitions
verses.footnote: Only four kinds of animal products are prohibited: animals that die of themselves, running blood (not trapped within the meat), the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than their Creator. Verse 146 informs us that such prohibitions are very specific; God prohibits either "the meat" or "the fat," or both, if He so wills.

1981.english: Say, "I do not find in what is revealed to me anything prohibited for any eater except the animals that die of themselves, running blood, the meat of pigs,* for it is unclean, or animals dedicated to other than God. However; if one is forced to eat these, without being malicious or deliberate, then your Lord is forgiver, merciful."
1981.subtitle: Only Four Things Prohibited
1981.footnote: Note that when God wants to prohibit "meat," He specifically prohibits "meat," and when He wants to prohibit "fat," He specifically prohibits fat (6:146). Unfortunately, most Muslims have gone too far in prohibiting everything remotely related to the pig, including such things as soaps, tooth pastes, and even hair brushes. We must remember that God shows a great deal of displeasure at those who prohibit perfectly lawful things.

1989.english: Say, “I do not find in the revelations given to me any food that is prohibited for any eater except: (1) carrion, (2) running blood, (3) the meat* of pigs, for it is unclean, and (4) the meat of animals blasphemously dedicated to other than GOD.” If one is forced {to eat these), without being deliberate or malicious, then your Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: The Only Dietary Prohibitions
1989.footnote: Only four kinds of animal products are prohibited: animals that die of themselves, running blood (not trapped within the meat), the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than their Creator. Verse 146 informs us that such prohibitions an very specific; God prohibits either,(the meat” or “the fat, ” or both, if He so wills.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِى ظُفُرٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ وَٱلْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُومَهُمَآ إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتْ ظُهُورُهُمَآ أَوِ ٱلْحَوَايَآ أَوْ مَا ٱخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِبَغْيِهِمْ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وعلى الذين هادوا حرمنا كل ذي ظفر ۖ ومن البقر والغنم حرمنا عليهم شحومهما إلا ما حملت ظهورهما أو الحوايا أو ما اختلط بعظم ۚ ذلك جزيناهم ببغيهم ۖ وإنا لصادقون
verses.transliterated: waʿalā alladhīna hādū ḥarramnā kulla dhī ẓufurin wamina l-baqari wal-ghanami ḥarramnā ʿalayhim shuḥūmahumā illā mā ḥamalat ẓuhūruhumā awi l-ḥawāyā aw mā ikh'talaṭa biʿaẓmin dhālika jazaynāhum bibaghyihim wa-innā laṣādiqūn
verses.english: For those who are Jewish we prohibited animals with undivided hoofs; and of the cattle and sheep we prohibited the fat, except that which is carried on their backs, or in the viscera, or mixed with bones. That was a retribution for their transgressions, and we are truthful.

1981.english: For the Jews we prohibited animals with undivided hoofs, and the fat of cattle and sheep, except fat which is on the back, or the entrails, or mixed with bones. We did this as punishment for their transgression, and we are truthful.
1981.footnote: Note that when God wants to prohibit "meat," He specifically prohibits "meat," and when He wants to prohibit "fat," He specifically prohibits fat (6:146). Unfortunately, most Muslims have gone too far in prohibiting everything remotely related to the pig, including such things as soaps, tooth pastes, and even hair brushes. We must remember that God shows a great deal of displeasure at those who prohibit perfectly lawful things.

1989.english: For those who are Jewish we prohibited animals with undivided hoofs; and of the cattle and sheep we prohibited the fat, except that which is carried on their backs, or in the viscera, or mixed with bones. That was a retribution for their transgressions, and we are truthful.
1989.footnote: Only four kinds of animal products are prohibited: animals that die of themselves, running blood (not trapped within the meat), the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than their Creator. Verse 146 informs us that such prohibitions an very specific; God prohibits either,(the meat” or “the fat, ” or both, if He so wills.

verses.arabic: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل رَّبُّكُمْ ذُو رَحْمَةٍ وَٰسِعَةٍ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن كذبوك فقل ربكم ذو رحمة واسعة ولا يرد بأسه عن القوم المجرمين
verses.transliterated: fa-in kadhabūka faqul rabbukum dhū raḥmatin wāsiʿatin walā yuraddu basuhu ʿani l-qawmi l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: If they disbelieve you, then say, "Your Lord possesses infinite mercy, but His retribution is unavoidable for the guilty people."

1981.english: If they disbelieve you, then say, "Your Lord is full of mercy, but His punishment cannot be evaded by the guilty."
1981.footnote: It is not mercy or justice when a teacher gives top grades to all the students.

1989.english: If they reject you, then say, “Your Lord possesses infinite mercy, and His retribution is unavoidable for the guilty people.”

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكْنَا وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن شَىْءٍ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ ذَاقُوا۟ بَأْسَنَا قُلْ هَلْ عِندَكُم مِّنْ عِلْمٍ فَتُخْرِجُوهُ لَنَآ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَخْرُصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سيقول الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما أشركنا ولا آباؤنا ولا حرمنا من شيء ۚ كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم حتى ذاقوا بأسنا ۗ قل هل عندكم من علم فتخرجوه لنا ۖ إن تتبعون إلا الظن وإن أنتم إلا تخرصون
verses.transliterated: sayaqūlu alladhīna ashrakū law shāa l-lahu mā ashraknā walā ābāunā walā ḥarramnā min shayin kadhālika kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim ḥattā dhāqū basanā qul hal ʿindakum min ʿil'min fatukh'rijūhu lanā in tattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in antum illā takhruṣūn
verses.english: The idol worshipers say, "Had GOD willed, we would not practice idolatry, nor would our parents, nor would we prohibit anything." Thus did those before them disbelieve, until they incurred our retribution. Say, "Do you have any proven knowledge that you can show us? You follow nothing but conjecture; you only guess."

1981.english: The idol worshipers would say, "Had God willed, we would not have idolized anything, nor our ancestors, and we would not have prohibited anything." Thus did those before them disbelieve, until they suffered our retribution. Say, "Do you have any knowledge that you can show us? You only follow conjecture, and you only guess."
1981.footnote: Long lists of unauthorized prohibitions are found in the inventions called "Hadith" and/or "Sunna," which are not more than conjecture and guesswork.

1989.english: The idol worshipers say, “Had GOD willed, we would not practice idolatry, nor would our parents, nor would we prohibit anything.” Thus did those before them disbelieve, until they incurred our retribution. Say, “Do you have any sure knowledge you can show us? You follow only conjecture; you only guess.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحُجَّةُ ٱلْبَٰلِغَةُ فَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل فلله الحجة البالغة ۖ فلو شاء لهداكم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: qul falillahi l-ḥujatu l-bālighatu falaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: Say, "GOD possesses the most powerful argument; if He wills He can guide all of you."
verses.subtitle: The Most Powerful Argument
verses.footnote: The Quran's mathematical code is a tangible and utterly incontrovertible proof that this is God's message to the world. It takes divine intervention to prevent any reader from appreciating this extraordinary phenomenon, then falling prostrate, and accepting this overwhelming miracle (see 17:45-46, 18:57, 56:79, and Appendix One).

1981.english: God possesses the most convincing proof; had He willed, He could have guided all of you.

1989.english: Say, “GOD possesses the most powerful argument; if He wills He can guide you all.”
1989.subtitle: The Most Powerful Argument
1989.footnote: The Quran’s mathematical code is a tangible and utterly incontrovertible proof that this is God’s message to the world. It takes divine intervention to prevent any reader from appreciating this extraordinary phenomenon, then falling prostrate, and accepting this overwhelming miracle (see 17:45-46, 18:57, 56:79, and Appendix One).

verses.arabic: قُلْ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَٰذَا فَإِن شَهِدُوا۟ فَلَا تَشْهَدْ مَعَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هلم شهداءكم الذين يشهدون أن الله حرم هذا ۖ فإن شهدوا فلا تشهد معهم ۚ ولا تتبع أهواء الذين كذبوا بآياتنا والذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة وهم بربهم يعدلون
verses.transliterated: qul halumma shuhadāakumu alladhīna yashhadūna anna l-laha ḥarrama hādhā fa-in shahidū falā tashhad maʿahum walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wahum birabbihim yaʿdilūn
verses.english: Say, "Bring your witnesses who would testify that GOD has prohibited this or that." If they testify, do not testify with them. Nor shall you follow the opinions of those who reject our revelations, and those who disbelieve in the Hereafter, and those who stray away from their Lord.

1981.english: Say, "Summon your witnesses who can testify that God prohibited this or that." Even if they do testify, do not testify as they do, and do not follow the opinions of those who reject our revelations, disbelieve in the hereafter, and set up idols to rank with their Lord.
1981.footnote: Accepting any prohibitions not specifically mentioned in Quran is idolatry. Although they confess belief in the hereafter, verse 113 tells us otherwise.

1989.english: Say, “Bring your witnesses who would testify that GOD has prohibited this or that.” If they testify, do not testify with them. Nor shall you follow the opinions of those who reject our revelations, or those who disbelieve in the Hereafter, or those who deviate from their Lord.

verses.arabic: قُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُم مِّنْ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل تعالوا أتل ما حرم ربكم عليكم ۖ ألا تشركوا به شيئا ۖ وبالوالدين إحسانا ۖ ولا تقتلوا أولادكم من إملاق ۖ نحن نرزقكم وإياهم ۖ ولا تقربوا الفواحش ما ظهر منها وما بطن ۖ ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق ۚ ذلكم وصاكم به لعلكم تعقلون
verses.transliterated: qul taʿālaw atlu mā ḥarrama rabbukum ʿalaykum allā tush'rikū bihi shayan wabil-wālidayni iḥ'sānan walā taqtulū awlādakum min im'lāqin naḥnu narzuqukum wa-iyyāhum walā taqrabū l-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara min'hā wamā baṭana walā taqtulū l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi dhālikum waṣṣākum bihi laʿallakum taʿqilūn
verses.english: Say, "Come let me tell you what your Lord has really prohibited for you: You shall not set up idols besides Him. You shall honor your parents. You shall not kill your children from fear of poverty—we provide for you and for them. You shall not commit gross sins, obvious or hidden. You shall not kill—GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. These are His commandments to you, that you may understand."
verses.subtitle: The Major Commandments

1981.english: Say, "Come let me tell you what is really prohibited for you: you shall not set up any idol besides God; you shall honor your parents; you shall not kill your infants from fear of poverty, for we provide for you and for them; you shall not approach gross sins, obvious or hidden; you shall not kill, for God has made life sacred, except in the course of justice. These are God's commandments to you, that you may understand.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Bicker Over Minor Issues

1989.english: Say, “Come let me tell you what your Lord has really prohibited for you: You shall not set up idols besides Him. You shall honor your parents. You shall not kill your children from fear of poverty—we provide for you and for them. You shall not commit gross sins, obvious or hidden. You shall not kill any soul—GOD has made life sacred— except in the course of justice. These are His commandments to you, that you may understand.”
1989.subtitle: The Major Commandments

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَٱعْدِلُوا۟ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ وَبِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْفُوا۟ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم إلا بالتي هي أحسن حتى يبلغ أشده ۖ وأوفوا الكيل والميزان بالقسط ۖ لا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها ۖ وإذا قلتم فاعدلوا ولو كان ذا قربى ۖ وبعهد الله أوفوا ۚ ذلكم وصاكم به لعلكم تذكرون
verses.transliterated: walā taqrabū māla l-yatīmi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ashuddahu wa-awfū l-kayla wal-mīzāna bil-qis'ṭi lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā wa-idhā qul'tum fa-iʿ'dilū walaw kāna dhā qur'bā wabiʿahdi l-lahi awfū dhālikum waṣṣākum bihi laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.english: You shall not touch the orphans' money except in the most righteous manner, until they reach maturity. You shall give full weight and a full measure when you trade, equitably. We do not burden any soul beyond its means. You shall be absolutely just when you bear witness, even against your relatives. You shall fulfill your covenant with GOD. These are His commandments to you, that you may take heed.
verses.subtitle: Additional Commandments

1981.english: You shall not approach the orphan's money, except in a righteous manner, until he reaches maturity. When you trade, you shall give full measure and weight, equitably. We never burden any soul beyond its means. When you bear witness, you shall be just, even against your own relatives. You shall fulfill your vows to God. These are God's commandments, that you may take heed.

1989.english: You shall not approach the orphans’ money except in the most righteous manner, until they reach maturity. You shall give full weight and measure when you trade, equitably. We do not burden any soul beyond its means. You shall be absolutely just when you bear witness, even against your relatives. You shall fulfill your covenant with GOD. These are His commandments to you, that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأن هذا صراطي مستقيما فاتبعوه ۖ ولا تتبعوا السبل فتفرق بكم عن سبيله ۚ ذلكم وصاكم به لعلكم تتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-anna hādhā ṣirāṭī mus'taqīman fa-ittabiʿūhu walā tattabiʿū l-subula fatafarraqa bikum ʿan sabīlihi dhālikum waṣṣākum bihi laʿallakum tattaqūn
verses.english: This is My path—a straight one. You shall follow it, and do not follow any other paths, lest they divert you from His path. These are His commandments to you, that you may be saved.

1981.english: This is My straight path; you shall follow it, and do not follow any other paths, lest they take you away from the path of God. These are God's commandments, that you may attain salvation.

1989.english: This is My path—a straight one. You shall follow it, and do not follow other paths, lest they divert you from His path. These are His commandments to you, that you may be saved.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ تَمَامًا عَلَى ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم آتينا موسى الكتاب تماما على الذي أحسن وتفصيلا لكل شيء وهدى ورحمة لعلهم بلقاء ربهم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: thumma ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba tamāman ʿalā alladhī aḥsana watafṣīlan likulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan laʿallahum biliqāi rabbihim yu'minūn
verses.english: And we gave Moses the scripture, complete with the best commandments, and detailing everything, and a beacon and mercy, that they may believe in meeting their Lord.

1981.english: We have given the scripture to Moses, detailing what is right, and explaining everything, and providing guidance and mercy, that they may believe in meeting their Lord.

1989.english: We gave Moses the scripture, complete with the best commandments, and detailing everything, and a beacon and mercy, that they may believe in meeting their Lord.

verses.arabic: وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهذا كتاب أنزلناه مبارك فاتبعوه واتقوا لعلكم ترحمون
verses.transliterated: wahādhā kitābun anzalnāhu mubārakun fa-ittabiʿūhu wa-ittaqū laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.english: This too is a blessed scripture that we have revealed; you shall follow it and lead a righteous life, that you may attain mercy.

1981.english: Similarly, this is a blessed scripture that we sent down; you shall follow it and work righteousness, that you may attain mercy.

1989.english: This too is a blessed scripture that we have revealed; you shall follow it and lead a righteous life, that you may attain mercy.

verses.arabic: أَن تَقُولُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ عَلَىٰ طَآئِفَتَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِنَا وَإِن كُنَّا عَن دِرَاسَتِهِمْ لَغَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أن تقولوا إنما أنزل الكتاب على طائفتين من قبلنا وإن كنا عن دراستهم لغافلين
verses.transliterated: an taqūlū innamā unzila l-kitābu ʿalā ṭāifatayni min qablinā wa-in kunnā ʿan dirāsatihim laghāfilīn
verses.english: Now you can no longer say, "The scripture was sent down to two groups before us, and we were unaware of their teachings."

1981.english: Thus, you cannot say, "The scripture was sent down for two previous groups, and we were unaware of their teachings."

1989.english: Now you can no longer say, “The scripture was sent down to two groups prior to us, and we were totally unaware of their teachings.”

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَقُولُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَكُنَّآ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنْهَا سَنَجْزِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْدِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أو تقولوا لو أنا أنزل علينا الكتاب لكنا أهدى منهم ۚ فقد جاءكم بينة من ربكم وهدى ورحمة ۚ فمن أظلم ممن كذب بآيات الله وصدف عنها ۗ سنجزي الذين يصدفون عن آياتنا سوء العذاب بما كانوا يصدفون
verses.transliterated: aw taqūlū law annā unzila ʿalaynā l-kitābu lakunnā ahdā min'hum faqad jāakum bayyinatun min rabbikum wahudan waraḥmatun faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba biāyāti l-lahi waṣadafa ʿanhā sanajzī alladhīna yaṣdifūna ʿan āyātinā sūa l-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yaṣdifūn
verses.english: Nor can you say, "If only a scripture could come down to us, we would be better guided than they." A proven scripture has now come to you from your Lord, and a beacon, and a mercy. Now, who is more evil than one who rejects these proofs from GOD, and disregards them? We will commit those who disregard our proofs to the worst retribution, for their heedlessness.
verses.subtitle: Mathematics: The Ultimate Proof
verses.footnote: The role of the Quran's mathematical code is evident from the fact that the sum of the verse number (157) plus the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), through whom the code was revealed, gives 1387, or 19x73.

1981.english: Nor can you say, "Had the scripture been sent down to us, we would have been better guided than they." A profound message has come to you from your Lord, and guidance and mercy. Consequently, who is more evil than one who rejects the revelations of God, and disregards them? We will punish those who disregard our revelation, a terrible punishment, for their heedlessness.

1989.english: Nor can you say, “If only a scripture could come down to us, we would be better guided than they.” A proven scripture has now come to you from your Lord, and a beacon, and a mercy. Thus, who is more evil than one who rejects these revelations of GOD, and disregards them? We will commit those who disregard our revelations to the worst retribution, as a consequence of their heedlessness.
1989.subtitle: Mathematics: The Ultimate Proof

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ رَبُّكَ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ بَعْضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِى بَعْضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَٰنُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ ءَامَنَتْ مِن قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِىٓ إِيمَٰنِهَا خَيْرًا قُلِ ٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة أو يأتي ربك أو يأتي بعض آيات ربك ۗ يوم يأتي بعض آيات ربك لا ينفع نفسا إيمانها لم تكن آمنت من قبل أو كسبت في إيمانها خيرا ۗ قل انتظروا إنا منتظرون
verses.transliterated: hal yanẓurūna illā an tatiyahumu l-malāikatu aw yatiya rabbuka aw yatiya baʿḍu āyāti rabbika yawma yatī baʿḍu āyāti rabbika lā yanfaʿu nafsan īmānuhā lam takun āmanat min qablu aw kasabat fī īmānihā khayran quli intaẓirū innā muntaẓirūn
verses.english: Are they waiting for the angels to come to them, or your Lord, or some physical manifestations of your Lord? The day this happens, no soul will benefit from believing if it did not believe before that, and did not reap the benefits of belief by leading a righteous life. Say, "Keep on waiting; we too are waiting."
verses.subtitle: Requirements of the Test
verses.footnote: After believing, the soul must grow and develop through the worship practices prescribed by God.

1981.english: Are they waiting until the angels, or your Lord, or some profound signs come to them? The day some profound signs come from your Lord, it will be too late for anyone to believe who has not believed already and gained righteousness. Say, "Keep waiting, and we too will wait."

1989.english: Are they waiting for the angels to come to them, or your Lord, or some manifestations of your Lord? The day this happens, no soul will benefit from believing if it did not believe before that, and did not reap the benefits of belief by leading a righteous life.* Say, “Keep on waiting; we too will wait.”
1989.footnote: After believing, the soul must grow and develop through the worship practices prescribed by God.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا لَّسْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِى شَىْءٍ إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُمْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعا لست منهم في شيء ۚ إنما أمرهم إلى الله ثم ينبئهم بما كانوا يفعلون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿan lasta min'hum fī shayin innamā amruhum ilā l-lahi thumma yunabbi-uhum bimā kānū yafʿalūn
verses.english: Those who divide themselves into sects do not belong with you. Their judgment rests with GOD, then He will inform them of everything they had done.
verses.subtitle: Religious Sects Condemned

1981.english: Those who divide their religion into sects do not belong with you (O Muhammad). Their judgment rests with God, and He will inform them of everything they did.
1981.subtitle: One Quran; One Islam
1981.footnote: The only reason behind the existence of several Islamic sects today is that the Muslims have abandoned the Quran in favor of the human opinions of their leaders, who are in fact their idols. The single most important factor contributing to this unholy division is the invention of "Hadith" and "Sunna." Ironically, the prophet Muhammad will be the first to disown those who follow "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" on the day of judgment, just as those who idolize Jesus will be disowned by him. Those who obey God and the prophet are those who uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see Appendix 15). Since there is only one Quran, there should be one Islam, and one Islamic congregation. As we learned from verses 19, 38, and 114 of this sura, the Quran is fully detailed, and needs no further explanation. Moreover, God Himself has informed us that only He will explain the Quran, as He puts it in the hearts of those worthy of it (see 40:44 and 75:19).

1989.english: Those who divide themselves into sects do not belong with you. Their judgment rests with GOD; He will then inform them of everything they had done.
1989.subtitle: Religious Sects Condemned

verses.arabic: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من جاء بالحسنة فله عشر أمثالها ۖ ومن جاء بالسيئة فلا يجزى إلا مثلها وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: man jāa bil-ḥasanati falahu ʿashru amthālihā waman jāa bil-sayi-ati falā yuj'zā illā mith'lahā wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: Whoever does a righteous work receives the reward for ten, and the one who commits a sin is requited for only one. No one suffers the slightest injustice.

1981.english: Whoever does one righteous work, will be rewarded for ten; while the one who commits a sin is punished for only one. No one will suffer injustice.

1989.english: Whoever does a righteous work receives the reward for ten, and the one who commits a sin is requited for only one. No one suffers the slightest injustice.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّنِى هَدَىٰنِى رَبِّىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا مِّلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إنني هداني ربي إلى صراط مستقيم دينا قيما ملة إبراهيم حنيفا ۚ وما كان من المشركين
verses.transliterated: qul innanī hadānī rabbī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin dīnan qiyaman millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord has guided me in a straight path—the perfect religion of Abraham, monotheism. He never was an idol worshiper."

1981.english: Say (O Muhammad), "My Lord has guided me in a straight path; the perfect religion of Abraham, the devoted monotheist; never was he an idol worshiper."
1981.subtitle: Muhammad: A Follower of Abraham
1981.footnote: When the false Muslims (see footnote 6:112-116) who follow "Hadith" and "Sunna" are faced with the Quranic reality that the Quran shall be the sole source of religious knowledge (6:19, 38, &114), their favorite argument is, "If the Quran is complete (see 6:114), where is the description of salat prayers?" This famous question reveals their ignorance and isolation from Quran. They are obviously unaware of the Quran's statements that salat was originally revealed to Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation, and that Muhammad prayed according to the religion of Abraham, Islam, before he, Muhammad, was appointed a messenger (see 2:128, 2:135, 3:67-68, 3:95, 4:125, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, 22:78, and Appendix 8).

1989.english: Say, “My Lord has guided me in a straight path: the perfect religion of Abraham, monotheism. He never was an idol worshiper.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن صلاتي ونسكي ومحياي ومماتي لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qul inna ṣalātī wanusukī wamaḥyāya wamamātī lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Say, "My Contact Prayers (Salat), my worship practices, my life and my death, are all devoted absolutely to GOD alone, the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: Say, "My salat prayers, my worship, and my life and death, belong to the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: Say, “My contact prayers (Salat), my worship practices, my life and my death, all belong to GOD, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا شريك له ۖ وبذلك أمرت وأنا أول المسلمين
verses.transliterated: lā sharīka lahu wabidhālika umir'tu wa-anā awwalu l-mus'limīn
verses.english: "He has no partner. This is what I am commanded to believe, and I am the first to submit."

1981.english: "He has no partner. These are the commandments given to me, and I am the first to submit."

1989.english: “He has no partner. This is what I am commanded to believe, and I am the first to submit.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْغِى رَبًّا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَلَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْهَا وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أغير الله أبغي ربا وهو رب كل شيء ۚ ولا تكسب كل نفس إلا عليها ۚ ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ۚ ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم فيه تختلفون
verses.transliterated: qul aghayra l-lahi abghī rabban wahuwa rabbu kulli shayin walā taksibu kullu nafsin illā ʿalayhā walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn
verses.english: Say, "Shall I seek other than GOD as a lord, when He is the Lord of all things? No soul benefits except from its own works, and none bears the burden of another. Ultimately, you return to your Lord, then He informs you regarding all your disputes."

1981.english: Say, "Shall I seek other than God as a Lord, when He is the Lord of all things?" Whatever anyone earns is for his own account. No burdened soul will bear the burdens of another. To your Lord is your ultimate return, then He will inform you of everything you disputed.

1989.english: Say, “Shall I seek other than GOD as a lord, when He is the Lord of all things? No soul benefits except from its own works, and none bears the burden of another. Ultimately, you return to your Lord, then He informs you regarding all your disputes.”

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَٰتٍ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي جعلكم خلائف الأرض ورفع بعضكم فوق بعض درجات ليبلوكم في ما آتاكم ۗ إن ربك سريع العقاب وإنه لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa l-arḍi warafaʿa baʿḍakum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyabluwakum fī mā ātākum inna rabbaka sarīʿu l-ʿiqābi wa-innahu laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth, and He raised some of you above others in rank, in order to test you in accordance with what He has given you. Surely, your Lord is efficient in enforcing retribution, and He is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: He is the one who made you inherit the earth, and He raised some of you above others, in order to put you to the test. Your Lord is swift in imposing retribution, and He is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth, and He raised some of you above others in rank, in order to test you in accordance with what He has given you. Surely, your Lord is efficient in enforcing retribution, and He is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: الٓمٓصٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم المص
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-meem-saad
verses.english: A. L. M. S.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the role of these initials in the Quran's mathematical miracle.

1981.english: A. L. M. S.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 1 for details of the Quran's secret numerical code, and the meaning of these Quranic initials.

1989.english: A.L. M. S.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the role of these initials in the Quran’s mathematical miracle. *7-9 Failing to heed our Creator leads to starvation and eventual “loss” of the soul.

verses.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُن فِى صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنْهُ لِتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كتاب أنزل إليك فلا يكن في صدرك حرج منه لتنذر به وذكرى للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: kitābun unzila ilayka falā yakun fī ṣadrika ḥarajun min'hu litundhira bihi wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: This scripture has been revealed to you—you shall not harbor doubt about it in your heart—that you may warn with it, and to provide a reminder for the believers.

1981.english: This scripture is God's revelation to you; let not any doubt enter your heart. It is sent down to you, to preach therewith, and to serve as a message to the believers.
1981.subtitle: Quran: The Only Source of Islamic Knowledge

1989.english: This scripture has been revealed to you—you shall harbor no doubt about it in your heart—that you may preach with it, and to serve as a reminder for the believers.

verses.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: اتبعوا ما أنزل إليكم من ربكم ولا تتبعوا من دونه أولياء ۗ قليلا ما تذكرون
verses.transliterated: ittabiʿū mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum walā tattabiʿū min dūnihi awliyāa qalīlan mā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: You shall all follow what is revealed to you from your Lord; do not follow any idols besides Him. Rarely do you take heed.

1981.english: You shall follow what is sent down to you from your Lord, and do not follow any idols besides Him.* Only a few of you take heed.
1981.footnote: Those who worship God alone, follow God's scripture alone. Those who follow anything else as a source of jurisprudence are idol worshipers, as defined by this verse.

1989.english: You shall follow what is revealed to you from your Lord, and do not follow any other sources besides it. Rarely do you take heed.

verses.arabic: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَٰتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكم من قرية أهلكناها فجاءها بأسنا بياتا أو هم قائلون
verses.transliterated: wakam min qaryatin ahlaknāhā fajāahā basunā bayātan aw hum qāilūn
verses.english: Many a community we annihilated; they incurred our retribution while they were asleep, or wide awake.

1981.english: We have annihilated many communities, and our retribution came to them as they slept, or wide awake.

1989.english: Many a community that we annihilated incurred our retribution while they were asleep, or wide awake.

verses.arabic: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَآ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما كان دعواهم إذ جاءهم بأسنا إلا أن قالوا إنا كنا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: famā kāna daʿwāhum idh jāahum basunā illā an qālū innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.english: Their utterance when our retribution came to them was: "Indeed, we have been transgressors."

1981.english: They had no discourse, when our retribution came to them, but to say, "We have been wrong indeed."

1989.english: Their utterance when our retribution came to them was: “Indeed, we have been wicked.”

verses.arabic: فَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلنسألن الذين أرسل إليهم ولنسألن المرسلين
verses.transliterated: falanasalanna alladhīna ur'sila ilayhim walanasalanna l-mur'salīn
verses.english: We will certainly question those who received the message, and we will question the messengers.

1981.english: Certainly, we will question those who received the message, and certainly, we will question the messengers.

1989.english: We will certainly question those who received the message, and we will question the messengers.

verses.arabic: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِم بِعِلْمٍ وَمَا كُنَّا غَآئِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلنقصن عليهم بعلم ۖ وما كنا غائبين
verses.transliterated: falanaquṣṣanna ʿalayhim biʿil'min wamā kunnā ghāibīn
verses.english: We will inform them authoritatively, for we were never absent.

1981.english: We will then inform them with real knowledge, for we were never absent.

1989.english: We will inform them authoritatively, for we were never absent.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والوزن يومئذ الحق ۚ فمن ثقلت موازينه فأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: wal-waznu yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: The scales will be set on that day, equitably. Those whose weights are heavy will be the winners.

1981.english: The weighing on that day will be equitable. As for those whose weights are heavy, they are the winners.

1989.english: The scales will be set on that day, equitably. Those whose weights are heavy will be the winners.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن خفت موازينه فأولئك الذين خسروا أنفسهم بما كانوا بآياتنا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum bimā kānū biāyātinā yaẓlimūn
verses.english: As for those whose weights are light, they will be the ones who lost their souls, as a consequence of disregarding our revelations, unjustly.
verses.footnote: Failing to heed our Creator leads to spiritual starvation and eventual "loss" of the soul.

1981.english: Those whose weights are light will be the losers; they have lost their souls as a consequence of discarding our revelations.

1989.english: As for those whose weights are light, they will be the ones who lost their souls,* as a consequence of disregarding our revelations.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد مكناكم في الأرض وجعلنا لكم فيها معايش ۗ قليلا ما تشكرون
verses.transliterated: walaqad makkannākum fī l-arḍi wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha qalīlan mā tashkurūn
verses.english: We have established you on earth, and we have provided for you the means of support therein. Rarely are you appreciative.

1981.english: We put you in control of the earth, and established for you provisions therein. Only a few of you are appreciative.

1989.english: We have established you on earth, and we have provided for you the means of support therein. Rarely are you appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَٰكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد خلقناكم ثم صورناكم ثم قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس لم يكن من الساجدين
verses.transliterated: walaqad khalaqnākum thumma ṣawwarnākum thumma qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa lam yakun mina l-sājidīn
verses.english: We created you, then we shaped you, then we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Iblees (Satan); he was not with the prostrators.

1981.english: We created you, then shaped you, then said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Iblis (Satan); he was not with the prostrators.
1981.subtitle: Satan: The Great Challenge
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: We created you, then we shaped you, then we said to the angels, “You shall fall prostrate before Adam.” They fell prostrate, except Iblees (Satan); he was not with the prostrators.

verses.arabic: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال ما منعك ألا تسجد إذ أمرتك ۖ قال أنا خير منه خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
verses.transliterated: qāla mā manaʿaka allā tasjuda idh amartuka qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīni
verses.english: He said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I ordered you?" He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from mud."
verses.subtitle: The Test Begins

1981.english: God said, "What prevented you from prostrating, when I ordered you?" He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from clay."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “What prevented you from prostrating when I ordered you?” He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from mud.”
1989.subtitle: The Test Begins

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَن تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَٱخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰغِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فاهبط منها فما يكون لك أن تتكبر فيها فاخرج إنك من الصاغرين
verses.transliterated: qāla fa-ih'biṭ min'hā famā yakūnu laka an tatakabbara fīhā fa-ukh'ruj innaka mina l-ṣāghirīn
verses.english: He said, "Therefore, you must go down, for you are not to be arrogant here. Get out; you are debased."

1981.english: God said, "Therefore, go down therefrom, for you are not to be proud therein. Get out; you are debased."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “Therefore, you must go down, for you are not to be arrogant here. Get out; you are debased.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال أنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون
verses.transliterated: qāla anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: He said, "Grant me a respite, until the Day of Resurrection."

1981.english: He said, "Respite me till the day of resurrection."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “Grant me a respite, until the Day of Resurrection.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إنك من المنظرين
verses.transliterated: qāla innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verses.english: He said, "You are granted a respite."

1981.english: God said, "You are respited."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “You are granted a respite.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فبما أغويتني لأقعدن لهم صراطك المستقيم
verses.transliterated: qāla fabimā aghwaytanī la-aqʿudanna lahum ṣirāṭaka l-mus'taqīm
verses.english: He said, "Since You have willed that I go astray, I will skulk for them on Your straight path.
verses.footnote: Satan is a proven liar, and so are his constituents (see 2:36, 6:22-23, & 7:20).

1981.english: He said, "Since You willed that I go astray, I will always skulk on Your straight path, and mislead them.
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “Since You have willed that I go astray,* I will skulk for them on Your straight path.
1989.footnote: Satan is a proven liar, and so are his constituents (see 2:36, 6:22-23, & 7:20).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمْ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم لآتينهم من بين أيديهم ومن خلفهم وعن أيمانهم وعن شمائلهم ۖ ولا تجد أكثرهم شاكرين
verses.transliterated: thumma laātiyannahum min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim waʿan aymānihim waʿan shamāilihim walā tajidu aktharahum shākirīn
verses.english: "I will come to them from before them, and from behind them, and from their right, and from their left, and You will find that most of them are unappreciative."

1981.english: "Then I will come to them from their front, from behind them, from their right, and from their left, and You will find most of them unappreciative."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: “I will come to them from their front, and from their back, and from their right, and from their left, and You will find most of them unappreciative.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًا مَّدْحُورًا لَّمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال اخرج منها مذءوما مدحورا ۖ لمن تبعك منهم لأملأن جهنم منكم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: qāla ukh'ruj min'hā madhūman madḥūran laman tabiʿaka min'hum la-amla-anna jahannama minkum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: He said, "Get out therefrom, despised and defeated. Those among them who follow you, I will fill Hell with you all.

1981.english: God said, "You are evicted therefrom, despised and debased. Those who follow you, will join you in hell.
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “Get out therefrom, despised and defeated. Those among them who follow you, I will fill Hell with you all.

verses.arabic: وَيَٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويا آدم اسكن أنت وزوجك الجنة فكلا من حيث شئتما ولا تقربا هذه الشجرة فتكونا من الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wayāādamu us'kun anta wazawjuka l-janata fakulā min ḥaythu shi'tumā walā taqrabā hādhihi l-shajarata fatakūnā mina l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: "As for you, Adam, dwell with your wife in Paradise, and eat therefrom as you please, but do not approach this one tree, lest you fall in sin."

1981.english: "As for you, Adam, dwell with your wife in Paradise, and eat therefrom as you please. But do not approach this one tree, lest you become wrongdoers."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: “As for you, Adam, dwell with your wife in Paradise, and eat therefrom as you please, but do not approach this one tree, lest you transgress.”

verses.arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُۥرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْءَٰتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَىٰكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْخَٰلِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فوسوس لهما الشيطان ليبدي لهما ما ووري عنهما من سوآتهما وقال ما نهاكما ربكما عن هذه الشجرة إلا أن تكونا ملكين أو تكونا من الخالدين
verses.transliterated: fawaswasa lahumā l-shayṭānu liyub'diya lahumā mā wūriya ʿanhumā min sawātihimā waqāla mā nahākumā rabbukumā ʿan hādhihi l-shajarati illā an takūnā malakayni aw takūnā mina l-khālidīn
verses.english: The devil whispered to them, in order to reveal their bodies, which were invisible to them. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you from this tree, except to prevent you from becoming angels, and from attaining eternal existence."

1981.english: But the devil whispered to them, in order to expose what was hidden from them, namely, their bodies. He said, "Your Lord did not prohibit you from this tree, except to prevent you from becoming angels, or becoming immortal."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: The devil whispered to them, in order to reveal their bodies, which were invisible to them. He said, “Your Lord did not forbid you from this tree, except to prevent you from becoming angels, and from attaining eternal existence.”

verses.arabic: وَقَاسَمَهُمَآ إِنِّى لَكُمَا لَمِنَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقاسمهما إني لكما لمن الناصحين
verses.transliterated: waqāsamahumā innī lakumā lamina l-nāṣiḥīn
verses.english: He swore to them, "I am giving you good advice."

1981.english: And he swore to them, "I am sincerely advising you."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He swore to them, “I am giving you good advice.”

verses.arabic: فَدَلَّىٰهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا ٱلشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَادَىٰهُمَا رَبُّهُمَآ أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَن تِلْكُمَا ٱلشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُل لَّكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: فدلاهما بغرور ۚ فلما ذاقا الشجرة بدت لهما سوآتهما وطفقا يخصفان عليهما من ورق الجنة ۖ وناداهما ربهما ألم أنهكما عن تلكما الشجرة وأقل لكما إن الشيطان لكما عدو مبين
verses.transliterated: fadallāhumā bighurūrin falammā dhāqā l-shajarata badat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati wanādāhumā rabbuhumā alam anhakumā ʿan til'kumā l-shajarati wa-aqul lakumā inna l-shayṭāna lakumā ʿaduwwun mubīnu
verses.english: He thus duped them with lies. As soon as they tasted the tree, their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Their Lord called upon them: "Did I not enjoin you from that tree, and warn you that the devil is your most ardent enemy?"

1981.english: He thus duped them, and when they tasted the tree, their bodies became visible to them, and they started to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Their Lord called upon them, "Did I not forbid you from this tree, and tell you that the devil is your ardent enemy?"
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He thus duped them with lies. As soon as they tasted the tree, their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Their Lord called to them, “Did I not enjoin you from that tree, and warn you that the devil is your most ardent enemy?”

verses.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالا ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: qālā rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa-in lam taghfir lanā watarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged our souls, and unless You forgive us and have mercy on us, we will be losers."

1981.english: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged our souls and unless you forgive us, and have mercy on us, we will be losers."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: They said, “Our Lord, we have wronged our souls, and unless You forgive us and have mercy on us, we will be losers.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال اهبطوا بعضكم لبعض عدو ۖ ولكم في الأرض مستقر ومتاع إلى حين
verses.transliterated: qāla ih'biṭū baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun walakum fī l-arḍi mus'taqarrun wamatāʿun ilā ḥīni
verses.english: He said, "Go down as enemies of one another. On earth shall be your habitation and provision for awhile."

1981.english: God said, "Go down therefrom, as enemies of one another. On earth will be your habitation and provision for a while."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “Go down as enemies of one another. On earth shall be your habitation and provision for awhile.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فيها تحيون وفيها تموتون ومنها تخرجون
verses.transliterated: qāla fīhā taḥyawna wafīhā tamūtūna wamin'hā tukh'rajūn
verses.english: He said, "On it you will live, on it you will die, and from it you will be brought out."

1981.english: God said, "You will live therein, die therein, and get resurrected thereon."
1981.footnote: Why were we created? Although the angels saw God, and knew that He was the absolute master, Satan entertained rebellious ideas inside his head, and God knew about these ideas (see 2:30). In order to expose Satan's rebellious ideas, God created Adam, and ordered the angels to bow down to him. The other reason for creating us is to show the angels that a creature who never sees God can reach God and worship Him alone. (See Appendix 6 for details).

1989.english: He said, “On it you will live, on it you will die, and from it you will be brought out.”

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ قَدْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَٰتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا وَلِبَاسُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني آدم قد أنزلنا عليكم لباسا يواري سوآتكم وريشا ۖ ولباس التقوى ذلك خير ۚ ذلك من آيات الله لعلهم يذكرون
verses.transliterated: yābanī ādama qad anzalnā ʿalaykum libāsan yuwārī sawātikum warīshan walibāsu l-taqwā dhālika khayrun dhālika min āyāti l-lahi laʿallahum yadhakkarūn
verses.english: O children of Adam, we have provided you with garments to cover your bodies, as well as for luxury. But the best garment is the garment of righteousness. These are some of GOD's signs, that they may take heed.

1981.english: O children of Adam, we have sent down to you garments to cover your bodies, and to serve as luxury. The garment of righteousness is the best. These are God's revelations to you, that you may take heed.
