1989.english: O children of Adam, we have provided you with garments to cover your bodies, as well as for luxury. But the best garment is the garment of righteousness. These are some of GOD’s signs, that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ كَمَآ أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَنزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتِهِمَآ إِنَّهُۥ يَرَىٰكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُۥ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني آدم لا يفتننكم الشيطان كما أخرج أبويكم من الجنة ينزع عنهما لباسهما ليريهما سوآتهما ۗ إنه يراكم هو وقبيله من حيث لا ترونهم ۗ إنا جعلنا الشياطين أولياء للذين لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: yābanī ādama lā yaftinannakumu l-shayṭānu kamā akhraja abawaykum mina l-janati yanziʿu ʿanhumā libāsahumā liyuriyahumā sawātihimā innahu yarākum huwa waqabīluhu min ḥaythu lā tarawnahum innā jaʿalnā l-shayāṭīna awliyāa lilladhīna lā yu'minūn
verses.english: O children of Adam, do not let the devil dupe you as he did when he caused the eviction of your parents from Paradise, and the removal of their garments to expose their bodies. He and his tribe see you, while you do not see them. We appoint the devils as companions of those who do not believe.

1981.english: O children of Adam, let not the devil mislead you, as he evicted your parents from Paradise, and removed their garments in order to show them their bodies. He and his tribe can see you, while you cannot see them. We have assigned the devils as companions to those who do not believe.

1989.english: O children of Adam, do not let the devil entice you as he did when he evicted your parents from Paradise. He removed their garments to expose their bodies. He and his tribe see you, while you do not see them. We appoint the devils as companions for those who do not believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَٰحِشَةً قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَآ ءَابَآءَنَا وَٱللَّهُ أَمَرَنَا بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا فعلوا فاحشة قالوا وجدنا عليها آباءنا والله أمرنا بها ۗ قل إن الله لا يأمر بالفحشاء ۖ أتقولون على الله ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā faʿalū fāḥishatan qālū wajadnā ʿalayhā ābāanā wal-lahu amaranā bihā qul inna l-laha lā yamuru bil-faḥshāi ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: They commit a gross sin, then say, "We found our parents doing this, and GOD has commanded us to do it." Say, "GOD never advocates sin. Are you saying about GOD what you do not know?"
verses.subtitle: Examine All Inherited Information

1981.english: They commit evil, then say, "We found our parents doing this, and God commanded us to do it." Say, "God never advocates evil. Do you say about God what you do not know?"
1981.subtitle: God Never Advocates Evil

1989.english: They commit a gross evil, then say, “We found our parents doing this, and GOD has commanded us to do it.” Say, “GOD never advocates evil. How dare you say about GOD what you do not know?”
1989.subtitle: Examine All Inherited Information

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَمَرَ رَبِّى بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ كَمَا بَدَأَكُمْ تَعُودُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أمر ربي بالقسط ۖ وأقيموا وجوهكم عند كل مسجد وادعوه مخلصين له الدين ۚ كما بدأكم تعودون
verses.transliterated: qul amara rabbī bil-qis'ṭi wa-aqīmū wujūhakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna kamā bada-akum taʿūdūn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord advocates justice, and to stand devoted to Him alone at every place of worship. You shall devote your worship absolutely to Him alone. Just as He initiated you, you will ultimately go back to Him."

1981.english: Say, "My Lord advocates justice, and to devote yourselves completely to the worship of God alone, at every place of worship. He is the one who created you, and He is the one who resurrects you."

1989.english: Say, “My Lord advocates justice, and to stand devoted to Him at every place of worship. You shall devote your worship absolutely to Him alone. Just as He initiated you, you will ultimately go back to Him.”

verses.arabic: فَرِيقًا هَدَىٰ وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ إِنَّهُمُ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فريقا هدى وفريقا حق عليهم الضلالة ۗ إنهم اتخذوا الشياطين أولياء من دون الله ويحسبون أنهم مهتدون
verses.transliterated: farīqan hadā wafarīqan ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-ḍalālatu innahumu ittakhadhū l-shayāṭīna awliyāa min dūni l-lahi wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūn
verses.english: Some He guided, while others are committed to straying. They have taken the devils as their masters, instead of GOD, yet they believe that they are guided.
verses.subtitle: Beware: They Believe that They Are Guided

1981.english: He guides some people, while others are committed to straying. They have chosen the devils as masters, instead of God, and they think they are guided.
1981.footnote: Those who follow and advocate "**Hadith**" and/or "**Sunna**" firmly believe that they are righteous, and that they are duely honoring and obeying the prophet! Thus, they are exactly like the Christians who firmly believe that they are duely honoring and obeying Jesus. The Quranic fact, however, is that these people have fallen in Satan's formidable trap, as indicated by this verse (see also 6:112-116).

1989.english: Some He guided, while others are committed to straying. They have taken the devils as their masters, instead of GOD, yet they think that they are guided.

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ خُذُوا۟ زِينَتَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَكُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني آدم خذوا زينتكم عند كل مسجد وكلوا واشربوا ولا تسرفوا ۚ إنه لا يحب المسرفين
verses.transliterated: yābanī ādama khudhū zīnatakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wakulū wa-ish'rabū walā tus'rifū innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'rifīn
verses.english: O children of Adam, you shall be clean and dress nicely when you go to the masjid. And eat and drink moderately. Surely, He does not love the gluttons.
verses.subtitle: Dress Nicely For The Masjid

1981.english: O children of Adam, you shall dress nicely when you go to the mosque. And eat and drink moderately, for God loves not the gluttonous.

1989.english: O children of Adam, you shall be clean and dress nicely when you go to the mosque. You shall eat and drink moderately; GOD does not love excesses.
1989.subtitle: Dress Nicely For The Mosque

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ وَٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلرِّزْقِ قُلْ هِىَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل من حرم زينة الله التي أخرج لعباده والطيبات من الرزق ۚ قل هي للذين آمنوا في الحياة الدنيا خالصة يوم القيامة ۗ كذلك نفصل الآيات لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: qul man ḥarrama zīnata l-lahi allatī akhraja liʿibādihi wal-ṭayibāti mina l-riz'qi qul hiya lilladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā khāliṣatan yawma l-qiyāmati kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "Who prohibited the nice things GOD has created for His creatures, and the good provisions?" Say, "Such provisions are to be enjoyed in this life by those who believe. Moreover, the good provisions will be exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection." We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
verses.subtitle: Innovated Prohibitions Condemned

1981.english: Say, "Who has forbidden the nice things that God produces for His creatures, and the good provisions?" Say, "For those who believe in this life, these things will be exclusively theirs on the day of resurrection." We thus explain the revelations for those who know.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit Lawful Things
1981.footnote: If it is not SPECIFICALLY prohibited in Quran, it must not be prohibited.

1989.english: Say, “Who prohibited the nice things GOD has created for His creatures, and the good provisions?” Say, “Such provisions are to be enjoyed in this life by those who believe. Moreover, the good provisions will be exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection.” We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
1989.subtitle: Innovated Prohibitions Condemned

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّىَ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَٱلْإِثْمَ وَٱلْبَغْىَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَأَن تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا وَأَن تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إنما حرم ربي الفواحش ما ظهر منها وما بطن والإثم والبغي بغير الحق وأن تشركوا بالله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا وأن تقولوا على الله ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qul innamā ḥarrama rabbiya l-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara min'hā wamā baṭana wal-ith'ma wal-baghya bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-an tush'rikū bil-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wa-an taqūlū ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord prohibits only evil deeds, be they obvious or hidden, and sins, and unjustifiable aggression, and to set up beside GOD powerless idols, and to say about GOD what you do not know."

1981.english: Say, "My Lord prohibits only evil works, be them obvious or hidden, and sinfulness, and aggression without justification, and to set up powerless idols besides Him, and to invent lies then attribute them to God."

1989.english: Say, “My Lord prohibits only evil deeds, be they obvious or hidden, and sins, and unjustifiable aggression, and to set up besides Him powerless idols, and to say about GOD what you do not know.”

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكل أمة أجل ۖ فإذا جاء أجلهم لا يستأخرون ساعة ۖ ولا يستقدمون
verses.transliterated: walikulli ummatin ajalun fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūn
verses.english: For each community, there is a predetermined life span. Once their interim comes to an end, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.

1981.english: Each community has a predetermined life span; once their end comes, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.

1989.english: For each community, there is a predetermined life span. Once their interim comes to an end, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ إِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني آدم إما يأتينكم رسل منكم يقصون عليكم آياتي ۙ فمن اتقى وأصلح فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: yābanī ādama immā yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātī famani ittaqā wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: O children of Adam, when messengers come to you from among you, and recite My revelations to you, those who take heed and lead a righteous life, will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.subtitle: Messengers From Among You

1981.english: O children of Adam, when messengers from among you come to you preaching My revelations, those among you who observe righteousness and reform, will have nothing to worry about, nor will they grieve.
1981.subtitle: Follow the Teachings of God Alone

1989.english: O children of Adam, when messengers come to you from among you, and recite My revelations to you, those who lead a righteous life and take heed, will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1989.subtitle: Messengers From Among You

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ عَنْهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كذبوا بآياتنا واستكبروا عنها أولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: As for those who reject our revelations, and are too arrogant to uphold them, they have incurred Hell, wherein they abide forever.

1981.english: As for those who reject our revelations, and are too arrogant to accept them, they have deserved hell; they abide therein forever.

1989.english: As for those who reject our revelations, and are too arrogant to accept them, they are destined for Hell; they abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته ۚ أولئك ينالهم نصيبهم من الكتاب ۖ حتى إذا جاءتهم رسلنا يتوفونهم قالوا أين ما كنتم تدعون من دون الله ۖ قالوا ضلوا عنا وشهدوا على أنفسهم أنهم كانوا كافرين
verses.transliterated: faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi ulāika yanāluhum naṣībuhum mina l-kitābi ḥattā idhā jāathum rusulunā yatawaffawnahum qālū ayna mā kuntum tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā washahidū ʿalā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīn
verses.english: Who is more evil than those who invent lies about GOD, or reject His revelations? These will get their share, in accordance with the scripture, then, when our messengers come to terminate their lives, they will say, "Where are the idols you used to implore beside GOD?" They will say, "They have abandoned us." They will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

1981.english: Who is more wicked than one who invents lies then attribute them to God, or rejects His revelations?* These will attain their due share in this life, then, when our messengers come to terminate their lives, they will say, "Where are those idols that you set up besides God?" They will answer, "They have abandoned us." They will bear witness against themselves, that they were disbelievers.
1981.footnote: The followers of "**Hadith**" are committing both evils; they invent lies then claim that they are divine inspiration, and they reject God's revelations in this Quran stating clearly that the Quran is complete, perfect, needs no explanation, and shall be the sole source of jurisprudence (see 6:19, 38, 112-116, and 75:19).

1989.english: Who is more evil than those who invent lies about GOD, or reject His revelations? These will get their share, in accordance with the scripture, then, when our messengers come to terminate their lives, they will say, “Where are the idols you used to implore besides GOD?” They will say, “They have abandoned us.” They will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ فِى ٱلنَّارِ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَّعَنَتْ أُخْتَهَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱدَّٰرَكَوا۟ فِيهَا جَمِيعًا قَالَتْ أُخْرَىٰهُمْ لِأُولَىٰهُمْ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَضَلُّونَا فَـَٔاتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال ادخلوا في أمم قد خلت من قبلكم من الجن والإنس في النار ۖ كلما دخلت أمة لعنت أختها ۖ حتى إذا اداركوا فيها جميعا قالت أخراهم لأولاهم ربنا هؤلاء أضلونا فآتهم عذابا ضعفا من النار ۖ قال لكل ضعف ولكن لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qāla ud'khulū fī umamin qad khalat min qablikum mina l-jini wal-insi fī l-nāri kullamā dakhalat ummatun laʿanat ukh'tahā ḥattā idhā iddārakū fīhā jamīʿan qālat ukh'rāhum liūlāhum rabbanā hāulāi aḍallūnā faātihim ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan mina l-nāri qāla likullin ḍiʿ'fun walākin lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: He will say, "Enter with the previous communities of jinns and humans into Hell." Every time a group enters, they will curse their ancestral group. Once they are all in it, the latest one will say of the previous one, "Our Lord, these are the ones who misled us. Give them double the retribution of Hell." He will say, "Each receives double, but you do not know."
verses.subtitle: Mutual Blaming

1981.english: God said, "Join the previous generations of Jinns and humans in hell." As each generation entered, they cursed each others. When all of them were gathered therein, the last one said of the first, "Our Lord, these people misguided us, so double the punishment for them." God said, "Each is suffering double, but you do not know."
1981.subtitle: What Happened on the Day of Judgment
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: He said, “Enter with the previous communities of jinns and humans into Hell.” Every time a community entered, they cursed the previous community. Once they were all in it, the later one said of the previous one, “Our Lord, these are the ones who misled us. Give them double the retribution of Hell.” He said, “Each receives double, but you do not know.”
1989.subtitle: Mutual Blaming

verses.arabic: وَقَالَتْ أُولَىٰهُمْ لِأُخْرَىٰهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالت أولاهم لأخراهم فما كان لكم علينا من فضل فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكسبون
verses.transliterated: waqālat ūlāhum li-ukh'rāhum famā kāna lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum taksibūn
verses.english: The ancestral group will say to the later group, "Since you had an advantage over us, taste the retribution for your own sins."

1981.english: And the first one said of the last, "Since you had an advantage over us, suffer the retribution for your own works."
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: The previous one said to the later one, “Since you had an advantage over us, taste the retribution for your own sins.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَٰبُ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ حَتَّىٰ يَلِجَ ٱلْجَمَلُ فِى سَمِّ ٱلْخِيَاطِ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كذبوا بآياتنا واستكبروا عنها لا تفتح لهم أبواب السماء ولا يدخلون الجنة حتى يلج الجمل في سم الخياط ۚ وكذلك نجزي المجرمين
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-is'takbarū ʿanhā lā tufattaḥu lahum abwābu l-samāi walā yadkhulūna l-janata ḥattā yalija l-jamalu fī sammi l-khiyāṭi wakadhālika najzī l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: Surely, those who reject our revelations and are too arrogant to uphold them, the gates of the sky will never open for them, nor will they enter Paradise until the camel passes through the needle's eye. We thus requite the guilty.
verses.subtitle: Rejecting God's Revelations: An Unforgivable Offense

1981.english: Indeed, those who reject our revelations, and were too arrogant to accept them, the gates of heaven will never open for them, until the camel can pass through the needle's eye. We thus requite the guilty.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: Surely, those who reject our revelations and are too arrogant to accept them, the gates of the sky will never open for them, nor will they enter Paradise until the camel passes through the needle’s eye. We thus requite the guilty.
1989.subtitle: Rejecting God’s Revelations Unforgivable Offense

verses.arabic: لَهُم مِّن جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَمِن فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لهم من جهنم مهاد ومن فوقهم غواش ۚ وكذلك نجزي الظالمين
verses.transliterated: lahum min jahannama mihādun wamin fawqihim ghawāshin wakadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: They have incurred Hell as an abode; they will have barriers above them. We thus requite the transgressors.

1981.english: Hell will be their abode, with barriers above them. We thus punish the wicked.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: They have incurred Hell as an abode, and will have barriers above them. We thus requite the transgressors.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها أولئك أصحاب الجنة ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—we never burden any soul beyond its means—these will be the dwellers of Paradise. They abide in it forever.

1981.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, and we never burden any soul beyond its means, they have deserved Paradise; they abide therein forever.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—we never burden any soul beyond its means—these have deserved Paradise. They abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى هَدَىٰنَا لِهَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِىَ لَوْلَآ أَنْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَنُودُوٓا۟ أَن تِلْكُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل تجري من تحتهم الأنهار ۖ وقالوا الحمد لله الذي هدانا لهذا وما كنا لنهتدي لولا أن هدانا الله ۖ لقد جاءت رسل ربنا بالحق ۖ ونودوا أن تلكم الجنة أورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī hadānā lihādhā wamā kunnā linahtadiya lawlā an hadānā l-lahu laqad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi wanūdū an til'kumu l-janatu ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: We will remove all jealousy from their hearts. Rivers will flow beneath them, and they will say, "GOD be praised for guiding us. We could not possibly be guided, if it were not that GOD has guided us. The messengers of our Lord did bring the truth." They will be called: "This is your Paradise. You have inherited it, in return for your works."
verses.subtitle: By God's Grace

1981.english: We remove all traces of hatred from their hearts. Rivers will flow beneath them, and they will say, "Praise be to God, who guided us towards this; we were not to be guided without His guidance. Indeed, the messengers of our Lord have brought the truth." They were told, "This is the Paradise you have deserved for your works."
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: We have removed all jealousy from their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them, and they said, “GOD be praised for guiding us. We could not possibly be guided, if it were not that GOD has guided us. The messengers of our Lord did bring the truth.” They were called, “This is your Paradise. You have deserved it in return for your works.”

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ أَن قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا قَالُوا۟ نَعَمْ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن لَّعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونادى أصحاب الجنة أصحاب النار أن قد وجدنا ما وعدنا ربنا حقا فهل وجدتم ما وعد ربكم حقا ۖ قالوا نعم ۚ فأذن مؤذن بينهم أن لعنة الله على الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wanādā aṣḥābu l-janati aṣḥāba l-nāri an qad wajadnā mā waʿadanā rabbunā ḥaqqan fahal wajadttum mā waʿada rabbukum ḥaqqan qālū naʿam fa-adhana mu-adhinun baynahum an laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: The dwellers of Paradise will call the dwellers of Hell: "We have found our Lord's promise to be the truth, have you found your Lord's promise to be the truth?" They will say, "Yes." An announcer between them will announce: "GOD's condemnation has befallen the transgressors;

1981.english: The dwellers of Paradise called upon the dwellers of hell, saying, "We have found exactly what our Lord had promised us; have you found what your Lord had promised you?" They answered, "Yes," then an announcer announced that the curse of God had befallen the wicked.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: The dwellers of Paradise called the dwellers of Hell: “We have found our Lord’s promise to be the truth, have you found your Lord’s promise to be the truth?” They said, “Yes.” An announcer between them announced: “GOD’s condemnation has befallen the transgressors.”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يصدون عن سبيل الله ويبغونها عوجا وهم بالآخرة كافرون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati kāfirūn
verses.english: "who repel from the path of GOD, and strive to make it crooked, and, with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers."

1981.english: They are those who divert others from the path of God, seek to distort it, and disbelieve in the hereafter.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: (The transgressors are) those who repel from the path of GOD, and strive to make it crooked; with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ وَعَلَى ٱلْأَعْرٰفِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّۢا بِسِيمَىٰهُمْ وَنَادَوْا۟ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَن سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وبينهما حجاب ۚ وعلى الأعراف رجال يعرفون كلا بسيماهم ۚ ونادوا أصحاب الجنة أن سلام عليكم ۚ لم يدخلوها وهم يطمعون
verses.transliterated: wabaynahumā ḥijābun waʿalā l-aʿrāfi rijālun yaʿrifūna kullan bisīmāhum wanādaw aṣḥāba l-janati an salāmun ʿalaykum lam yadkhulūhā wahum yaṭmaʿūn
verses.english: A barrier separates them, while the Purgatory is occupied by people who recognize each side by their looks. They will call the dwellers of Paradise: "Peace be upon you." They did not enter (Paradise) through wishful thinking.
verses.footnote: Initially, there will be 4 places: (1) the High Heaven, (2) the Lower Heaven, (3) the Purgatory, and (4) Hell. The Purgatory will be annexed into the Lower Heaven.

1981.english: Between the two sides there will be a barrier, while the purgatory will be occupied by people who recognize each group by their marks. They called the dwellers of Paradise, saying, "You have really attained peace." They did not enter it by wishful thinking.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: A barrier separates them, while the Purgatory* is occupied by people who recognize each side by their looks. They called the dwellers of Paradise: “Peace be upon you.” They did not enter (Paradise) through wishful thinking.
1989.footnote: Initially, there will be 4 places: (1) the High Heaven, (2) the Lower Heaven, (3) the Purgatory, and (4) Hell. The Purgatory will be annexed into the Lower Heaven.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تِلْقَآءَ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا صرفت أبصارهم تلقاء أصحاب النار قالوا ربنا لا تجعلنا مع القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ṣurifat abṣāruhum til'qāa aṣḥābi l-nāri qālū rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: When they turn their eyes towards the dwellers of Hell, they will say, "Our Lord, do not put us with these wicked people."

1981.english: Then, they turn their eyes towards the dwellers of hell, and say, "Our Lord, do not put us with these wicked people."
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: When they turned their eyes towards the dwellers of Hell, they said, “Our Lord, do not put us with these wicked people.”
1989.footnote: Initially, there will be 4 places: (1) the High Heaven, (2) the Lower Heaven, (3) the Purgatory, and (4) Hell. The Purgatory will be annexed into the Lower Heaven.

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَعْرٰفِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُم بِسِيمَىٰهُمْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ونادى أصحاب الأعراف رجالا يعرفونهم بسيماهم قالوا ما أغنى عنكم جمعكم وما كنتم تستكبرون
verses.transliterated: wanādā aṣḥābu l-aʿrāfi rijālan yaʿrifūnahum bisīmāhum qālū mā aghnā ʿankum jamʿukum wamā kuntum tastakbirūn
verses.english: The dwellers of the Purgatory will call on people they recognize by their looks, saying, "Your great numbers did not avail you in any way, nor did your arrogance.
verses.subtitle: The Majority Doomed

1981.english: The dwellers of the purgatory will call upon the dwellers of hell, whom they recognize by their marks, saying, "Your great number did not help you, nor did your pride.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: The dwellers of the Purgatory called on people they recognized by their looks, saying, “Your great numbers did not avail you in any way, nor did your arrogance.
1989.footnote: Initially, there will be 4 places: (1) the High Heaven, (2) the Lower Heaven, (3) the Purgatory, and (4) Hell. The Purgatory will be annexed into the Lower Heaven.

verses.arabic: أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أهؤلاء الذين أقسمتم لا ينالهم الله برحمة ۚ ادخلوا الجنة لا خوف عليكم ولا أنتم تحزنون
verses.transliterated: ahāulāi alladhīna aqsamtum lā yanāluhumu l-lahu biraḥmatin ud'khulū l-janata lā khawfun ʿalaykum walā antum taḥzanūn
verses.english: "Are those the people you swore that GOD will never touch them with mercy?" (The people in the Purgatory will then be told,) "Enter Paradise; you have nothing to fear, nor will you grieve."

1981.english: "Are those not the people you swore will never attain God's mercy? Indeed, it is they who were told, 'Enter Paradise; you have nothing to worry about, nor will you grieve.'"
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: “Are these the people you swore that GOD will never touch them with mercy?” (The people in the Purgatory will then be told,) “Enter Paradise; you have nothing to fear, nor will you grieve.”
1989.footnote: Initially, there will be 4 places: (1) the High Heaven, (2) the Lower Heaven, (3) the Purgatory, and (4) Hell. The Purgatory will be annexed into the Lower Heaven.

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوا۟ عَلَيْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونادى أصحاب النار أصحاب الجنة أن أفيضوا علينا من الماء أو مما رزقكم الله ۚ قالوا إن الله حرمهما على الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wanādā aṣḥābu l-nāri aṣḥāba l-janati an afīḍū ʿalaynā mina l-māi aw mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qālū inna l-laha ḥarramahumā ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verses.english: The dwellers of Hell will call on the dwellers of Paradise: "Let some of your water, or some of GOD's provisions to you flow towards us." They will say, "GOD has forbidden them for the disbelievers."

1981.english: The dwellers of hell called upon the dwellers of Paradise, saying, "Would you pour upon us some water, or some of God's provisions to you?" They said "God has forbidden them for the disbelievers."
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: The dwellers of Hell called on the dwellers of Paradise: “Let some of your water flow towards us, or some of GOD’s provisions to you.” They said, “GOD has forbidden them for the disbelievers.”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوا۟ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين اتخذوا دينهم لهوا ولعبا وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا ۚ فاليوم ننساهم كما نسوا لقاء يومهم هذا وما كانوا بآياتنا يجحدون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ittakhadhū dīnahum lahwan walaʿiban wagharrathumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma nansāhum kamā nasū liqāa yawmihim hādhā wamā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūn
verses.english: Those who do not take their religion seriously, and are totally preoccupied with this worldly life, we forget them on that day, because they forgot that day, and because they spurned our revelations.

1981.english: They took their religion in vain and play, and were distracted by the worldly life. Therefore, we forget them today, because they forgot this day, and ignored our revelations.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense, like the vast majority of the Quran's statements. They narrate events that actually took place on the day of judgment, as witnessed by God. Of course, the day of judgment is still in the future for us, but not so for God. Initially, there will be four distinct groups in the hereafter, namely, the high heaven, the lower heaven, the purgatory, and hell. Later, the purgatory will be merged into the lower heaven (see suras 55 and 56, and Appendix 10 for details).

1989.english: Those who do not take their religion seriously, and are totally absorbed in this worldly life, we forget them on that day, because they forgot that day, and because they spurned our revelations.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَٰهُم بِكِتَٰبٍ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جئناهم بكتاب فصلناه على علم هدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ji'nāhum bikitābin faṣṣalnāhu ʿalā ʿil'min hudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: We have given them a scripture that is fully detailed, with knowledge, guidance, and mercy for the people who believe.
verses.subtitle: Quran: Fully Detailed

1981.english: We had given them a fully detailed scripture, with knowledge, guidance and mercy for those who believe.
1981.footnote: This is another clear verse stating that the Quran is "fully detailed" (see also 6:19, 38, and 114). Those who invent and advocate other sources of religious knowledge, such as Hadith, Sunna, and the works of various "scholars," flagrantly defy God and His messenger, and refuse to submit to the truth of the Quran. The true believers, on the other hand, uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see footnote 6:112-116).

1989.english: We have given them a scripture that is fully detailed, with knowledge, guidance, and mercy for people who believe.
1989.subtitle: Quran: Fully Detailed

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُۥ يَوْمَ يَأْتِى تَأْوِيلُهُۥ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ فَهَل لَّنَا مِن شُفَعَآءَ فَيَشْفَعُوا۟ لَنَآ أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ قَدْ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هل ينظرون إلا تأويله ۚ يوم يأتي تأويله يقول الذين نسوه من قبل قد جاءت رسل ربنا بالحق فهل لنا من شفعاء فيشفعوا لنا أو نرد فنعمل غير الذي كنا نعمل ۚ قد خسروا أنفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: hal yanẓurūna illā tawīlahu yawma yatī tawīluhu yaqūlu alladhīna nasūhu min qablu qad jāat rusulu rabbinā bil-ḥaqi fahal lanā min shufaʿāa fayashfaʿū lanā aw nuraddu fanaʿmala ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu qad khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: Are they waiting until all (prophecies) are fulfilled? The day such fulfillment comes to pass, those who disregarded it in the past will say, "The messengers of our Lord have brought the truth. Are there any intercessors to intercede on our behalf? Would you send us back, so that we change our behavior, and do better works than what we did?" They have lost their souls, and their own innovations have caused their doom.

1981.english: Are they waiting for the full interpretation thereof? The day its final interpretation comes, those who had ignored it in the past would say, "Indeed, the messengers of our Lord have brought the truth. Now, can we find intercessors to intercede on our behalf? Or, can we get another chance, in order to live differently?" Indeed, they have lost their souls, and their own inventions did not help them.

1989.english: Are they waiting until all (the prophecies herein) are fulfilled? The day such fulfillment comes to pass, those who disregarded it in the past will say, “The messengers of our Lord have brought the truth. Are there any intercessors who would intercede on our behalf? Would you send us back, so that we behave differently?” They have lost their souls, and their own innovations have caused their doom.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۭ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْخَلْقُ وَٱلْأَمْرُ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربكم الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام ثم استوى على العرش يغشي الليل النهار يطلبه حثيثا والشمس والقمر والنجوم مسخرات بأمره ۗ ألا له الخلق والأمر ۗ تبارك الله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yugh'shī al-layla l-nahāra yaṭlubuhu ḥathīthan wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūma musakharātin bi-amrihi alā lahu l-khalqu wal-amru tabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Your Lord is the one GOD; who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then assumed all authority. The night overtakes the day, as it pursues it persistently, and the sun, the moon, and the stars are committed to serve by His command. Absolutely, He controls all creation and all commands. Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.
verses.footnote: The six days of creation are allegorical; they serve as a yardstick to let us know the relative complexity of our infinitesimal planet Earth—it was created in "4 days" (see 41:10).

1981.english: Indeed, your Lord is God; the one God who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then assumed all responsibility. The night overtakes the day, as it pursues it persistently, and the sun, the moon, and the stars are all subservient to His command. All creation and all authority belong to Him. Most exalted is God, the Lord of the universe.
1981.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

1989.english: Your Lord is the one GOD; who created the heavens and the earth in she days,* then assumed all authority. The night overtakes the day, as it pursues it gradually, and the sun, the moon, and the stars are committed to serve by His command. Absolutely, He controls all creation and all commands. Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.
1989.footnote: The six days of creation are allegorical; they serve as a yardstick to let us know the relative complexity of our planet Earth—it was created in “4 days” (see 41:10).

verses.arabic: ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ادعوا ربكم تضرعا وخفية ۚ إنه لا يحب المعتدين
verses.transliterated: id'ʿū rabbakum taḍarruʿan wakhuf'yatan innahu lā yuḥibbu l-muʿ'tadīn
verses.english: You shall worship your Lord publicly and privately; He does not love the transgressors.

1981.english: Implore your Lord publicly and secretly; He does not love the aggressors.

1989.english: You shall worship your Lord publicly and privately; He does not love the transgressors.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَٰحِهَا وَٱدْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تفسدوا في الأرض بعد إصلاحها وادعوه خوفا وطمعا ۚ إن رحمت الله قريب من المحسنين
verses.transliterated: walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā wa-id'ʿūhu khawfan waṭamaʿan inna raḥmata l-lahi qarībun mina l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Do not corrupt the earth after it has been set straight, and worship Him out of reverence, and out of hope. Surely, GOD's mercy is attainable by the righteous.

1981.english: And do not corrupt the earth after setting it in order. Implore Him out of reverence, and out of hope. Indeed, God's mercy is readily attainable by the righteous.

1989.english: Do not corrupt the earth after it has been set straight, and worship Him out of reverence, and out of hope. Surely, GOD’s mercy is attainable by the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنَٰهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَنزَلْنَا بِهِ ٱلْمَآءَ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ كَذَٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي يرسل الرياح بشرا بين يدي رحمته ۖ حتى إذا أقلت سحابا ثقالا سقناه لبلد ميت فأنزلنا به الماء فأخرجنا به من كل الثمرات ۚ كذلك نخرج الموتى لعلكم تذكرون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi ḥattā idhā aqallat saḥāban thiqālan suq'nāhu libaladin mayyitin fa-anzalnā bihi l-māa fa-akhrajnā bihi min kulli l-thamarāti kadhālika nukh'riju l-mawtā laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.english: He is the One who sends the wind with good omen, as a mercy from His hands. Once they gather heavy clouds, we drive them to dead lands, and send down water therefrom, to produce with it all kinds of fruits. We thus resurrect the dead, that you may take heed.

1981.english: And He is the one who sends the winds with good omen as a mercy from Him. Then, when they gather loaded clouds, we drive them to dead lands where we send down water, and produce all kinds of fruits. We will thus resurrect the dead, that you may take heed.

1989.english: He is the One who sends the wind with good omen, as a mercy from His hands. Once they gather heavy clouds, we drive them to dead lands, and send down water therefrom, to produce with it all kinds of fruits. We thus resurrect the dead, that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبَلَدُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُۥ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ وَٱلَّذِى خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدًا كَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والبلد الطيب يخرج نباته بإذن ربه ۖ والذي خبث لا يخرج إلا نكدا ۚ كذلك نصرف الآيات لقوم يشكرون
verses.transliterated: wal-baladu l-ṭayibu yakhruju nabātuhu bi-idh'ni rabbihi wa-alladhī khabutha lā yakhruju illā nakidan kadhālika nuṣarrifu l-āyāti liqawmin yashkurūn
verses.english: The good land readily produces its plants by the leave of its Lord, while the bad land barely produces anything useful. We thus explain the revelations for people who are appreciative.

1981.english: The good land readily produces its plants, by the will of its Lord, while the bad soil produces only with great difficulty. We thus explain the revelations for those who are appreciative.

1989.english: The good land readily produces its plants by the leave of its Lord, while the bad land barely produces anything useful. We thus explain the revelations for people who are appreciative.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: لقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه فقال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره إني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: laqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day."
verses.subtitle: Noah

1981.english: We have sent Noah to his people, saying, "O my people, you shall worship God. You have no other god besides Him. I fear for you the retribution of a profound day."
1981.subtitle:
Believers: The Ultimate Winners
Noah

1989.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, “O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day.”
1989.subtitle: Noah

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال الملأ من قومه إنا لنراك في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: qāla l-mala-u min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: The leaders among his people said, "We see that you are far astray."

1981.english: The leaders among his people said, "We see that you have gone astray."

1989.english: The leaders among his people said, “We see that you are far astray.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِى ضَلَٰلَةٌ وَلَٰكِنِّى رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا قوم ليس بي ضلالة ولكني رسول من رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāqawmi laysa bī ḍalālatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: He said, "O my people, I am not astray; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: He said, "O my people, I have not gone astray; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: He said, “O my people, I am not astray; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّى وَأَنصَحُ لَكُمْ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أبلغكم رسالات ربي وأنصح لكم وأعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anṣaḥu lakum wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: "I deliver to you the messages of my Lord, and I advise you, and I know from GOD what you do not know.

1981.english: "I deliver my Lord's messages to you, and I care about you. I have learned from God what you do not know.

1989.english: “I deliver to you the messages of my Lord, and I advise you, and I know from GOD what you do not know.

verses.arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ وَلِتَتَّقُوا۟ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر من ربكم على رجل منكم لينذركم ولتتقوا ولعلكم ترحمون
verses.transliterated: awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum walitattaqū walaʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.english: "Is it too much of a wonder that a reminder should come to you from your Lord, through a man like you, to warn you, and to lead you to righteousness, that you may attain mercy?"

1981.english: "Is it such a wonder that a message from your Lord should come to you through a man like you? This is to alert you, and to make you righteous, that you may attain mercy."

1989.english: “Is it too much of a wonder that a message should come to you from your Lord, through a man like you, to warn you, and to lead you to righteousness, that you may attain mercy?”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فكذبوه فأنجيناه والذين معه في الفلك وأغرقنا الذين كذبوا بآياتنا ۚ إنهم كانوا قوما عمين
verses.transliterated: fakadhabūhu fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawman ʿamīn
verses.english: They rejected him. Consequently, we saved him and those with him in the ark, and we drowned those who rejected our revelations; they were blind.

1981.english: They disbelieved him, and consequently, we saved him and his followers in the ark, and we drowned those who rejected our revelations; they had turned blind.

1989.english: They rejected him. Consequently, we saved him and those with him in the ark, and we drowned those who rejected our revelations, for they were blinded people. Hood

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا ۗ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۚ أفلا تتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
verses.english: To 'Ãd we sent their brother Hûd. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Would you then observe righteousness?"
verses.subtitle: Hûd

1981.english: To the people of 'Aad, we sent their brother Hood. He said, "O my people, you shall worship God. You have no other god besides Him. Would you not work righteousness?
1981.subtitle: Hood

1989.english: To ‘Aad we sent their brother Hood. He said, “O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. Would you then observe righteousness?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِى سَفَٰهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه إنا لنراك في سفاهة وإنا لنظنك من الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: qāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi innā lanarāka fī safāhatin wa-innā lanaẓunnuka mina l-kādhibīn
verses.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "We see that you are behaving foolishly, and we think that you are a liar."

1981.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "We see that you are foolish, and we believe that you are a liar."

1989.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, “We see that you are behaving foolishly, and we think that you are a liar.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِى سَفَٰهَةٌ وَلَٰكِنِّى رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا قوم ليس بي سفاهة ولكني رسول من رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāqawmi laysa bī safāhatun walākinnī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: He said, "O my people, there is no foolishness in me; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: He said, "O my people, I am not foolish; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: He said, “O my people, there is no foolishness in me; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّى وَأَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أبلغكم رسالات ربي وأنا لكم ناصح أمين
verses.transliterated: uballighukum risālāti rabbī wa-anā lakum nāṣiḥun amīnu
verses.english: "I deliver to you my Lord's messages, and I am honestly advising you.

1981.english: I deliver to you my Lord's messages, and I honestly care about you.

1989.english: “I deliver to you my Lord’s messages, and I am honestly advising you.

verses.arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَسْطَةً فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر من ربكم على رجل منكم لينذركم ۚ واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد قوم نوح وزادكم في الخلق بسطة ۖ فاذكروا آلاء الله لعلكم تفلحون
verses.transliterated: awaʿajib'tum an jāakum dhik'run min rabbikum ʿalā rajulin minkum liyundhirakum wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi qawmi nūḥin wazādakum fī l-khalqi baṣ'ṭatan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: "Is it too much of a wonder that a message should come to you from your Lord, through a man like you, to warn you? Recall that He made you inheritors after the people of Noah, and multiplied your number. Remember GOD's blessings, that you may succeed."

1981.english: "Is it such a wonder that a message from your Lord should come to you through a man like you, in order to alert you? Remember that He made you successors after the people of Noah, and multiplied you in number. Be appreciative of God's blessings, that you may succeed."

1989.english: “Is it too much of a wonder that a message should come to you from your Lord, through a man like you, to warn you? Recall that He made you inheritors after the people of Noah, and multiplied your number. Remember GOD’s blessings, that you may succeed.” A Human Tragedy

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَحْدَهُۥ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أجئتنا لنعبد الله وحده ونذر ما كان يعبد آباؤنا ۖ فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: qālū aji'tanā linaʿbuda l-laha waḥdahu wanadhara mā kāna yaʿbudu ābāunā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They said, "Did you come to make us worship GOD alone, and abandon what our parents used to worship? We challenge you to bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful."
verses.subtitle: Following the Parents Blindly: A Human Tragedy

1981.english: They said, "Do you want us to worship God alone, and discard what our parents have worshiped? Bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful."

1989.english: They said, “Did you come to make us worship GOD alone, and abandon what our parents used to worship? We challenge you to bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful.”
1989.subtitle: Following the Parents Blindly:

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ أَتُجَٰدِلُونَنِى فِىٓ أَسْمَآءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال قد وقع عليكم من ربكم رجس وغضب ۖ أتجادلونني في أسماء سميتموها أنتم وآباؤكم ما نزل الله بها من سلطان ۚ فانتظروا إني معكم من المنتظرين
verses.transliterated: qāla qad waqaʿa ʿalaykum min rabbikum rij'sun waghaḍabun atujādilūnanī fī asmāin sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā nazzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīn
verses.english: He said, "You have incurred condemnation and wrath from your Lord. Do you argue with me in defense of innovations you have fabricated— you and your parents—which were never authorized by GOD? Therefore, wait and I will wait along with you."

1981.english: He said, "You have deserved debasement from your Lord, and displeasure. Do you argue with me on behalf of idols that you made up; you and your ancestors? God never placed any authority therein. Therefore, just wait, and I too shall wait."

1989.english: He said, “You have incurred condemnation and wrath from your Lord. Do you argue with me in defense of innovations you have fabricated—you and your parents—in which GOD has placed no power? Therefore, wait and I will wait along with you.”

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأنجيناه والذين معه برحمة منا وقطعنا دابر الذين كذبوا بآياتنا ۖ وما كانوا مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: fa-anjaynāhu wa-alladhīna maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā waqaṭaʿnā dābira alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wamā kānū mu'minīn
verses.english: We then saved him and those with him, by mercy from us, and we annihilated those who rejected our revelations and refused to be believers.

1981.english: Subsequently, we saved him and his followers with our mercy, and we wiped out those who rejected our revelations and refused to believe.

1989.english: We then saved him and those with him, by mercy from us. And we annihilated those who rejected our revelations, and refused to be believers.

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى ثمود أخاهم صالحا ۗ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ قد جاءتكم بينة من ربكم ۖ هذه ناقة الله لكم آية ۖ فذروها تأكل في أرض الله ۖ ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: To Thamûd we sent their brother Sãleh. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Proof has been provided for you from your Lord: here is GOD's camel, to serve as a sign for you. Let her eat from GOD's land, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: Sãleh

1981.english: To Thamud (we sent) their brother Saalih, saying, "O my people, worship God; you have no other god besides Him. A profound sign has come to you from your Lord. Here is God's camel as a miracle for you; you shall allow her to eat in God's earth, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur a painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: Saalih

1989.english: To Thamood we sent their brother Saaleh. He said, “O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. Proof has been provided for you from your Lord: this is GOD’s camel, to serve as a sign for you. Let her eat from GOD’s earth, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur a painful retribution.
1989.subtitle: Saaleh

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِن سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا وَتَنْحِتُونَ ٱلْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد عاد وبوأكم في الأرض تتخذون من سهولها قصورا وتنحتون الجبال بيوتا ۖ فاذكروا آلاء الله ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kurū idh jaʿalakum khulafāa min baʿdi ʿādin wabawwa-akum fī l-arḍi tattakhidhūna min suhūlihā quṣūran watanḥitūna l-jibāla buyūtan fa-udh'kurū ālāa l-lahi walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīn
verses.english: "Recall that He made you inheritors after 'Ãd, and established you on earth, building mansions in its valleys, and carving homes from its mountains. You shall remember GOD's blessings, and do not roam the earth corruptingly."

1981.english: "Remember that He made you successors after the people of 'Aad, and put you in control of the earth, building mansions in its valleys, and carving homes out of the mountains. Remember God's favors, and do not roam the earth corruptingly."

1989.english: “Recall that He made you inheritors after ‘Aad, and established you on earth, building mansions in its valleys and carving homes in its mountains. You shall remember GOD’s blessings, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.” The Message, Not The Messenger, Is Important

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِمَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُمْ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ صَٰلِحًا مُّرْسَلٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلَ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال الملأ الذين استكبروا من قومه للذين استضعفوا لمن آمن منهم أتعلمون أن صالحا مرسل من ربه ۚ قالوا إنا بما أرسل به مؤمنون
verses.transliterated: qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lilladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū liman āmana min'hum ataʿlamūna anna ṣāliḥan mur'salun min rabbihi qālū innā bimā ur'sila bihi mu'minūn
verses.english: The arrogant leaders among his people said to the common people who believed, "How do you know that Sãleh is sent by his Lord?" They said, "The message he brought has made us believers."
verses.subtitle: The Message: Proof of Messengership

1981.english: The arrogent elders among his people said to their subjects who believed, "Are you sure that Saalih is sent by his Lord?" They said, "We believe in the message he brought."

1989.english: The arrogant leaders among his people said to the common people who believed, “Do you know that Saaleh is sent by his Lord?” They said, “We are believers in the message he brought.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال الذين استكبروا إنا بالذي آمنتم به كافرون
verses.transliterated: qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā bi-alladhī āmantum bihi kāfirūn
verses.english: The arrogant ones said, "We disbelieve in what you believe in."

1981.english: The arrogant ones said, "We reject what you believe in."

1989.english: The arrogant ones said, “We reject what you believe in.”

verses.arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰصَٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فعقروا الناقة وعتوا عن أمر ربهم وقالوا يا صالح ائتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من المرسلين
verses.transliterated: faʿaqarū l-nāqata waʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim waqālū yāṣāliḥu i'tinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Subsequently, they slaughtered the camel, rebelled against their Lord's command, and said, "O Sãleh, bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are really a messenger."

1981.english: Subsequently, they slaughtered the camel, and rebelled against the order of their Lord, and said, "Saalih, bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are really a messenger."

1989.english: Subsequently, they slaughtered the camel, rebelled against the command of their Lord, and said, “O Saaleh, bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are really a messenger.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذتهم الرجفة فأصبحوا في دارهم جاثمين
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīn
verses.english: Consequently, the quake annihilated them, leaving them dead in their homes.

1981.english: The quake then destroyed them, leaving them dead in their homes.

1989.english: Consequently, the quake annihilated them, leaving them dead in their homes.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّى وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُحِبُّونَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فتولى عنهم وقال يا قوم لقد أبلغتكم رسالة ربي ونصحت لكم ولكن لا تحبون الناصحين
verses.transliterated: fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālata rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum walākin lā tuḥibbūna l-nāṣiḥīn
verses.english: He turned away from them, saying, "O my people, I have delivered my Lord's message to you, and advised you, but you do not like any advisers."

1981.english: As he left them, he said, "O my people, I have delivered my Lord's message to you, and advised you, but you dislike anyone who advises you."

1989.english: He turned away from them, saying, “O my people, I have delivered my Lord’s message to you, and advised you, but you do not like any advisers.” Lot:

verses.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولوطا إذ قال لقومه أتأتون الفاحشة ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين
verses.transliterated: walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Lot said to his people, "You commit such an abomination; no one in the world has done it before!
verses.subtitle: Lot: Homosexuality Condemned

1981.english: Lot said to his people, "You commit such an abomination; no one ever has done it before.
1981.subtitle: Lot

1989.english: Lot said to his people, “You commit such an abomination; no one in the world has done it before!
1989.subtitle: Homosexuality Condemned

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنكم لتأتون الرجال شهوة من دون النساء ۚ بل أنتم قوم مسرفون
verses.transliterated: innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun mus'rifūn
verses.english: "You practice sex with the men, instead of the women. Indeed, you are a transgressing people."

1981.english: "You practice sex with the men, instead of the women! Indeed, you have transgressed."

1989.english: “You practice sex with the men, instead of the women. Indeed, you are a transgressing people.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوهُم مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا أخرجوهم من قريتكم ۖ إنهم أناس يتطهرون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijūhum min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūn
verses.english: His people responded by saying, "Evict them from your town. They are people who wish to be pure."

1981.english: The only answer his people gave him was, "Evict these people from your town; they wish to be holy."

1989.english: His people responded by saying, “Evict them from your town. They are people who wish to be pure.”

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأنجيناه وأهله إلا امرأته كانت من الغابرين
verses.transliterated: fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīn
verses.english: Consequently, we saved him and his family, but not his wife; she was with the doomed.

1981.english: Consequently, we saved him and his family, but not his wife, for she was doomed.

1989.english: Consequently, we saved him and his family, except his wife; she was with the doomed.

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأمطرنا عليهم مطرا ۖ فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المجرمين
verses.transliterated: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: We showered them with a certain shower; note the consequences for the guilty.

1981.english: We showered them with a miserable shower. Note the consequences for the guilty.

1989.english: We showered them with a certain shower; note the consequences for the guilty.

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَٰحِهَا ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى مدين أخاهم شعيبا ۗ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ قد جاءتكم بينة من ربكم ۖ فأوفوا الكيل والميزان ولا تبخسوا الناس أشياءهم ولا تفسدوا في الأرض بعد إصلاحها ۚ ذلكم خير لكم إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu qad jāatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum fa-awfū l-kayla wal-mīzāna walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi baʿda iṣ'lāḥihā dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Proof has come to you from your Lord. You shall give full weight and full measure when you trade. Do not cheat the people out of their rights. Do not corrupt the earth after it has been set straight. This is better for you, if you are believers.
verses.subtitle: Shu'aib: Cheating, Dishonesty Condemned

1981.english: And to Midyan (we sent) their brother Shu'aib, saying, "O my people, worship God; you have no other god besides Him. A profound sign has come to you from your Lord. Therefore, you shall give full measure and weight, and do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not corrupt the earth after it has been set in order. This is better for you, if you are believers.
1981.subtitle: Shu'aib

1989.english: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu‘aib. He said, “O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. Proof has come to you from your Lord. You shall give full weight and full measure when you trade. Do not cheat the people out of their rights. Do not corrupt the earth after it has been set straight. This is better for you, if you are believers.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوا۟ بِكُلِّ صِرَٰطٍ تُوعِدُونَ وَتَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِهِۦ وَتَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ كُنتُمْ قَلِيلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ وَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقعدوا بكل صراط توعدون وتصدون عن سبيل الله من آمن به وتبغونها عوجا ۚ واذكروا إذ كنتم قليلا فكثركم ۖ وانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين
verses.transliterated: walā taqʿudū bikulli ṣirāṭin tūʿidūna wataṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi man āmana bihi watabghūnahā ʿiwajan wa-udh'kurū idh kuntum qalīlan fakatharakum wa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: "Refrain from blocking every path, seeking to repel those who believe from the path of GOD, and do not make it crooked. Remember that you used to be few and He multiplied your number. Recall the consequences for the wicked.

1981.english: "Do not practice highway robbery, and do not divert others from the path of God, seeking the crooked ways. And recall that you used to be few, and He multiplied you in number, and note the consequences for the wicked.

1989.english: “Refrain from blocking every path, seeking to repel those who believe from the path of GOD, and do not make it crooked. Remember that you used to be few and He multiplied your number. And recall the consequences for the wicked.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنكُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَطَآئِفَةٌ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَٱصْبِرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كان طائفة منكم آمنوا بالذي أرسلت به وطائفة لم يؤمنوا فاصبروا حتى يحكم الله بيننا ۚ وهو خير الحاكمين
verses.transliterated: wa-in kāna ṭāifatun minkum āmanū bi-alladhī ur'sil'tu bihi waṭāifatun lam yu'minū fa-iṣ'birū ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu baynanā wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīn
verses.english: "Now that some of you have believed in what I was sent with, and some have disbelieved, wait until GOD issues His judgment between us; He is the best judge."

1981.english: "Now that some of you have believed in the message I bring, while others disbelieved, wait until God judges between us. He is the best judge."

1989.english: “Now that some of you have believed in the message I brought, and some have disbelieved, wait until GOD issues His judgment between us; He is the best judge.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَٰشُعَيْبُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَكَ مِن قَرْيَتِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا قَالَ أَوَلَوْ كُنَّا كَٰرِهِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال الملأ الذين استكبروا من قومه لنخرجنك يا شعيب والذين آمنوا معك من قريتنا أو لتعودن في ملتنا ۚ قال أولو كنا كارهين
verses.transliterated: qāla l-mala-u alladhīna is'takbarū min qawmihi lanukh'rijannaka yāshuʿaybu wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿaka min qaryatinā aw lataʿūdunna fī millatinā qāla awalaw kunnā kārihīn
verses.english: The arrogant leaders among his people said, "We will evict you, O Shu'aib, together with those who believed with you, from our town, unless you revert to our religion." He said, "Are you going to force us?"

1981.english: The arrogant elders among his people said, "We will banish you, O Shu'aib, and those who follow you, from our community, unless you revert to our religion." He said, "Are you going to force us?

1989.english: The arrogant leaders among his people said, “We will evict you, O Shu’aib, and those who have believed with you, from our town, unless you revert to our religion.” He said, “Are you going to force us?

verses.arabic: قَدِ ٱفْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِى مِلَّتِكُم بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّعُودَ فِيهَآ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا ٱفْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰتِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قد افترينا على الله كذبا إن عدنا في ملتكم بعد إذ نجانا الله منها ۚ وما يكون لنا أن نعود فيها إلا أن يشاء الله ربنا ۚ وسع ربنا كل شيء علما ۚ على الله توكلنا ۚ ربنا افتح بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق وأنت خير الفاتحين
verses.transliterated: qadi if'taraynā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban in ʿud'nā fī millatikum baʿda idh najjānā l-lahu min'hā wamā yakūnu lanā an naʿūda fīhā illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbunā wasiʿa rabbunā kulla shayin ʿil'man ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā if'taḥ baynanā wabayna qawminā bil-ḥaqi wa-anta khayru l-fātiḥīn
verses.english: "We would be blaspheming against GOD if we reverted to your religion after GOD has saved us from it. How could we revert back to it against the will of GOD our Lord? Our Lord's knowledge encompasses all things. We have put our trust in GOD. Our Lord, grant us a decisive victory over our people. You are the best supporter."

1981.english: "We will be inventing lies against God, if we ever revert to your religion, after God has saved us therefrom. We will never revert, unless it is the will of God our Lord. Our Lord is fully aware of all things. We trust in God. Our Lord, judge between us and our people with the truth. You are the best judge."

1989.english: “We would be inventing lies about GOD if we reverted to your religion after GOD has saved us from it. How could we revert back to it against the will of GOD our Lord? Our Lord’s knowledge encompasses all things. We have put our trust in GOD. Our Lord, grant us a decisive victory over our people. You are the best supporter.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه لئن اتبعتم شعيبا إنكم إذا لخاسرون
verses.transliterated: waqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi la-ini ittabaʿtum shuʿayban innakum idhan lakhāsirūn
verses.english: The disbelieving leaders among his people said, "If you follow Shu'aib, you will be losers."

1981.english: The elders who disbelieved among his people said, "If you follow Shu'aib, you will be losers."

1989.english: The disbelieving leaders among his people said, “If you follow Shu’aib, you will be losers.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذتهم الرجفة فأصبحوا في دارهم جاثمين
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīn
verses.english: The quake annihilated them, leaving them dead in their homes.
