1981.english: Consequently, the quake destroyed them, leaving them dead in their homes.

1989.english: The quake annihilated them, leaving them dead in their homes.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ شُعَيْبًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ شُعَيْبًا كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين كذبوا شعيبا كأن لم يغنوا فيها ۚ الذين كذبوا شعيبا كانوا هم الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alladhīna kadhabū shuʿayban kānū humu l-khāsirīn
verses.english: Those who rejected Shu'aib vanished, as if they never existed. Those who rejected Shu'aib were the losers.

1981.english: It was as though those who disbelieved Shu'aib never existed. Those who disbelieved Shu'aib were the losers.

1989.english: Those who rejected Shu'aib vanished, as if they never existed. Those who rejected Shu'aib were the losers.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّى وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ فَكَيْفَ ءَاسَىٰ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فتولى عنهم وقال يا قوم لقد أبلغتكم رسالات ربي ونصحت لكم ۖ فكيف آسى على قوم كافرين
verses.transliterated: fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risālāti rabbī wanaṣaḥtu lakum fakayfa āsā ʿalā qawmin kāfirīn
verses.english: He turned away from them, saying, "O my people, I have delivered to you the messages of my Lord, and I have advised you. How can I grieve over disbelieving people."

1981.english: As he moved away from them he said, "O my people, I have delivered to you the messages of my Lord, and advised you. How could I grieve over disbelieving people?"

1989.english: He turned away from them, saying, “O my people, I have delivered to you the messages of my Lord, and I have advised you. How can I grieve over disbelieving people.”

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّآ أَخَذْنَآ أَهْلَهَا بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا في قرية من نبي إلا أخذنا أهلها بالبأساء والضراء لعلهم يضرعون
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā fī qaryatin min nabiyyin illā akhadhnā ahlahā bil-basāi wal-ḍarāi laʿallahum yaḍḍarraʿūn
verses.english: Whenever we sent a prophet to any community, we afflicted its people with adversity and hardship, that they may implore.
verses.subtitle: Blessings in Disguise

1981.english: Whenever we sent a prophet to any community, we afflicted its people with hardship and adversity, that they may implore.
1981.subtitle: God's System

1989.english: Whenever we sent a prophet to any community, we afflicted its people with adversity and hardship, that they may implore.
1989.subtitle: Blessings in Disguise

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ ٱلسَّيِّئَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّىٰ عَفَوا۟ وَّقَالُوا۟ قَدْ مَسَّ ءَابَآءَنَا ٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَٱلسَّرَّآءُ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم بدلنا مكان السيئة الحسنة حتى عفوا وقالوا قد مس آباءنا الضراء والسراء فأخذناهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: thumma baddalnā makāna l-sayi-ati l-ḥasanata ḥattā ʿafaw waqālū qad massa ābāanā l-ḍarāu wal-sarāu fa-akhadhnāhum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: Then we substituted peace and prosperity in place of that hardship. But alas, they turned heedless and said, "It was our parents who experienced that hardship before prosperity." Consequently, we punished them suddenly when they least expected.

1981.english: Then we substituted prosperity in place of the hardship, until they forget and say, "It was our ancestors who underwent adversity and prosperity." Consequently, we seized them suddenly, when they least expected.

1989.english: Then we substituted peace and prosperity in place of that hardship. But, invariably, they turned heedless and said, “It was our parents who experienced that hardship before prosperity.” Consequently, we punished them suddenly when they least expected.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَرَكَٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبُوا۟ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أن أهل القرى آمنوا واتقوا لفتحنا عليهم بركات من السماء والأرض ولكن كذبوا فأخذناهم بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: walaw anna ahla l-qurā āmanū wa-ittaqaw lafataḥnā ʿalayhim barakātin mina l-samāi wal-arḍi walākin kadhabū fa-akhadhnāhum bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: Had the people of those communities believed and turned righteous, we would have showered them with blessings from the heaven and the earth. Since they decided to disbelieve, we punished them for what they earned.
verses.subtitle: Most People Make the Wrong Choice

1981.english: Had the people of those communities believed and worked righteousness, we would have showered them with blessings from the heaven and the earth. But they disbelieved, and consequently, we punished them for their works.

1989.english: Had the people of those communities believed and turned righteous, we would have showered them with blessings from the heaven and the earth. Since they decided to disbelieve, we punished them for what they earned.
1989.subtitle: Most People Make the Wrong Choice

verses.arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتِيَهُم بَأْسُنَا بَيَٰتًا وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفأمن أهل القرى أن يأتيهم بأسنا بياتا وهم نائمون
verses.transliterated: afa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā bayātan wahum nāimūn
verses.english: Did the people of the present communities guarantee that our retribution will not come to them in the night as they sleep?

1981.english: Do the people of the present communities guarantee that our affliction will not come to them at night while they sleep?

1989.english: Did the people of the present communities guarantee that our retribution will not come to them in the night as they sleep?

verses.arabic: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتِيَهُم بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أوأمن أهل القرى أن يأتيهم بأسنا ضحى وهم يلعبون
verses.transliterated: awa-amina ahlu l-qurā an yatiyahum basunā ḍuḥan wahum yalʿabūn
verses.english: Did the people of today's communities guarantee that our retribution will not come to them in the daytime while they play?

1981.english: Do the people of the present communitees guarantee that our affliction will not come to them in the forenoon, as they play?

1989.english: Did the people of today’s communities guarantee that our retribution will not come to them in the daytime while they play?

verses.arabic: أَفَأَمِنُوا۟ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفأمنوا مكر الله ۚ فلا يأمن مكر الله إلا القوم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: afa-aminū makra l-lahi falā yamanu makra l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: Have they taken GOD's plans for granted? None takes GOD's plans for granted except the losers.

1981.english: Have they taken God for granted? Indeed, no one takes God for granted, except the losers.

1989.english: Have they taken GOD’s plans for granted? None takes GOD’s plans for granted except the losers.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَآ أَن لَّوْ نَشَآءُ أَصَبْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَنَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يهد للذين يرثون الأرض من بعد أهلها أن لو نشاء أصبناهم بذنوبهم ۚ ونطبع على قلوبهم فهم لا يسمعون
verses.transliterated: awalam yahdi lilladhīna yarithūna l-arḍa min baʿdi ahlihā an law nashāu aṣabnāhum bidhunūbihim wanaṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yasmaʿūn
verses.english: Does it ever occur to those who inherit the earth after previous generations that, if we will, we can punish them for their sins, and seal their hearts, causing them to turn deaf?

1981.english: Did it ever occur to those who inherit the earth from previous generations that, if we will, we can punish them for their sins, and seal their hearts, so they cannot hear?

1989.english: Does it ever occur to those who inherit the earth after previous generations that, if we will, we can punish them for their sins, and seal their hearts, until they fail to hear?

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآئِهَا وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك القرى نقص عليك من أنبائها ۚ ولقد جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات فما كانوا ليؤمنوا بما كذبوا من قبل ۚ كذلك يطبع الله على قلوب الكافرين
verses.transliterated: til'ka l-qurā naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāihā walaqad jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū min qablu kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi l-kāfirīn
verses.english: We narrate to you the history of those communities: their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in what they had rejected before. GOD thus seals the hearts of the disbelievers.

1981.english: We narrate to you the history of those communities, who received messengers with profound signs. They refused to believe in what they had rejected before. God thus seals the hearts of disbelievers.

1989.english: We narrate to you the history of those communities: their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in what they had rejected before. GOD thus seals the hearts of the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِأَكْثَرِهِم مِّنْ عَهْدٍ وَإِن وَجَدْنَآ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما وجدنا لأكثرهم من عهد ۖ وإن وجدنا أكثرهم لفاسقين
verses.transliterated: wamā wajadnā li-aktharihim min ʿahdin wa-in wajadnā aktharahum lafāsiqīn
verses.english: We found that most of them disregard their covenant; we found most of them wicked.
verses.footnote: This life is our last chance to redeem ourselves, but most people are proven to be stubbornly rebellious and evil (see the INTRODUCTION).

1981.english: We find that most of them break their covenants; we found most of them wicked.

1989.english: We found that most of them do not fulfill their covenants; we found most of them wicked.*
1989.footnote: “We” here includes the humans. This life is our last chance to redeem ourselves, but most people are proven to be stubbornly evil (see the INTRODUCTION).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم بعثنا من بعدهم موسى بآياتنا إلى فرعون وملئه فظلموا بها ۖ فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين
verses.transliterated: thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faẓalamū bihā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: After (those messengers,) we sent Moses with our signs to Pharaoh and his people, but they transgressed. Note the consequences for the wicked.
verses.subtitle: Moses

1981.english: Subsequent to them, we sent Moses with our miracles to Pharaoh and his people, but they turned heedless. Note the consequences for the wicked.
1981.subtitle: Moses

1989.english: After {those messengers,) we sent Moses with our signs to Pharaoh and his people, but they transgressed. Note the consequences for the wicked.
1989.subtitle: Moses

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَٰفِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال موسى يا فرعون إني رسول من رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: waqāla mūsā yāfir'ʿawnu innī rasūlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: Moses said, “O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: حَقِيقٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّآ أَقُولَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِىَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: حقيق على أن لا أقول على الله إلا الحق ۚ قد جئتكم ببينة من ربكم فأرسل معي بني إسرائيل
verses.transliterated: ḥaqīqun ʿalā an lā aqūla ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa qad ji'tukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum fa-arsil maʿiya banī is'rāīl
verses.english: "It is incumbent upon me that I do not say about GOD except the truth. I come to you with a sign from your Lord; let the Children of Israel go."

1981.english: "My duty is never to say about God except the truth. I have come to you with a profound message from your Lord; let the children of Israel go."

1989.english: “It is incumbent upon me that I do not say about GOD except the truth. I come to you with a sign from your Lord; let the Children of Israel go.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِن كُنتَ جِئْتَ بِـَٔايَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إن كنت جئت بآية فأت بها إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: qāla in kunta ji'ta biāyatin fati bihā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: He said, "If you have a sign, then produce it, if you are truthful."

1981.english: He said, "If you brought a miracle, let us see it, if you are truthful."

1989.english: He said, “If you have a sign, then produce it, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: فألقى عصاه فإذا هي ثعبان مبين
verses.transliterated: fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnu
verses.english: He threw down his staff, and it turned into a tremendous serpent.

1981.english: He then threw down his staff, and it turned into a manifest serpent.

1989.english: He threw down his staff, and it turned into a tremendous serpent.

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونزع يده فإذا هي بيضاء للناظرين
verses.transliterated: wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīn
verses.english: He took out his hand, and it was white to the beholders.

1981.english: And he took out his hand, and it was white to the beholders.

1989.english: He took out his hand, and it was white to the beholders.

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قال الملأ من قوم فرعون إن هذا لساحر عليم
verses.transliterated: qāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmu
verses.english: The leaders among Pharaoh's people said, "This is no more than a clever magician.

1981.english: The elders among Pharaoh's people said, "He is no more than an experienced magician.

1989.english: The leaders among Pharaoh’s people said, “This is no more than an experienced magician.

verses.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُمْ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يريد أن يخرجكم من أرضكم ۖ فماذا تأمرون
verses.transliterated: yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum famādhā tamurūn
verses.english: "He wants to take you out of your land; what do you recommend?"

1981.english: "He wants to take you out of your land; so what do you think?"

1989.english: “He wants to take you out of your land; what do you recommend?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَأَرْسِلْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أرجه وأخاه وأرسل في المدائن حاشرين
verses.transliterated: qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-arsil fī l-madāini ḥāshirīn
verses.english: They said, "Respite him and his brother, and send summoners to every city.

1981.english: They said, "Respite him and his brother, and send delegates to every town.

1989.english: They said, “Respite him and his brother, and send summoners to every city.

verses.arabic: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: يأتوك بكل ساحر عليم
verses.transliterated: yatūka bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmi
verses.english: "Let them summon every experienced magician."

1981.english: "Let them summon every experienced magician."

1989.english: “Let them summon every expert magician.”

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وجاء السحرة فرعون قالوا إن لنا لأجرا إن كنا نحن الغالبين
verses.transliterated: wajāa l-saḥaratu fir'ʿawna qālū inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīn
verses.english: The magicians came to Pharaoh and said, "Do we get paid if we are the winners?"

1981.english: The magicians came to Pharaoh and said, "Do we get a reward, if we are the winners?"

1989.english: The magicians came to Pharaoh and said, “Do we get paid if we are the winners?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال نعم وإنكم لمن المقربين
verses.transliterated: qāla naʿam wa-innakum lamina l-muqarabīn
verses.english: He said, "Yes indeed; you will even become close to me."

1981.english: He said, "Yes, and you will become close to me."

1989.english: He said, “Yes indeed; you will also become close to me.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُلْقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا موسى إما أن تلقي وإما أن نكون نحن الملقين
verses.transliterated: qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna naḥnu l-mul'qīn
verses.english: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we are throwing."

1981.english: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we will throw."

1989.english: They said, “O Moses, either you throw, or we throw.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقُوا۟ فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ سَحَرُوٓا۟ أَعْيُنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُو بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال ألقوا ۖ فلما ألقوا سحروا أعين الناس واسترهبوهم وجاءوا بسحر عظيم
verses.transliterated: qāla alqū falammā alqaw saḥarū aʿyuna l-nāsi wa-is'tarhabūhum wajāū bisiḥ'rin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: He said, "You throw." When they threw, they tricked the people's eyes, intimidated them, and produced a great magic.

1981.english: He said, "You throw." When they threw, they bewitched the people's eyes, and intimidated them, and produced a profound magic.

1989.english: He said, “You throw.” When they threw, they bewitched the people’s eyes, intimidated them, and produced a great magic.

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأوحينا إلى موسى أن ألق عصاك ۖ فإذا هي تلقف ما يأفكون
verses.transliterated: wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an alqi ʿaṣāka fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūn
verses.english: We then inspired Moses: "Throw down your staff," whereupon it swallowed whatever they fabricated.

1981.english: We then inspired Moses to throw down his staff, whereupon it swallowed everything they fabricated.

1989.english: We then inspired Moses: “Throw down your staff,” whereupon it swallowed whatever they fabricated.

verses.arabic: فَوَقَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فوقع الحق وبطل ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: fawaqaʿa l-ḥaqu wabaṭala mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Thus, the truth prevailed, and what they did was nullified.
verses.subtitle: The Truth Recognized by the Experts

1981.english: Thus, the truth prevailed, and everything they did was nullified.

1989.english: Thus, the truth prevailed, and what they did was nullified.
1989.subtitle: The Truth Recognized by the Experts

verses.arabic: فَغُلِبُوا۟ هُنَالِكَ وَٱنقَلَبُوا۟ صَٰغِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فغلبوا هنالك وانقلبوا صاغرين
verses.transliterated: faghulibū hunālika wa-inqalabū ṣāghirīn
verses.english: They were defeated then and there; they were humiliated.

1981.english: They were defeated right there, and became totally stumped.

1989.english: They were defeated then and there; they were humiliated.

verses.arabic: وَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وألقي السحرة ساجدين
verses.transliterated: wa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīn
verses.english: The magicians fell prostrate.

1981.english: And the magicians fell prostrate.

1989.english: The magicians fell prostrate.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا آمنا برب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: They said, "We believe in the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: They said, "We believe in the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: They said, “We believe in the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: رب موسى وهارون
verses.transliterated: rabbi mūsā wahārūn
verses.english: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

1981.english: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

1989.english: “The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَّكَرْتُمُوهُ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أَهْلَهَا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فرعون آمنتم به قبل أن آذن لكم ۖ إن هذا لمكر مكرتموه في المدينة لتخرجوا منها أهلها ۖ فسوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qāla fir'ʿawnu āmantum bihi qabla an ādhana lakum inna hādhā lamakrun makartumūhu fī l-madīnati litukh'rijū min'hā ahlahā fasawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Pharaoh said, "Did you believe in him without my permission? This must be a conspiracy you schemed in the city, in order to take its people away. You will surely find out.

1981.english: Pharaoh said, "Do you believe in him without my permission? This must be a plot you conspired in the city, in order to take its people therefrom. Surely, you will find out.

1989.english: Pharaoh said, “Did you believe in him without my permission? This must be a plot you schemed in the city, in order to take its people away. You will surely find out.

verses.arabic: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلاف ثم لأصلبنكم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin thumma la-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: "I will cut your hands and feet on alternate sides, then I will crucify you all."

1981.english: "I will cut your hands and feet on alternate sides, then I will crucify all of you."

1989.english: “I will cut your hands and feet on alternate sides, then I will crucify you all.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا إنا إلى ربنا منقلبون
verses.transliterated: qālū innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūn
verses.english: They said, "We will then return to our Lord.

1981.english: They said, "We will then return to our Lord.

1989.english: They said, “We ultimately return to our Lord.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَنقِمُ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَآءَتْنَا رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما تنقم منا إلا أن آمنا بآيات ربنا لما جاءتنا ۚ ربنا أفرغ علينا صبرا وتوفنا مسلمين
verses.transliterated: wamā tanqimu minnā illā an āmannā biāyāti rabbinā lammā jāatnā rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran watawaffanā mus'limīn
verses.english: "You persecute us simply because we believed in the proofs of our Lord when they came to us." "Our Lord, grant us steadfastness, and let us die as submitters."

1981.english: "You are enraged simply because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us." "Our Lord, give us strength and steadfastness, and let us die as Muslims (submitters)."

1989.english: “You persecute us simply because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us.” “Our Lord, grant us steadfastness, and let us die as Muslims.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُۥ لِيُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَءَالِهَتَكَ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَٰهِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الملأ من قوم فرعون أتذر موسى وقومه ليفسدوا في الأرض ويذرك وآلهتك ۚ قال سنقتل أبناءهم ونستحيي نساءهم وإنا فوقهم قاهرون
verses.transliterated: waqāla l-mala-u min qawmi fir'ʿawna atadharu mūsā waqawmahu liyuf'sidū fī l-arḍi wayadharaka waālihataka qāla sanuqattilu abnāahum wanastaḥyī nisāahum wa-innā fawqahum qāhirūn
verses.english: The leaders among Pharaoh's people said, "Will you allow Moses and his people to corrupt the earth, and forsake you and your gods?" He said, "We will kill their sons, and spare their daughters. We are much more powerful than they are."

1981.english: The elders among Pharaoh's people said, "Will you leave Moses and his people to corrupt the earth, and discard you and your gods?" He said, "Let us kill their sons and spare their daughters. We have power over them."

1989.english: The leaders among Pharaoh’s people said, “Will you allow Moses and his people to corrupt the earth, and abandon you and your gods?” He said, “We will kill their sons, and spare their daughters. We are much more powerful than they are.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال موسى لقومه استعينوا بالله واصبروا ۖ إن الأرض لله يورثها من يشاء من عباده ۖ والعاقبة للمتقين
verses.transliterated: qāla mūsā liqawmihi is'taʿīnū bil-lahi wa-iṣ'birū inna l-arḍa lillahi yūrithuhā man yashāu min ʿibādihi wal-ʿāqibatu lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: Moses said to his people, "Seek GOD's help, and steadfastly persevere. The earth belongs to GOD, and He grants it to whomever He chooses from among His servants. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous."

1981.english: Moses said to his people, "Turn to God for help, and maintain your steadfastness. The whole earth belongs to God, and He gives it to whomever He chooses. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous."

1989.english: Moses said to his people, “Seek GOD’s help, and steadfastly persevere. The earth belongs to GOD, and He grants it to whomever He chooses from among His creatures. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أُوذِينَا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أوذينا من قبل أن تأتينا ومن بعد ما جئتنا ۚ قال عسى ربكم أن يهلك عدوكم ويستخلفكم في الأرض فينظر كيف تعملون
verses.transliterated: qālū ūdhīnā min qabli an tatiyanā wamin baʿdi mā ji'tanā qāla ʿasā rabbukum an yuh'lika ʿaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fī l-arḍi fayanẓura kayfa taʿmalūn
verses.english: They said, "We were persecuted before you came to us, and after you came to us." He said, "Your Lord will annihilate your enemy and establish you on earth, then He will see how you behave."

1981.english: They said, "We were persecuted before you showed up, and after you came to us." He said, "May your Lord destroy your enemy, and establish you as rulers of your land; He will see how you behave."

1989.english: They said, “We were persecuted before you came to us, and after you came.” He said, “Your Lord will annihilate your enemy and establish you on earth, then He will see how you behave.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أخذنا آل فرعون بالسنين ونقص من الثمرات لعلهم يذكرون
verses.transliterated: walaqad akhadhnā āla fir'ʿawna bil-sinīna wanaqṣin mina l-thamarāti laʿallahum yadhakkarūn
verses.english: We then afflicted Pharaoh's people with drought, and shortage of crops, that they may take heed.
verses.subtitle: The Plagues

1981.english: We afflicted Pharaoh's people with famine, and loss of crops, that they might take heed.

1989.english: We then afflicted Pharaoh’s people with drought, and shortage of crops, that they may take heed.
1989.subtitle: The Plagues

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوا۟ لَنَا هَٰذِهِۦ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا۟ بِمُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَلَآ إِنَّمَا طَٰٓئِرُهُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا جاءتهم الحسنة قالوا لنا هذه ۖ وإن تصبهم سيئة يطيروا بموسى ومن معه ۗ ألا إنما طائرهم عند الله ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā jāathumu l-ḥasanatu qālū lanā hādhihi wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun yaṭṭayyarū bimūsā waman maʿahu alā innamā ṭāiruhum ʿinda l-lahi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: When good omens came their way, they said, "We have deserved this," but when a hardship afflicted them, they blamed Moses and those with him. In fact, their omens are decided only by GOD, but most of them do not know.

1981.english: Whenever something good happened to them, they said, "We deserved this," but when adversity struck them, they blamed it on Moses and his people. They should have thought of God, but most of them do not know.

1989.english: Whenever good omens came their way, they said, “We have deserved this,” but when any hardship afflicted them, they blamed Moses and those with him. In fact, their omen comes only from GOD, but most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِۦ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ لِّتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا مهما تأتنا به من آية لتسحرنا بها فما نحن لك بمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: waqālū mahmā tatinā bihi min āyatin litasḥaranā bihā famā naḥnu laka bimu'minīn
verses.english: They said, "No matter what kind of sign you show us, to dupe us with your magic, we will not believe."

1981.english: And they said, "No matter what kind of plague you bring on us, in order to bewitch us, we will never believe."

1989.english: They said, “No matter what kind of miracle you show us, to bewitch us, we will not believe.”

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلطُّوفَانَ وَٱلْجَرَادَ وَٱلْقُمَّلَ وَٱلضَّفَٰدِعَ وَٱلدَّمَ ءَايَٰتٍ مُّفَصَّلَٰتٍ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأرسلنا عليهم الطوفان والجراد والقمل والضفادع والدم آيات مفصلات فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما مجرمين
verses.transliterated: fa-arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-ṭūfāna wal-jarāda wal-qumala wal-ḍafādiʿa wal-dama āyātin mufaṣṣalātin fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīn
verses.english: Consequently, we sent upon them the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, and the blood—profound signs. But they maintained their arrogance. They were evil people.
verses.subtitle: The Warnings Go Unheeded

1981.english: We then afflicted them with the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, and the blood; profound signs. But they were too arrogant, and really wicked.

1989.english: Consequently, we sent upon them the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, and the blood—profound signs. But they maintained their arrogance, for they were guilty people.
1989.subtitle: The Warnings Go Unheeded

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّجْزُ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَى ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ لَئِن كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا ٱلرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما وقع عليهم الرجز قالوا يا موسى ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك ۖ لئن كشفت عنا الرجز لنؤمنن لك ولنرسلن معك بني إسرائيل
verses.transliterated: walammā waqaʿa ʿalayhimu l-rij'zu qālū yāmūsā ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka la-in kashafta ʿannā l-rij'za lanu'minanna laka walanur'silanna maʿaka banī is'rāīl
verses.english: Whenever a plague afflicted them, they said, "O Moses, implore your Lord—you are close to Him. If you relieve this plague, we will believe with you, and will send the Children of Israel with you."

1981.english: Whenever a plague afflicted them, they said, "Call upon your Lord, with whom you have connections. If you relieve this plague, we will believe, and will let the children of Israel go with you."

1989.english: Whenever a plague afflicted them, they said, “O Moses, implore your Lord—you are close to Him. If you relieve this plague, we will believe with you, and we will send the Children of Israel with you.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلرِّجْزَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ هُم بَٰلِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما كشفنا عنهم الرجز إلى أجل هم بالغوه إذا هم ينكثون
verses.transliterated: falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-rij'za ilā ajalin hum bālighūhu idhā hum yankuthūn
verses.english: Yet, when we relieved the plague for any length of time, they violated their pledge.

1981.english: But as soon as we relieved their plague, temporarily, they broke their promise.

1989.english: Yet, when we relieved the plague for any length of time, they violated their pledge.

verses.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فانتقمنا منهم فأغرقناهم في اليم بأنهم كذبوا بآياتنا وكانوا عنها غافلين
verses.transliterated: fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum fī l-yami bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīn
verses.english: Consequently, we avenged their actions, and drowned them in the sea. That is because they rejected our signs, and were totally heedless thereof.
verses.subtitle: The Inevitable Retribution

1981.english: Consequently, we avenged from them, and drowned them in the sea, because they rejected our signs, and disregarded them.

1989.english: Consequently, we avenged their actions, and drowned them in the sea. That is because they rejected our signs, and were totally heedless thereof.
1989.subtitle: The Inevitable Retribution

verses.arabic: وَأَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ مَشَٰرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَغَٰرِبَهَا ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَدَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهُۥ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْرِشُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأورثنا القوم الذين كانوا يستضعفون مشارق الأرض ومغاربها التي باركنا فيها ۖ وتمت كلمت ربك الحسنى على بني إسرائيل بما صبروا ۖ ودمرنا ما كان يصنع فرعون وقومه وما كانوا يعرشون
verses.transliterated: wa-awrathnā l-qawma alladhīna kānū yus'taḍʿafūna mashāriqa l-arḍi wamaghāribahā allatī bāraknā fīhā watammat kalimatu rabbika l-ḥus'nā ʿalā banī is'rāīla bimā ṣabarū wadammarnā mā kāna yaṣnaʿu fir'ʿawnu waqawmuhu wamā kānū yaʿrishūn
verses.english: We let the oppressed people inherit the land, east and west, and we blessed it. The blessed commands of your Lord were thus fulfilled for the Children of Israel, to reward them for their steadfastness, and we annihilated the works of Pharaoh and his people and everything they harvested.

1981.english: And we blessed the oppressed people, and made them inherit the blessed land, East and West. Thus, the good promises of your Lord to the children of Israel were fulfilled, in return for their patience, and we nullified the works of Pharaoh and his people.

1989.english: We let the oppressed people inherit the land, east and west, and we blessed it. The commands of your Lord were fulfilled for the Children of Israel, to make up for their suffering, and we annihilated the works of Pharaoh and his people.

verses.arabic: وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصْنَامٍ لَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَى ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجاوزنا ببني إسرائيل البحر فأتوا على قوم يعكفون على أصنام لهم ۚ قالوا يا موسى اجعل لنا إلها كما لهم آلهة ۚ قال إنكم قوم تجهلون
verses.transliterated: wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-ataw ʿalā qawmin yaʿkufūna ʿalā aṣnāmin lahum qālū yāmūsā ij'ʿal lanā ilāhan kamā lahum ālihatun qāla innakum qawmun tajhalūn
verses.english: We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. When they passed by people who were worshiping statues, they said, "O Moses, make a god for us, like the gods they have." He said, "Indeed, you are ignorant people.
verses.subtitle: After All the Miracles

1981.english: We delivered the children of Israel across the sea, and they passed by people who worshiped idols. They said, "O Moses, erect an idol for us, like the idols they have." He said, "You are foolish indeed.
1981.subtitle: Idol Worship: A Perennial Human Disease

1989.english: We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. Afterwards, they passed by people who were worshiping statues. They said, “O Moses, make a god for us, like the gods they have.” He said, “Indeed, you are ignorant people.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَّا هُمْ فِيهِ وَبَٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هؤلاء متبر ما هم فيه وباطل ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: inna hāulāi mutabbarun mā hum fīhi wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: "These people are committing a blasphemy, for what they are doing is disastrous for them.

1981.english: "These people are disasterously afflicted, and abominable is what they do.

1989.english: “These people have incurred condemnation, for what they are doing is a gross blasphemy.

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَٰهًا وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال أغير الله أبغيكم إلها وهو فضلكم على العالمين
verses.transliterated: qāla aghayra l-lahi abghīkum ilāhan wahuwa faḍḍalakum ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: "Shall I seek for you other than GOD to be your god, when He has blessed you more than anyone else in the world?"

1981.english: "Shall I seek other than God as deity, after He has set you apart from all the people?

1989.english: “Shall I seek for you other than GOD to be your god, when He has blessed you more than anyone else in the world?”

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أنجيناكم من آل فرعون يسومونكم سوء العذاب ۖ يقتلون أبناءكم ويستحيون نساءكم ۚ وفي ذلكم بلاء من ربكم عظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-idh anjaynākum min āli fir'ʿawna yasūmūnakum sūa l-ʿadhābi yuqattilūna abnāakum wayastaḥyūna nisāakum wafī dhālikum balāon min rabbikum ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Recall that we delivered you from Pharaoh's people, who inflicted the worst persecution upon you, killing your sons and sparing your daughters. That was an exacting trial for you from your Lord.
verses.subtitle: Reminder to the Children of Israel

1981.english: "And after we delivered you from Pharaoh's people, who severely persecuted you; killing your sons and sparing your daughters? That was an exacting trial from your Lord."

1989.english: Recall that we delivered you from Pharaoh’s people, who inflicted the worst persecution upon you, killing your sons and sparing your daughters. That was an exacting trial for you from your Lord.
1989.subtitle: Reminder to the Children of Israel

verses.arabic: وَوَٰعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰ ثَلَٰثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَٰهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَٰتُ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَخِيهِ هَٰرُونَ ٱخْلُفْنِى فِى قَوْمِى وَأَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وواعدنا موسى ثلاثين ليلة وأتممناها بعشر فتم ميقات ربه أربعين ليلة ۚ وقال موسى لأخيه هارون اخلفني في قومي وأصلح ولا تتبع سبيل المفسدين
verses.transliterated: wawāʿadnā mūsā thalāthīna laylatan wa-atmamnāhā biʿashrin fatamma mīqātu rabbihi arbaʿīna laylatan waqāla mūsā li-akhīhi hārūna ukh'luf'nī fī qawmī wa-aṣliḥ walā tattabiʿ sabīla l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: We summoned Moses for thirty nights, and completed them by adding ten. Thus, the audience with his Lord lasted forty nights. Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Stay here with my people, maintain righteousness, and do not follow the ways of the corruptors."
verses.subtitle: Our World Cannot Stand the Physical Presence of God
verses.footnote: The manner in which these numbers are mentioned is significant. As detailed in Appendix 1, all the numbers mentioned in the Quran add up to 162146, 19x8534.

1981.english: We summoned Moses for thirty nights, and added to them ten, thus making the total audience with his Lord forty nights.* Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Stay behind with my people, maintain righteousness, and do not follow the ways of the wicked."
1981.footnote: This unique and deliberate way of stating these numbers is directly related to the Quran's secret numerical code. Since this Quranic miracle is based on numbers, it is only natural that any number mentioned in Quran must be involved. Thus, we find that the Quran contains 285 numbers, and this number is a multiple of 19 (19x15), and the total sum of the 285 numbers is 174,591 which is also a multiple of 19. Even if we remove all repetitions, we find that the remaining total is 162,146 which is a multiple of 19 as well. While other verses state that God summoned Moses for forty nights, this verse contains three numbers, which is necessary to conform with the Quran's miraculous code (see also 2:51, 2:196, and Appendix 1).

1989.english: We summoned Moses for thirty* nights, and added ten*, thus making the audience with his Lord forty* nights. Moses said to his brother Aaron, “Stay here with my people, maintain righteousness, and do not follow the ways of the corruptors.”
1989.subtitle: Our World Cannot Stand the Physical Presence of God
1989.footnote: The manner in which these numbers are mentioned is significant. As detailed in Appendix 1, all the numbers mentioned in the Quran add up to 162146, 19x8534.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَٰتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِىٓ أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَن تَرَىٰنِى وَلَٰكِنِ ٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُۥ فَسَوْفَ تَرَىٰنِى فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُۥ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُۥ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا فَلَمَّآ أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما جاء موسى لميقاتنا وكلمه ربه قال رب أرني أنظر إليك ۚ قال لن تراني ولكن انظر إلى الجبل فإن استقر مكانه فسوف تراني ۚ فلما تجلى ربه للجبل جعله دكا وخر موسى صعقا ۚ فلما أفاق قال سبحانك تبت إليك وأنا أول المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walammā jāa mūsā limīqātinā wakallamahu rabbuhu qāla rabbi arinī anẓur ilayka qāla lan tarānī walākini unẓur ilā l-jabali fa-ini is'taqarra makānahu fasawfa tarānī falammā tajallā rabbuhu lil'jabali jaʿalahu dakkan wakharra mūsā ṣaʿiqan falammā afāqa qāla sub'ḥānaka tub'tu ilayka wa-anā awwalu l-mu'minīn
verses.english: When Moses came at our appointed time, and his Lord spoke with him, he said, "My Lord, let me look and see You." He said, "You cannot see Me. Look at that mountain; if it stays in its place, then you can see Me." Then, his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, and this caused it to crumble. Moses fell unconscious. When he came to, he said, "Be You glorified. I repent to You, and I am the most convinced believer."

1981.english: When Moses came to our audience, and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, let me look at You and see You," He said, "You cannot see Me, but look at the mountain; if it stays in its place, then you can see Me." Then, when his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, He caused it to crumble, and Moses fell unconscious. When he came to, he said, "Glory be to You; I repent to You, and I am the first to believe."
1981.subtitle: God is Not Here
1981.footnote: While God controls everything in the universe to the extent that not even a leaf falls without His knowledge (6:59), our world cannot stand the "physical" presence of God (see also 56:4-6, 69:13-16, suras 81, 82, & 84, and Appendix 10).

1989.english: When Moses came at our appointed time, and his Lord spoke with him, he said, “My Lord, let me look and see You.” He said, “You cannot see Me. Look at that mountain; if it stays in its place, then you can see Me.” Then, his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, and this caused it to crumble. Moses fell unconscious. When he came to, he said, “Be You glorified. I repent to You, and I am the first believer.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى ٱصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِرِسَٰلَٰتِى وَبِكَلَٰمِى فَخُذْ مَآ ءَاتَيْتُكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا موسى إني اصطفيتك على الناس برسالاتي وبكلامي فخذ ما آتيتك وكن من الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāmūsā innī iṣ'ṭafaytuka ʿalā l-nāsi birisālātī wabikalāmī fakhudh mā ātaytuka wakun mina l-shākirīn
verses.english: He said, "O Moses, I have chosen you, out of all the people, with My messages and by speaking to you. Therefore, take what I have given you and be appreciative."

1981.english: God said, "O Moses, I have chosen you over the rest of the people with My messages and by speaking with you. You should take what I bestowed upon you, and be appreciative."

1989.english: He said, “O Moses, I have honored you, out of all the people, with My messages and by speaking to you. Take what I have given you and be appreciative.”

verses.arabic: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَلْوَٰحِ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوا۟ بِأَحْسَنِهَا سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ دَارَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكتبنا له في الألواح من كل شيء موعظة وتفصيلا لكل شيء فخذها بقوة وأمر قومك يأخذوا بأحسنها ۚ سأريكم دار الفاسقين
verses.transliterated: wakatabnā lahu fī l-alwāḥi min kulli shayin mawʿiẓatan watafṣīlan likulli shayin fakhudh'hā biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhudhū bi-aḥsanihā sa-urīkum dāra l-fāsiqīn
verses.english: We wrote for him on the tablets all kinds of enlightenments and details of everything: "You shall uphold these teachings strongly, and exhort your people to uphold them—these are the best teachings. I will point out for you the fate of the wicked."

1981.english: And we wrote for him on the tablets all kinds of enlightenments, and details of everything. "You shall firmly uphold these, and order your people to uphold the good teachings therein. I will point out for you the destiny of the wicked."

1989.english: We wrote for him on the tablets all kinds of enlightenments and details: “You shall uphold these teachings strongly, and command your people to uphold them— these are the best teachings. I will point out for you the fate of the wicked.”

verses.arabic: سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ سَبِيلَ ٱلرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ سَبِيلَ ٱلْغَىِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: سأصرف عن آياتي الذين يتكبرون في الأرض بغير الحق وإن يروا كل آية لا يؤمنوا بها وإن يروا سبيل الرشد لا يتخذوه سبيلا وإن يروا سبيل الغي يتخذوه سبيلا ۚ ذلك بأنهم كذبوا بآياتنا وكانوا عنها غافلين
verses.transliterated: sa-aṣrifu ʿan āyātiya alladhīna yatakabbarūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wa-in yaraw kulla āyatin lā yu'minū bihā wa-in yaraw sabīla l-rush'di lā yattakhidhūhu sabīlan wa-in yaraw sabīla l-ghayi yattakhidhūhu sabīlan dhālika bi-annahum kadhabū biāyātinā wakānū ʿanhā ghāfilīn
verses.english: I will divert from My revelations those who are arrogant on earth, without justification. Consequently, when they see every kind of proof they will not believe. And when they see the path of guidance they will not adopt it as their path, but when they see the path of straying they will adopt it as their path. This is the consequence of their rejecting our proofs, and being totally heedless thereof.
verses.subtitle: Divine Intervention Keeps the Disbelievers in the Dark

1981.english: I will divert from My revelations those who commit pride on earth, without justification. Consequently, even if they see all kinds of miracles, they will not believe therein, and when they see the path of guidance they will not accept it as their path, and when they see the path of evil they will accept it as their path. That is because they have rejected our revelations, and disregarded them.
1981.subtitle: The Curse of Pride

1989.english: I will divert from My revelations those who are arrogant on earth, without justification. Consequently, when they see every kind of miracle they will not believe. And when they see the path of guidance they will not adopt it as their path, but when they see the path of straying they will adopt it as their path. This is the consequence of their rejecting our revelations, and of being totally heedless thereof.
1989.subtitle: Divine Intervention Keeps the Disbelievers in the Dark

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كذبوا بآياتنا ولقاء الآخرة حبطت أعمالهم ۚ هل يجزون إلا ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā waliqāi l-ākhirati ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum hal yuj'zawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Those who reject our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, their works are nullified. Are they requited only for what they committed?

1981.english: Those who reject our revelations, and the meeting of the hereafter, their works are nullified. Have they not deserved the retribution by their actions?

1989.english: Those who reject our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, their works are in vain. Do they not pay for what they did?

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسَىٰ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلَا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا ٱتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واتخذ قوم موسى من بعده من حليهم عجلا جسدا له خوار ۚ ألم يروا أنه لا يكلمهم ولا يهديهم سبيلا ۘ اتخذوه وكانوا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-ittakhadha qawmu mūsā min baʿdihi min ḥuliyyihim ʿij'lan jasadan lahu khuwārun alam yaraw annahu lā yukallimuhum walā yahdīhim sabīlan ittakhadhūhu wakānū ẓālimīn
verses.english: During his absence, Moses' people made from their jewelry the statue of a calf, complete with the sound of a calf. Did they not see that it could not speak to them, or guide them in any path? They worshiped it, and thus turned wicked.
verses.subtitle: The Golden Calf
verses.footnote: How the golden calf acquired the sound of a calf is explained in Footnote 20:96.

1981.english: During his absence, the people of Moses sculpted from their jewelry a calf that produced a sound. Did they not see that it could not speak to them, nor help them in any way? They worshiped it and turned wicked.

1989.english: During his absence, Moses’ people made from their jewelry the statue of a calf, complete with the sound of a calf.* Could they not see that it could not speak to them, or guide them in any path? They worshiped it, and thus turned wicked.
1989.subtitle: The Golden Calf
1989.footnote: How the golden calf acquired the sound of a calf is explained in 20:96.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِىٓ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَرَأَوْا۟ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما سقط في أيديهم ورأوا أنهم قد ضلوا قالوا لئن لم يرحمنا ربنا ويغفر لنا لنكونن من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: walammā suqiṭa fī aydīhim wara-aw annahum qad ḍallū qālū la-in lam yarḥamnā rabbunā wayaghfir lanā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: Finally, when they regretted their action, and realized that they had gone astray, they said, "Unless our Lord redeems us with His mercy, and forgives us, we will be losers."

1981.english: When they finally wised up, and realized that they had deviated, they said, "Unless our Lord has mercy on us, and forgives us, we will be losers indeed."

1989.english: Finally, when they regretted their action, and realized that they had gone astray, they said, “Unless our Lord redeems us with His mercy, and forgives us, we will be losers.”

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَـٰنَ أَسِفًا قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُونِى مِنۢ بَعْدِىٓ أَعَجِلْتُمْ أَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَلْقَى ٱلْأَلْوَاحَ وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ ٱبْنَ أُمَّ إِنَّ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱسْتَضْعَفُونِى وَكَادُوا۟ يَقْتُلُونَنِى فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِىَ ٱلْأَعْدَآءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما رجع موسى إلى قومه غضبان أسفا قال بئسما خلفتموني من بعدي ۖ أعجلتم أمر ربكم ۖ وألقى الألواح وأخذ برأس أخيه يجره إليه ۚ قال ابن أم إن القوم استضعفوني وكادوا يقتلونني فلا تشمت بي الأعداء ولا تجعلني مع القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: walammā rajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla bi'samā khalaftumūnī min baʿdī aʿajil'tum amra rabbikum wa-alqā l-alwāḥa wa-akhadha birasi akhīhi yajurruhu ilayhi qāla ib'na umma inna l-qawma is'taḍʿafūnī wakādū yaqtulūnanī falā tush'mit biya l-aʿdāa walā tajʿalnī maʿa l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: When Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, he said, "What a terrible thing you have done in my absence! Could you not wait for the commandments of your Lord?" He threw down the tablets, and took hold of his brother's head, pulling him towards himself. (Aaron) said, "Son of my mother, the people took advantage of my weakness, and almost killed me. Let not my enemies rejoice, and do not count me with the transgressing people."

1981.english: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, he said, "Evil indeed is what you did in my absence. Were you in such a hurry to rebel against your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets, and took hold of his brother's head, dragging him. Aaron said, "Son of my mother, the people took advantage of my weakness, and almost killed me. Please do not let my enemies rejoice over my predicament, and do not count me with the wicked."

1989.english: When Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, he said, “What a terrible thing you have done in my absence! Could you not wait for the commandments of your Lord?” He threw down the tablets, and took hold of his brother’s head, pulling him towards himself. (Aaron) said, “Son of my mother, the people took advantage of my weakness, and almost killed me. Let not my enemies rejoice, and do not count me with the evildoers.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِأَخِى وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِى رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب اغفر لي ولأخي وأدخلنا في رحمتك ۖ وأنت أرحم الراحمين
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wali-akhī wa-adkhil'nā fī raḥmatika wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīn
verses.english: (Moses) said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy. Of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."

1981.english: Moses said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy. Of those who are merciful, You are the most merciful."

1989.english: (Moses) said, “My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy. You are the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ ٱلْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَذِلَّةٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُفْتَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين اتخذوا العجل سينالهم غضب من ربهم وذلة في الحياة الدنيا ۚ وكذلك نجزي المفترين
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ittakhadhū l-ʿij'la sayanāluhum ghaḍabun min rabbihim wadhillatun fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wakadhālika najzī l-muf'tarīn
verses.english: Surely, those who idolized the calf have incurred wrath from their Lord, and humiliation in this life. We thus requite the innovators.

1981.english: Indeed, those who idolized the calf have deserved wrath from their Lord, and disgrace in this life. We thus requite the fabricators.

1989.english: Surely, those who idolized the calf have incurred wrath from their Lord, and humiliation in this life. We thus requite the innovators.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا وَءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين عملوا السيئات ثم تابوا من بعدها وآمنوا إن ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna ʿamilū l-sayiāti thumma tābū min baʿdihā waāmanū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: As for those who committed sins, then repented thereafter and believed, your Lord—after this—is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: As for those who fall in sin, then repent thereafter, and believe, your Lord is then forgiving, merciful.

1989.english: As for those who committed sins, then repented thereafter and believed, your Lord—after this— is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى ٱلْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ ٱلْأَلْوَٰحَ وَفِى نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما سكت عن موسى الغضب أخذ الألواح ۖ وفي نسختها هدى ورحمة للذين هم لربهم يرهبون
verses.transliterated: walammā sakata ʿan mūsā l-ghaḍabu akhadha l-alwāḥa wafī nus'khatihā hudan waraḥmatun lilladhīna hum lirabbihim yarhabūn
verses.english: When Moses' anger subsided, he picked up the tablets, containing guidance and mercy for those who reverence their Lord.

1981.english: When Moses' anger subsided, he picked up the tablets, wherein guidance was written down, and mercy for those who reverence their Lord.

1989.english: When Moses’ anger subsided, he picked up the tablets, containing guidance and mercy for those who reverence their Lord.

verses.arabic: وَٱخْتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوْمَهُۥ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِّمِيقَٰتِنَا فَلَمَّآ أَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّٰىَ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهْدِى مَن تَشَآءُ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْغَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واختار موسى قومه سبعين رجلا لميقاتنا ۖ فلما أخذتهم الرجفة قال رب لو شئت أهلكتهم من قبل وإياي ۖ أتهلكنا بما فعل السفهاء منا ۖ إن هي إلا فتنتك تضل بها من تشاء وتهدي من تشاء ۖ أنت ولينا فاغفر لنا وارحمنا ۖ وأنت خير الغافرين
verses.transliterated: wa-ikh'tāra mūsā qawmahu sabʿīna rajulan limīqātinā falammā akhadhathumu l-rajfatu qāla rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa-iyyāya atuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-sufahāu minnā in hiya illā fit'natuka tuḍillu bihā man tashāu watahdī man tashāu anta waliyyunā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-ghāfirīn
verses.english: Moses then selected seventy men from among his people, to come to our appointed audience. When the quake shook them, he said, "My Lord, You could have annihilated them in the past, together with me, if You so willed. Would You annihilate us for the deeds of those among us who are foolish? This must be the test that You have instituted for us. With it, You condemn whomever You will, and guide whomever You will. You are our Lord and Master, so forgive us, shower us with Your mercy; You are the best Forgiver.

1981.english: Then Moses chose seventy men to have an audience with us. When the quake shook them, Moses said, "My Lord, had You willed, You could have annihilated them and me. Would You annihilate us because of what the fools among us had done? It was only Your test, whereby You send astray whomever You will, and guide whomever You will. You are our master, so forgive us, have mercy on us, and You are the best forgiver.

1989.english: Moses then selected seventy men from among his people, to come to our appointed audience. When the quake shook them, he said, “My Lord, You could have annihilated them in the past, together with me, if You so willed. Would You annihilate us for the deeds of those among us who are foolish? This must be the test that You have instituted for us. With it, You condemn whomever You will, and guide whomever You will. You are our Lord and Master, so forgive us, shower us with Your mercy; You are the best Forgiver. o

verses.arabic: وَٱكْتُبْ لَنَا فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ عَذَابِىٓ أُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَنْ أَشَآءُ وَرَحْمَتِى وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واكتب لنا في هذه الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة إنا هدنا إليك ۚ قال عذابي أصيب به من أشاء ۖ ورحمتي وسعت كل شيء ۚ فسأكتبها للذين يتقون ويؤتون الزكاة والذين هم بآياتنا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wa-uk'tub lanā fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wafī l-ākhirati innā hud'nā ilayka qāla ʿadhābī uṣību bihi man ashāu waraḥmatī wasiʿat kulla shayin fasa-aktubuhā lilladhīna yattaqūna wayu'tūna l-zakata wa-alladhīna hum biāyātinā yu'minūn
verses.english: "And decree for us righteousness in this world, and in the Hereafter. We have repented to You. He said, "My retribution befalls whomever I will. But My mercy encompasses all things. However, I will specify it for those who (1) lead a righteous life, (2) give the obligatory charity (Zakat), (3) believe in our revelations, and
verses.subtitle: Requirements For Attaining God's Mercy: The Importance of Zakat
verses.footnote: The importance of the obligatory charity (Zakat) cannot be over emphasized. As instituted in 6:141, Zakat must be given away upon receiving any income—2.5% of one's net income must be given to the parents, the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien, in this order (see 2:215).

1981.english: "And grant us righteousness in this life, and in the hereafter, for we have submitted to You." God said, "My retribution afflicts whomever I will, and My mercy encompasses all things. However, I will designate it for those who work righteousness, and give to charity, and believe in our revelations.

1989.english: “And decree for us righteousness in this world, and in the Hereafter. We have repented to You.” He said, “My retribution is incurred by whomever I will. But My mercy encompasses all things. However, I will specify it for those who (1) lead a righteous life, (2) give the obligatory charity {Zakat),* (3) believe in our revelations, and
1989.subtitle: Requirements For Attaining God’s Mercy The Importance of Zakat
1989.footnote: The importance of the obligatory charity (Zakat) cannot be over emphasized. As instituted in 6:141, Zakat must be given away upon receiving any income—2.5% of one’s net income must be given to the parents, the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien, in this order (see 2:215).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ ٱلنَّبِىَّ ٱلْأُمِّىَّ ٱلَّذِى يَجِدُونَهُۥ مَكْتُوبًا عِندَهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَٱلْإِنجِيلِ يَأْمُرُهُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَىٰهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْخَبَٰٓئِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ وَٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلنُّورَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ مَعَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يتبعون الرسول النبي الأمي الذي يجدونه مكتوبا عندهم في التوراة والإنجيل يأمرهم بالمعروف وينهاهم عن المنكر ويحل لهم الطيبات ويحرم عليهم الخبائث ويضع عنهم إصرهم والأغلال التي كانت عليهم ۚ فالذين آمنوا به وعزروه ونصروه واتبعوا النور الذي أنزل معه ۙ أولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yattabiʿūna l-rasūla l-nabiya l-umiya alladhī yajidūnahu maktūban ʿindahum fī l-tawrāti wal-injīli yamuruhum bil-maʿrūfi wayanhāhum ʿani l-munkari wayuḥillu lahumu l-ṭayibāti wayuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu l-khabāitha wayaḍaʿu ʿanhum iṣ'rahum wal-aghlāla allatī kānat ʿalayhim fa-alladhīna āmanū bihi waʿazzarūhu wanaṣarūhu wa-ittabaʿū l-nūra alladhī unzila maʿahu ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: "(4) follow the messenger, the gentile prophet (Muhammad), whom they find written in their Torah and Gospel. He exhorts them to be righteous, enjoins them from evil, allows for them all good food, and prohibits that which is bad, and unloads the burdens and the shackles imposed upon them. Those who believe in him, respect him, support him, and follow the light that came with him are the successful ones."
verses.footnote: Muhammad is prophesied in Deuteronomy 18:15-19 and John 14:16-17 & 16:13.

1981.english: "Also for those who follow the messenger, the Gentile prophet, whom they find written in their Torah and Gospel. He exhorts them to work righteousness and to refrain from evil, and he permits for them the good things and prohibits the bad, and he unloads the burdens of their covenant and removes the chains that bind them. Thus, those who believe in him, honor him, support him, and follow the light that was sent down with him, they are the winners."
1981.subtitle: Quran: God's Message to the Jews and the Christians
1981.footnote: See the inside front cover of this book.

1989.english: “(4) follow the messenger, the gentile prophet {Muhammad), whom they find written in their Torah and Gospel.* He prescribes for them righteousness, enjoins them from evil, allows for them all good food, and prohibits that which is bad, and unloads the burdens and the shackles imposed upon them. Those who believe in him, respect him, support him, and follow the light that came with him are the successful ones.”
1989.footnote: Muhammad is prophesied in Deuteronomy 18:15-19 and John 14:16-17 & 16:13.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ ٱلْأُمِّىِّ ٱلَّذِى يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَٱتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أيها الناس إني رسول الله إليكم جميعا الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض ۖ لا إله إلا هو يحيي ويميت ۖ فآمنوا بالله ورسوله النبي الأمي الذي يؤمن بالله وكلماته واتبعوه لعلكم تهتدون
verses.transliterated: qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innī rasūlu l-lahi ilaykum jamīʿan alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi l-nabiyi l-umiyi alladhī yu'minu bil-lahi wakalimātihi wa-ittabiʿūhu laʿallakum tahtadūn
verses.english: Say, "O people, I am GOD's messenger to all of you. To Him belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. There is no god except He. He controls life and death." Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messenger, the gentile prophet, who believes in GOD and His words. Follow him, that you may be guided.

1981.english: Say, "O people, I am God's messenger to all of you. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. There is no god except He. He grants life and death." Therefore, you shall believe in God and His messenger, the Gentile prophet, who believes in God and His words, and follow him, that you may be guided.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad: God's Messenger to ALL the People

1989.english: Say, “O people, I am GOD’s messenger to all of you. To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. There is no god except He. He controls life and death.” You shall believe in GOD and His messenger, the gentile prophet, who believes in GOD and His words. Follow him, that you may be guided.

verses.arabic: وَمِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰٓ أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن قوم موسى أمة يهدون بالحق وبه يعدلون
verses.transliterated: wamin qawmi mūsā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūn
verses.english: Among the followers of Moses there are those who guide in accordance with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.
verses.subtitle: The Guided Jews

1981.english: Among the followers of Moses, there are those who guide by the truth and judge accordingly.
1981.subtitle: The Example of Israel
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Among the followers of Moses there are those who guide in accordance with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.
1989.subtitle: The Children of Israel

verses.arabic: وَقَطَّعْنَٰهُمُ ٱثْنَتَىْ عَشْرَةَ أَسْبَاطًا أُمَمًا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰهُ قَوْمُهُۥٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ فَٱنۢبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْغَمَٰمَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقطعناهم اثنتي عشرة أسباطا أمما ۚ وأوحينا إلى موسى إذ استسقاه قومه أن اضرب بعصاك الحجر ۖ فانبجست منه اثنتا عشرة عينا ۖ قد علم كل أناس مشربهم ۚ وظللنا عليهم الغمام وأنزلنا عليهم المن والسلوى ۖ كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم ۚ وما ظلمونا ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: waqaṭṭaʿnāhumu ith'natay ʿashrata asbāṭan umaman wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā idhi is'tasqāhu qawmuhu ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-ḥajara fa-inbajasat min'hu ith'natā ʿashrata ʿaynan qad ʿalima kullu unāsin mashrabahum waẓallalnā ʿalayhimu l-ghamāma wa-anzalnā ʿalayhimu l-mana wal-salwā kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: We divided them into twelve tribal communities, and we inspired Moses when his people asked him for water: "Strike the rock with your staff," whereupon twelve springs gushed out therefrom. Thus, each community knew its water. And we shaded them with clouds, and sent down to them manna and quails: "Eat from the good things we provided for you." It is not us that they wronged; it is they who wronged their own souls.
verses.subtitle: Miracles in Sinai

1981.english: We divided them into twelve tribal communities, and when his people asked for water, we inspired Moses to strike the rock with his staff. Whereupon, twelve springs gushed out therefrom; one for each tribe. And we shaded them with clouds, and sent down to them manna and quails. Eat from the good things we provided for you. They did not harm us (by rebelling); they only harmed themselves.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: We divided them into twelve tribal communities, and we inspired Moses when his people asked him for water: “Strike the rock with your staff,” whereupon twelve springs gushed out therefrom. Thus, each community knew its water. And we shaded them with clouds, and sent down to them manna and quails: “Eat from the good things we provided for you.” It is not us that they wronged; it is they who wronged their own souls.
1989.subtitle: Miracles in Sinai

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِكُمْ سَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قيل لهم اسكنوا هذه القرية وكلوا منها حيث شئتم وقولوا حطة وادخلوا الباب سجدا نغفر لكم خطيئاتكم ۚ سنزيد المحسنين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qīla lahumu us'kunū hādhihi l-qaryata wakulū min'hā ḥaythu shi'tum waqūlū ḥiṭṭatun wa-ud'khulū l-bāba sujjadan naghfir lakum khaṭīātikum sanazīdu l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Recall that they were told, "Go into this town to live, and eat therefrom as you please, treat the people amicably, and enter the gate humbly. We will then forgive your transgressions. We will multiply the reward for the righteous."
verses.subtitle: Rebellion Despite the Miracles

1981.english: They were told, "Live in this town, and eat therefrom as you please. If you speak humbly, and enter the gate in peace, we will forgive your sins, and reward the pious."
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Recall that they were told, “Go into this town to live, and eat therefrom as you please, speak amicably, and enter the gate humbly. We will then forgive your transgressions, and multiply the reward for the righteous.”
1989.subtitle: Rebellion Despite the Miracles

verses.arabic: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فبدل الذين ظلموا منهم قولا غير الذي قيل لهم فأرسلنا عليهم رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: fabaddala alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum qawlan ghayra alladhī qīla lahum fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yaẓlimūn
verses.english: But the evil ones among them substituted other commands for the commands given to them. Consequently, we sent upon them condemnation from the sky, because of their wickedness.

1981.english: But the wicked among them listened to commandments other than the commandments given to them, and consequently, we afflicted them with a curse from the sky because of their wickedness.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: But the evil ones among them substituted other commands for the commands given to them. Consequently, we sent upon them condemnation from the sky, because of their wickedness.

verses.arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَٰنُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واسألهم عن القرية التي كانت حاضرة البحر إذ يعدون في السبت إذ تأتيهم حيتانهم يوم سبتهم شرعا ويوم لا يسبتون ۙ لا تأتيهم ۚ كذلك نبلوهم بما كانوا يفسقون
verses.transliterated: wasalhum ʿani l-qaryati allatī kānat ḥāḍirata l-baḥri idh yaʿdūna fī l-sabti idh tatīhim ḥītānuhum yawma sabtihim shurraʿan wayawma lā yasbitūna lā tatīhim kadhālika nablūhum bimā kānū yafsuqūn
verses.english: Remind them of the community by the sea, who desecrated the Sabbath. When they observed the Sabbath, the fish came to them abundantly. And when they violated the Sabbath, the fish did not come. We thus afflicted them, as a consequence of their transgression.
verses.subtitle: Observing the Commandments Brings Prosperity

1981.english: And ask them about the town by the sea shore. Because they desecrated the Sabbath, the fish came to them abundantly on the Sabbath day, but not so on the other days. We thus put them to the test, as a consequence of their wicked actions.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Remind them of the community by the sea, who desecrated the Sabbath. When they observed the Sabbath, the fish came to them abundantly. And when they violated the Sabbath, the fish did not come. We thus afflicted them, as a consequence of their transgression. o
1989.subtitle: Observing the Commandments Brings Prosperity

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا ٱللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا قَالُوا۟ مَعْذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قالت أمة منهم لم تعظون قوما ۙ الله مهلكهم أو معذبهم عذابا شديدا ۖ قالوا معذرة إلى ربكم ولعلهم يتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qālat ummatun min'hum lima taʿiẓūna qawman l-lahu muh'likuhum aw muʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan qālū maʿdhiratan ilā rabbikum walaʿallahum yattaqūn
verses.english: Recall that a group of them said, "Why should you preach to people whom GOD will surely annihilate or punish severely?" They answered, "Apologize to your Lord," that they might be saved.
verses.subtitle: Mocking and Ridiculing God's Message

1981.english: And recall that some of them said, "Why should you preach to people whom God is supposed to destroy or punish severely?" They answered, "Perhaps you can apologize to your Lord, and then attain salvation."
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Recall that a community among them said, “Why should you preach to people whom GOD will surely annihilate or punish severely?” They answered, “Apologize to your Lord,” that they might be saved.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلسُّوٓءِ وَأَخَذْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ بِعَذَابٍۭ بَـِٔيسٍۭ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء وأخذنا الذين ظلموا بعذاب بئيس بما كانوا يفسقون
verses.transliterated: falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihi anjaynā alladhīna yanhawna ʿani l-sūi wa-akhadhnā alladhīna ẓalamū biʿadhābin baīsin bimā kānū yafsuqūn
verses.english: When they disregarded what they were reminded of, we saved those who prohibited evil, and afflicted the wrongdoers with a terrible retribution for their wickedness.

1981.english: When they neglected the message given to them, we saved those who spoke up against evil, and punished the wrongdoers severely because of their wicked actions.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: When they disregarded what they were reminded of, we saved those who condemned evil, and afflicted the wrongdoers with a terrible retribution for their wickedness.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا۟ عَن مَّا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَٰسِـِٔينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما عتوا عن ما نهوا عنه قلنا لهم كونوا قردة خاسئين
verses.transliterated: falammā ʿataw ʿan mā nuhū ʿanhu qul'nā lahum kūnū qiradatan khāsiīn
