verses.english: When they continued to defy the commandments, we said to them, "Be you despicable apes."

1981.english: Because they transgressed the laws of prohibition, we said to them, "Be you despicable apes."
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: When they continued to defy the commandments, we said to them, “Be you despicable apes.”

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَن يَسُومُهُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ تأذن ربك ليبعثن عليهم إلى يوم القيامة من يسومهم سوء العذاب ۗ إن ربك لسريع العقاب ۖ وإنه لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-idh ta-adhana rabbuka layabʿathanna ʿalayhim ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati man yasūmuhum sūa l-ʿadhābi inna rabbaka lasarīʿu l-ʿiqābi wa-innahu laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Additionally, your Lord has decreed that He will raise up against them people who will inflict severe persecution upon them, until the Day of Resurrection. Your Lord is most efficient in enforcing retribution, and He is certainly the Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: (Because of their transgressions,) your Lord has decreed that tyrants will rise up against them, and persecute them, until the day of resurrection. Indeed, your Lord is most strict in imposing retribution, and He is forgiving, merciful.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Additionally, your Lord decreed that He will raise up against them people who will inflict severe persecution upon them, until the Day of Resurrection. Your Lord is most efficient in enforcing retribution, and He is certainly the Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَقَطَّعْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أُمَمًا مِّنْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنْهُمْ دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَبَلَوْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَسَنَٰتِ وَٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقطعناهم في الأرض أمما ۖ منهم الصالحون ومنهم دون ذلك ۖ وبلوناهم بالحسنات والسيئات لعلهم يرجعون
verses.transliterated: waqaṭṭaʿnāhum fī l-arḍi umaman min'humu l-ṣāliḥūna wamin'hum dūna dhālika wabalawnāhum bil-ḥasanāti wal-sayiāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.english: We scattered them among many communities throughout the land. Some of them were righteous, and some were less than righteous. We tested them with prosperity and hardship, that they may return.

1981.english: And we scattered them throughout the earth, into many communities. Some of them are righteous, while others are less than righteous. We tested them with prosperity, as well as adversity, that they may return.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: We scattered them among many communities throughout the land. Some of them were righteous, and some were less than righteous. We tested them with prosperity and hardship, that they may return.

verses.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَٰذَا ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ وَيَقُولُونَ سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا وَإِن يَأْتِهِمْ عَرَضٌ مِّثْلُهُۥ يَأْخُذُوهُ أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِم مِّيثَٰقُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَن لَّا يَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ وَٱلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فخلف من بعدهم خلف ورثوا الكتاب يأخذون عرض هذا الأدنى ويقولون سيغفر لنا وإن يأتهم عرض مثله يأخذوه ۚ ألم يؤخذ عليهم ميثاق الكتاب أن لا يقولوا على الله إلا الحق ودرسوا ما فيه ۗ والدار الآخرة خير للذين يتقون ۗ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun warithū l-kitāba yakhudhūna ʿaraḍa hādhā l-adnā wayaqūlūna sayugh'faru lanā wa-in yatihim ʿaraḍun mith'luhu yakhudhūhu alam yu'khadh ʿalayhim mīthāqu l-kitābi an lā yaqūlū ʿalā l-lahi illā l-ḥaqa wadarasū mā fīhi wal-dāru l-ākhiratu khayrun lilladhīna yattaqūna afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: Subsequent to them, He substituted new generations who inherited the scripture. But they opted for the worldly life instead, saying, "We will be forgiven." But then they continued to opt for the materials of this world. Did they not make a covenant to uphold the scripture, and not to say about GOD except the truth? Did they not study the scripture? Certainly, the abode of the Hereafter is far better for those who maintain righteousness. Do you not understand?

1981.english: Then God replaced them with new generations who inherited the scripture. But they preferred the materials of this world, saying, "We will be forgiven." Then again, they became attracted to similar materials. Did they not covenant that they will uphold the scripture, and never to say about God except the truth? Did they not study the scripture? Indeed, the abode of the hereafter is far better for those who work righteousness. Do you not understand?
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Subsequent to them, He substituted new generations who inherited the scripture. But they opted for the worldly life instead. TTiey said, “We will be forgiven,” but then they continued to opt for the materials of this world. Did they not make a covenant to uphold the scripture, and not to say about GOD except the truth? Did they not study the scripture? Certainly, the abode of the Hereafter is far better for those who maintain righteousness. Do you not understand?

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يمسكون بالكتاب وأقاموا الصلاة إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yumassikūna bil-kitābi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata innā lā nuḍīʿu ajra l-muṣ'liḥīn
verses.english: Those who uphold the scripture, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), we never fail to recompense the pious.

1981.english: Those who strictly adhere to the scripture, and observe the **salat** prayers, we never neglect to recompense the righteous.
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: Those who uphold the scripture, and observe the contact prayers (Salat), we never fail to reward the pious.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا ٱلْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُۥ ظُلَّةٌ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ نتقنا الجبل فوقهم كأنه ظلة وظنوا أنه واقع بهم خذوا ما آتيناكم بقوة واذكروا ما فيه لعلكم تتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh nataqnā l-jabala fawqahum ka-annahu ẓullatun waẓannū annahu wāqiʿun bihim khudhū mā ātaynākum biquwwatin wa-udh'kurū mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūn
verses.english: We raised the mountain above them like an umbrella, and they thought it was going to fall on them: "You shall uphold what we have given you, strongly, and remember the contents thereof, that you may be saved."

1981.english: As we raised the mountain above them like a canopy, and they thought it was about to fall with them, we said, "You shall uphold what we have given you, strongly, and study the contents thereof, that you may attain salvation."
1981.footnote: There is a great parallel between the followers of Moses, and the followers of Muhammad. This explains the fact that the history of Israel is narrated in such detail, and in such frequency throughout the Quran. The parallel becomes incredibly manifest when the reader notes that the followers of Moses invented the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) to overtake God's scripture, the Torah. The Muslims invented **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake Quran (see 24:1-2). Thus, both groups fell into idol worship in an almost identical manner.

1989.english: We raised the mountain above them like an umbrella, until they thought it was going to fall on them: “You shall uphold what we have given you, strongly, and remember the contents thereof, that you may be saved.” Your Covenant With God*

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ مِن ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ شَهِدْنَآ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّا كُنَّا عَنْ هَٰذَا غَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذ ربك من بني آدم من ظهورهم ذريتهم وأشهدهم على أنفسهم ألست بربكم ۖ قالوا بلى ۛ شهدنا ۛ أن تقولوا يوم القيامة إنا كنا عن هذا غافلين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadha rabbuka min banī ādama min ẓuhūrihim dhurriyyatahum wa-ashhadahum ʿalā anfusihim alastu birabbikum qālū balā shahid'nā an taqūlū yawma l-qiyāmati innā kunnā ʿan hādhā ghāfilīn
verses.english: Recall that your Lord summoned all the descendants of Adam, and had them bear witness for themselves: "Am I not your Lord?" They all said, "Yes. We bear witness." Thus, you cannot say on the Day of Resurrection, "We were not aware of this."
verses.subtitle: We Are Born With Instinctive Knowledge About God
verses.footnote: Thus, every human being is born with an instinctive knowledge about God.

1981.english: Recall that your Lord gathered all the descendants of Adam (before creation), and had them bear witness on themselves, saying, "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes indeed, we bear witness." Therefore, you cannot say on the day of resurrection, "We never knew about this!"
1981.subtitle: Knowledge of God: Our Natural Instinct
1981.footnote: A frequently asked question is, "What is the fault of one who grew up in a pagan society, or an atheistic environment?" These verses teach us that we have all witnessed our creator before the creation of Adam, and thus, we are born with the knowledge about God as a natural instinct. We also learn from these verses that no one is excused for not reaching and worshiping God. A prominent Quranic example is Abraham; he grew up in a pagan society, and his own father was the maker of idols. But he observed the world around him, and independently reached God (see 6:74-79).

1989.english: Recall that your Lord summoned all the descendants of Adam, and had them bear witness for themselves: “Am I not your Lord?” They all said, “Yes. We bear witness.” Thus, you cannot say on the Day of Resurrection, “We were not aware of this.”
1989.footnote: Thus, every human being is born with an instinctive knowledge about God.

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَقُولُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَشْرَكَ ءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ أَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أو تقولوا إنما أشرك آباؤنا من قبل وكنا ذرية من بعدهم ۖ أفتهلكنا بما فعل المبطلون
verses.transliterated: aw taqūlū innamā ashraka ābāunā min qablu wakunnā dhurriyyatan min baʿdihim afatuh'likunā bimā faʿala l-mub'ṭilūn
verses.english: Nor can you say, "It was our parents who practiced idolatry, and we simply followed in their footsteps. Will You punish us because of what others have innovated?"

1981.english: Nor can you say, "It was our parents who set up idols, and we followed in their footsteps. Would you punish us for what the falsehood inventors have done?"
1981.footnote: A frequently asked question is, "What is the fault of one who grew up in a pagan society, or an atheistic environment?" These verses teach us that we have all witnessed our creator before the creation of Adam, and thus, we are born with the knowledge about God as a natural instinct. We also learn from these verses that no one is excused for not reaching and worshiping God. A prominent Quranic example is Abraham; he grew up in a pagan society, and his own father was the maker of idols. But he observed the world around him, and independently reached God (see 6:74-79).

1989.english: Nor can you say, “It was our parents who practiced idolatry, and we simply followed in their footsteps. Will You punish us for the sins of the innovators?”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك نفصل الآيات ولعلهم يرجعون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti walaʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.english: We thus explain the revelations, to enable the people to redeem themselves.
verses.footnote: This life is our last chance to return to God's Kingdom (See INTRODUCTION).

1981.english: We thus explain the revelations; perhaps they come back.

1989.english: We thus explain the revelations, to enable them to return.*
1989.footnote: This life is our last chance to return to God’s Kingdom (See INTRODUCTION).

verses.arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَٱنسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واتل عليهم نبأ الذي آتيناه آياتنا فانسلخ منها فأتبعه الشيطان فكان من الغاوين
verses.transliterated: wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a alladhī ātaynāhu āyātinā fa-insalakha min'hā fa-atbaʿahu l-shayṭānu fakāna mina l-ghāwīn
verses.english: Recite for them the news of one who was given our proofs, but chose to disregard them. Consequently, the devil pursued him, until he became a strayer.

1981.english: And recite for them the example of one who received our revelations, but disregarded them. Consequently, the devil pursued him, and he became lost.

1989.english: Recite for them the news of one who was given our revelations, but discarded them. Consequently, the devil pursued him, until he became a strayer.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَٰهُ بِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْكَلْبِ إِن تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَث ذَّٰلِكَ مَثَلُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَٱقْصُصِ ٱلْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو شئنا لرفعناه بها ولكنه أخلد إلى الأرض واتبع هواه ۚ فمثله كمثل الكلب إن تحمل عليه يلهث أو تتركه يلهث ۚ ذلك مثل القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا ۚ فاقصص القصص لعلهم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: walaw shi'nā larafaʿnāhu bihā walākinnahu akhlada ilā l-arḍi wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu famathaluhu kamathali l-kalbi in taḥmil ʿalayhi yalhath aw tatruk'hu yalhath dhālika mathalu l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-uq'ṣuṣi l-qaṣaṣa laʿallahum yatafakkarūn
verses.english: Had we willed, we could have elevated him therewith, but he insisted on sticking to the ground, and pursued his own opinions. Thus, he is like the dog; whether you pet him or scold him, he pants. Such is the example of people who reject our proofs. Narrate these narrations, that they may reflect.

1981.english: Had we willed, we could have elevated him with the scripture, but he insisted on sticking to the ground, and following his own opinions. His example is that of the dog; if you give him attention he pants, and if you ignore him he pants. Such is the example of those who reject our revelations. You shall narrate these narrations, that they may reflect.

1989.english: Had we willed, we could have exalted him therewith, but he insisted on sticking to the ground, as he pursued his lusts. Thus, he is like the dog; whether you pet him or scold him, he pants. Such is the example of people who reject our revelations. Narrate these narrations, that they may reflect.

verses.arabic: سَآءَ مَثَلًا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَأَنفُسَهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ساء مثلا القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا وأنفسهم كانوا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: sāa mathalan l-qawmu alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā wa-anfusahum kānū yaẓlimūn
verses.english: Bad indeed is the example of people who reject our proofs; it is only their own souls that they wrong.

1981.english: Miserable indeed is the example of those who reject our revelations; they only hurt themselves.

1989.english: Bad indeed is the example of people who rejected our revelations; it is only their own souls that they wronged.

verses.arabic: مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِى وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من يهد الله فهو المهتدي ۖ ومن يضلل فأولئك هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: man yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadī waman yuḍ'lil fa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: Whomever GOD guides is the truly guided one, and whomever He commits to straying, these are the losers.

1981.english: Whomever God guides is the truly guided one, and whomever He sends astray, these are the losers.

1989.english: Whomever GOD guides is the truly guided one, and whomever He commits to straying, these are the losers.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد ذرأنا لجهنم كثيرا من الجن والإنس ۖ لهم قلوب لا يفقهون بها ولهم أعين لا يبصرون بها ولهم آذان لا يسمعون بها ۚ أولئك كالأنعام بل هم أضل ۚ أولئك هم الغافلون
verses.transliterated: walaqad dharanā lijahannama kathīran mina l-jini wal-insi lahum qulūbun lā yafqahūna bihā walahum aʿyunun lā yub'ṣirūna bihā walahum ādhānun lā yasmaʿūna bihā ulāika kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu ulāika humu l-ghāfilūn
verses.english: We have committed to Hell multitudes of jinns and humans. They have minds with which they do not understand, eyes with which they do not see, and ears with which they do not hear. They are like animals; no, they are far worse—they are totally unaware.
verses.subtitle: Satan Hypnotizes His Constituents

1981.english: We have assigned to hell multitudes of jinns and humans. They are the ones who have hearts that do not understand, eyes that do not see, and ears that do not hear. They are like animals; no, they are even worse. They are unaware.
1981.footnote: See the Gospel of Matthew 13:13-16.

1989.english: We have committed to Hell multitudes of jinns and humans. They have minds with which they do not understand, eyes with which they do not see, and ears with which they do not hear. They are like animals; in fact, they are far worse—they are totally unaware.
1989.subtitle: Satan Hypnotizes His Constituents

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَٰٓئِهِۦ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها ۖ وذروا الذين يلحدون في أسمائه ۚ سيجزون ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: walillahi l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā fa-id'ʿūhu bihā wadharū alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī asmāihi sayuj'zawna mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: To GOD belongs the most beautiful names; call upon Him therewith, and disregard those who distort His names. They will be requited for their sins.

1981.english: To God belong the most beautiful names, so call upon Him therewith, and disregard those who distort His names.* They will be punished for their work.
1981.footnote: Among the common inventions are the so-called "99 names of God," many of which are not mentioned in Quran. Not to be outdone, those who idolize the prophet Muhammad against his will have invented 201 names of Muhammad. These names, dutyfully engraved on the walls of the prophet's mosque in Medina, include some of God's own exclusive names, such as "Al-Muhaymin = the Supreme Being," and "Al-Shaafee = The Healer."

1989.english: To GOD belongs the most beautiful names; call upon Him therewith, and disregard those who distort His names. They will pay for their sins.

verses.arabic: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وممن خلقنا أمة يهدون بالحق وبه يعدلون
verses.transliterated: wamimman khalaqnā ummatun yahdūna bil-ḥaqi wabihi yaʿdilūn
verses.english: Among our creations, there are those who guide with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.

1981.english: Among our creation, there are those who guide with the truth, and live accordingly.

1989.english: Among our creations, there are those who guide with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كذبوا بآياتنا سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: As for those who reject our revelations, we lead them on without them ever realizing it.

1981.english: As for those who reject our revelations, we will lead them on, without them ever realizing it.

1989.english: As for those who reject our revelations, we lead them on whence they never know.

verses.arabic: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وأملي لهم ۚ إن كيدي متين
verses.transliterated: wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnu
verses.english: I will even encourage them; My scheming is formidable.

1981.english: I will even encourage them; indeed, My scheming is formidable.

1989.english: I will even encourage them; My scheming is perfect.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم مِّن جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يتفكروا ۗ ما بصاحبهم من جنة ۚ إن هو إلا نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: awalam yatafakkarū mā biṣāḥibihim min jinnatin in huwa illā nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: Why do they not reflect upon their friend (the messenger)? He is not crazy. He is simply a profound warner.

1981.english: Have they not reflected on their friend? He is not crazy; he is simply a manifest warner.

1989.english: Why do they not reflect upon their friend (the messenger)? He is not crazy. He is simply a profound warner.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا۟ فِى مَلَكُوتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ وَأَنْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَدِ ٱقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم ينظروا في ملكوت السماوات والأرض وما خلق الله من شيء وأن عسى أن يكون قد اقترب أجلهم ۖ فبأي حديث بعده يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: awalam yanẓurū fī malakūti l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin wa-an ʿasā an yakūna qadi iq'taraba ajaluhum fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūn
verses.english: Have they not looked at the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all the things GOD has created? Does it ever occur to them that the end of their life may be near? Which Hadith, beside this, do they believe in?

1981.english: Have they not seen the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all the things that God created? Does it ever occur to them that the end of their life may be near at hand? In which "**hadith**" (narration), other than this, do they believe in?
1981.subtitle: Quran is the Only "Hadith"

1989.english: Have they not looked at the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all the things created by GOD? Does it ever occur to them that the end of their life may be near? Which Hadith, besides this, do they believe in?

verses.arabic: مَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِىَ لَهُۥ وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من يضلل الله فلا هادي له ۚ ويذرهم في طغيانهم يعمهون
verses.transliterated: man yuḍ'lili l-lahu falā hādiya lahu wayadharuhum fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūn
verses.english: Whomever GOD commits to straying, there is no way for anyone to guide him. He leaves them in their sins, blundering.

1981.english: Whomever God sends astray, will find none to guide him, and He leaves them in their transgression, blundering.

1989.english: Whomever GOD commits to straying, there is no way for anyone to guide him. He leaves them in their sins, blundering.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقْتِهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ ثَقُلَتْ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَا تَأْتِيكُمْ إِلَّا بَغْتَةً يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِىٌّ عَنْهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يسألونك عن الساعة أيان مرساها ۖ قل إنما علمها عند ربي ۖ لا يجليها لوقتها إلا هو ۚ ثقلت في السماوات والأرض ۚ لا تأتيكم إلا بغتة ۗ يسألونك كأنك حفي عنها ۖ قل إنما علمها عند الله ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī lā yujallīhā liwaqtihā illā huwa thaqulat fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā tatīkum illā baghtatan yasalūnaka ka-annaka ḥafiyyun ʿanhā qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: They ask you about the end of the world (the Hour), and when it will come to pass. Say, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord. Only He reveals its time. Heavy it is, in the heavens and the earth. It will not come to you except suddenly." They ask you as if you are in control thereof. Say, "The knowledge thereof is with GOD," but most people do not know.
verses.footnote:
The right time to reveal this information was predestined to be 1980 A.D., through God's Messenger of the Covenant (See 15:87, 72:27, and Appendices 2 & 11).

±±7:187 The "Hour" comes "suddenly" only to the disbelievers (See Appendix 11).

1981.english: They ask you (O Muhammad) about the Hour, and when it will come! Say, "Only my Lord possesses such knowledge. None can reveal its time except He. Heavy indeed is such an event, in the heavens and the earth, and it will not come to you except suddenly." They ask you as if you are cognizant thereof. Say, "The knowledge thereof is with God alone, but most people do not know."
1981.subtitle: Do Not Idolize Muhammad

1989.english: They ask you (O Muhammad) about the end of the world (the Hour),* and when it will come to pass. Say, “The knowledge thereof is with my Lord. Only He reveals its time.* Heavy it is, in the heavens and the earth. It will not come to you except suddenly.”** They ask you as if you are in control thereof. Say, “The knowledge thereof is with GOD,” but most people do not know.
1989.footnote: The “Hour” comes “suddenly” only to the disbelievers (See Appendix 11).

verses.arabic: قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْ كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ لَٱسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِىَ ٱلسُّوٓءُ إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا أملك لنفسي نفعا ولا ضرا إلا ما شاء الله ۚ ولو كنت أعلم الغيب لاستكثرت من الخير وما مسني السوء ۚ إن أنا إلا نذير وبشير لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: qul lā amliku linafsī nafʿan walā ḍarran illā mā shāa l-lahu walaw kuntu aʿlamu l-ghayba la-is'takthartu mina l-khayri wamā massaniya l-sūu in anā illā nadhīrun wabashīrun liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: Say, "I have no power to benefit myself, or harm myself. Only what GOD wills happens to me. If I knew the future, I would have increased my wealth, and no harm would have afflicted me. I am no more than a warner, and a bearer of good news for those who believe."
verses.subtitle: Messengers Are Powerless; They Do Not Know the Future.

1981.english: Say (O Muhammad), "I possess no power to either benefit, or harm myself. Only what God wills takes place. Had I known the future, I would have increased my wealth, and no harm would have afflicted me. I am no more than a warner and preacher for those who believe."

1989.english: Say, “I have no power to benefit myself, or harm myself. Only what GOD wills happens to me. If I knew the future, I would have increased my wealth, and no harm would have afflicted me. I am no more than a warner, and a bearer of good news for those who believe.”
1989.subtitle: Messengers Are Powerless Do Not Know the Future

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّىٰهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا فَمَرَّتْ بِهِۦ فَلَمَّآ أَثْقَلَت دَّعَوَا ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنْ ءَاتَيْتَنَا صَٰلِحًا لَّنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة وجعل منها زوجها ليسكن إليها ۖ فلما تغشاها حملت حملا خفيفا فمرت به ۖ فلما أثقلت دعوا الله ربهما لئن آتيتنا صالحا لنكونن من الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin wajaʿala min'hā zawjahā liyaskuna ilayhā falammā taghashāhā ḥamalat ḥamlan khafīfan famarrat bihi falammā athqalat daʿawā l-laha rabbahumā la-in ātaytanā ṣāliḥan lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīn
verses.english: He created you from one person (Adam). Subsequently, He gives every man a mate to find tranquility with her. She then carries a light load that she can hardly notice. As the load gets heavier, they implore GOD their Lord: "If You give us a good baby, we will be appreciative."
verses.subtitle: Our Children Can be Idols

1981.english: God is the one who created you from one person, then created his mate from him to keep him company. When a man gets together with his wife, she first carries a light load that she hardly notices. Then, when the load becomes heavier, they implore God their Lord, "If You give us a good healthy baby, we will be appreciative."
1981.subtitle: Various Kinds of Idols
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: He created you from one person (Adam). Subsequently, He gives every man a mate to find tranquility with her. She then carries a light load that she hardly notice. As the load gets heavier, they implore GOD their Lord: “If You give us a good baby, we will be appreciative.”
1989.subtitle: Our Children Can hp IHnh

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا صَٰلِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُۥ شُرَكَآءَ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما آتاهما صالحا جعلا له شركاء فيما آتاهما ۚ فتعالى الله عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: falammā ātāhumā ṣāliḥan jaʿalā lahu shurakāa fīmā ātāhumā fataʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: But when He gives them a good baby, they turn His gift into an idol that rivals Him. GOD be exalted, far above any partnership.

1981.english: However, when He gives them a good healthy baby, they set up an idol out of God's gift to them. Most exalted is God, over and above anything they idolize.
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: But when He gives them a good baby, they turn His gift into an idol that rivals Him. GOD be exalted, far above any partnership.

verses.arabic: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أيشركون ما لا يخلق شيئا وهم يخلقون
verses.transliterated: ayush'rikūna mā lā yakhluqu shayan wahum yukh'laqūn
verses.english: Is it not a fact that they are idolizing idols who create nothing, and are themselves created?

1981.english: How could they idolize idols that create nothing, and are themselves created?
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: Is it not a fact that they are idolizing idols who create nothing, and are themselves created?

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَنصُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يستطيعون لهم نصرا ولا أنفسهم ينصرون
verses.transliterated: walā yastaṭīʿūna lahum naṣran walā anfusahum yanṣurūn
verses.english: Idols that can neither help them, nor even help themselves?

1981.english: They are too powerless to help them, or even help themselves.
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: Idols that can neither help them, nor even help themselves?

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنتُمْ صَٰمِتُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن تدعوهم إلى الهدى لا يتبعوكم ۚ سواء عليكم أدعوتموهم أم أنتم صامتون
verses.transliterated: wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yattabiʿūkum sawāon ʿalaykum adaʿawtumūhum am antum ṣāmitūn
verses.english: When you invite them to the guidance, they do not follow you. Thus, it is the same for them whether you invite them, or remain silent.

1981.english: And when you invite them to the right guidance, they refuse to follow you. It is the same for them, whether you invite them, or remain silent.
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: When you invite them to the guidance, they do not follow you. Thus, it is the same for them whether you invite them, or remain silent.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ فَٱدْعُوهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين تدعون من دون الله عباد أمثالكم ۖ فادعوهم فليستجيبوا لكم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi ʿibādun amthālukum fa-id'ʿūhum falyastajībū lakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: The idols you invoke besides GOD are creatures like you. Go ahead and call upon them; let them respond to you, if you are right.

1981.english: Indeed, the idols you idolize besides God are servants like you. Therefore, pray to them, and see if they can answer your prayers, if you are truthful.
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: The idols you invoke besides GOD are creatures like you. Go ahead and invoke them; let them respond to you, if you are right.

verses.arabic: أَلَهُمْ أَرْجُلٌ يَمْشُونَ بِهَآ أَمْ لَهُمْ أَيْدٍ يَبْطِشُونَ بِهَآ أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَآ أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
verses.arabicClean: ألهم أرجل يمشون بها ۖ أم لهم أيد يبطشون بها ۖ أم لهم أعين يبصرون بها ۖ أم لهم آذان يسمعون بها ۗ قل ادعوا شركاءكم ثم كيدون فلا تنظرون
verses.transliterated: alahum arjulun yamshūna bihā am lahum aydin yabṭishūna bihā am lahum aʿyunun yub'ṣirūna bihā am lahum ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā quli id'ʿū shurakāakum thumma kīdūni falā tunẓirūn
verses.english: Do they have legs on which they walk? Do they have hands with which they defend themselves? Do they have eyes with which they see? Do they have ears with which they hear? Say, "Call upon your idols, and ask them to smite me without delay.

1981.english: Do they have legs with which they walk; do they have hands with which they strike; do they have eyes with which they see; do they have ears with which they hear? Say, "Implore your idols to destroy me, without delay.
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: Do they have legs on which they walk? Do they have hands with which they defend themselves? Do they have eyes with which they see? Do they have ears with which they hear? Say, “Call upon your idols, and ask them to smite me without delay.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ وَلِۦِّىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن وليي الله الذي نزل الكتاب ۖ وهو يتولى الصالحين
verses.transliterated: inna waliyyiya l-lahu alladhī nazzala l-kitāba wahuwa yatawallā l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: "GOD is my only Lord and Master; the One who revealed this scripture. He protects the righteous.

1981.english: "My only master is God, the one God who revealed this scripture. He protects the righteous.
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: “GOD is my only Lord and Master; the One who revealed this scripture. He protects the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَنصُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين تدعون من دونه لا يستطيعون نصركم ولا أنفسهم ينصرون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrakum walā anfusahum yanṣurūn
verses.english: "As for the idols you set up beside Him, they cannot help you, nor can they help themselves."

1981.english: "While the idols you set up besides Him cannot protect you, nor protect themselves."
1981.footnote: Idols can be your children as shown here, or your spouse, or your leader, or your supervisor, or your own properties (see 18:42). Anything that takes priority over your creator's commandments is an idol.

1989.english: “As for the idols you set up besides Him, they cannot help you, nor can they help themselves.”

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن تدعوهم إلى الهدى لا يسمعوا ۖ وتراهم ينظرون إليك وهم لا يبصرون
verses.transliterated: wa-in tadʿūhum ilā l-hudā lā yasmaʿū watarāhum yanẓurūna ilayka wahum lā yub'ṣirūn
verses.english: When you invite them to the guidance, they do not hear. And you see them looking at you, but they do not see.

1981.english: When you invite them to the right guidance, they do not hear. And you see them looking at you, but they do not see.

1989.english: When you invite them to the guidance, they do not hear. And you see them looking at you, but they do not see.

verses.arabic: خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين
verses.transliterated: khudhi l-ʿafwa wamur bil-ʿur'fi wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-jāhilīn
verses.english: You shall resort to pardon, advocate tolerance, and disregard the ignorant.

1981.english: You shall resort to pardon, maintain compassion, and be tolerant of the ignorant.

1989.english: You shall resort to pardon, advocate tolerance, and disregard the ignorant.

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله ۚ إنه سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: When the devil whispers to you any whisper, seek refuge in GOD; He is Hearer, Omniscient.

1981.english: And when the devil approaches you with any idea, seek refuge in God. He is hearer, omniscient.

1989.english: When the devil whispers to you any whisper, seek refuge in GOD; He is Hearer, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَٰٓئِفٌ مِّنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ تَذَكَّرُوا۟ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين اتقوا إذا مسهم طائف من الشيطان تذكروا فإذا هم مبصرون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ittaqaw idhā massahum ṭāifun mina l-shayṭāni tadhakkarū fa-idhā hum mub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Those who are righteous, whenever the devil approaches them with an idea, they remember, whereupon they become seers.

1981.english: Whenever the righteous are touched by the devil's ideas, they remember; whereupon they become seers.

1989.english: Those who are righteous, whenever the devil approaches them with an idea, they remember, whereupon they become seers.

verses.arabic: وَإِخْوَٰنُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغَىِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإخوانهم يمدونهم في الغي ثم لا يقصرون
verses.transliterated: wa-ikh'wānuhum yamuddūnahum fī l-ghayi thumma lā yuq'ṣirūn
verses.english: Their brethren ceaselessly entice them to go astray.

1981.english: Their comrades ceaselessly entice them to fall in sin.

1989.english: Their brethren ceaselessly entice them to go astray.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِم بِـَٔايَةٍ قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا ٱجْتَبَيْتَهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ مِن رَّبِّى هَٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا لم تأتهم بآية قالوا لولا اجتبيتها ۚ قل إنما أتبع ما يوحى إلي من ربي ۚ هذا بصائر من ربكم وهدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā lam tatihim biāyatin qālū lawlā ij'tabaytahā qul innamā attabiʿu mā yūḥā ilayya min rabbī hādhā baṣāiru min rabbikum wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: If you do not produce a miracle that they demand, they say, "Why not ask for it?" Say, "I simply follow what is revealed to me from my Lord." These are enlightenments from your Lord, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe.

1981.english: When you do not produce a certain revelation that is acceptable to them, they say, "Make it up!" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This Quran provides insight from your Lord, and guidance and mercy for those who believe."
1981.subtitle: Muhammad Could Not Utter the Quran on His Own
1981.footnote: See the Bible's Deuteronomy 18:18, John 12:49 & 16:13.

1989.english: If you do not produce a miracle that they demand, they say, “Why not ask for it?” Say, “I simply follow what is revealed to me from my Lord.” These are enlightenments from your Lord, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَأَنصِتُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قرئ القرآن فاستمعوا له وأنصتوا لعلكم ترحمون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā quri-a l-qur'ānu fa-is'tamiʿū lahu wa-anṣitū laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.english: When the Quran is recited, you shall listen to it and take heed, that you may attain mercy.

1981.english: When the Quran is recited, you shall listen to it, and hearken, that you may attain mercy.

1989.english: When the Quran is recited, you shall listen to it and take heed, that you may attain mercy.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِى نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ ٱلْجَهْرِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْءَاصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْغَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واذكر ربك في نفسك تضرعا وخيفة ودون الجهر من القول بالغدو والآصال ولا تكن من الغافلين
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur rabbaka fī nafsika taḍarruʿan wakhīfatan wadūna l-jahri mina l-qawli bil-ghuduwi wal-āṣāli walā takun mina l-ghāfilīn
verses.english: You shall remember your Lord within yourself, publicly, privately, and quietly, day and night; do not be unaware.
verses.footnote: Your god is whoever or whatever occupies your mind most of the day. This explains the fact that most of those who believe in God are destined for Hell (See 12:106, 23:84-90, and Appendix 27).

1981.english: And commemorate your Lord within yourself, publicly, secretly, and quietly, day and night. Do not be like those who are unaware.

1989.english: You shall remember your Lord within yourself, publicly, privately, and quietly, day and night; do not be unaware.*
1989.footnote: Your god is whoever or whatever occupies your mind most of the day. This explains the fact that most of those who believe in God are destined for Hell (See 12:106, 23:84-90, and Appendix 27).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيُسَبِّحُونَهُۥ وَلَهُۥ يَسْجُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين عند ربك لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ويسبحونه وله يسجدون ۩
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ʿinda rabbika lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi wayusabbiḥūnahu walahu yasjudūn
verses.english: Those at your Lord are never too proud to worship Him; they glorify Him and fall prostrate before Him.

1981.english: Even those who are at your Lord are never too arrogant to worship Him, and they glorify Him, and fall prostrate for Him.

1989.english: Those at your Lord are never too proud to worship Him; they glorify Him and fall prostrate before Him.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَنفَالِ قُلِ ٱلْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا۟ ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يسألونك عن الأنفال ۖ قل الأنفال لله والرسول ۖ فاتقوا الله وأصلحوا ذات بينكم ۖ وأطيعوا الله ورسوله إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yasalūnaka ʿani l-anfāli quli l-anfālu lillahi wal-rasūli fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṣliḥū dhāta baynikum wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: They consult you about the spoils of war. Say, "The spoils of war belong to GOD and the messenger." You shall observe GOD, exhort one another to be righteous, and obey GOD and His messenger, if you are believers.

1981.english: They ask you about the spoils of war. Say, "The spoils of war belong to God and the messenger." You shall observe God, maintain righteousness among yourselves, and obey God and His messenger, if you are really believers.

1989.english: They consult you about the spoils of war. Say, “The spoils of war belong to GOD and the messenger.” You shall observe GOD, exhort one another to be righteous, and obey GOD and His messenger, if you are believers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَٰنًا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما المؤمنون الذين إذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم وإذا تليت عليهم آياته زادتهم إيمانا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون
verses.transliterated: innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna idhā dhukira l-lahu wajilat qulūbuhum wa-idhā tuliyat ʿalayhim āyātuhu zādathum īmānan waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
verses.english: The true believers are those whose hearts tremble when GOD is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited to them, their faith is strengthened, and they trust in their Lord.
verses.subtitle: The True Believers

1981.english: The true believers are those whose hearts cringe upon remembering God, their faith intensifies upon hearing His revelations, and they trust in their Lord.

1989.english: The true believers are those whose hearts tremble when GOD is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited to them, their faith is strengthened, and they trust in their Lord.
1989.subtitle: The True Believers

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ومما رزقناهم ينفقون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn
verses.english: They observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give to charity.

1981.english: They observe the **salat** prayers, and from our provisions to them, they give to charity.

1989.english: They observe the contact prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَّهُمْ دَرَجَٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك هم المؤمنون حقا ۚ لهم درجات عند ربهم ومغفرة ورزق كريم
verses.transliterated: ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfiratun wariz'qun karīmu
verses.english: Such are the true believers. They attain high ranks at their Lord, as well as forgiveness and a generous provision.

1981.english: These are the true believers; they have deserved high ranks at their Lord, and forgiveness, and a generous recompense.

1989.english: Such are the true believers. They attain high ranks at their Lord, as well as forgiveness and a generous recompense.

verses.arabic: كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَٰرِهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كما أخرجك ربك من بيتك بالحق وإن فريقا من المؤمنين لكارهون
verses.transliterated: kamā akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bil-ḥaqi wa-inna farīqan mina l-mu'minīna lakārihūn
verses.english: When your Lord willed that you leave your home, to fulfill a specific plan, some believers became exposed as reluctant believers.
verses.subtitle: The Weak Believers

1981.english: When your Lord willed that you leave your homes, some believers were exposed as reluctant believers.

1989.english: When your Lord willed that you leave your homes, to fulfill a specific plan, some were exposed as reluctant believers.
1989.subtitle: The Weak Believers

verses.arabic: يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ فِى ٱلْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يجادلونك في الحق بعد ما تبين كأنما يساقون إلى الموت وهم ينظرون
verses.transliterated: yujādilūnaka fī l-ḥaqi baʿdamā tabayyana ka-annamā yusāqūna ilā l-mawti wahum yanẓurūn
verses.english: They argued with you against the truth, even after everything was explained to them. They acted as if they were being driven to certain death.

1981.english: They argued with you, even after the truth had become evident to them, as if they were driven to certain death.

1989.english: They argued with you against the truth, even after it became evident to them, as if they were driven to certain death.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ يعدكم الله إحدى الطائفتين أنها لكم وتودون أن غير ذات الشوكة تكون لكم ويريد الله أن يحق الحق بكلماته ويقطع دابر الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh yaʿidukumu l-lahu iḥ'dā l-ṭāifatayni annahā lakum watawaddūna anna ghayra dhāti l-shawkati takūnu lakum wayurīdu l-lahu an yuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi wayaqṭaʿa dābira l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Recall that GOD promised you victory over a certain group, but you still wanted to face the weaker group. It was GOD's plan to establish the truth with His words, and to defeat the disbelievers.

1981.english: And when God promised you victory over one group, they wanted to face the weaker group instead. But God wanted to establish the truth with His words, and punish the disbelievers (at your hands).

1989.english: GOD promised you (O believers) victory over a certain group, but you still wanted to face the weaker group. It was GOD’s will to establish the truth with His words, and to punish the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليحق الحق ويبطل الباطل ولو كره المجرمون
verses.transliterated: liyuḥiqqa l-ḥaqa wayub'ṭila l-bāṭila walaw kariha l-muj'rimūn
verses.english: For He has decreed that the truth shall prevail, and the falsehood shall vanish, in spite of the evildoers.

1981.english: The truth is to be established, and falsehood is to be nullified, despite the evildoers.

1989.english: For He causes the truth to prevail, and the falsehood to vanish, despite the evildoers.

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ تستغيثون ربكم فاستجاب لكم أني ممدكم بألف من الملائكة مردفين
verses.transliterated: idh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fa-is'tajāba lakum annī mumiddukum bi-alfin mina l-malāikati mur'difīn
verses.english: Thus, when you implored your Lord to come to the rescue, He responded to you: "I am supporting you with one thousand angels in succession."
verses.subtitle: God's Invisible Soldiers

1981.english: Recall that you implored your Lord for help, and He answered your prayers, saying, "I will support you with one thousand angels, in succession."

1989.english: Thus, when you implored your Lord to come to the rescue, He responded to you: “I am supporting you with one thousand angels in succession.”
1989.subtitle: God’s Invisible Soldiers

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما جعله الله إلا بشرى ولتطمئن به قلوبكم ۚ وما النصر إلا من عند الله ۚ إن الله عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: wamā jaʿalahu l-lahu illā bush'rā walitaṭma-inna bihi qulūbukum wamā l-naṣru illā min ʿindi l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: GOD gave you this good news to strengthen your hearts. Victory comes only from GOD. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: Victory Guaranteed for the Believers

1981.english: God thus provided you with good news, and reassured your hearts. Victory comes only from God. God is almighty, wise.

1989.english: GOD provided you with this good news to strengthen your hearts. Victory comes only from GOD. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِّنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِۦ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمْ رِجْزَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلْأَقْدَامَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ يغشيكم النعاس أمنة منه وينزل عليكم من السماء ماء ليطهركم به ويذهب عنكم رجز الشيطان وليربط على قلوبكم ويثبت به الأقدام
verses.transliterated: idh yughashīkumu l-nuʿāsa amanatan min'hu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum mina l-samāi māan liyuṭahhirakum bihi wayudh'hiba ʿankum rij'za l-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihi l-aqdām
verses.english: He caused peaceful slumber to overtake you and pacify you, and He sent down water from the sky to clean you therewith. He protected you from the devil's curse, reassured your hearts and strengthened your foothold.

1981.english: He causes slumber to pacify you, and sends down water from the sky to clean you therewith, and removes the devil's curse from you, and reassures your hearts, and strengthens your footholds.

1989.english: He causes peaceful slumber to overtake you and pacify you. He sends down water from the sky to clean you therewith. He removes from you the devil’s curse, in order to assure your hearts and to strengthen your foothold. Only In Self-defense*

verses.arabic: إِذْ يُوحِى رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّى مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ سَأُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَٱضْرِبُوا۟ فَوْقَ ٱلْأَعْنَاقِ وَٱضْرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ
verses.arabicClean: إذ يوحي ربك إلى الملائكة أني معكم فثبتوا الذين آمنوا ۚ سألقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب فاضربوا فوق الأعناق واضربوا منهم كل بنان
verses.transliterated: idh yūḥī rabbuka ilā l-malāikati annī maʿakum fathabbitū alladhīna āmanū sa-ul'qī fī qulūbi alladhīna kafarū l-ruʿ'ba fa-iḍ'ribū fawqa l-aʿnāqi wa-iḍ'ribū min'hum kulla banāni
verses.english: Recall that your Lord inspired the angels: "I am with you; so support those who believed. I will throw terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved. You may strike them above the necks, and you may strike even every finger."
verses.subtitle: Lessons from History
verses.footnote: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.

1981.english: Your Lord instructed the angels, saying, "I will be with you as you support the believers, and I will throw terror in the hearts of the disbelievers. Therefore, strike above the necks, and strike every finger of them."

1989.english: Thus, your Lord inspired the angels: “I will be with you as you support those who believed. I will throw terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved. You may strike them above the necks; you may strike them everywhere.”
1989.footnote: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ۚ ومن يشاقق الله ورسوله فإن الله شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahum shāqqū l-laha warasūlahu waman yushāqiqi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: This is what they have justly incurred by fighting GOD and His messenger. For those who fight against GOD and His messenger, GOD's retribution is severe.

1981.english: They have deserved this, because they oppose God and His messenger. For those who oppose God and His messenger, God is most strict in imposing retribution.

1989.english: This is because they actively fight against GOD and His messenger. For those who fight against GOD and His messenger, GOD’s retribution is severe.
1989.footnote: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم فذوقوه وأن للكافرين عذاب النار
verses.transliterated: dhālikum fadhūqūhu wa-anna lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāba l-nār
verses.english: This is to punish the disbelievers; they have incurred the retribution of Hell.

1981.english: Suffer the war, O disbelievers, then end up in the retribution of hell.

1989.english: This is to punish the disbelievers; they have incurred the retribution of Hell.
1989.footnote: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا لقيتم الذين كفروا زحفا فلا تولوهم الأدبار
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumu l-adbār
verses.english: O you who believe, if you encounter the disbelievers who have mobilized against you, do not turn back and flee.

1981.english: O you who believe, when the disbelievers attack you, do not turn around and flee.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you encounter the disbelievers who have mobilized against you, do not turn back and flee.
1989.footnote: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُۥٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يولهم يومئذ دبره إلا متحرفا لقتال أو متحيزا إلى فئة فقد باء بغضب من الله ومأواه جهنم ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: waman yuwallihim yawma-idhin duburahu illā mutaḥarrifan liqitālin aw mutaḥayyizan ilā fi-atin faqad bāa bighaḍabin mina l-lahi wamawāhu jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: Anyone who turns back on that day, except to carry out a battle plan, or to join his group, has incurred wrath from GOD, and his abode is Hell; what a miserable destiny!

1981.english: Anyone who turns his back to them, except in the course of fighting, or to support another group, has deserved wrath from God, and his destiny is hell, and a miserable abode.

1989.english: Anyone who turns back on that day, except to carry out a battle plan, or to join his group, has incurred wrath from GOD, and his abode is Hell; what a miserable destiny!
1989.footnote: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ وَلِيُبْلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فلم تقتلوهم ولكن الله قتلهم ۚ وما رميت إذ رميت ولكن الله رمى ۚ وليبلي المؤمنين منه بلاء حسنا ۚ إن الله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: falam taqtulūhum walākinna l-laha qatalahum wamā ramayta idh ramayta walākinna l-laha ramā waliyub'liya l-mu'minīna min'hu balāan ḥasanan inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: It was not you who killed them; GOD is the One who killed them. It was not you who threw when you threw; GOD is the One who threw. But He thus gives the believers a chance to earn a lot of credit. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: God Is Doing Everything
verses.footnote: Believing in God necessitates believing in His qualities, one of which is that He is doing everything. Without knowing God, there is no belief (23:84-90). Bad things are incurred by us, and executed by Satan, in accordance with God's laws (4:78-79, 42:30).

1981.english: It was not you who killed them; God is the one who killed them. It was not you who threw, when you threw; God is the one who threw. He just wanted to grant the believers a good test.* God is hearer, fully aware.
1981.footnote: See Deuteronomy 20:4.

1989.english: It was not you who killed them; GOD is the One who killed them. It was not you who threw when you threw; GOD the One who threw. But He thus gives the believers a chance to earn a lot of credit. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
1989.subtitle: God Is Doing Everything
1989.footnote: Believing in God necessitates believing in His qualities, one of which is that He is doing everything. Without knowing God, there is no belief (23:84-90). Bad things are incurred by us, and executed by Satan, in accordance with God’s laws (4:78-79, 42:30).

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم وأن الله موهن كيد الكافرين
verses.transliterated: dhālikum wa-anna l-laha mūhinu kaydi l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Additionally, GOD thus nullifies the schemes of the disbelievers.

1981.english: God thus frustrates the plans of the disbelievers.

1989.english: Additionally, GOD thus nullifies the schemes of the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: إِن تَسْتَفْتِحُوا۟ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْفَتْحُ وَإِن تَنتَهُوا۟ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَإِن تَعُودُوا۟ نَعُدْ وَلَن تُغْنِىَ عَنكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن تستفتحوا فقد جاءكم الفتح ۖ وإن تنتهوا فهو خير لكم ۖ وإن تعودوا نعد ولن تغني عنكم فئتكم شيئا ولو كثرت وأن الله مع المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: in tastaftiḥū faqad jāakumu l-fatḥu wa-in tantahū fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in taʿūdū naʿud walan tugh'niya ʿankum fi-atukum shayan walaw kathurat wa-anna l-laha maʿa l-mu'minīn
verses.english: You sought victory (O disbelievers), and victory did come; it belonged to the believers. If you refrain (from aggression) it would be better for you, but if you return, so will we. Your armies will never help you, no matter how great. For GOD is on the side of the believers.

1981.english: You have sought victory, and victory has come against you. Thus, it would be best for you if you refrain. If you ever return (to aggression), we will repeat, and your numbers will never help you, no matter how great. God is always with the believers.

1989.english: You sought victory (O disbelievers), and victory belongs to the believers. If you refrain from aggression, it would be better for you, but if you return, so will we. Your armies will never help you, no matter how great. For GOD is on the side of the believers.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا أطيعوا الله ورسوله ولا تولوا عنه وأنتم تسمعون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tawallaw ʿanhu wa-antum tasmaʿūn
verses.english: O you who believe, obey GOD and His messenger, and do not disregard him while you hear.

1981.english: O you who believe, obey God and His messenger, and do not turn away from Him while you hear.

1989.english: O you who believe, obey GOD and His messenger, and do not disregard him while you hear.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تكونوا كالذين قالوا سمعنا وهم لا يسمعون
verses.transliterated: walā takūnū ka-alladhīna qālū samiʿ'nā wahum lā yasmaʿūn
verses.english: Do not be like those who say, "We hear," when they do not hear.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers Blocked Out

1981.english: Do not be like those who say, "We hear," when they really do not.

1989.english: Do not be like those who say, “We heard,” when they did not hear.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلْبُكْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن شر الدواب عند الله الصم البكم الذين لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi l-ṣumu l-buk'mu alladhīna lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: The worst creatures in the sight of GOD are the deaf and dumb, who do not understand.

1981.english: Indeed, the worst creatures in the sight of God are the deaf and dumb, who have no common sense.

1989.english: The worst creatures in the sight of GOD are the deaf and dumb, who do not understand.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو علم الله فيهم خيرا لأسمعهم ۖ ولو أسمعهم لتولوا وهم معرضون
verses.transliterated: walaw ʿalima l-lahu fīhim khayran la-asmaʿahum walaw asmaʿahum latawallaw wahum muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: Had GOD known of any good in them, He would have made them hearers. Even if He made them hearers, they still would turn away in aversion.

1981.english: If God knew of any good in them, He would have made them hear. Even if He made them hear, they still would turn away in aversion.
1981.subtitle: God Knows Which Among Us Deserve to Hear

1989.english: Had GOD known of any good in them, He would have made them hearers. Even if He made them hearers, they still would turn away in aversion.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَأَنَّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا استجيبوا لله وللرسول إذا دعاكم لما يحييكم ۖ واعلموا أن الله يحول بين المرء وقلبه وأنه إليه تحشرون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū is'tajībū lillahi walilrrasūli idhā daʿākum limā yuḥ'yīkum wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yaḥūlu bayna l-mari waqalbihi wa-annahu ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall respond to GOD and to the messenger when he invites you to what gives you life. You should know that GOD is closer to you than your heart, and that before Him you will be summoned.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous Do Not Really Die
verses.footnote: See Appendix 17. When the righteous exit their bodies, they go straight to Heaven.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall hearken to God and the messenger when He invites you to that which gives you life. You should realize that God stands between you and your heart, and that you will be gathered before Him.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall respond to GOD and to the messenger when he invites you to that which grants you life. You should know that GOD is closer to you than your heart, and that before Him you will be summoned.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: واتقوا فتنة لا تصيبن الذين ظلموا منكم خاصة ۖ واعلموا أن الله شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: wa-ittaqū fit'natan lā tuṣībanna alladhīna ẓalamū minkum khāṣṣatan wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: Beware of a retribution that may not be limited to the evildoers among you. You should know that GOD's retribution is severe.
verses.footnote: A community that tolerates homosexuality, for example, may be hit by an earthquake.

1981.english: Beware lest a punishment may come and afflict not only the wicked in particular, and know that God is most strict in imposing retribution.
1981.footnote: Therefore, if the righteous are too passive to preach the word of God, prohibit evil, and advocate righteousness, they will suffer along with their corrupt community.

1989.english: Beware of a retribution that may not be limited to the evildoers among you. You should know that GOD’s retribution is severe.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واذكروا إذ أنتم قليل مستضعفون في الأرض تخافون أن يتخطفكم الناس فآواكم وأيدكم بنصره ورزقكم من الطيبات لعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kurū idh antum qalīlun mus'taḍʿafūna fī l-arḍi takhāfūna an yatakhaṭṭafakumu l-nāsu faāwākum wa-ayyadakum binaṣrihi warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti laʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: Remember that you used to be few and oppressed, fearing that the people may snatch you, and He granted you a secure sanctuary, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good provisions, that you may be appreciative.
verses.subtitle: God Supports the Believers

1981.english: Remember that you used to be few and oppressed, fearing that the people may snatch you, and He gave you refuge, supported you with His victory, and provided for you generously. You should be appreciative.

1989.english: Remember that you used to be few and oppressed, fearing that the people may snatch you, and He gave you refuge, strengthened you with His support, and provided you with good provisions, that you may be appreciative.
1989.subtitle: God Supports the Believers

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَخُونُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوٓا۟ أَمَٰنَٰتِكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تخونوا الله والرسول وتخونوا أماناتكم وأنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takhūnū l-laha wal-rasūla watakhūnū amānātikum wa-antum taʿlamūn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not betray GOD and the messenger, and do not betray those who trust you, now that you know.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not betray God and the messenger*, and do not betray those who trust you, while you know.
1981.footnote: The greatest betrayal of Muhammad is the invention of "**Hadith**" and "**Sunna**" against his own instructions and the divine teachings of Quran (see Appendix 11).

1989.english: O you who believe, do not betray GOD and the messenger, and do not betray those who trust you, knowingly.

verses.arabic: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: واعلموا أنما أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة وأن الله عنده أجر عظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-iʿ'lamū annamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wa-anna l-laha ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: You should know that your money and your children are a test, and that GOD possesses a great recompense.
verses.subtitle: Money & Children Are Tests

1981.english: Remember that your money and children are a test, and that God possesses great rewards.

1989.english: You should know that your money and your children are a test, and that GOD possesses a great recompense.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن تتقوا الله يجعل لكم فرقانا ويكفر عنكم سيئاتكم ويغفر لكم ۗ والله ذو الفضل العظيم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tattaqū l-laha yajʿal lakum fur'qānan wayukaffir ʿankum sayyiātikum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: O you who believe, if you reverence GOD, He will enlighten you, remit your sins, and forgive you. GOD possesses infinite grace.

1981.english: O you who believe, if you observe God, He will enlighten you, remit your sins, and forgive you. God possesses unlimited grace.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you observe GOD, He will enlighten you, remit your sins, and forgive you. GOD possesses infinite grace.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ يمكر بك الذين كفروا ليثبتوك أو يقتلوك أو يخرجوك ۚ ويمكرون ويمكر الله ۖ والله خير الماكرين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh yamkuru bika alladhīna kafarū liyuth'bitūka aw yaqtulūka aw yukh'rijūka wayamkurūna wayamkuru l-lahu wal-lahu khayru l-mākirīn
verses.english: The disbelievers plot and scheme to neutralize you, or kill you, or banish you. However, they plot and scheme, but so does GOD. GOD is the best schemer.
verses.subtitle: God Protects His Messenger
verses.footnote: God chose His final prophet, Muhammad, from the strongest tribe of Arabia. It was tribal laws and traditions that prevented the disbelievers—by God's leave—from killing Muhammad. Similarly, it was God's will to move His Messenger of the Covenant from the Middle East, where he would have been killed, to the U.S.A. where God's message can flourish and reach every corner of the globe. This is mathematically confirmed: the sura & verse numbers= 8+30=19x2.

1981.english: The disbelievers schemed to neutralize you, or kill you, or banish you. But they plot and scheme, and so does God; and God is the best schemer.
1981.subtitle: The Believers Persecuted

1989.english: The disbelievers plotted and schemed to neutralize you, or kill you, or banish you. However, they plot and scheme, but so does GOD. GOD is the best schemer.
1989.subtitle: God Protects His Messenger

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالُوا۟ قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَٰذَآ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا قالوا قد سمعنا لو نشاء لقلنا مثل هذا ۙ إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā qālū qad samiʿ'nā law nashāu laqul'nā mith'la hādhā in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.english: When our revelations are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we wanted to, we could have said the same things. These are no more than tales from the past!"

1981.english: And when our revelations are recited to them, they say, "We have heard and, if we wish, we can write the same. These are tales from the past."

1989.english: When our revelations are recited to them, they say, “We have heard. If we want to, we can say the same things. These are only tales from the past!”

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالُوا۟ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَوِ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قالوا اللهم إن كان هذا هو الحق من عندك فأمطر علينا حجارة من السماء أو ائتنا بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qālū l-lahuma in kāna hādhā huwa l-ḥaqa min ʿindika fa-amṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratan mina l-samāi awi i'tinā biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: They also said, "Our god, if this is really the truth from You, then shower us with rocks from the sky, or pour upon us a painful punishment."

1981.english: They even said, "Our God, if this is really the truth from You, then shower us with stones from the sky, or strike us with a terrible disaster."

1989.english: They also said, “Our god, if this is really the truth from You, then shower us with rocks from the sky, or pour upon us a painful punishment.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان الله ليعذبهم وأنت فيهم ۚ وما كان الله معذبهم وهم يستغفرون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿadhibahum wa-anta fīhim wamā kāna l-lahu muʿadhibahum wahum yastaghfirūn
verses.english: However, GOD is not to punish them while you are in their midst; GOD is not to punish them while they are seeking forgiveness.

1981.english: However, God was not to strike them while you were still with them; God was not to strike them while they had a chance to repent.

1989.english: However, GOD is not to punish them while you are still in their midst; GOD is not to punish them so long as they seek forgiveness.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآءَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما لهم ألا يعذبهم الله وهم يصدون عن المسجد الحرام وما كانوا أولياءه ۚ إن أولياؤه إلا المتقون ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā lahum allā yuʿadhibahumu l-lahu wahum yaṣuddūna ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wamā kānū awliyāahu in awliyāuhu illā l-mutaqūna walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Have they not deserved GOD's retribution, by repelling others from the Sacred Masjid, even though they are not the custodians thereof? The true custodians thereof are the righteous, but most of them do not know.

1981.english: Have they not deserved retribution from God, when they repelled from the Sacred Mosque, as if they were the keepers thereof? The true keepers thereof are the righteous, but most people do not know.

1989.english: Have they not deserved GOD’s retribution, by repelling others from the Sacred Mosque, even though they are not the custodians thereof? The true custodians thereof are the righteous, but most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَآءً وَتَصْدِيَةً فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان صلاتهم عند البيت إلا مكاء وتصدية ۚ فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿinda l-bayti illā mukāan wataṣdiyatan fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
verses.english: Their Contact Prayers (Salat) at the shrine (Ka'bah) were no more than a mockery and a means of repelling the people (by crowding them out). Therefore, suffer the retribution for your disbelief.
verses.subtitle: The Contact Prayers (Salat) Existed Before the Quran
verses.footnote: All religious practices in Islam came to us through Abraham; when the Quran was revealed, all rites in "Submission" were already in existence (21:73, 22:78).

1981.english: Their prayer at the shrine was no more than deceit and alienation. They have deserved the retribution for disbelieving.
1981.subtitle: Salat Prayers Observed Before Muhammad
