1981.footnote: Many Muslims erroneously believe that the **salat** prayers were first revealed through Muhammad. The Quran, however, teaches us that **salat** was first revealed to Abraham, then transmitted to us generation after generation (see for example 2:4, 2:128, 2:135, 2:142, 3:67-68, 3:95, 4:125, 16:123, 21:73, 22:27, 22:78, and 73:20). Those who refuse to believe God's statements that the Quran is complete and perfect (6:19, 38, 114), as well as the ignorant, frequently ask the question, "If the Quran is complete, where is the description of **salat**?"

1989.english: Their contact prayers (Salat) at the shrine (Ka‘bah) were no more than a mockery and a means of repelling others. Therefore, suffer the retribution for your disbelief.
1989.subtitle: Contact Prayers (Salat) Existed Before the Quran
1989.footnote: All religious practices in Islam came to us through Abraham, many centuries before the Quran (21:73, 22:78).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا ينفقون أموالهم ليصدوا عن سبيل الله ۚ فسينفقونها ثم تكون عليهم حسرة ثم يغلبون ۗ والذين كفروا إلى جهنم يحشرون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū yunfiqūna amwālahum liyaṣuddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasratan thumma yugh'labūna wa-alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama yuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve spend their money to repel others from the way of GOD. They will spend it, then it will turn into sorrow and remorse for them. Ultimately, they will be defeated, and all disbelievers will be summoned to Hell.
verses.subtitle: Spending Their Money to Fight God
verses.footnote: The idol worshiping leaders of corrupted Islam, Saudi Arabia, have allocated huge sums of money annually to fight God and His miracle. For example, the famous Lebanese publisher Dãr Al-'Ilm Lil-Malãyîn (Knowledge for the Millions) published the Arabic version of "The Miracle of the Quran" in March 1983. The Saudis bought all the copies and destroyed them.

1981.english: The disbelievers are spending their money on repelling others from the path of God. Thus, they will spend it, and it will return nothing but sorrow for them, and defeat, then they will be gathered in hell.

1989.english: Those who disbelieve spend their money to repel others from the way of GOD. They will spend it, then it will turn into sorrow and remorse for them; they will be defeated in the end. Ultimately, such disbelievers will be summoned into Hell.

verses.arabic: لِيَمِيزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُۥ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُۥ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُۥ فِى جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليميز الله الخبيث من الطيب ويجعل الخبيث بعضه على بعض فيركمه جميعا فيجعله في جهنم ۚ أولئك هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: liyamīza l-lahu l-khabītha mina l-ṭayibi wayajʿala l-khabītha baʿḍahu ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahu jamīʿan fayajʿalahu fī jahannama ulāika humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: GOD will sift away the bad from the good, then pile the bad on top of each other, all in one pile, then throw it in Hell. Such are the losers.

1981.english: God separates the bad from the good, piles up the bad on each other, then casts them in hell. These are the losers.

1989.english: GOD will sift away the bad from the good, then pile the bad on top of each other, all in one pile, then throw it in Hell. Such are the losers.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَنتَهُوا۟ يُغْفَرْ لَهُم مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُوا۟ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل للذين كفروا إن ينتهوا يغفر لهم ما قد سلف وإن يعودوا فقد مضت سنت الأولين
verses.transliterated: qul lilladhīna kafarū in yantahū yugh'far lahum mā qad salafa wa-in yaʿūdū faqad maḍat sunnatu l-awalīn
verses.english: Tell those who disbelieved: if they stop, all their past will be forgiven. But if they return, they will incur the same fate as their previous counterparts.

1981.english: Tell those who disbelieve that if they repent, their past transgressions will be forgiven. But if they revert, then the examples of the past should be remembered.

1989.english: Tell those who disbelieved: if they stop, all their past will be forgiven. But if they return, they will incur the same fate as their previous counterparts.

verses.arabic: وَقَٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ كُلُّهُۥ لِلَّهِ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقاتلوهم حتى لا تكون فتنة ويكون الدين كله لله ۚ فإن انتهوا فإن الله بما يعملون بصير
verses.transliterated: waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fit'natun wayakūna l-dīnu kulluhu lillahi fa-ini intahaw fa-inna l-laha bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīru
verses.english: You shall fight them to ward off oppression, and to practice your religion devoted to GOD alone. If they refrain from aggression, then GOD is fully Seer of everything they do.

1981.english: You shall fight them to prevent persecution, and to practice God's religion in total freedom. Once they refrain, then God sees everything they do.

1989.english: You may fight them to ward off oppression, and to practice your religion devoted to GOD alone. If they refrain from aggression, then GOD is fully Seer of everything they do.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن تولوا فاعلموا أن الله مولاكم ۚ نعم المولى ونعم النصير
verses.transliterated: wa-in tawallaw fa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha mawlākum niʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīr
verses.english: If they turn away, then you should know that GOD is your Lord and Master; the best Lord and Master, the best supporter.

1981.english: If they turn away, then you should realize that God is your master; the best master, and the best supporter.

1989.english: If they turn away, then you should know that GOD is your Lord and Master; the best Lord and Master, the best supporter.

verses.arabic: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُۥ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: واعلموا أنما غنمتم من شيء فأن لله خمسه وللرسول ولذي القربى واليتامى والمساكين وابن السبيل إن كنتم آمنتم بالله وما أنزلنا على عبدنا يوم الفرقان يوم التقى الجمعان ۗ والله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: wa-iʿ'lamū annamā ghanim'tum min shayin fa-anna lillahi khumusahu walilrrasūli walidhī l-qur'bā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wa-ib'ni l-sabīli in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi wamā anzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawma l-fur'qāni yawma l-taqā l-jamʿāni wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: You should know that if you gain any spoils in war, one-fifth shall go to GOD and the messenger, to be given to the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien. You will do this if you believe in GOD and in what we revealed to our servant on the day of decision, the day the two armies clashed. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Whatever you win as spoils of war, you shall set aside one fifth thereof for God and the messenger, and donate it to the (poor) relatives, the orphans, the needy, and the alien, if you truly believe in God and in what we revealed to our servant on the day of decision; the day the two armies clashed. God is omnipotent.
1981.subtitle: Distribution of the Spoils of War

1989.english: You should know that if you gain any spoils in war, one-fifth shall go to GOD and the messenger. It shall be given to the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien if you believe in GOD and in what we revealed to our servant on the day of confrontation, the day the two armies clashed. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَنتُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلْقُصْوَىٰ وَٱلرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْمِيعَٰدِ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَىَّ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إذ أنتم بالعدوة الدنيا وهم بالعدوة القصوى والركب أسفل منكم ۚ ولو تواعدتم لاختلفتم في الميعاد ۙ ولكن ليقضي الله أمرا كان مفعولا ليهلك من هلك عن بينة ويحيى من حي عن بينة ۗ وإن الله لسميع عليم
verses.transliterated: idh antum bil-ʿud'wati l-dun'yā wahum bil-ʿud'wati l-quṣ'wā wal-rakbu asfala minkum walaw tawāʿadttum la-ikh'talaftum fī l-mīʿādi walākin liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan liyahlika man halaka ʿan bayyinatin wayaḥyā man ḥayya ʿan bayyinatin wa-inna l-laha lasamīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: Recall that you were on this side of the valley, while they were on the other side. Then their caravan had to move to lower ground. Had you planned it this way, you could not have done it. But GOD was to carry out a predetermined matter, whereby those destined to be annihilated were annihilated for an obvious reason, and those destined to be saved were saved for an obvious reason. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: God Controls Everything and Plans for the Believers

1981.english: You were on this side of the valley, while they were on the far side, and the caravan down beneath you. Had you deliberately planned it this way, you could not have done it. But God was to conclude a matter already decided, in order to destroy those who deserved destruction, and to save those who deserved to be saved. God is hearer, knower.

1989.english: You were on this side of the valley, while they were on the other side. Then their caravan had to move to lower ground. Had you planned it this way, you could not have done it. But GOD was to carry out a predetermined matter, whereby those destined to be annihilated were annihilated, and those destined to be saved were saved. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
1989.subtitle: God Controls Everything and Plans for the Believers

verses.arabic: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا وَلَوْ أَرَىٰكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَلَّمَ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: إذ يريكهم الله في منامك قليلا ۖ ولو أراكهم كثيرا لفشلتم ولتنازعتم في الأمر ولكن الله سلم ۗ إنه عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: idh yurīkahumu l-lahu fī manāmika qalīlan walaw arākahum kathīran lafashil'tum walatanāzaʿtum fī l-amri walākinna l-laha sallama innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: GOD made them appear in your dream (O Muhammad) fewer in number. Had He made them appear more numerous, you would have failed, and you would have disputed among yourselves. But GOD saved the situation. He is Knower of the innermost thoughts.

1981.english: God made them appear in your dream as few in number. Had He shown them to you as multitudes, you would have been discouraged, and you would have disputed among yourselves. But God spared you all this. God knows the innermost secrets.

1989.english: GOD made them appear in your dream (O Muhammad) fewer in number. Had He made them appear more numerous, you would have failed, and you would have disputed among yourselves. But GOD saved the situation. He is Knower of the innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ ٱلْتَقَيْتُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ يريكموهم إذ التقيتم في أعينكم قليلا ويقللكم في أعينهم ليقضي الله أمرا كان مفعولا ۗ وإلى الله ترجع الأمور
verses.transliterated: wa-idh yurīkumūhum idhi l-taqaytum fī aʿyunikum qalīlan wayuqallilukum fī aʿyunihim liyaqḍiya l-lahu amran kāna mafʿūlan wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūr
verses.english: And when the time came and you faced them, He made them appear fewer in your eyes, and made you appear fewer in their eyes as well. For GOD willed to carry out a certain plan. All decisions are made by GOD.

1981.english: And when you clashed, He made them appear few in your eyes, and made you appear few in their eyes, in order for God to conclude a matter already decided. God fully controls all things.

1989.english: And when the time came and you faced them, He made them appear fewer in your eyes, and made you appear fewer in their eyes as well. For GOD willed to carry out a certain plan. All decisions are made by GOD.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَٱثْبُتُوا۟ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا لقيتم فئة فاثبتوا واذكروا الله كثيرا لعلكم تفلحون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā laqītum fi-atan fa-uth'butū wa-udh'kurū l-laha kathīran laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: O you who believe, when you encounter an army, you shall hold fast and commemorate GOD frequently, that you may succeed.

1981.english: O you who believe, whenever you encounter the enemy, you shall be steadfast, and commemorate God frequently, that you may succeed.

1989.english: O you who believe, when you encounter an army, you shall hold fast and commemorate GOD frequently, that you may succeed.

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَنَٰزَعُوا۟ فَتَفْشَلُوا۟ وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأطيعوا الله ورسوله ولا تنازعوا فتفشلوا وتذهب ريحكم ۖ واصبروا ۚ إن الله مع الصابرين
verses.transliterated: wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu walā tanāzaʿū fatafshalū watadhhaba rīḥukum wa-iṣ'birū inna l-laha maʿa l-ṣābirīn
verses.english: You shall obey GOD and His messenger, and do not dispute among yourselves, lest you fail and scatter your strength. You shall steadfastly persevere. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.

1981.english: And obey God and His messenger,* and do not dispute among yourselves, lest you fail and scatter your strength. You shall steadfastly persevere, for God is with those who steadfastly persevere.
1981.footnote: Those who obey God and His messenger uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see 5:48-50, 17:73-75). On the other hand, those who advocate "**Hadith**" and/or "**Sunna**" disobey God and disobey the prophet and idolize him against his will, just like the Christians who idolize Jesus and claim that they love him.

1989.english: You shall obey GOD and His messenger, and do not dispute among yourselves, lest you fail and scatter your strength. You shall steadfastly persevere. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بَطَرًا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تكونوا كالذين خرجوا من ديارهم بطرا ورئاء الناس ويصدون عن سبيل الله ۚ والله بما يعملون محيط
verses.transliterated: walā takūnū ka-alladhīna kharajū min diyārihim baṭaran wariāa l-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wal-lahu bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭu
verses.english: Do not be like those who left their homes grudgingly, only to show off, and in fact discouraged others from following the path of GOD. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

1981.english: Do not be like those who left their homes grudgingly, and to show off, while alienating others from the path of God. God knows everything they do.

1989.english: Do not be like those who left their homes grudgingly, only to show off, while actually repelling from the path of GOD. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَإِنِّى جَارٌ لَّكُمْ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ ٱلْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ زين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم وقال لا غالب لكم اليوم من الناس وإني جار لكم ۖ فلما تراءت الفئتان نكص على عقبيه وقال إني بريء منكم إني أرى ما لا ترون إني أخاف الله ۚ والله شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: wa-idh zayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumu l-yawma mina l-nāsi wa-innī jārun lakum falammā tarāati l-fi-atāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla innī barīon minkum innī arā mā lā tarawna innī akhāfu l-laha wal-lahu shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: The devil had adorned their works in their eyes, and said, "You cannot be defeated by any people today," and "I will be fighting along with you." But as soon as the two armies faced each other, he turned back on his heels and fled, saying, "I disown you. I see what you do not see. I am afraid of GOD. GOD's retribution is awesome."
verses.subtitle: The Devil Sees God's Invisible Soldiers

1981.english: The devil has adorned their works for them, and said, "You can never be defeated by any people, and I will protect you." Then, when the two armies clashed, he turned back on his heels, saying, "I have nothing to do with you. I see what you do not see, and I fear God. God's retribution is very severe."

1989.english: The devil had adorned their works in their eyes, and said, “You cannot be defeated by any people today,” and “I will be with you.” But as soon as the two armies faced each other, he turned on his heels and fled, saying, “I do not know you. I see what you do not see. I am afraid of GOD. GOD’s retribution is severe.”
1989.subtitle: The Devil Sees God's Invisible Soldiers

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِينُهُمْ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إذ يقول المنافقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض غر هؤلاء دينهم ۗ ومن يتوكل على الله فإن الله عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun gharra hāulāi dīnuhum waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fa-inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: The hypocrites and those who harbored doubt in their hearts said, "These people are deceived by their religion." However, if one puts his trust in GOD, then GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: The hypocrites and those with disease in their hearts may say, "The believers are fooled by their religion!" Indeed, when you trust in God, you trust in the almighty, the wise.
1981.subtitle: The Disbelievers Always Losers

1989.english: The hypocrites and those with disease in their hearts said, “These people are deceived by their religion.” However, if one puts his trust in GOD, then GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.arabicClean: ولو ترى إذ يتوفى الذين كفروا ۙ الملائكة يضربون وجوههم وأدبارهم وذوقوا عذاب الحريق
verses.transliterated: walaw tarā idh yatawaffā alladhīna kafarū l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīq
verses.english: If you could only see those who disbelieved when the angels put them to death! They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends: "Taste the retribution of Hell.

1981.english: If you could only see the disbelievers at the time of death; the angels will beat them on the faces and the rear ends (saying), "You have deserved the retribution of hell.

1989.english: If you could only see those who disbelieved when the angels put them to death! They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends: “Taste the retribution of Hell.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بما قدمت أيديكم وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد
verses.transliterated: dhālika bimā qaddamat aydīkum wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīd
verses.english: "This is a consequence of what your hands have sent forth. GOD is never unjust towards the creatures."

1981.english: "This is what your own hands have advanced for you, and God is never unjust towards His creatures."

1989.english: “This is the consequence of what your own hands have sent forth. GOD is never unjust towards the creatures.”

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: كدأب آل فرعون ۙ والذين من قبلهم ۚ كفروا بآيات الله فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم ۗ إن الله قوي شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kafarū biāyāti l-lahi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim inna l-laha qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: This is the same fate as that of Pharaoh's people and those who disbelieved before them. They rejected GOD's revelations, and GOD punished them for their sins. GOD is powerful, and His retribution is severe.

1981.english: The people of Pharaoh and others before them have also rejected God's revelations. Consequently, God punished them for their sins. God is powerful, and strict in imposing retribution.

1989.english: This is but the same fate as that of Pharaoh’s people and those who disbelieved before them. They rejected GOD’s revelations, and GOD punished them for their sins. GOD is powerful, and His retribution is severe.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الله لم يك مغيرا نعمة أنعمها على قوم حتى يغيروا ما بأنفسهم ۙ وأن الله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna l-laha lam yaku mughayyiran niʿ'matan anʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā bi-anfusihim wa-anna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: GOD does not change a blessing He has bestowed upon any people unless they themselves decide to change. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: Retribution: A Consequence of Sin

1981.english: That is because God does not change the blessings He had bestowed upon any people, unless they themselves change. God is hearer, knower.

1989.english: GOD does not remove a blessing He has bestowed upon any people unless they themselves decide to change. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
1989.subtitle: Retribution: A Consequence of Sin

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كدأب آل فرعون ۙ والذين من قبلهم ۚ كذبوا بآيات ربهم فأهلكناهم بذنوبهم وأغرقنا آل فرعون ۚ وكل كانوا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: kadabi āli fir'ʿawna wa-alladhīna min qablihim kadhabū biāyāti rabbihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-aghraqnā āla fir'ʿawna wakullun kānū ẓālimīn
verses.english: Such was the case with the people of Pharaoh and others before them. They first rejected the signs of their Lord. Consequently, we annihilated them for their sins. We drowned Pharaoh's people; the wicked were consistently punished.

1981.english: Just like the people of Pharaoh and others before them; when they rejected the revelations of their Lord, we destroyed them as a consequence of their sins, and we drowned Pharaoh's people; they were all wicked.

1989.english: For example, the people of Pharaoh and others before them; they first rejected the signs of their Lord. Consequently, we annihilated them for their sins. We drowned Pharaoh’s people, because they were all evil.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن شر الدواب عند الله الذين كفروا فهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: inna sharra l-dawābi ʿinda l-lahi alladhīna kafarū fahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: The worst creatures in the sight of GOD are those who disbelieved; they cannot believe.

1981.english: Indeed, the worst creatures in the sight of God are those who are unappreciative and consequently, fail to believe.

1989.english: The worst creatures in the sight of GOD are those who disbelieved; consequently, they cannot believe.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِى كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين عاهدت منهم ثم ينقضون عهدهم في كل مرة وهم لا يتقون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ʿāhadtta min'hum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fī kulli marratin wahum lā yattaqūn
verses.english: You reach agreements with them, but they violate their agreements every time; they are not righteous.

1981.english: It is they who enter into agreements with you, then violate their agreements every time, and they do not work righteousness.

1989.english: You reach agreements with them, but they consistently violate their agreements; they are not righteous.

verses.arabic: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإما تثقفنهم في الحرب فشرد بهم من خلفهم لعلهم يذكرون
verses.transliterated: fa-immā tathqafannahum fī l-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum laʿallahum yadhakkarūn
verses.english: Therefore, if you encounter them in war, you shall set them up as a deterrent example for those who come after them, that they may take heed.

1981.english: Therefore, when you encounter them in war, you shall make them a deterrant example for the disbelievers who come after them, that they may get the message.
1981.subtitle: Believers Are Stern and Alert

1989.english: Therefore, if you encounter them in war, you shall set them up as a deterrent example for those who come after them, that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَٱنۢبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإما تخافن من قوم خيانة فانبذ إليهم على سواء ۚ إن الله لا يحب الخائنين
verses.transliterated: wa-immā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānatan fa-inbidh ilayhim ʿalā sawāin inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-khāinīn
verses.english: When you are betrayed by a group of people, you shall mobilize against them in the same manner. GOD does not love the betrayers.

1981.english: And when you are betrayed by any group, you shall mobilize against them, and inflict an equivalent punishment. God loves not the betrayers.

1989.english: When you are betrayed by a group of people, you shall mobilize against them in the same manner. GOD does not love the betrayers.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَبَقُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحسبن الذين كفروا سبقوا ۚ إنهم لا يعجزون
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū sabaqū innahum lā yuʿ'jizūn
verses.english: Let not those who disbelieve think that they can get away with it; they can never escape.

1981.english: Let not the disbelievers think that they will ever win. Nor will they evade the retribution.

1989.english: Let not those who disbelieve think that they can get away with it; they cannot escape.

verses.arabic: وَأَعِدُّوا۟ لَهُم مَّا ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ ٱلْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِۦ عَدُوَّ ٱللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأعدوا لهم ما استطعتم من قوة ومن رباط الخيل ترهبون به عدو الله وعدوكم وآخرين من دونهم لا تعلمونهم الله يعلمهم ۚ وما تنفقوا من شيء في سبيل الله يوف إليكم وأنتم لا تظلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-aʿiddū lahum mā is'taṭaʿtum min quwwatin wamin ribāṭi l-khayli tur'hibūna bihi ʿaduwwa l-lahi waʿaduwwakum waākharīna min dūnihim lā taʿlamūnahumu l-lahu yaʿlamuhum wamā tunfiqū min shayin fī sabīli l-lahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa-antum lā tuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: You shall prepare for them all the power you can muster, and all the equipment you can mobilize, that you may frighten the enemies of GOD, your enemies, as well as others who are not known to you; GOD knows them. Whatever you spend in the cause of GOD will be repaid to you generously, without the least injustice.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Be Prepared: A Divine Commandment

1981.english: You shall prepare for them all the force and equipment you can muster, in order to deter the enemies of God, and your enemies, as well as others you are not aware of, while God knows them. Anything you expend in the cause of God will be repaid to you without the least injustice.

1989.english: You shall prepare for them all the power you can muster, and all the equipment you can mobilize, that you may frighten the enemies of GOD, your enemies, as well as others who are not known to you; GOD knows them. Whatever you spend in the cause of GOD will be repaid to you generously, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: وَإِن جَنَحُوا۟ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن جنحوا للسلم فاجنح لها وتوكل على الله ۚ إنه هو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: wa-in janaḥū lilssalmi fa-ij'naḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: If they resort to peace, so shall you, and put your trust in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: If they resort to peace, you shall resort to peace, and trust in God; He is the hearer, the knower.

1989.english: If they resort to peace, so shall you, and put your trust in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ ٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَبِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يريدوا أن يخدعوك فإن حسبك الله ۚ هو الذي أيدك بنصره وبالمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wa-in yurīdū an yakhdaʿūka fa-inna ḥasbaka l-lahu huwa alladhī ayyadaka binaṣrihi wabil-mu'minīn
verses.english: If they want to deceive you, then GOD will suffice you. He will help you with His support, and with the believers.
verses.subtitle: God Suffices the Believers

1981.english: And if they try to deceive you, God will take care of them. He is the one who supported you with His victory, and with the believers.

1989.english: If they want to deceive you, GOD will suffice you. He helps you with His support, and with the believers.
1989.subtitle: God Suffices the Believers

verses.arabic: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّآ أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وألف بين قلوبهم ۚ لو أنفقت ما في الأرض جميعا ما ألفت بين قلوبهم ولكن الله ألف بينهم ۚ إنه عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: wa-allafa bayna qulūbihim law anfaqta mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan mā allafta bayna qulūbihim walākinna l-laha allafa baynahum innahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: He has reconciled the hearts (of the believers). Had you spent all the money on earth, you could not reconcile their hearts. But GOD did reconcile them. He is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: He is the one who harmonized their hearts, at a time when you could have spent all the money on earth to harmonize their hearts, and fail. But God created harmony among them. He is almighty, wise.

1989.english: He has reconciled their hearts. Had you spent all the money on earth, you could not reconcile their hearts. But GOD did reconcile them. He is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَسْبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي حسبك الله ومن اتبعك من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥasbuka l-lahu wamani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: O you prophet, sufficient for you is GOD and the believers who have followed you.

1981.english: O you prophet, sufficient for you is God, and the believers who follow you.

1989.english: O you prophet, sufficient for you is GOD, and the believers who have followed you.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي حرض المؤمنين على القتال ۚ إن يكن منكم عشرون صابرون يغلبوا مائتين ۚ وإن يكن منكم مائة يغلبوا ألفا من الذين كفروا بأنهم قوم لا يفقهون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ḥarriḍi l-mu'minīna ʿalā l-qitāli in yakun minkum ʿish'rūna ṣābirūna yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum mi-atun yaghlibū alfan mina alladhīna kafarū bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūn
verses.english: O you prophet, you shall exhort the believers to fight. If there are twenty of you who are steadfast, they can defeat two hundred, and a hundred of you can defeat a thousand of those who disbelieved. That is because they are people who do not understand.

1981.english: O you prophet, you shall exhort the believers to fight. If there are only twenty of you who steadfastly persevere, they can defeat two hundred, while one hundred of you can defeat one thousand disbelievers, for they do not comprehend.

1989.english: O you prophet, exhort the believers to fight. If there are twenty of you who are steadfast, they can defeat two hundred, and a hundred of you can defeat a thousand of those who disbelieved. That is because they are people who do not understand.

verses.arabic: ٱلْـَٰٔنَ خَفَّفَ ٱللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الآن خفف الله عنكم وعلم أن فيكم ضعفا ۚ فإن يكن منكم مائة صابرة يغلبوا مائتين ۚ وإن يكن منكم ألف يغلبوا ألفين بإذن الله ۗ والله مع الصابرين
verses.transliterated: al-āna khaffafa l-lahu ʿankum waʿalima anna fīkum ḍaʿfan fa-in yakun minkum mi-atun ṣābiratun yaghlibū mi-atayni wa-in yakun minkum alfun yaghlibū alfayni bi-idh'ni l-lahi wal-lahu maʿa l-ṣābirīn
verses.english: Now (that many new people have joined you) GOD has made it easier for you, for He knows that you are not as strong as you used to be. Henceforth, a hundred steadfast believers can defeat two hundred, and a thousand of you can defeat two thousand by GOD's leave. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.

1981.english: But in view of your weaknesses at this stage, God has reduced your burden. Henceforth, one hundred of you who are steadfast can defeat two hundred, and one thousand can defeat two thousand by God's leave. God is with those who steadfastly persevere.

1989.english: Now GOD has made the matter easier for you, for He knows that you are not as strong as you used to be. Henceforth, a hundred steadfast believers can defeat two hundred, and a thousand of you can defeat two thousand by GOD’s leave. GOD is with those who are steadfast.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان لنبي أن يكون له أسرى حتى يثخن في الأرض ۚ تريدون عرض الدنيا والله يريد الآخرة ۗ والله عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: mā kāna linabiyyin an yakūna lahu asrā ḥattā yuth'khina fī l-arḍi turīdūna ʿaraḍa l-dun'yā wal-lahu yurīdu l-ākhirata wal-lahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: No prophet shall acquire captives, unless he participates in the fighting. You people are seeking the materials of this world, while GOD advocates the Hereafter. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: No prophet shall acquire captives, unless he actually fights in battle. You may care about the material of this world, but God cares about the hereafter. God is almighty, wise.
1981.subtitle: The Prophet Subject to the Same Tests

1989.english: No prophet shall acquire captives, unless he participates in the fighting. You people are seeking the materials of this world, while GOD advocates the Hereafter. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَا كِتَٰبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَآ أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: لولا كتاب من الله سبق لمسكم فيما أخذتم عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: lawlā kitābun mina l-lahi sabaqa lamassakum fīmā akhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: If it were not for a predetermined decree from GOD, you would have suffered, on account of what you took, a terrible retribution.

1981.english: If it were not for God's knowledge about your future repentance, you would have suffered a terrible retribution for the spoils you acquired.

1989.english: If it were not for a predetermined decree from GOD, you would have suffered, on account of what you took, a terrible retribution.

verses.arabic: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فكلوا مما غنمتم حلالا طيبا ۚ واتقوا الله ۚ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: fakulū mimmā ghanim'tum ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Therefore, eat from the spoils you have earned that which is lawful and good, and observe GOD. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: You may take from the spoils of war that which is lawful and good, and beware of God. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Therefore, eat from the spoils you have obtained, that which is lawful and good. You shall observe GOD. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّمَن فِىٓ أَيْدِيكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَسْرَىٰٓ إِن يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّآ أُخِذَ مِنكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي قل لمن في أيديكم من الأسرى إن يعلم الله في قلوبكم خيرا يؤتكم خيرا مما أخذ منكم ويغفر لكم ۗ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul liman fī aydīkum mina l-asrā in yaʿlami l-lahu fī qulūbikum khayran yu'tikum khayran mimmā ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: O you prophet, tell the prisoners of war in your hands, "If GOD knew of anything good in your hearts, He would have given you better than anything you have lost, and would have forgiven you. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful."

1981.english: O you prophet, tell the captives who fell in your hands that if God knew of any good in their hearts, He would have given them better than that which was taken from them, and would have forgiven them. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: O you prophet, tell the prisoners of war in your hands, “If GOD knew of anything good in your hearts, He would have given you better than anything you have lost, and would have forgiven you. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُرِيدُوا۟ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يريدوا خيانتك فقد خانوا الله من قبل فأمكن منهم ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: wa-in yurīdū khiyānataka faqad khānū l-laha min qablu fa-amkana min'hum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: And if they want to betray you, they have already betrayed GOD. This is why He made them the losers. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: If they want to betray you, they have already betrayed God, and He has condemned them. God is knower, wise.

1989.english: But if they want to betray you, they have already betrayed GOD. This is why He made them losers. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَٰيَتِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ وَإِنِ ٱسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وهاجروا وجاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم في سبيل الله والذين آووا ونصروا أولئك بعضهم أولياء بعض ۚ والذين آمنوا ولم يهاجروا ما لكم من ولايتهم من شيء حتى يهاجروا ۚ وإن استنصروكم في الدين فعليكم النصر إلا على قوم بينكم وبينهم ميثاق ۗ والله بما تعملون بصير
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wa-alladhīna āmanū walam yuhājirū mā lakum min walāyatihim min shayin ḥattā yuhājirū wa-ini is'tanṣarūkum fī l-dīni faʿalaykumu l-naṣru illā ʿalā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mīthāqun wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verses.english: Surely, those who believed, and emigrated, and strove with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD, as well as those who hosted them and gave them refuge, and supported them, they are allies of one another. As for those who believe, but do not emigrate with you, you do not owe them any support, until they do emigrate. However, if they need your help, as brethren in faith, you shall help them, except against people with whom you have signed a peace treaty. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

1981.english: Those who believe, and leave their homes, and struggle with their money and their lives in the cause of God, and those who give them refuge and support them, are natural allies for one another. As for those who believe, but refuse to leave their homes along with you, you owe them no obligations until they do emigrate. However, if they need your support to defend their religion you shall support them, unless you have a peace treaty with their opponents. God sees everything you do.

1989.english: Surely, those who believe, and emigrate, and strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD, as well as those who give them refuge and support them, they are allies of one another. As for those who believe, but do not emigrate with you, you do not owe them any support, until they do emigrate. However, if they need your help, as brethren in faith, you shall help them, except against people with whom you have signed a peace treaty. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا بعضهم أولياء بعض ۚ إلا تفعلوه تكن فتنة في الأرض وفساد كبير
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin illā tafʿalūhu takun fit'natun fī l-arḍi wafasādun kabīru
verses.english: Those who disbelieved are allies of one another. Unless you keep these commandments, there will be chaos on earth, and terrible corruption.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve are allies of one another, and unless you check them, there will be chaos on earth, and terrible corruption.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved are allies of one another. Unless you keep these commandments, there will be chaos on earth, and terrible corruption.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وهاجروا وجاهدوا في سبيل الله والذين آووا ونصروا أولئك هم المؤمنون حقا ۚ لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna āwaw wanaṣarū ulāika humu l-mu'minūna ḥaqqan lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmu
verses.english: Those who believed and emigrated, and strove in the cause of GOD, as well as those who hosted them and gave them refuge, and supported them, these are the true believers. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous recompense.

1981.english: Those who believe, and emigrate, and struggle in the cause of God, as well as those who give them refuge, and support them, these are the true believers. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous reward.

1989.english: Those who believed and emigrated, and strove in the cause of GOD, as well as those who gave them refuge and supported them, these are the true believers. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous recompense.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ مَعَكُمْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا من بعد وهاجروا وجاهدوا معكم فأولئك منكم ۚ وأولو الأرحام بعضهم أولى ببعض في كتاب الله ۗ إن الله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū min baʿdu wahājarū wajāhadū maʿakum fa-ulāika minkum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: Those who believed afterwards, and emigrated, and strove with you, they belong with you. Those who are related to each other shall be the first to support each other, in accordance with GOD's commandments. GOD is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: And those who believe afterwards, and emigrate, and struggle along with you, they belong with you. Those who are related to each other shall give refuge and take care of each other, in accordance with God's commandments. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: Those who believed afterwards, and emigrated, and strove with you, they belong with you. Those who are related to each other shall be the first to support each other, in accordance with GOD’s commandments. GOD is fully aware of all things.

verses.arabic: بَرَآءَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: براءة من الله ورسوله إلى الذين عاهدتم من المشركين
verses.transliterated: barāatun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: An ultimatum is herein issued from GOD and His messenger to the idol worshipers who enter into a treaty with you.
verses.subtitle: No Basmalah
verses.footnote:
The absence of Basmalah from this sura is not only a profound sign from the Almighty Author of the Quran that this sura has been tampered with, but also represents an awesome miracle in its own right. See the details in Appendices 24 & 29.

±9:1 & ±9:127 This is the only sura that is not prefixed with the Basmalah. This phenomenon has puzzled the students of the Quran for 14 centuries, and many theories were advanced to explain it. Now we realize that the conspicuous absence of the Basmalah serves three purposes: (1) It represents an advance divine proclamation that the idol worshipers were destined to tamper with the Quran by adding 2 false verses (9:128-129). (2) It demonstrates one of the functions of God's mathematical code in the Quran, namely, to guard the Quran against any alteration. (3) It provides additional miraculous features of the Quran's code. Due to their extraordinary importance, the details are given in Appendices 24 and 29. One immediate observation is that the number of occurrences of the word "God" at the end of Sura 9 is 1273 (19x67). If the two false verses 128 & 129 are included, this phenomenon—and many more—will vanish.

1981.english: Reprieve is herein granted from God and His messenger to those among the idol worshipers who sign a peace treaty with you.
1981.footnote: This is the only sura that does not begin with the opening statement, "In the name of God, most gracious, most merciful." This fact puzzled the students of Quran throughout the last 14 centuries, and many theories were advanced to explain the absence of "**Basmalah**" from this sura. As it turned out, this is an integral part of the Quran's miraculous code that remained a divinely guarded secret until this very translation came into existence, and represented God's authorization of this translation. As the reader already knows (from Appendices 1 & 2), the Quran's code is based on the number 19, and its foundation is the opening statement "In the name of God, most gracious, most merciful," which consists of 19 Arabic letters. Since the Quran consists of 114 suras (19x6), and since the absence of "**Basmalah**" will violate the code by having only 113 opening statements, we find that this deficiency is compensated in sura 27, which contains two "**Basmalahs**" (see 27:30). Not only do we find that the additional statement in 27:30 perfecting the frequency of the opening statement, but also providing additional proof that the order of suras is divinely designed, and should never be tampered with. To find out this additional proof, the reader is requested to count the suras starting here at sura 9, and ending at sura 27. Glory be to God, the almighty, most exalted.

1989.english: An ultimatum is herein issued from GOD and His messenger to the idol worshipers who enter into an agreement with you.
1989.subtitle: No Basmalah
1989.footnote: & *9:127 This is the only sura that is not prefixed with the Basmalah. This phenomenon has puzzled the students of the Quran for 14 centuries, and many theories have been advanced, in vain, to explain it. Now we realize that the conspicuous absence of the Basmalah serves a dual purpose: (1) It represents an advance divine proclamation that the idol worshipers were destined to tamper with the Quran by adding 2 false verses (9:128-129). (2) It demonstrates one of the functions of God’s mathematical code in the Quran, namely, to guard the Quran against any alteration. (3) It provides additional miraculous features of the Quran’s code. Due to their extraordinary importance, the details are given in Appendices 24 and 29.

verses.arabic: فَسِيحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْزِى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فسيحوا في الأرض أربعة أشهر واعلموا أنكم غير معجزي الله ۙ وأن الله مخزي الكافرين
verses.transliterated: fasīḥū fī l-arḍi arbaʿata ashhurin wa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wa-anna l-laha mukh'zī l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Therefore, roam the earth freely for four months, and know that you cannot escape from GOD, and that GOD humiliates the disbelievers.

1981.english: Thus, you may roam the earth freely for four months, and know that you can never escape from God, and that God will inevitably defeat the disbelievers.

1989.english: Therefore, roam the earth freely for four months, and know that you cannot escape from GOD, and that GOD humiliates the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَأَذَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَجِّ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُۥ فَإِن تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأذان من الله ورسوله إلى الناس يوم الحج الأكبر أن الله بريء من المشركين ۙ ورسوله ۚ فإن تبتم فهو خير لكم ۖ وإن توليتم فاعلموا أنكم غير معجزي الله ۗ وبشر الذين كفروا بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wa-adhānun mina l-lahi warasūlihi ilā l-nāsi yawma l-ḥaji l-akbari anna l-laha barīon mina l-mush'rikīna warasūluhu fa-in tub'tum fahuwa khayrun lakum wa-in tawallaytum fa-iʿ'lamū annakum ghayru muʿ'jizī l-lahi wabashiri alladhīna kafarū biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: A proclamation is herein issued from GOD and His messenger to all the people on the great day of pilgrimage, that GOD has disowned the idol worshipers, and so did His messenger. Thus, if you repent, it would be better for you. But if you turn away, then know that you can never escape from GOD. Promise those who disbelieve a painful retribution.

1981.english: And a declaration is herein issued from God and His messenger, on the great day of pilgrimage, that God disowns the idol worshipers, and so does His messenger. If you repent, it would be best for you. But if you turn away, then know that you can never escape from God. Warn the disbelievers of a painful retribution.

1989.english: And a proclamation is herein issued from GOD and His messenger to all the people on the great day of pilgrimage, that GOD disowns the idol worshipers, and so does His messenger. Thus, if you repent, it would be better for you. But if you turn away, then know that you can not escape from GOD. Promise the disbelievers a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنقُصُوكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَمْ يُظَٰهِرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين عاهدتم من المشركين ثم لم ينقصوكم شيئا ولم يظاهروا عليكم أحدا فأتموا إليهم عهدهم إلى مدتهم ۚ إن الله يحب المتقين
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum mina l-mush'rikīna thumma lam yanquṣūkum shayan walam yuẓāhirū ʿalaykum aḥadan fa-atimmū ilayhim ʿahdahum ilā muddatihim inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīn
verses.english: If the idol worshipers sign a peace treaty with you, and do not violate it, nor band together with others against you, you shall fulfill your treaty with them, until the expiration date. GOD loves the righteous.

1981.english: As for the idol worshipers who sign a peace treaty with you, then abate none of your rights, nor ally themselves with your enemy, you shall fulfill their treaty to the end of its term. God loves the righteous.

1989.english: If the idol worshipers sign a peace treaty with you, and do not violate it, nor band together with others against you, you shall fulfill your treaty with them, until the expiration date. GOD loves the righteous.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنسَلَخَ ٱلْأَشْهُرُ ٱلْحُرُمُ فَٱقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَٱحْصُرُوهُمْ وَٱقْعُدُوا۟ لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَخَلُّوا۟ سَبِيلَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا انسلخ الأشهر الحرم فاقتلوا المشركين حيث وجدتموهم وخذوهم واحصروهم واقعدوا لهم كل مرصد ۚ فإن تابوا وأقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة فخلوا سبيلهم ۚ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā insalakha l-ashhuru l-ḥurumu fa-uq'tulū l-mush'rikīna ḥaythu wajadttumūhum wakhudhūhum wa-uḥ'ṣurūhum wa-uq'ʿudū lahum kulla marṣadin fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fakhallū sabīlahum inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Once the Sacred Months are past, (and they refuse to make peace) you may kill the idol worshipers when you encounter them, punish them, and resist every move they make. If they repent and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), you shall let them go. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Once the sacred months are over, you shall kill the idol worshipers whenever you encounter them, and capture them, and besiege them, and keep after them. However, if they repent, and observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, then you shall pardon them. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Once the Sacred Months are past, (and they refuse to make peace) you may kill the idol worshipers when you encounter them, punish them, and resist every move they make. If they repent and observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), you shall let them go. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ٱسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّىٰ يَسْمَعَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن أحد من المشركين استجارك فأجره حتى يسمع كلام الله ثم أبلغه مأمنه ۚ ذلك بأنهم قوم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-in aḥadun mina l-mush'rikīna is'tajāraka fa-ajir'hu ḥattā yasmaʿa kalāma l-lahi thumma abligh'hu mamanahu dhālika bi-annahum qawmun lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: If one of the idol worshipers sought safe passage with you, you shall grant him safe passage, so that he can hear the word of GOD, then send him back to his place of security. That is because they are people who do not know.

1981.english: If one of the idol worshipers seeks protection from you, you shall grant such protection and give him a chance to hear the word of God, then send him back in safety. That is because they are people who do not know.

1989.english: If one of the idol worshipers sought safe passage with you, you shall grant him safe passage, so that he can hear the word of GOD, then send him back to his place of security. That is because they are people who do not know.

verses.arabic: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَٰهَدتُّمْ عِندَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ فَمَا ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوا۟ لَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كيف يكون للمشركين عهد عند الله وعند رسوله إلا الذين عاهدتم عند المسجد الحرام ۖ فما استقاموا لكم فاستقيموا لهم ۚ إن الله يحب المتقين
verses.transliterated: kayfa yakūnu lil'mush'rikīna ʿahdun ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda rasūlihi illā alladhīna ʿāhadttum ʿinda l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi famā is'taqāmū lakum fa-is'taqīmū lahum inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-mutaqīn
verses.english: How can the idol worshipers demand any pledge from GOD and from His messenger? Exempted are those who have signed a peace treaty with you at the Sacred Masjid. If they honor and uphold such a treaty, you shall uphold it as well. GOD loves the righteous.

1981.english: How could the idol worshipers expect peace from God and His messenger, unless they sign a peace treaty with you at the sacred mosque? Whenever they keep their treaty with you, you shall keep your treaty with them. God loves the righteous.

1989.english: How can the idol worshipers demand any pledge from GOD and from His messenger? Exempted are those who did enter into a peace treaty with you at the Sacred Mosque. If they honor and uphold such an agreement, you shall uphold it as well. GOD loves the righteous.

verses.arabic: كَيْفَ وَإِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوا۟ فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً يُرْضُونَكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتَأْبَىٰ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كيف وإن يظهروا عليكم لا يرقبوا فيكم إلا ولا ذمة ۚ يرضونكم بأفواههم وتأبى قلوبهم وأكثرهم فاسقون
verses.transliterated: kayfa wa-in yaẓharū ʿalaykum lā yarqubū fīkum illan walā dhimmatan yur'ḍūnakum bi-afwāhihim watabā qulūbuhum wa-aktharuhum fāsiqūn
verses.english: How can they (demand a pledge) when they never observed any rights of kinship between you and them, nor any covenant, if they ever had a chance to prevail. They pacified you with lip service, while their hearts were in opposition, and most of them are wicked.

1981.english: How could they expect peace, when, if they ever prevail, they do not observe any ties of relationship or treaty towards you? They appease you with their words, while their hearts are concealing otherwise, and most of them are wicked.

1989.english: How can they (demand a pledge) when they never observed any rights of relationship between you and them, nor any covenant, if they ever had a chance to prevail. They pacified you with lip service, while their hearts were in opposition. Indeed, most of them are wicked.

verses.arabic: ٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: اشتروا بآيات الله ثمنا قليلا فصدوا عن سبيله ۚ إنهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: ish'taraw biāyāti l-lahi thamanan qalīlan faṣaddū ʿan sabīlihi innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: They traded away GOD's revelations for a cheap price. Consequently, they repulsed the people from His path. Miserable indeed is what they did!

1981.english: They have traded away God's revelations for a cheap price, and repelled from His path. Evil indeed is what they did.

1989.english: They traded away GOD’s revelations for a cheap price. Consequently, they repulsed the people from His path. Miserable indeed is what they did!

verses.arabic: لَا يَرْقُبُونَ فِى مُؤْمِنٍ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُعْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يرقبون في مؤمن إلا ولا ذمة ۚ وأولئك هم المعتدون
verses.transliterated: lā yarqubūna fī mu'minin illan walā dhimmatan wa-ulāika humu l-muʿ'tadūn
verses.english: They never observe any rights of kinship towards any believer, nor do they uphold their covenants; these are the real transgressors.

1981.english: They never observe towards any believer any tie of relationship or treaty, and they are the aggressors.

1989.english: They never observe any rights of relationship with a believer, nor any covenant; these are the real transgressors.

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن تابوا وأقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة فإخوانكم في الدين ۗ ونفصل الآيات لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fa-in tābū wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wanufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: If they repent and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), then they are your brethren in religion. We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
verses.subtitle: Repentance: Cleaning the Slate

1981.english: However, if they repent, and observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, then they are your brethren in faith. We thus explain the revelations for those who know.

1989.english: If they repent and observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), then they are your brethren in religion. We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
1989.subtitle: Repentance: Cleaning the Slate

verses.arabic: وَإِن نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ فَقَٰتِلُوٓا۟ أَئِمَّةَ ٱلْكُفْرِ إِنَّهُمْ لَآ أَيْمَٰنَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنتَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن نكثوا أيمانهم من بعد عهدهم وطعنوا في دينكم فقاتلوا أئمة الكفر ۙ إنهم لا أيمان لهم لعلهم ينتهون
verses.transliterated: wa-in nakathū aymānahum min baʿdi ʿahdihim waṭaʿanū fī dīnikum faqātilū a-immata l-kuf'ri innahum lā aymāna lahum laʿallahum yantahūn
verses.english: If they violate their oaths after pledging to keep their covenants, and attack your religion, you may fight the leaders of paganism—you are no longer bound by your covenant with them—that they may refrain.

1981.english: And if they violate their vows as spelled out in their treaty, and attack your faith, then you shall fight the leaders of paganism, who have violated their vows, until they refrain.

1989.english: If they violate their oaths after pledging to keep their covenants, and attack your religion, then you may fight such leaders of paganism— you are no longer bound by your covenant with them— that they might refrain.

verses.arabic: أَلَا تُقَٰتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ وَهَمُّوا۟ بِإِخْرَاجِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَهُم بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ فَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا تقاتلون قوما نكثوا أيمانهم وهموا بإخراج الرسول وهم بدءوكم أول مرة ۚ أتخشونهم ۚ فالله أحق أن تخشوه إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: alā tuqātilūna qawman nakathū aymānahum wahammū bi-ikh'rāji l-rasūli wahum badaūkum awwala marratin atakhshawnahum fal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: Would you not fight people who violated their treaties, tried to banish the messenger, and they are the ones who started the war in the first place? Are you afraid of them? GOD is the One you are supposed to fear, if you are believers.

1981.english: Would you not fight people who violated their vows, and conspired to banish the messenger, and initiated the aggression against you? Are you afraid of them? God is the one to be feared, if you are really believers.

1989.english: Would you not fight people who have violated their oaths and tried to banish the messenger, and they are the ones who started the war in the first place? Are you afraid of them? GOD is the One you are supposed to fear, if you are believers.

verses.arabic: قَٰتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قاتلوهم يعذبهم الله بأيديكم ويخزهم وينصركم عليهم ويشف صدور قوم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: qātilūhum yuʿadhib'humu l-lahu bi-aydīkum wayukh'zihim wayanṣur'kum ʿalayhim wayashfi ṣudūra qawmin mu'minīn
verses.english: You shall fight them, for GOD will punish them at your hands, humiliate them, grant you victory over them, and cool the chests of the believers.

1981.english: You shall fight them, for God will punish them at your hands, and humiliate them, while giving you victory, and please the hearts of those who believed;

1989.english: You shall fight them, for GOD will punish them at your hands, humiliate them, grant you victory over them, and cool the chests of the believers.

verses.arabic: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَيَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ويذهب غيظ قلوبهم ۗ ويتوب الله على من يشاء ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: wayudh'hib ghayẓa qulūbihim wayatūbu l-lahu ʿalā man yashāu wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: He will also remove the rage from the believers' hearts. GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: And remove the rage of their hearts. God redeems whomever He wills, and God is fully aware, wise.

1989.english: He will also remove the rage of the believers. GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD Omniscient, Most Wise. The Inevitable Test

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تُتْرَكُوا۟ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِۦ وَلَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةً وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم حسبتم أن تتركوا ولما يعلم الله الذين جاهدوا منكم ولم يتخذوا من دون الله ولا رسوله ولا المؤمنين وليجة ۚ والله خبير بما تعملون
verses.transliterated: am ḥasib'tum an tut'rakū walammā yaʿlami l-lahu alladhīna jāhadū minkum walam yattakhidhū min dūni l-lahi walā rasūlihi walā l-mu'minīna walījatan wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Did you think that you will be left alone without GOD distinguishing those among you who strive, and never ally themselves with GOD's enemies, or the enemies of His messenger, or the enemies of the believers? GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
verses.subtitle: The Inevitable Test

1981.english: Did you expect to be left alone, without distinguishing those among you who strive, and give no priority to anything over God, His messenger, or the believers? God is fully cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: Did you think that you will be left alone without GOD distinguishing those among you who strive, and never ally themselves with GOD enemies, or the enemies of His messenger, or the enemies of the believers? GOD is fully Cognizant o everything you do.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يَعْمُرُوا۟ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ شَٰهِدِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِم بِٱلْكُفْرِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ وَفِى ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان للمشركين أن يعمروا مساجد الله شاهدين على أنفسهم بالكفر ۚ أولئك حبطت أعمالهم وفي النار هم خالدون
verses.transliterated: mā kāna lil'mush'rikīna an yaʿmurū masājida l-lahi shāhidīna ʿalā anfusihim bil-kuf'ri ulāika ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum wafī l-nāri hum khālidūn
verses.english: The idol worshipers are not to frequent the masjids of GOD, while confessing their disbelief. These have nullified their works, and they will abide forever in Hell.

1981.english: The idol worshipers are not to frequent the mosques of God, while professing heathenism. They have nullified their works, and in hell they will abide.
1981.subtitle: God Guards His Mosques

1989.english: The idol worshipers are not to frequent the mosques of GOD, while confessing their disbelief. Their works are utterly nullified, and they abide forever in Hell.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَأَقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَى ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَعَسَىٰٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يعمر مساجد الله من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وأقام الصلاة وآتى الزكاة ولم يخش إلا الله ۖ فعسى أولئك أن يكونوا من المهتدين
verses.transliterated: innamā yaʿmuru masājida l-lahi man āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wa-aqāma l-ṣalata waātā l-zakata walam yakhsha illā l-laha faʿasā ulāika an yakūnū mina l-muh'tadīn
verses.english: The only people to frequent GOD's masjids are those who believe in GOD and the Last Day, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and do not fear except GOD. These will surely be among the guided ones.

1981.english: The only people to frequent the mosques of God are those who believe in God and the last day, and observe the **salat** and **zakat**, and fear no one except God. These are the truly guided ones.

1989.english: The only people to frequent the mosques of GOD are those who believe in GOD and the Last Day, and observe the contact prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and do not fear except GOD. These will surely be among the guided ones.

verses.arabic: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ ٱلْحَآجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَجَٰهَدَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَوُۥنَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أجعلتم سقاية الحاج وعمارة المسجد الحرام كمن آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وجاهد في سبيل الله ۚ لا يستوون عند الله ۗ والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: ajaʿaltum siqāyata l-ḥāji waʿimārata l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi kaman āmana bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wajāhada fī sabīli l-lahi lā yastawūna ʿinda l-lahi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Have you considered the watering of the pilgrims and caring for the Sacred Masjid a substitute for believing in GOD and the Last Day, and striving in the cause of GOD? They are not equal in the sight of GOD. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
verses.subtitle: Question to the Arabs

1981.english: Did you think that watering the pilgrims, and keeping the sacred mosque, is a substitute for believing in God and the last day, and striving in the cause of God? These are never the same in the sight of God. God does not guide the wicked people.

1989.english: Have you considered the watering of the pilgrims and caring for the Sacred Mosque a substitute for believing in GOD and the Last Day, and striving in the cause of GOD? They are not equal in the sight of GOD. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
1989.subtitle: Question to the Arabs

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين آمنوا وهاجروا وجاهدوا في سبيل الله بأموالهم وأنفسهم أعظم درجة عند الله ۚ وأولئك هم الفائزون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna āmanū wahājarū wajāhadū fī sabīli l-lahi bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim aʿẓamu darajatan ʿinda l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-fāizūn
verses.english: Those who believe, and emigrate, and strive in the cause of GOD with their money and their lives, are far greater in rank in the sight of GOD. These are the winners.
verses.subtitle: Good News

1981.english: Those who believe, and leave their homes, and strive in the cause of God with their money and their lives, occupy a greater rank at God; they are the winners.

1989.english: Those who believe, and emigrate, and strive in the cause of GOD with their money and their lives, are far greater in rank in the sight of GOD. These are the winners.
1989.subtitle: Good News

verses.arabic: يُبَشِّرُهُمْ رَبُّهُم بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَرِضْوَٰنٍ وَجَنَّٰتٍ لَّهُمْ فِيهَا نَعِيمٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يبشرهم ربهم برحمة منه ورضوان وجنات لهم فيها نعيم مقيم
verses.transliterated: yubashiruhum rabbuhum biraḥmatin min'hu wariḍ'wānin wajannātin lahum fīhā naʿīmun muqīmu
verses.english: Their Lord gives them good news: mercy and approval from Him, and gardens where they rejoice in everlasting bliss.

1981.english: Their Lord promises them mercy from Him, and approval, as well as gardens with eternal bliss.

1989.english: Their Lord gives them good news: mercy and approval from Him, and gardens where they enjoy an everlasting bliss.

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: خالدين فيها أبدا ۚ إن الله عنده أجر عظيم
verses.transliterated: khālidīna fīhā abadan inna l-laha ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Eternally they abide therein. GOD possesses a great recompense.

1981.english: They abide therein forever. Indeed, God possesses great rewards.

1989.english: Eternally they abide therein. GOD possesses a great recompense.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَكُمْ وَإِخْوَٰنَكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ إِنِ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْكُفْرَ عَلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا آباءكم وإخوانكم أولياء إن استحبوا الكفر على الإيمان ۚ ومن يتولهم منكم فأولئك هم الظالمون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū ābāakum wa-ikh'wānakum awliyāa ini is'taḥabbū l-kuf'ra ʿalā l-īmāni waman yatawallahum minkum fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not ally yourselves even with your parents and your siblings, if they prefer disbelieving over believing. Those among you who ally themselves with them are transgressing.
verses.subtitle: If You Have to Make a Choice

1981.english: O you who believe, do not ally yourselves with your parents, and your siblings, if they choose paganism instead of faith. If any of you side with them, then these are the wrongdoers.
1981.subtitle: God: The Only Priority

1989.english: O you who believe, do not accept your parents and your siblings as allies, if they prefer to disbelieve instead of believing. Those among you who ally themselves with them are transgressing. Appreciating the Value of Faith
1989.subtitle: If You Have to Make a Choice

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَأَبْنَآؤُكُمْ وَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ وَعَشِيرَتُكُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلٌ ٱقْتَرَفْتُمُوهَا وَتِجَٰرَةٌ تَخْشَوْنَ كَسَادَهَا وَمَسَٰكِنُ تَرْضَوْنَهَآ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَجِهَادٍ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن كان آباؤكم وأبناؤكم وإخوانكم وأزواجكم وعشيرتكم وأموال اقترفتموها وتجارة تخشون كسادها ومساكن ترضونها أحب إليكم من الله ورسوله وجهاد في سبيله فتربصوا حتى يأتي الله بأمره ۗ والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين
verses.transliterated: qul in kāna ābāukum wa-abnāukum wa-ikh'wānukum wa-azwājukum waʿashīratukum wa-amwālun iq'taraftumūhā watijāratun takhshawna kasādahā wamasākinu tarḍawnahā aḥabba ilaykum mina l-lahi warasūlihi wajihādin fī sabīlihi fatarabbaṣū ḥattā yatiya l-lahu bi-amrihi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīn
verses.english: Proclaim: "If your parents, your children, your siblings, your spouses, your family, the money you have earned, a business you worry about, and the homes you cherish are more beloved to you than GOD and His messenger, and the striving in His cause, then just wait until GOD brings His judgment." GOD does not guide the wicked people.
verses.subtitle: Important Criterion
verses.footnote:
Since the odds are overwhelming against any human being to actually believe and devote the worship to God alone (12:103, 106), it is virtually impossible to see a whole family believe. Thus, most believers have been faced with the question: "Either me or God and His messenger." This question is consistently stated by spouses of the believers, or their parents, their children, etc. Consistently, the believers made the right choice. This is a mandatory test for all believers (29:2).

±±9:24 The Quranic, mathematical evidence points specifically at God's Messenger of the Covenant. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus the verse number (24), we get 505+725+24=1254=19x66.

1981.english: Say, "If your parents, your children, your siblings, your spouses, your tribe, your money, your business, and the homes that you love, are more beloved to you than God, and His messenger, and the striving in His cause, then just wait until God brings His judgment. God does not guide the wicked people.

1989.english: Say, “If your parents, your children, your siblings, your spouses, your family, the money you have earned, the business you worry about, and the homes you cherish are more beloved to you than GOD and His messenger, and the striving in His cause, then just wait until GOD brings His judgment.” GOD does not guide the wicked people.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُم مُّدْبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لقد نصركم الله في مواطن كثيرة ۙ ويوم حنين ۙ إذ أعجبتكم كثرتكم فلم تغن عنكم شيئا وضاقت عليكم الأرض بما رحبت ثم وليتم مدبرين
verses.transliterated: laqad naṣarakumu l-lahu fī mawāṭina kathīratin wayawma ḥunaynin idh aʿjabatkum kathratukum falam tugh'ni ʿankum shayan waḍāqat ʿalaykumu l-arḍu bimā raḥubat thumma wallaytum mud'birīn
verses.english: GOD has granted you victory in many situations. But on the day of Hunayn, you became too proud of your great number. Consequently, it did not help you at all, and the spacious earth became so straitened around you, that you turned around and fled.

1981.english: God has supported you with many victories in many situations. But in the battle of Hunain, your number impressed you. Consequently, it did not help you at all, and the wide earth became so straitened for you, that you turned around and fled.

1989.english: GOD has granted you victory in many situations. But on the day of Hunayn, you became too proud of your number. Consequently, it did not help you at all, and the spacious earth became so straitened around you, that you turned around and fled.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنزَلَ جُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَعَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أنزل الله سكينته على رسوله وعلى المؤمنين وأنزل جنودا لم تروها وعذب الذين كفروا ۚ وذلك جزاء الكافرين
verses.transliterated: thumma anzala l-lahu sakīnatahu ʿalā rasūlihi waʿalā l-mu'minīna wa-anzala junūdan lam tarawhā waʿadhaba alladhīna kafarū wadhālika jazāu l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Then GOD sent down contentment upon His messenger and upon the believers. And He sent down invisible soldiers; He thus punished those who disbelieved. This is the requital for the disbelievers.

1981.english: Then God sent down a sense of security upon His messenger and the believers, and He sent down invisible soldiers, who tormented the disbelievers. This is what the disbelievers deserve.

1989.english: Then GOD sent down contentment upon His messenger and upon the believers. And He sent down invisible soldiers; He thus punished those who disbelieved. This is the requital for the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ثم يتوب الله من بعد ذلك على من يشاء ۗ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: thumma yatūbu l-lahu min baʿdi dhālika ʿalā man yashāu wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Ultimately, GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Yet, God redeems whomever He wills, for God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: In the end, GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِن شَآءَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إنما المشركون نجس فلا يقربوا المسجد الحرام بعد عامهم هذا ۚ وإن خفتم عيلة فسوف يغنيكم الله من فضله إن شاء ۚ إن الله عليم حكيم
