verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū innamā l-mush'rikūna najasun falā yaqrabū l-masjida l-ḥarāma baʿda ʿāmihim hādhā wa-in khif'tum ʿaylatan fasawfa yugh'nīkumu l-lahu min faḍlihi in shāa inna l-laha ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, the idol worshipers are polluted; they shall not be permitted to approach the Sacred Masjid after this year. If you fear loss of income, GOD will shower you with His provisions, in accordance with His will. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: O you who believe, the idol worshipers are unholy. Henceforth, let them not come close to the sacred mosque. If you fear loss of business, God will enrich you from His bounties, if He so wills. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: O you who believe, the idol worshipers are impure; they shall not approach the Sacred Mosque after this year. If you fear loss of income, (you should know that) GOD will shower you with His provisions, in accordance with His will. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise

verses.arabic: قَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَلَا بِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَلَا يُحَرِّمُونَ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَلَا يَدِينُونَ دِينَ ٱلْحَقِّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ حَتَّىٰ يُعْطُوا۟ ٱلْجِزْيَةَ عَن يَدٍ وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قاتلوا الذين لا يؤمنون بالله ولا باليوم الآخر ولا يحرمون ما حرم الله ورسوله ولا يدينون دين الحق من الذين أوتوا الكتاب حتى يعطوا الجزية عن يد وهم صاغرون
verses.transliterated: qātilū alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-lahi walā bil-yawmi l-ākhiri walā yuḥarrimūna mā ḥarrama l-lahu warasūluhu walā yadīnūna dīna l-ḥaqi mina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba ḥattā yuʿ'ṭū l-jiz'yata ʿan yadin wahum ṣāghirūn
verses.english: You shall fight back against those who do not believe in GOD, nor in the Last Day, nor do they prohibit what GOD and His messenger have prohibited, nor do they abide by the religion of truth among those who received the scripture, until they pay the due tax, willingly or unwillingly.

1981.english: You shall fight those who do not believe in God and the last day, nor abide by the prohibitions decreed by God and His messenger, nor uphold the religious truth among the followers of previous scripture, unless they pay the expiation willingly, and without a grudge.
1981.footnote: Since Islamic law forbids non-Muslims from enlisting in the military, this expiation is designed as a substitute for military service. In this way, the non-Muslims who live in a Muslim society equitably contribute towards the cost of defending them.

1989.english: You shall fight back against those who do not believe in GOD, nor in the Last Day, and they do not prohibit what GOD and His messenger have prohibited, and do not abide by the religion of truth among those who received the scripture, until they pay the due tax, peacefully.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ عُزَيْرٌ ٱبْنُ ٱللَّهِ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَى ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ قَوْلُهُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ يُضَٰهِـُٔونَ قَوْلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالت اليهود عزير ابن الله وقالت النصارى المسيح ابن الله ۖ ذلك قولهم بأفواههم ۖ يضاهئون قول الذين كفروا من قبل ۚ قاتلهم الله ۚ أنى يؤفكون
verses.transliterated: waqālati l-yahūdu ʿuzayrun ub'nu l-lahi waqālati l-naṣārā l-masīḥu ub'nu l-lahi dhālika qawluhum bi-afwāhihim yuḍāhiūna qawla alladhīna kafarū min qablu qātalahumu l-lahu annā yu'fakūn
verses.english: The Jews said, "Ezra is the son of GOD," while the Christians said, "Jesus is the son of GOD!" These are blasphemies uttered by their mouths. They thus match the blasphemies of those who have disbelieved in the past. GOD condemns them. They have surely deviated.
verses.subtitle: Blasphemies

1981.english: The Jews said that Ezra was the son of God, while the Christians said that Christ was the son of God. Such is their utterance with their mouths, resembling the utterances of the pagans. God has condemned them; how could they deviate!
1981.subtitle: Quran Rectifies Previous Deviations

1989.english: The Jews said, “Ezra is the son of GOD,” while the Christians said, “Jesus is the son of GOD!” These are blasphemies that they utter with their lips. They thus match the blasphemies of those who have disbelieved in the past. GOD condemns them. They have certainly deviated.

verses.arabic: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَٰنَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسِيحَ ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: اتخذوا أحبارهم ورهبانهم أربابا من دون الله والمسيح ابن مريم وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا إلها واحدا ۖ لا إله إلا هو ۚ سبحانه عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: ittakhadhū aḥbārahum waruh'bānahum arbāban min dūni l-lahi wal-masīḥa ib'na maryama wamā umirū illā liyaʿbudū ilāhan wāḥidan lā ilāha illā huwa sub'ḥānahu ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: They have set up their religious leaders and scholars as lords, instead of GOD. Others deified the Messiah, son of Mary. They were all commanded to worship only one god. There is no god except He. Be He glorified, high above having any partners.
verses.subtitle: Upholding the Teachings of Religious Leaders Instead of God's Teachings
verses.footnote: If you consult the "Muslim scholars" about worshiping God alone, and upholding the word of God alone, as taught in this proven scripture, they will advise you against it. If you consult the Pope about the identity of Jesus, he will advise you to uphold a trinity. If you obey the "Muslim scholars" whose advice is contrary to God's teachings, or if you take the Pope's advice instead of God's, you have set up these religious leaders as gods instead of God.

1981.english: They have taken their priests and rabbis as lords besides God, as well as Christ the son of Mary. They were commanded not to worship but the one God; there is no god except He, much too glorious to have partners.

1989.english: They have set up their religious leaders and scholars as lords, instead of GOD. Others deified the Messiah, son of Mary. They were all commanded to worship only one god; there is no god except He. Be He glorified, high above having any partners.
1989.subtitle: Upholding the Teachings of Religious Leaders, Instead of God’s Teachings

verses.arabic: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَيَأْبَى ٱللَّهُ إِلَّآ أَن يُتِمَّ نُورَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يريدون أن يطفئوا نور الله بأفواههم ويأبى الله إلا أن يتم نوره ولو كره الكافرون
verses.transliterated: yurīdūna an yuṭ'fiū nūra l-lahi bi-afwāhihim wayabā l-lahu illā an yutimma nūrahu walaw kariha l-kāfirūn
verses.english: They want to put out GOD's light with their mouths, but GOD insists upon perfecting His light, in spite of the disbelievers.

1981.english: They want to put out God's light with their mouths, but God insists upon perfecting His light, inspite of the disbelievers.

1989.english: They want to put out GOD’s light with their mouths, but GOD insists upon perfecting His light, in spite of the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ولو كره المشركون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī arsala rasūlahu bil-hudā wadīni l-ḥaqi liyuẓ'hirahu ʿalā l-dīni kullihi walaw kariha l-mush'rikūn
verses.english: He is the One who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, and will make it dominate all religions, in spite of the idol worshipers.
verses.subtitle: "Submission" Destined to Prevail
verses.footnote: This statement, letter for letter, occurs here and in 61:9. If we write down the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), followed by the value of "Khalifa" (725), followed by the sura and verse numbers where this statement occurs (9:33 & 61:9), we get 505 725 9 33 61 9, a multiple of 19. This confirms that the messenger here is Rashad Khalifa. Additionally, the number of verses from 9:33 to 61:9 (3902)+9+33+61+9+the value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230) gives 5244, also a multiple of 19. The gematrical value of 9:33 & 61:9, calculated by adding the values of every letter, is 7858. By adding this number, plus the number of letters in the two verses (120), plus the number of verses from 9:33 to 61:9 (3902), plus the value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), we get 7858+120+3902+1230 = 13110 = 19x690. See Appendices 1, 2, and 26.

1981.english: He is the one who sent His messenger, with the guidance and truthful religion, and will make it prevail over all other religions, inspite of the idolaters.

1989.english: He is the One who sent His messenger* with the guidance and the religion of truth, and will make it dominate all other religions, despite the idol worshipers.
1989.subtitle: Islam Destined to Prevail
1989.footnote: This statement is mentioned three times in the Quran—9:33, 48:28, and 61:9. There is evidence that these three occurrences refer to the “Three Messengers of Islam” (Abraham, Muhammad, and Rashad). See Appendices 1, 2, and 26..

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْبَارِ وَٱلرُّهْبَانِ لَيَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَٰلَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ ٱلذَّهَبَ وَٱلْفِضَّةَ وَلَا يُنفِقُونَهَا فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن كثيرا من الأحبار والرهبان ليأكلون أموال الناس بالباطل ويصدون عن سبيل الله ۗ والذين يكنزون الذهب والفضة ولا ينفقونها في سبيل الله فبشرهم بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū inna kathīran mina l-aḥbāri wal-ruh'bāni layakulūna amwāla l-nāsi bil-bāṭili wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wa-alladhīna yaknizūna l-dhahaba wal-fiḍata walā yunfiqūnahā fī sabīli l-lahi fabashir'hum biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: O you who believe, many religious leaders and preachers take the people's money illicitly, and repel from the path of GOD. Those who hoard the gold and silver, and do not spend them in the cause of GOD, promise them a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: Beware of Professional Religionists

1981.english: O you who believe, many priests and monks cheat the people out of their money, and divert them from the path of God. Those who hoard the gold and silver, and spend it not in the cause of God, promise them a painful retribution.

1989.english: O you who believe, many religious leaders and nrp.arhers take the people’s money illicitly, and repel from the path of GOD. Those who hoard the gold and silver, and do not spend them in the cause of GOD, promise them a painful retribution.
1989.subtitle: Professional Religionists

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُحْمَىٰ عَلَيْهَا فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ فَتُكْوَىٰ بِهَا جِبَاهُهُمْ وَجُنُوبُهُمْ وَظُهُورُهُمْ هَٰذَا مَا كَنَزْتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْنِزُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يحمى عليها في نار جهنم فتكوى بها جباههم وجنوبهم وظهورهم ۖ هذا ما كنزتم لأنفسكم فذوقوا ما كنتم تكنزون
verses.transliterated: yawma yuḥ'mā ʿalayhā fī nāri jahannama fatuk'wā bihā jibāhuhum wajunūbuhum waẓuhūruhum hādhā mā kanaztum li-anfusikum fadhūqū mā kuntum taknizūn
verses.english: The day will come when their gold and silver will be heated in the fire of Hell, then used to burn their foreheads, their sides, and their backs: "This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so taste what you have hoarded."

1981.english: The day will come when their money will be heated in the fire of hell, and then used to burn their foreheads, their sides, and their backs. This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so suffer the consequences of your hoarding.

1989.english: The day will come when their gold and silver will be heated in the fire of Hell, then used to burn their foreheads, their sides, and their backs: “This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so taste what you have hoarded.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ ٱلشُّهُورِ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ مِنْهَآ أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ فَلَا تَظْلِمُوا۟ فِيهِنَّ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ كَآفَّةً كَمَا يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمْ كَآفَّةً وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن عدة الشهور عند الله اثنا عشر شهرا في كتاب الله يوم خلق السماوات والأرض منها أربعة حرم ۚ ذلك الدين القيم ۚ فلا تظلموا فيهن أنفسكم ۚ وقاتلوا المشركين كافة كما يقاتلونكم كافة ۚ واعلموا أن الله مع المتقين
verses.transliterated: inna ʿiddata l-shuhūri ʿinda l-lahi ith'nā ʿashara shahran fī kitābi l-lahi yawma khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa min'hā arbaʿatun ḥurumun dhālika l-dīnu l-qayimu falā taẓlimū fīhinna anfusakum waqātilū l-mush'rikīna kāffatan kamā yuqātilūnakum kāffatan wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha maʿa l-mutaqīn
verses.english: The count of months, as far as GOD is concerned, is twelve. This has been GOD's law, since the day He created the heavens and the earth. Four of them are sacred. This is the perfect religion; you shall not wrong your souls (by fighting) during the Sacred Months. However, you may declare all-out war against the idol worshipers (even during the Sacred Months), when they declare all-out war against you, and know that GOD is on the side of the righteous.
verses.subtitle: God's System: Twelve Months Per Year
verses.footnote: The word "month" is mentioned in the Quran 12 times, and "day" 365 times.

1981.english: The count of months according to God is twelve, as decreed in God's scripture, since the day He created the heavens and the earth; four of them are sacred. This is the perfect religion. Therefore, you shall not wrong your souls during these months (by hunting or fighting).* However, you may fight the pagans at any time, if they attack you at any time, and know that God is with the righteous.
1981.subtitle: Conservation

1989.english: The count of months, as far as GOD is concerned, is twelve.* This has been GOD’s law, since the day He created the heavens and the earth. Four of them are sacred. This is the perfect religion; you shall not wrong your souls (by fighting) during the Sacred Months. However, you may declare all-out war against the idol worshipers (even during the Sacred Months), when they declare all-out war against you, and know that GOD is on the side of the righteous.
1989.subtitle: God’s System: Twelve Months Per Year
1989.footnote: The word “month” is mentioned in the Quran 12 times, and “day” 365 times. This is another miraculous feature of the Quran’s mathematical composition.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّسِىٓءُ زِيَادَةٌ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ يُضَلُّ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُحِلُّونَهُۥ عَامًا وَيُحَرِّمُونَهُۥ عَامًا لِّيُوَاطِـُٔوا۟ عِدَّةَ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ فَيُحِلُّوا۟ مَا حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ زُيِّنَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ أَعْمَٰلِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما النسيء زيادة في الكفر ۖ يضل به الذين كفروا يحلونه عاما ويحرمونه عاما ليواطئوا عدة ما حرم الله فيحلوا ما حرم الله ۚ زين لهم سوء أعمالهم ۗ والله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: innamā l-nasīu ziyādatun fī l-kuf'ri yuḍallu bihi alladhīna kafarū yuḥillūnahu ʿāman wayuḥarrimūnahu ʿāman liyuwāṭiū ʿiddata mā ḥarrama l-lahu fayuḥillū mā ḥarrama l-lahu zuyyina lahum sūu aʿmālihim wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Altering the Sacred Months is a sign of excessive disbelief; it augments the straying of those who have disbelieved. They alternate the Sacred Months and the regular months, while preserving the number of months consecrated by GOD. They thus violate what GOD has consecrated. Their evil works are adorned in their eyes. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
verses.subtitle: Altering the Sacred Months
verses.footnote: The Sacred Months according to the corrupted Muslim World are Rajab, Zul-Qe'dah, Zul-Hijjah, and Muharram (7th, 11th, 12th and 1st months of the Islamic Calendar). A careful study of the Quran, however, reveals that they should be Zul-Hijjah, Muharram, Safar, and Rabi I (12th, 1st, 2nd, and 3rd months). See Footnote 2:196.

1981.english: The alteration of the sacred months is a blasphemy indeed. With it, those who disbelieved mislead the people, and alter the sacred months from year to year, though they preserve the same number of God's sacred months. They thus violate what God has decreed as sacred. Their evil works are adorned in their eyes, for God does not guide the disbelieving people.

1989.english: Altering the Sacred Months is an excessive blasphemy. For it causes those who disbelieved to be misled. They alternate the Sacred months and the regular months, while preserving the number of months made sacred by GOD. Thus, they violate what GOD made sacred. Their evil works are adorned in their eyes. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
1989.subtitle: Altering the Sacred Months
1989.footnote: The prevalent Sacred Months in today’s Muslim World are Rajab, Zul-Qe‘dah, Zul-Hijjah, and Muharram (7th, 11th, 12th and 1st months of the Islamic Calendar). A careful study of the Quran, however, reveals that they should be Zul-Hijjah, Muharram, Safar, and Rabi I (12th, 1st, 2nd, and 3rd months). See Footnote 2:196.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَا لَكُمْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱنفِرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرَضِيتُم بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مِنَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَمَا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا ما لكم إذا قيل لكم انفروا في سبيل الله اثاقلتم إلى الأرض ۚ أرضيتم بالحياة الدنيا من الآخرة ۚ فما متاع الحياة الدنيا في الآخرة إلا قليل
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū mā lakum idhā qīla lakumu infirū fī sabīli l-lahi ithāqaltum ilā l-arḍi araḍītum bil-ḥayati l-dun'yā mina l-ākhirati famā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā fī l-ākhirati illā qalīlu
verses.english: O you who believe, when you are told, "Mobilize in the cause of GOD," why do you become heavily attached to the ground? Have you chosen this worldly life in place of the Hereafter? The materials of this world, compared to the Hereafter, are nil.

1981.english: O you who believe, why is it that when you are told to mobilize in the cause of God, you become heavily attached to the ground? Have you chosen this life over the hereafter? Indeed, the materials of this life are nil, compared with the hereafter.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Eagerly Struggle

1989.english: O you who believe, when you are told, “Mobilize in the cause of GOD,” why do you become heavily attached to the ground? Have you accepted this worldly life in place of the Hereafter? The materials of this world are nil, compared to the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَنفِرُوا۟ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَيَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّوهُ شَيْـًٔا وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا تنفروا يعذبكم عذابا أليما ويستبدل قوما غيركم ولا تضروه شيئا ۗ والله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: illā tanfirū yuʿadhib'kum ʿadhāban alīman wayastabdil qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūhu shayan wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Unless you mobilize, He will commit you to painful retribution and substitute other people in your place; you can never hurt Him in the least. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Unless you eagerly mobilize, God will punish you severely, and substitute others in your place, and you do not harm Him in the least. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: Unless you mobilize, He will commit you to painful retribution, and substitute other people in your place; you never hurt Him in the least. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثَانِىَ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِى ٱلْغَارِ إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٍ لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلسُّفْلَىٰ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِىَ ٱلْعُلْيَا وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا تنصروه فقد نصره الله إذ أخرجه الذين كفروا ثاني اثنين إذ هما في الغار إذ يقول لصاحبه لا تحزن إن الله معنا ۖ فأنزل الله سكينته عليه وأيده بجنود لم تروها وجعل كلمة الذين كفروا السفلى ۗ وكلمة الله هي العليا ۗ والله عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: illā tanṣurūhu faqad naṣarahu l-lahu idh akhrajahu alladhīna kafarū thāniya ith'nayni idh humā fī l-ghāri idh yaqūlu liṣāḥibihi lā taḥzan inna l-laha maʿanā fa-anzala l-lahu sakīnatahu ʿalayhi wa-ayyadahu bijunūdin lam tarawhā wajaʿala kalimata alladhīna kafarū l-suf'lā wakalimatu l-lahi hiya l-ʿul'yā wal-lahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: If you fail to support him (the messenger), GOD has already supported him. Thus, when the disbelievers chased him, and he was one of two in the cave, he said to his friend, "Do not worry; GOD is with us." GOD then sent down contentment and security upon him, and supported him with invisible soldiers. He made the word of the disbelievers lowly. GOD's word reigns supreme. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: God's Invisible Soldiers

1981.english: When you did not support (the messenger), God supported him when the disbelievers banished him. He was one of two people in the cave, when he said to his companion, "Do not worry; God is with us." God then sent down calm upon him, and supported him with invisible soldiers, and made the word of the disbelievers lowly, while God's word prevailed. God is almighty, wise.

1989.english: If you fail to support (the messenger), GOD is already supporting him. Thus, when the disbelievers chased him, and he was one of two in the cave, he said to his friend, “Do not worry; GOD is with us.” GOD then sent down contentment and security upon him, and supported him with invisible soldiers. He made the word of the disbelievers lowly, while GOD’s word reigns supreme. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
1989.subtitle: God’s Invisible Soldiers

verses.arabic: ٱنفِرُوا۟ خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: انفروا خفافا وثقالا وجاهدوا بأموالكم وأنفسكم في سبيل الله ۚ ذلكم خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: infirū khifāfan wathiqālan wajāhidū bi-amwālikum wa-anfusikum fī sabīli l-lahi dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: You shall readily mobilize, light or heavy, and strive with your money and your lives in the cause of GOD. This is better for you, if you only knew.
verses.subtitle: Better Believers Strive in the Cause of God

1981.english: You shall readily mobilize, light or heavy, and struggle with your money and your lives in the cause of God. This is better for you, if you only knew.

1989.english: You shall readily mobilize, light or heavy, and strive with your money and your lives in the cause of GOD. This is better for you, if you only knew.

verses.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ عَرَضًا قَرِيبًا وَسَفَرًا قَاصِدًا لَّٱتَّبَعُوكَ وَلَٰكِنۢ بَعُدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشُّقَّةُ وَسَيَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ لَوِ ٱسْتَطَعْنَا لَخَرَجْنَا مَعَكُمْ يُهْلِكُونَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لو كان عرضا قريبا وسفرا قاصدا لاتبعوك ولكن بعدت عليهم الشقة ۚ وسيحلفون بالله لو استطعنا لخرجنا معكم يهلكون أنفسهم والله يعلم إنهم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: law kāna ʿaraḍan qarīban wasafaran qāṣidan la-ittabaʿūka walākin baʿudat ʿalayhimu l-shuqatu wasayaḥlifūna bil-lahi lawi is'taṭaʿnā lakharajnā maʿakum yuh'likūna anfusahum wal-lahu yaʿlamu innahum lakādhibūn
verses.english: If there were a quick material gain, and a short journey, they would have followed you. But the striving is just too much for them. They will swear by GOD: "If we could, we would have mobilized with you." They thus hurt themselves, and GOD knows that they are liars.
verses.subtitle: The Sedentary

1981.english: If it were a quick gain, or a short journey, they would have readily followed you. But the hardship seems too much for them, and they would swear by God, "If we could, we would have gone with you." They thus destroy themselves, and God knows well that they are liars.

1989.english: If there were a quick material gain, and a short journey, they would have followed you. But the journey was just too long for them. They will swear by GOD: “If we could, we would have mobilized with you.” They thus hurt themselves, and GOD knows that they are liars.

verses.arabic: عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنكَ لِمَ أَذِنتَ لَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَتَعْلَمَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: عفا الله عنك لم أذنت لهم حتى يتبين لك الذين صدقوا وتعلم الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: amma Allah 'anka lam adhinta lahum hatta yatabayyana laka alladihna daqu wata'lam alkaathibin
verses.english: GOD has pardoned you: why did you give them permission (to stay behind), before you could distinguish those who are truthful from the liars?

1981.english: God has pardoned you (O Muhammad) for permitting them to stay behind. You thus deprived yourself of distinguishing those who are sincere, from those who are liars.

1989.english: GOD has pardoned you (O Muhammad); why did you give them permission (to stay behind), before you could distinguish those who are truthful from the liars?

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْتَـْٔذِنُكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ أَن يُجَٰهِدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يستأذنك الذين يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر أن يجاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم ۗ والله عليم بالمتقين
verses.transliterated: lā yastadhinuka alladhīna yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri an yujāhidū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim wal-lahu ʿalīmun bil-mutaqīn
verses.english: Those who truly believe in GOD and the Last Day do not ask your permission to evade the opportunity to strive with their money and their lives. GOD is fully aware of the righteous.

1981.english: The sincere believers in God and the last day never ask you to exempt them from struggling with their money and their lives. God is fully aware of the righteous.

1989.english: Those who believe in GOD and the Last Day do not ask your permission to evade the opportunity of striving with their money and their lives. GOD is fully aware of the righteous.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَـْٔذِنُكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَٱرْتَابَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِى رَيْبِهِمْ يَتَرَدَّدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يستأذنك الذين لا يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر وارتابت قلوبهم فهم في ريبهم يترددون
verses.transliterated: innamā yastadhinuka alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wa-ir'tābat qulūbuhum fahum fī raybihim yataraddadūn
verses.english: The only people who wish to be excused are those who do not really believe in GOD and the Last Day. Their hearts are full of doubt, and their doubts cause them to waver.

1981.english: The only ones who do this are those who do not believe in God and the last day, and their hearts are full of doubt. It is their doubt that makes them hesitate.

1989.english: The only people who wish to be excused are those who do not really believe in GOD and the Last Day. Their hearts are full of doubt, and their doubts cause them to waver.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا۟ ٱلْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا۟ لَهُۥ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ ٱللَّهُ ٱنۢبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ ٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أرادوا الخروج لأعدوا له عدة ولكن كره الله انبعاثهم فثبطهم وقيل اقعدوا مع القاعدين
verses.transliterated: walaw arādū l-khurūja la-aʿaddū lahu ʿuddatan walākin kariha l-lahu inbiʿāthahum fathabbaṭahum waqīla uq'ʿudū maʿa l-qāʿidīn
verses.english: Had they really wanted to mobilize, they would have prepared for it thoroughly. But GOD disliked their participation, so He discouraged them; they were told, "Stay behind with those who are staying behind."

1981.english: If they were readily willing to mobilize, they would have thoroughly prepared for it. But God disliked their participation, and He deliberately discouraged them. They were told, "Stay behind with the sedentary."

1989.english: Had they really wanted to mobilize, they would have prepared for it thoroughly. But GOD disliked their participation, so He discouraged them; they were told, “Stay behind with those who are staying behind.”

verses.arabic: لَوْ خَرَجُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا زَادُوكُمْ إِلَّا خَبَالًا وَلَأَوْضَعُوا۟ خِلَٰلَكُمْ يَبْغُونَكُمُ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ وَفِيكُمْ سَمَّٰعُونَ لَهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لو خرجوا فيكم ما زادوكم إلا خبالا ولأوضعوا خلالكم يبغونكم الفتنة وفيكم سماعون لهم ۗ والله عليم بالظالمين
verses.transliterated: law kharajū fīkum mā zādūkum illā khabālan wala-awḍaʿū khilālakum yabghūnakumu l-fit'nata wafīkum sammāʿūna lahum wal-lahu ʿalīmun bil-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Had they mobilized with you, they would have created confusion, and would have caused disputes and divisions among you. Some of you were apt to listen to them. GOD is fully aware of the transgressors.

1981.english: Had they mobilized with you, they would have only confused you, and discouraged you, especially that some of you would listen to them. God is fully aware of the wicked.

1989.english: Had they mobilized with you, they would have created confusion, and would have caused disputes and divisions among you. Some of you were apt to listen to them. GOD is fully aware of the evildoers.

verses.arabic: لَقَدِ ٱبْتَغَوُا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ مِن قَبْلُ وَقَلَّبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأُمُورَ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَهُمْ كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لقد ابتغوا الفتنة من قبل وقلبوا لك الأمور حتى جاء الحق وظهر أمر الله وهم كارهون
verses.transliterated: laqadi ib'taghawū l-fit'nata min qablu waqallabū laka l-umūra ḥattā jāa l-ḥaqu waẓahara amru l-lahi wahum kārihūn
verses.english: They sought to spread confusion among you in the past, and confounded the matters for you. However, the truth ultimately prevails, and GOD's plan is carried out, in spite of them.

1981.english: They had tried previously to confuse you, and turned things around for you. However, the truth finally prevailed, and God's will was done, inspite of them.

1989.english: They sought to spread chaos among you in the past, and confounded matters for you. However, the truth ultimately prevailed, and GOD’s judgment was issued, in spite of them.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ ٱئْذَن لِّى وَلَا تَفْتِنِّىٓ أَلَا فِى ٱلْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُوا۟ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من يقول ائذن لي ولا تفتني ۚ ألا في الفتنة سقطوا ۗ وإن جهنم لمحيطة بالكافرين
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yaqūlu i'dhan lī walā taftinnī alā fī l-fit'nati saqaṭū wa-inna jahannama lamuḥīṭatun bil-kāfirīn
verses.english: Some of them would say, "Give me permission (to stay behind); do not impose such a hardship on me." In fact, they have thus incurred a terrible hardship; Hell is surrounding the disbelievers.

1981.english: Some of them would say, "Allow me to stay behind, and spare me the hardship." Indeed, they have already incurred hardship by saying this, and hell is their inevitable destiny.

1989.english: Some of them would say, “Give me permission (to stay behind)-, do not impose such a hardship on me.” In fact, they have thus incurred a terrible hardship; Hell is surrounding such disbelievers.

verses.arabic: إِن تُصِبْكَ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَإِن تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ يَقُولُوا۟ قَدْ أَخَذْنَآ أَمْرَنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَيَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن تصبك حسنة تسؤهم ۖ وإن تصبك مصيبة يقولوا قد أخذنا أمرنا من قبل ويتولوا وهم فرحون
verses.transliterated: in tuṣib'ka ḥasanatun tasu'hum wa-in tuṣib'ka muṣībatun yaqūlū qad akhadhnā amranā min qablu wayatawallaw wahum fariḥūn
verses.english: If something good happens to you, they hurt, and if an affliction befalls you, they say, "We told you so," as they turn away rejoicing.

1981.english: When something good happens to you, they hurt; and when something bad happens to you, they rejoice and say, "We were wise not to participate with them."

1989.english: If something good happens to you, they hurt, and if an affliction befalls you, they say, “We told you so,” as they turn away rejoicing.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَىٰنَا وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لن يصيبنا إلا ما كتب الله لنا هو مولانا ۚ وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون
verses.transliterated: qul lan yuṣībanā illā mā kataba l-lahu lanā huwa mawlānā waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūn
verses.english: Say, "Nothing happens to us, except what GOD has decreed for us. He is our Lord and Master. In GOD the believers shall trust."

1981.english: Say, "Nothing will happen to us, except that which is decreed for us by God. He is our master." In God the believers shall trust.

1989.english: Say, “Nothing happens to us, except what GOD has decreed for us. He is our Lord and Master. In GOD the believers shall trust.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ تَرَبَّصُونَ بِنَآ إِلَّآ إِحْدَى ٱلْحُسْنَيَيْنِ وَنَحْنُ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمْ أَن يُصِيبَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنْ عِندِهِۦٓ أَوْ بِأَيْدِينَا فَتَرَبَّصُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّتَرَبِّصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هل تربصون بنا إلا إحدى الحسنيين ۖ ونحن نتربص بكم أن يصيبكم الله بعذاب من عنده أو بأيدينا ۖ فتربصوا إنا معكم متربصون
verses.transliterated: qul hal tarabbaṣūna binā illā iḥ'dā l-ḥus'nayayni wanaḥnu natarabbaṣu bikum an yuṣībakumu l-lahu biʿadhābin min ʿindihi aw bi-aydīnā fatarabbaṣū innā maʿakum mutarabbiṣūn
verses.english: Say, "You can only expect for us one of two good things (victory or martyrdom), while we expect for you condemnation from GOD and retribution from Him, or at our hands. Therefore, wait, and we will wait along with you."

1981.english: Say, "You can only expect for us one of two things (victory or martyrdom), while we expect that God afflicts you with a retribution from Him, or at our hands. Therefore, just wait, and we will wait along with you."

1989.english: Say, “You can only expect for us one of two good things (victory or martyrdom), while we expect for you condemnation from GOD and retribution from Him, or at our hands. Therefore, wait, and we will wait along with you.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَنفِقُوا۟ طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا لَّن يُتَقَبَّلَ مِنكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أنفقوا طوعا أو كرها لن يتقبل منكم ۖ إنكم كنتم قوما فاسقين
verses.transliterated: qul anfiqū ṭawʿan aw karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum innakum kuntum qawman fāsiqīn
verses.english: Say, "Spend, willingly or unwillingly. Nothing will be accepted from you, for you are evil people."

1981.english: Say, "Whether you spend your money willingly or unwillingly, nothing will be accepted from you, because you are wicked."

1989.english: Say, “Spend, willingly or unwillingly. Nothing will be accepted from you, for you are evil people.” Rejectors of God’s Messenger Observed the Salat Prayers*

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَهُمْ أَن تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَبِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِلَّا وَهُمْ كُسَالَىٰ وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ إِلَّا وَهُمْ كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما منعهم أن تقبل منهم نفقاتهم إلا أنهم كفروا بالله وبرسوله ولا يأتون الصلاة إلا وهم كسالى ولا ينفقون إلا وهم كارهون
verses.transliterated: wamā manaʿahum an tuq'bala min'hum nafaqātuhum illā annahum kafarū bil-lahi wabirasūlihi walā yatūna l-ṣalata illā wahum kusālā walā yunfiqūna illā wahum kārihūn
verses.english: What prevented the acceptance of their spending is that they disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and when they observed the Contact Prayers (Salat), they observed them lazily, and when they gave to charity, they did so grudgingly.
verses.subtitle: The Contact Prayer Existed Before Muhammad
verses.footnote: This is another proof that the Contact Prayers (Salat) existed before the Quran, and were handed down from Abraham (see 21:73). Also, it stumps those who challenge God's assertion that the Quran is complete and fully detailed when they ask, "Where can we find the details of the Contact Prayers in the Quran?" (6:19, 38, 114).

1981.english: The reason their charities are not acceptable is that they have disbelieved in God and His messenger, and do not observe the **salat** except unenthusiastically, and do not give to charity except grudgingly.

1989.english: What prevented the acceptance of their spending is that they disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and when they observed the contact prayers (Salat),* they observed them lazily, and when they gave to charity, they did so grudgingly.
1989.footnote: This is another proof that the contact prayers (Salat) existed before the Quran, and were handed down from Abraham (see 21:73). Also, it stumps those who challenge God’s assertion that the Quran is complete and fully detailed when they ask, “Where can we find the details of the contact prayers in the Quran” (6:19, 38, 114).

verses.arabic: فَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُمْ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَتَزْهَقَ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَهُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تعجبك أموالهم ولا أولادهم ۚ إنما يريد الله ليعذبهم بها في الحياة الدنيا وتزهق أنفسهم وهم كافرون
verses.transliterated: falā tuʿ'jib'ka amwāluhum walā awlāduhum innamā yurīdu l-lahu liyuʿadhibahum bihā fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kāfirūn
verses.english: Do not be impressed by their money, or their children. GOD causes these to be sources of retribution for them in this life, and (when they die) their souls depart while they are disbelievers.
verses.subtitle: Apparent Worldly Success

1981.english: Do not be impressed by their money and their children. For God punishes them therewith in this life, and then they die as disbelievers.

1989.english: Do not be impressed by their money, or their children. GOD turns these into means of retribution for them in this life, and their souls depart while they are disbelievers.
1989.subtitle: Apparent Worldly Success

verses.arabic: وَيَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَمِنكُمْ وَمَا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَفْرَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويحلفون بالله إنهم لمنكم وما هم منكم ولكنهم قوم يفرقون
verses.transliterated: wayaḥlifūna bil-lahi innahum laminkum wamā hum minkum walākinnahum qawmun yafraqūn
verses.english: They swear by GOD that they belong with you, while they do not belong with you; they are divisive people.

1981.english: They swear by God that they belong with you, when they do not really belong with you; they have deviated.

1989.english: They swear by GOD that they belong with you, while they do not belong with you; they are divisive people.

verses.arabic: لَوْ يَجِدُونَ مَلْجَـًٔا أَوْ مَغَٰرَٰتٍ أَوْ مُدَّخَلًا لَّوَلَّوْا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَهُمْ يَجْمَحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لو يجدون ملجأ أو مغارات أو مدخلا لولوا إليه وهم يجمحون
verses.transliterated: law yajidūna malja-an aw maghārātin aw muddakhalan lawallaw ilayhi wahum yajmaḥūn
verses.english: If they could find a refuge, or caves, or a hiding place, they would go to it, rushing.

1981.english: If they could find a refuge, or caves, or any place of hiding, they would go to it running.

1989.english: If they could find any refuge, or caves, or a hiding place, they would go to it, rushing.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَلْمِزُكَ فِى ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ فَإِنْ أُعْطُوا۟ مِنْهَا رَضُوا۟ وَإِن لَّمْ يُعْطَوْا۟ مِنْهَآ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْخَطُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من يلمزك في الصدقات فإن أعطوا منها رضوا وإن لم يعطوا منها إذا هم يسخطون
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yalmizuka fī l-ṣadaqāti fa-in uʿ'ṭū min'hā raḍū wa-in lam yuʿ'ṭaw min'hā idhā hum yaskhaṭūn
verses.english: Some of them criticize your distribution of the charities; if they are given therefrom, they become satisfied, but if they are not given therefrom, they become objectors.

1981.english: And some of them criticize your charity distributions; if they are given therefrom, they are satisfied, but if not given therefrom, they complain.

1989.english: Some of them criticize your distribution of the charities; if they are given therefrom, they become satisfied, but if they are not given therefrom, they become objectors.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَضُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ سَيُؤْتِينَا ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ رَٰغِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنهم رضوا ما آتاهم الله ورسوله وقالوا حسبنا الله سيؤتينا الله من فضله ورسوله إنا إلى الله راغبون
verses.transliterated: walaw annahum raḍū mā ātāhumu l-lahu warasūluhu waqālū ḥasbunā l-lahu sayu'tīnā l-lahu min faḍlihi warasūluhu innā ilā l-lahi rāghibūn
verses.english: They should be satisfied with what GOD and His messenger have given them. They should have said, "GOD suffices us. GOD will provide for us from His bounties, and so will His messenger. We are seeking only GOD."

1981.english: They should be content with whatever God and His messenger have bestowed upon them, and should have said, "God will suffice us, and will endow us from His bounty, and so will His messenger. We only seek God."

1989.english: They should be satisfied with what GOD and His messenger have given them. They should have said, “GOD suffices us. GOD will provide for us from His bounties, through his messenger. We are seeking only GOD.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلصَّدَقَٰتُ لِلْفُقَرَآءِ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا وَٱلْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَفِى ٱلرِّقَابِ وَٱلْغَٰرِمِينَ وَفِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَرِيضَةً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنما الصدقات للفقراء والمساكين والعاملين عليها والمؤلفة قلوبهم وفي الرقاب والغارمين وفي سبيل الله وابن السبيل ۖ فريضة من الله ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: innamā l-ṣadaqātu lil'fuqarāi wal-masākīni wal-ʿāmilīna ʿalayhā wal-mu-alafati qulūbuhum wafī l-riqābi wal-ghārimīna wafī sabīli l-lahi wa-ib'ni l-sabīli farīḍatan mina l-lahi wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: Charities shall go to the poor, the needy, the workers who collect them, the new converts, to free the slaves, to those burdened by sudden expenses, in the cause of GOD, and to the traveling alien. Such is GOD's commandment. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: Distribution System for Charities

1981.english: Charities shall go to the poor, the needy, those who administer them, the new converts, the freeing of slaves, those afflicted with hardship, in the cause of God, and to the alien. This is God's decree, and God is knower, wise.
1981.subtitle: Distribution of Charities

1989.english: Charities shall go to the poor, the needy, the workers who collect them, the new converts, to free the slaves, to those burdened by sudden expenses, in the cause of GOD, and to the traveling alien. Such is GOD’s commandment. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
1989.subtitle: Distribution System for Charities

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ أُذُنٌ قُلْ أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ لَّكُمْ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَيُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم الذين يؤذون النبي ويقولون هو أذن ۚ قل أذن خير لكم يؤمن بالله ويؤمن للمؤمنين ورحمة للذين آمنوا منكم ۚ والذين يؤذون رسول الله لهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wamin'humu alladhīna yu'dhūna l-nabiya wayaqūlūna huwa udhunun qul udhunu khayrin lakum yu'minu bil-lahi wayu'minu lil'mu'minīna waraḥmatun lilladhīna āmanū minkum wa-alladhīna yu'dhūna rasūla l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Some of them hurt the prophet by saying, "He is all ears!" Say, "It is better for you that he listens to you. He believes in GOD, and trusts the believers. He is a mercy for those among you who believe." Those who hurt GOD's messenger have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: And some used to hurt the prophet by saying, "He is all ears." Say, "Being all ears is better for you. He believes in God, trusts the believers, and he brought mercy for those among you who believe. As for those who hurt the messenger of God, they have deserved painful retribution."

1989.english: Some of them hurt the prophet by saying, “He is all ears!” Say, “It is better for you that he listens to you. He believes in GOD, and trusts the believers. He is a mercy for those among you who believe.” Those who hurt GOD’s messenger have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: يَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ لِيُرْضُوكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَحَقُّ أَن يُرْضُوهُ إِن كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يحلفون بالله لكم ليرضوكم والله ورسوله أحق أن يرضوه إن كانوا مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yaḥlifūna bil-lahi lakum liyur'ḍūkum wal-lahu warasūluhu aḥaqqu an yur'ḍūhu in kānū mu'minīn
verses.english: They swear by GOD to you, to please you, when GOD and His messenger are more worthy of pleasing, if they are really believers.

1981.english: They swear by God to please you, when it is God and His messenger that they should be pleasing, if they were really believers.

1989.english: They swear by GOD to you, to please you, when GOD and His messenger are more worthy of pleasing, if they are really believers.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ مَن يُحَادِدِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَأَنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدًا فِيهَا ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخِزْىُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يعلموا أنه من يحادد الله ورسوله فأن له نار جهنم خالدا فيها ۚ ذلك الخزي العظيم
verses.transliterated: alam yaʿlamū annahu man yuḥādidi l-laha warasūlahu fa-anna lahu nāra jahannama khālidan fīhā dhālika l-khiz'yu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: Did they not know that anyone who opposes GOD and His messenger has incurred the fire of Hell forever? This is the worst humiliation.
verses.subtitle: Retribution for Opposing God and His Messenger

1981.english: Did they not know that any one who opposes God and His messenger has deserved the fire of hell, wherein he abides forever? This is the worst humiliation.

1989.english: Did they not know that anyone who opposes GOD and His messenger has incurred the fire of Hell forever? This is the worst humiliation.
1989.subtitle: Retribution for Opposing God and His Messenger

verses.arabic: يَحْذَرُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ أَن تُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُورَةٌ تُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ قُلِ ٱسْتَهْزِءُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا تَحْذَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يحذر المنافقون أن تنزل عليهم سورة تنبئهم بما في قلوبهم ۚ قل استهزئوا إن الله مخرج ما تحذرون
verses.transliterated: yaḥdharu l-munāfiqūna an tunazzala ʿalayhim sūratun tunabbi-uhum bimā fī qulūbihim quli is'tahziū inna l-laha mukh'rijun mā taḥdharūn
verses.english: The hypocrites worry that a sura may be revealed exposing what is inside their hearts. Say, "Go ahead and mock. GOD will expose exactly what you are afraid of."
verses.subtitle: The Hypocrites

1981.english: The hypocrites are afraid lest a sura may expose what they hide in their hearts. Say, "Keep on scoffing; God will surely expose what you fear."

1989.english: The hypocrites worry that a sura may be revealed exposing what is inside their hearts. Say, “Go ahead and mock. GOD will bring out what you are worried about.”
1989.subtitle: The Hypocrites

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّمَا كُنَّا نَخُوضُ وَنَلْعَبُ قُلْ أَبِٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَرَسُولِهِۦ كُنتُمْ تَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن سألتهم ليقولن إنما كنا نخوض ونلعب ۚ قل أبالله وآياته ورسوله كنتم تستهزئون
verses.transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum layaqūlunna innamā kunnā nakhūḍu wanalʿabu qul abil-lahi waāyātihi warasūlihi kuntum tastahziūn
verses.english: If you ask them, they would say, "We were only mocking and kidding." Say, "Do you realize that you are mocking GOD, and His revelations, and His messenger?"

1981.english: If you ask them then, they would say, "We were only kidding." Say, "Do you take God, and His revelations, and His messenger, as objects of your kidding?

1989.english: If you ask them, they would say, “We were only mocking and playing.” Say, “Do you realize that you are mocking GOD and His revelations, and His messenger?”

verses.arabic: لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ قَدْ كَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمْ إِن نَّعْفُ عَن طَآئِفَةٍ مِّنكُمْ نُعَذِّبْ طَآئِفَةًۢ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا تعتذروا قد كفرتم بعد إيمانكم ۚ إن نعف عن طائفة منكم نعذب طائفة بأنهم كانوا مجرمين
verses.transliterated: lā taʿtadhirū qad kafartum baʿda īmānikum in naʿfu ʿan ṭāifatin minkum nuʿadhib ṭāifatan bi-annahum kānū muj'rimīn
verses.english: Do not apologize. You have disbelieved after having believed. If we pardon some of you, we will punish others among you, as a consequence of their wickedness.

1981.english: "Do not apologize now, for you have reverted to paganism after believing. We may pardon some of you, but some have deserved retribution for their crime."

1989.english: Do not apologize. You have disbelieved after having believed. If we pardon some of you, we will punish others among you, as a consequence of their transgressions.

verses.arabic: ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ بَعْضُهُم مِّنۢ بَعْضٍ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَقْبِضُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَنَسِيَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: المنافقون والمنافقات بعضهم من بعض ۚ يأمرون بالمنكر وينهون عن المعروف ويقبضون أيديهم ۚ نسوا الله فنسيهم ۗ إن المنافقين هم الفاسقون
verses.transliterated: al-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu baʿḍuhum min baʿḍin yamurūna bil-munkari wayanhawna ʿani l-maʿrūfi wayaqbiḍūna aydiyahum nasū l-laha fanasiyahum inna l-munāfiqīna humu l-fāsiqūn
verses.english: The hypocrite men and the hypocrite women belong with each other—they advocate evil and prohibit righteousness, and they are stingy. They forgot GOD, so He forgot them. The hypocrites are truly wicked.

1981.english: The hypocrite men and women are equally guilty. They advocate evil, forbid righteousness, and refrain from charity. They disregarded God, so He disregarded them. Indeed, it is the hypocrites who are wicked.
1981.subtitle: The Winners

1989.english: The hypocrite men and the hypocrite women belong with each other—they advocate evil and prohibit righteousness, and they are stingy. They forgot GOD, so He forgot them The hypocrites are truly wicked.

verses.arabic: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْكُفَّارَ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا هِىَ حَسْبُهُمْ وَلَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وعد الله المنافقين والمنافقات والكفار نار جهنم خالدين فيها ۚ هي حسبهم ۚ ولعنهم الله ۖ ولهم عذاب مقيم
verses.transliterated: waʿada l-lahu l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-kufāra nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā hiya ḥasbuhum walaʿanahumu l-lahu walahum ʿadhābun muqīmu
verses.english: GOD promises the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, as well as the disbelievers, the fire of Hell, wherein they abide forever. It suffices them. GOD has condemned them; they have incurred an everlasting retribution.

1981.english: God promises the hypocrite men and women, as well as the disbelievers, the fire of hell, wherein they abide forever. It is their only destiny, and God has cursed them; they have deserved eternal retribution.

1989.english: GOD promises the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, as well as the disbelievers, the fire of Hell. They abide therein forever. It suffices them. GOD has condemned them; they have incurred an unending retribution.

verses.arabic: كَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنكُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرَ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَٰدًا فَٱسْتَمْتَعُوا۟ بِخَلَٰقِهِمْ فَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِخَلَٰقِكُمْ كَمَا ٱسْتَمْتَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُم بِخَلَٰقِهِمْ وَخُضْتُمْ كَٱلَّذِى خَاضُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كالذين من قبلكم كانوا أشد منكم قوة وأكثر أموالا وأولادا فاستمتعوا بخلاقهم فاستمتعتم بخلاقكم كما استمتع الذين من قبلكم بخلاقهم وخضتم كالذي خاضوا ۚ أولئك حبطت أعمالهم في الدنيا والآخرة ۖ وأولئك هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: ka-alladhīna min qablikum kānū ashadda minkum quwwatan wa-akthara amwālan wa-awlādan fa-is'tamtaʿū bikhalāqihim fa-is'tamtaʿtum bikhalāqikum kamā is'tamtaʿa alladhīna min qablikum bikhalāqihim wakhuḍ'tum ka-alladhī khāḍū ulāika ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wa-ulāika humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: Some of those before you were stronger than you, and possessed more money and children. They became preoccupied with their material possessions. Similarly, you have become preoccupied with your material possessions, just like those before you have become preoccupied. You have become totally heedless, just as they were heedless. Such are the people who nullify their works, both in this world and in the Hereafter; they are the losers.
verses.subtitle: God's System Does Not Change

1981.english: Like those before them who were stronger, and possessed more money and children. They became distracted by their material share, just as you became distracted by your material share. You even utter the same utterances as they did. Such people waste their works in this life and in the hereafter, and they are the losers.

1989.english: Some of those before you were stronger than you, and possessed more money and children. They rejoiced in their material possessions. You have rejoiced in your material possessions, just like those before you have rejoiced. And you are totally preoccupied therewith, just as they were preoccupied. Such are those who nullify their works, both in this world and in the Hereafter; they are the losers.
1989.subtitle: God’s System Does Not Change

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَقَوْمِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَأَصْحَٰبِ مَدْيَنَ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتِ أَتَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يأتهم نبأ الذين من قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود وقوم إبراهيم وأصحاب مدين والمؤتفكات ۚ أتتهم رسلهم بالبينات ۖ فما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: alam yatihim naba-u alladhīna min qablihim qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda waqawmi ib'rāhīma wa-aṣḥābi madyana wal-mu'tafikāti atathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti famā kāna l-lahu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: Have they not learned anything from the previous generations; the people of Noah, 'Ãd, Thamûd, the people of Abraham, the dwellers of Midyan, and the evildoers (of Sodom and Gomorrah)? Their messengers went to them with clear proofs. GOD never wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
verses.subtitle: The Losers

1981.english: Do they not learn from the examples before them? The people of Noah, Aad, Thamud, the people of Abraham, the dwellers of Midyan, and the evildoers (of Sodom and Gomorrah), received messengers with profound signs. It was not God who wronged them; it was they who wronged themselves.

1989.english: Have they not learned anything from those before them such as the people of Noah, ‘Aad, Thamood, the people of Abraham, the dwellers of Midyan, and the evildoers (of Sodom and Gomorrah)? Their messengers went to them with clear proofs. GOD never wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
1989.subtitle: The Losers

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَيُطِيعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ سَيَرْحَمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض ۚ يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ويقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة ويطيعون الله ورسوله ۚ أولئك سيرحمهم الله ۗ إن الله عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: wal-mu'minūna wal-mu'minātu baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin yamurūna bil-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿani l-munkari wayuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wayuṭīʿūna l-laha warasūlahu ulāika sayarḥamuhumu l-lahu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: The believing men and women are allies of one another. They advocate righteousness and forbid evil, they observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they obey GOD and His messenger. These will be showered by GOD's mercy. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: The Winners

1981.english: The believing men and women are allies of one another. They advocate righteousness, forbid evil, observe the **salat** prayers, give the **zakat** charity, and obey God and His messenger. God will shower them with His mercy. God is almighty, wise.

1989.english: The believing men and women are allies of one another. They advocate righteousness and forbid evil, they observe the contact prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they obey GOD and His messenger. These will be showered by GOD’s mercy. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
1989.subtitle: The Winners

verses.arabic: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِى جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وعد الله المؤمنين والمؤمنات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ومساكن طيبة في جنات عدن ۚ ورضوان من الله أكبر ۚ ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: waʿada l-lahu l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wamasākina ṭayyibatan fī jannāti ʿadnin wariḍ'wānun mina l-lahi akbaru dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: GOD promises the believing men and the believing women gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever, and magnificent mansions in the gardens of Eden. And GOD's blessings and approval are even greater. This is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: God promises the believing men and women gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever, and enjoy beautiful homes in the gardens of Eden, and God's gratification is even greater. This is the greatest triumph.

1989.english: GOD promises the believing men and the believing women gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever, and good homes in the gardens of Eden. And GOD’s approval is even better. This is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي جاهد الكفار والمنافقين واغلظ عليهم ۚ ومأواهم جهنم ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: O you prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern in dealing with them. Their destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode!
verses.subtitle: You Shall Be Stern With the Disbelievers

1981.english: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Their final abode is hell, and a miserable destiny.

1989.english: O you prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern in dealing with them. Their destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode!
1989.subtitle: You Shall Be Stem With the Disbelievers

verses.arabic: يَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ مَا قَالُوا۟ وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا۟ كَلِمَةَ ٱلْكُفْرِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِسْلَٰمِهِمْ وَهَمُّوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يَنَالُوا۟ وَمَا نَقَمُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَنْ أَغْنَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ فَإِن يَتُوبُوا۟ يَكُ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَإِن يَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: يحلفون بالله ما قالوا ولقد قالوا كلمة الكفر وكفروا بعد إسلامهم وهموا بما لم ينالوا ۚ وما نقموا إلا أن أغناهم الله ورسوله من فضله ۚ فإن يتوبوا يك خيرا لهم ۖ وإن يتولوا يعذبهم الله عذابا أليما في الدنيا والآخرة ۚ وما لهم في الأرض من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: yaḥlifūna bil-lahi mā qālū walaqad qālū kalimata l-kuf'ri wakafarū baʿda is'lāmihim wahammū bimā lam yanālū wamā naqamū illā an aghnāhumu l-lahu warasūluhu min faḍlihi fa-in yatūbū yaku khayran lahum wa-in yatawallaw yuʿadhib'humu l-lahu ʿadhāban alīman fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wamā lahum fī l-arḍi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: They swear by GOD that they never said it, although they have uttered the word of disbelief; they have disbelieved after becoming submitters. In fact, they gave up what they never had. They have rebelled even though GOD and His messenger have showered them with His grace and provisions. If they repent, it would be best for them. But if they turn away, GOD will commit them to painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter. They will find no one on earth to be their lord and master.

1981.english: They swear by God that they never uttered the word of disbelief, when in fact they did. They reverted to disbelief after embracing Islam, and turned away when no material gains were attained. They became averse, even after God and His messenger brought to them many blessings. If they repent, it would be better for them. But if they turn away, God will punish them severely, both in this life and in the hereafter. They will find no helper on earth, nor a supporter.

1989.english: They swear by GOD that they never said it, although they have uttered the word of disbelief; they have disbelieved after being Muslims. Actually, they gave up what they never had. They have rebelled after GOD and His messenger have showered them with His grace and provisions. If they repent, it would be best for them. But if they turn away, GOD will commit them to painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter; they will find no one on earth to be their ally or supporter.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ عَٰهَدَ ٱللَّهَ لَئِنْ ءَاتَىٰنَا مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ وَلَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من عاهد الله لئن آتانا من فضله لنصدقن ولنكونن من الصالحين
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man ʿāhada l-laha la-in ātānā min faḍlihi lanaṣṣaddaqanna walanakūnanna mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: Some of them even pledged: "If GOD showered us with His grace, we would be charitable, and would lead a righteous life."

1981.english: Some of them had vowed to God that if He bestowed upon them from His bounty, they would be charitable and righteous.

1989.english: Some of them even pledged: “If GOD showered us with His grace, we would be charitable, and would lead a righteous life.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ بَخِلُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما آتاهم من فضله بخلوا به وتولوا وهم معرضون
verses.transliterated: falammā ātāhum min faḍlihi bakhilū bihi watawallaw wahum muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: But when He did shower them with His provisions, they became stingy, and turned away in aversion.

1981.english: Then, when He did bestow upon them from His bounty, they became stingy, and turned away in aversion.

1989.english: But when He did shower them with His grace, they became stingy, and turned away in aversion.

verses.arabic: فَأَعْقَبَهُمْ نِفَاقًا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يَلْقَوْنَهُۥ بِمَآ أَخْلَفُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا وَعَدُوهُ وَبِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأعقبهم نفاقا في قلوبهم إلى يوم يلقونه بما أخلفوا الله ما وعدوه وبما كانوا يكذبون
verses.transliterated: fa-aʿqabahum nifāqan fī qulūbihim ilā yawmi yalqawnahu bimā akhlafū l-laha mā waʿadūhu wabimā kānū yakdhibūn
verses.english: Consequently, He plagued them with hypocrisy in their hearts, till the day they meet Him. This is because they broke their promises to GOD, and because of their lying.

1981.english: Consequently, He committed their hearts to hypocrisy, until the day they meet Him, since they broke their vows to God, and because of their lying.

1989.english: Consequently, He plagued them with hypocrisy in their hearts, till the day they meet Him. This is because they broke their promises to GOD, and because they lied.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يعلموا أن الله يعلم سرهم ونجواهم وأن الله علام الغيوب
verses.transliterated: alam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yaʿlamu sirrahum wanajwāhum wa-anna l-laha ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb
verses.english: Do they not realize that GOD knows their secrets, and their conspiracies, and that GOD is the Knower of all secrets?

1981.english: Do they not know that God knows their secrets and their declarations, and that God is the knower of all secrets?

1989.english: Did they not know that GOD knows their secrets, as well as their declarations; that GOD is the Knower of all secrets?

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ ٱلْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِى ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ إِلَّا جُهْدَهُمْ فَيَسْخَرُونَ مِنْهُمْ سَخِرَ ٱللَّهُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات والذين لا يجدون إلا جهدهم فيسخرون منهم ۙ سخر الله منهم ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yalmizūna l-muṭawiʿīna mina l-mu'minīna fī l-ṣadaqāti wa-alladhīna lā yajidūna illā juh'dahum fayaskharūna min'hum sakhira l-lahu min'hum walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Those who criticize the generous believers for giving too much, and ridicule the poor believers for giving too little, GOD despises them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who ridicule the poor believers who give to charity, simply because they cannot afford but a bare minimum, will be ridiculed by God, and will suffer painful retribution.

1989.english: Those who criticize the generous believers for giving too much, and ridicule the poor believers for giving too little, GOD despises them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِن تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: استغفر لهم أو لا تستغفر لهم إن تستغفر لهم سبعين مرة فلن يغفر الله لهم ۚ ذلك بأنهم كفروا بالله ورسوله ۗ والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين
verses.transliterated: is'taghfir lahum aw lā tastaghfir lahum in tastaghfir lahum sabʿīna marratan falan yaghfira l-lahu lahum dhālika bi-annahum kafarū bil-lahi warasūlihi wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīn
verses.english: Whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them—even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times—GOD will not forgive them. This is because they disbelieve in GOD and His messenger. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
verses.subtitle: Satan's Most Effective Bait: The Myth of Intercession
verses.footnote: If Muhammad could not intercede on behalf of his own uncles and cousins, what makes strangers who never met him think that he will intercede on their behalf? Abraham could not intercede on behalf of his father, nor could Noah intercede on behalf of his son (11:46 & 60:4).

1981.english: You may ask forgiveness for them, or you may not ask forgiveness for them. Even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times, God will never forgive them.* That is because they have disbelieved in God and His messenger, and God does not guide the wicked people.
1981.footnote: Another proof that Muhammad does not possess the power of intercession, and that intercession is accepted only if it happens to coincide with God's decision (see 21:28, and Appendix 7).

1989.english: Whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them— even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times—GOD will not forgive their This is because they disbelieved in GOD and His messenger. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
1989.subtitle: Satan’s Most Effective Bait: The Myth of Intercession
1989.footnote: If Muhammad could not intercede on behalf of his own uncles and cousins, what makes strangers who never met him think that he will intercede on their behalf? Abraham could not intercede on behalf of his father, nor could Noah intercede on behalf of his son (11:46 & 60:4).

verses.arabic: فَرِحَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ خِلَٰفَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَرِهُوٓا۟ أَن يُجَٰهِدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَنفِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَرِّ قُلْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ أَشَدُّ حَرًّا لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فرح المخلفون بمقعدهم خلاف رسول الله وكرهوا أن يجاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم في سبيل الله وقالوا لا تنفروا في الحر ۗ قل نار جهنم أشد حرا ۚ لو كانوا يفقهون
verses.transliterated: fariḥa l-mukhalafūna bimaqʿadihim khilāfa rasūli l-lahi wakarihū an yujāhidū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi waqālū lā tanfirū fī l-ḥari qul nāru jahannama ashaddu ḥarran law kānū yafqahūn
verses.english: The sedentary rejoiced in their staying behind the messenger of GOD, and hated to strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. They said, "Let us not mobilize in this heat!" Say, "The fire of Hell is much hotter," if they could only comprehend.

1981.english: The sedentary rejoiced for staying behind the messenger of God, and hated to struggle with their money and their lives in the cause of God. They said, "Let us not mobilize in this heat." Say, "The fire of hell is a lot hotter," if they could comprehend.
1981.subtitle: The Sedentary

1989.english: The sedentary rejoiced in their staying behind the messenger of GOD; they hated to strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. They said, “Let us not mobilize in this heat!” Say, “The fire of Hell is much hotter,” if they could only comprehend.

verses.arabic: فَلْيَضْحَكُوا۟ قَلِيلًا وَلْيَبْكُوا۟ كَثِيرًا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فليضحكوا قليلا وليبكوا كثيرا جزاء بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: falyaḍḥakū qalīlan walyabkū kathīran jazāan bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: Let them laugh a little, and cry a lot. This is the requital for the sins they have earned.

1981.english: Let them laugh a little, and cry a lot, as a consequence of their work.

1989.english: Let them laugh a little and cry a lot. This is the requital for their sins.

verses.arabic: فَإِن رَّجَعَكَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَىٰ طَآئِفَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ فَٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِلْخُرُوجِ فَقُل لَّن تَخْرُجُوا۟ مَعِىَ أَبَدًا وَلَن تُقَٰتِلُوا۟ مَعِىَ عَدُوًّا إِنَّكُمْ رَضِيتُم بِٱلْقُعُودِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ فَٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْخَٰلِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن رجعك الله إلى طائفة منهم فاستأذنوك للخروج فقل لن تخرجوا معي أبدا ولن تقاتلوا معي عدوا ۖ إنكم رضيتم بالقعود أول مرة فاقعدوا مع الخالفين
verses.transliterated: fa-in rajaʿaka l-lahu ilā ṭāifatin min'hum fa-is'tadhanūka lil'khurūji faqul lan takhrujū maʿiya abadan walan tuqātilū maʿiya ʿaduwwan innakum raḍītum bil-quʿūdi awwala marratin fa-uq'ʿudū maʿa l-khālifīn
verses.english: If GOD returns you to a situation where they ask your permission to mobilize with you, you shall say, "You will never again mobilize with me, nor will you ever fight with me against any enemy. For you have chosen to be with the sedentary in the first place. Therefore, you must stay with the sedentary."

1981.english: When God returns you to a situation where some of them ask your permission to mobilize with you, then say, "You will never mobilize with me again, nor will you be allowed to fight an enemy. You have accepted to be with the sedentary the first time. Therefore, stay with the sedentary."

1989.english: If GOD returned you to a situation where they ask your permission to mobilize with you, you should say, “You will never again mobilize with me, nor will you ever fight with me against any enemy. For you have chosen to be with the sedentary in the first place. Therefore, you must stay with the sedentary.”

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُم مَّاتَ أَبَدًا وَلَا تَقُمْ عَلَىٰ قَبْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تصل على أحد منهم مات أبدا ولا تقم على قبره ۖ إنهم كفروا بالله ورسوله وماتوا وهم فاسقون
verses.transliterated: walā tuṣalli ʿalā aḥadin min'hum māta abadan walā taqum ʿalā qabrihi innahum kafarū bil-lahi warasūlihi wamātū wahum fāsiqūn
verses.english: You shall not observe the funeral prayer for any of them when he dies, nor shall you stand at his grave. They have disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and died in a state of wickedness.

1981.english: And do not observe the funeral prayer for any of them, nor shall you stand at his grave. They have disbelieved in God and His messenger, and died in a state of wickedness.

1989.english: You shall not observe the funeral prayer for any of them when he dies, nor shall you stand at his grave. They have disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and died in a state of wickedness.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُهُمْ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَتَزْهَقَ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَهُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تعجبك أموالهم وأولادهم ۚ إنما يريد الله أن يعذبهم بها في الدنيا وتزهق أنفسهم وهم كافرون
verses.transliterated: walā tuʿ'jib'ka amwāluhum wa-awlāduhum innamā yurīdu l-lahu an yuʿadhibahum bihā fī l-dun'yā watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kāfirūn
verses.english: Do not be impressed by their money or their children; GOD causes these to be sources of misery for them in this world, and their souls depart as disbelievers.
verses.subtitle: Worldly Materials Are Nil

1981.english: Do not be impressed by their money and children. God wants only to torment them therewith in this life, and their life expires as disbelievers.

1989.english: Do not be impressed by their money or children; GOD punishes them therewith in this world, then their souls depart as disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ مَعَ رَسُولِهِ ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَكَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلطَّوْلِ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ ذَرْنَا نَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا أنزلت سورة أن آمنوا بالله وجاهدوا مع رسوله استأذنك أولو الطول منهم وقالوا ذرنا نكن مع القاعدين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā unzilat sūratun an āminū bil-lahi wajāhidū maʿa rasūlihi is'tadhanaka ulū l-ṭawli min'hum waqālū dharnā nakun maʿa l-qāʿidīn
verses.english: When a sura is revealed, stating: "Believe in GOD, and strive with His messenger," even the strong among them say, "Let us stay behind!"

1981.english: When a sura comes down that you shall believe in God, and struggle with His messenger, the healthy among them ask you to exempt them, and say, "Let us stay with the sedentary."

1989.english: When a sura is revealed, stating: “Believe in GOD, and strive with His messenger,” even the strong among them say, “Let us stay behind!”

verses.arabic: رَضُوا۟ بِأَن يَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْخَوَالِفِ وَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: رضوا بأن يكونوا مع الخوالف وطبع على قلوبهم فهم لا يفقهون
verses.transliterated: raḍū bi-an yakūnū maʿa l-khawālifi waṭubiʿa ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yafqahūn
verses.english: They chose to be with the sedentary. Consequently, their hearts were sealed, and thus, they cannot comprehend.

1981.english: They accept to stay with the sedentary, and consequently, God seals their hearts, so they never comprehend.

1989.english: They chose to be with the sedentary. Consequently, their hearts were sealed. Thus, they cannot comprehend.

verses.arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ جَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتُ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لكن الرسول والذين آمنوا معه جاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم ۚ وأولئك لهم الخيرات ۖ وأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: lākini l-rasūlu wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu jāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim wa-ulāika lahumu l-khayrātu wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: As for the messenger and those who believed with him, they eagerly strive with their money and their lives. These have deserved all the good things; they are the winners.
verses.subtitle: True Believers are Eager to Strive

1981.english: As for the messenger and those who believed with him, they struggle with their money and their lives. They have deserved the best rewards, and they are the winners.

1989.english: As for the messenger and those who believed with him, they eagerly strive with their money and their lives. These have deserved all the good things; they are the winners.
1989.subtitle: True Believers are Eager to Strive

verses.arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: أعد الله لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ۚ ذلك الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: aʿadda l-lahu lahum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: GOD has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: God has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.

1989.english: GOD has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ ٱلْمُعَذِّرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ وَقَعَدَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وجاء المعذرون من الأعراب ليؤذن لهم وقعد الذين كذبوا الله ورسوله ۚ سيصيب الذين كفروا منهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wajāa l-muʿadhirūna mina l-aʿrābi liyu'dhana lahum waqaʿada alladhīna kadhabū l-laha warasūlahu sayuṣību alladhīna kafarū min'hum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: The Arabs made up excuses, and came to you seeking permission to stay behind. This is indicative of their rejection of GOD and His messenger—they stay behind. Indeed, those who disbelieve among them have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those among the bedouins who ask permission to stay behind, and those who stay behind because they disbelieve in God and His messenger, these are the real disbelievers. They have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: The Arabs made up excuses, and came to you seeking permission to stay behind. Such is the conse quence of their rejection of GOD and His messenger—they stayed behind. Indeed, those who dis believed among them have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلضُّعَفَآءِ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرْضَىٰ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ مَا يُنفِقُونَ حَرَجٌ إِذَا نَصَحُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ مَا عَلَى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ مِن سَبِيلٍ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ليس على الضعفاء ولا على المرضى ولا على الذين لا يجدون ما ينفقون حرج إذا نصحوا لله ورسوله ۚ ما على المحسنين من سبيل ۚ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: laysa ʿalā l-ḍuʿafāi walā ʿalā l-marḍā walā ʿalā alladhīna lā yajidūna mā yunfiqūna ḥarajun idhā naṣaḥū lillahi warasūlihi mā ʿalā l-muḥ'sinīna min sabīlin wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Not to be blamed are those who are weak, or ill, or do not find anything to offer, so long as they remain devoted to GOD and His messenger. The righteous among them shall not be blamed. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Not to be blamed are those who are weak, or ill, or have nothing to offer, provided they observe God and His messenger. The righteous among them have nothing to fear. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Not to be blamed are those who are weak, or ill, or do not find anything to offer, so long as they remain devoted to GOD and His messenger. The righteous among them shall not be blamed. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا مَآ أَتَوْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ قُلْتَ لَآ أَجِدُ مَآ أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ تَوَلَّوا۟ وَّأَعْيُنُهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ حَزَنًا أَلَّا يَجِدُوا۟ مَا يُنفِقُونَ
