verses.arabicClean: ولا على الذين إذا ما أتوك لتحملهم قلت لا أجد ما أحملكم عليه تولوا وأعينهم تفيض من الدمع حزنا ألا يجدوا ما ينفقون
verses.transliterated: walā ʿalā alladhīna idhā mā atawka litaḥmilahum qul'ta lā ajidu mā aḥmilukum ʿalayhi tawallaw wa-aʿyunuhum tafīḍu mina l-damʿi ḥazanan allā yajidū mā yunfiqūn
verses.english: Also excused are those who come to you wishing to be included with you, but you tell them, "I do not have anything to carry you on." They then turn back with tears in their eyes, genuinely saddened that they could not afford to contribute.

1981.english: Also excused are those who come to you offering themselves, but you tell them, "I have nothing to carry you on." They then go back with tears in their eyes, sincerely disappointed because they had nothing to offer.

1989.english: Also excused are those who come to you wishing to be included with you, but you tell them, “I do not have anything to carry you on.” They then turn back with tears in their eyes, genuinely saddened that they could not afford to contribute.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ وَهُمْ أَغْنِيَآءُ رَضُوا۟ بِأَن يَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْخَوَالِفِ وَطَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما السبيل على الذين يستأذنونك وهم أغنياء ۚ رضوا بأن يكونوا مع الخوالف وطبع الله على قلوبهم فهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yastadhinūnaka wahum aghniyāu raḍū bi-an yakūnū maʿa l-khawālifi waṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: The blame is on those who ask your permission to stay behind, even though they have no excuse. They have chosen to be with the sedentary. Consequently, GOD has sealed their hearts, and thus, they do not attain any knowledge.

1981.english: The blame is on those who wish to stay behind, even though they are rich. They accept to stay with the sedentary, and consequently, God seals their hearts, so they do not know.

1989.english: The blame is on those who ask your permission to stay behind, even though they have no excuse. They have chosen to be with the sedentary and, consequently, GOD has sealed their hearts. Thus, they do not know.

verses.arabic: يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ قُل لَّا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ قَدْ نَبَّأَنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنْ أَخْبَارِكُمْ وَسَيَرَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يعتذرون إليكم إذا رجعتم إليهم ۚ قل لا تعتذروا لن نؤمن لكم قد نبأنا الله من أخباركم ۚ وسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله ثم تردون إلى عالم الغيب والشهادة فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: yaʿtadhirūna ilaykum idhā rajaʿtum ilayhim qul lā taʿtadhirū lan nu'mina lakum qad nabba-anā l-lahu min akhbārikum wasayarā l-lahu ʿamalakum warasūluhu thumma turaddūna ilā ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: They apologize to you when you return to them (from battle). Say, "Do not apologize; we no longer trust you. GOD has informed us about you." GOD will see your works, and so will the messenger, then you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done.
verses.subtitle: Hard Times Serve to Expose the Hypocrites

1981.english: They apologize to you when you return. Say, "Do not apologize, for we no longer trust you. God has informed us about you, and God will see your works, as well as His messenger. Then you will be returned to the knower of all secrets and declarations, and He will inform you of everything you had done.

1989.english: They apologize to you after you come back (from battle). Say, “Do not apologize; we no longer believe you. GOD has exposed you for us.” GOD will see your works, and so will the messenger, then you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, and He will inform you of everything you had done.
1989.subtitle: Hard Times Serve to Expose the Hypocrites

verses.arabic: سَيَحْلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ إِذَا ٱنقَلَبْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لِتُعْرِضُوا۟ عَنْهُمْ فَأَعْرِضُوا۟ عَنْهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ رِجْسٌ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سيحلفون بالله لكم إذا انقلبتم إليهم لتعرضوا عنهم ۖ فأعرضوا عنهم ۖ إنهم رجس ۖ ومأواهم جهنم جزاء بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: sayaḥlifūna bil-lahi lakum idhā inqalabtum ilayhim lituʿ'riḍū ʿanhum fa-aʿriḍū ʿanhum innahum rij'sun wamawāhum jahannamu jazāan bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: They will swear by GOD to you, when you return to them, that you may disregard them. Do disregard them. They are polluted, and their destiny is Hell, as a requital for the sins they have earned.

1981.english: They will swear by God when you return to them, in order to disregard them. You should disregard them, for they are unholy, and their inevitable abode is hell because of their actions.

1989.english: They will swear by GOD to you, after you come back, that you may disregard them. Do disregard them. They are condemned, and their destiny is Hell as a requital for what they earned.

verses.arabic: يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ لِتَرْضَوْا۟ عَنْهُمْ فَإِن تَرْضَوْا۟ عَنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَرْضَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يحلفون لكم لترضوا عنهم ۖ فإن ترضوا عنهم فإن الله لا يرضى عن القوم الفاسقين
verses.transliterated: yaḥlifūna lakum litarḍaw ʿanhum fa-in tarḍaw ʿanhum fa-inna l-laha lā yarḍā ʿani l-qawmi l-fāsiqīn
verses.english: They swear to you, that you may pardon them. Even if you pardon them, GOD does not pardon such wicked people.

1981.english: They implore you to be gracious towards them. Even if you turn gracious towards them, God does not like the wicked people.

1989.english: They swear to you, in order to please you. Even if you are pleased with them, GOD is never pleased with the wicked people.

verses.arabic: ٱلْأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَنِفَاقًا وَأَجْدَرُ أَلَّا يَعْلَمُوا۟ حُدُودَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: الأعراب أشد كفرا ونفاقا وأجدر ألا يعلموا حدود ما أنزل الله على رسوله ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: al-aʿrābu ashaddu kuf'ran wanifāqan wa-ajdaru allā yaʿlamū ḥudūda mā anzala l-lahu ʿalā rasūlihi wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: The Arabs are the worst in disbelief and hypocrisy, and the most likely to ignore the laws that GOD has revealed to His messenger. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: The Arabs

1981.english: The nomads are deeper in disbelief and hypocrisy, and more likely to be ignorant of God's laws as revealed to His messenger. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: The Arabs are the worst in disbelief and hypocrisy, and the most likely to ignore the laws that GOD has revealed to His messenger. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
1989.subtitle: The Arabs

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنفِقُ مَغْرَمًا وَيَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمُ ٱلدَّوَآئِرَ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الأعراب من يتخذ ما ينفق مغرما ويتربص بكم الدوائر ۚ عليهم دائرة السوء ۗ والله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: wamina l-aʿrābi man yattakhidhu mā yunfiqu maghraman wayatarabbaṣu bikumu l-dawāira ʿalayhim dāiratu l-sawi wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: Some Arabs consider their spending (in the cause of GOD) to be a loss, and even wait in anticipation that a disaster may hit you. It is they who will incur the worst disaster. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

1981.english: Thus, some nomads consider charity a loss, and can hardly wait for you to incur defeat. It is they who incur the worst defeat. God is hearer, knower.

1989.english: Some Arabs consider their spending (in the cause of God) to be a loss, and even wait in anticipation that a disaster may hit you. It is they who will incur the worst disaster. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَيَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنفِقُ قُرُبَٰتٍ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَصَلَوَٰتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ أَلَآ إِنَّهَا قُرْبَةٌ لَّهُمْ سَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الأعراب من يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر ويتخذ ما ينفق قربات عند الله وصلوات الرسول ۚ ألا إنها قربة لهم ۚ سيدخلهم الله في رحمته ۗ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: wamina l-aʿrābi man yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wayattakhidhu mā yunfiqu qurubātin ʿinda l-lahi waṣalawāti l-rasūli alā innahā qur'batun lahum sayud'khiluhumu l-lahu fī raḥmatihi inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Other Arabs do believe in GOD and the Last Day, and consider their spending to be a means towards GOD, and a means of supporting the messenger. Indeed, it will bring them nearer; GOD will admit them into His mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Other nomads, however, do believe in God and the last day, and consider their charities a means of drawing nearer to God, and responding to the messenger. Indeed, it will bring them nearer to God, and God will admit them into His mercy. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Other Arabs do believe in GOD and the Last Day, and consider their spending to be a means towards GOD, and a means of supporting the messenger. Indeed, it will bring them nearer; GOD will admit them into His mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ وَٱلْأَنصَارِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُم بِإِحْسَٰنٍ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى تَحْتَهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: والسابقون الأولون من المهاجرين والأنصار والذين اتبعوهم بإحسان رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه وأعد لهم جنات تجري تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا ۚ ذلك الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: wal-sābiqūna l-awalūna mina l-muhājirīna wal-anṣāri wa-alladhīna ittabaʿūhum bi-iḥ'sānin raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu wa-aʿadda lahum jannātin tajrī taḥtahā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: As for the early vanguards who immigrated (Muhãjerin), and the supporters who gave them refuge (Ansãr) and those who followed them in righteousness, GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. He has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: Similarly, the first vanguards who emigrated, as well as those who gave them refuge, and those who followed them in righteousness. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. God has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.

1989.english: As for the early vanguards who immigrated (Muhaajerin), and the supporters who gave them refuge (Ansaar) and those who followed them in righteousness, GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. He has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. This is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: وَمِمَّنْ حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ مُنَٰفِقُونَ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ مَرَدُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنِّفَاقِ لَا تَعْلَمُهُمْ نَحْنُ نَعْلَمُهُمْ سَنُعَذِّبُهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وممن حولكم من الأعراب منافقون ۖ ومن أهل المدينة ۖ مردوا على النفاق لا تعلمهم ۖ نحن نعلمهم ۚ سنعذبهم مرتين ثم يردون إلى عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: wamimman ḥawlakum mina l-aʿrābi munāfiqūna wamin ahli l-madīnati maradū ʿalā l-nifāqi lā taʿlamuhum naḥnu naʿlamuhum sanuʿadhibuhum marratayni thumma yuraddūna ilā ʿadhābin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: Among the Arabs around you, there are hypocrites. Also, among the city dwellers, there are those who are accustomed to hypocrisy. You do not know them, but we know them. We will double the retribution for them, then they end up committed to a terrible retribution.
verses.subtitle: Retribution Doubled for the Hypocrites
verses.footnote: The hypocrites sit among the believers, listen to the message and proofs, then spread their poisonous doubts. It is a Quranic law that they receive double the retribution, now and forever.

1981.english: Among the nomads around you there are hypocrites, and among the city dwellers as well. They persist in hypocrisy, and while you may not know them, we know them. We will double the punishment for them, then they will be returned for a terrible retribution.

1989.english: Among the Arabs around you, there are hypocrites, and among the city dwellers, there are those who are accustomed to hypocrisy. You do not know them, but we know them. We will double the retribution for them, then they end up committed to a terrible retribution.

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرُونَ ٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ خَلَطُوا۟ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا وَءَاخَرَ سَيِّئًا عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وآخرون اعترفوا بذنوبهم خلطوا عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا عسى الله أن يتوب عليهم ۚ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: waākharūna iʿ'tarafū bidhunūbihim khalaṭū ʿamalan ṣāliḥan waākhara sayyi-an ʿasā l-lahu an yatūba ʿalayhim inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: There are others who have confessed their sins; they have mixed good deeds with bad deeds. GOD will redeem them, for GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: There are others who confess their sins, and mix righteous work with evil work. May God redeem them, for God is forgiver, merciful.
1981.subtitle: Repentance

1989.english: Others have confessed their sins, and have mixed good deeds with bad deeds. GOD may redeem them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ صَلَوٰتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: خذ من أموالهم صدقة تطهرهم وتزكيهم بها وصل عليهم ۖ إن صلاتك سكن لهم ۗ والله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: khudh min amwālihim ṣadaqatan tuṭahhiruhum watuzakkīhim bihā waṣalli ʿalayhim inna ṣalataka sakanun lahum wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: Take from their money a charity to purify them and sanctify them. And encourage them, for your encouragement reassures them. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

1981.english: Take from their money a portion for charity, in order to cleanse them thereby, and sanctify them; and pray for them, for your prayer pacifies them. God is hearer, knower.

1989.english: Take from their money a charity to purify them and sanctify them. And encourage them, for your encouragement pleases them. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَأْخُذُ ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يعلموا أن الله هو يقبل التوبة عن عباده ويأخذ الصدقات وأن الله هو التواب الرحيم
verses.transliterated: alam yaʿlamū anna l-laha huwa yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayakhudhu l-ṣadaqāti wa-anna l-laha huwa l-tawābu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Do they not realize that GOD accepts the repentance of His worshipers, and takes the charities, and that GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful?

1981.english: Do they not know that God accepts the repentance of His servants, and accepts the charities, and that God is the redeemer, the merciful?

1989.english: Do they not realize that GOD accepts the repentance of His worshipers, and takes the charities, and that GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful?

verses.arabic: وَقُلِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ فَسَيَرَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَسَتُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقل اعملوا فسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله والمؤمنون ۖ وستردون إلى عالم الغيب والشهادة فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: waquli iʿ'malū fasayarā l-lahu ʿamalakum warasūluhu wal-mu'minūna wasaturaddūna ilā ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: Say, "Work righteousness; GOD will see your work, and so will His messenger and the believers. Ultimately, you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done."

1981.english: Say, "You shall work, for God will see your work, as well as His messenger and the believers, then you will be returned to the knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done."

1989.english: Say, “Work righteousness; GOD will see your work, and so will His messenger and the believers. Ultimately, you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done.”

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرُونَ مُرْجَوْنَ لِأَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِمَّا يُعَذِّبُهُمْ وَإِمَّا يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وآخرون مرجون لأمر الله إما يعذبهم وإما يتوب عليهم ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: waākharūna mur'jawna li-amri l-lahi immā yuʿadhibuhum wa-immā yatūbu ʿalayhim wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: Others are waiting for GOD's decision; He may punish them, or He may redeem them. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: There are others who await God's decision; He may punish them, or He may redeem them. God is fully aware, wise.

1989.english: Others are waiting for GOD’s judgment; He may punish them, or He may redeem them. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مَسْجِدًا ضِرَارًا وَكُفْرًا وَتَفْرِيقًۢا بَيْنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَإِرْصَادًا لِّمَنْ حَارَبَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَيَحْلِفُنَّ إِنْ أَرَدْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين اتخذوا مسجدا ضرارا وكفرا وتفريقا بين المؤمنين وإرصادا لمن حارب الله ورسوله من قبل ۚ وليحلفن إن أردنا إلا الحسنى ۖ والله يشهد إنهم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū masjidan ḍirāran wakuf'ran watafrīqan bayna l-mu'minīna wa-ir'ṣādan liman ḥāraba l-laha warasūlahu min qablu walayaḥlifunna in aradnā illā l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu yashhadu innahum lakādhibūn
verses.english: There are those who abuse the masjid by practicing idol worship, dividing the believers, and providing comfort to those who oppose GOD and His messenger. They solemnly swear: "Our intentions are honorable!" GOD bears witness that they are liars.
verses.subtitle: Masjids that Oppose God and His Messenger
verses.footnote: Any masjid where the practices are not devoted absolutely to God ALONE belongs to Satan, not God. For example, mentioning the names of Abraham, Muhammad, and/or Ali in the Azan and/or the Salat prayers violates God's commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 72:18. Unfortunately, this is a common idolatrous practice throughout the corrupted Muslim world.

1981.english: And some abuse the mosque, creating dissent, disbelief, and dividing the believers, while providing aid and comfort to those who had fought God and His messenger. Yet, they swear that their intentions are good, and God bears witness that they are liars.
1981.subtitle: Mosques Abused
1981.footnote: Those who use the mosque to preach anything besides Quran, are abusing the mosque, disobeying God and His messenger, and creating divisiveness. It is the preaching of other than the Quran that caused division and sectarianism in Islam.

1989.english: There are those who abuse the mosque by practicing disbelief, dividing the believers, and providing comfort to those who oppose GOD and His messenger. They swear: “Our intentions are honorable!” GOD bears witness that they are liars.
1989.subtitle: Mosques that Oppose God and His Messenger
1989.footnote: Any mosque where the practices are not devoted absolutely to God ALONE belongs to Satan, not God. For example, mentioning Muhammad’s name in the Azan and/or the Salat prayers violates God’s commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 72:18.

verses.arabic: لَا تَقُمْ فِيهِ أَبَدًا لَّمَسْجِدٌ أُسِّسَ عَلَى ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنْ أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ أَحَقُّ أَن تَقُومَ فِيهِ فِيهِ رِجَالٌ يُحِبُّونَ أَن يَتَطَهَّرُوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُطَّهِّرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا تقم فيه أبدا ۚ لمسجد أسس على التقوى من أول يوم أحق أن تقوم فيه ۚ فيه رجال يحبون أن يتطهروا ۚ والله يحب المطهرين
verses.transliterated: lā taqum fīhi abadan lamasjidun ussisa ʿalā l-taqwā min awwali yawmin aḥaqqu an taqūma fīhi fīhi rijālun yuḥibbūna an yataṭahharū wal-lahu yuḥibbu l-muṭahirīn
verses.english: You shall never pray in such a masjid. A masjid that is established on the basis of righteousness from the first day is more worthy of your praying therein. In it, there are people who love to be purified. GOD loves those who purify themselves.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Pray in Those Masjids

1981.english: Do not worship in such a mosque. A mosque that is founded on righteousness from the first day is more worthy of your worship therein. It is a mosque where the people wish to purify themselves, and God loves those who purify themselves.

1989.english: You shall never pray in such a mosque. A mosque that is established on the basis of righteousness from the first day is more worthy of your praying therein. In it, there are people who love to be purified. GOD loves those who purify themselves.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَٰنَهُۥ عَلَىٰ تَقْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٍ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَٰنَهُۥ عَلَىٰ شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٍ فَٱنْهَارَ بِهِۦ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن أسس بنيانه على تقوى من الله ورضوان خير أم من أسس بنيانه على شفا جرف هار فانهار به في نار جهنم ۗ والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: afaman assasa bun'yānahu ʿalā taqwā mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānin khayrun am man assasa bun'yānahu ʿalā shafā jurufin hārin fa-in'hāra bihi fī nāri jahannama wal-lahu lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Is one who establishes his building on the basis of reverencing GOD and to gain His approval better, or one who establishes his building on the brink of a crumbling cliff, that falls down with him into the fire of Hell? GOD does not guide the transgressing people.

1981.english: Is one who builds upon foundations of righteousness and gratification from God better, or one who builds on the brink of a crumbling ledge that falls with him into the fire of hell? God does not guide the wicked people.

1989.english: Is one who establishes his building on the basis of righteousness from GOD and His approval better, or one who establishes his building on the brink of a crumbling cliff, that falls down with him into the fire of Hell? GOD does not guide the transgressing people.

verses.arabic: لَا يَزَالُ بُنْيَٰنُهُمُ ٱلَّذِى بَنَوْا۟ رِيبَةً فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَقَطَّعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: لا يزال بنيانهم الذي بنوا ريبة في قلوبهم إلا أن تقطع قلوبهم ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: lā yazālu bun'yānuhumu alladhī banaw rībatan fī qulūbihim illā an taqaṭṭaʿa qulūbuhum wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: Such a building that they have established remains a source of doubt in their hearts, until their hearts are stilled. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: Such building will only provide them with doubt in their hearts, unless their hearts are torn asunder. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: Such a building that they have established remains a source of doubt in their hearts, until their hearts are stilled. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَٱلْإِنجِيلِ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فَٱسْتَبْشِرُوا۟ بِبَيْعِكُمُ ٱلَّذِى بَايَعْتُم بِهِۦ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله اشترى من المؤمنين أنفسهم وأموالهم بأن لهم الجنة ۚ يقاتلون في سبيل الله فيقتلون ويقتلون ۖ وعدا عليه حقا في التوراة والإنجيل والقرآن ۚ ومن أوفى بعهده من الله ۚ فاستبشروا ببيعكم الذي بايعتم به ۚ وذلك هو الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha ish'tarā mina l-mu'minīna anfusahum wa-amwālahum bi-anna lahumu l-janata yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi fayaqtulūna wayuq'talūna waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan fī l-tawrāti wal-injīli wal-qur'āni waman awfā biʿahdihi mina l-lahi fa-is'tabshirū bibayʿikumu alladhī bāyaʿtum bihi wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: GOD has bought from the believers their lives and their money in exchange for Paradise. Thus, they fight in the cause of GOD, willing to kill and get killed. Such is His truthful pledge in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran—and who fulfills His pledge better than GOD? You shall rejoice in making such an exchange. This is the greatest triumph.
verses.subtitle: The Most Profitable Investment

1981.english: God has bought from the believers their lives and their properties, in exchange for Paradise. They readily fight in the cause of God, willing to kill or get killed. This is the truthful promise of God, as stated in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran. Who fulfills promises better than God? Therefore, rejoice in the trade you have made; this is the greatest triumph.
1981.subtitle: Most Profitable Trade

1989.english: GOD has bought from the believers their lives and their money in exchange for Paradise. Thus, they fight in the cause of GOD, willing to kill and get killed. Such is His truthful pledge in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran, and who fulfills His pledge better than GOD? You shall rejoice in making such an exchange. This is the greatest triumph.
1989.subtitle: The Most Profitable Investment

verses.arabic: ٱلتَّٰٓئِبُونَ ٱلْعَٰبِدُونَ ٱلْحَٰمِدُونَ ٱلسَّٰٓئِحُونَ ٱلرَّٰكِعُونَ ٱلسَّٰجِدُونَ ٱلْءَامِرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱلنَّاهُونَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْحَٰفِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: التائبون العابدون الحامدون السائحون الراكعون الساجدون الآمرون بالمعروف والناهون عن المنكر والحافظون لحدود الله ۗ وبشر المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: al-tāibūna l-ʿābidūna l-ḥāmidūna l-sāiḥūna l-rākiʿūna l-sājidūna l-āmirūna bil-maʿrūfi wal-nāhūna ʿani l-munkari wal-ḥāfiẓūna liḥudūdi l-lahi wabashiri l-mu'minīn
verses.english: They are the repenters, the worshipers, the praisers, the meditators, the bowing and prostrating, the advocators of righteousness and forbidders of evil, and the keepers of GOD's laws. Give good news to such believers.
verses.subtitle: The Believers

1981.english: The repenters, worshipers, praisers, devout, bowing and prostrating, advocators of righteousness and forbidders of evil, and observers of God's law; give good news to these believers.

1989.english: They are repenters, worshipers, praisers, meditators, bowing and prostrating, advocators of righteousness and forbidders of evil, and keepers of GOD’s laws. Give good news to such believers. You Shall Disown God’s Enemies
1989.subtitle: The Believers

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِىِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن يَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى قُرْبَىٰ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان للنبي والذين آمنوا أن يستغفروا للمشركين ولو كانوا أولي قربى من بعد ما تبين لهم أنهم أصحاب الجحيم
verses.transliterated: mā kāna lilnnabiyyi wa-alladhīna āmanū an yastaghfirū lil'mush'rikīna walaw kānū ulī qur'bā min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahum annahum aṣḥābu l-jaḥīm
verses.english: Neither the prophet, nor those who believe shall ask forgiveness for the idol worshipers, even if they were their nearest of kin, once they realize that they are destined for Hell.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Disown God's Enemies Abraham Disowned His Father

1981.english: It is not right for the prophet, nor the believers, to ask forgiveness for the idol worshipers, even if they were their relatives, once they find out that they have deserved hell.
1981.subtitle: God: The Only Priority

1989.english: Neither the prophet, nor the believers shall ask forgiveness for the idol worshipers, even if they were their relatives, once they realize that they are destined for Hell.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱسْتِغْفَارُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَن مَّوْعِدَةٍ وَعَدَهَآ إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥٓ أَنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّ لِّلَّهِ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَأَوَّٰهٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان استغفار إبراهيم لأبيه إلا عن موعدة وعدها إياه فلما تبين له أنه عدو لله تبرأ منه ۚ إن إبراهيم لأواه حليم
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna is'tigh'fāru ib'rāhīma li-abīhi illā ʿan mawʿidatin waʿadahā iyyāhu falammā tabayyana lahu annahu ʿaduwwun lillahi tabarra-a min'hu inna ib'rāhīma la-awwāhun ḥalīmu
verses.english: The only reason Abraham asked forgiveness for his father was that he had promised him to do so. But as soon as he realized that he was an enemy of GOD, he disowned him. Abraham was extremely kind, clement.

1981.english: Abraham did not ask forgiveness for his father, except to fulfill a promise he had made to him. But when he found out that he was an enemy of God, he disowned him. Indeed, Abraham was compassionate, clement.

1989.english: The only reason Abraham asked forgiveness for his father was that he had promised him to do so. But, as soon as he realized that he was an enemy of GOD, he disowned him. Abraham was extremely kind, clement.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْمًۢا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُبَيِّنَ لَهُم مَّا يَتَّقُونَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان الله ليضل قوما بعد إذ هداهم حتى يبين لهم ما يتقون ۚ إن الله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna l-lahu liyuḍilla qawman baʿda idh hadāhum ḥattā yubayyina lahum mā yattaqūna inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: GOD does not send any people astray, after He had guided them, without first pointing out for them what to expect. GOD is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: God never sends any people astray without first pointing out the consequences for them. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: GOD does not send any people astray, after He had guided them, without first pointing out for them what to expect. GOD is fully aware of all things.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله له ملك السماوات والأرض ۖ يحيي ويميت ۚ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yuḥ'yī wayumītu wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He controls life and death. You have none beside GOD as a Lord and Master.

1981.english: To God belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth; He grants life and death; and you have none besides God as master and supporter.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He grants life and death. You have none besides GOD as a Lord and Master.

verses.arabic: لَّقَد تَّابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ وَٱلْأَنصَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ فِى سَاعَةِ ٱلْعُسْرَةِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا كَادَ يَزِيغُ قُلُوبُ فَرِيقٍ مِّنْهُمْ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّهُۥ بِهِمْ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: لقد تاب الله على النبي والمهاجرين والأنصار الذين اتبعوه في ساعة العسرة من بعد ما كاد يزيغ قلوب فريق منهم ثم تاب عليهم ۚ إنه بهم رءوف رحيم
verses.transliterated: laqad tāba l-lahu ʿalā l-nabiyi wal-muhājirīna wal-anṣāri alladhīna ittabaʿūhu fī sāʿati l-ʿus'rati min baʿdi mā kāda yazīghu qulūbu farīqin min'hum thumma tāba ʿalayhim innahu bihim raūfun raḥīmu
verses.english: GOD has redeemed the prophet, and the immigrants (Muhãjireen) and the supporters who hosted them and gave them refuge (Ansãr), who followed him during the difficult times. That is when the hearts of some of them almost wavered. But He has redeemed them, for He is Compassionate towards them, Most Merciful.

1981.english: God has redeemed the prophet, and the emigrants, and their supporters, who stayed with him throughout the difficult times. The hearts of some of them almost waivered; but God redeemed them. He is compassionate towards them, merciful.

1989.english: GOD has redeemed the prophet, and the immigrants (Muhaajirin) and the supporters who gave them refuge (Ansaar), who followed him during the difficult times. That is when the hearts of some of them almost wavered. But He has redeemed them, for He is Compassionate towards them, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلثَّلَٰثَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَن لَّا مَلْجَأَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّآ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وعلى الثلاثة الذين خلفوا حتى إذا ضاقت عليهم الأرض بما رحبت وضاقت عليهم أنفسهم وظنوا أن لا ملجأ من الله إلا إليه ثم تاب عليهم ليتوبوا ۚ إن الله هو التواب الرحيم
verses.transliterated: waʿalā l-thalāthati alladhīna khullifū ḥattā idhā ḍāqat ʿalayhimu l-arḍu bimā raḥubat waḍāqat ʿalayhim anfusuhum waẓannū an lā malja-a mina l-lahi illā ilayhi thumma tāba ʿalayhim liyatūbū inna l-laha huwa l-tawābu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Also (redeemed were) the three who stayed behind. The spacious earth became so straitened for them, that they almost gave up all hope for themselves. Finally, they realized that there was no escape from GOD, except to Him. He then redeemed them that they may repent. GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Abandon the Messenger

1981.english: Even the three who were left behind, then the vast earth became straitened around them, their remorse intensified, and they finally realized that there was no escape from God, except to Him. God then redeemed them, that they may repent. God is the redeemer, the merciful.

1989.english: Also (redeemed were) the three who stayed behind. The spacious earth became so straitened for them, that they almost gave up all hope for themselves. Finally, they realized that there was no escape from GOD, except to Him. He then redeemed them that they might repent. GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَكُونُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله وكونوا مع الصادقين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha wakūnū maʿa l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall reverence GOD, and be among the truthful.

1981.english: O you who believe, observe God, and be sincere.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall observe GOD; you shall be among the truthful.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِأَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ أَن يَتَخَلَّفُوا۟ عَن رَّسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَرْغَبُوا۟ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ لَا يُصِيبُهُمْ ظَمَأٌ وَلَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا مَخْمَصَةٌ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَطَـُٔونَ مَوْطِئًا يَغِيظُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَلَا يَنَالُونَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ نَّيْلًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عَمَلٌ صَٰلِحٌ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان لأهل المدينة ومن حولهم من الأعراب أن يتخلفوا عن رسول الله ولا يرغبوا بأنفسهم عن نفسه ۚ ذلك بأنهم لا يصيبهم ظمأ ولا نصب ولا مخمصة في سبيل الله ولا يطئون موطئا يغيظ الكفار ولا ينالون من عدو نيلا إلا كتب لهم به عمل صالح ۚ إن الله لا يضيع أجر المحسنين
verses.transliterated: mā kāna li-ahli l-madīnati waman ḥawlahum mina l-aʿrābi an yatakhallafū ʿan rasūli l-lahi walā yarghabū bi-anfusihim ʿan nafsihi dhālika bi-annahum lā yuṣībuhum ẓama-on walā naṣabun walā makhmaṣatun fī sabīli l-lahi walā yaṭaūna mawṭi-an yaghīẓu l-kufāra walā yanālūna min ʿaduwwin naylan illā kutiba lahum bihi ʿamalun ṣāliḥun inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Neither the dwellers of the city, nor the Arabs around them, shall seek to stay behind the messenger of GOD (when he mobilizes for war). Nor shall they give priority to their own affairs over supporting him. This is because they do not suffer any thirst, or any effort, or hunger in the cause of GOD, or make a single step that enrages the disbelievers, or inflict any hardship upon the enemy, without having it written down for them as a credit. GOD never fails to recompense those who work righteousness.

1981.english: Neither the dwellers of the city, nor the nomads, should seek to stay behind the messenger of God when he mobilizes for war, nor should they place their lives ahead of his life. This is because no thirst afflicts them, or any effort, or any hardship in the cause of God, nor do they make a single step that discourages the disbelievers, nor do they strike an enemy, without having this credited to them as a righteous work. God never fails to reward the righteous.

1989.english: Neither the people of the city, nor the Arabs around them, shall seek to stay behind the messenger of GOD (when he mobilizes for war). Nor shall they give priority to their own affairs over supporting him. This is because they do not suffer any thirst, or any effort, or hunger in the cause of GOD, or make a single step that enrages the disbelievers, or inflict any hardship upon the enemy, without having it written down for them as a credit. GOD never fails to recompense those who work righteousness.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ نَفَقَةً صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً وَلَا يَقْطَعُونَ وَادِيًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمْ لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا ينفقون نفقة صغيرة ولا كبيرة ولا يقطعون واديا إلا كتب لهم ليجزيهم الله أحسن ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: walā yunfiqūna nafaqatan ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan walā yaqṭaʿūna wādiyan illā kutiba lahum liyajziyahumu l-lahu aḥsana mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Nor do they incur any expense, small or large, nor do they cross any valley, without having the credit written down for them. GOD will surely reward them generously for their works.

1981.english: Nor do they spend anything, small or large, nor travel any distance, without being credited, in order that God rewards them generously for their work.

1989.english: Nor do they incur any expense, small or large, nor do they cross any valley, without having it written down for them. GOD will surely reward them generously for their works.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُوا۟ كَآفَّةً فَلَوْلَا نَفَرَ مِن كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ طَآئِفَةٌ لِّيَتَفَقَّهُوا۟ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَلِيُنذِرُوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ إِذَا رَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَحْذَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان المؤمنون لينفروا كافة ۚ فلولا نفر من كل فرقة منهم طائفة ليتفقهوا في الدين ولينذروا قومهم إذا رجعوا إليهم لعلهم يحذرون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna l-mu'minūna liyanfirū kāffatan falawlā nafara min kulli fir'qatin min'hum ṭāifatun liyatafaqqahū fī l-dīni waliyundhirū qawmahum idhā rajaʿū ilayhim laʿallahum yaḥdharūn
verses.english: When the believers mobilize, not all of them shall do so. A few from each group shall mobilize by devoting their time to studying the religion. Thus, they can pass the knowledge on to their people when they return, that they may remain religiously informed.
verses.subtitle: The Importance of Religious Education

1981.english: It is not right that all the believers should mobilize for war; a few from each group shall stay behind in order to study the religion, then preach to their people when they come back from battle, that they may beware.
1981.subtitle: The Importance of Religious Knowledge

1989.english: When the believers mobilize, not all of them shall do so. A few from each group shall mobilize by devoting their time to studying the religion. Thus, they can pass the knowledge on to their people when they return, that they may remain informed.
1989.subtitle: The Importance of Religious Education

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ وَلْيَجِدُوا۟ فِيكُمْ غِلْظَةً وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا قاتلوا الذين يلونكم من الكفار وليجدوا فيكم غلظة ۚ واعلموا أن الله مع المتقين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qātilū alladhīna yalūnakum mina l-kufāri walyajidū fīkum ghil'ẓatan wa-iʿ'lamū anna l-laha maʿa l-mutaqīn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall fight the disbelievers who attack you—let them find you stern—and know that GOD is with the righteous.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall fight those who actively oppose you among the disbelievers, and let them find you stern, and know that God is always with the righteous.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall fight the disbelievers who attack you—let them find you stern— and know that GOD is with the righteous. The Hypocrites
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمْ زَادَتْهُ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنًا فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَزَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَٰنًا وَهُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا ما أنزلت سورة فمنهم من يقول أيكم زادته هذه إيمانا ۚ فأما الذين آمنوا فزادتهم إيمانا وهم يستبشرون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā mā unzilat sūratun famin'hum man yaqūlu ayyukum zādathu hādhihi īmānan fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū fazādathum īmānan wahum yastabshirūn
verses.english: When a sura was revealed, some of them would say, "Did this sura strengthen the faith of anyone among you?" Indeed, it did strengthen the faith of those who believed, and they rejoice in any revelation.
verses.subtitle: The Hypocrites

1981.english: Whenever a sura is revealed, some of them said "Did this augment the faith of anyone?" As for those who believed, it does augment their faith, and they rejoice.

1989.english: When a sura was revealed, some of them would say, “Did this sura strengthen the faith of any of you?” Indeed, it did strengthen the faith of those who believed, and they rejoice in such a revelation.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَتْهُمْ رِجْسًا إِلَىٰ رِجْسِهِمْ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما الذين في قلوبهم مرض فزادتهم رجسا إلى رجسهم وماتوا وهم كافرون
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun fazādathum rij'san ilā rij'sihim wamātū wahum kāfirūn
verses.english: As for those who harbored doubts in their hearts, it actually added unholiness to their unholiness, and they died as disbelievers.

1981.english: As for those with disease in their hearts, it only augments their unholiness, and they die as disbelievers.

1989.english: As for those who harbored doubts in their hearts, it actually added unholiness to their unholiness, and they died as disbelievers.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ يُفْتَنُونَ فِى كُلِّ عَامٍ مَّرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لَا يَتُوبُونَ وَلَا هُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولا يرون أنهم يفتنون في كل عام مرة أو مرتين ثم لا يتوبون ولا هم يذكرون
verses.transliterated: awalā yarawna annahum yuf'tanūna fī kulli ʿāmin marratan aw marratayni thumma lā yatūbūna walā hum yadhakkarūn
verses.english: Do they not see that they suffer from exacting trials every year once or twice? Yet, they consistently fail to repent, and fail to take heed?

1981.english: Do they not see that they are struck every year once or twice, then they fail to repent or take heed?

1989.english: Do they not realize that they suffer from exacting trials every year— once or twice—yet, they consistently fail to repent, nor do they take heed? God Provides Irrefutable Evidence

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَّظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ هَلْ يَرَىٰكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ ثُمَّ ٱنصَرَفُوا۟ صَرَفَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا ما أنزلت سورة نظر بعضهم إلى بعض هل يراكم من أحد ثم انصرفوا ۚ صرف الله قلوبهم بأنهم قوم لا يفقهون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā mā unzilat sūratun naẓara baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin hal yarākum min aḥadin thumma inṣarafū ṣarafa l-lahu qulūbahum bi-annahum qawmun lā yafqahūn
verses.english: Whenever a sura was revealed, some of them would look at each other as if to say: "Does anyone see you?" Then they left. Thus, GOD has diverted their hearts, for they are people who do not comprehend.
verses.subtitle: A Historical Crime Unveiled: Tampering With the Word of God.* God Provides Irrefutable Evidence

1981.english: When a sura is revealed, they look at each other, as if to say, "Does anyone see you?" Then they turn away, for God has turned their hearts away, since they refuse to comprehend.

1989.english: Whenever a sura was revealed, some of them would look at each other as if to say: “Does anyone see you?” Then they left. Thus, GOD has diverted their hearts, for they are people who do not comprehend.
1989.subtitle: A Historical Crime Unveiled: Tampering With the Word of God.

1981.english: A messenger has come to you from among you, who is careful not to impose any hardship on you, and cares about you, and is tolerant and merciful towards the believers.
If they turn away, then say, "God suffices me; there is no god except He; I trust in Him; and He is the Lord of the great dominion."

verses.arabic: الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الر ۚ تلك آيات الكتاب الحكيم
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīm
verses.english: A. L. R. These (letters) are the proofs of this book of wisdom.
verses.footnote: These letters constitute a major portion of the Quran's awesome mathematical code and proof of divine authorship. See Appendix 1 for details.

1981.english: A. L. R. These (letters) constitute the miracle of this book of wisdom.
1981.footnote: These letters participate in the Quran's miraculous numerical code that remained a divinely guarded secret for 14 centuries, pending the preparation of this translation (see Appendix 1). Thus, we find the total frequency of occurrence of these three letters a multiple of 19 in every single sura that is initialed with them. This sura contains 2527 of the Arabic letters A, L, and R; sura 11 contains the same total of A, L, and R; sura 12 contains 2413; sura 14 contains 1216; and the last A.L.R.-initialed sura, namely, sura 15, contains 931. Each of these totals is a multiple of 19. This miraculously flawless numerical code explains the expression, "These letters constitute the miracle of Quran." It should be noted that this particular expression appears exclusively in conjunction with Quranic initials (see also 12:1, 13:1, 15:1, 26:1, 27:1, 28:2, and 31:2).

1989.english: A.L.R.* These (letters) are the miracles of this book of wisdom.
1989.footnote: These letters constitute a major portion of the Quran’s awesome mathematical code and proof of divine authorship. See Appendix 1 for details.

verses.arabic: أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَنْ أَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أكان للناس عجبا أن أوحينا إلى رجل منهم أن أنذر الناس وبشر الذين آمنوا أن لهم قدم صدق عند ربهم ۗ قال الكافرون إن هذا لساحر مبين
verses.transliterated: akāna lilnnāsi ʿajaban an awḥaynā ilā rajulin min'hum an andhiri l-nāsa wabashiri alladhīna āmanū anna lahum qadama ṣid'qin ʿinda rabbihim qāla l-kāfirūna inna hādhā lasāḥirun mubīnu
verses.english: Is it too much of a wonder for the people that we inspired a man like them? He (was inspired to say), "You shall warn the people, and give good news to those who believe that they have attained a position of prominence at their Lord." The disbelievers said, "This is a clever magician!"

1981.english: Is it too much of a wonder for the people that we inspired a man like them, saying, "Warn the people, and give good news to the believers, that they have deserved an honorable rank at their Lord?" The disbelievers said, "This is indeed a clever magician!"

1989.english: Is it too much of a wonder for the people that we inspired a man like them? He is told: “You shall warn the people, and give good news to those who believed that they have attained a position of prominence at their Lord.” The disbelievers said, “This is a clever magician!”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مَا مِن شَفِيعٍ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِذْنِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربكم الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام ثم استوى على العرش ۖ يدبر الأمر ۖ ما من شفيع إلا من بعد إذنه ۚ ذلكم الله ربكم فاعبدوه ۚ أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: inna rabbakumu l-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yudabbiru l-amra mā min shafīʿin illā min baʿdi idh'nihi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: Your only Lord is GOD; the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then assumed all authority. He controls all matters. There is no intercessor, except in accordance with His will. Such is GOD your Lord. You shall worship Him. Would you not take heed?

1981.english: Your Lord is the one God who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then assumed all authority. He controls all things. There is no intercessor, except in accordance with His will.* Such is God your Lord; you shall worship Him. Would you not take heed?
1981.footnote: Intercession on the day of judgment will be accepted only if it happens to coincide with God's decision (see 21:28 and Appendix 7). In effect, there is no such thing as intercession (see 2:254).

1989.english: Your Lord is GOD; the One who created the heavens and the earth in she days, then assumed all authority. He controls all matters. There is no intercessor, except in accordance with His will. Such is GOD your Lord. You shall worship Him. Would you not take heed?

verses.arabic: إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا إِنَّهُۥ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إليه مرجعكم جميعا ۖ وعد الله حقا ۚ إنه يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده ليجزي الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات بالقسط ۚ والذين كفروا لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب أليم بما كانوا يكفرون
verses.transliterated: ilayhi marjiʿukum jamīʿan waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan innahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti bil-qis'ṭi wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum sharābun min ḥamīmin waʿadhābun alīmun bimā kānū yakfurūn
verses.english: To Him is your ultimate return, all of you. This is GOD's truthful promise. He initiates the creation, then repeats it, in order to reward those who believe and lead a righteous life, equitably. As for those who disbelieve, they incur hellish drinks, and a painful retribution for their disbelieving.

1981.english: To Him is your ultimate return, all of you, and this is the truthful promise of God. Just as He initiated the creation, He will repeat it, in order to reward the believers who work righteousness, equitably. As for those who disbelieve, they have deserved lava drinks, and painful retribution because they disbelieved.

1989.english: To Him is your ultimate return, all of you. This is GOD’s truthful promise. He initiates creation, then repeats it, in order to reward those who believe and lead a righteous life, equitably. As for those who disbelieve, they incur hellish drinks, and a painful retribution for their disbelieving.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ ضِيَآءً وَٱلْقَمَرَ نُورًا وَقَدَّرَهُۥ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي جعل الشمس ضياء والقمر نورا وقدره منازل لتعلموا عدد السنين والحساب ۚ ما خلق الله ذلك إلا بالحق ۚ يفصل الآيات لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī jaʿala l-shamsa ḍiyāan wal-qamara nūran waqaddarahu manāzila litaʿlamū ʿadada l-sinīna wal-ḥisāba mā khalaqa l-lahu dhālika illā bil-ḥaqi yufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: He is the One who rendered the sun radiant, and the moon a light, and He designed its phases that you may learn to count the years and to calculate. GOD did not create all this, except for a specific purpose. He explains the revelations for people who know.

1981.english: God is the one who made the sun luminescent, and the moon a light; and He designed its phases to provide you with a timing device. God did not create all this in vain. He explains the revelations for people who know.
1981.subtitle: Overwhelming Signs of God

1989.english: He is the One who rendered the sun luminescent, and the moon a light, and He designed its phases that you may learn to count the years and to calculate. GOD did not create all this, without a specific purpose. He explains the revelations for people who know.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في اختلاف الليل والنهار وما خلق الله في السماوات والأرض لآيات لقوم يتقون
verses.transliterated: inna fī ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā khalaqa l-lahu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin liqawmin yattaqūn
verses.english: Surely, in the alternation of night and day, and what GOD created in the heavens and the earth, there are proofs for people who are righteous.

1981.english: The alteration of the night and day, and the things that God created in the heavens and the earth, provide signs for the righteous.

1989.english: Surely, in the alternation of night and day, and what GOD has created in the heavens and the earth, there are proofs for people who are righteous.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا وَرَضُوا۟ بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱطْمَأَنُّوا۟ بِهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا ورضوا بالحياة الدنيا واطمأنوا بها والذين هم عن آياتنا غافلون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā waraḍū bil-ḥayati l-dun'yā wa-iṭ'ma-annū bihā wa-alladhīna hum ʿan āyātinā ghāfilūn
verses.english: Those who are not expecting to meet us, and are preoccupied with this worldly life and are content with it, and refuse to heed our proofs;
verses.subtitle: Preoccupation With This World

1981.english: Yet, there are those who are oblivious of meeting us, are satisfied and content with this life, and are heedless of our revelations.

1989.english: Those who are not expecting to meet us, who are preoccupied and content with this worldly life, and who are totally heedless of our revelations—
1989.subtitle: Preoccupation With This World

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك مأواهم النار بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: ulāika mawāhumu l-nāru bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: these have incurred Hell as their ultimate abode, as a consequence of their own works.

1981.english: These have deserved hell, as a consequence of their work.

1989.english: have incurred Hell as their ultimate abode. Such is the consequence of their own works.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِإِيمَٰنِهِمْ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات يهديهم ربهم بإيمانهم ۖ تجري من تحتهم الأنهار في جنات النعيم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti yahdīhim rabbuhum biīmānihim tajrī min taḥtihimu l-anhāru fī jannāti l-naʿīm
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, their Lord guides them, by virtue of their belief. Rivers will flow beneath them in the gardens of bliss.
verses.subtitle: God Guides the Believers

1981.english: Those who believe and work righteousness, their Lord guides them, as a reward for their faith. Rivers will flow beneath them in the gardens of bliss.
1981.subtitle: The Initial Decision is Ours

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, their Lord guides them, because of their belief. Rivers will flow beneath them in the gardens of bliss.
1989.subtitle: God Guides the Believers

verses.arabic: دَعْوَىٰهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ وَءَاخِرُ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ أَنِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: دعواهم فيها سبحانك اللهم وتحيتهم فيها سلام ۚ وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: daʿwāhum fīhā sub'ḥānaka l-lahuma wataḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun waākhiru daʿwāhum ani l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Their prayer therein is: "Be You glorified, our god," their greeting therein is, "Peace," and their ultimate prayer is: "Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe."

1981.english: Their prayer therein will be, "Glory be to You, our God," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." Their ultimate prayer will be, "Praise be to God, Lord of the universe."

1989.english: Their prayer therein is: “Be You glorified, our god,” their greeting therein is, “Peace,” and their ultimate prayer is: “Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.”

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ ٱلشَّرَّ ٱسْتِعْجَالَهُم بِٱلْخَيْرِ لَقُضِىَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو يعجل الله للناس الشر استعجالهم بالخير لقضي إليهم أجلهم ۖ فنذر الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا في طغيانهم يعمهون
verses.transliterated: walaw yuʿajjilu l-lahu lilnnāsi l-shara is'tiʿ'jālahum bil-khayri laquḍiya ilayhim ajaluhum fanadharu alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūn
verses.english: If GOD hastened the retribution incurred by the people, the way they demand provisions, they would have been annihilated long ago. However, we leave those who do not believe in meeting us in their transgressions, blundering.

1981.english: If God is to hasten the retribution to the people, the way they hasten in hoarding material things, their life would be terminated immediately. But we leave those who are oblivious of meeting us, blundering in their transgression.

1989.english: If GOD hastened the retribution incurred by the people, the way they demand bounties, they would have been annihilated long ago. However, we leave those who do not believe in meeting us in their transgressions, blundering.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ٱلضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنۢبِهِۦٓ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَآئِمًا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُۥ مَرَّ كَأَن لَّمْ يَدْعُنَآ إِلَىٰ ضُرٍّ مَّسَّهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا مس الإنسان الضر دعانا لجنبه أو قاعدا أو قائما فلما كشفنا عنه ضره مر كأن لم يدعنا إلى ضر مسه ۚ كذلك زين للمسرفين ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā massa l-insāna l-ḍuru daʿānā lijanbihi aw qāʿidan aw qāiman falammā kashafnā ʿanhu ḍurrahu marra ka-an lam yadʿunā ilā ḍurrin massahu kadhālika zuyyina lil'mus'rifīna mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: When adversity touches the human being, he implores us while lying down, or sitting, or standing up. But as soon as we relieve his adversity, he goes on as if he never implored us to relieve any hardship! The works of the transgressors are thus adorned in their eyes.

1981.english: When the human being is afflicted with hardship, he implores us while lying on his side, or sitting, or standing. But as soon as we relieve his hardship, he goes on as if he never implored us. Thus are the works of the transgressors adorned in their eyes.

1989.english: When adversity touches the human being, he implores us while lying down, or sitting, or standing up. But as soon as we relieve his adversity, he goes on as if he never implored us to relieve it! The works of the transgressors are thus adorned in their eyes.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْقُرُونَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أهلكنا القرون من قبلكم لما ظلموا ۙ وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات وما كانوا ليؤمنوا ۚ كذلك نجزي القوم المجرمين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ahlaknā l-qurūna min qablikum lammā ẓalamū wajāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wamā kānū liyu'minū kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: Many a generation we have annihilated before you when they transgressed. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they refused to believe. We thus requite the guilty people.
verses.subtitle: Lessons from the Past

1981.english: We destroyed generations before them, when they turned wicked. Their messengers went to them with manifest signs, but they refused to believe. We thus punish the guilty people.

1989.english: Many a generation we have annihilated before them when they transgressed. Their messengers had gone to them with clear proofs, but they refused to believe. We thus requite the guilty people.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لِنَنظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم جعلناكم خلائف في الأرض من بعدهم لننظر كيف تعملون
verses.transliterated: thumma jaʿalnākum khalāifa fī l-arḍi min baʿdihim linanẓura kayfa taʿmalūn
verses.english: Then we made you inheritors of the earth after them, to see how you will do.
verses.subtitle: Now It Is Your Turn

1981.english: Then we made you inherit the earth after them, to see what you do.

1989.english: Then we made you inheritors of the earth after them, to see how you will do.
1989.subtitle: Now It Is Your Turn

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا ٱئْتِ بِقُرْءَانٍ غَيْرِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُۥ مِن تِلْقَآئِ نَفْسِىٓ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات ۙ قال الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا ائت بقرآن غير هذا أو بدله ۚ قل ما يكون لي أن أبدله من تلقاء نفسي ۖ إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي ۖ إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā i'ti biqur'ānin ghayri hādhā aw baddil'hu qul mā yakūnu lī an ubaddilahu min til'qāi nafsī in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: When our revelations are recited to them, those who do not expect to meet us say, "Bring a Quran other than this, or change it!" Say, "I cannot possibly change it on my own. I simply follow what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of an awesome day."
verses.subtitle: Every Letter Calculated and Divinely Designed
verses.footnote: The word "Quran" is mentioned in the Quran 58 times, but since this verse refers to "another Quran," it must be excluded; "This Quran" is mentioned in the Quran 57 times, 19x3.

1981.english: When our revelations are recited to them, those unmindful of meeting us say, "Produce a Quran other than this, or change it." Say, "I cannot change it on my own. I simply follow what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of a terrible day."
1981.subtitle: Quran: Muhammad's Sole Mission

1989.english: When our revelations are recited to them, those who do not expect to meet us say, “Bring a Quran* other than this, or change it!” Say, “I cannot possibly change it on my own. I simply follow what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of an awesome day.”
1989.footnote: The word “Quran” is mentioned in the Quran 58 times, but since this verse refers to “another Quran, ” it is excluded. “This Quran” is mentioned 57 times, 19x3.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَآ أَدْرَىٰكُم بِهِۦ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦٓ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لو شاء الله ما تلوته عليكم ولا أدراكم به ۖ فقد لبثت فيكم عمرا من قبله ۚ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: qul law shāa l-lahu mā talawtuhu ʿalaykum walā adrākum bihi faqad labith'tu fīkum ʿumuran min qablihi afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: Say, "Had GOD willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would you have known anything about it. I have lived among you a whole life before this (and you have known me as a sane, truthful person). Do you not understand?"

1981.english: Say, "It is completely up to God; had He willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would you ever know about it. I have lived among you for a long time before this. Do you not understand?"

1989.english: Say, “Had GOD willed, I would have never recited it to you, nor would you have known anything about it. I have lived among you a whole life before this. Do you not understand?”

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته ۚ إنه لا يفلح المجرمون
verses.transliterated: faman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba biāyātihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-muj'rimūn
verses.english: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies about GOD, or rejects His revelations. Certainly, the transgressors never succeed.

1981.english: Who is more evil than one who invents lies, then attributes them to God, or rejects His revelations? Indeed, the wicked never succeed.

1989.english: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies about GOD, or rejects His revelations. Certainly, such criminals never succeed.

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُفَعَٰٓؤُنَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّـُٔونَ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا يضرهم ولا ينفعهم ويقولون هؤلاء شفعاؤنا عند الله ۚ قل أتنبئون الله بما لا يعلم في السماوات ولا في الأرض ۚ سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yaḍurruhum walā yanfaʿuhum wayaqūlūna hāulāi shufaʿāunā ʿinda l-lahi qul atunabbiūna l-laha bimā lā yaʿlamu fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: They worship beside GOD idols that possess no power to harm them or benefit them, and they say, "These are our intercessors at GOD!" Say, "Are you informing GOD of something He does not know in the heavens or the earth?" Be He glorified. He is the Most High; far above needing partners.

1981.english: They idolize besides God idols that are too powerless to harm them, or benefit them, then say, "These are our intercessors at God." Say, "Are you informing God of something He does not know in the heavens or the earth?" Most glorified He is, and exalted, over and above any idols.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Idolize Anyone

1989.english: They worship besides GOD idols that possess no power to harm them or benefit them, and they say, “These are our intercessors at GOD!” Say, “Are you informing GOD of something He does not know in the heavens or the earth?” Be He glorified. He is the Most High; far above needing partners.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ إِلَّآ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً فَٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيمَا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان الناس إلا أمة واحدة فاختلفوا ۚ ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم فيما فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna l-nāsu illā ummatan wāḥidatan fa-ikh'talafū walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum fīmā fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: The people used to be one congregation, then they disputed. If it were not for a predetermined word from your Lord, they would have been judged immediately regarding their disputes.

1981.english: The people used to be one congregation, but they differed. If it were not for a predetermined decision by your Lord, they would have been judged concerning their disputes.

1989.english: The people used to be one congregation, until they disputed. If it were not for a predetermined word from your Lord, they would have been judged regarding their disputes.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْغَيْبُ لِلَّهِ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويقولون لولا أنزل عليه آية من ربه ۖ فقل إنما الغيب لله فانتظروا إني معكم من المنتظرين
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlūna lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi faqul innamā l-ghaybu lillahi fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīn
verses.english: They say, "How come no miracle came down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The future belongs to GOD; so wait, and I am waiting along with you."
verses.subtitle: Miracle of the Quran to be Unveiled After Muhammad
verses.footnote: In retrospect, we see now that the Quran's miracle, indeed "One of the greatest miracles" (74:30-35), was divinely predestined to be unveiled 14 centuries after Muhammad. In view of the current condition of the traditional Muslims, if Muhammad had been given this miracle, those Muslims, who are already idolizing Muhammad beside God, would have worshiped him as God incarnate. Additionally, this miracle is obviously designed for the computer age, and to be appreciated by mathematically sophisticated generations.

1981.english: They say, "How come no miracle came down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Only God knows the future. Therefore, just wait, and I will wait along with you."
1981.subtitle: Muhammad's Miracle Revealed Centuries Later
1981.footnote: The Quran is Muhammad's only miracle (see 29:50-51), and the miracle of the Quran was not revealed until this translation was done (see Appendices 1 & 2, and 13:43).

1989.english: They say, “How come no miracle came down to him from his Lord?” Say, “The future belongs to GOD; so wait, and I am waiting with you.”
1989.subtitle: Miracle of the Quran to be Unveiled After Muhammad
1989.footnote: In retrospect, we see now that the Quran’s miracle, indeed “One of the greatest miracles” (74:30-35), was divinely predestined to be unveiled 14 centuries after Muhammad. In view of the current condition of the traditional Muslims, if Muhammad had been given this miracle, these Muslims would have worshiped him as God incarnate. Additionally, this miracle is obviously designed for the computer age, and to be appreciated by mathematically sophisticated generations.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ إِذَا لَهُم مَّكْرٌ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَسْرَعُ مَكْرًا إِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكْتُبُونَ مَا تَمْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا أذقنا الناس رحمة من بعد ضراء مستهم إذا لهم مكر في آياتنا ۚ قل الله أسرع مكرا ۚ إن رسلنا يكتبون ما تمكرون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathum idhā lahum makrun fī āyātinā quli l-lahu asraʿu makran inna rusulanā yaktubūna mā tamkurūn
verses.english: When we bestow mercy upon the people, after adversity had afflicted them, they immediately scheme against our revelations! Say, "GOD's scheming is far more effective. For our messengers are recording everything you scheme."
verses.subtitle: Rebellious Humans

1981.english: When we bestow mercy on the people, following adversity, they plot and scheme against our revelations. Say, "God's scheming is most efficient, and our messengers write down everything you scheme."
1981.subtitle: Do Not Waiver With Circumstances

1989.english: When we bestow mercy upon the people, after adversity had afflicted them, they immediately scheme against our revelations! Say, “GOD’s scheming is far more effective. For our messengers are recording everything you scheme.”

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا كُنتُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَجَرَيْنَ بِهِم بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ وَفَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا جَآءَتْهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْجُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أُحِيطَ بِهِمْ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ لَئِنْ أَنجَيْتَنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي يسيركم في البر والبحر ۖ حتى إذا كنتم في الفلك وجرين بهم بريح طيبة وفرحوا بها جاءتها ريح عاصف وجاءهم الموج من كل مكان وظنوا أنهم أحيط بهم ۙ دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين لئن أنجيتنا من هذه لنكونن من الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī yusayyirukum fī l-bari wal-baḥri ḥattā idhā kuntum fī l-ful'ki wajarayna bihim birīḥin ṭayyibatin wafariḥū bihā jāathā rīḥun ʿāṣifun wajāahumu l-mawju min kulli makānin waẓannū annahum uḥīṭa bihim daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna la-in anjaytanā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina l-shākirīn
verses.english: He is the One who moves you across the land and sea. You get onto the ships, and they sail smoothly in nice breeze. Then, while rejoicing therein, violent wind blows, and the waves surround them from every side. This is when they implore GOD, sincerely devoting their prayers to Him alone: "If You only save us this time, we will be eternally appreciative."

1981.english: God is the one who moves you on land and sea. Thus, when they ride the sea, and the ships are driven with good wind, they rejoice. But when violent wind blows, and the waves surround them, and they think they lost all hope, they remember God and sincerely implore Him alone, "If You save us from this one, we will be appreciative."

1989.english: He is the One who moves you across the land and sea. You get onto the ships, and they sail smoothly in nice breeze. Then, while rejoicing therein, violent wind blows, and the waves surround them from every side. This is when they implore GOD, sincerely devoting their prayers to Him alone: “If You only save us this time, we will be appreciative.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَنجَىٰهُمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغْيُكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُم مَّتَٰعَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما أنجاهم إذا هم يبغون في الأرض بغير الحق ۗ يا أيها الناس إنما بغيكم على أنفسكم ۖ متاع الحياة الدنيا ۖ ثم إلينا مرجعكم فننبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: falammā anjāhum idhā hum yabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā baghyukum ʿalā anfusikum matāʿa l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿukum fanunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: But as soon as He saves them, they transgress on earth, and oppose the truth. O people, your transgression is only to the detriment of your own souls. You remain preoccupied with this worldly life, then to us is your ultimate return, then we inform you of everything you had done.

1981.english: However, as soon as He saves them, they transgress throughout the land. O people, your transgression is only against yourselves. You temporarily live in this world, then you return to us, then we inform you of everything you did.

1989.english: Yet, when He saves them, they transgress on earth, and oppose the truth. O people, your transgression is only against your own souls. You remain preoccupied with this worldly life, then to us is your ultimate return, then we inform you of everything you had done.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا وَٱزَّيَّنَتْ وَظَنَّ أَهْلُهَآ أَنَّهُمْ قَٰدِرُونَ عَلَيْهَآ أَتَىٰهَآ أَمْرُنَا لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَجَعَلْنَٰهَا حَصِيدًا كَأَن لَّمْ تَغْنَ بِٱلْأَمْسِ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما مثل الحياة الدنيا كماء أنزلناه من السماء فاختلط به نبات الأرض مما يأكل الناس والأنعام حتى إذا أخذت الأرض زخرفها وازينت وظن أهلها أنهم قادرون عليها أتاها أمرنا ليلا أو نهارا فجعلناها حصيدا كأن لم تغن بالأمس ۚ كذلك نفصل الآيات لقوم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: innamā mathalu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā kamāin anzalnāhu mina l-samāi fa-ikh'talaṭa bihi nabātu l-arḍi mimmā yakulu l-nāsu wal-anʿāmu ḥattā idhā akhadhati l-arḍu zukh'rufahā wa-izzayyanat waẓanna ahluhā annahum qādirūna ʿalayhā atāhā amrunā laylan aw nahāran fajaʿalnāhā ḥaṣīdan ka-an lam taghna bil-amsi kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verses.english: The analogy of this worldly life is like this: we send down water from the sky to produce with it all kinds of plants from the earth, and to provide food for the people and the animals. Then, just as the earth is perfectly adorned, and its people think that they are in control thereof, our judgment comes by night or by day, leaving it completely barren, as if nothing existed the previous day. We thus explain the revelations for people who reflect.
verses.footnote: God, of course, knows whether His judgment will come during the day, or during the night. But it just happens that the earth will be half day and half night when the end of the world comes. Another "scientific miracle" of the Quran.

1981.english: The allegory of this life is that of water that we send down from the sky, produce earthly plants for the people and the animals, then, just as the earth is beautified and perfected, and its people think that they are in full control thereof, our judgment comes to them by night, or by day. Thus, it becomes barren land, as if nothing existed the previous day. We thus clarify the revelations for those who reflect.

1989.english: The analogy of this worldly life is like this: we send down water from the sky, to produce with it all kinds of plants from the earth, and to provide food for the people and the animals. Then, just as the earth is perfectly adorned, and its people think that they are in control thereof, our judgment comes by night or by day,* rendering it completely barren, as if nothing existed the previous day. We thus explain the revelations for people who reflect.
1989.footnote: God, of course, knows whether His judgment will come during the day, or during the night. But it just happens that the earth will be half day and half night when the end of the world comes. Another “scientific miracle” of the Quran.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: والله يدعو إلى دار السلام ويهدي من يشاء إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu yadʿū ilā dāri l-salāmi wayahdī man yashāu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: GOD invites to the abode of peace, and guides whomever He wills in a straight path.

1981.english: God invites to the abode of peace, and guides whomever He wills in a straight path.

1989.english: GOD invites to the abode of peace, and guides whomever He wills in a straight path.

verses.arabic: لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَزِيَادَةٌ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: للذين أحسنوا الحسنى وزيادة ۖ ولا يرهق وجوههم قتر ولا ذلة ۚ أولئك أصحاب الجنة ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: lilladhīna aḥsanū l-ḥus'nā waziyādatun walā yarhaqu wujūhahum qatarun walā dhillatun ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: For the righteous, the reward will be multiplied manifold. Their faces will never experience any deprivation or shame. These are the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.
verses.subtitle: Heaven and Hell are Eternal

1981.english: For those who do good, even better rewards. No misery, nor humiliation, will ever cover their faces. They have deserved Paradise; they abide therein forever.

1989.english: As for the righteous, they have deserved a far better reward, multiplied manifold. Never will they suffer any deprivation or shame. They will be the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.
1989.subtitle: Heaven and Hell are Eternal
