verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَسَبُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ جَزَآءُ سَيِّئَةٍۭ بِمِثْلِهَا وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ مَّا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ كَأَنَّمَآ أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كسبوا السيئات جزاء سيئة بمثلها وترهقهم ذلة ۖ ما لهم من الله من عاصم ۖ كأنما أغشيت وجوههم قطعا من الليل مظلما ۚ أولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kasabū l-sayiāti jazāu sayyi-atin bimith'lihā watarhaquhum dhillatun mā lahum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin ka-annamā ugh'shiyat wujūhuhum qiṭaʿan mina al-layli muẓ'liman ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: As for those who earned sins, their requital is equivalent to their sin. Humiliation is their lot, and no one beside GOD can protect them. Their faces will seem overwhelmed by masses of dark night. They will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide therein forever.

1981.english: As for those who commit sins, they get punished once for each sin, and humiliation covers them. They have no protector from God. It will be as if their faces were covered with dark pieces of night. They have deserved hell; they abide therein forever.

1989.english: As for those who earned sins, their requital is equivalent to their sin. Humiliation is their lot, and nothing, other than GOD, can protect them. Their faces will seem like masses of dark night have surrounded them. They will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ مَكَانَكُمْ أَنتُمْ وَشُرَكَآؤُكُمْ فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَقَالَ شُرَكَآؤُهُم مَّا كُنتُمْ إِيَّانَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم نحشرهم جميعا ثم نقول للذين أشركوا مكانكم أنتم وشركاؤكم ۚ فزيلنا بينهم ۖ وقال شركاؤهم ما كنتم إيانا تعبدون
verses.transliterated: wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū makānakum antum washurakāukum fazayyalnā baynahum waqāla shurakāuhum mā kuntum iyyānā taʿbudūn
verses.english: On the day when we summon them all, we will say to those who worshiped idols, "We have summoned you, together with your idols." We will have them confront each other, and their idols will say to them, "We had no idea that you idolized us.
verses.subtitle: Idols Disown Their Worshipers

1981.english: The day will come when we gather them all, then say to the idol worshipers, "Here you are together with your idols." Then we will have them face each other, and the idols will say, "It was not us that you worshiped."
1981.subtitle: Idols Disown Their Idolizers

1989.english: On the day when we summon them all, we will say to those who worshiped idols, “We have summoned you, together with your idols.” We will have them confront each other, and their idols will say to them, “It is not us that you worshiped.
1989.subtitle: Idols Disown Their Worshipers

verses.arabic: فَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِن كُنَّا عَنْ عِبَادَتِكُمْ لَغَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فكفى بالله شهيدا بيننا وبينكم إن كنا عن عبادتكم لغافلين
verses.transliterated: fakafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynanā wabaynakum in kunnā ʿan ʿibādatikum laghāfilīn
verses.english: GOD suffices as a witness between us and you, that we were completely unaware of your worshiping us.

1981.english: "God suffices as witness between us and you. We were totally unaware of your idolizing us."

1989.english: “GOD suffices as a witness between us and you; we were completely oblivious of your worshiping us.”

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُوا۟ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّآ أَسْلَفَتْ وَرُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هنالك تبلو كل نفس ما أسلفت ۚ وردوا إلى الله مولاهم الحق ۖ وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: hunālika tablū kullu nafsin mā aslafat waruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: That is when each soul will examine everything it had done. They will be returned to GOD, their rightful Lord and Master, and the idols they had fabricated will disown them.

1981.english: That is when every soul will examine everything it did. They are returned to God, their rightful master, and all the idols they invented have disowned them.

1989.english: That is when each soul will examine everything it had done. They will be returned to GOD, their rightful Lord and Master, while the idols they had fabricated will disown them.

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَمَّن يَمْلِكُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَمَن يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَمَن يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ فَسَيَقُولُونَ ٱللَّهُ فَقُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل من يرزقكم من السماء والأرض أمن يملك السمع والأبصار ومن يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ومن يدبر الأمر ۚ فسيقولون الله ۚ فقل أفلا تتقون
verses.transliterated: qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi amman yamliku l-samʿa wal-abṣāra waman yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi waman yudabbiru l-amra fasayaqūlūna l-lahu faqul afalā tattaqūn
verses.english: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Who controls all the hearing and the eyesight? Who produces the living from the dead, and the dead from the living? Who is in control of all things?" They would say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you not observe the commandments?"

1981.english: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Who controls the senses of hearing and sight? Who produces the living from the dead, and the dead from the living? Who is in control?" They would say, "God." Say, "Would you then work righteousness?"

1989.english: Say, “Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Who controls all the hearing and the eyesight? Who produces the living from the dead, and the dead from the living? Who is in control of all things?” They would say, “GOD.” Say, “Why then do you not observe righteousness?”

verses.arabic: فَذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ إِلَّا ٱلضَّلَٰلُ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فذلكم الله ربكم الحق ۖ فماذا بعد الحق إلا الضلال ۖ فأنى تصرفون
verses.transliterated: fadhālikumu l-lahu rabbukumu l-ḥaqu famādhā baʿda l-ḥaqi illā l-ḍalālu fa-annā tuṣ'rafūn
verses.english: Such is GOD, your rightful Lord. What is there after the truth, except falsehood? How could you disregard all this?

1981.english: Such is God, your rightful Lord. After the truth, what else but falsehood? How could you deviate?

1989.english: Such is GOD, your rightful Lord. What is there after the truth, except falsehood? How could you disregard all this?

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك حقت كلمت ربك على الذين فسقوا أنهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: kadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna fasaqū annahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: This is what your Lord's decision does to those who choose to be wicked: they cannot believe.

1981.english: It is predetermined by your Lord's decision that the wicked will not believe.

1989.english: Thus does the decree of your Lord determine the fate of those who decided to be wicked; they cannot believe.

verses.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هل من شركائكم من يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده ۚ قل الله يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده ۖ فأنى تؤفكون
verses.transliterated: qul hal min shurakāikum man yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu quli l-lahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu fa-annā tu'fakūn
verses.english: Say, "Can any of your idols initiate creation, then repeat it?" Say, "GOD initiates the creation, then repeats it."
verses.subtitle: Reflect on Your Idols

1981.english: Say, "Can any of your idols initiate creation, then repeat it?" Say, "God initiates creation, then repeats it." How could you deviate?

1989.english: Say, “Can any of your idols initiate creation, then repeat it?” Say, “GOD initiates the creation, then repeats it.”
1989.subtitle: Reflect on Your Idols

verses.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى لِلْحَقِّ أَفَمَن يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَن يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّن لَّا يَهِدِّىٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُهْدَىٰ فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هل من شركائكم من يهدي إلى الحق ۚ قل الله يهدي للحق ۗ أفمن يهدي إلى الحق أحق أن يتبع أمن لا يهدي إلا أن يهدى ۖ فما لكم كيف تحكمون
verses.transliterated: qul hal min shurakāikum man yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi quli l-lahu yahdī lil'ḥaqqi afaman yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi aḥaqqu an yuttabaʿa amman lā yahiddī illā an yuh'dā famā lakum kayfa taḥkumūn
verses.english: Say, "Does any of your idols guide to the truth?" Say, "GOD guides to the truth. Is one who guides to the truth more worthy of being followed, or one who does not guide, and needs guidance for himself? What is wrong with your judgment?"

1981.english: Say, "Can any of your idols guide to the truth?" Say, "God guides to the truth." Is one who guides to the truth worthy of being followed or one who needs the guidance himself? What is wrong with you? How do you make your decisions?

1989.english: Say, “Does any of your idols guide to the truth?” Say, “GOD guides to the truth. Is one who guides to the truth more worthy of being followed, or one who does not guide, and needs guidance for himself? What is wrong with your judgment?”

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا إِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما يتبع أكثرهم إلا ظنا ۚ إن الظن لا يغني من الحق شيئا ۚ إن الله عليم بما يفعلون
verses.transliterated: wamā yattabiʿu aktharuhum illā ẓannan inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūn
verses.english: Most of them follow nothing but conjecture, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

1981.english: The majority follows only conjecture, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth. God is fully aware of everything they do.
1981.subtitle: "Hadith" is Conjecture, While Quran is Flawless
1981.footnote: Even the most enthusiastic advocates of "**Hadith**" and/or "**Sunna**" admit that they follow only conjecture; that they are never sure whether the source of "**Hadith**" or a "**Sunna**" is actually the prophet or some inventor. On the other hand, the reader of Quran is handed physical, indisputable proof that it is God's message to the world (see Appendix 1).

1989.english: Most of them follow nothing but conjecture. Surely, conjecture is no substitute for the truth. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان هذا القرآن أن يفترى من دون الله ولكن تصديق الذي بين يديه وتفصيل الكتاب لا ريب فيه من رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna hādhā l-qur'ānu an yuf'tarā min dūni l-lahi walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: This Quran could not possibly be authored by other than GOD. It confirms all previous messages, and provides a fully detailed scripture. It is infallible; for it comes from the Lord of the universe.
verses.subtitle: Only God Can Author the Quran

1981.english: But the Quran can never be invented by other than God. It confirms all previous scripture, and consummates them. There is absolutely no doubt that it comes from the Lord of the universe.
1981.footnote: Even the most enthusiastic advocates of "**Hadith**" and/or "**Sunna**" admit that they follow only conjecture; that they are never sure whether the source of "**Hadith**" or a "**Sunna**" is actually the prophet or some inventor. On the other hand, the reader of Quran is handed physical, indisputable proof that it is God's message to the world (see Appendix 1).

1989.english: This Quran could not possibly be written by other than GOD. It confirms all previous messages, and provides a fully detailed scripture. It is infallible; for it comes from the Lord of the universe.
1989.subtitle: Only God Can Author the Quran

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون افتراه ۖ قل فأتوا بسورة مثله وادعوا من استطعتم من دون الله إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū bisūratin mith'lihi wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: If they say, "He fabricated it," say, "Then produce one sura like these, and invite whomever you wish, other than GOD, if you are truthful."

1981.english: If they ever say, "He made it up," then say, "Produce a sura like these, and invite whomever you like, other than God, if you are truthful."

1989.english: If they say, “He fabricated it,” say, “Then produce one sura like these, and invite whomever you wish, other than GOD, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوا۟ بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بل كذبوا بما لم يحيطوا بعلمه ولما يأتهم تأويله ۚ كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم ۖ فانظر كيف كان عاقبة الظالمين
verses.transliterated: bal kadhabū bimā lam yuḥīṭū biʿil'mihi walammā yatihim tawīluhu kadhālika kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Indeed, they have rejected this without studying and examining it, and before understanding it. Thus did those before them disbelieve. Therefore, note the consequences for the transgressors.

1981.english: Indeed, they have rejected the Quran without even studying it, and without knowing its secrets. Thus did those before them disbelieve, and note the consequences for the wicked.

1989.english: Indeed, they have rejected what they have no knowledge about, and before the full understanding thereof is attained by them. Thus did those before them disbelieve. Therefore, note the consequences for the transgressors.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من يؤمن به ومنهم من لا يؤمن به ۚ وربك أعلم بالمفسدين
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yu'minu bihi wamin'hum man lā yu'minu bihi warabbuka aʿlamu bil-muf'sidīn
verses.english: Some of them believe (in this scripture), while others disbelieve in it. Your Lord is fully aware of the evildoers.

1981.english: Some of them believe therein, and some disbelieve. Your Lord knows best which are the wicked.

1989.english: Some of them believe (in this scripture), while others disbelieve in it. Your Lord is fully aware of the evildoers.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّى عَمَلِى وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كذبوك فقل لي عملي ولكم عملكم ۖ أنتم بريئون مما أعمل وأنا بريء مما تعملون
verses.transliterated: wa-in kadhabūka faqul lī ʿamalī walakum ʿamalukum antum barīūna mimmā aʿmalu wa-anā barīon mimmā taʿmalūn
verses.english: If they reject you, then say, "I have my works, and you have your works. You are innocent of anything I do, and I am innocent of anything you do."

1981.english: If they disbelieve you, then say, "I have my work, and you have your work. You are not answerable for my work, and I am not answerable for your work."

1989.english: If they reject you, then say, “I have my works, and you have your works. You are innocent of my works, and I am innocent of your works.”

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من يستمعون إليك ۚ أفأنت تسمع الصم ولو كانوا لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yastamiʿūna ilayka afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma walaw kānū lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: Some of them listen to you, but can you make the deaf hear, even though they cannot understand?

1981.english: Some of them may listen to you; but can you make the deaf hear, even if they do not understand?

1989.english: Some of them listen to you, but can you make the deaf hear, even if they do not understand?

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من ينظر إليك ۚ أفأنت تهدي العمي ولو كانوا لا يبصرون
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yanẓuru ilayka afa-anta tahdī l-ʿum'ya walaw kānū lā yub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Some of them look at you, but can you guide the blind, even though they do not see?
verses.subtitle: Humans Freely Choose Their Paths

1981.english: Some of them look at you; but can you guide the blind, even if they do not see?

1989.english: Some of them look at you, but can you guide the blind, even though they do not see?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله لا يظلم الناس شيئا ولكن الناس أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha lā yaẓlimu l-nāsa shayan walākinna l-nāsa anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: GOD never wrongs the people; it is the people who wrong their own souls.

1981.english: God is never unjust towards the people; it is the people who are unjust to themselves.

1989.english: GOD never wrongs the people; it is the people who wrong their own souls.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَن لَّمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يحشرهم كأن لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من النهار يتعارفون بينهم ۚ قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله وما كانوا مهتدين
verses.transliterated: wayawma yaḥshuruhum ka-an lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan mina l-nahāri yataʿārafūna baynahum qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi wamā kānū muh'tadīn
verses.english: On the day when He summons all of them, they will feel as if they lasted in this world one hour of the day, during which they met. Losers indeed are those who disbelieved in meeting GOD; and chose to be misguided.

1981.english: When the day comes, and God gathers them all, they will feel as if they lived only one hour, during which they met. Losers indeed are those who disbelieve in meeting God; they are not guided.

1989.english: On the day when He summons all of them, they will feel as if they lasted in this world one hour of the day, during which they met. Losers indeed are those who disbelieved in meeting GOD; they are not guided.

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم أو نتوفينك فإلينا مرجعهم ثم الله شهيد على ما يفعلون
verses.transliterated: wa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma l-lahu shahīdun ʿalā mā yafʿalūn
verses.english: Whether we show you some (of the retribution) we promise them, or terminate your life before that, to us is their ultimate return. GOD witnesses everything they do.

1981.english: Whether we show you the doom we promise them, or terminate your life, their ultimate return is to us. God witnesses everything they do.

1989.english: Whether we show you some (of the retribution) we promise them, or terminate your life before that, to us is their ultimate return. GOD is witnessing everything they do.

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكل أمة رسول ۖ فإذا جاء رسولهم قضي بينهم بالقسط وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: walikulli ummatin rasūlun fa-idhā jāa rasūluhum quḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: To each community, a messenger. After their messenger comes, they are judged equitably, without the least injustice.

1981.english: To every community (we send) a messenger. After their messenger comes to them, they are judged equitably; no one suffers injustice.

1989.english: To each community, a messenger (is sent); once their messenger comes, they are judged equitably, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They challenge: "When will this prophecy come to pass, if you are telling the truth?"

1981.english: They say, "Where is the doom you are threatening, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: They challenge: “When will this (doom) come to pass, if you are telling the truth?”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا أملك لنفسي ضرا ولا نفعا إلا ما شاء الله ۗ لكل أمة أجل ۚ إذا جاء أجلهم فلا يستأخرون ساعة ۖ ولا يستقدمون
verses.transliterated: qul lā amliku linafsī ḍarran walā nafʿan illā mā shāa l-lahu likulli ummatin ajalun idhā jāa ajaluhum falā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūn
verses.english: Say, "I possess no power to harm myself, or benefit myself; only what GOD wills takes place." Each community has a predetermined life span. Once their interim comes to an end, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.
verses.subtitle: The Messenger Possesses No Power

1981.english: Say (O Muhammad), "I possess no power to harm or benefit myself, except in accordance with God's will. Every community has a predetermined end. Once their end comes, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it."

1989.english: Say, “I possess no power to even harm myself, or benefit myself. Only what GOD wills takes place.” Each community has a predetermined life span. Once their interim comes to an end, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.
1989.subtitle: The Messenger Possesses No Power

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَٰتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن أتاكم عذابه بياتا أو نهارا ماذا يستعجل منه المجرمون
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in atākum ʿadhābuhu bayātan aw nahāran mādhā yastaʿjilu min'hu l-muj'rimūn
verses.english: Say, "Whether His retribution comes to you by night or by day, why are the transgressors in such a hurry?

1981.english: Say, "What will you do when His doom comes to you by night or by day? Why are the guilty in such a hurry?

1989.english: Say,“Whether His retribution comes to you by night or by day, why are the guilty in such a hurry?

verses.arabic: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦٓ ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أثم إذا ما وقع آمنتم به ۚ آلآن وقد كنتم به تستعجلون
verses.transliterated: athumma idhā mā waqaʿa āmantum bihi āl'āna waqad kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūn
verses.english: "If it does happen, will you believe then? Why should you believe then? You used to challenge it to come?"

1981.english: "Would you believe when it afflicts you? Now you believe, after your challenging and questioning it?"

1989.english: “If it does happen, will you believe then? Why should you believe then, when you already have challenged it to come?”

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم قيل للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب الخلد هل تجزون إلا بما كنتم تكسبون
verses.transliterated: thumma qīla lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di hal tuj'zawna illā bimā kuntum taksibūn
verses.english: It will be said to the transgressors, "Taste the eternal retribution. Are you not requited precisely for what you have earned?"

1981.english: The wicked will be told, "Suffer the eternal retribution. Do you not get what you deserved?"

1989.english: It will be said to the transgressors, “Taste the eternal retribution. Are you not requited precisely for what you earned?”

verses.arabic: وَيَسْتَنۢبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ قُلْ إِى وَرَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويستنبئونك أحق هو ۖ قل إي وربي إنه لحق ۖ وما أنتم بمعجزين
verses.transliterated: wayastanbiūnaka aḥaqqun huwa qul ī warabbī innahu laḥaqqun wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīn
verses.english: They challenge you to prophesy: "Is this really what will happen?" Say, "Yes indeed, by my Lord, this is the truth, and you can never escape."

1981.english: They question you, "Is this the truth?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord, this is the truth, and you can never escape."

1989.english: They challenge you to prophesy: “Is this really what will happen?” Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, this is the truth, and you can never escape.”

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أن لكل نفس ظلمت ما في الأرض لافتدت به ۗ وأسروا الندامة لما رأوا العذاب ۖ وقضي بينهم بالقسط ۚ وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: walaw anna likulli nafsin ẓalamat mā fī l-arḍi la-if'tadat bihi wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba waquḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: If any wicked soul possessed everything on earth, it would readily offer it as ransom. They will be ridden with remorse when they see the retribution. They will be judged equitably, without the least injustice.
verses.subtitle: What Price Faith

1981.english: If any wicked soul possessed everything on earth, it would readily offer it as ransom. They will suffer severe remorse when they see the retribution. They will be judged equitably, without the least injustice.
1981.subtitle: One Chance to Develop Our Souls

1989.english: If any wicked soul possessed everything on earth, it would readily offer it as ransom. They will be ridden with remorse when they see the retribution. They will be judged equitably, without the least injustice.
1989.subtitle: What Price Faith

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَلَآ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا إن لله ما في السماوات والأرض ۗ ألا إن وعد الله حق ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: alā inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alā inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Absolutely, GOD's promise is truth, but most of them do not know.

1981.english: Absolutely, everything in the heavens and the earth belong to God, and absolutely, God's promise is truth, but the majority do not know.

1989.english: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Absolutely, GOD’s promise is truth. However, most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو يحيي ويميت وإليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: He controls life and death, and to Him you will be returned.

1981.english: He grants life and death, and to Him you ultimately return.

1989.english: He controls life and death, and to Him you will be returned.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس قد جاءتكم موعظة من ربكم وشفاء لما في الصدور وهدى ورحمة للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāatkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum washifāon limā fī l-ṣudūri wahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: O people, enlightenment has come to you herein from your Lord, and healing for anything that troubles your hearts, and guidance, and mercy for the believers.

1981.english: O people, this is an enlightenment from your Lord, and a healing for the hearts, and a guide and mercy for the believers.

1989.english: O people, enlightenment has come to you herein from your Lord, and healing for anything that troubles your hearts, and guidance, and mercy for the believers.

verses.arabic: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل بفضل الله وبرحمته فبذلك فليفرحوا هو خير مما يجمعون
verses.transliterated: qul bifaḍli l-lahi wabiraḥmatihi fabidhālika falyafraḥū huwa khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūn
verses.english: Say, "With GOD's grace and with His mercy they shall rejoice." This is far better than any wealth they can accumulate.
verses.subtitle: Joy for the Believers

1981.english: Say, "With this grace from God, and His mercy, they should rejoice. This is far better than anything they hoard."

1989.english: Say, “With GOD’s grace and with His mercy they shall rejoice.” For this is far greater than any wealth they can accumulate.
1989.subtitle: Joy for the Believers

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَٰلًا قُلْ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ أَمْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم ما أنزل الله لكم من رزق فجعلتم منه حراما وحلالا قل آلله أذن لكم ۖ أم على الله تفترون
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum mā anzala l-lahu lakum min riz'qin fajaʿaltum min'hu ḥarāman waḥalālan qul āllahu adhina lakum am ʿalā l-lahi taftarūn
verses.english: Say, "Did you note how GOD sends down to you all kinds of provisions, then you render some of them unlawful, and some lawful?" Say, "Did GOD give you permission to do this? Or, do you fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD?"
verses.subtitle: Human-made Dietary Prohibitions

1981.english: Say, "Do you note how God provides for you, then you render some provisions "haram" (prohibited), and render others "halal" (permitted)? Say, "Did God give you permission to do this, or do you invent lies about God?"
1981.subtitle: Only Four Meats Specifically Prohibited
1981.footnote: God is extremely displeased with those who prohibit perfectly lawful provisions. Unless something is "specifically" prohibited in Quran, it must never be considered "**haram**" (prohibited). Please see footnote 6:145 and Appendix 13.

1989.english: Say, “Did you note how GOD sends down to you all kinds of provisions, then you render some of them unlawful, and some lawful?” Say, “Did GOD give you permission to do this? Or, do you fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD?”
1989.subtitle: Human-made Dietary Prohibitions

verses.arabic: وَمَا ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما ظن الذين يفترون على الله الكذب يوم القيامة ۗ إن الله لذو فضل على الناس ولكن أكثرهم لا يشكرون
verses.transliterated: wamā ẓannu alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūn
verses.english: Does it ever occur to those who fabricate lies about GOD that they will have to face Him on the Day of Resurrection? Certainly, GOD showers the people with His grace, but most of them are unappreciative.

1981.english: What do those who invent lies about God expect on the day of resurrection? God is most gracious towards the people, but the majority are thankless.
1981.footnote: God is extremely displeased with those who prohibit perfectly lawful provisions. Unless something is "specifically" prohibited in Quran, it must never be considered "**haram**" (prohibited). Please see footnote 6:145 and Appendix 13.

1989.english: Does it ever occur to those who fabricate lies about GOD that they will have to face Him on the Day of Resurrection? Certainly, GOD showers the people with His grace, but most of them are unappreciative.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِى شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوا۟ مِنْهُ مِن قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما تكون في شأن وما تتلو منه من قرآن ولا تعملون من عمل إلا كنا عليكم شهودا إذ تفيضون فيه ۚ وما يعزب عن ربك من مثقال ذرة في الأرض ولا في السماء ولا أصغر من ذلك ولا أكبر إلا في كتاب مبين
verses.transliterated: wamā takūnu fī shanin wamā tatlū min'hu min qur'ānin walā taʿmalūna min ʿamalin illā kunnā ʿalaykum shuhūdan idh tufīḍūna fīhi wamā yaʿzubu ʿan rabbika min mith'qāli dharratin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi walā aṣghara min dhālika walā akbara illā fī kitābin mubīni
verses.english: You do not get into any situation, nor do you recite any Quran, nor do you do anything, without us being witnesses thereof as you do it. Not even an atom's weight is out of your Lord's control, be it in the heavens or the earth. Nor is there anything smaller than an atom, or larger, that is not recorded in a profound record.
verses.subtitle: Knowing God

1981.english: There is not any condition that you may be in, nor any reading of Quran that you may do, nor anything you do, that is not witnessed by us, as you engage therein. Nothing is concealed from your Lord, as small as an atom, in the earth or in the heaven; not even smaller that that, or larger except in a manifest record.

1989.english: You do not get into any situation, nor do you recite any Quran, nor do you do anything, without us being witnesses thereof as you do it. Not even an atom’s weight is out of your Lord’s control, be it in the heavens or the earth. Nor is there anything smaller than an atom, nor larger, that is not recorded in a profound record.
1989.subtitle: Knowing God

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا إن أولياء الله لا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: alā inna awliyāa l-lahi lā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: Absolutely, GOD's allies have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.subtitle: Happiness: Now and Forever
verses.footnote: Most people think that they have to wait until the Day of Resurrection before they receive their rewards for righteousness, or the retribution for wickedness. But the Quran repeatedly assures the believers that they are guaranteed perfect happiness here in this world, now and forever. At the end of their interim here, they go directly to Paradise (see Appendix 17).

1981.english: Absolutely, God's allies have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1981.subtitle: Heaven Begins Here

1989.english: Absolutely, GOD’s allies have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
1989.subtitle: Happiness: Now and Forever
1989.footnote: Most people think that they have to wait until the Day of Resurrection before they receive their rewards for righteousness, or the retribution for wickedness. But the Quran repeatedly assures the believers that they are guaranteed perfect happiness here in this world, now and forever.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūn
verses.english: They are those who believe and lead a righteous life.

1981.english: Those who believe and work righteousness.

1989.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life.
1989.footnote: Most people think that they have to wait until the Day of Resurrection before they receive their rewards for righteousness, or the retribution for wickedness. But the Quran repeatedly assures the believers that they are guaranteed perfect happiness here in this world, now and forever.

verses.arabic: لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: لهم البشرى في الحياة الدنيا وفي الآخرة ۚ لا تبديل لكلمات الله ۚ ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: lahumu l-bush'rā fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati lā tabdīla likalimāti l-lahi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: For them, joy and happiness in this world, as well as in the Hereafter. This is GOD's unchangeable law. Such is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: They have deserved happiness in this life, as well as in the hereafter. God's decisions are never changeable. This is the greatest triumph.

1989.english: For them, joy in this world, and in the Hereafter. This is GOD’s unchangeable decree. Such is the greatest triumph.
1989.footnote: Most people think that they have to wait until the Day of Resurrection before they receive their rewards for righteousness, or the retribution for wickedness. But the Quran repeatedly assures the believers that they are guaranteed perfect happiness here in this world, now and forever.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحزنك قولهم ۘ إن العزة لله جميعا ۚ هو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥzunka qawluhum inna l-ʿizata lillahi jamīʿan huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: Do not be saddened by their utterances. All power belongs to GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: Do not be saddened by their utterances. All power belongs to God. He is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: Do not be saddened by their utterances. All dignity belongs with GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا إن لله من في السماوات ومن في الأرض ۗ وما يتبع الذين يدعون من دون الله شركاء ۚ إن يتبعون إلا الظن وإن هم إلا يخرصون
verses.transliterated: alā inna lillahi man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi wamā yattabiʿu alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi shurakāa in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in hum illā yakhruṣūn
verses.english: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everyone in the heavens and everyone on earth. Those who set up idols beside GOD are really following nothing. They only think that they are following something. They only guess.

1981.english: To God belong everyone in the heavens and the earth, and those who follow idols besides God are following powerless idols. They follow only conjecture, and they totally deviate.

1989.english: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everyone in the heavens and everyone on earth. Those who set up idols besides GOD are really following nothing. They only follow conjecture. They only guess.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي جعل لكم الليل لتسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يسمعون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūn
verses.english: He is the One who rendered the night for your rest, and rendered the day lighted. These are proofs for people who can hear.

1981.english: God is the one who made the night for your rest, and the day visible. These are signs for people who hear.

1989.english: He is the One who rendered the night for your rest, and rendered the day lighted. These are proofs for people who can hear.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِنْ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ بِهَٰذَآ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا اتخذ الله ولدا ۗ سبحانه ۖ هو الغني ۖ له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ إن عندكم من سلطان بهذا ۚ أتقولون على الله ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qālū ittakhadha l-lahu waladan sub'ḥānahu huwa l-ghaniyu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi in ʿindakum min sul'ṭānin bihādhā ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: They said, "GOD has begotten a son!" Be He glorified. He is the Most Rich. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. You have no proof to support such a blasphemy. Are you saying about GOD what you do not know?
verses.subtitle: The Gross Blasphemy

1981.english: They said, "God has begotten a son!" God be glorified; He needs no one. To Him belong everything in the heavens and everything on earth. You have absolutely no evidence for this. Do you say about God what you do not know?

1989.english: They said, “GOD has begotten a son!” Be He glorified. He is the Most Rich. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. You have no proof to support such an utterance. Do you say about GOD what you do not know?

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن الذين يفترون على الله الكذب لا يفلحون
verses.transliterated: qul inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūn
verses.english: Proclaim: "Those who fabricate lies about GOD will never succeed."

1981.english: Say, "Those who invent lies about God never succeed."

1989.english: Say, “Surely, those who fabricate lies about GOD will never succeed.”

verses.arabic: مَتَٰعٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: متاع في الدنيا ثم إلينا مرجعهم ثم نذيقهم العذاب الشديد بما كانوا يكفرون
verses.transliterated: matāʿun fī l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma nudhīquhumu l-ʿadhāba l-shadīda bimā kānū yakfurūn
verses.english: They get their temporary share in this world, then to us is their ultimate return, then we commit them to severe retribution for their disbelieving.

1981.english: A temporary life in this world, then to us is their final return, then we afflict them with terrible retribution for their disbelief.

1989.english: They get their share in this world, then to us is their ultimate return, then we commit them to severe retribution for their disbelieving.

verses.arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُم مَّقَامِى وَتَذْكِيرِى بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ ٱقْضُوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ وَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
verses.arabicClean: واتل عليهم نبأ نوح إذ قال لقومه يا قوم إن كان كبر عليكم مقامي وتذكيري بآيات الله فعلى الله توكلت فأجمعوا أمركم وشركاءكم ثم لا يكن أمركم عليكم غمة ثم اقضوا إلي ولا تنظرون
verses.transliterated: wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a nūḥin idh qāla liqawmihi yāqawmi in kāna kabura ʿalaykum maqāmī watadhkīrī biāyāti l-lahi faʿalā l-lahi tawakkaltu fa-ajmiʿū amrakum washurakāakum thumma lā yakun amrukum ʿalaykum ghummatan thumma iq'ḍū ilayya walā tunẓirūn
verses.english: Recite for them the history of Noah. He said to his people, "O my people, if you find my position and my reminding you of GOD's revelations too much for you, then I put my trust in GOD. You should get together with your leaders, agree on a final decision among yourselves, then let me know it without delay.
verses.subtitle: Noah

1981.english: Narrate for them the history of Noah. He said to his people, "O my people, if you find it too much that I persistently remind you of God's signs, I have put my trust in God. Therefore, get together with your masters, and make a final decision, then inform me without delay.
1981.subtitle: Noah

1989.english: Recite for them the history of Noah. He said to his people, “O my people, if you find my position and my reminding you of GOD’s revelations too much for you, then I put my trust in GOD (and I exhort you to do the following:) You should get together with your leaders, agree on a final decision among yourselves, then let me know it without delay.
1989.subtitle: Noah

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن توليتم فما سألتكم من أجر ۖ إن أجري إلا على الله ۖ وأمرت أن أكون من المسلمين
verses.transliterated: fa-in tawallaytum famā sa-altukum min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīn
verses.english: "If you turn away, then I have not asked you for any wage. My wage comes from GOD. I have been commanded to be a submitter."

1981.english: "If you decide to turn away, I have not asked you for any wage. My wage comes from God, and I am ordered to be a Muslim (submitter)."

1989.english: “If you turn away, then I have not asked you for any wage. My wage comes from GOD. I have been commanded to be a Muslim.”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فكذبوه فنجيناه ومن معه في الفلك وجعلناهم خلائف وأغرقنا الذين كذبوا بآياتنا ۖ فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المنذرين
verses.transliterated: fakadhabūhu fanajjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wajaʿalnāhum khalāifa wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīn
verses.english: They rejected him and, consequently, we saved him and those who joined him in the ark; we made them the inheritors. And we drowned those who rejected our revelations. Note the consequences; they have been warned.

1981.english: They disbelieved him, and consequently, we saved him and his followers in the ark, and made them inheritors, while drowning those who rejected our revelations. Note the consequences for those who were warned.

1989.english: They rejected him and, consequently, we saved him and those who joined him in the ark; we made them the inheritors. And we drowned those who rejected our revelations. Note the consequences for those who have been warned.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ كَذَٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم بعثنا من بعده رسلا إلى قومهم فجاءوهم بالبينات فما كانوا ليؤمنوا بما كذبوا به من قبل ۚ كذلك نطبع على قلوب المعتدين
verses.transliterated: thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihi rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū bihi min qablu kadhālika naṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbi l-muʿ'tadīn
verses.english: Then we sent after him messengers to their people, and they showed them clear proofs. But they were not to believe in what they had rejected in the past. We thus seal the hearts of the transgressors.
verses.subtitle: Humans Insist on Their Original Sin

1981.english: Then we sent after him messengers to their people, and they went to them with profound signs. But they were not to believe in what they had rejected before. We thus seal the hearts of the transgressors.

1989.english: Then we sent after him messengers to their people. They went to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in what they had rejected in the past. We thus seal the hearts of the transgressors.
1989.subtitle: Humans Insist on Their Original Sin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم بعثنا من بعدهم موسى وهارون إلى فرعون وملئه بآياتنا فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما مجرمين
verses.transliterated: thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā wahārūna ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi biāyātinā fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīn
verses.english: Then we sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his group, with our proofs. But they turned arrogant; and were transgressing people.
verses.subtitle: Moses and Aaron

1981.english: Subsequent to them, we sent Moses and Aaron, with our signs, to Pharaoh and his elders. But they were too arrogant, and sinful people.
1981.subtitle: Moses

1989.english: Then we sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his group, with our miracles. But they turned arrogant; they were guilty.
1989.subtitle: Moses and Aaron

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاءهم الحق من عندنا قالوا إن هذا لسحر مبين
verses.transliterated: falammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu min ʿindinā qālū inna hādhā lasiḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: When the truth came to them from us, they said, "This is obviously magic!"

1981.english: When he showed them the truth from us, they said, "This is no more than clever magic."

1989.english: When the truth came to them from us, they said, “This is obviously magic!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّٰحِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال موسى أتقولون للحق لما جاءكم ۖ أسحر هذا ولا يفلح الساحرون
verses.transliterated: qāla mūsā ataqūlūna lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāakum asiḥ'run hādhā walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥirūn
verses.english: Moses said, "Is this how you describe the truth when it comes to you? Is this magic? How can any magicians prevail?"

1981.english: Moses said, "Is this what you say about the truth when it comes to you? Is this magic? Magicians can never prevail."

1989.english: Moses said, “Do you describe the truth when it comes to you as magic? How can the magicians succeed?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أجئتنا لتلفتنا عما وجدنا عليه آباءنا وتكون لكما الكبرياء في الأرض وما نحن لكما بمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: qālū aji'tanā litalfitanā ʿammā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā watakūna lakumā l-kib'riyāu fī l-arḍi wamā naḥnu lakumā bimu'minīn
verses.english: They said, "Did you come to divert us from what we found our parents doing, and to attain positions of prominence for yourselves? We will never join you as believers."

1981.english: They said, "Did you come to divert us from the ways of our parents, and to claim leadership on earth? We will never believe with you."

1989.english: They said, “Did you come to divert us from what we found our parents doing, and to attain positions of prominence for yourselves? We will never believe with you.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱئْتُونِى بِكُلِّ سَٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقال فرعون ائتوني بكل ساحر عليم
verses.transliterated: waqāla fir'ʿawnu i'tūnī bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmi
verses.english: Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every experienced magician."
verses.subtitle: The Truth Prevails

1981.english: Then Pharaoh said, "Let us summon all experienced magicians."

1989.english: Pharaoh said, “Bring to me every experienced magician.”
1989.subtitle: The Truth Prevails

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاء السحرة قال لهم موسى ألقوا ما أنتم ملقون
verses.transliterated: falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūn
verses.english: When the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you are going to throw."

1981.english: When the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw what you wish to throw."

1989.english: When the magicians came, Moses said to them, “Throw whatever you are going to throw.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ ٱلسِّحْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما ألقوا قال موسى ما جئتم به السحر ۖ إن الله سيبطله ۖ إن الله لا يصلح عمل المفسدين
verses.transliterated: falammā alqaw qāla mūsā mā ji'tum bihi l-siḥ'ru inna l-laha sayub'ṭiluhu inna l-laha lā yuṣ'liḥu ʿamala l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: When they threw, Moses said, "What you have produced is magic, and GOD will make it fail. GOD does not support the transgressors' work."

1981.english: When they threw, Moses said, "What you produced is magic, and God will expose it as falsehood. God does not support the corruptors.

1989.english: When they threw, Moses said, “What you have just produced is magic; GOD will nullify it. GOD does not support the transgressors’ work.”

verses.arabic: وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويحق الله الحق بكلماته ولو كره المجرمون
verses.transliterated: wayuḥiqqu l-lahu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi walaw kariha l-muj'rimūn
verses.english: GOD establishes the truth with His words, despite the criminals.

1981.english: "God supports the truth with His words, no matter how averse the guilty might be."

1989.english: GOD establishes the truth with His words, despite the criminals.

verses.arabic: فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما آمن لموسى إلا ذرية من قومه على خوف من فرعون وملئهم أن يفتنهم ۚ وإن فرعون لعال في الأرض وإنه لمن المسرفين
verses.transliterated: famā āmana limūsā illā dhurriyyatun min qawmihi ʿalā khawfin min fir'ʿawna wamala-ihim an yaftinahum wa-inna fir'ʿawna laʿālin fī l-arḍi wa-innahu lamina l-mus'rifīn
verses.english: None believed with Moses except a few of his people, while fearing the tyranny of Pharaoh and his elders. Surely, Pharaoh was much too arrogant on earth, and a real tyrant.

1981.english: Only a small group of his people believed with Moses, while fearing the tyranny of Pharaoh and his elders. Indeed, Pharaoh was a tyrant on earth; he was a transgressor.

1989.english: The only ones who believed with Moses were a few of his people, in spite of fearing the tyranny of Pharaoh and his elders. Surely, Pharaoh was much too arrogant on earth; a real tyrant.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَٰقَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال موسى يا قوم إن كنتم آمنتم بالله فعليه توكلوا إن كنتم مسلمين
verses.transliterated: waqāla mūsā yāqawmi in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi faʿalayhi tawakkalū in kuntum mus'limīn
verses.english: Moses said, "O my people, if you have really believed in GOD, then put your trust in Him, if you are really submitters."

1981.english: Moses said, "O my people, if you truly believe in God, then put your trust in Him, and totally submit (be Muslims)."

1989.english: Moses said, “O my people, if you have really believed in GOD, then put your trust in Him, if you are Muslims.”

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فقالوا على الله توكلنا ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للقوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: faqālū ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: They said, "We trust in GOD. Our Lord, save us from the persecution of these oppressive people.

1981.english: They said, "We have put our trust in God." "Our Lord, let us not be victimized by the oppressive people.

1989.english: They said, “We trust in GOD. Our Lord, save us from the persecution of these unjust people.

verses.arabic: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونجنا برحمتك من القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
verses.english: "Deliver us, with Your mercy, from the disbelieving people."

1981.english: "Deliver us with Your mercy from the disbelievers."

1989.english: “Deliver us, with Your mercy, from the disbelieving people.”

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَن تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَٱجْعَلُوا۟ بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأوحينا إلى موسى وأخيه أن تبوآ لقومكما بمصر بيوتا واجعلوا بيوتكم قبلة وأقيموا الصلاة ۗ وبشر المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā wa-akhīhi an tabawwaā liqawmikumā bimiṣ'ra buyūtan wa-ij'ʿalū buyūtakum qib'latan wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata wabashiri l-mu'minīn
verses.english: We inspired Moses and his brother. "Maintain your homes in Egypt for the time being, turn your homes into synagogues, and maintain the Contact Prayers (Salat). Give good news to the believers."

1981.english: We inspired Moses and his brother, "Let your people confine themselves to their homes in Egypt, and let them consider their homes temples, and let them observe the **salat** prayers therein, and give good news to the believers."

1989.english: We inspired Moses and his brother. “Maintain your homes in Egypt for the time being, turn your homes into sanctuaries, and observe the contact prayers (Salat). Give good news to the believers.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُۥ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَٰلًا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا ٱطْمِسْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَٱشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال موسى ربنا إنك آتيت فرعون وملأه زينة وأموالا في الحياة الدنيا ربنا ليضلوا عن سبيلك ۖ ربنا اطمس على أموالهم واشدد على قلوبهم فلا يؤمنوا حتى يروا العذاب الأليم
verses.transliterated: waqāla mūsā rabbanā innaka ātayta fir'ʿawna wamala-ahu zīnatan wa-amwālan fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā rabbanā liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlika rabbanā iṭ'mis ʿalā amwālihim wa-ush'dud ʿalā qulūbihim falā yu'minū ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.english: Moses said, "Our Lord, You have given Pharaoh and his elders luxuries and wealth in this world. Our Lord, they only use them to repulse others from Your path. Our Lord, wipe out their wealth, and harden their hearts to prevent them from believing, until they see the painful retribution."

1981.english: Moses said, "Our Lord, You have endowed Pharaoh and his elders with luxury and wealth in this life. Our Lord, they only use this to repel from Your path. Our Lord, neutralize their wealth, and seal their hearts so that they fail to believe until the painful retribution comes to them."

1989.english: Moses said, “Our Lord, you have given Pharaoh and his elders luxuries and wealth in this world. Our Lord, they only use them to repulse others from Your path. Our Lord, wipe out their wealth, and harden their hearts to prevent them from believing, until they see the painful retribution.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا فَٱسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَآنِّ سَبِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال قد أجيبت دعوتكما فاستقيما ولا تتبعان سبيل الذين لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: qāla qad ujībat daʿwatukumā fa-is'taqīmā walā tattabiʿānni sabīla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: He said, "Your prayer has been answered (O Moses and Aaron), so be steadfast, and do not follow the ways of those who do not know."

1981.english: God said, "Your prayers have been answered. Therefore, you shall remain steadfast, and do not follow the ways of those who do not know."

1989.english: He said, “Your prayer has been answered (O Moses and Aaron), so be steadfast, and do not follow the way of those who do not know.”

verses.arabic: وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ بَغْيًا وَعَدْوًا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَدْرَكَهُ ٱلْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنتُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَتْ بِهِۦ بَنُوٓا۟ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وجاوزنا ببني إسرائيل البحر فأتبعهم فرعون وجنوده بغيا وعدوا ۖ حتى إذا أدركه الغرق قال آمنت أنه لا إله إلا الذي آمنت به بنو إسرائيل وأنا من المسلمين
verses.transliterated: wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu wajunūduhu baghyan waʿadwan ḥattā idhā adrakahu l-gharaqu qāla āmantu annahu lā ilāha illā alladhī āmanat bihi banū is'rāīla wa-anā mina l-mus'limīn
verses.english: We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. Pharaoh and his troops pursued them, aggressively and sinfully. When drowning became a reality for him, he said, "I believe that there is no god except the One in whom the Children of Israel have believed; I am a submitter."

1981.english: We then delivered the children of Israel across the sea. Pharaoh and his troops, blinded by hatred and transgression, pursued them. When Pharaoh realized that he was drowning, he said, "I believe that there is no god except the one in which the children of Israel believe, and I am a Muslim (submitter)."

1989.english: We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. Pharaoh and his troops pursued them, aggressively and sinfully. When drowning became a reality for him, he said, “I believe that there is no god except the One in whom the Children of Israel have believed. I am a Muslim.”

verses.arabic: ءَآلْـَٰٔنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: آلآن وقد عصيت قبل وكنت من المفسدين
verses.transliterated: āl'āna waqad ʿaṣayta qablu wakunta mina l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: "Too late! For you have rebelled already, and chose to be a transgressor.
verses.footnote: Believing in God is the first step. Thereafter, one needs to nourish and develop the soul through the practices of worship (see Appendix 15).

1981.english: "Now (you believe)? After you had rebelled in the past, and worked evil?
1981.footnote: Although Pharaoh actually believed in God as he was drowning, this was not sufficient for his salvation (see 2:62, 32:29, & 40:85). Believing in God is only the first, though the most important, step. We need to nourish, sustain, and develop our souls through the acts of worship and righteous works. Following his sincere belief, Pharaoh did not have time to grow and develop (see 7:8, 23:102, 101:6, and Appendix 10).

1989.english: “Too late!* For you have rebelled in the past; you have been wicked.
1989.footnote: Believing in God is the first step. Thereafter, one needs to nourish and develop the soul through the practices of worship (see Appendix 15).

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ ءَايَةً وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَغَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاليوم ننجيك ببدنك لتكون لمن خلفك آية ۚ وإن كثيرا من الناس عن آياتنا لغافلون
verses.transliterated: fal-yawma nunajjīka bibadanika litakūna liman khalfaka āyatan wa-inna kathīran mina l-nāsi ʿan āyātinā laghāfilūn
verses.english: "Today, we will preserve your body, to set you up as a lesson for future generations." Unfortunately, many people are totally oblivious to our signs.
verses.subtitle: Pharaoh's Body Preserved
verses.footnote: God endowed the Egyptians with the exclusive knowledge of mummification. Today, Pharaoh's mummified body is on display at the Cairo Museum.

1981.english: "Today, we will only preserve your body, to set you up as a sign for subsequent generations." Indeed, most people are heedless of our signs.
1981.footnote: This is another profound Quranic miracle. Pharaoh's body was indeed preserved, and can be viewed today in the Mummies Room of the Cairo Museum. The ancient Egyptians were exclusively gifted with the science of mummification.

1989.english: “Today, we will preserve your body, to set you up as a lesson for future generations.”* Yet, many people are totally heedless of our signs.
1989.footnote: God endowed the Egyptians with the exclusive knowledge of mummification. Today, Pharaoh’s mummified body is on display at the Cairo Museum.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد بوأنا بني إسرائيل مبوأ صدق ورزقناهم من الطيبات فما اختلفوا حتى جاءهم العلم ۚ إن ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: walaqad bawwanā banī is'rāīla mubawwa-a ṣid'qin warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti famā ikh'talafū ḥattā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: We have endowed the Children of Israel with a position of honor, and blessed them with good provisions. Yet, they disputed when this knowledge came to them. Your Lord will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they disputed.

1981.english: We have exalted the children of Israel to a place of honor, and provided for them generously. Ironically, they deviated only after the knowledge came to them. Your Lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection, regarding their deviations.

1989.english: We have endowed the Children of Israel with a position of honor, and provided them with good things. Yet, they disputed when this knowledge came to them. Your Lord will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding their disputes.

verses.arabic: فَإِن كُنتَ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَقَدْ جَآءَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن كنت في شك مما أنزلنا إليك فاسأل الذين يقرءون الكتاب من قبلك ۚ لقد جاءك الحق من ربك فلا تكونن من الممترين
verses.transliterated: fa-in kunta fī shakkin mimmā anzalnā ilayka fasali alladhīna yaqraūna l-kitāba min qablika laqad jāaka l-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīn
verses.english: If you have any doubt regarding what is revealed to you from your Lord, then ask those who read the previous scripture. Indeed, the truth has come to you from your Lord. Do not be with the doubters.
verses.subtitle: The Messenger's Doubt

1981.english: If you (Muhammad) have any doubts concerning what we reveal to you, then ask those who studied the previous scriptures. The truth has come to you from your Lord, and you should not be with the doubters.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad the Man vs Muhammad the Messenger
1981.footnote: Muhammad the man is instructed here to follow Muhammad the messenger, and the distinction becomes even clearer in 33:37, where Muhammad the man actually disobeys Muhammad the messenger. The Quran teaches us that Muhammad the messenger is infallible, because he utters only the Quran. On the other hand, Muhammad the man is a human being like you and me, who is required to uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see 6:50, 10:49, 18:110, and 41:6).

1989.english: If you have any doubt regarding what is revealed to you from your Lord, then ask those who read the previous scripture. Indeed, the truth has come to you from your Lord. Do not be with the doubters.
1989.subtitle: The Messenger’s Doubt

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تكونن من الذين كذبوا بآيات الله فتكون من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: walā takūnanna mina alladhīna kadhabū biāyāti l-lahi fatakūna mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: Nor shall you join those who rejected GOD's revelations, lest you be with the losers.

1981.english: Nor shall you be with those who reject God's revelations, lest you become a loser.
1981.footnote: Muhammad the man is instructed here to follow Muhammad the messenger, and the distinction becomes even clearer in 33:37, where Muhammad the man actually disobeys Muhammad the messenger. The Quran teaches us that Muhammad the messenger is infallible, because he utters only the Quran. On the other hand, Muhammad the man is a human being like you and me, who is required to uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see 6:50, 10:49, 18:110, and 41:6).

1989.english: Nor shall you reject GOD’s revelations, lest you be with the losers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين حقت عليهم كلمت ربك لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimatu rabbika lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Surely, those condemned by a decree from your Lord cannot believe.

1981.english: Those who have deserved condemnation from your Lord can never believe.

1989.english: Surely, those condemned by a decree from your Lord cannot believe.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ جَآءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ ءَايَةٍ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو جاءتهم كل آية حتى يروا العذاب الأليم
verses.transliterated: walaw jāathum kullu āyatin ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.english: No matter what kind of proof you show them, (they cannot believe), until they see the painful retribution.

1981.english: Even if every miracle comes to them, (they will not believe) until they see the painful retribution.

1989.english: No matter what kind of miracle you show them, {they cannot believe). (They will continue like this) until they see the painful retribution.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فلولا كانت قرية آمنت فنفعها إيمانها إلا قوم يونس لما آمنوا كشفنا عنهم عذاب الخزي في الحياة الدنيا ومتعناهم إلى حين
verses.transliterated: falawlā kānat qaryatun āmanat fanafaʿahā īmānuhā illā qawma yūnusa lammā āmanū kashafnā ʿanhum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīni
verses.english: Any community that believes will surely be rewarded for believing. For example, the people of Jonah: when they believed, we relieved the humiliating retribution they had been suffering in this world, and we made them prosperous.
verses.subtitle: Believing Nations Prosper

1981.english: When any community believes, it does so for its own good. Thus, when the people of Jonah believed, we relieved their humiliating retribution in this life, and we endowed them for a while.

1989.english: Any community that believes will surely benefit from its belief. For example, the people of Jonah: when they believed, we removed their humiliating retribution in this world, and we made them prosperous for awhile.
1989.subtitle: Believing Nations Prosper

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا أَفَأَنتَ تُكْرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو شاء ربك لآمن من في الأرض كلهم جميعا ۚ أفأنت تكره الناس حتى يكونوا مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walaw shāa rabbuka laāmana man fī l-arḍi kulluhum jamīʿan afa-anta tuk'rihu l-nāsa ḥattā yakūnū mu'minīn
verses.english: Had your Lord willed, all the people on earth would have believed. Do you want to force the people to become believers?
verses.footnote: The test demands that we denounce idolatry on our own, without divine intervention in our initial decision. God blocks out those who choose to disbelieve.

1981.english: If your Lord wills, He can make all the people on earth believe. Would you force the people to believe?
1981.subtitle: God Blocks Out the Skeptics
1981.footnote: See Appendix 12.

1989.english: Had your Lord willed, all the people on earth would have believed.* Would you force the people to become believers?
1989.footnote: The test demands that we denounce idolatry on our own, without divine intervention in our initial decision. God blocks out those who decide to disbelieve.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان لنفس أن تؤمن إلا بإذن الله ۚ ويجعل الرجس على الذين لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna linafsin an tu'mina illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wayajʿalu l-rij'sa ʿalā alladhīna lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: No soul can believe except in accordance with GOD's will. For He places a curse upon those who refuse to understand.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers Blocked Out

1981.english: No soul can believe except with God's leave, for He deliberately blocks out those who defy common sense.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 12.

1989.english: No soul can believe except in accordance with GOD’s will. Those who refuse to understand are blocked out by Him—He has placed a curse upon them.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers Blocked Out
1989.footnote: The test demands that we denounce idolatry on our own, without divine intervention in our initial decision. God blocks out those who decide to disbelieve.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱنظُرُوا۟ مَاذَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُغْنِى ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل انظروا ماذا في السماوات والأرض ۚ وما تغني الآيات والنذر عن قوم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: quli unẓurū mādhā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā tugh'nī l-āyātu wal-nudhuru ʿan qawmin lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Say, "Look at all the signs in the heavens and the earth." All the proofs and all the warnings can never help people who decided to disbelieve.

1981.english: Say, "Look at all the marvels in the heavens and the earth." All these marvels, and all these warnings, can never help those who disbelieve.

1989.english: Say, “Note (the abundant signs in) the heavens and the earth.” All these signs and warnings never help people who have decided to disbelieve.
1989.footnote: The test demands that we denounce idolatry on our own, without divine intervention in our initial decision. God blocks out those who decide to disbelieve.

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ يَنتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قُلْ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فهل ينتظرون إلا مثل أيام الذين خلوا من قبلهم ۚ قل فانتظروا إني معكم من المنتظرين
verses.transliterated: fahal yantaẓirūna illā mith'la ayyāmi alladhīna khalaw min qablihim qul fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīn
verses.english: Can they expect other than the fate of their counterparts in the past? Say, "Just wait, and, along with you, I am also waiting."

1981.english: Should they expect anything but the same fate as those before them? Say, "Wait, and I will wait along with you."

1989.english: Can they expect other than the fate of their counterparts in the past? Say, “Just wait, and I am with you waiting.”

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنجِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم ننجي رسلنا والذين آمنوا ۚ كذلك حقا علينا ننج المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: thumma nunajjī rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū kadhālika ḥaqqan ʿalaynā nunji l-mu'minīn
verses.english: We ultimately save our messengers and those who believe. It is our immutable law that we save the believers.
verses.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory

1981.english: We always save our messengers and those who believe, for it is our duty to save the believers.

1989.english: We ultimately save our messengers and those who believed. It is our decree that we guarantee victory for the believers.
1989.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن دِينِى فَلَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنْ أَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أيها الناس إن كنتم في شك من ديني فلا أعبد الذين تعبدون من دون الله ولكن أعبد الله الذي يتوفاكم ۖ وأمرت أن أكون من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī shakkin min dīnī falā aʿbudu alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi walākin aʿbudu l-laha alladhī yatawaffākum wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: Say, "O people, if you have any doubt regarding my religion, I do not worship what you worship beside GOD. I worship GOD alone; the One who will terminate your lives. I am commanded to be a believer."

1981.english: Say, "O people, if you have any doubt about my religion, I do not idolize those whom you idolize besides God. I worship the one God who puts you to death, and I was commanded to be with the believers.

1989.english: Say, “O people, if you have any doubt regarding my religion, I do not worship what you worship besides GOD. I worship GOD (alone); the One who controls your lives. I am enjoined to be a believer.”

verses.arabic: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأن أقم وجهك للدين حنيفا ولا تكونن من المشركين
verses.transliterated: wa-an aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: I was commanded: "Keep yourself devoted to the religion of monotheism; you shall not practice idol worship.

1981.english: "And (I was told,) 'Devote yourself to the religion of absolute oneness of God, and never be with the idol worshipers.

1989.english: I was enjoined: “Keep yourself devoted to the religion of monotheism; you shall not practice idol worship.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ فَإِن فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تدع من دون الله ما لا ينفعك ولا يضرك ۖ فإن فعلت فإنك إذا من الظالمين
verses.transliterated: walā tadʿu min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuka walā yaḍurruka fa-in faʿalta fa-innaka idhan mina l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: "You shall not worship beside GOD what possesses no power to benefit you or harm you. If you do, you will be a transgressor."

1981.english: "'Do not idolize besides God those who can neither benefit you, nor harm you. If you do, then you are wicked.'"

1989.english: “You shall not call upon any idols besides GOD. They possess no power to benefit you or harm you. If you do, you will be a transgressor.”

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضْلِهِۦ يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له إلا هو ۖ وإن يردك بخير فلا راد لفضله ۚ يصيب به من يشاء من عباده ۚ وهو الغفور الرحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-in yamsaska l-lahu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu illā huwa wa-in yurid'ka bikhayrin falā rādda lifaḍlihi yuṣību bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīm
verses.english: If GOD touches you with a hardship, none can relieve it except He. And when He blesses you, no force can prevent His grace. He bestows it upon whomever He chooses from among His servants. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: All Power Belongs To God

1981.english: If God afflicts you with adversity, only He can relieve it for you. And if He blesses you with something good, none can repel His grace. He bestows it upon whomever He chooses, and He is the forgiver, the merciful.

1989.english: If GOD touches you with adversity, none can relieve it except He. And when He blesses you, none can repel His grace. He bestows it upon whomever He chooses from among His worshipers. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: All Power Belongs To God

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أيها الناس قد جاءكم الحق من ربكم ۖ فمن اهتدى فإنما يهتدي لنفسه ۖ ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها ۖ وما أنا عليكم بوكيل
verses.transliterated: qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakumu l-ḥaqu min rabbikum famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anā ʿalaykum biwakīli
verses.english: Proclaim: "O people, the truth has come to you herein from your Lord. Whoever is guided is guided for his own good. And whoever goes astray, goes astray to his own detriment. I am not a guardian over you."

1981.english: Say, "O people, the truth has come to you from your Lord. Thus, whoever is guided, is guided for his own good; and whoever goes astray, does so to his own detriment. I am not your advocate."

1989.english: Say, “O people, the truth has come to you herein from your Lord. Whoever is guided is guided for his own good. And whoever goes astray, goes astray to his own detriment. I am not a guardian over you.”
