verses.arabic: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَٱصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واتبع ما يوحى إليك واصبر حتى يحكم الله ۚ وهو خير الحاكمين
verses.transliterated: wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka wa-iṣ'bir ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīn
verses.english: Follow what is revealed to you, and be patient until GOD issues His judgment; He is the best judge.

1981.english: You shall follow what is revealed to you, and be patient until God issues His judgment; He is the best judge.

1989.english: Follow what is revealed to you, and be patient until GOD issues His judgment; He is the best judge. s

verses.arabic: الٓر كِتَٰبٌ أُحْكِمَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الر ۚ كتاب أحكمت آياته ثم فصلت من لدن حكيم خبير
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-ra kitābun uḥ'kimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīri
verses.english: A.L.R. This is a scripture whose verses have been perfected, then elucidated. It comes from a Most Wise, Most Cognizant.
verses.footnote: Our generation is fortunate to witness two awesome phenomena in the Quran: (1) an extraordinary mathematical code (Appendix 1), and (2) a literary miracle of incredible dimensions. If humans attempt to write a mathematically structured work, the numerical manipulations will adversely affect the literary quality. The Quran sets the standard for literary excellence.

1981.english: A.L.R.* A scripture whose verses were perfectly designed, then elucidated, from One who is wise, cognizant.
1981.footnote: See footnote 10:1. This verse states that the Quranic initials bear the proof that the verses of Quran are perfectly designed by the almighty.

1989.english: A.L.R. (This is) a scripture whose verses have been perfected, then elucidated.* It comes from a Most Wise, Most Cognizant.
1989.footnote: Our generation is fortunate to witness not only (1) the Quran’s mathematical miracle (App. 1), but also (2) a literary miracle of incredible dimensions. If humans attempt to write a mathematically structured work, the numerical manipulations will adversely affect the literary quality. The Quran sets the standard for literary excellence.

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنَّنِى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألا تعبدوا إلا الله ۚ إنني لكم منه نذير وبشير
verses.transliterated: allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innanī lakum min'hu nadhīrun wabashīru
verses.english: Proclaiming: "You shall not worship except GOD. I come to you from Him as a warner, as well as a bearer of good news.
verses.subtitle: The Quran: Messenger of God

1981.english: That you shall not worship except God. I come to you, from Him, as a warner, as well as a bearer of good news.
1981.footnote: This is the "First Commandment," and it is a "negative" commandment stating that "You shall NOT worship other than God." This is because a "positive" commandment stating that "You shall worship God," does not necessarily guarantee salvation; one can worship God, and idolize Jesus, or Muhammad, or the saints, will inevitably end up in hell (see footnote 41:14 and verses 23:84-89). Note that it is the Quran that says, "I come to you as a warner."

1989.english: Proclaiming: “You shall not worship except GOD. I come to you from Him as a warner, as well as a bearer of good news.
1989.subtitle: The Quran: Messenger of God

verses.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِى فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُۥ وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأن استغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا إليه يمتعكم متاعا حسنا إلى أجل مسمى ويؤت كل ذي فضل فضله ۖ وإن تولوا فإني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم كبير
verses.transliterated: wa-ani is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿ'kum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa-in tawallaw fa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīri
verses.english: "You shall seek your Lord's forgiveness, then repent to Him. He will then bless you generously for a predetermined period, and bestow His grace upon those who deserve it. If you turn away, then I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day."

1981.english: And, that you shall ask forgiveness from your Lord, then repent to Him. He will then endow you with a happy life, for a finite period, and bestow grace upon every one who deserves it. But if you turn away, then I fear for you the retribution of a terrible day.

1989.english: “You shall seek your Lord’s forgiveness, then repent to Him. He will then bless you generously for a predetermined period, and bestow His grace upon those who deserve it. If you turn away, then I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day.”

verses.arabic: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلى الله مرجعكم ۖ وهو على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: ilā l-lahi marjiʿukum wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: To GOD is your ultimate return, and He is Omnipotent.

1981.english: To God is your ultimate return, and He is omnipotent.

1989.english: To GOD is your ultimate return, and He is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا۟ مِنْهُ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: ألا إنهم يثنون صدورهم ليستخفوا منه ۚ ألا حين يستغشون ثيابهم يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون ۚ إنه عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū min'hu alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: Indeed, they hide their innermost thoughts, as if to keep Him from knowing them. In fact, as they cover themselves with their clothes, He knows all their secrets and declarations. He knows the innermost thoughts.

1981.english: They try to hide their thoughts from God. However, no matter how they cover themselves, He knows everything they conceal, and everything they declare. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1989.english: Indeed, they corrupt their innermost thoughts, as if to hide them from Him. Indeed, even as they wrap themselves in their clothes, He knows all their secrets and declarations. He knows the innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما من دابة في الأرض إلا على الله رزقها ويعلم مستقرها ومستودعها ۚ كل في كتاب مبين
verses.transliterated: wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā ʿalā l-lahi riz'quhā wayaʿlamu mus'taqarrahā wamus'tawdaʿahā kullun fī kitābin mubīni
verses.english: There is not a creature on earth whose provision is not guaranteed by GOD. And He knows its course and its final destiny. All are recorded in a profound record.
verses.subtitle: Provisions Guaranteed

1981.english: There is not a creature on earth that is not guaranteed its provision from God, and He knows its course, and its final destiny. All is recorded in a manifest record.

1989.english: There is not a creature on earth whose provision is not guaranteed by GOD. And He knows its course and its final destiny. All are recorded in a profound record.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَلَئِن قُلْتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام وكان عرشه على الماء ليبلوكم أيكم أحسن عملا ۗ ولئن قلت إنكم مبعوثون من بعد الموت ليقولن الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin wakāna ʿarshuhu ʿalā l-māi liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wala-in qul'ta innakum mabʿūthūna min baʿdi l-mawti layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days—and His (earthly) domain was completely covered with water—in order to test you, to distinguish those among you who work righteousness. Yet, when you say, "You will be resurrected after death," those who disbelieve would say, "This is clearly witchcraft."
verses.footnote:
The six days are simply a yardstick providing us with a lot of information. Thus, we learn that the vast lifeless physical universe was created in two days, while the tiny mote called "Earth" was created in four days (41:10-12). The provision of food, water, and oxygen for the earth's inhabitants had to be precisely calculated and arranged.

±±11:7 The earth was initially covered with water. Subsequently, the land mass emerged, and the continents drifted apart.

1981.english: And He is the one who created the heavens and the earth in six days, and His dominion was initially over water. This, in order to test you and show which of you is the most righteous. Yet, when you say, "You will be resurrected after death," the disbelievers would say, "This is obviously magic."

1989.english: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days—* * and His throne was on water—* * in order to test you, to distinguish those among you who work righteousness. Yet, when you say, “You will be resurrected after death,” those who disbelieved will say, “This is clearly witchcraft.”
1989.footnote: The earth was initially covered with water, then the land mass emerged.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُودَةٍ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُۥٓ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أخرنا عنهم العذاب إلى أمة معدودة ليقولن ما يحبسه ۗ ألا يوم يأتيهم ليس مصروفا عنهم وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: wala-in akharnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba ilā ummatin maʿdūdatin layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu alā yawma yatīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: And if we delay the retribution they have incurred—for we reserve it for a specific community—they say, "What is keeping Him?" In fact, once it comes to them, nothing can stop it, and their mocking will come back to haunt them.

1981.english: Because we delay their retribution to a specific time, they say, "What is holding him?" Indeed, when it comes to them, they can never evade it, and the very thing they ridicule will overwhelm them.

1989.english: Whenever we delay the retribution they have incurred—for we reserve it for a specific community—they say, “What is keeping Him?” In fact, once it comes to them, nothing can stop it, and their mocking will come back to haunt them.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَٰهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٌ كَفُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أذقنا الإنسان منا رحمة ثم نزعناها منه إنه ليئوس كفور
verses.transliterated: wala-in adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma nazaʿnāhā min'hu innahu layaūsun kafūru
verses.english: Whenever we bless the human being with mercy from us, then remove it, he turns despondent, unappreciative.

1981.english: When we bless the human being with mercy from us, then remove it, he turns desperate, ungrateful.

1989.english: Whenever we bless the human being with mercy from us, then remove it, he turns despondent, unappreciative.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أذقناه نعماء بعد ضراء مسته ليقولن ذهب السيئات عني ۚ إنه لفرح فخور
verses.transliterated: wala-in adhaqnāhu naʿmāa baʿda ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba l-sayiātu ʿannī innahu lafariḥun fakhūru
verses.english: Whenever we bless him, after adversity had afflicted him, he says, "All adversity has gone away from me;" he becomes excited, proud.

1981.english: And when we endow him with a blessing, after adversity, he says, "Hardship is gone from me," and he turns joyful and proud.

1989.english: Whenever we bless him after adversity had afflicted him, he says, “All adversity has gone away from me;” he turns joyful, proud.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين صبروا وعملوا الصالحات أولئك لهم مغفرة وأجر كبير
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna ṣabarū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīru
verses.english: As for those who steadfastly persevere, and lead a righteous life, they deserve forgiveness and a generous recompense.

1981.english: As for those who remain steadfast (under any circumstance), and work righteousness, they have deserved forgiveness and a generous reward.

1989.english: As for those who steadfastly persevere, and lead a righteous life, they deserve forgiveness and a generous recompense.

verses.arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
verses.arabicClean: فلعلك تارك بعض ما يوحى إليك وضائق به صدرك أن يقولوا لولا أنزل عليه كنز أو جاء معه ملك ۚ إنما أنت نذير ۚ والله على كل شيء وكيل
verses.transliterated: falaʿallaka tārikun baʿḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍāiqun bihi ṣadruka an yaqūlū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi kanzun aw jāa maʿahu malakun innamā anta nadhīrun wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlu
verses.english: You may wish to disregard some of that which is revealed to you, and you may be annoyed by it. Also, they may say, "How come no treasure comes down to him, or an angel?" You are only a warner; GOD controls all things.
verses.subtitle: God's Revelation is Heavy

1981.english: You may wish to discard some of God's revelations to you (Muhammad), and you may be annoyed therewith. For they say, "If only a treasure could come down to him, or an angel comes with him!" You are no more than a warner, while God is in full control of all things.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad's Role: Deliver the Message

1989.english: You may tend to disregard some of that which is revealed to you, and you may be annoyed by it when they say, “How come no treasure comes down to him, or an angel?” You are only a warner; GOD controls all things.

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ مُفْتَرَيَٰتٍ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون افتراه ۖ قل فأتوا بعشر سور مثله مفتريات وادعوا من استطعتم من دون الله إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū biʿashri suwarin mith'lihi muf'tarayātin wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: If they say, "He fabricated (the Quran)," tell them, "Then produce ten suras like these, fabricated, and invite whomever you can, other than GOD, if you are truthful."
verses.subtitle: The Quran: Impossible to Imitate
verses.footnote: The Quran's mathematical miracle is inimitable (See Appendix 1).

1981.english: Or, they may say, "He made it up!" Say, "Then produce ten suras like these, fabricated; and invite whomever you can besides God, if you are truthful."

1989.english: If they say, “He is the one who fabricated (the Quran)," tell them, “Then produce ten suras like these, fabricated, and invite whomever you can, other than GOD, if you are truthful.”* *
1989.subtitle: The Quran: Impossible to Imitate
1989.footnote: The Quran’s mathematical miracle is utterly inimitable (See Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإلم يستجيبوا لكم فاعلموا أنما أنزل بعلم الله وأن لا إله إلا هو ۖ فهل أنتم مسلمون
verses.transliterated: fa-illam yastajībū lakum fa-iʿ'lamū annamā unzila biʿil'mi l-lahi wa-an lā ilāha illā huwa fahal antum mus'limūn
verses.english: If they fail to meet your challenge, then know that this is revealed with GOD's knowledge, and that there is no god except He. Will you then submit?

1981.english: If they fail to respond, then know that this is revealed with God's knowledge, and that there is no god except He. Would you then submit?

1989.english: If they fail to respond to you, then know that this is revealed with GOD’s knowledge, and that there is no god except He. Will you then submit?

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من كان يريد الحياة الدنيا وزينتها نوف إليهم أعمالهم فيها وهم فيها لا يبخسون
verses.transliterated: man kāna yurīdu l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim aʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yub'khasūn
verses.english: Those who pursue this worldly life and its material vanities, we will pay them for their works in this life; without the least reduction.

1981.english: Those who prefer this life and its vanities, we will pay them for their works therein, without the least reduction.

1989.english: Those who seek this worldly life and its material vanities, we will pay them for their works in this life; without the least reduction.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوا۟ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين ليس لهم في الآخرة إلا النار ۖ وحبط ما صنعوا فيها وباطل ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna laysa lahum fī l-ākhirati illā l-nāru waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿū fīhā wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: It is they who gave up their share in the Hereafter, and, consequently, Hell is their lot. All their works are in vain; everything they have done is nullified.

1981.english: It is these who get nothing in the hereafter except hell. Everything they had done is nullified, and all their work is in vain.

1989.english: It is they who gave up their share in the Hereafter. Hell is their lot. All their works are in vain; everything they have done is nullified.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن كان على بينة من ربه ويتلوه شاهد منه ومن قبله كتاب موسى إماما ورحمة ۚ أولئك يؤمنون به ۚ ومن يكفر به من الأحزاب فالنار موعده ۚ فلا تك في مرية منه ۚ إنه الحق من ربك ولكن أكثر الناس لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun min'hu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan ulāika yu'minūna bihi waman yakfur bihi mina l-aḥzābi fal-nāru mawʿiduhu falā taku fī mir'yatin min'hu innahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūn
verses.english: As for those who are given solid proof from their Lord, reported by a witness from Him, and before it, the book of Moses has set a precedent and a mercy, they will surely believe. As for those who disbelieve among the various groups, Hell is awaiting them. Do not harbor any doubt; this is the truth from your Lord, but most people disbelieve.
verses.subtitle: The Quran's Mathematical Code
verses.footnote:
The Quran's 19-based mathematical code is a built-in proof of divine authorship. It is noteworthy that the word "Bayyinah" (proof) is mentioned in the Quran 19 times.

±±11:17 As it turns out, Moses' book was also mathematically composed, with "19" as the common denominator. See Footnote 46:10 and Appendix 1.

1981.english: On the other hand, those who see the clear proof from their Lord, as recited in this message, and as predicted by the scripture of Moses which served as an example and mercy, they are the true believers. As for the parties who reject this, hell is their only destiny. You shall have no doubt about this. This is the truth from your Lord, but most people do not believe.

1989.english: As for those who attain a solid proof from their Lord, reported by a witness from Him,** and before it, the book of Moses was a precedent and a mercy,*** they will surely believe. As for those who disbelieve among the various groups, Hell is awaiting them. Do not harbor any doubt; this is the truth from your Lord, but most people do not know.
1989.footnote: As it turns out, Moses’ book was also mathematically composed, with “19” as the common denominator. See Footnote 46:10 and Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا ۚ أولئك يعرضون على ربهم ويقول الأشهاد هؤلاء الذين كذبوا على ربهم ۚ ألا لعنة الله على الظالمين
verses.transliterated: waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban ulāika yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlu l-ashhādu hāulāi alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā rabbihim alā laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Who are more evil than those who fabricate lies about GOD? They will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied about their Lord. GOD's condemnation has befallen the transgressors."

1981.english: Who is more evil than those who invent lies, then attribute them to God?* They will face their Lord, and the witnesses will testify, "These are the ones who lied about their Lord." Indeed, God's curse befalls the wicked.
1981.footnote: These verses describe vividly those who have invented the "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" and claim that they are "divine revelations."

1989.english: Who are more evil than those who fabricate lies about GOD? They will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, “These are the ones who lied about their Lord. GOD’s condemnation has befallen the transgressors.”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يصدون عن سبيل الله ويبغونها عوجا وهم بالآخرة هم كافرون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūn
verses.english: They repel from the way of GOD and seek to make it crooked, and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

1981.english: They have repelled from the path of God, and seek to distort it; and they do not believe in the hereafter.
1981.footnote: See verse 6:113, and footnote 6:112-116.

1989.english: They repel from the way of GOD and seek to make it crooked, and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك لم يكونوا معجزين في الأرض وما كان لهم من دون الله من أولياء ۘ يضاعف لهم العذاب ۚ ما كانوا يستطيعون السمع وما كانوا يبصرون
verses.transliterated: ulāika lam yakūnū muʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa yuḍāʿafu lahumu l-ʿadhābu mā kānū yastaṭīʿūna l-samʿa wamā kānū yub'ṣirūn
verses.english: These will never escape, nor will they find any lords or masters to help them against GOD. Retribution will be doubled for them. They have failed to hear, and they have failed to see.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: They will never escape from God, nor will they find any allies against God. The retribution is doubled for them, for they failed to hear, and failed to see.
1981.footnote: These verses describe vividly those who have invented the "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" and claim that they are "divine revelations."

1989.english: They can never escape, nor will they find any allies to help them against GOD. Retribution will be doubled for them. They have failed to hear, and they have failed to see.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين خسروا أنفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: These are the ones who lose their souls, and the idols they had fabricated will disown them.

1981.english: It is these who have lost their souls, and the very inventions they fabricated have caused their doom.
1981.footnote: These verses describe vividly those who have invented the "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" and claim that they are "divine revelations."

1989.english: They are the ones who lose their souls. Even the idols they have set up will disown them.

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا جرم أنهم في الآخرة هم الأخسرون
verses.transliterated: lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūn
verses.english: There is no doubt that, in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.

1981.english: No doubt, they will be the worst losers in the hereafter.
1981.footnote: These verses describe vividly those who have invented the "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" and claim that they are "divine revelations."

1989.english: There is no doubt that, in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَخْبَتُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وأخبتوا إلى ربهم أولئك أصحاب الجنة ۖ هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wa-akhbatū ilā rabbihim ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, and devote themselves to their Lord, they are the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.
verses.subtitle: The Believers

1981.english: As for those who believe, work righteousness, and totally submit to their Lord, they have deserved Paradise, wherein they abide forever.

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, and devote themselves to their Lord, they are the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.

verses.arabic: مَثَلُ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْأَصَمِّ وَٱلْبَصِيرِ وَٱلسَّمِيعِ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: مثل الفريقين كالأعمى والأصم والبصير والسميع ۚ هل يستويان مثلا ۚ أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: mathalu l-farīqayni kal-aʿmā wal-aṣami wal-baṣīri wal-samīʿi hal yastawiyāni mathalan afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: The example of these two groups is like the blind and deaf, compared to the seer and hearer. Are they equal? Would you not take heed?

1981.english: The allegory of the groups is that of the blind and deaf, compared to the seer and hearer; are they equal? Would you not take heed?

1989.english: The two groups are like the blind and deaf, compared to the seer and hearer. Are they the same? Would you not take heed?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه إني لكم نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "I come to you as a clear warner.
verses.subtitle: Noah

1981.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "I am a manifest warner to you.
1981.subtitle:
The First Commandment
You Shall NOT Worship Except God

1989.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, “I come to you as a clear warner.
1989.subtitle: Noah

verses.arabic: أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: أن لا تعبدوا إلا الله ۖ إني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم أليم
verses.transliterated: an lā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin alīmi
verses.english: "You shall not worship except GOD. I fear for you the retribution of a painful day."

1981.english: "That you shall not worship except God. I fear for you the retribution of a painful day."
1981.footnote: See footnote 11:2.

1989.english: “You shall not worship except GOD. I fear for you the retribution of a painful day.”

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا نَرَىٰكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَىٰكَ ٱتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِىَ ٱلرَّأْىِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍۭ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فقال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه ما نراك إلا بشرا مثلنا وما نراك اتبعك إلا الذين هم أراذلنا بادي الرأي وما نرى لكم علينا من فضل بل نظنكم كاذبين
verses.transliterated: faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā narāka illā basharan mith'lanā wamā narāka ittabaʿaka illā alladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiya l-rayi wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīn
verses.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "We see that you are no more than a human being like us, and we see that the first people to follow you are the worst among us. We see that you do not possess any advantage over us. Indeed, we think you are liars."

1981.english: The elders who disbelieved among his people said, "We see that you are a human being like us, and that the worst among us were the first to follow you. We do not see any advantage for you over us, and, in fact, we think you are liars."

1989.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, “We see that you are no more than a human being like us, and we see that the first people to follow you are the worst among us. We see that you do not possess any advantage over us. Indeed, we think you are liars.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنتُمْ لَهَا كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا قوم أرأيتم إن كنت على بينة من ربي وآتاني رحمة من عنده فعميت عليكم أنلزمكموها وأنتم لها كارهون
verses.transliterated: qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī raḥmatan min ʿindihi faʿummiyat ʿalaykum anul'zimukumūhā wa-antum lahā kārihūn
verses.english: He said, "O my people, what if I have a solid proof from my Lord? What if He has blessed me out of His mercy, though you cannot see it? Are we going to force you to believe therein?

1981.english: He said, "O my people, what if I have proof from my Lord, and mercy from Him that is concealed from you? We cannot force it upon you, against your will.

1989.english: He said, “O my people, what if I have a clear proof from my Lord? What if He has blessed me out of His mercy, and you cannot see it? Are we going to force you to believe therein?

verses.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويا قوم لا أسألكم عليه مالا ۖ إن أجري إلا على الله ۚ وما أنا بطارد الذين آمنوا ۚ إنهم ملاقو ربهم ولكني أراكم قوما تجهلون
verses.transliterated: wayāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi mālan in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wamā anā biṭāridi alladhīna āmanū innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūn
verses.english: "O my people, I do not ask you for any money; my wage comes only from GOD. I am not dismissing those who believed; they will meet their Lord (and He alone will judge them). I see that you are ignorant people.

1981.english: "And, O my people, I do not ask you for any money; my wage comes from God. I cannot dismiss those who believe; they will face their Lord, and He is the one to judge them. Indeed, I see that you are ignorant people.

1989.english: “O my people, I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes only from GOD. I am not dismissing those who believed; they will meet their Lord (and He alone will judge them). I see that you are ignorant people.

verses.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويا قوم من ينصرني من الله إن طردتهم ۚ أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: wayāqawmi man yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ṭaradttuhum afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: "O my people, who can support me against GOD, if I dismiss them? Would you not take heed?

1981.english: "And, O my people, who would support me against God, if I dismiss them? Would you not be reasonable?

1989.english: “O my people, who can support me against GOD, if I dismiss them? Would you not take heed?

verses.arabic: وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِىٓ أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرًا ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا أقول لكم عندي خزائن الله ولا أعلم الغيب ولا أقول إني ملك ولا أقول للذين تزدري أعينكم لن يؤتيهم الله خيرا ۖ الله أعلم بما في أنفسهم ۖ إني إذا لمن الظالمين
verses.transliterated: walā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakun walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdarī aʿyunukum lan yu'tiyahumu l-lahu khayran l-lahu aʿlamu bimā fī anfusihim innī idhan lamina l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: "I do not claim that I possess the treasures of GOD, nor do I know the future, nor do I claim to be an angel. Nor do I say to those despised by your eyes that GOD will not bestow any blessings upon them. GOD knows best what is in their innermost thoughts. (If I did this,) I would be a transgressor."
verses.subtitle: All Power Belongs to God

1981.english: "I do not say that I possess the treasures of God, nor do I know the future, nor do I say that I am an angel, nor can I say that the people you despise will attain no mercy from God; God knows their true convictions. If I do, I would be unjust."

1989.english: “I do not claim that I possess the treasures of GOD, nor do I know the future, nor do I claim to be an angel. Nor do I say to those despised by your eyes that GOD will not bestow any blessings upon them. GOD knows best what is in their innermost thoughts. (If I did this,) I would be a transgressor."

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰنُوحُ قَدْ جَٰدَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا نوح قد جادلتنا فأكثرت جدالنا فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: qālū yānūḥu qad jādaltanā fa-aktharta jidālanā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They said, "O Noah, you have argued with us, and kept on arguing. We challenge you to bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful."

1981.english: They said, "O Noah, you argued with us too much. Bring us the doom you are threatening, if you are truthful."

1989.english: They said, “O Noah, you have argued with us, and kept on arguing. We challenge you to bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إنما يأتيكم به الله إن شاء وما أنتم بمعجزين
verses.transliterated: qāla innamā yatīkum bihi l-lahu in shāa wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīn
verses.english: He said, "GOD is the One who brings it to you, if He so wills, then you cannot escape.

1981.english: He said, "God is the only one who can bring it, if He so wills, then you can never escape.

1989.english: He said, “GOD is the One who brings it to you, if He so wills, then you cannot escape.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِىٓ إِنْ أَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَنصَحَ لَكُمْ إِن كَانَ ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا ينفعكم نصحي إن أردت أن أنصح لكم إن كان الله يريد أن يغويكم ۚ هو ربكم وإليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: walā yanfaʿukum nuṣ'ḥī in aradttu an anṣaḥa lakum in kāna l-lahu yurīdu an yugh'wiyakum huwa rabbukum wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: "Even if I advised you, my advice cannot benefit you if it is GOD's will to send you astray. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."

1981.english: "My concern for you, even if I do care about you, will be useless, if God's will is to send you astray. He is your Lord, and to Him is your final return."

1989.english: “Even if I advised you, my advice cannot benefit you if it is GOD’s will to send you astray. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned.”

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَعَلَىَّ إِجْرَامِى وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون افتراه ۖ قل إن افتريته فعلي إجرامي وأنا بريء مما تجرمون
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu faʿalayya ij'rāmī wa-anā barīon mimmā tuj'rimūn
verses.english: If they say, "He made up this story," then say, "If I made it up, then I am responsible for my crime, and I am innocent of any crime you commit."

1981.english: If they say, "He made it up," then say, "If I made it up, then I am responsible for my crime, and I am innocent of your crimes."

1989.english: If they say, “He made up this story,” then say, “If I made it up, then I am responsible for my crime, and I am innocent of any crime you commit.”

verses.arabic: وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُۥ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدْ ءَامَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأوحي إلى نوح أنه لن يؤمن من قومك إلا من قد آمن فلا تبتئس بما كانوا يفعلون
verses.transliterated: waūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabta-is bimā kānū yafʿalūn
verses.english: Noah was inspired: "No more of your people are going to believe, beyond those who already believe. Do not be saddened by their actions.

1981.english: It was revealed to Noah that, "No more of your people will believe. Do not be saddened by their actions."

1989.english: Noah was inspired: “No more of your people are going to believe, beyond those who have already believed. Do not be saddened by their actions.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واصنع الفلك بأعيننا ووحينا ولا تخاطبني في الذين ظلموا ۚ إنهم مغرقون
verses.transliterated: wa-iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūn
verses.english: "Build the ark under our watchful eyes, and with our inspiration, and do not implore Me on behalf of those who have transgressed; they are destined to drown."

1981.english: "And build the ark under our eyes, and with our inspiration. And do not defend the evildoers; they will be drowned."

1989.english: “Build the ark under our watchful eyes, and with our inspiration, and do not implore Me on behalf of those who have transgressed; they are destined to drown.”

verses.arabic: وَيَصْنَعُ ٱلْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُ قَالَ إِن تَسْخَرُوا۟ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويصنع الفلك وكلما مر عليه ملأ من قومه سخروا منه ۚ قال إن تسخروا منا فإنا نسخر منكم كما تسخرون
verses.transliterated: wayaṣnaʿu l-ful'ka wakullamā marra ʿalayhi mala-on min qawmihi sakhirū min'hu qāla in taskharū minnā fa-innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūn
verses.english: While he was building the ark, whenever some of his people passed by him they laughed at him. He said, "You may be laughing at us, but we are laughing at you, just as you are laughing.
verses.subtitle: He Who Laughs Last Laughs Best

1981.english: As he built the ark, his people mocked him whenever they passed by him. He said, "You may mock us, but we mock you, just as you are mocking us.

1989.english: While he was building the ark, whenever some of his people passed by him they laughed at him. He said, “You may be laughing at us, but we are laughing at you, just as you are laughing.

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فسوف تعلمون من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
verses.transliterated: fasawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmu
verses.english: "You will surely find out who will suffer a shameful retribution, and incur an everlasting punishment."

1981.english: "You will find out which of us will deserve a humiliating retribution, and abide in everlasting misery."

1989.english: “You will soon find out who will suffer a shameful retribution, and incur an everlasting punishment.”

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا ٱحْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
verses.arabicClean: حتى إذا جاء أمرنا وفار التنور قلنا احمل فيها من كل زوجين اثنين وأهلك إلا من سبق عليه القول ومن آمن ۚ وما آمن معه إلا قليل
verses.transliterated: ḥattā idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru qul'nā iḥ'mil fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu waman āmana wamā āmana maʿahu illā qalīlu
verses.english: When our judgment came, and the atmosphere boiled over, we said, "Carry on it a pair of each kind, together with your family, except those who are condemned. Carry with you those who have believed," and only a few have believed with him.
verses.footnote: & 44 This is God's proven truth: Noah's ark was made of logs, tied together with primitive ropes (54:13). Contrary to common belief, the flood was limited to the area around today's Dead Sea, and the animals were only Noah's livestock; not every animal that lived on earth.

1981.english: When our judgment came, and the water fountains gushed out, we said, "Carry a pair of each kind, and your family, except those who have been condemned, and those who believed;" only a few believed with him.

1989.english: When our judgment came, and the pot boiled over, we said, “Carry on it a pair of each kind,* together with your family, except those who are condemned. Carry with you those who have believed,” and they were only a few.
1989.footnote: & 44 Noah’s ark was simply logs tied together (see 54:13), the flood was limited to the area around today’s Dead Sea, and the animals were only Noah’s livestock. The story tellers grossly exaggerated the ark, the flood, and the animals.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱرْكَبُوا۟ فِيهَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْر۪ىٰهَا وَمُرْسَىٰهَآ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقال اركبوا فيها بسم الله مجراها ومرساها ۚ إن ربي لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: waqāla ir'kabū fīhā bis'mi l-lahi majrahā wamur'sāhā inna rabbī laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: He said, "Come on board. In the name of GOD shall be its sailing, and its mooring. My Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful."

1981.english: He said, "Ride therein, in the name of God shall be its running, and its mooring. Indeed, my Lord is forgiver, merciful."

1989.english: He said, “Come on board. In the name of GOD shall be its sailing, and its mooring. My Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: وَهِىَ تَجْرِى بِهِمْ فِى مَوْجٍ كَٱلْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبْنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِى مَعْزِلٍ يَٰبُنَىَّ ٱرْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وهي تجري بهم في موج كالجبال ونادى نوح ابنه وكان في معزل يا بني اركب معنا ولا تكن مع الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāli wanādā nūḥun ib'nahu wakāna fī maʿzilin yābunayya ir'kab maʿanā walā takun maʿa l-kāfirīn
verses.english: As it sailed with them in waves like hills, Noah called his son, who was isolated: "O my son, come ride with us; do not be with the disbelievers."

1981.english: As it moved with them on waves like hills, Noah called upon his son, who was isolated, "O my son, ride with us, and do not be with the disbelievers."

1989.english: As it sailed with them in waves like hills, Noah called his son, who was isolated: “O my son, join us; do not be with the disbelievers.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِى مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال سآوي إلى جبل يعصمني من الماء ۚ قال لا عاصم اليوم من أمر الله إلا من رحم ۚ وحال بينهما الموج فكان من المغرقين
verses.transliterated: qāla saāwī ilā jabalin yaʿṣimunī mina l-māi qāla lā ʿāṣima l-yawma min amri l-lahi illā man raḥima waḥāla baynahumā l-mawju fakāna mina l-mugh'raqīn
verses.english: He said, "I will take refuge on top of a hill, to protect me from the water." He said, "Nothing can protect anyone today from GOD's judgment; only those worthy of His mercy (will be saved)." The waves separated them, and he was among those who drowned.

1981.english: He said, "I will take refuge on top of a hill, to protect me from the water." He said, "There is no protector today from God's judgment, except for those who attain His mercy." The waves separated them, and he drowned with the others.

1989.english: He said, “I will take refuge on top of a hill, to protect me from the water.” He said, “Nothing can protect anyone today from GOD’s judgment. Only those worthy of His mercy (will be saved)” The waves separated them, and he was among those who drowned.

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ يَٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقيل يا أرض ابلعي ماءك ويا سماء أقلعي وغيض الماء وقضي الأمر واستوت على الجودي ۖ وقيل بعدا للقوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: waqīla yāarḍu ib'laʿī māaki wayāsamāu aqliʿī waghīḍa l-māu waquḍiya l-amru wa-is'tawat ʿalā l-jūdiyi waqīla buʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: It was proclaimed: "O earth, swallow your water," and "O sky, cease." The water then subsided; the judgment was fulfilled. The ark finally rested on the hills of Judea. It was then proclaimed: "The transgressors have perished."
verses.subtitle: Where Did the Ark Land

1981.english: Then it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, halt." The water subsided, and the judgment was done, and the ark rested on the Joodiy. It was said, "The wicked have perished."

1989.english: It was proclaimed: “O earth, swallow your water,” and “O sky, cease.” The water then subsided; the judgment was carried out. The ark finally rested on the hills of Judea.* It was then proclaimed: “The transgressors have perished.”

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونادى نوح ربه فقال رب إن ابني من أهلي وإن وعدك الحق وأنت أحكم الحاكمين
verses.transliterated: wanādā nūḥun rabbahu faqāla rabbi inna ib'nī min ahlī wa-inna waʿdaka l-ḥaqu wa-anta aḥkamu l-ḥākimīn
verses.english: Noah implored his Lord: "My Lord, my son is a member of my family, and Your promise is the truth. You are the wisest of the wise."

1981.english: Noah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, my son is from my family, and Your promise is truth, and You are the wisest of the wise."

1989.english: Noah implored his Lord: “My Lord, my son is a member of my family, Your promise is truthful, and You are the wisest of the wise.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَٰلِحٍ فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ إِنِّىٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا نوح إنه ليس من أهلك ۖ إنه عمل غير صالح ۖ فلا تسألن ما ليس لك به علم ۖ إني أعظك أن تكون من الجاهلين
verses.transliterated: qāla yānūḥu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tasalni mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun innī aʿiẓuka an takūna mina l-jāhilīn
verses.english: He said, "O Noah, he is not of your family. It is unrighteous to ask Me for something you do not know. I enlighten you, lest you be like the ignorant."
verses.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession
verses.footnote: Intercession is Satan's most effective bait to entice people into idol worship. However, Abraham could not help his father, nor could Noah help his son, nor could Muhammad help his own relatives (2:254, 9:80 & 114).

1981.english: God said, "O Noah, he is not from your family. It is unrighteous (to ask forgiveness for him).* Therefore, do not ask Me for what you do not know. I enlighten you, lest you be ignorant."

1989.english: He said, “O Noah, he is not of your family. It is unrighteous to ask Me for something you do not know.* I enlighten you, lest you be ignorant.”
1989.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession
1989.footnote: Intercession is Satan’s most effective bait to entice people into idol worship. However, Abraham could not help his father, nor could Noah help his son, nor could Muhammad help his own relatives (2:254, 9:80 & 114).

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب إني أعوذ بك أن أسألك ما ليس لي به علم ۖ وإلا تغفر لي وترحمني أكن من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an asalaka mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-illā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akun mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You, lest I implore You again for something I do not know. Unless You forgive me, and have mercy on me, I will be with the losers."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You, lest I ask You for what I do not know. Unless You forgive me, and have mercy on me, I will be a loser."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, I seek refuge in You lest I implore You again for something I do not know. Unless You forgive me, and have mercy on me, I will be with the losers.”

verses.arabic: قِيلَ يَٰنُوحُ ٱهْبِطْ بِسَلَٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَٰتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قيل يا نوح اهبط بسلام منا وبركات عليك وعلى أمم ممن معك ۚ وأمم سنمتعهم ثم يمسهم منا عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: qīla yānūḥu ih'biṭ bisalāmin minnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā umamin mimman maʿaka wa-umamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: It was proclaimed: "O Noah, disembark, with peace and blessings upon you, and upon nations who will descend from your companions. As for the other nations descending from you, we will bless them for awhile, then commit them to painful retribution."

1981.english: It was said, "O Noah, disembark with peace and blessings from us, upon you and generations that will come from those with you. As for the others (who do not deserve our blessings), we will let them enjoy temporarily, then afflict them with painful retribution."

1989.english: It was proclaimed: “O Noah, disembark, with peace and blessings upon you, and upon nations who will descend from your companions. As for the other nations descending from you, we will bless them for awhile, then commit them to painful retribution.”

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَٰذَا فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ ٱلْعَٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك من أنباء الغيب نوحيها إليك ۖ ما كنت تعلمها أنت ولا قومك من قبل هذا ۖ فاصبر ۖ إن العاقبة للمتقين
verses.transliterated: til'ka min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayka mā kunta taʿlamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā fa-iṣ'bir inna l-ʿāqibata lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You had no knowledge about them—neither you, nor your people—before this. Therefore, be patient. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.

1981.english: This is history from the past that we reveal to you. Neither you, nor your people knew any of this before. Therefore, you shall steadfastly persevere, for the ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.

1989.english: This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You had no knowledge about them—neither you, nor your people—before this. Therefore, be patient. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous. Hood

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا ۚ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ إن أنتم إلا مفترون
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu in antum illā muf'tarūn
verses.english: To 'Ãd we sent their brother Hûd. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. You are inventing.
verses.subtitle: Hûd: One and the Same Message

1981.english: To Aad we sent their brother Hood. He said, "O my people, worship God; you have no other god besides Him. You are only inventing.
1981.subtitle: Hood

1989.english: To Aad we sent their brother Hood. He said, “O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. You are inventing.

verses.arabic: يَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِىٓ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا قوم لا أسألكم عليه أجرا ۖ إن أجري إلا على الذي فطرني ۚ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: yāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran in ajriya illā ʿalā alladhī faṭaranī afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: "O my people, I do not ask you for any wage. My wage comes only from the One who initiated me. Do you not understand?

1981.english: "O my people, I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes from the one who created me. Would you not understand?

1989.english: “0 my people, I do not ask you for any wage. My wage comes only from the One who initiated me. Would you not understand?

verses.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويا قوم استغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا إليه يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا ويزدكم قوة إلى قوتكم ولا تتولوا مجرمين
verses.transliterated: wayāqawmi is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran wayazid'kum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw muj'rimīn
verses.english: "O my people, seek forgiveness from your Lord, then repent to Him. He will then shower you with provisions from the sky, and augment your strength. Do not turn back into transgressors."

1981.english: "And, O my people, ask forgiveness from your Lord, then repent to Him. He will then send the sky pouring generously for you, and add strength to your strength. Do not turn away as sinners."

1989.english: “O my people, seek forgiveness from your Lord, then repent to Him. He will then shower you with provisions from the sky, and augment your strength. Do not turn back like the guilty ones.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِىٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا هود ما جئتنا ببينة وما نحن بتاركي آلهتنا عن قولك وما نحن لك بمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: qālū yāhūdu mā ji'tanā bibayyinatin wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimu'minīn
verses.english: They said, "O Hûd, you did not show us any proof, and we are not abandoning our gods on account of what you say. We will never be believers with you.

1981.english: They said, "O Hood, you have not shown us any proof, and we will never abandon our gods for what you say; we will not believe with you."

1989.english: They said, “O Hood, you did not show us any proof, and we are not abandoning our gods on account of what you say. In you, we are not believers.

verses.arabic: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا ٱعْتَرَىٰكَ بَعْضُ ءَالِهَتِنَا بِسُوٓءٍ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱشْهَدُوٓا۟ أَنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن نقول إلا اعتراك بعض آلهتنا بسوء ۗ قال إني أشهد الله واشهدوا أني بريء مما تشركون
verses.transliterated: in naqūlu illā iʿ'tarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūin qāla innī ush'hidu l-laha wa-ish'hadū annī barīon mimmā tush'rikūn
verses.english: "We believe that some of our gods have afflicted you with a curse." He said, "I bear witness before GOD, and you bear witness as well, that I disown the idols you have set up—

1981.english: "We only say that our gods have afflicted you with a curse." He said, "I call upon God to bear witness, and you bear witness, that I disown the idols you set up

1989.english: “We say that some of our gods have afflicted you with a curse.” He said, “I bear witness before GOD, and you bear witness, that I disown the idols you have set up—

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِهِۦ فَكِيدُونِى جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
verses.arabicClean: من دونه ۖ فكيدوني جميعا ثم لا تنظرون
verses.transliterated: min dūnihi fakīdūnī jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūn
verses.english: "—beside Him. So, give me your collective decision, without delay.

1981.english: "besides Him. Thus, you may plot and scheme against me, all of you, without delay.

1989.english: “—besides Him. So, give me your collective response, without delay.

verses.arabic: إِنِّى تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: إني توكلت على الله ربي وربكم ۚ ما من دابة إلا هو آخذ بناصيتها ۚ إن ربي على صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: innī tawakkaltu ʿalā l-lahi rabbī warabbikum mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: "I have put my trust in GOD, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a creature that He does not control. My Lord is on the right path.

1981.english: "I have put my trust in God, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a creature on earth that He does not control. My Lord is on the right path.

1989.english: “I have put my trust in GOD, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a creature that He does not control. My Lord is on the right path.

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
verses.arabicClean: فإن تولوا فقد أبلغتكم ما أرسلت به إليكم ۚ ويستخلف ربي قوما غيركم ولا تضرونه شيئا ۚ إن ربي على كل شيء حفيظ
verses.transliterated: fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shayan inna rabbī ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓu
verses.english: "If you turn away, I have delivered to you what I was sent with. My Lord will substitute other people in your place; you cannot harm Him in the least. My Lord is in control of all things."

1981.english: "If you turn away, I have delivered to you what was entrusted to me. God will substitute others in your place, and you can never harm Him in the least. My Lord is in full control of all things."

1989.english: “If you turn away, then I have delivered to you what I was sent with. My Lord will substitute other people in your place, and you cannot harm Him in the least. My Lord is in control of all things.”

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولما جاء أمرنا نجينا هودا والذين آمنوا معه برحمة منا ونجيناهم من عذاب غليظ
verses.transliterated: walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā hūdan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wanajjaynāhum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓi
verses.english: When our judgment came, we saved Hûd and those who believed with him, by mercy from us. We saved them from a terrible retribution.

1981.english: When our judgment came, we saved Hood and those who believed with him, by mercy from us; we saved them from a terrible disaster.

1989.english: When our judgment came, we saved Hood and those who believed with him, by mercy from us. We saved them from a terrible retribution.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: وتلك عاد ۖ جحدوا بآيات ربهم وعصوا رسله واتبعوا أمر كل جبار عنيد
verses.transliterated: watil'ka ʿādun jaḥadū biāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣaw rusulahu wa-ittabaʿū amra kulli jabbārin ʿanīdi
verses.english: Such was 'Ãd—they disregarded the revelations of their Lord, disobeyed His messengers, and followed the ways of every stubborn tyrant.

1981.english: Thus was Aad, they discarded their Lord's signs, and disobeyed His messengers, and followed the orders of the stubborn tyrants.

1989.english: Such was ‘Aad—they disregarded the revelations of their Lord, disobeyed His messengers, and followed the ways of every stubborn transgressor.

verses.arabic: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأتبعوا في هذه الدنيا لعنة ويوم القيامة ۗ ألا إن عادا كفروا ربهم ۗ ألا بعدا لعاد قوم هود
verses.transliterated: wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati alā inna ʿādan kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan liʿādin qawmi hūdi
verses.english: Consequently, they incurred condemnation in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, 'Ãd rejected their Lord. Indeed, 'Ãd, the people of Hûd, have perished.

1981.english: Consequently, they incurred a curse in this life, as well as in the hereafter. Indeed, Aad have rejected their Lord. Indeed, Aad, the people of Hood, have perished.

1989.english: Consequently, they incurred condemnation in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, ‘Aad rejected their Lord. Indeed, Aad, the people of Hood, have perished. Saaleh

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى ثمود أخاهم صالحا ۚ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ هو أنشأكم من الأرض واستعمركم فيها فاستغفروه ثم توبوا إليه ۚ إن ربي قريب مجيب
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu huwa ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-is'taʿmarakum fīhā fa-is'taghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī qarībun mujību
verses.english: To Thamûd we sent their brother Sãleh. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. He initiated you from the earth, then settled you in it. You shall seek His forgiveness, then repent to Him. My Lord is always near, responsive."
verses.subtitle: Sãleh: One and the Same Message

1981.english: To Thamud we sent their brother Saalih. He said, "O my people, worship God, you have no other god besides Him. He initiated you from the earth, and settled you therein. Therefore, you shall ask His forgiveness, then repent to Him. My Lord is near, responsive."
1981.subtitle: Saalih

1989.english: To Thamoud we sent their brother Saaleh. He said, “O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. He initiated you from the earth, then settled you therein. You shall seek His forgiveness, then repent to Him. My Lord is near, responsive.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰصَٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَٰذَآ أَتَنْهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا صالح قد كنت فينا مرجوا قبل هذا ۖ أتنهانا أن نعبد ما يعبد آباؤنا وإننا لفي شك مما تدعونا إليه مريب
verses.transliterated: qālū yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an naʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāunā wa-innanā lafī shakkin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi murībi
verses.english: They said, "O Sãleh, you used to be popular among us before this. Are you enjoining us from worshiping what our parents are worshiping? We are full of doubt concerning everything you have told us."

1981.english: They said, "O Saalih, you used to be popular among us. Do you forbid us from idolizing what our parents have idolized? We are doubtful of what you tell us; very doubtful."

1989.english: They said, “O Saaleh, you used to be popular among us before this. Are you enjoining us from worshiping what our parents are worshiping? We have a lot of doubt concerning everything you tell us.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُۥ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِى غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا قوم أرأيتم إن كنت على بينة من ربي وآتاني منه رحمة فمن ينصرني من الله إن عصيته ۖ فما تزيدونني غير تخسير
verses.transliterated: qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī min'hu raḥmatan faman yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ʿaṣaytuhu famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīri
verses.english: He said, "O my people, what if I have solid proof from my Lord, and mercy from Him? Who would support me against GOD, if I disobeyed Him? You can only augment my loss.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers Always Losers

1981.english: He said, "O my people, what if I have a proof from my Lord, and mercy? Who would support me against God, if I disobeyed Him. You can only increase my problems.

1989.english: He said, “O my people, what if I have solid proof from my Lord, and mercy from Him? Who would support me against GOD, if I disobeyed Him? You can only augment my loss.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers Always Losers

verses.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: ويا قوم هذه ناقة الله لكم آية فذروها تأكل في أرض الله ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب قريب
verses.transliterated: wayāqawmi hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun qarību
verses.english: "O my people, this is GOD's camel to serve as a proof for you. You shall let her eat from GOD's earth, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur an immediate retribution."

1981.english: "And, O my people, here is God's camel as a sign for you. You shall let her graze on God's land, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur an immediate disaster."

1989.english: “O my people, this is GOD’s camel to serve as a sign for you. You shall let her eat from GOD’s earth, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur unavoidable retribution ”

verses.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فِى دَارِكُمْ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ
verses.arabicClean: فعقروها فقال تمتعوا في داركم ثلاثة أيام ۖ ذلك وعد غير مكذوب
verses.transliterated: faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyāmin dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūbi
verses.english: They slaughtered her. He then said, "You have only three days to live. This is a prophecy that is inevitable."

1981.english: But they slaughtered her, and he said, "You will live only three days in your homeland; this is a promise that will never fail."

1989.english: They slaughtered her. He then said, “You have only three days to live. This is a prophecy that is inevitable.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَٰلِحًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْىِ يَوْمِئِذٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاء أمرنا نجينا صالحا والذين آمنوا معه برحمة منا ومن خزي يومئذ ۗ إن ربك هو القوي العزيز
verses.transliterated: falammā jāa amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wamin khiz'yi yawmi-idhin inna rabbaka huwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīz
verses.english: When our judgment came, we saved Sãleh and those who believed with him by mercy from us, from the humiliation of that day. Your Lord is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

1981.english: When our judgment came, we saved Saalih and those who believed, by mercy from us, from the humiliation of that day. Your Lord is the most powerful, the almighty.

1989.english: When our judgment came, we saved Saaleh and those who believed with him by mercy from us, from the humiliation of that day. Your Lord is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

verses.arabic: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَٰرِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأخذ الذين ظلموا الصيحة فأصبحوا في ديارهم جاثمين
verses.transliterated: wa-akhadha alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīn
verses.english: Those who transgressed were annihilated by the disaster, leaving them in their homes, dead.

1981.english: And the disaster struck the wicked, leaving them dead in their homes.

1989.english: Those who transgressed were annihilated by the quake, leaving them in their homes, dead.

verses.arabic: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ
verses.arabicClean: كأن لم يغنوا فيها ۗ ألا إن ثمود كفروا ربهم ۗ ألا بعدا لثمود
verses.transliterated: ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā inna thamūdā kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan lithamūd
verses.english: It was as if they never lived there. Indeed, Thamûd have rejected their Lord. Absolutely, Thamûd have incurred their annihilation.

1981.english: It was as though they never existed. Behold! Thamud have rejected their Lord. Behold! Thamud have perished.

1989.english: It was as if they never lived there. Indeed, Thamoud have rejected their Lord; Thamoud have perished.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جاءت رسلنا إبراهيم بالبشرى قالوا سلاما ۖ قال سلام ۖ فما لبث أن جاء بعجل حنيذ
verses.transliterated: walaqad jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū salāman qāla salāmun famā labitha an jāa biʿij'lin ḥanīdhi
verses.english: When our messengers went to Abraham with good news, they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and soon brought a roasted calf.
verses.subtitle: Abraham and Lot

1981.english: When our messengers went to Abraham, carrying good news, they said, "Peace," and he said, "Peace." Soon, he brought a roasted calf.
1981.subtitle: Abraham

1989.english: When our messengers went to Abraham with good news, they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace,” and soon brought a roasted calf.
1989.subtitle: Abraham and Lot

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأى أيديهم لا تصل إليه نكرهم وأوجس منهم خيفة ۚ قالوا لا تخف إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم لوط
verses.transliterated: falammā raā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum wa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmi lūṭi
verses.english: When he saw that their hands did not touch it, he became suspicious and fearful of them. They said, "Do not be afraid, we are being dispatched to the people of Lot."

1981.english: When he saw that they did not reach for it, he feared them. They said, "Have no fear; we are being sent to the people of Lot."

1989.english: When he saw that their hands did not touch it, he became suspicious and fearful of them. They said, “Do not be afraid, we are being dispatched to the people of Lot.”

verses.arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَٰهَا بِإِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ
verses.arabicClean: وامرأته قائمة فضحكت فبشرناها بإسحاق ومن وراء إسحاق يعقوب
verses.transliterated: wa-im'ra-atuhu qāimatun faḍaḥikat fabasharnāhā bi-is'ḥāqa wamin warāi is'ḥāqa yaʿqūb
verses.english: His wife was standing, and she laughed when we gave her the good news about Isaac, and after Isaac, Jacob.

1981.english: His wife stood there and laughed, when we gave her the good news of Isaac, and, after Isaac, Jacob.

1989.english: His wife was standing, and she laughed when we gave her the good news about Isaac, and after Isaac, Jacob.

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌ وَهَٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: قالت يا ويلتى أألد وأنا عجوز وهذا بعلي شيخا ۖ إن هذا لشيء عجيب
verses.transliterated: qālat yāwaylatā a-alidu wa-anā ʿajūzun wahādhā baʿlī shaykhan inna hādhā lashayon ʿajību
verses.english: She said, "Woe to me, how could I bear a child at my age, and here is my husband; an old man? This is really strange!"

1981.english: She said, "How can I bear a child at my old age, and my husband is an old man? This is really strange."

1989.english: She said, “Woe to me, how could I bear a child at my age, and my husband is an old man? This is really strange!”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أتعجبين من أمر الله ۖ رحمت الله وبركاته عليكم أهل البيت ۚ إنه حميد مجيد
verses.transliterated: qālū ataʿjabīna min amri l-lahi raḥmatu l-lahi wabarakātuhu ʿalaykum ahla l-bayti innahu ḥamīdun majīdu
verses.english: They said, "Do you find it strange for GOD? GOD has bestowed His mercy and blessings upon you, O inhabitants of the shrine. He is Praiseworthy, Glorious."

1981.english: They said, "Do you find God's command strange? God's mercy and blessings are upon you, O people of the shrine. He is praiseworthy, glorious."

1989.english: They said,“Do you find it too strange for GOD? GOD has bestowed His mercy and blessings upon you, O inhabitants of the shrine. He is Praiseworthy, Glorious.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ وَجَآءَتْهُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
verses.arabicClean: فلما ذهب عن إبراهيم الروع وجاءته البشرى يجادلنا في قوم لوط
verses.transliterated: falammā dhahaba ʿan ib'rāhīma l-rawʿu wajāathu l-bush'rā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭi
verses.english: When Abraham's fear subsided, and the good news was delivered to him, he proceeded to argue with us on behalf of Lot's people.

1981.english: When Abraham's fears subsided, and he received the good news, he started to defend the people of Lot.

1989.english: When Abraham’s fear subsided, and the good news was delivered to him, he proceeded to argue with us on behalf of Lot’s people.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّٰهٌ مُّنِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن إبراهيم لحليم أواه منيب
verses.transliterated: inna ib'rāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhun munību
verses.english: Indeed, Abraham was clement, extremely kind, and obedient.

1981.english: Indeed, Abraham was clement, compassionate, and obedient.

1989.english: Indeed, Abraham was clement, extremely kind, and obedient.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ
verses.arabicClean: يا إبراهيم أعرض عن هذا ۖ إنه قد جاء أمر ربك ۖ وإنهم آتيهم عذاب غير مردود
verses.transliterated: yāib'rāhīmu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā innahu qad jāa amru rabbika wa-innahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūdi
verses.english: "O Abraham, refrain from this. Your Lord's judgment has been issued; they have incurred unavoidable retribution."

1981.english: O Abraham, refrain from this; your Lord's judgment has come. They have deserved unavoidable retribution.

1989.english: “O Abraham, refrain from this. Your Lord’s judgment has been issued; they have incurred unavoidable retribution.”

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولما جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا وقال هذا يوم عصيب
verses.transliterated: walammā jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣību
verses.english: When our messengers went to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed by their presence. He said, "This is a difficult day."
verses.subtitle: Homosexuality Condemned

1981.english: When our messengers went to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed by them. He said, "This is a difficult day."
1981.subtitle: Lot

1989.english: When our messengers went to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed by their presence. He said, “This is a difficult day.”
1989.subtitle: Homosexuality Condemned

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: وجاءه قومه يهرعون إليه ومن قبل كانوا يعملون السيئات ۚ قال يا قوم هؤلاء بناتي هن أطهر لكم ۖ فاتقوا الله ولا تخزون في ضيفي ۖ أليس منكم رجل رشيد
verses.transliterated: wajāahu qawmuhu yuh'raʿūna ilayhi wamin qablu kānū yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti qāla yāqawmi hāulāi banātī hunna aṭharu lakum fa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni fī ḍayfī alaysa minkum rajulun rashīdu
verses.english: His people came rushing; they had grown accustomed to their sinful acts. He said, "O my people, it would be purer for you, if you take my daughters instead. You shall reverence GOD; do not embarrass me with my guests. Have you not one reasonable man among you?"

1981.english: His people came rushing, hoping to practice their evil ways. He said, "O my people, take my daughters instead; they are purer for you. Observe God, and do not embarrass me with my guests. Is there any reasonable man among you?"

1989.english: His people came rushing; they were accustomed to committing sins. He said, “O my people, it would be purer for you, if you take my daughters instead. Observe GOD; do not embarrass me with my guests. Have you not one reasonable man among you?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا لقد علمت ما لنا في بناتك من حق وإنك لتعلم ما نريد
verses.transliterated: qālū laqad ʿalim'ta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqqin wa-innaka lataʿlamu mā nurīd
verses.english: They said, "You know well that we have no need for your daughters; you know exactly what we want."

1981.english: They said, "You know well our rights to your daughters, and you know well what we want."

1989.english: They said, “You know well that we have no need for your d a u g h t e r s you know exactly what we want.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال لو أن لي بكم قوة أو آوي إلى ركن شديد
verses.transliterated: qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruk'nin shadīdi
verses.english: He said, "I wish I were strong enough, or had a powerful ally!"

1981.english: He said, "I wish I had power over you, or find a mighty ally."

1989.english: He said, “I wish I were strong enough, or had a powerful ally!”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا لوط إنا رسل ربك لن يصلوا إليك ۖ فأسر بأهلك بقطع من الليل ولا يلتفت منكم أحد إلا امرأتك ۖ إنه مصيبها ما أصابهم ۚ إن موعدهم الصبح ۚ أليس الصبح بقريب
verses.transliterated: qālū yālūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilū ilayka fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illā im'ra-ataka innahu muṣībuhā mā aṣābahum inna mawʿidahumu l-ṣub'ḥu alaysa l-ṣub'ḥu biqarībi
verses.english: (The angels) said, "O Lot, we are your Lord's messengers, and these people cannot touch you. You shall leave with your family during the night, and let not anyone of you look back, except your wife; she is condemned along with those who are condemned. Their appointed time is the morning. Is not the morning soon enough?"
