1981.english: Recall that Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a peaceful place, and protect me and my children from idol-worship.
1981.subtitle: Abraham

1989.english: Recall that Abraham said, “My Lord, make this a peaceful land, and protect me and my children from worshiping idols.
1989.subtitle: Abraham

verses.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: رب إنهن أضللن كثيرا من الناس ۖ فمن تبعني فإنه مني ۖ ومن عصاني فإنك غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: rabbi innahunna aḍlalna kathīran mina l-nāsi faman tabiʿanī fa-innahu minnī waman ʿaṣānī fa-innaka ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: "My Lord, they have misled so many people. As for those who follow me, they belong with me. As for those who disobey me, You are Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: "My Lord, the idols have led too many people astray. Therefore, whoever follows me belongs with me, and if anyone disobeys me, then You are forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: “My Lord, the idols have misled so many people. As for those who followed me, they belong with me. As for those who disobeyed me, You are Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا إني أسكنت من ذريتي بواد غير ذي زرع عند بيتك المحرم ربنا ليقيموا الصلاة فاجعل أفئدة من الناس تهوي إليهم وارزقهم من الثمرات لعلهم يشكرون
verses.transliterated: rabbanā innī askantu min dhurriyyatī biwādin ghayri dhī zarʿin ʿinda baytika l-muḥarami rabbanā liyuqīmū l-ṣalata fa-ij'ʿal afidatan mina l-nāsi tahwī ilayhim wa-ur'zuq'hum mina l-thamarāti laʿallahum yashkurūn
verses.english: "Our Lord, I have settled part of my family in this plantless valley, at Your Sacred House. Our Lord, they are to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), so let throngs of people converge upon them, and provide for them all kinds of fruits, that they may be appreciative.

1981.english: "My Lord, I have settled some of my family in this plantless valley, at Your sacred shrine. Our Lord, this is to let them observe the **salat** prayers, so make throngs of people come to them, and provide them with fruits, that they may be appreciative.

1989.english: “Our Lord, I have settled part of my family in this plantless valley, at Your Sacred House. Our Lord, they are to observe the contact prayers (Salat), so let throngs of people converge upon them, and provide for them all kinds of fruits, that they may be appreciative.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا إنك تعلم ما نخفي وما نعلن ۗ وما يخفى على الله من شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء
verses.transliterated: rabbanā innaka taʿlamu mā nukh'fī wamā nuʿ'linu wamā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min shayin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samā
verses.english: "Our Lord, You know whatever we conceal and whatever we declare— nothing is hidden from GOD on earth, nor in the heavens.

1981.english: "Our Lord, You know everything we conceal, and everything we declare. Nothing is hidden from God in the earth, nor in the heaven.

1989.english: “Our Lord, You know whatever we conceal and whatever we declare— nothing is hidden from GOD on earth, nor in the heavens.

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verses.arabicClean: الحمد لله الذي وهب لي على الكبر إسماعيل وإسحاق ۚ إن ربي لسميع الدعاء
verses.transliterated: al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī wahaba lī ʿalā l-kibari is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa inna rabbī lasamīʿu l-duʿā
verses.english: "Praise be to GOD for granting me, despite my old age, Ismail and Isaac. My Lord answers the prayers.

1981.english: "Praise be to God, who granted me, despite my old age, Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the hearer of all prayers.

1989.english: “Praise be to GOD for granting me, at an old age, Ismail and Isaac. My Lord answers the prayers.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
verses.arabicClean: رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاة ومن ذريتي ۚ ربنا وتقبل دعاء
verses.transliterated: rabbi ij'ʿalnī muqīma l-ṣalati wamin dhurriyyatī rabbanā wataqabbal duʿā
verses.english: "My Lord, make me one who consistently observes the Contact Prayers (Salat), and also my children. Our Lord, please answer my prayers.
verses.subtitle: The Contact Prayers: Gift From God

1981.english: "My Lord, make me an observer of **salat**, and also some of my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my prayers.

1989.english: “My Lord, make me one who consistently observes the contact prayers (Salat), and also my children. Our Lord, please answer my prayers.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا اغفر لي ولوالدي وللمؤمنين يوم يقوم الحساب
verses.transliterated: rabbanā igh'fir lī waliwālidayya walil'mu'minīna yawma yaqūmu l-ḥisāb
verses.english: "My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and the believers, on the day when the reckoning takes place."

1981.english: "Our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers, on the day the reckoning takes place."

1989.english: “My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and the believers, on the day when the reckoning takes place.”

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تحسبن الله غافلا عما يعمل الظالمون ۚ إنما يؤخرهم ليوم تشخص فيه الأبصار
verses.transliterated: walā taḥsabanna l-laha ghāfilan ʿammā yaʿmalu l-ẓālimūna innamā yu-akhiruhum liyawmin tashkhaṣu fīhi l-abṣār
verses.english: Do not ever think that GOD is unaware of what the transgressors are doing. He only respites them until a day where the eyes stare in horror.

1981.english: Do not think that God is ever unaware of what the wicked are doing. He respites them until a day wherein the eyes will stare in horror.
1981.subtitle: The Day of Reckoning
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: Do not think that GOD is unaware of what the transgressors do. He only respites them until a day where the eyes stare in horror.

verses.arabic: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ
verses.arabicClean: مهطعين مقنعي رءوسهم لا يرتد إليهم طرفهم ۖ وأفئدتهم هواء
verses.transliterated: muh'ṭiʿīna muq'niʿī ruūsihim lā yartaddu ilayhim ṭarfuhum wa-afidatuhum hawāo
verses.english: As they rush (out of the graves), their faces will be looking upward, their eyes will not even blink, and their minds will be horrified.

1981.english: They rise instantaneously, looking upward, and their eyes will not even blink; their minds will be terrified.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: As they rush (out of the graves), their faces will be looking upward, their eyes will not even blink, and their minds will be horrified.

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأنذر الناس يوم يأتيهم العذاب فيقول الذين ظلموا ربنا أخرنا إلى أجل قريب نجب دعوتك ونتبع الرسل ۗ أولم تكونوا أقسمتم من قبل ما لكم من زوال
verses.transliterated: wa-andhiri l-nāsa yawma yatīhimu l-ʿadhābu fayaqūlu alladhīna ẓalamū rabbanā akhir'nā ilā ajalin qarībin nujib daʿwataka wanattabiʿi l-rusula awalam takūnū aqsamtum min qablu mā lakum min zawāli
verses.english: You shall warn the people of the day when the retribution comes to them. Those who transgressed will say, "Our Lord, give us one more respite. We will then respond to Your call and follow the messengers." Did you not swear in the past that you will last forever?
verses.subtitle: God Sends His Commands Through His Messengers

1981.english: You shall warn the people of the retribution. When it comes, the evildoers will say, "Our Lord, if You give us another chance, we will respond to Your invitation, and follow the messengers." Did you not act previously as if you will never pass away?"
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: You shall warn the people of the day when the retribution comes to them. Those who transgressed will say, “Our Lord, give us one more chance. We will then respond to Your call and follow the messengers.” Did you not swear in the past that you will last forever?
1989.subtitle: God Sends His Commands Through His Messengers

verses.arabic: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
verses.arabicClean: وسكنتم في مساكن الذين ظلموا أنفسهم وتبين لكم كيف فعلنا بهم وضربنا لكم الأمثال
verses.transliterated: wasakantum fī masākini alladhīna ẓalamū anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faʿalnā bihim waḍarabnā lakumu l-amthāl
verses.english: You dwelled in the homes of those before you, who wronged their souls, and you have seen clearly what we did to them. We have set many precedents for you.

1981.english: And you dwelt in the dwellings of those before you who wronged their souls, and you found out what we did to them; we set the examples for you.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: Even though you lived in the homes of those before you, who also wronged their souls! You have clearly seen what we did to them. We have set many examples for you.

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
verses.arabicClean: وقد مكروا مكرهم وعند الله مكرهم وإن كان مكرهم لتزول منه الجبال
verses.transliterated: waqad makarū makrahum waʿinda l-lahi makruhum wa-in kāna makruhum litazūla min'hu l-jibāl
verses.english: They schemed their schemes, and GOD is fully aware of their schemes. Indeed, their schemes were sufficient to erase mountains.

1981.english: They schemed their schemes, and God recorded their schemes. Indeed, their scheming was enough to wipe out mountains.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: They schemed their schemes, and GOD is fully aware of their schemes. Indeed, their schemes were sufficient to erase mountains.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تحسبن الله مخلف وعده رسله ۗ إن الله عزيز ذو انتقام
verses.transliterated: falā taḥsabanna l-laha mukh'lifa waʿdihi rusulahu inna l-laha ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmi
verses.english: Do not think that GOD will ever break His promise to His messengers. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.
verses.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory for God's Messengers

1981.english: Do not ever think that God will break His promise to His messengers. God is almighty, avenger.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: Do not think that GOD will ever break His promise to His messengers GOD is Almighty, Avenger.
1989.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory for God’s Messengers

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تبدل الأرض غير الأرض والسماوات ۖ وبرزوا لله الواحد القهار
verses.transliterated: yawma tubaddalu l-arḍu ghayra l-arḍi wal-samāwātu wabarazū lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahār
verses.english: The day will come when this earth will be substituted with a new earth, and also the heavens, and everyone will be brought before GOD, the One, the Supreme.
verses.subtitle: New Heavens and New Earth
verses.footnote: This prophecy is also found in the Old Testament (Isaiah 65:17 & 66:22) and the New Testament: "What we await are new heavens and a new earth where, according to his promise, the justice of God will reside." (2 Peter 3:13).

1981.english: On that day, a new earth will replace this earth, and also the heavens will be replaced, and all will rise up before God, the One, the supreme.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: The day will come when this earth will be substituted with a new earth, and also the heavens, and everyone will be brought before GOD, the One, the Supreme.
1989.subtitle: New Heavens and New Earth
1989.footnote: This prophecy is also found in the Old Testament (Isaiah 65:17 & 66:22) and the New Testament: “What we await are new heavens and a new earth where, according tc his promise, the justice of God will reside. ” (2 Peter 3:13).

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.arabicClean: وترى المجرمين يومئذ مقرنين في الأصفاد
verses.transliterated: watarā l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin muqarranīna fī l-aṣfād
verses.english: And you will see the guilty on that day chained in shackles.

1981.english: And you will see the guilty on that day chained in shackles.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: And you will see the guilty on that day chained in shackles.

verses.arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
verses.arabicClean: سرابيلهم من قطران وتغشى وجوههم النار
verses.transliterated: sarābīluhum min qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu l-nār
verses.english: Their garments will be made of tar, and fire will overwhelm their faces.

1981.english: Their garments will be made of tar, and fire will envelope their faces.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: Their garments will be made of tar, and fire will overwhelm their faces.

verses.arabic: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: ليجزي الله كل نفس ما كسبت ۚ إن الله سريع الحساب
verses.transliterated: liyajziya l-lahu kulla nafsin mā kasabat inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisāb
verses.english: For GOD will pay each soul for whatever it earned; GOD is the most efficient reckoner.

1981.english: For God repays every soul for whatever it earned; God's reckoning is swift.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: For GOD will pay each soul for whatever it earned; GOD is the most efficient reckoner.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: هذا بلاغ للناس ولينذروا به وليعلموا أنما هو إله واحد وليذكر أولو الألباب
verses.transliterated: hādhā balāghun lilnnāsi waliyundharū bihi waliyaʿlamū annamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ulū l-albāb
verses.english: This is a proclamation for the people, to be warned herewith, and to let them know that He is only one god, and for those who possess intelligence to take heed.

1981.english: This is a declaration for the people, in order to be forewarned, and to know that there is only one God, and to let those who possess intelligence take heed.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 10 for details.

1989.english: This is a proclamation for the people, to be warned herewith, that they may know that He is only one god. Those who possess intelligence will take heed.

verses.arabic: الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الر ۚ تلك آيات الكتاب وقرآن مبين
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīni
verses.english: A.L.R. These (letters) are proofs of this scripture; a profound Quran.
verses.footnote: & ±15:9 The divine source and the perfect preservation of the Quran are proven by the Quran's mathematical code (App. 1). God's Messenger of the Covenant was destined to unveil this great miracle. The word "Dhikr" denotes the Quran's code in several verses (15:6, 21:2, 26:5, 38:1, 38:8, 74:31). The value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230)+15+9=1254, 19x66.

1981.english: A.L.R.* These (letters) constitute the miracles of this scripture; the profound Quran.
1981.footnote: See footnote 10:1 for the meaning of these letters.

1989.english: A.L.R.* These (letters) are miracles of this scripture; a profound Quran.
1989.footnote: & *15:9 The divine source and the perfect preservation of the Quran are proven by the Quran’s mathematical code (App. 1). The name of the person destined to unveil the Quran’s miracle is mathematically coded into the crucial verse 15:9 (Appendix 2).

verses.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ربما يود الذين كفروا لو كانوا مسلمين
verses.transliterated: rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīn
verses.english: Certainly, those who disbelieved will wish they were submitters.

1981.english: Perhaps those who disbelieved should wish to be Muslims.

1989.english: Perhaps those who disbelieved will wish they were Muslims.

verses.arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذرهم يأكلوا ويتمتعوا ويلههم الأمل ۖ فسوف يعلمون
verses.transliterated: dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Let them eat, enjoy, and remain blinded by wishful thinking; they will find out.

1981.english: Let them eat and enjoy themselves, and get distracted by wishful thinking, for they will ultimately find out.

1989.english: Let them eat, enjoy, and remain blinded by wishful thinking; they will surely find out.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا ولها كتاب معلوم
verses.transliterated: wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmu
verses.english: We never annihilated any community, except in accordance with a specific, predetermined time.

1981.english: We have not destroyed any community without fulfilling a specific system.

1989.english: We never annihilated any community, except in accordance with a specific, predetermined time.

verses.arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما تسبق من أمة أجلها وما يستأخرون
verses.transliterated: mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūn
verses.english: The end of any community can never be advanced, nor delayed.

1981.english: No community can hasten its end, nor can they delay it.

1989.english: The end of any community can never be advanced, nor delayed.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا يا أيها الذي نزل عليه الذكر إنك لمجنون
verses.transliterated: waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnu
verses.english: They said, "O you who received this reminder, you are crazy.

1981.english: They said, "O you who received the message, you are crazy.

1989.english: They said, “O you who received this message, you are crazy.

verses.arabic: لَّوْمَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لو ما تأتينا بالملائكة إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: "Why do you not bring down the angels, if you are truthful?"

1981.english: "Why do you not bring the angels, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: “Why do you not bring down the angels, if you are truthful?”

verses.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ما ننزل الملائكة إلا بالحق وما كانوا إذا منظرين
verses.transliterated: mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīn
verses.english: We do not send down the angels except for specific functions. Otherwise, no one will be respited.

1981.english: We do not send down the angels, except for specific functions. Otherwise, no one will be respited.

1989.english: We do not send down the angels except for a specific purpose. Otherwise, no one will be respited. Perfect Preservation of the Quran*

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا نحن نزلنا الذكر وإنا له لحافظون
verses.transliterated: innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūn
verses.english: Absolutely, we have revealed the reminder, and, absolutely, we will preserve it.
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant

1981.english: Surely, we sent down this message, and surely, we will preserve it.
1981.subtitle: God's Promise
1981.footnote: The Quran's miraculous numerical code, a divinely guarded secret for the last 1400 years, proves the two components of this verse: (1) that the Quran is a divine scripture, and (2) that it has been perfectly protected from the slightest distortion. See Appendices 1 and 2 for details.

1989.english: Surely, we have revealed this mes sage, and surely, we are preserving it.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا من قبلك في شيع الأولين
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīn
verses.english: We have sent (messengers) before you to the communities in the past.

1981.english: We have sent (messengers) before you, to previous groups.
1981.subtitle: The Disbelievers Hopelessly Blocked

1989.english: We have sent (messengers) before you to the communities of the past.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما يأتيهم من رسول إلا كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: Every time a messenger went to them, they ridiculed him.

1981.english: When a messenger went to any group, they ridiculed him.

1989.english: Every time a messenger went to them, they ridiculed him.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك نسلكه في قلوب المجرمين
verses.transliterated: kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: We thus control the minds of the guilty.

1981.english: We thus control the hearts of the guilty.

1989.english: We thus control the guilty hearts.

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يؤمنون به ۖ وقد خلت سنة الأولين
verses.transliterated: lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīn
verses.english: Consequently, they cannot believe in him. This has been the system since the past generations.

1981.english: This is why they cannot believe in this; just like their previous counterparts.

1989.english: Consequently, they cannot believe in him. This has been proven throughout past generations.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو فتحنا عليهم بابا من السماء فظلوا فيه يعرجون
verses.transliterated: walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūn
verses.english: Even if we opened for them a gate into the sky, through which they climb;

1981.english: Even if we opened a gate into heaven, through which they keep on climbing;

1989.english: Even if we opened for them a gate into the sky, through which they climbed—

verses.arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لقالوا إنما سكرت أبصارنا بل نحن قوم مسحورون
verses.transliterated: laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūn
verses.english: they will say, "Our eyes have been deceived. We have been bewitched."

1981.english: they would say, "Our eyes are dazed. We are duped by magic."

1989.english: they would say, “Our eyes have been deceived. We have been bewitched.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جعلنا في السماء بروجا وزيناها للناظرين
verses.transliterated: walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīn
verses.english: We placed galaxies in the sky, and adorned it for the beholders.

1981.english: We created constellations in the sky, and adorned it for the beholders.

1989.english: We placed galaxies in the sky, and adorned it for the beholders.

verses.arabic: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وحفظناها من كل شيطان رجيم
verses.transliterated: waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmi
verses.english: And we guarded it against every rejected devil.

1981.english: And protected it from every rejected devil.

1989.english: We guarded it against every rejected devil.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا من استرق السمع فأتبعه شهاب مبين
verses.transliterated: illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnu
verses.english: If any of them sneaks around to listen, a mighty projectile will chase him back.

1981.english: If any of them tries to sneak, a mighty projectile strikes at him.

1989.english: If any of them sneaks around, a mighty projectile will chase him back.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: والأرض مددناها وألقينا فيها رواسي وأنبتنا فيها من كل شيء موزون
verses.transliterated: wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūni
verses.english: As for the earth, we constructed it, and placed on it stabilizers (mountains), and we grew on it a perfect balance of everything.

1981.english: And we constructed the earth, and placed stabilizers therein. And we planted all kinds of things therein, in perfect balance.

1989.english: As for the earth, we constructed it, and placed on it stabilizers (<mountains), and grew on it a perfect balance of everything.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا لكم فيها معايش ومن لستم له برازقين
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīn
verses.english: We made it habitable for you, and for creatures you do not provide for.
verses.footnote: When we send astronauts into space, we provide them with precisely measured quantities of food, water, and oxygen. God created the spaceship Earth with billions of astronauts who work and reproduce; He supplied them with a self-supporting system that generates oxygen, fresh water, and a great variety of delicious foods and drinks.

1981.english: We placed therein your means of survival, and the survival of other creatures.

1989.english: We made it habitable for you,* and for creatures you do not provide for.
1989.footnote: When we send astronauts into space, we provide them with precisely measured quantities of food, water, and oxygen. God created the spaceship Earth with billions ol astronauts who work and reproduce, and supplied them with a self-supporting system that generates oxygen, fresh water, and a great variety of delicious foods and drinks.

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإن من شيء إلا عندنا خزائنه وما ننزله إلا بقدر معلوم
verses.transliterated: wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmi
verses.english: There is nothing that we do not own infinite amounts thereof. But we send it down in precise measure.

1981.english: There is nothing that we do not own treasures thereof. But we send it down in exact measure.

1989.english: There is nothing that we do not own infinite amounts thereof. But we send it down in exact measure.

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأرسلنا الرياح لواقح فأنزلنا من السماء ماء فأسقيناكموه وما أنتم له بخازنين
verses.transliterated: wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīn
verses.english: And we send the winds as pollinators, and cause water to come down from the sky for you to drink. Otherwise, you could not keep it palatable.

1981.english: And we send the winds as pollinators, causing water to pour down for you to drink; you can never store it (in a fresh condition).

1989.english: And we send the winds as pollinators to send down from the sky water for you to drink. Otherwise, you could not keep it palatable.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنا لنحن نحيي ونميت ونحن الوارثون
verses.transliterated: wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūn
verses.english: It is we who control life and death, and we are the ultimate inheritors.

1981.english: And it is we who grant life and death, and we are the inheritors.

1989.english: It is we who control life and death, and we are the ultimate inheritors.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد علمنا المستقدمين منكم ولقد علمنا المستأخرين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīn
verses.english: And we fully know those among you who advance, and we fully know those who regress.

1981.english: And we already know which of you are ahead, and which are behind.

1989.english: And we fully know those among you who advance, and we fully know those who regress.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن ربك هو يحشرهم ۚ إنه حكيم عليم
verses.transliterated: wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmu
verses.english: Your Lord will surely summon them. He is Most Wise, Omniscient.

1981.english: Your Lord will gather them all; He is wise, omniscient.

1989.english: Your Lord will surely summon them. He is Most Wise, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ

verses.transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūni
verses.english: We created the human being from aged mud, like the potter's clay.
verses.subtitle: The Human Race

1981.english: We created the human being from pre-shaped potter's clay.
1981.subtitle: The Humans and the Jinns
1981.footnote: The humans are descendants of Adam, while the jinns are descendants of Satan. The Quran teaches clearly that Satan is a fallen angel. Therefore, a jinn is a fallen angel. Certain parts of the Muslim world, especially where Arabic is not the native tongue, fail to recognize Satan as a fallen angel. The order to fall prostrate was directed "to the angels" (see 2:30, 15:28, and Appendix 18).

1989.english: We created the human being from aged mud, like the potter’s clay.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.arabicClean: والجان خلقناه من قبل من نار السموم
verses.transliterated: wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūm

1989.english: As for the jinns, we created them, before that, from blazing fire.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قال ربك للملائكة إني خالق بشرا من صلصال من حمإ مسنون
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūni
verses.english: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from aged mud, like the potter's clay.

1989.english: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from aged mud, like the potter’s clay.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verses.english: "Once I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."

1981.english: "When I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."

1989.english: “Once I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him.”

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فسجد الملائكة كلهم أجمعون
verses.transliterated: fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verses.english: The angels fell prostrate; all of them,

1981.english: The angels fell prostrate; all of them,

1989.english: The angels fell prostrate; all of them—

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا إبليس أبى أن يكون مع الساجدين
verses.transliterated: illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīn
verses.english: except Iblis (Satan). He refused to be with the prostrators.

1981.english: except Iblis (Satan); he refused to be with the prostrators.

verses.arabicClean: قال يا إبليس ما لك ألا تكون مع الساجدين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīn
verses.english: He said, "O Iblis (Satan), why are you not with the prostrators?"

1981.english: God said, "O Iblis, why are you not with the prostrators?"

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال لم أكن لأسجد لبشر خلقته من صلصال من حمإ مسنون
verses.transliterated: qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūni

1981.english: He said, "I was not to fall prostrate before a human being You created from pre-shaped potter's clay."

1989.english: He said, “I am not to prostrate before a human being, whom You created from aged mud, like the potter’s clay.”

verses.arabicClean: قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم
verses.transliterated: qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmu
verses.english: He said, "Therefore, you must get out; you are banished.

1981.english: God said, "Then get out of here; you are rejected.
1981.footnote: The humans are descendants of Adam, while the jinns are descendants of Satan. The Quran teaches clearly that Satan is a fallen angel. Therefore, a jinn is a fallen angel. 1989.english: He said, “Therefore, you must get out; you are banished.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.arabicClean: وإن عليك اللعنة إلى يوم الدين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīn
verses.english: "You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment."

1981.english: "You have deserved the curse, until the day of judgment."
1981.footnote: The humans are descendants of Adam, while the jinns are descendants of Satan. The Quran teaches clearly that Satan is a fallen angel. Therefore, a jinn is a fallen angel. The order to fall prostrate was directed "to the angels" (see 2:30, 15:28, and Appendix 18).

1989.english: “You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, respite me until the day they are resurrected."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, respite me till the day of resurrection."

verses.transliterated: qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn

1981.english: God said, "You are respited.
1981.footnote: The humans are descendants of Adam, while the jinns are descendants of Satan. The Quran teaches clearly that Satan is a fallen angel. Therefore, a jinn is a fallen angel. verses.transliterated: ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm

1981.english: "Till the day of the appointed time."
1981.footnote: The humans are descendants of Adam, while the jinns are descendants of Satan. The Quran teaches clearly that Satan is a fallen angel. Therefore, a jinn is a fallen angel. The order to fall prostrate was directed "to the angels" (see 2:30, 15:28, and Appendix 18).

1989.english: “Until the specified day and time.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب بما أغويتني لأزينن لهم في الأرض ولأغوينهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, since You have willed that I go astray, I will surely entice them on earth; I will send them all astray.

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, since it is Your will that I go astray, I will entice them on earth, and will mislead them all.

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, since You have sent me astray, I will surely entice them on earth; I will send them all astray.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.english: "Except those among Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone."

1981.english: "Except Your servants among them, who are totally devoted."

1989.english: “Except those among Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone.”

verses.transliterated: qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīmu
verses.english: He said, "This is a law that is inviolable.

1981.english: God said, "This will be My irrevocable law.

1989.english: He said, “This is a law that is inviolable.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

verses.transliterated: inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīn
verses.english: "You have no power over My servants. You only have power over the strayers who follow you.

1981.english: "You will have no power over My servants; only over the strayers who follow you."

1989.english: “You have no power over My servants, except the strayers who follow you.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن جهنم لموعدهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: "And Hell awaits them all.

1981.english: Hell awaits them all.

1989.english: “And Hell awaits them all.

verses.arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
verses.arabicClean: لها سبعة أبواب لكل باب منهم جزء مقسوم
verses.transliterated: lahā sabʿatu abwābin likulli bābin min'hum juz'on maqsūmu
verses.english: "It will have seven gates. Each gate will get a specific share of them."

1981.english: It has seven gates; for each gate, an assigned number of them.

1989.english: “It will have seven gates. Each gate will get a specific share of them.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن المتقين في جنات وعيون
verses.transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūni
verses.english: As for the righteous, they will enjoy gardens and springs.

1981.english: As for the righteous, they enjoy gardens and springs.

1989.english: As for the righteous, they will enjoy gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

verses.transliterated: ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīn

1989.english: Enter therein, peaceful and secure.

verses.transliterated: wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīn
verses.english: We remove all jealousy from their hearts. Like one family, they will be on adjacent furnishings.

1989.english: We remove all jealousy from their hearts; like one family, on adjacent furnishings.

verses.transliterated: lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīn
verses.english: Never will they suffer any fatigue therein; never will they be evicted therefrom.

1981.english: No fatigue will ever afflict them, nor will they ever be evicted therefrom.

1989.english: Never will they suffer from fatigue therein; never will they be evicted therefrom.

verses.arabic: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

verses.transliterated: nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru l-raḥīm

1981.english: Inform My servants that I am the forgiver, the merciful.

1989.english: Inform My servants that I am the Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1989.english: And that My retribution is the most painful retribution.

1981.english: They said, "Do not be wary. We bring good news; a knowledgeable son."

1989.english: They said, “Do not be apprehensive. We give you good news: an enlightened son.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال أبشرتموني على أن مسني الكبر فبم تبشرون
verses.transliterated: qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā an massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūn
verses.english: He said, "How can you give me such good news, when I am so old? Do you still give me this good news?"

1981.english: He said, "Do you bring such good news, despite my old age? How can you bring this news?

1989.english: He said, “How can you give me such good news, when I am so old?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا بشرناك بالحق فلا تكن من القانطين
verses.transliterated: qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takun mina l-qāniṭīn
verses.english: They said, "The good news we give you is true; do not despair."

1981.english: They said, "This is the truth, so do not despair."

1989.english: They said, “The good news we give you is the truth. Do not despair.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال ومن يقنط من رحمة ربه إلا الضالون
verses.transliterated: qāla waman yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi illā l-ḍālūn
verses.english: He said, "None despairs of his Lord's mercy, except the strayers."

1981.english: He said, "Who despairs of his Lord's mercy, except the strayers?"

1989.english: He said, “None despairs of the mercy of his Lord, except the strayers.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون
verses.transliterated: qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūn
verses.english: He said, "What is your mission, O messengers?"

1981.english: Then he said, "What else are you doing, O messengers?

1989.english: He said, “What is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين
verses.transliterated: qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīn
verses.english: They said, "We are being dispatched to guilty people.

1981.english: They said, "We are being dispatched to wicked people.

1989.english: They said, “We are being dispatched to guilty people.

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا آل لوط إنا لمنجوهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: "As for Lot's family, we will save them all.

1981.english: "But Lot's family will be saved.

1989.english: “As for Lot’s family, we will save them all—

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا امرأته قدرنا ۙ إنها لمن الغابرين
verses.transliterated: illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīn
verses.english: "But not his wife; she is destined to be with the doomed."

1981.english: "Not so his wife, she is destined to be doomed."

1989.english: “except his wife; she is destined to be with the doomed.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاء آل لوط المرسلون
verses.transliterated: falammā jāa āla lūṭin l-mur'salūn
verses.english: The messengers went to Lot's town.
verses.subtitle: Lot

1981.english: When the messengers went to Lot's house,

1989.english: When the messengers came to Lot—
1989.subtitle: Lot

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إنكم قوم منكرون
verses.transliterated: qāla innakum qawmun munkarūn
verses.english: He said, "You are unknown people."

1981.english: he said, "You are strange people."

1989.english: he said, “You are people unknown to us.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا بل جئناك بما كانوا فيه يمترون
verses.transliterated: qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūn
verses.english: They said, "We bring to you what they have been doubting.

1981.english: They said, "We bring to you what they have always doubted.

1989.english: They said, “We bring to you what they have been doubting.

verses.arabic: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأتيناك بالحق وإنا لصادقون
verses.transliterated: wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūn
verses.english: "We bring to you the truth; we are truthful.

1981.english: "We bring the truth to you; we are truthful.

1989.english: “We bring to you the truth; we are truthful.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأسر بأهلك بقطع من الليل واتبع أدبارهم ولا يلتفت منكم أحد وامضوا حيث تؤمرون
verses.transliterated: fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūn
verses.english: "You shall take your family during the night. Stay behind them, and make sure that none of you looks back. Go straight as commanded."

1981.english: "Thus, you shall move with your family in the darkness of night, with you in the rear, and let not anyone look behind. Go as commanded."

1989.english: “You shall take your family during the night. Stay behind them, and make sure that none of you looks back. Go straight as you are commanded.”

verses.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقضينا إليه ذلك الأمر أن دابر هؤلاء مقطوع مصبحين
verses.transliterated: waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿun muṣ'biḥīn
verses.english: We delivered to him this command: those people are to be annihilated in the morning.

1981.english: We informed him about the judgment, and that the wicked will be wiped out in the morning.

1989.english: We delivered to him this command, for those people were to be annihilated in the morning.

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجاء أهل المدينة يستبشرون
verses.transliterated: wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūn
verses.english: The people of the city came joyfully.

1981.english: The people came from the city with joy.

1989.english: The people of the city came joyfully.

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
verses.arabicClean: قال إن هؤلاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون
verses.transliterated: qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūn
verses.english: He said, "These are my guests; do not embarrass me.

1981.english: But he said, "These are my guests; do not scandalize me.

1989.english: He said, “These are my guests; do not embarrass me.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
verses.arabicClean: واتقوا الله ولا تخزون
verses.transliterated: wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūn
verses.english: "Fear GOD, and do not shame me."

1981.english: "Beware of God, and do not embarrass me."

1989.english: “Fear GOD; do not shame me.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أولم ننهك عن العالمين
verses.transliterated: qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: They said, "Did we not enjoin you from contacting anyone?"

1981.english: They said, "Did we not forbid you from (contacting) the people?"

1989.english: They said, “Did we not enjoin you from contacting anyone?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال هؤلاء بناتي إن كنتم فاعلين
verses.transliterated: qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīn
verses.english: He said, "Here are my daughters, if you must."

1981.english: He said, "Here are my daughters, if you wish."

1989.english: He said, “Here are my daughters, if you must.”

verses.arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لعمرك إنهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون
verses.transliterated: laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūn
verses.english: But, alas, they were totally blinded by their lust.

1981.english: But alas, they were blundering in their intoxication.

1989.english: But, alas, they were totally blinded by their lust.

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذتهم الصيحة مشرقين
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīn
verses.english: Consequently, the disaster struck them in the morning.

1981.english: Consequently, the disaster struck them at sun rise.

1989.english: Consequently, the disaster struck them in the morning.

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: فجعلنا عاليها سافلها وأمطرنا عليهم حجارة من سجيل
verses.transliterated: fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min sijjīli
verses.english: We turned it upside down, and showered them with devastating rocks.

1981.english: We turned it upside down, and we showered them with hard rocks.

1989.english: We turned it upside down, and showered them with devastating rocks.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لآيات للمتوسمين
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'mutawassimīn
verses.english: This is a lesson for those who possess intelligence.

1981.english: These are lessons for the intelligent.

1989.english: This should be a lesson for the intelligent ones.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإنها لبسبيل مقيم
verses.transliterated: wa-innahā labisabīlin muqīmi
verses.english: This will always be the system.

1981.english: And will consistently be the system.

1989.english: This will always be the system.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لآية للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: This is a sign for the believers.

1981.english: This is a lesson for the believers.

1989.english: This is a sign for the believers.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كان أصحاب الأيكة لظالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīn
verses.english: The people of the woods also were transgressors.

1981.english: The people of the woods were also wicked.

1989.english: Thus, the people of the woods also were transgressors.

verses.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فانتقمنا منهم وإنهما لبإمام مبين
verses.transliterated: fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmin mubīni
verses.english: Consequently, we avenged from them, and both communities are fully documented.

1981.english: Consequently, we avenged from them, and both groups are duly documented.

1989.english: We then avenged from them. Both communities are documented.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد كذب أصحاب الحجر المرسلين
verses.transliterated: walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīn
verses.english: The people of Al-Hijr disbelieved the messengers.

1981.english: The dwellers of Al-Hijr Valley also disbelieved the messengers.
1981.subtitle: Al-Hijr

1989.english: The people of Al-Hijr disbelieved the messengers.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وآتيناهم آياتنا فكانوا عنها معرضين
verses.transliterated: waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīn
verses.english: We gave them our revelations, but they disregarded them.

1981.english: We showed them our revelations, but they turned away therefrom.

1989.english: We gave them our revelations, but they disregarded them.

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكانوا ينحتون من الجبال بيوتا آمنين
verses.transliterated: wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīn
verses.english: They used to carve secure homes out of the mountains.

1981.english: They used to carve secure homes out of the mountains.

1989.english: They used to carve secure homes out of the mountains.

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذتهم الصيحة مصبحين
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīn
verses.english: The disaster hit them in the morning.

1981.english: But the disaster struck them in the morning.

1989.english: The disaster hit them in the morning.

verses.arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: What they hoarded did not help them.

1981.english: And their secure homes did not help them.

1989.english: What they earned did not help them.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: وما خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إلا بالحق ۗ وإن الساعة لآتية ۖ فاصفح الصفح الجميل
verses.transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi l-ṣafḥa l-jamīl
verses.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose. The end of the world will come, so treat them with benign neglect.
verses.subtitle: End of the World Unveiled
verses.footnote: One of the functions of God's Messenger of the Covenant is to deliver the Quranic assertion that the world will end in AD 2280 (20:15, 72:27 & Appendix 25).

1981.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a purpose. The hour is surely coming, so treat them with benign neglect.
1981.subtitle: The Seven Pairs
1981.footnote: The seven pairs refer to the 14 sets of Quranic initials. As decoded by computers, the 14 sets of initials are indeed 14 sets of numbers that add up to 1709, the number of years from the time of this Quranic revelation to the end of the world. See the book, "The Computer Speaks" for details.

1989.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose. The end of the world is coming, so treat them with benign neglect.
1989.subtitle: End of the World Unveiled
1989.footnote: One of the functions of God’s Messenger of the Covenant was to deliver the Quranic assertion that the world will end in AD 2280 (20:15, 72:27 & Appendix 25).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربك هو الخلاق العليم
verses.transliterated: inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: Your Lord is the Creator, the Omniscient.

1981.english: Your Lord is the omniscient creator.
1981.footnote: The seven pairs refer to the 14 sets of Quranic initials. As decoded by computers, the 14 sets of initials are indeed 14 sets of numbers that add up to 1709, the number of years from the time of this Quranic revelation to the end of the world. See the book, "The Computer Speaks" for details.

1989.english: Your Lord is the Creator, the Omniscient.
1989.footnote: One of the functions of God’s Messenger of the Covenant was to deliver the Quranic assertion that the world will end in AD 2280 (20:15, 72:27 & Appendix 25).

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتيناك سبعا من المثاني والقرآن العظيم
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: We have given you the seven pairs, and the great Quran.

1981.english: And we have given you (O Muhammad) seven pairs, and the great Quran.
1981.footnote: The seven pairs refer to the 14 sets of Quranic initials. As decoded by computers, the 14 sets of initials are indeed 14 sets of numbers that add up to 1709, the number of years from the time of this Quranic revelation to the end of the world. See the book, "The Computer Speaks" for details.

1989.english: We have given you the seven pairs, and the great Quran.
1989.footnote: One of the functions of God’s Messenger of the Covenant was to deliver the Quranic assertion that the world will end in AD 2280 (20:15, 72:27 & Appendix 25).

verses.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزواجا منهم ولا تحزن عليهم واخفض جناحك للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: Do not be jealous of what we bestowed upon the other (messengers), and do not be saddened (by the disbelievers), and lower your wing for the believers.

1981.english: Do not covet what we bestowed upon the other groups, and do not be saddened by them, and humble yourself for the believers.
1981.footnote: The seven pairs refer to the 14 sets of Quranic initials. As decoded by computers, the 14 sets of initials are indeed 14 sets of numbers that add up to 1709, the number of years from the time of this Quranic revelation to the end of the world. See the book, "The Computer Speaks" for details.

1989.english: Do not be jealous of what we bestowed upon the other (messengers), do not be saddened (by the disbelievers), and lower your wing for the believers.
1989.footnote: One of the functions of God’s Messenger of the Covenant was to deliver the Quranic assertion that the world will end in AD 2280 (20:15, 72:27 & Appendix 25).

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وقل إني أنا النذير المبين
verses.transliterated: waqul innī anā l-nadhīru l-mubīn
verses.english: And proclaim: "I am the manifest warner."

1981.english: And declare that you are the profound warner.

1989.english: And proclaim: “I am the manifest warner.”

verses.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كما أنزلنا على المقتسمين
verses.transliterated: kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīn
verses.english: We will deal with the dividers.

1981.english: We will also send down retribution upon the dividers,

1989.english: For we will also deal with the dividers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين جعلوا القرآن عضين
verses.transliterated: alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīn
verses.english: They accept the Quran only partially.

1981.english: who accept the Quran only partially.

1989.english: They accept the Quran only partially.

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فوربك لنسألنهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: By your Lord, we will question them all,

1981.english: By your Lord, we will question them all.

1989.english: By your Lord, we will question them all—

verses.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: عما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: amma kaanu ya'limun
verses.english: about everything they have done.

1981.english: About everything they did.

1989.english: about everything they have done.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فاصدع بما تؤمر وأعرض عن المشركين
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Therefore, carry out the orders given to you, and disregard the idol worshipers.

1981.english: Therefore, abide by the orders given to you, and pay no attention to the idol worshipers.

1989.english: Therefore, carry out the orders given to you, and disregard the idol worshipers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا كفيناك المستهزئين
verses.transliterated: innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīn
verses.english: We will spare you the mockers,

1981.english: We will take care of the scoffers;

1989.english: We will spare you the mockers—

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يجعلون مع الله إلها آخر ۚ فسوف يعلمون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.english: who set up another god beside GOD. They will surely find out.

1981.english: who set up another god with God; they will surely find out.

1989.english: who set up another god besides GOD. They will surely find out.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد نعلم أنك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون
verses.transliterated: walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūn
verses.english: We know full well that you may be annoyed by their utterances.

1981.english: We know that you may be annoyed by what they say.

1989.english: We know full well that you may be annoyed by their utterances.

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فسبح بحمد ربك وكن من الساجدين
verses.transliterated: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mina l-sājidīn
verses.english: You shall sing the praises of your Lord, and be with the prostrators.

1981.english: Therefore, praise the glory of your Lord, and fall prostrate.

1989.english: You shall sing the praises of your Lord, and be with the prostrators.

verses.arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.arabicClean: واعبد ربك حتى يأتيك اليقين
verses.transliterated: wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīn
verses.english: And worship your Lord, in order to attain certainty.
verses.footnote: The practices of worship are our means of attaining certainty (Appendix 15).

1981.english: And worship your Lord, so that certainty will come to you.
1981.footnote: This verse explains the function of the worship rituals, i.e., the **salat** prayers, the fasting of Ramadan, the **zakat** charity, and the pilgrimage. These religious duties are the means to attain certainty.

1989.english: And worship your Lord, in order to attain certainty.*
1989.footnote: The practices of worship are our means of attaining certainty (Appendix 15).

verses.arabic: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم أتى أمر الله فلا تستعجلوه ۚ سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: atā amru l-lahi falā tastaʿjilūhu sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: GOD's command has already been issued (and everything has already been written), so do not rush it. Be He glorified; the Most High, far above any idols they set up.
verses.footnote: Everything is already recorded (57:22). See also Appendix 14.

1981.english: God's judgment is already predetermined; do not challenge Him to bring it. God be glorified, and most exalted, over anything they idolize.

1989.english: GOD s command has been issued (and everything has already been written), so do not rush it.* Be He glorified; the Most High, far above any idols they set up besides Him.
1989.footnote: Everything is already recorded (57:22). See also Appendix 14.

verses.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.arabicClean: ينزل الملائكة بالروح من أمره على من يشاء من عباده أن أنذروا أنه لا إله إلا أنا فاتقون
verses.transliterated: yunazzilu l-malāikata bil-rūḥi min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi an andhirū annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ittaqūn
verses.english: He sends down the angels with the revelations, carrying His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants: "You shall preach that there is no other god beside Me; You shall reverence Me."

1981.english: He sends down the angels, carrying the spirit (revelation) of His commands.* They descend upon His servants, whom He chooses, that: "You shall preach that there is no god except Me; you shall observe Me."
1981.footnote: The word "spirit" frequently refers to God's revelations, including this Quran as stated in 42:52. See also 4:171, 17:85-89, 26:193, 40:15, 58:22.

1989.english: He sends down the angels with inspiration, carrying His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants: “You shall preach that there is no other god besides Me; You shall observe Me.”

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق ۚ تعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi taʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: He created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose. He is much too High, far above any idols they set up.

1981.english: He created the heavens and the earth, truthfully. Most exalted He is, over anything they idolize.

1989.english: He created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose. He is much too High, far above any idols they set up.

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: خلق الإنسان من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين
verses.transliterated: khalaqa l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnu
verses.english: He created the human from a tiny drop, then he turns into an ardent opponent.

1981.english: He created the human being from a drop; yet he turns into a manifest opponent.

1989.english: He created the human from a tiny drop, yet he turns into an ardent opponent.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والأنعام خلقها ۗ لكم فيها دفء ومنافع ومنها تأكلون
verses.transliterated: wal-anʿāma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'on wamanāfiʿu wamin'hā takulūn
verses.english: And He created the livestock for you, to provide you with warmth, and many other benefits, as well as food.

1981.english: And the livestock He created to provide you with warmth, benefits, and food.

1989.english: And He created the livestock for you, to provide you with warmth, and many other benefits, as well as food.

verses.arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكم فيها جمال حين تريحون وحين تسرحون
verses.transliterated: walakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna waḥīna tasraḥūn
verses.english: They also provide you with luxury during your leisure, and when you travel.

1981.english: They also provide you with luxury, in your leisure, and your travels.

1989.english: They also provide you with luxury during your leisure, and when you travel.

verses.arabic: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وتحمل أثقالكم إلى بلد لم تكونوا بالغيه إلا بشق الأنفس ۚ إن ربكم لرءوف رحيم
verses.transliterated: wataḥmilu athqālakum ilā baladin lam takūnū bālighīhi illā bishiqqi l-anfusi inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmu
verses.english: And they carry your loads to lands that you could not reach without a great hardship. Surely, your Lord is Compassionate, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: God's Blessings

1981.english: And they carry your loads to distant lands that you cannot reach, except with great hardship. Your Lord is kind, merciful.

1989.english: And they carry your loads to lands that you could not reach without a great effort. Surely, your Lord is Compassionate, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: God's Blessings

verses.arabic: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينة ۚ ويخلق ما لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: wal-khayla wal-bighāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnatan wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: And (He created) the horses, the mules, and the donkeys for you to ride, and for luxury. Additionally, He creates what you do not know.

1981.english: And He created the horses, the mules, and the donkeys for you to ride, as well as for luxury. And He creates what you do not know.
1981.footnote: A clear reference to the automobile, the train, the plane, etc. (see 37:96).

1989.english: And (He created) the horses, the mules, and the donkeys for you to ride, and for luxury. Additionally, He creates what you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وعلى الله قصد السبيل ومنها جائر ۚ ولو شاء لهداكم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: waʿalā l-lahi qaṣdu l-sabīli wamin'hā jāirun walaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: GOD points out the paths, including the wrong ones. If He willed, He could have guided all of you.

1981.english: God is the one who points out the paths for you, including the wrong ones. Had He willed, He could have guided all of you.

1989.english: GOD points out the paths, including the wrong ones. If He willed, He could have guided all of you.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي أنزل من السماء ماء ۖ لكم منه شراب ومنه شجر فيه تسيمون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan lakum min'hu sharābun wamin'hu shajarun fīhi tusīmūn
verses.english: He sends down from the sky water for your drink, and to grow trees for your benefit.

1981.english: He is the one who sends down from the sky water, from which you drink and grow plants for pasture.

1989.english: He sends down from the sky water for your drink, and to grow trees for your benefit.

verses.arabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ينبت لكم به الزرع والزيتون والنخيل والأعناب ومن كل الثمرات ۗ إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: yunbitu lakum bihi l-zarʿa wal-zaytūna wal-nakhīla wal-aʿnāba wamin kulli l-thamarāti inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verses.english: With it, He grows for you crops, olives, date palms, grapes, and all kinds of fruits. This is (sufficient) proof for people who think.

1981.english: With it, He grows for you crops, olives, date palms, grapes, and all kinds of fruits. This is a lesson for those who reflect.

1989.english: With it, He grows for you crops, olives, date palms, grapes, and all kinds of fruits. This is a sign for people who think.

verses.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وسخر لكم الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر ۖ والنجوم مسخرات بأمره ۗ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūmu musakharātun bi-amrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: And He commits, in your service, the night and the day, as well as the sun and the moon. Also, the stars are committed by His command. These are (sufficient) proofs for people who understand.

1981.english: He placed in your service the night and day, and the sun and moon. The stars are similarly committed, by His command. These are lessons for people who understand.

1989.english: And He commits, in your service, the night and the day, as well as the sun and the moon. Also, the stars are committed by His command. These are signs for people who understand.

verses.arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما ذرأ لكم في الأرض مختلفا ألوانه ۗ إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يذكرون
verses.transliterated: wamā dhara-a lakum fī l-arḍi mukh'talifan alwānuhu inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yadhakkarūn
verses.english: And (He created) for you on earth things of various colors. This is a (sufficient) proof for people who take heed.

1981.english: All the things He created for you on earth, in various colors, should be a lesson for those who take heed.

1989.english: And (He created) for you on earth things of various colors. This is a sign for people who take heed.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي سخر البحر لتأكلوا منه لحما طريا وتستخرجوا منه حلية تلبسونها وترى الفلك مواخر فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī sakhara l-baḥra litakulū min'hu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijū min'hu ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: And He committed the sea to serve you; you eat from it tender meat, and extract jewelry which you wear. And you see the ships roaming it for your commercial benefits, as you seek His bounties, that you may be appreciative.

1981.english: And He is the one who placed the ocean in your service, in order to eat tender meat therefrom, and extract jewels for you to wear. And you see the ships roaming therein, as you seek God's bounties. You should be appreciative.

1989.english: And He committed the sea to serve you; you eat from it tender meat, and extract jewelry which you wear. And you see the ships roaming it for your commercial benefits, as you seek His bounties, that you may be appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وألقى في الأرض رواسي أن تميد بكم وأنهارا وسبلا لعلكم تهتدون
verses.transliterated: wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan laʿallakum tahtadūn
verses.english: And He placed stabilizers (mountains) on earth, lest it tumbles with you, as well as rivers and roads, that you may be guided.

1981.english: And He placed stabilizers on earth, lest it tumbles with you, as well as rivers and roads to guide you.

1989.english: And He placed stabilizers (mountains) on earth, lest it tumbles with you, as well as rivers and roads, that you may be guided.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٍ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وعلامات ۚ وبالنجم هم يهتدون
verses.transliterated: waʿalāmātin wabil-najmi hum yahtadūn
verses.english: And landmarks, as well as the stars; to be used for navigation.

1981.english: Also, landmarks, and the stars to guide them.

1989.english: And landmarks. Also, the stars they use for navigation.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن يخلق كمن لا يخلق ۗ أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: afaman yakhluqu kaman lā yakhluqu afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: Is One who creates like one who does not create? Would you now take heed?

1981.english: Is one who creates equal to one who does not create? Would you not take heed?
1981.subtitle: God vs the Idols

1989.english: Is One who creates like one who does not create?

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن تعدوا نعمة الله لا تحصوها ۗ إن الله لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-laha laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: If you count GOD's blessings, you cannot possibly encompass them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: If you count God's blessings, you can never encompass them. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: If you count GOD’s blessings, you cannot possibly encompass them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله يعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūn
verses.english: And GOD knows whatever you conceal and whatever you declare.

1981.english: And God knows everything you conceal, and everything you declare.

1989.english: And GOD knows whatever you conceal and whatever you declare.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يدعون من دون الله لا يخلقون شيئا وهم يخلقون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūn
verses.english: As for the idols they set up beside GOD, they do not create anything; they themselves were created.
verses.subtitle: The Dead Prophets and Saints

1981.english: And the idols they set up besides God create nothing; they themselves are created.

1989.english: As for the idols they set up besides GOD, they do not create anything; they themselves were created.
1989.subtitle: The Dead Prophets and Saints

verses.arabic: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أموات غير أحياء ۖ وما يشعرون أيان يبعثون
verses.transliterated: amwātun ghayru aḥyāin wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: They are dead, not alive, and they have no idea how or when they will be resurrected.

1981.english: They are dead, not alive, and they have no idea how or when they will be resurrected.
1981.footnote: When the idol worshipers call upon Jesus, or Mary, or Muhammad, or any saint, they are not only wasting their breath, but also committing themselves to doom. These idolized individuals are servants of God who are dead, and completely unaware of their idolizers (see also 17:56-57, 19:81-82, and 72:21-22). Their souls exist somewhere far from our world, as stated in 23:100.

1989.english: They are dead, not alive. Moreover, they have no idea how or when they will be resurrected.

verses.arabic: إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إلهكم إله واحد ۚ فالذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة قلوبهم منكرة وهم مستكبرون
verses.transliterated: ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratun wahum mus'takbirūn
verses.english: Your god is one god. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are denying, and they are arrogant.

1981.english: Your God is one god; but those who do not believe in the hereafter, their hearts are denying, and they are arrogant.
1981.footnote: What we utter with our mouths does not necessarily reflect our innermost convictions. The Quran teaches us here that some disbelievers do not know that they are disbelievers; they say that they are believers merely because they grew up in a society that praises the believers and condemns the disbelievers. This verse states that such people have "denying hearts." The test we are put through is designed to show us on the day of judgment whether we were really believers, or merely deceived ourselves (6:112-116). This profound test for the Muslims is described in 6:112-116; those who are attracted to the blasphemy known as "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" are false believers, while those who uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran are true believers.

1989.english: Your god is one god. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are denying, and they are arrogant.

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا جرم أن الله يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون ۚ إنه لا يحب المستكبرين
verses.transliterated: lā jarama anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'takbirīn
verses.english: Absolutely, GOD knows everything they conceal and everything they declare. He does not love those who are arrogant.

1981.english: Undoubtedly, God knows whatever they conceal, and whatever they declare; He does not love the arrogant.

1989.english: There is no doubt that GOD knows everything they conceal and everything they declare. He does not love those who are arrogant.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم ماذا أنزل ربكم ۙ قالوا أساطير الأولين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahum mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū asāṭīru l-awalīn
