verses.english: When they are asked, "What do you think of these revelations from your Lord," they say, "Tales from the past."

1981.english: When they are told, "What did your Lord send down," they say, "Tales of the past."

1989.english: When they are asked, “What do you think of these revelations from your Lord,” they say, “Tales from the past.”

verses.arabic: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليحملوا أوزارهم كاملة يوم القيامة ۙ ومن أوزار الذين يضلونهم بغير علم ۗ ألا ساء ما يزرون
verses.transliterated: liyaḥmilū awzārahum kāmilatan yawma l-qiyāmati wamin awzāri alladhīna yuḍillūnahum bighayri ʿil'min alā sāa mā yazirūn
verses.english: They will be held responsible for their sins on the Day of Resurrection, all of them, in addition to sins of all those whom they misled by their ignorance. What a miserable load!

1981.english: Because of this, they will carry their sins complete on the day of resurrection, as well as some sins of those misled by them and their ignorance. What a miserable load!

1989.english: They will carry their sins on the Day of Resurrection, all of them, in addition to some sins of those whom they misled by their ignorance. What a miserable load!

verses.arabic: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قد مكر الذين من قبلهم فأتى الله بنيانهم من القواعد فخر عليهم السقف من فوقهم وأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: qad makara alladhīna min qablihim fa-atā l-lahu bun'yānahum mina l-qawāʿidi fakharra ʿalayhimu l-saqfu min fawqihim wa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: Others like them have schemed in the past, and consequently, GOD destroyed their building at the foundation, causing the roof to fall on them. The retribution struck them when they least expected.

1981.english: Others before them have similarly schemed. Consequently, God destroyed their building at the foundation, causing the roof to fall on them. The retribution came to them whence they never expected.

1989.english: Others like them have schemed in the past, and consequently, GOD destroyed their building at the foundation, causing the roof to fall on them. The retribution struck them when they least expected.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم يوم القيامة يخزيهم ويقول أين شركائي الذين كنتم تشاقون فيهم ۚ قال الذين أوتوا العلم إن الخزي اليوم والسوء على الكافرين
verses.transliterated: thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yukh'zīhim wayaqūlu ayna shurakāiya alladhīna kuntum tushāqqūna fīhim qāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma inna l-khiz'ya l-yawma wal-sūa ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and ask, "Where are My partners that you had set up beside Me, and had opposed Me for their sake?" Those blessed with knowledge will say, "Today, the shame and misery have befallen the disbelievers."

1981.english: Then on the day of resurrection He will disgrace them, and say, "Where are the idols for whose sake you became opponents?" Those who had acquired knowledge would say, "Today, disgrace and misery are the share of the disbelievers."

1989.english: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and ask, “Where are My partners that you set up besides Me, and opposed Me for their sake?” Those who were endowed with knowledge will say, “Today, the shame and misery have befallen the disbelievers.”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة ظالمي أنفسهم ۖ فألقوا السلم ما كنا نعمل من سوء ۚ بلى إن الله عليم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ẓālimī anfusihim fa-alqawū l-salama mā kunnā naʿmalu min sūin balā inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: The angels put them to death in a state of wronging their souls. That is when they finally submit, and say, "We did not do anything wrong!" Yes indeed. GOD is fully aware of everything you have done.
verses.subtitle: Death for the Disbelievers

1981.english: Whom the angels put to death while they are in a state of wickedness. They will then submit and say, "We did nothing wrong!" Indeed, God is fully aware of everything you did.

1989.english: The angels put them to death in a state of wronging their souls. That is when they finally submit, saying, “We did not do anything wrong!” Yes indeed. GOD is fully aware of everything you have done.

verses.arabic: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فلبئس مثوى المتكبرين
verses.transliterated: fa-ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā falabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīn
verses.english: Therefore, enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.

1981.english: Therefore, enter the gates of hell forever; what a miserable abode for the arrogant.

1989.english: Therefore, enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقيل للذين اتقوا ماذا أنزل ربكم ۚ قالوا خيرا ۗ للذين أحسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة ۚ ولدار الآخرة خير ۚ ولنعم دار المتقين
verses.transliterated: waqīla lilladhīna ittaqaw mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū khayran lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun walaniʿ'ma dāru l-mutaqīn
verses.english: As for the righteous, when they are asked, "What do you think of these revelations from your Lord," they say, "Good." For those who lead a righteous life, happiness, and the abode of the Hereafter is even better. What a blissful abode for the righteous.
verses.subtitle: The Believers Do Not Really Die
verses.footnote: The righteous taste only the first death, which has been already experienced by all of us (see 44:56). At the end of their interim in this world, the angels of death simply invite them to move on to the Paradise where Adam and Eve once lived (2:154, 3:169, 8:24, 22:58, 36:27).

1981.english: And when the righteous are asked, "What do you think of your Lord's revelations," they answer, "(They are) good." For those who work righteousness, happiness in this world; and the abode of the hereafter is even better. Blissful indeed is the abode of the righteous.

1989.english: On the other hand, when the righteous are asked, “What do you think of these revelations from your Lord,” they say, “Good.” For those who lead a righteous life, happiness. And the abode of the Hereafter is even better. What a blissful abode for the righteous.
1989.subtitle: The Believers

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: جنات عدن يدخلونها تجري من تحتها الأنهار ۖ لهم فيها ما يشاءون ۚ كذلك يجزي الله المتقين
verses.transliterated: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru lahum fīhā mā yashāūna kadhālika yajzī l-lahu l-mutaqīn
verses.english: The gardens of Eden are reserved for them, wherein rivers flow. They have anything they wish therein. GOD thus rewards the righteous.

1981.english: They have deserved the gardens of Eden, where rivers flow, and where they find anything they wish for. God thus rewards the righteous.

1989.english: They enter the gardens of Eden, wherein rivers flow. They have anything they wish therein GOD thus rewards the righteous.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين تتوفاهم الملائكة طيبين ۙ يقولون سلام عليكم ادخلوا الجنة بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ṭayyibīna yaqūlūna salāmun ʿalaykumu ud'khulū l-janata bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: The angels terminate their lives in a state of righteousness, saying, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise (now) as a reward for your works."
verses.subtitle: They Go Straight to Paradise

1981.english: The angels put them to death in a state of righteousness, saying, "Peace be upon you; you have deserved Paradise, in return for your works."

1989.english: The angels terminate their lives in a state of righteousness, saying, “Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your works.”

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هل ينظرون إلا أن تأتيهم الملائكة أو يأتي أمر ربك ۚ كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم ۚ وما ظلمهم الله ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: hal yanẓurūna illā an tatiyahumu l-malāikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim wamā ẓalamahumu l-lahu walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: Are they waiting for the angels to come to them, or until your Lord's judgment comes to pass? Those before them did the same thing. GOD is not the One who wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: Are (the disbelievers) waiting for the angels, or God's judgment, to come to them? Others before them have done the same thing. It is not God who wrongs them; it is they who wrong themselves.

1989.english: Are they waiting for the angels to come to them, or until your Lord’s judgment comes to pass? Those before them did the same thing. GOD is not the One who wronged them; they are the ones who wronged themselves.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers

verses.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأصابهم سيئات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: They have incurred the consequences of their evil works, and the very things they ridiculed came back to haunt them.
verses.subtitle: Famous Excuse

1981.english: Consequently, the evils they did afflict them, and the very things they ridicule cause their doom.

1989.english: Therefore, they incurred the consequences of their evil works, and the very things they ridiculed came back to haunt them.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين أشركوا لو شاء الله ما عبدنا من دونه من شيء نحن ولا آباؤنا ولا حرمنا من دونه من شيء ۚ كذلك فعل الذين من قبلهم ۚ فهل على الرسل إلا البلاغ المبين
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna ashrakū law shāa l-lahu mā ʿabadnā min dūnihi min shayin naḥnu walā ābāunā walā ḥarramnā min dūnihi min shayin kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim fahal ʿalā l-rusuli illā l-balāghu l-mubīn
verses.english: The idol worshipers say, "Had GOD willed, we would not worship any idols besides Him, nor would our parents. Nor would we prohibit anything besides His prohibitions." Those before them have done the same. Can the messengers do anything but deliver the complete message?

1981.english: Those who practice idol worship would say, "If it is God's will, we would not idolize anything, nor would our parents, and we would not prohibit anything besides His prohibitions." Others before them have done the same thing. Is it not the sole duty of the messengers to deliver the message?

1989.english: The idol worshipers say, “Had GOD willed, we would not have worshiped any idols besides Him, nor would our parents. Nor would we have prohibited anything besides (what was prohibited by) Him.” Those before them have done the same. Can the messengers do anything but deliver the message?
1989.subtitle: Famous Excuse

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد بعثنا في كل أمة رسولا أن اعبدوا الله واجتنبوا الطاغوت ۖ فمنهم من هدى الله ومنهم من حقت عليه الضلالة ۚ فسيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين
verses.transliterated: walaqad baʿathnā fī kulli ummatin rasūlan ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ij'tanibū l-ṭāghūta famin'hum man hadā l-lahu wamin'hum man ḥaqqat ʿalayhi l-ḍalālatu fasīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīn
verses.english: We have sent a messenger to every community, saying, "You shall worship GOD, and avoid idolatry." Subsequently, some were guided by GOD, while others were committed to straying. Roam the earth and note the consequences for the rejectors.

1981.english: We have sent to every community a messenger, saying, "Worship God, and beware of idol-worship." Subsequently, some are guided by God, while others are committed to straying. Roam the earth and see the consequences for the disbelievers.

1989.english: We have sent a messenger to every community, saying, “You shall worship GOD, and avoid idolatry.” Some of them were guided by GOD, while others were committed to straying. Roam the earth and note the consequences for the rejectors.

verses.arabic: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن تحرص على هداهم فإن الله لا يهدي من يضل ۖ وما لهم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: in taḥriṣ ʿalā hudāhum fa-inna l-laha lā yahdī man yuḍillu wamā lahum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: No matter how hard you try to guide them, GOD does not guide the ones He had committed to straying. Thus, no one can help them.

1981.english: No matter what you do to guide them, God will never guide those who deserve the straying; no one can help them.

1989.english: No matter how hard you try to guide them, GOD will not guide whomever He commits to straying; no one can help them.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم ۙ لا يبعث الله من يموت ۚ بلى وعدا عليه حقا ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim lā yabʿathu l-lahu man yamūtu balā waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: They swore solemnly by GOD: "GOD will not resurrect the dead." Absolutely, such is His inviolable promise, but most people do not know.
verses.subtitle: Deep In Their Minds

1981.english: Others swear by God solemnly, that God will not resurrect the dead. Yes indeed; this is His truthful promise, but most people do not know.

1989.english: They swore solemnly by GOD that GOD will not resurrect the dead. Indeed, such is His truthful promise, but most people do not know.
1989.subtitle: Deep In Their Minds

verses.arabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ليبين لهم الذي يختلفون فيه وليعلم الذين كفروا أنهم كانوا كاذبين
verses.transliterated: liyubayyina lahumu alladhī yakhtalifūna fīhi waliyaʿlama alladhīna kafarū annahum kānū kādhibīn
verses.english: He will then point out to everyone all the things they had disputed, and will let those who disbelieved know that they were liars.

1981.english: In order to resolve everything they disputed, and to let the disbelievers know that they were liars.

1989.english: (He will resurrect them) in order to point out to them all the things they disputed, and to let those who disbelieved know that they were liars.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.arabicClean: إنما قولنا لشيء إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون
verses.transliterated: innamā qawlunā lishayin idhā aradnāhu an naqūla lahu kun fayakūn
verses.english: To have anything done, we simply say to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.subtitle: To Resurrect the Dead

1981.english: All we need to say, for anything to take place, is, "Be," and it is.

1989.english: To have anything done, we simply say to it, “Be,” and it is.
1989.subtitle: God Is Able to Resurrect the Dead

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هاجروا في الله من بعد ما ظلموا لنبوئنهم في الدنيا حسنة ۖ ولأجر الآخرة أكبر ۚ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hājarū fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā ẓulimū lanubawwi-annahum fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wala-ajru l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Those who emigrated for the sake of GOD, because they were persecuted, we will surely make it up to them generously in this life, and the recompense of the Hereafter is even greater, if they only knew.

1981.english: Those who have to leave their homes in the cause of God, due to persecution, we will honor them in this world; their reward in the hereafter is even greater, if they only know.

1989.english: Those who emigrated for the sake of GOD, because they were persecuted, we will surely make it up to them generously in this life, and the recompense of the Hereafter is even greater, if they only knew.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين صبروا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
verses.english: This is because they steadfastly persevere, and in their Lord they trust.

1981.english: They steadfastly persevere, and trust in their Lord.

1989.english: They steadfastly persevere, and in their Lord they trust.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا من قبلك إلا رجالا نوحي إليهم ۚ فاسألوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask those who know the scripture, if you do not know.

1981.english: All the messengers we sent before you were no more than humans who were inspired by us. Ask those who know, if you do not know.
1981.subtitle: All the Messengers Humans Like You and Me

1989.english: We did not send before you (O messenger) except men whom we inspired. If you (O people) do not know, you may ask the experts.

verses.arabic: بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بالبينات والزبر ۗ وأنزلنا إليك الذكر لتبين للناس ما نزل إليهم ولعلهم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wa-anzalnā ilayka l-dhik'ra litubayyina lilnnāsi mā nuzzila ilayhim walaʿallahum yatafakkarūn
verses.english: We provided them with the proofs and the scriptures. And we sent down to you this message, to proclaim for the people everything that is sent down to them, perhaps they will reflect.

1981.english: They carried manifest revelations, such as the Psalms. Similarly, we reveal to you this message, to show the people what is revealed to them, and to let them reflect.

1989.english: We provided them with the proofs and the scripture. And we sent down to you this message, to proclaim for the people everything that is sent down to them, perhaps they will reflect.

verses.arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفأمن الذين مكروا السيئات أن يخسف الله بهم الأرض أو يأتيهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: afa-amina alladhīna makarū l-sayiāti an yakhsifa l-lahu bihimu l-arḍa aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: Did those who scheme evil schemes guarantee that GOD will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the retribution will not come to them when they least expect it?

1981.english: Have the evil doers guaranteed that God will not wipe them off the earth, or that the doom will not come to them when they least expect it?

1989.english: Did those who scheme evil schemes guarantee that GOD will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the retribution will not come to them when they least expect it?

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أو يأخذهم في تقلبهم فما هم بمعجزين
verses.transliterated: aw yakhudhahum fī taqallubihim famā hum bimuʿ'jizīn
verses.english: It may strike them while they are asleep; they can never escape.

1981.english: Or that He will not punish them as they sleep, and thus cannot escape?

1989.english: Or strike them while they are asleep, and cannot escape?

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: أو يأخذهم على تخوف فإن ربكم لرءوف رحيم
verses.transliterated: aw yakhudhahum ʿalā takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmu
verses.english: Or it may strike them while they are fearfully expecting it. Your Lord is Compassionate, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Or punish them after a warning? Indeed, your Lord is compassionate, merciful.

1989.english: Or strike them while they are fearfully awake? Your Lord is Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا إلى ما خلق الله من شيء يتفيأ ظلاله عن اليمين والشمائل سجدا لله وهم داخرون
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw ilā mā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin yatafayya-u ẓilāluhu ʿani l-yamīni wal-shamāili sujjadan lillahi wahum dākhirūn
verses.english: Have they not seen all the things created by GOD? Their shadows surround them right and left, in total submission to GOD, and willingly.

1981.english: Have they not seen all the things created by God, with their shadows all around them, right and left? All submissive to God, and subservient.

1989.english: Have they not seen all the things GOD created? Their shadows surround them right and left, in total submission to GOD, and willingly.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولله يسجد ما في السماوات وما في الأرض من دابة والملائكة وهم لا يستكبرون
verses.transliterated: walillahi yasjudu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi min dābbatin wal-malāikatu wahum lā yastakbirūn
verses.english: To GOD prostrates everything in the heavens and everything on earth — every creature—and so do the angels; without the least arrogance.
verses.footnote: The human body, whether it belongs to a believer or a disbeliever, submits to God; the heartbeats, the lungs' movement, and peristalsis illustrate this submission.

1981.english: To God prostrate everything in the heavens and every creature on earth, as well as the angels; they are never too arrogant.

1989.english: To GOD prostrates everything in the heavens and everything on earth— every creature—and so do the angels; without the least arrogance.*
1989.footnote: The human body, whether it belongs to a believer or a disbeliever, submits to God; the heartbeats, the lungs' movement, and peristalsis illustrate this submission.

verses.arabic: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يخافون ربهم من فوقهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون ۩
verses.transliterated: yakhāfūna rabbahum min fawqihim wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūn
verses.english: They reverence their Lord, high above them, and they do what they are commanded to do.

1981.english: They reverence their Lord above them, and do what they are commanded.

1989.english: They reverence their Lord above them, and do what they are commanded to do.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الله لا تتخذوا إلهين اثنين ۖ إنما هو إله واحد ۖ فإياي فارهبون
verses.transliterated: waqāla l-lahu lā tattakhidhū ilāhayni ith'nayni innamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun fa-iyyāya fa-ir'habūn
verses.english: GOD has proclaimed: "Do not worship two gods; there is only one god. You shall reverence Me alone."

1981.english: God says, "Do not set up two gods; there is only one God; you shall reverence Me."
1981.subtitle: One God

1989.english: GOD has proclaimed: “Do not worship two gods; there is only one god. Therefore, you shall reverence Me alone.”

verses.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وله ما في السماوات والأرض وله الدين واصبا ۚ أفغير الله تتقون
verses.transliterated: walahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walahu l-dīnu wāṣiban afaghayra l-lahi tattaqūn
verses.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth and therefore, the religion shall be devoted absolutely to Him alone. Would you worship other than GOD?

1981.english: To Him belong everything in the heavens and the earth, and the religion shall be absolutely devoted to Him. Would you observe other than God?

1989.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth and therefore, the religion shall be devoted absolutely to Him alone. Would you worship other than GOD?

verses.arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما بكم من نعمة فمن الله ۖ ثم إذا مسكم الضر فإليه تجأرون
verses.transliterated: wamā bikum min niʿ'matin famina l-lahi thumma idhā massakumu l-ḍuru fa-ilayhi tajarūn
verses.english: Any blessing you enjoy is from GOD. Yet, whenever you incur any adversity you immediately complain to Him.

1981.english: Any blessing you enjoy is from God, and when adversity hits you, you complain to Him.

1989.english: Any blessing you enjoy is from GOD, and whenever adversity afflicts you, you readily complain to Him alone.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم إذا كشف الضر عنكم إذا فريق منكم بربهم يشركون
verses.transliterated: thumma idhā kashafa l-ḍura ʿankum idhā farīqun minkum birabbihim yush'rikūn
verses.english: Yet, as soon as He relieves your affliction, some of you revert to idol worship.

1981.english: Yet, when He relieves your adversity, some of you set up idols besides their Lord!

1989.english: Yet, as soon as He relieves your affliction, some of you revert to idol worship.

verses.arabic: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم ۚ فتمتعوا ۖ فسوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them. Go ahead and enjoy temporarily; you will surely find out.

1981.english: Let them reject what we have given them. Enjoy yourselves, you will surely find out.

1989.english: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them. Go ahead and enjoy; you will surely find out.

verses.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويجعلون لما لا يعلمون نصيبا مما رزقناهم ۗ تالله لتسألن عما كنتم تفترون
verses.transliterated: wayajʿalūna limā lā yaʿlamūna naṣīban mimmā razaqnāhum tal-lahi latus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taftarūn
verses.english: They designate for the idols they set up out of ignorance, a share of the provisions we bestow upon them. By GOD, you will be held accountable for your innovations.

1981.english: And they set aside for what they do not even know a share of their provisions to them. By God, you will be questioned about your fabrications.

1989.english: And they assign for their idols a share of the provisions we bestowed upon them. By GOD, you will be held accountable for your innovations.

verses.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَٰتِ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويجعلون لله البنات سبحانه ۙ ولهم ما يشتهون
verses.transliterated: wayajʿalūna lillahi l-banāti sub'ḥānahu walahum mā yashtahūn
verses.english: They even assign daughters to GOD, be He glorified, while they prefer for themselves what they like.
verses.subtitle: Bigoted Bias Against Baby Girls

1981.english: They also assigned for God daughters, God be glorified, while assigning for themselves what they like.

1989.english: They even assign daughters to GOD, be He glorified, while choosing for themselves what they like.
1989.subtitle: Bigoted Bias Against Baby Girls

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا بشر أحدهم بالأنثى ظل وجهه مسودا وهو كظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bil-unthā ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmu
verses.english: When one of them gets a baby girl, his face becomes darkened with overwhelming grief.

1981.english: When any of them begets a daughter, his face becomes darkened with sadness and rage.

1989.english: Thus, when one of them gets a baby girl, his face becomes darkened with overwhelming grief.

verses.arabic: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يتوارى من القوم من سوء ما بشر به ۚ أيمسكه على هون أم يدسه في التراب ۗ ألا ساء ما يحكمون
verses.transliterated: yatawārā mina l-qawmi min sūi mā bushira bihi ayum'sikuhu ʿalā hūnin am yadussuhu fī l-turābi alā sāa mā yaḥkumūn
verses.english: Ashamed, he hides from the people, because of the bad news given to him. He even ponders: should he keep the baby grudgingly, or bury her in the dust. Miserable indeed is their judgment.

1981.english: He even hides from the people, ashamed of the bad news. Should he keep the daughter, or bury her in the soil? Miserable indeed is their judgment.

1989.english: Ashamed, he hides from the people, because of the bad news. He even debates: should he keep the baby grudgingly, or bury her in the dust. Miserable indeed is their judgment.

verses.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: للذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة مثل السوء ۖ ولله المثل الأعلى ۚ وهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: lilladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati mathalu l-sawi walillahi l-mathalu l-aʿlā wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter set the worst examples, while to GOD belongs the most sublime examples. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve in the hereafter set the worst example; while God sets the most exalted example. He is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter set the worst examples, while to GOD belongs the most sublime examples. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بظلمهم ما ترك عليها من دابة ولكن يؤخرهم إلى أجل مسمى ۖ فإذا جاء أجلهم لا يستأخرون ساعة ۖ ولا يستقدمون
verses.transliterated: walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa biẓul'mihim mā taraka ʿalayhā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūn
verses.english: If GOD punished the people for their transgressions, He would have annihilated every creature on earth. But He respites them for a specific, predetermined time. Once their interim ends, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.
verses.subtitle: The Original Sin

1981.english: If God punished the people for their actions, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined time. Once their end comes, they can neither delay it by one hour, nor advance it.

1989.english: If GOD punished the people for their transgressions, He would have annihilated every creature on earth. But He respites them for a specific, predetermined time. Once their interim ends, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.

verses.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويجعلون لله ما يكرهون وتصف ألسنتهم الكذب أن لهم الحسنى ۖ لا جرم أن لهم النار وأنهم مفرطون
verses.transliterated: wayajʿalūna lillahi mā yakrahūna wataṣifu alsinatuhumu l-kadhiba anna lahumu l-ḥus'nā lā jarama anna lahumu l-nāra wa-annahum muf'raṭūn
verses.english: They ascribe to GOD what they dislike for themselves, then utter the lie with their own tongues that they are righteous! Without any doubt, they have incurred Hell, for they have rebelled.

1981.english: They ascribe to God what they themselves do not like. Yet their tongues claim that they are righteous. No doubt, they have deserved hell; they have deviated.

1989.english: They ascribe to GOD what they dislike for themselves, then utter the lie with their own tongues that they are righteous! Without any doubt, they have incurred Hell, for they have blasphemed.

verses.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: تالله لقد أرسلنا إلى أمم من قبلك فزين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم فهو وليهم اليوم ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: tal-lahi laqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu l-yawma walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: By GOD, we have sent (messengers) to communities before you, but the devil adorned their works in their eyes. Consequently, he is now their lord, and they have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: By God, we have sent messengers to communities before yours, and the devil adorned their works in their eyes. Consequently, he is their leader today; they have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: By GOD, we have sent (messengers) to communities before you, but the devil adorned their works in their eyes. Consequently, he is now their lord. They have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أنزلنا عليك الكتاب إلا لتبين لهم الذي اختلفوا فيه ۙ وهدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wamā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumu alladhī ikh'talafū fīhi wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: We have revealed this scripture to you, to point out for them what they dispute, and to provide guidance and mercy for people who believe.

1981.english: We did not send this scripture down to you, except to show them what they dispute, and to provide guidance and mercy for those who believe.

1989.english: We have revealed this scripture to you, to point out to them what they dispute, and to provide guidance and mercy for people who believe.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله أنزل من السماء ماء فأحيا به الأرض بعد موتها ۚ إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يسمعون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yasmaʿūn
verses.english: GOD sends down from the sky water to revive the land after it had died. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who hear.
verses.subtitle: Additional Proofs From God

1981.english: God sends down water from the sky, whereby He revives dead land. This should be a sign for those who hear.
1981.subtitle: Overwhelming Signs of God

1989.english: And GOD sends down water from the sky to revive the land after it had died. This is a sign for people who hear.
1989.subtitle: Additional Signs From God

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن لكم في الأنعام لعبرة ۖ نسقيكم مما في بطونه من بين فرث ودم لبنا خالصا سائغا للشاربين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khāliṣan sāighan lilshāribīn
verses.english: And in the livestock there is a lesson for you: we provide you with a drink from their bellies. From the midst of digested food and blood, you get pure milk, delicious for the drinkers.

1981.english: And the livestock offer you another lesson; we let you drink from their bellies, from the midst of waste and blood, pure and delicious milk.

1989.english: And in the livestock there is a lesson for you: we provide you with a drink from their bellies. From the midst of digested food and blood, you get pure milk, delicious for the drinkers.

verses.arabic: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن ثمرات النخيل والأعناب تتخذون منه سكرا ورزقا حسنا ۗ إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wamin thamarāti l-nakhīli wal-aʿnābi tattakhidhūna min'hu sakaran wariz'qan ḥasanan inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes you produce intoxicants, as well as good provisions. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who understand.

1981.english: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes you make intoxicants, as well as good provisions. This should be a sign for those who understand.

1989.english: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes you produce intoxicants, as well as good provisions. This is a sign for people who understand. The Bee

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأوحى ربك إلى النحل أن اتخذي من الجبال بيوتا ومن الشجر ومما يعرشون
verses.transliterated: wa-awḥā rabbuka ilā l-naḥli ani ittakhidhī mina l-jibāli buyūtan wamina l-shajari wamimmā yaʿrishūn
verses.english: And your Lord inspired the bee: build homes in mountains and trees, and in (the hives) they build for you.
verses.subtitle: The Bee

1981.english: And your Lord inspires the bee: "build homes in the mountains, the trees, and what the people build for you.

1989.english: And your Lord inspired the bee: build homes in mountains and trees, and in (the hives) they build for you.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم كلي من كل الثمرات فاسلكي سبل ربك ذللا ۚ يخرج من بطونها شراب مختلف ألوانه فيه شفاء للناس ۗ إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: thumma kulī min kulli l-thamarāti fa-us'lukī subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukh'talifun alwānuhu fīhi shifāon lilnnāsi inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verses.english: Then eat from all the fruits, following the design of your Lord, precisely. From their bellies comes a drink of different colors, wherein there is healing for the people. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who reflect.
verses.footnote: Besides its recognized nutritive value, honey has been scientifically proven as a healing medicine for certain allergies and other ailments.

1981.english: "Then eat from all kinds of crops, and obediently follow the designs of your Lord." Out of their bellies comes a liquid of various colors, wherein there is healing for the people. This should be a sign for those who reflect.

1989.english: Then eat from all the fruits, following the design of your Lord, precisely. From their bellies comes a drink of different colors, wherein there is healing for the people. This is a sign for people who reflect.*
1989.footnote: Besides its recognized nutritive value, honey has been scientifically proven as a healing medicine of certain allergies and other ailments.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: والله خلقكم ثم يتوفاكم ۚ ومنكم من يرد إلى أرذل العمر لكي لا يعلم بعد علم شيئا ۚ إن الله عليم قدير
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likay lā yaʿlama baʿda ʿil'min shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun qadīru
verses.english: GOD created you, then He terminates your lives. He lets some of you live to the oldest age, only to find out that there is a limit to the knowledge they can acquire. GOD is Omniscient, Omnipotent.

1981.english: And God is the one who created you, then puts you to death. Some of you are allowed to live to the oldest age, in order to find out that there is a limit to their knowledge. God is omniscient, omnipotent.

1989.english: And GOD created you, and He terminates your lives. He lets some of you live to the oldest age, only to find out that there is a limit to the knowledge they can acquire. GOD is Omniscient, Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله فضل بعضكم على بعض في الرزق ۚ فما الذين فضلوا برادي رزقهم على ما ملكت أيمانهم فهم فيه سواء ۚ أفبنعمة الله يجحدون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu faḍḍala baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍin fī l-riz'qi famā alladhīna fuḍḍilū birāddī riz'qihim ʿalā mā malakat aymānuhum fahum fīhi sawāon afabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yajḥadūn
verses.english: GOD has provided for some of you more than others. Those who are given plenty would never give their properties to their subordinates to the extent of making them partners. Would they give up GOD's blessings?
verses.subtitle: No Partners With God
verses.footnote: If the humans would not give up their power to that extent, why do they expect God to do this, and create partners for Himself?

1981.english: God bestows provisions upon you in various degrees; those of you endowed with plenty never give back their provisions to their servants, to the extent of equality. Would they reject God's blessings?

1989.english: And GOD has provided for some of you more than others. Those who are given plenty would never give their properties to their subordinates to the extent of making them partners. Would they give up GOD’s blessings?*
1989.footnote: If the humans would not give up their power to that extent, why do they expect God to do this, and create partners for Himself?

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا وجعل لكم من أزواجكم بنين وحفدة ورزقكم من الطيبات ۚ أفبالباطل يؤمنون وبنعمت الله هم يكفرون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wajaʿala lakum min azwājikum banīna waḥafadatan warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi hum yakfurūn
verses.english: And GOD made for you spouses from among yourselves, and produced for you from your spouses children and grandchildren, and provided you with good provisions. Should they believe in falsehood, and turn unappreciative of GOD's blessings?

1981.english: And God created for you spouses from among yourselves, then creates from your spouses children and grand children, and He provided for you. Would they then believe in falsehood, and disbelieve in God's blessings?

1989.english: And GOD made for you spouses from among yourselves, and produced for you from your spouses children and grandchildren, and provided you with good provisions. Should they believe in falsehood, and turn unappreciative of GOD’s blessings?

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا يملك لهم رزقا من السماوات والأرض شيئا ولا يستطيعون
verses.transliterated: wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yamliku lahum riz'qan mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi shayan walā yastaṭīʿūn
verses.english: Yet, they worship beside GOD what possesses no provisions for them in the heavens, nor on earth, nor can provide them with anything.
verses.subtitle: Idol Worship: Not Very Intelligent

1981.english: Yet, they idolize besides God what possesses no provisions in the heavens or the earth, nor can provide them with anything.

1989.english: Yet, they worship besides GOD what possesses no provisions for them in the heavens, nor on earth, nor can provide them with anything.
1989.subtitle: Idol Worship: Not Very Intelligent

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تضربوا لله الأمثال ۚ إن الله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: falā taḍribū lillahi l-amthāla inna l-laha yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: Therefore, do not cite the examples for GOD; GOD knows while you do not know.

1981.english: Therefore, do not cite any examples for God; God knows, while you do not know.

1989.english: Therefore, do not cite the examples for GOD; GOD knows while you do not know.

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ضرب الله مثلا عبدا مملوكا لا يقدر على شيء ومن رزقناه منا رزقا حسنا فهو ينفق منه سرا وجهرا ۖ هل يستوون ۚ الحمد لله ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan ʿabdan mamlūkan lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin waman razaqnāhu minnā riz'qan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu min'hu sirran wajahran hal yastawūna l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: GOD cites the example of a slave who is owned, and is totally powerless, compared to one whom we blessed with good provisions, from which he gives to charity secretly and publicly. Are they equal? Praise be to GOD, most of them do not know.
verses.subtitle: The Rich Believer is Better than the Poor Believer

1981.english: God cites the example of a slave who is owned and possesses nothing, compared to one whom we provided generously, and he gives to charity secretly and publicly; are they equal? Praise be to God; most of them do not know.
1981.subtitle: The Strong Believer Better Than The Weak Believer

1989.english: GOD cites the example of a slave who is owned, and is totally powerless, compared to one whom we blessed with good provisions, from which he gives to charity secretly and publicly. Are they equal? Praise be to GOD, most of them do not know.
1989.subtitle: The Rich Believer Better than the Poor Believer

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وضرب الله مثلا رجلين أحدهما أبكم لا يقدر على شيء وهو كل على مولاه أينما يوجهه لا يأت بخير ۖ هل يستوي هو ومن يأمر بالعدل ۙ وهو على صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulayni aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin wahuwa kallun ʿalā mawlāhu aynamā yuwajjihhu lā yati bikhayrin hal yastawī huwa waman yamuru bil-ʿadli wahuwa ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: And GOD cites the example of two men: one is dumb, lacks the ability to do anything, is totally dependent on his master—whichever way he directs him, he cannot produce anything good. Is he equal to one who rules with justice, and is guided in the right path?

1981.english: And God cites the example of two men; one is dumb and helpless, and totally dependent on his master; wherever he directs him, he produces nothing good. Is he equal to one who rules with justice, and follows a straight path?

1989.english: And GOD cites the example of two men: one is dumb, lacks the ability to do anything, totally dependent on his master— whichever way he directs him, he cannot produce anything good. Is he equal to one who rules with justice, and is guided?

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولله غيب السماوات والأرض ۚ وما أمر الساعة إلا كلمح البصر أو هو أقرب ۚ إن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā amru l-sāʿati illā kalamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth. As far as He is concerned, the end of the world (the Hour) is a blink of an eye away, or even closer. GOD is Omnipotent.
verses.subtitle: This Life is Very Short

1981.english: To God belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and the Hour is only a matter of an eye's blinking; or even closer. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth. As far as He is concerned, the end of the world (the Hour) is only a blink of an eye away, or even closer. GOD is Omnipotent.
1989.subtitle: This Life is Very Short

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله أخرجكم من بطون أمهاتكم لا تعلمون شيئا وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة ۙ لعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu akhrajakum min buṭūni ummahātikum lā taʿlamūna shayan wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata laʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: GOD brought you out of your mothers' bellies knowing nothing, and He gave you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains, that you may be appreciative.

1981.english: And God is the one who got you out of your mothers' wombs knowing nothing, and He gave you the hearing, the eyes, and the minds, that you may be thankful.

1989.english: GOD brought you out of your mothers’ bellies knowing nothing. He gave you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains, that you may be appreciative.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يروا إلى الطير مسخرات في جو السماء ما يمسكهن إلا الله ۗ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: alam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri musakharātin fī jawwi l-samāi mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-lahu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: Do they not see the birds committed to fly in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up in the air except GOD. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who believe.

1981.english: Do they not see the birds assigned to fly in mid air, none can catch them except God? This should provide signs for those who believe.

1989.english: Do they not see the birds designed to fly in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up in the air except GOD. This is a sign for people who believe.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثًا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: والله جعل لكم من بيوتكم سكنا وجعل لكم من جلود الأنعام بيوتا تستخفونها يوم ظعنكم ويوم إقامتكم ۙ ومن أصوافها وأوبارها وأشعارها أثاثا ومتاعا إلى حين
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min buyūtikum sakanan wajaʿala lakum min julūdi l-anʿāmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓaʿnikum wayawma iqāmatikum wamin aṣwāfihā wa-awbārihā wa-ashʿārihā athāthan wamatāʿan ilā ḥīni
verses.english: And GOD provided for you stationary homes where you can live. And He provided for you portable homes made of the hides of livestock, so you can use them when you travel, and when you settle down. And from their wools, furs, and hair, you make furnishings and luxuries for awhile.

1981.english: And God provided you with homes to settle in, as well as portable homes made of animal hides. And from their wool, fur, and hair, you make furnishings and materials for a while.

1989.english: And GOD provided for you homes where you can live. And provided for you portable homes out of the hides of livestock, so you can use them when you travel, and when you settle down. And from their wools, furs, and hair, you make furnishings and luxuries for awhile.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله جعل لكم مما خلق ظلالا وجعل لكم من الجبال أكنانا وجعل لكم سرابيل تقيكم الحر وسرابيل تقيكم بأسكم ۚ كذلك يتم نعمته عليكم لعلكم تسلمون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu jaʿala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālan wajaʿala lakum mina l-jibāli aknānan wajaʿala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu l-ḥara wasarābīla taqīkum basakum kadhālika yutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tus'limūn
verses.english: And GOD provided for you shade through things which He created, and provided for you shelters in the mountains, and provided for you garments that protect you from heat, and garments that protect when you fight in wars. He thus perfects His blessings upon you, that you may submit.

1981.english: God made for you creations that provide you with shade, and mountains that provide you with shelter. He made for you garments that protect you from the heat, as well as garments that shield you in war. He thus perfects His provisions to you, that you may submit.

1989.english: And GOD provided for you shade through things {such as trees) which He created, and provided for you shelters in the mountains, and provided for you garments that protect you from heat, and garments that protect you in your wars. He thus perfects His blessings upon you, that you may submit.

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: فإن تولوا فإنما عليك البلاغ المبين
verses.transliterated: fa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu l-mubīn
verses.english: If they still turn away, then your sole mission is the clear delivery (of the message).

1981.english: If they still turn away, then your sole mission is to deliver the message.

1989.english: If they still turn away, then your sole mission is the clear delivery (of the message).

verses.arabic: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يعرفون نعمت الله ثم ينكرونها وأكثرهم الكافرون
verses.transliterated: yaʿrifūna niʿ'mata l-lahi thumma yunkirūnahā wa-aktharuhumu l-kāfirūn
verses.english: They fully recognize GOD's blessings, then deny them; the majority of them are disbelievers.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers Unappreciative

1981.english: Although they recognize God's blessings, they disregard them, and most of them disbelieve.

1989.english: They fully recognize GOD’s blessings, then deny them, and most of them are disbelievers.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers Unappreciative

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم نبعث من كل أمة شهيدا ثم لا يؤذن للذين كفروا ولا هم يستعتبون
verses.transliterated: wayawma nabʿathu min kulli ummatin shahīdan thumma lā yu'dhanu lilladhīna kafarū walā hum yus'taʿtabūn
verses.english: The day will come when we raise from every community a witness, then those who disbelieved will not be permitted (to speak), nor will they be excused.
verses.subtitle: On The Day of Resurrection

1981.english: The day will come when we raise a witness from each community; the disbelievers will not be permitted to speak, nor will they be excused.
1981.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Idolizers

1989.english: The day will come when we raise a witness from every community, then those who disbelieved will not be permitted (to speak), nor will they be excused.
1989.subtitle: On The Day of Resurrection

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا رأى الذين ظلموا العذاب فلا يخفف عنهم ولا هم ينظرون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā raā alladhīna ẓalamū l-ʿadhāba falā yukhaffafu ʿanhum walā hum yunẓarūn
verses.english: Once those who transgressed see the retribution, it will be too late; it will not be commuted for them, nor will they be respited.

1981.english: Once the wicked see the retribution, it will never be commuted for them, nor will they be respited.

1989.english: And when those who transgressed see the retribution, it will be too late; it will not be commuted for them, nor will they be respited.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَهُمْ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِكَ فَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا رأى الذين أشركوا شركاءهم قالوا ربنا هؤلاء شركاؤنا الذين كنا ندعو من دونك ۖ فألقوا إليهم القول إنكم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā raā alladhīna ashrakū shurakāahum qālū rabbanā hāulāi shurakāunā alladhīna kunnā nadʿū min dūnika fa-alqaw ilayhimu l-qawla innakum lakādhibūn
verses.english: And when those who committed idol worship see their idols, they will say, "Our Lord, these are the idols we had set up beside You." The idols will then confront them and say, "You are liars."
verses.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Idolizers

1981.english: And when the idol worshipers see their idols, they will say, "Our Lord, these are the idols that we idolized besides You." But the idols will shock them with the utterance, "You are indeed liars."
1981.footnote: This verse proves that the idols are not only stone statues, but also human beings such as Muhammad, Jesus, Mary, and the saints.

1989.english: And when those who committed idol worship see their idols, they will say, “Our Lord, these are the idols we had set up besides You.” The idols will then confront them and say, “You are liars.”
1989.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Idolizers

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وألقوا إلى الله يومئذ السلم ۖ وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: wa-alqaw ilā l-lahi yawma-idhin l-salama waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: They will totally submit to GOD on that day, and the idols they had invented will disown them.

1981.english: They will then offer the total submission to God, and the idols they fabricated will disown them.

1989.english: They will totally submit to GOD on that day, and the idols they invented will disown them.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَٰهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله زدناهم عذابا فوق العذاب بما كانوا يفسدون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi zid'nāhum ʿadhāban fawqa l-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yuf'sidūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, we augment their retribution by adding more retribution, due to their transgressions.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of God, we will double the retribution for them, because of their wickedness.

1989.english: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, we augment their retribution by adding more retribution, due to their transgressions.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ تِبْيَٰنًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم نبعث في كل أمة شهيدا عليهم من أنفسهم ۖ وجئنا بك شهيدا على هؤلاء ۚ ونزلنا عليك الكتاب تبيانا لكل شيء وهدى ورحمة وبشرى للمسلمين
verses.transliterated: wayawma nabʿathu fī kulli ummatin shahīdan ʿalayhim min anfusihim waji'nā bika shahīdan ʿalā hāulāi wanazzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba tib'yānan likulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīn
verses.english: The day will come when we will raise from every community a witness from among them, and bring you as the witness of these people. We have revealed to you this book to provide explanations for everything, and guidance, and mercy, and good news for the submitters.

1981.english: The day will come when we raise a witness from each community, and bring you as a witness against these people. We have sent down to you this scripture to explain all things, and to provide guidance and mercy, and good news, for the Muslims.

1989.english: The day will come when we raise from every community a witness, and bring you as a witness for these people. We have revealed to you this book to provide explanations for everything, and guidance, and mercy, and good news for the Muslims.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يأمر بالعدل والإحسان وإيتاء ذي القربى وينهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر والبغي ۚ يعظكم لعلكم تذكرون
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yamuru bil-ʿadli wal-iḥ'sāni waītāi dhī l-qur'bā wayanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari wal-baghyi yaʿiẓukum laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.english: GOD advocates justice, charity, and regarding the relatives. And He forbids evil, vice, and transgression. He enlightens you, that you may take heed.

1981.english: Indeed, God commands justice, righteousness, and regarding the relatives. And He prohibits evil, vice and transgression. He enlightens you, that you may take heed.

1989.english: GOD commands justice, charity, and regarding the relatives. And He forbids evil, vice, and transgression. He enlightens you, that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَٰهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا۟ ٱلْأَيْمَٰنَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأوفوا بعهد الله إذا عاهدتم ولا تنقضوا الأيمان بعد توكيدها وقد جعلتم الله عليكم كفيلا ۚ إن الله يعلم ما تفعلون
verses.transliterated: wa-awfū biʿahdi l-lahi idhā ʿāhadttum walā tanquḍū l-aymāna baʿda tawkīdihā waqad jaʿaltumu l-laha ʿalaykum kafīlan inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūn
verses.english: You shall fulfill your covenant with GOD when you make such a covenant. You shall not violate the oaths after swearing (by GOD) to carry them out, for you have made GOD a guarantor for you. GOD knows everything you do.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Keep Your Word

1981.english: You shall fulfill the vows you make to God. Do not break your oaths, after pledging to keep them, and after using God's name as surety. God knows everything you do.

1989.english: You shall fulfill your covenant with GOD when you make such a covenant. You shall not violate the oaths after swearing (by God) to carry them out, for you have made GOD a guarantor for you. GOD knows everything you do.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Keep Your Word

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَٰثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِىَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تكونوا كالتي نقضت غزلها من بعد قوة أنكاثا تتخذون أيمانكم دخلا بينكم أن تكون أمة هي أربى من أمة ۚ إنما يبلوكم الله به ۚ وليبينن لكم يوم القيامة ما كنتم فيه تختلفون
verses.transliterated: walā takūnū ka-allatī naqaḍat ghazlahā min baʿdi quwwatin ankāthan tattakhidhūna aymānakum dakhalan baynakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummatin innamā yablūkumu l-lahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma l-qiyāmati mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn
verses.english: Do not be like the knitter who unravels her strong knitting into piles of flimsy yarn. This is your example if you abuse the oaths to take advantage of one another. Whether one group is larger than the other, GOD thus puts you to the test. He will surely show you on the Day of Resurrection everything you had disputed.

1981.english: Do not be like one who rips out her tight knitting into piles of flimsy yarn. Do not use your oaths as a means of deceit amongst yourselves. This shall distinguish your community from any other community. God thus puts you to the test. He will surely explain to you, on the day of resurrection, everything you disputed in.

1989.english: Do not be like the knitter who unravels her strong knitting into piles of flimsy yarn. Thus are you when you abuse the oaths among you, and take advantage of others who are not as numerous as you. This shall be a distinguishing trait that sets you apart from other communities. GOD thus puts you to the test, and He will surely show you on the Day of Resurrection everything you disputed.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو شاء الله لجعلكم أمة واحدة ولكن يضل من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء ۚ ولتسألن عما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalakum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu walatus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: Had GOD willed, He could have made you one congregation. But He sends astray whoever chooses to go astray, and He guides whoever wishes to be guided. You will surely be asked about everything you have done.
verses.footnote: God knows the sincere believers among us who deserve to be redeemed. Accordingly, He guides them, while blocking out those who choose to disbelieve.

1981.english: Had God willed, He could have made you one community. But He misleads whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills. You will surely be questioned about everything you did.
1981.footnote: God does mislead those who deserve to be misled, after making their free-will decision to disbelieve (see Appendix 12 for details).

1989.english: Had GOD willed, He could have made you one congregation. But He sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills.* You will surely be asked about everything you have done.
1989.footnote: God knows the sincere believers among us who deserve to be redeemed. Accordingly, He guides them, while blocking out those who do not qualify for redemption.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تتخذوا أيمانكم دخلا بينكم فتزل قدم بعد ثبوتها وتذوقوا السوء بما صددتم عن سبيل الله ۖ ولكم عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: walā tattakhidhū aymānakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baʿda thubūtihā watadhūqū l-sūa bimā ṣadadttum ʿan sabīli l-lahi walakum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Do not abuse the oaths among you, lest you slide back after having a strong foothold, then you incur misery. Such is the consequence of repelling from the path of GOD (by setting a bad example); you incur a terrible retribution.
verses.subtitle: Violating Your Oath: A Serious Offense

1981.english: Do not use your oaths as a means of deceit amongst yourselves. Otherwise, your foothold may slip after being firm, and you incur misery for deviating from the way of God; then deserve a terrible retribution.

1989.english: Do not abuse the oaths among you, lest you slide back after having a strong foothold, and incur misery. Such is the consequence of repelling from the path of GOD; you incur a terrible retribution.
1989.subtitle: Violating Your Oath: A Serious Offense

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تشتروا بعهد الله ثمنا قليلا ۚ إنما عند الله هو خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: walā tashtarū biʿahdi l-lahi thamanan qalīlan innamā ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: Do not sell your oaths before GOD short. What GOD possesses is far better for you, if you only knew.

1981.english: Nor shall you violate your vows to God, in exchange for a cheap price. What God possesses is far better for you, if you only knew.

1989.english: Do not sell your oaths before GOD short. What GOD possesses is far better for you, if you only knew.

verses.arabic: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٍ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما عندكم ينفد ۖ وما عند الله باق ۗ ولنجزين الذين صبروا أجرهم بأحسن ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: mā ʿindakum yanfadu wamā ʿinda l-lahi bāqin walanajziyanna alladhīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: What you possess runs out, but what GOD possesses lasts forever. We will surely reward those who steadfastly persevere; we will recompense them for their righteous works.

1981.english: Whatever you possess runs out, and what God possesses is eternal. We will surely reward the steadfast for their righteous works.

1989.english: What you possess runs out, but what GOD possesses lasts forever. We will surely reward those who steadfastly persevere; we will recompense them for their righteous works.

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةً طَيِّبَةً وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من عمل صالحا من ذكر أو أنثى وهو مؤمن فلنحيينه حياة طيبة ۖ ولنجزينهم أجرهم بأحسن ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun falanuḥ'yiyannahu ḥayatan ṭayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Anyone who works righteousness, male or female, while believing, we will surely grant them a happy life in this world, and we will surely pay them their full recompense (on the Day of Judgment) for their righteous works.
verses.subtitle: Guaranteed Happiness Now and Forever

1981.english: Whoever works righteousness, be it male or female, while being a believer, we will grant him a happy life, and reward them generously for their righteous works.

1989.english: Anyone who works righteousness, male or female, while believing, we will surely grant them a happy life in this world, and we will surely pay them their full recompense (on the Day of Judgment) for their righteous works.
1989.subtitle: Guaranteed Happiness Now and Forever

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا قرأت القرآن فاستعذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi mina l-shayṭāni l-rajīm
verses.english: When you read the Quran, you shall seek refuge in GOD from Satan the rejected.
verses.subtitle: An Important Commandment
verses.footnote: Our salvation is attained by knowing God's message to us, the Quran, and Satan will do his utmost to keep us from being redeemed. Hence this commandment.

1981.english: When you read the Quran, seek refuge in God from the rejected devil.
1981.subtitle: Satan Prevents People From Reading Quran

1989.english: When you read the Quran, you shall seek refuge in GOD from Satan the rejected.
1989.subtitle: An Important Commandment
1989.footnote: Our salvation is attained by knowing God’s message to us, the Quran, and Satan will do his utmost to keep us from being redeemed. Hence this commandment.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنه ليس له سلطان على الذين آمنوا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون
verses.transliterated: innahu laysa lahu sul'ṭānun ʿalā alladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
verses.english: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord.

1981.english: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord.

1989.english: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما سلطانه على الذين يتولونه والذين هم به مشركون
verses.transliterated: innamā sul'ṭānuhu ʿalā alladhīna yatawallawnahu wa-alladhīna hum bihi mush'rikūn
verses.english: His power is limited to those who choose him as their master; those who choose him as their god.

1981.english: His power is limited to those who ally themselves with him, and fall into idol worship.

1989.english: His power is limited to those who choose him as their master; those who choose him as their god.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةً مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا بدلنا آية مكان آية ۙ والله أعلم بما ينزل قالوا إنما أنت مفتر ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā baddalnā āyatan makāna āyatin wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yunazzilu qālū innamā anta muf'tarin bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: When we substitute one revelation in place of another, and GOD is fully aware of what He reveals, they say, "You made this up!" Indeed, most of them do not know.

1981.english: When we substitute a revelation in place of a previous revelation, God is fully aware of everything He sends down, they would say, "You have invented this." Indeed, most of them do not know.

1989.english: When we substitute one revelation in place of another, and GOD is fully aware of what He reveals, they say, “You made this up!” Indeed, most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُۥ رُوحُ ٱلْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل نزله روح القدس من ربك بالحق ليثبت الذين آمنوا وهدى وبشرى للمسلمين
verses.transliterated: qul nazzalahu rūḥu l-qudusi min rabbika bil-ḥaqi liyuthabbita alladhīna āmanū wahudan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīn
verses.english: Say, "The Holy Spirit has brought it down from your Lord, truthfully, to assure those who believe, and to provide a beacon and good news for the submitters."

1981.english: Say, "This was brought down by the Holy Spirit, truthfully from your Lord, in order to strengthen the believers, and to provide guidance and good news for the Muslims.

1989.english: Say, “The Holy Spirit has brought it down from your Lord, truthfully, in order to strengthen those who believe, and to provide a beacon and good news for the Muslims.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٌ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِىٌّ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد نعلم أنهم يقولون إنما يعلمه بشر ۗ لسان الذي يلحدون إليه أعجمي وهذا لسان عربي مبين
verses.transliterated: walaqad naʿlamu annahum yaqūlūna innamā yuʿallimuhu basharun lisānu alladhī yul'ḥidūna ilayhi aʿjamiyyun wahādhā lisānun ʿarabiyyun mubīnu
verses.english: We are fully aware that they say, "A human being is teaching him!" The tongue of the source they hint at is non-Arabic, and this is a perfect Arabic tongue.
verses.subtitle: The Quran Is Not Copied From The Bible

1981.english: We are fully aware that they say, "A human being has taught him this." The source they hint at is non-Arabic, while this is a perfect Arabic tongue.

1989.english: We are fully aware that they say, “A human being is teaching him!” The tongue of the source they hint at is non-Arabic, and this is a perfect Arabic tongue.
1989.subtitle: The Quran Is Not Copied From The Bible

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين لا يؤمنون بآيات الله لا يهديهم الله ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi lā yahdīhimu l-lahu walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Surely, those who do not believe in GOD's revelations, GOD does not guide them. They have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who refuse to believe God's revelations, God will never guide them, and they have deserved painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: The Advocates of "Hadith" and/or "Sunna"

1989.english: Surely, those who do not believe in GOD’s revelations, GOD does not guide them. They incur a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى ٱلْكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يفتري الكذب الذين لا يؤمنون بآيات الله ۖ وأولئك هم الكاذبون
verses.transliterated: innamā yaftarī l-kadhiba alladhīna lā yu'minūna biāyāti l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-kādhibūn
verses.english: The only ones who fabricate false doctrines are those who do not believe in GOD's revelations; they are the real liars.

1981.english: Those who make up religious regulations do not believe God's revelations;* they are the real liars.
1981.footnote: Those who blasphemed against the prophet, and disobeyed him by inventing "Hadith" and/or "Sunna" commit such lies because they obviously reject the Quran's repeated assertions that it is complete, perfect, and shall be the sole source of religious regulations (6:19, 38, 114, 20:114, and 75:19).

1989.english: The only ones who fabricate false doctrines are those who do not believe in GOD’s revelations they are the real liars.

verses.arabic: مَن كَفَرَ بِٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَٰنِهِۦٓ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُۥ مُطْمَئِنٌّۢ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَلَٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِٱلْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: من كفر بالله من بعد إيمانه إلا من أكره وقلبه مطمئن بالإيمان ولكن من شرح بالكفر صدرا فعليهم غضب من الله ولهم عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: man kafara bil-lahi min baʿdi īmānihi illā man uk'riha waqalbuhu muṭ'ma-innun bil-īmāni walākin man sharaḥa bil-kuf'ri ṣadran faʿalayhim ghaḍabun mina l-lahi walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Those who disbelieve in GOD, after having acquired faith, and become fully content with disbelief, have incurred wrath from GOD. The only ones to be excused are those who are forced to profess disbelief, while their hearts are full of faith.
verses.subtitle: Lip Service Does Not Count
