verses.footnote: God's wisdom decrees that if someone holds a gun to your head and orders you to declare that you disbelieve in God, you may grant him his wish. What the heart harbors is what counts.

1981.english: Anyone who disbelieves in God after having believed, unless forced while the heart is content with faith; such persons whose hearts are willingly open to disbelief, invoke wrath from God and terrible retribution.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved in GOD, after having acquired faith, and became fully content with disbelief, have incurred wrath from GOD. The only ones to be excused are those who are forced to profess disbelief, while their hearts are full of faith.*
1989.subtitle: Lip Service Does Not Count
1989.footnote: God’s wisdom decrees that if someone holds a gun to your head and orders you to declare that you disbelieve in God, you may grant him his wish. What the heart harbors is what counts.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم استحبوا الحياة الدنيا على الآخرة وأن الله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahumu is'taḥabbū l-ḥayata l-dun'yā ʿalā l-ākhirati wa-anna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīn
verses.english: This is because they have given priority to this life over the Hereafter, and GOD does not guide such disbelieving people.
verses.subtitle: Preoccupation With This Life Leads to Exile From God

1981.english: That is because they preferred this life over the hereafter, and because God does not guide the disbelieving people.

1989.english: This is because they have given priority to this life over the Hereafter, and GOD does not guide such disbelieving people.
1989.subtitle: Preoccupation With This Life Leads to Exile From God

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين طبع الله على قلوبهم وسمعهم وأبصارهم ۖ وأولئك هم الغافلون
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wasamʿihim wa-abṣārihim wa-ulāika humu l-ghāfilūn
verses.english: Those are the ones whom GOD has sealed their hearts, and their hearing, and their eyesight. Consequently, they remain unaware.

1981.english: God seals their hearts, their hearing, and their visions. Consequently, they are totally unaware.

1989.english: These are the ones whom GOD seals their hearts, their hearing, and their eyesight; they remain unaware.

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا جرم أنهم في الآخرة هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: Without a doubt, they will be the losers in the Hereafter.

1981.english: No doubt, they will be losers in the hereafter.

1989.english: Without a doubt, they will be the losers in the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا۟ ثُمَّ جَٰهَدُوا۟ وَصَبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ثم إن ربك للذين هاجروا من بعد ما فتنوا ثم جاهدوا وصبروا إن ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna hājarū min baʿdi mā futinū thumma jāhadū waṣabarū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: As for those who emigrate because of persecution, then continue to strive and steadfastly persevere, your Lord, because of all this, is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: However, your Lord regards those who leave their homes, due to persecution in the cause of God, then continue to strive and persevere. For these people, your Lord is forgiving, merciful.

1989.english: Certainly, as regards those who emigrated because of persecution, then continued to strive and steadfastly persevered, your Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَأْتِى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَٰدِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تأتي كل نفس تجادل عن نفسها وتوفى كل نفس ما عملت وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: yawma tatī kullu nafsin tujādilu ʿan nafsihā watuwaffā kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: The day will come when every soul will serve as its own advocate, and every soul will be paid fully for whatever it had done, without the least injustice.

1981.english: The day will come when each soul defends itself, and each soul will be paid for whatever it did. No one will suffer injustice.

1989.english: The day will come when every soul will serve as its own advocate, and every soul will be paid fully for whatever it had done, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلْجُوعِ وَٱلْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وضرب الله مثلا قرية كانت آمنة مطمئنة يأتيها رزقها رغدا من كل مكان فكفرت بأنعم الله فأذاقها الله لباس الجوع والخوف بما كانوا يصنعون
verses.transliterated: waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan qaryatan kānat āminatan muṭ'ma-innatan yatīhā riz'quhā raghadan min kulli makānin fakafarat bi-anʿumi l-lahi fa-adhāqahā l-lahu libāsa l-jūʿi wal-khawfi bimā kānū yaṣnaʿūn
verses.english: GOD cites the example of a community that used to be secure and prosperous, with provisions coming to it from everywhere. But then, it turned unappreciative of GOD's blessings. Consequently, GOD caused them to taste the hardships of starvation and insecurity. Such is the requital for what they did.
verses.subtitle: Prohibiting Lawful Food Brings Deprivation

1981.english: God cites the example of a community that enjoyed peace and security, with abundant provisions from everywhere. Then they prohibited some of God's givings, and consequently, God afflicted them with hunger and fear.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Prohibit Lawful Foods

1989.english: GOD cites the example of a community that used to be secure and prosperous, with provisions coming to it from everywhere. But then, it turned unappreciative of GOD’s blessings. Consequently, GOD permitted them to taste the affliction of starvation and insecurity. That was the requital for what they did.
1989.subtitle: Prohibiting Lawful Food Brings Misery

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جاءهم رسول منهم فكذبوه فأخذهم العذاب وهم ظالمون
verses.transliterated: walaqad jāahum rasūlun min'hum fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu wahum ẓālimūn
verses.english: A messenger had gone to them from among them, but they rejected him. Consequently, the retribution struck them for their transgression.

1981.english: A messenger had come to them, from among them, but they rejected him. Subsequently, the retribution afflicted them, because of their wickedness.

1989.english: A messenger had gone to them, from among them, but they rejected him. Consequently, the retribution struck them as they transgressed.

verses.arabic: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فكلوا مما رزقكم الله حلالا طيبا واشكروا نعمت الله إن كنتم إياه تعبدون
verses.transliterated: fakulū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu ḥalālan ṭayyiban wa-ush'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall eat from GOD's provisions everything that is lawful and good, and be appreciative of GOD's blessings, if you do worship Him alone.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall eat from God's lawful and good provisions, and be appreciative of God's blessings, if you do worship Him alone.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall eat from GOD’s provisions everything that is lawful and good, and be appreciative of GOD’s blessings, if you do worship Him alone.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنما حرم عليكم الميتة والدم ولحم الخنزير وما أهل لغير الله به ۖ فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فإن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: innamā ḥarrama ʿalaykumu l-maytata wal-dama walaḥma l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri l-lahi bihi famani uḍ'ṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: He only prohibits for you dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs, and food which is dedicated to other than GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being deliberate or malicious, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Only Four Foods Prohibited
verses.footnote: & 118 The most devastating trichinosis parasite, Trichinella spiralis, (also the pork tapeworm Taenia solium) survives in the meat of pigs, not the fat. More than 150,000 people are infected annually in the United States. See 6:145-146, and Appendix 16.

1981.english: He only prohibits for you animals that die of themselves, blood, the meat of pigs, and animals dedicated to other than God. However, if one is forced (to eat these) without being deliberate or malicious, then God is forgiver, merciful.
1981.subtitle: Only Four Prohibited Foods
1981.footnote: All food prohibitions must fall under these four categories. Upholding any other prohibitions is a form of idol worship.

1989.english: He only prohibits for you dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs,* and that which is dedicated to other than GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being deliberate or malicious, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: Only Four Meats Prohibited
1989.footnote: & 118 The most devastating trichinosis parasite, Trichinella spiralis, (also the pork tapeworm Taenia solium) survives in the meat of pigs, not the fat. More than 150,000 people are infected annually in the United States. See 6:145-146, and App. 16.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ هَٰذَا حَلَٰلٌ وَهَٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقولوا لما تصف ألسنتكم الكذب هذا حلال وهذا حرام لتفتروا على الله الكذب ۚ إن الذين يفترون على الله الكذب لا يفلحون
verses.transliterated: walā taqūlū limā taṣifu alsinatukumu l-kadhiba hādhā ḥalālun wahādhā ḥarāmun litaftarū ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūn
verses.english: You shall not utter lies with your own tongues stating: "This is lawful, and this is unlawful," to fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD. Surely, those who fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD will never succeed.

1981.english: And do not make lies with your own tongues, rendering this food prohibited and that food permissible; thus inventing lies about God. Surely, those who invent lies about God never succeed.

1989.english: You shall not utter lies with your own tongues saying, “This is lawful, and this is unlawful.” You thus fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD. Surely, those who fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD will never succeed.

verses.arabic: مَتَٰعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: متاع قليل ولهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: matāʿun qalīlun walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: They enjoy briefly, then suffer painful retribution.

1981.english: A temporary enjoyment, then they suffer painful retribution.

1989.english: They enjoy briefly, then suffer painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وعلى الذين هادوا حرمنا ما قصصنا عليك من قبل ۖ وما ظلمناهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: waʿalā alladhīna hādū ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka min qablu wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: For the Jews, we prohibited what we narrated to you previously. It was not us who wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.

1981.english: We had prohibited for the Jews what we already narrated herein. It was not we who wronged them, it was they who wronged themselves.

1989.english: For the Jews, we prohibited what we narrated to you previously.* We did not wrong them; they are the ones who wronged themselves.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِجَهَٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ثم إن ربك للذين عملوا السوء بجهالة ثم تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا إن ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna ʿamilū l-sūa bijahālatin thumma tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū inna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Yet, as regards those who fall in sin out of ignorance then repent thereafter and reform, your Lord, after this is done, is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Yet, your Lord regards those who fall in sin out of ignorance, then repent and reform; your Lord thereafter is forgiving, merciful.

1989.english: Yet, as regards those who fall in sin out of ignorance then repent thereafter and reform, your Lord, after this is done, is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن إبراهيم كان أمة قانتا لله حنيفا ولم يك من المشركين
verses.transliterated: inna ib'rāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillahi ḥanīfan walam yaku mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Abraham was indeed an exemplary vanguard in his submission to GOD, a monotheist who never worshiped idols.
verses.subtitle: Abraham

1981.english: Indeed, Abraham was a vanguard; submitting to God alone, and never regarding any idol.
1981.subtitle:
Abraham: The Source of Religious Practice
Muhammad: A Follower of Abraham

1989.english: Abraham was indeed an exemplary vanguard in his submission to GOD, a monotheist who never worshiped idols.
1989.subtitle: Abraham

verses.arabic: شَاكِرًا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ٱجْتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: شاكرا لأنعمه ۚ اجتباه وهداه إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: shākiran li-anʿumihi ij'tabāhu wahadāhu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: Because he was appreciative of His Lord's blessings, He chose him and guided him in a straight path.

1981.english: Because he was appreciative of God's blessings, God chose him, and guided him in a straight path.

1989.english: Because he was appreciative of His blessings, He chose him and guided him in a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وآتيناه في الدنيا حسنة ۖ وإنه في الآخرة لمن الصالحين
verses.transliterated: waātaynāhu fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: We granted him happiness in this life, and in the Hereafter he will be with the righteous.

1981.english: We endowed him with piety in this life, and in the hereafter he will be with the righteous.

1989.english: And we granted him happiness in this life, and in the Hereafter he will be with the righteous.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أوحينا إليك أن اتبع ملة إبراهيم حنيفا ۖ وما كان من المشركين
verses.transliterated: thumma awḥaynā ilayka ani ittabiʿ millata ib'rāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Then we inspired you (Muhammad) to follow the religion of Abraham, the monotheist; he never was an idol worshiper.
verses.subtitle: Muhammad: A Follower of Abraham
verses.footnote: This informs us that all religious practices, which came to us through Abraham, were intact at the time of Muhammad (see 22:78 and Appendix 9).

1981.english: Then we inspired you (Muhammad) to follow the religion of Abraham, monotheism; he never fell into idol worship.

1989.english: Then we inspired you (Muhammad, to follow the religion of Abraham,* the monotheist; he never was an idol worshiper.
1989.subtitle: Muhammad A Follower of Abraham
1989.footnote: This informs us that all religious practices, which came to us through Abraham, were intact at the time of Muhammad (see 22:78 and Appendix 9)

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبْتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما جعل السبت على الذين اختلفوا فيه ۚ وإن ربك ليحكم بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: innamā juʿila l-sabtu ʿalā alladhīna ikh'talafū fīhi wa-inna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: The Sabbath was decreed only for those who ended up disputing it (Jews & Christians). Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding their disputes.
verses.subtitle: The Sabbath Abrogated

1981.english: The Sabbath observance was decreed only for those who disputed it, and your Lord is the one who will judge them on the day of resurrection.
1981.subtitle: The Sabbath Law Modified

1989.english: The Sabbath was decreed only for those who ended up disputing it (Jews & Christians). Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding their disputes.
1989.subtitle: The Sabbath Abrogated

verses.arabic: ٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَجَٰدِلْهُم بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ادع إلى سبيل ربك بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة ۖ وجادلهم بالتي هي أحسن ۚ إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله ۖ وهو أعلم بالمهتدين
verses.transliterated: ud'ʿu ilā sabīli rabbika bil-ḥik'mati wal-mawʿiẓati l-ḥasanati wajādil'hum bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīn
verses.english: You shall invite to the path of your Lord with wisdom and kind enlightenment, and debate with them in the best possible manner. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who are the guided ones.
verses.subtitle: How to Spread God's Message

1981.english: You shall invite to the path of your Lord with wisdom and compassionate enlightenment, and debate with them in the best possible manner. Your Lord knows best who is deviating from His path, and He knows best who are the guided ones.

1989.english: You shall invite to the path of your Lord with wisdom and kind enlightenment, and debate with them in the best possible manner. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who are the guided ones.

verses.arabic: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن عاقبتم فعاقبوا بمثل ما عوقبتم به ۖ ولئن صبرتم لهو خير للصابرين
verses.transliterated: wa-in ʿāqabtum faʿāqibū bimith'li mā ʿūqib'tum bihi wala-in ṣabartum lahuwa khayrun lilṣṣābirīn
verses.english: And if you punish, you shall inflict an equivalent punishment. But if you resort to patience (instead of revenge), it would be better for the patient ones.

1981.english: And when you avenge any aggression against you, you shall inflict an equivalent punishment. But if you resort to patience, it would be best for the patient.

1989.english: And if you punish, you shall inflict an equivalent punishment. But if you resort to patience (instead of revenge), it would be better for the patient ones.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واصبر وما صبرك إلا بالله ۚ ولا تحزن عليهم ولا تك في ضيق مما يمكرون
verses.transliterated: wa-iṣ'bir wamā ṣabruka illā bil-lahi walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā taku fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūn
verses.english: You shall resort to patience—and your patience is attainable only with GOD's help. Do not grieve over them, and do not be annoyed by their schemes.

1981.english: You shall resort to patience; and your patience will be aided by God. Do not grieve over them, and do not be annoyed by their schemes.

1989.english: You shall resort to patience—and your patience is attainable only with GOD’s help. Do not grieve over them, and do not be annoyed by their schemes.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله مع الذين اتقوا والذين هم محسنون
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha maʿa alladhīna ittaqaw wa-alladhīna hum muḥ'sinūn
verses.english: GOD is with those who lead a righteous life, and those who are charitable.

1981.english: Surely, God is with those who observe righteousness, and those who are pious.

1989.english: GOD is with those who lead a righteous life, and those who are charitable.

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سبحان الذي أسرى بعبده ليلا من المسجد الحرام إلى المسجد الأقصى الذي باركنا حوله لنريه من آياتنا ۚ إنه هو السميع البصير
verses.transliterated: sub'ḥāna alladhī asrā biʿabdihi laylan mina l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi ilā l-masjidi l-aqṣā alladhī bāraknā ḥawlahu linuriyahu min āyātinā innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīr
verses.english: Most glorified is the One who summoned His servant (Muhammad) during the night, from the Sacred Masjid (of Mecca) to the farthest place of prostration, whose surroundings we have blessed, in order to show him some of our signs. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
verses.footnote: "The Aqsa Masjid" means "the farthest place where there is prostration," many billions of Light Years away. This verse informs us that Muhammad, the soul, was taken to the highest Heaven to be given the Quran (2:185, 44:3, 53:1-18, & 97:1).

1981.english: Glory be to the One who summoned His servant during the night from the Sacred Mosque to the faraway mosque, which is located in blessed surroundings, in order to give him our revelations. God is the hearer, the seer.
1981.footnote: Two hundred years after Muhammad, some story tellers with limited knowledge, and a lot of imagination, fabricated a story alleging a night journey by the Prophet from Mecca to Jerusalem, followed by ascension to heaven and an audience with God. The story was designed to both entertain the masses who had no other means of entertainment, and to idolize and glorify the prophet against his will. The truth is that there was no "Aqsa Mosque" during the lifetime of Muhammad, and that this verse refers to the manner of Quranic revelation. The truth is plainly obvious throughout the Quran. Verses 2:185, 17:1, 44:3, and 97:1 inform us in a straightforward manner that the Quran was revealed into Muhammad's heart in one night. Verse 17:106, informs us that the Quran was to be "released" from Muhammad's heart to us over a long period (23 years). The process of revealing the Quran into Muhammad's heart, all at once, is described in 53:1-18. Thus, the manner of Quranic revelation can be likened to the manner whereby God taught the human being at creation (see 2:31 and 7:173). The word "Masjid," translated here as "mosque," means "a place of worship." Throughout the Quran, "Al-Masjid Al-Haram" refers to the area of Mecca where the shrine (Ka'ba) was built by Abraham and Ishmael. Thus, "Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa" refers to a "faraway holy area," described in more detail in 53:1-18. The mosque that was established in Jerusalem after Muhammad's death, and named "Aqsa Mosque" has nothing to do with 17:1.

1989.english: Most glorified is the One who summoned His servant (Muhammad) during the night, from the Sacred Mosque (of Mecca) to the farthest place of prostration,* whose surroundings we have blessed, in order to show him some of our signs. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
1989.footnote: and 53:1-18, is a test because the people had to believe Muhammad on faith.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: وآتينا موسى الكتاب وجعلناه هدى لبني إسرائيل ألا تتخذوا من دوني وكيلا
verses.transliterated: waātaynā mūsā l-kitāba wajaʿalnāhu hudan libanī is'rāīla allā tattakhidhū min dūnī wakīla
verses.english: Similarly, we gave Moses the scripture, and rendered it a beacon for the Children of Israel that: "You shall not set up any idol as a Lord and Master beside Me."

1981.english: Similarly, we revealed the scripture to Moses, and made it a beacon for the children of Israel, instructing them that: "You shall not set up any idol beside Me."

1989.english: Similarly, we gave Moses the scripture, and rendered it a beacon for the Children of Israel that: “You shall not set up any idol as a Lord and Master besides me.”

verses.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ذرية من حملنا مع نوح ۚ إنه كان عبدا شكورا
verses.transliterated: dhurriyyata man ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin innahu kāna ʿabdan shakūra
verses.english: They are descendants of those whom we carried with Noah; he was an appreciative servant.

1981.english: They are descendants of those whom we carried with Noah; our appreciative servant.

1989.english: They are descendants of those whom we carried with Noah; he was an appreciative servant.

verses.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وقضينا إلى بني إسرائيل في الكتاب لتفسدن في الأرض مرتين ولتعلن علوا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: waqaḍaynā ilā banī is'rāīla fī l-kitābi latuf'sidunna fī l-arḍi marratayni walataʿlunna ʿuluwwan kabīra
verses.english: We addressed the Children of Israel in the scripture: "You will commit gross evil on earth, twice. You are destined to fall into great heights of arrogance.

1981.english: And we decreed for the children of Israel in the scripture that: "You will transgress on earth twice, and will be gross tyrants.

1989.english: We addressed the Children of Israel in the scripture: “You will commit gross evil on earth, twice. You are destined to fall into great heights of arrogance.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَّفْعُولًا
verses.arabicClean: فإذا جاء وعد أولاهما بعثنا عليكم عبادا لنا أولي بأس شديد فجاسوا خلال الديار ۚ وكان وعدا مفعولا
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā jāa waʿdu ūlāhumā baʿathnā ʿalaykum ʿibādan lanā ulī basin shadīdin fajāsū khilāla l-diyāri wakāna waʿdan mafʿūla
verses.english: "When the first time comes to pass, we will send against you servants of ours who possess great might, and they will invade your homes. This is a prophecy that must come to pass.

1981.english: "When the first time takes place, we will set up against you servants of ours who possess great might; they will invade your homeland. This is a promise that will come to pass.

1989.english: “When the first time comes to pass, we will send against you servants of ours who possess great might. They will invade your homes. This is a prophecy that must come to pass.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ثم رددنا لكم الكرة عليهم وأمددناكم بأموال وبنين وجعلناكم أكثر نفيرا
verses.transliterated: thumma radadnā lakumu l-karata ʿalayhim wa-amdadnākum bi-amwālin wabanīna wajaʿalnākum akthara nafīra
verses.english: "Afterwards, we will give you a turn over them, and will supply you with a lot of wealth and children; we will give you the upper hand.

1981.english: "Then we will turn the tide in your favor, and supply you with wealth and children, and will make you more powerful.

1989.english: “Afterwards, we will give you a turn over them, and will supply you with a lot of wealth and children; we will give you the upper hand.

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لِيَسُۥٓـُٔوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا۟ مَا عَلَوْا۟ تَتْبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن أحسنتم أحسنتم لأنفسكم ۖ وإن أسأتم فلها ۚ فإذا جاء وعد الآخرة ليسوءوا وجوهكم وليدخلوا المسجد كما دخلوه أول مرة وليتبروا ما علوا تتبيرا
verses.transliterated: in aḥsantum aḥsantum li-anfusikum wa-in asatum falahā fa-idhā jāa waʿdu l-ākhirati liyasūū wujūhakum waliyadkhulū l-masjida kamā dakhalūhu awwala marratin waliyutabbirū mā ʿalaw tatbīra
verses.english: "If you work righteousness, you work righteousness for your own good, but if you commit evil you do so to your own detriment. Thus, when the second time comes to pass, they will defeat you and enter the mosque (masjid), just as they did the first time. They will wipe out all the gains you had accomplished."

1981.english: "When you work righteousness, you do so for your own good; and when you work evil, you do so to your own detriment. Then, when the second time comes to pass, they will defeat you, and enter the mosque, just as they entered it the first time." They will completely neutralize your tyranny.

1989.english: “If you work righteousness, you work righteousness for your own good, but if you commit evil you do so to your own detriment. Thus, when the second time comes to pass, they will defeat you and enter the mosque, just as they did in the first time. They will wipe out all the gains you had accomplished.”

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: عسى ربكم أن يرحمكم ۚ وإن عدتم عدنا ۘ وجعلنا جهنم للكافرين حصيرا
verses.transliterated: eesa rabbakum an yarhumukum wa an 'adtum 'adnaa waja'alna jahannam lilkaafireena haseera
verses.english: Your Lord showers you with His mercy. But if you revert to transgression, we will counter with retribution. We have designated Gehenna as a final abode for the disbelievers.

1981.english: May your Lord have mercy on you. Whenever you return to transgression, we return to retribution, and we made Gehenna the disbelievers' final abode.

1989.english: Your Lord showers you with His mercy. But if you revert to transgression, we will counter with retribution. We have designated Gehenna as a final abode for the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا القرآن يهدي للتي هي أقوم ويبشر المؤمنين الذين يعملون الصالحات أن لهم أجرا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā l-qur'āna yahdī lillatī hiya aqwamu wayubashiru l-mu'minīna alladhīna yaʿmalūna l-ṣāliḥāti anna lahum ajran kabīra
verses.english: This Quran guides to the best path, and brings good news to the believers who lead a righteous life, that they have deserved a great recompense.
verses.subtitle: Quran: Our Means to Salvation

1981.english: Indeed, this Quran presents the most reliable (information), and delivers good news to the believers who work righteousness, that they have deserved a great recompense.
1981.subtitle: Quran: The Only Reliable Source

1989.english: This Quran guides to the best path, and brings good news to the believers who lead a righteous life that they have deserved a great recompense.
1989.subtitle: Quran: A Means to Salvation

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وأن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة أعتدنا لهم عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: wa-anna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve in the Hereafter, we have prepared for them a painful retribution.

1981.english: And states that those who do not believe in the hereafter, we have prepared for them a painful retribution.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieve in the Hereafter, we have prepared for them a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولًا
verses.arabicClean: ويدع الإنسان بالشر دعاءه بالخير ۖ وكان الإنسان عجولا
verses.transliterated: wayadʿu l-insānu bil-shari duʿāahu bil-khayri wakāna l-insānu ʿajūla
verses.english: The human being often prays for something that may hurt him, thinking that he is praying for something good. The human being is impatient.

1981.english: The human being invokes evil, the way he should invoke righteousness. Indeed, the human being is hasty.

1989.english: The human being often prays for something that may hurt him, thinking that he is praying for something good. The human being is impatient.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا الليل والنهار آيتين ۖ فمحونا آية الليل وجعلنا آية النهار مبصرة لتبتغوا فضلا من ربكم ولتعلموا عدد السنين والحساب ۚ وكل شيء فصلناه تفصيلا
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā al-layla wal-nahāra āyatayni famaḥawnā āyata al-layli wajaʿalnā āyata l-nahāri mub'ṣiratan litabtaghū faḍlan min rabbikum walitaʿlamū ʿadada l-sinīna wal-ḥisāba wakulla shayin faṣṣalnāhu tafṣīla
verses.english: We rendered the night and the day two signs. We made the night dark, and the day lighted, that you may seek provisions from your Lord therein. This also establishes for you a timing system, and the means of calculation. We thus explain everything in detail.

1981.english: We made the night and the day two signs; we darkened the sign of night, and made the sign of day lighted, that you may seek God's bounties therein, and to provide you with a system of timing and calculation. Everything we explained in detail.

1989.english: We rendered the night and the day two signs. We made the night dark, and made the day lighted, that you may seek provisions from your Lord therein. This also establishes for you a timing system, and the means of calculation. We thus explain everything in detail.

verses.arabic: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وكل إنسان ألزمناه طائره في عنقه ۖ ونخرج له يوم القيامة كتابا يلقاه منشورا
verses.transliterated: wakulla insānin alzamnāhu ṭāirahu fī ʿunuqihi wanukh'riju lahu yawma l-qiyāmati kitāban yalqāhu manshūra
verses.english: We have recorded the fate of every human being; it is tied to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection we will hand him a record that is accessible.
verses.subtitle: The Video Tape
verses.footnote: Your life is already recorded, as if on a video tape, from birth to death. This same record will be made accessible to us upon resurrection. See 57:22 & Appendix 14.

1981.english: We have the record of every human being tied to his neck. Then, on the day of resurrection, we will give him a record that he will find accessible.
1981.subtitle: The Video Record
1981.footnote: We learn from this verse that we are born with our life already recorded, from birth to death. The closest analogy to our minds is the video tape of any event, such as historical narration, a football game, or a boxing match. See also 57:22.

1989.english: We have recorded the fate of every human being; it is tied to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection we will hand him a record that is accessible.
1989.subtitle: The Video Tape
1989.footnote: Your life is already recorded, as if on a video tape, from birth to death. This same record will be made accessible to us upon resurrection. See 57:22 & Appendix 14.

verses.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: اقرأ كتابك كفى بنفسك اليوم عليك حسيبا
verses.transliterated: iq'ra kitābaka kafā binafsika l-yawma ʿalayka ḥasība
verses.english: Read your own record. Today, you suffice as your own reckoner.

1981.english: Read your record. Today, you suffice as reckoner for yourself.
1981.footnote: We learn from this verse that we are born with our life already recorded, from birth to death. The closest analogy to our minds is the video tape of any event, such as historical narration, a football game, or a boxing match. See also 57:22.

1989.english: Read your own record. Today, you suffice as your own reckoner.

verses.arabic: مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًا
verses.arabicClean: من اهتدى فإنما يهتدي لنفسه ۖ ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها ۚ ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ۗ وما كنا معذبين حتى نبعث رسولا
verses.transliterated: mani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā wamā kunnā muʿadhibīna ḥattā nabʿatha rasūla
verses.english: Whoever is guided, is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray does so to his own detriment. No sinner will bear the sins of anyone else. We never punish without first sending a messenger.

1981.english: Whoever is guided, is guided for his own good; and whoever goes astray, does so to his own detriment. No burdened soul will bear the burden of another soul. We do not punish without sending a messenger.

1989.english: Whoever is guided, is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray does so to his own detriment. No sinner will bear the sins of anyone else. We never punish without first sending a messenger.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا أردنا أن نهلك قرية أمرنا مترفيها ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرناها تدميرا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā aradnā an nuh'lika qaryatan amarnā mut'rafīhā fafasaqū fīhā faḥaqqa ʿalayhā l-qawlu fadammarnāhā tadmīra
verses.english: If we are to annihilate any community, we let the leaders commit vast corruption therein. Once they deserve retribution, we annihilate it completely.

1981.english: Before we destroy any community, we send our commandments to the leaders thereof. If they rebel and refuse to honor our message, they invoke our retribution, and we utterly annihilate them.

1989.english: If we are to annihilate any community, we let the leaders commit vast corruption therein. Once they deserve retribution, we annihilate it completely.

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وكم أهلكنا من القرون من بعد نوح ۗ وكفى بربك بذنوب عباده خبيرا بصيرا
verses.transliterated: wakam ahlaknā mina l-qurūni min baʿdi nūḥin wakafā birabbika bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīran baṣīra
verses.english: Many a generation have we annihilated after Noah. Your Lord is most efficient in dealing with the sins of His servants; He is fully Cognizant, Seer.

1981.english: We have thus annihilated many a generation after Noah. Your Lord suffices as knower and seer of His creatures' sins.

1989.english: Many a generation have we annihilated after Noah. Your Lord is most efficient in dealing with the sins of His servants; He is fully Cognizant, Seer.

verses.arabic: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
verses.arabicClean: من كان يريد العاجلة عجلنا له فيها ما نشاء لمن نريد ثم جعلنا له جهنم يصلاها مذموما مدحورا
verses.transliterated: man kāna yurīdu l-ʿājilata ʿajjalnā lahu fīhā mā nashāu liman nurīdu thumma jaʿalnā lahu jahannama yaṣlāhā madhmūman madḥūra
verses.english: Anyone who chooses this fleeting life as his priority, we will rush to him what we decide to give him, then we commit him to Gehenna, where he suffers forever, despised and defeated.
verses.subtitle: Choose Your Priorities Carefully This Life

1981.english: If anyone prefers this fleeting life, we will hasten whatever we will for whomever we choose therein. Then we commit him to hell, wherein he burns despised and disgraced.

1989.english: For those who choose this fleeting life, we give what we will to whomever we choose during this life. But then we designate Gehenna as the abode for them, wherein they live, despised and defeated.
1989.subtitle: Choose Your Priorities Carefully This Life

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن أراد الآخرة وسعى لها سعيها وهو مؤمن فأولئك كان سعيهم مشكورا
verses.transliterated: waman arāda l-ākhirata wasaʿā lahā saʿyahā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika kāna saʿyuhum mashkūra
verses.english: As for those who choose the Hereafter as their priority, and work righteousness, while believing, their efforts will be appreciated.
verses.subtitle: The Hereafter

1981.english: As for the one who prefers the hereafter, and strives to fulfill the requirement thereof, while believing, these will be rewarded for their work.

1989.english: As for those who choose the Hereafter, and fulfill the requirements thereof, while believing, these will enjoy the fruits of their work.
1989.subtitle: The Hereafter

verses.arabic: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا
verses.arabicClean: كلا نمد هؤلاء وهؤلاء من عطاء ربك ۚ وما كان عطاء ربك محظورا
verses.transliterated: kullan numiddu hāulāi wahāulāi min ʿaṭāi rabbika wamā kāna ʿaṭāu rabbika maḥẓūra
verses.english: For each one of them we provide; we provide those and these from your Lord's bounties. Your Lord's bounties are inexhaustible.

1981.english: For both kinds of people, we provide from your Lord's bounties. The bounties of your Lord are not restricted.

1989.english: For each one of them we provide from your Lord’s bounties; your Lord’s bounties are inexhaustible.

verses.arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: انظر كيف فضلنا بعضهم على بعض ۚ وللآخرة أكبر درجات وأكبر تفضيلا
verses.transliterated: unẓur kayfa faḍḍalnā baʿḍahum ʿalā baʿḍin walalākhiratu akbaru darajātin wa-akbaru tafḍīla
verses.english: Note how we preferred some people above others (in this life). The differences in the Hereafter are far greater and far more significant.

1981.english: Note how we provide more for some people than others, in this life. However, the differences are far greater in the hereafter, and far more profound.

1989.english: Note how we raised some people above others (in this life). The differences in the Hereafter are far greater and far more significant.

verses.arabic: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا
verses.arabicClean: لا تجعل مع الله إلها آخر فتقعد مذموما مخذولا
verses.transliterated: lā tajʿal maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fataqʿuda madhmūman makhdhūla
verses.english: You shall not set up any other god beside GOD, lest you end up despised and disgraced.
verses.subtitle: Major Commandments

1981.english: You shall not set up besides God any other god, lest you end up despised and disgraced.
1981.subtitle: The Commandments

1989.english: You shall not set up any other god besides GOD, lest you end up despised and disgraced.
1989.subtitle: Major Commandments

verses.arabic: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وقضى ربك ألا تعبدوا إلا إياه وبالوالدين إحسانا ۚ إما يبلغن عندك الكبر أحدهما أو كلاهما فلا تقل لهما أف ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما
verses.transliterated: waqaḍā rabbuka allā taʿbudū illā iyyāhu wabil-wālidayni iḥ'sānan immā yablughanna ʿindaka l-kibara aḥaduhumā aw kilāhumā falā taqul lahumā uffin walā tanharhumā waqul lahumā qawlan karīma
verses.english: Your Lord has decreed that you shall not worship except Him, and your parents shall be honored. As long as one or both of them live, you shall never say to them, "Uff" (the slightest gesture of annoyance), nor shall you shout at them; you shall treat them amicably.

1981.english: And your Lord has decreed that you shall not worship except Him,* and honor your parents. For as long as they live, one of them or both of them, you shall not speak harshly to them, nor mistreat them; you shall speak to them amicably.
1981.footnote: This is the first, and most important commandment. It is a negative commandment, because people can worship God and still end up in hell (see footnote 11:2).

1989.english: Your Lord has decreed that you shall not worship except Him, and your parents shall be honored. As long as one or both of them live, you shall never say to them, “Uff” (the slightest gesture of annoyance), nor shout at them, nor mistreat them. You shall speak to them nicely.

verses.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: واخفض لهما جناح الذل من الرحمة وقل رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا
verses.transliterated: wa-ikh'fiḍ lahumā janāḥa l-dhuli mina l-raḥmati waqul rabbi ir'ḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīra
verses.english: And lower for them the wings of humility, and kindness, and say, "My Lord, have mercy on them, for they have raised me from infancy."

1981.english: And lower for them the wings of humility and kindness, and say, "My Lord, have mercy on them, for they brought me up from infancy."

1989.english: And lower for them the wings of humility, and mercy, and say, “My Lord, shower them with Your mercy, for they have raised me from infancy.”

verses.arabic: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ربكم أعلم بما في نفوسكم ۚ إن تكونوا صالحين فإنه كان للأوابين غفورا
verses.transliterated: rabbukum aʿlamu bimā fī nufūsikum in takūnū ṣāliḥīna fa-innahu kāna lil'awwābīna ghafūra
verses.english: Your Lord is fully aware of your innermost thoughts. If you maintain righteousness, He is Forgiver of those who repent.

1981.english: Your Lord is fully aware of your innermost thoughts; if you are righteous, whenever you turn to Him, you will find Him forgiving.

1989.english: Your Lord is fully aware of your innermost thoughts. If you are righteous, He is Forgiver of the repenters.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وآت ذا القربى حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل ولا تبذر تبذيرا
verses.transliterated: waāti dhā l-qur'bā ḥaqqahu wal-mis'kīna wa-ib'na l-sabīli walā tubadhir tabdhīra
verses.english: You shall give the due alms to the relatives, the needy, the poor, and the traveling alien, but do not be excessive, extravagant.

1981.english: And you shall regard the relative, and the needy, and the poor, and the alien, without extravagance.

1989.english: You shall give the due alms to the relatives, the needy, the poor, and the traveling alien, but do not be extravagant.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إن المبذرين كانوا إخوان الشياطين ۖ وكان الشيطان لربه كفورا
verses.transliterated: inna l-mubadhirīna kānū ikh'wāna l-shayāṭīni wakāna l-shayṭānu lirabbihi kafūra
verses.english: The extravagant are brethren of the devils, and the devil is unappreciative of his Lord.

1981.english: For the extravagant are brethren to the devils, and the devil is unappreciative of his Lord.

1989.english: The extravagant are brethren of the devils, and the devil is unappreciative of his Lord.

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّيْسُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وإما تعرضن عنهم ابتغاء رحمة من ربك ترجوها فقل لهم قولا ميسورا
verses.transliterated: wa-immā tuʿ'riḍanna ʿanhumu ib'tighāa raḥmatin min rabbika tarjūhā faqul lahum qawlan maysūra
verses.english: Even if you have to turn away from them, as you pursue the mercy of your Lord, you shall treat them in the nicest manner.

1981.english: If you have to break up with any of them, in the cause of seeking your Lord's mercy, you shall continue to speak to them amicably.

1989.english: Even if you get into a conflict with them, in your pursuit of mercy from your Lord, you shall speak to them amicably.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًا مَّحْسُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تجعل يدك مغلولة إلى عنقك ولا تبسطها كل البسط فتقعد ملوما محسورا
verses.transliterated: walā tajʿal yadaka maghlūlatan ilā ʿunuqika walā tabsuṭ'hā kulla l-basṭi fataqʿuda malūman maḥsūra
verses.english: You shall not keep your hand stingily tied to your neck, nor shall you foolishly open it up, lest you end up blamed and sorry.
verses.subtitle: Stinginess Condemned

1981.english: And do not keep your hand tied to your neck, nor open it completely, in excessive charity, lest you end up blamed and remorseful.

1989.english: You shall not keep your hand stingily tied to your neck, nor shall you foolishly open it up, lest you end up blamed and sorry.
1989.subtitle: Stinginess Condemned

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن ربك يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ۚ إنه كان بعباده خبيرا بصيرا
verses.transliterated: inna rabbaka yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīran baṣīra
verses.english: For your Lord increases the provision for anyone He chooses, and reduces it. He is fully Cognizant of His creatures, Seer.

1981.english: Your Lord increases the provision for whomever He wills, and withholds it. He is fully aware of His creatures, cognizant.

1989.english: For your Lord increases the provision for anyone He chooses, and reduces it. He is fully Cognizant of His creatures, Seer. Abortion is Murder

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَٰقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًٔا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقتلوا أولادكم خشية إملاق ۖ نحن نرزقهم وإياكم ۚ إن قتلهم كان خطئا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: walā taqtulū awlādakum khashyata im'lāqin naḥnu narzuquhum wa-iyyākum inna qatlahum kāna khiṭ'an kabīra
verses.english: You shall not kill your children due to fear of poverty. We provide for them, as well as for you. Killing them is a gross offense.
verses.subtitle: Abortion is Murder

1981.english: You shall not kill your children from fear of poverty; we provide for them along with you. Indeed, killing them is a gross offense.

1989.english: You shall not kill your children due to fear of poverty. We provide for them, as well as for you. Killing them is a gross offense.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةً وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقربوا الزنى ۖ إنه كان فاحشة وساء سبيلا
verses.transliterated: walā taqrabū l-zinā innahu kāna fāḥishatan wasāa sabīla
verses.english: You shall not commit adultery; it is a gross sin, and an evil behavior.

1981.english: You shall not commit adultery, for it is a vice, and a wicked path.

1989.english: You shall not commit adultery; it is a gross sin, and an evil behavior.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى ٱلْقَتْلِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقتلوا النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق ۗ ومن قتل مظلوما فقد جعلنا لوليه سلطانا فلا يسرف في القتل ۖ إنه كان منصورا
verses.transliterated: walā taqtulū l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi waman qutila maẓlūman faqad jaʿalnā liwaliyyihi sul'ṭānan falā yus'rif fī l-qatli innahu kāna manṣūra
verses.english: You shall not kill any person—for GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. If one is killed unjustly, then we give his heir authority to enforce justice. Thus, he shall not exceed the limits in avenging the murder, he will be helped.

1981.english: You shall not kill anyone; for life is made sacred by God, except in the course of justice. Anyone who is killed unjustly, we give his kin authority to avenge; thus, he shall not avenge excessively; he will then be helped.

1989.english: You shall not kill any person, for GOD has made life sacred, except in the course of justice. If one is killed unjustly, then we give his heir authority— if he does not exceed the limits in avenging the murder, he will be helped.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقربوا مال اليتيم إلا بالتي هي أحسن حتى يبلغ أشده ۚ وأوفوا بالعهد ۖ إن العهد كان مسئولا
verses.transliterated: walā taqrabū māla l-yatīmi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ashuddahu wa-awfū bil-ʿahdi inna l-ʿahda kāna masūla
verses.english: You shall not touch the orphans' money except for their own good, until they reach maturity. You shall fulfill your covenants, for a covenant is a great responsibility.

1981.english: You shall not touch the orphan's money, except for his own good, until he grows up. You shall fulfill your covenants; you are responsible for your covenants.

1989.english: You shall not touch the orphans’ money except for their own good, until they reach maturity. You shall fulfill your covenants, for a covenant is a great responsibility.

verses.arabic: وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: وأوفوا الكيل إذا كلتم وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم ۚ ذلك خير وأحسن تأويلا
verses.transliterated: wa-awfū l-kayla idhā kil'tum wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīmi dhālika khayrun wa-aḥsanu tawīla
verses.english: You shall give full measure when you trade, and weigh equitably. This is better and more righteous.

1981.english: You shall give full measure when you trade, and weigh with an equitable balance. This is better, and more righteous.

1989.english: You shall give full measure when you trade, and weigh equitably. This is better and more righteous.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تقف ما ليس لك به علم ۚ إن السمع والبصر والفؤاد كل أولئك كان عنه مسئولا
verses.transliterated: walā taqfu mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun inna l-samʿa wal-baṣara wal-fuāda kullu ulāika kāna ʿanhu masūla
verses.english: You shall not accept any information, unless you verify it for yourself. I have given you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brain, and you are responsible for using them.
verses.subtitle: Crucial Advice

1981.english: Do not accept anything that you yourself cannot ascertain. You are given the hearing, the eyes, and the mind, in order to examine and verify.
1981.footnote: This commandment teaches us that we shall not accept anything without first examining it with our God-given senses and mind. Following the elders, the scholars, the sages, or the saints, without verifying what they give us, often leads to hell (see 14:21).

1989.english: You shall not accept any information, unless you verify it for yourself. I have given you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brain, and you are responsible for using them.
1989.subtitle: Crucial Divine Advice

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تمش في الأرض مرحا ۖ إنك لن تخرق الأرض ولن تبلغ الجبال طولا
verses.transliterated: walā tamshi fī l-arḍi maraḥan innaka lan takhriqa l-arḍa walan tablugha l-jibāla ṭūla
verses.english: You shall not walk proudly on earth —you cannot bore through the earth, nor can you be as tall as the mountains.

1981.english: Do not walk on earth proudly, for you can never rend the earth, nor become as tall as the mountains.

1989.english: You shall not walk proudly on earth— you cannot bore through the earth, nor can you be as tall as the mountains.

verses.arabic: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًا
verses.arabicClean: كل ذلك كان سيئه عند ربك مكروها
verses.transliterated: kullu dhālika kāna sayyi-uhu ʿinda rabbika makrūha
verses.english: All bad behavior is condemned by your Lord.

1981.english: All the evil things are disliked by your Lord.

1989.english: All bad behavior is condemned by your Lord.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ذلك مما أوحى إليك ربك من الحكمة ۗ ولا تجعل مع الله إلها آخر فتلقى في جهنم ملوما مدحورا
verses.transliterated: dhālika mimmā awḥā ilayka rabbuka mina l-ḥik'mati walā tajʿal maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatul'qā fī jahannama malūman madḥūra
verses.english: This is some of the wisdom inspired to you by your Lord. You shall not set up another god beside GOD, lest you end up in Gehenna, blamed and defeated.
verses.subtitle: Quran Is Wisdom

1981.english: This is part of the wisdom that your Lord reveals to you. Most important, you shall not set up any idol besides God. If you do, you will be cast into hell, blamed and disgraced.

1989.english: This is some of the wisdom inspired to you by your Lord. You shall not set up another god besides GOD, lest you end up in Gehenna, blamed and defeated.
1989.subtitle: Quran Is Wisdom

verses.arabic: أَفَأَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًا إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: أفأصفاكم ربكم بالبنين واتخذ من الملائكة إناثا ۚ إنكم لتقولون قولا عظيما
verses.transliterated: afa-aṣfākum rabbukum bil-banīna wa-ittakhadha mina l-malāikati ināthan innakum lataqūlūna qawlan ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Has your Lord given you boys, while giving Himself the angels as daughters?! How could you utter such a blasphemy?

1981.english: Did your Lord bless you with sons, while taking the angels as daughters? This is one of the gross blasphemies that you utter.

1989.english: Has your Lord given you boys, while giving Himself the angels as daughters?! How could you utter such a blasphemy?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرآن ليذكروا وما يزيدهم إلا نفورا
verses.transliterated: walaqad ṣarrafnā fī hādhā l-qur'āni liyadhakkarū wamā yazīduhum illā nufūra
verses.english: We have cited in this Quran (all kinds of examples), that they may take heed. But it only augments their aversion.

1981.english: We cite (all kinds of examples) in this Quran, that they may take heed. But it only increases their aversion.

1989.english: We have cited in this Quran (all kinds of examples), that they may take heed. But it only augments their aversion.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًا لَّٱبْتَغَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: قل لو كان معه آلهة كما يقولون إذا لابتغوا إلى ذي العرش سبيلا
verses.transliterated: qul law kāna maʿahu ālihatun kamā yaqūlūna idhan la-ib'taghaw ilā dhī l-ʿarshi sabīla
verses.english: Say, "If there were any other gods beside Him, as they claim, they would have tried to overthrow the Possessor of the throne."

1981.english: Say, "If there were any other gods besides Him, as they claim, they would have competed with Him for authority.

1989.english: Say, “If there were other gods besides oc tried to overthrow the Possessor of the throne.”

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: سبحانه وتعالى عما يقولون علوا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yaqūlūna ʿuluwwan kabīra
verses.english: Be He glorified, He is much too exalted, far above their utterances.

1981.english: God be glorified; He is much too exalted above anything they say.

1989.english: Be He glorified, He is much too exalted, far above their utterances.

verses.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: تسبح له السماوات السبع والأرض ومن فيهن ۚ وإن من شيء إلا يسبح بحمده ولكن لا تفقهون تسبيحهم ۗ إنه كان حليما غفورا
verses.transliterated: tusabbiḥu lahu l-samāwātu l-sabʿu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna wa-in min shayin illā yusabbiḥu biḥamdihi walākin lā tafqahūna tasbīḥahum innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūra
verses.english: Glorifying Him are the seven universes, the earth, and everyone in them. There is nothing that does not glorify Him, but you do not understand their glorification. He is Clement, Forgiver.
verses.subtitle: Everything Glorifies God

1981.english: Glorifying Him are the seven heavens, and the earth, and everyone in them. There is nothing that does not praise His glory, but you do not understand their glorification. He is clement, forgiver.

1989.english: Glorifying Him are the seven universes, the earth, and everyone in them. There is nothing that does not glorify Him, but you do not comprehend their glorification. He is Clement, Forgiver. The Invisible Barrier

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قرأت القرآن جعلنا بينك وبين الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة حجابا مستورا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna jaʿalnā baynaka wabayna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ḥijāban mastūra
verses.english: When you read the Quran, we place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier.
verses.subtitle: Disbelievers Cannot Understand Quran

1981.english: When you read the Quran, we place between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter an invisible barrier.
1981.subtitle: Quran: An Uncommon Book
1981.footnote: Those who refuse to accept the Quran as the sole source of religious regulations are consistently characterized as disbelievers in the hereafter. They may confess belief in the hereafter, but their hearts inside are denying (see 16:22-24). They reject the Quran's repeated assertions that it is perfect, and they resort to the inventions of "hadith" and "sunna" as alternative sources (see 6:113, 150, 7:147, 11:18-19, 17:9-10, 27:4-6, 34:6-8, 39:45, and especially 41:6-7).

1989.english: When you read the Quran, we place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا ۚ وإذا ذكرت ربك في القرآن وحده ولوا على أدبارهم نفورا
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan an yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqran wa-idhā dhakarta rabbaka fī l-qur'āni waḥdahu wallaw ʿalā adbārihim nufūra
verses.english: We place shields around their minds, to prevent them from understanding it, and deafness in their ears. And when you preach your Lord, using the Quran alone, they run away in aversion.
verses.subtitle: Quran: The ONLY Source
verses.footnote: The Arabic word "alone" refers to God in 7:70, 39:45, 40:12 & 84, and 60:4. If you add these numbers, you get 361, 19x19. But if you include 17:46, which refers to the Quran, the product is not a multiple of 19. "Alone," therefore refers to the Quran in 17:46 (Appendix 18).

1981.english: And we place on their hearts shields to prevent them from understanding it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord (alone), in the Quran alone,* they run away in aversion.
1981.footnote: When you exhort the idol worshipers who advocate "hadith" and "sunna" to follow the Quran "alone," as stated in this verse, they run away in aversion (see 39:45 & 40:12).

1989.english: And we place shields around their hearts, to prevent them from understanding it (the Quran), and deafness in their ears. And when you preach your Lord, using the Quran alone,* they run away in aversion.
1989.subtitle: Quran: The Only Source
1989.footnote: The Arabic word ‘alone’ refers to God in 7:70, 39:45, 40:12 & 84, and 60:4. If you add these numbers, you get 361, 19x19. But if you include 17:46, which refers to the Quran, the product is not a multiple of 19. “Alone” here refers to the Quran (App. 18).

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
verses.arabicClean: نحن أعلم بما يستمعون به إذ يستمعون إليك وإذ هم نجوى إذ يقول الظالمون إن تتبعون إلا رجلا مسحورا
verses.transliterated: naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yastamiʿūna bihi idh yastamiʿūna ilayka wa-idh hum najwā idh yaqūlu l-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulan masḥūra
verses.english: We are fully aware of what they hear, when they listen to you, and when they conspire secretly—the disbelievers say, "You are following a crazy man."

1981.english: We are in full control of what they hear, when they listen to you. In their private conversations, the wicked say, "You are following a bewitched man."

1989.english: We are fully aware of what they hear, when they listen to you, and when they conspire secretly—the disbelievers say, “You are following a crazy man.”

verses.arabic: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الأمثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
verses.transliterated: unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīla
verses.english: Note how they describe you, and how this causes them to stray off the path.

1981.english: Note the kinds of examples they cite for you. This is what causes them to go astray, and never find the path.

1989.english: Note how they describe you, and how this causes them to stray off the path.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا أإذا كنا عظاما ورفاتا أإنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا
verses.transliterated: waqālū a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan a-innā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīda
verses.english: They said, "After we turn into bones and fragments, we get resurrected anew?!"

1981.english: They said, "After becoming bones and fragments, are we resurrected as new creation?"
1981.subtitle: Resurrection Closer Than You Think
1981.footnote: The period between death and resurrection passes like one night of sleep (see Appendix 14 for details).

1989.english: They said, “After we turn into bones and fragments, we get resurrected anew?!”

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُونُوا۟ حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: قل كونوا حجارة أو حديدا
verses.transliterated: qul kūnū ḥijāratan aw ḥadīda
verses.english: Say, "Even if you turn into rocks or iron.

1981.english: Say, "Even if you become rocks, or iron.
1981.footnote: The period between death and resurrection passes like one night of sleep (see Appendix 14 for details).

1989.english: Say, “Even if you turn into rocks or iron—

verses.arabic: أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا قُلِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: أو خلقا مما يكبر في صدوركم ۚ فسيقولون من يعيدنا ۖ قل الذي فطركم أول مرة ۚ فسينغضون إليك رءوسهم ويقولون متى هو ۖ قل عسى أن يكون قريبا
verses.transliterated: aw khalqan mimmā yakburu fī ṣudūrikum fasayaqūlūna man yuʿīdunā quli alladhī faṭarakum awwala marratin fasayun'ghiḍūna ilayka ruūsahum wayaqūlūna matā huwa qul ʿasā an yakūna qarība
verses.english: "Even if you turn into any kind of creation that you deem impossible." They will then say, "Who will bring us back?" Say, "The One who created you in the first place." They will then shake their heads and say, "When will that be?" Say, "It may be closer than you think."

1981.english: "Even if you turn into anything that you deem impossible." They will then say, "Who recreates us?" Say, "The One who created you the first time." They will then shake their heads and say, "When will that be?" Say, "It may be closer than you think."
1981.footnote: The period between death and resurrection passes like one night of sleep (see Appendix 14 for details).

1989.english: “or any kind of creation that you deem impossible to resurrect, (you will be resurrected anew).” They will then say, “Who will bring us back?” Say, “The One who created you in the first place.” They will then shake their heads and say, “When will that be?” Say, “It may be closer than you think.”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: يوم يدعوكم فتستجيبون بحمده وتظنون إن لبثتم إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: yawma yadʿūkum fatastajībūna biḥamdihi wataẓunnūna in labith'tum illā qalīla
verses.english: The day He summons you, you will respond by praising Him, and you will then realize that you had lasted in this life but a short while.

1981.english: The day He calls you, you will respond as you praise Him, and realize that you lasted only briefly.

1989.english: The day He summons you, you will respond by praising Him, and you will then realize that you had lasted in this life but a short while.

verses.arabic: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: وقل لعبادي يقولوا التي هي أحسن ۚ إن الشيطان ينزغ بينهم ۚ إن الشيطان كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا
verses.transliterated: waqul liʿibādī yaqūlū allatī hiya aḥsanu inna l-shayṭāna yanzaghu baynahum inna l-shayṭāna kāna lil'insāni ʿaduwwan mubīna
verses.english: Tell My servants to treat each other in the best possible manner, for the devil will always try to drive a wedge among them. Surely, the devil is man's most ardent enemy.
verses.subtitle: Treat Each Other Amicably

1981.english: Tell My servants to treat each other in the best possible manner, for the devil will always try to divide them. Indeed, the devil is man's most ardent enemy.
1981.subtitle: Satan Divides You

1989.english: Tell My servants to treat each other in the best possible manner, for the devil will always try to drive a wedge among them. Surely, the devil is man’s most ardent enemy.
1989.subtitle: Treat Each Other Amicably

verses.arabic: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ربكم أعلم بكم ۖ إن يشأ يرحمكم أو إن يشأ يعذبكم ۚ وما أرسلناك عليهم وكيلا
verses.transliterated: rabbukum aʿlamu bikum in yasha yarḥamkum aw in yasha yuʿadhib'kum wamā arsalnāka ʿalayhim wakīla
verses.english: Your Lord knows you best. According to His knowledge, He may shower you with mercy, or He may requite you. We did not send you to be their advocate.

1981.english: Your Lord is fully aware of you, and thus, He showers you with mercy, if He so wills, or punishes you, if He so wills. We did not send you as guardian over them.

1989.english: Your Lord is the best knower of you. In accordance with His knowledge, He showers you with mercy, or, in accordance with His knowledge, He requites you. We did not send you to be their advocate.

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وربك أعلم بمن في السماوات والأرض ۗ ولقد فضلنا بعض النبيين على بعض ۖ وآتينا داوود زبورا
verses.transliterated: warabbuka aʿlamu biman fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walaqad faḍḍalnā baʿḍa l-nabiyīna ʿalā baʿḍin waātaynā dāwūda zabūra
verses.english: Your Lord is the best knower of everyone in the heavens and the earth. In accordance with this knowledge, we preferred some prophets over others. For example, we gave David the Psalms.

1981.english: Your Lord is fully aware of everyone in the heavens and the earth. (Based on this knowledge,) we endowed some prophets more than others; we endowed David with the Psalms.

1989.english: Your Lord is the best knower of everyone in the heavens and the earth. In accordance with this knowledge, we preferred some prophets over others; for example, we gave David the Psalms.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: قل ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دونه فلا يملكون كشف الضر عنكم ولا تحويلا
verses.transliterated: quli id'ʿū alladhīna zaʿamtum min dūnihi falā yamlikūna kashfa l-ḍuri ʿankum walā taḥwīla
verses.english: Say, "Implore whatever idols you have set up beside Him." They have no power to relieve your afflictions, nor can they prevent them.

1981.english: Say, "Pray to your idols, whom you invent besides Him; they have no power to relieve your hardships, nor avert them."
1981.subtitle: The Idols Themselves Need God's Help
1981.footnote: The Quran lists various kinds of idols, such as statues (21:52), property (18:42), children (7:190), and people (16:86). Here we learn that some idols are righteous people who are idolized against their will. This category includes Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, and the saints. When the leader of a prominent church prayed to Mary to bring peace to Ireland, he was not only wasting his breath, but also committing a gross blasphemy.

1989.english: Say, “Implore whomever you claim (to be gods) besides Him.” They have no power to relieve your afflictions, nor can they prevent them.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًا
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين يدعون يبتغون إلى ربهم الوسيلة أيهم أقرب ويرجون رحمته ويخافون عذابه ۚ إن عذاب ربك كان محذورا
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna yadʿūna yabtaghūna ilā rabbihimu l-wasīlata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjūna raḥmatahu wayakhāfūna ʿadhābahu inna ʿadhāba rabbika kāna maḥdhūra
verses.english: Even the idols that they implore are seeking the ways and means towards their Lord. They pray for His mercy, and fear His retribution. Surely, the retribution of your Lord is dreadful.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous Idols Worship God Alone

1981.english: In fact, the idols themselves seek the ways and means to their Lord, whichever is fastest. They need God's mercy, and dread His retribution. Surely, the retribution of your Lord should be dreaded.
1981.footnote: The Quran lists various kinds of idols, such as statues (21:52), property (18:42), children (7:190), and people (16:86). Here we learn that some idols are righteous people who are idolized against their will. This category includes Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, and the saints. When the leader of a prominent church prayed to Mary to bring peace to Ireland, he was not only wasting his breath, but also committing a gross blasphemy.

1989.english: Even the idols that they implore are seeking the ways and means towards their Lord, wish for His mercy, and fear His retribution. Surely, the retribution of your Lord is dreadful.
1989.subtitle: The Righteous Idols Worship God Alone

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وإن من قرية إلا نحن مهلكوها قبل يوم القيامة أو معذبوها عذابا شديدا ۚ كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا
verses.transliterated: wa-in min qaryatin illā naḥnu muh'likūhā qabla yawmi l-qiyāmati aw muʿadhibūhā ʿadhāban shadīdan kāna dhālika fī l-kitābi masṭūra
verses.english: There is not a community that we will not annihilate before the Day of Resurrection, or inflict severe retribution upon them. This is already written down in the book.

1981.english: There is not a community that we will not annihilate before the day of resurrection, or afflict it with severe retribution. This is already predetermined in the book.

1989.english: There is not a community that we will not annihilate before the Day of Resurrection, or inflict severe retribution upon them. This is already written down in the book.

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا
verses.arabicClean: وما منعنا أن نرسل بالآيات إلا أن كذب بها الأولون ۚ وآتينا ثمود الناقة مبصرة فظلموا بها ۚ وما نرسل بالآيات إلا تخويفا
verses.transliterated: wamā manaʿanā an nur'sila bil-āyāti illā an kadhaba bihā l-awalūna waātaynā thamūda l-nāqata mub'ṣiratan faẓalamū bihā wamā nur'silu bil-āyāti illā takhwīfa
verses.english: What stopped us from sending the miracles is that the previous generations have rejected them. For example, we showed Thamûd the camel, a profound (miracle), but they transgressed against it. We sent the miracles only to instill reverence.
verses.subtitle: Old Kind of Miracles Made Obsolete

1981.english: What stopped us from manifesting any more miracles, is that the previous generations rejected them. For example, we sent the camel to Thamud, a profound miracle, but they turned wicked thereby. We sent the miracles to instill reverence.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad Performed No Miracles
1981.footnote: The only miracle manifested through Muhammad, namely, the Quran, was not unveiled until the preparation of this very translation. See 29:50-51 for details.

1989.english: What stopped us from sending the miracles is that the previous generations have rejected them. For example, we showed Thamoud the camel, a profound (miracle). But they transgressed against it. We sent the miracles only to instill reverence.
1989.subtitle: Old Kind of Miracles Made Obsolete

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قلنا لك إن ربك أحاط بالناس ۚ وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك إلا فتنة للناس والشجرة الملعونة في القرآن ۚ ونخوفهم فما يزيدهم إلا طغيانا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qul'nā laka inna rabbaka aḥāṭa bil-nāsi wamā jaʿalnā l-ru'yā allatī araynāka illā fit'natan lilnnāsi wal-shajarata l-malʿūnata fī l-qur'āni wanukhawwifuhum famā yazīduhum illā ṭugh'yānan kabīra
verses.english: We informed you that your Lord fully controls the people, and we rendered the vision that we showed you a test for the people, and the tree that is accursed in the Quran. We showed them solid proofs to instill reverence in them, but this only augmented their defiance.
verses.footnote: Muhammad's journey to the highest heaven to receive the Quran, as stated in 17:1 and 53:1-18, is a test because the people had to believe Muhammad on faith.

1981.english: Then we informed you that your Lord is in full control of the people. We made the vision that we showed you a test for the people, as well as the tree that is accursed in Quran. We exhort them to reverence, but they increase in sinfulness.
