verses.transliterated: fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyya
verses.english: She came to her family, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have committed something that is totally unexpected.

1981.english: She went to her family, carrying him. They said, "O, Mary, you have committed something unbelievable."

1989.english: She came with him to her family, carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something gross.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: يا أخت هارون ما كان أبوك امرأ سوء وما كانت أمك بغيا
verses.transliterated: yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawin wamā kānat ummuki baghiyya
verses.english: "O descendant of Aaron, your father was not a bad man, nor was your mother unchaste."

1981.english: "O sister of Aaron; your father was not unrighteous, nor was your mother unchaste."

1989.english: “O descendant of Aaron, your father was not a bad man, nor was your mother unchaste.”

verses.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: فأشارت إليه ۖ قالوا كيف نكلم من كان في المهد صبيا
verses.transliterated: fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyya
verses.english: She pointed to him. They said, "How can we talk with an infant in the crib?"
verses.subtitle: The Infant Makes a Statement

1981.english: She pointed at him; they said, "How can we speak with a child in the crib?"

1989.english: She pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk with an infant in the crib?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: قال إني عبد الله آتاني الكتاب وجعلني نبيا
verses.transliterated: qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyya
verses.english: (The infant spoke and) said, "I am a servant of GOD. He has given me the scripture, and has appointed me a prophet.

1981.english: (The child) said, "I am a servant of God. He endowed me with the scripture, and appointed me a prophet.

1989.english: (The infant spoke and) said, “I am a servant of GOD. He has given me the scripture, and made me a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وجعلني مباركا أين ما كنت وأوصاني بالصلاة والزكاة ما دمت حيا
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayya
verses.english: "He made me blessed wherever I go, and enjoined me to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat) for as long as I live.

1981.english: "And He made me blessed wherever I go, and enjoined upon me the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, for as long as I live.

1989.english: “He made me blessed wherever I go, and enjoined me to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat) for as long as I live.

verses.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وبرا بوالدتي ولم يجعلني جبارا شقيا
verses.transliterated: wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyya
verses.english: "I am to honor my mother; He did not make me a disobedient rebel.

1981.english: "I am to honor my mother, for He did not make me a disobedient rebel.

1989.english: “I am to honor my mother; He did not make me a disobedient rebel.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.arabicClean: والسلام علي يوم ولدت ويوم أموت ويوم أبعث حيا
verses.transliterated: wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayya
verses.english: "And peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I get resurrected."

1981.english: "And I have deserved peace the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I am resurrected."

1989.english: “And peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I get resurrected.”

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك عيسى ابن مريم ۚ قول الحق الذي فيه يمترون
verses.transliterated: dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūn
verses.english: That was Jesus, the son of Mary, and this is the truth of this matter, about which they continue to doubt.
verses.subtitle: The Proven Truth

1981.english: This is the truthful story of Jesus, the son of Mary, about whom they guess.
1981.subtitle: The True Story of Jesus

1989.english: Such was Jesus, the son of Mary. This is the truth of this matter, about which they have a lot of doubt.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان لله أن يتخذ من ولد ۖ سبحانه ۚ إذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون
verses.transliterated: mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verses.english: It does not befit GOD that He begets a son, be He glorified. To have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.

1981.english: God is never to take a son for Himself; God be glorified. To have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.

1989.english: GOD is never to beget a son, be He glorified. To have anything done, He simply says to it, “Be,” and it is.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن الله ربي وربكم فاعبدوه ۚ هذا صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmu
verses.english: He also proclaimed, "GOD is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path."
verses.footnote: This is similar to the statement attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John 20:17.

1981.english: (Jesus preached) that: "God is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him. This is the right path."

1989.english: He also proclaimed, “GOD is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him alone. This is the straight path.”*
1989.footnote: This is similar to the statement attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John 20:17.

verses.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فاختلف الأحزاب من بينهم ۖ فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: The various parties disputed among themselves (regarding the identity of Jesus). Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day.

1981.english: But the various parties disputed among themselves. Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the witnessing of a terrible day.

1989.english: The various parties disputed among themselves (regarding the identity of Jesus). Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day.

verses.arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: أسمع بهم وأبصر يوم يأتوننا ۖ لكن الظالمون اليوم في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Wait till you hear them and see them when they come to face us. The transgressors on that day will be totally lost.

1981.english: Listen and look at them, on the day they come to us. On that day, the wicked will discover that they had gone astray.

1989.english: Wait till you hear them and see them when they come to face us. The transgressors on that day will be totally astray.

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنذرهم يوم الحسرة إذ قضي الأمر وهم في غفلة وهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Warn them about the day of remorse, when judgment will be issued. They are totally oblivious; they do not believe.

1981.english: You shall warn them of the day of sorrow, when the whole matter is terminated while they are unaware, and while they do not believe.

1989.english: Warn them about the day of sorrow, when judgment will be issued. For they are totally oblivious; they do not believe.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا نحن نرث الأرض ومن عليها وإلينا يرجعون
verses.transliterated: innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūn
verses.english: We are the ones who inherit the earth and everyone on it; to us everyone will be returned.

1981.english: It is us who inherit the earth and everyone thereon, and to us they will be returned.

1989.english: We are the ones who inherit the earth and everyone on it; to us they will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: واذكر في الكتاب إبراهيم ۚ إنه كان صديقا نبيا
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyya
verses.english: Mention in the scripture Abraham; he was a saint, a prophet.
verses.subtitle: Abraham

1981.english: And mention in this scripture Abraham. He was a saintly prophet.
1981.subtitle: Abraham

1989.english: Mention in the scripture Abraham; he was a saint, a prophet.
1989.subtitle: Abraham

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال لأبيه يا أبت لم تعبد ما لا يسمع ولا يبصر ولا يغني عنك شيئا
verses.transliterated: idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shaya
verses.english: He said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor help you in any way?

1981.english: He said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship what neither hears, nor sees, nor helps you in anything?

1989.english: He said to his father, “O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor help you in any way?

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: يا أبت إني قد جاءني من العلم ما لم يأتك فاتبعني أهدك صراطا سويا
verses.transliterated: yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyya
verses.english: "O my father, I have received certain knowledge that you did not receive. Follow me, and I will guide you in a straight path.

1981.english: "O my father, I have attained knowledge you have not attained, so follow me and I will show you the right way.

1989.english: “O my father, I have received certain knowledge that you did not receive. Follow me, and I will guide you in a straight path.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: يا أبت لا تعبد الشيطان ۖ إن الشيطان كان للرحمن عصيا
verses.transliterated: yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyya
verses.english: "O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil has rebelled against the Most Gracious.

1981.english: "O my father, do not be a servant to the devil, for the devil has rebelled against God most gracious.

1989.english: “O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil has rebelled against the Most Gracious.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: يا أبت إني أخاف أن يمسك عذاب من الرحمن فتكون للشيطان وليا
verses.transliterated: yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyya
verses.english: "O my father, I fear lest you incur retribution from the Most Gracious, then become an ally of the devil."

1981.english: "O my father, I fear lest a retribution from the gracious God may afflict you, then you become an ally of the devil."

1989.english: “O my father, I fear lest you incur retribution from the Most Gracious, then become a slave of the devil.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: قال أراغب أنت عن آلهتي يا إبراهيم ۖ لئن لم تنته لأرجمنك ۖ واهجرني مليا
verses.transliterated: qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyya
verses.english: He said, "Have you forsaken my gods, O Abraham? Unless you stop, I will stone you. Leave me alone."

1981.english: He said, "Are you forsaking my idols, O Abraham? Unless you refrain, I will stone you. Leave me alone."

1989.english: He said, “Are you rejecting my gods, 0 Abraham? Unless you stop, I will surely stone you. Leave me alone.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: قال سلام عليك ۖ سأستغفر لك ربي ۖ إنه كان بي حفيا
verses.transliterated: qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyya
verses.english: He said, "Peace be upon you. I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He has been Most Kind to me.

1981.english: He said, "Peace be upon you; I will ask my Lord to forgive you. He has been gracious towards me.

1989.english: He said, “Peace be upon you. I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He has been Most Kind to me.

verses.arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وأعتزلكم وما تدعون من دون الله وأدعو ربي عسى ألا أكون بدعاء ربي شقيا
verses.transliterated: wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyya
verses.english: "I will abandon you and the gods you worship besides GOD. I will worship only my Lord. By imploring my Lord alone, I cannot go wrong."

1981.english: "I will avoid you, and the idols that you set up besides God. I will implore my Lord, and I am confident that my Lord will answer my prayers."

1989.english: “I will abandon you and the gods you worship besides GOD. 1 will worship only my Lord. By imploring only my Lord alone, I cannot go wrong.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: فلما اعتزلهم وما يعبدون من دون الله وهبنا له إسحاق ويعقوب ۖ وكلا جعلنا نبيا
verses.transliterated: falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyya
verses.english: Because he abandoned them and the gods they worshiped beside GOD, we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we made each of them a prophet.

1981.english: Because he avoided them and their idol worship, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and We made them both prophets.

1989.english: Because he abandoned them and the gods they worshiped besides GOD, we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we made each of them a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا وجعلنا لهم لسان صدق عليا
verses.transliterated: wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyya
verses.english: We showered them with our mercy, and we granted them an honorable position in history.

1981.english: And We blessed them with Our mercy, and endowed them with an honorable and truthful history.

1989.english: We showered them with our mercy, and we granted them an honorable position in history.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: واذكر في الكتاب موسى ۚ إنه كان مخلصا وكان رسولا نبيا
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyya
verses.english: Mention in the scripture Moses. He was devoted, and he was a messenger prophet.
verses.subtitle: Moses

1981.english: And mention in the scripture Moses; he attained salvation, and he was a messenger prophet.
1981.subtitle: Other Prophets

1989.english: Mention in the scripture Moses. He was devoted, and he was a messenger prophet.
1989.subtitle: Moses

verses.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وناديناه من جانب الطور الأيمن وقربناه نجيا
verses.transliterated: wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyya
verses.english: We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai. We brought him close, to confer with him.

1981.english: We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai, and We conferred with him privately.

1989.english: We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai. We brought him close, and we conferred with him.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ووهبنا له من رحمتنا أخاه هارون نبيا
verses.transliterated: wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyya
verses.english: And we granted him, out of our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.

1981.english: And We granted him, out of Our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet (to assist him).

1989.english: And we granted him, out of our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: واذكر في الكتاب إسماعيل ۚ إنه كان صادق الوعد وكان رسولا نبيا
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyya
verses.english: And mention in the scripture Ismail. He was truthful when he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.

1981.english: And mention in the scripture Ishmael; he was truthful whenever he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.

1989.english: And mention in the scripture Ismail. He was truthful when he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وكان يأمر أهله بالصلاة والزكاة وكان عند ربه مرضيا
verses.transliterated: wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyya
verses.english: He used to enjoin his family to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat); he was acceptable to his Lord.

1981.english: And he used to order his family to observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity; he was acceptable to his Lord.

1989.english: He used to enjoin his family to observe the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat); he was acceptable to his Lord.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: واذكر في الكتاب إدريس ۚ إنه كان صديقا نبيا
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyya
verses.english: And mention in the scripture Idrîs. He was a saint, a prophet.

1981.english: And mention in the scripture Idris; he was a saintly prophet.

1989.english: And mention in the scripture Idris. He was a saint, a prophet.

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ورفعناه مكانا عليا
verses.transliterated: warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyya
verses.english: We raised him to an honorable rank.

1981.english: And We exalted him to an honorable position.

1989.english: We exalted him to an honorable rank

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين أنعم الله عليهم من النبيين من ذرية آدم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذرية إبراهيم وإسرائيل وممن هدينا واجتبينا ۚ إذا تتلى عليهم آيات الرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا ۩
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyya
verses.english: These are some of the prophets whom GOD blessed. They were chosen from among the descendants of Adam, and the descendants of those whom we carried with Noah, and the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom we guided and selected. When the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.

1981.english: These are some prophets whom God blessed from the descendants of Adam, and those whom We carried with Noah (in the Ark), and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from those whom we guided and chose. Whenever God's revelations are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.

1989.english: These are some of the prophets whom GOD blessed. They were chosen from among the descendants of Adam, and the descendants of those whom we carried with Noah, and the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom we guided and selected. When the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.

verses.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.arabicClean: فخلف من بعدهم خلف أضاعوا الصلاة واتبعوا الشهوات ۖ فسوف يلقون غيا
verses.transliterated: fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayya
verses.english: After them, He substituted generations who lost the Contact Prayers (Salat), and pursued their lusts. They will suffer the consequences.
verses.subtitle: Losing the Contact Prayers (Salat)

1981.english: Then He established generations after them who lost the **salat** prayers,* and pursued their lusts. Consequently, they have deserved to stray.
1981.footnote: This verse informs us that the Jews, Christians, and Muslims were enjoined to observe the **salat** prayers, but they have "lost" it. Today, there is a diminishing proportion of Muslims who still observe this divine commandment (see 2:43, 83, 110, 10:87, 14:37, 19:31, 55, 20:14, 31:17, and 35:8).

1989.english: After them, He substituted generations that lost the contact prayers (Salat), and pursued their lusts. Consequently, they will go astray.
1989.subtitle: Losing the Contact Prayers (Salat)

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.arabicClean: إلا من تاب وآمن وعمل صالحا فأولئك يدخلون الجنة ولا يظلمون شيئا
verses.transliterated: illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shaya
verses.english: Only those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life will enter Paradise, without the least injustice.

1981.english: Only those who repent, believe, and work righteousness will enter Paradise, and will not be deprived of anything.

1989.english: Only those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life will enter Paradise, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: جنات عدن التي وعد الرحمن عباده بالغيب ۚ إنه كان وعده مأتيا
verses.transliterated: jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyya
verses.english: The gardens of Eden await them, as promised by the Most Gracious for those who worship Him, even in privacy. Certainly, His promise must come to pass.

1981.english: (They enter) the gardens of Eden promised by God in the future, for His servants. Surely, His promise will come to pass.

1989.english: (They enter) the gardens of Eden, which the Most Gracious has promised for His worshipers in the future. Certainly, His promise will come to pass.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا إلا سلاما ۖ ولهم رزقهم فيها بكرة وعشيا
verses.transliterated: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyya
verses.english: They will not hear any nonsense therein; only peace. They receive their provisions therein, day and night.

1981.english: They hear no nonsense therein; only peace, and their provisions are guaranteed therein day and night.

1989.english: They will not hear any nonsense therein; only peace. They receive their provisions therein, endlessly.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: تلك الجنة التي نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا
verses.transliterated: til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyya
verses.english: Such is Paradise; we grant it to those among our servants who are righteous.

1981.english: Such is Paradise that We offer to the righteous among Our creatures.

1989.english: Such is Paradise; we grant it to those among our creatures who are righteous.

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وما نتنزل إلا بأمر ربك ۖ له ما بين أيدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك ۚ وما كان ربك نسيا
verses.transliterated: wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyya
verses.english: We do not come down except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs our past, our future, and everything between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.

1981.english: We (the words of Quran) are not revealed except in accordance with the command of your Lord. To Him belong our past, and our future, and everything between them; and your Lord is never forgetful.
1981.subtitle: The Words of Quran Speaking
1981.footnote: A reminder to those who see wisdom in the words of other than God.

1989.english: We do not come down except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs our past, our future, and everything between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما فاعبده واصطبر لعبادته ۚ هل تعلم له سميا
verses.transliterated: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyya
verses.english: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; you shall worship Him and steadfastly persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone who equals Him?

1981.english: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. You shall worship Him and persist in worshiping Him; do you know of any equal to Him?

1989.english: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; you shall worship Him and steadfastly persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone who equals Him?

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ويقول الإنسان أإذا ما مت لسوف أخرج حيا
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayya
verses.english: The human being asks, "After I die, do I come back to life?"

1981.english: The human being may say, "After I die, how could I be brought back to life?"

1989.english: The human being asks, “After I die, do I come back to life?”

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.arabicClean: أولا يذكر الإنسان أنا خلقناه من قبل ولم يك شيئا
verses.transliterated: awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shaya
verses.english: Did the human being forget that we created him already, and he was nothing?

1981.english: Does the human not remember that we created him before, and he was nothing?

1989.english: Does the human not remember that we created him, and he was nothing?

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: فوربك لنحشرنهم والشياطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا
verses.transliterated: fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyya
verses.english: By your Lord, we will certainly summon them, together with the devils, and will gather them around Hell, humiliated.
verses.subtitle: Special Warning to the Leaders

1981.english: By your Lord, we will indeed gather them all, together with the devils. Then we will bring them around Gehenna, kneeling.

1989.english: By your Lord, we will certainly summon them, together with the devils. We will gather them around Hell, humiliated.
1989.subtitle: Special Warning to the Leaders

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ثم لننزعن من كل شيعة أيهم أشد على الرحمن عتيا
verses.transliterated: thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyya
verses.english: Then we will pick out from each group the most ardent opponent of the Most Gracious.

1981.english: Then, we will pick out from each group, the most ardent opponent of the gracious God.

1989.english: Then we will pick out from each group the most ardent opponent of the Most Gracious.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ثم لنحن أعلم بالذين هم أولى بها صليا
verses.transliterated: thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyya
verses.english: We know full well those who are most deserving of burning therein.

1981.english: For we are fully aware of those who are most worthy of burning therein.

1989.english: For we know full well those who are most deserving of burning therein.

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وإن منكم إلا واردها ۚ كان على ربك حتما مقضيا
verses.transliterated: wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyya
verses.english: Every single one of you must see it; this is an irrevocable decision of your Lord.
verses.subtitle: Everyone Sees Hell
verses.footnote: As detailed in Appendix 11, we will be resurrected prior to God's physical arrival to our universe. That will be a temporary taste of Hell, since the absence of God is Hell. When God comes (89:22), the righteous will be rescued. See 19:72.

1981.english: Every single one of you will initially enter therein.* This is an inevitable matter, decreed by your Lord.
1981.subtitle: Initially, We All Go To Hell
1981.footnote: Your appreciation and enjoyment of heaven doubles after seeing what hell is like.

1989.english: Every single one of you must ex perience Hell; this is an irrevocable decision of your Lord.
1989.subtitle: Everyone Experiences Hell
1989.footnote: As detailed in Appendix 11, we will be resurrected before God comes to our universe. That will be a temporary taste of Hell for the righteous, since the absence of God is Hell. When God comes (89:22), the righteous will be rescued. See 19:72.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: ثم ننجي الذين اتقوا ونذر الظالمين فيها جثيا
verses.transliterated: thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyya
verses.english: Then we rescue the righteous, and leave the transgressors in it, humiliated.

1981.english: Then, we save those who worked righteousness, leaving the wicked therein humiliated.

1989.english: Then we rescue the righteous there from, and leave the transgressors in it, humiliated.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات قال الذين كفروا للذين آمنوا أي الفريقين خير مقاما وأحسن نديا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyya
verses.english: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of us is more prosperous? Which of us is in the majority?"
verses.subtitle: The Majority

1981.english: (That is because) when our revelations are recited to them, clearly explained, the disbelievers ask the believers, "Which side is more powerful, and greater in number?"

1989.english: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Which of us is more prosperous? Which of us is in the majority?”

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
verses.arabicClean: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم أحسن أثاثا ورئيا
verses.transliterated: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'ya
verses.english: Many a generation have we annihilated before them; they were more powerful, and more prosperous.

1981.english: We annihilated many generations before them, who were better equipped, and better endowed.

1989.english: Many a generation have we annihilated before them, who were more powerful, and much better looking.

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
verses.arabicClean: قل من كان في الضلالة فليمدد له الرحمن مدا ۚ حتى إذا رأوا ما يوعدون إما العذاب وإما الساعة فسيعلمون من هو شر مكانا وأضعف جندا
verses.transliterated: qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu junda
verses.english: Say, "Those who choose to go astray, the Most Gracious will lead them on, until they see what is promised for them—either the retribution or the Hour. That is when they find out who really is worse off, and weaker in power."

1981.english: Say, "Those who choose the straying, the gracious God will lead them on, and even encourage them, until they see what is awaiting them; either the retribution or the hour. That is when they discover who are really in worse shape, and weaker in power.

1989.english: Say, “Indeed, those who choose to go astray, the Most Gracious will lead them on, until they see what is promised to them—either the retribution or the Hour. That is when they find out who really is worse off, and weaker in power.”

verses.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
verses.arabicClean: ويزيد الله الذين اهتدوا هدى ۗ والباقيات الصالحات خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا
verses.transliterated: wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maradda
verses.english: GOD augments the guidance of those who choose to be guided. For the good deeds are eternally rewarded by your Lord, and bring far better returns.

1981.english: As for those who choose the guidance, God augments their guidance, and their recorded righteous works bring them better rewards from your Lord, and better returns.

1989.english: GOD augments the guidance of those who choose to be guided. For the good deeds are eternally rewarded by your Lord; they bring far better returns.

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
verses.arabicClean: أفرأيت الذي كفر بآياتنا وقال لأوتين مالا وولدا
verses.transliterated: afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawalada
verses.english: Have you noted the one who rejected our revelations then said, "I will be given wealth and children"?!

1981.english: Have you noted the one who rejects our revelations, then says, "I will attain wealth and children"?

1989.english: Have you noted the one who rejected our revelations then said, “I will be given wealth and children?!”

verses.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.arabicClean: أطلع الغيب أم اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
verses.transliterated: aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahda
verses.english: Has he seen the future? Has he taken such a pledge from the Most Gracious?

1981.english: Has he seen the future, or did he make such a covenant with God most gracious?

1989.english: Has he seen the future? Has he taken such a pledge from the Most Gracious?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
verses.arabicClean: كلا ۚ سنكتب ما يقول ونمد له من العذاب مدا
verses.transliterated: kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi madda
verses.english: Indeed, we will record what he utters, then commit him to ever-increasing retribution.

1981.english: Nay, we will write everything he says, and afflict him with more retribution.

1989.english: No. We will record what he utters, then punish him, increasingly.

verses.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
verses.arabicClean: ونرثه ما يقول ويأتينا فردا
verses.transliterated: wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā farda
verses.english: Then we inherit everything he possessed, and he comes back to us all alone.

1981.english: We will let him inherit whatever he says, then he comes to us as an individual.

1989.english: Then we will inherit from him everything he said he possessed; he will come back to us all alone. Worshiping Human Creatures

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
verses.arabicClean: واتخذوا من دون الله آلهة ليكونوا لهم عزا
verses.transliterated: wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizza
verses.english: They worship beside GOD other gods that may be of help to them.

1981.english: They set up idols besides God, to be of help to them.
1981.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Idolizers
1981.footnote: By their own admission, the people who idolize Muhammad, Jesus, Mary, or the saints believe that these idols will help them. However, we learn here that the idols will disown their idolizers, and abhor their idol worship. Those who idolize Muhammad and pursue the words and actions attributed to him, will be terribly embarrassed and ashamed when Muhammad disowns them on the day of judgment. Those who call upon Mary, who is dead, powerless, and totally unaware, to bring peace to Ireland for example, will be similarly doomed. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the idols themselves enjoined us from falling in such sin (see Deuteronomy 6:4, Mark 12:29, and Quran 17:23).

1989.english: They worship besides GOD other gods that thev hone will heln them.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.arabicClean: كلا ۚ سيكفرون بعبادتهم ويكونون عليهم ضدا
verses.transliterated: kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍidda
verses.english: On the contrary; they will reject their idolatry, and will be their enemies.
verses.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Worshipers

1981.english: Instead, the idols will disown their idol worship, and become their enemies.
1981.footnote: By their own admission, the people who idolize Muhammad, Jesus, Mary, or the saints believe that these idols will help them. However, we learn here that the idols will disown their idolizers, and abhor their idol worship. Those who idolize Muhammad and pursue the words and actions attributed to him, will be terribly embarrassed and ashamed when Muhammad disowns them on the day of judgment. Those who call upon Mary, who is dead, powerless, and totally unaware, to bring peace to Ireland for example, will be similarly doomed. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the idols themselves enjoined us from falling in such sin (see Deuteronomy 6:4, Mark 12:29, and Quran 17:23).

1989.english: On the contrary; their idols will reject their idolatry; they will be enemies.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أنا أرسلنا الشياطين على الكافرين تؤزهم أزا
verses.transliterated: alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azza
verses.english: Do you not see how we unleash the devils upon the disbelievers to stir them up?

1981.english: Do you not note how we unleash the devils on the disbelievers to stir them up?

1989.english: Do you not see how we unleash the devils upon the disbelievers to stir them up?

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.arabicClean: فلا تعجل عليهم ۖ إنما نعد لهم عدا
verses.transliterated: falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿadda
verses.english: Do not be impatient; we are preparing for them some preparation.

1981.english: Therefore, do not be impatient; we are preparing for them some preparation.

1989.english: Do not be in a hurry; we are really preparing for them some preparation

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًا
verses.arabicClean: يوم نحشر المتقين إلى الرحمن وفدا
verses.transliterated: yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafda
verses.english: The day will come when we summon the righteous before the Most Gracious in a group.

1981.english: The day will come when we gather the righteous before God most gracious, in a group.

1989.english: On that day, we will summon the righteous before the Most Gracious in a group.

verses.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
verses.arabicClean: ونسوق المجرمين إلى جهنم وردا
verses.transliterated: wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'da
verses.english: And we will herd the guilty to Hell, to be their eternal abode.

1981.english: And herd the guilty to Gehenna as their stockade.

1989.english: And we will herd the guilty to Hell, to be their abode.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.arabicClean: لا يملكون الشفاعة إلا من اتخذ عند الرحمن عهدا
verses.transliterated: lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahda
verses.english: No one will possess the power to intercede, except those who conform to the laws of the Most Gracious.

1981.english: None will have the power of intercession, unless it agrees with the covenant of God most gracious.

1989.english: No one will possess the power to intercede, except those who conform to the system of the Most Gracious. The Great Blasphemy

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا
verses.transliterated: waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu walada
verses.english: They said, "The Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
verses.subtitle: Gross Blasphemy

1981.english: They said, "God most gracious has begotten a son!"
1981.subtitle: The Great Blasphemy

1989.english: They said, “The Most Gracious has begotten a son!”

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
verses.arabicClean: لقد جئتم شيئا إدا
verses.transliterated: laqad ji'tum shayan idda
verses.english: You have uttered a gross blasphemy.

1981.english: Indeed, you have uttered a gross blasphemy.

1989.english: You have uttered a gross blasphemy.

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.arabicClean: تكاد السماوات يتفطرن منه وتنشق الأرض وتخر الجبال هدا
verses.transliterated: takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu hadda
verses.english: The heavens are about to shatter, the earth is about to tear asunder, and the mountains are about to crumble.

1981.english: The heavens are about to shatter, the earth is about to burst, and the mountains are about to crumble,

1989.english: The heavens are about to shatter therefrom, the earth is about to tear asunder, and the mountains are about to crumble.

verses.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا
verses.arabicClean: أن دعوا للرحمن ولدا
verses.transliterated: an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni walada
verses.english: Because they claim that the Most Gracious has begotten a son.

1981.english: Upon hearing such a claim about God most gracious.

1989.english: Because they invented for the Most Gracious a son.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.arabicClean: وما ينبغي للرحمن أن يتخذ ولدا
verses.transliterated: wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha walada
verses.english: It is not befitting the Most Gracious that He should beget a son.

1981.english: It is utterly improper that God most gracious should take for Himself a son.

1989.english: It is not befitting the Most Gracious that He should beget a son.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًا
verses.arabicClean: إن كل من في السماوات والأرض إلا آتي الرحمن عبدا
verses.transliterated: in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabda
verses.english: Every single one in the heavens and the earth is a servant of the Most Gracious.

1981.english: Every single one in the heavens and the earth is no more than a slave of God most gracious.

1989.english: Every single one in the heavens and the earth is a servant of the Most Gracious.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.arabicClean: لقد أحصاهم وعدهم عدا
verses.transliterated: laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿadda
verses.english: He has encompassed them, and has counted them one by one.

1981.english: He has counted every single one of them.

1989.english: He has encompassed them, and has counted them one by one.

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.arabicClean: وكلهم آتيه يوم القيامة فردا
verses.transliterated: wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati farda
verses.english: All of them will come before Him on the Day of Resurrection as individuals.

1981.english: And each will come before Him as an individual, on the day of resurrection.

1989.english: All of them will come before Him on the Day of Resurrection as individuals.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wudda
verses.english: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, the Most Gracious will shower them with love.

1981.english: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, God most gracious will shower them with love.

1989.english: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, the Most Gracious will shower them with love.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
verses.arabicClean: فإنما يسرناه بلسانك لتبشر به المتقين وتنذر به قوما لدا
verses.transliterated: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman ludda
verses.english: We thus made this (Quran) elucidated in your tongue, in order to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn with it the opponents.

1981.english: Thus, we have elucidated this scripture in your tongue, to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn therewith those who oppose.

1989.english: We thus made this (Quran) elucidated in your tongue, in order to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn with it the opponents.

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.arabicClean: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من أحد أو تسمع لهم ركزا
verses.transliterated: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'za
verses.english: Many a generation before them we annihilated; can you perceive any of them, or hear from them any sound?

1981.english: We annihilated many generations in the past; do you perceive any of them, or hear from them any sound?

1989.english: Many a generation before them we annihilated; can you perceive any of them, or hear from them any sound?

verses.arabic: طه
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم طه
verses.transliterated: tta-ha
verses.english: T. H.
verses.footnote: The role of these Quranic initials as components of the Quran's awesome mathematical miracle is given in detail in Appendix 1.

1981.english: Ṭ. H.
1981.footnote: Like all the other Quranic initials, these letters participate in the Quran's miraculous numerical code. They present the reader with physical, examinable, and indisputable proof that the Quran is God's message to the world (see Appendix 1).

1989.english: T. H.*
1989.footnote: The role of these Quranic initials as participants in the Quran’s awesome mathematical miracle is given in detail in Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: ما أنزلنا عليك القرآن لتشقى
verses.transliterated: mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashq
verses.english: We did not reveal the Quran to you, to cause you any hardship.

1981.english: We did not reveal this Quran to you (O Muhammad) to cause you any hardship.

1989.english: We did not reveal the Quran to you, to cause you any trouble.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إلا تذكرة لمن يخشى
verses.transliterated: illā tadhkiratan liman yakhsh
verses.english: Only to remind the reverent.

1981.english: Only to remind the reverent.

1989.english: Only to remind the reverent.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.arabicClean: تنزيلا ممن خلق الأرض والسماوات العلى
verses.transliterated: tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿul
verses.english: A revelation from the Creator of the earth and the high heavens.

1981.english: A revelation from the One who created the earth, and the high heavens.

1989.english: A revelation from the Creator of the earth and the high heavens.

verses.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: الرحمن على العرش استوى
verses.transliterated: al-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'taw
verses.english: The Most Gracious; He has assumed all authority.

1981.english: God most Gracious; He has assumed all authority.

1989.english: The Most Gracious; He has assumed all authority.

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وما بينهما وما تحت الثرى
verses.transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta l-thar
verses.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens, and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the ground.

1981.english: To Him belong everything in the heavens and everything in the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the soil.

1989.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens, and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the ground.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.arabicClean: وإن تجهر بالقول فإنه يعلم السر وأخفى
verses.transliterated: wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu l-sira wa-akhf
verses.english: Whether you declare your convictions (or not) He knows the secret, and what is even more hidden.

1981.english: And whether you declare your thoughts, (or not,) He knows the secrets, and even what is better hidden.

1989.english: Whether you declare your convictions (or not) He knows the secret, and what is even more hidden.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: الله لا إله إلا هو ۖ له الأسماء الحسنى
verses.transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'n
verses.english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. To Him belong the most beautiful names.

1981.english: The one God; there is no god except He; to Him belong the most beautiful names.

1989.english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. To Him belongs the most beautiful names.

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: وهل أتاك حديث موسى
verses.transliterated: wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūs
verses.english: Have you noted the history of Moses?

1981.english: Has the history of Moses come to you?
1981.subtitle: Moses

1989.english: Have you noted the history of Moses?

verses.arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verses.arabicClean: إذ رأى نارا فقال لأهله امكثوا إني آنست نارا لعلي آتيكم منها بقبس أو أجد على النار هدى
verses.transliterated: idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā l-nāri huda
verses.english: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, "Stay here. I have seen a fire. Maybe I can bring you some of it, or find some guidance at the fire."

1981.english: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, "Wait here; I have seen a fire. Maybe I can bring you some of it, or find some guidance at it."

1989.english: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay here. I have seen a fire. Maybe I can bring you some of it, or find some guidance at the fire.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: فلما أتاها نودي يا موسى
verses.transliterated: falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūs
verses.english: When he came to it, he was called, "O, Moses.

1981.english: When he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

1989.english: When he came to it, he was called, “O, Moses.

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.arabicClean: إني أنا ربك فاخلع نعليك ۖ إنك بالواد المقدس طوى
verses.transliterated: innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwa
verses.english: "I am your Lord; remove your sandals. You are in the sacred valley, Tuwã.

1981.english: "I am your Lord, so take off your shoes. You are in the sacred valley Tuwa.
1981.footnote: Note that God speaks here in the first person singular, because the angels are not involved. Wherever the plural is used, the angels are involved and given credit for their participation.

1989.english: “I am your Lord. Remove your sandals; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwaa.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: وأنا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحى
verses.transliterated: wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥ
verses.english: "I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.

1981.english: "And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed.

1989.english: “And I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.

verses.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.arabicClean: إنني أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدني وأقم الصلاة لذكري
verses.transliterated: innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi l-ṣalata lidhik'r
verses.english: "I am GOD; there is no other god beside Me. You shall worship Me alone, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) to remember Me.

1981.english: "I am the one God; there is no god except Me. You shall worship Me, and observe the **salat** prayers to commemorate Me.

1989.english: “I am GOD; there is no other god besides Me. You shall worship Me alone, and observe the contact prayers (Salat) to remember Me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إن الساعة آتية أكاد أخفيها لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى
verses.transliterated: inna l-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿ
verses.english: "The Hour (end of the world) is surely coming; I will keep it almost hidden. For each soul must be paid for its works.
verses.subtitle: End of the World is Not Hidden
verses.footnote: The end of the world is given in the Quran, God's final message (15:87).

1981.english: "The hour is sure to come; I keep it almost hidden, to repay each soul for whatever it did.
1981.footnote: Go to sura 15 to find the Quranic statement regarding the end of the world.

1989.english: “The Hour (end of the world) is surely coming. I will keep it almost hidden. For each soul must be paid for its works.
1989.subtitle: The End of the World Not Hidden
1989.footnote: The end of the world is given in the Quran, for it is God’s final message (15:87).

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هواه فتردى
verses.transliterated: falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatard
verses.english: "Do not be diverted therefrom by those who do not believe in it— those who pursue their own opinions—lest you fall.

1981.english: "So, do not be distracted therefrom by those who disbelieve therein and follow their own opinions, lest you perish.

1989.english: “Do not be diverted therefrom by those who do not believe therein—those who pursue their lusts—lest you fall.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وما تلك بيمينك يا موسى
verses.transliterated: wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūs
verses.english: "What is this in your right hand, Moses?"

1981.english: "And what is that in your right hand, Moses?"

1989.english: “What is this in your hand, Moses?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال هي عصاي أتوكأ عليها وأهش بها على غنمي ولي فيها مآرب أخرى
verses.transliterated: qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'r
verses.english: He said, "This is my staff. I lean on it, herd my sheep with it, and I use it for other purposes."

1981.english: He said, "This is my staff. I lean on it, herd my sheep therewith, and use it for other purposes."

1989.english: He said, “This is my staff. I lean on it herd my sheep with it, and I use it for other purposes.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال ألقها يا موسى
verses.transliterated: qāla alqihā yāmūs
verses.english: He said, "Throw it down, Moses."

1981.english: He said, "Throw it down, Moses."

1989.english: He said, “Throw it down, O Moses.”

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فألقاها فإذا هي حية تسعى
verses.transliterated: fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿ
verses.english: He threw it down, whereupon it turned into a moving serpent.

1981.english: He threw it down, and it turned into a live serpent.

1989.english: He threw it down, whereupon it turned into a moving serpent.

verses.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال خذها ولا تخف ۖ سنعيدها سيرتها الأولى
verses.transliterated: qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūl
verses.english: He said, "Pick it up; do not be afraid. We will return it to its original state.

1981.english: He said, "Pick it up, and do not be afraid; we will return it to its original state.

1989.english: He said, “Pick it up; do not be afraid. We will return it to its original state.

verses.arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: واضمم يدك إلى جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء آية أخرى
verses.transliterated: wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'r
verses.english: "And hold your hand under your wing; it will come out white without a blemish; another proof.

1981.english: "And put your hand under your wing, and it will come out white without a blemish; another miracle.

1989.english: “Hold your hand under your wing; it will come out white without a blemish; another sign.

verses.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.arabicClean: لنريك من آياتنا الكبرى
verses.transliterated: linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'r
verses.english: "We thus show you some of our great portents.

1981.english: "We will give you some of our great revelations.

1989.english: “We thus show you some of our great signs.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى
verses.transliterated: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verses.english: "Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed."

1981.english: "Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed.

1989.english: “Go to Pharaoh; for he transgressed.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.arabicClean: قال رب اشرح لي صدري
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadr
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, cool my temper.

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, cool my temper,

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, cool my temper.

verses.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.arabicClean: ويسر لي أمري
verses.transliterated: wayassir lī amr
verses.english: "And make this matter easy for me.

1981.english: "And make this matter easy for me,

1989.english: “Make this matter easy for me.

verses.arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.arabicClean: واحلل عقدة من لساني
verses.transliterated: wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datan min lisān
verses.english: "And untie a knot from my tongue.

1981.english: "And untie a knot in my tongue,

1989.english: “Untie a knot from my tongue.

verses.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.arabicClean: يفقهوا قولي
verses.transliterated: yafqahū qawl
verses.english: "So they can understand my speech.

1981.english: "To let them understand my speech.

1989.english: “That they may understand me.

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.arabicClean: واجعل لي وزيرا من أهلي
verses.transliterated: wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīran min ahl
verses.english: "And appoint an assistant for me from my family.

1981.english: "And appoint an assistant for me from my family,

1989.english: “And appoint an assistant for me from my family.

verses.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.arabicClean: هارون أخي
verses.transliterated: hārūna akh
verses.english: "My brother Aaron.

1981.english: "Aaron my brother.

1989.english: “My brother Aaron.

verses.arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.arabicClean: اشدد به أزري
verses.transliterated: ush'dud bihi azr
verses.english: "Strengthen me with him.

1981.english: "Strengthen my mission with him,

1989.english: “Strengthen me with him.

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.arabicClean: وأشركه في أمري
verses.transliterated: wa-ashrik'hu fī amr
verses.english: "Let him be my partner in this matter.

1981.english: "And make him my partner in this matter,

1989.english: “Let him be my partner in this matter. 33. “That we may glorify You frequently.

verses.arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: كي نسبحك كثيرا
verses.transliterated: kay nusabbiḥaka kathīra
verses.english: "That we may glorify You frequently.

1981.english: "That we may glorify You frequently,

1989.english: “That we may glorify You frequently.

verses.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ونذكرك كثيرا
verses.transliterated: wanadhkuraka kathīra
verses.english: "And commemorate You frequently.

1981.english: "And commemorate You frequently.

1989.english: “And commemorate You frequently.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إنك كنت بنا بصيرا
verses.transliterated: innaka kunta binā baṣīra
verses.english: "You are Seer of us."

1981.english: "Surely, You are seer of us."

1989.english: “You are Seer of us.” 36. He said, “Your request is granted, O Moses.

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال قد أوتيت سؤلك يا موسى
verses.transliterated: qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūs
verses.english: He said, "Your request is granted, O Moses.

1981.english: He said, "You are granted your request, Moses.

1989.english: He said, “Your request is granted, O Moses.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى
verses.transliterated: walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'r
verses.english: "We have blessed you another time.

1981.english: "And we have bestowed other blessings upon you before,

1989.english: “We blessed you another time.

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: إذ أوحينا إلى أمك ما يوحى
verses.transliterated: idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥ
verses.english: "When we revealed to your mother what we revealed.

1981.english: "When we inspired your mother certain inspirations.

1989.english: “When we revealed to your mother some revelation.

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.arabicClean: أن اقذفيه في التابوت فاقذفيه في اليم فليلقه اليم بالساحل يأخذه عدو لي وعدو له ۚ وألقيت عليك محبة مني ولتصنع على عيني
verses.transliterated: ani iq'dhifīhi fī l-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwun lī waʿaduwwun lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatan minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿayn
verses.english: "Saying: 'Throw him into the box, then throw him into the river. The river will throw him onto the shore, to be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.' I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made before My watchful eye.

1981.english: "That: 'You shall throw him into the box, then throw him into the river, and the river will cast him to the bank. An enemy of Mine and his will get hold of him.' And I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made under My watchful eyes.

1989.english: “Saying: ‘Throw him into the box, then throw him into the river. The river will throw him onto the shore, to be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.’ I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made before My watchful eye.

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إذ تمشي أختك فتقول هل أدلكم على من يكفله ۖ فرجعناك إلى أمك كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن ۚ وقتلت نفسا فنجيناك من الغم وفتناك فتونا ۚ فلبثت سنين في أهل مدين ثم جئت على قدر يا موسى
verses.transliterated: idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadarin yāmūs
verses.english: "Your sister walked to them and said, 'I can tell you about a nursing mother who can take good care of him.' We thus returned you to your mother, that she may be happy and stop worrying. And when you killed a soul, we saved you from the grievous consequences; indeed we tested you thoroughly. You stayed years with the people of Midyan, and now you have come back in accordance with a precise plan.

1981.english: "Your sister then followed you, and said, 'Let me tell you about one who can nurse him.' We thus returned you to your mother, in order to keep her happy, and to remove her worries. And you killed someone, but we saved you from disaster, and tested you thoroughly. Then you lived years in Midian, and now you have come according to plan, Moses.

1989.english: “Your sister walked, and said, ‘I can tell you about a nursing mother who can take good care of him.’ We thus returned you to your mother, that she may be happy and stop worrying. And when you killed a soul, we saved you from grief, then we tested you thoroughly. You stayed years with the people of Midyan, and now you have come back in accordance with a predetermined plan.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.arabicClean: واصطنعتك لنفسي
verses.transliterated: wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafs
verses.english: "I have made you just for Me.

1981.english: "I have made you just for Me.

1989.english: “I have made you just for Me.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.arabicClean: اذهب أنت وأخوك بآياتي ولا تنيا في ذكري
verses.transliterated: idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'r
verses.english: "Go with your brother, supported by My signs, and do not waver in remembering Me.

1981.english: "Go, you and your brother, with My revelations to Pharaoh, and do not waver in commemorating Me.

1989.english: “Go to Pharaoh, together with your brother, supported by My signs. Do not waver in remembering Me.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: اذهبا إلى فرعون إنه طغى
verses.transliterated: idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verses.english: "Go to Pharaoh, for he transgressed.

1981.english: "Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed.

1989.english: “Go to Pharaoh, for he transgressed.

verses.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فقولا له قولا لينا لعله يتذكر أو يخشى
verses.transliterated: faqūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhsh
verses.english: "Speak to him nicely; he may take heed, or become reverent."

1981.english: "Talk to him gently, that he may take heed, or become reverent."

1989.english: “Speak to him nicely; he may take heed, or become reverent.”

verses.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قالا ربنا إننا نخاف أن يفرط علينا أو أن يطغى
verses.transliterated: qālā rabbanā innanā nakhāfu an yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw an yaṭgh
verses.english: They said, "Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress."

1981.english: They said, "Our Lord, we fear lest he persecutes us, or transgresses."

1989.english: They said, “Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال لا تخافا ۖ إنني معكما أسمع وأرى
verses.transliterated: qāla lā takhāfā innanī maʿakumā asmaʿu wa-ar
verses.english: He said, "Do not be afraid, for I will be with you, listening and watching.

1981.english: He said, "Have no fear; I will be with you, listening and watching.

1989.english: He said, “Do not be afraid. I will be with you, listening and watching.

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: فأتياه فقولا إنا رسولا ربك فأرسل معنا بني إسرائيل ولا تعذبهم ۖ قد جئناك بآية من ربك ۖ والسلام على من اتبع الهدى
verses.transliterated: fatiyāhu faqūlā innā rasūlā rabbika fa-arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla walā tuʿadhib'hum qad ji'nāka biāyatin min rabbika wal-salāmu ʿalā mani ittabaʿa l-hud
verses.english: "Go to him and say, 'We are two messengers from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go. You must refrain from persecuting them. We bring a sign from your Lord, and peace is the lot of those who heed the guidance.

1981.english: "Go to him and say, 'We are messengers from your Lord, so let the children of Israel go with us, and stop persecuting them. We bring miracles to you, and peace be upon those who follow the guidance.' "

1989.english: “Go to him and say, ‘We are two messengers from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go, and do not persecute them. We bring a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon those who follow the guidance.’ ”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إنا قد أوحي إلينا أن العذاب على من كذب وتولى
verses.transliterated: innā qad ūḥiya ilaynā anna l-ʿadhāba ʿalā man kadhaba watawall
verses.english: " 'We have been inspired that the retribution will inevitably afflict those who disbelieve and turn away.' "

1981.english: " 'It has been revealed to us that retribution is inevitable for those who disbelieve and turn away.' "

1989.english: (They said to Pharaoh) “We have been inspired that the retribution will inevitably afflict those who disbelieve and turn away.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال فمن ربكما يا موسى
verses.transliterated: qāla faman rabbukumā yāmūs
verses.english: He said, "Who is your Lord, O Moses."

1981.english: Pharaoh said, "Who is your Lord, Moses?"

1989.english: He said, “Who is the Lord of the two of you, O Moses.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال ربنا الذي أعطى كل شيء خلقه ثم هدى
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbunā alladhī aʿṭā kulla shayin khalqahu thumma had
verses.english: He said, "Our Lord is the One who granted everything its existence, and its guidance."

1981.english: He said, "Our Lord is the one who gave everything its existence, then provided guidance."

1989.english: He said, “Our Lord is the One who granted everything its existence, and its guidance.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال فما بال القرون الأولى
verses.transliterated: qāla famā bālu l-qurūni l-ūl
verses.english: He said, "What about the past generations?"

1981.english: He said, "What about the previous generations?"

1989.english: He said, “What about the past generations?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.arabicClean: قال علمها عند ربي في كتاب ۖ لا يضل ربي ولا ينسى
verses.transliterated: qāla ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī fī kitābin lā yaḍillu rabbī walā yans
verses.english: He said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget."

1981.english: He said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record; my Lord never errs, nor does He forget."

1989.english: He said, “The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget.”

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: الذي جعل لكم الأرض مهدا وسلك لكم فيها سبلا وأنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به أزواجا من نبات شتى
verses.transliterated: alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wasalaka lakum fīhā subulan wa-anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi azwājan min nabātin shatt
verses.english: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and paved in it roads for you. And He sends down from the sky water with which we produce many different kinds of plants.

1981.english: "He is the one who made the earth for your habitation, and erected for you roads therein, and sends down water from the sky, to produce therewith all kinds of plants."

1989.english: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you. He paved for you roads therein. And He sends down from the sky water whereby we produce many different kinds of plants.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: كلوا وارعوا أنعامكم ۗ إن في ذلك لآيات لأولي النهى
verses.transliterated: kulū wa-ir'ʿaw anʿāmakum inna fī dhālika laāyātin li-ulī l-nuh
verses.english: Eat and raise your livestock. These are sufficient proofs for those who possess intelligence.
verses.footnote: Those who possess intelligence appreciate the fact that we are astronauts who were launched into space on this 'Spaceship Earth.' God provided us with renewable food, water, pets, wildlife, and livestock, as we embark on this temporary space odyssey. Compare God's provisions to 'Spaceship Earth' with the provisions we give to our astronauts (Appendix 7).

1981.english: Eat and herd your livestock. These are lessons for those who possess intelligence.

1989.english: Eat and herd your livestock. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.4
1989.footnote: Those who possess intelligence appreciate the fact that we are astronauts who were launched into space on this ‘Spaceship Earth.’ God provided us with renewable food, water, pets, wildlife, and livestock, as we embark on this temporary space odyssey. Compare God’s ‘Spaceship Earth’ with our spaceships and astronauts (Appendix 7).

verses.arabic: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: منها خلقناكم وفيها نعيدكم ومنها نخرجكم تارة أخرى
verses.transliterated: min'hā khalaqnākum wafīhā nuʿīdukum wamin'hā nukh'rijukum tāratan ukh'r
verses.english: From it we created you, into it we return you, and from it we bring you out once more.

1981.english: "From it We created you, and into it We return you, and from it We bring you out again."

1989.english: From it we created you, into it we return you, and from it we bring you out once more.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أريناه آياتنا كلها فكذب وأبى
verses.transliterated: walaqad araynāhu āyātinā kullahā fakadhaba wa-ab
verses.english: We showed him all our proofs, but he disbelieved and refused.

1981.english: We showed Pharaoh all Our miracles, but he disbelieved and refused.

1989.english: We showed him all our signs, but he disbelieved and refused.

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال أجئتنا لتخرجنا من أرضنا بسحرك يا موسى
verses.transliterated: qāla aji'tanā litukh'rijanā min arḍinā bisiḥ'rika yāmūs
verses.english: He said, "Did you come here to take us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

1981.english: He said, "Did you come to evict us from our land with your magic, Moses?

1989.english: He said, “Did you come here to take us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

verses.arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
verses.arabicClean: فلنأتينك بسحر مثله فاجعل بيننا وبينك موعدا لا نخلفه نحن ولا أنت مكانا سوى
verses.transliterated: falanatiyannaka bisiḥ'rin mith'lihi fa-ij'ʿal baynanā wabaynaka mawʿidan lā nukh'lifuhu naḥnu walā anta makānan suwa
verses.english: "We will surely show you similar magic. Therefore, set an appointment that neither we, nor you will violate; in a neutral place."

1981.english: "We will surely show you similar magic, so set up an appointment neither we nor you shall break, and let us meet on neutral grounds."

1989.english: “We will surely show you similar magic. Therefore, set an appointment that neither we, nor you will violate; in a neutral place.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًى
verses.arabicClean: قال موعدكم يوم الزينة وأن يحشر الناس ضحى
verses.transliterated: qāla mawʿidukum yawmu l-zīnati wa-an yuḥ'shara l-nāsu ḍuḥa
verses.english: He said, "Your appointed time shall be the day of festivities. Let us all meet in the forenoon."

1981.english: He said, "Your appointment is the day of festival, and let the people gather at forenoon."

1989.english: He said, “Your appointed time shall be the day of festivities. Let us all meet in the forenoon.”

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فتولى فرعون فجمع كيده ثم أتى
verses.transliterated: fatawallā fir'ʿawnu fajamaʿa kaydahu thumma at
verses.english: Pharaoh summoned his forces, then came.

1981.english: Pharaoh then went and mobilized his forces, and came.

1989.english: (On the appointed day,) Pharaoh summoned his forces, and came.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال لهم موسى ويلكم لا تفتروا على الله كذبا فيسحتكم بعذاب ۖ وقد خاب من افترى
verses.transliterated: qāla lahum mūsā waylakum lā taftarū ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fayus'ḥitakum biʿadhābin waqad khāba mani if'tar
