verses.english: Moses said to them, "Woe to you. Do you fabricate lies to fight GOD and thus incur His retribution? Such fabricators will surely fail."

1981.english: Moses said to them, "Woe to you; do not fabricate lies against God, lest He smites you with retribution. The fabricators never succeed."

1989.english: Moses said to them, “Woe to you. Do you fabricate lies to fight GOD and thus incur His retribution? Such fabricators will surely fail.”

verses.arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فتنازعوا أمرهم بينهم وأسروا النجوى
verses.transliterated: fatanāzaʿū amrahum baynahum wa-asarrū l-najw
verses.english: They disputed among themselves, as they conferred privately.

1981.english: They conferred with each other, and secretly decided.

1989.english: They disputed among themselves, as they conferred privately.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا إن هذان لساحران يريدان أن يخرجاكم من أرضكم بسحرهما ويذهبا بطريقتكم المثلى
verses.transliterated: qālū in hādhāni lasāḥirāni yurīdāni an yukh'rijākum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihimā wayadhhabā biṭarīqatikumu l-muth'l
verses.english: They said, "These two are no more than magicians who wish to take you out of your land with their magic, and to destroy your ideal way of life.

1981.english: They said, "These two are simply magicians who want to evict you from your land with their magic, and destroy your good way of life.

1989.english: They said, “These two are no more than magicians who wish to take you out of your land with their magic, and thus destroy your ideal way of life.

verses.arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّا وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فأجمعوا كيدكم ثم ائتوا صفا ۚ وقد أفلح اليوم من استعلى
verses.transliterated: fa-ajmiʿū kaydakum thumma i'tū ṣaffan waqad aflaḥa l-yawma mani is'taʿl
verses.english: "Let us agree upon one scheme and face them as a united front. The winner today will have the upper hand."

1981.english: "Thus, mobilize your forces, and come united. Whoever wins today will be exalted."

1989.english: “Let us unite our plans and face them as a united front. The winner today will surely succeed.” *

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا موسى إما أن تلقي وإما أن نكون أول من ألقى
verses.transliterated: qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna awwala man alq
verses.english: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw."

1981.english: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we throw first."

1989.english: They said, “O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال بل ألقوا ۖ فإذا حبالهم وعصيهم يخيل إليه من سحرهم أنها تسعى
verses.transliterated: qāla bal alqū fa-idhā ḥibāluhum waʿiṣiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min siḥ'rihim annahā tasʿ
verses.english: He said, "You throw." Whereupon, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their magic, as if they were moving.

1981.english: He said, "You go ahead," whereupon their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their magic, to be moving.

1989.english: He said, “You throw.” Whereupon, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their trickery, as if they were moving.

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فأوجس في نفسه خيفة موسى
verses.transliterated: fa-awjasa fī nafsihi khīfatan mūs
verses.english: Moses harbored some fear.

1981.english: Fear crept into Moses.

1989.english: Moses harbored some fear.

verses.arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قلنا لا تخف إنك أنت الأعلى
verses.transliterated: qul'nā lā takhaf innaka anta l-aʿl
verses.english: We said, "Have no fear. You will prevail.

1981.english: We said, "Have no fear; you are the winner.

1989.english: We said, “Have no fear. You will prevail.

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وألق ما في يمينك تلقف ما صنعوا ۖ إنما صنعوا كيد ساحر ۖ ولا يفلح الساحر حيث أتى
verses.transliterated: wa-alqi mā fī yamīnika talqaf mā ṣanaʿū innamā ṣanaʿū kaydu sāḥirin walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥiru ḥaythu at
verses.english: "Throw what you hold in your right hand, and it will swallow what they fabricated. What they fabricated is no more than the scheming of a magician. The magician's work will not succeed."

1981.english: "Throw what is in your right hand, and it will swallow everything they fabricated. What they fabricated is a magician's trick, and the magician can never succeed in this manner."

1989.english: “Throw what you hold in your right hand, and it will swallow whatever they fabricated. What they fabricated is no more than the scheming of a magician. The magician’s work will not succeed.”

verses.arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فألقي السحرة سجدا قالوا آمنا برب هارون وموسى
verses.transliterated: fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sujjadan qālū āmannā birabbi hārūna wamūs
verses.english: The magicians fell prostrate, saying, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verses.subtitle: The Experts Recognize The Truth

1981.english: The magicians fell prostrate, saying, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."

1989.english: The magicians fell prostrate, saying, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
1989.subtitle: The Experts Recognize The Truth

verses.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال آمنتم له قبل أن آذن لكم ۖ إنه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر ۖ فلأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلاف ولأصلبنكم في جذوع النخل ولتعلمن أينا أشد عذابا وأبقى
verses.transliterated: qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra fala-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum fī judhūʿi l-nakhli walataʿlamunna ayyunā ashaddu ʿadhāban wa-abq
verses.english: He said, "Did you believe in him without my permission? He must be your chief; the one who taught you magic. I will surely sever your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out which of us can inflict the worst retribution, and who outlasts whom."

1981.english: Pharaoh said, "Did you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your leader who taught you magic. I will cut off your hands and feet on alternate sides, and crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out which of us can inflict a severe and lasting retribution."

1989.english: He said, “Did you believe in him without my permission? He must be your chief; the one who taught you magic. I will surely cut your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out soon which of us can inflict the worst retribution, and who outlasts whom.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا لن نؤثرك على ما جاءنا من البينات والذي فطرنا ۖ فاقض ما أنت قاض ۖ إنما تقضي هذه الحياة الدنيا
verses.transliterated: qālū lan nu'thiraka ʿalā mā jāanā mina l-bayināti wa-alladhī faṭaranā fa-iq'ḍi mā anta qāḍin innamā taqḍī hādhihi l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verses.english: They said, "We will not prefer you over the clear proofs that came to us, and over the One who created us. Therefore, issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.

1981.english: They said, "We will not give you preference over the one who created us, and the profound miracles shown to us. So issue whatever judgment you wish; you only rule in this lowly life.

1989.english: They said, “We will not prefer you over the clear signs that came to us, and over the One who created us. Therefore, issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: إنا آمنا بربنا ليغفر لنا خطايانا وما أكرهتنا عليه من السحر ۗ والله خير وأبقى
verses.transliterated: innā āmannā birabbinā liyaghfira lanā khaṭāyānā wamā akrahtanā ʿalayhi mina l-siḥ'ri wal-lahu khayrun wa-abq
verses.english: "We have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic that you forced us to perform. GOD is far better and Everlasting."

1981.english: "We have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic you forced us to commit. God is far better, and ever lasting."

1989.english: “We have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic that you had forced us to perform. GOD is far better and Everlasting.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إنه من يأت ربه مجرما فإن له جهنم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى
verses.transliterated: innahu man yati rabbahu muj'riman fa-inna lahu jahannama lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥy
verses.english: Anyone who comes to his Lord guilty will incur Hell, wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.

1981.english: Indeed, whoever comes guilty to his Lord, has deserved Gehenna, wherein he neither dies, nor lives.

1989.english: Anyone who comes to his Lord guilty, will incur Hell, wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يأته مؤمنا قد عمل الصالحات فأولئك لهم الدرجات العلى
verses.transliterated: waman yatihi mu'minan qad ʿamila l-ṣāliḥāti fa-ulāika lahumu l-darajātu l-ʿul
verses.english: As for those who come to Him as believers who had led a righteous life, they attain the high ranks.

1981.english: And whoever comes to Him as a believer who had worked righteousness, then these have deserved the highest ranks.

1989.english: As for those who come to Him as believers who had led a righteous life, they attain the high ranks.

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: جنات عدن تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ۚ وذلك جزاء من تزكى
verses.transliterated: jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wadhālika jazāu man tazakk
verses.english: The gardens of Eden, beneath which rivers flow, will be their abode forever. Such is the reward for those who purify themselves.

1981.english: They abide forever in gardens of Eden, with flowing streams. This is the reward for the pious.

1989.english: The gardens of Eden, beneath which rivers flow. They abide therein forever. Such is the reward for those who purify themselves.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أوحينا إلى موسى أن أسر بعبادي فاضرب لهم طريقا في البحر يبسا لا تخاف دركا ولا تخشى
verses.transliterated: walaqad awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī fa-iḍ'rib lahum ṭarīqan fī l-baḥri yabasan lā takhāfu darakan walā takhsh
verses.english: We inspired Moses: "Lead My servants out, and strike for them a dry road across the sea. You shall not fear that you may get caught, nor shall you worry."

1981.english: We inspired Moses that: "You shall move out with My servants, and strike a dry path across the sea. Do not fear capture, or oppression."
1981.subtitle: The Children of Israel Delivered

1989.english: We inspired Moses: “Lead My servants out, and strike for them a dry road across the sea. Do not fear getting caught; do not worry.”

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فأتبعهم فرعون بجنوده فغشيهم من اليم ما غشيهم
verses.transliterated: fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu bijunūdihi faghashiyahum mina l-yami mā ghashiyahu
verses.english: Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, but the sea overwhelmed them, as it was destined to overwhelm them.

1981.english: Pharaoh pursued them, with his troops, but the sea overwhelmed them.

1989.english: Pharaoh pursued them with his troops. The sea overwhelmed them, as it was destined to overwhelm them.

verses.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وأضل فرعون قومه وما هدى
verses.transliterated: wa-aḍalla fir'ʿawnu qawmahu wamā had
verses.english: Thus, Pharaoh misled his people; he did not guide them.

1981.english: Thus, Pharaoh misled his people, and never guided them.

1989.english: Thus, Pharaoh misled his people; he did not guide them.

verses.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني إسرائيل قد أنجيناكم من عدوكم وواعدناكم جانب الطور الأيمن ونزلنا عليكم المن والسلوى
verses.transliterated: yābanī is'rāīla qad anjaynākum min ʿaduwwikum wawāʿadnākum jāniba l-ṭūri l-aymana wanazzalnā ʿalaykumu l-mana wal-salw
verses.english: O Children of Israel, we delivered you from your enemy, summoned you to the right side of Mount Sinai, and we sent down to you manna and quails.

1981.english: O children of Israel, we saved you from your enemy, summoned you to the right side of Mount Sinai, and provided you with manna and quails.

1989.english: O Children of Israel, we delivered you from your enemy, summoned you to the right side of Mount Sinai, and we sent down to you manna and quails.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم ولا تطغوا فيه فيحل عليكم غضبي ۖ ومن يحلل عليه غضبي فقد هوى
verses.transliterated: kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum walā taṭghaw fīhi fayaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabī waman yaḥlil ʿalayhi ghaḍabī faqad haw
verses.english: Eat from the good things we provided for you, and do not transgress, lest you incur My wrath. Whoever incurs My wrath has fallen.

1981.english: Eat from the good things we provided for you, and do not transgress, lest you incur My wrath. Whoever incurs My wrath is doomed to failure.

1989.english: Eat from the good things we provided for you, and do not transgress thereby, lest you incur My wrath. Whoever incurs My wrath has fallen.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وإني لغفار لمن تاب وآمن وعمل صالحا ثم اهتدى
verses.transliterated: wa-innī laghaffārun liman tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan thumma ih'tad
verses.english: I am surely Forgiving for those who repent, believe, lead a righteous life, and steadfastly remain guided.

1981.english: Yet, I forgive those who repent, believe, work righteousness, and maintain the guidance.

1989.english: I am surely Forgiving for those who repent, believe, lead a righteous life, and steadfastly remain guided.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وما أعجلك عن قومك يا موسى
verses.transliterated: wamā aʿjalaka ʿan qawmika yāmūs
verses.english: "Why did you rush away from your people, O Moses?"
verses.subtitle: The Children of Israel Rebel

1981.english: And why did you rush away from your people, Moses?

1989.english: “Why did you rush away from your people, O Moses?”
1989.subtitle: The Children of Israel Rebel

verses.arabic: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال هم أولاء على أثري وعجلت إليك رب لترضى
verses.transliterated: qāla hum ulāi ʿalā atharī waʿajil'tu ilayka rabbi litarḍ
verses.english: He said, "They are close behind me. I have rushed to You my Lord, that You may be pleased."

1981.english: He said, "They are close behind me, and I rushed to You, my Lord, that You may be pleased."

1989.english: He said, “They are close behind me, and I rushed to You my Lord, that You may be pleased.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.arabicClean: قال فإنا قد فتنا قومك من بعدك وأضلهم السامري
verses.transliterated: qāla fa-innā qad fatannā qawmaka min baʿdika wa-aḍallahumu l-sāmiriy
verses.english: He said, "We have put your people to the test after you left, but the Samarian misled them."

1981.english: God said, "We have tested your people during your absence, and the Samarian led them astray."

1989.english: He said, “We put your people to the test after you left, and the Samarian misled them.”

verses.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًا قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
verses.arabicClean: فرجع موسى إلى قومه غضبان أسفا ۚ قال يا قوم ألم يعدكم ربكم وعدا حسنا ۚ أفطال عليكم العهد أم أردتم أن يحل عليكم غضب من ربكم فأخلفتم موعدي
verses.transliterated: farajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla yāqawmi alam yaʿid'kum rabbukum waʿdan ḥasanan afaṭāla ʿalaykumu l-ʿahdu am aradttum an yaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabun min rabbikum fa-akhlaftum mawʿid
verses.english: Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, saying, "O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Could you not wait? Did you want to incur wrath from your Lord? Is this why you broke your agreement with me?"

1981.english: Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed. He said, "O my people, did you not receive a good promise from your Lord? Has it been too long for you, or were you anxious to incur wrath from your Lord? Is this why you violated your agreement with me?"

1989.english: Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, saying, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Could you not wait? Did you want to incur wrath from your Lord? Is this why you broke your covenant with me?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ما أخلفنا موعدك بملكنا ولكنا حملنا أوزارا من زينة القوم فقذفناها فكذلك ألقى السامري
verses.transliterated: qālū mā akhlafnā mawʿidaka bimalkinā walākinnā ḥummil'nā awzāran min zīnati l-qawmi faqadhafnāhā fakadhālika alqā l-sāmiriy
verses.english: They said, "We did not break our agreement with you on purpose. But we were loaded down with jewelry, and decided to throw our loads in. This is what the Samarian suggested."

1981.english: They said, "We did not violate our agreement on our own accord. We wanted to get rid of our loads of jewelry, so we threw them in, and so advised the Samarian."

1989.english: They said, “We did not break our covenant with you on purpose. But we were loaded down with jewelry, and decided to throw our loads in. This is what the Samarian suggested.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخرج لهم عجلا جسدا له خوار فقالوا هذا إلهكم وإله موسى فنسي
verses.transliterated: fa-akhraja lahum ʿij'lan jasadan lahu khuwārun faqālū hādhā ilāhukum wa-ilāhu mūsā fanasiy
verses.english: He produced for them a sculpted calf, complete with a calf's sound. They said, "This is your god, and the god of Moses." Thus, he forgot.
verses.footnote: & 96 The Samarian went to the spot where God spoke to Moses, and grabbed a fistful of dust upon which God's voice had echoed. This dust, when mixed with the molten gold caused the golden statue to acquire the sound of a calf.

1981.english: He produced for them a sculpted calf, complete with sound, so they said, "This is your god, and the god of Moses." He certainly forgot.

1989.english: He produced for them a calf, complete with a calf’s sound.* They said, “This is your god, and the god of Moses.” Thus, he forgot.
1989.footnote: & 96 The Samarian went to the spot where God spoke to Moses, and grabbed a fistful of dust upon which God’s voice had echoed. This dust, when mixed with the molten gold caused the golden statue to acquire the sound of a calf.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
verses.arabicClean: أفلا يرون ألا يرجع إليهم قولا ولا يملك لهم ضرا ولا نفعا
verses.transliterated: afalā yarawna allā yarjiʿu ilayhim qawlan walā yamliku lahum ḍarran walā nafʿa
verses.english: Could they not see that it neither responded to them, nor possessed any power to harm them, or benefit them?

1981.english: Did they not see that it could not answer them, nor possess any power to harm them or benefit them?

1989.english: Do they not see that it neither responded to them, nor possessed any power to harm them, or benefit them?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَـٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
verses.arabicClean: ولقد قال لهم هارون من قبل يا قوم إنما فتنتم به ۖ وإن ربكم الرحمن فاتبعوني وأطيعوا أمري
verses.transliterated: walaqad qāla lahum hārūnu min qablu yāqawmi innamā futintum bihi wa-inna rabbakumu l-raḥmānu fa-ittabiʿūnī wa-aṭīʿū amr
verses.english: And Aaron had told them, "O my people, this is a test for you. Your only Lord is the Most Gracious, so follow me, and obey my commands."

1981.english: And Aaron said to them repeatedly, "O my people, you are being put to the test therewith. Your true God is the most gracious God, so follow me, and obey my order."

1989.english: And Aaron had told them, “O my people, this is a test for you. Your only Lord is the Most Gracious, so follow me, and obey my commands.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا لن نبرح عليه عاكفين حتى يرجع إلينا موسى
verses.transliterated: qālū lan nabraḥa ʿalayhi ʿākifīna ḥattā yarjiʿa ilaynā mūs
verses.english: They said, "We will continue to worship it, until Moses comes back."

1981.english: They said, "We will continue to worship it, until Moses returns."

1989.english: They said, “We will continue to worship it, until Moses comes back.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
verses.arabicClean: قال يا هارون ما منعك إذ رأيتهم ضلوا
verses.transliterated: qāla yāhārūnu mā manaʿaka idh ra-aytahum ḍall
verses.english: (Moses) said, "O Aaron, what is it that prevented you, when you saw them go astray,

1981.english: Moses said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them go astray,

1989.english: He said, “O Aaron, what stopped you when you saw them go astray—

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
verses.arabicClean: ألا تتبعن ۖ أفعصيت أمري
verses.transliterated: allā tattabiʿani afaʿaṣayta amr
verses.english: "from following my orders? Have you rebelled against me?"

1981.english: "From following me? Have you disobeyed my orders?"

1989.english: “from following my orders? Have you rebelled against me?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
verses.arabicClean: قال يا ابن أم لا تأخذ بلحيتي ولا برأسي ۖ إني خشيت أن تقول فرقت بين بني إسرائيل ولم ترقب قولي
verses.transliterated: qāla yabna-umma lā takhudh biliḥ'yatī walā birasī innī khashītu an taqūla farraqta bayna banī is'rāīla walam tarqub qawl
verses.english: He said, "O son of my mother, do not pull me by my beard and my head. I was afraid that you might say, 'You have divided the Children of Israel, and disobeyed my orders.' "

1981.english: He said, "O son of my mother, do not pull my beard and my hair. I feared lest you say, 'You divided the children of Israel, and did not observe my instructions.' "

1989.english: He said, “O son of my mother; do nol pull me by my beard and my head. I was afraid that you might say that I divided the Children of Israel, and did not follow your orders.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ
verses.arabicClean: قال فما خطبك يا سامري
verses.transliterated: qāla famā khaṭbuka yāsāmiriyy
verses.english: He said, "What is the matter with you, O Samarian?"

1981.english: He said, "What is the matter with you, O Samarian?"

1989.english: He said, “What is the matter with you, O Samarian?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
verses.arabicClean: قال بصرت بما لم يبصروا به فقبضت قبضة من أثر الرسول فنبذتها وكذلك سولت لي نفسي
verses.transliterated: qāla baṣur'tu bimā lam yabṣurū bihi faqabaḍtu qabḍatan min athari l-rasūli fanabadhtuhā wakadhālika sawwalat lī nafs
verses.english: He said, "I saw what they could not see. I grabbed a fistful (of dust) from the place where the messenger stood, and used it (to mix into the golden calf). This is what my mind inspired me to do."

1981.english: He said, "I saw what they failed to see. So, I picked up a trace from the (angel) messenger, and used it (to make the calf). It was my own idea."

1989.english: He said, “I saw what they could not see, so I grabbed a fistful (of dust) from the place where the messenger stood, and used it (to mix into the golden calf). This is what my mind inspired me to do.”*

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verses.arabicClean: قال فاذهب فإن لك في الحياة أن تقول لا مساس ۖ وإن لك موعدا لن تخلفه ۖ وانظر إلى إلهك الذي ظلت عليه عاكفا ۖ لنحرقنه ثم لننسفنه في اليم نسفا
verses.transliterated: qāla fa-idh'hab fa-inna laka fī l-ḥayati an taqūla lā misāsa wa-inna laka mawʿidan lan tukh'lafahu wa-unẓur ilā ilāhika alladhī ẓalta ʿalayhi ʿākifan lanuḥarriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fī l-yami nasfa
verses.english: He said, "Then go, and, throughout your life, do not even come close. You have an appointed time (for your final judgment) that you can never evade. Look at your god that you used to worship; we will burn it and throw it into the sea, to stay down there forever."

1981.english: He said, "Then go; throughout your life, do not come close. As for your god, whom you worshiped, we will burn it up, then throw it into the bottom of the sea."

1989.english: He said, “Then go, and, throughout your life, do not even come close. You have an appointed time (for your final judgment) that you can never evade. Watch your god that you used to worship; we will burn it and throw it into the sea, to stay there forever.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا
verses.arabicClean: إنما إلهكم الله الذي لا إله إلا هو ۚ وسع كل شيء علما
verses.transliterated: innamā ilāhukumu l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa wasiʿa kulla shayin ʿil'ma
verses.english: Your only god is GOD; the One beside whom there is no other god. His knowledge encompasses all things.
verses.subtitle: You Have But One God

1981.english: Your only God is the one God; there is no god except He; His knowledge encompasses all things.

1989.english: Your only god is GOD; the One besides whom there is no other god. His knowledge encompasses all things.
1989.subtitle: You Have But One God

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا
verses.arabicClean: كذلك نقص عليك من أنباء ما قد سبق ۚ وقد آتيناك من لدنا ذكرا
verses.transliterated: kadhālika naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi mā qad sabaqa waqad ātaynāka min ladunnā dhik'ra
verses.english: We thus narrate to you some news from the past generations. We have revealed to you a message from us.

1981.english: We thus narrate to you some history from the past, and we have given you a message from us.

1989.english: We thus narrate to you some news from the past generations. We have given you a message from us.

verses.arabic: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
verses.arabicClean: من أعرض عنه فإنه يحمل يوم القيامة وزرا
verses.transliterated: man aʿraḍa ʿanhu fa-innahu yaḥmilu yawma l-qiyāmati wiz'ra
verses.english: Those who disregard it will bear a load (of sins) on the Day of Resurrection.

1981.english: Anyone who disregards it will bear a terrible burden on the day of resurrection.

1989.english: Those who disregard it will bear a load (of sins) on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًا
verses.arabicClean: خالدين فيه ۖ وساء لهم يوم القيامة حملا
verses.transliterated: khālidīna fīhi wasāa lahum yawma l-qiyāmati ḥim'la
verses.english: Eternally they abide therein; what a miserable load on the Day of Resurrection!

1981.english: They abide therein forever; what a miserable load on the day of resurrection!

1989.english: Eternally they abide therein. What a miserable load on the Day of Resurrection!

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا
verses.arabicClean: يوم ينفخ في الصور ۚ ونحشر المجرمين يومئذ زرقا
verses.transliterated: yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri wanaḥshuru l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin zur'qa
verses.english: That is the day when the horn is blown, and we summon the guilty on that day blue.

1981.english: That is the day when the horn is blown, and the guilty are summoned blue.

1989.english: That is the day when the horn is blown, and we summon the guilty on that day blue.

verses.arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
verses.arabicClean: يتخافتون بينهم إن لبثتم إلا عشرا
verses.transliterated: yatakhāfatūna baynahum in labith'tum illā ʿashra
verses.english: Whispering among themselves, they will say, "You have stayed (in the first life) no more than ten days!"

1981.english: As they whisper to each other, they would say, "You lasted only ten days."

1989.english: Whispering among themselves, they will say, “You have stayed (in the first life) no more than ten!”

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
verses.arabicClean: نحن أعلم بما يقولون إذ يقول أمثلهم طريقة إن لبثتم إلا يوما
verses.transliterated: naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna idh yaqūlu amthaluhum ṭarīqatan in labith'tum illā yawma
verses.english: We are fully aware of their utterances. The most accurate among them will say, "You stayed no more than a day."

1981.english: We are fully aware of whatever they say, and the closest to the truth among them would say, "You lasted no more than one day."

1989.english: We are fully aware of their utterances. The most accurate among them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”

verses.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًا
verses.arabicClean: ويسألونك عن الجبال فقل ينسفها ربي نسفا
verses.transliterated: wayasalūnaka ʿani l-jibāli faqul yansifuhā rabbī nasfa
verses.english: They ask you about the mountains. Say, "My Lord will wipe them out.
verses.subtitle: On the Day of Resurrection

1981.english: And they ask you what will happen to the mountains. Say, "My Lord will completely wipe them out.

1989.english: They ask you about the mountains. Say, “My Lord will wipe them out.
1989.subtitle: On the Day of Resurrection

verses.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا
verses.arabicClean: فيذرها قاعا صفصفا
verses.transliterated: fayadharuhā qāʿan ṣafṣafa
verses.english: "He will leave them like a barren, flat land.

1981.english: "He will thus leave the earth perfectly level.

1989.english: “He will leave them like a barren, flat land.

verses.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَآ أَمْتًا
verses.arabicClean: لا ترى فيها عوجا ولا أمتا
verses.transliterated: lā tarā fīhā ʿiwajan walā amta
verses.english: "Not even the slightest hill will you see therein, nor a dip."

1981.english: "Not even a crookedness, or a terrain, will you see therein."

1989.english: “Not even the slightest hill will you see therein, nor a dip.”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا
verses.arabicClean: يومئذ يتبعون الداعي لا عوج له ۖ وخشعت الأصوات للرحمن فلا تسمع إلا همسا
verses.transliterated: yawma-idhin yattabiʿūna l-dāʿiya lā ʿiwaja lahu wakhashaʿati l-aṣwātu lilrraḥmāni falā tasmaʿu illā hamsa
verses.english: On that day, everyone will follow the caller, without the slightest deviation. All sounds will be hushed before the Most Gracious; you will hear nothing but whispers.

1981.english: On that day, they will follow the summoner, without the least deviation, and all voices will yield to God most gracious; you will not hear but whispers.

1989.english: On that day, everyone will follow the caller, without the slightest deviation. All sounds will be hushed before the Most Gracious; you will hear nothing but whispers.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًا
verses.arabicClean: يومئذ لا تنفع الشفاعة إلا من أذن له الرحمن ورضي له قولا
verses.transliterated: yawma-idhin lā tanfaʿu l-shafāʿatu illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waraḍiya lahu qawla
verses.english: On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by the Most Gracious, and whose utterances conform to His will.

1981.english: On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by God most gracious, and whose intercession happens to agree with God's decisions.
1981.subtitle: No Intercession For the Wicked

1989.english: On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by the Most Gracious, and those whose utterances conform to His wi

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًا
verses.arabicClean: يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون به علما
verses.transliterated: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bihi ʿil'ma
verses.english: He knows their past and their future, while none encompasses His knowledge.

1981.english: He knows their past, and their future, while their knowledge never encompasses Him.

1989.english: He knows their past and their future, while none encompasses His knowledge.

verses.arabic: وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
verses.arabicClean: وعنت الوجوه للحي القيوم ۖ وقد خاب من حمل ظلما
verses.transliterated: waʿanati l-wujūhu lil'ḥayyi l-qayūmi waqad khāba man ḥamala ẓul'ma
verses.english: All faces will submit to the Living, the Eternal, and those who are burdened by their transgressions will fail.

1981.english: All faces will submit to the living, the eternal God, and thus, those burdened by sin will be doomed.

1989.english: All faces will submit to the Living, the Eternal, and those who are burdened by their transgressions will fail.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يعمل من الصالحات وهو مؤمن فلا يخاف ظلما ولا هضما
verses.transliterated: waman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā yakhāfu ẓul'man walā haḍma
verses.english: As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they will have no fear of injustice or adversity.

1981.english: As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they fear no hardship, nor humiliation.

1989.english: As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they will have no fear of injustice or adversity.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك أنزلناه قرآنا عربيا وصرفنا فيه من الوعيد لعلهم يتقون أو يحدث لهم ذكرا
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan waṣarrafnā fīhi mina l-waʿīdi laʿallahum yattaqūna aw yuḥ'dithu lahum dhik'ra
verses.english: We thus revealed it, an Arabic Quran, and we cited in it all kinds of prophecies, that they may be saved, or it may cause them to take heed.

1981.english: Thus, we send it down as an Arabic Quran, and we cite in it all kinds of admonitions, that they may turn to righteousness or take heed.

1989.english: We thus revealed it, an Arabic Quran, and we cited in it all kinds of prophecies that they may be saved, or it may cause them to take heed.

verses.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
verses.arabicClean: فتعالى الله الملك الحق ۗ ولا تعجل بالقرآن من قبل أن يقضى إليك وحيه ۖ وقل رب زدني علما
verses.transliterated: fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu walā taʿjal bil-qur'āni min qabli an yuq'ḍā ilayka waḥyuhu waqul rabbi zid'nī ʿil'ma
verses.english: Most Exalted is GOD, the only true King. Do not rush into uttering the Quran before it is revealed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase my knowledge."

1981.english: Most exalted is God, the true king. Do not hasten to utter the Quran (O Muhammad), before we ordered you to reveal it, and say, "My Lord, increase my knowledge."
1981.footnote: Muhammad was given the Quran in one night, to be released over a period of 23 years, in a manner similar to the teaching of Adam (see 17:1 and 106).

1989.english: Most Exalted is GOD, the only true King. Do not rush into uttering the Quran before it is revealed to you, and say, “My Lord, increase my knowledge.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولقد عهدنا إلى آدم من قبل فنسي ولم نجد له عزما
verses.transliterated: walaqad ʿahid'nā ilā ādama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu ʿazma
verses.english: We tested Adam in the past, but he forgot, and we found him indecisive.
verses.subtitle: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand
verses.footnote: When Satan challenged God's absolute authority (38:69), you and I did not make a firm stand against Satan. God is giving us a chance, on this earth, to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan and upholding God's absolute authority (Appendix 7).

1981.english: We have made an agreement with Adam previously, but he forgot, and we found him lacking in strength.
1981.footnote: Muhammad was given the Quran in one night, to be released over a period of 23 years, in a manner similar to the teaching of Adam (see 17:1 and 106).

1989.english: We tested Adam in the past, but he forgot, and we found him indecisive.
1989.subtitle: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand
1989.footnote: When Satan challenged God’s absolute authority (38:69), you and I did not make a firm stand against Satan. God is giving us a chance, on this earth, to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan and upholding God’s absolute authority (Appendix 7).

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس أبى
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa ab
verses.english: Recall that we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused.

1981.english: When we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam," they fell prostrate, except Iblis (Satan); he refused.
1981.subtitle: Adam Fails

1989.english: And when we said to the angels, “Fall prostrate before Adam,” they fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused.

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: فقلنا يا آدم إن هذا عدو لك ولزوجك فلا يخرجنكما من الجنة فتشقى
verses.transliterated: faqul'nā yāādamu inna hādhā ʿaduwwun laka walizawjika falā yukh'rijannakumā mina l-janati fatashq
verses.english: We then said, "O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife. Do not let him evict you from Paradise, lest you become miserable.

1981.english: So we said, "O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife; let him not evict you from heaven, lest you become miserable.

1989.english: We then said, “O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife. Do not let him evict you from Paradise, lest you become miserable.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إن لك ألا تجوع فيها ولا تعرى
verses.transliterated: inna laka allā tajūʿa fīhā walā taʿr
verses.english: "You are guaranteed never to hunger therein, nor go unsheltered.

1981.english: "You are guaranteed that you do not hunger therein, nor go naked.

1989.english: “You are guaranteed never to hunger therein, nor go unsheltered.

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وأنك لا تظمأ فيها ولا تضحى
verses.transliterated: wa-annaka lā taẓma-u fīhā walā taḍḥ
verses.english: "Nor will you thirst therein, nor suffer from any heat."

1981.english: "And that you do not thirst therein, nor suffer any heat."

1989.english: “Nor will you thirst therein, nor suffer from any heat.”

verses.arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فوسوس إليه الشيطان قال يا آدم هل أدلك على شجرة الخلد وملك لا يبلى
verses.transliterated: fawaswasa ilayhi l-shayṭānu qāla yāādamu hal adulluka ʿalā shajarati l-khul'di wamul'kin lā yabl
verses.english: But the devil whispered to him, saying, "O Adam, let me show you the tree of eternity and unending kingship."

1981.english: But the devil whispered to him, saying, "O Adam, let me show you the tree of eternity, and ever lasting kingship."

1989.english: But the devil whispered to him, saying, “O Adam, shall I show you the tree of eternity and unending kingship?”

verses.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فأكلا منها فبدت لهما سوآتهما وطفقا يخصفان عليهما من ورق الجنة ۚ وعصى آدم ربه فغوى
verses.transliterated: fa-akalā min'hā fabadat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati waʿaṣā ādamu rabbahu faghaw
verses.english: They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Adam thus disobeyed his Lord, and fell.

1981.english: They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Thus, Adam disobeyed his Lord, and lost.

1989.english: They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Adam disobeyed his Lord, and went astray.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ثم اجتباه ربه فتاب عليه وهدى
verses.transliterated: thumma ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fatāba ʿalayhi wahad
verses.english: Subsequently, his Lord chose him, redeemed him, and guided him.

1981.english: Then his Lord chose him; He redeemed and guided him.

1989.english: Then his Lord chose him, redeemed him, and guided him.

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال اهبطا منها جميعا ۖ بعضكم لبعض عدو ۖ فإما يأتينكم مني هدى فمن اتبع هداي فلا يضل ولا يشقى
verses.transliterated: qāla ih'biṭā min'hā jamīʿan baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun fa-immā yatiyannakum minnī hudan famani ittabaʿa hudāya falā yaḍillu walā yashq
verses.english: He said, "Go down therefrom, all of you. You are enemies of one another. When guidance comes to you from Me, anyone who follows My guidance will not go astray, nor suffer any misery.

1981.english: God said, "Go down therefrom, all of you, as enemies of one another. When guidance comes to you from Me, those who follow My guidance will never go astray, nor suffer misery.

1989.english: He said, “Go down therefrom, all of you, as enemies of one another. When guidance comes to you from Me, anyone who follows My guidance will not go astray, nor suffer any misery.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أعرض عن ذكري فإن له معيشة ضنكا ونحشره يوم القيامة أعمى
verses.transliterated: waman aʿraḍa ʿan dhik'rī fa-inna lahu maʿīshatan ḍankan wanaḥshuruhu yawma l-qiyāmati aʿm
verses.english: "As for the one who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we resurrect him, on the Day of Resurrection, blind."
verses.subtitle: For the Disbelievers: Miserable Life Unavoidable

1981.english: "As for him who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we raise him, on the day of resurrection, blind."

1989.english: “As for the one who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: قال رب لم حشرتني أعمى وقد كنت بصيرا
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi lima ḥashartanī aʿmā waqad kuntu baṣīra
verses.english: He will say, "My Lord, why did you summon me blind, when I used to be a seer?"

1981.english: He would say, "My Lord, why did you raise me blind, when I was a seer?"

1989.english: He will say, “My Lord, why did you summon me blind, when I used to be a seer?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قال كذلك أتتك آياتنا فنسيتها ۖ وكذلك اليوم تنسى
verses.transliterated: qāla kadhālika atatka āyātunā fanasītahā wakadhālika l-yawma tuns
verses.english: He will say, "Because you forgot our revelations when they came to you, you are now forgotten."

1981.english: God will say, "Because our revelations came to you, but you discarded them. Consequently, you are discarded today."

1989.english: He will say, “Because you forgot our revelations when they came to you, you are now forgotten.”

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك نجزي من أسرف ولم يؤمن بآيات ربه ۚ ولعذاب الآخرة أشد وأبقى
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika najzī man asrafa walam yu'min biāyāti rabbihi walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati ashaddu wa-abq
verses.english: We thus requite those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. The retribution in the Hereafter is far worse and everlasting.

1981.english: We punish those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. Additionally, the retribution of the hereafter is even worse, and ever lasting.

1989.english: We thus requite those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. The retribution in the Hereafter is far worse and everlasting.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: أفلم يهد لهم كم أهلكنا قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مساكنهم ۗ إن في ذلك لآيات لأولي النهى
verses.transliterated: afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin li-ulī l-nuh
verses.english: Does it ever occur to them how many previous generations we have annihilated? They are now walking in the homes of those before them. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.

1981.english: Did it ever occur to them that we annihilated many generations before them? They are walking in the dwellings left by them. This should be a lesson for those who possess understanding.

1989.english: Does it ever occur to them how many previous generations we have annihilated? They are now walking in the homes of those before them. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى
verses.arabicClean: ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لكان لزاما وأجل مسمى
verses.transliterated: walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakāna lizāman wa-ajalun musamma
verses.english: If it were not for your Lord's predetermined plan, they would have been judged immediately.

1981.english: If it were not for your Lord's decision to predetermine their end, they would have been judged immediately.

1989.english: If it were not for your Lord’s predetermined plan, they would have been judged immediately.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها ۖ ومن آناء الليل فسبح وأطراف النهار لعلك ترضى
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla ghurūbihā wamin ānāi al-layli fasabbiḥ wa-aṭrāfa l-nahāri laʿallaka tarḍ
verses.english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And during the night glorify Him, as well as at both ends of the day, that you may be happy.

1981.english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise the glory of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset; also during parts of the night, and at both ends of the day, that you may attain happiness.

1989.english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And during the night glorify Him, as well as at both ends of the day, that you may be happy.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزواجا منهم زهرة الحياة الدنيا لنفتنهم فيه ۚ ورزق ربك خير وأبقى
verses.transliterated: walā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum zahrata l-ḥayati l-dun'yā linaftinahum fīhi wariz'qu rabbika khayrun wa-abq
verses.english: And do not covet what we bestowed upon any other people. Such are temporary ornaments of this life, whereby we put them to the test. What your Lord provides for you is far better, and everlasting.

1981.english: Do not covet what we bestow upon the various kinds of people, for these are temporary vanities of this life; we only test them therewith. Your Lord's blessings are far better, and everlasting.

1989.english: And do not covet what we bestowed upon any other people. Such are temporary ornaments of this life, whereby we put them to the test. What your Lord provides for you is far better, and everlasting.

verses.arabic: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًا نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وأمر أهلك بالصلاة واصطبر عليها ۖ لا نسألك رزقا ۖ نحن نرزقك ۗ والعاقبة للتقوى
verses.transliterated: wamur ahlaka bil-ṣalati wa-iṣ'ṭabir ʿalayhā lā nasaluka riz'qan naḥnu narzuquka wal-ʿāqibatu lilttaqw
verses.english: You shall enjoin your family to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and steadfastly persevere in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; we are the ones who provide for you. The ultimate triumph belongs to the righteous.
verses.subtitle: The Parents' Responsibility

1981.english: You shall exhort your family to observe the **salat** prayers, and persist in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; it is us who provide for you. The final victory belongs to the righteous.
1981.subtitle: Important Commandment

1989.english: You shall enjoin your family to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and steadfastly persevere in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; we are the ones who provide for you. The ultimate triumph belongs to the righteous.
1989.subtitle: The Parents’ Responsibility

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لولا يأتينا بآية من ربه ۚ أولم تأتهم بينة ما في الصحف الأولى
verses.transliterated: waqālū lawlā yatīnā biāyatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu mā fī l-ṣuḥufi l-ūl
verses.english: They said, "If he could only show us a miracle from his Lord!" Did they not receive sufficient miracles with the previous messages?
verses.subtitle: Why Messengers?

1981.english: They said, "How come he does not show us any miracle from his Lord?" Did they not know how many miracles we manifested in the previous missions?

1989.english: They said, “If he could only show us a miracle from his Lord!” Did they not receive sufficient miracles with the previous messages?
1989.subtitle: Why Messengers?

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنا أهلكناهم بعذاب من قبله لقالوا ربنا لولا أرسلت إلينا رسولا فنتبع آياتك من قبل أن نذل ونخزى
verses.transliterated: walaw annā ahlaknāhum biʿadhābin min qablihi laqālū rabbanā lawlā arsalta ilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhz
verses.english: Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, "Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation."

1981.english: Had we afflicted them with retribution without this message, they would have said, "Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have honored Your message, and would have evaded this humiliation and disgrace."

1989.english: Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, “Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قل كل متربص فتربصوا ۖ فستعلمون من أصحاب الصراط السوي ومن اهتدى
verses.transliterated: qul kullun mutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣū fasataʿlamūna man aṣḥābu l-ṣirāṭi l-sawiyi wamani ih'tad
verses.english: Say, "All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided."

1981.english: Say, "Everyone is waiting, so wait along. You will find out who are following the right path and the true guidance."

1989.english: Say, “All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided.”

verses.arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اقترب للناس حسابهم وهم في غفلة معرضون
verses.transliterated: iq'taraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatin muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: Fast approaching is the reckoning for the people, but they are oblivious, averse.

1981.english: The reckoning for the people is fast approaching, while they are totally unaware, heedless.

1989.english: Fast approaching is the reckoning for the people, but they are unaware, averse. Opposition to New Revelations

verses.arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما يأتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث إلا استمعوه وهم يلعبون
verses.transliterated: mā yatīhim min dhik'rin min rabbihim muḥ'dathin illā is'tamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūn
verses.english: When a proof comes to them from their Lord, that is new, they listen to it heedlessly.
verses.subtitle: Opposition to the New Evidence

1981.english: Whenever a new reminder comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it thoughtlessly.

1989.english: Whenever a reminder comes to them from their Lord, which is new, they listen to it heedlessly.

verses.arabic: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لاهية قلوبهم ۗ وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا هل هذا إلا بشر مثلكم ۖ أفتأتون السحر وأنتم تبصرون
verses.transliterated: lāhiyatan qulūbuhum wa-asarrū l-najwā alladhīna ẓalamū hal hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum afatatūna l-siḥ'ra wa-antum tub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Their minds are heedless. And the transgressors confer secretly: "Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept the magic that is presented to you?"
verses.footnote: Although the Bible (Malachi 3:1) and the Quran (3:81) prophesy the advent of God's Messenger of the Covenant, when he did appear, supported by 'one of the greatest miracles' (74:30-35), he was met with heedlessness and opposition. The divine assertion that every 'new' proof is opposed has been proven by the Arabs' opposition to the Quran's miracle. (App. 1 & 2).

1981.english: Their hearts are distracted, and the wicked confide to each other, "Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept magic while you see?"

1989.english: Their hearts are heedless. And the transgressors confer secretly: “Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept magic when you see it?”*
1989.footnote: Although both the Bible (Malachi 3:3) and the Quran (3:81) clearly prophesy the advent of God’s Messenger of the Covenant, when he did appear, supported with ‘one of the greatest miracles’ (74:30-35), he was met with heedlessness and opposition. The divine assertion that every ‘new’ revelation is opposed has been proven by the fierce opposition to the Quran’s great miracle, (see Appendices 1 & 2).

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قال ربي يعلم القول في السماء والأرض ۖ وهو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbī yaʿlamu l-qawla fī l-samāi wal-arḍi wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: He said, "My Lord knows every thought in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord is fully aware of all the utterances in the heaven and the earth; He is the Hearer, the Omniscient."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord knows every thought in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.”

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل قالوا أضغاث أحلام بل افتراه بل هو شاعر فليأتنا بآية كما أرسل الأولون
verses.transliterated: bal qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmin bali if'tarāhu bal huwa shāʿirun falyatinā biāyatin kamā ur'sila l-awalūn
verses.english: They even said, "Hallucinations," "He made it up," and, "He is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like those of the previous messengers."

1981.english: They even said, "He dreamt this up; he invented it; he is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like the past messengers."

1989.english: They even said, “Hallucinations,” “He made it up,” and, “He is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like the those of previous messengers.”

verses.arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما آمنت قبلهم من قرية أهلكناها ۖ أفهم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā afahum yu'minūn
verses.english: We never annihilated a believing community in the past. Are these people believers?

1981.english: Any community that disbelieved in the past was annihilated; would these people believe?

1989.english: None of the communities that we annihilated in the past were believers. Are these people believers?

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا قبلك إلا رجالا نوحي إليهم ۖ فاسألوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask those who know the scripture, if you do not know.

1981.english: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired, so ask those who know, if you do not know.

1989.english: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask the experts if you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما جعلناهم جسدا لا يأكلون الطعام وما كانوا خالدين
verses.transliterated: wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadan lā yakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wamā kānū khālidīn
verses.english: We did not give them bodies that did not eat, nor were they immortal.

1981.english: We did not give them bodies that required no food, nor were they immortal.

1989.english: We did not give them bodies that did not eat, nor were they immortal.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم صدقناهم الوعد فأنجيناهم ومن نشاء وأهلكنا المسرفين
verses.transliterated: thumma ṣadaqnāhumu l-waʿda fa-anjaynāhum waman nashāu wa-ahlaknā l-mus'rifīn
verses.english: We fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them together with whomever we willed, and annihilated the transgressors.

1981.english: We always fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them, together with those whom we chose, and we destroyed the transgressors.

1989.english: We fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them with whomever we willed, and annihilated the transgressors.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لقد أنزلنا إليكم كتابا فيه ذكركم ۖ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: laqad anzalnā ilaykum kitāban fīhi dhik'rukum afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: We have sent down to you a scripture containing your message. Do you not understand?

1981.english: We send down to you this book, containing your message. Do you not understand?

1989.english: We have sent down to you a scripture containing your message. Would you not understand?

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وكم قصمنا من قرية كانت ظالمة وأنشأنا بعدها قوما آخرين
verses.transliterated: wakam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimatan wa-anshanā baʿdahā qawman ākharīn
verses.english: Many a community we terminated because of their transgression, and we substituted other people in their place.

1981.english: Many a community we punished in the past because of their wickedness, and we established after them other people.

1989.english: Many a community we terminated because of their transgression, and we substituted other people in their place.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما أحسوا بأسنا إذا هم منها يركضون
verses.transliterated: falammā aḥassū basanā idhā hum min'hā yarkuḍūn
verses.english: When our requital came to pass, they started to run.

1981.english: When they sensed our punishment coming, they started to run.

1989.english: When our requital came to pass, they started to run.

verses.arabic: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا تركضوا وارجعوا إلى ما أترفتم فيه ومساكنكم لعلكم تسألون
verses.transliterated: lā tarkuḍū wa-ir'jiʿū ilā mā ut'rif'tum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tus'alūn
verses.english: Do not run, and come back to your luxuries and your mansions, for you must be held accountable.

1981.english: Do not run, and return to your material luxuries and your homes, that you may be held accountable.

1989.english: Do not run, and come back to your luxuries and your homes, for you must be held accountable.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا ويلنا إنا كنا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.english: They said, "Woe to us. We were really wicked."

1981.english: They said, "Woe to us, we were really wrong."

1989.english: They said, “Woe to us. We were really wicked.”

verses.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما زالت تلك دعواهم حتى جعلناهم حصيدا خامدين
verses.transliterated: famā zālat til'ka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīn
verses.english: This continued to be their proclamation, until we completely wiped them out.

1981.english: This continued to be their utterance, until we completely wiped them out.

1989.english: This continued to be their proclamation, until we completely wiped them out.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما لاعبين
verses.transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn
verses.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them just for amusement.

1981.english: We did not create the heaven and the earth, and everything between them, for amusement.

1989.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them just to play.

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لو أردنا أن نتخذ لهوا لاتخذناه من لدنا إن كنا فاعلين
verses.transliterated: law aradnā an nattakhidha lahwan la-ittakhadhnāhu min ladunnā in kunnā fāʿilīn
verses.english: If we needed amusement, we could have initiated it without any of this, if that is what we wanted to do.

1981.english: If we wanted to make up an amusement, we could have done it on our own.

1989.english: If we needed entertainment, we could have initiated it without any of this, if that is what we wanted to do.

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل نقذف بالحق على الباطل فيدمغه فإذا هو زاهق ۚ ولكم الويل مما تصفون
verses.transliterated: bal naqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿalā l-bāṭili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhā huwa zāhiqun walakumu l-waylu mimmā taṣifūn
verses.english: Instead, it is our plan to support the truth against falsehood, in order to defeat it. Woe to you for the utterances you utter.

1981.english: But we want to set up the truth against falsehood, in order to expose it and render it obsolete. Woe to you from your claims.

1989.english: Instead, it is our plan to support the truth against falsehood, in order to defeat it. Woe to you for the utterances you utter.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وله من في السماوات والأرض ۚ ومن عنده لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ولا يستحسرون
verses.transliterated: walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waman ʿindahu lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi walā yastaḥsirūn
verses.english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth, and those at Him are never too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they ever waver.

1981.english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and those at Him are never too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they ever regret it.

1989.english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth, and those at Him are never too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they ever waver.

verses.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يسبحون الليل والنهار لا يفترون
verses.transliterated: yusabbiḥūna al-layla wal-nahāra lā yafturūn
verses.english: They glorify night and day, without ever tiring.

1981.english: They glorify (Him) day and night without tiring.

1989.english: They glorify night and day without tiring.

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم اتخذوا آلهة من الأرض هم ينشرون
verses.transliterated: ami ittakhadhū ālihatan mina l-arḍi hum yunshirūn
verses.english: Have they found gods on earth who can create?
verses.subtitle: One God

1981.english: Have they found gods on earth who can resurrect the dead?
1981.subtitle: Do Not Idolize the Prophets

1989.english: Have they found gods on earth who can create?
1989.subtitle: One God

verses.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لو كان فيهما آلهة إلا الله لفسدتا ۚ فسبحان الله رب العرش عما يصفون
verses.transliterated: law kāna fīhimā ālihatun illā l-lahu lafasadatā fasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.english: If there were in them (the heavens and the earth) other gods beside GOD, there would have been chaos. Glory be to GOD; the Lord with absolute authority. He is high above their claims.

1981.english: If there were gods (in the heavens and the earth) besides God, they would have corrupted. Therefore, God be glorified; He is the Lord with total authority; high above any description.

1989.english: If there were in them (the heavens and the earth) other gods besides GOD, there would have been chaos. Glory be to GOD; the Lord with absolute authority. He is high above their claims.

verses.arabic: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يسأل عما يفعل وهم يسألون
verses.transliterated: lā yus'alu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yus'alūn
verses.english: He is never to be asked about anything He does, while all others are questioned.
verses.subtitle: Never Question God's Wisdom

1981.english: He is never questioned about anything He does, while they are questioned.

1989.english: He is never questioned about anything He does, while all others are questioned.

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم اتخذوا من دونه آلهة ۖ قل هاتوا برهانكم ۖ هذا ذكر من معي وذكر من قبلي ۗ بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون الحق ۖ فهم معرضون
verses.transliterated: ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan qul hātū bur'hānakum hādhā dhik'ru man maʿiya wadhik'ru man qablī bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna l-ḥaqa fahum muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: Have they found other gods beside Him? Say, "Show me your proof. This is the message to my generation, consummating all previous messages." Indeed, most of them do not recognize the truth; this is why they are so hostile.

1981.english: Have they found gods besides Him? Say, "Show us your proofs. This Quran is my proof; it encompasses the present and the past." Indeed, most of them fail to recognize the truth; this is why they turn away.

1989.english: Have they found other gods besides Him? Say, “Show me your proof. This message to my generation is the same message given to the generations before me.” Indeed, most of them do not recognize the truth; this is why they are averse.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول إلا نوحي إليه أنه لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدون
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin illā nūḥī ilayhi annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'budūn
verses.english: We did not send any messenger before you except with the inspiration: "There is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone."
verses.subtitle: One God / One Message / One Religion

1981.english: We did not send any messenger before you, except with the message, "There is no god except Me; therefore, you shall worship Me."

1989.english: We did not send any messenger before you except with the inspiration: “There is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone.”
1989.subtitle: One God/One Message/One Religion

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا ۗ سبحانه ۚ بل عباد مكرمون
verses.transliterated: waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan sub'ḥānahu bal ʿibādun muk'ramūn
verses.english: Yet, they said, "The Most Gracious has begotten a son!" Glory be to Him. All (messengers) are (His) honored servants.

1981.english: But they said, "God most gracious has taken for Himself a son!" God be glorified; nay, the prophets are no more than honored servants.

1989.english: Still, they said, “The Most Gracious has begotten a son!” Glory be to Him. All (messengers) are (His) honored servants.

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يسبقونه بالقول وهم بأمره يعملون
verses.transliterated: lā yasbiqūnahu bil-qawli wahum bi-amrihi yaʿmalūn
verses.english: They never speak on their own, and they strictly follow His commands.

1981.english: Their utterances shall never supercede His;* instead, they follow His orders.
1981.footnote: In defiance of God and His messenger Muhammad, multitudes of Muslims have turned to the utterances attributed to Muhammad for wisdom and religious regulations. Many of them uphold these inventions, known as "**Hadith**," so strongly that it abrogates the Quran (see footnote 24:1-2). See also 6:112-116.

1989.english: They never initiate any utterances; they strictly follow His commands.

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يشفعون إلا لمن ارتضى وهم من خشيته مشفقون
verses.transliterated: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna illā limani ir'taḍā wahum min khashyatihi mush'fiqūn
verses.english: He knows their future and their past. They do not intercede, except for those already accepted by Him, and they are worried about their own necks.
verses.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession
verses.footnote: The myth of intercession is Satan's most effective bait (see Appendix 8).

1981.english: He knows their past and their future, and they do not possess the power of intercession, except on behalf of those already saved by Him. The prophets themselves worry about their own fate.

1989.english: He knows their future and their past. They do not intercede, except for those already accepted by Him, and they are worried about their own necks.*
1989.footnote: The myth of intercession is Satan’s most effective bait (see Appendix 8).

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يقل منهم إني إله من دونه فذلك نجزيه جهنم ۚ كذلك نجزي الظالمين
verses.transliterated: waman yaqul min'hum innī ilāhun min dūnihi fadhālika najzīhi jahannama kadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: If any of them claims to be a god beside Him, we requite him with Hell; we thus requite the wicked.

1981.english: Furthermore, if any of them ever claims to be an idol besides Him, we will throw him in Gehenna. We thus punish the wicked.

1989.english: If any of them claims to be a god besides Him, we requite him with Hell; we thus reward the wicked.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم ير الذين كفروا أن السماوات والأرض كانتا رتقا ففتقناهما ۖ وجعلنا من الماء كل شيء حي ۖ أفلا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: awalam yara alladhīna kafarū anna l-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā wajaʿalnā mina l-māi kulla shayin ḥayyin afalā yu'minūn
verses.english: Do the unbelievers not realize that the heaven and the earth used to be one solid mass that we exploded into existence? And from water we made all living things. Would they believe?
verses.subtitle: The Big Bang Theory Confirmed
verses.footnote: The Big Bang Theory is now supported by the Creator's infallible mathematical code (Appendix 1). Thus, it is no longer a theory; it is a law, a proven fact.

1981.english: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and the earth used to be one entity; then we parted them? And we made water a requisite for every living organism. Therefore, would they not believe?
1981.subtitle: The "Big Bang Theory" Confirmed
1981.footnote: A prominent theory among the scientific community dealing with the origin of the universe.

1989.english: Do the unbelievers not realize that the heaven and the earth used to be one solid mass that we exploded into existence? And from water we made all living things. Would they believe?
1989.subtitle: The Big Bang Theory Confirmed
1989.footnote: The Big Bang Theory is now supported by the Creator’s infallible mathematical code (Appendix 1). Thus, it is no longer a theory; it is a proven fact.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا في الأرض رواسي أن تميد بهم وجعلنا فيها فجاجا سبلا لعلهم يهتدون
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulan laʿallahum yahtadūn
verses.english: And we placed on earth stabilizers, lest it tumbles with them, and we placed straight roads therein, that they may be guided.

1981.english: And we placed stabilizers on earth, lest it swerves with them, and we placed valleys therein to serve as roads, that they may travel.

1989.english: And we placed on earth stabilizers, lest it tumbles with them, and we placed straight roads therein, that they may be guided.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا السماء سقفا محفوظا ۖ وهم عن آياتها معرضون
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā l-samāa saqfan maḥfūẓan wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: And we rendered the sky a guarded ceiling. Yet, they are totally oblivious to all the portents therein.

1981.english: And we made the sky a protected ceiling; they are heedless of all the marvels therein.

1989.english: And we rendered the sky a guarded ceiling. Yet, they are totally heedless of the signs therein.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي خلق الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر ۖ كل في فلك يسبحون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī khalaqa al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fī falakin yasbaḥūn
verses.english: And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in its own orbit.

1981.english: And He is the one who created the night and day, and the sun and moon, each floating in its own orbit.

1989.english: And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in its own orbit.

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما جعلنا لبشر من قبلك الخلد ۖ أفإن مت فهم الخالدون
verses.transliterated: wamā jaʿalnā libasharin min qablika l-khul'da afa-in mitta fahumu l-khālidūn
verses.english: We never decreed immortality for anyone before you; should you die, are they immortal?

1981.english: We never made any human before you immortal; if you die, are they immortal?

1989.english: We never decreed immortality for anyone before you; should you die, are they immortal?
