1989.footnote: People who have insisted on going to Hell will inevitably complain: ‘Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently. ’ They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.

verses.arabic: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.arabicClean: كلما أرادوا أن يخرجوا منها من غم أعيدوا فيها وذوقوا عذاب الحريق
verses.transliterated: kullamā arādū an yakhrujū min'hā min ghammin uʿīdū fīhā wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīq
verses.english: Whenever they try to exit such misery, they will be forced back in: "Taste the agony of burning."

1981.english: Whenever they try to flee from the agony thereof, they will be returned therein: "Taste the retribution of burning."
1981.footnote: These are allegorical descriptions of heaven and hell (see Appendix 4).

1989.english: Whenever they try to exit such misery, they will be forced back in: “Taste the agony of burning.”
1989.footnote: People who have insisted on going to Hell will inevitably complain: ‘Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently. ’ They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا ۖ ولباسهم فيها حرير
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīru
verses.english: GOD will admit those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
verses.subtitle: The Bliss of Heaven

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, God will admit them into gardens with flowing streams. They are adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and their clothes are silk.
1981.footnote: These are allegorical descriptions of heaven and hell (see Appendix 4).

1989.english: GOD will admit those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
1989.subtitle: The Bliss of Heaven

verses.arabic: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: وهدوا إلى الطيب من القول وهدوا إلى صراط الحميد
verses.transliterated: wahudū ilā l-ṭayibi mina l-qawli wahudū ilā ṣirāṭi l-ḥamīd
verses.english: They have been guided to the good words; they have been guided in the path of the Most Praised.

1981.english: They have been guided to the right message; they have been guided in the path of God most praised.

1989.english: They have been guided to the good words; they have been guided in the path of the Most Praised.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا ويصدون عن سبيل الله والمسجد الحرام الذي جعلناه للناس سواء العاكف فيه والباد ۚ ومن يرد فيه بإلحاد بظلم نذقه من عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wal-masjidi l-ḥarāmi alladhī jaʿalnāhu lilnnāsi sawāan l-ʿākifu fīhi wal-bādi waman yurid fīhi bi-il'ḥādin biẓul'min nudhiq'hu min ʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: Surely, those who disbelieve and repulse others from the path of GOD, and from the Sacred Masjid that we designated for all the people—be they natives or visitors—and seek to pollute it and corrupt it, we will afflict them with painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve and repel others from the path of God, and from the Sacred Mosque that we appointed for all the people to retreat therein or just visit, and those who introduce any wickedness therein, we will commit them to painful retribution.

1989.english: Surely, those who disbelieve and repulse from the path of GOD, and from the Sacred Mosque that we designated for all the people—be they natives, or merely visiting it—and seek to corrupt it, we will afflict them with painful retribution. Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Islam, Decreed Through Abraham*

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ بوأنا لإبراهيم مكان البيت أن لا تشرك بي شيئا وطهر بيتي للطائفين والقائمين والركع السجود
verses.transliterated: wa-idh bawwanā li-ib'rāhīma makāna l-bayti an lā tush'rik bī shayan waṭahhir baytiya lilṭṭāifīna wal-qāimīna wal-rukaʿi l-sujūd
verses.english: We appointed Abraham to establish the Shrine: "You shall not idolize any other god beside Me, and purify My shrine for those who visit it, those who live near it, and those who bow and prostrate.
verses.subtitle: Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Submission, Decreed Through Abraham
verses.footnote: Abraham was the original messenger of Submission (Islam). See 22:78 and Appendix 9.

1981.english: We pointed out for Abraham the location of the shrine: "You shall never idolize anything besides Me, and purify My shrine for those who encircle it, retreat in it, and those who bow and prostrate therein.
1981.subtitle: Hajj Pilgrimage, Like All Religious Practices, Decreed Through Abraham
1981.footnote: Many people erroneously assume that all religious practices in Islam were originally decreed through Muhammad. The Quran, however, consistently teaches that Abraham was the original source of **salat**, **zakat**, fasting, and **hajj** (see 2:128, 135, 3:67-68, 95, 16:123, 21:73, and 22:78).

1989.english: We appointed Abraham to establish the Shrine: “You shall not idolize any other god besides Me, and purify My shrine for those who visit it, those who live near it, and those who bow and prostrate.
1989.footnote: Abraham was the original messenger of Islam. See 22:78 and Appendix 9.

verses.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأذن في الناس بالحج يأتوك رجالا وعلى كل ضامر يأتين من كل فج عميق
verses.transliterated: wa-adhin fī l-nāsi bil-ḥaji yatūka rijālan waʿalā kulli ḍāmirin yatīna min kulli fajjin ʿamīqi
verses.english: "And proclaim that the people shall observe Hajj pilgrimage. They will come to you walking or riding on various exhausted (means of transportation). They will come from the farthest locations."

1981.english: "And announce that the people shall observe the **hajj** pilgrimage. They will come to you walking and riding; they will come from the farthest valleys.

1989.english: “And proclaim that the people shall observe Hajj pilgrimage.* They will come to you walking or riding on various exhausted (means of transportation). They will come from the farthest locations.”
1989.footnote: Abraham was the original messenger of Islam. See 22:78 and Appendix 9.

verses.arabic: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ
verses.arabicClean: ليشهدوا منافع لهم ويذكروا اسم الله في أيام معلومات على ما رزقهم من بهيمة الأنعام ۖ فكلوا منها وأطعموا البائس الفقير
verses.transliterated: liyashhadū manāfiʿa lahum wayadhkurū is'ma l-lahi fī ayyāmin maʿlūmātin ʿalā mā razaqahum min bahīmati l-anʿāmi fakulū min'hā wa-aṭʿimū l-bāisa l-faqīr
verses.english: They may seek commercial benefits, and they shall commemorate GOD's name during the specified days for providing them with livestock. "Eat therefrom and feed the despondent and the poor."

1981.english: "They will reap many benefits, commemorate God's name during the specified days, and show their appreciation for the livestock He provides for them. Eat therefrom, and feed the poor and the needy.

1989.english: They may seek commercial benefits, and they shall commemorate GOD’s name during the specified days for providing them with livestock. “Eat therefrom and feed the despondent and the poor.”

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
verses.arabicClean: ثم ليقضوا تفثهم وليوفوا نذورهم وليطوفوا بالبيت العتيق
verses.transliterated: thumma l'yaqḍū tafathahum walyūfū nudhūrahum walyaṭṭawwafū bil-bayti l-ʿatīq
verses.english: They shall complete their obligations, fulfill their vows, and visit the ancient shrine.

1981.english: "They shall carry out the religious duties, fulfill their vows, and encircle the grand shrine."

1989.english: They shall complete their obligations, fulfill their vows, and visit the ancient shrine.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك ومن يعظم حرمات الله فهو خير له عند ربه ۗ وأحلت لكم الأنعام إلا ما يتلى عليكم ۖ فاجتنبوا الرجس من الأوثان واجتنبوا قول الزور
verses.transliterated: dhālika waman yuʿaẓẓim ḥurumāti l-lahi fahuwa khayrun lahu ʿinda rabbihi wa-uḥillat lakumu l-anʿāmu illā mā yut'lā ʿalaykum fa-ij'tanibū l-rij'sa mina l-awthāni wa-ij'tanibū qawla l-zūr
verses.english: Those who reverence the rites decreed by GOD have deserved a good reward at their Lord. All livestock is made lawful for your food, except for those specifically prohibited for you. You shall avoid the abomination of idol worship, and avoid bearing false witness.

1981.english: Indeed, for those who respect the sacred duties decreed by God, it will be better for them at their Lord. All livestock are permitted for you as food, except what is already stated. You shall avoid the abomination of idol worship, and avoid false regulations.
1981.footnote: This verse alerts us that following false regulations regarding food prohibitions is tantamount to idol worship; following religious regulations not decreed by God is idol worship. The major source of false regulations is "**hadith**" and "**sunna**."

1989.english: This is a duty; and those who uphold the commandments decreed by GOD, have deserved a good reward at their Lord. All livestock is made lawful for your food, except for those specifically prohibited for you. You shall avoid the abomination of idol worship, and avoid bearing any false witness.

verses.arabic: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
verses.arabicClean: حنفاء لله غير مشركين به ۚ ومن يشرك بالله فكأنما خر من السماء فتخطفه الطير أو تهوي به الريح في مكان سحيق
verses.transliterated: ḥunafāa lillahi ghayra mush'rikīna bihi waman yush'rik bil-lahi faka-annamā kharra mina l-samāi fatakhṭafuhu l-ṭayru aw tahwī bihi l-rīḥu fī makānin saḥīqi
verses.english: You shall maintain your devotion absolutely to GOD alone. Anyone who sets up any idol beside GOD is like one who fell from the sky, then gets snatched up by vultures, or blown away by the wind into a deep ravine.

1981.english: You shall devote your worship to God alone; do not set up any idols besides Him. Anyone who idolizes anything besides God is like one who falls from the sky, and gets snatched away by the vultures, or gets blown away by the wind into a bottomless pit.

1989.english: You shall maintain your devotion absolutely to GOD alone. Anyone who sets up any idols besides GOD is like one who fell from the sky, and was snatched up by the vultures, or blown away by the wind into a deep ravine.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك ومن يعظم شعائر الله فإنها من تقوى القلوب
verses.transliterated: dhālika waman yuʿaẓẓim shaʿāira l-lahi fa-innahā min taqwā l-qulūb
verses.english: Indeed, those who reverence the rites decreed by GOD demonstrate the righteousness of their hearts.

1981.english: Indeed, those who honor the offerings decreed by God, demonstrate the righteousness of their hearts.

1989.english: Indeed, those who reverence GOD’s commandments, demonstrate the righteousness of their hearts.

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
verses.arabicClean: لكم فيها منافع إلى أجل مسمى ثم محلها إلى البيت العتيق
verses.transliterated: lakum fīhā manāfiʿu ilā ajalin musamman thumma maḥilluhā ilā l-bayti l-ʿatīq
verses.english: The (livestock) provide you with many benefits for a period, before being donated to the ancient shrine.
verses.subtitle: Livestock Offerings During Pilgrimage

1981.english: After reaping benefits from the livestock for awhile, they offer it as charity at the grand shrine.

1989.english: The (livestock) provide you with many benefits for a period, before being donated to the ancient shrine.
1989.subtitle: Livestock Offerings During Pilgrimage

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ فَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكل أمة جعلنا منسكا ليذكروا اسم الله على ما رزقهم من بهيمة الأنعام ۗ فإلهكم إله واحد فله أسلموا ۗ وبشر المخبتين
verses.transliterated: walikulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakan liyadhkurū is'ma l-lahi ʿalā mā razaqahum min bahīmati l-anʿāmi fa-ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun falahu aslimū wabashiri l-mukh'bitīn
verses.english: For each congregation we have decreed rites whereby they commemorate the name of GOD for providing them with the livestock. Your god is one and the same god; you shall all submit to Him. Give good news to the obedient.

1981.english: We decreed certain rituals for each congregation, whereby they show their appreciation of God's provision of livestock. However, your God is the same God; you shall submit to Him. Give good news to the reverent;

1989.english: For each congregation we have decreed a ritual whereby they commemorate the name of GOD for providing them with the livestock. Your god is one and the same god; you shall all submit to Him. Give good news to the obedient.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين إذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم والصابرين على ما أصابهم والمقيمي الصلاة ومما رزقناهم ينفقون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna idhā dhukira l-lahu wajilat qulūbuhum wal-ṣābirīna ʿalā mā aṣābahum wal-muqīmī l-ṣalati wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn
verses.english: They are the ones whose hearts tremble upon mentioning GOD, they steadfastly persevere during adversity, they observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give to charity.

1981.english: whose hearts cringe upon remembering God, remain steadfast in the face of adversity, observe the **salat** prayers, and give to charity from our provisions to them.

1989.english: They are the ones whose hearts tremble upon mentioning GOD, they steadfastly persevere during adversity, they observe the contact prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والبدن جعلناها لكم من شعائر الله لكم فيها خير ۖ فاذكروا اسم الله عليها صواف ۖ فإذا وجبت جنوبها فكلوا منها وأطعموا القانع والمعتر ۚ كذلك سخرناها لكم لعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wal-bud'na jaʿalnāhā lakum min shaʿāiri l-lahi lakum fīhā khayrun fa-udh'kurū is'ma l-lahi ʿalayhā ṣawāffa fa-idhā wajabat junūbuhā fakulū min'hā wa-aṭʿimū l-qāniʿa wal-muʿ'tara kadhālika sakharnāhā lakum laʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: The animal offerings are among the rites decreed by GOD for your own good. You shall mention GOD's name on them while they are standing in line. Once they are offered for sacrifice, you shall eat therefrom and feed the poor and the needy. This is why we subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation.
verses.footnote: Animal offerings from the pilgrims conserve the resources at the pilgrimage site. Note that almost 2,000,000 pilgrims converge on Mecca during pilgrimage.

1981.english: The livestock offerings are part of the religious duties decreed by God, for your own good. Thus, you shall mention God's name as you sacrifice them. Once they fall on their sides, you shall eat therefrom, and feed the poor and needy. That is what we created them for, that you may be appreciative.

1989.english: The animal offerings were included in GOD’s rituals for your own good.* You shall mention GOD’s name on them while they are standing in line. You shall eat therefrom and feed the poor and the needy. This is why we have subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation.
1989.footnote: Animal offerings from the pilgrims conserve the resources at the pilgrimage site. Note that almost 2,000,000 pilgrims converge on Mecca during pilgrimage.

verses.arabic: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماؤها ولكن يناله التقوى منكم ۚ كذلك سخرها لكم لتكبروا الله على ما هداكم ۗ وبشر المحسنين
verses.transliterated: lan yanāla l-laha luḥūmuhā walā dimāuhā walākin yanāluhu l-taqwā minkum kadhālika sakharahā lakum litukabbirū l-laha ʿalā mā hadākum wabashiri l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Neither their meat, nor their blood reaches GOD. What reaches Him is your righteousness. He has subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation by glorifying GOD for guiding you. Give good news to the charitable.

1981.english: None of their meat or blood reaches God; what reaches Him is your righteousness. That is what He created them for; that you may magnify God for guiding you; give good news to the good doers.

1989.english: Neither their meat, nor their blood reaches GOD. What reaches Him is your righteousness. He has subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation by glorifying GOD for guiding you. Give good new to the good doers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يدافع عن الذين آمنوا ۗ إن الله لا يحب كل خوان كفور
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yudāfiʿu ʿani alladhīna āmanū inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu kulla khawwānin kafūri
verses.english: GOD defends those who believe. GOD does not love any betrayer, unappreciative.
verses.subtitle: God Defends the Believers

1981.english: God surely defends those who believe; and God loves not any betrayer, unappreciative.
1981.subtitle: God Defends the Believers

1989.english: GOD defends those who believe. GOD does not love any betrayer, unappreciative.

verses.arabic: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أذن للذين يقاتلون بأنهم ظلموا ۚ وإن الله على نصرهم لقدير
verses.transliterated: udhina lilladhīna yuqātalūna bi-annahum ẓulimū wa-inna l-laha ʿalā naṣrihim laqadīru
verses.english: Permission is granted to those who are being persecuted, since injustice has befallen them, and GOD is certainly able to support them.
verses.subtitle: Synagogues, Churches, and Masjids

1981.english: Sanction is given to those who suffer aggression, because of the injustice that befalls them. God certainly is able to give them victory.

1989.english: Injustice has befallen those who are being persecuted, and GOD is certainly able to support them.
1989.subtitle: Synagogues, Churches, and Mosques

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.arabicClean: الذين أخرجوا من ديارهم بغير حق إلا أن يقولوا ربنا الله ۗ ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض لهدمت صوامع وبيع وصلوات ومساجد يذكر فيها اسم الله كثيرا ۗ ولينصرن الله من ينصره ۗ إن الله لقوي عزيز
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ukh'rijū min diyārihim bighayri ḥaqqin illā an yaqūlū rabbunā l-lahu walawlā dafʿu l-lahi l-nāsa baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin lahuddimat ṣawāmiʿu wabiyaʿun waṣalawātun wamasājidu yudh'karu fīhā us'mu l-lahi kathīran walayanṣuranna l-lahu man yanṣuruhu inna l-laha laqawiyyun ʿazīzu
verses.english: They were evicted from their homes unjustly, for no reason other than saying, "Our Lord is GOD." If it were not for GOD's supporting of some people against others, monasteries, churches, synagogues, and masjids—where the name of GOD is commemorated frequently—would have been destroyed. Absolutely, GOD supports those who support Him. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.

1981.english: They are evicted from their homes unjustly; for no reason other than saying, "Our Lord is God." If it were not for God's setting up of some people against others, synagogues, churches, and mosques; where God's name is commemorated frequently; would have been destroyed. Most certainly, God will support those who support Him. God is powerful, almighty.

1989.english: They were evicted from their homes unjustly, for no reason except their saying, “Our Lord is GOD.” If it were not for GOD’s supporting of some people against others, monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques, where the name of GOD is commemorated frequently, would have been destroyed. Most assuredly, GOD supports those who support Him. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.arabicClean: الذين إن مكناهم في الأرض أقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة وأمروا بالمعروف ونهوا عن المنكر ۗ ولله عاقبة الأمور
verses.transliterated: alladhīna in makkannāhum fī l-arḍi aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata wa-amarū bil-maʿrūfi wanahaw ʿani l-munkari walillahi ʿāqibatu l-umūr
verses.english: They are those who, if we appointed them as rulers on earth, they would establish the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat), and would advocate righteousness and forbid evil. GOD is the ultimate ruler.

1981.english: (God supports) those who, upon assuming control on earth, establish the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, and advocate righteousness and prohibit evil. The ultimate victory belongs with God.

1989.english: If we appoint them as rulers on earth they are the ones who establish the contact prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat), and advocate righteousness and forbid evil. GOD is the ultimate ruler.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود
verses.transliterated: wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wathamūd
verses.english: If they reject you, the people of Noah, 'Ãd, and Thamûd have also disbelieved before them.

1981.english: If they disbelieve you, others before them have disbelieved, such as the people of Noah, 'Ad, and Thamood.
1981.subtitle: The Disbelievers Consistently Doomed

1989.english: If they disbelieve you, the people of Noah, ‘Aad, and Thamoud have also disbelieved before them.

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقوم إبراهيم وقوم لوط
verses.transliterated: waqawmu ib'rāhīma waqawmu lūṭi
verses.english: Also the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot.

1981.english: And the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot.

1989.english: And the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot.

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ مَدْيَنَ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: وأصحاب مدين ۖ وكذب موسى فأمليت للكافرين ثم أخذتهم ۖ فكيف كان نكير
verses.transliterated: wa-aṣḥābu madyana wakudhiba mūsā fa-amlaytu lil'kāfirīna thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna nakīr
verses.english: And the dwellers of Midyan. Moses was also rejected. I led all those people on, then I called them to account; how (devastating) was My requital!

1981.english: And the inhabitants of Midyan; even Moses was disbelieved. I consistently allowed the disbelievers to carry on for awhile, then I punished them. How devastating was My retribution!

1989.english: And the dwellers of Midyan. And Moses was disbelieved. I led all those people on, then I called them to account; how (devastating) was My requital!

verses.arabic: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: فكأين من قرية أهلكناها وهي ظالمة فهي خاوية على عروشها وبئر معطلة وقصر مشيد
verses.transliterated: faka-ayyin min qaryatin ahlaknāhā wahiya ẓālimatun fahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wabi'rin muʿaṭṭalatin waqaṣrin mashīdi
verses.english: Many a community have we annihilated because of their wickedness. They ended up with ruins, stilled wells, and great empty mansions.

1981.english: Every community that we destroyed because of their wickedness, ended up in ruins, stilled wells, and empty mansions.

1989.english: Many a community have we annihilated because of their wickedness. They ended up with ruins, stilled wells, and empty mansions.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: أفلم يسيروا في الأرض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها أو آذان يسمعون بها ۖ فإنها لا تعمى الأبصار ولكن تعمى القلوب التي في الصدور
verses.transliterated: afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fatakūna lahum qulūbun yaʿqilūna bihā aw ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā fa-innahā lā taʿmā l-abṣāru walākin taʿmā l-qulūbu allatī fī l-ṣudūr
verses.english: Did they not roam the earth, then use their minds to understand, and use their ears to hear? Indeed, the real blindness is not the blindness of the eyes, but the blindness of the hearts inside the chests.

1981.english: Did they not travel the land, then have hearts that understand, and ears that hear? Indeed, it is not the eyes that go blind; it is the hearts inside chests that go blind.

1989.english: Have they not roamed the earth, then used their minds to understand, or their ears to hear? Indeed, the real blindness in not the blindness of the eyes, but the blindness of the hearts inside the chests.

verses.arabic: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولن يخلف الله وعده ۚ وإن يوما عند ربك كألف سنة مما تعدون
verses.transliterated: wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walan yukh'lifa l-lahu waʿdahu wa-inna yawman ʿinda rabbika ka-alfi sanatin mimmā taʿuddūn
verses.english: They challenge you to bring retribution, and GOD never fails to fulfill His prophecy. A day of your Lord is like a thousand of your years.

1981.english: They challenge you to bring doom upon them! God never breaks His promise, and a day at your Lord is like one thousand years of your count.

1989.english: They challenge you to bring retribution, and GOD never breaks His promise. A day of your Lord is like a thousand of your years.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وكأين من قرية أمليت لها وهي ظالمة ثم أخذتها وإلي المصير
verses.transliterated: waka-ayyin min qaryatin amlaytu lahā wahiya ẓālimatun thumma akhadhtuhā wa-ilayya l-maṣīr
verses.english: Many a community in the past committed evil, and I led them on for awhile, then I punished them. To Me is the ultimate destiny.

1981.english: Many a community I allowed to carry on their wickedness for awhile, then I punished them; to Me is the final destiny.

1989.english: Many a community in the past committed evil; I led them on for awhile, then I called them to account; to Me is the ultimate destiny.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا أيها الناس إنما أنا لكم نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā anā lakum nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: Say, "O people, I have been sent to you as a profound warner."
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: This command is directed specifically to God's Messenger of the Covenant. This fact, and the specific name of the messenger are mathematically coded into the Quran. See the details, together with the irrefutable proofs, in Appendices 2 and 26.

1981.english: Say, "O people, I am no more than a manifest warner for you."

1989.english: Say, “O people, I have been sent to you as a profound warner.”*
1989.subtitle: God’s Messenger of the Covenant
1989.footnote: This command is directed specifically to God’s Messenger of the Covenant This fact, and the specific name of the messenger are mathematically coded into the Quran. See the details, together with physical evidence, in Appendices 2 and 26.

verses.arabic: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم
verses.transliterated: fa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmu
verses.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a generous recompense.

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, they have deserved forgiveness and a generous reward.

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they deserve forgiveness and a generous recompense.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: والذين سعوا في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك أصحاب الجحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīm
verses.english: As for those who strive to challenge our revelations, they incur Hell.

1981.english: As for those who challenge our revelations, they have deserved Gehenna.

1989.english: As for those who strive to challenge our revelations, they deserve Hell.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي إلا إذا تمنى ألقى الشيطان في أمنيته فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطان ثم يحكم الله آياته ۗ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin walā nabiyyin illā idhā tamannā alqā l-shayṭānu fī um'niyyatihi fayansakhu l-lahu mā yul'qī l-shayṭānu thumma yuḥ'kimu l-lahu āyātihi wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: We did not send before you any messenger, nor a prophet, without having the devil interfere in his wishes. GOD then nullifies what the devil has done. GOD perfects His revelations. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: The System
verses.footnote: Throughout this worldly test, Satan is allowed to present his point of view (we are born with a representative of Satan in our bodies). This allows the people to make a choice between God's evidence and Satan's evidence. Satan's evidence is invariably based on lies. This system explains the fact that the devil's agents continuously come up with the most absurd lies, insults and accusations against every messenger (see 6:33-34, 8:30, 17:76-77, 27:70).

1981.english: Every messenger and prophet before you, did not preach the message without having the devil interfere to frustrate his wishes. God then nullifies the devil's works, and establishes His revelations. God is omniscient, wise.
1981.subtitle: Messengers Surrounded By Tests
1981.footnote: As part of the tests to distinguish the true believers from the insincere ones, the devil is permitted to impart some suspicious or immoral accusations against those who serve God's message. While the believers recognize the devil's work, and steadfastly uphold God's message, the others are driven away by the devil's plan, and thus reject God's path on account of the messenger's apparent fault. As stated in verse 54, the sincere believers worship God, not the messenger, and uphold God's message, regardless of the messenger's personal characteristics. While the murder committed by Moses and his speech defect (see 43:52-54) drove away the unfortunate, the believers followed him and were saved.

1989.english: We did not send before you any messenger, nor a prophet, without having the devil interfere in his wishes. GOD then abrogates the consequences of the devil’s inter ference. GOD perfects His revelations. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.

verses.arabic: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: ليجعل ما يلقي الشيطان فتنة للذين في قلوبهم مرض والقاسية قلوبهم ۗ وإن الظالمين لفي شقاق بعيد
verses.transliterated: liyajʿala mā yul'qī l-shayṭānu fit'natan lilladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-qāsiyati qulūbuhum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lafī shiqāqin baʿīdi
verses.english: He thus sets up the devil's scheme as a test for those who harbor doubts in their hearts, and those whose hearts are hardened. The wicked must remain with the opposition.
verses.subtitle: The Hypocrites Drop Out

1981.english: God thus sets up the devil's work as a test, to expose those with disease in their hearts, and those whose hearts are hardened. Indeed, the wicked are thus blocked out.
1981.footnote: As part of the tests to distinguish the true believers from the insincere ones, the devil is permitted to impart some suspicious or immoral accusations against those who serve God's message. While the believers recognize the devil's work, and steadfastly uphold God's message, the others are driven away by the devil's plan, and thus reject God's path on account of the messenger's apparent fault. As stated in verse 54, the sincere believers worship God, not the messenger, and uphold God's message, regardless of the messenger's personal characteristics. While the murder committed by Moses and his speech defect (see 43:52-54) drove away the unfortunate, the believers followed him and were saved.

1989.english: He thus sets up the devil’s scheme as a test for those who harbor doubts in their hearts, and those whose hearts are hardened. Indeed, the wicked are in manifest opposition.

verses.arabic: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وليعلم الذين أوتوا العلم أنه الحق من ربك فيؤمنوا به فتخبت له قلوبهم ۗ وإن الله لهاد الذين آمنوا إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: waliyaʿlama alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma annahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika fayu'minū bihi fatukh'bita lahu qulūbuhum wa-inna l-laha lahādi alladhīna āmanū ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: Those who are blessed with knowledge will recognize the truth from your Lord, then believe in it, and their hearts will readily accept it. Most assuredly, GOD guides the believers in the right path.

1981.english: At the same time, those who have attained knowledge recognize the truth from your Lord, then believe therein, and fill their hearts thereof. God will always guide those who believe to the right path.
1981.footnote: As part of the tests to distinguish the true believers from the insincere ones, the devil is permitted to impart some suspicious or immoral accusations against those who serve God's message. While the believers recognize the devil's work, and steadfastly uphold God's message, the others are driven away by the devil's plan, and thus reject God's path on account of the messenger's apparent fault. As stated in verse 54, the sincere believers worship God, not the messenger, and uphold God's message, regardless of the messenger's personal characteristics. While the murder committed by Moses and his speech defect (see 43:52-54) drove away the unfortunate, the believers followed him and were saved.

1989.english: At the same time, this allows those who are endowed with knowledge to realize that this is the truth from your Lord. They will then believe in it, and their hearts will readily accept it. Most assuredly, GOD guides the believers in a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يزال الذين كفروا في مرية منه حتى تأتيهم الساعة بغتة أو يأتيهم عذاب يوم عقيم
verses.transliterated: walā yazālu alladhīna kafarū fī mir'yatin min'hu ḥattā tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan aw yatiyahum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaqīmi
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve, they will continue to harbor doubts until the Hour comes to them suddenly, or until the retribution of a terrible day comes to them.

1981.english: As for those who disbelieve, they will continue to harbor doubts, until the Hour comes to them suddenly, or the retribution of a miserable day.
1981.footnote: As part of the tests to distinguish the true believers from the insincere ones, the devil is permitted to impart some suspicious or immoral accusations against those who serve God's message. While the believers recognize the devil's work, and steadfastly uphold God's message, the others are driven away by the devil's plan, and thus reject God's path on account of the messenger's apparent fault. As stated in verse 54, the sincere believers worship God, not the messenger, and uphold God's message, regardless of the messenger's personal characteristics. While the murder committed by Moses and his speech defect (see 43:52-54) drove away the unfortunate, the believers followed him and were saved.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieve, they will continue to harbor doubts, until the Hour comes to them suddenly, or the retribution of a terrible day comes to them.

verses.arabic: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: الملك يومئذ لله يحكم بينهم ۚ فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات في جنات النعيم
verses.transliterated: al-mul'ku yawma-idhin lillahi yaḥkumu baynahum fa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī jannāti l-naʿīm
verses.english: All sovereignty on that day belongs to GOD, and He will judge among them. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the gardens of bliss.
verses.subtitle: Satan's Temporary Kingship

1981.english: On that day, all kingship belongs to God, and He will judge them. Then, those who believed and led a righteous life, will be in the gardens of bliss.

1989.english: All kingship on that day belongs to GOD. He will judge among them. As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of bliss.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا فأولئك لهم عذاب مهين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā fa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnu
verses.english: While those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations have incurred a shameful retribution.

1981.english: As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they have deserved humiliating retribution.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they incur a shameful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله ثم قتلوا أو ماتوا ليرزقنهم الله رزقا حسنا ۚ وإن الله لهو خير الرازقين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hājarū fī sabīli l-lahi thumma qutilū aw mātū layarzuqannahumu l-lahu riz'qan ḥasanan wa-inna l-laha lahuwa khayru l-rāziqīn
verses.english: Those who emigrate for the sake of GOD, then get killed, or die, GOD will surely shower them with good provisions. GOD is certainly the best Provider.
verses.subtitle: Striving in the Cause of God

1981.english: Those who flee their homes in the cause of God, then are killed or die, God will certainly reward them generously; God is the best provider.

1989.english: Those who emigrated for the sake of GOD, then got killed, or died, GOD will surely shower them with good provisions. GOD is certainly the best Provider.

verses.arabic: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ليدخلنهم مدخلا يرضونه ۗ وإن الله لعليم حليم
verses.transliterated: layud'khilannahum mud'khalan yarḍawnahu wa-inna l-laha laʿalīmun ḥalīmu
verses.english: Most assuredly, He will admit them an admittance that will please them. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.

1981.english: He will certainly admit them into a position that pleases them. He is omniscient, clement.

1989.english: Most assuredly, He will admit them an admittance that will please them. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك ومن عاقب بمثل ما عوقب به ثم بغي عليه لينصرنه الله ۗ إن الله لعفو غفور
verses.transliterated: dhālika waman ʿāqaba bimith'li mā ʿūqiba bihi thumma bughiya ʿalayhi layanṣurannahu l-lahu inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūru
verses.english: It is decreed that if one avenges an injustice that was inflicted upon him, equitably, then is persecuted because of this, GOD will surely support him. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiving.
verses.subtitle: Divine Help for the Oppressed

1981.english: If anyone avenges the persecution against him with an equitable punishment, then is attacked again, God will certainly protect him and grant him victory. God is pardoner, forgiver.

1989.english: It is decreed that if one avenges an injustice, equitably, then is persecuted because of that, GOD will surely grant him victory. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiving.
1989.subtitle: Divine Help for the Oppressed

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الله يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل وأن الله سميع بصير
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wa-anna l-laha samīʿun baṣīru
verses.english: It is a fact that GOD merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night, and that GOD is Hearer, Seer.
verses.subtitle: God's Omnipotence

1981.english: God is the one who merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. God is hearer, seer.
1981.subtitle: Tokens of God's Power

1989.english: This is as guaranteed as the fact that GOD merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night, and that GOD is Hearer, Seer.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الله هو الحق وأن ما يدعون من دونه هو الباطل وأن الله هو العلي الكبير
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi huwa l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīr
verses.english: It is a fact that GOD is the Truth, while the setting up of any idols beside Him constitutes a falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, the Supreme.

1981.english: God is the truth, and whatever else they set up as idols besides Him is falsehood. God is the most high, the great.

1989.english: This is as guaranteed as the fact that GOD is the Truth, while any idols they set up besides Him are falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, the Supreme.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فتصبح الأرض مخضرة ۗ إن الله لطيف خبير
verses.transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fatuṣ'biḥu l-arḍu mukh'ḍarratan inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīru
verses.english: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water that turns the land green? GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.

1981.english: Do you not see that God sends down water from the sky, causing the earth to turn green? God is kind, fully cognizant.

1989.english: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water that turns the land green? GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.

verses.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۗ وإن الله لهو الغني الحميد
verses.transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīd
verses.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praiseworthy.

1981.english: To Him belong everything in the heavens and everything on earth. God is bounteous, most praised.

1989.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything in the earth. Most assuredly, GOD is the Rich, Most Praised.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أن الله سخر لكم ما في الأرض والفلك تجري في البحر بأمره ويمسك السماء أن تقع على الأرض إلا بإذنه ۗ إن الله بالناس لرءوف رحيم
verses.transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-arḍi wal-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri bi-amrihi wayum'siku l-samāa an taqaʿa ʿalā l-arḍi illā bi-idh'nihi inna l-laha bil-nāsi laraūfun raḥīmu
verses.english: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything on earth? The ships run in the ocean by His command. He prevents the heavenly bodies from crashing onto the earth, except in accordance with His command. GOD is Most Kind towards the people, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Do you not see how God placed in your service everything on earth, as well as the ships that roam the sea? And He prevents the sky from crashing with the earth, except in accordance with His command. God is compassionate towards the people, most merciful.

1989.english: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything on earth? The ships run in the ocean by His command. He prevents the heavenly bodies from crashing with the earth, except in accordance with His command. GOD is Most Kind towards the people, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي أحياكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ۗ إن الإنسان لكفور
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī aḥyākum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum inna l-insāna lakafūru
verses.english: He is the One who granted you life, then He puts you to death, then He brings you back to life. Surely, the human being is unappreciative.

1981.english: He is the one who gave you life, then He puts you to death, then brings you back to life. Indeed, the human being is unappreciative.

1989.english: He is the One who granted you life, then puts you to death, then brings you back to life. Surely, the human being is unappreciative.

verses.arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: لكل أمة جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه ۖ فلا ينازعنك في الأمر ۚ وادع إلى ربك ۖ إنك لعلى هدى مستقيم
verses.transliterated: likulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakan hum nāsikūhu falā yunāziʿunnaka fī l-amri wa-ud'ʿu ilā rabbika innaka laʿalā hudan mus'taqīmi
verses.english: For each congregation, we have decreed a set of rites that they must uphold. Therefore, they should not dispute with you. You shall continue to invite everyone to your Lord. Most assuredly, you are on the right path.

1981.english: We decreed religious duties for each congregation, so let them not dispute with you. And continue to invite them to the path of your Lord, for you are in the right guidance.

1989.english: For each congregation, we have decreed a set of obligations that they must uphold. Therefore, let them not dispute with you, and invite to your Lord. Most assuredly, you are on the right path.

verses.arabic: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن جادلوك فقل الله أعلم بما تعملون
verses.transliterated: wa-in jādalūka faquli l-lahu aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūn
verses.english: If they argue with you, then say, "GOD is fully aware of everything you do."

1981.english: If they argue with you, then say, "God is fully aware of everything you do."

1989.english: If they argue with you, then say, “GOD is fully aware of everything you do.”

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيامة فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu yaḥkumu baynakum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn
verses.english: GOD will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection regarding all your disputes.

1981.english: God is the one who will judge between you on the day of resurrection, regarding your disputes.

1989.english: GOD will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection regarding all your disputes.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تعلم أن الله يعلم ما في السماء والأرض ۗ إن ذلك في كتاب ۚ إن ذلك على الله يسير
verses.transliterated: alam taʿlam anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāi wal-arḍi inna dhālika fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīru
verses.english: Do you not realize that GOD knows everything in the heavens and everything on earth? All this is recorded in a record. This is easy for GOD to do.

1981.english: Do you know that God knows everything in the heavens and the earth? This is already in a record; this is easy for God.

1989.english: Do you not realize that GOD knows everything in the heavens and everything on earth? All this is recorded in a record. This is easy for GOD.

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: ويعبدون من دون الله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا وما ليس لهم به علم ۗ وما للظالمين من نصير
verses.transliterated: wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wamā laysa lahum bihi ʿil'mun wamā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīri
verses.english: Yet, they idolize beside GOD idols wherein He placed no power, and they know nothing about them. The transgressors have no helper.

1981.english: Yet, they idolize besides God powerless idols, and idols they do not even know. The wicked will never be helped (by their idols).

1989.english: Yet, they idolize besides GOD idols wherein He placed no power, and they know nothing about them. Such transgressors have no helper.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات تعرف في وجوه الذين كفروا المنكر ۖ يكادون يسطون بالذين يتلون عليهم آياتنا ۗ قل أفأنبئكم بشر من ذلكم ۗ النار وعدها الله الذين كفروا ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin taʿrifu fī wujūhi alladhīna kafarū l-munkara yakādūna yasṭūna bi-alladhīna yatlūna ʿalayhim āyātinā qul afa-unabbi-ukum bisharrin min dhālikumu l-nāru waʿadahā l-lahu alladhīna kafarū wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, you recognize wickedness on the faces of those who disbelieve. They almost attack those who recite our revelations to them. Say, "Shall I inform you of something much worse? Hell is promised by GOD for those who disbelieve; what a miserable destiny."
verses.subtitle: Violence & Belligerence: Signs of Disbelief

1981.english: And when our clear revelations are recited, you recognize denial on the faces of those who disbelieve. They almost attack those who simply recite our revelations to them. Say, "Shall I tell you what is worse? That is the hellfire which is promised by God for those who disbelieve. What a miserable destiny!"

1989.english: When our revelations are recited for them, you recognize wickedness on the faces of those who disbelieved. They almost attack those who recite our revelations to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something much worse? Hell is promised by GOD for those who disbelieved; what a miserable destiny.”
1989.subtitle: Violence & Belligerence: Signs of Disbelief

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس ضرب مثل فاستمعوا له ۚ إن الذين تدعون من دون الله لن يخلقوا ذبابا ولو اجتمعوا له ۖ وإن يسلبهم الذباب شيئا لا يستنقذوه منه ۚ ضعف الطالب والمطلوب
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu ḍuriba mathalun fa-is'tamiʿū lahu inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lan yakhluqū dhubāban walawi ij'tamaʿū lahu wa-in yaslub'humu l-dhubābu shayan lā yastanqidhūhu min'hu ḍaʿufa l-ṭālibu wal-maṭlūb
verses.english: O people, here is a parable that you must ponder carefully: the idols you set up beside GOD can never create a fly, even if they banded together to do so. Furthermore, if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it; weak is the pursuer and the pursued.
verses.subtitle: Can They Create a Fly?

1981.english: O people, here is an example for you to ponder: the idols you set up besides God can never create a fly; even if they banded together. Furthermore, if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it. Weak is the seeker, and the sought after.
1981.subtitle: Can Your Idols Create A Fly?

1989.english: O people, here is a parable that you must consider carefully: the idols you call upon besides GOD can never create a fly, even if they banded together to do so. Furthermore, if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it; weak is the pursuer and the pursued.
1989.subtitle: Can They Create a Fly?

verses.arabic: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما قدروا الله حق قدره ۗ إن الله لقوي عزيز
verses.transliterated: mā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi inna l-laha laqawiyyun ʿazīzu
verses.english: They do not value GOD as He should be valued. GOD is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.

1981.english: Never did they value God as He should be valued. God is the most powerful, the almighty.

1989.english: They do not value GOD as He should be valued. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: الله يصطفي من الملائكة رسلا ومن الناس ۚ إن الله سميع بصير
verses.transliterated: al-lahu yaṣṭafī mina l-malāikati rusulan wamina l-nāsi inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīru
verses.english: GOD chooses from among the angels messengers, as well as from among the people. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

1981.english: God chooses messengers from among the angels, and from among the people. God is hearer, seer.

1989.english: GOD chooses from among the angels messengers, and from among the people. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.arabicClean: يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ۗ وإلى الله ترجع الأمور
verses.transliterated: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūr
verses.english: He knows their past and their future. To GOD belongs the ultimate control of all matters.

1981.english: He controls their past and their future; God is in full control of all things.

1989.english: He knows their past and their future. To GOD belongs the ultimate control of all matters.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اركعوا واسجدوا واعبدوا ربكم وافعلوا الخير لعلكم تفلحون ۩
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ir'kaʿū wa-us'judū wa-uʿ'budū rabbakum wa-if'ʿalū l-khayra laʿallakum tuf'liḥūn
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall bow, prostrate, worship your Lord, and work righteousness, that you may succeed.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall bow and prostrate; you shall worship your Lord; and you shall work righteousness, that you may succeed.

1989.english: O you who believe, bow, prostrate, worship your Lord, and work righteousness, that you may succeed.

verses.arabic: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وجاهدوا في الله حق جهاده ۚ هو اجتباكم وما جعل عليكم في الدين من حرج ۚ ملة أبيكم إبراهيم ۚ هو سماكم المسلمين من قبل وفي هذا ليكون الرسول شهيدا عليكم وتكونوا شهداء على الناس ۚ فأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة واعتصموا بالله هو مولاكم ۖ فنعم المولى ونعم النصير
verses.transliterated: wajāhidū fī l-lahi ḥaqqa jihādihi huwa ij'tabākum wamā jaʿala ʿalaykum fī l-dīni min ḥarajin millata abīkum ib'rāhīma huwa sammākumu l-mus'limīna min qablu wafī hādhā liyakūna l-rasūlu shahīdan ʿalaykum watakūnū shuhadāa ʿalā l-nāsi fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-iʿ'taṣimū bil-lahi huwa mawlākum faniʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīr
verses.english: You shall strive for the cause of GOD as you should strive for His cause. He has chosen you and has placed no hardship on you in practicing your religion—the religion of your father Abraham. He is the one who named you "Submitters" originally. Thus, the messenger shall serve as a witness among you, and you shall serve as witnesses among the people. Therefore, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and hold fast to GOD; He is your Lord, the best Lord and the best Supporter.
verses.subtitle: Abraham: Original Messenger of Submission
verses.footnote: Although all messengers preached one and the same message, "Worship God alone," Abraham was the first messenger to coin the terms "Submission" (Islam) and "Submitter" (Muslim) (2:128). What did Abraham contribute to Submission (Islam)? We learn from 16:123 that all religious duties in Submission were revealed through Abraham (see Appendices 9 & 26).

1981.english: And strive in the cause of God, as you should strive for Him. He is the one who selected you, and imposed no hardship on you in observing the religion. This is the religion of your father Abraham; he is the one who named you "Muslims." Thus, the messenger will be a witness among you, and you will be witnesses among the people. So observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, and hold fast to God; He is your Lord, the best Lord, and the best supporter.
1981.subtitle: Islam: The Religion of Abraham

1989.english: And strive for the cause of GOD as you should strive for His cause. He has chosen you and placed no hardship on you in practicing your religion—the religion of your father Abraham. He is the one who named you “Muslims” (Submitters), originally. Thus, the messenger shall serve as a witness among you, and you shall serve as witnesses among the people. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and hold fast to GOD; He is your Lord, the best Lord and the best Supporter.
1989.subtitle: Abraham: Original Messenger of Islam
1989.footnote: Although all messengers preached one and the same message: “Worship God alone,” Abraham was the Grst messenger to coin the terms “Islam” and “Muslim’ (2:128). What did Abraham contribute to Islam? We learn from 16:123 that all religious duties in Islam were revealed through Abraham (see Appendices 9 & 26).

verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قد أفلح المؤمنون
verses.transliterated: qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūn
verses.english: Successful indeed are the believers;

1981.english: Successful indeed are the believers;

1989.english: Successful indeed are the believers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين هم في صلاتهم خاشعون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūn
verses.english: who are reverent during their Contact Prayers (Salat).

1981.english: who stand reverent in their **salat** prayer;

1989.english: Who are reverent during their contact prayers (Salat).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم عن اللغو معرضون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: And they avoid vain talk.

1981.english: and avoid vain talk;

1989.english: And they avoid vain talk.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم للزكاة فاعلون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūn
verses.english: And they give their obligatory charity (Zakat).

1981.english: and carry out the **zakat** charity;

1989.english: And they give their obligatory charity (Zakat).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم لفروجهم حافظون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn
verses.english: And they maintain their chastity.

1981.english: and guard their chastity;

1989.english: And they maintain their chastity.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا على أزواجهم أو ما ملكت أيمانهم فإنهم غير ملومين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīn
verses.english: Only with their spouses, or those who are rightfully theirs, do they have sexual relations; they are not to be blamed.

1981.english: only with their spouses, or those who rightfully belong to them, do they have sexual relations, without blame.

1989.english: Only with their spouses, or those who are rightfully theirs (as in common-law marriages), do they have sexual relations; they are not blamed.

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن ابتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم العادون
verses.transliterated: famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūn
verses.english: Those who transgress these limits are the transgressors.

1981.english: Those who transgress beyond this limit are sinners.

1989.english: Those who transgress these limits are the sinful ones.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم لأماناتهم وعهدهم راعون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūn
verses.english: When it comes to deposits entrusted to them, as well as any agreements they make, they are trustworthy.

1981.english: And they are trustworthy when it comes to deposits entrusted to them, or the promises they make.

1989.english: When it comes to deposits entrusted to them, they are trustworthy. And they honor their agreements.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم على صلواتهم يحافظون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūn
verses.english: And they observe their Contact Prayers (Salat) regularly.

1981.english: And they consistently observe their **salat** prayers.

1989.english: And they observe their contact prayers (Salat) regularly.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك هم الوارثون
verses.transliterated: ulāika humu l-wārithūn
verses.english: Such are the inheritors.

1981.english: These are the inheritors;

1989.english: Such are the inheritors.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يرثون الفردوس هم فيها خالدون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūn
verses.english: They will inherit Paradise, wherein they abide forever.

1981.english: who inherit paradise; they abide therein forever.

1989.english: They will inherit Paradise, wherein they abide forever.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد خلقنا الإنسان من سلالة من طين
verses.transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīni
verses.english: We created the human being from a certain kind of mud.
verses.subtitle: Accurate Embryology

1981.english: We created the human from a certain kind of clay.
1981.subtitle: Evolution of the Human Being

1989.english: We created the human being from a special kind of mud.
1989.subtitle: Accurate Embryology

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ثم جعلناه نطفة في قرار مكين
verses.transliterated: thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārin makīni
verses.english: Subsequently, we reproduced him from a tiny drop, that is placed into a well protected repository.

1981.english: Then we made him a drop into a protected repository.

1989.english: Subsequently, we reproduced him from a tiny drop, that is placed into a well protected repository.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم خلقنا النطفة علقة فخلقنا العلقة مضغة فخلقنا المضغة عظاما فكسونا العظام لحما ثم أنشأناه خلقا آخر ۚ فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين
verses.transliterated: thumma khalaqnā l-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīn
verses.english: Then we developed the drop into a hanging (embryo), then developed the hanging (embryo) into a bite-size (fetus), then created the bite-size (fetus) into bones, then covered the bones with flesh. We thus produce a new creature. Most blessed is GOD, the best Creator.

1981.english: Then we created the drop into a clot; then we created the clot into a cartilage; then we created the cartilage into bones; then we covered the bones with flesh; then we turned him into a new creation. Most exalted is God, the best creator.

1989.english: Then we developed the drop into a hanging (embryo), then developed the hanging (embryo) into a bite-size (fetus), then created the bite-size (fetus) into bones, then covered the bones with flesh. then produced a new creature. Most blessed is GOD, the best Creator.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم إنكم بعد ذلك لميتون
verses.transliterated: thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūn
verses.english: Then, later on, you die.

1981.english: Then you will die;

1989.english: Then, later on, you die.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم إنكم يوم القيامة تبعثون
verses.transliterated: thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūn
verses.english: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be resurrected.

1981.english: Then on the day of resurrection, you will be raised.

1989.english: On the Day of Resurrection, you will be resurrected.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد خلقنا فوقكم سبع طرائق وما كنا عن الخلق غافلين
verses.transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīn
verses.english: We created above you seven universes in layers, and we are never unaware of a single creature in them.
verses.subtitle: The Seven Universes

1981.english: We created above you seven layers; we are never unaware of anything we create.
1981.subtitle: Creation of the Heavens and the Earth

1989.english: We created above you seven universes in layers, and we are never unaware of a single creature therein.
1989.subtitle: The Seven Universes

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنزلنا من السماء ماء بقدر فأسكناه في الأرض ۖ وإنا على ذهاب به لقادرون
verses.transliterated: wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūn
verses.english: We send down from the sky water, in exact measure, then we store it in the ground. Certainly, we can let it escape.
verses.subtitle: Innumerable Blessings From God

1981.english: We send down water from the sky, in exact measure, and store it underground. If we will, we can surely take it away.

1989.english: And we sent water from the sky, in exact measure, and stored it in the ground. Certainly, we could have let it escape.
1989.subtitle: Innumerable Blessings From God

verses.arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأنشأنا لكم به جنات من نخيل وأعناب لكم فيها فواكه كثيرة ومنها تأكلون
verses.transliterated: fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūn
verses.english: With it, we produce for you orchards of date palms, grapes, all kinds of fruits, and various foods.

1981.english: We establish therewith orchards of date palms, grapes and many fruits, from which you eat.

1989.english: With it, we produced for you orchards of date palms, grapes, all kinds of fruits, and various foods.

verses.arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وشجرة تخرج من طور سيناء تنبت بالدهن وصبغ للآكلين
verses.transliterated: washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghin lil'ākilīn
verses.english: Also, a tree native to Sinai produces oil, as well as relish for the eaters.

1981.english: And desert trees, native to Sinai, which produce oil as well as relish for the eaters.

1989.english: A tree that grows near Mount Sinai produces oil and relish for the eaters.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن لكم في الأنعام لعبرة ۖ نسقيكم مما في بطونها ولكم فيها منافع كثيرة ومنها تأكلون
verses.transliterated: wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūn
verses.english: And the livestock should provide you with a lesson. We let you drink (milk) from their bellies, you derive other benefits from them, and some of them you use for food.

1981.english: And the livestock represent another illustration for you; we provide you with a drink from their bellies, and you enjoy many benefits therefrom, including food.

1989.english: And the livestock should provide you with a lesson. We let you drink (milk) from their bellies, you derive many benefits from them, and you eat some of them.

verses.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وعليها وعلى الفلك تحملون
verses.transliterated: waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūn
verses.english: On them, and on the ships, you ride.

1981.english: And on them, and on the ships, you are carried.

1989.english: On them, and on the ships, you ride

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه فقال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ أفلا تتقون
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
verses.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "O my people, worship GOD. You have no other god beside Him. Would you not be righteous?"
verses.subtitle: Noah

1981.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "O my people, you shall worship God; you have no other god besides Him. Would you not be righteous?"
1981.subtitle: Noah

1989.english: We sent Noah to his people, saying, “O my people, worship GOD. You have no other god besides Him Would you not be righteous?”
1989.subtitle: Noah

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فقال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه ما هذا إلا بشر مثلكم يريد أن يتفضل عليكم ولو شاء الله لأنزل ملائكة ما سمعنا بهذا في آبائنا الأولين
verses.transliterated: faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yurīdu an yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatan mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīn
verses.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "This is no more than a human like you, who wants to gain prominence among you. Had GOD willed, He could have sent down angels. We never heard of anything like this from our ancestors.

1981.english: The elders who disbelieved among his people said, "This is no more than a human being like you, who wants to gain honor among you. Had God willed, He could have sent down angels. We never heard of this before.

1989.english: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, “This is no more than a human like you, who wants to gain a higher rank above you. Had GOD willed, He could have sent angels. We never heard of anything like this from our ancestors.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن هو إلا رجل به جنة فتربصوا به حتى حين
verses.transliterated: in huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīni
verses.english: "He is simply a man gone crazy. Just ignore him for awhile."

1981.english: "He is simply a crazy man, so just ignore him for awhile."

1989.english: “He is simply a man gone crazy. Just ignore him for awhile.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب انصرني بما كذبون
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, give me victory, for they have disbelieved me.”

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأوحينا إليه أن اصنع الفلك بأعيننا ووحينا فإذا جاء أمرنا وفار التنور ۙ فاسلك فيها من كل زوجين اثنين وأهلك إلا من سبق عليه القول منهم ۖ ولا تخاطبني في الذين ظلموا ۖ إنهم مغرقون
verses.transliterated: fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūn
verses.english: We then inspired him: "Make the watercraft under our watchful eyes, and in accordance with our inspiration. When our command comes, and the atmosphere boils up, put on it a pair of every kind (of your domesticated animals), and your family, except those condemned to be doomed. Do not speak to Me on behalf of those who transgressed; they will be drowned.
verses.footnote: The story tellers have created a mockery of Noah's history. Noah's ark was a flat watercraft made of logs, tied together with primitive ropes (54:13), the flood was local, around the Dead Sea area, and the animals were Noah's domesticated animals.

1981.english: We then inspired him: "Build the ark under our eyes, and with our inspiration. When our judgment comes, and the pot boils over, place a pair of each kind therein, and your family, except those who are doomed. Do not intercede on behalf of the wicked; they will be drowned.

1989.english: We then inspired him: “Make the watercraft* under our watchful eyes, and by our inspiration. When our command comes, and the pot boils over, put on it a pair of every kind (of your domesticated animals), and your family, except those condemned to be doomed. And do not speak to Me on behalf of those who transgressed; they will be drowned.
1989.footnote: The story tellers have created a mockery of Noah’s history. Noah’s ark was a flat watercraft made of logs, tied together with primitive ropes (54:13), the flood was local, around the Dead Sea area, and the animals were Noah’s domesticated animals.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا استويت أنت ومن معك على الفلك فقل الحمد لله الذي نجانا من القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā is'tawayta anta waman maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: "Once you are settled, together with those who are with you, on the watercraft, you shall say, 'Praise GOD for saving us from the evil people.'

1981.english: "Once you board the ark, together with those who followed you, then say, 'Praise God; He has delivered us from the wicked people.'

1989.english: “Once you are settled, together with those who are with you, on the watercraft, you shall say, ‘Praise GOD for saving us from the evil people.’

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقل رب أنزلني منزلا مباركا وأنت خير المنزلين
verses.transliterated: waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalan mubārakan wa-anta khayru l-munzilīn
verses.english: "And say, 'My Lord, let me disembark onto a blessed location; You are the best deliverer.' "

1981.english: "And say, 'My Lord, let us disembark into a blessed place; You are the best deliverer.' "
