1989.english: “And say, ‘My Lord, let me disembark onto a blessed location; You are the best deliverer.’ ”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لآيات وإن كنا لمبتلين
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika laāyātin wa-in kunnā lamub'talīn
verses.english: These should provide sufficient proofs for you. We will certainly put you to the test.

1981.english: These are valuable lessons. We will surely put you to the test.

1989.english: These should provide sufficient signs for you, that we must put you to the test.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرنا آخرين
verses.transliterated: thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīn
verses.english: Subsequently, we established another generation after them.

1981.english: Then we established after them another generation.
1981.subtitle: Similar Conditions Face Every Messenger

1989.english: We established another generation after them.

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأرسلنا فيهم رسولا منهم أن اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ أفلا تتقون
verses.transliterated: fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
verses.english: We sent to them a messenger from among them, saying, "You shall worship GOD. You have no other god beside Him. Would you not be righteous?"

1981.english: And we sent to them a messenger from among them, saying that: "You shall worship God; you have no other god besides Him. Would you not be righteous?"

1989.english: And we sent to them a messenger from among them: “You shall worship GOD. You have no other god besides Him. Would you not be righteous?”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الملأ من قومه الذين كفروا وكذبوا بلقاء الآخرة وأترفناهم في الحياة الدنيا ما هذا إلا بشر مثلكم يأكل مما تأكلون منه ويشرب مما تشربون
verses.transliterated: waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūn
verses.english: The leaders among his people who disbelieved and rejected the idea of the Hereafter—although we provided for them generously in this life—said, "This is no more than a human being like you. He eats from what you eat, and drinks as you drink.

1981.english: The elders among his people, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the hereafter, though we endowed them generously in this life, said, "This is no more than a human being like you, who eats as you eat and drinks as you drink.

1989.english: The leaders among his people who disbelieved and rejected the idea of the Hereafter—although we provided for them generously in this life—said, “This is no more than a human being like you. He eats from what you eat, and drinks as you drink.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أطعتم بشرا مثلكم إنكم إذا لخاسرون
verses.transliterated: wala-in aṭaʿtum basharan mith'lakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūn
verses.english: "If you obey a human being like you, then you are really losers.

1981.english: "Indeed, if you obey a human being like you, you would be losers.

1989.english: “If you obey a human being like you, you are really losers.

verses.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أيعدكم أنكم إذا متم وكنتم ترابا وعظاما أنكم مخرجون
verses.transliterated: ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūn
verses.english: "Does he promise you that, after you die and turn into dust and bones, you will come out again?

1981.english: "Is he promising you that, after you die and turn into dust and bones, you will be resurrected?

1989.english: “Does he promise you that after you die and turn into dust and bones you will come back?

verses.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هيهات هيهات لما توعدون
verses.transliterated: hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūn
verses.english: "Impossible, impossible indeed is what is promised to you.

1981.english: "Impossible, impossible, is such a promise.

1989.english: “Impossible, impossible indeed is what is promised to you.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
verses.transliterated: in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīn
verses.english: "We only live this life—we live and die—and we will never be resurrected.

1981.english: "We only live this life; we die and live, no resurrection for us.

1989.english: “We only live this life—we live and die—and we will never be resurrected

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هو إلا رجل افترى على الله كذبا وما نحن له بمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: in huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīn
verses.english: "He is just a man who fabricated lies and attributed them to GOD. We will never believe him."

1981.english: "He is simply a man who invented a lie about God; we will never believe him."

1989.english: “He is just a man who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD. We will never believe him.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب انصرني بما كذبون
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, support me, for they have disbelieved me."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال عما قليل ليصبحن نادمين
verses.transliterated: qāla ʿammā qalīlin layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīn
verses.english: He said, "Soon they will be sorry."

1981.english: (God) said, "Soon, they will be sorry."

1989.english: He said, “Soon they will be sorry.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءً فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذتهم الصيحة بالحق فجعلناهم غثاء ۚ فبعدا للقوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: The retribution struck them, equitably, and thus, we turned them into ruins. The wicked people perished.

1981.english: The disaster struck them, justly, and turned them into ruins. Doomed are the wicked people.

1989.english: The disaster struck them, equitably, and thus, we turned them into ruins. The wicked people perished.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرونا آخرين
verses.transliterated: thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīn
verses.english: Subsequently, we established other generations after them.

1981.english: Then we established after them other generations.

1989.english: Then we established other generations after them.

verses.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما تسبق من أمة أجلها وما يستأخرون
verses.transliterated: mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūn
verses.english: No community can advance its predetermined fate, nor delay it.

1981.english: No community could advance its end, nor could it delay it.

1989.english: No community can advance its predetermined fate, nor delay it.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أرسلنا رسلنا تترى ۖ كل ما جاء أمة رسولها كذبوه ۚ فأتبعنا بعضهم بعضا وجعلناهم أحاديث ۚ فبعدا لقوم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatan rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Then we sent our messengers in succession. Every time a messenger went to his community, they disbelieved him. Consequently, we annihilated them, one after the other, and made them history. The people who disbelieved have perished.

1981.english: Then we sent our messengers in succession. Every time a community received their messenger, they rejected him. Consequently, we annihilated them one after the other, and we turned them into history. Doomed are the people who do not believe.

1989.english: Then we sent our messengers in succession. Every time a messenger went to his community, they disbelieved him. Consequently, we annihilated them, one after the other, and made them history. The people who disbelieved have perished.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أرسلنا موسى وأخاه هارون بآياتنا وسلطان مبين
verses.transliterated: thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīni
verses.english: Then we sent Moses and his brother Aaron with our revelations and a profound proof.
verses.subtitle: Moses and Aaron

1981.english: Then we sent Moses and his brother Aaron with our miracles and profound authority;

1989.english: Then we sent Moses and his brother Aaron with our revelations and a profound proof—
1989.subtitle: Moses and Aaron

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلى فرعون وملئه فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما عالين
verses.transliterated: ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīn
verses.english: To Pharaoh and his elders, but they turned arrogant. They were oppressive people.

1981.english: to Pharaoh and his elders, but they turned arrogant, and were tyrant people.

1989.english: to Pharaoh and his elders, but they turned arrogant. They were oppressive people.

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فقالوا أنؤمن لبشرين مثلنا وقومهما لنا عابدون
verses.transliterated: faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūn
verses.english: They said, "Shall we believe for two men whose people are our slaves?"

1981.english: They said, "Shall we believe in two humans like us, while their people are our slaves?"

1989.english: They said, “Shall we believe for two men whose people are our slaves?”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فكذبوهما فكانوا من المهلكين
verses.transliterated: fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīn
verses.english: They rejected the two, and consequently, they were annihilated.

1981.english: They rejected them, and consequently they were doomed.

1989.english: They rejected the two, and consequently, they were annihilated.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب لعلهم يهتدون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūn
verses.english: We gave Moses the scripture, that they may be guided.

1981.english: We have given the scripture to Moses, that they may be guided.

1989.english: We gave Moses the scripture, that they may be guided.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا ابن مريم وأمه آية وآويناهما إلى ربوة ذات قرار ومعين
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyatan waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīni
verses.english: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and we gave them refuge on a mesa with food and drink.

1981.english: And we set up the son of Mary and his mother as a miracle, and we gave them refuge on a mesa with shelter and water.

1989.english: And we made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and we gave them refuge on a mesa with food and drink.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الرسل كلوا من الطيبات واعملوا صالحا ۖ إني بما تعملون عليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmu
verses.english: O you messengers, eat from the good provisions, and work righteousness. I am fully aware of everything you do.
verses.subtitle: One God/One Religion

1981.english: O you messengers, eat from the good provisions, and work righteousness; I am fully aware of everything you do.

1989.english: O you messengers, eat from the good provisions, and work righteousness. I am fully aware of everything you do
1989.subtitle: One God/One Religion

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وإن هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة وأنا ربكم فاتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūn
verses.english: Such is your congregation—one congregation—and I am your Lord; you shall reverence Me.

1981.english: The religion you preach is one religion and I am your Lord, so observe Me.
1981.subtitle: All Messengers Preached One Religion

1989.english: Such is your congregation—one congregation—and I am your Lord; you shall observe Me.

verses.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فتقطعوا أمرهم بينهم زبرا ۖ كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
verses.transliterated: fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūn
verses.english: But they tore themselves into disputing factions; each party happy with what they have.

1981.english: But the people divided themselves into sects; each happy with what they have.

1989.english: But they tore themselves into disputing factions; each party happy with what they have.

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فذرهم في غمرتهم حتى حين
verses.transliterated: fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīni
verses.english: Therefore, just leave them in their confusion, for awhile.

1981.english: Thus, leave them in their blunder for awhile.

1989.english: Therefore, just leave them alone in their confusion, for awhile.

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أيحسبون أنما نمدهم به من مال وبنين
verses.transliterated: ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabanīn
verses.english: Do they think that, since we provided them with money and children,

1981.english: Do they think that, just because we do provide them with money and children,

1989.english: Do they think that since we provided them with money and children,—

verses.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: نسارع لهم في الخيرات ۚ بل لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: we must be showering them with blessings? Indeed, they have no idea.

1981.english: We are rewarding them for their actions? Nay, they do not perceive.

1989.english: we must be showering them with blessings? Indeed, they do not perceive.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين هم من خشية ربهم مشفقون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūn
verses.english: Surely, those who are reverently conscious of their Lord,

1981.english: As for those who are concerned about their relationship with their Lord,

1989.english: Surely, those who are reverently conscious of their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم بآيات ربهم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūn
verses.english: And who believe in the revelations of their Lord,

1981.english: And in the revelations of their Lord they believe;

1989.english: And who believe in the revelations of their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم بربهم لا يشركون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūn
verses.english: And who never set up any idols beside their Lord,

1981.english: And never set up idols besides their Lord;

1989.english: And who never set up any idols besides their Lord,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يؤتون ما آتوا وقلوبهم وجلة أنهم إلى ربهم راجعون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūn
verses.english: As they give their charities, their hearts are fully reverent. For they recognize that they will be summoned before their Lord,

1981.english: And give whatever charity they give, while their hearts are conscious that they ultimately return to their Lord;

1989.english: And who give their charities while their minds know full well that they will be summoned before their Lord,

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك يسارعون في الخيرات وهم لها سابقون
verses.transliterated: ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūn
verses.english: They are eager to do righteous works; they compete in doing them.

1981.english: It is these who readily work righteousness, and are far ahead of all others therein.

1989.english: These are the ones who hasten to work righteousness; they are always far ahead.

verses.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها ۖ ولدينا كتاب ينطق بالحق ۚ وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: We never burden any soul beyond its means, and we keep a record that utters the truth. No one will suffer injustice.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers Unappreciative

1981.english: We never burden any soul beyond its means, and we have a record that utters the truth; no one will be wronged.

1989.english: We never burden any soul beyond its means, and we keep a record that presents the truth. No one will suffer injustice.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers Unappreciative

verses.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل قلوبهم في غمرة من هذا ولهم أعمال من دون ذلك هم لها عاملون
verses.transliterated: bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum aʿmālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūn
verses.english: Because their minds are oblivious to this, they commit works that do not conform with this; their works are evil.

1981.english: Regrettably, the hearts of the people are too busy to study this (Quran), and they remain preoccupied with lesser works.
1981.subtitle: The Unfortunate Disregard These Revelations

1989.english: Because their minds are oblivious to this, they commit works that do not conform with this. Such are their works.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: حتى إذا أخذنا مترفيهم بالعذاب إذا هم يجأرون
verses.transliterated: ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūn
verses.english: Then, when we requite their leaders with retribution, they complain.

1981.english: Then, when we strike their leaders with the retribution, they scream.

1989.english: Then, when we afflict their leaders with retribution, they complain.

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا تجأروا اليوم ۖ إنكم منا لا تنصرون
verses.transliterated: lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūn
verses.english: Do not complain now; you have given up all help from us.

1981.english: Do not scream now; you cannot be helped against us.

1989.english: Do not complain; today you cannot receive any help.

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قد كانت آياتي تتلى عليكم فكنتم على أعقابكم تنكصون
verses.transliterated: qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūn
verses.english: My proofs have been presented to you, but you turned back on your heels.

1981.english: My revelations have been recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels.

1989.english: My revelations were recited to you, but you turned back on your heels.

verses.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: مستكبرين به سامرا تهجرون
verses.transliterated: mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūn
verses.english: You were too arrogant to accept them, and you defiantly disregarded them.

1981.english: You were too arrogant, so you disregarded them, with contempt.

1989.english: You were too arrogant to accept them; you disregarded them.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أفلم يدبروا القول أم جاءهم ما لم يأت آباءهم الأولين
verses.transliterated: afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīn
verses.english: Why do they not reflect upon this scripture? Do they not realize that they have received something never attained by their ancestors?

1981.english: Why do they not study this message? Is this different from the previous messages?

1989.english: Have they not reflected on this scripture? Have they attained something never attained by their ancestors?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم لم يعرفوا رسولهم فهم له منكرون
verses.transliterated: am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūn
verses.english: Have they failed to recognize their messenger? Is this why they are disregarding him?

1981.english: Or, did they not recognize their messenger? Is this why they rejected him?

1989.english: Have they failed to recognize their messenger? Is this why they are disregarding him?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون به جنة ۚ بل جاءهم بالحق وأكثرهم للحق كارهون
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūn
verses.english: Have they decided that he is crazy? Indeed, he has brought the truth to them, but most of them hate the truth.

1981.english: Or, do they say that he is crazy? Indeed, he has come to them with the truth, and most of them hate the truth.

1989.english: Have they decided that he is crazy? Indeed, he has brought the truth to them, but most of them hate the truth.

verses.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو اتبع الحق أهواءهم لفسدت السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن ۚ بل أتيناهم بذكرهم فهم عن ذكرهم معرضون
verses.transliterated: walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: Indeed, if the truth conformed to their wishes, there would be chaos in the heavens and the earth; everything in them would be corrupted. We have given them their proof, but they are disregarding their proof.

1981.english: If the truth is to conform to their opinions, corruption would have pervaded the heavens and the earth, and everyone in them. Indeed, we have given them their message, but they are disregarding their message.

1989.english: Indeed, if the truth were to follow their opinions, there would be chaos in the heavens and the earth, and everything in them. We have given them their reminder, but they are disregarding their reminder.

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أم تسألهم خرجا فخراج ربك خير ۖ وهو خير الرازقين
verses.transliterated: am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīn
verses.english: Are you asking them for a wage? Your Lord's wage is far better. He is the best Provider.

1981.english: Are you asking them for any recompense? The recompense from your Lord is far better, and He is the best provider.

1989.english: Are you asking them for a wage? Your Lord’s wage is far better. He is the best Provider.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإنك لتدعوهم إلى صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: Most assuredly, you are inviting them to a straight path.

1981.english: And certainly, you are inviting them to the right path.

1989.english: Most assuredly, you are inviting them to a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة عن الصراط لناكبون
verses.transliterated: wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani l-ṣirāṭi lanākibūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will surely deviate from the right path.

1981.english: And those who do not believe in the hereafter are deviating from the path.

1989.english: It is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter that deviate from the path.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو رحمناهم وكشفنا ما بهم من ضر للجوا في طغيانهم يعمهون
verses.transliterated: walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūn
verses.english: Even when we showered them with mercy, and relieved their problems, they plunged deeper into transgression, and continued to blunder.

1981.english: Had we showered them with mercy, and relieved their afflictions, they would have plunged deeper into transgression.

1989.english: Had we showered them with mercy, and relieved their adversity, they would have plunged deeper into their transgressions.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أخذناهم بالعذاب فما استكانوا لربهم وما يتضرعون
verses.transliterated: walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūn
verses.english: Even when we afflicted them with retribution, they never turned to their Lord imploring.

1981.english: We afflicted them with the retribution, but they did not turn to their Lord, nor did they implore.

1989.english: Even when we afflicted them with retribution, they never turned to their Lord; they never implored.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: حتى إذا فتحنا عليهم بابا ذا عذاب شديد إذا هم فيه مبلسون
verses.transliterated: ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūn
verses.english: Subsequently, when we requited them with the severe retribution they had incurred, they were shocked.

1981.english: Then, when we open the gates of severe retribution against them, they become stunned.

1989.english: When we showered them with well deserved retribution, they were shocked.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي أنشأ لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة ۚ قليلا ما تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
verses.english: He is the One who granted you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative.

1981.english: God is the one who gave you the hearing, the eyes, and the brains; rarely do you appreciate.
1981.subtitle: Belief in God Nullified by Idol Worship
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: He is the One who granted you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي ذرأكم في الأرض وإليه تحشرون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: He is the One who established you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned.

1981.english: And He is the one who established you on earth, and before Him you will be gathered.
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: He is the One who established you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي يحيي ويميت وله اختلاف الليل والنهار ۚ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: He is the One who controls life and death, and He is the One who alternates the night and day. Do you not understand?

1981.english: And He is the one who grants life and death, and alternates the night and day; do you not understand?
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: He is the One who controls life and death, and He is the One who alternates the night and day. Do you not understand?

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل قالوا مثل ما قال الأولون
verses.transliterated: bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūn
verses.english: They said what their ancestors said.

1981.english: Yet, they utter what the previous generations have uttered.
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: They said what their ancestors said.

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
verses.transliterated: qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūn
verses.english: They said, "After we die and become dust and bones, we get resurrected?

1981.english: They said, "After we die and turn into dust and bones, do we get resurrected?"
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: They said, “After we die and turn into dust and bones, we get resurrected?

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لقد وعدنا نحن وآباؤنا هذا من قبل إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين
verses.transliterated: laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.english: "Such promises were given to us and to our parents in the past. These are no more than tales from the past."

1981.english: "We have been promised this before, and so were our ancestors. This is no more than tales from the past."
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: “Such promises were given to us and to our parents in the past. These are no more than tales from the past.”

verses.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لمن الأرض ومن فيها إن كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "To whom belongs the earth and everyone on it, if you know?"
verses.subtitle: Most Believers are Destined for Hell
verses.footnote: Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God's qualities, such as the fact that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing such powerless idols as the prophets and saints (6:106).

1981.english: Say, "To whom belongs the earth and everyone therein, if you know?"
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. 1989.english: Say, “To whom belongs the earth and everyone on it, if you know?”

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سيقولون لله ۚ قل أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: They will say, "To GOD." Say, "Why then do you not take heed?"

1981.english: They will say, "To God." Say, "Would you then take heed?"

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: قل من رب السماوات السبع ورب العرش العظيم
verses.transliterated: qul man rabbu l-samāwāti l-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: Say, "Who is the Lord of the seven universes; the Lord of the great dominion?"

1981.english: Say, "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the mighty throne?"

verses.english: They will say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you not turn righteous?"

1981.english: They will say, "God." Say, "Would you then be righteous?"

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

verses.transliterated: qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "In whose hand is all sovereignty over all things, and He is the only one who can provide help, but needs no help, if you know?"

1981.english: Say, "In whose hand is the sovereignty over all things; and is capable of providing help, while none can find help against Him, if you know?"

Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: Say, “Who possesses kingship over all things, and He provides support but needs no support, if you know?”
1989.footnote: Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سيقولون لله ۚ قل فأنى تسحرون
verses.transliterated: sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūn
verses.english: They will say, "GOD." Say, "Where did you go wrong?"

1981.english: They will say, "God." Say, "What then bewitched you?"
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: They will say, “GOD.” Say, “Where did you go wrong?”
1989.footnote: Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God’s qualities, such as the fad that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing prophets and saints (6:106).

verses.arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل أتيناهم بالحق وإنهم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūn
verses.english: We have given them the truth, while they are liars.

1981.english: Indeed, we have given them the truth, while they are liars.
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: We have given them the truth herein, and they are liars.

verses.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما اتخذ الله من ولد وما كان معه من إله ۚ إذا لذهب كل إله بما خلق ولعلا بعضهم على بعض ۚ سبحان الله عما يصفون
verses.transliterated: mā ittakhadha l-lahu min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.english: GOD has never begotten a son. Nor was there ever any other god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have declared independence with his creations, and they would have competed with each other for dominance. GOD be glorified; far above their claims.

1981.english: God has never taken for Himself a son, nor was there ever any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have declared independence for himself and his creations, and they would have fought with each other. God be glorified; over and above their utterances.
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: GOD has never begotten a son. Nor was there ever any other god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have declared independence with his creations, and they would have competed with each other for dominance. GOD be glorified; far above their claims.

verses.arabic: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: عالم الغيب والشهادة فتعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: aleemun alghaybi washahaadati tata'aala 'amma yushrikoon
verses.english: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; be He exalted, far above having a partner.

1981.english: He is the knower of all secrets and declarations; most exalted above their idol worship.
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that worshiping God alone is the prime commandment. Worshiping God does not guarantee salvation. Millions of people worship God, but are destined for hell; in fact, the majority of believers will go to hell as stated in 12:106. The reason is that these millions of believers who worship God, fall into idol worship whereby they idolize Jesus, Muhammad, the saints, their properties, their children, or some other forms of idols. Idol worship is the only unforgivable offense, and the absolute devotion of worship to God ALONE is the minimum requirement for salvation.

1989.english: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; be He exalted, far above having a partner.

verses.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل رب إما تريني ما يوعدون
verses.transliterated: qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord, whether You show me (the retribution) they have incurred,

1981.english: Say, "My Lord, if you show me the judgment promised to them;

1989.english: Say, “My Lord, if You show me (the retribution) they have incurred—

verses.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: رب فلا تجعلني في القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: "My Lord, let me not be one of the transgressing people."

1981.english: "My Lord, then do not include me with the wicked people."

1989.english: “let me not be, my Lord, with the transgressing people.”

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنا على أن نريك ما نعدهم لقادرون
verses.transliterated: wa-innā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūn
verses.english: To show you (the retribution) we have reserved for them is something we can easily do.

1981.english: Indeed, we are able to show you the judgment that is awaiting them.

1989.english: To show you (the retribution) we have reserved for them is something we can easily do.

verses.arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ادفع بالتي هي أحسن السيئة ۚ نحن أعلم بما يصفون
verses.transliterated: id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu l-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūn
verses.english: Therefore, counter their evil works with goodness; we are fully aware of their claims.

1981.english: Meanwhile, repel with compassion and tolerance their evil work. We are fully aware of everything they utter.

1989.english: Therefore, just counter their evil with goodness; we are fully aware of their claims.

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
verses.arabicClean: وقل رب أعوذ بك من همزات الشياطين
verses.transliterated: waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti l-shayāṭīn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils.
verses.subtitle: To Be Protected From Satan

1981.english: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the devils' suggestions.

1989.english: Say, “My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils.
1989.subtitle: To Be Protected From Satan

verses.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون
verses.transliterated: wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūn
verses.english: "And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they come near me."

1981.english: "And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

1989.english: “And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they come near me.”

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
verses.arabicClean: حتى إذا جاء أحدهم الموت قال رب ارجعون
verses.transliterated: ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūn
verses.english: When death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back.
verses.subtitle: The Dead Never Come Back Until the Day of Resurrection

1981.english: Finally, when death comes to the one of them, he says, "My Lord, return me back
1981.subtitle: Only One Chance

1989.english: When death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back.
1989.subtitle: The Dead Never Come Back Until the Day of Resurrection

verses.arabic: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لعلي أعمل صالحا فيما تركت ۚ كلا ۚ إنها كلمة هو قائلها ۖ ومن ورائهم برزخ إلى يوم يبعثون
verses.transliterated: laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamin warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: "I will then work righteousness in everything I left." Not true. This is a false claim that he makes. A barrier will separate his soul from this world until resurrection.

1981.english: "And I will lead a righteous life." Nay, this is just an utterance that he utters. Once death comes, a barrier is placed behind them (between the soul and this world) until the day of resurrection.
1981.footnote: The souls of all the people, including those of Muhammad, Jesus, Mary, and the saints are sent away and a barrier is placed behind them. Thus, they are totally unaware of anything that goes on on earth. See Appendix 14.

1989.english: “I will then work righteousness in everything I left.” Not true. This is a false claim that he makes. A barrier will separate the soul from this world until resurrection.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا نفخ في الصور فلا أنساب بينهم يومئذ ولا يتساءلون
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhin walā yatasāalūn
verses.english: When the horn is blown, no relations among them will exist on that day, nor will they care about one another.

1981.english: Then, when the horn is blown, no relationship among them will exist on that day, nor will they even ask about it.

1989.english: When the horn is blown, no relations among them will exist on that day, nor will they care about one another.

verses.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن ثقلت موازينه فأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: As for those whose weights are heavy, they will be the winners.

1981.english: Those whose weights are heavy will be the winners.

1989.english: As for those whose weights are heavy, they will be the winners.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن خفت موازينه فأولئك الذين خسروا أنفسهم في جهنم خالدون
verses.transliterated: waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūn
verses.english: Those whose weights are light are the ones who lost their souls; they abide in Hell forever.

1981.english: While those whose weights are light are the ones who lost their souls; they abide in Gehenna forever.

1989.english: Those whose weights are light are the ones who lost their souls; they abide in Hell forever.

verses.arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: تلفح وجوههم النار وهم فيها كالحون
verses.transliterated: talfaḥu wujūhahumu l-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūn
verses.english: Fire will overwhelm their faces, and they last miserably therein.

1981.english: The fire will burn their faces; they will be miserable therein.

1989.english: Fire will overwhelm their faces, and they last miserably therein.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تكن آياتي تتلى عليكم فكنتم بها تكذبون
verses.transliterated: alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūn
verses.english: Were not My revelations recited to you, and you kept on rejecting them?

1981.english: Were not My revelations recited to you, and you rejected them?

1989.english: Were not My revelations recited to you, and you kept on rejecting them?

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ربنا غلبت علينا شقوتنا وكنا قوما ضالين
verses.transliterated: qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīn
verses.english: They will say, "Our Lord, our wickedness overwhelmed us, and we were people gone astray.

1981.english: They would say, "Our Lord, we were overcome by our wickedness, and we were totally astray.

1989.english: They will say, “Our Lord, our wickedness overwhelmed us, and we were people gone astray.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا أخرجنا منها فإن عدنا فإنا ظالمون
verses.transliterated: rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūn
verses.english: "Our Lord, take us out of this; if we return (to our old behavior), then we are really wicked."

1981.english: "Our Lord, deliver us out of this; if we return (to evil work), then we are really wicked."

1989.english: “Our Lord, take us out of this; if we return (to our old behavior), then we are really wicked.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.arabicClean: قال اخسئوا فيها ولا تكلمون
verses.transliterated: qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūn
verses.english: He will say, "Abide therein, humiliated, and do not speak to Me.

1981.english: God said,* "Parch therein, and do not speak to Me.
1981.footnote: This frequently used past tense teaches us that the Quran informs us of events that actually took place in the future. What is future to us is past, as far as God is concerned.

1989.english: He will say, “Abide therein, humiliated, and do not speak to Me. They Ridiculed the Believers

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنه كان فريق من عبادي يقولون ربنا آمنا فاغفر لنا وارحمنا وأنت خير الراحمين
verses.transliterated: innahu kāna farīqun min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīn
verses.english: "A group of My servants used to say, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and shower us with mercy. Of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful.'
verses.subtitle: They Ridiculed the Believers

1981.english: "For there was a group of My servants who used to say, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us, and have mercy on us; You are the most merciful.' "

1989.english: “A group of My servants used to say ‘Our T.nrd we. have he.lie.ve.d sn fnraive n and shower us with mercy; You are the best of all the merciful ones.’

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاتخذتموهم سخريا حتى أنسوكم ذكري وكنتم منهم تضحكون
verses.transliterated: fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūn
verses.english: "But you mocked and ridiculed them, to the extent that you forgot Me. You used to laugh at them.

1981.english: "Then you ridiculed them and mocked them, until they caused you to disregard My message. You used to laugh at them.

1989.english: “But you mocked and ridiculed them, until they caused you to forget to commemorate Me. You used to laugh at them.

verses.arabic: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إني جزيتهم اليوم بما صبروا أنهم هم الفائزون
verses.transliterated: innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūn
verses.english: "I have rewarded them today, in return for their steadfastness, by making them the winners."

1981.english: "I have rewarded them today for their steadfastness, by making them the winners."

1989.english: “I have rewarded them today, in return for their steadfastness, by making them the winners.”

verses.arabic: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال كم لبثتم في الأرض عدد سنين
verses.transliterated: qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīn
verses.english: He said, "How long have you lasted on earth? How many years?"

1981.english: He said, "How many years have you lasted on earth?"

1989.english: He said, “How long did you last on earth? How many years?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا لبثنا يوما أو بعض يوم فاسأل العادين
verses.transliterated: qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīn
verses.english: They said, "We lasted a day or part of a day. Ask those who counted."

1981.english: They said, "We lasted one day or part of the day, so ask those who count."

1989.english: They said, “We lasted a day or part of a day. Ask those who count.”

verses.arabic: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إن لبثتم إلا قليلا ۖ لو أنكم كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qāla in labith'tum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: He said, "In fact, you stayed but a brief interim, if you only knew.

1981.english: He said, "Indeed, you lasted only a short while, if you only knew."

1989.english: He said, “In fact, you stayed but a short while, if you only knew.

verses.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفحسبتم أنما خلقناكم عبثا وأنكم إلينا لا ترجعون
verses.transliterated: afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: "Did you think that we created you in vain; that you were not to be returned to us?"

1981.english: Did you think that we created you in vain, and that you will not be returned to us?

1989.english: “Did you think that we created you in vain; that you were not to be returned to us?”

verses.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فتعالى الله الملك الحق ۖ لا إله إلا هو رب العرش الكريم
verses.transliterated: fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm
verses.english: Most exalted is GOD, the true Sovereign. There is no other god beside Him; the Most Honorable Lord, possessor of all authority.

1981.english: Most exalted is God, the true king. There is no god except He, the Lord of the honorable throne.

1989.english: Most exalted is GOD, the true King. There is no other god besides Him; the Most Honorable Lord, possessor of all authority.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يدع مع الله إلها آخر لا برهان له به فإنما حسابه عند ربه ۚ إنه لا يفلح الكافرون
verses.transliterated: waman yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūn
verses.english: Anyone who idolizes beside GOD any other god, and without any kind of proof, his reckoning rests with his Lord. The disbelievers never succeed.

1981.english: Anyone who implores any other idol besides God, possesses no proof thereof. His reckoning is at his Lord. Surely, the disbelievers never succeed.

1989.english: Anyone who idolizes besides GOD any other god, and without any kind of proof, his reckoning rests with his Lord. The disbelievers never succeed.

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقل رب اغفر وارحم وأنت خير الراحمين
verses.transliterated: waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord, shower us with forgiveness and mercy. Of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."

1981.english: And say, "My Lord, forgive and bestow Your mercy; You are the best bestower of mercy."

1989.english: Say, “My Lord, shower us with forgiveness and mercy; You are the best of all the merciful ones.”

verses.arabic: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سورة أنزلناها وفرضناها وأنزلنا فيها آيات بينات لعلكم تذكرون
verses.transliterated: sūratun anzalnāhā wafaraḍnāhā wa-anzalnā fīhā āyātin bayyinātin laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.english: A sura that we have sent down, and we have decreed as law. We have revealed in it clear revelations, that you may take heed.

1981.english: This is a sura that we send down, and decree as law. We send down in it verses that are perfectly clear, that you may take heed.
1981.footnote: These verses expose the most vivid example of Satan's work against the Quran. Through the invention of "**hadith**" and "**sunna**" Satan succeeded in abrogating God's law, and enforcing human prejudices and strong traditions. Although verse 24:1 states that these verses are perfectly clear, the advocates of "**hadith**" and/or "**sunna**" refuse to believe it, and claim that the prophet clarified and instituted death for the married men and women (especially women) who commit adultery. This satanic law is the predominant law in most so-called Muslim countries, in total defiance of God and His prophet.

1989.english: A sura that we reveal, and decree as a law. We reveal in it clear revelations, that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الزانية والزاني فاجلدوا كل واحد منهما مائة جلدة ۖ ولا تأخذكم بهما رأفة في دين الله إن كنتم تؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر ۖ وليشهد عذابهما طائفة من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: al-zāniyatu wal-zānī fa-ij'lidū kulla wāḥidin min'humā mi-ata jaldatin walā takhudh'kum bihimā rafatun fī dīni l-lahi in kuntum tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri walyashhad ʿadhābahumā ṭāifatun mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: The adulteress and the adulterer you shall whip each of them a hundred lashes. Do not be swayed by pity from carrying out GOD's law, if you truly believe in GOD and the Last Day. And let a group of believers witness their penalty.
verses.subtitle: Adultery
verses.footnote: Social pressure, i.e., public witnessing of the penalty, is the basic punishment (see also 5:38). The lashes shall be symbolic, not severe.

1981.english: The adulteress and the adulterer, you shall whip each of them one hundred lashes, and do not be swayed by pity from carrying out God's law, if you truly believe in God and the last day. And let a group of believers witness their punishment.
1981.footnote: These verses expose the most vivid example of Satan's work against the Quran. Through the invention of "**hadith**" and "**sunna**" Satan succeeded in abrogating God's law, and enforcing human prejudices and strong traditions. Although verse 24:1 states that these verses are perfectly clear, the advocates of "**hadith**" and/or "**sunna**" refuse to believe it, and claim that the prophet clarified and instituted death for the married men and women (especially women) who commit adultery. This satanic law is the predominant law in most so-called Muslim countries, in total defiance of God and His prophet.

1989.english: The adulteress and the adulterer you shall whip each of them a hundred lashes. Do not be swayed by kindness from carrying out GOD’s law, if you truly believe in GOD and the Last Day. And let a group of believers witness their punishment.*
1989.subtitle: Adultery
1989.footnote: Social pressure, i.e., public witnessing of the punishment, is the basic punishment (see also 5:38). The lashes shall be symbolic, not severe.

verses.arabic: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الزاني لا ينكح إلا زانية أو مشركة والزانية لا ينكحها إلا زان أو مشرك ۚ وحرم ذلك على المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: al-zānī lā yankiḥu illā zāniyatan aw mush'rikatan wal-zāniyatu lā yankiḥuhā illā zānin aw mush'rikun waḥurrima dhālika ʿalā l-mu'minīn
verses.english: The adulterer will end up marrying an adulteress or an idol worshiper, and the adulteress will end up marrying an adulterer or an idol worshiper. This is prohibited for the believers.

1981.english: The adulterer marries only an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress marries only an adulterer or an idolater. This is forbidden for the believers.

1989.english: The adulterer will end up marrying an adulteress or an idol worshiper, and the adulteress will end up marrying an adulterer or an idol worshiper. This is prohibited for the believers.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًا وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يرمون المحصنات ثم لم يأتوا بأربعة شهداء فاجلدوهم ثمانين جلدة ولا تقبلوا لهم شهادة أبدا ۚ وأولئك هم الفاسقون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yarmūna l-muḥ'ṣanāti thumma lam yatū bi-arbaʿati shuhadāa fa-ij'lidūhum thamānīna jaldatan walā taqbalū lahum shahādatan abadan wa-ulāika humu l-fāsiqūn
verses.english: Those who accuse married women of adultery, then fail to produce four witnesses, you shall whip them eighty lashes, and do not accept any testimony from them; they are wicked.

1981.english: And those who accuse married women of adultery, then produce not four witnesses, you shall whip them eighty lashes, and never again accept any testimony from them; they are wicked.

1989.english: Those who accuse married women of adultery, then fail to produce four witnesses, you shall whip them eighty lashes, and do not accept any testimony from them. These are the wicked ones.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا فإن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: If they repent afterwards and reform, then GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.

1981.english: Only if they repent thereafter and reform, then God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: However, if they repent afterwards, and reform, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يرمون أزواجهم ولم يكن لهم شهداء إلا أنفسهم فشهادة أحدهم أربع شهادات بالله ۙ إنه لمن الصادقين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yarmūna azwājahum walam yakun lahum shuhadāu illā anfusuhum fashahādatu aḥadihim arbaʿu shahādātin bil-lahi innahu lamina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: As for those who accuse their own spouses, without any other witnesses, then the testimony may be accepted if he swears by GOD four times that he is telling the truth.

1981.english: As for those who accuse their own wives, without producing any witnesses besides themselves, the testimony of the husband is equal to four, if he swears by God four times that he is telling the truth;

1989.english: As for those who accuse their own spouses, without any other witnesses, then the testimony may be accepted if he swears by GOD four times that he is telling the truth.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والخامسة أن لعنت الله عليه إن كان من الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: wal-khāmisatu anna laʿnata l-lahi ʿalayhi in kāna mina l-kādhibīn
verses.english: The fifth oath shall be to incur GOD's condemnation upon him, if he was lying.

1981.english: The fifth oath by him shall be to incur God's curse upon him, if he was lying.

1989.english: And the fifth oath shall be to incur GOD’s condemnation upon him, if he was lying.

verses.arabic: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويدرأ عنها العذاب أن تشهد أربع شهادات بالله ۙ إنه لمن الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: wayadra-u ʿanhā l-ʿadhāba an tashhada arbaʿa shahādātin bil-lahi innahu lamina l-kādhibīn
verses.english: She shall be considered innocent if she swears by GOD four times that he is a liar.

1981.english: The wife shall be exempted from the punishment, if she swears four times by God that he is lying;

1989.english: She shall be considered innocent if she swears by GOD four times that he is a liar.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والخامسة أن غضب الله عليها إن كان من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: wal-khāmisata anna ghaḍaba l-lahi ʿalayhā in kāna mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: The fifth oath shall incur GOD's wrath upon her if he was telling the truth.

1981.english: And a fifth oath to incur God's curse upon her, if he was telling the truth.

1989.english: And the fifth oath shall be to incur GOD’s wrath upon her if he was telling the truth.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته وأن الله تواب حكيم
verses.transliterated: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna l-laha tawwābun ḥakīmu
verses.english: This is GOD's grace and mercy towards you. GOD is Redeemer, Most Wise.

1981.english: This is but grace from your Lord and mercy; God is redeemer, wise.

1989.english: This is GOD’s grace and mercy towards you. GOD is Redeemer, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنكُمْ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَّكُم بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين جاءوا بالإفك عصبة منكم ۚ لا تحسبوه شرا لكم ۖ بل هو خير لكم ۚ لكل امرئ منهم ما اكتسب من الإثم ۚ والذي تولى كبره منهم له عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna jāū bil-if'ki ʿuṣ'batun minkum lā taḥsabūhu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli im'ri-in min'hum mā ik'tasaba mina l-ith'mi wa-alladhī tawallā kib'rahu min'hum lahu ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: A gang among you produced a big lie. Do not think that it was bad for you; instead, it was good for you. Meanwhile, each one of them has earned his share of the guilt. As for the one who initiated the whole incident, he has incurred a terrible retribution.
verses.subtitle: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
verses.footnote: This refers to a historical incident where the Prophet's wife Aysha was left in the desert by mistake, and later found by a young man who helped her catch up with the Prophet's caravan. This triggered the famous 'Big Lie' against Aysha.

1981.english: Those who produced the big lie are an evil band among you; do not think that it is bad for you, for it is actually good for you. Each person is responsible for the sins he commits. And anyone among them who bears the greater share thereof has deserved a terrible retribution.
1981.subtitle: Historical Accusation of the Prophet's Wife

1989.english: A gang among you produced a big lie.* Do not think that it was bad for you; in fact, it was good for you (as a lesson). Meanwhile, each one of them has earned his share of the guilt. And the one who initiated the whole incident has incurred a terrible retribution.
1989.subtitle: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
1989.footnote: This refers to a historical incident where the Prophet’s wife Aysha was left in the desert by mistake, and found by a young man who helped her catch up with the Prophet’s caravan. This triggered the famous (Big Lie’ against Aysha.

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: لولا إذ سمعتموه ظن المؤمنون والمؤمنات بأنفسهم خيرا وقالوا هذا إفك مبين
verses.transliterated: lawlā idh samiʿ'tumūhu ẓanna l-mu'minūna wal-mu'minātu bi-anfusihim khayran waqālū hādhā if'kun mubīnu
verses.english: When you heard it, the believing men and the believing women should have had better thoughts about themselves, and should have said, "This is obviously a big lie."

1981.english: When you heard it, the believing men and women should have trusted themselves as righteous people, and should have said, "This is a terrible falsehood."

1989.english: When you heard it, the believers should have had better thoughts about themselves, and should have said, “This is obviously a big lie.”

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لولا جاءوا عليه بأربعة شهداء ۚ فإذ لم يأتوا بالشهداء فأولئك عند الله هم الكاذبون
verses.transliterated: lawlā jāū ʿalayhi bi-arbaʿati shuhadāa fa-idh lam yatū bil-shuhadāi fa-ulāika ʿinda l-lahi humu l-kādhibūn
verses.english: Only if they produced four witnesses (you may believe them). If they fail to produce the witnesses, then they are, according to GOD, liars.

1981.english: They should have produced four witnesses thereof. Since they failed to produce the witnesses, then they are, in the sight of God, real liars.

1989.english: You should have demanded four witnesses. If the witnesses were not produced, then they are, according to GOD, liars.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته في الدنيا والآخرة لمسكم في ما أفضتم فيه عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati lamassakum fī mā afaḍtum fīhi ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: If it were not for GOD's grace towards you, and His mercy in this world and in the Hereafter, you would have suffered a great retribution because of this incident.

1981.english: If it were not for God's indulgence towards you, and His mercy, you would have suffered terrible retribution for what you did.

1989.english: If it were not for GOD’s grace towards you, and His mercy in this world and in the Hereafter, you would have suffered a great retribution because of this incident.

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إذ تلقونه بألسنتكم وتقولون بأفواهكم ما ليس لكم به علم وتحسبونه هينا وهو عند الله عظيم
verses.transliterated: idh talaqqawnahu bi-alsinatikum wataqūlūna bi-afwāhikum mā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wataḥsabūnahu hayyinan wahuwa ʿinda l-lahi ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: You fabricated it with your own tongues, and the rest of you repeated it with your mouths without proof. You thought it was simple, when it was, according to GOD, gross.

1981.english: You reiterated the accusation with your tongues, thus uttering with your mouths what you did not know for sure. You also thought it was a simple matter, when it is a gross offense in the sight of God.

1989.english: You fabricated it with your own tongues, and the rest of you repeated it with your mouths without proof. You thought it was simple, when it was, according to GOD, gross.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَٰنٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولولا إذ سمعتموه قلتم ما يكون لنا أن نتكلم بهذا سبحانك هذا بهتان عظيم
verses.transliterated: walawlā idh samiʿ'tumūhu qul'tum mā yakūnu lanā an natakallama bihādhā sub'ḥānaka hādhā buh'tānun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: When you heard it, you should have said, "We will not repeat this. Glory be to You. This is a gross falsehood."
verses.subtitle: What to Do

1981.english: When you heard it, you should have said, "We will not reiterate such a thing. God be glorified; this is a profound falsehood."

1989.english: When you heard it, you should have said, “We will not repeat this. Glory be to You. This is a gross lie.”

verses.arabic: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يعظكم الله أن تعودوا لمثله أبدا إن كنتم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: yaʿiẓukumu l-lahu an taʿūdū limith'lihi abadan in kuntum mu'minīn
verses.english: GOD admonishes you that you shall never do it again, if you are believers.

1981.english: God enlightens you, that you may never again do this, if you are really believers.

1989.english: GOD admonishes you that you shall never do this again, if you are really believers.

verses.arabic: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ويبين الله لكم الآيات ۚ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: wayubayyinu l-lahu lakumu l-āyāti wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: GOD thus explains the revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.

1981.english: And God clarifies the revelations for you; God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: GOD thus explains the revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يحبون أن تشيع الفاحشة في الذين آمنوا لهم عذاب أليم في الدنيا والآخرة ۚ والله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yuḥibbūna an tashīʿa l-fāḥishatu fī alladhīna āmanū lahum ʿadhābun alīmun fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: Those who love to see immorality spread among the believers have incurred a painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter. GOD knows, while you do not know.

1981.english: Surely, those who wish to see the believers accused of vice, have deserved painful retribution in this life and in the hereafter. God knows, while you do not know.

1989.english: Those who love to see immorality spread among the believers have incurred a painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter. GOD knows, while you do not know.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته وأن الله رءوف رحيم
verses.transliterated: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna l-laha raūfun raḥīmu
verses.english: GOD showers you with His grace and mercy. GOD is Most Kind towards the believers, Most Merciful.

1981.english: God showers you with His grace and mercy; God is compassionate, merciful.

1989.english: GOD showers you with His grace and mercy. GOD is Most Kind towards the believers, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتبعوا خطوات الشيطان ۚ ومن يتبع خطوات الشيطان فإنه يأمر بالفحشاء والمنكر ۚ ولولا فضل الله عليكم ورحمته ما زكى منكم من أحد أبدا ولكن الله يزكي من يشاء ۗ والله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattabiʿū khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni waman yattabiʿ khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni fa-innahu yamuru bil-faḥshāi wal-munkari walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu mā zakā minkum min aḥadin abadan walākinna l-laha yuzakkī man yashāu wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, do not follow the steps of Satan. Anyone who follows the steps of Satan, should know that he advocates evil and vice. If it were not for GOD's grace towards you, and His mercy, none of you would have been purified. But GOD purifies whomever He wills. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
verses.subtitle: The Devil Encourages Baseless Accusations

1981.english: O you who believe, do not follow the steps of Satan. If anyone follows the steps of Satan, he would advocate evil and vice. If it were not for God's indulgence towards you, and His mercy, none of you would have been saved. But God saves whomever He wills; for God is hearer, knower.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not follow the steps of Satan, for anyone who follows the steps of Satan will be led to evil and vice. If it were not for GOD’s grace towards you, and His mercy, none of you would have been purified. But GOD purifies whomever He wills. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
1989.subtitle: The Devil Encourages Baseless Accusations

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يأتل أولو الفضل منكم والسعة أن يؤتوا أولي القربى والمساكين والمهاجرين في سبيل الله ۖ وليعفوا وليصفحوا ۗ ألا تحبون أن يغفر الله لكم ۗ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: walā yatali ulū l-faḍli minkum wal-saʿati an yu'tū ulī l-qur'bā wal-masākīna wal-muhājirīna fī sabīli l-lahi walyaʿfū walyaṣfaḥū alā tuḥibbūna an yaghfira l-lahu lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
