verses.english: "The One who puts me to death, then brings me back to life.

1981.english: "The one who puts me to death, then resurrects me.

1989.english: “The One who puts me to death, then resurrects me.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.arabicClean: والذي أطمع أن يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu an yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma l-dīn
verses.english: "The One who hopefully will forgive my sins on the Day of Judgment.

1981.english: "The one who I hope will forgive my sins on the day of judgment.

1989.english: “The One who hopefully will forgive my sins on the Day of Judgment.

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين
verses.transliterated: rabbi hab lī ḥuk'man wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: "My Lord, grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.

1981.english: "My Lord, grant me wisdom, and count me with the righteous.

1989.english: “My Lord, grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واجعل لي لسان صدق في الآخرين
verses.transliterated: wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīn
verses.english: "Let the example I set for the future generations be a good one.

1981.english: except a condemned old woman.

1989.english: except an old woman to be doomed.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم دمرنا الآخرين
verses.transliterated: thumma dammarnā l-ākharīn
verses.english: We then destroyed the others.

1981.english: And we destroyed the others.

1989.english: We destroyed the others.

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأمطرنا عليهم مطرا ۖ فساء مطر المنذرين
verses.transliterated: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīn
verses.english: We showered them with a miserable shower; what a terrible shower for those who had been warned!

1981.english: We showered them a miserable shower, after having warned them.

1989.english: We showered them with a miserable shower; what a terrible shower for those who had been warned!

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لآية ۖ وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.english: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.

1981.english: This should be a lesson, but most people are not to believe.

1989.english: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Surely, your Lord is the almighty, the most merciful.

1989.english: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كذب أصحاب الأيكة المرسلين
verses.transliterated: kadhaba aṣḥābu al'aykati l-mur'salīn
verses.english: The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.
verses.subtitle: Shu'aib

1981.english: The people of Midyan disbelieved the messengers.
1981.subtitle: Shu'aib

1989.english: The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.
1989.subtitle: Shu'aib

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال لهم شعيب ألا تتقون
verses.transliterated: idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūn
verses.english: Shu'aib said to them, "Would you not be righteous?

1981.english: Their brother Shu'aib said to them, "Would you not be righteous?

1989.english: Shu‘aib said to them, “Would you not be righteous?

verses.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: إني لكم رسول أمين
verses.transliterated: innī lakum rasūlun amīnu
verses.english: "I am an honest messenger to you.

1981.english: "I am an honest messenger to you.

1989.english: “I am an honest messenger to you.

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.arabicClean: فاتقوا الله وأطيعون
verses.transliterated: fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūn
verses.english: "You shall reverence GOD, and obey me.

1981.english: "Observe God and obey me.

1989.english: “Observe GOD and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أسألكم عليه من أجر ۖ إن أجري إلا على رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: "I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes only from the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: "I do not ask you for any pay; my pay comes from God, Lord of the universe.

1989.english: “I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أوفوا الكيل ولا تكونوا من المخسرين
verses.transliterated: awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīn
verses.english: "You shall give full measure when you trade; do not cheat.

1981.english: "Give the full measure when you trade, and do not be cheaters.

1989.english: “You shall give full measure when you trade; do not cheat.

verses.arabic: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: وزنوا بالقسطاس المستقيم
verses.transliterated: wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīm
verses.english: "You shall weigh with an equitable scale.

1981.english: "And weigh with an equitable scale.

1989.english: “And weigh with an equitable scale.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تبخسوا الناس أشياءهم ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين
verses.transliterated: walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīn
verses.english: "Do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.

1981.english: "Do not cheat the people out of their things, and do not corrupt the earth.

1989.english: “Do not cheat the people out of their rights, and stop committing evil.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واتقوا الذي خلقكم والجبلة الأولين
verses.transliterated: wa-ittaqū alladhī khalaqakum wal-jibilata l-awalīn
verses.english: "Reverence the One who created you and the previous generations."

1981.english: "Observe the One who created you and the multitudes before you."

1989.english: “Observe the One who created you and the previous generations.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا إنما أنت من المسحرين
verses.transliterated: qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīn
verses.english: They said, "You are bewitched.

1981.english: They said, "You are simply bewitched.

1989.english: They said, “You are bewitched.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أنت إلا بشر مثلنا وإن نظنك لمن الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: wamā anta illā basharun mith'lunā wa-in naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīn
verses.english: "You are no more than a human being like us. In fact, we think you are a liar.

1981.english: "You are no more than a man like us, and we think you are a liar.

1989.english: “You are no more than a human like us, and we think that you are a liar.

verses.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأسقط علينا كسفا من السماء إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mina l-samāi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: "Let masses from the sky fall on us, if you are truthful."

1981.english: "Why do you not drop masses from the sky on us, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: “Let masses from the sky fall on us, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال ربي أعلم بما تعملون
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbī aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord is the One who knows everything you do."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord is the One who knows your works."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord is fully aware of everything you do.”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فكذبوه فأخذهم عذاب يوم الظلة ۚ إنه كان عذاب يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi l-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: They disbelieved him and, consequently, they incurred the retribution of the Day of the Canopy. It was the retribution of an awesome day.

1981.english: Since they disbelieved him, the retribution struck them on the day of the canopy; it was the retribution of a terrible day.

1989.english: They disbelieved him and, consequently, they incurred the retribution of the Day of the Canopy; it was the retribution of a terrible day.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لآية ۖ وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīn
verses.english: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.

1981.english: This should be a lesson, but most people are not to believe.

1989.english: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Surely, your Lord is the almighty, the most merciful.

1989.english: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه لتنزيل رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu latanzīlu rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: This is a revelation from the Lord of the universe.
verses.subtitle: The Quran

1981.english: This is a revelation from the Lord of the universe.
1981.subtitle: The Guilty Isolated From Quran

1989.english: And this is a revelation from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
verses.arabicClean: نزل به الروح الأمين
verses.transliterated: nazala bihi l-rūḥu l-amīn
verses.english: The Honest Spirit (Gabriel) came down with it.

1981.english: Brought down by the honest Spirit (Gabriel).

1989.english: The Honest Spirit {Gabriel) brought it down.

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: على قلبك لتكون من المنذرين
verses.transliterated: alaa qalbaka ltakuun min almundireen
verses.english: To reveal it into your heart, that you may be one of the warners.

1981.english: It was placed into your heart (O Muhammad), to make you one of the warners.

1989.english: To reveal it into your heart, that you may be one of the warners

verses.arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: بلسان عربي مبين
verses.transliterated: bilisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīni
verses.english: In a perfect Arabic tongue.

1981.english: It comes in clear Arabic tongue.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 3 for details as to why the Quran was revealed in Arabic.

1989.english: In a perfect Arabic tongue.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه لفي زبر الأولين
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu lafī zuburi l-awalīn
verses.english: It has been prophesied in the books of previous generations.

1981.english: It contains the same message as the previous scriptures.

1989.english: It has been prophesied in the previous scriptures.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يكن لهم آية أن يعلمه علماء بني إسرائيل
verses.transliterated: awalam yakun lahum āyatan an yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīl
verses.english: Is it not a sufficient sign for them that it was known to the scholars among the Children of Israel?

1981.english: Is it not a clue for them that it is recognized by the scholars of Israel?

1989.english: Is it not a sufficient sign for them that it was known to the scholars of the Children of Israel? Translate This Scripture

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو نزلناه على بعض الأعجمين
verses.transliterated: walaw nazzalnāhu ʿalā baʿḍi l-aʿjamīn
verses.english: If we revealed this to people who do not know Arabic.
verses.subtitle: The Quran Must Be Translated

1981.english: If presented in Arabic to non-Arabic people;

1989.english: If we revealed this to people who do not know Arabic.

verses.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فقرأه عليهم ما كانوا به مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīn
verses.english: And had him recite it (in Arabic), they could not possibly believe in it.

1981.english: they could not believe in it when recited to them.

1989.english: And had him recite it in Arabic, they could not possibly believe in it.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك سلكناه في قلوب المجرمين
verses.transliterated: kadhālika salaknāhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: We thus render it (like a foreign language) in the hearts of the guilty.

1981.english: This is the way we render it to the hearts of the wicked.

1989.english: We thus render it (like a foreign language) in the hearts of the guilty.

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يؤمنون به حتى يروا العذاب الأليم
verses.transliterated: lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.english: Thus, they cannot believe in it; not until they see the painful retribution.

1981.english: Consequently, they fail to believe, till the painful retribution strikes them.

1989.english: As such, they cannot believe in it; not until they see the painful retribution.

verses.arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فيأتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: It will come to them suddenly, when they least expect it.

1981.english: And it only strikes them suddenly, when they least expect it.

1989.english: It will come to them suddenly, when they least expect it.

verses.arabic: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فيقولوا هل نحن منظرون
verses.transliterated: fayaqūlū hal naḥnu munẓarūn
verses.english: They will then say, "Can we have a respite?"

1981.english: Then they say, "Can we get a second chance?"

1989.english: They will then say, “Can we have a respite?”

verses.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفبعذابنا يستعجلون
verses.transliterated: afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūn
verses.english: Did they not challenge our retribution?

1981.english: Did they not challenge our doom?

1989.english: Did they not challenge our retribution?

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أفرأيت إن متعناهم سنين
verses.transliterated: afara-ayta in mattaʿnāhum sinīn
verses.english: As you see, we allowed them to enjoy for years.

1981.english: We may let them enjoy for years;

1989.english: As you see, we allowed them to enjoy for years.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم جاءهم ما كانوا يوعدون
verses.transliterated: thumma jāahum mā kānū yūʿadūn
verses.english: Then the retribution came to them, just as promised.

1981.english: then what is promised to them afflicts them.

1989.english: Then the retribution promised for them came to pass.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون
verses.transliterated: mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūn
verses.english: Their vast resources did not help them in the least.

1981.english: Their possessions can never help them.

1989.english: All their resources did not help them.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا لها منذرون
verses.transliterated: wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūn
verses.english: We never annihilate any community without sending warners.

1981.english: We never destroy any community without sending warners.

1989.english: We never annihilated any community without sending warners.

verses.arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ذكرى وما كنا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: dhik'rā wamā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.english: Therefore, this is a reminder, for we are never unjust.

1981.english: They first remind them, for we are never unjust.

1989.english: This is a reminder, for we are never unjust.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وما تنزلت به الشياطين
verses.transliterated: wamā tanazzalat bihi l-shayāṭīn
verses.english: The devils can never reveal this.
verses.subtitle: False Messengers Incapable of Preaching the Worship of God ALONE
verses.footnote: A false messenger is a messenger of Satan, for he is the fabricator of the most horrendous lie. Such a messenger can never denounce idolatry, or preach the worship of God ALONE.

1981.english: This Quran cannot be a revelation by the devils.

1989.english: The devils can never reveal this.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما ينبغي لهم وما يستطيعون
verses.transliterated: wamā yanbaghī lahum wamā yastaṭīʿūn
verses.english: They neither would, nor could.

1981.english: They neither would, nor could.

1989.english: They neither would, nor could.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنهم عن السمع لمعزولون
verses.transliterated: innahum ʿani l-samʿi lamaʿzūlūn
verses.english: For they are prevented from hearing.

1981.english: For they have been isolated from hearing.

1989.english: For they are prevented from hearing.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تدع مع الله إلها آخر فتكون من المعذبين
verses.transliterated: falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīn
verses.english: Therefore, do not idolize beside GOD any other god, lest you incur the retribution.

1981.english: You shall not call on any idol besides God, lest you join the doomed.

1989.english: Therefore, do not idolize besides GOD anv other vod. lest vou suffer.

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين
verses.transliterated: wa-andhir ʿashīrataka l-aqrabīn
verses.english: You shall preach to the people who are closest to you.
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: These verses refer to God's Messenger of the Covenant: the sum of the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (214) is 1230+ 214=1444=19x76= 19x19x4, and the sum of the verse numbers from 214 through 223 is 2185=19x115 (Appendix 1).

1981.english: And warn the people closest to you.

1989.english: And warn the people closest to you.

verses.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: واخفض جناحك لمن اتبعك من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: And lower your wing for the believers who follow you.

1981.english: And lower your wing for the believers who follow you.

1989.english: And lower your wing for the believers who follow you.

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن عصوك فقل إني بريء مما تعملون
verses.transliterated: fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīon mimmā taʿmalūn
verses.english: If they disobey you, then say, "I disown what you do."

1981.english: If they disobey you, then say, "I disown your works."

1989.english: If they disobey you, then say, “I am innocent of your works.”

verses.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: وتوكل على العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: watawakkal ʿalā l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīm
verses.english: And put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: And trust in the almighty, the most merciful.

1989.english: Trust in the Almighty, the Merciful.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.arabicClean: الذي يراك حين تقوم
verses.transliterated: alladhī yarāka ḥīna taqūm
verses.english: Who sees you when you meditate during the night.

1981.english: He is the One who sees you when you pray in the night.

1989.english: Who sees you when you meditate during the night.

verses.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وتقلبك في الساجدين
verses.transliterated: wataqallubaka fī l-sājidīn
verses.english: And your frequent prostrations.

1981.english: And when you fall prostrate.

1989.english: And when you fall prostrate.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إنه هو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: He is the Hearer, the knower.

1989.english: He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.arabicClean: هل أنبئكم على من تنزل الشياطين
verses.transliterated: hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu l-shayāṭīn
verses.english: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

1981.english: Let me tell you upon whom the devils descend.

1989.english: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: تنزل على كل أفاك أثيم
verses.transliterated: tanazzalu ʿalā kulli affākin athīmi
verses.english: They descend upon every guilty fabricator.

1981.english: They descend on every wicked fabricator.

1989.english: They descend upon every guilty fabricator.

verses.arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يلقون السمع وأكثرهم كاذبون
verses.transliterated: yul'qūna l-samʿa wa-aktharuhum kādhibūn
verses.english: They pretend to listen, but most of them are liars.

1981.english: They appear to listen, and most of them are liars.

1989.english: They pretend to listen, but most of them are liars.

verses.arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
verses.arabicClean: والشعراء يتبعهم الغاوون
verses.transliterated: wal-shuʿarāu yattabiʿuhumu l-ghāwūn
verses.english: As for the poets, they are followed only by the strayers.

1981.english: As for the poets, they are followed by the strayers.

1989.english: And the poets are followed by the strayers.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أنهم في كل واد يهيمون
verses.transliterated: alam tara annahum fī kulli wādin yahīmūn
verses.english: Do you not see that their loyalty shifts according to the situation?

1981.english: Do you not notice that their loyalty constantly shifts?

1989.english: Do you not see that their loyalty shifts according to the situation?

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون
verses.transliterated: wa-annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yafʿalūn
verses.english: And that they say what they do not do?

1981.english: And they utter what they do not necessarily do?

1989.english: And that they say what they do not do?

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وذكروا الله كثيرا وانتصروا من بعد ما ظلموا ۗ وسيعلم الذين ظلموا أي منقلب ينقلبون
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīran wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabin yanqalibūn
verses.english: Exempted are those who believe, lead a righteous life, commemorate GOD frequently, and stand up for their rights. Surely, the transgressors will find out what their ultimate destiny is.

1981.english: Excepted are those who believe and work righteousness, and commemorate God constantly, and steadfastly persevere when oppressed. As for the wicked, they will certainly find out how miserable their ultimate destiny is.

1989.english: Exempted are those who believe, lead a righteous life, commemorate GOD frequently, and stand up for their rights. Surely, the transgressors will find out what their ultimate destiny is.

verses.arabic: طسٓ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم طس ۚ تلك آيات القرآن وكتاب مبين
verses.transliterated: tta-seen til'ka āyātu l-qur'āni wakitābin mubīni
verses.english: T. S. These (letters) constitute proofs of the Quran; a profound scripture.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the meaning of these Quranic initials.

1981.english: T.S.* These (letters) are miracles of this Quran; a profound scripture.
1981.footnote: These letters are part of the Quran's miraculous numerical code that proves that Quran is God's message to the world (see Appendix 1 and footnotes 10:1, 12:1, and 26:2).

1989.english: T. S.* These (letters) are miracles of the Quran; a profound scripture.
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the meaning of these Quranic initials.

verses.arabic: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هدى وبشرى للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: hudan wabush'rā lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: A beacon, and good news, for the believers.

1981.english: A guide and good news for the believers;

1989.english: A beacon, and good news, for the believers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم يوقنون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūn
verses.english: Who observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they are, with regard to the Hereafter, absolutely certain.

1981.english: who observe the **salat** prayers, give the **zakat** charity, and are positively certain about the hereafter.

1989.english: Who observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and are absolutely certain about the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة زينا لهم أعمالهم فهم يعمهون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati zayyannā lahum aʿmālahum fahum yaʿmahūn
verses.english: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, we adorn their works in their eyes. Thus, they continue to blunder.

1981.english: As for those who do not believe in the hereafter, we adorn their works in their eyes so that they continue to blunder.

1989.english: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, we adorn their works in their eyes. Thus, they continue to blunder.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين لهم سوء العذاب وهم في الآخرة هم الأخسرون
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna lahum sūu l-ʿadhābi wahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūn
verses.english: It is these who incur the worst retribution, and in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.

1981.english: They have deserved the worst retribution, and in the hereafter they will be the losers.

1989.english: They are the ones who incur the worst retribution, and in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإنك لتلقى القرآن من لدن حكيم عليم
verses.transliterated: wa-innaka latulaqqā l-qur'āna min ladun ḥakīmin ʿalīmi
verses.english: Surely, you are receiving the Quran from a Most Wise, Omniscient.

1981.english: This Quran comes to you from One who is wise, omniscient.

1989.english: Surely, you are receiving the Quran from a Most Wise, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال موسى لأهله إني آنست نارا سآتيكم منها بخبر أو آتيكم بشهاب قبس لعلكم تصطلون
verses.transliterated: idh qāla mūsā li-ahlihi innī ānastu nāran saātīkum min'hā bikhabarin aw ātīkum bishihābin qabasin laʿallakum taṣṭalūn
verses.english: Recall that Moses said to his family, "I see a fire; let me bring you news therefrom, or a torch to warm you."
verses.subtitle: Moses

1981.english: Recall that Moses said to his family, "I just saw a fire, and I am going to check. I may bring you some of it to warm up."
1981.subtitle: Moses

1989.english: Recall that Moses said to his family, “I have seen a fire; let me bring you some news therefrom, or bring a torch to warm you up.”
1989.subtitle: Moses

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاءها نودي أن بورك من في النار ومن حولها وسبحان الله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: falammā jāahā nūdiya an būrika man fī l-nāri waman ḥawlahā wasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: When he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is the One (who is speaking from) within the fire, and those around it." Glory be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

1981.english: But when he approached it, it was announced, "Blessed is this fire and its surroundings. Glory be to God, Lord of the universe."

1989.english: When he came to it, he was called, “Blessed is the One (who is speaking from) within the fire, and those around it.” Glory be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: يا موسى إنه أنا الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: yāmūsā innahu anā l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: "O Moses, this is Me, GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: "O Moses, this is I, God, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: “O Moses, this is Me, GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وألق عصاك ۚ فلما رآها تهتز كأنها جان ولى مدبرا ولم يعقب ۚ يا موسى لا تخف إني لا يخاف لدي المرسلون
verses.transliterated: wa-alqi ʿaṣāka falammā raāhā tahtazzu ka-annahā jānnun wallā mud'biran walam yuʿaqqib yāmūsā lā takhaf innī lā yakhāfu ladayya l-mur'salūn
verses.english: "Throw down your staff." When he saw it moving like a demon, he turned around and fled. "O Moses, do not be afraid. My messengers shall not fear.

1981.english: "Throw down your staff." When he saw it move like a demon, he turned around and ran. "O Moses, do not be afraid; My messengers have nothing to fear.

1989.english: “Throw down your staff.” When he saw it moving like a demon, he turned around and ran. “O Moses, do not be afraid. My messengers do not have any fear.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلا من ظلم ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء فإني غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: illā man ẓalama thumma baddala ḥus'nan baʿda sūin fa-innī ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: "Except those who commit a transgression, then substitute righteousness after sinning; I am Forgiving, Most Merciful.

1981.english: "Even those who commit evil, but later substitute righteousness in place of evil; I am forgiving, merciful.

1989.english: “Except those who commit a transgression, then substitute righteousness after sinning; I am Forgiving, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأدخل يدك في جيبك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء ۖ في تسع آيات إلى فرعون وقومه ۚ إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين
verses.transliterated: wa-adkhil yadaka fī jaybika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin fī tis'ʿi āyātin ilā fir'ʿawna waqawmihi innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verses.english: "Put your hand in your pocket; it will come out white, without a blemish. These are among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people, for they are wicked people."

1981.english: "Now put your hand in your pocket; it will come out white, without a blemish. Another one of nine miracles you shall show Pharaoh and his people, for they are wicked."

1989.english: “And put your hand in your pocket; it will come out white without a blemish. These are among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people; evil people.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاءتهم آياتنا مبصرة قالوا هذا سحر مبين
verses.transliterated: falammā jāathum āyātunā mub'ṣiratan qālū hādhā siḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: When our miracles were presented to them, clear and profound, they said, "This is obviously magic."

1981.english: When our clear signs were presented to them, they said, "This is clever magic."

1989.english: When our profound miracles were presented to them, they said, “This is obviously magic.”

verses.arabic: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها أنفسهم ظلما وعلوا ۚ فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين
verses.transliterated: wajaḥadū bihā wa-is'tayqanathā anfusuhum ẓul'man waʿuluwwan fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: They rejected them and were utterly convinced of their wrong ways, due to their arrogance. Note the consequences for the evildoers.

1981.english: They thus disregarded them, and their souls were ridden with wickedness and pride. Therefore, note the consequences for the wicked.

1989.english: They rejected them and were utterly convinced of their wrong ways, due to their arrogance. Note the consequences for the evildoers.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا داوود وسليمان علما ۖ وقالا الحمد لله الذي فضلنا على كثير من عباده المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā dāwūda wasulaymāna ʿil'man waqālā l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin min ʿibādihi l-mu'minīn
verses.english: We endowed David and Solomon with knowledge, and they said, "Praise GOD for blessing us more than many of His believing servants."
verses.subtitle: David and Solomon

1981.english: We gave David and Solomon knowledge, and they acknowledged, "Praise be to God, who blessed us more than many other believing servants."
1981.subtitle: David and Solomon

1989.english: We endowed David and Solomon with knowledge, and they said, “Praise GOD for blessing us more than many of His believing servants.”
1989.subtitle: David and Solomon

verses.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وورث سليمان داوود ۖ وقال يا أيها الناس علمنا منطق الطير وأوتينا من كل شيء ۖ إن هذا لهو الفضل المبين
verses.transliterated: wawaritha sulaymānu dāwūda waqāla yāayyuhā l-nāsu ʿullim'nā manṭiqa l-ṭayri waūtīnā min kulli shayin inna hādhā lahuwa l-faḍlu l-mubīn
verses.english: Solomon was David's heir. He said, "O people, we have been endowed with understanding the language of the birds, and all kinds of things have been bestowed upon us. This is indeed a real blessing."

1981.english: Solomon was David's heir, and he said, "O people, we have been endowed with the understanding of the birds' language; we have been blessed with all kinds of things; a profound grace."

1989.english: Solomon was David’s heir. He said, “O people, we have been endowed with understanding the language of the birds, and all kinds of things have been bestowed upon us. This is indeed a real blessing.”

verses.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وحشر لسليمان جنوده من الجن والإنس والطير فهم يوزعون
verses.transliterated: waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhu mina l-jini wal-insi wal-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūn
verses.english: Mobilized in the service of Solomon were his obedient soldiers of jinns and humans, as well as the birds; all at his disposal.

1981.english: Mobilized for Solomon were troops of jinns and humans, as well as the birds; all subjugated.

1989.english: Mobilized for Solomon were his soldiers of jinns, and humans, and birds; all at his service.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: حتى إذا أتوا على واد النمل قالت نملة يا أيها النمل ادخلوا مساكنكم لا يحطمنكم سليمان وجنوده وهم لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: ḥattā idhā ataw ʿalā wādi l-namli qālat namlatun yāayyuhā l-namlu ud'khulū masākinakum lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhu wahum lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: When they approached the valley of the ants, one ant said, "O you ants, go into your homes, lest you get crushed by Solomon and his soldiers, without perceiving."
verses.footnote: The more unusual the events in a given sura, the stronger the mathematical evidence supporting them. This helps assure us that such strange phenomena are indicative of God's power. This sura's initials, T.S., constitute a complex part of the mathematical miracles related to the Quranic initials. The unusual birth and miracles of Jesus are in Sura 19, which is prefixed with five Quranic Initials. See Appendix 1 for the details.

1981.english: Once, when they approached a valley of ants, one ant said, "O you ants, go inside your homes, otherwise Solomon and his troops may crush you unintentionally."

1989.english: When they approached the valley of the ants, one ant said, “O you ants, go into your homes, lest you get crushed by Solomon and his soldiers, while they do not perceive.”*
1989.footnote: The more unusual the events in a given sura, the stronger the mathematical evidence supporting them. This helps assure us that such strange events are indicative of God’s power. This sura’s initials, T.S., constitute a complex part of the mathematical miracles related to the Quranic initials. The unusual birth and miracles of Jesus are in Sura 19, which is prefixed with five Quranic Initials. See Appendix 1 for the details.

verses.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فتبسم ضاحكا من قولها وقال رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك التي أنعمت علي وعلى والدي وأن أعمل صالحا ترضاه وأدخلني برحمتك في عبادك الصالحين
verses.transliterated: fatabassama ḍāḥikan min qawlihā waqāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhil'nī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādika l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: He smiled and laughed at her statement, and said, "My Lord, direct me to be appreciative of the blessings You have bestowed upon me and my parents, and to do the righteous works that please You. Admit me by Your mercy into the company of Your righteous servants."

1981.english: He smiled in amusement from her statement, and prayed, "My Lord, direct me to appreciate the blessings You bestowed upon me and my parents, and to work righteousness that is pleasing to You, and admit me into Your mercy with Your righteous servants."

1989.english: He smiled and laughed at her statement,* and said, “My Lord, direct me to be appreciative of the blessings that You bestowed upon me and my parents, and to do the righteous works that please You, and admit me by Your mercy to be one of Your righteous servants.”
1989.footnote: The more unusual the events in a given sura, the stronger the mathematical evidence supporting them. This helps assure us that such strange events are indicative of God’s power. This sura’s initials, T.S., constitute a complex part of the mathematical miracles related to the Quranic initials. The unusual birth and miracles of Jesus are in Sura 19, which is prefixed with five Quranic Initials. See Appendix 1 for the details.

verses.arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وتفقد الطير فقال ما لي لا أرى الهدهد أم كان من الغائبين
verses.transliterated: watafaqqada l-ṭayra faqāla mā liya lā arā l-hud'huda am kāna mina l-ghāibīn
verses.english: He inspected the birds, and noted: "Why do I not see the hoopoe? Why is he missing?

1981.english: He inspected the birds and said, "How come I do not see the hoopoe? Why is he absent?

1989.english: He inspected the birds, and noted: “Why do I not see the hoopoe? Why is he missing?

verses.arabic: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: لأعذبنه عذابا شديدا أو لأذبحنه أو ليأتيني بسلطان مبين
verses.transliterated: la-uʿadhibannahu ʿadhāban shadīdan aw laādh'baḥannahu aw layatiyannī bisul'ṭānin mubīni
verses.english: "I will punish him severely or sacrifice him, unless he gives me a good excuse."

1981.english: "I will certainly punish him severely, or sacrifice him, unless he shows a valid excuse."

1989.english: “I will punish him severely or sacrifice him, unless he gives me a good excuse.”

verses.arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فمكث غير بعيد فقال أحطت بما لم تحط به وجئتك من سبإ بنبإ يقين
verses.transliterated: famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihi waji'tuka min saba-in binaba-in yaqīni
verses.english: He did not wait for long. (The hoopoe) said, "I have news that you do not have. I brought to you from Sheba, some important information.

1981.english: Not much later, the hoopoe came and said, "I found out something you do not know. I bring you important news from Sheba.

1989.english: He did not wait for long. (The hoopoe) said, “I have news that you do not have. I brought to you, from Sheba, some important news.

verses.arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إني وجدت امرأة تملكهم وأوتيت من كل شيء ولها عرش عظيم
verses.transliterated: innī wajadttu im'ra-atan tamlikuhum waūtiyat min kulli shayin walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: "I found a woman ruling them, who is blessed with everything, and possesses a tremendous palace.

1981.english: "I found a woman ruling them, who possesses all kinds of things, and a great mansion.

1989.english: “I found a woman ruling them, who is endowed with everything, and possesses a tremendous palace.

verses.arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجدتها وقومها يسجدون للشمس من دون الله وزين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم فصدهم عن السبيل فهم لا يهتدون
verses.transliterated: wajadttuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lilshamsi min dūni l-lahi wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūn
verses.english: "I found her and her people prostrating before the sun, instead of GOD. The devil has adorned their works in their eyes, and has repulsed them from the path; consequently, they are not guided."

1981.english: "I found her and her people worshiping the sun, instead of God. The devil has adorned their works for them, and diverted them from the path; they are misguided.

1989.english: “I found her and her people prostrating before the sun, instead of GOD. The devil has adorned their works in their eyes, and has diverted them from the path; they are not guided.”

verses.arabic: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا يسجدوا لله الذي يخرج الخبء في السماوات والأرض ويعلم ما تخفون وما تعلنون
verses.transliterated: allā yasjudū lillahi alladhī yukh'riju l-khaba-a fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukh'fūna wamā tuʿ'linūn
verses.english: They should have been prostrating before GOD, the One who manifests all the mysteries in the heavens and the earth, and the One who knows everything you conceal and everything you declare.

1981.english: "That is because they did not submit to God; the One who uncovers the secrets of the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you declare.

1989.english: They should have been prostrating before GOD, the One who unveils the secrets wherever they may be in the heavens and the earth, and who knows everything you conceal and everything you declare.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: الله لا إله إلا هو رب العرش العظيم ۩
verses.transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: GOD: there is no other god beside Him; the Lord with the great dominion.

1981.english: "God; there is no god except He; the Lord with the great throne.

1989.english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. He is the Lord with the great throne.

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال سننظر أصدقت أم كنت من الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta mina l-kādhibīn
verses.english: (Solomon) said, "We will see if you told the truth, or if you are a liar.

1981.english: Solomon said, "We will find out whether you told the truth, or lied.

1989.english: (Solomon) said, “We will see if you told the truth, or if you are a liar.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: اذهب بكتابي هذا فألقه إليهم ثم تول عنهم فانظر ماذا يرجعون
verses.transliterated: idh'hab bikitābī hādhā fa-alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fa-unẓur mādhā yarjiʿūn
verses.english: "Take this letter from me, give it to them, then watch for their response."

1981.english: "Take this message to them, then turn away and watch their response."

1989.english: “Take this letter from me, give it to them, then watch for their response.’

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قالت يا أيها الملأ إني ألقي إلي كتاب كريم
verses.transliterated: qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u innī ul'qiya ilayya kitābun karīmu
verses.english: She said, "O my advisers, I have received an honorable letter.
verses.subtitle: Back in Sheba

1981.english: The Queen of Sheba said, "O my elders, I just received an honorable message.

1989.english: She said, “O my advisers, I have received an honorable letter.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إنه من سليمان وإنه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
verses.transliterated: innahu min sulaymāna wa-innahu bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verses.english: "It is from Solomon, and it is, 'In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.'
verses.footnote: The 'Basmalah' included in this verse compensates for the 'Basmalah' that is missing from Sura 9, 19 suras earlier. This restores the total occurrence of 'Basmalah' to 114, 19x6. See Appendix 29 for details of a vast and profound miracle attached to this 'Basmalah.'

1981.english: "It is from Solomon, and it is IN THE NAME OF GOD, MOST GRACIOUS, MOST MERCIFUL.
1981.footnote: This verse represents a significant part of the Quran's numerical miracle; the physical, touchable, and examinable miracle that proves that Quran is a divine scripture. The reader knows by now that the foundation of the Quran's miraculous numerical code is the 19-letter statement "BISM ALLAH ARRAHMAN ARRAHEEM" (in the name of God, most gracious, most merciful). Every sura opens with this statement, except one, namely, sura 9. Since the Quran consists of 114 suras (19x6), the absence of "**Bismillah**" from sura 9 would upset the intricate and delicate balance of this divine system. Since this miraculous code must be perfect, we find that the missing "**Bismillah**" statement is compensated for in this sura, verse 27:30. Thus, while the "**Bismillah**" is missing from sura 9, we find two **Bismillah**'s in sura 27. This makes the total frequency of this important statement 114, a multiple of 19. Equally miraculous is the fact that the total number of suras from sura 9, where the "**Bismillah**" is missing, through sura 27, where we find two **Bismillah**s, is exactly 19 suras. This proves to us that the specific order of suras as we know them today is divinely revealed.

1989.english: “It is from Solomon, and it is, Tn the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.’*
1989.footnote: The ‘Basmalah’ included in this verse compensates for the ‘BasmalalT that is missing from Sura 9, 19 suras earlier. This restores the total occurrence of ‘Basmalah to 114, 19x6. See Appendix 29 for details of a vast miracle attached to this ‘Basmalah. ’

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا تعلوا علي وأتوني مسلمين
verses.transliterated: allā taʿlū ʿalayya watūnī mus'limīn
verses.english: "Proclaiming: 'Do not be arrogant; come to me as submitters.' "

1981.english: "It says, 'Do not be too arrogant, and come to me as Muslims (submitters).'"

1989.english: “Proclaiming: ‘Do not be too arrogant; come to me as Muslims.’ ”

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
verses.arabicClean: قالت يا أيها الملأ أفتوني في أمري ما كنت قاطعة أمرا حتى تشهدون
verses.transliterated: qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u aftūnī fī amrī mā kuntu qāṭiʿatan amran ḥattā tashhadūn
verses.english: She said, "O my advisers, counsel me in this matter. I am not deciding anything until you advise me."

1981.english: She said, "O you elders, advise me in this matter; I will not make a decision without your opinion."

1989.english: She said, “O my advisers, counsel me in this matter. I am not deciding anything until you advise me.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا نحن أولو قوة وأولو بأس شديد والأمر إليك فانظري ماذا تأمرين
verses.transliterated: qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatin wa-ulū basin shadīdin wal-amru ilayki fa-unẓurī mādhā tamurīn
verses.english: They said, "We possess the power, we possess the fighting skills, and the ultimate command is in your hand. You decide what to do."

1981.english: They said, "We possess tremendous power and great influence. The final decision is yours. What is your command?"

1989.english: They said, “We possess the power, we possess the fighting skills, and the ultimate command is in your hand. You decide what to do.”

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالت إن الملوك إذا دخلوا قرية أفسدوها وجعلوا أعزة أهلها أذلة ۖ وكذلك يفعلون
verses.transliterated: qālat inna l-mulūka idhā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wajaʿalū aʿizzata ahlihā adhillatan wakadhālika yafʿalūn
verses.english: She said, "The kings corrupt any land they invade, and subjugate its dignified people. This is what they usually do.

1981.english: She said, "Whenever the kings invade a community, they corrupt it and humiliate the dignified people thereof; this is what they usually do.

1989.english: She said, “The kings corrupt any land mey invade, and subjugate its dignified people. This is what they do.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإني مرسلة إليهم بهدية فناظرة بم يرجع المرسلون
verses.transliterated: wa-innī mur'silatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratun bima yarjiʿu l-mur'salūn
verses.english: "I am sending a gift to them; let us see what the messengers come back with."

1981.english: "I will send them a gift, then see what the messengers bring back."

1989.english: “I am sending a gift to them; let us see what the messengers come back with.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاء سليمان قال أتمدونن بمال فما آتاني الله خير مما آتاكم بل أنتم بهديتكم تفرحون
verses.transliterated: falammā jāa sulaymāna qāla atumiddūnani bimālin famā ātāniya l-lahu khayrun mimmā ātākum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūn
verses.english: When the hoopoe returned to Solomon (he told him the news), and he responded (to Sheba's people): "Are you giving me money? What GOD has given me is far better than what He has given you. You are the ones to rejoice in such gifts."

1981.english: When they came to Solomon he said, "Are you giving me money? What God bestowed upon me is far better than what He bestowed upon you. It is you who may be impressed by such a gift.

1989.english: When the hoopoe returned to Solomon (he told him the news), he said (to Sheba’s people), “Arc you giving me money? What GOD gave me is far better than what He has given you. You are the ones who may be happy with your gift.

verses.arabic: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ارجع إليهم فلنأتينهم بجنود لا قبل لهم بها ولنخرجنهم منها أذلة وهم صاغرون
verses.transliterated: ir'jiʿ ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunūdin lā qibala lahum bihā walanukh'rijannahum min'hā adhillatan wahum ṣāghirūn
verses.english: (To the hoopoe, he said,) "Go back to them (and let them know that) we will come to them with forces they cannot imagine. We will evict them, humiliated and debased."

1981.english: "Go back (and tell them) we will mobilize against them formidable troops. We will banish them in humiliation and disgrace."

1989.english: “Go back to them (and let them know that) we will come to them with forces that they cannot stand up to. We will evict them, humiliated and debased.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا أيها الملأ أيكم يأتيني بعرشها قبل أن يأتوني مسلمين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāayyuhā l-mala-u ayyukum yatīnī biʿarshihā qabla an yatūnī mus'limīn
verses.english: He said, "O you elders, which of you can bring me her mansion, before they arrive here as submitters?"
verses.subtitle: Faster Than the Speed of Light

1981.english: Solomon said to his troops, "Which of you can bring her mansion to me, ahead of their arrival here?"

1989.english: He said, “O you elders, which of you can bring me her mansion, before they arrive here as Muslims?”
1989.subtitle: Faster Than the Speed of Light

verses.arabic: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: قال عفريت من الجن أنا آتيك به قبل أن تقوم من مقامك ۖ وإني عليه لقوي أمين
verses.transliterated: qāla ʿif'rītun mina l-jini anā ātīka bihi qabla an taqūma min maqāmika wa-innī ʿalayhi laqawiyyun amīnu
verses.english: One afrit from the jinns said, "I can bring it to you before you stand up. I am powerful enough to do this."

1981.english: A demon from the jinns said, "I can bring it to you before you stand up. I am capable and honest."

1989.english: One afrit from the jinns said, “I can bring it to you before you stand up. I am powerful enough to do this.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قال الذي عنده علم من الكتاب أنا آتيك به قبل أن يرتد إليك طرفك ۚ فلما رآه مستقرا عنده قال هذا من فضل ربي ليبلوني أأشكر أم أكفر ۖ ومن شكر فإنما يشكر لنفسه ۖ ومن كفر فإن ربي غني كريم
verses.transliterated: qāla alladhī ʿindahu ʿil'mun mina l-kitābi anā ātīka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka ṭarfuka falammā raāhu mus'taqirran ʿindahu qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbī liyabluwanī a-ashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna rabbī ghaniyyun karīmu
verses.english: The one who possessed knowledge from the book said, "I can bring it to you in the blink of your eye." When he saw it settled in front of him, he said, "This is a blessing from my Lord, whereby He tests me, to show whether I am appreciative or unappreciative. Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good, and if one turns unappreciative, then my Lord is in no need for him, Most Honorable."

1981.english: But the one who possessed knowledge from the scripture said, "I can bring it to you while you blink your eyes." When he saw it placed before him, he said, "This is grace from my Lord, in order to test me and show whether I turn appreciative or unappreciative. Those who are appreciative are appreciative for their own good. As for those who are not appreciative, my Lord is in no need, generous."

1989.english: The one who possessed knowledge from the book said, “I can bring it to you in the blink of your eye.” When he saw it settled in front of him, he said, “This is a blessing from my Lord, whereby He tests me and shows whether I am appreciative or unappreciative. The appreciative is appreciative for his own good, and the unappreciative (never hurts) my Lord. He is Rich, Honorable.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال نكروا لها عرشها ننظر أتهتدي أم تكون من الذين لا يهتدون
verses.transliterated: qāla nakkirū lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu mina alladhīna lā yahtadūn
verses.english: He said, "Remodel her mansion for her. Let us see if she will be guided, or continue with the misguided."

1981.english: He then said, "Remodel the inside of her mansion, and let us see if she will be guided, or fail to follow the guidance."

1989.english: He said, “Remodel her mansion for her. Let us see if she will be guided, or continue with the misguided.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاءت قيل أهكذا عرشك ۖ قالت كأنه هو ۚ وأوتينا العلم من قبلها وكنا مسلمين
verses.transliterated: falammā jāat qīla ahākadhā ʿarshuki qālat ka-annahu huwa waūtīnā l-ʿil'ma min qablihā wakunnā mus'limīn
verses.english: When she arrived, she was asked, "Does your mansion look like this?" She said, "It seems that this is it." (Solomon said,) "We knew beforehand what she was going to do, and we were already submitters."

1981.english: When she arrived, she was told, "Is this your mansion?" She said, "This is exactly like it." We knew in advance what she was going to do, and we were already Muslims.

1989.english: When she arrived, she was asked, “Does your mansion look like this?” She said, “It seems that this is it.” (Solomon said,) “We knew beforehand what she was going to do, and we were already Muslims.”

verses.arabic: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وصدها ما كانت تعبد من دون الله ۖ إنها كانت من قوم كافرين
verses.transliterated: waṣaddahā mā kānat taʿbudu min dūni l-lahi innahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīn
verses.english: She had been diverted by worshiping idols instead of GOD; she belonged to disbelieving people.

1981.english: The idol worship had kept her from the right guidance, and thus, she belonged with the disbelieving people.

1989.english: She had been diverted by worshiping idols instead of GOD; she belonged to disbelieving people.

verses.arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قيل لها ادخلي الصرح ۖ فلما رأته حسبته لجة وكشفت عن ساقيها ۚ قال إنه صرح ممرد من قوارير ۗ قالت رب إني ظلمت نفسي وأسلمت مع سليمان لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qīla lahā ud'khulī l-ṣarḥa falammā ra-athu ḥasibathu lujjatan wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā qāla innahu ṣarḥun mumarradun min qawārīra qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa-aslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: She was told, "Go inside the palace." When she saw its interior, she thought it was a pool of water, and she (pulled up her dress,) exposing her legs. He said, "This interior is now paved with crystal." She said, "My Lord, I have wronged my soul. I now submit with Solomon to GOD, Lord of the universe."

1981.english: She was told, "Go inside the mansion." When she saw its interior, she thought it was a pond, and uncovered her legs.* Solomon said, "This is made of reflective crystal." (When she realized that it was her mansion, moved and remodeled,) she said, "My Lord, I have wronged my soul. I submit, together with Solomon, to God, Lord of the universe."

1989.english: She was told, “Go inside the palace.” When she saw its interior, she thought it was a pool of water, and she (pulled up her dress,) exposing her legs. He said, “This interior is now paved with crystal.” She said, “My Lord, I have wronged my soul. I submit with Solomon to GOD, Lord of the universe.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا إلى ثمود أخاهم صالحا أن اعبدوا الله فإذا هم فريقان يختصمون
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani uʿ'budū l-laha fa-idhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūn
verses.english: We have sent to Thamûd their brother Sãleh, saying, "You shall worship GOD." But they turned into two feuding factions.
verses.subtitle: Sãleh

1981.english: We sent to Thamood their brother Saalih, saying, "You shall worship God." But they divided themselves into two feuding parties.
1981.subtitle: Saalih

1989.english: We have sent to Thamoud their brother Saaleh, saying, “You shall worship GOD.” Whereupon, they turned into two feuding factions.
1989.subtitle: Saaleh

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا قوم لم تستعجلون بالسيئة قبل الحسنة ۖ لولا تستغفرون الله لعلكم ترحمون
verses.transliterated: qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bil-sayi-ati qabla l-ḥasanati lawlā tastaghfirūna l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.english: He said, "O my people, why do you hasten to commit evil instead of good works? If only you implore GOD for forgiveness, you may attain mercy."

1981.english: He said, "O my people, why do you challenge me to bring doom, instead of prosperity? If only you turn to God for forgiveness, you will attain mercy."

1989.english: He said, “O my people, why do you hasten to commit evil instead of good works? You should implore GOD for forgiveness, that you may attain mercy.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا اطيرنا بك وبمن معك ۚ قال طائركم عند الله ۖ بل أنتم قوم تفتنون
verses.transliterated: qālū iṭṭayyarnā bika wabiman maʿaka qāla ṭāirukum ʿinda l-lahi bal antum qawmun tuf'tanūn
verses.english: They said, "We consider you a bad omen for us, you and those who joined you." He said, "Your omen is fully controlled by GOD. Indeed, you are deviant people."

1981.english: They said, "You and your followers are a bad omen for us." He said, "Your omen rests only with God, and you are being put to the test."

1989.english: They said, “We consider you a bad omen for us, you and those who joined you.” He said, “Your omen rests with GOD. Indeed, you are deviant people.”

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكان في المدينة تسعة رهط يفسدون في الأرض ولا يصلحون
verses.transliterated: wakāna fī l-madīnati tis'ʿatu rahṭin yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūn
verses.english: There were nine gangsters in the city who were wicked, and never did anything good.

1981.english: There was a gang of nine in the city, who were corrupt and never did any good.

1989.english: There were nine gangsters in the city who committed evil, and never did anything good.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا تقاسموا بالله لنبيتنه وأهله ثم لنقولن لوليه ما شهدنا مهلك أهله وإنا لصادقون
verses.transliterated: qālū taqāsamū bil-lahi lanubayyitannahu wa-ahlahu thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihi mā shahid'nā mahlika ahlihi wa-innā laṣādiqūn
verses.english: They said, "Let us swear by GOD that we kill him and his people, then tell his tribe, 'We know nothing about their death. We are truthful.'"

1981.english: They said, "Let us swear by God that we eliminate Saalih and his people, then say to his heirs that we never witnessed their demise, and that we are truthful."

1989.english: They said, “Let us swear by GOD that we kill him and his people, then tell his tribe, ‘We know nothing about their death. We are truthful.’ ”

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومكروا مكرا ومكرنا مكرا وهم لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: wamakarū makran wamakarnā makran wahum lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: They plotted and schemed, but we also plotted and schemed, while they did not perceive.
verses.subtitle: God Protects The Believers

1981.english: They thus schemed their schemes, but we also schemed our scheme, while they did not perceive.

1989.english: They plotted and schemed, but we also plotted and schemed, while they did not perceive.
1989.subtitle: God Protects The Believers

verses.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فانظر كيف كان عاقبة مكرهم أنا دمرناهم وقومهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: Note the consequences of their plotting; we annihilated them and all their people.

1981.english: Note the consequences of their scheming; we utterly destroyed them and their people.

1989.english: Note the consequences of their plotting; we annihilated them and all their people.

verses.arabic: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فتلك بيوتهم خاوية بما ظلموا ۗ إن في ذلك لآية لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fatil'ka buyūtuhum khāwiyatan bimā ẓalamū inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Here are their homes utterly ruined, because of their transgression. This should be a lesson for people who know.

1981.english: Their homes became empty ruins, because of their wickedness. This should be a lesson for those who know.

1989.english: Here are their homes utterly ruined, as a consequence of their transgression. This should be a lesson for people who know.

verses.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنجينا الذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-anjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūn
verses.english: We save those who believe and lead a righteous life.

1981.english: We saved those who believed and worked righteousness.

1989.english: We saved those who believed and led a righteous life.

verses.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولوطا إذ قال لقومه أتأتون الفاحشة وأنتم تبصرون
verses.transliterated: walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata wa-antum tub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Lot said to his people, "How could you commit such an abomination, publicly, while you see?
verses.subtitle: Lot

1981.english: Also Lot (was sent) to his people, saying, "How could you commit such an abomination before your eyes?
1981.subtitle: Lot

1989.english: Lot said to his people, “How could you commit such an abomination while you see?
1989.subtitle: Lot

verses.arabic: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أئنكم لتأتون الرجال شهوة من دون النساء ۚ بل أنتم قوم تجهلون
verses.transliterated: a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun tajhalūn
verses.english: "You practice sex with the men, lustfully, instead of the women. Indeed, you are ignorant people."

1981.english: "You practice sex with the men, instead of the women! Indeed, you are ignorant people."

1989.english: “You practice sex with the men, lustfully, instead of the women. Indeed, you are ignorant people.”

verses.arabic: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا أخرجوا آل لوط من قريتكم ۖ إنهم أناس يتطهرون
verses.transliterated: famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭin min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūn
verses.english: The only response from his people was their saying, "Banish Lot's family from your town; they are people who wish to be pure."

1981.english: The only response from his people was their saying, "Banish Lot and his followers from your town; they wish to be holy."

1989.english: The only response from his people was their saying, “Banish Lot’s family from your town; they are people who wish to be pure.”

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأنجيناه وأهله إلا امرأته قدرناها من الغابرين
verses.transliterated: fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnāhā mina l-ghābirīn
verses.english: Consequently, we saved him and his family, except his wife; we counted her among the doomed.

1981.english: We then saved him and his family, but not his wife; we condemned her with the doomed.

1989.english: Consequently, we saved him and his family, except his wife; we counted her among the doomed.

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأمطرنا عليهم مطرا ۖ فساء مطر المنذرين
verses.transliterated: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīn
verses.english: We showered them with a certain shower. It was a miserable shower upon people who had been warned.

1981.english: We showered them a certain shower (of stones); a miserable shower, after being forewarned.

1989.english: We showered them with a certain shower; a miserable shower upon people who had been warned.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل الحمد لله وسلام على عباده الذين اصطفى ۗ آلله خير أما يشركون
verses.transliterated: quli l-ḥamdu lillahi wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihi alladhīna iṣ'ṭafā āllahu khayrun ammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: Say, "Praise be to GOD and peace be upon His servants whom He chose. Is GOD better, or the idols some people set up?"
verses.subtitle: Make No Distinction Among God's Messengers

1981.english: Say, "Praise be to God, and peace be on His servants whom He chose. Is God better, or the idols they set up?"
1981.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

1989.english: Say, “Praise be to GOD and peace b< upon His servants whom He chose. Is GOD better, or the idols some people set up?”
1989.subtitle: Make No Distinction Among God’s Messengers

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أمن خلق السماوات والأرض وأنزل لكم من السماء ماء فأنبتنا به حدائق ذات بهجة ما كان لكم أن تنبتوا شجرها ۗ أإله مع الله ۚ بل هم قوم يعدلون
verses.transliterated: amman khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa-anzala lakum mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā bihi ḥadāiqa dhāta bahjatin mā kāna lakum an tunbitū shajarahā a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal hum qawmun yaʿdilūn
verses.english: Who is the One who created the heavens and the earth? Who is the One who sends down to you from the sky water, whereby we produce gardens full of beauty—you could not possibly manufacture its trees? Is it another god with GOD? Indeed, they are people who have deviated.
verses.subtitle: God ALONE Worthy of Worship

1981.english: Who is it that created the heavens and the earth, and sent down water from the sky? We grow with it gardens full of beauty. You could not possibly initiate the trees thereof. Is it another god besides God? Indeed, they are people who deviate.

1989.english: Who is the One who created the heavens and the earth? Who is the One who sends down to you from the sky water, whereby we produce gardens full of beauty—you could not possibly manufacture its trees? Is it another god with GOD? Indeed, they are people who deviate.
1989.subtitle: God ALONE Worthy of Worship

verses.arabic: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنْهَٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أمن جعل الأرض قرارا وجعل خلالها أنهارا وجعل لها رواسي وجعل بين البحرين حاجزا ۗ أإله مع الله ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: amman jaʿala l-arḍa qarāran wajaʿala khilālahā anhāran wajaʿala lahā rawāsiya wajaʿala bayna l-baḥrayni ḥājizan a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Who is the One who made the earth habitable, caused rivers to run through it, placed on it mountains, and created a barrier between the two waters? Is it another god with GOD? Indeed, most of them do not know.
verses.subtitle: Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, the Saints, etc. Never Participated

1981.english: Who is it that made the earth habitable, and placed rivers and stabilizers therein, and created a barrier between the two seas? Is it another god besides God? Indeed, most of them do not know.

1989.english: Who is the One who made the earth habitable, made in it rivers, placed on it mountains, and created a barrier between the two waters? Is it another god with GOD? Indeed, most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أمن يجيب المضطر إذا دعاه ويكشف السوء ويجعلكم خلفاء الأرض ۗ أإله مع الله ۚ قليلا ما تذكرون
verses.transliterated: amman yujību l-muḍ'ṭara idhā daʿāhu wayakshifu l-sūa wayajʿalukum khulafāa l-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qalīlan mā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: Who is the One who rescues those who become desperate and call upon Him, relieves adversity, and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is it another god with GOD? Rarely do you take heed.

1981.english: Who is it that answers the distressed who implore Him, relieves adversity, and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is it another god besides God? Rarely do you take heed.

1989.english: Who is the One who rescues the needy when they call upon Him, relieves adversity, and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is it another god with GOD? Rarely do you take heed.

verses.arabic: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أمن يهديكم في ظلمات البر والبحر ومن يرسل الرياح بشرا بين يدي رحمته ۗ أإله مع الله ۚ تعالى الله عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: amman yahdīkum fī ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri waman yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi taʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: Who is the One who guides you in the darkness of land and sea? Who is the One who sends the winds with good news, signaling His mercy? Is it another god with GOD? Most exalted is GOD, above having any partner.

1981.english: Who is it that guides you in the darkness of land and sea? Who is it that sends the winds with good omen and mercy from His hands? Is it another god besides God? Most exalted is God, over any partnership.

1989.english: Who is the One who guides you in the darkness of land and sea? Who is the One who sends the winds with good news, signaling His mercy? Is it another god with GOD? Most exalted is GOD, above having any partner.

verses.arabic: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أمن يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده ومن يرزقكم من السماء والأرض ۗ أإله مع الله ۚ قل هاتوا برهانكم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: amman yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu waman yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qul hātū bur'hānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Who is the One who initiates the creation, then repeats it? Who is the One who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Is it another god with GOD? Say, "Show me your proof, if you are truthful."

1981.english: Who is it that initiates the creation, then repeats it? Who is it that provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Is it another god besides God? Say, "Show us your proof, if you are truthful."

1989.english: Who is the One who initiates the creation, then repeats it? Who is the One who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Is it another god with GOD? Say, “Show me your proof, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا يعلم من في السماوات والأرض الغيب إلا الله ۚ وما يشعرون أيان يبعثون
verses.transliterated: qul lā yaʿlamu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi l-ghayba illā l-lahu wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: Say, "No one in the heavens and the earth knows the future except GOD. They do not even perceive how or when they will be resurrected."

1981.english: Say, "None knows the future in the heavens and the earth except God; nor do they perceive the manner or the time of their resurrection."

1989.english: Say, “No one in the heavens and the earth knows the future except GOD. They do not even perceive how or when they will be resurrected.”

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل ادارك علمهم في الآخرة ۚ بل هم في شك منها ۖ بل هم منها عمون
verses.transliterated: bali iddāraka ʿil'muhum fī l-ākhirati bal hum fī shakkin min'hā bal hum min'hā ʿamūn
verses.english: In fact, their knowledge concerning the Hereafter is confused. In fact, they harbor doubts about it. In fact, they are totally heedless thereof.
verses.subtitle: Believing in the Hereafter: Great Obstacle for Most People

1981.english: Indeed, their knowledge about the hereafter is nil. They are even doubtful thereof. Indeed, they are totally blind thereto.
