verses.arabicClean: قال الذين حق عليهم القول ربنا هؤلاء الذين أغوينا أغويناهم كما غوينا ۖ تبرأنا إليك ۖ ما كانوا إيانا يعبدون
verses.transliterated: qāla alladhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu rabbanā hāulāi alladhīna aghwaynā aghwaynāhum kamā ghawaynā tabarranā ilayka mā kānū iyyānā yaʿbudūn
verses.english: Those who incurred the judgment will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we misled; we misled them only because we ourselves had gone astray. We now devote ourselves totally to You. They were not really worshiping us."

1981.english: Those who have deserved the judgment would say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we misled. We only misled them because we ourselves were misled. We now disown them and surrender to You; they were not worshiping us."

1989.english: Those who incurred the judgment will say, “Our Lord, these are the ones we misled; we misled them because we ourselves were astray. We now devote ourselves totally to You. They were not really worshiping us.”

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱدْعُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَرَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقيل ادعوا شركاءكم فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم ورأوا العذاب ۚ لو أنهم كانوا يهتدون
verses.transliterated: waqīla id'ʿū shurakāakum fadaʿawhum falam yastajībū lahum wara-awū l-ʿadhāba law annahum kānū yahtadūn
verses.english: It will be said, "Call upon your idols (to help you)." They will call upon them, but they will not respond. They will suffer the retribution, and wish that they were guided!

1981.english: They will be told, "Call upon your idols (to help you)." They would call upon them, but they will not respond. They will then see the retribution, and they will wish that they had been guided.

1989.english: It will be said, “Call upon your idols (to help you).” They will call upon them, but they will not respond. They will see the retribution, and wish that they were guided!

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبْتُمُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يناديهم فيقول ماذا أجبتم المرسلين
verses.transliterated: wayawma yunādīhim fayaqūlu mādhā ajabtumu l-mur'salīn
verses.english: On that day, He will ask everyone, "How did you respond to the messengers?"
verses.subtitle: Our Response to the Messengers

1981.english: On that day, God will call on them, saying, "How did you respond to the messengers?"

1989.english: On that day, He will ask everyone, “How did you respond to the messengers?”
1989.subtitle: Our Response to the Messengers

verses.arabic: فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فعميت عليهم الأنباء يومئذ فهم لا يتساءلون
verses.transliterated: faʿamiyat ʿalayhimu l-anbāu yawma-idhin fahum lā yatasāalūn
verses.english: They will be so stunned by the facts on that day, they will be speechless.

1981.english: They will be so stunned by the news on that day, that they will not ask any questions.

1989.english: They will be so stunned by the facts on that day, they will be speechless.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأما من تاب وآمن وعمل صالحا فعسى أن يكون من المفلحين
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan faʿasā an yakūna mina l-muf'liḥīn
verses.english: As for those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life, they will end up with the winners.

1981.english: As for him who repents, believes, and works righteousness, he will be with the winners.

1989.english: The one who repented, believed, and led a righteous life will end up with the winners. God Redeems the True Believers

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وربك يخلق ما يشاء ويختار ۗ ما كان لهم الخيرة ۚ سبحان الله وتعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: warabbuka yakhluqu mā yashāu wayakhtāru mā kāna lahumu l-khiyaratu sub'ḥāna l-lahi wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: Your Lord is the One who creates whatever He wills, and chooses; no one else does any choosing. Glory be to GOD, the Most Exalted. He is far above needing partners.

1981.english: Your Lord creates whatever He wills, and chooses. None else can do the choosing. God be glorified; He is most exalted, above any partnership.

1989.english: Your Lord is the One who creates whatever He wills, and chooses; no one else does any choosing. Glory be to GOD, the Most Exalted—far above needing partners.

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وربك يعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون
verses.transliterated: warabbuka yaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿ'linūn
verses.english: Your Lord knows the innermost thoughts hidden in their chests, as well as everything they declare.

1981.english: And your Lord is fully aware of anything they hide in their chests, and anything they declare.

1989.english: For your Lord knows the innermost thoughts hidden in their chests, as well as everything they declare.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الله لا إله إلا هو ۖ له الحمد في الأولى والآخرة ۖ وله الحكم وإليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa l-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ūlā wal-ākhirati walahu l-ḥuk'mu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: He is the one GOD; there is no other god beside Him. To Him belongs all praise in this first life, and in the Hereafter. All judgment belongs with Him, and to Him you will be returned.

1981.english: And He is the One God; there is no god except He. To Him belongs all praise in the first and in the hereafter. All kingship belongs to Him, and to Him you ultimately return.

1989.english: And He is GOD; there is no other god besides Him. To Him belongs all praise in this first life, and in the Hereafter. All judgment belongs with Him, and to Him you will be returned.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن جعل الله عليكم الليل سرمدا إلى يوم القيامة من إله غير الله يأتيكم بضياء ۖ أفلا تسمعون
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in jaʿala l-lahu ʿalaykumu al-layla sarmadan ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati man ilāhun ghayru l-lahi yatīkum biḍiyāin afalā tasmaʿūn
verses.english: Say, "What if GOD made the night perpetual, until the Day of Resurrection? Which god, other than GOD, can provide you with light? Do you not hear?"
verses.subtitle: God's Blessings

1981.english: Say, "If God caused the night to become eternal for you until the day of resurrection, which god, other than God, can bring you light? Do you not hear?"

1989.english: Say, “What if GOD made the night continuous, until the Day of Resurrection? Which god, other than GOD, can bring you light? Do you not hear?”
1989.subtitle: God’s Blessings

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن جعل الله عليكم النهار سرمدا إلى يوم القيامة من إله غير الله يأتيكم بليل تسكنون فيه ۖ أفلا تبصرون
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in jaʿala l-lahu ʿalaykumu l-nahāra sarmadan ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati man ilāhun ghayru l-lahi yatīkum bilaylin taskunūna fīhi afalā tub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Say, "What if GOD made the daylight perpetual, until the Day of Resurrection? Which god, other than GOD, can provide you with a night for your rest? Do you not see?"

1981.english: Say, "If God caused the daylight to become eternal for you until the day of resurrection, which god, other than God, can bring you a night for your rest? Do you not see?"

1989.english: Say, “What if GOD made the daylight continuous, until the Day of Resurrection? Which god, other than GOD, can bring you a night for your rest? Do you not see?”

verses.arabic: وَمِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن رحمته جعل لكم الليل والنهار لتسكنوا فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wamin raḥmatihi jaʿala lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra litaskunū fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: It is mercy from Him that He created for you the night and the day in order to rest (during the night), then seek His provisions (during the day), that you may be appreciative.

1981.english: It is mercy from Him that He created the night and day, so you can rest after seeking his bounties, that you may be appreciative.

1989.english: It is mercy from Him that He created for you the night and the day in order to rest (during the night), then seek His bounties (during the day), that you may be appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يناديهم فيقول أين شركائي الذين كنتم تزعمون
verses.transliterated: wayawma yunādīhim fayaqūlu ayna shurakāiya alladhīna kuntum tazʿumūn
verses.english: The day will come when He asks them, "Where are the idols you had fabricated to rank with Me?"
verses.subtitle: Idols Possess No Power

1981.english: The day will come when God calls on them, saying, "Where are the idols you had set up besides Me?"

1989.english: The day will come when He asks them, “Where are the idols you had set up besides Me?”
1989.subtitle: Idols Possess No Such Power

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلْحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ونزعنا من كل أمة شهيدا فقلنا هاتوا برهانكم فعلموا أن الحق لله وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: wanazaʿnā min kulli ummatin shahīdan faqul'nā hātū bur'hānakum faʿalimū anna l-ḥaqa lillahi waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: We will select from every community a witness, then say, "Present your proof." They will realize then that all truth belongs with GOD, while the idols they had fabricated will abandon them.

1981.english: Then we will summon from each community a witness, and say, "Show us your proof." They will then realize that all truth belongs to God, and the idols they had invented will abandon them.

1989.english: We will select from every community a witness, then say, “Present your proof.” They will realize then that all truth belongs with GOD, while the idols they had fabricated will abandon them.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ قَٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْكُنُوزِ مَآ إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُۥ لَتَنُوٓأُ بِٱلْعُصْبَةِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُوَّةِ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ لَا تَفْرَحْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْفَرِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن قارون كان من قوم موسى فبغى عليهم ۖ وآتيناه من الكنوز ما إن مفاتحه لتنوء بالعصبة أولي القوة إذ قال له قومه لا تفرح ۖ إن الله لا يحب الفرحين
verses.transliterated: inna qārūna kāna min qawmi mūsā fabaghā ʿalayhim waātaynāhu mina l-kunūzi mā inna mafātiḥahu latanūu bil-ʿuṣ'bati ulī l-quwati idh qāla lahu qawmuhu lā tafraḥ inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-fariḥīn
verses.english: Qãroon (the slave driver) was one of Moses' people who betrayed them and oppressed them. We gave him so many treasures that the keys thereof were almost too heavy for the strongest band. His people said to him, "Do not be so arrogant; GOD does not love those who are arrogant.
verses.subtitle: Qãroon

1981.english: Qaroon was a member of Moses' clan, but he oppressed them. We endowed him with so much wealth, the keys of his treasures were almost too heavy for the strong men. His people used to tell him, "Do not be so vain, for God dislikes those who are vain."
1981.subtitle: Qaroon

1989.english: Qaaroon (the slave driver) was one of Moses’ people who betrayed them and oppressed them. We gave him so many treasures that the keys thereof were almost too heavy for the strongest of men. His people said to him, “Do not be so proud; GOD does not love the proud.
1989.subtitle: Qaaroon

verses.arabic: وَٱبْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَأَحْسِن كَمَآ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ وَلَا تَبْغِ ٱلْفَسَادَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وابتغ فيما آتاك الله الدار الآخرة ۖ ولا تنس نصيبك من الدنيا ۖ وأحسن كما أحسن الله إليك ۖ ولا تبغ الفساد في الأرض ۖ إن الله لا يحب المفسدين
verses.transliterated: wa-ib'taghi fīmā ātāka l-lahu l-dāra l-ākhirata walā tansa naṣībaka mina l-dun'yā wa-aḥsin kamā aḥsana l-lahu ilayka walā tabghi l-fasāda fī l-arḍi inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: Use the provisions bestowed upon you by GOD to seek the abode of the Hereafter, without neglecting your share in this world. Be charitable, as GOD has been charitable towards you. Do not keep on corrupting the earth. GOD does not love the corruptors.

1981.english: "And use God's blessings to you in seeking the hereafter, without necessarily neglecting your share in this life. And be charitable as God has been charitable towards you. Do not corrupt the earth, for God dislikes the corruptors."

1989.english: “And use the bounties bestowed upon you by GOD to seek the abode of the Hereafter, without neglecting your share of this world. Be charitable, as GOD has been charitable towards you, and do not seek the corruption of this earth. GOD does not love the corruptors.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِىٓ أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا وَلَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إنما أوتيته على علم عندي ۚ أولم يعلم أن الله قد أهلك من قبله من القرون من هو أشد منه قوة وأكثر جمعا ۚ ولا يسأل عن ذنوبهم المجرمون
verses.transliterated: qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min ʿindī awalam yaʿlam anna l-laha qad ahlaka min qablihi mina l-qurūni man huwa ashaddu min'hu quwwatan wa-aktharu jamʿan walā yus'alu ʿan dhunūbihimu l-muj'rimūn
verses.english: He said, "I attained all this because of my own cleverness." Did he not realize that GOD had annihilated before him generations that were much stronger than he, and greater in number? The (annihilated) transgressors were not asked about their crimes.

1981.english: He said, "I accomplished this through my cleverness." Did he not know that God has destroyed generations before him, who were more powerful, and more numerous? The guilty need not be asked about their sins.
1981.footnote: See 55:39-41 and Appendix 10.

1989.english: He said, “I attained all this by my own cleverness.” Did he not realize that GOD had annihilated before him generations that were much stronger than he, and greater in number? The (annihilated) transgressors were not asked about their crimes.

verses.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فخرج على قومه في زينته ۖ قال الذين يريدون الحياة الدنيا يا ليت لنا مثل ما أوتي قارون إنه لذو حظ عظيم
verses.transliterated: fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi fī zīnatihi qāla alladhīna yurīdūna l-ḥayata l-dun'yā yālayta lanā mith'la mā ūtiya qārūnu innahu ladhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: One day, he came out to his people in full splendor. Those who preferred this worldly life said, "Oh, we wish that we possess what Qãroon has attained. Indeed, he is very fortunate."

1981.english: One day, he went out in full splendor, and those who care about the materials of this world said, "Oh, we wish we were as lucky as Qaroon. He is really fortunate."

1989.english: One day, he came out to his people in full splendor. Those who preferred this worldly life said, “Oh, we wish that we had what Qaaroon has. Indeed, he is very fortunate.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا وَلَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين أوتوا العلم ويلكم ثواب الله خير لمن آمن وعمل صالحا ولا يلقاها إلا الصابرون
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma waylakum thawābu l-lahi khayrun liman āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan walā yulaqqāhā illā l-ṣābirūn
verses.english: As for those who were blessed with knowledge, they said, "Woe to you, GOD's recompense is far better for those who believe and lead a righteous life." None attains this except the steadfast.
verses.subtitle: The Real Wealth

1981.english: Those who possessed knowledge said, "Woe to you; God's rewards are far better for those who believe and work righteousness. None attains them except the steadfast."

1989.english: As for those who were blessed with knowledge, they said, “Woe to you, GOD’s recompense is far better for those who believe and lead a righteous life.” None attains this except the steadfast.
1989.subtitle: The Real Wealth

verses.arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فخسفنا به وبداره الأرض فما كان له من فئة ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان من المنتصرين
verses.transliterated: fakhasafnā bihi wabidārihi l-arḍa famā kāna lahu min fi-atin yanṣurūnahu min dūni l-lahi wamā kāna mina l-muntaṣirīn
verses.english: We then caused the earth to swallow him and his mansion. No army could have helped him against GOD; he was not destined to be a winner.
verses.subtitle: The Tyrants' Inevitable Fate

1981.english: Subsequently, we caused the earth to swallow Qaroon and his mansion. No army could help him against God, nor was he ever to win.

1989.english: We then caused the earth to swallow him and his mansion. No army could have helped him against GOD; he was not destined to be a winner.

verses.arabic: وَأَصْبَحَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْا۟ مَكَانَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَوْلَآ أَن مَّنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا وَيْكَأَنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأصبح الذين تمنوا مكانه بالأمس يقولون ويكأن الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر ۖ لولا أن من الله علينا لخسف بنا ۖ ويكأنه لا يفلح الكافرون
verses.transliterated: wa-aṣbaḥa alladhīna tamannaw makānahu bil-amsi yaqūlūna wayka-anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lawlā an manna l-lahu ʿalaynā lakhasafa binā wayka-annahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūn
verses.english: Those who were envious of him the day before said, "Now we realize that GOD is the One who provides for whomever He chooses from among His servants, and withholds. If it were not for GOD's grace towards us, He could have caused the earth to swallow us too. We now realize that the disbelievers never succeed."

1981.english: Those who wished to be in his place the day before said, "It seems that God is the only one who increases the provision for anyone, or withholds it. If it were not for God's grace towards us, He could have caused the earth to swallow us too. It seems that the disbelievers never succeed."

1989.english: Those who were envious of him the day before said, “Now we realize that GOD is the One who provides for whomever He wills, and withholds. If it were not for GOD’s grace, He could have caused the earth to swallow us too. We now realize that the disbelievers never succeed.”

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك الدار الآخرة نجعلها للذين لا يريدون علوا في الأرض ولا فسادا ۚ والعاقبة للمتقين
verses.transliterated: til'ka l-dāru l-ākhiratu najʿaluhā lilladhīna lā yurīdūna ʿuluwwan fī l-arḍi walā fasādan wal-ʿāqibatu lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: We reserve the abode of the Hereafter for those who do not seek exaltation on earth, nor corruption. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.
verses.subtitle: The Ultimate Winners

1981.english: We have reserved the abode of the hereafter for those who do not seek exaltation in this life, or corruption. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.

1989.english: We reserve the abode of the Hereafter for those who do not seek exaltation on earth, nor corruption. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.
1989.subtitle: The Ultimate Winners

verses.arabic: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من جاء بالحسنة فله خير منها ۖ ومن جاء بالسيئة فلا يجزى الذين عملوا السيئات إلا ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: man jāa bil-ḥasanati falahu khayrun min'hā waman jāa bil-sayi-ati falā yuj'zā alladhīna ʿamilū l-sayiāti illā mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Whoever works righteousness receives a far better reward. As for those who commit sins, the retribution for their sins is precisely equivalent to their works.

1981.english: Whoever works righteousness receives credit for more, and those who work evil are punished only for the evil they commit.

1989.english: Whoever works righteousness receives a far better reward. As for those who commit sins, the retribution for their sins is precisely equivalent to their works.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِى فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذي فرض عليك القرآن لرادك إلى معاد ۚ قل ربي أعلم من جاء بالهدى ومن هو في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: inna alladhī faraḍa ʿalayka l-qur'āna larādduka ilā maʿādin qul rabbī aʿlamu man jāa bil-hudā waman huwa fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Surely, the One who decreed the Quran for you will summon you to a predetermined appointment. Say, "My Lord is fully aware of those who uphold the guidance, and those who have gone astray."

1981.english: Surely, the one who decreed the Quran for you, will bring you back at a predetermined time. Say, "My Lord is fully aware of those who follow the right guidance, and those who have gone astray."

1989.english: Surely, the One who decreed the Quran for you will summon you to a predetermined appointment. Say, “My Lord is fully aware of those who uphold the guidance, and those who have gone astray.”

verses.arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوٓا۟ أَن يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كنت ترجو أن يلقى إليك الكتاب إلا رحمة من ربك ۖ فلا تكونن ظهيرا للكافرين
verses.transliterated: wamā kunta tarjū an yul'qā ilayka l-kitābu illā raḥmatan min rabbika falā takūnanna ẓahīran lil'kāfirīn
verses.english: You never expected this scripture to come your way; but this is a mercy from your Lord. Therefore, you shall not side with the disbelievers.

1981.english: You never expected to receive the scripture, but it is mercy from your Lord. Therefore, do not be defender of the disbelievers.

1989.english: You did not hope to have this scripture come your way; but this is a mercy from your Lord. Do not be of any help to the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يصدنك عن آيات الله بعد إذ أنزلت إليك ۖ وادع إلى ربك ۖ ولا تكونن من المشركين
verses.transliterated: walā yaṣuddunnaka ʿan āyāti l-lahi baʿda idh unzilat ilayka wa-ud'ʿu ilā rabbika walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: Nor shall you be diverted from GOD's revelations, after they have come to you, and invite the others to your Lord. And do not ever fall into idol worship.

1981.english: Nor shall you be diverted from the revelations of God, after being revealed to you. You shall invite others to come to your Lord, and never fall into idol worship.

1989.english: Nor shall you be diverted from GOD’s revelations, after they have come to you and invite the others to your Lord. And do not be an idol worshiper.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُۥ لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تدع مع الله إلها آخر ۘ لا إله إلا هو ۚ كل شيء هالك إلا وجهه ۚ له الحكم وإليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: walā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā ilāha illā huwa kullu shayin hālikun illā wajhahu lahu l-ḥuk'mu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: You shall not worship beside GOD any other god. There is no other god beside Him. Everything perishes except His presence. To Him belongs all sovereignty, and to Him you will be returned.

1981.english: You shall never call on any other god besides God. There is no god except He. Everything perishes except His countenance. To Him belongs all the command, and to Him you will be returned.

1989.english: You shall not worship besides GOD any other god. There is no other god besides Him. Everything perishes except His presence. To Him belongs all kingship, and to Him you will be returned.

verses.arabic: الٓمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الم
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-meem
verses.english: A. L. M.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for details of the Quran's mathematical composition, and the meaning of these previously mysterious Quranic Initials.

1981.english: A. L. M.
1981.footnote: These letters constitute a significant part of the Quran's miraculous numerical code, and physically and indisputably prove that the Quran is God's message to the world. See Appendix 1 for details.

1989.english: A. L. M.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1 for details of the Quran’s mathematical composition, and the meaning of these previously mysterious Quranic Initials.

verses.arabic: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أحسب الناس أن يتركوا أن يقولوا آمنا وهم لا يفتنون
verses.transliterated: aḥasiba l-nāsu an yut'rakū an yaqūlū āmannā wahum lā yuf'tanūn
verses.english: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe," without being put to the test?
verses.subtitle: The Test is Mandatory

1981.english: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe," without being put to the test?

1989.english: Do the people think that they will be left to say, “We believe,” without being tested?
1989.subtitle: The Test is Inevitable

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد فتنا الذين من قبلهم ۖ فليعلمن الله الذين صدقوا وليعلمن الكاذبين
verses.transliterated: walaqad fatannā alladhīna min qablihim falayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna ṣadaqū walayaʿlamanna l-kādhibīn
verses.english: We have tested those before them, for GOD must distinguish those who are truthful, and He must expose the liars.

1981.english: We have tested the generations before them, for God must distinguish those who are truthful from those who are liars.

1989.english: We have tested those before them, for GOD must distinguish those who are truthful, and He must expose the liars.

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم حسب الذين يعملون السيئات أن يسبقونا ۚ ساء ما يحكمون
verses.transliterated: am ḥasiba alladhīna yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti an yasbiqūnā sāa mā yaḥkumūn
verses.english: Do those who commit sins think that they can ever fool us? Wrong indeed is their judgment.

1981.english: Or, do those who commit evil think that they will get away from us? How wrong is their notion!

1989.english: Or, do those who commit sins think that they can fool us? Bad indeed is their judgment.

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَءَاتٍ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: من كان يرجو لقاء الله فإن أجل الله لآت ۚ وهو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: man kāna yarjū liqāa l-lahi fa-inna ajala l-lahi laātin wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: Anyone hoping to meet GOD, (should know that) such a meeting with GOD will most assuredly come to pass. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: If anyone is looking forward to the meeting with God, such predetermined audience will certainly come to pass. God is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: Anyone hoping to meet GOD, (should know that) such a meeting with GOD will most assuredly come to pass. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن جاهد فإنما يجاهد لنفسه ۚ إن الله لغني عن العالمين
verses.transliterated: waman jāhada fa-innamā yujāhidu linafsihi inna l-laha laghaniyyun ʿani l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Those who strive, strive for their own good. GOD is in no need for anyone.

1981.english: Whoever strives is only striving for his own good; God is in no need for anyone.

1989.english: Those who strive, strive for their own good. GOD does not need anyone.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لنكفرن عنهم سيئاتهم ولنجزينهم أحسن الذي كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiātihim walanajziyannahum aḥsana alladhī kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will certainly remit their sins, and will certainly reward them generously for their righteous works.

1981.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will certainly remit their sins, and reward them manyfold for their works.

1989.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will certainly remit their sins, and reward them generously for their righteous works.

verses.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حسنا ۖ وإن جاهداك لتشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما ۚ إلي مرجعكم فأنبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥus'nan wa-in jāhadāka litush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. But if they try to force you to set up idols beside Me, do not obey them. To Me is your ultimate return, then I will inform you of everything you had done.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Honor Your Parents

1981.english: We enjoined the humans to honor their parents. However, if they exhort you to idolize besides Me what you do not recognize, then do not obey them. To Me alone is your final return, then I alone will inform you of everything you had done.

1989.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. But if they try to force you to set up idols besides Me, do not obey them. To Me is your ultimate return, then I will inform you of everything you had done.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Honor Your Parents

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لندخلنهم في الصالحين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanud'khilannahum fī l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will certainly admit them with the righteous.

1981.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will certainly admit them with the righteous.

1989.english: Those who believed and led a righteous life, we will admit them with the righteous. Fair Weather Friends

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الناس من يقول آمنا بالله فإذا أوذي في الله جعل فتنة الناس كعذاب الله ولئن جاء نصر من ربك ليقولن إنا كنا معكم ۚ أوليس الله بأعلم بما في صدور العالمين
verses.transliterated: wamina l-nāsi man yaqūlu āmannā bil-lahi fa-idhā ūdhiya fī l-lahi jaʿala fit'nata l-nāsi kaʿadhābi l-lahi wala-in jāa naṣrun min rabbika layaqūlunna innā kunnā maʿakum awalaysa l-lahu bi-aʿlama bimā fī ṣudūri l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Among the people there are those who say, "We believe in GOD," but as soon as they suffer any hardship because of GOD, they equate the people's persecution with GOD's retribution. But if blessings from your Lord come your way, they say, "We were with you." Is GOD not fully aware of the people's innermost thoughts?
verses.subtitle: Fair Weather Friends

1981.english: Among the people there are those who say, "We believe in God," but if they ever suffer in the cause of God, they equate the people's persecution with God's retribution. And when victory comes from your Lord, they say, "We were with you." Is God not fully aware of the people's innermost thoughts?

1989.english: Among the people there are those who say, “We believe in GOD,” but as soon as they suffer any hardship because of GOD, they equate the people’s persecution with GOD’s retribution. And if victory from your Lord comes your way, they say, “We were with you.” Is GOD not fully aware of the people’s innermost thoughts?

verses.arabic: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وليعلمن الله الذين آمنوا وليعلمن المنافقين
verses.transliterated: walayaʿlamanna l-lahu alladhīna āmanū walayaʿlamanna l-munāfiqīn
verses.english: GOD will most certainly distinguish those who believe, and He will most certainly expose the hypocrites.

1981.english: God will certainly distinguish the believers and the hypocrites.

1989.english: GOD will surely distinguish those who believed, and He will surely expose the hypocrites.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا للذين آمنوا اتبعوا سبيلنا ولنحمل خطاياكم وما هم بحاملين من خطاياهم من شيء ۖ إنهم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ittabiʿū sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum wamā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum min shayin innahum lakādhibūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieved said to those who believed, "If you follow our way, we will be responsible for your sins." Not true; they cannot bear any of their sins. They are liars.

1981.english: Those who disbelieved would say to the believers, "Follow our path, and we will carry your sins." They can never carry any of their sins; they are liars.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved said to those who believed, “If you follow our way, we will be responsible for your sins.” Not true; they cannot bear any of their sins. They are liars.

verses.arabic: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وليحملن أثقالهم وأثقالا مع أثقالهم ۖ وليسألن يوم القيامة عما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: walayaḥmilunna athqālahum wa-athqālan maʿa athqālihim walayus'alunna yawma l-qiyāmati ʿammā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: In fact, they will carry their own sins, in addition to loads of other people's sins for which they were responsible. Most certainly, they will be asked on the Day of Resurrection about their false claims.

1981.english: Indeed, they will carry their own loads, in addition to other loads besides their loads, and they will be held answerable, on the day of resurrection, for all their inventions.
1981.footnote: There are literally hundreds of "**Hadiths**" that "guarantee" salvation, regardless of one's deeds. These include for example the recitation of specific portions of Quran a specific number of times. The inventors of these lies will certainly perish in hell.

1989.english: In fact, they will be burdened by their own sins, plus loads of other people’s sins for which they were responsible. On the Day of Resurrection, they will be asked about their claims.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه فلبث فيهم ألف سنة إلا خمسين عاما فأخذهم الطوفان وهم ظالمون
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi falabitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāman fa-akhadhahumu l-ṭūfānu wahum ẓālimūn
verses.english: We sent Noah to his people, and he stayed with them one thousand years, less fifty. Subsequently, they incurred the flood because of their transgressions.
verses.subtitle: Noah
verses.footnote: Since the Quran's miracle is mathematical, the numbers especially constitute an important part of the 19-based code. Thus, the numbers mentioned in the Quran add up to 162146, or 19x8534 (see Appendix 1 for the details).

1981.english: We have sent Noah to his people, and he lived among them one thousand years less fifty,* then the flood annihilated them because of their wickedness.
1981.footnote: See footnote 7:142.

1989.english: We sent Noah to his people, and he stayed with them one thousand years, less fifty.* They incurred the flood, due to their transgressions.
1989.subtitle: Noah
1989.footnote: Since the Quran’s miracle is mathematical, the numbers especially constitute ar. important part of the 19-based code. Thus, the numbers mentioned in the Quran adc up to 162146, or 19x8534 (see Appendix 1 for the details).

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأنجيناه وأصحاب السفينة وجعلناها آية للعالمين
verses.transliterated: fa-anjaynāhu wa-aṣḥāba l-safīnati wajaʿalnāhā āyatan lil'ʿālamīn
verses.english: We saved him and those who accompanied him in the ark, and we set it up as a lesson for all the people.

1981.english: We delivered him and those who accompanied him in the ark, and we set this up as a lesson for the world.

1989.english: We saved him and those in the ark, and we made it a sign for all the people.

verses.arabic: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإبراهيم إذ قال لقومه اعبدوا الله واتقوه ۖ ذلكم خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-ib'rāhīma idh qāla liqawmihi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu dhālikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: Abraham said to his people, "You shall worship GOD, and reverence Him. This is better for you, if you only knew.
verses.subtitle: Abraham

1981.english: And Abraham went to his people, saying, "Worship God and observe Him. This is better for you, if you only knew."

1989.english: Abraham said to his people, “You shall worship GOD, and reverence Him. This is better for you, if you only knew.
1989.subtitle: Abraham

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما تعبدون من دون الله أوثانا وتخلقون إفكا ۚ إن الذين تعبدون من دون الله لا يملكون لكم رزقا فابتغوا عند الله الرزق واعبدوه واشكروا له ۖ إليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: innamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi awthānan watakhluqūna if'kan inna alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi lā yamlikūna lakum riz'qan fa-ib'taghū ʿinda l-lahi l-riz'qa wa-uʿ'budūhu wa-ush'kurū lahu ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: "What you worship instead of GOD are powerless idols; you have invented a lie." The idols you worship beside GOD do not possess any provisions for you. Therefore, you shall seek provisions only from GOD. You shall worship Him alone, and be appreciative of Him; to Him is your ultimate return.
verses.subtitle: God: The Only Source of Provisions

1981.english: What you idolize besides God are idols of your creation. Whatever idols you set up possess no provision for you. Therefore, seek the provisions only from God, and worship Him alone, and be appreciative of Him. To Him you will be returned.

1989.english: “You only worship besides GOD powerless idols, and you invent a lie.” The idols you worship besides GOD do not possess any provisions for you. Therefore, you shall seek provisions only from GOD. You shall worship Him alone, and be appreciative of Him; to Him is your ultimate return. Sole Function of the Messenger

verses.arabic: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن تكذبوا فقد كذب أمم من قبلكم ۖ وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ المبين
verses.transliterated: wa-in tukadhibū faqad kadhaba umamun min qablikum wamā ʿalā l-rasūli illā l-balāghu l-mubīn
verses.english: If you disbelieve, generations before you have also disbelieved. The sole function of the messenger is to deliver (the message).

1981.english: If you disbelieve, so did many generations before you. The messenger's sole mission is to deliver (the message).
1981.subtitle: Role Of the Messenger

1989.english: If you disbelieve, generations before you have also disbelieved. The sole function of the messenger is to deliver (the message).
1989.subtitle: Only One Source of Provisions

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا كيف يبدئ الله الخلق ثم يعيده ۚ إن ذلك على الله يسير
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw kayfa yub'di-u l-lahu l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīru
verses.english: Have they not seen how GOD initiates the creation, then repeats it? This is easy for GOD to do.
verses.subtitle: Study the Origin of Life
verses.footnote: We learn from the Quran that evolution is a divinely guided process. See Appendix 31 for the details.

1981.english: Do they not see how God initiates the creation, then repeats it? This is easy for God to do.

1989.english: Have they not seen how GOD initiates the creation, then repeats it? This is easy for GOD to do.
1989.subtitle: Study the Origin of Life
1989.footnote: We learn from the Quran that evolution within a given species is a divinely guided process. See Appendix 31 for the details.

verses.arabic: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل سيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف بدأ الخلق ۚ ثم الله ينشئ النشأة الآخرة ۚ إن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa bada-a l-khalqa thumma l-lahu yunshi-u l-nashata l-ākhirata inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Say, "Roam the earth and find out the origin of life." For GOD will thus initiate the creation in the Hereafter. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Say, "Travel the earth and see how the creation was started. God will also initiate the recreation in the hereafter. God is omnipotent."

1989.english: Say, “Roam the earth and find out the origin of life.”* Similarly, GOD will initiate the creation in the Hereafter. GOD is Omnipotent.
1989.footnote: We learn from the Quran that evolution within a given species is a divinely guided process. See Appendix 31 for the details.

verses.arabic: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يعذب من يشاء ويرحم من يشاء ۖ وإليه تقلبون
verses.transliterated: yuʿadhibu man yashāu wayarḥamu man yashāu wa-ilayhi tuq'labūn
verses.english: He condemns to retribution whomever He wills, and showers His mercy upon whomever He wills. Ultimately, to Him you will be turned over.

1981.english: He punishes whomever He wills, and showers mercy upon whomever He wills. To Him you are finally turned over.

1989.english: He will then condemn to retribution whomever He wills, and will shower His mercy upon whomever He wills; to Him is your ultimate destiny.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما أنتم بمعجزين في الأرض ولا في السماء ۖ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: None of you can escape from these facts, on earth or in the heaven, and you have none beside GOD as a Lord and Master.

1981.english: You can never escape, on earth or in the heaven, nor do you have any lord or supporter besides God.

1989.english: None of you can avoid this, on earth or in the heaven, and you have none besides GOD as Lord and Master.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا بآيات الله ولقائه أولئك يئسوا من رحمتي وأولئك لهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi waliqāihi ulāika ya-isū min raḥmatī wa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Those who disbelieve in GOD's revelations, and in meeting Him, have despaired from My mercy. They have incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Those who disbelieved in God's revelations, and in meeting Him, have despaired from My mercy; they have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved in GOD’s revelations, and in meeting Him, have despaired from My mercy. They have incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا اقتلوه أو حرقوه فأنجاه الله من النار ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū uq'tulūhu aw ḥarriqūhu fa-anjāhu l-lahu mina l-nāri inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: The only response from his people was their saying, "Kill him, or burn him." But GOD saved him from the fire. This should provide lessons for people who believe.
verses.subtitle: Back to Abraham

1981.english: The only response from Abraham's people was their saying, "Kill him, or burn him." But God saved him from the fire. These should be lessons for people who believe.

1989.english: The only response from his people was their saying, “Kill him, or burn him.” But GOD saved him from the fire. This should provide lessons for people who believe.
1989.subtitle: Back to Abraham

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال إنما اتخذتم من دون الله أوثانا مودة بينكم في الحياة الدنيا ۖ ثم يوم القيامة يكفر بعضكم ببعض ويلعن بعضكم بعضا ومأواكم النار وما لكم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: waqāla innamā ittakhadhtum min dūni l-lahi awthānan mawaddata baynikum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yakfuru baʿḍukum bibaʿḍin wayalʿanu baʿḍukum baʿḍan wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: He said, "You worship beside GOD powerless idols due to peer pressure, just to preserve some friendship among you in this worldly life. But then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will disown one another, and curse one another. Your destiny is Hell, wherein you cannot help one another."
verses.subtitle: Social Pressure: A Profound Disaster

1981.english: Abraham said, "You keep on idolizing these idols only to maintain each others' friendship in this life. However, on the day of resurrection you will disown each other, and curse one another. Your final abode is hell, and you will find no supporters."

1989.english: He said, “You worship besides GOD powerless idols due to peer pressure, just to preserve some friendship among you in this lowly life. But then, on the Day of Resurrection you will disown one another, and curse one another. Your destiny is Hell, wherein you cannot help one another.”
1989.subtitle: Social Pressure: A Profound Disaster

verses.arabic: فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌ وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: فآمن له لوط ۘ وقال إني مهاجر إلى ربي ۖ إنه هو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: faāmana lahu lūṭun waqāla innī muhājirun ilā rabbī innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: Lot believed with him and said, "I am emigrating to my Lord. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise."

1981.english: Among the believers was Lot. He said, "I will flee to my Lord; He is the almighty, the wise."

1989.english: Lot believed with him and said, “I am emigrating to my Lord. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.”

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَجْرَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ووهبنا له إسحاق ويعقوب وجعلنا في ذريته النبوة والكتاب وآتيناه أجره في الدنيا ۖ وإنه في الآخرة لمن الصالحين
verses.transliterated: wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihi l-nubuwata wal-kitāba waātaynāhu ajrahu fī l-dun'yā wa-innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: We granted him Isaac and Jacob, we assigned to his descendants prophethood and the scriptures, we endowed him with his due recompense in this life, and in the Hereafter he will surely be with the righteous.

1981.english: And to Abraham we granted Isaac and Jacob, and we endowed him with prophethood and the scripture. We gave him his recompense in this life, and in the hereafter he will be with the righteous.

1989.english: We granted him (Abraham) Isaac and Jacob, we assigned to his descendants prophethood and scriptures, we endowed him with his recompense in this life, and in the Hereafter he will surely be with the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولوطا إذ قال لقومه إنكم لتأتون الفاحشة ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين
verses.transliterated: walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi innakum latatūna l-fāḥishata mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadin mina l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Lot said to his people, "You commit such an abomination, no one in the world has ever done it before you.
verses.subtitle: Lot

1981.english: And (we sent) Lot to his people, saying, "You commit such an abomination; no one else has committed this.

1989.english: Lot said to his people, “You commit such an abomination, no one in the world has ever done it before you.
1989.subtitle: Lot

verses.arabic: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أئنكم لتأتون الرجال وتقطعون السبيل وتأتون في ناديكم المنكر ۖ فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا ائتنا بعذاب الله إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla wataqṭaʿūna l-sabīla watatūna fī nādīkumu l-munkara famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū i'tinā biʿadhābi l-lahi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: "You practice sex with the men, you commit highway robbery, and you allow all kinds of vice in your society." The only response from his people was to say, "Bring to us GOD's retribution, if you are truthful."

1981.english: "You practice sex with the men, commit highway robbery, and work evil in your society." The only response his people gave him was, "Bring God's doom, if you are truthful."

1989.english: “You practice sex with the men, you commit highway robbery, and you allow all kinds of vice in your society.” The only response from his people was to say, “Bring to us GOD’s retribution, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب انصرني على القوم المفسدين
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi unṣur'nī ʿalā l-qawmi l-muf'sidīn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory over these wicked people."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory over these wicked people."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, give me victory over the wicked people.”

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓا۟ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما جاءت رسلنا إبراهيم بالبشرى قالوا إنا مهلكو أهل هذه القرية ۖ إن أهلها كانوا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: walammā jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū innā muh'likū ahli hādhihi l-qaryati inna ahlahā kānū ẓālimīn
verses.english: When our messengers went to Abraham with good news (about Isaac's birth), they also said, "We are on our way to annihilate the people of that town (Sodom). For its people have been wicked."
verses.subtitle: Angels Visit Abraham and Lot

1981.english: And when our messengers went to Abraham with the good news (of Isaac's birth), they said, "We will destroy that community (of Sodom), for the people therein are wicked."

1989.english: When our messengers went to Abraham with good news (about Isaac’s birth), they also said, “We are on our way to annihilate the people of that town (Sodom), for its people have been wicked.”
1989.subtitle: Angels Visit Abraham and Lot

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إن فيها لوطا ۚ قالوا نحن أعلم بمن فيها ۖ لننجينه وأهله إلا امرأته كانت من الغابرين
verses.transliterated: qāla inna fīhā lūṭan qālū naḥnu aʿlamu biman fīhā lanunajjiyannahu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu kānat mina l-ghābirīn
verses.english: He said, "But Lot is living there." They said, "We are fully aware of everyone who lives in it. We will of course save him and his family, except his wife; she is doomed."

1981.english: Abraham said, "But Lot lives there." They said, "We are fully aware who lives there. Certainly, we will save him and his family, but not his wife; she is doomed."

1989.english: He said, “But Lot is in it.” They said, “We are fully aware of everyone in it. We will of course save him and his family, but not his wife; she is doomed.”

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولما أن جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا وقالوا لا تخف ولا تحزن ۖ إنا منجوك وأهلك إلا امرأتك كانت من الغابرين
verses.transliterated: walammā an jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqālū lā takhaf walā taḥzan innā munajjūka wa-ahlaka illā im'ra-ataka kānat mina l-ghābirīn
verses.english: When our messengers arrived at Lot's place, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed by their presence. But they said, "Have no fear, and do not worry. We will save you and your family, except your wife; she is doomed.

1981.english: And when our messengers went to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed in their presence. But they said, "Have no fear, nor worry; we will save you and your family except your wife; she is doomed.

1989.english: And when our messengers arrived at Lot’s place, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed as a result of their presence. But they said, “Have no fear, and do not worry. We will save you and your family, except your wife; she is doomed.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا منزلون على أهل هذه القرية رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون
verses.transliterated: innā munzilūna ʿalā ahli hādhihi l-qaryati rij'zan mina l-samāi bimā kānū yafsuqūn
verses.english: "We will pour upon the people of this town a disaster from the sky, as a consequence of their wickedness."

1981.english: "We will smite this community with disaster from the sky, due to their wickedness."

1989.english: “We will pour upon the people of this town a disaster from the sky, due to their wickedness.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد تركنا منها آية بينة لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: walaqad taraknā min'hā āyatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: We left standing some of their ruins, to serve as a profound lesson for people who understand.

1981.english: We have left some of the ruins thereof as a profound lesson for those who understand.

1989.english: We left some of their ruins to serve as a profound lesson for people who understand.

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى مدين أخاهم شعيبا فقال يا قوم اعبدوا الله وارجوا اليوم الآخر ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ir'jū l-yawma l-ākhira walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīn
verses.english: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, "O my people, you shall worship GOD and seek the Last Day, and do not roam the earth corruptingly."
verses.subtitle: Shu'aib

1981.english: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, "O my people, worship God, seek the last day, and do not corrupt the earth."

1989.english: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, “O my people, you shall worship GOD and seek the Last Day, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.”
1989.subtitle: Shu'aib

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فكذبوه فأخذتهم الرجفة فأصبحوا في دارهم جاثمين
verses.transliterated: fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhathumu l-rajfatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīn
verses.english: They disbelieved him and, consequently, the earthquake annihilated them; they were left dead in their homes by morning.

1981.english: Because they disbelieved him, the quake struck them, leaving them dead in their homes.

1989.english: They disbelieved him and, consequently, the earthquake annihilated them; they were left dead in their homes by morning.

verses.arabic: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وعادا وثمود وقد تبين لكم من مساكنهم ۖ وزين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم فصدهم عن السبيل وكانوا مستبصرين
verses.transliterated: waʿādan wathamūdā waqad tabayyana lakum min masākinihim wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli wakānū mus'tabṣirīn
verses.english: Similarly, 'Ãd and Thamûd (were annihilated). This is made manifest to you through their ruins. The devil had adorned their works in their eyes, and had diverted them from the path, even though they had eyes.

1981.english: Similarly, 'Aad and Thamood; you have seen their ruins. The devil had adorned their works in their eyes and diverted them from the path, despite all the warnings to them.

1989.english: Similarly, Aad and Thamoud (were annihilated). This is made manifest to you through their ruins. The devil had adorned their works in their eyes, and diverted them from the path, even though they had eyes.

verses.arabic: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقارون وفرعون وهامان ۖ ولقد جاءهم موسى بالبينات فاستكبروا في الأرض وما كانوا سابقين
verses.transliterated: waqārūna wafir'ʿawna wahāmāna walaqad jāahum mūsā bil-bayināti fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi wamā kānū sābiqīn
verses.english: Also Qãroon, Pharaoh, and Hãmãn; Moses went to them with clear signs. But they continued to commit tyranny on earth. Consequently, they could not evade (the retribution).
verses.subtitle: God's Immutable System

1981.english: Also Qaroon, Pharaoh, and Haamaan. Moses went to them with clear signs, but they were too arrogant and could not get away with it.

1989.english: Also Qaaroon, Pharaoh, and Hamaan; Moses went to them with clear signs, but they turned arrogant on earth. They could not escape.
1989.subtitle: God’s Unchangeable System

verses.arabic: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فكلا أخذنا بذنبه ۖ فمنهم من أرسلنا عليه حاصبا ومنهم من أخذته الصيحة ومنهم من خسفنا به الأرض ومنهم من أغرقنا ۚ وما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: fakullan akhadhnā bidhanbihi famin'hum man arsalnā ʿalayhi ḥāṣiban wamin'hum man akhadhathu l-ṣayḥatu wamin'hum man khasafnā bihi l-arḍa wamin'hum man aghraqnā wamā kāna l-lahu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: All those disbelievers were doomed as a consequence of their sins. Some of them we annihilated by violent winds, some were annihilated by the quake, some we caused the earth to swallow, and some we drowned. GOD is not the One who wronged them; it is they who wronged their own souls.

1981.english: Each of these we punished for their sins. Some we afflicted with a violent storm, some were struck by the quake, some were swallowed by the earth, and some we drowned. It is not God who wronged them; it is they who wronged themselves.

1989.english: All those disbelievers were doomed as a consequence of their sins. Some of them we annihilated by violent winds, some were annihilated by the quake, some we caused the earth to swallow, and some we drowned. GOD is not the One who wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their souls.

verses.arabic: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: مثل الذين اتخذوا من دون الله أولياء كمثل العنكبوت اتخذت بيتا ۖ وإن أوهن البيوت لبيت العنكبوت ۖ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: mathalu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa kamathali l-ʿankabūti ittakhadhat baytan wa-inna awhana l-buyūti labaytu l-ʿankabūti law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: The allegory of those who accept other masters beside GOD is that of the spider and her home; the flimsiest of all homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
verses.subtitle: The Spider
verses.footnote: It takes a knowledgeable person to know that the Black Widow spider kills her mate. The use of the feminine reference to the spider in 29:41 is thus significant. This is in addition to the fact that the spider web is physically very flimsy.

1981.english: The example of those who set up idols besides God is like those who take refuge in the female spider's home. The least trustworthy home is that of the female spider, if they only knew."
1981.footnote: Those who are knowledgeable in entomology know that the black widow spider kills her mate after mating. Thus, the spider web is really a death trap for the male. Note that the spider mentioned in verse 41 is female and that verse 43 states that only the knowledgeable can appreciate such an example. These entomological facts were not known at the time of Quran's revelation.

1989.english: The allegory of those who accept other masters besides GOD is that of the spider and her home; the flimsiest of all homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.*
1989.subtitle: The Spider
1989.footnote: It takes a knowledgeable person to know that the Black Widow spider kills her mate. The use of the feminine reference to the spider in 29:41 is thus significant.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يعلم ما يدعون من دونه من شيء ۚ وهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yadʿūna min dūnihi min shayin wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: GOD knows full well that whatever they worship besides Him are really nothing. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.

1981.english: God knows that the idols they set up besides Him are powerless, while He is the almighty, the wise.
1981.footnote: Those who are knowledgeable in entomology know that the black widow spider kills her mate after mating. Thus, the spider web is really a death trap for the male. Note that the spider mentioned in verse 41 is female and that verse 43 states that only the knowledgeable can appreciate such an example. These entomological facts were not known at the time of Quran's revelation.

1989.english: GOD knows full well that whatever they worship besides Him are really nothing. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
1989.footnote: It takes a knowledgeable person to know that the Black Widow spider kills her mate. The use of the feminine reference to the spider in 29:41 is thus significant.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وتلك الأمثال نضربها للناس ۖ وما يعقلها إلا العالمون
verses.transliterated: watil'ka l-amthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi wamā yaʿqiluhā illā l-ʿālimūn
verses.english: We cite these examples for the people, and none appreciate them except the knowledgeable.

1981.english: We cite these examples for the people, and only the knowledgeable can appreciate them.
1981.footnote: Those who are knowledgeable in entomology know that the black widow spider kills her mate after mating. Thus, the spider web is really a death trap for the male. Note that the spider mentioned in verse 41 is female and that verse 43 states that only the knowledgeable can appreciate such an example. These entomological facts were not known at the time of Quran's revelation.

1989.english: We cite these examples for the people, and none appreciate them except the knowledgeable.*
1989.footnote: It takes a knowledgeable person to know that the Black Widow spider kills her mate. The use of the feminine reference to the spider in 29:41 is thus significant.

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: خلق الله السماوات والأرض بالحق ۚ إن في ذلك لآية للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: khalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: GOD created the heavens and the earth, truthfully. This provides a sufficient proof for the believers.

1981.english: God is the one who created the heavens and the earth, truthfully; this is a lesson for the believers.

1989.english: GOD created the heavens and the earth, truthfully. This is a sign for the believers. The Contact Prayers (Salat)

verses.arabic: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: اتل ما أوحي إليك من الكتاب وأقم الصلاة ۖ إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر ۗ ولذكر الله أكبر ۗ والله يعلم ما تصنعون
verses.transliterated: ut'lu mā ūḥiya ilayka mina l-kitābi wa-aqimi l-ṣalata inna l-ṣalata tanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari waladhik'ru l-lahi akbaru wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā taṣnaʿūn
verses.english: You shall recite what is revealed to you of the scripture, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), for the Contact Prayers prohibit evil and vice. But the remembrance of GOD (through Salat) is the most important objective. GOD knows everything you do.
verses.subtitle: The Contact Prayers (Salat)
verses.footnote: Your god is whatever occupies your mind most of the time (see 20:14 & Appendix 27).

1981.english: You shall recite what is revealed to you of the scripture,* and observe the **salat** prayers. For **salat** protects from falling in sin and evil and is the means for remembering God, which is even greater. God is fully aware of everything you do.
1981.footnote: This proves that the Quran was revealed to each one of us, and that we were all represented by the prophet Muhammad when he received the Quran. See 18:27-28, 33:21, 42:51, and Appendix 11.

1989.english: Recite what is revealed to you of the scripture, and observe the contact prayers (Salat). The contact prayers (Salat) will help you avoid evil works and vice. But the remembrance of GOD (through Salat) is the most important thing.* GOD knows everything you do.
1989.footnote: Your god is whatever occupies your mind most of the time (see Appendix 27).

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تجادلوا أهل الكتاب إلا بالتي هي أحسن إلا الذين ظلموا منهم ۖ وقولوا آمنا بالذي أنزل إلينا وأنزل إليكم وإلهنا وإلهكم واحد ونحن له مسلمون
verses.transliterated: walā tujādilū ahla l-kitābi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu illā alladhīna ẓalamū min'hum waqūlū āmannā bi-alladhī unzila ilaynā wa-unzila ilaykum wa-ilāhunā wa-ilāhukum wāḥidun wanaḥnu lahu mus'limūn
verses.english: Do not argue with the people of the scripture (Jews, Christians, & Muslims) except in the nicest possible manner—unless they transgress— and say, "We believe in what was revealed to us and in what was revealed to you, and our god and your god is one and the same; to Him we are submitters."
verses.subtitle: One God/One Religion

1981.english: Do not argue with the people of the scripture except in the best manner, unless they treat you unjustly. And say, "We believe in what was sent down to us, and what was sent down to you; our God and your God is one and the same; to Him we submit."

1989.english: Do not argue with the people of the scripture (Jews and Christians) except in the nicest possible manner—unless they transgress—and say, “We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you, and our god and your god is one and the same; to Him we are Muslims.”
1989.subtitle: One God/One Religion

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَمِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك أنزلنا إليك الكتاب ۚ فالذين آتيناهم الكتاب يؤمنون به ۖ ومن هؤلاء من يؤمن به ۚ وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا الكافرون
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba fa-alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yu'minūna bihi wamin hāulāi man yu'minu bihi wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-kāfirūn
verses.english: We have revealed to you this scripture, and those whom we blessed with the previous scripture will believe in it. Also, some of your people will believe in it. Indeed, those who disregard our revelations are the real disbelievers.

1981.english: We have revealed to you this scripture; and those who received previous scripture shall believe in this. Some of them do believe; and only the disbelievers will ignore our revelations.

1989.english: We have revealed to you this scripture, and those whom we blessed with the previous scripture will believe in it. Also, some of your people will believe in it. As for those who disregard our revelations, they are the real disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كنت تتلو من قبله من كتاب ولا تخطه بيمينك ۖ إذا لارتاب المبطلون
verses.transliterated: wamā kunta tatlū min qablihi min kitābin walā takhuṭṭuhu biyamīnika idhan la-ir'tāba l-mub'ṭilūn
verses.english: You did not read the previous scriptures, nor did you write them with your hand. In that case, the rejectors would have had reason to harbor doubts.
verses.subtitle: Quran: Muhammad's Miracle
verses.footnote: It was the will of the Most Wise to separate the Quran from its awesome mathematical miracle by 1400 years. Seeing how the Muslims en masse have idolized Muhammad, it is obvious that if the Quran's mathematical miracle were also revealed through Muhammad, many people would have worshiped him as God incarnate. As it is, God willed that the great miracle of the Quran (74:30-35) shall await the computer age, and to have it revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (see Appendices 1, 2, & 26).

1981.english: You (Muhammad) never studied previous scripture, nor are you capable of writing one. In that case, the falsehood seekers may have reason to doubt.

1989.english: You did not read the previous scriptures, nor did you write them with your hand. In that case, the objectors would have had reason to harbor doubts.
1989.subtitle: Quran: Muhammad’s Miracle

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل هو آيات بينات في صدور الذين أوتوا العلم ۚ وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا الظالمون
verses.transliterated: bal huwa āyātun bayyinātun fī ṣudūri alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: In fact, these revelations are clear in the chests of those who possess knowledge. Only the wicked will disregard our revelations.

1981.english: Indeed, these revelations are clear in the chests of those who possess knowledge. Only the wicked disregard our revelations.

1989.english: Indeed, these revelations are clear in the chests of those who possess knowledge. Only the wicked will discard our revelations.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْءَايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لولا أنزل عليه آيات من ربه ۖ قل إنما الآيات عند الله وإنما أنا نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyātun min rabbihi qul innamā l-āyātu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: They said, "If only miracles could come down to him from his Lord!" Say, "All miracles come only from GOD; I am no more than a manifest warner."

1981.english: They said, "How come no miracles were sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The miracles come only from God, and I am no more than a warner."
1981.subtitle: Muhammad Performed No Miracles
1981.footnote: Those who idolize the prophet against his wishes claim that he performed a long list of miracles. The Quran, however, which narrates the miracles of many prophets, teaches us that Muhammad did not perform any miracles. Those who love and respect the prophet, love him and respect him as he is.

1989.english: They said, “If only miracles* could come down to him from his Lord!” Say, “All miracles come only from GOD; I am no more than a profound warner.”
1989.footnote: It was the will of the Most Wise to separate the Quran from its awesome mathematical miracle by 1400 years. Seeing how the Muslims en masse have idolized Muhammad, it is obvious that if the Quran’s numerical miracle were also revealed through Muhammad, many people would have worshiped him as God incarnate. As it is, God willed that the great miracle of the Quran (74:30-35) shall await the computer age, to be revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (see Appendices 1, 2, & 26).

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يكفهم أنا أنزلنا عليك الكتاب يتلى عليهم ۚ إن في ذلك لرحمة وذكرى لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: awalam yakfihim annā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba yut'lā ʿalayhim inna fī dhālika laraḥmatan wadhik'rā liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: Is it not enough of a miracle that we sent down to you this book, being recited to them? This is indeed a mercy and a reminder for people who believe.

1981.english: Is it not enough of a miracle that we sent down to you this scripture, which is being recited to them? Indeed, it is a mercy and a message for those who believe.

1989.english: Is it not enough of a miracle* that we sent down to you this book, being recited to them? This is indeed a mercy and a reminder for people who believe.
1989.footnote: It was the will of the Most Wise to separate the Quran from its awesome mathematical miracle by 1400 years. Seeing how the Muslims en masse have idolized Muhammad, it is obvious that if the Quran’s numerical miracle were also revealed through Muhammad, many people would have worshiped him as God incarnate. As it is, God willed that the great miracle of the Quran (74:30-35) shall await the computer age, to be revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (see Appendices 1, 2, & 26).

verses.arabic: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل كفى بالله بيني وبينكم شهيدا ۖ يعلم ما في السماوات والأرض ۗ والذين آمنوا بالباطل وكفروا بالله أولئك هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: qul kafā bil-lahi baynī wabaynakum shahīdan yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-bāṭili wakafarū bil-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: Say, "GOD suffices as a witness between me and you. He knows everything in the heavens and the earth. Surely, those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in GOD are the real losers."

1981.english: Say, "God suffices as a witness between me and you. He is fully aware of everything in the heavens and the earth. Those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in God are the real losers."

1989.english: Say, “GOD suffices as a witness between me and you. He knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in GOD are the real losers.”

verses.arabic: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَآ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ۚ ولولا أجل مسمى لجاءهم العذاب وليأتينهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walawlā ajalun musamman lajāahumu l-ʿadhābu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: They challenge you to bring the retribution! If it were not for a predetermined appointment, the retribution would have come to them immediately. Certainly, it will come to them suddenly, when they least expect it.
verses.subtitle: They (Are) in Hell
verses.footnote: Anyone who dies before the age of 40 goes to Heaven, and not everyone deserves this. People sometimes lament the slowness of justice when a vicious criminal is not executed promptly. God knows who deserves Heaven (see 46:15 and Appendix 32).

1981.english: They challenge you to bring doom upon them. If it were not for a predetermined decision, the retribution would have come to them immediately. However, it will surely come suddenly, when they least expect it.

1989.english: They challenge you to bring the retribution! If it were not for a predetermined appointment, the retribution would have come to them immediately.* It comes to them suddenly, when they least expect it.
1989.subtitle: They Are in Hell
