1989.footnote: Anyone who dies before the age of 40 goes to Heaven, and not everyone deserves this. People sometimes lament the slowness of justice when a vicious criminal is not executed promptly. God knows who deserves Heaven (see 46:15 and Appendix 32).

verses.arabic: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يستعجلونك بالعذاب وإن جهنم لمحيطة بالكافرين
verses.transliterated: yastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi wa-inna jahannama lamuḥīṭatun bil-kāfirīn
verses.english: They challenge you to bring retribution! Hell already surrounds the disbelievers.

1981.english: They challenge you to bring doom, though hell is actually surrounding the disbelievers.

1989.english: They challenge you to bring the retribution, when Hell is already surrounding the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يغشاهم العذاب من فوقهم ومن تحت أرجلهم ويقول ذوقوا ما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: yawma yaghshāhumu l-ʿadhābu min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim wayaqūlu dhūqū mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: The day will come when the retribution overwhelms them, from above them and from beneath their feet; He will say, "Taste the consequences of your works."

1981.english: The day will come when retribution will overwhelm them; from above them, and from beneath their feet. God will then say, "Suffer (the consequences of) your works."

1989.english: The day will come when the retribution will overwhelm them, from above them and from beneath their feet. He will say, “Taste the consequences of your sins.”

verses.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.arabicClean: يا عبادي الذين آمنوا إن أرضي واسعة فإياي فاعبدون
verses.transliterated: yāʿibādiya alladhīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsiʿatun fa-iyyāya fa-uʿ'budūn
verses.english: O My servants who believed, My earth is spacious, so worship Me.
verses.subtitle: Immigrate in the Cause of God

1981.english: O My servants who believed, My earth is spacious, so worship Me alone.
1981.subtitle: Move Away, If You Have To

1989.english: O My believing servants, My earth is spacious, so worship Me alone.
1989.subtitle: Immigrate in the Cause of God

verses.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كل نفس ذائقة الموت ۖ ثم إلينا ترجعون
verses.transliterated: kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti thumma ilaynā tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: Every soul will taste death, then to us you will be ultimately returned.

1981.english: Everyone will taste death, then to us you will be returned.

1989.english: Every soul will taste death, then to us you will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لنبوئنهم من الجنة غرفا تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ۚ نعم أجر العاملين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwi-annahum mina l-janati ghurafan tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā niʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīn
verses.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will surely settle them in Paradise, with mansions and flowing streams. Eternally they abide therein. What a beautiful reward for the workers.

1981.english: Those who believe and work righteousness, we will assign them to mansions in Paradise, with flowing streams; they abide therein forever; what a beautiful recompense for the workers.

1989.english: Those who believed and led a righteous life, we will surely settle them in Paradise, with mansions and flowing streams. Eternally they abide therein. What a beautiful recompense for the workers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين صبروا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
verses.english: They are the ones who steadfastly persevere, and trust in their Lord.

1981.english: They remained steadfast and trusted in their Lord.

1989.english: They are the ones who are steadfast, and in their Lord they trust.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وكأين من دابة لا تحمل رزقها الله يرزقها وإياكم ۚ وهو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: waka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu riz'qahā l-lahu yarzuquhā wa-iyyākum wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: Many a creature that does not carry its provision, GOD provides for it, as well as for you. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: Any creature that possesses no provision, God provides for it as well as for you. He is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: Many a creature that does not carry its provision, GOD provides for it, and for you. He is Hearer, Knower.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض وسخر الشمس والقمر ليقولن الله ۖ فأنى يؤفكون
verses.transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūn
verses.english: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth, and put the sun and the moon in your service," they will say, "GOD." Why then did they deviate?
verses.subtitle: Most Believers Destined for Hell

1981.english: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth, and subdued the sun and the moon," they will answer, "God." How come they deviate?
1981.subtitle: The Idol-Worshipers Believe in God

1989.english: If you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth, and com mitted the sun and the moon in your service,” they would say, “GOD.” Why then did they deviate?
1989.subtitle: Most Believers Going to Hell

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له ۚ إن الله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: al-lahu yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His creatures, and withholds it. GOD is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: God is the only one who increases the provision for whomever He chooses among His servants, or reduces it. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His creatures, and withholds it. GOD is fully aware of all things.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن سألتهم من نزل من السماء ماء فأحيا به الأرض من بعد موتها ليقولن الله ۚ قل الحمد لله ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum man nazzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa min baʿdi mawtihā layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: If you ask them, "Who sends down from the sky water, to revive dead land," they will say, "GOD." Say, "Praise GOD." Most of them do not understand.

1981.english: If you ask them, "Who sends down water from the sky, to revive dead land," they will answer, "God." Say, "Praise be to God." Indeed, most of them do not understand.

1989.english: If you asked them, “Who sends down from the sky water, to revive dead land,” they would say, “GOD.” Say, “Praise GOD.” Most of them do not understand.

verses.arabic: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما هذه الحياة الدنيا إلا لهو ولعب ۚ وإن الدار الآخرة لهي الحيوان ۚ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā lahwun walaʿibun wa-inna l-dāra l-ākhirata lahiya l-ḥayawānu law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: This worldly life is no more than vanity and play, while the abode of the Hereafter is the real life, if they only knew.
verses.subtitle: Re-arrange Your Priorities

1981.english: This life is no more than vanity and play, while the abode of the hereafter is the real life, if they only knew.

1989.english: This worldly life is no more than vanity and play, while the abode of the Hereafter is the real life, if they only knew.
1989.subtitle: Re-arrange Your Priorities

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا ركبوا في الفلك دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجاهم إلى البر إذا هم يشركون
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā rakibū fī l-ful'ki daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari idhā hum yush'rikūn
verses.english: When they ride on a ship, they implore GOD, devoting their prayers to Him. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, they revert to idolatry.

1981.english: When they ride a ship, they sincerely implore God, totally devoted to Him. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, they set up idols.

1989.english: When they ride on a ship, they implore GOD, devoting themselves to Him. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, they revert to idolatry.

verses.arabic: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم وليتمتعوا ۖ فسوف يعلمون
verses.transliterated: liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum waliyatamattaʿū fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them enjoy temporarily; they will surely find out.

1981.english: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them enjoy. They will surely find out.

1989.english: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them enjoy temporarily; they will surely find out.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا أنا جعلنا حرما آمنا ويتخطف الناس من حولهم ۚ أفبالباطل يؤمنون وبنعمة الله يكفرون
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw annā jaʿalnā ḥaraman āminan wayutakhaṭṭafu l-nāsu min ḥawlihim afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yakfurūn
verses.english: Have they not seen that we have established a Sacred Sanctuary that we made secure, while all around them the people are in constant danger? Would they still believe in falsehood, and reject GOD's blessings?

1981.english: Do they not see that we appointed a sacred sanctuary for them, while the people around them are never safe? Would they still believe in falsehood and deny God's blessings?

1989.english: Have they not seen that we have established for them a Sacred Sanctuary that we made secure, while all around them the people are in constant danger? Would they still believe in falsehood, and reject GOD’s blessings?

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بالحق لما جاءه ۚ أليس في جهنم مثوى للكافرين
verses.transliterated: waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban aw kadhaba bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīn
verses.english: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD, or rejects the truth when it comes to him? Is Hell not a just retribution for the disbelievers?

1981.english: Who is more wicked than one who invents lies about God, or rejects the truth when it comes to him?* Is hell not well deserved by the disbelievers?
1981.footnote: The advocates and followers of "**Hadith**" and/or "**Sunna**" are committing both evils; they reject the Quran's assertions that it is complete and perfect (6:19, 38, 114), and invent lies about God when they claim that "**Hadith**" and "**Sunna**" are divine revelations.

1989.english: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD, or rejects the truth when it comes to him? Is Hell not a just retribution for the disbelievers?

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا ۚ وإن الله لمع المحسنين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā wa-inna l-laha lamaʿa l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: As for those who strive in our cause, we will surely guide them in our paths. Most assuredly, GOD is with the pious.

1981.english: As for those who strive towards us, we will surely guide them to our paths. God is always with the righteous.

1989.english: As for those who strive in our cause, we will surely guide them in our paths. Most assuredly, GOD is with the pious.

verses.arabic: الٓمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الم
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-meem
verses.english: A. L. M.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the detailed explanation of these previously mysterious initials.

1981.english: A. L. M.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 1 for details of the miraculous numerical code of Quran, and the meaning of these letters.

1989.english: A. L. M.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ
verses.arabicClean: غلبت الروم
verses.transliterated: ghulibati l-rūm
verses.english: Certainly, the Romans will be defeated.

1981.english: The Romans will be defeated.

1989.english: The Romans will be defeated.

verses.arabic: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: في أدنى الأرض وهم من بعد غلبهم سيغلبون
verses.transliterated: fī adnā l-arḍi wahum min baʿdi ghalabihim sayaghlibūn
verses.english: In the nearest land. After their defeat, they will rise again and win.

1981.english: Throughout the land. After being defeated, they will win.

1989.english: In the near future. After their defeat, they will rise again.

verses.arabic: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: في بضع سنين ۗ لله الأمر من قبل ومن بعد ۚ ويومئذ يفرح المؤمنون
verses.transliterated: fī biḍ'ʿi sinīna lillahi l-amru min qablu wamin baʿdu wayawma-idhin yafraḥu l-mu'minūn
verses.english: Within several years. Such is GOD's decision, both in the first prophecy, and the second. On that day, the believers shall rejoice

1981.english: Within a few years. Such is God's decision, both in the first time and the second time. The believers will then rejoice.

1989.english: In several years. Such is GOD’s decision, both the first time, and the second. On that day, the believers shall rejoice—

verses.arabic: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: بنصر الله ۚ ينصر من يشاء ۖ وهو العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: binaṣri l-lahi yanṣuru man yashāu wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīm
verses.english: in GOD's victory. He grants victory to whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: With God's victory. He grants victory to whomever He wills. He is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: in GOD’s victory. He grants victory to whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وعد الله ۖ لا يخلف الله وعده ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu waʿdahu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Such is GOD's promise—and GOD never breaks His promise—but most people do not know.
verses.subtitle: Preoccupation With the Wrong Life

1981.english: This is the promise of God; and God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know.

1989.english: Such is GOD’s promise, and GOD never breaks His promise, but most people do not know.
1989.subtitle: Preoccupation With the Wrong Life

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يعلمون ظاهرا من الحياة الدنيا وهم عن الآخرة هم غافلون
verses.transliterated: yaʿlamūna ẓāhiran mina l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wahum ʿani l-ākhirati hum ghāfilūn
verses.english: They care only about things of this world that are visible to them, while being totally oblivious to the Hereafter.

1981.english: They recognize only the visible part of this world, while disregarding the hereafter.

1989.english: (Most people) care only about things of this world that are visible to them, while being totally oblivious to (the eternal real life in) the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يتفكروا في أنفسهم ۗ ما خلق الله السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إلا بالحق وأجل مسمى ۗ وإن كثيرا من الناس بلقاء ربهم لكافرون
verses.transliterated: awalam yatafakkarū fī anfusihim mā khalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-inna kathīran mina l-nāsi biliqāi rabbihim lakāfirūn
verses.english: Why do they not reflect on themselves? GOD did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose, and for a specific life span. However, most people, with regard to meeting their Lord, are disbelievers.

1981.english: Why do they not reflect on themselves? God did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose, and for a specific period. However, most people disbelieve in meeting their Lord.

1989.english: Why do they not reflect on themselves? GOD did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose, and for a specific life span. However, most people, with regard to meeting their Lord, are disbelievers.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم ۚ كانوا أشد منهم قوة وأثاروا الأرض وعمروها أكثر مما عمروها وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات ۖ فما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون
verses.transliterated: awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim kānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wa-athārū l-arḍa waʿamarūhā akthara mimmā ʿamarūhā wajāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti famā kāna l-lahu liyathlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
verses.english: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be more powerful, more prosperous, and more productive on earth. Their messengers went to them with clear signs. Consequently, GOD was not the One who wronged them, they are the ones who wronged their own souls.

1981.english: Did they not travel the earth and see the consequences for those before them? They possessed more power, and developed the earth and built on it even more than these have built. Their messengers went to them with profound signs. It was never God who wronged them; it was they who wronged themselves.

1989.english: Have they not roamed the earth, and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be more powerful, more prosperous, and more productive on earth. Their messengers went to them with clear signs. Consequently, GOD is not the One who wronged them, they are the ones who wronged themselves.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم كان عاقبة الذين أساءوا السوأى أن كذبوا بآيات الله وكانوا بها يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: thumma kāna ʿāqibata alladhīna asāū l-sūā an kadhabū biāyāti l-lahi wakānū bihā yastahziūn
verses.english: The consequences for those who committed evil had to be evil. That is because they rejected GOD's revelations, and ridiculed them.

1981.english: The consequences were evil for those who committed evil; they rejected God's revelations and ridiculed them.

1989.english: The consequences for those who committed evil was evil. That is because they rejected GOD’s revelations, and used to mock them.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده ثم إليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who initiates the creation and repeats it. Ultimately, you will be returned to Him.
verses.subtitle: Idol Worshipers Disown Their Idols

1981.english: God initiates the creation, and He repeats it, then to Him you will finally return.

1989.english: GOD is the One who initiates the creation and repeats it. Ultimately, you will be returned to Him.
1989.subtitle: Idol Worshipers Disown Their Idols

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم تقوم الساعة يبلس المجرمون
verses.transliterated: wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yub'lisu l-muj'rimūn
verses.english: On the Day when the Hour comes to pass, the guilty will be shocked.

1981.english: When the Hour comes, the guilty will be stunned.

1989.english: On the Day when the Hour comes to pass, the guilty will be shocked.

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولم يكن لهم من شركائهم شفعاء وكانوا بشركائهم كافرين
verses.transliterated: walam yakun lahum min shurakāihim shufaʿāu wakānū bishurakāihim kāfirīn
verses.english: Their idols will have no power to intercede on their behalf; on the contrary, they will disown their idols.

1981.english: None of their idols can intercede on their behalf; they will even disown their idols.

1989.english: Their idols will not have any power to intercede on their behalf; in fact, they will disown their idols.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم تقوم الساعة يومئذ يتفرقون
verses.transliterated: wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yatafarraqūn
verses.english: On the day when the Hour comes to pass, they will part company.

1981.english: When the Hour comes, they will be divided.

1989.english: On the day when the Hour comes to pass, they will part company.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فهم في روضة يحبرون
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fahum fī rawḍatin yuḥ'barūn
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be in Paradise, rejoicing.

1981.english: As for those who believed and worked righteousness, they enjoy Paradise.

1989.english: As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in Paradise, rejoicing.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما الذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا ولقاء الآخرة فأولئك في العذاب محضرون
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā waliqāi l-ākhirati fa-ulāika fī l-ʿadhābi muḥ'ḍarūn
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve, and reject our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, they will last in the retribution forever.

1981.english: But those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations and the meeting of the hereafter, they will be committed to retribution.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieved, and rejected our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, they will last in the retribution forever.

verses.arabic: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فسبحان الله حين تمسون وحين تصبحون
verses.transliterated: fasub'ḥāna l-lahi ḥīna tum'sūna waḥīna tuṣ'biḥūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall glorify GOD when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning.
verses.subtitle: Remember God, Always

1981.english: You shall glorify God when you retire at night, and when you get up in the morning.
1981.subtitle: Signs of God

1989.english: Therefore, you shall glorify GOD when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وله الحمد في السماوات والأرض وعشيا وحين تظهرون
verses.transliterated: walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waʿashiyyan waḥīna tuẓ'hirūn
verses.english: All praise is due to Him in the heavens and the earth, throughout the evening, as well as in the middle of your day.

1981.english: He is worthy of all praise, in the heavens and the earth; in the evening, and when you rest at noon.

1989.english: All praise is due to Him in the heavens and the earth, throughout the evening, as well as in the middle of your day.

verses.arabic: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ويحيي الأرض بعد موتها ۚ وكذلك تخرجون
verses.transliterated: yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi wayuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wakadhālika tukh'rajūn
verses.english: He produces the live from the dead, and produces the dead from the live, and He revives the land after it had died; you are similarly resurrected.

1981.english: He produces the live from the dead, and the dead from the live. Just as He revives the land that had been dead, you will be resurrected.

1989.english: He produces the live from the dead, and produces the dead from the live. And He revives the land after it had died; you are similarly resurrected.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته أن خلقكم من تراب ثم إذا أنتم بشر تنتشرون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi an khalaqakum min turābin thumma idhā antum basharun tantashirūn
verses.english: Among His proofs is that He created you from dust, then you became reproducing humans.
verses.subtitle: Marriage: A Divine Institution

1981.english: Among His signs is that He created you from dust, then you became multiplying humans.

1989.english: Among His signs is that He created you from dust, then you became reproducing humans.
1989.subtitle: Marriage: A Divine Institution

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته أن خلق لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا لتسكنوا إليها وجعل بينكم مودة ورحمة ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājan litaskunū ilayhā wajaʿala baynakum mawaddatan waraḥmatan inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verses.english: Among His proofs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves, in order to have tranquility and contentment with each other, and He placed in your hearts love and care towards your spouses. In this, there are sufficient proofs for people who think.

1981.english: Among His signs is that He created for you spouses from among you, in order to find harmony together, and created love and kindness to join you together. These are lessons for people who reflect.

1989.english: Among His signs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves, in order to have tranquility and contentment with each other. He places in your hearts love and care towards your spouses. In this, there are signs for people who think.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّلْعَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته خلق السماوات والأرض واختلاف ألسنتكم وألوانكم ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات للعالمين
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ikh'tilāfu alsinatikum wa-alwānikum inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'ʿālimīn
verses.english: Among His proofs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variations in your languages and your colors. In these, there are signs for the knowledgeable.
verses.subtitle: More Proofs

1981.english: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variations in your languages and colors. These are signs for all the people.

1989.english: Among His signs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variations in your languages and your colors. In these, there are signs for the knowledgeable.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته منامكم بالليل والنهار وابتغاؤكم من فضله ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يسمعون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi manāmukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wa-ib'tighāukum min faḍlihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūn
verses.english: Among His proofs is your sleeping during the night or the day, and your working in pursuit of His provisions. In this, there are sufficient proofs for people who can hear.

1981.english: Among His signs is your sleep during the night, and your work to seek His bounties during the day. These are signs for people who hear.

1989.english: Among His signs is your sleeping during the night or the day, and your working in pursuit of His bounties. In this, there are signs for people who hear.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته يريكم البرق خوفا وطمعا وينزل من السماء ماء فيحيي به الأرض بعد موتها ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi yurīkumu l-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunazzilu mina l-samāi māan fayuḥ'yī bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: Among His proofs is that He shows you the lightning as a source of fear, as well as hope, then He sends down from the sky water to revive a land that has been dead. In these, there are sufficient proofs for people who understand.

1981.english: Among His signs is the lightning that He shows you to instill both fear and hope; He sends down water from the sky to revive a land that has been dead. These are signs for people who understand.

1989.english: Among His signs is that He shows you the lightning as a source of fear as well as hope. And He sends down from the sky water to revive a land that has died. In these, there are signs for people who understand.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته أن تقوم السماء والأرض بأمره ۚ ثم إذا دعاكم دعوة من الأرض إذا أنتم تخرجون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi an taqūma l-samāu wal-arḍu bi-amrihi thumma idhā daʿākum daʿwatan mina l-arḍi idhā antum takhrujūn
verses.english: Among His proofs is that the heaven and the earth are standing at His disposal. Finally, when He calls you out of the earth, one call, you will immediately come out.

1981.english: Among His signs is the fact that the heaven and the earth stand at His disposal. When He calls upon you, from the earth you will come out.

1989.english: Among His signs is that the heaven and the earth are standing at His disposal. Finally, He calls you out of the earth, one call, whereupon you immediately rise.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وله من في السماوات والأرض ۖ كل له قانتون
verses.transliterated: walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kullun lahu qānitūn
verses.english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth; all are subservient to Him.

1981.english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth; all subservient to Him.

1989.english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth; all are subservient to Him.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده وهو أهون عليه ۚ وله المثل الأعلى في السماوات والأرض ۚ وهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu wahuwa ahwanu ʿalayhi walahu l-mathalu l-aʿlā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: And He is the One who initiates the creation, then repeats it; this is even easier for Him. To Him belongs the most sublime similitude, in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: He is the one who initiates the creation, and repeats it; this is the easiest thing for Him. To Him belongs the highest similitude in the heavens and the earth; He is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: And He is the One who initiates the creation, then repeats it; this is the easiest thing for Him. And to Him belongs the most sublime similitude, in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ضرب لكم مثلا من أنفسكم ۖ هل لكم من ما ملكت أيمانكم من شركاء في ما رزقناكم فأنتم فيه سواء تخافونهم كخيفتكم أنفسكم ۚ كذلك نفصل الآيات لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: ḍaraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum min mā malakat aymānukum min shurakāa fī mā razaqnākum fa-antum fīhi sawāon takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum kadhālika nufaṣṣilu l-āyāti liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: He cites for you herein an example from among yourselves: Do you ever elevate your servants or subordinates to the level where they rival you, and to the point that you pay them as much allegiance as is being paid to you? We thus explain the revelations for people who understand.
verses.subtitle: Absurdity of Idol Worship

1981.english: God cites herein an example from among you; would you share your assets with your servants, to the extent that you become equal, and to the extent that you respect them as they respect you now? We thus explain the revelations for those who understand.
1981.subtitle: Monotheism: Natural Instinct

1989.english: He cites for you herein an example from among yourselves: Do you ever elevate your servants or subordinates to the level where they rival you, and to the point that you pay them as much allegiance as is being paid to you? We thus explain the revelations for the people who understand.
1989.subtitle: Absurdity of Idolatry

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بل اتبع الذين ظلموا أهواءهم بغير علم ۖ فمن يهدي من أضل الله ۖ وما لهم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: bali ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū ahwāahum bighayri ʿil'min faman yahdī man aḍalla l-lahu wamā lahum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: Indeed, the transgressors have followed their own opinions, without knowledge. Who then can guide those who have been sent astray by GOD? No one can ever help them.

1981.english: Indeed, the wicked follow their own opinions, without knowledge. Can anyone guide those misguided by God? No one can help them.

1989.english: Indeed, the transgressors have followed their own opinions, without knowledge. Thus, who can guide those who have been sent astray by GOD? No one can help them.

verses.arabic: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأقم وجهك للدين حنيفا ۚ فطرت الله التي فطر الناس عليها ۚ لا تبديل لخلق الله ۚ ذلك الدين القيم ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan fiṭ'rata l-lahi allatī faṭara l-nāsa ʿalayhā lā tabdīla likhalqi l-lahi dhālika l-dīnu l-qayimu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall devote yourself to the religion of strict monotheism. Such is the natural instinct placed into the people by GOD. Such creation of GOD will never change. This is the perfect religion, but most people do not know.
verses.subtitle: Monotheism: Natural Instinct
verses.footnote: Recognizing God ALONE as our Lord and Master is a natural instinct. We are born into this world with such an instinct. See 7:172-173 and Appendix 7.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall devote yourself completely to the religion of monotheism. This is the natural instinct that God implanted into the people.* Nothing can change such creation of God. This is the perfect religion, but most people do not know.
1981.footnote: God gathered all the people and had them bear witness that He is the Lord. See 7:172.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall devote yourselves to the religion of strict monotheism. Such is the natural instinct placed into the people by GOD. Such creation of GOD will never change. This is the perfect religion, but most people do not know.
1989.subtitle: Monotheism: Natural Instinct
1989.footnote: Recognizing God ALONE as our Lord and Master is a natural instinct. We are born into this world with such an instinct. See 7:172-173 and Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: منيبين إليه واتقوه وأقيموا الصلاة ولا تكونوا من المشركين
verses.transliterated: munībīna ilayhi wa-ittaqūhu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata walā takūnū mina l-mush'rikīn
verses.english: You shall submit to Him, reverence Him, observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and—whatever you do—do not ever fall into idol worship.

1981.english: You shall all submit to God, beware of Him, observe the **salat** prayers, and never fall into idol worship.

1989.english: You shall submit to Him, reverence Him, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and do not be among the idol worshipers.

verses.arabic: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من الذين فرقوا دينهم وكانوا شيعا ۖ كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
verses.transliterated: mina alladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūn
verses.english: (Do not fall in idol worship,) like those who divide their religion into sects; each party rejoicing with what they have.
verses.subtitle: Sectarianism Condemned

1981.english: Do not be with those who divided their religion into sects; each party satisfied with what they have.
1981.footnote: The only reason the Muslims are divided into various sects is that some of them advocate other than the Quran; specifically, "**hadith**" and "**sunna**" as sources of law. The Quran calls these people idol worshipers, as we see in verse 31. Throughout the Quran, we are reminded that we shall adhere to Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. Ironically, those who claim to love the prophet, yet disobey him by inventing and advocating "**hadith**" and "**sunna**," are disowned by the prophet (see 6:159 and 25:31).

1989.english: (Do not be) among those who divide their religion into sects; each party rejoicing with what they have.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا مس الناس ضر دعوا ربهم منيبين إليه ثم إذا أذاقهم منه رحمة إذا فريق منهم بربهم يشركون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā massa l-nāsa ḍurrun daʿaw rabbahum munībīna ilayhi thumma idhā adhāqahum min'hu raḥmatan idhā farīqun min'hum birabbihim yush'rikūn
verses.english: When adversity afflicts the people, they turn to their Lord, totally devoting themselves to Him. But then, as soon as He showers them with mercy, some of them revert to idol worship.
verses.subtitle: Bad Weather Friends
verses.footnote: A common example is the classified advertisements we note in the newspapers, placed by people thanking St. Jude for healing them. Before undergoing surgery, they sincerely implore God to heal them. But as soon as the surgery succeeds, they thank St. Jude!!!

1981.english: When adversity touches the people, they implore their Lord and submit to Him. But as soon as He relieves them with His mercy, some of them set up idols besides their Lord.

1989.english: When adversity afflicts the people, they turn to their Lord, totally devoted to Him. But then, as soon as He showers them with mercy, some of them revert to idolatry.
1989.subtitle: Bad Weather Friends

verses.arabic: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم ۚ فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum fatamattaʿū fasawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Let them be unappreciative of what we have given them. Enjoy temporarily; you will surely find out.

1981.english: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them, and let them temporarily enjoy themselves; they will surely find out.

1989.english: Let them be unappreciative of what we have given them. Enjoy temporarily; you will surely find out.

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم أنزلنا عليهم سلطانا فهو يتكلم بما كانوا به يشركون
verses.transliterated: am anzalnā ʿalayhim sul'ṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihi yush'rikūn
verses.english: Have we given them authorization that justifies their idolatry?

1981.english: Have we given them any commandment that supports the setting up of idols?

1989.english: Have we given them any authorization that justifies their idolatry?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا أذقنا الناس رحمة فرحوا بها ۖ وإن تصبهم سيئة بما قدمت أيديهم إذا هم يقنطون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā adhaqnā l-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim idhā hum yaqnaṭūn
verses.english: When we bestow mercy upon the people, they rejoice therein. But when adversity befalls them, as a consequence of their own works, they become despondent.

1981.english: When we bless the people with mercy, they rejoice therewith, and when adversity afflicts them, as a consequence of their own deeds, they become dejected.

1989.english: When we bestow mercy upon the people, they rejoice therein. But when adversity befalls them, as a consequence of their own works, they become despondent.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا أن الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: Do they not realize that GOD increases the provision for whomever He wills, or reduces it? These should be lessons for people who believe.

1981.english: Do they not realize that God is the only one who increases the provision for whomever He wills, and reduces it? These are lessons for people who believe.

1989.english: Do they not realize that GOD increases the provision for whomever He wills, and reduces it? This should provide lessons for those who believe

verses.arabic: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فآت ذا القربى حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل ۚ ذلك خير للذين يريدون وجه الله ۖ وأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: faāti dhā l-qur'bā ḥaqqahu wal-mis'kīna wa-ib'na l-sabīli dhālika khayrun lilladhīna yurīdūna wajha l-lahi wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall give the relatives their rightful share (of charity), as well as the poor, and the traveling alien. This is better for those who sincerely seek GOD's pleasure; they are the winners.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall give the relative his right, and the needy, and the alien. This is better for those who seek the pleasure of God; they are the winners.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall give the relatives their rightful share (of charity), as well as the poor, and the traveling alien. This is better for those who sincerely seek GOD’s pleasure; they are the winners.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما آتيتم من ربا ليربو في أموال الناس فلا يربو عند الله ۖ وما آتيتم من زكاة تريدون وجه الله فأولئك هم المضعفون
verses.transliterated: wamā ātaytum min riban liyarbuwā fī amwāli l-nāsi falā yarbū ʿinda l-lahi wamā ātaytum min zakatin turīdūna wajha l-lahi fa-ulāika humu l-muḍ'ʿifūn
verses.english: The usury that is practiced to increase some people's wealth, does not gain anything at GOD. But if you give to charity, seeking GOD's pleasure, these are the ones who receive their reward manifold.

1981.english: The usury you practice may increase the people's money, but it earns nothing at God, while the charities you practice, seeking only the pleasure of God, are multiplied manyfold.

1989.english: The usury that is practiced to increase some people’s wealth, does not increase at GOD. As for those who give to charity, seeking GOD’s pleasure, they multiply their investment manifold.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي خلقكم ثم رزقكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ۖ هل من شركائكم من يفعل من ذلكم من شيء ۚ سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum hal min shurakāikum man yafʿalu min dhālikum min shayin sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who created you. He is the One who provides for you. He is the One who puts you to death. He is the One who resurrects you. Can any of your idols do any of these things? Be He glorified. He is much too exalted to have any partners.
verses.subtitle: Who Is Worthy of Worship?

1981.english: God is the one who created you; He is the one who provides for you; He is the one who puts you to death; and He is the one who resurrects you. Can any of your idols do any of these? God be glorified; He is high above any idols they set up.

1989.english: GOD is the One who created you. He is the One who provides for you. He is the One who puts you to death. He is the One who resurrects you. Can any of your idols do any of these things? Be He glorified. He is much too exalted to have any partners.
1989.subtitle: Who Is Worthy of Worship?

verses.arabic: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ظهر الفساد في البر والبحر بما كسبت أيدي الناس ليذيقهم بعض الذي عملوا لعلهم يرجعون
verses.transliterated: ẓahara l-fasādu fī l-bari wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aydī l-nāsi liyudhīqahum baʿḍa alladhī ʿamilū laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.english: Disasters have spread throughout the land and sea, because of what the people have committed. He thus lets them taste the consequences of some of their works, that they may return (to the right works).

1981.english: Corruption has prevailed throughout the land and sea, due to the people's work. Therefore, He makes them suffer the consequences of their works, that they may return.

1989.english: Disasters have spread throughout the land and sea, because of what the people have committed. He thus lets them taste the consequences of their works, that they may return (to righteousness).

verses.arabic: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل سيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبل ۚ كان أكثرهم مشركين
verses.transliterated: qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablu kāna aktharuhum mush'rikīn
verses.english: Say, "Roam the earth and note the consequences for those before you." Most of them were idol worshipers.
verses.subtitle: Learning From History

1981.english: Say, "Travel the earth and see the consequences for those before you." The majority of them were idol-worshipers.

1989.english: Say, “Roam the earth and note the consequences for those before you.” Most of them were idol worshipers.
1989.subtitle: Learning From History

verses.arabic: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأقم وجهك للدين القيم من قبل أن يأتي يوم لا مرد له من الله ۖ يومئذ يصدعون
verses.transliterated: fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni l-qayimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi yawma-idhin yaṣṣaddaʿūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall devote yourself completely to this perfect religion, before a day comes which is made inevitable by GOD. On that day, they will be shocked.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall devote yourself to the perfect religion, before a day comes that is inevitable. On that day, the people will be stunned.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall devote yourself completely to this perfect religion, before a day comes which is made inevitable by GOD. On that day, they will be shocked.

verses.arabic: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من كفر فعليه كفره ۖ ومن عمل صالحا فلأنفسهم يمهدون
verses.transliterated: man kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan fali-anfusihim yamhadūn
verses.english: Whoever disbelieves, disbelieves to the detriment of his own soul, while those who lead a righteous life, do so to strengthen and develop their own souls.

1981.english: Whoever disbelieves causes his own detriment, and those who work righteousness do so for their own good.

1989.english: Whoever disbelieves, disbelieves to the detriment of his own soul, while those who lead a righteous life, do so to strengthen and develop their own souls.

verses.arabic: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ليجزي الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات من فضله ۚ إنه لا يحب الكافرين
verses.transliterated: liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlihi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-kāfirīn
verses.english: For He will generously recompense those who believe and lead a righteous life from His bounties. He does not love the disbelievers.

1981.english: God bestows His grace upon those who believe and work righteousness, while those who disbelieve are displeasing Him.

1989.english: For He will generously recompense from His bounties those who believe and lead a righteous life. And He does not love the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته أن يرسل الرياح مبشرات وليذيقكم من رحمته ولتجري الفلك بأمره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi an yur'sila l-riyāḥa mubashirātin waliyudhīqakum min raḥmatihi walitajriya l-ful'ku bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: Among His proofs is that He sends the winds with good omen, to shower you with His mercy, and to allow the ships to run in the sea in accordance with His rules, and for you to seek His bounties (through commerce), that you may be appreciative.

1981.english: Among His signs is the sending of winds with good omen, showering you with His mercy, and allowing the ships to run by His command to seek His bounties, that you may be appreciative.

1989.english: Among His signs is that He sends the winds with good omen, to shower you with His mercy, and to allow the ships to run in the sea by His command, and for you to seek His bounties (through commerce), that you may be appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا من قبلك رسلا إلى قومهم فجاءوهم بالبينات فانتقمنا من الذين أجرموا ۖ وكان حقا علينا نصر المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti fa-intaqamnā mina alladhīna ajramū wakāna ḥaqqan ʿalaynā naṣru l-mu'minīn
verses.english: We have sent messengers before you to their people, with profound signs. Subsequently, we punished those who transgressed. It is our duty that we grant victory to the believers.
verses.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory for the Believers

1981.english: We have sent messengers before you to their people with profound signs, then we punished the rebellious. (As for those who believe,) I have made it a duty upon Myself to give victory to the believers.

1989.english: We have sent messengers before you to their people, with profound signs. Subsequently, we punished those who transgressed. For it is our duty to give victory to the believers.
1989.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory for the Believers

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي يرسل الرياح فتثير سحابا فيبسطه في السماء كيف يشاء ويجعله كسفا فترى الودق يخرج من خلاله ۖ فإذا أصاب به من يشاء من عباده إذا هم يستبشرون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī yur'silu l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhu fī l-samāi kayfa yashāu wayajʿaluhu kisafan fatarā l-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi fa-idhā aṣāba bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi idhā hum yastabshirūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, to be spread throughout the sky in accordance with His will. He then piles the clouds up, then you see the rain coming down therefrom. When it falls on whomever He chooses from among His servants, they rejoice.

1981.english: God is the one who sends the winds to stir up clouds, spreads them throughout the sky as He wills, then makes them condense into rain and pours it down upon whomever He wills, that they may rejoice.

1989.english: GOD is the One who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, to be spread throughout the sky in accordance with His will. He piles the clouds up, then you see the rain coming down therefrom. As it falls on whomever He chooses from His servants, they rejoice.

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كانوا من قبل أن ينزل عليهم من قبله لمبلسين
verses.transliterated: wa-in kānū min qabli an yunazzala ʿalayhim min qablihi lamub'lisīn
verses.english: Before it fell on them, they had resorted to despair.

1981.english: Before it was sent down to them, they had despaired.

1989.english: Before it fell on them, they had resorted to despair.

verses.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: فانظر إلى آثار رحمت الله كيف يحيي الأرض بعد موتها ۚ إن ذلك لمحيي الموتى ۖ وهو على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: fa-unẓur ilā āthāri raḥmati l-lahi kayfa yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna dhālika lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: You shall appreciate GOD's continuous mercy, and how He revives the land that has been dead. He will just as certainly resurrect the dead. He is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Note the results of God's mercy and how He revives land that had been dead. He will thus resurrect the dead; for He is omnipotent.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall appreciate GOD’s continuous mercy, and how He revives the dead land. He will just as certainly resurrect the dead. He is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أرسلنا ريحا فرأوه مصفرا لظلوا من بعده يكفرون
verses.transliterated: wala-in arsalnā rīḥan fara-awhu muṣ'farran laẓallū min baʿdihi yakfurūn
verses.english: Had we sent upon them instead a yellow sandstorm, they would have continued to disbelieve.

1981.english: Had we sent upon them a yellow sandstorm, they would have continued to disbelieve.

1989.english: Had we sent upon them instead a yellow sandstorm, they would have continued to disbelieve.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإنك لا تسمع الموتى ولا تسمع الصم الدعاء إذا ولوا مدبرين
verses.transliterated: fa-innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīn
verses.english: You cannot make the dead, nor the deaf, hear the call, once they turn away.

1981.english: You can never make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear once they turn away.

1989.english: For you cannot make the dead, nor the deaf, hear the call, once they turn away (from the message).

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أنت بهاد العمي عن ضلالتهم ۖ إن تسمع إلا من يؤمن بآياتنا فهم مسلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā anta bihādi l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūn
verses.english: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can only be heard by those who believe in our revelations, and decide to become submitters.

1981.english: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can make none hear, except those who believe in our revelations and totally submit.

1989.english: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can only be heard by those who believe in our revelations, and decide to be submitters (Muslims).

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي خلقكم من ضعف ثم جعل من بعد ضعف قوة ثم جعل من بعد قوة ضعفا وشيبة ۚ يخلق ما يشاء ۖ وهو العليم القدير
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī khalaqakum min ḍaʿfin thumma jaʿala min baʿdi ḍaʿfin quwwatan thumma jaʿala min baʿdi quwwatin ḍaʿfan washaybatan yakhluqu mā yashāu wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-qadīr
verses.english: GOD is the One who created you weak, then granted you after the weakness strength, then substituted after the strength weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent.
verses.subtitle: This Life is Very Short

1981.english: God is the one who created you weak, then He makes you grow stronger, then he makes you feeble and gray. He creates whatever He wills. He is the omniscient, the omnipotent.

1989.english: GOD is the One who created you weak, then granted you after the weakness strength, then substituted after the strength weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent.
1989.subtitle: This Life is Very Short

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم تقوم الساعة يقسم المجرمون ما لبثوا غير ساعة ۚ كذلك كانوا يؤفكون
verses.transliterated: wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yuq'simu l-muj'rimūna mā labithū ghayra sāʿatin kadhālika kānū yu'fakūn
verses.english: On the day when the Hour comes to pass, the guilty will swear that they lasted (in this world) only one hour. That is how wrong they were.

1981.english: On the day of resurrection, the sinners will swear that they had lasted one hour. That is how wrong they were.
1981.subtitle: No Time Between Death and Resurrection
1981.footnote: The period between death and resurrection will feel like a one-night sleep (see 2:259, 18:19 and 25, and Appendix 14).

1989.english: On the day when the Hour comes to pass, the guilty will swear that they lasted (in this world) only one hour. That is how wrong they were.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَهَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين أوتوا العلم والإيمان لقد لبثتم في كتاب الله إلى يوم البعث ۖ فهذا يوم البعث ولكنكم كنتم لا تعلمون
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma wal-īmāna laqad labith'tum fī kitābi l-lahi ilā yawmi l-baʿthi fahādhā yawmu l-baʿthi walākinnakum kuntum lā taʿlamūn
verses.english: Those who are blessed with knowledge and faith will say, "You have lasted, according to GOD's decree, until the Day of Resurrection. Now, this is the Day of Resurrection, but you failed to recognize it."

1981.english: Those who possessed knowledge and faith will say, "You have lasted in God's record until the day of resurrection. This is the day of resurrection, but you did not know."

1989.english: Those who are blessed with knowledge and faith will say, “You have lasted, according to GOD’s decree, until the Day of Resurrection. Now, this is the Day of Resurrection, but you failed to know.”

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فيومئذ لا ينفع الذين ظلموا معذرتهم ولا هم يستعتبون
verses.transliterated: fayawma-idhin lā yanfaʿu alladhīna ẓalamū maʿdhiratuhum walā hum yus'taʿtabūn
verses.english: Therefore, no apology, on that day, will benefit the transgressors, nor will they be excused.

1981.english: On that day, no excuse will be accepted from the wrongdoers, nor will they be asked to apologize.

1989.english: On that day, no apology will benefit the transgressors, nor will they be excused.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرآن من كل مثل ۚ ولئن جئتهم بآية ليقولن الذين كفروا إن أنتم إلا مبطلون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin wala-in ji'tahum biāyatin layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in antum illā mub'ṭilūn
verses.english: Thus, we have cited for the people in this Quran all kinds of examples. Yet, no matter what kind of proof you present to the disbelievers, they say, "You are falsifiers."

1981.english: We have cited for the people all kinds of examples in this Quran. However, even if you show them a miracle, the disbelievers will say, "You are falsifiers."

1989.english: We have cited for the people in this Quran all kinds of examples. Yet, no matter what kind of miracle you present to the disbelievers, they will say, “You are falsifiers.”

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك يطبع الله على قلوب الذين لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā qulūbi alladhīna lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: GOD thus seals the hearts of those who do not know.
verses.subtitle: Divine Intervention

1981.english: Thus does God seal the hearts of those who do not know.

1989.english: GOD thus seals the hearts of those who do not know.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر إن وعد الله حق ۖ ولا يستخفنك الذين لا يوقنون
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walā yastakhiffannaka alladhīna lā yūqinūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall steadfastly persevere—for GOD's promise is the truth—and do not be intimidated by those who have not attained certainty.

1981.english: Therefore, be patient, for God's promise is true, and do not be intimidated by those who possess no faith.

1989.english: Therefore, be patient. For GOD’s promise is the truth. And do not be intimidated by those who have not attained certainty.

verses.arabic: الٓمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الم
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-meem
verses.english: A. L. M.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the important role of these initials.

1981.english: A.L.M.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 1 for details of the Quran's miraculous numerical code involving these letters.

1989.english: A. L. M.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تلك آيات الكتاب الحكيم
verses.transliterated: til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-ḥakīm
verses.english: These (letters) constitute proofs of this book of wisdom.

1981.english: These (letters) are the miracles of this book of wisdom.
1981.footnote: This expression is used exclusively in conjunction with Quranic initials.

1989.english: These (letters) are miracles of this book of wisdom.

verses.arabic: هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هدى ورحمة للمحسنين
verses.transliterated: hudan waraḥmatan lil'muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: A beacon and a mercy for the righteous.

1981.english: A guide and mercy for the pious;

1989.english: A beacon and a mercy for the pious.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم يوقنون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūn
verses.english: Who observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and as regards the Hereafter, they are absolutely certain.

1981.english: who observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, and are absolutely positive about the hereafter.

1989.english: Who observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and as regards the Hereafter, they are absolutely certain.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك على هدى من ربهم ۖ وأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: ulāika ʿalā hudan min rabbihim wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: They are following the guidance from their Lord, and they are the winners.

1981.english: They have followed the guidance from their Lord; they are the winners.

1989.english: They are following the guidance from their Lord; they are the winners.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الناس من يشتري لهو الحديث ليضل عن سبيل الله بغير علم ويتخذها هزوا ۚ أولئك لهم عذاب مهين
verses.transliterated: wamina l-nāsi man yashtarī lahwa l-ḥadīthi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattakhidhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnu
verses.english: Among the people, there are those who uphold baseless Hadith, and thus divert others from the path of GOD without knowledge, and take it in vain. These have incurred a shameful retribution.

1981.english: Some people uphold vain **hadith** in order to divert others from the path of God without knowledge, and to create a mockery out of it. These have deserved humiliating retribution.
1981.subtitle: Quran versus Hadith
1981.footnote: The Quran teaches us that those who advocate **hadith** are false Muslims who have disobeyed the prophet and rejected God's revelations (See 6:112-116, 18:109-110, and Appendices 11, 15, 16, and 17).

1989.english: Among the people, there are those who uphold baseless Hadith, and thus divert others from the path of GOD without knowledge, and take it in vain. These have incurred a shameful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِىٓ أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليه آياتنا ولى مستكبرا كأن لم يسمعها كأن في أذنيه وقرا ۖ فبشره بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā wallā mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā ka-anna fī udhunayhi waqran fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: And when our revelations are recited to the one of them, he turns away in arrogance as if he never heard them, as if his ears are deaf. Promise him a painful retribution.

1981.english: When our revelations are recited to them, they turn away in arrogance, as if they never heard them; as if their ears are deaf. Promise them painful retribution.
1981.footnote: The Quran teaches us that those who advocate **hadith** are false Muslims who have disobeyed the prophet and rejected God's revelations (See 6:112-116, 18:109-110, and Appendices 11, 15, 16, and 17).

1989.english: And when our revelations are recited to the one of them, he turns away in arrogance as if he never heard them, as if his ears are deaf. Promise him a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم جنات النعيم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātu l-naʿīm
verses.english: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved the gardens of bliss.

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, they have deserved the gardens of bliss.

1989.english: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved the gardens of bliss.

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: خالدين فيها ۖ وعد الله حقا ۚ وهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: khālidīna fīhā waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: Eternally they abide therein. This is the truthful promise of GOD. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: They live in them forever; this is the truthful promise of God, He is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: Eternally they abide therein. This is the truthful promise of GOD. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: خلق السماوات بغير عمد ترونها ۖ وألقى في الأرض رواسي أن تميد بكم وبث فيها من كل دابة ۚ وأنزلنا من السماء ماء فأنبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
verses.transliterated: khalaqa l-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wabatha fīhā min kulli dābbatin wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmi
verses.english: He created the heavens without pillars that you can see. He established on earth stabilizers (mountains) lest it tumbles with you, and He spread on it all kinds of creatures. We send down from the sky water to grow all kinds of beautiful plants.

1981.english: He created the heavens without visible pillars, and placed stabilizers on the earth to prevent it from aberrating, and He spread all kinds of creatures therein. And We send down water from the sky, to grow all kinds of beautiful plants.

1989.english: He created the heavens without pillars that you can see. He established on earth stabilizers (mountains) lest it tumbles with you, and He spread on it all kinds of creatures. And we send down from the sky water to grow all kinds of beautiful plants.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: هذا خلق الله فأروني ماذا خلق الذين من دونه ۚ بل الظالمون في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: hādhā khalqu l-lahi fa-arūnī mādhā khalaqa alladhīna min dūnihi bali l-ẓālimūna fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Such is the creation of GOD; show me what the idols you set up beside Him have created. Indeed, the transgressors are far astray.

1981.english: Such is the creation of God; show me what their idols have created. Indeed, the wicked are totally astray.

1989.english: Such is the creation of GOD; show me what any idols besides Him have created. Indeed, the transgressors are far astray.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا لقمان الحكمة أن اشكر لله ۚ ومن يشكر فإنما يشكر لنفسه ۖ ومن كفر فإن الله غني حميد
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā luq'māna l-ḥik'mata ani ush'kur lillahi waman yashkur fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ḥamīdu
verses.english: We have endowed Luqmãn with wisdom: "You shall be appreciative of GOD." Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good. As for those who turn unappreciative, GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.
verses.subtitle: Luqmãn's Wisdom

1981.english: We have endowed Luqmaan with wisdom, for he was appreciative of God. Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good. As for the unappreciative, God is in no need; He is worthy of all praise.
1981.subtitle: Luqmaan's Wisdom

1989.english: We have endowed Luqmaan with wisdom: “You shall be appreciative of GOD.’ Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good, but if one turns unappreciative, then GOD is in no need, Most Praised.
1989.subtitle: Luqmaan's Wisdom

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَٰنُ لِٱبْنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قال لقمان لابنه وهو يعظه يا بني لا تشرك بالله ۖ إن الشرك لظلم عظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qāla luq'mānu li-ib'nihi wahuwa yaʿiẓuhu yābunayya lā tush'rik bil-lahi inna l-shir'ka laẓul'mun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Recall that Luqmãn said to his son, as he enlightened him, "O my son, do not set up any idols beside GOD; idolatry is a gross injustice."
verses.footnote: How will you feel if you take care of a child, give him the best education, and prepare him for life, only to see him thank someone else? Thus is idolatry; injustice.

1981.english: Luqmaan said to his son as he enlightened him, "O my son, do not set up any idol besides God; idol worship is a gross offense."
1981.footnote: Idol worship is defined as a "gross offense," rather than a sin. It is far worse than any sin. The Quran teaches us that God forgives "all" sins (see 31:53), while idol worship is the only unforgivable offense (see 4:48, 4:116, and 5:72).

1989.english: Thus, Luqmaan said to his son, as he enlightened him, “O my son, do not set up any idols besides GOD; idolatry is a gross injustice.”*
1989.footnote: How will you feel if you take care of a child, give him the best education, and prepare him for life, only to see him thank someone else? Thus is idolatry; injustice.

verses.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حملته أمه وهنا على وهن وفصاله في عامين أن اشكر لي ولوالديك إلي المصير
verses.transliterated: wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi ḥamalathu ummuhu wahnan ʿalā wahnin wafiṣāluhu fī ʿāmayni ani ush'kur lī waliwālidayka ilayya l-maṣīr
verses.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him, and the load got heavier and heavier. It takes two years (of intensive care) until weaning. You shall be appreciative of Me, and of your parents. To Me is the ultimate destiny.
verses.subtitle: The Second Commandment

1981.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents; his mother bore him as he got heavier and heavier, and cared for him for two years until weaning. You shall be appreciative to Me and to your parents; to Me is the ultimate destiny.

1989.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him, and the load got heavier and heavier. It takes two years (of intensive care) until weaning. You shall be appreciative of Me, and of your parents. To Me is the ultimate destiny.

verses.arabic: وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا وَٱتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَىَّ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن جاهداك على أن تشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما ۖ وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا ۖ واتبع سبيل من أناب إلي ۚ ثم إلي مرجعكم فأنبئكم بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: wa-in jāhadāka ʿalā an tush'rika bī mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun falā tuṭiʿ'humā waṣāḥib'humā fī l-dun'yā maʿrūfan wa-ittabiʿ sabīla man anāba ilayya thumma ilayya marjiʿukum fa-unabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: If they try to force you to set up any idols beside Me, do not obey them. But continue to treat them amicably in this world. You shall follow only the path of those who have submitted to Me. Ultimately, you all return to Me, then I will inform you of everything you have done.

1981.english: However, if they exhort you to set up idols besides Me, do not obey them. But continue to treat them nicely. You shall follow the path of those who submit to Me. To Me is your ultimate return, then I will inform you of everything you did.

1989.english: If they try to force you to set up idols besides Me, do not obey them. But continue to treat them amicably in this world. You shall follow only the path of those who have submitted to Me. Ultimately, you all return to Me, then I will inform you of everything you have done.

verses.arabic: يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني إنها إن تك مثقال حبة من خردل فتكن في صخرة أو في السماوات أو في الأرض يأت بها الله ۚ إن الله لطيف خبير
verses.transliterated: yābunayya innahā in taku mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin fatakun fī ṣakhratin aw fī l-samāwāti aw fī l-arḍi yati bihā l-lahu inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīru
verses.english: "O my son, know that even something as tiny as a mustard seed, deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, GOD will bring it. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
verses.subtitle: Luqmãn's Advice

1981.english: "O my son, even if your deed is as small as a mustard seed, placed inside a rock or anywhere in the heavens or the earth, God will bring it. God is compassionate, cognizant.

1989.english: “O my son, know that even something as tiny as a mustard seed, deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, GOD will bring it. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
