1989.subtitle: Luqmaan’s Advice

verses.arabic: يَٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.arabicClean: يا بني أقم الصلاة وأمر بالمعروف وانه عن المنكر واصبر على ما أصابك ۖ إن ذلك من عزم الأمور
verses.transliterated: yābunayya aqimi l-ṣalata wamur bil-maʿrūfi wa-in'ha ʿani l-munkari wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā aṣābaka inna dhālika min ʿazmi l-umūr
verses.english: "O my son, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat). You shall advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of adversity. These are the most honorable traits.

1981.english: "O my son, observe the **salat** prayers, advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and stay steadfast in the face of adversity; this is the real strength.

1989.english: “O my son, you shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), enjoin righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of adversity. These are the most honorable traits.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تصعر خدك للناس ولا تمش في الأرض مرحا ۖ إن الله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
verses.transliterated: walā tuṣaʿʿir khaddaka lilnnāsi walā tamshi fī l-arḍi maraḥan inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūri
verses.english: "You shall not treat the people with arrogance, nor shall you roam the earth proudly. GOD does not like the arrogant showoffs.

1981.english: "Do not be arrogant, nor shall you walk in pride; God does not love the boastful, the arrogant.

1989.english: “You shall not treat the people with arrogance, nor shall you walk on earth proudly. GOD does not like the arrogant showoffs.

verses.arabic: وَٱقْصِدْ فِى مَشْيِكَ وَٱغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلْأَصْوَٰتِ لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: واقصد في مشيك واغضض من صوتك ۚ إن أنكر الأصوات لصوت الحمير
verses.transliterated: wa-iq'ṣid fī mashyika wa-ugh'ḍuḍ min ṣawtika inna ankara l-aṣwāti laṣawtu l-ḥamīr
verses.english: "Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey's voice."

1981.english: "Be humble as you walk, and lower your voice; the ugliest voice is that of the donkey."

1989.english: “Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey’s voice.”

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تروا أن الله سخر لكم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وأسبغ عليكم نعمه ظاهرة وباطنة ۗ ومن الناس من يجادل في الله بغير علم ولا هدى ولا كتاب منير
verses.transliterated: alam taraw anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-asbagha ʿalaykum niʿamahu ẓāhiratan wabāṭinatan wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīri
verses.english: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings— obvious and hidden? Yet, some people argue about GOD without knowledge, without guidance, and without the enlightening scripture.

1981.english: Do you not see that God put in your service everything in the heavens and everything on earth? He showers you with His bounties, obvious and hidden. Yet some people argue about God without knowledge, nor guidance, nor divine scripture.
1981.subtitle: Be Appreciative of God

1989.english: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings—obvious and hidden? Yet, some people argue about GOD without knowledge, without guidance, and without (knowing) the enlightening scripture.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما أنزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا ۚ أولو كان الشيطان يدعوهم إلى عذاب السعير
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittabiʿū mā anzala l-lahu qālū bal nattabiʿu mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā awalaw kāna l-shayṭānu yadʿūhum ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīr
verses.english: When they are told, "Follow these revelations of GOD," they say, "No, we follow only what we found our parents doing." What if the devil is leading them to the agony of Hell?
verses.subtitle: Following the Parents Blindly: A Common Tragedy

1981.english: And when they are told, "Follow what God has sent down," they say, "We follow only what we found our parents following." What if the devil is leading them to the hellfire?

1989.english: And when they are told, “Follow these revelations of GOD,” they say, “No, we follow only what we found our parents doing.” What if the devil is leading them to the agony of Hell?
1989.subtitle: Following Parents Blindly: A Common Tragedy

verses.arabic: وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يسلم وجهه إلى الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقى ۗ وإلى الله عاقبة الأمور
verses.transliterated: waman yus'lim wajhahu ilā l-lahi wahuwa muḥ'sinun faqadi is'tamsaka bil-ʿur'wati l-wuth'qā wa-ilā l-lahi ʿāqibatu l-umūr
verses.english: Those who submit completely to GOD, while leading a righteous life, have gotten hold of the strongest bond. For GOD is in full control of all things.
verses.subtitle: The Strongest Bond

1981.english: Anyone who submits himself to God, and maintains piety, has gotten hold of the strongest bond. The ultimate end of all things is with God.

1989.english: Only those who submit completely to GOD, while leading a righteous life, have gotten hold of the strongest bond. For GOD is in full control of all things.
1989.subtitle: The Strongest Bond

verses.arabic: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُۥٓ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن كفر فلا يحزنك كفره ۚ إلينا مرجعهم فننبئهم بما عملوا ۚ إن الله عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: waman kafara falā yaḥzunka kuf'ruhu ilaynā marjiʿuhum fanunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū inna l-laha ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve, do not be saddened by their disbelief. To us is their ultimate return, then we will inform them of everything they had done. GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1981.english: As for those who disbelieve, do not be saddened by their disbelief. To us is their ultimate return, then we will inform them of everything they did. God is fully aware of the innermost convictions.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieve, do not be saddened by their disbelief; to us is their ultimate return. We will then inform them of everything they had done. GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verses.arabicClean: نمتعهم قليلا ثم نضطرهم إلى عذاب غليظ
verses.transliterated: numattiʿuhum qalīlan thumma naḍṭarruhum ilā ʿadhābin ghalīẓi
verses.english: We let them enjoy temporarily, then commit them to severe retribution.

1981.english: We may let them enjoy temporarily, then commit them to a terrible retribution.

1989.english: We let them enjoy temporarily, then commit them to severe retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله ۚ قل الحمد لله ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu quli l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth," they will say, "GOD." Say, "Praise be to GOD." Yet, most of them do not know.
verses.subtitle: They Believe in God

1981.english: If you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will say, "God." Say, "Praise God;" most of them do not know.

1989.english: If you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth,” they will say, “GOD.” Say, “Praise be to GOD.” Indeed, most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: لله ما في السماوات والأرض ۚ إن الله هو الغني الحميد
verses.transliterated: lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīd
verses.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praiseworthy.

1981.english: To God belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; God is bounteous, praiseworthy.

1989.english: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praised.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَٰمٌ وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنما في الأرض من شجرة أقلام والبحر يمده من بعده سبعة أبحر ما نفدت كلمات الله ۗ إن الله عزيز حكيم
verses.transliterated: walaw annamā fī l-arḍi min shajaratin aqlāmun wal-baḥru yamudduhu min baʿdihi sabʿatu abḥurin mā nafidat kalimātu l-lahi inna l-laha ʿazīzun ḥakīmu
verses.english: If all the trees on earth were made into pens, and the ocean supplied the ink, augmented by seven more oceans, the words of GOD would not run out. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
verses.subtitle: These Are All the Words We Need

1981.english: If all the trees on earth were made into pens; and the ocean, multiplied sevenfold, supplied the ink, God will never run out of words.* God is almighty, wise.
1981.footnote: Yet some people claim that the Quran is not complete. This verse teaches us that God has given us all the words we need; He did not run out of words. Those who seek other than Quran as a source of law, flatly reject God's revelations (see also 18:109).

1989.english: If all the trees on earth were made into pens, and the ocean supplied the ink, augmented by seven more oceans, the words of GOD would not run out. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
1989.subtitle: These Are All the Words We Need

verses.arabic: مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما خلقكم ولا بعثكم إلا كنفس واحدة ۗ إن الله سميع بصير
verses.transliterated: mā khalqukum walā baʿthukum illā kanafsin wāḥidatin inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīru
verses.english: The creation and resurrection of all of you is the same as that of one person. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

1981.english: Your creation, and your resurrection, is like the creation and resurrection of one person.* God is hearer, seer.
1981.footnote: Once you design and perfect the original (master copy), the copies are easy to make.

1989.english: The creation and resurrection of all of you is the same as that of one person. GOD is Hearer, Seer.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أن الله يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري إلى أجل مسمى وأن الله بما تعملون خبير
verses.transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī ilā ajalin musamman wa-anna l-laha bimā taʿmalūna khabīru
verses.english: Do you not realize that GOD merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night, and that He has committed the sun and the moon in your service, each running in its orbit for a specific life span, and that GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do?
verses.subtitle: God ALONE Worthy of Worship

1981.english: Do you not realize that God merges the night into the day and merges the day into night? He subdued the sun and the moon, each running for a predetermined life span. God is cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: Do you not realize that GOD merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night? And that He has committed the sun and the moon; each running in its orbit for a specific life span? And that GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do?
1989.subtitle: God ALONE Worthy of Worship

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الله هو الحق وأن ما يدعون من دونه الباطل وأن الله هو العلي الكبير
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīr
verses.english: This proves that GOD is the truth, while any idol they set up beside Him is falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, Most Great.

1981.english: This is to show that God is truth, and whatever they idolize besides Him is falsehood, and that God is the most high, the great.

1989.english: This proves that GOD is the truth, that any idol they set up besides Him is falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, Most Great.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أن الفلك تجري في البحر بنعمت الله ليريكم من آياته ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور
verses.transliterated: alam tara anna l-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri biniʿ'mati l-lahi liyuriyakum min āyātihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūri
verses.english: Do you not see that the ships roam the sea, carrying GOD's provisions, to show you some of His proofs? Indeed, these should be sufficient proofs for everyone who is steadfast, appreciative.

1981.english: Do you not realize that the ships roam the sea carrying God's bounties, in order to show you some of His signs? These are signs for everyone who is steadfast, appreciative.

1989.english: Do you not see that the ships roam the sea, carrying GOD’s bounties, to show you some of His signs? In this, there are signs for everyone who is steadfast, appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا غشيهم موج كالظلل دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين فلما نجاهم إلى البر فمنهم مقتصد ۚ وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا كل ختار كفور
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ghashiyahum mawjun kal-ẓulali daʿawū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna falammā najjāhum ilā l-bari famin'hum muq'taṣidun wamā yajḥadu biāyātinā illā kullu khattārin kafūri
verses.english: When violent waves surround them, they implore GOD, sincerely devoting their prayers to Him alone. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, some of them revert. None discards our revelations except those who are betrayers, unappreciative.

1981.english: When overwhelming waves surround them, they implore God sincerely. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, some of them revert. Only unappreciative betrayers discard our revelations.

1989.english: When violent waves surround them, they implore GOD, sincerely devoting the religion to Him alone. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, some of them revert. None discards our revelations except the betrayer, unappreciative.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱخْشَوْا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا يَجْزِى وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما لا يجزي والد عن ولده ولا مولود هو جاز عن والده شيئا ۚ إن وعد الله حق ۖ فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum wa-ikh'shaw yawman lā yajzī wālidun ʿan waladihi walā mawlūdun huwa jāzin ʿan wālidihi shayan inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūr
verses.english: O people, you shall reverence your Lord, and fear a day when a father cannot help his own child, nor a child can help his father. Certainly, GOD's promise is truth. Therefore, do not be distracted by this life; do not be distracted from GOD by mere illusions.

1981.english: O people, beware of your Lord, and reverence the day when no father can help his son, nor a son can help his father. God's promise is true; therefore do not be distracted by this life, and do not be distracted by deceivers.

1989.english: O people, you shall reverence your Lord, and fear a day when a father cannot help his child, nor a child can help his father. Certainly, GOD’s promise is truth. Therefore, do not be distracted by this life; do not be distracted from GOD by illusions.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۢ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله عنده علم الساعة وينزل الغيث ويعلم ما في الأرحام ۖ وما تدري نفس ماذا تكسب غدا ۖ وما تدري نفس بأي أرض تموت ۚ إن الله عليم خبير
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha ʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wayunazzilu l-ghaytha wayaʿlamu mā fī l-arḥāmi wamā tadrī nafsun mādhā taksibu ghadan wamā tadrī nafsun bi-ayyi arḍin tamūtu inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīru
verses.english: With GOD is the knowledge regarding the Hour (end of the world). He is the One who sends down the rain, and He knows the contents of the womb. No soul knows what will happen to it tomorrow, and no one knows in which land he or she will die. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant.
verses.subtitle: Things We May and May Not Know
verses.footnote: God reveals His knowledge whenever He wills. We learn from this verse that we may be able to predict the rain, and the gender of the fetus. But we can never know the time or place of death. In accordance with 72:27, God has revealed the end of the world through His Messenger of the Covenant. See 15:87, 20:15, and Appendix 25 for the details.

1981.english: God is the only one who knows about the Hour: He is the one who sends down the rain; He knows the contents of every womb. Meanwhile, no one else knows what happens tomorrow, nor in which land he will die. God is omniscient, cognizant.

1989.english: With GOD is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world) * He is the One who sends down the rain, and He knows the contents of the womb. No soul knows what will happen to it tomorrow, and no one knows in which land he or she will die. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant. v
1989.footnote: In accordance with 72:27, God has revealed the end of the world through His Messenger of the Covenant. See 15:87, 20:15, and Appendix 25 for the details.

verses.arabic: الٓمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الم
verses.transliterated: alif-lam-meem
verses.english: A. L. M.
verses.footnote: The meaning of these letters is given in the next verse: "This book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe." See Appendix 1 for the details.

1981.english: A.L.M.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 1 for details of the Quran's secret numerical code. These Quranic initials constitute a significant part of the Quran's miracle. The Quran came to the world 1400 years ago and stood on its own without any supporting evidence that it is a divine scripture. This 1400-year-old secret has been unveiled in the course of this translation.

1989.english: A. L. M.*
1989.footnote: The meaning of these letters is given in the next verse: “This book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe. ” See Appendix 1 for the details.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل الكتاب لا ريب فيه من رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: tanzīlu l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: The book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: The revelation of this scripture is, without a doubt, from the Lord of the universe.
1981.footnote: This verse tells us the meaning or significance of the first verse, i.e., these letters prove that the Quran is the word of God. This kind of statement invariably follows the Quranic initials throughout the Quran. In retrospect, our Creator has been telling us the meaning of these "mysterious" letters since the revelation of Quran.

1989.english: The book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون افتراه ۚ بل هو الحق من ربك لتنذر قوما ما أتاهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يهتدون
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu bal huwa l-ḥaqu min rabbika litundhira qawman mā atāhum min nadhīrin min qablika laʿallahum yahtadūn
verses.english: They said, "He fabricated it." Indeed, this is the truth from your Lord, to warn people who never received a warner before you, that they may be guided.

1981.english: Do they say that he made it up? Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, to warn people who received no warner before you, that they may be guided.

1989.english: They may say, “He fabricated it.” No. This is the truth from your Lord, to warn people who never received a warner before you, that they may be guided.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض وما بينهما في ستة أيام ثم استوى على العرش ۖ ما لكم من دونه من ولي ولا شفيع ۚ أفلا تتذكرون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi mā lakum min dūnihi min waliyyin walā shafīʿin afalā tatadhakkarūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, then assumed all authority. You have none beside Him as Lord, nor do you have an intercessor. Would you not take heed?
verses.subtitle: No Mediator Between God And You

1981.english: God is the one who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, then assumed all authority. You have none besides Him as a lord or intercessor; would you take heed?

1989.english: GOD the One who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, then assumed all authority. You have none besides Him as Lord, nor a mediator. Would you not take heed?
1989.subtitle: No Mediator Between God and You

verses.arabic: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: يدبر الأمر من السماء إلى الأرض ثم يعرج إليه في يوم كان مقداره ألف سنة مما تعدون
verses.transliterated: yudabbiru l-amra mina l-samāi ilā l-arḍi thumma yaʿruju ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu alfa sanatin mimmā taʿuddūn
verses.english: All matters are controlled by Him from the heaven to the earth. To Him, the day is equivalent to one thousand of your years.

1981.english: He controls everything from the heaven to the earth, through a distance where one day is equivalent to one thousand of your years.

1989.english: All matters are controlled by Him from the heaven to the earth. To Him, the day is equivalent to one thousand of your years,

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك عالم الغيب والشهادة العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: dhālika ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Such is the knower of all secrets and declarations; the almighty, the merciful.

1989.english: Such is the Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Almighty, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ مِن طِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: الذي أحسن كل شيء خلقه ۖ وبدأ خلق الإنسان من طين
verses.transliterated: alladhī aḥsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabada-a khalqa l-insāni min ṭīni
verses.english: He is the One who perfected everything He created, and started the creation of the human from clay.
verses.subtitle: The Origin of Man

1981.english: He perfected everything He created, and started the creation of man from clay.

1989.english: He perfected everything He created, and started the creation of man from clay.
1989.subtitle: The Origin of Man

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ثم جعل نسله من سلالة من ماء مهين
verses.transliterated: thumma jaʿala naslahu min sulālatin min māin mahīni
verses.english: Then He continued his reproduction through a certain lowly liquid.

1981.english: Then He continued his reproduction through a certain lowly liquid.

1989.english: Then He continued his reproduction through a certain lowly liquid.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم سواه ونفخ فيه من روحه ۖ وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة ۚ قليلا ما تشكرون
verses.transliterated: thumma sawwāhu wanafakha fīhi min rūḥihi wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
verses.english: He shaped him and blew into him from His spirit. And He gave you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains; rarely are you thankful.

1981.english: Then He perfected him and blew into him from His soul. He gave you the hearing, the eyes, and the minds; yet rarely are you appreciative.

1989.english: He shaped him and blew into him from His spirit. And He gave yoi the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains; rarely are you appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا أإذا ضللنا في الأرض أإنا لفي خلق جديد ۚ بل هم بلقاء ربهم كافرون
verses.transliterated: waqālū a-idhā ḍalalnā fī l-arḍi a-innā lafī khalqin jadīdin bal hum biliqāi rabbihim kāfirūn
verses.english: They wonder, "After we vanish into the earth, do we get created anew?" Thus, as regards meeting their Lord, they are disbelievers.

1981.english: They said, "After we vanish into the soil, do we get recreated?" Indeed, they disbelieve in meeting their Lord.

1989.english: They wondered, “After we vanish into the earth, do we get created anew?” Indeed, they have disbelieved in meeting their Lord.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يتوفاكم ملك الموت الذي وكل بكم ثم إلى ربكم ترجعون
verses.transliterated: qul yatawaffākum malaku l-mawti alladhī wukkila bikum thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: Say, "You will be put to death by the angel in whose charge you are placed, then to your Lord you will be returned."

1981.english: Say, "The angel of death that is assigned to you will terminate your life, then to your Lord is your ultimate return."

1989.english: Say, “You will be put to death by the angel in whose charge you are placed, then to your Lord you will be returned.”

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو ترى إذ المجرمون ناكسو رءوسهم عند ربهم ربنا أبصرنا وسمعنا فارجعنا نعمل صالحا إنا موقنون
verses.transliterated: walaw tarā idhi l-muj'rimūna nākisū ruūsihim ʿinda rabbihim rabbanā abṣarnā wasamiʿ'nā fa-ir'jiʿ'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūn
verses.english: If only you could see the guilty when they bow down their heads before their Lord: "Our Lord, now we have seen and we have heard. Send us back and we will be righteous. Now we have attained certainty."
verses.subtitle: Too Late
verses.footnote: If sent back, they would commit the same transgressions. See Footnote 6:28.

1981.english: If you could only envision the guilty, bowing their heads, when they meet their Lord; they will say, "Our Lord, now we see and we hear. Send us back and we will work righteousness; now we are positive."

1989.english: If only you could see the guilty when they bow their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, now we have seen and we have heard; send us back and we will be righteous. Now we have attained certainty.”*
1989.subtitle: Too Late
1989.footnote: If sent back, they would commit the same sins. See Footnote 6:28.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو شئنا لآتينا كل نفس هداها ولكن حق القول مني لأملأن جهنم من الجنة والناس أجمعين
verses.transliterated: walaw shi'nā laātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā walākin ḥaqqa l-qawlu minnī la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīn
verses.english: Had we willed, we could have given every soul its guidance, but it is already predetermined that I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together.
verses.footnote: The majority of humans "insist" upon going to Hell, by choosing to ignore God's invitations to redeem them. God will not put a single person in Hell. Those who fail to redeem themselves by denouncing idolatry and devoting themselves to God ALONE, and fail to develop their souls through the practices prescribed by our Creator, will have to run to Hell on their own volition. They will be too weak to stand the physical presence of God's energy.

1981.english: Had we willed, we could have given guidance to everyone. But it is already predetermined that I fill hell with jinns and humans all together.

1989.english: Had we willed, we could have given every soul its guidance, but it is already a predetermined fact that I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together.*
1989.footnote: The majority of humans “insist” on going to Hell, choosing to ignore God’s invitations to redeem them. God will not put a single person into Hell. Those who fail to redeem themselves by denouncing idolatry and devoting themselves to God ALONE, then developing their souls through the practices prescribed by our Creator, will have to run to Hell on their own volition, because they cannot stand God’s energy.

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فذوقوا بما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا إنا نسيناكم ۖ وذوقوا عذاب الخلد بما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: fadhūqū bimā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā innā nasīnākum wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: Taste the consequences of your forgetting this day; now we forget you. You have incurred eternal retribution in return for your own works.

1981.english: Suffer the consequences of ignoring this day; for we ignore you now. Suffer the eternal retribution because of what you did.

1989.english: Taste the consequences of your forgetting this day—we now forget you. Taste the eternal retribution in return for your works.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما يؤمن بآياتنا الذين إذا ذكروا بها خروا سجدا وسبحوا بحمد ربهم وهم لا يستكبرون ۩
verses.transliterated: innamā yu'minu biāyātinā alladhīna idhā dhukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadan wasabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wahum lā yastakbirūn
verses.english: The only people who truly believe in our revelations are those who fall prostrate upon hearing them. They glorify and praise their Lord, without any arrogance.

1981.english: The only people who truly believe in our revelations are those who, when reminded thereof, submit immediately;* they fall prostrate and praise the glory of their Lord without hesitation.
1981.footnote: The true believers submit to the Quran without question and accept it as the **only** source of jurisprudence. See Appendices 15, 16, and 17.

1989.english: The only people who truly believe in our revelations are those who fall prostrate upon hearing them. They glorify and praise their Lord, without any arrogance.

verses.arabic: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: تتجافى جنوبهم عن المضاجع يدعون ربهم خوفا وطمعا ومما رزقناهم ينفقون
verses.transliterated: tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿani l-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfan waṭamaʿan wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn
verses.english: Their sides readily forsake their beds, in order to worship their Lord, out of reverence and hope, and from our provisions to them, they give.

1981.english: Their bodies forsake the beds in favor of worshiping their Lord, out of reverence and hope, and they spend (in charity) from our provisions to them.

1989.english: Their sides readily forsake their beds, in order to worship their Lord, out of reverence and hope. And from our provisions to them, they give.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تعلم نفس ما أخفي لهم من قرة أعين جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: falā taʿlamu nafsun mā ukh'fiya lahum min qurrati aʿyunin jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: You have no idea how much joy and happiness are waiting for you as a reward for your (righteous) works.
verses.subtitle: Heaven: Indescribably Beautiful

1981.english: No soul knows what is kept hidden for them of joy, as a reward for their work.

1989.english: You have no idea how much joy and happiness are waiting for you as a reward for your (righteous) works.
1989.subtitle: Heaven: Indescribably Beautiful

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن كان مؤمنا كمن كان فاسقا ۚ لا يستوون
verses.transliterated: afaman kāna mu'minan kaman kāna fāsiqan lā yastawūn
verses.english: Is one who is a believer the same as one who is wicked? They are not equal.

1981.english: Is one who is a believer the same as one who is wicked? They are not equal.

1989.english: Is one who is a believer the same as one who is wicked? They are not equal.

verses.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فلهم جنات المأوى نزلا بما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātu l-mawā nuzulan bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the eternal Paradise. Such is their abode, in return for their works.

1981.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the eternal abode of Paradise as a recompense for their work.

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the eternal Paradise. Such is their abode, in return for their works.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما الذين فسقوا فمأواهم النار ۖ كلما أرادوا أن يخرجوا منها أعيدوا فيها وقيل لهم ذوقوا عذاب النار الذي كنتم به تكذبون
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā alladhīna fasaqū famawāhumu l-nāru kullamā arādū an yakhrujū min'hā uʿīdū fīhā waqīla lahum dhūqū ʿadhāba l-nāri alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūn
verses.english: As for the wicked, their destiny is Hell. Every time they try to leave it, they will be forced back. They will be told, "Taste the agony of Hell which you used to disbelieve in."

1981.english: But those who worked evil, their abode is hell; whenever they try to get out of it, they will be returned to it and told, "Suffer the retribution of hell that you used to deny."

1989.english: As for the wicked, their destiny is Hell. Every time they try to leave it, they will be forced back. They will be told, “Taste the agony of Hell which you used to deny.”

verses.arabic: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولنذيقنهم من العذاب الأدنى دون العذاب الأكبر لعلهم يرجعون
verses.transliterated: walanudhīqannahum mina l-ʿadhābi l-adnā dūna l-ʿadhābi l-akbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.english: We let them taste the smaller retribution (of this world), before they incur the greater retribution (of the Hereafter), that they may (take a hint and) reform.
verses.subtitle: Take A Hint

1981.english: We afflict them with some retribution in this life, that they may reform.

1989.english: We let them taste the smaller retribution (of this world), before they incur the greater retribution (of the Hereafter), that they may (take a hint and) reform.
1989.subtitle: Take A Hint

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أظلم ممن ذكر بآيات ربه ثم أعرض عنها ۚ إنا من المجرمين منتقمون
verses.transliterated: waman aẓlamu mimman dhukkira biāyāti rabbihi thumma aʿraḍa ʿanhā innā mina l-muj'rimīna muntaqimūn
verses.english: Who is more evil than one who is reminded of these revelations of his Lord, then insists upon disregarding them? We will certainly punish the guilty.

1981.english: Who is more wicked than one who is reminded of his Lord's revelations, then disregards them? We will certainly punish the guilty.

1989.english: Who is more evil than one who is reminded of these revelations of his Lord, then insists upon disregarding them? We will certainly avenge from the guilty.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فلا تكن في مرية من لقائه ۖ وجعلناه هدى لبني إسرائيل
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba falā takun fī mir'yatin min liqāihi wajaʿalnāhu hudan libanī is'rāīl
verses.english: We have given Moses the scripture—do not harbor any doubt about meeting Him—and we made it a guide for the Children of Israel.

1981.english: We have given Moses the scripture, stating, "You shall have no doubt about meeting God," and we made it a guide for the children of Israel.

1989.english: We have given Moses the scripture—do not harbor any doubt about that—and we made it a guide for the Children of Israel.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا منهم أئمة يهدون بأمرنا لما صبروا ۖ وكانوا بآياتنا يوقنون
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā min'hum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā lammā ṣabarū wakānū biāyātinā yūqinūn
verses.english: We appointed from among them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, because they steadfastly persevered and attained certainty about our revelations.

1981.english: We appointed **imams** from among them, who guided in accordance with our commandments, because they maintained steadfastness and upheld our scripture.

1989.english: We appointed from among them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, because they steadfastly persevered and attained certainty about our revelations.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربك هو يفصل بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection, regarding everything they disputed.

1981.english: Your Lord is the one who judges them on the day of resurrection, regarding their disputes.

1989.english: Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection, regarding everything they disputed.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يهد لهم كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مساكنهم ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات ۖ أفلا يسمعون
verses.transliterated: awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin afalā yasmaʿūn
verses.english: Does it ever occur to them how many generations we have annihilated before them? They now live and walk in their ancestors' homes. This should provide sufficient proofs. Do they not hear?

1981.english: Does it ever occur to them how many generations we have annihilated before them? They have walked in their ruins. These are profound lessons; do they not hear?

1989.english: Did it ever occur to them how many generations we have annihilated before them? They now live in their ancestors’ homes. This should provide sufficient signs. Do they not hear?

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا أنا نسوق الماء إلى الأرض الجرز فنخرج به زرعا تأكل منه أنعامهم وأنفسهم ۖ أفلا يبصرون
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw annā nasūqu l-māa ilā l-arḍi l-juruzi fanukh'riju bihi zarʿan takulu min'hu anʿāmuhum wa-anfusuhum afalā yub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Do they not realize that we drive the water to barren lands, and produce with it crops to feed their livestock, as well as themselves? Do they not see?

1981.english: Do they not realize that we drive the water to barren land and produce plants that feed them and their animals? Do they not see?

1989.english: Do they not realize that we drive the water to arid lands, and produce with it crops to feed their livestock, as well as themselves? Do they not see?

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويقولون متى هذا الفتح إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They challenge: "Where is that victory, if you are truthful?"

1981.english: They say, "Where is this victory, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: They challenge: “Where is that victory, if you are truthful?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يوم الفتح لا ينفع الذين كفروا إيمانهم ولا هم ينظرون
verses.transliterated: qul yawma l-fatḥi lā yanfaʿu alladhīna kafarū īmānuhum walā hum yunẓarūn
verses.english: Say, "The day such a victory comes, believing will not benefit those who did not believe before that, nor will they be given another chance."

1981.english: Say, "On the day of victory, it will be useless for the disbelievers to believe; no longer will they be respited."

1989.english: Say, “The day such a victory comes, believing will not benefit those who did not believe before that, nor will they be given another chance.”

verses.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأعرض عنهم وانتظر إنهم منتظرون
verses.transliterated: fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum wa-intaẓir innahum muntaẓirūn
verses.english: Therefore, disregard them and wait, they too are waiting.

1981.english: Therefore, disregard them and wait; they too have to wait.

1989.english: Therefore, disregard them and wait, they too are waiting. N

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا أيها النبي اتق الله ولا تطع الكافرين والمنافقين ۗ إن الله كان عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu ittaqi l-laha walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: O you prophet, you shall reverence GOD and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: O you prophet, observe God, and do not obey the disbelievers or the hypocrites. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: O you prophet, observe GOD, and do not obey the disbelievers and hypocrites. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: واتبع ما يوحى إليك من ربك ۚ إن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا
verses.transliterated: wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka min rabbika inna l-laha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīra
verses.english: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you all do.

1981.english: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord; God is cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you all do.

verses.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: وتوكل على الله ۚ وكفى بالله وكيلا
verses.transliterated: watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīla
verses.english: And put your trust in GOD. GOD suffices as an advocate.

1981.english: You shall trust in God; for God suffices as guardian.

1989.english: You shall put your trust in GOD. GOD suffices as an advocate.

verses.arabic: مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِى جَوْفِهِۦ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى تُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَآءَكُمْ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى ٱلسَّبِيلَ
verses.arabicClean: ما جعل الله لرجل من قلبين في جوفه ۚ وما جعل أزواجكم اللائي تظاهرون منهن أمهاتكم ۚ وما جعل أدعياءكم أبناءكم ۚ ذلكم قولكم بأفواهكم ۖ والله يقول الحق وهو يهدي السبيل
verses.transliterated: mā jaʿala l-lahu lirajulin min qalbayni fī jawfihi wamā jaʿala azwājakumu allāī tuẓāhirūna min'hunna ummahātikum wamā jaʿala adʿiyāakum abnāakum dhālikum qawlukum bi-afwāhikum wal-lahu yaqūlu l-ḥaqa wahuwa yahdī l-sabīl
verses.english: GOD did not give any man two hearts in his chest. Nor did He turn your wives whom you estrange (according to your custom) into your mothers. Nor did He turn your adopted children into genetic offspring. All these are mere utterances that you have invented. GOD speaks the truth, and He guides in the (right) path.
verses.subtitle: Devotion to God Is Indivisible
verses.footnote: It was a custom in Arabia to estrange the wife by declaring that she was like the husband's mother. Such an unfair practice is abrogated herein.

1981.english: God did not give any human two hearts. Nor did He make your wives, whom you estrange, forbidden for intercourse as if they were your mothers.* Nor did He make your adopted children your own. These are your inventions. God speaks the truth, and He guides to the right way.
1981.subtitle: Forsake Traditions
1981.footnote: A previously prevalent expression in the Arabic language was to estrange a wife by saying that she is like the husband's mother (as far as intercourse is concerned), without giving her the freedom of divorce.

1989.english: GOD did not give any man two hearts. Nor did He turn your wives whom you estrange (according to your custom) into your mothers.* Nor did He turn your adopted children into genetic offspring. All these are mere utterances that you have invented. GOD speaks the truth, and He guides in the (right) path.
1989.subtitle: Devotion to God Is Indivisible
1989.footnote: It was a custom in Arabia to estrange the wife by declaring that she was like the husband’s mother. Such an unfair practice is abrogated by the Quran.

verses.arabic: ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِءَابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ادعوهم لآبائهم هو أقسط عند الله ۚ فإن لم تعلموا آباءهم فإخوانكم في الدين ومواليكم ۚ وليس عليكم جناح فيما أخطأتم به ولكن ما تعمدت قلوبكم ۚ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: id'ʿūhum liābāihim huwa aqsaṭu ʿinda l-lahi fa-in lam taʿlamū ābāahum fa-ikh'wānukum fī l-dīni wamawālīkum walaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun fīmā akhṭatum bihi walākin mā taʿammadat qulūbukum wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: You shall give your adopted children names that preserve their relationship to their genetic parents. This is more equitable in the sight of GOD. If you do not know their parents, then, as your brethren in religion, you shall treat them as members of your family. You do not commit a sin if you make a mistake in this respect; you are responsible for your purposeful intentions. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Do Not Change Your Names

1981.english: You shall give your adopted children names that preserve their relationship to their real parents. This is more equitable in the sight of God. If you do not know their parents, then treat them as family members. You commit no sin if you make unintentional mistakes; you are responsible for your real intentions. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: You shall give your adopted children names that preserve their relationship to their genetic fathers. This is more equitable in the sight of GOD. If you do not know their fathers, then, as your brethren in religion, you shall treat them as members of your family. You do not commit a sin if you make a mistake in this respect; you are only responsible for your actual intentions. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: Do Not Change Your Names

verses.arabic: ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفْعَلُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِكُم مَّعْرُوفًا كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
verses.arabicClean: النبي أولى بالمؤمنين من أنفسهم ۖ وأزواجه أمهاتهم ۗ وأولو الأرحام بعضهم أولى ببعض في كتاب الله من المؤمنين والمهاجرين إلا أن تفعلوا إلى أوليائكم معروفا ۚ كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا
verses.transliterated: al-nabiyu awlā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa-azwājuhu ummahātuhum wa-ulū l-arḥāmi baʿḍuhum awlā bibaʿḍin fī kitābi l-lahi mina l-mu'minīna wal-muhājirīna illā an tafʿalū ilā awliyāikum maʿrūfan kāna dhālika fī l-kitābi masṭūra
verses.english: The prophet is closer to the believers than they are to each other, and his wives are like mothers to them. The relatives ought to take care of one another in accordance with GOD's scripture. Thus, the believers shall take care of their relatives who immigrate to them, provided they have taken care of their own families first. These are commandments of this scripture.

1981.english: The prophet is closer to the believers than themselves, and his wives are like mothers to them. The relatives shall be given priority, in accordance with God's scripture, ahead of the other believers and immigrants. But you shall maintain kindness towards all of them. These are written commandments of the scripture.

1989.english: The prophet is closer to the believers than they are to each other, and his wives are like their mothers. Those who are related to each other shall take care of one another in accordance with GOD’s scripture. Thus, the believers shall take care of their relatives who immigrate to them, provided they have taken care of their own families first. These are commandments of this scripture.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِيثَٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أخذنا من النبيين ميثاقهم ومنك ومن نوح وإبراهيم وموسى وعيسى ابن مريم ۖ وأخذنا منهم ميثاقا غليظا
verses.transliterated: wa-idh akhadhnā mina l-nabiyīna mīthāqahum waminka wamin nūḥin wa-ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā ib'ni maryama wa-akhadhnā min'hum mīthāqan ghalīẓa
verses.english: Recall that we took from the prophets their covenant, including you (O Muhammad), Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn pledge.
verses.subtitle: Muhammad Pledges to Support God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: The covenant is detailed in 3:81. God took a covenant from the prophets that they shall support His Messenger of the Covenant who would come after Muhammad to purify and unify their messages. The Covenant was made before the earth's creation, and was fulfilled in Mecca Zul-Hijja 3, 1391 (Dec. 21, 1971). The sum of the Islamic month (12), plus the day (3), plus the year (1391) gives 1406, 19x74. Overwhelming proof identifying God's Messenger of the Covenant as Rashad Khalifa is provided throughout the Quran (Appendices 2 & 26).

1981.english: We have made a covenant with all the prophets; with you, and with Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary. We made a solemn covenant with them.

1989.english: Recall that we took from the prophets their covenant, including a pledge from you (O Muhammad), and from Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn pledge.*
1989.subtitle: Muhammad Pledges to Support God’s Messenger of the Covenant
1989.footnote: This verse refers to the covenant that is detailed in 3:81. God took a covenant from the prophets that they shall support His Messenger of the Covenant who would come after them, and is destined to unify their messages under the banner of worship ing God alone. The specific identity of that messenger, and details of incontrovertible supporting evidence are given in Appendices 2 and 26. The Covenant was made before creation, and was finally fulfilled in Mecca, December 21, 1971 (Zul-Hijja 3, 1391).

verses.arabic: لِّيَسْـَٔلَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ليسأل الصادقين عن صدقهم ۚ وأعد للكافرين عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: liyasala l-ṣādiqīna ʿan ṣid'qihim wa-aʿadda lil'kāfirīna ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: Subsequently, He will surely question the truthful about their truthfulness, and has prepared for the disbelievers (in this Quranic fact) a painful retribution.

1981.english: That God rewards the truthful for their truthfulness, and has prepared for the disbelievers a painful retribution.

1989.english: He will surely question the truthful about their truthfulness, and has prepared for the disbelievers (in this Quranic fact) a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اذكروا نعمة الله عليكم إذ جاءتكم جنود فأرسلنا عليهم ريحا وجنودا لم تروها ۚ وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh jāatkum junūdun fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan wajunūdan lam tarawhā wakāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīra
verses.english: O you who believe, remember GOD's blessing upon you; when soldiers attacked you, we sent upon them violent wind and invisible soldiers. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
verses.subtitle: The Battle of the Parties

1981.english: O you who believe, remember God's blessing upon you when the troops came to you. We sent upon them a storm and invisible soldiers. God is seer of everything you do.
1981.subtitle: The Battle of the Allies
1981.footnote: This is the battle where the Muslims dug a ditch around Yathrib (Medina). The disbelievers were hit with a violent storm and had to disperse without victory.

1989.english: O you who believe, remember GOD’s blessing upon you when soldiers attacked you; we sent upon them violent wind, and invisible soldiers. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
1989.subtitle: The Battle of the Parties

verses.arabic: إِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠
verses.arabicClean: إذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن أسفل منكم وإذ زاغت الأبصار وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا
verses.transliterated: idh jāūkum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa-idh zāghati l-abṣāru wabalaghati l-qulūbu l-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna bil-lahi l-ẓunūn
verses.english: When they came from above you, and from beneath you, your eyes were terrified, your hearts ran out of patience, and you harbored unbefitting thoughts about GOD.

1981.english: They converged upon you from above you, and from below you, and you became utterly frightened; you lost your confidence in God.

1989.english: They came from above you, and from beneath you. Your eyes and hearts were terrified, and you harbored unbefitting thoughts about GOD.

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: هنالك ابتلي المؤمنون وزلزلوا زلزالا شديدا
verses.transliterated: hunālika ub'tuliya l-mu'minūna wazul'zilū zil'zālan shadīda
verses.english: That is when the believers were truly tested; they were severely shaken up.

1981.english: The believers were really tested then and were shaken up violently.

1989.english: That is when the believers were truly tested, and were severely shaken up.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذ يقول المنافقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض ما وعدنا الله ورسوله إلا غرورا
verses.transliterated: wa-idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu illā ghurūra
verses.english: The hypocrites and those with doubts in their hearts said, "What GOD and His messenger promised us was no more than an illusion!"

1981.english: That is when the hypocrites and the doubtful were exposed and said, "What God and His messenger promised us is false."

1989.english: The hypocrites and those with doubts in their hearts said, “What GOD and His messenger promised us was no more than an illusion!”

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذ قالت طائفة منهم يا أهل يثرب لا مقام لكم فارجعوا ۚ ويستأذن فريق منهم النبي يقولون إن بيوتنا عورة وما هي بعورة ۖ إن يريدون إلا فرارا
verses.transliterated: wa-idh qālat ṭāifatun min'hum yāahla yathriba lā muqāma lakum fa-ir'jiʿū wayastadhinu farīqun min'humu l-nabiya yaqūlūna inna buyūtanā ʿawratun wamā hiya biʿawratin in yurīdūna illā firāra
verses.english: A group of them said, "O people of Yathrib, you cannot attain victory; go back." Others made up excuses to the prophet: "Our homes are vulnerable," when they were not vulnerable. They just wanted to flee.

1981.english: Some of them even said, "O people of Yathrib,* you have no chance to win; let us give up." Some of them asked the prophet's permission to give up, saying, "Our homes are vulnerable," even though they were not vulnerable. All they wanted was to flee.
1981.footnote: The ancient name of Medina.

1989.english: A group of them said, “O people of Yathrib, you cannot attain victory; go back.” Others made up excuses to the prophet: “Our homes are exposed,” when they were not exposed. They just wanted to flee.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ولو دخلت عليهم من أقطارها ثم سئلوا الفتنة لآتوها وما تلبثوا بها إلا يسيرا
verses.transliterated: walaw dukhilat ʿalayhim min aqṭārihā thumma su-ilū l-fit'nata laātawhā wamā talabbathū bihā illā yasīra
verses.english: Had the enemy invaded and asked them to join, they would have joined the enemy without hesitation.

1981.english: If the enemy were to invade from every direction, and they were asked to betray the believers, they would readily cooperate.

1989.english: Had the enemy invaded, and asked them to join, they would have joined the enemy without hesitation.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ عَٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًا
verses.arabicClean: ولقد كانوا عاهدوا الله من قبل لا يولون الأدبار ۚ وكان عهد الله مسئولا
verses.transliterated: walaqad kānū ʿāhadū l-laha min qablu lā yuwallūna l-adbāra wakāna ʿahdu l-lahi masūla
verses.english: They had pledged to GOD in the past that they would not turn around and flee; making a pledge with GOD involves a great responsibility.

1981.english: They had vowed to God that they will never flee, and they are responsible for such a vow.

1989.english: They had covenanted with GOD in the past that they would not turn around and flee; making a pledge with GOD involves responsibility.

verses.arabic: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَوِ ٱلْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: قل لن ينفعكم الفرار إن فررتم من الموت أو القتل وإذا لا تمتعون إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: qul lan yanfaʿakumu l-firāru in farartum mina l-mawti awi l-qatli wa-idhan lā tumattaʿūna illā qalīla
verses.english: Say, "If you flee, you can never flee from death or from being killed. No matter what happens, you only live a short while longer."

1981.english: Say, "Fleeing will never save you from death or from getting killed, eventually. You can only last a while longer."

1989.english: Say, “If you flee, you can never flee from death or from being killed. No matter what happens, you only live a short while longer.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: قل من ذا الذي يعصمكم من الله إن أراد بكم سوءا أو أراد بكم رحمة ۚ ولا يجدون لهم من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا
verses.transliterated: qul man dhā alladhī yaʿṣimukum mina l-lahi in arāda bikum sūan aw arāda bikum raḥmatan walā yajidūna lahum min dūni l-lahi waliyyan walā naṣīra
verses.english: Say, "Who would protect you from GOD if He willed any adversity, or willed any blessing for you?" They can never find, beside GOD, any other Lord and Master.

1981.english: Say, "Afterwards, who will protect you from God, if He decides to punish you or pardon you?" They can never find, besides God, any Lord or supporter.

1989.english: Say, “Who would protect you from GOD if He willed any adversity, or willed any blessing for you?” They can never find, besides GOD, any other Lord or Master.

verses.arabic: قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلْقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: قد يعلم الله المعوقين منكم والقائلين لإخوانهم هلم إلينا ۖ ولا يأتون البأس إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: qad yaʿlamu l-lahu l-muʿawiqīna minkum wal-qāilīna li-ikh'wānihim halumma ilaynā walā yatūna l-basa illā qalīla
verses.english: GOD is fully aware of the hinderers among you, and those who say to their comrades, "Let us all stay behind." Rarely do they mobilize for defense.

1981.english: God is fully aware of the hinderers among you, and those who tell their comrades, "Stay with us;" they are not willing to strive, except rarely.

1989.english: GOD is fully aware of the hinderers among you, and those who say to their comrades, “Let us all stay behind.” Rarely do they mobilize for defense.

verses.arabic: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ فَإِذَا جَآءَ ٱلْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَٱلَّذِى يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ٱلْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَأَحْبَطَ ٱللَّهُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: أشحة عليكم ۖ فإذا جاء الخوف رأيتهم ينظرون إليك تدور أعينهم كالذي يغشى عليه من الموت ۖ فإذا ذهب الخوف سلقوكم بألسنة حداد أشحة على الخير ۚ أولئك لم يؤمنوا فأحبط الله أعمالهم ۚ وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا
verses.transliterated: ashiḥḥatan ʿalaykum fa-idhā jāa l-khawfu ra-aytahum yanẓurūna ilayka tadūru aʿyunuhum ka-alladhī yugh'shā ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-idhā dhahaba l-khawfu salaqūkum bi-alsinatin ḥidādin ashiḥḥatan ʿalā l-khayri ulāika lam yu'minū fa-aḥbaṭa l-lahu aʿmālahum wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīra
verses.english: Also, they are too stingy when dealing with you. If anything threatens the community, you see their eyes rolling with fear, as if death had already come to them. Once the crisis is over, they whip you with sharp tongues. They are too stingy with their wealth. These are not believers, and, consequently, GOD has nullified their works. This is easy for GOD to do.

1981.english: They are stingy towards you; and when war erupts, you see them looking at you with terrified eyes, as if they were about to die. Once the war is over, they scold you with sharp tongues. They are too stingy to offer help, for they never really believed. Therefore, God nullifies their works, and this is easy for God to do.

1989.english: They are too stingy when dealing with you. If anything threatens the community, you see their eyes rolling with fear, as if death had already come to them. Once the crisis is over, they whip you with sharp tongues. They are too stingy with their wealth. These are not believers, and this is why GOD nullifies their works. This is easy for GOD to do.

verses.arabic: يَحْسَبُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ وَإِن يَأْتِ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِى ٱلْأَعْرَابِ يَسْـَٔلُونَ عَنْ أَنۢبَآئِكُمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا قَٰتَلُوٓا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: يحسبون الأحزاب لم يذهبوا ۖ وإن يأت الأحزاب يودوا لو أنهم بادون في الأعراب يسألون عن أنبائكم ۖ ولو كانوا فيكم ما قاتلوا إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: yaḥsabūna l-aḥzāba lam yadhhabū wa-in yati l-aḥzābu yawaddū law annahum bādūna fī l-aʿrābi yasalūna ʿan anbāikum walaw kānū fīkum mā qātalū illā qalīla
verses.english: They thought that the parties might come back. In that case, they would wish that they were lost in the desert, asking about your news from afar. Had the parties attacked you while they were with you, they would rarely support you.

1981.english: They thought that the allies may come back and wished they were scattered throughout the desert, checking on you from afar. If they happened to be with you, they would not fight, except rarely.

1989.english: They thought that the parties might come back. In that case, they would wish that they were lost in the desert, asking about your news from afar. Had the parties attacked you while they were with you, they would rarely support you.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: لقد كان لكم في رسول الله أسوة حسنة لمن كان يرجو الله واليوم الآخر وذكر الله كثيرا
verses.transliterated: laqad kāna lakum fī rasūli l-lahi us'watun ḥasanatun liman kāna yarjū l-laha wal-yawma l-ākhira wadhakara l-laha kathīra
verses.english: The messenger of GOD has set up a good example for those among you who seek GOD and the Last Day, and constantly think about GOD.
verses.subtitle: The Prophet's Courage
verses.footnote: Satan took this verse out of context, and relied on the people's idolization of the prophet Muhammad to innovate a whole set of unauthorized and unreasonable regulations called "Sunna of the Prophet." This created a totally different religion (see 42:21 and Appendix 18).

1981.english: The messenger of God is a good example for you; for any of you who truly seek God and the hereafter and commemorate God frequently.
1981.footnote: This verse refers specifically to the prophet's confidence in God's support and victory. It is placed right in the middle of the story of the **Al-Ahzaab** battle, where the believers were truly shaken up and thought that Islam was finished. However, there is no harm in generalizing the verse and considering the prophet a good example for all of us. The prophet's example is set by the fact that he upheld the Quran, and nothing but the Quran (see 5:48, 49 and 7:73-75). Those who idolize the prophet forget that to love, respect, and obey the prophet is to worship God alone and uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. They invented a whole set of actions, which they called **sunna**, and attributed them to the prophet. The prophet will be the first to disown them on the day of judgment. Moreover, the abusers of this verse reveal their ignorance of Quran. They are not aware that this verse is repeated almost word for word in reference to Abraham (see 60:4 and 6).

1989.english: The messenger of GOD has set up a good example for those among you who seek GOD and the Last Day, and remember GOD frequently.
1989.subtitle: The Prophet’s Courage
1989.footnote: Satan took this verse out of context, and relied on the people’s idolization of the prophet Muhammad to innovate a whole set of unreasonable regulations called “Sunna of the Prophet.” This created a totally different religion (42:21 and Appendix 18).

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّآ إِيمَٰنًا وَتَسْلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولما رأى المؤمنون الأحزاب قالوا هذا ما وعدنا الله ورسوله وصدق الله ورسوله ۚ وما زادهم إلا إيمانا وتسليما
verses.transliterated: walammā raā l-mu'minūna l-aḥzāba qālū hādhā mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu waṣadaqa l-lahu warasūluhu wamā zādahum illā īmānan wataslīma
verses.english: When the true believers saw the parties (ready to attack), they said, "This is what GOD and His messenger have promised us, and GOD and His messenger are truthful." This (dangerous situation) only strengthened their faith and augmented their submission.

1981.english: As for the believers, when they saw the allies, they said, "This is what God and His messenger had promised us; God and His messenger are truthful." The prospect of war actually augmented their faith and their submission.

1989.english: When the true believers saw the parties (ready to attack), they said, “This is what GOD and His messenger have promised us, and GOD and His messenger are truthful.” This (dangerous situation) only strengthened their faith and augmented their submission (to God).

verses.arabic: مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا۟ مَا عَٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُۥ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا۟ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: من المؤمنين رجال صدقوا ما عاهدوا الله عليه ۖ فمنهم من قضى نحبه ومنهم من ينتظر ۖ وما بدلوا تبديلا
verses.transliterated: mina l-mu'minīna rijālun ṣadaqū mā ʿāhadū l-laha ʿalayhi famin'hum man qaḍā naḥbahu wamin'hum man yantaẓiru wamā baddalū tabdīla
verses.english: Among the believers there are people who fulfill their pledges with GOD. Some of them died, while others stand ready, never wavering.

1981.english: Among the believers, there are those who fulfill their vows to God. Some of them give up their lives, while the others stand ready; they never waver.

1989.english: Among the believers there are people who fulfill their pledges with GOD. Thus, some of them died, while others stand ready, never wavering.

verses.arabic: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ إِن شَآءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ليجزي الله الصادقين بصدقهم ويعذب المنافقين إن شاء أو يتوب عليهم ۚ إن الله كان غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: liyajziya l-lahu l-ṣādiqīna biṣid'qihim wayuʿadhiba l-munāfiqīna in shāa aw yatūba ʿalayhim inna l-laha kāna ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: GOD will surely recompense the truthful for their truthfulness, and will punish the hypocrites, if He so wills, or redeem them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: God will recompense the truthful for their truthfulness, and punish the hypocrites if He wills, or redeem them.

1989.english: GOD will surely recompense the truthful for their truthfulness, and will punish the hypocrites, if He so wills, or redeem them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful. God Supports the Believers

verses.arabic: وَرَدَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا وَكَفَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلْقِتَالَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا
verses.arabicClean: ورد الله الذين كفروا بغيظهم لم ينالوا خيرا ۚ وكفى الله المؤمنين القتال ۚ وكان الله قويا عزيزا
verses.transliterated: waradda l-lahu alladhīna kafarū bighayẓihim lam yanālū khayran wakafā l-lahu l-mu'minīna l-qitāla wakāna l-lahu qawiyyan ʿazīza
verses.english: GOD repulsed those who disbelieved with their rage, and they left empty handed. GOD thus spared the believers any fighting. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.
verses.subtitle: During Muhammad's Time

1981.english: God repelled the disbelievers with their rage; they gained nothing, and He spared the believers any fighting; God is powerful, almighty.

1989.english: GOD repulsed those who disbelieved with their rage, and they left empty handed. GOD thus spared the believers any fighting. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَٰهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا
verses.arabicClean: وأنزل الذين ظاهروهم من أهل الكتاب من صياصيهم وقذف في قلوبهم الرعب فريقا تقتلون وتأسرون فريقا
verses.transliterated: wa-anzala alladhīna ẓāharūhum min ahli l-kitābi min ṣayāṣīhim waqadhafa fī qulūbihimu l-ruʿ'ba farīqan taqtulūna watasirūna farīqa
verses.english: He also brought down their allies among the people of the scripture from their secure positions, and threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and some you took captive.

1981.english: And He embarrassed the people of the scripture who allied themselves with the disbelievers, and He threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and some you took as captives.

1989.english: And He brought down their allies among the people of the scripture from their secure positions, and threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and some you took captive.

verses.arabic: وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَٰرَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَـُٔوهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وأورثكم أرضهم وديارهم وأموالهم وأرضا لم تطئوها ۚ وكان الله على كل شيء قديرا
verses.transliterated: wa-awrathakum arḍahum wadiyārahum wa-amwālahum wa-arḍan lam taṭaūhā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīra
verses.english: He made you inherit their land, their homes, their money, and lands you had never stepped on. GOD is in full control of all things.

1981.english: He made you inherit their land, their homes, their properties, and lands that you had never set foot on. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: And He made you inherit their land, their homes, their money, and lands you had never stepped on. GOD is in full control of all things.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك إن كنتن تردن الحياة الدنيا وزينتها فتعالين أمتعكن وأسرحكن سراحا جميلا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika in kuntunna turid'na l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā fataʿālayna umattiʿ'kunna wa-usarriḥ'kunna sarāḥan jamīla
verses.english: O prophet, say to your wives, "If you are seeking this life and its vanities, then let me compensate you and allow you to go amicably.
verses.subtitle: Special Responsibility For Being Close

1981.english: O you prophet, say to your wives, "If you seek this life and its vanities, I can let you enjoy and allow you to go amicably.
1981.subtitle: Instructions to All Women
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: O prophet, say to your wives, “If you are seeking this life and its vanities, then let me compensate you and allow you to go amicably.
1989.subtitle: Special Responsibility For Being Close

verses.arabic: وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَٰتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وإن كنتن تردن الله ورسوله والدار الآخرة فإن الله أعد للمحسنات منكن أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: wa-in kuntunna turid'na l-laha warasūlahu wal-dāra l-ākhirata fa-inna l-laha aʿadda lil'muḥ'sināti minkunna ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: "But if you are seeking GOD and His messenger, and the abode of the Hereafter, then GOD has prepared for the righteous among you a great recompense."

1981.english: "But if you seek God, His messenger, and the abode of the hereafter, then God has prepared for the righteous among you a great reward."
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: “But if you are seeking GOD and His messenger, and the abode of the Hereafter, then GOD has prepared for the pious among you a great recompense.”

verses.arabic: يَٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ مَن يَأْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَٰعَفْ لَهَا ٱلْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يا نساء النبي من يأت منكن بفاحشة مبينة يضاعف لها العذاب ضعفين ۚ وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا
verses.transliterated: yānisāa l-nabiyi man yati minkunna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin yuḍāʿaf lahā l-ʿadhābu ḍiʿ'fayni wakāna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīra
verses.english: O wives of the prophet, if any of you commits a gross sin, the retribution will be doubled for her. This is easy for GOD to do.
verses.subtitle: Special Responsibility

1981.english: O wives of the prophet, if any of you commits a gross sin, the retribution will be doubled for her. This is easy for God to do.
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: O wives of the prophet, if any of you commits a gross sin, the retribution will be doubled for her. This is easy for GOD to do.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا نُّؤْتِهَآ أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن يقنت منكن لله ورسوله وتعمل صالحا نؤتها أجرها مرتين وأعتدنا لها رزقا كريما
