verses.transliterated: waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasūlihi wataʿmal ṣāliḥan nu'tihā ajrahā marratayni wa-aʿtadnā lahā riz'qan karīma
verses.english: Any one of you who obeys GOD and His messenger, and leads a righteous life, we will grant her double the recompense, and we have prepared for her a generous provision.

1981.english: If any of you maintains obedience to God and His messenger, and works righteousness, we will double the reward for her; we have prepared for her a generous recompense.
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: Any one among you who obeys GOD and His messenger, and works righteousness, we will grant her double the recompense, and we have prepared for her a generous provision.

verses.arabic: يَٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ إِنِ ٱتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِۦ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا
verses.arabicClean: يا نساء النبي لستن كأحد من النساء ۚ إن اتقيتن فلا تخضعن بالقول فيطمع الذي في قلبه مرض وقلن قولا معروفا
verses.transliterated: yānisāa l-nabiyi lastunna ka-aḥadin mina l-nisāi ini ittaqaytunna falā takhḍaʿna bil-qawli fayaṭmaʿa alladhī fī qalbihi maraḍun waqul'na qawlan maʿrūfa
verses.english: O wives of the prophet, you are not the same as any other women, if you observe righteousness. (You have a greater responsibility.) Therefore, you shall not speak too softly, lest those with disease in their hearts may get the wrong ideas; you shall speak only righteousness.
verses.subtitle: Setting the Example

1981.english: O wives of the prophet, you are not the same as other women, if you maintain righteousness. Do not speak so softly that a person with a doubtful heart would misunderstand your motive; you shall speak righteousness.
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: O wives of the prophet, you are not the same as any other women, if you observe righteousness. (You have a greater responsibility.) Therefore, you shall not speak too softly, lest those with disease in their hearts may get the wrong impression; you shall speak righteousness.

verses.arabic: وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَأَقِمْنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وقرن في بيوتكن ولا تبرجن تبرج الجاهلية الأولى ۖ وأقمن الصلاة وآتين الزكاة وأطعن الله ورسوله ۚ إنما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس أهل البيت ويطهركم تطهيرا
verses.transliterated: waqarna fī buyūtikunna walā tabarrajna tabarruja l-jāhiliyati l-ūlā wa-aqim'na l-ṣalata waātīna l-zakata wa-aṭiʿ'na l-laha warasūlahu innamā yurīdu l-lahu liyudh'hiba ʿankumu l-rij'sa ahla l-bayti wayuṭahhirakum taṭhīra
verses.english: You shall settle down in your homes, and do not mingle with the people excessively, like you used to do in the old days of ignorance. You shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and obey GOD and His messenger. GOD wishes to remove all unholiness from you, O you who live around the Sacred Shrine, and to purify you completely.

1981.english: Let your homes be your base, and forsake the permissiveness of the days of ignorance. You shall observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity, and obey God and His messenger. God thus wishes to remove all impurity from you, O people of the shrine,* and to thoroughly purify you.

1989.english: You shall settle down in your homes, and do not mingle with the people excessively, like you used to do in the old days of ignorance. You shall observe the contact prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and obey GOD and His messenger. GOD wishes to remove all unholiness from you, O you who live around the Sacred Shrine, and to purify you completely.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: واذكرن ما يتلى في بيوتكن من آيات الله والحكمة ۚ إن الله كان لطيفا خبيرا
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur'na mā yut'lā fī buyūtikunna min āyāti l-lahi wal-ḥik'mati inna l-laha kāna laṭīfan khabīra
verses.english: Remember what is being recited in your homes of GOD's revelations and the wisdom inherent therein. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.

1981.english: You shall heed what is recited in your homes of God's revelations and wisdom. God is compassionate, cognizant.
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: And remember what is being recited in your homes of GOD’s revelations and the wisdom inherent therein. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَٱلْمُسْلِمَٰتِ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْقَٰنِتَٰتِ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقَٰتِ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰبِرَٰتِ وَٱلْخَٰشِعِينَ وَٱلْخَٰشِعَٰتِ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقَٰتِ وَٱلصَّٰٓئِمِينَ وَٱلصَّٰٓئِمَٰتِ وَٱلْحَٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَٱلْحَٰفِظَٰتِ وَٱلذَّٰكِرِينَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱلذَّٰكِرَٰتِ أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إن المسلمين والمسلمات والمؤمنين والمؤمنات والقانتين والقانتات والصادقين والصادقات والصابرين والصابرات والخاشعين والخاشعات والمتصدقين والمتصدقات والصائمين والصائمات والحافظين فروجهم والحافظات والذاكرين الله كثيرا والذاكرات أعد الله لهم مغفرة وأجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: inna l-mus'limīna wal-mus'limāti wal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-qānitīna wal-qānitāti wal-ṣādiqīna wal-ṣādiqāti wal-ṣābirīna wal-ṣābirāti wal-khāshiʿīna wal-khāshiʿāti wal-mutaṣadiqīna wal-mutaṣadiqāti wal-ṣāimīna wal-ṣāimāti wal-ḥāfiẓīna furūjahum wal-ḥāfiẓāti wal-dhākirīna l-laha kathīran wal-dhākirāti aʿadda l-lahu lahum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: The submitting men, the submitting women, the believing men, the believing women, the obedient men, the obedient women, the truthful men, the truthful women, the steadfast men, the steadfast women, the reverent men, the reverent women, the charitable men, the charitable women, the fasting men, the fasting women, the chaste men, the chaste women, and the men who commemorate GOD frequently, and the commemorating women; GOD has prepared for them forgiveness and a great recompense.
verses.subtitle: Equality of Men and Women

1981.english: The Muslim men and the Muslim women, the believing men and the believing women, the obedient men and the obedient women, the truthful men and the truthful women, the steadfast men and the steadfast women, the reverent men and the reverent women, the charitable men and the charitable women, the fasting men and the fasting women, the chaste men and the chaste women, and the men and women who commemorate God frequently; God has prepared for them forgiveness and a great recompense.
1981.footnote: Any home where the Quran is preached is the same as the prophet's home. The responsibility is doubled when any person receives the message. Thus, receiving the message can be a great blessing or a disastrous curse, depending on one's response, i.e., heeding or not heeding. Obviously, the sin is a greater offense when committed by a person who knows, as compared to the one who does not know.

1989.english: The Muslim men, the Muslim women the believing men, the believing women, the obedient men, the obedient women, the truthful men, the truthful women, the steadfast men, the steadfast women, the reverent men, the reverent women, the charitable men, the charitable women, the fasting men, the fasting women, the chaste men, the chaste women, and the men who commemorate GOD frequently, and the commemorating women; GOD has prepared for them forgiveness and a great recompense.
1989.subtitle: Equality of Men and Women

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: وما كان لمؤمن ولا مؤمنة إذا قضى الله ورسوله أمرا أن يكون لهم الخيرة من أمرهم ۗ ومن يعص الله ورسوله فقد ضل ضلالا مبينا
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna limu'minin walā mu'minatin idhā qaḍā l-lahu warasūluhu amran an yakūna lahumu l-khiyaratu min amrihim waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu faqad ḍalla ḍalālan mubīna
verses.english: No believing man or believing woman, if GOD and His messenger issue any command, has any choice regarding that command. Anyone who disobeys GOD and His messenger has gone far astray.
verses.subtitle:
Major Error Committed by Muhammad
Muhammad the Man Disobeys Muhammad the Messenger

1981.english: No believing man or believing woman would voice any objection when God and His messenger decree a commandment. Anyone who disobeys God and His messenger has gone astray.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad the Man versus Muhammad the Messenger
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that Muhammad the man is not different from any other man; he makes mistakes. Throughout the Quran, we see that Muhammad the man makes mistakes (see 4:79, 9:117, 17:73-74, 33:37, 40:66, 61:1, 80:1-10, and 94:7), while Muhammad the messenger utters only the perfection of Quran (53:3). Those who idolize the prophet claim that he never made mistakes. Thus, they flagrantly deny the truthfulness of God almighty and flatly refuse to believe the Quran. In verses 36 and 37, we see Muhammad the man disobey Muhammad the messenger.

1989.english: No believing man or believing woman, if GOD and His messenger issue any command, has any choice regarding that command. Anyone who disobeys GOD and His messenger has gone far astray.
1989.subtitle: Major Error Committed by Muhammad Muhammad the Man Disobeys Muhammad the Messenger

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذ تقول للذي أنعم الله عليه وأنعمت عليه أمسك عليك زوجك واتق الله وتخفي في نفسك ما الله مبديه وتخشى الناس والله أحق أن تخشاه ۖ فلما قضى زيد منها وطرا زوجناكها لكي لا يكون على المؤمنين حرج في أزواج أدعيائهم إذا قضوا منهن وطرا ۚ وكان أمر الله مفعولا
verses.transliterated: wa-idh taqūlu lilladhī anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhi wa-anʿamta ʿalayhi amsik ʿalayka zawjaka wa-ittaqi l-laha watukh'fī fī nafsika mā l-lahu mub'dīhi watakhshā l-nāsa wal-lahu aḥaqqu an takhshāhu falammā qaḍā zaydun min'hā waṭaran zawwajnākahā likay lā yakūna ʿalā l-mu'minīna ḥarajun fī azwāji adʿiyāihim idhā qaḍaw min'hunna waṭaran wakāna amru l-lahi mafʿūla
verses.english: Recall that you said to the one who was blessed by GOD, and blessed by you, "Keep your wife and reverence GOD," and you hid inside yourself what GOD wished to proclaim. Thus, you feared the people, when you were supposed to fear only GOD. When Zeid was completely through with his wife, we had you marry her, in order to establish the precedent that a man can marry the divorced wife of his adopted son. GOD's commands shall be done.

1981.english: Thus, you said to the one endowed by God and by you, "Keep your wife, and observe God," while hiding in yourself what God wanted you to declare. You thus feared the people, instead of fearing God. Then, when Zeid (Muhammad's adopted son) was completely through with his wife, we had you marry her. This was done to establish the law that the believers can marry the divorced wives of their adopted sons. God's command must be carried out.
1981.footnote: These verses teach us that Muhammad the man is not different from any other man; he makes mistakes. Throughout the Quran, we see that Muhammad the man makes mistakes (see 4:79, 9:117, 17:73-74, 33:37, 40:66, 61:1, 80:1-10, and 94:7), while Muhammad the messenger utters only the perfection of Quran (53:3). Those who idolize the prophet claim that he never made mistakes. Thus, they flagrantly deny the truthfulness of God almighty and flatly refuse to believe the Quran. In verses 36 and 37, we see Muhammad the man disobey Muhammad the messenger.

1989.english: Recall that you said to the one who was blessed by GOD, and blessed by you, “Keep your wife and observe GOD,” and you hid inside yourself what GOD wished to proclaim. Thus, you feared the people, when you were supposed to fear only GOD. When Zeid was completely through with his wife, we had you marry her, in order to establish the precedent that a man can marry the divorced wife of his adopted son. GOD’s commands shall be carried out.

verses.arabic: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ما كان على النبي من حرج فيما فرض الله له ۖ سنة الله في الذين خلوا من قبل ۚ وكان أمر الله قدرا مقدورا
verses.transliterated: mā kāna ʿalā l-nabiyi min ḥarajin fīmā faraḍa l-lahu lahu sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu wakāna amru l-lahi qadaran maqdūra
verses.english: The prophet is not committing an error by doing anything that is made lawful by GOD. Such is GOD's system since the early generations. GOD's command is a sacred duty.

1981.english: The prophet should not be embarrassed by what God decrees for him. This has always been God's system. The command of God is an obligatory duty.

1989.english: The prophet is not committing an error by doing anything that is made lawful by GOD. Such is GOD’s system since the early generations. GOD’s command is a sacred duty—

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَٰلَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُۥ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: الذين يبلغون رسالات الله ويخشونه ولا يخشون أحدا إلا الله ۗ وكفى بالله حسيبا
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yuballighūna risālāti l-lahi wayakhshawnahu walā yakhshawna aḥadan illā l-laha wakafā bil-lahi ḥasība
verses.english: Those who deliver GOD's messages, and who reverence Him alone, shall never fear anyone but GOD. GOD is the most efficient reckoner.

1981.english: For those who deliver God's messages, fear Him only, and never fear anyone else, God suffices as rewarder.

1989.english: for those who deliver GOD’s messages, and who reverence Him alone. They never fear anyone but GOD. GOD is the best reckoner.

verses.arabic: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَآ أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن رَّسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ما كان محمد أبا أحد من رجالكم ولكن رسول الله وخاتم النبيين ۗ وكان الله بكل شيء عليما
verses.transliterated: mā kāna muḥammadun abā aḥadin min rijālikum walākin rasūla l-lahi wakhātama l-nabiyīna wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīma
verses.english: Muhammad was not the father of any man among you. He was a messenger of GOD and the final prophet. GOD is fully aware of all things.
verses.subtitle: Not The Final Messenger
verses.footnote: Despite this clear definition of Muhammad, most Muslims insist that he was the last prophet and also the last messenger. This is a tragic human trait as we see in 40:34. Those who readily believe God realize that God sends His purifying and consolidating Messenger of the Covenant after the final prophet Muhammad (3:81, 33:7).

1981.english: Muhammad is not the father of any of you; he is a messenger of God, and the final prophet. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: Muhammad was not the father of anj man among you. He was a messenger of GOD and the final prophet. GOD is fully aware of all things.
1989.subtitle: Not The Final Messenger
1989.footnote: After the final prophet, God sends His Messenger of the Covenant (3:81, 33:7).

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اذكروا الله ذكرا كثيرا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū udh'kurū l-laha dhik'ran kathīra
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall remember GOD frequently.
verses.footnote: Your god is whatever occupies your thoughts most of the time. Hence the commandment to commemorate God and glorify Him day and night. See Appendix 27.

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall commemorate God as much as you can.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall remember GOD frequently.*
1989.footnote: Your god is whatever occupies your thoughts most of the time. Hence the commandment to remember God and glorify Him day and night. See Appendix 27.

verses.arabic: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: وسبحوه بكرة وأصيلا
verses.transliterated: wasabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīla
verses.english: You shall glorify Him day and night.

1981.english: Glorify Him day and night.

1989.english: You shall glorify Him day and night.
1989.footnote: Your god is whatever occupies your thoughts most of the time. Hence the commandment to remember God and glorify Him day and night. See Appendix 27.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَلِّى عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتُهُۥ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَكَانَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي يصلي عليكم وملائكته ليخرجكم من الظلمات إلى النور ۚ وكان بالمؤمنين رحيما
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī yuṣallī ʿalaykum wamalāikatuhu liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wakāna bil-mu'minīna raḥīma
verses.english: He is the One who helps you, together with His angels, to lead you out of darkness into the light. He is Most Merciful towards the believers.

1981.english: He and His angels honor you, in order to lead you out of the darkness into the light; He showers His mercy upon the believers.
1981.footnote: These are the same words as those applied to the prophet in 33:56, a verse that is widely abused by those who idolize the prophet against his will.

1989.english: He is the One who helps you, together with His angels, to lead you out of darkness into the light. He is Most Merciful towards the believers.

verses.arabic: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُۥ سَلَٰمٌ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: تحيتهم يوم يلقونه سلام ۚ وأعد لهم أجرا كريما
verses.transliterated: taḥiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salāmun wa-aʿadda lahum ajran karīma
verses.english: Their greeting the day they meet Him is, "Peace," and He has prepared for them a generous recompense.

1981.english: Their greeting on the day they meet God is, "Peace;" He has prepared for them a generous recompense.

1989.english: Their greeting the day they meet Him is, “Peace,” and He has prepared for them a generous recompense.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ شَٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي إنا أرسلناك شاهدا ومبشرا ونذيرا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu innā arsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīra
verses.english: O prophet, we have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner.

1981.english: O you prophet, we have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.

1989.english: O prophet, we have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.

verses.arabic: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وداعيا إلى الله بإذنه وسراجا منيرا
verses.transliterated: wadāʿiyan ilā l-lahi bi-idh'nihi wasirājan munīra
verses.english: Inviting to GOD, in accordance with His will, and a guiding beacon.

1981.english: And a caller towards God, by His leave, and a guiding beacon.

1989.english: Inviting to GOD, in accordance with His will, and a guiding beacon.

verses.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وبشر المؤمنين بأن لهم من الله فضلا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: wabashiri l-mu'minīna bi-anna lahum mina l-lahi faḍlan kabīra
verses.english: Deliver good news to the believers, that they have deserved from GOD a great blessing.

1981.english: Give good news to the believers, that they will receive from God a great bounty.

1989.english: Deliver good news to the believers, that they have deserved from GOD a great blessing.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَىٰهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا تطع الكافرين والمنافقين ودع أذاهم وتوكل على الله ۚ وكفى بالله وكيلا
verses.transliterated: walā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna wadaʿ adhāhum watawakkal ʿalā l-lahi wakafā bil-lahi wakīla
verses.english: Do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, disregard their insults, and put your trust in GOD; GOD suffices as an advocate.

1981.english: Do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and disregard their insults. Put your trust in God; God suffices as a guardian.

1989.english: Do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, disregard their persecu tion, and put your trust in GOD; GOD suffices as an advocate.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا نكحتم المؤمنات ثم طلقتموهن من قبل أن تمسوهن فما لكم عليهن من عدة تعتدونها ۖ فمتعوهن وسرحوهن سراحا جميلا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nakaḥtumu l-mu'mināti thumma ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli an tamassūhunna famā lakum ʿalayhinna min ʿiddatin taʿtaddūnahā famattiʿūhunna wasarriḥūhunna sarāḥan jamīla
verses.english: O you who believe, if you married believing women, then divorced them before having intercourse with them, they do not owe you any waiting interim (before marrying another man). You shall compensate them equitably, and let them go amicably.
verses.subtitle: Marriage Laws

1981.english: O you who believe, when you marry the believing women, if you divorce them before touching them, then you owe them no interim.* You shall pay them a compensation, and let them go amicably.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you married believing women, then divorced them before having intercourse with them, they do not owe you any waiting interim (before marrying another man). You shall compensate them, and let them go amicably.
1989.subtitle: Marriage Laws

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّٰتِىٓ ءَاتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَٰلَٰتِكَ ٱلَّٰتِى هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمْرَأَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِىِّ إِنْ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَن يَسْتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي إنا أحللنا لك أزواجك اللاتي آتيت أجورهن وما ملكت يمينك مما أفاء الله عليك وبنات عمك وبنات عماتك وبنات خالك وبنات خالاتك اللاتي هاجرن معك وامرأة مؤمنة إن وهبت نفسها للنبي إن أراد النبي أن يستنكحها خالصة لك من دون المؤمنين ۗ قد علمنا ما فرضنا عليهم في أزواجهم وما ملكت أيمانهم لكيلا يكون عليك حرج ۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu innā aḥlalnā laka azwājaka allātī ātayta ujūrahunna wamā malakat yamīnuka mimmā afāa l-lahu ʿalayka wabanāti ʿammika wabanāti ʿammātika wabanāti khālika wabanāti khālātika allātī hājarna maʿaka wa-im'ra-atan mu'minatan in wahabat nafsahā lilnnabiyyi in arāda l-nabiyu an yastankiḥahā khāliṣatan laka min dūni l-mu'minīna qad ʿalim'nā mā faraḍnā ʿalayhim fī azwājihim wamā malakat aymānuhum likaylā yakūna ʿalayka ḥarajun wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: O prophet, we made lawful for you your wives to whom you have paid their due dowry, or what you already have, as granted to you by GOD. Also lawful for you in marriage are the daughters of your father's brothers, the daughters of your father's sisters, the daughters of your mother's brothers, the daughters of your mother's sisters, who have emigrated with you. Also, if a believing woman gave herself to the prophet—by forfeiting the dowry—the prophet may marry her without a dowry, if he so wishes. However, her forfeiting of the dowry applies only to the prophet, and not to the other believers. We have already decreed their rights in regard to their spouses or what they already have. This is to spare you any embarrassment. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: O you prophet, we have permitted for you your wives, to whom you paid a dowry, and those who are rightly lawful for you from among the daughters of your uncles, and the daughters of your aunts who immigrated with you, and any believing woman who forfeits the dowry only for the prophet, if the prophet wishes to marry her. However, forfeiture of the dowry for the prophet may not apply to any other believer. We have already established the obligations for them towards their wives, and the women they can legally marry. In this way, you will not suffer any embarrassment. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: O prophet, we made lawful for you in marriage the wives to whom you have paid their due dowry, or what you already have, as granted to you by GOD. Also lawful for you in marriage are the daughters of your father’s brothers, the daughters of your father’s sisters, the daughters of your mother’s brothers, the daughters of your mother’s sisters, who have emigrated with you. Also, if a believing woman gave herself to the prophet, by forfeiting the dowry, the prophet may marry her, without a dowry, if he so wishes. However, her forfeiting of the dowry applies only to the prophet, and not to the other believers. We have already decreed their rights in regard to their spouses or what they already have. This is to spare you any embarrassment. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: تُرْجِى مَن تَشَآءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِىٓ إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ترجي من تشاء منهن وتؤوي إليك من تشاء ۖ ومن ابتغيت ممن عزلت فلا جناح عليك ۚ ذلك أدنى أن تقر أعينهن ولا يحزن ويرضين بما آتيتهن كلهن ۚ والله يعلم ما في قلوبكم ۚ وكان الله عليما حليما
verses.transliterated: tur'jī man tashāu min'hunna watu'wī ilayka man tashāu wamani ib'taghayta mimman ʿazalta falā junāḥa ʿalayka dhālika adnā an taqarra aʿyunuhunna walā yaḥzanna wayarḍayna bimā ātaytahunna kulluhunna wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā fī qulūbikum wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥalīma
verses.english: You may gently shun any one of them, and you may bring closer to you any one of them. If you reconcile with any one you had estranged, you commit no error. In this way, they will be pleased, will have no grief, and will be content with what you equitably offer to all of them. GOD knows what is in your hearts. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.

1981.english: You may shun any of them, or accept any of them, if you wish; or you may accept one you had shunned previously. This will please them, and they will accept the dowry you give them. God is fully aware of your intentions; God is omniscient, clement.

1989.english: You may gently shun any one of them, and you may bring closer any one of them. If you reconcile with any one you had estranged, you commit no error. In this way, they will be pleased, and will have no worries, and will be content with what you equitably offer to all of them. GOD knows what is in your hearts. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رَّقِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: لا يحل لك النساء من بعد ولا أن تبدل بهن من أزواج ولو أعجبك حسنهن إلا ما ملكت يمينك ۗ وكان الله على كل شيء رقيبا
verses.transliterated: lā yaḥillu laka l-nisāu min baʿdu walā an tabaddala bihinna min azwājin walaw aʿjabaka ḥus'nuhunna illā mā malakat yamīnuka wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin raqība
verses.english: Beyond the categories described to you, you are enjoined from marrying any other women, nor can you substitute a new wife (from the prohibited categories), no matter how much you admire their beauty. You must be content with those already made lawful to you. GOD is watchful over all things.

1981.english: You are not permitted to marry the women beyond these limits; nor shall you substitute any of them, even if you admire their beauty. Only those you can legally marry are permitted. God is watching all things.

1989.english: Beyond the categories described to you, you are enjoined from marrying any other women, nor can you substitute a new wife (from the prohibited categories), no matter how much you admire their beauty. You must be content with what you are already permitted. GOD is watchful over all things.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَٰكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوا۟ فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ وَلَا مُسْتَـْٔنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى ٱلنَّبِىَّ فَيَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَٰعًا فَسْـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُؤْذُوا۟ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓا۟ أَزْوَٰجَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تدخلوا بيوت النبي إلا أن يؤذن لكم إلى طعام غير ناظرين إناه ولكن إذا دعيتم فادخلوا فإذا طعمتم فانتشروا ولا مستأنسين لحديث ۚ إن ذلكم كان يؤذي النبي فيستحيي منكم ۖ والله لا يستحيي من الحق ۚ وإذا سألتموهن متاعا فاسألوهن من وراء حجاب ۚ ذلكم أطهر لقلوبكم وقلوبهن ۚ وما كان لكم أن تؤذوا رسول الله ولا أن تنكحوا أزواجه من بعده أبدا ۚ إن ذلكم كان عند الله عظيما
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tadkhulū buyūta l-nabiyi illā an yu'dhana lakum ilā ṭaʿāmin ghayra nāẓirīna ināhu walākin idhā duʿītum fa-ud'khulū fa-idhā ṭaʿim'tum fa-intashirū walā mus'tanisīna liḥadīthin inna dhālikum kāna yu'dhī l-nabiya fayastaḥyī minkum wal-lahu lā yastaḥyī mina l-ḥaqi wa-idhā sa-altumūhunna matāʿan fasalūhunna min warāi ḥijābin dhālikum aṭharu liqulūbikum waqulūbihinna wamā kāna lakum an tu'dhū rasūla l-lahi walā an tankiḥū azwājahu min baʿdihi abadan inna dhālikum kāna ʿinda l-lahi ʿaẓīma
verses.english: O you who believe, do not enter the prophet's homes unless you are given permission to eat, nor shall you force such an invitation in any manner. If you are invited, you may enter. When you finish eating, you shall leave; do not engage him in lengthy conversations. This used to hurt the prophet, and he was too shy to tell you. But GOD does not shy away from the truth. If you have to ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a barrier. This is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You are not to hurt the messenger of GOD. You shall not marry his wives after him, for this would be a gross offense in the sight of GOD.
verses.subtitle: Etiquette
verses.footnote: We are enjoined in 4:22 from marrying women who were previously married to our fathers. Nor can the father marry the divorced wife of his son (4:23). This divine commandment preserves our respect for our fathers and their most private affairs. Similarly, the prophet was a father figure to the believers of his time. For the good of those believers, God enjoined them from marrying women who were previously married to the prophet. Marriage is a sacred and very private relationship, and the prophet's private life was better kept private.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not enter the prophet's homes, unless you have permission to eat, and do not wait there expecting an invitation. But if you are invited, then you may enter. Once you finish eating, then leave; do not carry on a conversation. This used to hurt the prophet, and he was too embarrassed to tell you. But God does not shy away from the truth. When you ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a barrier. This is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You should beware of hurting the messenger of God. Do not marry any of his wives after him (divorced or widowed),* for this would be a blasphemy.
1981.subtitle: General Etiquette
1981.footnote: Verse 4:22 prohibits us from marrying any woman who was previously married to our fathers. Because marriage involves some very private behavior, God decreed this law to preserve respect for our fathers. Similarly, the prophet was a fatherly figure to all the believers of his generation. To preserve respect for the prophet and for the message he preached, God decreed a similar law regarding the prophet's wives.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not enter the prophet’s homes unless you are given permission to eat, nor shall you force such an invitation. Once you are invited, you may enter. When you finish eating, you shall leave; do not engage him in lengthy conversations. This used to hurt the prophet, and he was too shy to tell you. But GOD does not shy away from the truth. If you have to ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a barrier. This is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You do not wish to hurt the messenger of GOD. You shall not marry his wives after him, for this would be a gross offense in the sight of GOD.*
1989.subtitle: Etiquette
1989.footnote: We are enjoined in 4:22 from marrying women who were previously married to our fathers. This divine commandment preserves our respect for our fathers and their most private affairs. Similarly, the prophet was a father figure to the believers of his time. For the good of those believers, God enjoined them from marrying women who were previously married to the prophet. Marriage is a sacred and very private relationship, and the prophet's private life was better kept private.

verses.arabic: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إن تبدوا شيئا أو تخفوه فإن الله كان بكل شيء عليما
verses.transliterated: in tub'dū shayan aw tukh'fūhu fa-inna l-laha kāna bikulli shayin ʿalīma
verses.english: Whether you declare anything, or hide it, GOD is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: Whether you declare anything or conceal it, God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: Whether you declare anything, or hide it, GOD is fully aware of all things.

verses.arabic: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِىٓ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَآئِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُنَّ وَٱتَّقِينَ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: لا جناح عليهن في آبائهن ولا أبنائهن ولا إخوانهن ولا أبناء إخوانهن ولا أبناء أخواتهن ولا نسائهن ولا ما ملكت أيمانهن ۗ واتقين الله ۚ إن الله كان على كل شيء شهيدا
verses.transliterated: lā junāḥa ʿalayhinna fī ābāihinna walā abnāihinna walā ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi ikh'wānihinna walā abnāi akhawātihinna walā nisāihinna walā mā malakat aymānuhunna wa-ittaqīna l-laha inna l-laha kāna ʿalā kulli shayin shahīda
verses.english: The women may relax (their dress code) around their fathers, their sons, their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, the other women, and their (female) servants. They shall reverence GOD. GOD witnesses all things.

1981.english: The women commit no error by (dressing comfortably) in the presence of their fathers, their sons, their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, the women, and their servants. They shall observe God; for God witnesses all things.

1989.english: The women may relax (their dress code) around their fathers, their sons, their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, the other women, and their (female) servants. They shall observe GOD. GOD witnesses all things.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ صَلُّوا۟ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الله وملائكته يصلون على النبي ۚ يا أيها الذين آمنوا صلوا عليه وسلموا تسليما
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha wamalāikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā l-nabiyi yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wasallimū taslīma
verses.english: GOD and His angels help and support the prophet. O you who believe, you shall help and support him, and regard him as he should be regarded.
verses.subtitle: During the Prophet's Life
verses.footnote: The word "prophet" (Nabi) consistently refers to Muhammad only when he was alive. Satan used this verse to entice the Muslims into commemorating Muhammad, constantly, instead of commemorating God as enjoined in 33:41-42.

1981.english: God and His angels honor the prophet;* O you who believe, you shall honor him and regard him as he should be regarded.
1981.footnote: God and His angels honor and regard every believer. Note the similarity of Arabic words in 33:43. This is the verse that is used by satan most frequently to lead the believers into the trap of idol worship. To love and honor the prophet Muhammad or any other prophet is to worship God alone and to follow and uphold God's scripture as the only source of law.

1989.english: GOD and His angels help and support the prophet. O you who believe, you shall help and support him, and regard him as he should be regarded.*
1989.subtitle: During the Prophet’s Life
1989.footnote: The word “prophet” (Nabi) consistently refers to Muhammad only when he was alive. Satan used this verse to entice the Muslims into commemorating Muhammad, constantly, instead of commemorating God as enjoined in 33:41-42.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يؤذون الله ورسوله لعنهم الله في الدنيا والآخرة وأعد لهم عذابا مهينا
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yu'dhūna l-laha warasūlahu laʿanahumu l-lahu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wa-aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban muhīna
verses.english: Surely, those who oppose GOD and His messenger, GOD afflicts them with a curse in this life, and in the Hereafter; He has prepared for them a shameful retribution.

1981.english: Those who insult God and His messenger are cursed by God in this life and in the hereafter; He has prepared for them a humiliating retribution.

1989.english: Surely, those who insult GOD and His messenger, GOD condemns them in this life and in the Hereafter; He has prepared for them a shameful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا ٱكْتَسَبُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلُوا۟ بُهْتَٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: والذين يؤذون المؤمنين والمؤمنات بغير ما اكتسبوا فقد احتملوا بهتانا وإثما مبينا
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yu'dhūna l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti bighayri mā ik'tasabū faqadi iḥ'tamalū buh'tānan wa-ith'man mubīna
verses.english: Those who persecute the believing men and the believing women, who did not do anything wrong, have committed not only a falsehood, but also a gross sin.

1981.english: Those who insult the believing men and the believing women, without justification, have incurred a blasphemy and a gross sin.

1989.english: Those who insult the believing men and the believing women, without justification, have committed not only a falsehood, but also a gross blasphemy.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَٰبِيبِهِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك وبناتك ونساء المؤمنين يدنين عليهن من جلابيبهن ۚ ذلك أدنى أن يعرفن فلا يؤذين ۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu qul li-azwājika wabanātika wanisāi l-mu'minīna yud'nīna ʿalayhinna min jalābībihinna dhālika adnā an yuʿ'rafna falā yu'dhayna wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: O prophet, tell your wives, your daughters, and the wives of the believers that they shall lengthen their garments. Thus, they will be recognized (as righteous women) and avoid being insulted. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Dress Code for Women

1981.english: O you prophet, tell your wives and your daughters, and the believing women to lengthen their garments. Thus, they will be recognized and will not be insulted. God is forgiver, merciful.
1981.subtitle: Women Shall Dress Modestly

1989.english: O prophet, tell your wives, your daughters, and the believing women to lengthen their garments. Thus, they will be recognized (as righteous women) and avoid being insulted. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: Dress Code for Women

verses.arabic: لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْمُرْجِفُونَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: لئن لم ينته المنافقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض والمرجفون في المدينة لنغرينك بهم ثم لا يجاورونك فيها إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: la-in lam yantahi l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-mur'jifūna fī l-madīnati lanugh'riyannaka bihim thumma lā yujāwirūnaka fīhā illā qalīla
verses.english: Unless the hypocrites, and those with disease in their hearts, and the vicious liars of the city refrain (from persecuting you), we will surely grant you the upper hand, then they will be forced to leave within a short while.

1981.english: Unless the hypocrites, those whose hearts are diseased, and the skeptics of the town refrain (from insulting the believers), we will order you to fight them until they move away.

1989.english: Unless the hypocrites, and those with disease in their hearts, and the vicious people of the city refrain (from attacking you), we will surely grant you the upper hand, then they will be forced to leave within a short while.

verses.arabic: مَّلْعُونِينَ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ أُخِذُوا۟ وَقُتِّلُوا۟ تَقْتِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ملعونين ۖ أينما ثقفوا أخذوا وقتلوا تقتيلا
verses.transliterated: malʿūnīna aynamā thuqifū ukhidhū waquttilū taqtīla
verses.english: They have incurred condemnation wherever they go; (unless they stop attacking you,) they may be taken and killed.

1981.english: Otherwise, they shall be condemned wherever they go; they shall be taken and executed.

1989.english: They have incurred condemnation wherever they go; (unless they stop attacking you,) they may be taken and killed.

verses.arabic: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: سنة الله في الذين خلوا من قبل ۖ ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا
verses.transliterated: sunnata l-lahi fī alladhīna khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīla
verses.english: This is GOD's eternal system, and you will find that GOD's system is unchangeable.

1981.english: This is the same system of God as given to those before you, for God's system is never changeable.

1989.english: This is GOD’s eternal system, and GOD’s system never changes.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: يسألك الناس عن الساعة ۖ قل إنما علمها عند الله ۚ وما يدريك لعل الساعة تكون قريبا
verses.transliterated: yasaluka l-nāsu ʿani l-sāʿati qul innamā ʿil'muhā ʿinda l-lahi wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata takūnu qarība
verses.english: The people ask you about the Hour (end of the world). Say, "The knowledge thereof is only with GOD. For all that you know, the Hour may be close."
verses.subtitle: End of the World Revealed
verses.footnote: Less than a century ago, only God possessed knowledge about television and space satellites, for example. He revealed this knowledge at the predetermined time. Similarly, God has revealed the time appointed for the end of this world (Appendix 25).

1981.english: The people ask you about the Hour; say, "Only God knows about it." You may not realize it, but the Hour may be very close.
1981.footnote: The time from now to the day of resurrection equals, for all practical purposes, the time that is left of anyone's life. For people who will die within the next hour, the "hour" (of resurrection) is less than one hour away from them. See 30:55.

1989.english: The people ask you about the Hour. Say, “The knowledge thereof is with G O I For all that you know, the Hour may be close.”
1989.subtitle: End of the World Revealed
1989.footnote: Less than a century ago, only God possessed knowledge about television anc space satellites, for example. He revealed this knowledge at the predetermined time. Similarly, God has revealed the time appointed for the end of this world (Appendix 25).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الله لعن الكافرين وأعد لهم سعيرا
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha laʿana l-kāfirīna wa-aʿadda lahum saʿīra
verses.english: GOD has condemned the disbelievers, and has prepared for them Hell.
verses.subtitle: The Followers Turn On Their Leaders

1981.english: God has cursed the disbelievers and has prepared for them hell.

1989.english: GOD has condemned the disbelievers, and has prepared for them Hell.
1989.subtitle: The Followers Turn On Their Leaders

verses.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: خالدين فيها أبدا ۖ لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا
verses.transliterated: khālidīna fīhā abadan lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīra
verses.english: Eternally they abide therein. They will find no lord, nor a supporter.

1981.english: They abide therein forever; they will find no ally or supporter.

1989.english: Eternally they abide therein. They will find no lord, nor a supporter.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَٰلَيْتَنَآ أَطَعْنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا۠
verses.arabicClean: يوم تقلب وجوههم في النار يقولون يا ليتنا أطعنا الله وأطعنا الرسولا
verses.transliterated: yawma tuqallabu wujūhuhum fī l-nāri yaqūlūna yālaytanā aṭaʿnā l-laha wa-aṭaʿnā l-rasūl
verses.english: The day they are thrown into Hell, they will say, "Oh, we wish we obeyed GOD, and obeyed the messenger."

1981.english: On the day when their faces turn about the hellfire, they will say, "We wish we obeyed God and obeyed the messenger."

1989.english: The day they are thrown into Hell, they will say, “Oh, we wish we obeyed GOD and the messenger.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا۠
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا ربنا إنا أطعنا سادتنا وكبراءنا فأضلونا السبيلا
verses.transliterated: waqālū rabbanā innā aṭaʿnā sādatanā wakubarāanā fa-aḍallūnā l-sabīl
verses.english: They will also say, "Our Lord, we have obeyed our masters and leaders, but they led us astray.

1981.english: They will say, "Our Lord, we obeyed our masters and elders, and they misguided us.

1989.english: And they will say, “Our Lord, we have obeyed our masters and leaders but they led us astray.

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ربنا آتهم ضعفين من العذاب والعنهم لعنا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: rabbanā ātihim ḍiʿ'fayni mina l-ʿadhābi wal-ʿanhum laʿnan kabīra
verses.english: "Our Lord, give them double the retribution, and curse them a tremendous curse."

1981.english: "Our Lord, give them double the retribution, and curse them a mighty curse."

1989.english: “Our Lord, give them double the retribution, and curse them a tremendous curse.”

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا۟ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا۟ وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تكونوا كالذين آذوا موسى فبرأه الله مما قالوا ۚ وكان عند الله وجيها
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā takūnū ka-alladhīna ādhaw mūsā fabarra-ahu l-lahu mimmā qālū wakāna ʿinda l-lahi wajīha
verses.english: O you who believe, do not be like those who hurt Moses, then GOD absolved him of what they said. He was, in the sight of GOD, honorable.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not be like those who insulted Moses, then God absolved him of everything they said; he was honorable in the sight of God.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not be like those who hurt Moses, then GOD absolved him of what they said. He was, in the sight of GOD, honorable

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله وقولوا قولا سديدا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waqūlū qawlan sadīda
verses.english: O you who believe, reverence GOD and utter only the correct utterances.

1981.english: O you who believe, beware of God and speak only righteousness.

1989.english: O you who believe, observe GOD and utter only the correct utterances.

verses.arabic: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: يصلح لكم أعمالكم ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم ۗ ومن يطع الله ورسوله فقد فاز فوزا عظيما
verses.transliterated: yuṣ'liḥ lakum aʿmālakum wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu faqad fāza fawzan ʿaẓīma
verses.english: He will then fix your works, and forgive your sins. Those who obey GOD and His messenger have triumphed a great triumph.

1981.english: He will then correct your works and forgive your sins. Whoever obeys God and His messenger has triumphed a great triumph.

1989.english: He will then correct your works, and forgive your sins. Those who obey GOD and His messenger have triumphed a great triumph.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا عرضنا الأمانة على السماوات والأرض والجبال فأبين أن يحملنها وأشفقن منها وحملها الإنسان ۖ إنه كان ظلوما جهولا
verses.transliterated: innā ʿaraḍnā l-amānata ʿalā l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-jibāli fa-abayna an yaḥmil'nahā wa-ashfaqna min'hā waḥamalahā l-insānu innahu kāna ẓalūman jahūla
verses.english: We have offered the responsibility (freedom of choice) to the heavens and the earth, and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were afraid of it. But the human being accepted it; he was transgressing, ignorant.
verses.subtitle: Freedom of Choice
verses.footnote: The animals, trees, stars, etc. took advantage of this most gracious offer. See Appendix 7.

1981.english: We had offered the responsibility to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to accept it and were afraid thereof. But the human being accepted it; surely, he was wrong, ignorant.
1981.subtitle: Only The Humans Are Free To Choose
1981.footnote: In view of the general human plague of idol-worship, and the fact that the vast majority of people are condemned to hell (see 12:103 and 106), the chance that any particular individual will make it to heaven is practically nil. See also 32:13 and 36:7.

1989.english: We have offered the responsibility (freedom of choice) to the heavens and the earth, and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were afraid of it. But the human being accepted it; he was transgressing, ignorant.*
1989.subtitle: Freedom of Choice
1989.footnote: See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۢا
verses.arabicClean: ليعذب الله المنافقين والمنافقات والمشركين والمشركات ويتوب الله على المؤمنين والمؤمنات ۗ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: liyuʿadhiba l-lahu l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-mush'rikīna wal-mush'rikāti wayatūba l-lahu ʿalā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: For GOD will inevitably punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, and the idol worshiping men and the idol worshiping women. GOD redeems the believing men and the believing women. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: For God will punish the hypocrite men and women, and the idol-worshiping men and women. And God will redeem the believing men and women; God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: For GOD will inevitably punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, and the idol worshiping men and the idol worshiping women. GOD redeems the believing men and the believing women. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله الذي له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وله الحمد في الآخرة ۚ وهو الحكيم الخبير
verses.transliterated: al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ākhirati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīr
verses.english: Praise be to GOD—to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; all praise is also due to Him in the Hereafter. He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

1981.english: Praise be to God, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and to Him belongs all praise in the hereafter; He is the wise, the cognizant.

1989.english: Praise be to GOD, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. All praise is due to Him in the Hereafter, and He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.arabicClean: يعلم ما يلج في الأرض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من السماء وما يعرج فيها ۚ وهو الرحيم الغفور
verses.transliterated: yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa l-raḥīmu l-ghafūr
verses.english: He knows everything that goes into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. He is the Most Merciful, the Forgiving.

1981.english: He knows everything that goes into the earth and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky and everything that climbs into it; He is the merciful, the forgiver.

1989.english: He knows everything that goes into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. And He is the Most Merciful, the Forgiving.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا لا تأتينا الساعة ۖ قل بلى وربي لتأتينكم عالم الغيب ۖ لا يعزب عنه مثقال ذرة في السماوات ولا في الأرض ولا أصغر من ذلك ولا أكبر إلا في كتاب مبين
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tatīnā l-sāʿatu qul balā warabbī latatiyannakum ʿālimi l-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mith'qālu dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābin mubīni
verses.english: Those who disbelieve have said, "The Hour will never come to pass!" Say, "Absolutely—by my Lord—it will most certainly come to you. He is the Knower of the future. Not even the equivalent of an atom's weight is hidden from Him, be it in the heavens or the earth. Not even smaller than that, or larger (is hidden). All are in a profound record."

1981.english: Those who disbelieved said, "The hereafter will never come to pass." Say, "Yes indeed, by my Lord; it will certainly come to pass." He is the knower of all secrets; not an atom's weight is hidden from Him, be it in the heavens or the earth; not even smaller than that, nor larger, except in a profound record.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved said, “The Hour will never come to pass!” Say, “Absolutely, by my Lord, it will inevitably come to you. He is the Knower of the future. Not even the equivalent of an atom’s weight is hidden from Him, be it in the heavens or the earth. Not even smaller than that, or larger (is hidden). All are in a profound record.”

verses.arabic: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ليجزي الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ۚ أولئك لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم
verses.transliterated: liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmu
verses.english: Most certainly, He will reward those who believe and lead a righteous life. These have deserved forgiveness and a generous provision.

1981.english: God rewards those who believe and work righteousness with forgiveness and a generous recompense.

1989.english: Most assuredly, He will recompense those who believe and lead a righteous life. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous provision.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين سعوا في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك لهم عذاب من رجز أليم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmu
verses.english: As for those who constantly challenge our revelations, they have incurred a retribution of painful humiliation.

1981.english: As for those who challenge our revelations, they have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: As for those who constantly challenge our revelations, they have incurred a retribution of painful humiliation.

verses.arabic: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ويرى الذين أوتوا العلم الذي أنزل إليك من ربك هو الحق ويهدي إلى صراط العزيز الحميد
verses.transliterated: wayarā alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma alladhī unzila ilayka min rabbika huwa l-ḥaqa wayahdī ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīd
verses.english: It is evident to those who are blessed with knowledge that this revelation from your Lord to you is the truth, and that it guides to the path of the Almighty, the Most Praiseworthy.

1981.english: Those who possess knowledge realize that what was sent down to you from your Lord is the truth, and that it guides to the path of the almighty, the praiseworthy.

1989.english: It is evident to those who are blessed with knowledge that this revelation from your Lord to you is indeed the truth, and that it guides to the path of the Almighty, the Most Praised.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا هل ندلكم على رجل ينبئكم إذا مزقتم كل ممزق إنكم لفي خلق جديد
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū hal nadullukum ʿalā rajulin yunabbi-ukum idhā muzziq'tum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafī khalqin jadīdi
verses.english: Those who disbelieve have said, "Let us show you a man who tells you that after you are torn apart you will be created anew.

1981.english: The disbelievers said, "Let us show you a man who claims that after you disintegrate completely, you will be recreated.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved said, “We can show you a man who tells you that after you are torn apart you will be created anew.

verses.arabic: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: أفترى على الله كذبا أم به جنة ۗ بل الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة في العذاب والضلال البعيد
verses.transliterated: aftarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban am bihi jinnatun bali alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati fī l-ʿadhābi wal-ḍalāli l-baʿīd
verses.english: "Either he fabricated lies about GOD, or he is crazy." Indeed, those who disbelieve in the Hereafter have incurred the worst retribution; they have gone far astray.

1981.english: "He either invented a lie about God, or he must be crazy." Indeed, those who disbelieve in the hereafter are condemned to retribution and total loss.

1989.english: “Is he fabricating lies about GOD, or is he crazy?” Indeed, those who disbelieve in the Hereafter have incurred the worst retribution, for they have gone far astray.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: أفلم يروا إلى ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم من السماء والأرض ۚ إن نشأ نخسف بهم الأرض أو نسقط عليهم كسفا من السماء ۚ إن في ذلك لآية لكل عبد منيب
verses.transliterated: afalam yaraw ilā mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi in nasha nakhsif bihimu l-arḍa aw nus'qiṭ ʿalayhim kisafan mina l-samāi inna fī dhālika laāyatan likulli ʿabdin munībi
verses.english: Have they not seen all the things in front of them and behind them, in the heaven and the earth? If we willed, we could have caused the earth to swallow them, or caused masses to fall on them from the sky. This should be a sufficient proof for every obedient servant.

1981.english: Do they not see (all the marvels) in front of them and behind them, in the heaven and the earth? If we wish, we can make the earth swallow them, or drop on them masses from the sky. This is a lesson for every obedient servant.

1989.english: Have they not seen all the things in front of them and behind them, in the heaven and the earth? If we willed, we could have caused the earth to swallow them, or caused masses to fall on them from the sky. This is a sign for every obedient servant.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا يَٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا داوود منا فضلا ۖ يا جبال أوبي معه والطير ۖ وألنا له الحديد
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā dāwūda minnā faḍlan yājibālu awwibī maʿahu wal-ṭayra wa-alannā lahu l-ḥadīd
verses.english: We endowed David with blessings from us: "O mountains, submit with him, and you too, O birds." We softened the iron for him.
verses.subtitle: David and Solomon

1981.english: We have endowed David with blessings from us, "O mountains, serve him," and the birds, and we softened the iron for him.
1981.subtitle: David and Solomon

1989.english: We endowed David with blessings from us: “O mountains, submit with him, and you too, O birds.” We softened the iron for him.
1989.subtitle: David and Solomon

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَٰبِغَٰتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أن اعمل سابغات وقدر في السرد ۖ واعملوا صالحا ۖ إني بما تعملون بصير
verses.transliterated: ani iʿ'mal sābighātin waqaddir fī l-sardi wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verses.english: "You may make shields that fit perfectly, and work righteousness. Whatever you do, I am Seer thereof."

1981.english: Now you can make useful things and control the way they fit. You shall work righteousness; for I see everything you do.

1989.english: “You may make shields that fit perfectly, and work righteousness. I am Seer of everything you do.”

verses.arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: ولسليمان الريح غدوها شهر ورواحها شهر ۖ وأسلنا له عين القطر ۖ ومن الجن من يعمل بين يديه بإذن ربه ۖ ومن يزغ منهم عن أمرنا نذقه من عذاب السعير
verses.transliterated: walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ghuduwwuhā shahrun warawāḥuhā shahrun wa-asalnā lahu ʿayna l-qiṭ'ri wamina l-jini man yaʿmalu bayna yadayhi bi-idh'ni rabbihi waman yazigh min'hum ʿan amrinā nudhiq'hu min ʿadhābi l-saʿīr
verses.english: To Solomon we committed the wind at his disposal, traveling one month coming and one month going. And we caused a spring of oil to gush out for him. Also, the jinns worked for him, by his Lord's leave. Any one of them who disregarded our commands, we subjected him to a severe retribution.
verses.subtitle: The First Oil Field

1981.english: To Solomon we subdued the wind that traveled for a month back and forth, and we caused a spring of black oil to gush out for him. We subdued the jinns to work at his disposal, by God's leave. Any of them who deviated, we condemned him to the retribution of hell.

1989.english: And to Solomon we committed the wind in his service, traveling one month coming and one month going. And we caused a spring of oil to gush out for him. Also, the jinns worked for him, by his Lord’s leave. Any one of them who disregarded our commands, we subjected him to a severe punishment.
1989.subtitle: The First Oil Field

verses.arabic: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ
verses.arabicClean: يعملون له ما يشاء من محاريب وتماثيل وجفان كالجواب وقدور راسيات ۚ اعملوا آل داوود شكرا ۚ وقليل من عبادي الشكور
verses.transliterated: yaʿmalūna lahu mā yashāu min maḥārība watamāthīla wajifānin kal-jawābi waqudūrin rāsiyātin iʿ'malū āla dāwūda shuk'ran waqalīlun min ʿibādiya l-shakūr
verses.english: They made for him anything he wanted—niches, statues, deep pools, and heavy cooking pots. O family of David, work (righteousness) to show your appreciation. Only a few of My servants are appreciative.

1981.english: They made anything he wanted, including niches, statues, deep pools, and heavy pots. You shall work to show your appreciation, O David's family. Only a few of My creatures are appreciative.

1989.english: They made for him anything he wanted—niches, statues, deep pools, and heavy cooking pots. O family of David, work (righteousness) to show your appreciation—only a few of My servants are appreciative.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.arabicClean: فلما قضينا عليه الموت ما دلهم على موته إلا دابة الأرض تأكل منسأته ۖ فلما خر تبينت الجن أن لو كانوا يعلمون الغيب ما لبثوا في العذاب المهين
verses.transliterated: falammā qaḍaynā ʿalayhi l-mawta mā dallahum ʿalā mawtihi illā dābbatu l-arḍi takulu minsa-atahu falammā kharra tabayyanati l-jinu an law kānū yaʿlamūna l-ghayba mā labithū fī l-ʿadhābi l-muhīn
verses.english: When the appointed time for his death came, they had no clue that he had died. Not until one of the animals tried to eat his staff, and he fell down, that the jinns realized that he was dead. They thus realized that if they really knew the unseen, they would have stopped working so hard as soon as he died.
verses.subtitle: Jinns' Knowledge is Limited

1981.english: When we terminated his life, (the jinns) did not realize that he had died until an earthly creature* tried to eat his staff. When he fell down, the jinns realized that if they really knew the secrets, they would not have continued to labor.
1981.footnote: Could be a goat or a sheep.

1989.english: When the appointed time for his death came, they had no clue that he had died. It was only when one of the animals knocked away his staff, and he fell down, that the jinns realized that he was dead. They also realized that if they really knew the unseen, they would have stopped working so hard when he died.
1989.subtitle: Jinns’ Knowledge is Limited

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: لقد كان لسبإ في مسكنهم آية ۖ جنتان عن يمين وشمال ۖ كلوا من رزق ربكم واشكروا له ۚ بلدة طيبة ورب غفور
verses.transliterated: laqad kāna lisaba-in fī maskanihim āyatun jannatāni ʿan yamīnin washimālin kulū min riz'qi rabbikum wa-ush'kurū lahu baldatun ṭayyibatun warabbun ghafūru
verses.english: Sheba's homeland used to be a marvel, with two gardens on the right and the left. Eat from your Lord's provisions, and be appreciative of Him—good land, and a forgiving Lord.

1981.english: Sheba lived in a marvelous palace with two gardens, one to the right and one to the left. Eat from the provisions of your Lord, and be thankful to Him. You have good land, and a forgiving Lord.
1981.subtitle: Sheba

1989.english: Sheba’s homeland used to be a marvel, with two gardens on the right and the left. Eat from your Lord’s provisions, and be appreciative of Him. Good land, and a forgiving Lord.

verses.arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَىْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: فأعرضوا فأرسلنا عليهم سيل العرم وبدلناهم بجنتيهم جنتين ذواتي أكل خمط وأثل وشيء من سدر قليل
verses.transliterated: fa-aʿraḍū fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim sayla l-ʿarimi wabaddalnāhum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawātay ukulin khamṭin wa-athlin washayin min sid'rin qalīli
verses.english: They turned away and, consequently, we poured upon them a disastrous flood, and we substituted their two gardens into two gardens of bad tasting fruits, thorny plants, and a skimpy harvest.

1981.english: But they turned away, and consequently, we poured upon them a disasterous flood. We thus replaced their two gardens with gardens that grew only thorny cactus, bitter fruit, and a few edible plants.

1989.english: They turned away and, consequently, we poured upon them a disastrous flood, and we substituted their two gardens into two gardens of bad tasting fruits, thorny plants, and a small yield.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَهَلْ نُجَٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك جزيناهم بما كفروا ۖ وهل نجازي إلا الكفور
verses.transliterated: dhālika jazaynāhum bimā kafarū wahal nujāzī illā l-kafūr
verses.english: We thus requited them for their disbelief. Do we not requite only the disbelievers?

1981.english: We thus punished them because they disbelieved; do we punish other than the disbelievers?

1989.english: We thus requited them for their disbelief. Do we not requite the disbeliever?

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا بينهم وبين القرى التي باركنا فيها قرى ظاهرة وقدرنا فيها السير ۖ سيروا فيها ليالي وأياما آمنين
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā baynahum wabayna l-qurā allatī bāraknā fīhā quran ẓāhiratan waqaddarnā fīhā l-sayra sīrū fīhā layāliya wa-ayyāman āminīn
verses.english: We placed between them and the communities that we blessed other oases, and we secured the journey between them: "Travel therein days and nights in complete security."

1981.english: Then we placed between them and the blessed communities a number of stations that we made accessible. Travel therein night and day in complete safety.

1989.english: We placed between them and the communities that we blessed other oases, and we secured the journey between them: “Travel therein days and nights in complete security.”

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: فقالوا ربنا باعد بين أسفارنا وظلموا أنفسهم فجعلناهم أحاديث ومزقناهم كل ممزق ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور
verses.transliterated: faqālū rabbanā bāʿid bayna asfārinā waẓalamū anfusahum fajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha wamazzaqnāhum kulla mumazzaqin inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūri
verses.english: But they (turned unappreciative and) challenged: "Our Lord, we do not care if You increase the distance of our journeys (without any stations)." They thus wronged their own souls. Consequently, we made them history, and scattered them into small communities throughout the land. This should provide lessons for those who are steadfast, appreciative.

1981.english: But (they were unappreciative;) they said, "Our Lord, let us travel long distances (without stopping in any stations)," thus creating inconvenience to themselves. Consequently, we turned them into history and broke them apart. These are lessons for everyone who is steadfast, appreciative.

1989.english: But they (turned unappreciative and) challenged: “Our Lord, we do not care if You increase the distance of our journeys (without any stations).” They thus wronged their own souls. Consequently, we made them history, and scattered them into small communities throughout the land. This should provide lessons for those who are steadfast, appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد صدق عليهم إبليس ظنه فاتبعوه إلا فريقا من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ṣaddaqa ʿalayhim ib'līsu ẓannahu fa-ittabaʿūhu illā farīqan mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: Satan found them readily fulfilling his expectations. They followed him, except a few believers.
verses.subtitle: Satan Claims the Majority

1981.english: Satan found them readily fulfilling his expectations, and they followed him, except a few believers.

1989.english: Satan found them readily fulfilling his expectations. They followed him, except a few believers.

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما كان له عليهم من سلطان إلا لنعلم من يؤمن بالآخرة ممن هو منها في شك ۗ وربك على كل شيء حفيظ
verses.transliterated: wamā kāna lahu ʿalayhim min sul'ṭānin illā linaʿlama man yu'minu bil-ākhirati mimman huwa min'hā fī shakkin warabbuka ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓu
verses.english: He never had any power over them. But we thus distinguish those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are doubtful about it. Your Lord is in full control of all things.
verses.subtitle: The Objective: Do We Believe in the Hereafter?
verses.footnote: The criteria that inform us whether we believe in the Hereafter or not are in 6:113, 17:45, & 39:45. These three criteria bring out our true convictions, regardless of our oral statements.

1981.english: He never had any power over them. But we thus distinguish those who believe in the hereafter, from those who are doubtful. Your Lord is in full control of all things.

1989.english: He never had any power over them. But we thus distinguish those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are doubtful about it. Your Lord is in full control of all things.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دون الله ۖ لا يملكون مثقال ذرة في السماوات ولا في الأرض وما لهم فيهما من شرك وما له منهم من ظهير
verses.transliterated: quli id'ʿū alladhīna zaʿamtum min dūni l-lahi lā yamlikūna mith'qāla dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi wamā lahum fīhimā min shir'kin wamā lahu min'hum min ẓahīri
verses.english: Say, "Implore the idols you have set up beside GOD. They do not possess as much as a single atom in the heavens, or the earth. They possess no partnership therein, nor does He permit them to be His assistants."

1981.english: Say, "Call upon the idols you set up besides God. They do not possess an atom's weight in the heavens or the earth. Nor do they own any partnership therein, nor is any of them a helper of God."
1981.subtitle: Worship God, And Do Not Idolize Anyone

1989.english: Say, “Implore the idols you set up besides GOD. They do not possess as much as a single atom in the heavens, nor the earth. They possess no partnership therein, nor does He use any of them as an assistant.”

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تنفع الشفاعة عنده إلا لمن أذن له ۚ حتى إذا فزع عن قلوبهم قالوا ماذا قال ربكم ۖ قالوا الحق ۖ وهو العلي الكبير
verses.transliterated: walā tanfaʿu l-shafāʿatu ʿindahu illā liman adhina lahu ḥattā idhā fuzziʿa ʿan qulūbihim qālū mādhā qāla rabbukum qālū l-ḥaqa wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīr
verses.english: Intercession with Him will be in vain, unless it coincides with His will. When their minds are finally settled down, and they ask, "What did your Lord say," they will say, "The truth." He is the Most High, the Most Great.
verses.subtitle: No Intercession

1981.english: Intercession is useless at Him, except on behalf of those already saved.* Once their hearts settle down and they are asked, "What did your Lord say?" They will answer, "The truth. He is the most exalted, the great."
1981.footnote: See Appendix 7.

1989.english: Intercession with Him is in vain, unless it coincides with His will. When their minds are finally settled down, and they ask, “What did your Lord say,” they will say, “The truth.” He is the Most High, the Most Great
1989.subtitle: No Intercession

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل من يرزقكم من السماوات والأرض ۖ قل الله ۖ وإنا أو إياكم لعلى هدى أو في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi quli l-lahu wa-innā aw iyyākum laʿalā hudan aw fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Say, "Who provides for you, from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "GOD," and "Either we or you are guided, or have gone far astray."

1981.english: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "God," and, "Only one side is guided, either we or you; the other side is totally astray."

1989.english: Say, “Who provides for you, from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “GOD,” and “Either we or you are guided, or far astray.”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لا تسألون عما أجرمنا ولا نسأل عما تعملون
