verses.transliterated: qul lā tus'alūna ʿammā ajramnā walā nus'alu ʿammā taʿmalūn
verses.english: Say, "You are not responsible for our crimes, nor are we responsible for what you do."

1981.english: Say, "You are not responsible for our sins, nor are we responsible for what you do."

1989.english: Say, “You are not responsible for our crimes, nor are we responsible for what you do.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قل يجمع بيننا ربنا ثم يفتح بيننا بالحق وهو الفتاح العليم
verses.transliterated: qul yajmaʿu baynanā rabbunā thumma yaftaḥu baynanā bil-ḥaqi wahuwa l-fatāḥu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: Say, "Our Lord will gather us all together before Him, then He will judge between us equitably. He is the Judge, the Omniscient."

1981.english: Say, "Our Lord will gather us together, then He will judge between us equitably. He is the final judge, the omniscient."

1989.english: Say, “Our Lord will summon all of us then He will judge between us truth fully. He is the Judge, the Knower.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ كَلَّا بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قل أروني الذين ألحقتم به شركاء ۖ كلا ۚ بل هو الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: qul arūniya alladhīna alḥaqtum bihi shurakāa kallā bal huwa l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: Say, "Show me the idols you have set up as partners with Him!" Say, "No; He is the one GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise."

1981.english: Say, "Prove to me that the idols you set up are partners of God." Never! He is the one God; the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: Say, “Show me the idols you set up as partners with Him!” Say, “No; He is the one GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.” God’s Messenger of the Covenant

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلناك إلا كافة للناس بشيرا ونذيرا ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnāka illā kāffatan lilnnāsi bashīran wanadhīran walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: We have sent you (O Rashad) to all the people, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner, but most people do not know.
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: As detailed in Appendix 2, the name of this messenger is mathematically coded into the Quran as "Rashad Khalifa." By adding the numerical value of the name "Rashad" (505), plus the numerical value of the name "Khalifa" (725), plus the number of the sura (34), plus the number of the verse (28), we obtain a total that conforms with the Quran's 19-based mathematical miracle, which was unveiled through Rashad Khalifa. (505+725+34+28=1292=19x68). More information is given in 5:19 and its footnote.

1981.english: We have sent you to all the people; a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. But most people do not know.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad Sent To All The People

1989.english: We have sent you (O Rashad)* to all the people, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner, but most people do not know.
1989.footnote: As detailed in Appendix 2, the name of this messenger is mathematically coded into the Quran as “Rashad Khalifa.” By adding the numerical value of the name “Rashad” (505), plus the numerical value of the name “Khalifa” (725), plus the number of the sura (34), plus the number of the verse (28), we obtain a total that conforms with the Quran’s 19-based mathematical miracle, which was unveiled through Rashad. (505+ 725+34+28=1292=19x68). More information is given in 5:19 and its footnote. 2056,

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They challenge, "When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?"

1981.english: They say, "Where is that doom, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: They challenge, “When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?”

verses.arabic: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لكم ميعاد يوم لا تستأخرون عنه ساعة ولا تستقدمون
verses.transliterated: qul lakum mīʿādu yawmin lā tastakhirūna ʿanhu sāʿatan walā tastaqdimūn
verses.english: Say, "You have a specific time, on a specific day, that you cannot delay by one hour, nor advance."

1981.english: Say, "You have a predetermined time; and you can never delay it by one hour, nor advance it."

1989.english: Say, “You have a specific time, on a specific day, that you cannot delay by one hour, nor advance.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا لن نؤمن بهذا القرآن ولا بالذي بين يديه ۗ ولو ترى إذ الظالمون موقوفون عند ربهم يرجع بعضهم إلى بعض القول يقول الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا لولا أنتم لكنا مؤمنين
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū lan nu'mina bihādhā l-qur'āni walā bi-alladhī bayna yadayhi walaw tarā idhi l-ẓālimūna mawqūfūna ʿinda rabbihim yarjiʿu baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin l-qawla yaqūlu alladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū lilladhīna is'takbarū lawlā antum lakunnā mu'minīn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve have said, "We will not believe in this Quran, nor in the previous scriptures." If you could only envision these transgressors when they stand before their Lord! They will argue with one another back and forth. The followers will tell their leaders, "If it were not for you, we would have been believers."

1981.english: And the disbelievers say, "We will not believe in this Quran, or in the previous scriptures." If you could only envision the wicked when they face their Lord; they will blame each other. Thus, the followers will say to the leaders, "If it were not for you, we would have believed."

1989.english: Those who disbelieved said, “We will not believe in this Quran, nor in the previous scriptures.” If you could only envision these transgressors when they stand before their Lord! They will argue with one another back and forth. The followers will tell their leaders, “If it were not for you, we would have been believers.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال الذين استكبروا للذين استضعفوا أنحن صددناكم عن الهدى بعد إذ جاءكم ۖ بل كنتم مجرمين
verses.transliterated: qāla alladhīna is'takbarū lilladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū anaḥnu ṣadadnākum ʿani l-hudā baʿda idh jāakum bal kuntum muj'rimīn
verses.english: The leaders will say to those who followed them, "Are we the ones who diverted you from the guidance after it came to you? No; it is you who were wicked."
verses.subtitle: On the Day of Resurrection

1981.english: The leaders will say to the followers, "It is not us who diverted you from the guidance when it came to you; it is you who were guilty."

1989.english: The leaders said to those who followed them, “Are we the ones who diverted you from the guidance after it came to you? No; it is you who were criminals.”
1989.subtitle: On the Day of Resurrection

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا بل مكر الليل والنهار إذ تأمروننا أن نكفر بالله ونجعل له أندادا ۚ وأسروا الندامة لما رأوا العذاب وجعلنا الأغلال في أعناق الذين كفروا ۚ هل يجزون إلا ما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū lilladhīna is'takbarū bal makru al-layli wal-nahāri idh tamurūnanā an nakfura bil-lahi wanajʿala lahu andādan wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba wajaʿalnā l-aghlāla fī aʿnāqi alladhīna kafarū hal yuj'zawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: The followers will say to their leaders, "It was you who schemed night and day, then commanded us to be unappreciative of GOD, and to set up idols to rank with Him." They will be ridden with remorse, when they see the retribution, for we will place shackles around the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they not justly requited for what they did?

1981.english: The followers will say to the leaders, "It was your scheming, night and day, that directed us to disbelieve in God and set up idols to rank with Him." They will be grief stricken when they see the retribution. We will tie chains around the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they not equitably punished for their works?

1989.english: The followers said to their leaders, “It was you who schemed night and day, then commanded us to be unappreciative of GOD, and to set up idols to rank with Him.” They became ridden with remorse, when they saw the retribution. We placed shackles around the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they not justly requited for whatever they did?

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلنا في قرية من نذير إلا قال مترفوها إنا بما أرسلتم به كافرون
verses.transliterated: wamā arsalnā fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūn
verses.english: Every time we sent a warner to a community, the leaders of that community said, "We reject the message you are sent with."
verses.subtitle: Every Time!

1981.english: Whenever we sent a warner to any community, the leaders therein would say, "We disbelieve in the message you bring."

1989.english: Every time we sent a warner to a community, the leaders of that community said, “We reject the message you are sent with.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا نحن أكثر أموالا وأولادا وما نحن بمعذبين
verses.transliterated: waqālū naḥnu aktharu amwālan wa-awlādan wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīn
verses.english: They also said, "We are more powerful, with more money and children, and we will not be punished."

1981.english: And they say, "We possess enough wealth and children; we will never be punished."

1989.english: They also said, “We are more powerful, with more money and children; we will not be punished.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن ربي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: qul inna rabbī yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord is the One who controls all provisions; He grants the provisions to whomever He wills, or reduces them, but most people do not know."

1981.english: Say, "My Lord is the one who provides for whomever He wills, and He withholds." But most people do not know.

1989.english: Say, “My Lord grants the provision for whomever He wills, and reduces it, but most people do not know.”

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أموالكم ولا أولادكم بالتي تقربكم عندنا زلفى إلا من آمن وعمل صالحا فأولئك لهم جزاء الضعف بما عملوا وهم في الغرفات آمنون
verses.transliterated: wamā amwālukum walā awlādukum bi-allatī tuqarribukum ʿindanā zul'fā illā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika lahum jazāu l-ḍiʿ'fi bimā ʿamilū wahum fī l-ghurufāti āminūn
verses.english: It is not your money or your children that bring you closer to us. Only those who believe and lead a righteous life will receive the reward for their works, multiplied manifold. In the abode of Paradise they will live in perfect peace.

1981.english: It is not your wealth or your children that bring you closer to us. Only those who believe and work righteousness are rewarded manyfold for their works; they are secure in their homes.

1989.english: It is not your money or your children that will bring you closer to us. Only those who believe and lead a righteous life will receive the reward for their works, multiplied manifold. In the abode of Paradise they will live in security.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يسعون في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك في العذاب محضرون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yasʿawna fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika fī l-ʿadhābi muḥ'ḍarūn
verses.english: As for those who consistently challenge our revelations, they will abide in retribution.

1981.english: As for those who challenge our revelations, they are condemned to retribution.

1989.english: As for those who consistently challenge our revelations, they will abide in retribution.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن ربي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له ۚ وما أنفقتم من شيء فهو يخلفه ۖ وهو خير الرازقين
verses.transliterated: qul inna rabbī yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu wamā anfaqtum min shayin fahuwa yukh'lifuhu wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīn
verses.english: Say, "My Lord is the One who controls all provisions; He increases the provisions for whomever He chooses from among His servants, or reduces them. Anything you spend (in the cause of GOD), He will reward you for it; He is the Best Provider."

1981.english: Say, "My Lord is the one who provides for whomever He chooses, or withholds it from him." Whatever you spend in charity, He multiplies it; He is the best provider.

1989.english: Say, “My Lord increases the provision for whomever He chooses from among His servants, and reduces it. Anything you spend (in the cause of God), He will pay you for it; He is the Best Provider.”

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يحشرهم جميعا ثم يقول للملائكة أهؤلاء إياكم كانوا يعبدون
verses.transliterated: wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma yaqūlu lil'malāikati ahāulāi iyyākum kānū yaʿbudūn
verses.english: On the day when He summons them all, He will say to the angels, "Did these people worship you?"

1981.english: On the day when He gathers them all, He will say to the angels, "Did these people idolize you?"

1989.english: On the day when He summons them all, He will say to the angels, “Did these people worship you?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا سبحانك أنت ولينا من دونهم ۖ بل كانوا يعبدون الجن ۖ أكثرهم بهم مؤمنون
verses.transliterated: qālū sub'ḥānaka anta waliyyunā min dūnihim bal kānū yaʿbudūna l-jina aktharuhum bihim mu'minūn
verses.english: They will answer, "Be You glorified. You are our Lord and Master, not them. Instead, they were worshiping the jinns; most of them were believers therein."

1981.english: They will say, "Glory be to You; You are our Lord, not them." Instead, they idolized the jinns, and most of them were believers therein.
1981.footnote: When we fail to worship God alone, we are in effect worshiping the devil. (See 36:60.)

1989.english: They will answer, “Be You glorified. You are our Lord and Master, not them. Instead, they were worshiping the jinns; most of them were believers therein.”

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاليوم لا يملك بعضكم لبعض نفعا ولا ضرا ونقول للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون
verses.transliterated: fal-yawma lā yamliku baʿḍukum libaʿḍin nafʿan walā ḍarran wanaqūlu lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-nāri allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūn
verses.english: On that day, you possess no power to help or harm one another, and we will say to the transgressors, "Taste the retribution of the Hell that you used to deny."

1981.english: Today, you possess no power to benefit or harm one another. We will say to the wicked, "Suffer the retribution of hell that you used to deny."

1989.english: On that day, you will not possess any power to help one another, or harm one another. We will say to the transgressors, “Suffer the retribution of Hell, which you used to deny.”

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات قالوا ما هذا إلا رجل يريد أن يصدكم عما كان يعبد آباؤكم وقالوا ما هذا إلا إفك مفترى ۚ وقال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم إن هذا إلا سحر مبين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qālū mā hādhā illā rajulun yurīdu an yaṣuddakum ʿammā kāna yaʿbudu ābāukum waqālū mā hādhā illā if'kun muf'taran waqāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: When our proofs were recited to them, perfectly clear, they said, "This is simply a man who wants to divert you from the way your parents are worshiping." They also said, "These are fabricated lies." Those who disbelieved also said about the truth that came to them, "This is obviously magic."
verses.subtitle: Mathematical Miracle of the Quran
verses.footnote: By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus this verse number (43), we get 505+725+43=1273=19x67. See Appendices 1 & 2.

1981.english: When our clear revelations are recited for them, they say, "This is a man who wants to divert you from the religion of your parents." They also say, "This is fabricated falsehood." And the disbelievers say, when the truth comes to them, "This is obvious magic."

1989.english: When our revelations are recited to them, perfectly clear, they say, “This is simply a man who wants to divert you from the way your parents used to worship.” They also say, “This is no more than fabricated lies.” And those who disbelieved said about the truth when it came to them, “This is obviously magic.”

verses.arabic: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما آتيناهم من كتب يدرسونها ۖ وما أرسلنا إليهم قبلك من نذير
verses.transliterated: wamā ātaynāhum min kutubin yadrusūnahā wamā arsalnā ilayhim qablaka min nadhīri
verses.english: We did not give them any other books to study, nor did we send to them before you another warner.

1981.english: We did not give them scriptures to study, nor did we send to them a warner before you.

1989.english: We did not give them any scriptures to study, nor did we send to them before you a warner. Mathematical Miracle of the Quran Greater Than All Previous Miracles*

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: وكذب الذين من قبلهم وما بلغوا معشار ما آتيناهم فكذبوا رسلي ۖ فكيف كان نكير
verses.transliterated: wakadhaba alladhīna min qablihim wamā balaghū miʿ'shāra mā ātaynāhum fakadhabū rusulī fakayfa kāna nakīr
verses.english: Those before them disbelieved, and even though they did not see one-tenth of (the miracle) we have given to this generation, when they disbelieved My messengers, how severe was My retribution!
verses.footnote: The great miracles given to Moses and Jesus were limited in time and place; they were witnessed by a few people who happened to exist in that place at that time. But the mathematical miracle of the Quran is perpetual (see 74:30-35 & Appendix 1).

1981.english: Others before them have disbelieved; and although we gave them less than one-tenth of this, when they disbelieved My messengers, how terrible was My retribution!

1989.english: Those before them disbelieved, and they did not see even one-tenth of (the miracle) we have given to these people. Yet, when they disbelieved My messengers, how severe was My retribution!
1989.footnote: The great miracles given to Moses and Jesus were limited in time and place, they were witnessed by a few people who happened to exist in that place at that time. But the mathematical miracle of the Quran is perpetual (see 74:30-35 & Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل إنما أعظكم بواحدة ۖ أن تقوموا لله مثنى وفرادى ثم تتفكروا ۚ ما بصاحبكم من جنة ۚ إن هو إلا نذير لكم بين يدي عذاب شديد
verses.transliterated: qul innamā aʿiẓukum biwāḥidatin an taqūmū lillahi mathnā wafurādā thumma tatafakkarū mā biṣāḥibikum min jinnatin in huwa illā nadhīrun lakum bayna yaday ʿadhābin shadīdi
verses.english: Say, "I ask you to do one thing: Devote yourselves to GOD, in pairs or as individuals, then reflect. Your friend (Rashad) is not crazy. He is a manifest warner to you, just before the advent of a terrible retribution."
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: By placing the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505) next to the value of "Khalifa" (725), then the sura number (34), and the verse number (46), we get 5057253446 = 19x266171234.

1981.english: Say, "I exhort you to do one thing: that you totally submit to God in pairs, or as individuals, then reflect. Your friend is not crazy; he only alerts you to evade terrible retribution."

1989.english: Say, “I admonish you to do one thing You shall devote yourselves to GOD in pairs or as individuals, then reflect. Your friend is not crazy. He is a pro found warner to you, just before the advent of a terrible retribution.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل ما سألتكم من أجر فهو لكم ۖ إن أجري إلا على الله ۖ وهو على كل شيء شهيد
verses.transliterated: qul mā sa-altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
verses.english: Say, "I do not ask you for any wage; you can keep it. My wage comes only from GOD. He witnesses all things."

1981.english: Say, "I have not asked you for any wage. My wage comes from God; He witnesses all things."

1989.english: Say, “I do not ask you for any wage; you can keep it. My wage comes only from GOD. He witnesses all things.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن ربي يقذف بالحق علام الغيوب
verses.transliterated: qul inna rabbī yaqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb
verses.english: Say, "My Lord causes the truth to prevail. He is the Knower of all secrets."

1981.english: Say, "My Lord presents the truth; He is fully aware of all secrets."

1989.english: Say, “My Lord causes the truth to prevail. He is the Knower of all secrets.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: قل جاء الحق وما يبدئ الباطل وما يعيد
verses.transliterated: qul jāa l-ḥaqu wamā yub'di-u l-bāṭilu wamā yuʿīd
verses.english: Say, "The truth has come; while falsehood can neither initiate anything, nor repeat it."

1981.english: Say, "The truth has come, while falsehood can neither initiate anything nor repeat it."

1989.english: Say, “The truth has come; while falsehood can neither initiate anything, nor repeat it.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل إن ضللت فإنما أضل على نفسي ۖ وإن اهتديت فبما يوحي إلي ربي ۚ إنه سميع قريب
verses.transliterated: qul in ḍalaltu fa-innamā aḍillu ʿalā nafsī wa-ini ih'tadaytu fabimā yūḥī ilayya rabbī innahu samīʿun qarību
verses.english: Say, "If I go astray, I go astray because of my own shortcomings. And if I am guided, it is because of my Lord's inspiration. He is Hearer, Near."

1981.english: Say, "If I go astray, I go astray to my own detriment; and if I am guided, it is because I follow the revelations of my Lord; He is hearer and very close."

1989.english: Say, “If I go astray, I go astray because of my own shortcomings. And if I am guided, it is because of my Lord’s inspiration. He is Hearer, Near.”

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولو ترى إذ فزعوا فلا فوت وأخذوا من مكان قريب
verses.transliterated: walaw tarā idh faziʿū falā fawta wa-ukhidhū min makānin qarībi
verses.english: If you could only see them when the great terror strikes them; they cannot escape then, and they will be taken away forcibly.

1981.english: If you could envision them as terror strikes; they cannot escape then and will be readily seized.

1989.english: If you could only see them when the great terror strikes them; they cannot escape then, and will be taken forcibly.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا آمنا به وأنى لهم التناوش من مكان بعيد
verses.transliterated: waqālū āmannā bihi wa-annā lahumu l-tanāwushu min makānin baʿīdi
verses.english: They will then say, "We now believe in it," but it will be far too late.

1981.english: They will say, "We now believe in this," but it will be too late.

1989.english: And they will say, “We now believe in it,” but it will be too late.

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقد كفروا به من قبل ۖ ويقذفون بالغيب من مكان بعيد
verses.transliterated: waqad kafarū bihi min qablu wayaqdhifūna bil-ghaybi min makānin baʿīdi
verses.english: They have rejected it in the past; they have decided instead to uphold conjecture and guesswork.
verses.footnote: People of all religions tend to forsake the word of God and uphold the words of men. The Jews and the Muslims uphold the Mishnah (Hadith) and Gemarrah (Sunna), while the Christians uphold a trinity invented by the Nicene Conference, 325 years after Jesus.

1981.english: They had already disbelieved; and when they believe in the unseen after it becomes manifest it will be much too late.

1989.english: They had rejected it in the past, and decided instead to uphold conjecture and guesswork.*
1989.footnote: People of all religions tend to forsake the word of God, and uphold the words of men. The Jews and the Muslims uphold the Mishnah (Hadith) and Gemarrah (Sunna), while the Christians uphold Gospels other than ((The Gospel according to Jesus. ”

verses.arabic: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: وحيل بينهم وبين ما يشتهون كما فعل بأشياعهم من قبل ۚ إنهم كانوا في شك مريب
verses.transliterated: waḥīla baynahum wabayna mā yashtahūna kamā fuʿila bi-ashyāʿihim min qablu innahum kānū fī shakkin murībi
verses.english: Consequently, they were deprived of everything they longed for. This is the same fate as their counterparts in the previous generations. They harbored too many doubts.

1981.english: They will be isolated from everything they like, just like the previous generations of their kind. They had harbored too much doubt.

1989.english: Consequently, they were deprived of everything they longed for. This was also the fate of their likes in the previous generations. They harbored too many doubts.

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله فاطر السماوات والأرض جاعل الملائكة رسلا أولي أجنحة مثنى وثلاث ورباع ۚ يزيد في الخلق ما يشاء ۚ إن الله على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: al-ḥamdu lillahi fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jāʿili l-malāikati rusulan ulī ajniḥatin mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa yazīdu fī l-khalqi mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Praise be to GOD, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, and appointer of the angels to be messengers with wings—two, three, and four (wings). He increases the creation as He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Praise be to God, initiator of the heavens and the earth. He appoints angels as messengers with wings; two, three, and four. He adds to the creation whatever He wills. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: Praise be to GOD, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, and appointer of the angels to be messengers with wings—two, three, and four (wings). He increases the creation as He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ما يفتح الله للناس من رحمة فلا ممسك لها ۖ وما يمسك فلا مرسل له من بعده ۚ وهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: mā yaftaḥi l-lahu lilnnāsi min raḥmatin falā mum'sika lahā wamā yum'sik falā mur'sila lahu min baʿdihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: When GOD showers the people with mercy, no force can stop it. And if He withholds it, no force, other than He, can send it. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: When God showers mercy upon the people, none can stop it; and if He withholds it, who can release it? He is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: When GOD showers any people with mercy, no force can stop it. And if He withholds it, no force, other than He, can send it. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ خَٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس اذكروا نعمت الله عليكم ۚ هل من خالق غير الله يرزقكم من السماء والأرض ۚ لا إله إلا هو ۖ فأنى تؤفكون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum hal min khāliqin ghayru l-lahi yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūn
verses.english: O people, remember GOD's blessings upon you. Is there any creator other than GOD who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no other god beside Him. How could you deviate?

1981.english: O people, be appreciative of God's favors upon you. Is there any creator, other than God, who provides for you from the heavens and the earth? There is no god except He; how could you deviate?

1989.english: O people, remember GOD’s blessings upon you. Is there any creator other than GOD who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يكذبوك فقد كذبت رسل من قبلك ۚ وإلى الله ترجع الأمور
verses.transliterated: wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūr
verses.english: If they disbelieve you, messengers before you have been disbelieved. GOD is in control of all things.

1981.english: If they disbelieve you, messengers before you have been disbelieved. To God everything returns.

1989.english: If they disbelieve you, messengers before you have been disbelieved. GOD is in control of all things.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس إن وعد الله حق ۖ فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا ۖ ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūr
verses.english: O people, GOD's promise is the truth; therefore, do not be distracted by this lowly life. Do not be diverted from GOD by mere illusions.

1981.english: O people, God's promise is true. Therefore, do not be distracted by this life; nor shall you be distracted from God by any deceiver.

1989.english: O people, GOD’s promise is truth; do not be distracted by this lowly life. Do not be diverted from GOD by an illusion.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الشيطان لكم عدو فاتخذوه عدوا ۚ إنما يدعو حزبه ليكونوا من أصحاب السعير
verses.transliterated: inna l-shayṭāna lakum ʿaduwwun fa-ittakhidhūhu ʿaduwwan innamā yadʿū ḥiz'bahu liyakūnū min aṣḥābi l-saʿīr
verses.english: The devil is your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be the dwellers of Hell.

1981.english: The devil is your enemy, so count him as one. He leads his allies to be deservers of hell.

1989.english: The devil is your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be the dwellers of Hell.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: الذين كفروا لهم عذاب شديد ۖ والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم مغفرة وأجر كبير
verses.transliterated: alladhīna kafarū lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīru
verses.english: Those who disbelieve have incurred a severe retribution, and those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve have deserved terrible retribution, and those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved have incurred a severe retribution, and those who believed and led a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن زين له سوء عمله فرآه حسنا ۖ فإن الله يضل من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء ۖ فلا تذهب نفسك عليهم حسرات ۚ إن الله عليم بما يصنعون
verses.transliterated: afaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi faraāhu ḥasanan fa-inna l-laha yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu falā tadhhab nafsuka ʿalayhim ḥasarātin inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yaṣnaʿūn
verses.english: Note the one whose evil work is adorned in his eyes, until he thinks that it is righteous. GOD thus sends astray whoever wills (to go astray), and He guides whoever wills (to be guided). Therefore, do not grieve over them. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

1981.english: What if one's evil work is adorned for him, until he thinks it is righteous? God thus misleads those who deserve it,* and guides those who deserve guidance. Therefore, do not be terribly saddened over them. God is fully aware of all their works.
1981.footnote: God is the only one who knows our innermost convictions, and He knows those of us who deserve to be sent astray. Based on our real convictions, God goes out of His way to guide us or mislead us. See Appendix 12.

1989.english: What if one’s evil work is adorned in his eyes, until he thinks it is righteous? GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and He guides whomever He wills. Therefore, do not grieve over them. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.arabicClean: والله الذي أرسل الرياح فتثير سحابا فسقناه إلى بلد ميت فأحيينا به الأرض بعد موتها ۚ كذلك النشور
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fasuq'nāhu ilā baladin mayyitin fa-aḥyaynā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā kadhālika l-nushūr
verses.english: GOD is the One who sends the winds to stir up clouds, then we drive them towards barren lands, and revive such lands after they were dead. Thus is the resurrection.

1981.english: God is the one who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, then we drive them to dead land and restore life to the dead soil. Such is the resurrection.
1981.subtitle: Dignity Only With God

1989.english: GOD is the One who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, then we drive them towards barren lands, and revive such lands after they were dead. Thus is the resurrection.

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
verses.arabicClean: من كان يريد العزة فلله العزة جميعا ۚ إليه يصعد الكلم الطيب والعمل الصالح يرفعه ۚ والذين يمكرون السيئات لهم عذاب شديد ۖ ومكر أولئك هو يبور
verses.transliterated: man kāna yurīdu l-ʿizata falillahi l-ʿizatu jamīʿan ilayhi yaṣʿadu l-kalimu l-ṭayibu wal-ʿamalu l-ṣāliḥu yarfaʿuhu wa-alladhīna yamkurūna l-sayiāti lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wamakru ulāika huwa yabūr
verses.english: Anyone seeking dignity should know that to GOD belongs all dignity. To Him ascends the good words, and He exalts the righteous works. As for those who scheme evil works, they incur severe retribution; the scheming of such people is destined to fail.
verses.subtitle: All Dignity Belongs With God

1981.english: If anyone wants dignity, all dignity belongs with God. To Him ascends the good words, and He exalts the righteous work. As for those who scheme evil, they have deserved terrible retribution; their scheming is utterly detrimental to them.

1989.english: Anyone seeking dignity should know that to GOD belongs all dignity. To Him ascends the good words, and He exalts the righteous works. As for those who scheme evil works, they incur severe retribution; the scheming of such people is destined to fail.
1989.subtitle: All Dignity Belongs With God

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: والله خلقكم من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم جعلكم أزواجا ۚ وما تحمل من أنثى ولا تضع إلا بعلمه ۚ وما يعمر من معمر ولا ينقص من عمره إلا في كتاب ۚ إن ذلك على الله يسير
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma jaʿalakum azwājan wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wamā yuʿammaru min muʿammarin walā yunqaṣu min ʿumurihi illā fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīru
verses.english: GOD created you from dust, then from a tiny drop, then He causes you to reproduce through your spouses. No female becomes pregnant, nor gives birth, without His knowledge. No one survives for a long life, and no one's life is snapped short, except in accordance with a pre-existing record. This is easy for GOD.
verses.subtitle: God is in Full Control

1981.english: God is the one who created you from dust, then from a drop, then He made you mates. Not a single female becomes pregnant or gives birth without His knowledge. Nor does anyone live a long life or a short one except in accordance with a profound record. This is easy for God to do.

1989.english: GOD created you from dust, then from a tiny drop, then He caused you to reproduce through your spouses. No female becomes pregnant, nor gives birth, without His knowledge. No one survives for a long life, and no one’s life is snapped short, except in accordance with a pre-existing record. This is easy for GOD.
1989.subtitle: God is in Full Control

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما يستوي البحران هذا عذب فرات سائغ شرابه وهذا ملح أجاج ۖ ومن كل تأكلون لحما طريا وتستخرجون حلية تلبسونها ۖ وترى الفلك فيه مواخر لتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: wamā yastawī l-baḥrāni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun sāighun sharābuhu wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wamin kullin takulūna laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūna ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka fīhi mawākhira litabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: The two seas are not the same; one is fresh and delicious, while the other is salty and undrinkable. From each of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry to wear. And you see the ships sailing through them, seeking His provisions, that you may be appreciative.
verses.subtitle: Appreciating God's Greatness
verses.footnote: When we send our astronauts into space, we provide them with their minimum needs of food, water, and oxygen. When we sided with Satan's blasphemy billions of years ago (Appendix 7), God launched us into space aboard the spaceship Earth. But God has supplied our spaceship with awesome renewable systems that provide a great variety of fresh foods, water, oxygen, and even the reproduction of us astronauts.

1981.english: The two seas are not the same; this one is sweet and fresh, while the other is salty and undrinkable. But from both of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewels to wear. And you see the ships traveling therein, seeking His bounties, that you may be appreciative.

1989.english: And the two seas are not the same; one is fresh and potable, while the other is salty and undrinkable. From each of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry to wear. And you see the ships sailing therein, seeking His bounties, that you may be appreciative.
1989.subtitle: Appreciating God’s Greatness
1989.footnote: When we send our astronauts into space, we provide them with their minimum needs of food, water, and oxygen. When we sided with Satan’s blasphemy billions of years ago (Appendix 7), God launched us into space aboard the spaceship Earth. But God has supplied our spaceship Earth with awesome renewable systems that provide a great variety of fresh foods, water, oxygen, and even the reproduction of us astronauts.

verses.arabic: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لأجل مسمى ۚ ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك ۚ والذين تدعون من دونه ما يملكون من قطمير
verses.transliterated: yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi mā yamlikūna min qiṭ'mīri
verses.english: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He has committed the sun and the moon to run for a predetermined period of time. Such is GOD your Lord; to Him belongs all kingship. Any idols you set up beside Him do not possess as much as a seed's shell.

1981.english: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night; He subdued the sun and the moon, each running for a specific period. Such is God, your Lord. To Him belongs all kingship. Any idols you set up besides Him possess not as much as a seed.

1989.english: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He has committed the sun and the moon to run for a predetermined period of time. Such is GOD your Lord; to Him belongs all kingship. Any idols you set up besides Him do not possess as much a J’ The Idols*
1989.footnote: When we send our astronauts into space, we provide them with their minimum needs of food, water, and oxygen. When we sided with Satan’s blasphemy billions of years ago (Appendix 7), God launched us into space aboard the spaceship Earth. But God has supplied our spaceship Earth with awesome renewable systems that provide a great variety of fresh foods, water, oxygen, and even the reproduction of us astronauts.

verses.arabic: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن تدعوهم لا يسمعوا دعاءكم ولو سمعوا ما استجابوا لكم ۖ ويوم القيامة يكفرون بشرككم ۚ ولا ينبئك مثل خبير
verses.transliterated: in tadʿūhum lā yasmaʿū duʿāakum walaw samiʿū mā is'tajābū lakum wayawma l-qiyāmati yakfurūna bishir'kikum walā yunabbi-uka mith'lu khabīri
verses.english: If you call on them, they cannot hear you. Even if they hear you, they cannot respond to you. On the Day of Resurrection, they will disown you. None can inform you like the Most Cognizant.
verses.subtitle: The Idols Utterly Powerless
verses.footnote: People idolize Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and/or the saints; such idols are dead, unaware, and utterly powerless. Even when they were alive, they were powerless.

1981.english: If you implore them, they cannot hear you; even if they hear you, they cannot answer your prayers. On the day of resurrection, they disown your idol worship. None can inform you like a cognizant one.

1989.english: If you call on them, they cannot hear you. Even if they hear you, they cannot respond to you. On the Day of Resurrection, they disown you. None informs you like the Most Cognizant.
1989.footnote: People idolize Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and/or the saints; such idols are dead, unaware, and utterly powerless. Even when they were alive, they were powerless.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس أنتم الفقراء إلى الله ۖ والله هو الغني الحميد
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu antumu l-fuqarāu ilā l-lahi wal-lahu huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīd
verses.english: O people, you are the ones who need GOD, while GOD is in no need for anyone, the Most Praiseworthy.

1981.english: O people, you are the ones who need God, while God needs no one; He is worthy of all praise.

1989.english: O people, you are the ones who need GOD, while GOD is in no need, Most Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن يشأ يذهبكم ويأت بخلق جديد
verses.transliterated: in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayati bikhalqin jadīdi
verses.english: If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.

1981.english: If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.

1989.english: If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.

verses.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما ذلك على الله بعزيز
verses.transliterated: wamā dhālika ʿalā l-lahi biʿazīzi
verses.english: This is not too difficult for GOD.

1981.english: This is not too difficult for God.

1989.english: This is not too difficult for GOD.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ۚ وإن تدع مثقلة إلى حملها لا يحمل منه شيء ولو كان ذا قربى ۗ إنما تنذر الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب وأقاموا الصلاة ۚ ومن تزكى فإنما يتزكى لنفسه ۚ وإلى الله المصير
verses.transliterated: walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā wa-in tadʿu muth'qalatun ilā ḥim'lihā lā yuḥ'mal min'hu shayon walaw kāna dhā qur'bā innamā tundhiru alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waman tazakkā fa-innamā yatazakkā linafsihi wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīr
verses.english: No soul can carry the sins of another soul. If a soul that is loaded with sins implores another to bear part of its load, no other soul can carry any part of it, even if they were related. The only people to heed your warnings are those who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat). Whoever purifies his soul, does so for his own good. To GOD is the final destiny.

1981.english: No soul will bear the load of another, and when a burdened soul implores for help, nothing can be unloaded, not even by a close relative. None will heed your warnings except those who reverence their Lord in their privacy, and observe **salat**. Anyone who purifies himself, does so for his own good. To God is the ultimate destiny.

1989.english: No soul can carry the sins of another soul. If a soul that is loaded with sins implores to have part of its load removed, no other soul can carry any part of it, even if they are related. The only people to heed your warnings are those who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and observe the contact prayers (Salat). Whoever purifies his soul, does so for his own good. To GOD is the final destiny.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وما يستوي الأعمى والبصير
verses.transliterated: wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīr
verses.english: The blind and the seer are not equal.

1981.english: The blind and the seer are not the same.

1989.english: The blind and the seer are not equal.

verses.arabic: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا الظلمات ولا النور
verses.transliterated: walā l-ẓulumātu walā l-nūr
verses.english: Nor are the darkness and the light.

1981.english: Nor is darkness and the light.

1989.english: Nor are the darkness and the light.

verses.arabic: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا الظل ولا الحرور
verses.transliterated: walā l-ẓilu walā l-ḥarūr
verses.english: Nor are the coolness of the shade and the heat of the sun.

1981.english: Nor is the shade and the heat.

1989.english: Nor are the coolness and the heat.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.arabicClean: وما يستوي الأحياء ولا الأموات ۚ إن الله يسمع من يشاء ۖ وما أنت بمسمع من في القبور
verses.transliterated: wamā yastawī l-aḥyāu walā l-amwātu inna l-laha yus'miʿu man yashāu wamā anta bimus'miʿin man fī l-qubūr
verses.english: Nor are the living and the dead; GOD causes whomever He wills to hear. You cannot make hearers out of those in the graves.

1981.english: Nor the living and the dead. God is the one who can make anyone hear; you cannot be heard by those in the graves.

1989.english: Nor are the living and the dead; GOD causes whomever He wills to hear. You cannot make hearers out of those in the graves.

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن أنت إلا نذير
verses.transliterated: in anta illā nadhīru
verses.english: You are no more than a warner.

1981.english: You are no more than a warner.

1989.english: You are no more than a warner.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنا أرسلناك بالحق بشيرا ونذيرا ۚ وإن من أمة إلا خلا فيها نذير
verses.transliterated: innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqi bashīran wanadhīran wa-in min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nadhīru
verses.english: We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. Every community must receive a warner.
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: The gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (24) give us a total that is a multiple of 19 (1230+24=1254=19x66).

1981.english: We have sent you with the truth as a preacher and a warner; every community receives a warner.

1989.english: We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. Every community must receive a warner.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يكذبوك فقد كذب الذين من قبلهم جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات وبالزبر وبالكتاب المنير
verses.transliterated: wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wabil-zuburi wabil-kitābi l-munīr
verses.english: If they disbelieve you, those before them have also disbelieved. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, and the Psalms, and the enlightening scriptures.

1981.english: If they disbelieve you, those before them also disbelieved. Their messengers went to them with clear signs, the Psalms, and enlightened scripture.

1989.english: If they disbelieve you, those before them have also disbelieved. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, and the Psalms, and the enlightening scriptures.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أخذت الذين كفروا ۖ فكيف كان نكير
verses.transliterated: thumma akhadhtu alladhīna kafarū fakayfa kāna nakīr
verses.english: Subsequently, I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!

1981.english: Then I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was my punishment!

1989.english: Subsequently, I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به ثمرات مختلفا ألوانها ۚ ومن الجبال جدد بيض وحمر مختلف ألوانها وغرابيب سود
verses.transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mukh'talifan alwānuhā wamina l-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥum'run mukh'talifun alwānuhā wagharābību sūdu
verses.english: Do you not realize that GOD sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce fruits of various colors? Even the mountains have different colors; the peaks are white, or red, or some other color. And the ravens are black.
verses.subtitle: God's Colorful Creations

1981.english: Do you not see that God sends down water from the sky to produce fruits of various colors? The mountains show white and red streaks of different shades; and the ravens are black.

1989.english: Do you not realize that GOD sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce fruits of various colors? Even the mountains have different colors; the peaks are white, or red, or some other color. And the ravens are black.
1989.subtitle: God’s Colorful Creations

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الناس والدواب والأنعام مختلف ألوانه كذلك ۗ إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلماء ۗ إن الله عزيز غفور
verses.transliterated: wamina l-nāsi wal-dawābi wal-anʿāmi mukh'talifun alwānuhu kadhālika innamā yakhshā l-laha min ʿibādihi l-ʿulamāu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ghafūru
verses.english: Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock come in various colors. This is why the people who truly reverence GOD are those who are knowledgeable. GOD is Almighty, Forgiving.

1981.english: Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock are of different colors. This is why the servants of God who truly reverence Him are the knowledgeable. God is almighty, forgiving.

1989.english: Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock come in various colors. This is why the people who truly reverence GOD are the knowledgeable. GOD is Almighty, Forgiving.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةً لَّن تَبُورَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يتلون كتاب الله وأقاموا الصلاة وأنفقوا مما رزقناهم سرا وعلانية يرجون تجارة لن تبور
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yatlūna kitāba l-lahi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūr
verses.english: Surely, those who recite the book of GOD, observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them they spend—secretly and publicly—are engaged in an investment that never loses.

1981.english: Those who recite God's scripture, observe the **salat** prayers, and give to charity from our provisions to them, secretly and publicly, seek a trade that never loses.

1989.english: Surely, those who recite the book of GOD, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them they spend secretly and publicly, are engaged in an enterprise that never fails.

verses.arabic: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: ليوفيهم أجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله ۚ إنه غفور شكور
verses.transliterated: liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wayazīdahum min faḍlihi innahu ghafūrun shakūru
verses.english: He will recompense them generously, and will multiply His blessings upon them. He is Forgiving, Appreciative.

1981.english: God will fully recompense them and shower them with His grace; He is forgiving, appreciative.

1989.english: For He will pay them generously, and will multiply His bounties to them. He is Forgiving, Appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذي أوحينا إليك من الكتاب هو الحق مصدقا لما بين يديه ۗ إن الله بعباده لخبير بصير
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka mina l-kitābi huwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi inna l-laha biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīru
verses.english: What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. GOD is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.
verses.subtitle: Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures

1981.english: What we revealed to you of scripture is the truth, confirming all previous scriptures. God is fully cognizant of His servants, seer.

1989.english: What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. GOD is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.
1989.subtitle: Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أورثنا الكتاب الذين اصطفينا من عبادنا ۖ فمنهم ظالم لنفسه ومنهم مقتصد ومنهم سابق بالخيرات بإذن الله ۚ ذلك هو الفضل الكبير
verses.transliterated: thumma awrathnā l-kitāba alladhīna iṣ'ṭafaynā min ʿibādinā famin'hum ẓālimun linafsihi wamin'hum muq'taṣidun wamin'hum sābiqun bil-khayrāti bi-idh'ni l-lahi dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīr
verses.english: We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we allowed whomever we chose from among our servants to receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness in accordance with GOD's will; this is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: Then we pass on the scripture to our servants whom we choose. Some of them wrong their souls, others waver, while others are eager to work righteousness in accordance with God's will; this is the great triumph.

1989.english: We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we let whomever we chose from among our servants receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness, in accordance with GOD’s will— this is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: جنات عدن يدخلونها يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا ۖ ولباسهم فيها حرير
verses.transliterated: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīru
verses.english: They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments in it will be made of silk.
verses.subtitle: The Believers

1981.english: They have deserved the gardens of Eden, where they are adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their clothes therein are made of silk.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 4 for details of this allegorical description.

1989.english: They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments will be made of silk.
1989.subtitle: The Believers

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا الحمد لله الذي أذهب عنا الحزن ۖ إن ربنا لغفور شكور
verses.transliterated: waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūru
verses.english: They will say, "Praise GOD for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.

1981.english: They will say, "Praise be to God, who removed our sorrows; our Lord is forgiving, appreciative.

1989.english: They will say, “Praise GOD for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ
verses.arabicClean: الذي أحلنا دار المقامة من فضله لا يمسنا فيها نصب ولا يمسنا فيها لغوب
verses.transliterated: alladhī aḥallanā dāra l-muqāmati min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbu
verses.english: "He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired."

1981.english: "He placed us in this eternal abode, out of His grace. Never do we tire therein, nor do we suffer."

1989.english: “He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired.”

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها ۚ كذلك نجزي كل كفور
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannama lā yuq'ḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtū walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum min ʿadhābihā kadhālika najzī kulla kafūri
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite the unappreciative.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: As for those who disbelieve, they have deserved the fire of hell; they are neither finished therein by death, nor is the retribution commuted for them. We thus requite every disbeliever.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieved, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite those who are unappreciative.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وهم يصطرخون فيها ربنا أخرجنا نعمل صالحا غير الذي كنا نعمل ۚ أولم نعمركم ما يتذكر فيه من تذكر وجاءكم النذير ۖ فذوقوا فما للظالمين من نصير
verses.transliterated: wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā akhrij'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu awalam nuʿammir'kum mā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāakumu l-nadhīru fadhūqū famā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīri
verses.english: They will scream therein, "Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do." Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? Did you not receive the warner? Therefore, taste (the consequences). The transgressors will have no one to help them.

1981.english: They will scream therein, "Our Lord, if you take us out, we will work righteousness instead of what we used to do." Did we not give you a lifetime? None of you took heed when the warner came to you. Therefore, you have deserved this; the wicked have no helper.

1989.english: They will scream therein, “Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do.” Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? And the warner went to you. Therefore, suffer (the consequences). The transgressors will have no helpers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله عالم غيب السماوات والأرض ۚ إنه عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha ʿālimu ghaybi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: GOD is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.

1981.english: God is the knower of all the secrets in the heavens and the earth; He is fully aware of the innermost convictions.

1989.english: GOD is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي جعلكم خلائف في الأرض ۚ فمن كفر فعليه كفره ۖ ولا يزيد الكافرين كفرهم عند ربهم إلا مقتا ۖ ولا يزيد الكافرين كفرهم إلا خسارا
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa fī l-arḍi faman kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum ʿinda rabbihim illā maqtan walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum illā khasāra
verses.english: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever chooses to disbelieve does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only augments their Lord's abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers plunges them deeper into loss.
verses.subtitle: The Winners and the Losers

1981.english: He is the one who made you inherit the earth, and anyone who disbelieves, disbelieves to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers incurs a great loss for them.

1989.english: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever disbelieves does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only increases their Lord’s abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers only plunges them deeper into loss.
1989.subtitle: The Winners and the Losers

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم شركاءكم الذين تدعون من دون الله أروني ماذا خلقوا من الأرض أم لهم شرك في السماوات أم آتيناهم كتابا فهم على بينت منه ۚ بل إن يعد الظالمون بعضهم بعضا إلا غرورا
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum shurakāakumu alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti am ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin min'hu bal in yaʿidu l-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan illā ghurūra
verses.english: Say, "Consider the idols you have set up beside GOD; show me what on earth have they created." Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.

1981.english: Say, "About the idols that you set up besides God; show me what on earth did they create. Do they own a share of the heavens? Did we give them a scripture that preaches idol worship? Indeed, the wicked promise each other nothing but illusions."

1989.english: Say, “Consider the idols you have set up besides GOD; show me what on earth have they created.” Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يمسك السماوات والأرض أن تزولا ۚ ولئن زالتا إن أمسكهما من أحد من بعده ۚ إنه كان حليما غفورا
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yum'siku l-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā wala-in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadin min baʿdihi innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūra
verses.english: GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.

1981.english: It is God who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else held them, they would surely vanish. He is clement, forgiving.

1989.english: GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم لئن جاءهم نذير ليكونن أهدى من إحدى الأمم ۖ فلما جاءهم نذير ما زادهم إلا نفورا
verses.transliterated: wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāahum nadhīrun layakūnunna ahdā min iḥ'dā l-umami falammā jāahum nadhīrun mā zādahum illā nufūra
verses.english: They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better guided than a certain congregation! However, now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.
verses.subtitle: Putting Them to the Test

1981.english: They swore by God, solemnly, that if a warner had gone to them, they would have been better guided. But when a warner did go to them, it only increased their aversion.

1989.english: They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better than any other congregation! Now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.
1989.subtitle: Putting Them to the Test

verses.arabic: ٱسْتِكْبَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: استكبارا في الأرض ومكر السيئ ۚ ولا يحيق المكر السيئ إلا بأهله ۚ فهل ينظرون إلا سنت الأولين ۚ فلن تجد لسنت الله تبديلا ۖ ولن تجد لسنت الله تحويلا
verses.transliterated: is'tik'bāran fī l-arḍi wamakra l-sayi-i walā yaḥīqu l-makru l-sayi-u illā bi-ahlihi fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnata l-awalīna falan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi taḥwīla
verses.english: They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming, and the evil schemes only backfire on those who scheme them. Should they then expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD's system is never changeable; you will find that GOD's system is immutable.

1981.english: This was due to their arrogance and evil schemes. The evil schemes only backfire against the schemers. Can they expect anything but the fate of previous generations? You will never find any change in God's system; you will never find any alteration in God's system.

1989.english: They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming. However, evil schemes backfire on those who scheme them. Should they expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD’s system is never changeable; you will Find that GOD’s system is immutable.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: أولم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم وكانوا أشد منهم قوة ۚ وما كان الله ليعجزه من شيء في السماوات ولا في الأرض ۚ إنه كان عليما قديرا
verses.transliterated: awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim wakānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿ'jizahu min shayin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi innahu kāna ʿalīman qadīra
verses.english: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger than they. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.

1981.english: Did they not travel the land and see the consequences for those before them? Although they were even stronger; nothing can escape from God in the heavens or the earth. He is omniscient, omnipotent.

1989.english: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
verses.arabicClean: ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بما كسبوا ما ترك على ظهرها من دابة ولكن يؤخرهم إلى أجل مسمى ۖ فإذا جاء أجلهم فإن الله كان بعباده بصيرا
verses.transliterated: walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum fa-inna l-laha kāna biʿibādihi baṣīra
verses.english: If GOD punished the people for their sins, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined interim. Once their interim is fulfilled, then GOD is Seer of His servants.

1981.english: If God were to punish the people immediately for their actions, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined period. Once their time is up, then God is seer of His servants.

1989.english: If GOD were to punish the people for their sins, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined interim. Once their interim is fulfilled, then GOD is Seer of His servants. <

verses.arabic: يسٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يس
verses.transliterated: ya-seen
verses.english: Y. S.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the detailed explanation of these initials.

1981.footnote: The miraculous numerical code associated with the Quranic initials, such as Y. S. here, proves that Muhammad was indeed a messenger of God (see also 13:43), and that the Quran is a divine revelation (see Appendix 1 for details).

1989.english: Y.S.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: والقرآن الحكيم
verses.transliterated: wal-qur'āni l-ḥakīm
verses.english: And the Quran that is full of wisdom.

1981.english: and this Quran that is full of wisdom;
1981.footnote: The miraculous numerical code associated with the Quranic initials, such as Y. S. here, proves that Muhammad was indeed a messenger of God (see also 13:43), and that the Quran is a divine revelation (see Appendix 1 for details).

1989.english: And the Quran, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنك لمن المرسلين
verses.transliterated: innaka lamina l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Most assuredly, you (Rashad) are one of the messengers.
verses.footnote: See Appendices 2 & 26 for the irrefutable physical evidence.

1981.english: (prove that) you (Muhammad) are one of the messengers.
1981.footnote: The miraculous numerical code associated with the Quranic initials, such as Y. S. here, proves that Muhammad was indeed a messenger of God (see also 13:43), and that the Quran is a divine revelation (see Appendix 1 for details).

1989.english: Surely, you are one of the messengers.*
1989.footnote: For the specific identity of this messenger, see Appendices 2 and 26.

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: على صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: alaa siratal mustaqeem
verses.english: On a straight path.

1981.english: Advocating the right path.
1981.footnote: The miraculous numerical code associated with the Quranic initials, such as Y. S. here, proves that Muhammad was indeed a messenger of God (see also 13:43), and that the Quran is a divine revelation (see Appendix 1 for details).

1989.english: On a straight path.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: tanzīla l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīm
verses.english: This revelation is from the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: (And prove that this is) a revelation from the almighty, most merciful.
1981.footnote: The miraculous numerical code associated with the Quranic initials, such as Y. S. here, proves that Muhammad was indeed a messenger of God (see also 13:43), and that the Quran is a divine revelation (see Appendix 1 for details).

1989.english: This is the revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لتنذر قوما ما أنذر آباؤهم فهم غافلون
verses.transliterated: litundhira qawman mā undhira ābāuhum fahum ghāfilūn
verses.english: To warn people whose parents were never warned, and therefore, they are unaware.

1981.english: To warn people whose parents were never warned; they are unaware.

1989.english: To warn people whose parents were never warned, and therefore, are totally unaware.

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لقد حق القول على أكثرهم فهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: laqad ḥaqqa l-qawlu ʿalā aktharihim fahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: It has been predetermined that most of them do not believe.

1981.english: It is already predetermined* that the majority of people will not believe.
1981.footnote: This does not imply lack of freedom in our choice. It is simply a statement of fact as witnessed by God, who knows the future.

1989.english: It is already predetermined that most of them will not believe.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا جعلنا في أعناقهم أغلالا فهي إلى الأذقان فهم مقمحون
verses.transliterated: innā jaʿalnā fī aʿnāqihim aghlālan fahiya ilā l-adhqāni fahum muq'maḥūn
verses.english: For we place around their necks shackles, up to their chins. Consequently, they become locked in their disbelief.

1981.english: Consequently, we chain their necks to their chins, and thus they are forced (into the direction they chose).

1989.english: We place around their necks shackles up to their chins. Consequently, they are locked in their disbelief.
