1989.english: We delivered them and their people from the great disaster.

verses.arabic: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونصرناهم فكانوا هم الغالبين
verses.transliterated: wanaṣarnāhum fakānū humu l-ghālibīn
verses.english: We supported them, until they became the winners.

1981.english: We supported them and made them the winners.

1989.english: We supported them, and they became the winners.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وآتيناهما الكتاب المستبين
verses.transliterated: waātaynāhumā l-kitāba l-mus'tabīn
verses.english: We gave both of them the profound scripture.

1981.english: We gave them enlightening scripture.

1989.english: We gave both of them the profound scripture.

verses.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: وهديناهما الصراط المستقيم
verses.transliterated: wahadaynāhumā l-ṣirāṭa l-mus'taqīm
verses.english: We guided them in the right path.

1981.english: We guided them in the straight path.

1989.english: We guided them in the right path.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وتركنا عليهما في الآخرين
verses.transliterated: wataraknā ʿalayhimā fī l-ākhirīn
verses.english: We preserved their history for subsequent generations.

1981.english: And preserved their history for the following generations.

1989.english: We preserved their history for subsequent generations.

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سلام على موسى وهارون
verses.transliterated: salāmun ʿalā mūsā wahārūn
verses.english: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

1981.english: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

1989.english: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
verses.transliterated: innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: We thus reward the righteous.

1981.english: We thus reward the pious.

1989.english: We thus reward the pious.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنهما من عبادنا المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: innahumā min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīn
verses.english: Both of them were among our righteous servants.

1981.english: They were of our believing servants.

1989.english: Both of them were among our righteous servants.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن إلياس لمن المرسلين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna il'yāsa lamina l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Elias was one of the messengers.
verses.subtitle: Elias

1981.english: Elias was one of the messengers.
1981.subtitle: Elias

1989.english: Elias was one of the messengers.
1989.subtitle: Elias

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال لقومه ألا تتقون
verses.transliterated: idh qāla liqawmihi alā tattaqūn
verses.english: He said to his people, "Would you not work righteousness?

1981.english: He said to his people, "Would you turn to righteousness?

1989.english: He said to his people, “Would you not work righteousness?

verses.arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أتدعون بعلا وتذرون أحسن الخالقين
verses.transliterated: atadʿūna baʿlan watadharūna aḥsana l-khāliqīn
verses.english: "Do you worship a statue, instead of the Supreme Creator?

1981.english: "Do you worship an idol and leave the almighty creator?

1989.english: “Do you worship a statue, instead of the best Creator?

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الله ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين
verses.transliterated: al-laha rabbakum warabba ābāikumu l-awalīn
verses.english: "GOD; your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!"

1981.english: "God is your Lord, and the Lord of your ancestors."

1989.english: “GOD; your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!”

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فكذبوه فإنهم لمحضرون
verses.transliterated: fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūn
verses.english: They disbelieved him. Consequently, they had to be called to account.

1981.english: They disbelieved him and were doomed.

1989.english: They disbelieved him. Consequently, they had to pay.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا عباد الله المخلصين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.english: Only GOD's servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (are saved).

1981.english: Only the devoted servants of God are saved.

1989.english: Only GOD’s servants who are absolutely devoted to Him alone (are saved).

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وتركنا عليه في الآخرين
verses.transliterated: wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīn
verses.english: We preserved his history for subsequent generations.

1981.english: We preserved his history for the following generations.

1989.english: We preserved his history for subsequent generations.

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
verses.arabicClean: سلام على إل ياسين
verses.transliterated: salāmun ʿalā il yāsīn
verses.english: Peace be upon Elias, and all those like Elias.

1981.english: Peace be upon Elias' followers.

1989.english: Peace be upon Eliaseen.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
verses.transliterated: innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: We thus reward the righteous.

1981.english: We thus reward the pious.

1989.english: We thus reward the pious.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīn
verses.english: He was one of our believing servants.

1981.english: He was one of our believing servants.

1989.english: He was one of our believing servants.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن لوطا لمن المرسلين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna lūṭan lamina l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Lot was one of the messengers.
verses.subtitle: Lot

1981.english: Lot was one of the messengers.
1981.subtitle: Lot

1989.english: Lot was one of the messengers.
1989.subtitle: Lot

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ نجيناه وأهله أجمعين
verses.transliterated: idh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīn
verses.english: We saved him and all his family.

1981.english: We saved him and all his family;

1989.english: We saved him and all his family.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا عجوزا في الغابرين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīn
verses.english: Only the old woman was doomed.

1981.english: Except the old woman; she was doomed.

1989.english: Only the old woman was doomed.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم دمرنا الآخرين
verses.transliterated: thumma dammarnā l-ākharīn
verses.english: We annihilated all the others.

1981.english: Then we destroyed the others.

1989.english: We annihilated the others.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنكم لتمرون عليهم مصبحين
verses.transliterated: wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim muṣ'biḥīn
verses.english: You still pass by their ruins by day.

1981.english: You can travel and see their ruins by day,

1989.english: You still pass by their ruins by day.

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وبالليل ۗ أفلا تعقلون
verses.transliterated: wabi-al-layli afalā taʿqilūn
verses.english: And by night. Would you understand?

1981.english: And by night. Would you then understand?

1989.english: And by night. Do you understand?

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يونس لمن المرسلين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna yūnusa lamina l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Jonah was one of the messengers.
verses.subtitle: Jonah

1981.english: Jonah was one of the messengers.
1981.subtitle: Jonah

1989.english: Jonah was one of the messengers.
1989.subtitle: Jonah

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.arabicClean: إذ أبق إلى الفلك المشحون
verses.transliterated: idh abaqa ilā l-ful'ki l-mashḥūn
verses.english: He escaped to the loaded ship.

1981.english: He fled to the loaded ship.

1989.english: He escaped to the loaded ship.

verses.arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فساهم فكان من المدحضين
verses.transliterated: fasāhama fakāna mina l-mud'ḥaḍīn
verses.english: He rebelled and thus, he joined the losers.

1981.english: He rebelled and deserved distress.

1989.english: He rebelled, and joined the losers.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فالتقمه الحوت وهو مليم
verses.transliterated: fal-taqamahu l-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmu
verses.english: Consequently, the fish swallowed him, and he was the one to blame.

1981.english: Consequently, the fish swallowed him, as he complained.

1989.english: The fish swallowed him, and he was the one to blame.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلولا أنه كان من المسبحين
verses.transliterated: falawlā annahu kāna mina l-musabiḥīn
verses.english: If it were not that he resorted to meditation (on GOD),

1981.english: If it were not that he repented.

1989.english: If it were not that he resorted to meditation (on God)—

verses.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: للبث في بطنه إلى يوم يبعثون
verses.transliterated: lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.

1981.english: He would have stayed in his belly until the day of resurrection.

1989.english: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.arabic: فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فنبذناه بالعراء وهو سقيم
verses.transliterated: fanabadhnāhu bil-ʿarāi wahuwa saqīmu
verses.english: We had him thrown up into the desert, exhausted.

1981.english: We threw him out into the desert, exhausted.

1989.english: We had him thrown up into the desert, exhausted.

verses.arabic: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأنبتنا عليه شجرة من يقطين
verses.transliterated: wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajaratan min yaqṭīni
verses.english: We had a tree of edible fruit grown for him.

1981.english: We grew for him an edible tree.

1989.english: We had a tree of edible fruit grow for him.

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأرسلناه إلى مائة ألف أو يزيدون
verses.transliterated: wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūn
verses.english: Then we sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.

1981.english: Then we sent him to a hundred thousand people, or more.

1989.english: We sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.

verses.arabic: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فآمنوا فمتعناهم إلى حين
verses.transliterated: faāmanū famattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīni
verses.english: They did believe, and we let them enjoy this life.

1981.english: They believed, and we let them enjoy their lives.

1989.english: They did believe, and we let them enjoy this life.

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاستفتهم ألربك البنات ولهم البنون
verses.transliterated: fa-is'taftihim alirabbika l-banātu walahumu l-banūn
verses.english: Ask them if your Lord has daughters, while they have sons!

1981.english: Consult them; does your Lord have daughters, while they have sons?
1981.subtitle: Blasphemies Against God

1989.english: Ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters, while you have sons?”

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم خلقنا الملائكة إناثا وهم شاهدون
verses.transliterated: am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūn
verses.english: Did we create the angels to be females? Did they witness that?

1981.english: Did we create the angels as females? Did they witness?

1989.english: Did we create the angels to be females? Did they witness that?

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألا إنهم من إفكهم ليقولون
verses.transliterated: alā innahum min if'kihim layaqūlūn
verses.english: Indeed, they grossly blaspheme when they say—

1981.english: They make up other blasphemies and say,

1989.english: Indeed, they blaspheme when they say—

verses.arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولد الله وإنهم لكاذبون
verses.transliterated: walada l-lahu wa-innahum lakādhibūn
verses.english: "GOD has begotten a son." Indeed, they are liars.

1981.english: "God has begotten a son!" They are liars.

1989.english: “GOD begets;” they are liars.

verses.arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أصطفى البنات على البنين
verses.transliterated: aṣṭafā l-banāti ʿalā l-banīn
verses.english: Did He choose the girls over the boys?

1981.english: Did He prefer daughters over sons?

1989.english: Did He choose the girls over the boys?

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
verses.transliterated: mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūn
verses.english: What is wrong with your logic?

1981.english: What is wrong with you? How do you make those statements?

1989.english: What is wrong with your logic?

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: Why do you not take heed?
verses.subtitle: Addressing the Disbelievers

1981.english: Would you not take heed?

1989.english: Why do you not take heed?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أم لكم سلطان مبين
verses.transliterated: am lakum sul'ṭānun mubīnu
verses.english: Do you have any proof?

1981.english: Do you have any proof?

1989.english: Do you have solid proof?

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأتوا بكتابكم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: fatū bikitābikum in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Show us your book, if you are truthful.

1981.english: Show me your scripture, if you are truthful.

1989.english: Show us your book, if you are truthful.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنة نسبا ۚ ولقد علمت الجنة إنهم لمحضرون
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūn
verses.english: They even invented a special relationship between Him and the jinns. The jinns themselves know that they are subservient.

1981.english: They even invented a relationship between Him and the jinns. But the jinns know that they are subservient.

1989.english: They even invented a relationship between Him and the jinns. However, the jinns themselves know that they are subservient.

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سبحان الله عما يصفون
verses.transliterated: sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.english: GOD be glorified; far above their claims.

1981.english: God be glorified; high above their claims.

1989.english: GOD be glorified; far above their claims.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا عباد الله المخلصين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.english: Only GOD's servants who are devoted to Him alone (are saved).

1981.english: Only the devoted servants of God are saved.

1989.english: Only GOD’s servants who are devoted to Him alone (will be saved).

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإنكم وما تعبدون
verses.transliterated: fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūn
verses.english: Indeed, you and what you worship.

1981.english: You and the idols you worship.

1989.english: Indeed, you and what you worship.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ما أنتم عليه بفاتنين
verses.transliterated: mā antum ʿalayhi bifātinīn
verses.english: Cannot impose anything on Him.

1981.english: Do not bother Him in the least.

1989.english: Cannot impose anything on Him.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إلا من هو صال الجحيم
verses.transliterated: illā man huwa ṣāli l-jaḥīm
verses.english: Only you will burn in Hell.

1981.english: It is the idol worshipers who will burn in hell.

1989.english: Everyone of you will burn in Hell. The Angels

verses.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.arabicClean: وما منا إلا له مقام معلوم
verses.transliterated: wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmu
verses.english: Each one of us has a specific job.
verses.subtitle: The Angels

1981.english: Each one of us (angels) has a recognized position.

1989.english: Each one of us has a specific job.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنا لنحن الصافون
verses.transliterated: wa-innā lanaḥnu l-ṣāfūn
verses.english: We are the arrangers.

1981.english: It is we who will arrange them in ranks.

1989.english: We are the arrangers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنا لنحن المسبحون
verses.transliterated: wa-innā lanaḥnu l-musabiḥūn
verses.english: We have duly glorified (our Lord).

1981.english: It is we who glorify Him.

1989.english: We have duly glorified (our Lord). Following The Parents

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن كانوا ليقولون
verses.transliterated: wa-in kānū layaqūlūn
verses.english: They used to say,
verses.subtitle: Following The Parents Blindly

1981.english: They used to say,

1989.english: They used to say,

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لو أن عندنا ذكرا من الأولين
verses.transliterated: law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīn
verses.english: "Had we received the correct instructions from our parents,

1981.english: "If we receive a message, like those before us,

1989.english: “Had we received the correct instructions from our parents—

verses.arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لكنا عباد الله المخلصين
verses.transliterated: lakunnā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.english: "we would have been worshipers; devoted to GOD alone."

1981.english: "We would be devoted servants of God."

1989.english: “we would have been worshipers devoted to GOD alone.”

verses.arabic: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فكفروا به ۖ فسوف يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fakafarū bihi fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.english: But they disbelieved, and they will surely find out.

1981.english: They disbelieved therein, and consequently, they will find out.

1989.english: They disbelieved; they will find out. Victory for the Messengers Guaranteed

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا المرسلين
verses.transliterated: walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Our decision is already decreed for our servants the messengers.
verses.subtitle: Victory for the Messengers Guaranteed

1981.english: Our decree has already been issued to our servant messengers.

1989.english: Our decision is already decreed for our servants the messengers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنهم لهم المنصورون
verses.transliterated: innahum lahumu l-manṣūrūn
verses.english: They are surely the victors.

1981.english: They will always be victorious.

1989.english: They are surely the victors.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن جندنا لهم الغالبون
verses.transliterated: wa-inna jundanā lahumu l-ghālibūn
verses.english: Our soldiers are the winners.

1981.english: Our soldiers will always be winners.

1989.english: Our soldiers are the winners.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فتول عنهم حتى حين
verses.transliterated: fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīni
verses.english: So disregard them for awhile.

1981.english: Therefore, disregard them for awhile.

1989.english: So disregard them for awhile.

verses.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأبصرهم فسوف يبصرون
verses.transliterated: wa-abṣir'hum fasawfa yub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Watch them; they too will watch.

1981.english: Watch them, and they will be watching.

1989.english: Watch them; they too will watch.

verses.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفبعذابنا يستعجلون
verses.transliterated: afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūn
verses.english: Do they challenge our retribution?

1981.english: Are they in a hurry to see our retribution?

1989.english: Do they challenge our retribution?

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīn
verses.english: When it hits them one day, it will be a miserable day; they have been sufficiently warned.

1981.english: Once it comes to their area, what a miserable day it will be; they have been warned.

1989.english: When it hits, they will be sorry— they have been warned.

verses.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وتول عنهم حتى حين
verses.transliterated: watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīni
verses.english: Disregard them for awhile.

1981.english: Just leave them alone for awhile.

1989.english: Disregard them for awhile.

verses.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأبصر فسوف يبصرون
verses.transliterated: wa-abṣir fasawfa yub'ṣirūn
verses.english: Watch them; they too will watch.

1981.english: Watch them, and they will be watching.

1989.english: Watch them; they too will watch.

verses.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: سبحان ربك رب العزة عما يصفون
verses.transliterated: sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.english: Glory be to your Lord, the great Lord; far above their claims.

1981.english: Glory be to your Lord; the Lord who possesses all power; over and above anything they claim.

1989.english: Glory be to your Lord, the great Lord; far above their claims.

verses.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وسلام على المرسلين
verses.transliterated: wasalāmun ʿalā l-mur'salīn
verses.english: Peace be upon the messengers.

1981.english: And peace be upon the messengers.

1989.english: Peace be upon the messengers.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والحمد لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

1981.english: Praise be to God, Lord of the universe.

1989.english: Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: صٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ص ۚ والقرآن ذي الذكر
verses.transliterated: sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'r
verses.english: S. (Saad), and the Quran that contains the proof.
verses.footnote:
This Initial (Saad) occurs in suras 7, 19, & 38 a total of 152 times, 19x8 (Appendix 1).

±±38:1 The word "Zikr" is made distinct from the Quran and clearly points at the Quran's miraculous mathematical code. See 15:6, 9; 16:44; 21:2, 24; 26:5; & 36:11, 69.

1981.english: S.*, and the Quran that contains the message.
1981.footnote: This Quranic initial occurs in three suras, namely 7, 19, and 38. The total frequency of occurrence of this letter in the three suras is 152 (19 x 8). See Appendix 1 for details of the Quran's miraculous numerical code.

1989.english: S.* and the Quran that contains the message.
1989.footnote: This Quranic Initial (Saad) occurs in 3 suras. See Appendix 1 for explanation.

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
verses.arabicClean: بل الذين كفروا في عزة وشقاق
verses.transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqi
verses.english: Those who disbelieve have plunged into arrogance and defiance.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve are plunged in pride and defiance.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved have plunged into arrogance and defiance.

verses.arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
verses.arabicClean: كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
verses.transliterated: kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣi
verses.english: Many a generation before them we annihilated. They called for help; in vain.

1981.english: Many a generation before them we annihilated; they called for help, but to no avail.

1989.english: Many a generation before them we annihilated. They called for help, but to no avail.

verses.arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: وعجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم ۖ وقال الكافرون هذا ساحر كذاب
verses.transliterated: waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābu
verses.english: They wondered that a warner should come to them, from among them. The disbelievers said, "A magician; a liar.

1981.english: They wondered that a warner should come from among them. The disbelievers said, "He is a magician; a liar."

1989.english: They wondered that a warner should come to them, from among them. The disbelievers said, “He is a magician; a liar.

verses.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verses.arabicClean: أجعل الآلهة إلها واحدا ۖ إن هذا لشيء عجاب
verses.transliterated: ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābu
verses.english: "Did he make the gods into one god? This is really strange."

1981.english: "Does he want to make the gods one god? This is really strange."

1989.english: “Did he make the gods into one god This is really strange.”

verses.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
verses.arabicClean: وانطلق الملأ منهم أن امشوا واصبروا على آلهتكم ۖ إن هذا لشيء يراد
verses.transliterated: wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurād
verses.english: The leaders announced, "Go and steadfastly persevere in worshiping your gods. This is what is desired.

1981.english: Their elders advised, "Carry on, and stay loyal to your gods. This is what we want."

1989.english: The leaders announced, “Go and steadfastly persevere in worshiping your gods. This is all you need.

verses.arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما سمعنا بهذا في الملة الآخرة إن هذا إلا اختلاق
verses.transliterated: mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqu
verses.english: "We never heard of this from the religion of our fathers. This is a lie.

1981.english: "We never heard of this before. This is a fabrication."

1989.english: “We never heard of this from the religion of our fathers. This is a lie.

verses.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.arabicClean: أأنزل عليه الذكر من بيننا ۚ بل هم في شك من ذكري ۖ بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
verses.transliterated: a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhāb
verses.english: "Why did the proof come down to him, instead of us?" Indeed, they are doubtful of My proof. Indeed, they have not yet tasted My retribution.

1981.english: "Did he, out of all us, receive the message?" Thus, they are doubtful about My message. They have not tasted My retribution yet.

1989.english: “Why did the message come down to him, instead of us?” Indeed, they are doubtful of My message. Indeed, the} have not yet tasted My retribution.

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.arabicClean: أم عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك العزيز الوهاب
verses.transliterated: am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahāb
verses.english: Do they own the treasures of mercy of your Lord, the Almighty, the Grantor?

1981.english: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord's mercy? He is the almighty, the grantor.

1989.english: Do they own the treasures of your Lord’s mercy? He is the Almighty, the Grantor.

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: أم لهم ملك السماوات والأرض وما بينهما ۖ فليرتقوا في الأسباب
verses.transliterated: am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbāb
verses.english: Do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them? Let them help themselves.

1981.english: Do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them? Then let them exalt themselves.

1989.english: Do they possess the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them? Let them promote themselves.

verses.arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.arabicClean: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الأحزاب
verses.transliterated: jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzāb
verses.english: Instead, whatever forces they can muster—even if all their parties banded together—will be defeated.

1981.english: Their forces will always be defeated, no matter how numerous.

1989.english: Instead, whatever forces they can muster, even if all their parties banded together, will be defeated.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.arabicClean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الأوتاد
verses.transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtād
verses.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, 'Ãd, and the mighty Pharaoh.

1981.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, 'Aad, and Pharaoh the powerful.

1989.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, ‘Aad, and the mighty Pharaoh.

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.arabicClean: وثمود وقوم لوط وأصحاب الأيكة ۚ أولئك الأحزاب
verses.transliterated: wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzāb
verses.english: Also, Thamûd, the people of Lot, the dwellers of the Woods (of Midyan); those were the opponents.

1981.english: Also Thamood, the people of Lot, and the (Midyanites) dwellers of the wood. These are the allies.

1989.english: Also, Thamoud, the people of Lot, the dwellers of the Woods (of Midyan); those were the parties.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: إن كل إلا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
verses.transliterated: in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqāb
verses.english: Each of them disbelieved the messengers and thus, My retribution was inevitable.

1981.english: All of them disbelieved the messenger, and thus incurred retribution.

1989.english: Each of them disbelieved the messengers; thus, My retribution was inevitable.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما ينظر هؤلاء إلا صيحة واحدة ما لها من فواق
verses.transliterated: wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqi
verses.english: These people can expect a single blow, from which they never recover.

1981.english: As for these, all they need is one blow, from which they never recover.

1989.english: These people can expect a single blow, from which they will never recover.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
verses.transliterated: waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.english: They challenged: "Our Lord, why do you not rush the retribution for us, before the Day of Reckoning."

1981.english: They said, "Our Lord show us the doom, before the day of reckoning."

1989.english: They challenged: “Our Lord, why do you not rush the retribution for us, before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: اصبر على ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داوود ذا الأيد ۖ إنه أواب
verses.transliterated: iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābu
verses.english: Be patient in the face of their utterances, and remember our servant David, the resourceful; he was obedient.

1981.english: You shall be patient in the face of their utterances, and remember our servant David the resourceful; he was obedient.

1989.english: Be patient in the face of their utterances, and remember our servant David, the resourceful; he was obedient.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.arabicClean: إنا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشي والإشراق
verses.transliterated: innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāq
verses.english: We committed the mountains in his service, glorifying with him night and day.

1981.english: We subdued the mountains in his service, day and night.
1981.subtitle: David

1989.english: We committed the mountains in his service, glorifying with him night and day.

verses.arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: والطير محشورة ۖ كل له أواب
verses.transliterated: wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābu
verses.english: Also the birds were committed to serve him; all were obedient to him.

1981.english: Also, the birds were mobilized to serve him.

1989.english: Also the birds were committed to serve him; all were obedient to him.

verses.arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وشددنا ملكه وآتيناه الحكمة وفصل الخطاب
verses.transliterated: washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭāb
verses.english: We strengthened his kingship, and endowed him with wisdom and good logic.

1981.english: We strengthened his kingship and bestowed upon him wisdom and correct judgment.

1989.english: We strengthened his kingship, and endowed him with wisdom and good logic.

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.arabicClean: وهل أتاك نبأ الخصم إذ تسوروا المحراب
verses.transliterated: wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāb
verses.english: Have you received news of the feuding men who sneaked into his sanctuary?

1981.english: Have you noted the opponents who climbed into his sanctuary?

1989.english: Have you received news of the feuding men who sneaked into his sanctuary?

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.arabicClean: إذ دخلوا على داوود ففزع منهم ۖ قالوا لا تخف ۖ خصمان بغى بعضنا على بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا إلى سواء الصراط
verses.transliterated: idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭ
verses.english: When they entered his room, he was startled. They said, "Have no fear. We are feuding with one another, and we are seeking your fair judgment. Do not wrong us, and guide us in the right path.

1981.english: When they entered, David was frightened, but they said, "Have no fear; we are just feuding against one another. Can you judge between us equitably and without bias? Guide us to the right way.

1989.english: When they entered his room, he was startled. They said, “Have no fear. We have been feuding with one anotl and we are seeking your fair judgment. Do not wrong us, and guide us in the right path.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا أخي له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولي نعجة واحدة فقال أكفلنيها وعزني في الخطاب
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭāb
verses.english: "This brother of mine owns ninety-nine sheep, while I own one sheep. He wants to mix my sheep with his, and continues to pressure me."
verses.footnote: This is the only place where the number 99 occurs. Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran, and their total comes to 162146, 19x8534. See Appendix 1.

1981.english: "This man is my brother, and he owns ninety-nine sheep, while I own one sheep. Yet he asked me to give him my sheep, and insisted."

1989.english: “This brother of mine owns ninety nine* sheep, while I own one sheep. He wants to mix my sheep with his, and continues to pressure me.”
1989.footnote: This is the only place where the number 99 occurs. Thirty different numbers are mentioned in the Quran, and their total comes to 162146, 19x8534. See Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
verses.arabicClean: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك إلى نعاجه ۖ وإن كثيرا من الخلطاء ليبغي بعضهم على بعض إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وقليل ما هم ۗ وظن داوود أنما فتناه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا وأناب ۩
verses.transliterated: qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāb
verses.english: He said, "He is being unfair to you by asking to combine your sheep with his. Most people who combine their properties treat each other unfairly, except those who believe and work righteousness, and these are so few." Afterwards, David wondered if he made the right judgment. He thought that we were testing him. He then implored his Lord for forgiveness, bowed down, and repented.
verses.subtitle: David's Exemplary Piety
verses.footnote: In this clear example, 99 on one side vs 1 on the other side, David's extreme care to render the correct judgment caused him to ask forgiveness. Are we this careful?

1981.english: David said, "He has wronged you by asking to mix your sheep with his sheep. Those who mix their properties usually transgress against one another, except for those who believe and lead a righteous life; these are rare." David thought that we disliked his judgment, and he asked his Lord for forgiveness as he bowed down; he totally submitted.

1989.english: He said, “He is being unfair to you by asking to combine your sheep with his. Most people who combine their properties treat each other unfairly, except those who believe and work righteousness, and these are so few.” Afterwards, David wondered if he made the right judgment. He thought that we were testing him. He then implored his Lord for forgiveness, bowed down, and repented.*
1989.footnote: In this clear example, 99 on one side vs 1 on the other side, David’s extreme care to render the correct judgment caused him to ask forgiveness. Are we this careful?

verses.arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.arabicClean: فغفرنا له ذلك ۖ وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مآب
verses.transliterated: faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābi
verses.english: We forgave him in this matter. We have granted him a position of honor with us, and a beautiful abode.

1981.english: We forgave him and reserved for him a reward and a beautiful abode.

1989.english: We forgave him, and granted him a position of honor with us, and a beautiful abode.

verses.arabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: يا داوود إنا جعلناك خليفة في الأرض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى فيضلك عن سبيل الله ۚ إن الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب
verses.transliterated: yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisāb
verses.english: O David, we have made you a ruler on earth. Therefore, you shall judge among the people equitably, and do not follow your personal opinion, lest it diverts you from the way of GOD. Surely, those who stray off the way of GOD incur severe retribution for forgetting the Day of Reckoning.

1981.english: O David, we have appointed you a king on earth, so judge between the people equitably. Do not follow the ego, lest it diverts you from the path of God. Those who deviate from the path of God will suffer severe retribution. They disregarded the day of reckoning.

1989.english: O David, we have made you a ruler on earth. You shall rule among the people equitably, and do not follow your personal opinion, lest it diverts you from the way of GOD. Surely, those who stray off the way of GOD incur severe retribution for forgetting the Day of Reckoning.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًا ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما باطلا ۚ ذلك ظن الذين كفروا ۚ فويل للذين كفروا من النار
verses.transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nār
verses.english: We did not create the heaven and the earth, and everything between them, in vain. Such is the thinking of those who disbelieve. Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve; they will suffer in Hell.

1981.english: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in vain. This is what the disbelievers think. Consequently, they will suffer in hell.

1989.english: We did not create the heaven and the earth, and everything between them, in vain. Such is the thinking of those who disbelieved. Woe to those who disbelieved; they will suffer in Hell.

verses.arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: أم نجعل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات كالمفسدين في الأرض أم نجعل المتقين كالفجار
verses.transliterated: am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujār
verses.english: Shall we treat those who believe and lead a righteous life as we treat those who commit evil on earth? Shall we treat the righteous as we treat the wicked?

1981.english: Shall we treat those who believe and do righteous works like those who corrupt the earth? Shall we treat the righteous like the wicked?

1989.english: Shall we treat those who believed and led a righteous life as we treat those who committed evil on earth? Shall we treat the righteous as we treat the criminals?

verses.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: كتاب أنزلناه إليك مبارك ليدبروا آياته وليتذكر أولو الألباب
verses.transliterated: kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albāb
verses.english: This is a scripture that we sent down to you, that is sacred—perhaps they reflect on its verses. Those who possess intelligence will take heed.

1981.english: We revealed to you this blessed scripture for them to study it carefully, and for those who possess intelligence to take heed.

1989.english: This is a scripture that we sent down to you, that is sacred—perhaps they reflect on its verses. Those who possess intelligence will take heed.

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: ووهبنا لداوود سليمان ۚ نعم العبد ۖ إنه أواب
verses.transliterated: wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābu
verses.english: To David we granted Solomon; a good and obedient servant.
verses.subtitle: Solomon's Exemplary Devotion

1981.english: We granted to David Solomon, a good servant; he totally submitted.
1981.subtitle: Solomon

1989.english: To David we granted Solomon; a good and obedient servant.

verses.arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.arabicClean: إذ عرض عليه بالعشي الصافنات الجياد
verses.transliterated: idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyād
verses.english: One day he became preoccupied with beautiful horses, until the night fell.

1981.english: One evening he became preoccupied with his beautiful horses.

1989.english: One day he became preoccupied with beautiful horses, until the night fell.

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.arabicClean: فقال إني أحببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربي حتى توارت بالحجاب
verses.transliterated: faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb
verses.english: He then said, "I enjoyed the material things more than I enjoyed worshiping my Lord, until the sun was gone.
verses.footnote: Solomon missed his afternoon prayer because of his horses. To nullify Satan's possible claim that Solomon loved his horses more than loving God, he got rid of his horses.

1981.english: Then he said, "I loved the material things more than the remembrance of my Lord, until they disappeared behind a barrier."

1989.english: He then said, “I enjoyed the material things more than I enjoyed worshiping my Lord, until the sun was gone.

verses.arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.arabicClean: ردوها علي ۖ فطفق مسحا بالسوق والأعناق
verses.transliterated: ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāq
verses.english: "Bring them back." (To bid farewell,) he rubbed their legs and necks.

1981.english: He asked to have them brought back, then he bid farewell to all of them after rubbing their legs and necks.

1989.english: “Bring them back.” (To bid farewell,) he rubbed their legs and necks.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد فتنا سليمان وألقينا على كرسيه جسدا ثم أناب
verses.transliterated: walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāb
verses.english: We thus put Solomon to the test; we blessed him with vast material wealth, but he steadfastly submitted.
verses.footnote: & 41 Solomon and Job represent both ends of the testing spectrum. We are put to the test through wealth, health, or lack of them, to see if we worship God alone under all circumstances.

1981.english: We thus put Solomon to the test. We placed in his dominion material wealth, but he submitted to God.

1989.english: We thus put Solomon to the test; we blessed him with vast material wealth, but he steadfastly submitted.*
1989.footnote: & 41 Solomon and Job represent both ends of the testing spectrum. We are put to the test through wealth, health, or lack of them, to see if we worship God always.

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لأحد من بعدي ۖ إنك أنت الوهاب
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahāb
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingship never attained by anyone else. You are the Grantor."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingship never to be attained by anyone else. You are the grantor."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingship never attained bj anyone else. You are the Grantor.”

verses.arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.arabicClean: فسخرنا له الريح تجري بأمره رخاء حيث أصاب
verses.transliterated: fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāb
verses.english: We (answered his prayer and) committed the wind at his disposal, pouring rain wherever he wanted.

1981.english: We subdued the wind to run at his disposal and to bring rain wherever he wanted.

1989.english: We (answered his prayer and) committed the wind at his disposal, pouring rain wherever he wanted.

verses.arabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
verses.arabicClean: والشياطين كل بناء وغواص
verses.transliterated: wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣi
verses.english: And the devils, building and diving.

1981.english: Also, the devils were subjugated as builders and divers.

1989.english: And the devils, building and diving.

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.arabicClean: وآخرين مقرنين في الأصفاد
verses.transliterated: waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfād
verses.english: Others were placed at his disposal.

1981.english: Many others were bound in his service.

1989.english: Others were placed at his disposal.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: هذا عطاؤنا فامنن أو أمسك بغير حساب
verses.transliterated: hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābi
verses.english: "This is our provision to you; you may give generously, or withhold, without limits."

1981.english: These are our provisions; you can donate or withhold without limits.

1989.english: “This is our provision to you (Solomon)', you may give generously, or withhold, without limits.”

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مآب
verses.transliterated: wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābi
verses.english: He has deserved an honorable position with us, and a wonderful abode.

1981.english: We have reserved for him a reward and a beautiful abode.

1989.english: He has deserved an honorable position with us, and a beautiful abode. The Devil Afflicts Job*

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: واذكر عبدنا أيوب إذ نادى ربه أني مسني الشيطان بنصب وعذاب
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābi
verses.english: Remember our servant Job: he called upon his Lord, "The devil has afflicted me with hardship and pain."
verses.subtitle: The Devil Afflicts Job

1981.english: Recall our servant Job; he called his Lord saying, "The devil has afflicted me with disease and suffering."
1981.subtitle: Job

1989.english: Remember our servant Job: he called upon his Lord, “The devil has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

verses.arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
verses.arabicClean: اركض برجلك ۖ هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب
verses.transliterated: ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābu
verses.english: "Strike the ground with your foot. A spring will give you healing and a drink."

1981.english: (We said,) "Strike the ground with your foot. A spring will provide you with healing as well as a cool drink."

1989.english: “Strike the ground with your foot. A spring will give you healing and a drink.”

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: ووهبنا له أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكرى لأولي الألباب
verses.transliterated: wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verses.english: We restored his family for him; twice as many. Such is our mercy; a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
verses.subtitle: God Makes it up to the Believers

1981.english: We restored his family for him and multiplied them, as mercy from us, and a lesson for those who possess intelligence.

1989.english: We restored his family for him, and twice as many. Such is our mercy; a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
1989.subtitle: God Makes it up to the Believers

verses.arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث ۗ إنا وجدناه صابرا ۚ نعم العبد ۖ إنه أواب
verses.transliterated: wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābu
verses.english: "Now, you shall travel the land and preach the message, to fulfill your pledge." We found him steadfast. What a good servant! He was a submitter.

1981.english: We told him, "Whenever you make a covenant, do not violate it." We found him steadfast; a good servant and a repenter.

1989.english: “Now, you shall travel the land and preach the message, to fulfill your pledge.” We found him steadfast. What a good servant! He was a submitter.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verses.arabicClean: واذكر عبادنا إبراهيم وإسحاق ويعقوب أولي الأيدي والأبصار
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣār
verses.english: Remember also our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They were resourceful, and possessed vision.

1981.english: Recall our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They were resourceful and possessed vision.
1981.subtitle: Abraham And Descendants

1989.english: Remember also our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They were resourceful, and possessed vision.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: إنا أخلصناهم بخالصة ذكرى الدار
verses.transliterated: innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dār
verses.english: We bestowed upon them a great blessing: awareness of the Hereafter.

1981.english: We blessed them with a special blessing, being mindful of the final abode.

1989.english: We blessed them with a great blessing’ r*f

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.arabicClean: وإنهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الأخيار
verses.transliterated: wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyār
verses.english: They were chosen, for they were among the most righteous.

1981.english: They were among our chosen righteous people.

1989.english: They were chosen, among the best.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.arabicClean: واذكر إسماعيل واليسع وذا الكفل ۖ وكل من الأخيار
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyār
verses.english: Remember Ismail, Elisha, and Zal-Kifl; among the most righteous.

1981.english: Recall also Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhalkifl; all were pious.

1989.english: And remember Ismail, Elisha, and Zal-Kifl; they were among the best.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.arabicClean: هذا ذكر ۚ وإن للمتقين لحسن مآب
verses.transliterated: hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābi
verses.english: This is a reminder: The righteous have deserved a wonderful destiny.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous

1981.english: This is a message; the righteous have deserved a beautiful destiny.

1989.english: This is a message: The righteous have deserved a good destiny.

verses.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.arabicClean: جنات عدن مفتحة لهم الأبواب
verses.transliterated: jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwāb
verses.english: The gardens of Eden will open up their gates for them.

1981.english: The gardens of Eden will be wide open for them.

1989.english: The gardens of Eden will open up their gates for them.

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: متكئين فيها يدعون فيها بفاكهة كثيرة وشراب
verses.transliterated: muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābi
verses.english: Relaxing therein, they will be given many kinds of fruits and drinks.

1981.english: Relaxing therein, they will enjoy many fruits and drinks.

1989.english: Relaxing therein, they will be given many kinds of fruits and drinks.

verses.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.arabicClean: وعندهم قاصرات الطرف أتراب
verses.transliterated: waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābu
verses.english: They will have wonderful spouses.

1981.english: With them will be the most magnificent spouses.

1989.english: They will have beautiful companions.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب
verses.transliterated: hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.english: This is what you have deserved on the Day of Reckoning.

1981.english: This is promised for you on the day of reckoning.

1989.english: This is what you deserved on the Day of Reckoning.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādi
verses.english: Our provisions are inexhaustible.

1981.english: Our provision to you will never end.

1989.english: Our provisions are inexhaustible.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.arabicClean: هذا ۚ وإن للطاغين لشر مآب
verses.transliterated: hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābi
verses.english: As for the transgressors, they have incurred a miserable destiny.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers: Feuding With One Another

1981.english: As for the transgressors, they have deserved a terrible destiny.

1989.english: As for the transgressors, they have incurred a miserable destiny.

verses.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.arabicClean: جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد
verses.transliterated: jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihād
verses.english: Hell is where they burn; what a miserable abode!

1981.english: Hell, wherein they burn; what a miserable abode!

1989.english: Hell is where they burn; what a miserable abode!

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
verses.arabicClean: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
verses.transliterated: hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqu
verses.english: What they taste therein will be hellish drinks and bitter food.

1981.english: They will suffer therein, with boiling lava and bitter food.

1989.english: What they taste therein will be hellish drinks and bitter food.

verses.arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.arabicClean: وآخر من شكله أزواج
verses.transliterated: waākharu min shaklihi azwāju
verses.english: And much more of the same kind.

1981.english: Also, other kinds, equally bad.

1989.english: And much more of the same kind.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم ۖ لا مرحبا بهم ۚ إنهم صالو النار
verses.transliterated: hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nār
verses.english: "This is a group to be thrown into Hell with you." They will not be welcomed (by the residents of Hell). They have deserved to burn in the hellfire.

1981.english: Here is another group to be condemned with you in hell. They will not welcome them and will burn together in hell.

1989.english: This is a group to join you in Hell. They will say, “You are not welcomed.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا بل أنتم لا مرحبا بكم ۖ أنتم قدمتموه لنا ۖ فبئس القرار
verses.transliterated: qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarār
verses.english: The newcomers will respond, "Nor are you welcomed. You are the ones who preceded us and misled us. Therefore, suffer this miserable end."

1981.english: They will say, "You are not welcome either; you are the ones who misled us; what a miserable fate!"

1989.english: They will respond, “Nor are you welcomed. You are the ones who misled us, so suffer this miserable end.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار
verses.transliterated: qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nār
verses.english: They will also say, "Our Lord, these are the ones who led us into this; double the retribution of hellfire for them."

1981.english: They will say, "Our Lord, double the punishment of hell for those who misguided us and led us into this."

1989.english: They will also say, “Our Lord, whoever led us into this, double the retribution for him in Hell.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا ما لنا لا نرى رجالا كنا نعدهم من الأشرار
verses.transliterated: waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrār
verses.english: They will say, "How come we do not see (in Hell) people we used to count among the wicked?
verses.subtitle: Surprise!

1981.english: They will also say, "How come we do not see people we had considered wicked?

1989.english: They will say, “How come we do not see people whom we considered evil?

verses.arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verses.arabicClean: أتخذناهم سخريا أم زاغت عنهم الأبصار
verses.transliterated: attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣār
verses.english: "We used to ridicule them; we used to turn our eyes away from them."

1981.english: "We used to ridicule them, and we diverted our eyes from them."

1989.english: “We kept on mocking them. We diverted our eyes from them.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: إن ذلك لحق تخاصم أهل النار
verses.transliterated: inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nār
verses.english: This is a predetermined fact: the people of Hell will feud with one another.

1981.english: It is an established truth that the people of hell will feud with each other.

1989.english: This is a predetermined fact: the people of Hell will feud with one another.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.arabicClean: قل إنما أنا منذر ۖ وما من إله إلا الله الواحد القهار
verses.transliterated: qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verses.english: Say, "I warn you; there is no other god beside GOD, the One, the Supreme.

1981.english: Say, "I am only a warner; there is no god except God, the One, the most powerful.
1981.subtitle: Satan Determined To Mislead Us

1989.english: Say, “I warn you; there is no other god besides GOD, the One, the Supreme.

verses.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verses.arabicClean: رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما العزيز الغفار
verses.transliterated: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verses.english: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Almighty, the Forgiving."

1981.english: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the almighty, the forgiving."

1989.english: “The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Almighty, the Forgiving.” The Great Feud

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل هو نبأ عظيم
verses.transliterated: qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Say, "Here is awesome news.
verses.subtitle: The Great Feud

1981.english: Say, "This is a great event.

1989.english: Say, “Here is awesome news.

verses.arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أنتم عنه معرضون
verses.transliterated: antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: "That you are totally oblivious to.

1981.english: "But you are heedless thereof.

1989.english: “That you are totally oblivious to.

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما كان لي من علم بالملإ الأعلى إذ يختصمون
verses.transliterated: mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūn
verses.english: "I had no knowledge previously, about the feud in the High Society.
verses.footnote: The feud in the High Society was triggered by Satan's challenge to God's absolute authority. This is definitely the most important event in the history of the human race. We failed to make a firm stand regarding God's absolute authority. This life represents the third and final chance to redeem ourselves (See the Introduction and Appendix 7).

1981.english: "I have no information that the heavenly society ever feuded.

1989.english: “I did not possess any knowledge about the feud in the High Society.*
1989.footnote: The feud in the High Society was triggered by Satan’s challenge to God’s absolute authority. This is definitely the most important event in the history of the human race, since we failed to make a firm stand regarding God’s absolute authority. We are here to redeem ourselves (See Introduction and Appendix 7)

verses.arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن يوحى إلي إلا أنما أنا نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: "I am inspired that my sole mission is to deliver the warnings to you."

1981.english: "I have been inspired that I am no more than a manifest warner."

1989.english: “I am inspired that my sole mission is to deliver the warnings to you.”

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: إذ قال ربك للملائكة إني خالق بشرا من طين
verses.transliterated: idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīni
verses.english: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from clay.

1981.english: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human from clay.

1989.english: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verses.english: "Once I design him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."

1981.english: "Once I perfect him and blow into him from My soul, you shall fall prostrate before him."
1981.footnote: See Appendix 6.

1989.english: “Once I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him.”

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فسجد الملائكة كلهم أجمعون
verses.transliterated: fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verses.english: The angels fell prostrate, all of them,

1981.english: All the angels fell prostrate.

1989.english: The angels fell prostrate, all of them.

verses.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا إبليس استكبر وكان من الكافرين
verses.transliterated: illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīn
verses.english: except Satan; he refused, and was too arrogant, unappreciative.

1981.english: But not Satan; he was arrogant, and thus he became a disbeliever.

1989.english: Only Satan refused. He was too arrogant, unappreciative.

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا إبليس ما منعك أن تسجد لما خلقت بيدي ۖ أستكبرت أم كنت من العالين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīn
verses.english: He said, "O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My hands? Are you too arrogant? Have you rebelled?"

1981.english: God said, "O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before My creation; are you too arrogant; or much too high?"

1989.english: He said, “O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before the one I created with My hand? Were you too arrogant? Have you rebelled?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال أنا خير منه ۖ خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
verses.transliterated: qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīni
verses.english: He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from clay."

1981.english: He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire and created him from clay."

1989.english: He said, “I am better than he. You created me from fire, and created him from clay.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم
verses.transliterated: qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmu
verses.english: He said, "Therefore, you must be exiled, you will be banished.

1981.english: He said, "Then you must get out, for you are rejected.

1989.english: He said, “Therefore, you must be exiled, you are rejected.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.arabicClean: وإن عليك لعنتي إلى يوم الدين
verses.transliterated: wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīn
verses.english: "You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment."

1981.english: "You have deserved My curse till the day of judgment."

1989.english: “You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال رب فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, respite me till the Day of Resurrection."

1981.english: He said, "My Lord, respite me till the day of resurrection."

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, respite me till the Day of Resurrection.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فإنك من المنظرين
verses.transliterated: qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verses.english: He said, "You are respited.

1981.english: God said, "You are respited,

1989.english: He said, “You are respited.

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.arabicClean: إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم
verses.transliterated: ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verses.english: "Until the appointed day."

1981.english: "Until the specified time."

1989.english: “Until the appointed day.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: He said, "I swear by Your majesty, that I will send them all astray.

1981.english: He said, "I swear by Your majesty that I will mislead them all.

1989.english: He said, “By Your majesty, I will mislead them all.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.english: "Except Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone."

1981.english: "Except Your servants who are absolutely devoted to You alone."

1989.english: “Except Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.arabicClean: قال فالحق والحق أقول
verses.transliterated: qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūl
verses.english: He said, "This is the truth, and the truth is all that I utter.

1981.english: He said, "The truth is, and I utter only truth,

1989.english: He said, “This is the truth, and truth is all that I utter.

verses.arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لأملأن جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: I will fill Hell with you and all those who follow you.

1981.english: "I will fill hell with you and all those who follow you."

1989.english: “I will fill Hell with you and all those who follow you.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل ما أسألكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين
verses.transliterated: qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīn
verses.english: Say, "I do not ask you for any wage, and I am not an imposter.

1981.english: Say, "I do not ask you for a wage; I am not an imposter.

1989.english: Say, “I do not ask you for any wage, and I am not an imposter.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين
verses.transliterated: in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīn
verses.english: "This is a reminder for the world.

1981.english: "This is a message to all the people.

1989.english: “This is a reminder for the world.

verses.arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: ولتعلمن نبأه بعد حين
verses.transliterated: walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīni
verses.english: "And you will certainly find out in awhile."

1981.english: "You will surely find out after awhile."

1989.english: “And you will certainly find out in awhile.”

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
verses.english: This is a revelation of the scripture, from GOD, the Almighty, the Wise.

1981.english: This is the revealed scripture from God, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: This is a revelation of the scripture, from GOD, the Almighty, the Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا أنزلنا إليك الكتاب بالحق فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
verses.transliterated: innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīn
verses.english: We sent down to you this scripture, truthfully; you shall worship GOD, devoting your religion to Him alone.

1981.english: We have revealed to you this scripture truthfully. Accordingly, you shall worship God alone and devote your worship absolutely to Him.

1989.english: We sent down to you this scripture, truthfully, so worship GOD alone, devoting your religion to Him alone.

verses.arabic: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
verses.arabicClean: ألا لله الدين الخالص ۚ والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء ما نعبدهم إلا ليقربونا إلى الله زلفى إن الله يحكم بينهم في ما هم فيه يختلفون ۗ إن الله لا يهدي من هو كاذب كفار
verses.transliterated: alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffāru
verses.english: Absolutely, the religion shall be devoted to GOD alone. Those who set up idols beside Him say, "We idolize them only to bring us closer to GOD; for they are in a better position!" GOD will judge them regarding their disputes. GOD does not guide such liars, disbelievers.
verses.subtitle: The Idols as Mediators A Common Myth

1981.english: To God alone shall be the worship. Those who set up idols besides Him say, "We idolize them to bring us closer to God."* God will judge between them regarding their disputes. God never guides any liar, disbeliever.
1981.footnote: This is exactly what the worshipers of Muhammad and/or the saints say. They think that the invention of **sunna** and the establishment of **hadith** as a source of jurisprudence, and the other forms of idolizing the prophet will bring them closer to God. See Appendices 7, 8, and 11.

1989.english: Absolutely, the religion shall be devoted to GOD alone. Those who set up idols besides Him say, “We idolize them only to bring us closer to GOD; they are in a good position!” GOD will judge them regarding their disputes. GOD does not guide any liar, unappreciative.
1989.subtitle: The Idols as Mediators A Common Myth

verses.arabic: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.arabicClean: لو أراد الله أن يتخذ ولدا لاصطفى مما يخلق ما يشاء ۚ سبحانه ۖ هو الله الواحد القهار
verses.transliterated: law arāda l-lahu an yattakhidha waladan la-iṣ'ṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāu sub'ḥānahu huwa l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verses.english: If GOD wanted to have a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed from among His creations. Be He glorified; He is GOD, the One, the Supreme.

1981.english: If God wanted to get a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed. God be glorified; He is the One, the supreme.

1989.english: If GOD wanted to have a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed from among His creation. Be He glorified; He is GOD, the One, the Supreme.

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verses.arabicClean: خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق ۖ يكور الليل على النهار ويكور النهار على الليل ۖ وسخر الشمس والقمر ۖ كل يجري لأجل مسمى ۗ ألا هو العزيز الغفار
verses.transliterated: khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā l-nahāri wayukawwiru l-nahāra ʿalā al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman alā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verses.english: He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day, and rolls the day over the night. He committed the sun and the moon, each running for a finite period. Absolutely, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
verses.subtitle: The Shape of the Earth
verses.footnote: This verse clearly informs us that the earth is round. The Arabic for "He rolls" (Yukawwir) is derived from the Arabic word for "ball" (Kurah). Since the Earth is not exactly round, a specific reference to its shape is given in 79:30. The Quran is replete with scientific information that became known to us centuries after the revelation of the Quran. See Appendix 20.

1981.english: He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day and rolls the day over the night.* He subdued the sun and the moon, each to last a predetermined life span. He is the almighty, the forgiving.
1981.footnote: The expression used here, taken from the noun that means "ball" (**yukawwir**), cannot be used unless the planet earth is generally ball-shaped, a fact that was not known at the time of Quranic revelation.

1989.english: He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day, and rolls the day over the night.* He committed the sun and the moon, each running for a finite period. Absolutely, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
1989.footnote: This verse clearly informs us that the earth is round. The Arabic for “He rolls” (Yukawwiru) is derived from the Arabic word for “ball” (Kurah). The Quran is replete with scientific information that became known to us many centuries after the revelation of the Quran. See Appendix 20.
