verses.arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍ ثَلَٰثٍ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: خلقكم من نفس واحدة ثم جعل منها زوجها وأنزل لكم من الأنعام ثمانية أزواج ۚ يخلقكم في بطون أمهاتكم خلقا من بعد خلق في ظلمات ثلاث ۚ ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك ۖ لا إله إلا هو ۖ فأنى تصرفون
verses.transliterated: khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala min'hā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mina l-anʿāmi thamāniyata azwājin yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fī ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tuṣ'rafūn
verses.english: He created you from one person, then created from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers' bellies, creation after creation, in trimesters of darkness. Such is GOD your Lord. To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no other god beside Him. How could you deviate?

1981.english: He created you from one person, then made from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers' wombs, creation after creation, in three stages of darkness.* Such is God your Lord, to whom belongs all kingship. There is no god except He; how could you deviate?
1981.footnote: The three stages of darkness probably are the dark period before birth, the dark period inside the womb, and the dark period in the grave.

1989.english: He created you from one person, then created from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers’ bellies, creation after creation, in three layers of darkness. Such is GOD your Lord. To Him belongs all kingship. There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?

verses.arabic: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: إن تكفروا فإن الله غني عنكم ۖ ولا يرضى لعباده الكفر ۖ وإن تشكروا يرضه لكم ۗ ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ۗ ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون ۚ إنه عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: in takfurū fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kuf'ra wa-in tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: If you disbelieve, GOD does not need anyone. But He dislikes to see His servants make the wrong decision. If you decide to be appreciative, He is pleased for you. No soul bears the sins of any other soul. Ultimately, to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you of everything you had done. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verses.subtitle: Believe For Your Own Good

1981.english: If you disbelieve, God is in no need of you. And He dislikes for His servants disbelief. But if you are appreciative, then He is pleased for you. No one is responsible for anyone else's sins. To your Lord is your final return; then He will inform you of everything you did. He is fully aware of the innermost intentions.

1989.english: If you disbelieve, GOD does not need you. But He dislikes to see His servants make the wrong decision. If you decide to be appreciative, He approves it for you. No soul bears the sins of any other soul. Ultimately, to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you of everything you had done. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
1989.subtitle: Believe For Your Own Good

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا مس الإنسان ضر دعا ربه منيبا إليه ثم إذا خوله نعمة منه نسي ما كان يدعو إليه من قبل وجعل لله أندادا ليضل عن سبيله ۚ قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا ۖ إنك من أصحاب النار
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ilayhi thumma idhā khawwalahu niʿ'matan min'hu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillahi andādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikuf'rika qalīlan innaka min aṣḥābi l-nār
verses.english: When the human being is afflicted, he implores his Lord, sincerely devoted to Him. But as soon as He blesses him, he forgets his previous imploring, sets up idols to rank with GOD and to divert others from His path. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief temporarily; you have incurred the hellfire."

1981.english: When adversity touches the human being, he implores his Lord in total submission. But as soon as He bestows a blessing upon him, he forgets his previous submission and sets up idols to divert others from the path of God. Say, "Enjoy your heathenism temporarily, for you have deserved hell."

1989.english: When the human being is afflicted, he implores his Lord, sincerely devoted to Him. But as soon as He blesses him, he forgets his previous imploring, sets up idols to rank with GOD and diverts others from His path. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief temporarily; you have incurred Hell.”

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: أمن هو قانت آناء الليل ساجدا وقائما يحذر الآخرة ويرجو رحمة ربه ۗ قل هل يستوي الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون ۗ إنما يتذكر أولو الألباب
verses.transliterated: amman huwa qānitun ānāa al-layli sājidan waqāiman yaḥdharu l-ākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawī alladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albāb
verses.english: Is it not better to be one of those who meditate in the night, prostrating and staying up, being aware of the Hereafter, and seeking the mercy of their Lord? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

1981.english: As for the one who meditates through the night, prostrating and worshipping, conscious of the hereafter, and seeking mercy from his Lord; are those who know equal to those who do not know? Indeed, only those who possess intelligence take heed.

1989.english: Is it not better to be one of those who meditate in the night, prostrating and staying up, being aware of the Hereafter, and seeking the mercy of their Lord? Say, “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا عباد الذين آمنوا اتقوا ربكم ۚ للذين أحسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة ۗ وأرض الله واسعة ۗ إنما يوفى الصابرون أجرهم بغير حساب
verses.transliterated: qul yāʿibādi alladhīna āmanū ittaqū rabbakum lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun wa-arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatun innamā yuwaffā l-ṣābirūna ajrahum bighayri ḥisābi
verses.english: Say, "O My servants who believed, you shall reverence your Lord." For those who worked righteousness in this world, a good reward. GOD's earth is spacious, and those who steadfastly persevere will receive their recompense generously, without limits.

1981.english: Say to My servants who believe, "You shall maintain righteousness towards your Lord. Those who are pious in this life will reap the credit therefor, and God's earth is spacious. The steadfast will be fully repaid without limits."

1989.english: Say, “O My servants who believed, you shall observe your Lord.” For those who worked righteousness in this world, a good reward. GOD’s earth is spacious, and those who steadfastly persevere will receive their recompense without limits.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إني أمرت أن أعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
verses.transliterated: qul innī umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīn
verses.english: Say, "I have been commanded to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone.
verses.subtitle: God ALONE

1981.english: Say, "I was commanded to worship God and devote the worship absolutely to Him alone.
1981.subtitle: Muhammad An Example

1989.english: Say, “I have been commanded to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone.
1989.subtitle: God ALONE

verses.arabic: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين
verses.transliterated: wa-umir'tu li-an akūna awwala l-mus'limīn
verses.english: "And I was commanded to be the utmost submitter."

1981.english: "I was commanded to be the first to submit."

1989.english: “And I was commanded to be the utmost submitter.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: Say, "I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of a great day."

1981.english: Say, "I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of a terrible day."

1989.english: Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of a great day.”

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
verses.arabicClean: قل الله أعبد مخلصا له ديني
verses.transliterated: quli l-laha aʿbudu mukh'liṣan lahu dīn
verses.english: Say, "GOD is the only One I worship, devoting my religion absolutely to Him alone.

1981.english: Say, "I worship God, and I devote my worship absolutely to Him alone.

1989.english: Say, “GOD is the only One I worship, devoting my religion absolutely to Him alone.

verses.arabic: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: فاعبدوا ما شئتم من دونه ۗ قل إن الخاسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيامة ۗ ألا ذلك هو الخسران المبين
verses.transliterated: fa-uʿ'budū mā shi'tum min dūnihi qul inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīn
verses.english: "Therefore, worship whatever you wish besides Him." Say, "The real losers are those who lose their souls, and their families, on the Day of Resurrection." Most certainly, this is the real loss.

1981.english: "You may idolize whatever you wish besides Him." Say, "Such losers lose their souls and their families on the day of resurrection, and this is the real loss."

1989.english: “Therefore, worship whatever you wish besides Him.” Say, “The real losers are those who lose their souls, and their families, on the Day of Resurrection.” Most certainly, this is the worst loss.

verses.arabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.arabicClean: لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل ۚ ذلك يخوف الله به عباده ۚ يا عباد فاتقون
verses.transliterated: lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina l-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu l-lahu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fa-ittaqūn
verses.english: They will have masses of fire on top of them, and under them. GOD thus alerts His servants: O My servants, you shall reverence Me.

1981.english: They have deserved masses of fire above them, and masses of fire below them. God thus instills fear into His servants. O My servants, you shall reverence Me.

1989.english: They will have masses of fire on top of them, and under them. GOD thus alerts His servants. O My servants, you shall reverence Me.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: والذين اجتنبوا الطاغوت أن يعبدوها وأنابوا إلى الله لهم البشرى ۚ فبشر عباد
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna ij'tanabū l-ṭāghūta an yaʿbudūhā wa-anābū ilā l-lahi lahumu l-bush'rā fabashir ʿibād
verses.english: As for those who discard the worship of all idols, and devote themselves totally to GOD alone, they have deserved happiness. Give good news to My servants.

1981.english: Those who avoid idol worship and totally submit to God, deserve to be congratulated. Therefore, congratulate My servants.

1989.english: As for those who discard the worship of all idols, and devoted themselves totally to GOD, they have the good news. Give good news to My servants.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه ۚ أولئك الذين هداهم الله ۖ وأولئك هم أولو الألباب
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna aḥsanahu ulāika alladhīna hadāhumu l-lahu wa-ulāika hum ulū l-albāb
verses.english: They are the ones who examine all words, then follow the best. These are the ones whom GOD has guided; these are the ones who possess intelligence.
verses.subtitle: Follow the Word of God

1981.english: They listen to any views, then follow the best thereof. These are the ones guided by God; these are the ones who possess intelligence.

1989.english: They are the ones who examine all words, then follow the best. These are the ones whom GOD has guided; these are the ones who possess intelligence.
1989.subtitle: Follow the Word of God

verses.arabic: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن حق عليه كلمة العذاب أفأنت تنقذ من في النار
verses.transliterated: afaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi afa-anta tunqidhu man fī l-nār
verses.english: With regard to those who have deserved the retribution, can you save those who are already in Hell?

1981.english: If anyone has already deserved retribution, can you save them from hell?

1989.english: For those who have incurred the retribution, can you save those who are already in Hell?

verses.arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.arabicClean: لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنية تجري من تحتها الأنهار ۖ وعد الله ۖ لا يخلف الله الميعاد
verses.transliterated: lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu l-mīʿād
verses.english: As for those who reverence their Lord, they will have mansions upon mansions constructed for them, with flowing streams. This is GOD's promise, and GOD never breaks His promise.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous

1981.english: As for those who reverence their Lord, they have deserved mansions upon constructed mansions and flowing streams. This is God's promise; and God never breaks His promise.

1989.english: As for those who reverence their Lord, they will have mansions upon mansions constructed for them, with flowing streams. This is GOD’s promise, and GOD never breaks His promise.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينابيع في الأرض ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا ألوانه ثم يهيج فتراه مصفرا ثم يجعله حطاما ۚ إن في ذلك لذكرى لأولي الألباب
verses.transliterated: alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fī l-arḍi thumma yukh'riju bihi zarʿan mukh'talifan alwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verses.english: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water, then places it into underground wells, then produces with it plants of various colors, then they grow until they turn yellow, then He turns them into hay? This should be a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

1981.english: Do you not realize that God sends down water from the sky, then directs it to springs throughout the earth, then produces plants of various colors, turning yellow as they grow, then He turns them into hay? This is a reminder for the intelligent.

1989.english: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water, then places it into underground wells, then produces with it plants of various colors, then they grow until they turn yellow, and become hay? This should be a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن شرح الله صدره للإسلام فهو على نور من ربه ۚ فويل للقاسية قلوبهم من ذكر الله ۚ أولئك في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: afaman sharaḥa l-lahu ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lil'qāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhik'ri l-lahi ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: If GOD renders one's heart content with Submission, he will be following a light from his Lord. Therefore, woe to those whose hearts are hardened against GOD's message; they have gone far astray.

1981.english: The one whose chest is made wide open to Islam is the one who had followed the guidance from his Lord. But woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the message of God; they are in total loss.

1989.english: If GOD renders one’s heart content with Islam, he will be following a light from his Lord. Therefore, woe to those whose hearts are hardened against GOD’s message; they have gone far astray.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبًا مُّتَشَٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.arabicClean: الله نزل أحسن الحديث كتابا متشابها مثاني تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم إلى ذكر الله ۚ ذلك هدى الله يهدي به من يشاء ۚ ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
verses.transliterated: al-lahu nazzala aḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru min'hu julūdu alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ilā dhik'ri l-lahi dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādi
verses.english: GOD has revealed herein the best Hadith; a book that is consistent, and points out both ways (to Heaven and Hell). The skins of those who reverence their Lord cringe therefrom, then their skins and their hearts soften up for GOD's message. Such is GOD's guidance; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. As for those sent astray by GOD, nothing can guide them.
verses.subtitle: The Best Hadith

1981.english: God sent down the best hadith,* a scripture that is consistent, and describes both ways (to heaven and to hell). The skins of those who reverence their Lord shudder therefrom, then their skins and their hearts soften and readily receive God's message. This is God's guidance; He guides with it whomever He wills. But the one who is misguided by God can never be guided.
1981.subtitle: Quran: Sufficient Source of Jurisprudence
1981.footnote: Although the blasphemy against the prophet called "**hadith**" did not appear until 250 years after the prophet's death, God obviously knew about it in advance. Therefore, it is appropriate to leave this word (**hadith**) without translation (see Appendices 11, 15, 16, and 17).

1989.english: GOD has revealed herein the best Hadith', a book that is consistent, and points out both ways (to Heaven and Hell). The skins of those who reverence their Lord cringe therefrom, then their skins and their hearts soften for GOD’s message. Such is GOD’s guidance; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. As for those sent astray by GOD, nothing can guide them.
1989.subtitle: The Best Hadith

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيامة ۚ وقيل للظالمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون
verses.transliterated: afaman yattaqī biwajhihi sūa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūn
verses.english: What is better than saving one's face from the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection? The transgressors will be told, "Taste the consequences of what you earned."

1981.english: That is the one who will face terrible retribution on the day of resurrection. The wicked will be told, "Suffer (the consequences of) your works."

1989.english: What is better than saving one’s face from the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection? The transgressors will be told, “Suffer the consequences you have earned.”

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كذب الذين من قبلهم فأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
verses.transliterated: kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūn
verses.english: Others before them have disbelieved and, consequently, the retribution afflicted them whence they never expected.

1981.english: Others before them have disbelieved and, consequently, the retribution came to them when they least expected.

1989.english: Others before them have disbelieved and, consequently, the retribution afflicted them whence they never expected.

verses.arabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأذاقهم الله الخزي في الحياة الدنيا ۖ ولعذاب الآخرة أكبر ۚ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fa-adhāqahumu l-lahu l-khiz'ya fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: GOD has condemned them to humiliation in this life, and the retribution in the Hereafter will be far worse, if they only knew.

1981.english: God made them taste the humiliation in this life; and the retribution in the hereafter is far worse, if they only knew.

1989.english: GOD has condemned them to humiliation in this life, and the retribution in the Hereafter will be far worse, if they only knew. Quran: The Only Source

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرآن من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūn
verses.english: We have cited for the people every kind of example in this Quran, that they may take heed.
verses.subtitle: Quran: No Ambiguity

1981.english: We have cited for the people in this Quran every kind of example, that they may take heed.

1989.english: We have cited for the people every kind of example in this Quran, that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قرآنا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون
verses.transliterated: qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhī ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūn
verses.english: An Arabic Quran, without any ambiguity, that they may be righteous.

1981.english: A Quran in Arabic, without ambiguity, that they may attain salvation.

1989.english: An Arabic Quran, without any ambiguity, that they may be righteous

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشاكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا ۚ الحمد لله ۚ بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: GOD cites the example of a man who deals with disputing partners (Hadith), compared to a man who deals with only one consistent source (Quran). Are they the same? Praise be to GOD; most of them do not know.

1981.english: God cites the example of a man with partners who contradict one another and a man who relies on one consistent source; are they the same?* Praise be to God; the majority do not know.
1981.footnote: When the Muslims abandoned the Quran as their source of law, they plunged into perennial arguments and became divided partners. They argue about the "prophet's **hadith**," which is authentic and which is not. They argue about the various opinions; is Imam Shafei correct or Imam Hanbali; was Abu Bakr supposed to be the first Caliph, or was Ali? Ironically, the prophet is the first to disown those who claim to love him (see 6:159). Similarly, Jesus will be the first to disown those who "love him very much" and call him "God" or "son of God."

1989.english: GOD cites the example of a man who deals with disputing partners (Hadith), compared to a man who deals with only one consistent source (Quran). Are they the same? Praise be to GOD; most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنك ميت وإنهم ميتون
verses.transliterated: innaka mayyitun wa-innahum mayyitūn
verses.english: You (Muhammad) will surely die, just like they will die.
verses.subtitle: Hadith: A Gross Blasphemy

1981.english: You will surely die, and they will surely die.
1981.footnote: In other words, do not idolize Muhammad. He is a human like you. Leave the invented lies that you call **sunna** and **hadith**, and come back to the Quran.

1989.english: You (Muhammad) will surely die, just like they will die.
1989.subtitle: Hadith: Gross Blasphemy

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم إنكم يوم القيامة عند ربكم تختصمون
verses.transliterated: thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūn
verses.english: On the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, you people will feud with one another.

1981.english: Then, on the day of resurrection, you will blame one another before your Lord.

1989.english: On the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, you people will blame one another.

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن أظلم ممن كذب على الله وكذب بالصدق إذ جاءه ۚ أليس في جهنم مثوى للكافرين
verses.transliterated: faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā l-lahi wakadhaba bil-ṣid'qi idh jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīn
verses.english: Who is more evil than one who attributes lies to GOD, while disbelieving in the truth that has come to him? Is Hell not a just requital for the disbelievers?

1981.english: Who is more wicked than one who lies about God and rejects the truth when it comes to him?* Is hell not well deserved by the disbelievers?
1981.subtitle: You May Believe In God And Still Go To Hell
1981.footnote: Those who claim that **hadith** is divine revelation are lying about God and, at the same time, rejecting the truth of Quran (see 6:19, 38, and 114).

1989.english: Who is more evil than one who attributes lies to GOD, while disbelieving in the truth that has come to him? Is Hell not a just requital for the disbelievers?

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذي جاء بالصدق وصدق به ۙ أولئك هم المتقون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhī jāa bil-ṣid'qi waṣaddaqa bihi ulāika humu l-mutaqūn
verses.english: As for those who promote the truth, and believe therein, they are the righteous.
verses.subtitle: Quran: Absolute Truth

1981.english: As for those who are truthful and follow the truth, they are the righteous.

1989.english: On the other hand, those who promote the truth, and believe therein, are the righteous.
1989.subtitle: Quran: Absolute Truth

verses.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ۚ ذلك جزاء المحسنين
verses.transliterated: lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: They will get everything they wish, at their Lord. Such is the reward for the righteous.

1981.english: They will enjoy everything they wish at their Lord. This is the well-deserved reward for the pious.

1989.english: They get anything they wish, at their Lord. Such is the reward for the pious.

verses.arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ليكفر الله عنهم أسوأ الذي عملوا ويجزيهم أجرهم بأحسن الذي كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: liyukaffira l-lahu ʿanhum aswa-a alladhī ʿamilū wayajziyahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani alladhī kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: GOD remits their sinful works, and rewards them generously for their good works.

1981.english: God will remit their bad deeds and reward them manyfold for their good deeds.

1989.english: GOD remits their sinful works, and rewards them generously for their righteous works.

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.arabicClean: أليس الله بكاف عبده ۖ ويخوفونك بالذين من دونه ۚ ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
verses.transliterated: alaysa l-lahu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka bi-alladhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādi
verses.english: Is GOD not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with the idols they set up beside Him. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him.
verses.subtitle: Profound Question

1981.english: Is God not sufficient for His servant? Yet they frighten you with the (powerless) idols they had set up besides Him.* Whomever God misleads will have no guide.
1981.footnote: Those who idolize the prophet give us the impression that Muhammad will put you in hell or take you out of heaven if you do not follow the lies attributed to him, known as "**hadith**" and/or "**sunna**."

1989.english: Is GOD not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with the idols they set up besides Him. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him.
1989.subtitle: Profound Question

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل ۗ أليس الله بعزيز ذي انتقام
verses.transliterated: waman yahdi l-lahu famā lahu min muḍillin alaysa l-lahu biʿazīzin dhī intiqāmi
verses.english: And whomever GOD guides, nothing can send him astray. Is GOD not Almighty, Avenger?

1981.english: And whomever God guides, none can mislead him. Is God not almighty, Lord of retribution?

1989.english: And whomever GOD guides, nothing can send him astray. Is GOD not Almighty, Avenger?

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله ۚ قل أفرأيتم ما تدعون من دون الله إن أرادني الله بضر هل هن كاشفات ضره أو أرادني برحمة هل هن ممسكات رحمته ۚ قل حسبي الله ۖ عليه يتوكل المتوكلون
verses.transliterated: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu qul afara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi in arādaniya l-lahu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi aw arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mum'sikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya l-lahu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakilūn
verses.english: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they will say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you set up idols beside GOD? If GOD willed any adversity for me, can they relieve such an adversity? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they prevent such a blessing?" Say, "GOD is sufficient for me." In Him the trusters shall trust.
verses.subtitle: They Believe in God Yet, They Are Going to Hell

1981.english: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would say, "God." Say, "What about the idols you set up besides Him? If God wanted to hurt me, can they prevent Him? And if He wanted to bless me, can they stop His blessing?" Say, "God suffices for me; in Him the trusting put their trust."
1981.footnote: Unless you worship God ALONE, your worship is null and void (see 39:45, 39:65, 40:10-12, and 40:83-85).

1989.english: If you ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they will say, “GOD.” Say, “What about the idols you set up besides GOD? If GOD willed any adversity for me, can they relieve such an adversity? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they prevent such a blessing?” Say, “GOD is sufficient for me.” In Him the trusters shall trust.
1989.subtitle: They Believe in God Yet, They Are Going to Hell

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَٰمِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا قوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إني عامل ۖ فسوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "O my people, do your best and I will do my best; you will surely find out.

1981.english: Say, "O my people, work in your best way, and so will I; you will surely find out.

1989.english: Say, “O my people, do your best, and I will do my best; you will surely find out.

verses.arabic: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
verses.transliterated: man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmu
verses.english: "(You will find out) who has incurred shameful punishment, and has deserved an eternal retribution."

1981.english: "(You will find out) which of us incurs humiliating retribution and abides in eternal suffering."

1989.english: “(You will find out) who has incurred shameful punishment, and has deserved an eternal retribution.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: إنا أنزلنا عليك الكتاب للناس بالحق ۖ فمن اهتدى فلنفسه ۖ ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها ۖ وما أنت عليهم بوكيل
verses.transliterated: innā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bil-ḥaqi famani ih'tadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīli
verses.english: We have revealed the scripture through you for the people, truthfully. Then, whoever is guided is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray goes astray to his own detriment. You are not their advocate.

1981.english: We have revealed to you the scripture for the people, bearing the truth. Thus, whoever is guided is guided for his own good, and if one goes astray, it is to his own detriment. You are not their advocate.

1989.english: We have revealed the scripture through you for the people, truthfully. Then, whoever is guided is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray goes astray to his own detriment. You are not their advocate.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله يتوفى الأنفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها ۖ فيمسك التي قضى عليها الموت ويرسل الأخرى إلى أجل مسمى ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu yatawaffā l-anfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-allatī lam tamut fī manāmihā fayum'siku allatī qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayur'silu l-ukh'rā ilā ajalin musamman inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verses.english: GOD puts the souls to death when the end of their life comes, and also at the time of sleep. Thus, He takes some back during their sleep, while others are allowed to continue living until the end of their predetermined interim. This should provide lessons for people who reflect.

1981.english: God puts the souls to rest at the time of death and at the time of sleep.* He seizes the one that is decreed to die, and lets the other one go until the predetermined time. These are lessons for people who reflect.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 14.

1989.english: GOD puts the souls to rest at the time of death, and at the time of sleep. Thus, while some are put to death during their sleep, others are allowed to continue living for a predetermined interim. This should provide lessons for people who reflect.

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم اتخذوا من دون الله شفعاء ۚ قل أولو كانوا لا يملكون شيئا ولا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: ami ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi shufaʿāa qul awalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: Have they invented intercessors to mediate between them and GOD? Say, "What if they do not possess any power, nor understanding?"
verses.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession

1981.english: Did they find intercessors besides God? Say, "Even though they possess no power, nor understanding?"

1989.english: Have they invented intercessors to mediate between them and GOD' Say, “What if they do not possess any power, nor understanding?”
1989.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل لله الشفاعة جميعا ۖ له ملك السماوات والأرض ۖ ثم إليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: qul lillahi l-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: Say, "All intercession belongs to GOD." To Him belongs all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you will be returned.

1981.english: Say, "All intercession belongs to God.* To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Him you will be returned."
1981.footnote: See Appendix 7. Neither Muhammad, nor Jesus, nor the saints, nor any idol possesses the power to intercede. All intercession belongs to God. See also 2:255, 6:51, 6:70, 10:3, 19:87, 22:28, 32:4, and 40:18.

1989.english: Say, “All intercession belongs to GOD.” To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا ذكر الله وحده اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة ۖ وإذا ذكر الذين من دونه إذا هم يستبشرون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā dhukira l-lahu waḥdahu ish'ma-azzat qulūbu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wa-idhā dhukira alladhīna min dūnihi idhā hum yastabshirūn
verses.english: When GOD ALONE is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion. But when others are mentioned beside Him, they become satisfied.
verses.subtitle: The Greatest Criterion
verses.footnote: Despite the clear commandment in 3:18 that the First Pillar of Submission is proclaiming: "Ash-hadu An Lã Elãha Ellã Allãh (there is no other god beside God)," the majority of "Muslims" insist upon adding the name of Muhammad. This Greatest Criterion alerts us that rejoicing in adding the name of Muhammad, or any other name, exposes disbelief in the Hereafter. See also Footnote 17:46.

1981.english: When God alone is advocated, the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter shrink with aversion. But when idols are mentioned besides Him, they rejoice.
1981.subtitle: The Great Criterion
1981.footnote: This is the classic test that shows us whether we really believe in the hereafter or simply deceive ourselves. A perfect example is footnote 39:44 above; those who disbelieve in the hereafter will dislike it. With many people, if you speak of God alone, they dislike you; but if you speak of God and Muhammad, e.g., Quran and **hadith**, they become happy and satisfied. This is characteristic of false Muslims, as we learn from this verse and from 6:112-116.

1989.english: When GOD ALONE is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion. But when others are mentioned besides Him, they rejoice.*
1989.subtitle: The Greatest Criterion
1989.footnote: Despite the clear commandment in 3:18 that the First Pillar of Islam ii proclaiming: “Ash-hadu An Laa Elaaha Ellaa Allah (there is no other god beside God),” the majority of “Muslims” insist upon adding the name of Muhammad. This Greatest Criterion alerts us that rejoicing in adding the name of Muhammad, or any other name, exposes disbelief in the Hereafter. See also Footnote 17:46.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل اللهم فاطر السماوات والأرض عالم الغيب والشهادة أنت تحكم بين عبادك في ما كانوا فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: quli l-lahuma fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi wal-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: Proclaim: "Our god, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations, You are the only One who judges among Your servants regarding their disputes."

1981.english: Say, "O God, initiator of the heavens and the earth, knower of all secrets and declarations; You alone judge Your servants regarding their differences."

1989.english: Say, “Our god, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations, You are the only One who judges among You servants regarding their disputes.”

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أن للذين ظلموا ما في الأرض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به من سوء العذاب يوم القيامة ۚ وبدا لهم من الله ما لم يكونوا يحتسبون
verses.transliterated: walaw anna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi min sūi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina l-lahi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūn
verses.english: If those who transgressed owned everything on earth, even twice as much, they would readily give it up to avoid the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection. They will be shown by GOD what they never expected.

1981.english: If the wrongdoers possessed everything on earth, and even twice as much, they will readily offer it to spare them the terrible retribution on the day of resurrection. They will find out from God what they never expected.

1989.english: If those who transgressed owned everything on earth, even twice as much, they would readily give it up to avoid the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection. They will be shown by GOD what they never expected.

verses.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وبدا لهم سيئات ما كسبوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: The sinful works they had earned will be shown to them, and the very things they used to mock will come back to haunt them.

1981.english: The evils they committed will become obvious to them, and the very things they had ridiculed will cause their doom.

1989.english: The sinful works they had earned will be shown to them, and the very things they used to mock will come back to haunt them.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا مس الإنسان ضر دعانا ثم إذا خولناه نعمة منا قال إنما أوتيته على علم ۚ بل هي فتنة ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma idhā khawwalnāhu niʿ'matan minnā qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min bal hiya fit'natun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: If the human is touched by adversity, he implores us, but as soon as we bestow a blessing upon him, he says, "I attained this because of my cleverness!" Indeed, this is only a test, but most of them do not know.
verses.subtitle: Human Fickleness

1981.english: When the human being is touched by adversity, he turns to us imploring; but when we bless him, he says, "I attained this through my cleverness." These are all tests, but most of them do not know.

1989.english: If the human is touched by adversity, he implores us, but as soon as we bestow a blessing upon him, he says, “I attained this because of my cleverness!” Indeed, this is only a test, but most of them do not know.
1989.subtitle: Human Fickleness

verses.arabic: قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قد قالها الذين من قبلهم فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: qad qālahā alladhīna min qablihim famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: Those before them have uttered the same thing, and their earnings did not help them in the least.

1981.english: Others before them have uttered the same. Consequently, the material they acquired never helped them.

1989.english: Those before them have uttered the same thing, but their earnings did not help them in the least.

verses.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأصابهم سيئات ما كسبوا ۚ والذين ظلموا من هؤلاء سيصيبهم سيئات ما كسبوا وما هم بمعجزين
verses.transliterated: fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā kasabū wa-alladhīna ẓalamū min hāulāi sayuṣībuhum sayyiātu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿ'jizīn
verses.english: They suffered the consequences of their evil works. Similarly, the transgressors among the present generation will suffer the consequences of their evil works; they cannot escape.

1981.english: They were doomed because of the evils they committed. Similarly, the wicked among this generation will be doomed for the evils they commit; they can never escape.

1989.english: They suffered the consequences of their evil works. Similarly, the transgressors among the present generation will suffer the consequences of their evil works; they cannot escape.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يعلموا أن الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: awalam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
verses.english: Do they not realize that GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses, and withholds? These are lessons for people who believe.

1981.english: Do they not realize that God is the one who increases the provision for anyone, or reduces? These are lessons for people who believe.

1989.english: Do they not realize that GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses, and withholds it? These are lessons for people who believe.

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قل يا عبادي الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله ۚ إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا ۚ إنه هو الغفور الرحيم
verses.transliterated: qul yāʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati l-lahi inna l-laha yaghfiru l-dhunūba jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīm
verses.english: Proclaim: "O My servants who exceeded the limits, never despair of GOD's mercy. For GOD forgives all sins. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful."
verses.subtitle: God's Infinite Mercy

1981.english: Say to My servants who exceeded the limits, "Never despair of God's mercy; God forgives all sins; for He is the forgiver, the merciful."
1981.subtitle: God Forgives All Sins
1981.footnote: According to Quran, idol worship is not a sin; it is a category by itself; it is the only unforgivable offense (see 4:48, 116 and 31:13). The whole purpose of our creation is to worship God ALONE and never idolize anything or anyone besides Him.

1989.english: Proclaim: “O My servants who exceeded the limits, never despair of GOD’s mercy. GOD forgives all sins. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”
1989.subtitle: God’s Infinite Mercy

verses.arabic: وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأنيبوا إلى ربكم وأسلموا له من قبل أن يأتيكم العذاب ثم لا تنصرون
verses.transliterated: wa-anībū ilā rabbikum wa-aslimū lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūn
verses.english: You shall obey your Lord, and submit to Him totally, before the retribution overtakes you, then you cannot be helped.

1981.english: You shall be obedient to your Lord and totally submit to Him, before the retribution comes to you, then you find out it is too late to be helped.

1989.english: You shall obey your Lord, and submit to Him totally, before the retribution overtakes you, then you cannot be helped.

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واتبعوا أحسن ما أنزل إليكم من ربكم من قبل أن يأتيكم العذاب بغتة وأنتم لا تشعرون
verses.transliterated: wa-ittabiʿū aḥsana mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu baghtatan wa-antum lā tashʿurūn
verses.english: And follow the best path that is pointed out for you by your Lord, before the retribution overtakes you suddenly when you least expect it.

1981.english: You shall uphold the honorable revelations from your Lord, before the retribution comes to you suddenly when you least expect it.

1989.english: And follow the best path that is pointed out for you by your Lord, before the retribution overtakes you suddenly when you least expect it.

verses.arabic: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أن تقول نفس يا حسرتى على ما فرطت في جنب الله وإن كنت لمن الساخرين
verses.transliterated: an taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fī janbi l-lahi wa-in kuntu lamina l-sākhirīn
verses.english: Lest a soul may say, "How sorry I am for disregarding GOD's commandments; I was certainly one of the mockers."

1981.english: Otherwise, you may say, "How miserable I am for being heedless of God, and for being one of the mockers."

1989.english: Lest a soul may say, “How sorry I am for disregarding GOD’s commandments; I was certainly one of the mockers.”

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أو تقول لو أن الله هداني لكنت من المتقين
verses.transliterated: aw taqūla law anna l-laha hadānī lakuntu mina l-mutaqīn
verses.english: Or say, "Had GOD guided me, I would have been with the righteous."

1981.english: Or say, "Had God guided me, I would have been righteous."

1989.english: Or say, “Had GOD guided me, I would have been with the righteous.”

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أو تقول حين ترى العذاب لو أن لي كرة فأكون من المحسنين
verses.transliterated: aw taqūla ḥīna tarā l-ʿadhāba law anna lī karratan fa-akūna mina l-muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Or say, when it sees the retribution, "If I get another chance, I will work righteousness."

1981.english: Or say when it sees the retribution, "If given another chance, I will be righteous."

1989.english: Or say, when it sees the retribution, “If I get another chance, I will work righteousness.”

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بلى قد جاءتك آياتي فكذبت بها واستكبرت وكنت من الكافرين
verses.transliterated: balā qad jāatka āyātī fakadhabta bihā wa-is'takbarta wakunta mina l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Yes indeed (you did get enough chances). My proofs came to you, but you rejected them, turned arrogant, and became a disbeliever.

1981.english: Indeed, My revelations had come to you, but you rejected them, you turned arrogant, and you became a disbeliever.

1989.english: Yes indeed (you did get enough chances). My revelations came to you, but you rejected them, turned arrogant, and were a disbeliever.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم القيامة ترى الذين كذبوا على الله وجوههم مسودة ۚ أليس في جهنم مثوى للمتكبرين
verses.transliterated: wayawma l-qiyāmati tarā alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā l-lahi wujūhuhum mus'waddatun alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'mutakabbirīn
verses.english: On the Day of Resurrection you will see the faces of those who lied about GOD covered with misery. Is Hell not the right retribution for the arrogant ones?

1981.english: On the day of resurrection, you will see the faces of those who lied about God darkened with misery.* Is hell not the right place for the arrogant?
1981.footnote: This is an Arabic proverb that has nothing to do with the color of the skin.

1989.english: On the Day of Resurrection you will see the faces of those who lied about GOD covered with misery. Is Hell not the right retribution for the arrogant ones?

verses.arabic: وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وينجي الله الذين اتقوا بمفازتهم لا يمسهم السوء ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: wayunajjī l-lahu alladhīna ittaqaw bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu l-sūu walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: And GOD will save those who have maintained righteousness; He will reward them. No harm will touch them, nor will they have any grief.

1981.english: God will save those who worked righteousness because of their fortunate decision. No harm will ever touch them, nor will they grieve.

1989.english: And GOD will save those who observed righteousness and will reward them. No harm will touch them, nor will they have any worries.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
verses.arabicClean: الله خالق كل شيء ۖ وهو على كل شيء وكيل
verses.transliterated: al-lahu khāliqu kulli shayin wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlu
verses.english: GOD is the Creator of all things, and He is in full control of all things.

1981.english: God is the creator of all things; in full control of all things.
1981.subtitle: God Alone Worthy of Worship

1989.english: GOD is the Creator of all things, and He is in full control of all things.

verses.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: له مقاليد السماوات والأرض ۗ والذين كفروا بآيات الله أولئك هم الخاسرون
verses.transliterated: lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūn
verses.english: To Him belongs all decisions in the heavens and the earth, and those who disbelieve in GOD's revelations are the real losers.

1981.english: To Him belongs all kingship in the heavens and the earth. Those who reject the revelations of God are losers.

1989.english: To Him belongs all decisions in the heavens and the earth, and those who disbelieve in GOD’s revelations are the real losers.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أفغير الله تأمروني أعبد أيها الجاهلون
verses.transliterated: qul afaghayra l-lahi tamurūnnī aʿbudu ayyuhā l-jāhilūn
verses.english: Say, "Is it other than GOD you exhort me to worship, O you ignorant ones?"

1981.english: Say, "Do you enjoin me to idolize others besides God, O you fools?"

1989.english: Say, “Is it other than GOD you exhort me to worship, O ignorant ones?”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أوحي إليك وإلى الذين من قبلك لئن أشركت ليحبطن عملك ولتكونن من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ūḥiya ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika la-in ashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: It has been revealed to you, and to those before you that if you ever commit idol worship, all your works will be nullified, and you will be with the losers.
verses.subtitle: Idol Worship Nullifies All Work

1981.english: It has been revealed to you (Muhammad), and to those before you, that if you ever fall into idol worship,* all your works will be nullified, and you will be a loser.
1981.footnote: The idols listed throughout Quran include the prophets, saints, representations (statues), spouses, children, and material possessions.

1989.english: It has been revealed to you, and to those before you that if you ever commit idol worship, all your works will be nullified, and you will be with the losers.
1989.subtitle: Idol Worship Nullifies All Work

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: بل الله فاعبد وكن من الشاكرين
verses.transliterated: bali l-laha fa-uʿ'bud wakun mina l-shākirīn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall worship GOD alone, and be appreciative.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall worship God alone, and be thankful.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall worship GOD alone, and be appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما قدروا الله حق قدره والأرض جميعا قبضته يوم القيامة والسماوات مطويات بيمينه ۚ سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون
verses.transliterated: wamā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi wal-arḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma l-qiyāmati wal-samāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.english: They can never fathom the greatness of GOD. The whole earth is within His fist on the Day of Resurrection. In fact, the universes are folded within His right hand. Be He glorified; He is much too high above needing any partners.
verses.subtitle: Greatness of God
verses.footnote: Our universe, with its billion galaxies, a billion trillion stars, uncountable decillions of heavenly bodies, spanning many billions of light-years, is the smallest and innermost of seven universes. This incomprehensible vastness of the seven universes is within God's hand. Such is the greatness of God. See Appendix 6.

1981.english: They never valued God as He should be valued. The whole earth is within His fist on the day of resurrection, and the heavens are folded in His right hand. God be glorified; He is the most high, far above any idols.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 5.

1989.english: They can never fathom the greatness of GOD. The whole earth is within His fist on the Day of Resurrection. In fact, the universes are folded within His right hand.* Be He glorified; He is much too high above needing any partners.
1989.subtitle: Greatness of God
1989.footnote: Our universe, with its billion galaxies, a billion trillion stars, uncountable decillions of heavenly bodies, spanning many billions of light-years, is the smallest and innermost of seven universes. This incomprehensible vastness of the seven universes k within God’s hand. Such is the greatness of God. See Appendix 6.

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ونفخ في الصور فصعق من في السماوات ومن في الأرض إلا من شاء الله ۖ ثم نفخ فيه أخرى فإذا هم قيام ينظرون
verses.transliterated: wanufikha fī l-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu thumma nufikha fīhi ukh'rā fa-idhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūn
verses.english: The horn will be blown, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth will be struck unconscious, except those who will be spared by GOD. Then it will be blown another time, whereupon they will all rise up, looking.
verses.subtitle: The Day of Judgment
verses.footnote: The sequence of events on the Day of Resurrection begins with the symbolic blowing of the horn. The second blowing of the horn—by a creature who was spared from unconsciousness—marks the resurrection of all people; they will be resurrected on today's earth. This earth will then be destroyed by the physical coming of God, then a new earth and new heavens will be created (14:48). We will then be stratified according to our degree of development (Appendix 11).

1981.english: The horn was* blown, and everyone in the heavens and the earth, except whomever God willed, was struck dead. Then it was blown another time, whereupon they were all up, looking.
1981.subtitle: The Day Of Resurrection
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they narrate events that actually did take place in the future -- our future. As far as God is concerned, our future is past, since the dimension of time does not apply to the almighty. See Appendix 10.

1989.english: The horn is blown, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth is struck dead, except those whom GOD wills. Then it is blown again, whereupon they rise up, looking.
1989.subtitle: The Day of Judgment

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأشرقت الأرض بنور ربها ووضع الكتاب وجيء بالنبيين والشهداء وقضي بينهم بالحق وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: wa-ashraqati l-arḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu wajīa bil-nabiyīna wal-shuhadāi waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: Then the earth will shine with the light of its Lord. The record will be proclaimed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought forth. Everyone will then be judged equitably, without the least injustice.

1981.english: The earth then shined with the light of its Lord. The record was set up, the prophets and the witnesses were brought, and everyone was judged equitably. No one was wronged.

1989.english: Then the earth shines with the light of its Lord. The record is presented, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought forth. Then everyone is judged equitably, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ووفيت كل نفس ما عملت وهو أعلم بما يفعلون
verses.transliterated: wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahuwa aʿlamu bimā yafʿalūn
verses.english: Every soul will be paid for whatever it did, for He is fully aware of everything they have done.

1981.english: Everyone was then repaid for their works, for God is fully aware of everything they did.

1989.english: Every soul is paid for whatever it did. He is fully aware of everything they have done.

verses.arabic: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وسيق الذين كفروا إلى جهنم زمرا ۖ حتى إذا جاءوها فتحت أبوابها وقال لهم خزنتها ألم يأتكم رسل منكم يتلون عليكم آيات ربكم وينذرونكم لقاء يومكم هذا ۚ قالوا بلى ولكن حقت كلمة العذاب على الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wasīqa alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā futiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatlūna ʿalaykum āyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāa yawmikum hādhā qālū balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verses.english: Those who disbelieved will be led to Hell in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, "Did you not receive messengers from among you, who recited to you the revelations of your Lord, and warned you about meeting this day?" They will answer, "Yes indeed. But the word 'retribution' was already stamped upon the disbelievers."
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: Those who disbelieved were herded to hell in throngs. When they arrived, and the gates thereof were opened, the guardians of hell said to them, "Did you not receive messengers from among you who recited the revelations of your Lord and warned you about this day?" They said, "Yes, indeed, but the word of doom had been decreed against the disbelievers."

1989.english: Those who disbelieved are led to Hell in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, “Did you not receive messengers from among you, who recited to you the revelations of your Lord, and warned you about meeting this day?” They will answer, “Yes. But the word ‘retribution’ was already stamped upon the disbelievers.”
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers

verses.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قيل ادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فبئس مثوى المتكبرين
verses.transliterated: qīla ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīn
verses.english: It will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever." What a miserable destiny for the arrogant.

1981.english: It was said, "Enter the gates of hell, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable abode for the arrogant!"

1989.english: It will be said, “Enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever.” What a miserable destiny for the arrogant.

verses.arabic: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وسيق الذين اتقوا ربهم إلى الجنة زمرا ۖ حتى إذا جاءوها وفتحت أبوابها وقال لهم خزنتها سلام عليكم طبتم فادخلوها خالدين
verses.transliterated: wasīqa alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum ilā l-janati zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā wafutiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭib'tum fa-ud'khulūhā khālidīn
verses.english: Those who reverenced their Lord will be led to Paradise in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, "Peace be upon you; you have won. Therefore, you abide herein forever."
verses.subtitle: The Believers

1981.english: As for those who had observed their Lord, they were led to Paradise in throngs. When they arrived, and the gates were opened, the guardians of heaven said, "Peace be upon you. You are the fortunate ones. Enter therein forever."

1989.english: Those who reverenced their Lord will be led to Paradise in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, “Peace be upon you; you have won. Therefore, you abide herein forever.”
1989.subtitle: The Believers

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا الحمد لله الذي صدقنا وعده وأورثنا الأرض نتبوأ من الجنة حيث نشاء ۖ فنعم أجر العاملين
verses.transliterated: waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī ṣadaqanā waʿdahu wa-awrathanā l-arḍa natabawwa-u mina l-janati ḥaythu nashāu faniʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīn
verses.english: They will say, "Praise be to GOD, who fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the earth, enjoying Paradise as we please." What a beautiful recompense for the workers!

1981.english: They said, "Praise be to God, who fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the earth and enjoy Paradise as we please." What a beautiful reward for the workers!

1989.english: They will say, “Praise be to GOD, who fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the earth, enjoying Paradise as we please.” What a beautiful recompense for the workers!

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وترى الملائكة حافين من حول العرش يسبحون بحمد ربهم ۖ وقضي بينهم بالحق وقيل الحمد لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: watarā l-malāikata ḥāffīna min ḥawli l-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi waqīla l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: You will see the angels floating around the throne, glorifying and praising their Lord. After the equitable judgment is issued to all, it will be proclaimed: "Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe."

1981.english: You will see the angels floating around the throne, glorifying and praising their Lord. Judgment has been issued among the people equitably; they will all declare, "Praise be to God, Lord of the universe."

1989.english: You will see the angels floating around the throne, glorifying and praising their Lord. After the equitable judgment is issued to all, it is proclaimed: “Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.”

verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم حم
verses.transliterated: hha-meem
verses.english: H. M.
verses.footnote: The initials "Hã Mîm" occur in Suras 40-46. The total frequency of occurrence of the letters "Hã" and "Mîm" in the seven suras is 2147, or 19x113 (Appendix 1).

1981.english: H.M.
1981.footnote: These two Quranic initials occur in the next seven consecutive suras. The frequency of occurrence of the letter "H" in the seven suras is 280, and the frequency of occurrence of the letter "M" in the seven suras is 1829; making the total occurrence of the two letters 2109, a multiple of 19. Thus, like all Quranic initials, these two letters conform to the miraculous numerical code of Quran. (See Appendix 1.)

1989.english: H. M.*
1989.footnote: The initials “Haa Meem” occur in Suras 40-46. The total frequency of occurrence of the letters “Haa” and “Meem” in the seven suras is 2147, or 19x113 (Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز العليم
verses.transliterated: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīm
verses.english: This revelation of the scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, the Omniscient.

1981.english: (These two letters prove that) the revelation of this scripture is from God, the almighty, the omniscient.

1989.english: This revelation of the scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, the Omniscient.

verses.arabic: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: غافر الذنب وقابل التوب شديد العقاب ذي الطول ۖ لا إله إلا هو ۖ إليه المصير
verses.transliterated: ghāfiri l-dhanbi waqābili l-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī l-ṭawli lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīr
verses.english: Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, strict in enforcing retribution, and possessor of all power. There is no other god beside Him. To Him is the ultimate destiny.

1981.english: Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, strict in imposing retribution, and most powerful; there is no god but He; to Him is the final destiny.

1989.english: Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, strict in enforcing retribution, and possessor of all power. There is no other god besides Him. To Him is the ultimate destiny.

verses.arabic: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verses.arabicClean: ما يجادل في آيات الله إلا الذين كفروا فلا يغررك تقلبهم في البلاد
verses.transliterated: mā yujādilu fī āyāti l-lahi illā alladhīna kafarū falā yaghrur'ka taqallubuhum fī l-bilād
verses.english: None argues against GOD's revelations except those who disbelieve. Do not be impressed by their apparent success.

1981.english: None argues against the revelations of God except those who disbelieve; do not be deceived by their apparent success in this world.

1989.english: None argues against GOD’s revelations except those who disbelieve. Do not be impressed by their apparent success.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح والأحزاب من بعدهم ۖ وهمت كل أمة برسولهم ليأخذوه ۖ وجادلوا بالباطل ليدحضوا به الحق فأخذتهم ۖ فكيف كان عقاب
verses.transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wal-aḥzābu min baʿdihim wahammat kullu ummatin birasūlihim liyakhudhūhu wajādalū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa fa-akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna ʿiqāb
verses.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, and many other opponents after them. Every community persecuted their messenger to neutralize him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat the truth. Consequently, I punished them; how terrible was My retribution!

1981.english: Rebelling before them were the people of Noah and communities after them. Every generation persecuted their messenger, seeking to neutralize him, and they argued with falsehood to make it dominate the truth. But I overtook them; how terrible was My retribution!

1989.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, and many parties after them. Every community attack ed their messenger to neutralize him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat the truth. Consequently, I punished them; how terrible was My retribution!

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك حقت كلمت ربك على الذين كفروا أنهم أصحاب النار
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna kafarū annahum aṣḥābu l-nār
verses.english: Thus, the judgment of your Lord is already stamped upon those who disbelieve, that they are the dwellers of Hell.

1981.english: Thus, the word of your Lord is predetermined that the disbelievers have deserved hell.

1989.english: Thus, the word of your Lord is already stamped upon those who disbelieve, that they are the dwellers of Hell.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يحملون العرش ومن حوله يسبحون بحمد ربهم ويؤمنون به ويستغفرون للذين آمنوا ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمة وعلما فاغفر للذين تابوا واتبعوا سبيلك وقهم عذاب الجحيم
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yaḥmilūna l-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayu'minūna bihi wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanū rabbanā wasiʿ'ta kulla shayin raḥmatan waʿil'man fa-igh'fir lilladhīna tābū wa-ittabaʿū sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verses.english: Those who serve the throne and all those around it glorify and praise their Lord, and believe in Him. And they ask forgiveness for those who believe: "Our Lord, Your mercy and Your knowledge encompass all things. Forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and spare them the retribution of Hell.
verses.subtitle: Angels Pray for the Believers

1981.english: Those who serve the throne, and all those around it, praise the glory of their Lord, and believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for those who believe. "Our Lord, Your mercy and knowledge encompass all things. Therefore, forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and spare them the agony of hell.
1981.subtitle: Believers Enjoy The Privilege Of Forgiveness

1989.english: Those who serve the throne and all those around it glorify and praise their Lord, and believe in Him. And they ask forgiveness for those who believed: “Our Lord, Your mercy and Your knowledge encompass all things. Forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and spare them the retribution of Hell.
1989.subtitle: Angels Pray for the Believers

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا وأدخلهم جنات عدن التي وعدتهم ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم ۚ إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: rabbanā wa-adkhil'hum jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: "Our Lord, and admit them into the gardens of Eden that You promised for them and for the righteous among their parents, spouses, and children. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: "Our Lord, admit them into the gardens of Eden that You promised for them and the righteous among their ancestors, their spouses, and their descendants. You are the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: “Our Lord, and admit them into the gardens of Eden that You promised for them and for the righteous among their parents, spouses, and children. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وقهم السيئات ۚ ومن تق السيئات يومئذ فقد رحمته ۚ وذلك هو الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: waqihimu l-sayiāti waman taqi l-sayiāti yawma-idhin faqad raḥim'tahu wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: "And protect them from falling in sin. Whomever You protect from falling in sin, on that day, has attained mercy from You. This is the greatest triumph."

1981.english: "And protect them from falling in sin; whomever You protect from sin, You have endowed with mercy on that day. This is the great triumph."

1989.english: “And protect them from sins, whomever You protect from sins has attained mercy from You. This is the great triumph.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا ينادون لمقت الله أكبر من مقتكم أنفسكم إذ تدعون إلى الإيمان فتكفرون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū yunādawna lamaqtu l-lahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'ʿawna ilā l-īmāni fatakfurūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieve will be told, "GOD's abhorrence towards you is even worse than your own abhorrence towards yourselves. For you were invited to believe, but you chose to disbelieve."
verses.subtitle: God ALONE: The Disbelievers Confess

1981.english: Those who disbelieved will be told, "God's abhorrence towards you is even greater than your abhorrence towards yourselves; because you were invited to belief, but you chose to disbelieve."
1981.subtitle: Worship God ALONE

1989.english: Those who disbelieved will be told, “GOD’s abhorrence towards you is even worse than your own abhorrence towards yourselves. For you were invited to believe, and you decided to disbelieve.”
1989.subtitle: God ALONE
