verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا ربنا أمتنا اثنتين وأحييتنا اثنتين فاعترفنا بذنوبنا فهل إلى خروج من سبيل
verses.transliterated: qālū rabbanā amattanā ith'natayni wa-aḥyaytanā ith'natayni fa-iʿ'tarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ilā khurūjin min sabīli
verses.english: They will say, "Our Lord, you have put us to death twice, and You gave us two lives; now we have confessed our sins. Is there any way out?"
verses.subtitle: God ALONE: The Disbelievers Suffer Two Deaths
verses.footnote: The disbelievers go through two deaths, while the righteous believers do not taste death, beyond the death we already experienced (44:56). Please see Appendix 17. The reason for going to Hell is obvious; even those who believe in God associate others with Him (see 39:45).

1981.english: They will say, "Our Lord, you have given us two deaths and two lives;* we now confess our sins. Is there any way out?"
1981.footnote: We were dead, then brought into this life, then we die, then we get resurrected for the eternal life of the hereafter. (See 2:28).

1989.english: They will say, “Our Lord, you have given us two deaths and two lives; now we have confessed our sins. Is there any way out?” The Reason

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم بأنه إذا دعي الله وحده كفرتم ۖ وإن يشرك به تؤمنوا ۚ فالحكم لله العلي الكبير
verses.transliterated: dhālikum bi-annahu idhā duʿiya l-lahu waḥdahu kafartum wa-in yush'rak bihi tu'minū fal-ḥuk'mu lillahi l-ʿaliyi l-kabīr
verses.english: This is because when GOD ALONE was advocated, you disbelieved, but when others were mentioned beside Him, you believed. Therefore, GOD's judgment has been issued; He is the Most High, the Great.
verses.subtitle: God ALONE: Note the Reason

1981.english: This is because when invited to worship God alone, you disbelieved, but when idols were mentioned besides Him, you believed.* Alas, the judgment has been decreed by God, the most exalted, the great.
1981.footnote: This is exactly what the majority of "Muslims" have fallen in. Thus, if you ask them to worship God alone, i.e., uphold the Quran alone, they disbelieve. But when you mention God and Muhammad, i.e., the Quran and "**hadith**," they believe. (See 5:22).

1989.english: This is because when GOD ALONE was advocated, you disbelieved, but when others were mentioned besides Him, you believed. Therefore, GOD’s judgment has been issued; He is the Most High the Great.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي يريكم آياته وينزل لكم من السماء رزقا ۚ وما يتذكر إلا من ينيب
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī yurīkum āyātihi wayunazzilu lakum mina l-samāi riz'qan wamā yatadhakkaru illā man yunīb
verses.english: He is the One who continuously shows you His proofs, and sends down to you from the sky provisions. Only those who totally submit will be able to take heed.

1981.english: He continuously shows you His signs, and sends down from the sky provisions for you. Only those who submit will take heed.

1989.english: He is the One who continuously shows you His signs, and sends down to you from the sky provisions. Only those who totally submit will be able to take heed.

verses.arabic: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فادعوا الله مخلصين له الدين ولو كره الكافرون
verses.transliterated: fa-id'ʿū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall devote your worship absolutely to GOD ALONE, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall worship God, devoting your worship absolutely to Him alone, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall devote your worship absolutely to GOD alone, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

verses.arabic: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
verses.arabicClean: رفيع الدرجات ذو العرش يلقي الروح من أمره على من يشاء من عباده لينذر يوم التلاق
verses.transliterated: rafīʿu l-darajāti dhū l-ʿarshi yul'qī l-rūḥa min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi liyundhira yawma l-talāq
verses.english: Possessor of the highest ranks, and Ruler of the whole dominion. He sends inspiration, bearing His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants, to warn about the Day of Summoning.

1981.english: He is the grantor of the high ranks; the possessor of all authority. He dispatches inspiration to whomever He chooses among His servants, in order to warn about the day of audience.

1989.english: Possessor of the highest ranks, and Ruler of the whole dominion. He sends inspiration, bearing His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants, to warn about the Day of Gathering.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم هم بارزون ۖ لا يخفى على الله منهم شيء ۚ لمن الملك اليوم ۖ لله الواحد القهار
verses.transliterated: yawma hum bārizūna lā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min'hum shayon limani l-mul'ku l-yawma lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahār
verses.english: That is the day when everyone will be completely exposed; none of them will hide anything from GOD. To whom belongs all sovereignty on that day? To GOD, the One, the Supreme.

1981.english: That is the day when all will be exposed; nothing of them will be hidden from God. To whom does kingship belong on that day? To God alone; the one; the most powerful.

1989.english: That is the day when they will be completely exposed; none of them will hide anything from GOD. To whom belongs all kingship on that day? To GOD, the One, the Supreme.

verses.arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: اليوم تجزى كل نفس بما كسبت ۚ لا ظلم اليوم ۚ إن الله سريع الحساب
verses.transliterated: al-yawma tuj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat lā ẓul'ma l-yawma inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisāb
verses.english: On that day, every soul will be requited for whatever it had earned. There will be no injustice on that day. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.
verses.subtitle: Prepare for the Big Day

1981.english: On that day, every soul will be paid for whatever it did. No injustice on that day. God's reckoning is quick.
1981.footnote: The reckoning on the day of judgment will be instantaneous and automatic. See Appendix 10.

1989.english: On that day, every soul will be paid for whatever it earned. There will be no injustice on that day. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.
1989.subtitle: Prepare for the Big Day

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ
verses.arabicClean: وأنذرهم يوم الآزفة إذ القلوب لدى الحناجر كاظمين ۚ ما للظالمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع
verses.transliterated: wa-andhir'hum yawma l-āzifati idhi l-qulūbu ladā l-ḥanājiri kāẓimīna mā lilẓẓālimīna min ḥamīmin walā shafīʿin yuṭāʿ
verses.english: Warn them about the imminent day, when the hearts will be terrified, and many will be remorseful. The transgressors will have no friend nor an intercessor to be obeyed.
verses.subtitle: No Intercession

1981.english: Warn them about the inevitable day, when the hearts will be terrified and helpless. The wicked will have no friend or intercessor to be obeyed.

1989.english: Warn them about the imminent day, when the hearts will be terrified, and the transgressors will be remorseful. They will have no friend nor an intercessor to be obeyed.

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ
verses.arabicClean: يعلم خائنة الأعين وما تخفي الصدور
verses.transliterated: yaʿlamu khāinata l-aʿyuni wamā tukh'fī l-ṣudūr
verses.english: He is fully aware of what the eyes cannot see, and everything that the minds conceal.

1981.english: He knows what the eyes cannot see and what the chest hides.

1989.english: He is fully aware of what the eyes cannot see, and everything that the minds conceal.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: والله يقضي بالحق ۖ والذين يدعون من دونه لا يقضون بشيء ۗ إن الله هو السميع البصير
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishayin inna l-laha huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīr
verses.english: GOD judges equitably, while the idols they implore beside Him cannot judge anything. GOD is the One who is the Hearer, the Seer.

1981.english: And God judges equitably, while the idols they set up possess no power to judge anything. God is the hearer, the seer.

1989.english: And GOD judges equitably, while the idols they worship besides Him cannot judge anything. GOD is the One who is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين كانوا من قبلهم ۚ كانوا هم أشد منهم قوة وآثارا في الأرض فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم وما كان لهم من الله من واق
verses.transliterated: awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna kānū min qablihim kānū hum ashadda min'hum quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mina l-lahi min wāqi
verses.english: Did they not roam the earth and note the consequences for those before them? They used to be stronger than they, and more productive on earth. But GOD punished them for their sins, and nothing could protect them from GOD.

1981.english: Did they not travel the earth and find out about the generations before them? They were even stronger and left a greater legacy. But God punished them for their sins, and nothing could protect them from God.

1989.english: Did they not roam the earth and note the consequences for those before them? They used to be stronger than they, and more productive on earth. But GOD punished them for their sins, and nothing could protect them from GOD.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم كانت تأتيهم رسلهم بالبينات فكفروا فأخذهم الله ۚ إنه قوي شديد العقاب
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahum kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti fakafarū fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu innahu qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqāb
verses.english: That is because their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved. Consequently, GOD punished them. He is Mighty, strict in enforcing retribution.

1981.english: That is because their messengers used to go to them with profound revelations, but they disbelieved. Consequently, God punished them, for He is powerful, most strict in imposing retribution.

1989.english: That is because their messengers went to them with clear signs, but they disbelieved. Consequently, GOD punished them. He is Mighty, strict in enforcing retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا وسلطان مبين
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīni
verses.english: We sent Moses with our signs and a profound authority.
verses.subtitle: Moses

1981.english: We sent Moses with our miracles and manifest authority.
1981.subtitle: Moses

1989.english: We sent Moses with our signs and profound authority.
1989.subtitle: Moses

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُوا۟ سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: إلى فرعون وهامان وقارون فقالوا ساحر كذاب
verses.transliterated: ilā fir'ʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālū sāḥirun kadhābu
verses.english: To Pharaoh, Hãmãn, and Qãroon. But they said, "A magician; a liar."

1981.english: To Pharaoh, Haamaan, and Qaaroon. But they said, "A magician; a liar."

1989.english: To Pharaoh, Haamaan, and Qaaroon. But they said, “A magician; a liar.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاءهم بالحق من عندنا قالوا اقتلوا أبناء الذين آمنوا معه واستحيوا نساءهم ۚ وما كيد الكافرين إلا في ضلال
verses.transliterated: falammā jāahum bil-ḥaqi min ʿindinā qālū uq'tulū abnāa alladhīna āmanū maʿahu wa-is'taḥyū nisāahum wamā kaydu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāli
verses.english: And when he showed them the truth from us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who believed with him, and spare their daughters." Thus, the scheming of the disbelievers is always wicked.

1981.english: And when he showed them the truth from us, they said, "Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their daughters." Thus, the schemes of the disbelievers are always evil.

1989.english: And when he showed them the truth from us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who believed with him, and spare their daughters.” Thus, the scheming of the disbelievers is always evil.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْفَسَادَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال فرعون ذروني أقتل موسى وليدع ربه ۖ إني أخاف أن يبدل دينكم أو أن يظهر في الأرض الفساد
verses.transliterated: waqāla fir'ʿawnu dharūnī aqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbahu innī akhāfu an yubaddila dīnakum aw an yuẓ'hira fī l-arḍi l-fasād
verses.english: Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses, and let him implore his Lord. I worry lest he corrupts your religion, or spreads evil throughout the land."
verses.subtitle: Moses vs Pharaoh

1981.english: Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses, and let him implore his Lord. I fear lest he alters your religion or spreads corruption on earth."

1989.english: Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Moses, and let him implore his Lord. I worry lest he corrupts your religion, or spreads evil throughout the land.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وقال موسى إني عذت بربي وربكم من كل متكبر لا يؤمن بيوم الحساب
verses.transliterated: waqāla mūsā innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin lā yu'minu biyawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.english: Moses said, "I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning."

1981.english: Moses said, "I seek refuge in my Lord, and your Lord, from the arrogant who disbelieves in the day of reckoning."

1989.english: Moses said, “I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقال رجل مؤمن من آل فرعون يكتم إيمانه أتقتلون رجلا أن يقول ربي الله وقد جاءكم بالبينات من ربكم ۖ وإن يك كاذبا فعليه كذبه ۖ وإن يك صادقا يصبكم بعض الذي يعدكم ۖ إن الله لا يهدي من هو مسرف كذاب
verses.transliterated: waqāla rajulun mu'minun min āli fir'ʿawna yaktumu īmānahu ataqtulūna rajulan an yaqūla rabbiya l-lahu waqad jāakum bil-bayināti min rabbikum wa-in yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuhu wa-in yaku ṣādiqan yuṣib'kum baʿḍu alladhī yaʿidukum inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa mus'rifun kadhābu
verses.english: A believing man among Pharaoh's people, who was concealing his belief, said, "How can you kill a man just for saying, 'My Lord is GOD,' and he has shown you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, that is his problem, and if he is truthful, you benefit from his promises. Surely, GOD does not guide any transgressor, liar.
verses.subtitle: God Guides Not the Liars

1981.english: A believing man among Pharaoh's people who was hiding his belief said, "Do you want to kill a man just for saying, 'My Lord is God,' despite the miracles he showed you from your Lord? If he is a liar, that is his problem. But if he is truthful, then you benefit from the promises he had given you. God does not guide any transgressor, liar.

1989.english: A believing man among Pharaoh’s people, who was concealing his belief, said, “How can you kill a man just for saying, ‘My Lord is GOD,’ and he showed you clear signs from your Lord? If he is a liar, that is his problem, and if he is truthful, you benefit from his prophecies. Surely, GOD does not guide any transgressor, liar.

verses.arabic: يَٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَا قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
verses.arabicClean: يا قوم لكم الملك اليوم ظاهرين في الأرض فمن ينصرنا من بأس الله إن جاءنا ۚ قال فرعون ما أريكم إلا ما أرى وما أهديكم إلا سبيل الرشاد
verses.transliterated: yāqawmi lakumu l-mul'ku l-yawma ẓāhirīna fī l-arḍi faman yanṣurunā min basi l-lahi in jāanā qāla fir'ʿawnu mā urīkum illā mā arā wamā ahdīkum illā sabīla l-rashād
verses.english: "O my people, today you have kingship and the upperhand. But who will help us against GOD's judgment, should it come to us?" Pharaoh said, "You are to follow only what I see fit; I will guide you only in the right path."

1981.english: "My people, today you have kingship and dominance on earth. But who will support us against God's doom if it comes?" Pharaoh said, "You shall follow only what I point out for you; I guide you in the right path."

1989.english: “O my people, today you have kingship and the upperhand. But who will help us against GOD’s judgment, should it come to us?” Pharaoh said, “You are to follow whatever I see fit; I will guide you in the right path.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذي آمن يا قوم إني أخاف عليكم مثل يوم الأحزاب
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum mith'la yawmi l-aḥzāb
verses.english: The one who believed said, "O my people, I fear for you the same fate as the previous opponents.

1981.english: The one who believed said, "My people, I fear for you a day like the days of the parties;

1989.english: The one who believed said, “O my people, I fear for you the same fate as the previous parties.

verses.arabic: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: مثل دأب قوم نوح وعاد وثمود والذين من بعدهم ۚ وما الله يريد ظلما للعباد
verses.transliterated: mith'la dabi qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-alladhīna min baʿdihim wamā l-lahu yurīdu ẓul'man lil'ʿibād
verses.english: "The opponents of Noah, and 'Ãd, Thamûd, and others who came after them. GOD does not wish any injustice for the people.

1981.english: "like the example of Noah's people, 'Aad, Thamood, and those after them. God does not wish any hardship for the people.

1989.english: “The parties of Noah, ‘Aad, Thamoud, and others who came after them. GOD does not wish any injustice for the people.

verses.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
verses.arabicClean: ويا قوم إني أخاف عليكم يوم التناد
verses.transliterated: wayāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum yawma l-tanād
verses.english: "O my people, I fear for you the Day of Summoning.

1981.english: "O my people, I fear for you the day of summoning.

1989.english: “O my people, I fear for you the Day of Summoning.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تولون مدبرين ما لكم من الله من عاصم ۗ ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
verses.transliterated: yawma tuwallūna mud'birīna mā lakum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādi
verses.english: "That is the day when you may wish to turn around and flee. But nothing will protect you then from GOD. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him."

1981.english: "That is the day when you will flee, but you will have no protector from God. Whomever God sends astray will have no guide.

1989.english: “That is the day when you turn around and flee. But nothing will protect you from GOD. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد جاءكم يوسف من قبل بالبينات فما زلتم في شك مما جاءكم به ۖ حتى إذا هلك قلتم لن يبعث الله من بعده رسولا ۚ كذلك يضل الله من هو مسرف مرتاب
verses.transliterated: walaqad jāakum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayināti famā zil'tum fī shakkin mimmā jāakum bihi ḥattā idhā halaka qul'tum lan yabʿatha l-lahu min baʿdihi rasūlan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man huwa mus'rifun mur'tābu
verses.english: Joseph had come to you before that with clear revelations, but you continued to doubt his message. Then, when he died you said, "GOD will not send any other messenger after him. (He was the last messenger)!" GOD thus sends astray those who are transgressors, doubtful.
verses.subtitle: Who is the Last Messenger?* A Tragic Human Trait
verses.footnote:
The Jews refused to believe in the Messiah when he came to them, the Christians refused to believe in Muhammad when he came to them, and a majority of today's Muslims believe that Muhammad was the last messenger. On that erroneous basis, they refused to accept God's Messenger of the Covenant. We learn from 3:81-90 and 33:7 that those who fail to accept the Quranic injunction to "believe in and support God's Messenger of the Covenant" are no longer believers. See Appendices 2 & 26.

±±40:34 It is noteworthy that we find the name "Rashad" in the Arabic text precisely four verses ahead of the injunction against saying "the last messenger," and also four verses after it.

1981.english: "Joseph had come to you with clear signs, but you continued to doubt his message. When he died, you said, 'God will not send another messenger after him.'" God thus misguides the transgressors, the doubtful.

1989.english: Joseph had come to you in the past with clear signs, but you continued to doubt his message. And when he died you said, “GOD will not send any messenger after him. (He was the last messenger)!” GOD thus sends astray those who are transgressors, doubtful.*
1989.footnote: The Jews refused to believe in the Messiah when he came to them, the Christians refused to believe in Muhammad when he came, and a majority of today's Muslims believe that Muhammad was the last messenger. On that erroneous basis, they refused to accept God’s Messenger of the Covenant We learn from 3:81-90 and 33:1 that those who fail to accept the Quranic injunction to “believe in and support God’s messenger of the covenant” are no longer believers. See Appendices 2 & 26.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
verses.arabicClean: الذين يجادلون في آيات الله بغير سلطان أتاهم ۖ كبر مقتا عند الله وعند الذين آمنوا ۚ كذلك يطبع الله على كل قلب متكبر جبار
verses.transliterated: alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda alladhīna āmanū kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbāri
verses.english: They argue against GOD's revelations, without any basis. This is a trait that is most abhorred by GOD and by those who believe. GOD thus seals the hearts of every arrogant tyrant.

1981.english: For they dispute the revelations of God without any basis. This is abhorred by God and those who believe. God thus seals the hearts of every arrogant tyrant.

1989.english: They argue against GOD’s revelations, without any basis. This is a trait that is most abhorred by GOD and by those who believe. GOD thus seals the hearts of every arrogant oppressor.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبْنِ لِى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَبْلُغُ ٱلْأَسْبَٰبَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال فرعون يا هامان ابن لي صرحا لعلي أبلغ الأسباب
verses.transliterated: waqāla fir'ʿawnu yāhāmānu ib'ni lī ṣarḥan laʿallī ablughu l-asbāb
verses.english: Pharaoh said, "O Hãmãn, build for me a high tower, that I may reach out and discover.

1981.english: Pharaoh said, "O Haamaan, build for me a tower, that I may reach high.

1989.english: Pharaoh said, “O Haamaan, build for me a high tower, that I may reach out and discover.

verses.arabic: أَسْبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبًا وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: أسباب السماوات فأطلع إلى إله موسى وإني لأظنه كاذبا ۚ وكذلك زين لفرعون سوء عمله وصد عن السبيل ۚ وما كيد فرعون إلا في تباب
verses.transliterated: asbāba l-samāwāti fa-aṭṭaliʿa ilā ilāhi mūsā wa-innī la-aẓunnuhu kādhiban wakadhālika zuyyina lifir'ʿawna sūu ʿamalihi waṣudda ʿani l-sabīli wamā kaydu fir'ʿawna illā fī tabābi
verses.english: "I want to reach the heaven, and take a look at the god of Moses. I believe he is a liar." Thus were the evil works of Pharaoh adorned in his eyes, and thus was he kept from following (the right) path. Pharaoh's scheming was truly evil.

1981.english: "The height of the heavens, that I may look at the God of Moses. I think he is a liar." Thus was the evil work of Pharaoh adorned in his eyes, and he was thus prevented from following the path. Pharaoh's schemes were condemned.

1989.english: “I want to reach the heaven, and take a look at the god of Moses. I believe he is a liar.” Thus were the evil works of Pharaoh adorned in his eyes, and thus was he diverted from the path. Pharaoh’s scheming was truly evil.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذي آمن يا قوم اتبعون أهدكم سبيل الرشاد
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi ittabiʿūni ahdikum sabīla l-rashād
verses.english: The one who believed said, "O my people, follow me, and I will guide you in the right way.

1981.english: The one who believed said, "My people, follow me and I will guide you in the right path.

1989.english: The one who believed said, “O my people, follow me, and I will guide you in the right way.

verses.arabic: يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَٰعٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ
verses.arabicClean: يا قوم إنما هذه الحياة الدنيا متاع وإن الآخرة هي دار القرار
verses.transliterated: yāqawmi innamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā matāʿun wa-inna l-ākhirata hiya dāru l-qarār
verses.english: "O my people, this first life is a temporary illusion, while the Hereafter is the eternal abode."

1981.english: "O my people, this life is only temporary; while the hereafter is the eternal abode.

1989.english: “O my people, this first life is a temporary existence, while the Hereafter is the eternal abode.”

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: من عمل سيئة فلا يجزى إلا مثلها ۖ ومن عمل صالحا من ذكر أو أنثى وهو مؤمن فأولئك يدخلون الجنة يرزقون فيها بغير حساب
verses.transliterated: man ʿamila sayyi-atan falā yuj'zā illā mith'lahā waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata yur'zaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisābi
verses.english: Whoever commits a sin is requited for just that, and whoever works righteousness—male or female—while believing, these will enter Paradise wherein they receive provisions without any limits.
verses.subtitle: The Best Deal

1981.english: "Whoever commits a sin is punished for the same, but whoever works righteousness, male or female, while believing, these have deserved Paradise. They enjoy provisions therein without limits.

1989.english: Whoever commits a sin is requited for just that. But whoever works righteousness, be it male or female, while believing, these will enter Paradise wherein they receive provisions without any limits.
1989.subtitle: The Best Deal

verses.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: ويا قوم ما لي أدعوكم إلى النجاة وتدعونني إلى النار
verses.transliterated: wayāqawmi mā lī adʿūkum ilā l-najati watadʿūnanī ilā l-nār
verses.english: "O my people, while I invite you to be saved, you invite me to the hellfire.
verses.subtitle: The Believing Egyptian Debates With His People

1981.english: "My people, I only invite you to salvation; while you invite me to hell.

1989.english: “O my people, while I invite you to be saved, you invite me to Hell.
1989.subtitle: The Believing Egyptian Debates With His People

verses.arabic: تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّٰرِ
verses.arabicClean: تدعونني لأكفر بالله وأشرك به ما ليس لي به علم وأنا أدعوكم إلى العزيز الغفار
verses.transliterated: tadʿūnanī li-akfura bil-lahi wa-ush'rika bihi mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-anā adʿūkum ilā l-ʿazīzi l-ghafār
verses.english: "You invite me to be unappreciative of GOD, and to set up beside Him idols that I do not recognize. I am inviting you to the Almighty, the Forgiver.

1981.english: "You invite me to be unappreciative of God, by setting up powerless idols besides Him; while I invite you to the One that is almighty, forgiver.

1989.english: “You invite me to be unappreciative of GOD, by setting up besides Him idols that I do not recognize, while I invite you to the Almighty, the Forgiver.

verses.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: لا جرم أنما تدعونني إليه ليس له دعوة في الدنيا ولا في الآخرة وأن مردنا إلى الله وأن المسرفين هم أصحاب النار
verses.transliterated: lā jarama annamā tadʿūnanī ilayhi laysa lahu daʿwatun fī l-dun'yā walā fī l-ākhirati wa-anna maraddanā ilā l-lahi wa-anna l-mus'rifīna hum aṣḥābu l-nār
verses.english: "There is no doubt that what you invite me to do has no basis in this world, nor in the Hereafter, that our ultimate return is to GOD, and that the transgressors have incurred the hellfire.

1981.english: "There is no doubt that what you advocate has no basis in this life, nor in the hereafter, that our ultimate return is to God, and that the transgressors will end up in hell.

1989.english: “There is no doubt that what you invite me to do has no basis in this world, nor in the Hereafter, that our ultimate return is to GOD, and that the transgressors will end up in Hell.

verses.arabic: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: فستذكرون ما أقول لكم ۚ وأفوض أمري إلى الله ۚ إن الله بصير بالعباد
verses.transliterated: fasatadhkurūna mā aqūlu lakum wa-ufawwiḍu amrī ilā l-lahi inna l-laha baṣīrun bil-ʿibād
verses.english: "Some day you will remember what I am telling you now. I leave the judgment of this matter to GOD; GOD is the Seer of all the people."

1981.english: "You will remember everything I told you, and now I leave everything up to God. God fully sees all the people."

1989.english: “Some day you will remember what I am telling you now. I leave the judgment of this matter to GOD; GOD is the Seer of all the people.”

verses.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.arabicClean: فوقاه الله سيئات ما مكروا ۖ وحاق بآل فرعون سوء العذاب
verses.transliterated: fawaqāhu l-lahu sayyiāti mā makarū waḥāqa biāli fir'ʿawna sūu l-ʿadhāb
verses.english: GOD then protected him from their evil schemes, while the people of Pharaoh have incurred the worst retribution.

1981.english: God protected him from the consequences of their evil work, while Pharaoh's people suffered terrible retribution.

1989.english: GOD then protected him from their evil schemes. The people of Pharaoh have incurred the worst retribution.

verses.arabic: ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.arabicClean: النار يعرضون عليها غدوا وعشيا ۖ ويوم تقوم الساعة أدخلوا آل فرعون أشد العذاب
verses.transliterated: al-nāru yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwan waʿashiyyan wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu adkhilū āla fir'ʿawna ashadda l-ʿadhāb
verses.english: The Hell will be shown to them day and night, and on the Day of Resurrection: "Admit Pharaoh's people into the worst retribution."
verses.subtitle: While in the Grave: A Continuous Nightmare

1981.english: The hellfire is shown to them day and night;* then, on the day of resurrection, admit Pharaoh's people into the worst punishment.
1981.footnote: The period of death, no matter how long, passes like one night of sleep. During that night, our dreams go on as happy dreams or nightmares, depending on our degree of righteousness at death. See Appendix 14.

1989.english: The Hell will be shown to them day and night, and on the Day of Resurrection: “Admit Pharaoh’s people into the worst retribution.”
1989.subtitle: A Continuous Nightmare

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ يتحاجون في النار فيقول الضعفاء للذين استكبروا إنا كنا لكم تبعا فهل أنتم مغنون عنا نصيبا من النار
verses.transliterated: wa-idh yataḥājjūna fī l-nāri fayaqūlu l-ḍuʿafāu lilladhīna is'takbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mugh'nūna ʿannā naṣīban mina l-nār
verses.english: As they argue in Hell, the followers will say to their leaders, "We used to be your followers, can you spare us any part of this Hell?"

1981.english: As they argue with each other in hell, the followers will say to the leaders, "We were your followers, can you spare us some of this hell?"

1989.english: As they argue in Hell, the followers will say to their leaders, “We used to be your followers, can you spare us any part of this Hell?”

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.arabicClean: قال الذين استكبروا إنا كل فيها إن الله قد حكم بين العباد
verses.transliterated: qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā kullun fīhā inna l-laha qad ḥakama bayna l-ʿibād
verses.english: The leaders will say, "We are all in this together. GOD has judged among the people."

1981.english: The leaders will say, "We are in this together; God has judged the people."

1989.english: The leaders will say, “We are all in this together. GOD has judged among the people.”

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين في النار لخزنة جهنم ادعوا ربكم يخفف عنا يوما من العذاب
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna fī l-nāri likhazanati jahannama id'ʿū rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawman mina l-ʿadhāb
verses.english: Those in the hellfire will say to the guardians of Hell, "Call upon your Lord to reduce the retribution for us, for even one day."
verses.subtitle: Too Late

1981.english: Those in the fire will say to the guardians of hell, "Call upon your Lord to commute our retribution for one day."

1989.english: Those in the fire will say to the guardians of Hell, “Call upon your Lord to reduce the retribution for us by one day.”
1989.subtitle: Too Late

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ وَمَا دُعَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أولم تك تأتيكم رسلكم بالبينات ۖ قالوا بلى ۚ قالوا فادعوا ۗ وما دعاء الكافرين إلا في ضلال
verses.transliterated: qālū awalam taku tatīkum rusulukum bil-bayināti qālū balā qālū fa-id'ʿū wamā duʿāu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāli
verses.english: They will say, "Did you not receive your messengers who delivered to you clear messages?" They will reply, "Yes we did." They will say, "Then implore (as much as you wish); the imploring of the disbelievers is always in vain."

1981.english: They will say, "Did you not receive messengers with clear revelations?" They will say, "Yes, indeed." They will say, "Then call (as much as you want); the disbelievers' calls are in vain."

1989.english: They will say, “Did you not receive your messengers who delivered to you clear messages?” They will reply, “Yes we did.” They will say, “Then implore (as much as you wish); the imploring of the disbelievers is always in vain.” Guaranteed Victory

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ
verses.arabicClean: إنا لننصر رسلنا والذين آمنوا في الحياة الدنيا ويوم يقوم الأشهاد
verses.transliterated: innā lananṣuru rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wayawma yaqūmu l-ashhād
verses.english: Most assuredly, we will give victory to our messengers and to those who believe, both in this world and on the day the witnesses are summoned.
verses.subtitle: Guaranteed Victory; Here and Forever

1981.english: We will surely give victory to our messengers, and to those who believe, both in this life and on the day the witnesses are raised.
1981.subtitle: Victory For The Believers

1989.english: We will surely give victory to our messengers and to those who believe, both in this world and on the day the witnesses are summoned.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم لا ينفع الظالمين معذرتهم ۖ ولهم اللعنة ولهم سوء الدار
verses.transliterated: yawma lā yanfaʿu l-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum walahumu l-laʿnatu walahum sūu l-dār
verses.english: On that day, the apologies of the disbelievers will not benefit them. They have incurred condemnation; they have incurred the worst destiny.

1981.english: That is the day when the wicked will not be excused; they have deserved the curse, and a miserable abode.

1989.english: On that day, the apologies of the disbelievers will not benefit them. They have incurred condemnation; they have incurred the worst destiny.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا موسى الهدى وأورثنا بني إسرائيل الكتاب
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-hudā wa-awrathnā banī is'rāīla l-kitāb
verses.english: We have given Moses the guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the scripture.
verses.subtitle: Learn From History

1981.english: We have given Moses the guidance and made the children of Israel inherit the scripture.

1989.english: We have given Moses the guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the scripture.
1989.subtitle: Learn From History

verses.arabic: هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.arabicClean: هدى وذكرى لأولي الألباب
verses.transliterated: hudan wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verses.english: (Their history) is a lesson and a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

1981.english: A guidance and a message for those who possess intelligence.

1989.english: (Their history) is a lesson and a reminder for those who possess intelligence.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر إن وعد الله حق واستغفر لذنبك وسبح بحمد ربك بالعشي والإبكار
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kār
verses.english: Therefore, be patient, for GOD's promise is true, and ask forgiveness for your sin, and glorify and praise your Lord night and day.

1981.english: Therefore, be patient, for God's promise is truth; ask forgiveness for your sin, and praise and glorify your Lord night and day.

1989.english: Therefore, be patient, for GOD’s promise is true, and ask forgiveness for your sins. You shall glorify and praise your Lord night and day.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يجادلون في آيات الله بغير سلطان أتاهم ۙ إن في صدورهم إلا كبر ما هم ببالغيه ۚ فاستعذ بالله ۖ إنه هو السميع البصير
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum in fī ṣudūrihim illā kib'run mā hum bibālighīhi fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīr
verses.english: Surely, those who argue against GOD's revelations without proof are exposing the arrogance that is hidden inside their chests, and they are not even aware of it. Therefore, seek refuge in GOD; He is the Hearer, the Seer.

1981.english: Those who dispute God's revelations without any basis are so full of arrogance, they cannot accept them. You shall seek refuge in God (from this condition); He is the hearer, the seer.

1989.english: Surely, those who argue against GOD’s revelations without proof are exposing the arrogance that is hidden inside them, and they are not even aware of it. Therefore, seek refuge in GOD; He is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.arabic: لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: لخلق السماوات والأرض أكبر من خلق الناس ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: lakhalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi akbaru min khalqi l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: The creation of the heavens and the earth is even more awesome than the creation of the human being, but most people do not know.
verses.subtitle: Awesome Construction of the Universe

1981.english: Indeed, the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of people, but most people do not know.
1981.subtitle: Creation of the Universe More Complex than the Creation of Man
1981.footnote: Our immediate universe, the smallest and innermost among seven universes, contains a billion galaxies, a billion trillion stars, and countless trillions of planets. All these heavenly bodies move precisely in their specific orbits without crashing into each other.

1989.english: The creation of the heavens and the earth is even more awesome than the creation of the human being, but most people do not know.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما يستوي الأعمى والبصير والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ولا المسيء ۚ قليلا ما تتذكرون
verses.transliterated: wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti walā l-musīu qalīlan mā tatadhakkarūn
verses.english: Not equal are the blind and the seer. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. Rarely do you take heed.

1981.english: The blind is not the same as the seer, nor are those who believe and work righteousness the same as the sinners. Rarely do you take heed.

1989.english: Not equal are the blind and the seer. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. Rarely do you take heed.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الساعة لآتية لا ريب فيها ولكن أكثر الناس لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun lā rayba fīhā walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Most certainly, the Hour (Day of Judgment) is coming, no doubt about it, but most people do not believe.

1981.english: The Hour is coming; no doubt about it; but most people do not believe.

1989.english: Most certainly, the Hour is coming, no doubt about it, but most people do not believe.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال ربكم ادعوني أستجب لكم ۚ إن الذين يستكبرون عن عبادتي سيدخلون جهنم داخرين
verses.transliterated: waqāla rabbukumu id'ʿūnī astajib lakum inna alladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīn
verses.english: Your Lord says, "Implore Me, and I will respond to you. Surely, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Gehenna, forcibly."
verses.subtitle: Supplication: A Form of Worship
verses.footnote: Supplication, imploring God for anything, even material luxuries, is a form of worship. Hence the commandment to implore God whenever we have any need. An atheist will never implore God for anything.

1981.english: Your Lord says, "Pray to Me, and I will answer your prayers. As for those who are too arrogant to worship Me, they will be committed to hell."

1989.english: Your Lord says, “Implore Me, and I will respond to you.” Surely, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell, forcibly.
1989.subtitle: Supplication: A Form of Worship
1989.footnote: Supplication, imploring God for anything, even material luxuries, is a form of worship. Hence the commandment to implore God whenever we have any needs. An atheist will never implore God for anything.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي جعل لكم الليل لتسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا ۚ إن الله لذو فضل على الناس ولكن أكثر الناس لا يشكرون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yashkurūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who designed the night so you can rest in it, and the day lighted. GOD bestows many blessings upon the people, but most people are not thankful.

1981.english: God is the one who made the night for your rest and the day visible. God is most generous towards the people, but most people are thankless.

1989.english: GOD is the One who designed the night so you can rest therein, and the day lighted. GOD bestows many blessings upon the people, but most people are not appreciative.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم الله ربكم خالق كل شيء لا إله إلا هو ۖ فأنى تؤفكون
verses.transliterated: dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum khāliqu kulli shayin lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūn
verses.english: Such is GOD your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no god except He. How could you deviate?

1981.english: Such is God your Lord; the creator of all things. There is no god except He; how could you deviate?

1989.english: Such is GOD your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no other god besides Him. How could you deviate?

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك يؤفك الذين كانوا بآيات الله يجحدون
verses.transliterated: kadhālika yu'faku alladhīna kānū biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūn
verses.english: Deviating are those who disregard GOD's revelations.

1981.english: Only those who disregard God's revelations will deviate.

1989.english: Thus are those who disregard GOD’s revelations caused to deviate.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي جعل لكم الأرض قرارا والسماء بناء وصوركم فأحسن صوركم ورزقكم من الطيبات ۚ ذلكم الله ربكم ۖ فتبارك الله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa qarāran wal-samāa bināan waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fatabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: GOD is the One who rendered the earth habitable for you, and the sky a formidable structure, and He designed you, and designed you well. He is the One who provides you with good provisions. Such is GOD your Lord; Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.

1981.english: God is the one who made the earth for your settlement and the sky a structure; He designed you a perfect design and provided for you good things. Such is God your Lord; most exalted is God, Lord of the universe.

1989.english: GOD is the One who rendered the earth habitable for you, and the sky a structure. He is the One who designed you, and designed you well. He is the One who provides you with good provisions.* Such is GOD your Lord; Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الحي لا إله إلا هو فادعوه مخلصين له الدين ۗ الحمد لله رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: huwa l-ḥayu lā ilāha illā huwa fa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: He is the Living; there is no god except He. You shall worship Him alone, devoting your religion absolutely to Him alone. Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

1981.english: He is the eternally living; there is no god except He. You shall worship Him, devoting the worship absolutely to Him alone. Praise be to God, Lord of the universe.

1989.english: He is the Living; there is no other god besides Him. You shall worship Him, devoting your religion absolutely to Him alone. Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إني نهيت أن أعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله لما جاءني البينات من ربي وأمرت أن أسلم لرب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lammā jāaniya l-bayinātu min rabbī wa-umir'tu an us'lima lirabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Say, "I have been enjoined from worshiping the idols you worship beside GOD, when the clear revelations came to me from my Lord. I was commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe."
verses.subtitle: Before God's Blessings Upon Him, Muhammad Used to Worship Idols
verses.footnote: The Arabic word "Nahaa" used in this verse indicates the stopping of something that was going on. See for example the same word in 4:171. See also 93:7.

1981.english: Say, "I was stopped from worshiping the idols you worship besides God when the clear revelations came to me from my Lord. I was ordered to submit completely to the Lord of the universe."
1981.subtitle: Muhammad Worshiped Idols Before The Message
1981.footnote: It is valuable education to understand the mentality of the idol worshipers in order to effectively preach to them later. Those who idolize the prophet, exactly like those who idolize Jesus, refuse to believe the truth about the prophet. See also 6:56 and 93:7. As a human being, the prophet passed through the stages that each of us passes through towards perfection, i.e., the worship of God alone. (See 18:110 and 41:6.) The Arabic word "**naha**" indicates the termination of something that was actually taking place (See 2:192-193, 4:171, 8:38-39, 19:46, 26:116, 26:167, and 36:18).

1989.english: Say, “I have been enjoined from worshiping the idols you worship besides GOD, when the clear revelations came to me from my Lord. I was commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe.”*
1989.subtitle: Before God’s Blessings Upon Him, Muhammad Used to Worship Idols
1989.footnote: The Arabic word “Nahaa” used in this verse indicates the stopping of something that was going on. See for example the same word in 4:171. See also 93:7.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي خلقكم من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم من علقة ثم يخرجكم طفلا ثم لتبلغوا أشدكم ثم لتكونوا شيوخا ۚ ومنكم من يتوفى من قبل ۖ ولتبلغوا أجلا مسمى ولعلكم تعقلون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma yukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum thumma litakūnū shuyūkhan waminkum man yutawaffā min qablu walitablughū ajalan musamman walaʿallakum taʿqilūn
verses.english: He is the One who created you from dust, and subsequently from a tiny drop, then from a hanging embryo, then He brings you out as a child, then He lets you reach maturity, then you become old—some of you die earlier. You attain a predetermined age, that you may understand.

1981.english: He is the one who created you from dust, then from a drop, then from a clot, then He brings you out as an infant, then you reach full strength, then you become old, though some of you die earlier. You attain a predetermined life span, that you may understand.

1989.english: He is the One who created you from dust, and subsequently from a tiny drop, then from a hanging embryo, then He brings you out as a child, then He lets you reach maturity, then you become old. Some of you die earlier. You attain a predetermined age, that you may understand.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي يحيي ويميت ۖ فإذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu fa-idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verses.english: He is the only One who controls life and death. To have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.

1981.english: He is the one who controls life and death; to have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.

1989.english: He is the One who grants life and death. To have anything done, He simply says to it, “Be,” and it is.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر إلى الذين يجادلون في آيات الله أنى يصرفون
verses.transliterated: alam tara ilā alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi annā yuṣ'rafūn
verses.english: Have you noted those who argue against GOD's proofs, and how they have deviated?

1981.english: Have you noted those who dispute God's revelations and how they totally deviate?

1989.english: Have you noted those who argue against GOD’s revelations, and how they are diverted?

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين كذبوا بالكتاب وبما أرسلنا به رسلنا ۖ فسوف يعلمون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna kadhabū bil-kitābi wabimā arsalnā bihi rusulanā fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.english: They are the ones who have disbelieved in the scripture, and in the messages we have sent with our messengers. Therefore, they will surely find out.

1981.english: They have rejected the scripture and what we sent with our messengers. Therefore, they will surely find out.

1989.english: They are the ones who disbelieved in the scripture, and in the messages delivered by our messengers. Therefore, they will surely find out.

verses.arabic: إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ الأغلال في أعناقهم والسلاسل يسحبون
verses.transliterated: idhi l-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim wal-salāsilu yus'ḥabūn
verses.english: The shackles will be around their necks, and the chains will be used to drag them.

1981.english: The shackles will be around their necks, and they will be dragged in chains.

1989.english: The shackles will be around their necks, and the chains will be used to drag them.

verses.arabic: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: في الحميم ثم في النار يسجرون
verses.transliterated: fī l-ḥamīmi thumma fī l-nāri yus'jarūn
verses.english: In the Inferno, then in the Fire, they will burn.
verses.footnote: Those who did not prepare themselves will suffer tremendously in the presence of God, on the Day of Judgment. They cannot stand the closeness to God due to lack of sufficient growth and development of their souls. I am using "Inferno" to describe this particular situation (55:44). Preparation of the soul is accomplished by the rites decreed by God, such as the Contact Prayer.

1981.english: In Gehenna, and then in the hellfire; they will burn.
1981.footnote: See 19:71, 55:43-44, and Appendix 10.

1989.english: In the Inferno,* then in the Fire, they will burn.
1989.footnote: Those who did not prepare themselves will suffer tremendously in the presence of God, on the Day of Judgment They cannot stand the closeness to God due to lack ol sufficient growth and development of their souls. I am using “Inferno” to describe this particular situation. See 55:44.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم قيل لهم أين ما كنتم تشركون
verses.transliterated: thumma qīla lahum ayna mā kuntum tush'rikūn
verses.english: They will be asked, "Where are the idols you used to worship,

1981.english: They will be told, "Where are the idols you had set up

1989.english: Then they will be asked, “Where are the idols you used to worship—

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًٔا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: من دون الله ۖ قالوا ضلوا عنا بل لم نكن ندعو من قبل شيئا ۚ كذلك يضل الله الكافرين
verses.transliterated: min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā bal lam nakun nadʿū min qablu shayan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu l-kāfirīn
verses.english: "beside GOD?" They will say, "They have abandoned us. In fact, when we worshiped them, we were worshiping nothing." Thus does GOD send the disbelievers astray.
verses.subtitle: They Worshiped Nothing

1981.english: "besides God?" They will say, "They have abandoned us. When we implored them, we were imploring nothing." Thus does God mislead the disbelievers.

1989.english: “besides GOD?” They will say, “They have abandoned us. In fact, when we worshiped them, we were worshiping nothing.” Thus does GOD send the disbelievers astray.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم بما كنتم تفرحون في الأرض بغير الحق وبما كنتم تمرحون
verses.transliterated: dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūn
verses.english: This is because you used to rejoice in false doctrines, on earth, and you used to promote them.

1981.english: This is because you were satisfied on earth with other than the truth. You only wanted to play.

1989.english: This is because you used to rejoice in false doctrines, on earth, and you used to promote them.

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فبئس مثوى المتكبرين
verses.transliterated: ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīn
verses.english: Enter the gates of Gehenna, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.

1981.english: Enter the gates of hell, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable abode for the arrogant!

1989.english: Enter the gates of Gehenna, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر إن وعد الله حق ۚ فإما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم أو نتوفينك فإلينا يرجعون
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūn
verses.english: You shall be patient, for GOD's promise is truth. Whether we show you some of (the retribution) we have promised for them, or terminate your life before that, they will be returned to us.

1981.english: Therefore, be patient, for God's promise is truth. Whether we show you some of the retribution we promise them, or terminate your life before then, they ultimately return to us.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall be patient; GOD’s promise is truth. Whether we show you some of (the retribution) we have promised for them, or terminate your life before that, they will be returned to us.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أرسلنا رسلا من قبلك منهم من قصصنا عليك ومنهم من لم نقصص عليك ۗ وما كان لرسول أن يأتي بآية إلا بإذن الله ۚ فإذا جاء أمر الله قضي بالحق وخسر هنالك المبطلون
verses.transliterated: walaqad arsalnā rusulan min qablika min'hum man qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka wamin'hum man lam naqṣuṣ ʿalayka wamā kāna lirasūlin an yatiya biāyatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi fa-idhā jāa amru l-lahi quḍiya bil-ḥaqi wakhasira hunālika l-mub'ṭilūn
verses.english: We have sent messengers before you—some of them we mentioned to you, and some we did not mention to you. No messenger can produce any miracle without GOD's authorization. Once GOD's judgment is issued, the truth dominates, and the falsifiers are exposed and humiliated.
verses.subtitle: God's Authorization for the Quran's Mathematical Miracle
verses.footnote: We learn from 17:45-46, 18:57, and 56:79 that the unbelievers have no access to the Quran; only the believers and the sincere seekers are permitted by God to understand it. The Quran's mathematical code, "One of the great miracles" (74:30-35), was authorized by God, and revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 2).

1981.english: We have sent messengers before you; some we told you about, and some we did not tell you about. No messenger was sent, except by God's leave. Whenever God's judgment comes, the truth is established, and the advocates of falsehood perish.

1989.english: We have sent messengers before you. Some of them we mentioned to you, and some we did not mention to you. No messenger can produce any miracle without GOD’s authorization.* Once GOD’s judgment is issued, the truth prevails, and the falsifiers are condemned.
1989.footnote: We learn from 17:45-46, 18:57, and 56:79 that the unbelievers have no access to the Quran; only the believers and the sincere seekers are permitted by God to understand it. The Quran’s mathematical code, “One of the great miracles” (74:30-35), was authorized by God, and revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 2).

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي جعل لكم الأنعام لتركبوا منها ومنها تأكلون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-anʿāma litarkabū min'hā wamin'hā takulūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who created the livestock for you; some you ride, and some you eat.

1981.english: God is the one who made the livestock for you, to ride some and eat some.

1989.english: GOD is the One who created the livestock for you; some to ride, and some to eat.

verses.arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكم فيها منافع ولتبلغوا عليها حاجة في صدوركم وعليها وعلى الفلك تحملون
verses.transliterated: walakum fīhā manāfiʿu walitablughū ʿalayhā ḥājatan fī ṣudūrikum waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūn
verses.english: They also provide you with additional benefits that satisfy many of your needs. On them, as well as on the ships, you are carried.

1981.english: You derive other benefits from them and satisfy many needs. You ride them, and you ride the ships.

1989.english: They also provide you with additional benefits that satisfy many of your needs. On them, and on the ships, you are carried.

verses.arabic: وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويريكم آياته فأي آيات الله تنكرون
verses.transliterated: wayurīkum āyātihi fa-ayya āyāti l-lahi tunkirūn
verses.english: He thus shows you His proofs. Which of GOD's proofs can you deny?

1981.english: He shows you His marvels; which of God's marvels can you deny?

1989.english: He thus shows you His signs. Which of GOD’s signs will you deny?

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفلم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم ۚ كانوا أكثر منهم وأشد قوة وآثارا في الأرض فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim kānū akthara min'hum wa-ashadda quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be greater in number, greater in power, and possessed a greater legacy on earth. Yet, all their achievements did not help them in the least.

1981.english: Did they not travel the land and see the consequences for those before them? They used to be greater in number and in power, and they established more structures on earth. But their material achievements did not help them.

1989.english: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be greater in number, greater in power, and possessed a greater legacy on earth. All their achievements did not help them in the least.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات فرحوا بما عندهم من العلم وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: falammā jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti fariḥū bimā ʿindahum mina l-ʿil'mi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: When their messengers went to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in the knowledge they had inherited, and the very things they ridiculed were the cause of their fall.

1981.english: When their messengers went to them with clear revelations, they were satisfied with the knowledge they had. The very things they ridiculed caused their doom.
1981.subtitle: Evil Satisfaction With Inherited Knowledge

1989.english: When their messengers went to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in the knowledge they already possessed, and the very things they mocked were the cause of their fall.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأوا بأسنا قالوا آمنا بالله وحده وكفرنا بما كنا به مشركين
verses.transliterated: falammā ra-aw basanā qālū āmannā bil-lahi waḥdahu wakafarnā bimā kunnā bihi mush'rikīn
verses.english: Subsequently, when they saw our retribution they said, "Now we believe in GOD ALONE, and we now disbelieve in the idol worship that we used to practice."
verses.subtitle: God ALONE

1981.english: Then, when they saw our retribution, they said, "Now we believe in God ALONE, and we reject the idols we had set up."

1989.english: Subsequently, when they saw our retribution they said, “Now we believe in GOD ALONE, and we disbelieve in the idolatry we practiced.” Too L ate
1989.subtitle: GodALONE

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلم يك ينفعهم إيمانهم لما رأوا بأسنا ۖ سنت الله التي قد خلت في عباده ۖ وخسر هنالك الكافرون
verses.transliterated: falam yaku yanfaʿuhum īmānuhum lammā ra-aw basanā sunnata l-lahi allatī qad khalat fī ʿibādihi wakhasira hunālika l-kāfirūn
verses.english: Their belief then could not help them in the least, once they saw our retribution. Such is GOD's system that has been established to deal with His creatures; the disbelievers are always doomed.
verses.subtitle: Too Late

1981.english: But alas, their belief is no longer useful, once they see our retribution. This is God's system that is never changeable. The disbelievers are always losers.

1989.english: Their belief then could not help them in the least, once they saw our retribution. Such is GOD’s system that has been established to deal with His creatures; the disbelievers are always doomed.

verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم حم
verses.transliterated: hha-meem
verses.english: H. M.
verses.footnote: For the significance of these Quranic Initials, see Footnote 40:1.

1981.english: H. M.
1981.footnote: See footnote 40:1.

1989.english: H. M.*

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل من الرحمن الرحيم
verses.transliterated: tanzīlun mina l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verses.english: A revelation from the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

1981.english: (These two letters prove that) this revelation is from God most gracious, most merciful.

1989.english: A revelation from the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كتاب فصلت آياته قرآنا عربيا لقوم يعلمون
verses.transliterated: kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan liqawmin yaʿlamūn
verses.english: A scripture whose verses provide the complete details, in an Arabic Quran, for people who know.

1981.english: A scripture whose verses have been elucidated in an Arabic Quran,* for those who know.
1981.footnote: See footnote 41:44 and Appendix 3.

1989.english: A scripture whose verses have been precisely designed, in an Arabic Quran, for people who know.

verses.arabic: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بشيرا ونذيرا فأعرض أكثرهم فهم لا يسمعون
verses.transliterated: bashīran wanadhīran fa-aʿraḍa aktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūn
verses.english: A bearer of good news, as well as a warner. However, most of them turn away; they do not hear.

1981.english: A bearer of good news, as well as a warner. But most people turn away, and thus, they fail to hear.

1989.english: A bearer of good news, as well as a warner. However, most of them turn away; they do not hear.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا قلوبنا في أكنة مما تدعونا إليه وفي آذاننا وقر ومن بيننا وبينك حجاب فاعمل إننا عاملون
verses.transliterated: waqālū qulūbunā fī akinnatin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi wafī ādhāninā waqrun wamin bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun fa-iʿ'mal innanā ʿāmilūn
verses.english: They said, "Our minds are made up, our ears are deaf to your message, and a barrier separates us from you. Do what you want, and so will we."

1981.english: And they said, "Our hearts are protected from your views, our ears are deaf, and a barrier separates us and you. Do what you want, and we will do what we want."

1989.english: They said, “Our minds are made up, our ears are deaf to your message, and a barrier separates us from you. Do what you want, and so will we.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل إنما أنا بشر مثلكم يوحى إلي أنما إلهكم إله واحد فاستقيموا إليه واستغفروه ۗ وويل للمشركين
verses.transliterated: qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-is'taqīmū ilayhi wa-is'taghfirūhu wawaylun lil'mush'rikīn
verses.english: Say, "I am no more than a human being like you, who has been inspired that your god is one god. You shall be devoted to Him, and ask His forgiveness. Woe to the idol worshipers.

1981.english: Say, "I am a human being like you, who received inspiration that your God is the one God. Therefore, you shall be totally devoted to Him alone, ask Him for forgiveness, and woe to the idol worshipers.
1981.subtitle: Do Not Idolize Muhammad
1981.footnote: In the two Quranic statements that describe the prophet as a human being (see also 18:110), we note that both verses close by enjoining us from idolizing the prophet. Obviously, God is fully aware of the human disease that led the Jews to invent the Mishnah (oral) and Gemarah (traditions) of Talmud to overtake the Torah, and the Christians to invent the trinity, and the Muslims to idolize Muhammad by inventing **hadith** (oral) and **sunna** (traditions) to overtake the Quran.

1989.english: Say, “I am no more than a human being like you, who has been inspired that your god is one god. You shall be devoted to Him, and ask His forgiveness. Woe to the idol worshipers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين لا يؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم كافرون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna lā yu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūn
verses.english: "Who do not give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers."

1981.english: Who do not observe the **zakat** charity, and disbelieve in the hereafter.
1981.footnote: What we utter through our lips does not necessarily reflect what our hearts really believe. (See 16:22). In order to show us whether we believe or disbelieve in the hereafter, God has established the test of "**hadith**" as stated in 6:112-116. He allowed enemies of the prophet to fabricate "**sunna**" and "**hadith**" and attributed them to the prophet. As stated in 6:113, those who accept "**hadith**" and/or "**sunna**" do not believe in the hereafter as they claim. But those who reject all "**hadith**" and all "**sunna**" and accept the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran as their source of religious guidance and law, are the true believers (see also 25:30-31).

1989.english: “They do not give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير ممنون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūni
verses.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a well deserved recompense.

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, they receive a well-deserved recompense.

1989.english: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a well deserved recompense.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أئنكم لتكفرون بالذي خلق الأرض في يومين وتجعلون له أندادا ۚ ذلك رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: qul a-innakum latakfurūna bi-alladhī khalaqa l-arḍa fī yawmayni watajʿalūna lahu andādan dhālika rabbu l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: Say, "You disbelieve in the One who created the earth in two days, and you set up idols to rank with Him, though He is Lord of the universe."
verses.footnote: The "days" of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth.

1981.english: Say, "You disbelieve in the One who created the earth in two days, and you set up idols to rank with Him, though He is the Lord of the universe."

1989.english: Say, “You are disbelieving in the One who created the earth in two days,* and you set up idols to rival Him, the Lord of the universe.”
1989.footnote: The “days” of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth. q

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وجعل فيها رواسي من فوقها وبارك فيها وقدر فيها أقواتها في أربعة أيام سواء للسائلين
verses.transliterated: wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arbaʿati ayyāmin sawāan lilssāilīn
verses.english: He placed on it stabilizers (mountains), made it productive, and He calculated its provisions in four days, to satisfy the needs of all its inhabitants.

1981.english: He placed stabilizers on earth, blessed it, and designed all provisions for it in four days to cover all needs.

1989.english: He placed on it stabilizers (mountains), and blessed it. And He measured precisely all its provisions, in four days, to satisfy the needs of all its inhabitants.
1989.footnote: The “days” of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth. q

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم استوى إلى السماء وهي دخان فقال لها وللأرض ائتيا طوعا أو كرها قالتا أتينا طائعين
verses.transliterated: thumma is'tawā ilā l-samāi wahiya dukhānun faqāla lahā walil'arḍi i'tiyā ṭawʿan aw karhan qālatā ataynā ṭāiʿīn
verses.english: Then He turned to the sky, when it was still gas, and said to it, and to the earth, "Come into existence, willingly or unwillingly." They said, "We come willingly."

1981.english: Then He turned to the sky while it was still gas and said to it and to the earth, "Come into existence, willingly or unwillingly." They said, "We come willingly."

1989.english: Then He turned to the sky, when it was still gas, and said to it, and to the earth, “Come into existence, willingly or unwillingly.” They said, “We come willingly.” *4 1:1 For the significance of these Quranic Initials, see Footnote 40:1.

verses.arabic: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فقضاهن سبع سماوات في يومين وأوحى في كل سماء أمرها ۚ وزينا السماء الدنيا بمصابيح وحفظا ۚ ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
verses.transliterated: faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fī yawmayni wa-awḥā fī kulli samāin amrahā wazayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa waḥif'ẓan dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīm
