verses.english: Thus, He completed the seven universes in two days, and set up the laws for every universe. And we adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and placed guards around it. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
verses.footnote: God alone created the universe (18:51), but the angels participated in handling certain jobs in the lowest universe. Our universe cannot stand the physical presence of God (7:143). The plural tense acknowledges the angels' role in our universe (Appendix 10).

1981.english: He thus established them as seven heavens (or universes) in two days, and established for each heaven its own laws. And We adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and established an unpenetrable barrier around it. Such is the design of the almighty, the omniscient.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 5.

1989.english: Thus, He* completed the seven universes in two days, and set up the laws for every universe. And we* adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and placed guards therein. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
1989.footnote: God alone created the universe (18:51), but the angels participated in handling certain jobs in the lowest universe. Our universe cannot stand the physical presence of God (7:143). The plural tense acknowledges the angels’ role in our universe (App. 10).

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن أعرضوا فقل أنذرتكم صاعقة مثل صاعقة عاد وثمود
verses.transliterated: fa-in aʿraḍū faqul andhartukum ṣāʿiqatan mith'la ṣāʿiqati ʿādin wathamūd
verses.english: If they turn away, then say, "I am warning you of a disaster like the disaster that annihilated 'Ãd and Thamûd."
verses.subtitle: Warning

1981.english: If they still turn away, then say, "I warn you lest you get struck as the people of 'Aad and Thamood were struck."

1989.english: If they turn away, then say, “I am warning you of a disaster like the disaster that annihilated Aad and Thamoud.”
1989.subtitle: Warning

verses.arabic: إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ جاءتهم الرسل من بين أيديهم ومن خلفهم ألا تعبدوا إلا الله ۖ قالوا لو شاء ربنا لأنزل ملائكة فإنا بما أرسلتم به كافرون
verses.transliterated: idh jāathumu l-rusulu min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim allā taʿbudū illā l-laha qālū law shāa rabbunā la-anzala malāikatan fa-innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūn
verses.english: Their messengers went to them, as well as before them and after them, saying, "You shall not worship except GOD." They said, "Had our Lord willed, He could have sent angels. We are disbelievers in what you say."

1981.english: The messengers who came before them and after them said, "You shall not worship except God." They said, "Had God willed, He could have sent down angels. Therefore, we reject what you are sent with."
1981.subtitle: You Shall Not Worship Except God
1981.footnote: The commandment, "You shall worship God," is not complete, since people can worship God and still go to hell, as stated in 23:85-89. The complete commandment is, "You shall worship God alone," or, "You shall not worship except God." The First Commandment, therefore, is a negative commandment, "YOU SHALL NOT WORSHIP EXCEPT GOD."

1989.english: Their messengers went to them, in front of them and behind them, saying, “You shall not worship except GOD.” They said, “Had our Lord willed, He could have sent angels. We are disbelievers in what you say.”

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأما عاد فاستكبروا في الأرض بغير الحق وقالوا من أشد منا قوة ۖ أولم يروا أن الله الذي خلقهم هو أشد منهم قوة ۖ وكانوا بآياتنا يجحدون
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā ʿādun fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi waqālū man ashaddu minnā quwwatan awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqahum huwa ashaddu min'hum quwwatan wakānū biāyātinā yajḥadūn
verses.english: As for 'Ãd, they turned arrogant on earth, opposed the truth, and said, "Who is more powerful than we?" Did they not realize that GOD, who created them, is more powerful than they? They were unappreciative of our revelations.

1981.english: As for 'Aad, they were tyrants on earth without justice, and they said, "Who is more powerful than we?" Did they not realize that God, who created them, is more powerful than they? They discarded our revelations.

1989.english: As for Aad, they turned arrogant on earth, without the truth, and said, “Who is more powerful than we?” Did they not realize that GOD, who created them, is more powerful than they? They were unappreciative of our revelations.

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأرسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في أيام نحسات لنذيقهم عذاب الخزي في الحياة الدنيا ۖ ولعذاب الآخرة أخزى ۖ وهم لا ينصرون
verses.transliterated: fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātin linudhīqahum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akhzā wahum lā yunṣarūn
verses.english: Consequently, we sent upon them violent wind, for a few miserable days. We thus afflicted them with humiliating retribution in this life, and the retribution of the Hereafter is more humiliating; they can never win.

1981.english: Consequently, we sent upon them devastating wind for a few miserable days that afflicted them with humiliating retribution in this life. The retribution of the hereafter is far more humiliating, and no one can help them.

1989.english: Consequently, we sent upon them violent wind, for a few miserable days to afflict them with a humiliating retribution in this life, and the retribution of the Hereafter is far more humiliating; they can never win.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما ثمود فهديناهم فاستحبوا العمى على الهدى فأخذتهم صاعقة العذاب الهون بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fa-is'taḥabbū l-ʿamā ʿalā l-hudā fa-akhadhathum ṣāʿiqatu l-ʿadhābi l-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: As for Thamûd, we provided them with guidance, but they preferred blindness over guidance. Consequently, the disastrous and shameful retribution annihilated them, because of what they earned.

1981.english: As for Thamood, we guided them, but they chose blindness instead of guidance. Consequently, humiliating retribution struck them, because of what they did.

1989.english: As for Thamoud, we provided them with guidance, but they preferred blindness over guidance. Consequently, the disastrous and shameful retribution annihilated them, because of what they earned.

verses.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ونجينا الذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون
verses.transliterated: wanajjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūn
verses.english: We always save those who believe and lead a righteous life.

1981.english: We saved those who believed and maintained righteousness.

1989.english: And we saved those who believed and led a righteous life.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يحشر أعداء الله إلى النار فهم يوزعون
verses.transliterated: wayawma yuḥ'sharu aʿdāu l-lahi ilā l-nāri fahum yūzaʿūn
verses.english: The day will come when the enemies of GOD will be summoned to the hellfire, forcibly.

1981.english: The day will come when the enemies of God are gathered into the hellfire; they will be forced.

1989.english: The day will come when the enemies of GOD will be summoned to the hellfire, forcibly.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: حتى إذا ما جاءوها شهد عليهم سمعهم وأبصارهم وجلودهم بما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: ḥattā idhā mā jāūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum wa-abṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: Once they get there, their own hearing, eyes, and skins will bear witness to everything they had done.

1981.english: When they arrive, their hearing, their eyes, and their skins will bear witness to everything they did.
1981.subtitle: All Our Works Recorded
1981.footnote: The invention of the video recording systems brings to mind the closest idea about the day of reckoning. We will view our lives from birth to death (see also 36:65). While the disbelievers cannot edit their audio/video record, the believers enjoy this advantage through repentance. Repentance edits out all our sins, and thus, they will not exist on the record.

1989.english: Once they get there, their own hearing, eyes, and skins will bear witness to everything they had done.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لجلودهم لم شهدتم علينا ۖ قالوا أنطقنا الله الذي أنطق كل شيء وهو خلقكم أول مرة وإليه ترجعون
verses.transliterated: waqālū lijulūdihim lima shahidttum ʿalaynā qālū anṭaqanā l-lahu alladhī anṭaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: They will say to their skins, "Why did you bear witness against us?" They will reply, "GOD made us speak up; He is the One who causes everything to speak. He is the One who created you the first time, and now you have been returned to Him."
verses.subtitle: The Video Record

1981.english: They will say to their skins, "Why did you bear witness against us?" It will say, "God made us speak up, for He makes everything speak up." He is the one who created you the first time, and to Him you ultimately return.
1981.footnote: The invention of the video recording systems brings to mind the closest idea about the day of reckoning. We will view our lives from birth to death (see also 36:65). While the disbelievers cannot edit their audio/video record, the believers enjoy this advantage through repentance. Repentance edits out all our sins, and thus, they will not exist on the record.

1989.english: They will say to their skins, “Why did you bear witness against us?” They will reply, “GOD made us speak up; He is the One who causes everything to speak.” He is the One who created you the first time, and to Him you will be returned.
1989.subtitle: A Video Record

verses.arabic: وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما كنتم تستترون أن يشهد عليكم سمعكم ولا أبصاركم ولا جلودكم ولكن ظننتم أن الله لا يعلم كثيرا مما تعملون
verses.transliterated: wamā kuntum tastatirūna an yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā abṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum anna l-laha lā yaʿlamu kathīran mimmā taʿmalūn
verses.english: There is no way you can hide from your own hearing, your eyes, or your skins. In fact, you thought that GOD was unaware of much of what you do.

1981.english: You could never avoid being witnessed by your own hearing, your own eyes, and your skins. In fact, you thought that God was unaware of many things you did.
1981.footnote: The invention of the video recording systems brings to mind the closest idea about the day of reckoning. We will view our lives from birth to death (see also 36:65). While the disbelievers cannot edit their audio/video record, the believers enjoy this advantage through repentance. Repentance edits out all our sins, and thus, they will not exist on the record.

1989.english: There is no way you can hide from your own hearing, your eyes, nor your skins. In fact, you thought that GOD was unaware of much of what you do.

verses.arabic: وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وذلكم ظنكم الذي ظننتم بربكم أرداكم فأصبحتم من الخاسرين
verses.transliterated: wadhālikum ẓannukumu alladhī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum fa-aṣbaḥtum mina l-khāsirīn
verses.english: This kind of thinking about your Lord will cause you to fall, and then you become losers.

1981.english: Such is your thinking about your Lord, and it was utterly detrimental to you. This is why you turned losers.

1989.english: Such thinking about your Lord is what caused your fall, and thus you became losers.

verses.arabic: فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن يصبروا فالنار مثوى لهم ۖ وإن يستعتبوا فما هم من المعتبين
verses.transliterated: fa-in yaṣbirū fal-nāru mathwan lahum wa-in yastaʿtibū famā hum mina l-muʿ'tabīn
verses.english: If they continue the way they are, Hell will be their destiny, and if they make up excuses, they will not be excused.

1981.english: No matter how long they survive, the hellfire is their inevitable destiny; and no matter what kind of excuse they offer, they are not excused.

1989.english: If they continue the way they are, Hell will be their destiny, and if they make up excuses, they will not be excused.

verses.arabic: وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقيضنا لهم قرناء فزينوا لهم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم وحق عليهم القول في أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والإنس ۖ إنهم كانوا خاسرين
verses.transliterated: waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāa fazayyanū lahum mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīn
verses.english: We assign to them companions who adorn everything they do in their eyes. Thus, they end up incurring the same fate as the previous communities of jinns and humans, who were also losers.
verses.subtitle: The Jinn Companions

1981.english: We appoint companions for them, who entice them continuously. They are condemned along with their kinds of jinns and humans. They are real losers.

1989.english: We assign to them companions who adorn everything they do in their eyes. Thus, they end up incurring the same fate as the communities who preceded them of jinns and humans, who were also losers.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا لا تسمعوا لهذا القرآن والغوا فيه لعلكم تغلبون
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tasmaʿū lihādhā l-qur'āni wal-ghaw fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūn
verses.english: Those who disbelieved said, "Do not listen to this Quran and distort it, that you may win."

1981.english: Those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Quran, and distort it, that you may prevail."
1981.subtitle: The Disbelievers Violate Quran

1989.english: Those who disbelieved said, “Do not listen to this Quran and distort it, that you may win.”

verses.arabic: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلنذيقن الذين كفروا عذابا شديدا ولنجزينهم أسوأ الذي كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: falanudhīqanna alladhīna kafarū ʿadhāban shadīdan walanajziyannahum aswa-a alladhī kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: We will certainly afflict these disbelievers with a severe retribution. We will certainly requite them for their evil works.

1981.english: Consequently, we afflict them with severe retribution, and punish them for their evil works.

1989.english: Consequently, we will afflict these disbelievers with a severe retribution. We simply requite them for their evil works.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك جزاء أعداء الله النار ۖ لهم فيها دار الخلد ۖ جزاء بما كانوا بآياتنا يجحدون
verses.transliterated: dhālika jazāu aʿdāi l-lahi l-nāru lahum fīhā dāru l-khul'di jazāan bimā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūn
verses.english: Such is the requital that awaits GOD's enemies. Hell will be their eternal abode; a just requital for discarding our revelations.

1981.english: Such is the retribution deserved by the enemies of God. Hell will be their eternal abode, for disregarding our revelations.

1989.english: Such is the requital for GOD’s enemies. Hell will be their eternal abode; a requital for discarding our revelations.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا ربنا أرنا اللذين أضلانا من الجن والإنس نجعلهما تحت أقدامنا ليكونا من الأسفلين
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū rabbanā arinā alladhayni aḍallānā mina l-jini wal-insi najʿalhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā mina l-asfalīn
verses.english: Those who disbelieved will say, "Our Lord, show us those among the two kinds—jinns and humans—who misled us, so we can trample them under our feet, and render them the lowliest."
verses.subtitle: On the Day of Judgment

1981.english: The disbelievers will say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us among the jinns and the humans, in order to trample them under our feet and debase them.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved will say, “Our Lord, show us those among the two kinds—jinns and humans— who misled us, so we can trample them under our feet, and render them the lowliest.”
1989.subtitle: On the Day of Judgment

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقاموا تتنزل عليهم الملائكة ألا تخافوا ولا تحزنوا وأبشروا بالجنة التي كنتم توعدون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu l-malāikatu allā takhāfū walā taḥzanū wa-abshirū bil-janati allatī kuntum tūʿadūn
verses.english: Those who proclaim: "Our Lord is GOD," then lead a righteous life, the angels descend upon them: "You shall have no fear, nor shall you grieve. Rejoice in the good news that Paradise has been reserved for you.
verses.subtitle: Perfect Happiness: Now and Forever

1981.english: Those who say, "Our Lord is God," then maintain righteousness, the angels descend upon them saying, "You have nothing to fear, nor will you grieve. We deliver to you good news that Paradise awaits you.
1981.subtitle: Happiness In This World Guaranteed For The Believers

1989.english: Those who say, “Our Lord is GOD,” then lead a righteous life, the angels descend upon them: “Have no fear, nor shall you grieve, and know the good news that Paradise has been reserved for you.
1989.subtitle: Perfect Happiness: Now and Forever

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: نحن أولياؤكم في الحياة الدنيا وفي الآخرة ۖ ولكم فيها ما تشتهي أنفسكم ولكم فيها ما تدعون
verses.transliterated: naḥnu awliyāukum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati walakum fīhā mā tashtahī anfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūn
verses.english: "We are your allies in this life, and in the Hereafter. You will have in it anything you wish for; you will have anything you want.

1981.english: "We are your protectors in this life, as well as in the hereafter. You will have anything you desire therein; you will have anything you ask for."

1989.english: “We are your allies in this life, and in the Hereafter. You will have in it anything you wish for; you will have anything you want.

verses.arabic: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: نزلا من غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: nuzulan min ghafūrin raḥīmi
verses.english: "(Such is your) ultimate abode, from a Forgiver, Most Merciful."

1981.english: "This is the position assigned to you by God, the forgiver, most merciful."

1989.english: “(Such is your) ultimate abode, from the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أحسن قولا ممن دعا إلى الله وعمل صالحا وقال إنني من المسلمين
verses.transliterated: waman aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ilā l-lahi waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla innanī mina l-mus'limīn
verses.english: Who can utter better words than one who invites to GOD, works righteousness, and says, "I am one of the submitters"?
verses.subtitle: Submitters

1981.english: Who is better than one who invites others to come to God, works righteousness, and says, "I am a submitter (Muslim)."

1989.english: Who can utter better statements than one who invites to GOD, works righteousness, and says, “I am one of the submitters (Muslims)!”

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تستوي الحسنة ولا السيئة ۚ ادفع بالتي هي أحسن فإذا الذي بينك وبينه عداوة كأنه ولي حميم
verses.transliterated: walā tastawī l-ḥasanatu walā l-sayi-atu id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idhā alladhī baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīmu
verses.english: Not equal is the good response and the bad response. You shall resort to the nicest possible response. Thus, the one who used to be your enemy, may become your best friend.

1981.english: The righteous deed is not the same as the evil deed. You shall counter the evil deed with the best possible response, so that the one who used to be your enemy may become a close friend.

1989.english: Not equal is the good response and the bad response. You shall resort to the nicest possible response. Thus, the one who used to be your enemy, may become your best friend.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما يلقاها إلا الذين صبروا وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم
verses.transliterated: wamā yulaqqāhā illā alladhīna ṣabarū wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: None can attain this except those who steadfastly persevere. None can attain this except those who are extremely fortunate.

1981.english: None attains this except those who steadfastly persevere; none attains this except those who are extremely fortunate.

1989.english: None can attain this except one who steadfastly perseveres. None can attain this except one who is extremely fortunate.

verses.arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله ۖ إنه هو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: When the devil whispers an idea to you, you shall seek refuge in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
verses.subtitle: When the Devil Entices You

1981.english: Whenever the devil approaches you, you shall seek refuge in God. He is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: When the devil whispers an idea to you, you shall seek refuge in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient. Signs of God
1989.subtitle: When the Devil Entices You

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر ۚ لا تسجدوا للشمس ولا للقمر واسجدوا لله الذي خلقهن إن كنتم إياه تعبدون
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi al-laylu wal-nahāru wal-shamsu wal-qamaru lā tasjudū lilshamsi walā lil'qamari wa-us'judū lillahi alladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūn
verses.english: Among His proofs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate before the sun, nor the moon; you shall fall prostrate before the GOD who created them, if you truly worship Him alone.
verses.subtitle: Proofs of God

1981.english: Among His signs are the night and day, and the sun and moon. Do not fall prostrate before the sun or the moon; you shall fall prostrate before the one God who created them, if you really worship Him.

1989.english: Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not fall prostrate before the sun, nor the moon, and fall prostrate before GOD, who created them, if you truly worship Him alone.

verses.arabic: فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإن استكبروا فالذين عند ربك يسبحون له بالليل والنهار وهم لا يسأمون ۩
verses.transliterated: fa-ini is'takbarū fa-alladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wahum lā yasamūn
verses.english: If they are too arrogant to do this, then those at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without ever tiring.

1981.english: If they are too arrogant (to prostrate), those (honorable angels) at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without tiring.

1989.english: If they are too arrogant to do this, then those at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without ever tiring.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته أنك ترى الأرض خاشعة فإذا أنزلنا عليها الماء اهتزت وربت ۚ إن الذي أحياها لمحيي الموتى ۚ إنه على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi annaka tarā l-arḍa khāshiʿatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat inna alladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Among His proofs is that you see the land still, then, as soon as we shower it with water, it vibrates with life. Surely, the One who revived it can revive the dead. He is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Among His signs is that you see the land still, then as soon as we send down water, it vibrates with life. The one who revived it can certainly revive the dead. He is omnipotent.

1989.english: Among His signs is that you see the land still, then, as soon as we shower it with water it vibrates with life. Surely, the One who revived it can revive the dead. He is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يلحدون في آياتنا لا يخفون علينا ۗ أفمن يلقى في النار خير أم من يأتي آمنا يوم القيامة ۚ اعملوا ما شئتم ۖ إنه بما تعملون بصير
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā afaman yul'qā fī l-nāri khayrun am man yatī āminan yawma l-qiyāmati iʿ'malū mā shi'tum innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīru
verses.english: Surely, those who distort our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who gets thrown into Hell better, or one who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you wish; He is Seer of everything you do.

1981.english: Those who manipulate our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who is destined for hell the same as one who comes secure on the day of resurrection? Do whatever you choose to do; He fully sees everything you do.
1981.subtitle: Blaspheming Against Quran

1989.english: Surely, those who distort our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who gets thrown into Hell better, or one who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; He is Seer of everything you do. No Falsehood Can Enter The Quran*

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا بالذكر لما جاءهم ۖ وإنه لكتاب عزيز
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū bil-dhik'ri lammā jāahum wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzu
verses.english: Those who have rejected the Quran's proof  when it came to them, have also rejected an Honorable book.
verses.subtitle: Mathematical Miracle of the Quran
verses.footnote: The word "Zikr" refers to the Quran's mathematical code, as made clear in 38:1.

1981.english: They reject this message when given to them, though it is a profound scripture.

1989.english: Those who have rejected the message when it came to them, have rejected an Honorable book.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: لا يأتيه الباطل من بين يديه ولا من خلفه ۖ تنزيل من حكيم حميد
verses.transliterated: lā yatīhi l-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi tanzīlun min ḥakīmin ḥamīdi
verses.english: No falsehood could enter it, in the past or in the future; a revelation from a Most Wise, Praiseworthy.
verses.footnote: One of the major functions of the Quran's mathematical miracle is to guard every letter and every aspect of the Quran. Thus, any tampering is immediately recognized (Apps. 1 & 24).

1981.english: No falsehood can ever enter it, in the past or in the future; for it is a revelation from God, most wise, praiseworthy.

1989.english: No falsehood can ever enter it, from its front, nor its back;* a revelation from a Most Wise, Praiseworthy.
1989.footnote: The Quran’s formidable mathematical composition guarantees that any addition, deletion, or distortion of a single letter or any other element in the Quran, is exposed and utterly rejected. The one attempt by idolizers of the Prophet to inject two false verses was thus exposed. The “pure” Quran always existed. See Appendices 1 & 24.

verses.arabic: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: ما يقال لك إلا ما قد قيل للرسل من قبلك ۚ إن ربك لذو مغفرة وذو عقاب أليم
verses.transliterated: mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin wadhū ʿiqābin alīmi
verses.english: What is said to you is precisely what was said to the previous messengers. Your Lord possesses forgiveness, and He also possesses painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: Mathematical proof shows that this verse refers to God's Messenger of the Covenant. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus this verse number (43), we get 505+725+43=1273=19x67. See Appendix 2.

1981.english: What is said to you was said to messengers before you. Surely, your Lord possesses forgiveness, as well as painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: Language Is No Barrier

1989.english: What is said to you is precisely what was said to the previous messengers. Your Lord possesses forgiveness, and He also possesses painful retribution. Language is Irrelevant

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولو جعلناه قرآنا أعجميا لقالوا لولا فصلت آياته ۖ أأعجمي وعربي ۗ قل هو للذين آمنوا هدى وشفاء ۖ والذين لا يؤمنون في آذانهم وقر وهو عليهم عمى ۚ أولئك ينادون من مكان بعيد
verses.transliterated: walaw jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan aʿjamiyyan laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu āʿ'jamiyyun waʿarabiyyun qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan washifāon wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna fī ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿaman ulāika yunādawna min makānin baʿīdi
verses.english: If we made it a non-Arabic Quran they would have said, "Why did it come down in that language?" Whether it is Arabic or non-Arabic, say, "For those who believe, it is a guide and healing. As for those who disbelieve, they will be deaf and blind to it, as if they are being addressed from faraway."
verses.subtitle: Language is Irrelevant

1981.english: Had we made it a non-Arabic Quran, they would have said, "Why did it come down in that language?" Whether it is non-Arabic or Arabic, say, "For those who believe, it is a beacon and a healing (regardless of their language).* As for those who do not believe, they will be deaf and blind to it; as if they are being called from afar.
1981.footnote: We are told here that the only prerequisite to fully understand the Quran is sincerity of faith. The Quran will be placed into the hearts of sincere believers, regardless of their language. On the other hand, those who are not sincere will be rendered incapable of understanding the Quran, even if they are the highest scholars of Arabic linguistics. The Quran is not like any other book (see 17:45-46 and 18:57), and God is the only teacher thereof (see 55:1-2, 75:19 and Appendices 3 and 17).

1989.english: If we made it a non-Arabic Quran they would have said, “Why did it come down in that language?” Whether it is in Arabic or non- Arabic, say, “For those who believe, it is a guide and healing (regardless of their language). As for those who disbelieve, they will be deaf and blind to it, as if they are being addressed from a faraway place.”

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فاختلف فيه ۗ ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم ۚ وإنهم لفي شك منه مريب
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībi
verses.english: We have given Moses the scripture and it was also disputed. If it were not for your Lord's predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, they harbor too many doubts.

1981.english: We have given Moses the scripture, and it too was disputed. If it were not for a predetermined decision by your Lord, they would have been judged immediately. They are in great doubt thereof.

1989.english: We have given Moses the scripture (in Hebrew), and it was also disputed. If it were not for your Lord’s predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, they harbor many doubts.

verses.arabic: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: من عمل صالحا فلنفسه ۖ ومن أساء فعليها ۗ وما ربك بظلام للعبيد
verses.transliterated: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīd
verses.english: Whoever works righteousness, does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. Your Lord is never unjust towards the people.

1981.english: Whoever works righteousness does so for his own good, and whoever commits evil does so to his own detriment. Your Lord is never unjust towards the people.

1989.english: Whoever works righteousness, does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. Your Lord is never unjust towards the people.

verses.arabic: إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: إليه يرد علم الساعة ۚ وما تخرج من ثمرات من أكمامها وما تحمل من أنثى ولا تضع إلا بعلمه ۚ ويوم يناديهم أين شركائي قالوا آذناك ما منا من شهيد
verses.transliterated: ilayhi yuraddu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wamā takhruju min thamarātin min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdi
verses.english: With Him is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world). No fruits emerge from their sheaths, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He asks them: "Where are those idols that you set up beside Me?" They will say, "We proclaim to You that none of us bears witness to that."
verses.subtitle: Idols Disown Their Followers
verses.footnote: God has revealed this knowledge through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 25).

1981.english: Only He knows the time of resurrection; not a fruit emerges from its sheath, nor a female bears a fetus or gives birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He calls upon them, "Where are the idols you had set up besides Me?" They will say, "We hear; but there is no witness among us."

1989.english: Knowledge about the Hour is with Him.* No fruits emerge from their sheaths, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He asks them: “Where are those idols that you set up besides Me?” They will say, “We proclaim to You that none of us bears witness to that.”
1989.subtitle: Idols Disown Their Followers
1989.footnote: See Appendix 25.

verses.arabic: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.arabicClean: وضل عنهم ما كانوا يدعون من قبل ۖ وظنوا ما لهم من محيص
verses.transliterated: waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum min maḥīṣi
verses.english: The idols they had idolized will disown them, and they will realize that there will be no escape.

1981.english: Thus, whatever they idolize will abandon them, and they will find no refuge.

1989.english: The idols they had idolized will disown them, and they will realize that there is no escape.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
verses.arabicClean: لا يسأم الإنسان من دعاء الخير وإن مسه الشر فيئوس قنوط
verses.transliterated: lā yasamu l-insānu min duʿāi l-khayri wa-in massahu l-sharu fayaūsun qanūṭu
verses.english: The human being never tires of imploring for good things. And when adversity befalls him, he turns despondent, desperate.
verses.subtitle: Bad Weather Friends

1981.english: The human being never tires from imploring for bounties. But when afflicted with adversity, he becomes despondent, desparate.
1981.subtitle: Submission Required Under All Circumstances

1989.english: The human being never tires of imploring for good things. And when adversity befalls him, he turns despondent, desperate.
1989.subtitle: Bad Weather Friends

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولئن أذقناه رحمة منا من بعد ضراء مسته ليقولن هذا لي وما أظن الساعة قائمة ولئن رجعت إلى ربي إن لي عنده للحسنى ۚ فلننبئن الذين كفروا بما عملوا ولنذيقنهم من عذاب غليظ
verses.transliterated: wala-in adhaqnāhu raḥmatan minnā min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rujiʿ'tu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahu lalḥus'nā falanunabbi-anna alladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓi
verses.english: And when we bless him after suffering some adversity, he says, "This belongs to me. I do not believe that the Hour will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find at Him better things." Most certainly, we will inform the disbelievers of all their works, and will commit them to severe retribution.

1981.english: When we endow him with mercy from us, after adversity had afflicted him, he says, "I deserve this; I do not believe in resurrection; even if returned to my Lord, I will find better things." We will certainly inform the disbelievers of everything they had done. We will let them suffer terrible retribution.

1989.english: Then, when we bless him after suffering some adversity, he says, “This belongs to me. I do not believe that the Hour will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find at Him better things.” Most certainly, we will inform the disbelievers of all their works, and will afflict them with severe retribution.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا أنعمنا على الإنسان أعرض ونأى بجانبه وإذا مسه الشر فذو دعاء عريض
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu fadhū duʿāin ʿarīḍi
verses.english: When we bless the human being, he turns away, and drifts farther and farther away, and when he suffers any affliction, he implores loudly.

1981.english: When we endow man with a blessing, he becomes heedless and turns away; but when adversity touches him, he implores loudly.

1989.english: When we bless the human being, he turns and drifts farther and farther away. But as soon as he suffers an affliction, he implores loudly.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن كان من عند الله ثم كفرتم به من أضل ممن هو في شقاق بعيد
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi thumma kafartum bihi man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqin baʿīdi
verses.english: Proclaim: "What if this is truly from GOD, then you decide to reject it? Who are farther astray than those who decide to oppose this?"

1981.english: Say, "What if it is really from God, and you disbelieve therein? Who is worse than those who oppose it?"
1981.subtitle: Quran's Miracles To Be Revealed

1989.english: Say, “What if this is from GOD, and you reject it? Who is farther astray than one who opposes this?”

verses.arabic: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْءَافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: سنريهم آياتنا في الآفاق وفي أنفسهم حتى يتبين لهم أنه الحق ۗ أولم يكف بربك أنه على كل شيء شهيد
verses.transliterated: sanurīhim āyātinā fī l-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahu l-ḥaqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
verses.english: We will show them our proofs in the horizons, and within themselves, until they realize that this is the truth. Is your Lord not sufficient, as a witness of all things?
verses.subtitle: A Great Prophecy
verses.footnote: The letters that compose this verse are 19, and their gematrical values add up to 1387, 19x73. This great prophecy, together with 9:33, 48:28, 61:9 & 110:2, informs us that the whole world is destined to accept the Quran as God's unaltered message (See Appendix 38).

1981.english: We will show them our miracles in the horizons and within themselves, until it becomes evident that this is the truth. Is your Lord not sufficient as witness to all things?

1989.english: We will show them our signs in the horizons, and within themselves, until they realize that this is the truth. Is your Lord not sufficient? He witnesses all things.*
1989.subtitle: The Great Prophecy
1989.footnote: As detailed in Appendix 1, God has provided physical, verifiable, perpetual, and utterly irrefutable proof that this Quran is divine truth. This great prophecy, together with 9:33, 48:28, 61:9 & 110:2 inform us that the whole world is destined to accept the Quran as God’s unaltered message to the world. God witnesses the future (App. 38).

verses.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: ألا إنهم في مرية من لقاء ربهم ۗ ألا إنه بكل شيء محيط
verses.transliterated: alā innahum fī mir'yatin min liqāi rabbihim alā innahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭu
verses.english: Indeed, they are doubtful about meeting their Lord. He is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: Indeed, they harbor doubts about meeting their Lord, and He is fully aware of everything.

1989.english: They harbor doubts about meeting their Lord, and He is fully aware of all things.

verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم حم
verses.transliterated: hha-meem
verses.english: H.M.
verses.footnote: These initials constitute a significant part of the Quran's miracle (Footnote 40:1).

1981.english: H. M.
1981.footnote: See footnote 40:1.

1989.english: H.M.*
1989.footnote: These initials constitute a significant part of the Quran’s miracle (Footnote 40:1).

verses.arabic: عٓسٓقٓ
verses.arabicClean: عسق
verses.transliterated: ain-seen-qaaf
verses.english: A. S. Q.
verses.footnote: This is the only sura where we see the initials 'A.S.Q. ('Ayn Seen Qaf), and the total occurrence of these three letters in this sura is 209, 19x11. Also, the letter "Q" occurs in this sura 57 times, 19x3. The only other sura where we see the initial "Q" is Sura 50, and this letter occurs in that sura also 57 times (See Appendix 1).

1981.english: 'A. S. Q.
1981.footnote: When the reader counts the Arabic letters 'Ayn, Seen, and Qaf, in this sura, he will find their total frequency of occurrence 209, a multiple of 19. Thus, it conforms to the Quran's secret numerical code. The letter Q has a special characteristic. There is only one other sura that is initiated with this letter, namely sura 50, which is entitled "Q." The frequency of occurrence of the letter Q in each of these suras is exactly the same, 57, despite the difference in length of the two suras. For details of this Quranic miracle, see Appendix 1.

1989.footnote: This is the only sura where we see the initials ‘A.S.Q. Ayn Seen Qaf), and the total occurrence of these three letters in this sura is 209, 19x11. Also, the letter “Q’ occurs in this sura 57 times, 19x3. The only other sura where we see the initial “Q” is Sura 50, and this letter occurs in that sura also 57 times (See Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك يوحي إليك وإلى الذين من قبلك الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: Inspiring you, and those before you, is GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: This is what is revealed to you and to those before you from God, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: Inspiring you, and those before you, is GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۖ وهو العلي العظيم
verses.transliterated: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and He is the Most High, the Great.

1981.english: To Him belong everything in the heavens and the earth. He is the most high, the great.

1989.english: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and He is the Most High, the Great.

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: تكاد السماوات يتفطرن من فوقهن ۚ والملائكة يسبحون بحمد ربهم ويستغفرون لمن في الأرض ۗ ألا إن الله هو الغفور الرحيم
verses.transliterated: takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fī l-arḍi alā inna l-laha huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīm
verses.english: The heavens above them almost shatter, out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise and glorify their Lord, and they ask forgiveness for those on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: The heavens almost shatter out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise the glory of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Indeed, God is the forgiver, most merciful.

1989.english: The heavens above them almost shatter out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise and glorify their Lord, and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء الله حفيظ عليهم وما أنت عليهم بوكيل
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa l-lahu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīli
verses.english: Those who set up other lords beside Him, GOD is the One in charge of them; you are not their advocate.

1981.english: Those who set up idols besides Him, God is in full charge of them; you are not their advocate.

1989.english: Those who set up other lords besides Him, GOD is the One in charge of them; you are not their advocate.

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: وكذلك أوحينا إليك قرآنا عربيا لتنذر أم القرى ومن حولها وتنذر يوم الجمع لا ريب فيه ۚ فريق في الجنة وفريق في السعير
verses.transliterated: wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan litundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma l-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi farīqun fī l-janati wafarīqun fī l-saʿīr
verses.english: We thus reveal to you an Arabic Quran to warn the central community and all around it, and to warn about the Day of Summoning that is inevitable. Some will end up in Heaven, and some in Hell.

1981.english: We have revealed to you this Quran in Arabic, to warn the central town and all around it, and to warn about the day of gathering, which is inevitable. Consequently, some will deserve heaven and some will deserve hell.

1989.english: We thus revealed to you an Arabic Quran to warn the central community and all around it, and to warn about the Day of Summoning that is inevitable. Some will be in Heaven, and some will be in Hell.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولو شاء الله لجعلهم أمة واحدة ولكن يدخل من يشاء في رحمته ۚ والظالمون ما لهم من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalahum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimūna mā lahum min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: Had GOD willed, He could have made them one community. But He redeems into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the transgressors, they have no master, nor a helper.

1981.english: Had God willed, He could have made you one congregation. But He admits whomever He wills into His mercy, while the wicked have no lord or supporter.

1989.english: Had GOD willed, He could have made them one community. But He redeems into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the transgressors, they have no master, nor a helper.

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أم اتخذوا من دونه أولياء ۖ فالله هو الولي وهو يحيي الموتى وهو على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa fal-lahu huwa l-waliyu wahuwa yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Did they find other lords beside Him? GOD is the only Lord and Master. He is the One who resurrects the dead, and He is the Omnipotent One.

1981.english: Why should they set up idols besides Him, when God is the Lord? He is the one who resurrects the dead, and He is omnipotent.

1989.english: Did they find other lords besides Him? GOD is the only Lord, and He is the One who resurrects the dead, and He is the Omnipotent One.

verses.arabic: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
verses.arabicClean: وما اختلفتم فيه من شيء فحكمه إلى الله ۚ ذلكم الله ربي عليه توكلت وإليه أنيب
verses.transliterated: wamā ikh'talaftum fīhi min shayin faḥuk'muhu ilā l-lahi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unīb
verses.english: If you dispute any part of this message, the judgment for doing this rests with GOD. Such is GOD my Lord. In Him I trust, and to Him I submit.

1981.english: Anything you dispute among yourselves will be ultimately judged by God. Such is God, my Lord; in Him I trust, and to Him I submit.

1989.english: If you dispute any part of this message, the judgment for doing this rests with GOD. Such is GOD my Lord. In Him I trust, and to Him I submit.

verses.arabic: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: فاطر السماوات والأرض ۚ جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا ومن الأنعام أزواجا ۖ يذرؤكم فيه ۚ ليس كمثله شيء ۖ وهو السميع البصير
verses.transliterated: fāṭiru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wamina l-anʿāmi azwājan yadhra-ukum fīhi laysa kamith'lihi shayon wahuwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīr
verses.english: Initiator of the heavens and the earth. He created for you from among yourselves spouses—and also for the animals. He thus provides you with the means to multiply. There is nothing that equals Him. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
verses.subtitle: None Equals God

1981.english: He is the initiator of the heavens and the earth. He created for you mates, from among you, and also for the animals, in order to multiply. Nothing equals Him; He is the hearer, the seer.

1989.english: He is the Initiator of the heavens and the earth. He created for you, from among you, spouses, and created for the livestock mates, in order to multiply. There is nothing that equals Him. He is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: له مقاليد السماوات والأرض ۖ يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر ۚ إنه بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He is the One who increases the provision for whomever He wills, or reduces it. He is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: To Him belongs the keys of the heavens and the earth. He increases the provision for whomever He wills, or reduces it. He is omniscient.

1989.english: To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He increases the provision for whomever He wills, and reduces it. He is fully aware of all things. Only One Religion

verses.arabic: شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
verses.arabicClean: شرع لكم من الدين ما وصى به نوحا والذي أوحينا إليك وما وصينا به إبراهيم وموسى وعيسى ۖ أن أقيموا الدين ولا تتفرقوا فيه ۚ كبر على المشركين ما تدعوهم إليه ۚ الله يجتبي إليه من يشاء ويهدي إليه من ينيب
verses.transliterated: sharaʿa lakum mina l-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmū l-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīhi kabura ʿalā l-mush'rikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayhi l-lahu yajtabī ilayhi man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man yunīb
verses.english: He decreed for you the same religion decreed for Noah, and what we inspired to you, and what we decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: "You shall uphold this one religion, and do not divide it."The idol worshipers will greatly resent what you invite them to do. GOD redeems to Himself whomever He wills; He guides to Himself only those who totally submit.
verses.subtitle: Only One Religion, Monotheists vs Idol Worshipers

1981.english: He has decreed for you the same religion decreed for Noah, and what is revealed herein, and what was decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus. You shall uphold the one religion, and do not be divided. It is simply too difficult for the idol worshipers to accept what you advocate. God is the one who brings towards Him whomever He wills; He guides towards Himself those who submit.
1981.subtitle: Only One Religion

1989.english: He decreed for you the same religion He decreed for Noah, and what we inspired to you, and what we decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: “You shall uphold this one religion, and do not divide it.” The idol worshipers will resent what you invite them to do. GOD redeems to Himself whomever He wills; He guides to Himself everyone who submits.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما تفرقوا إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ۚ ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك إلى أجل مسمى لقضي بينهم ۚ وإن الذين أورثوا الكتاب من بعدهم لفي شك منه مريب
verses.transliterated: wamā tafarraqū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilā ajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna alladhīna ūrithū l-kitāba min baʿdihim lafī shakkin min'hu murībi
verses.english: Ironically, they broke up into sects only after the knowledge had come to them, due to jealousy and resentment among themselves. If it were not for a predetermined decision from your Lord to respite them for a definite interim, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the later generations who inherited the scripture are full of doubts.

1981.english: They became divided after the knowledge had come to them, due to sheer jealousy. If it were not for a predetermined decision by your Lord, they would have been judged immediately. Even those who inherited the scripture continued to harbor doubts.

1989.english: Ironically, they broke up into sects—only after the knowledge had come to them—due to jealousy and resentment among themselves. If it were not for a predetermined decision from your Lord to respite them for a definite interim, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, these later generations who inherited the scripture are full of doubts.
1989.subtitle: Monotheists w Idol Worshipers

verses.arabic: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَآ أَعْمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: فلذلك فادع ۖ واستقم كما أمرت ۖ ولا تتبع أهواءهم ۖ وقل آمنت بما أنزل الله من كتاب ۖ وأمرت لأعدل بينكم ۖ الله ربنا وربكم ۖ لنا أعمالنا ولكم أعمالكم ۖ لا حجة بيننا وبينكم ۖ الله يجمع بيننا ۖ وإليه المصير
verses.transliterated: falidhālika fa-ud'ʿu wa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta walā tattabiʿ ahwāahum waqul āmantu bimā anzala l-lahu min kitābin wa-umir'tu li-aʿdila baynakumu l-lahu rabbunā warabbukum lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakumu l-lahu yajmaʿu baynanā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīr
verses.english: This is what you shall preach, and steadfastly maintain what you are commanded to do, and do not follow their wishes. And proclaim: "I believe in all the scriptures sent down by GOD. I was commanded to judge among you equitably. GOD is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no argument between us and you. GOD will gather us all together; to Him is the ultimate destiny."
verses.subtitle: Message to the Christians and the Jews

1981.english: You shall preach and uphold this scripture as commanded, and do not follow their wishes. And say, "I believe in all the scriptures revealed by God, and I am commanded to treat you amicably, God is our Lord and your Lord; we have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no argument between us and you. God will gather us together; to Him is the ultimate destiny."

1989.english: This is what you shall preach, and steadfastly maintain what you are commanded to do, and do not follow their wishes. And say, “I believe in all the scriptures sent down by GOD. I was commanded to judge among you equitably. GOD is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no dispute between us and you. GOD will gather us all together; to Him is the ultimate destiny.”
1989.subtitle: Message to the Christians and the Jews

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يحاجون في الله من بعد ما استجيب له حجتهم داحضة عند ربهم وعليهم غضب ولهم عذاب شديد
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yuḥājjūna fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā us'tujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdu
verses.english: Those who argue about GOD, after receiving His message, their argument is nullified at their Lord. They have incurred condemnation, and have deserved a severe retribution.

1981.english: Those who argue about God, after being declared, their argument is nullified at their Lord; they have deserved wrath and retribution.

1989.english: Those who argue about GOD with people who have responded to Him, their argument is nullified at their Lord, they have incurred wrath, and have deserved a severe retribution.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي أنزل الكتاب بالحق والميزان ۗ وما يدريك لعل الساعة قريب
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī anzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wal-mīzāna wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata qarību
verses.english: GOD is the One who sent down the scripture, to deliver the truth and the law. For all that you know, the Hour (Day of Judgment) may be very close.

1981.english: God is the one who revealed this scripture truthfully and equitably. For all you know, the Hour may be very close.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 14. The hour of resurrection is only as far from us as the end of our individual lives in this world.

1989.english: GOD is the One who sent down the scripture, bringing the truth and the law. For all that you know, the Hour may be very close.

verses.arabic: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: يستعجل بها الذين لا يؤمنون بها ۖ والذين آمنوا مشفقون منها ويعلمون أنها الحق ۗ ألا إن الذين يمارون في الساعة لفي ضلال بعيد
verses.transliterated: yastaʿjilu bihā alladhīna lā yu'minūna bihā wa-alladhīna āmanū mush'fiqūna min'hā wayaʿlamūna annahā l-ḥaqu alā inna alladhīna yumārūna fī l-sāʿati lafī ḍalālin baʿīdi
verses.english: Challenging it are those who do not believe in it. As for those who believe, they are concerned about it, and they know that it is the truth. Absolutely, those who deny the Hour have gone far astray.
verses.subtitle: The Believers Mindful of the Day of Judgment

1981.english: Challenging it are those who do not believe in it. But those who believe are concerned about it, and recognize that it is the inevitable truth. Indeed, those who are doubtful about the Hour are totally astray.

1989.english: Challenging it are those who do not believe in it. As for those who believe, they are concerned about it, and know that it is the truth. Absolutely, those who deny the Hour (the Day of Judgment) have gone far astray.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
verses.arabicClean: الله لطيف بعباده يرزق من يشاء ۖ وهو القوي العزيز
verses.transliterated: al-lahu laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāu wahuwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīz
verses.english: GOD is fully aware of all His creatures; He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Almighty.

1981.english: God is most compassionate towards His servants, providing as He wills. He is the most powerful, the almighty.

1989.english: GOD is Compassionate towards His creatures; He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Almighty.

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: من كان يريد حرث الآخرة نزد له في حرثه ۖ ومن كان يريد حرث الدنيا نؤته منها وما له في الآخرة من نصيب
verses.transliterated: man kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-ākhirati nazid lahu fī ḥarthihi waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā wamā lahu fī l-ākhirati min naṣībi
verses.english: Whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we multiply the rewards for him. And whoever seeks the materials of this world, we give him therefrom, then he receives no share in the Hereafter.

1981.english: Anyone who seeks the harvest of the hereafter, we multiply his harvest. But anyone who seeks the harvest of this world, we will give him therefrom, while receiving no share in the hereafter.

1989.english: Whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we multiply the rewards for him. And whoever seeks the materials of this world, we give him therefrom, while reserving no share for him in the Hereafter. Inventing A New Religion*

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: أم لهم شركاء شرعوا لهم من الدين ما لم يأذن به الله ۚ ولولا كلمة الفصل لقضي بينهم ۗ وإن الظالمين لهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: am lahum shurakāu sharaʿū lahum mina l-dīni mā lam yadhan bihi l-lahu walawlā kalimatu l-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: They follow idols who decree for them religious laws never authorized by GOD. If it were not for the predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the transgressors have incurred a painful retribution.
verses.subtitle: The Idols: Innovating New Religious Laws
verses.footnote: The Islam of today's Muslim world has been so distorted, it has become a Satanic cult. The Ulama, or religious scholars, have added many extraneous laws, prohibitions, dress codes, dietary regulations, and religious practices never authorized by God. This is one of the main reasons for sending God's Messenger of the Covenant (9:31, 33:67, and Appendix 33).

1981.english: They follow idols who decree for them religious laws never authorized by God.* If it were not for the predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. The wicked have deserved painful retribution.
1981.subtitle: The Idol Worshipers Invent Laws
1981.footnote: A typical example is shown in footnote 24:1-2. The idol worshipers refuse to accept God's laws and follow instead laws attributed to their idols, including the prophet and the various saints and imams. When God alone is advocated as the only source of jurisprudence, they become uncontrollably upset (see 17:46, 39:45, 40:10-12, and 40:84).

1989.english: They follow idols who decree for them religious laws never authorized by GOD. If it were not for the predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the transgressors have incurred a painful retribution.*
1989.footnote: The Islam of today’s “Muslim” world has been so distorted, it has become a Satanic cult. The Ulama, or religious scholars, have added too many extraneous laws, prohibitions, dress codes, dietary regulations, and religious practices never authorized by God. This is why God’s Messenger of the Covenant was sent (9:31, 33:67, App. 33).

verses.arabic: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ترى الظالمين مشفقين مما كسبوا وهو واقع بهم ۗ والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات في روضات الجنات ۖ لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ۚ ذلك هو الفضل الكبير
verses.transliterated: tarā l-ẓālimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍāti l-janāti lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīr
verses.english: You will see the transgressors worried about everything they had committed; everything will come back and haunt them. As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of Paradise. They will receive whatever they wish from their Lord. This is the great blessing.

1981.english: You will see the wicked frightened by their own works, knowing that the consequences are unavoidable. As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in gardens of Paradise where they have anything they wish. This is the greatest achievement.

1989.english: You will see the transgressors worried about what they earned, and for sure it will afflict them. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of Paradise. They receive whatever they wish at their Lord. This is the great blessing.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك الذي يبشر الله عباده الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ۗ قل لا أسألكم عليه أجرا إلا المودة في القربى ۗ ومن يقترف حسنة نزد له فيها حسنا ۚ إن الله غفور شكور
verses.transliterated: dhālika alladhī yubashiru l-lahu ʿibādahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran illā l-mawadata fī l-qur'bā waman yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fīhā ḥus'nan inna l-laha ghafūrun shakūru
verses.english: This is the good news from GOD to His servants who believe and lead a righteous life. Say, "I do not ask you for any wage. I do ask each of you to take care of your own relatives." Anyone who does a righteous work, we multiply his reward for it. GOD is Forgiver, Appreciative.

1981.english: Such is the good news that God offers to His servants who believe and work righteousness. Say, "I do not ask you for any wage; I ask that each of you regard his own relatives.*" Whoever produces a righteous work, we multiply it for him manyfold. God is forgiver, appreciative.
1981.footnote: If everyone regards his own relatives, we will all be taken care of.

1989.english: This is the good news from GOD to His servants who believe and lead a righteous life. Say, “I do not ask you for any money. All I ask is that each of you shall take care of his own relatives.” Anyone who performs a righteous work, we multiply his reward for it. GOD is Forgiver, Appreciative. God Controls the Writing of the Scripture He Erases the Falsehood and Fixes the Truth*

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون افترى على الله كذبا ۖ فإن يشإ الله يختم على قلبك ۗ ويمح الله الباطل ويحق الحق بكلماته ۚ إنه عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fa-in yasha-i l-lahu yakhtim ʿalā qalbika wayamḥu l-lahu l-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: Are they saying, "He (Rashad) has fabricated lies about GOD!"? If GOD willed, He could have sealed your mind, but GOD erases the falsehood and affirms the truth with His words. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
verses.subtitle: God Erases the Falsehood and Affirms the Truth
verses.footnote: The disbelievers added 2 false statements at the end of Sura 9 to commemorate their idol, the prophet Muhammad. God has revealed overwhelming evidence to erase this blasphemy and establish the truth. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (24), we get 1254, 19x66 (please see Appendices 2 & 24 for the details).

1981.english: If they claim that you fabricated some lies and attributed them to God, then God is able to seal your heart, erase any falsehood, and reestablish the truth with His words. He is fully aware of the innermost intentions.
1981.footnote: We are told here that even if the prophet erred or unintentionally distorted the Quran, God would have corrected any distortion. God is omnipotent, and He has guaranteed the integrity of Quran forever (see 15:9 and 17:73-75).

1989.english: Are they saying, “He fabricated lies about GOD!?” If GOD willed, He could have sealed your mind. GOD erases what is wrong,* and fixes the truth of His words. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
1989.footnote: An example of erasing falsehood and fixing the truth is in Appendix 24.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي يقبل التوبة عن عباده ويعفو عن السيئات ويعلم ما تفعلون
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfū ʿani l-sayiāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūn
verses.english: He is the One who accepts the repentance from His servants, and remits the sins. He is fully aware of everything you do.

1981.english: He accepts the repentance of His servants and pardons the sins. He is fully aware of everything you do.

1989.english: And He is the One who accepts the repentance from His servants, and remits the sins. He is fully aware of everything you do.

verses.arabic: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: ويستجيب الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ويزيدهم من فضله ۚ والكافرون لهم عذاب شديد
verses.transliterated: wayastajību alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdu
verses.english: Responding to Him are those who believe and lead a righteous life. He will shower them with His blessings. As for the disbelievers, they have incurred a severe retribution.

1981.english: He responds to those who believe and work righteousness and increases His blessings to them, while the disbelievers have deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: Those who believe and lead a righteous life respond to Him, and He showers them with His blessings. As for the disbelievers, they have incurred a severe retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولو بسط الله الرزق لعباده لبغوا في الأرض ولكن ينزل بقدر ما يشاء ۚ إنه بعباده خبير بصير
verses.transliterated: walaw basaṭa l-lahu l-riz'qa liʿibādihi labaghaw fī l-arḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mā yashāu innahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīru
verses.english: If GOD increased the provision for His servants, they would transgress on earth. This is why He sends it precisely measured to whomever He wills. He is fully Cognizant and Seer of His servants.

1981.english: If God were to increase the provisions for His servants, they would transgress; this is why He sends it down in exact measure, as He wills. He is fully cognizant of His servants' needs, seer.
1981.subtitle: Why God Controls Provisions

1989.english: If GOD increased the provision for His servants, they would transgress on earth. This is why He sends it precisely measured to whomever He wills. Surely, He is fully Cognizant and Seer of His servants.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي ينزل الغيث من بعد ما قنطوا وينشر رحمته ۚ وهو الولي الحميد
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatahu wahuwa l-waliyu l-ḥamīd
verses.english: He is the One who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. He is the only Master, Most Praiseworthy.

1981.english: He is the one who sends down the rain when they despair and spreads His mercy. He is the only Lord, the praiseworthy.

1989.english: And He is the One who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. He is the only Master, the Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته خلق السماوات والأرض وما بث فيهما من دابة ۚ وهو على جمعهم إذا يشاء قدير
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbatin wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāu qadīru
verses.english: Among His proofs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the creatures He spreads in them. He is able to summon them, when He wills.

1981.english: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the creatures He spread in both of them. He is able to gather them together, when He so wills.

1989.english: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and all the creatures He spread in them. He is certainly able to summon them all, if He so wills.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما أصابكم من مصيبة فبما كسبت أيديكم ويعفو عن كثير
verses.transliterated: wamā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīri
verses.english: Anything bad that happens to you is a consequence of your own deeds, and He overlooks many (of your sins).
verses.subtitle: Only A Consequence

1981.english: Any disaster that hits you is the result of your own works, and He overlooks much more.

1989.english: Any disaster that afflicts you is a consequence of something you have done. And He overlooks many (of your sins).
1989.subtitle: Only A Consequence

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وما أنتم بمعجزين في الأرض ۖ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
verses.transliterated: wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīri
verses.english: You can never escape, and you have none beside GOD as a Lord and Master.

1981.english: There is no escape for anyone, and you have none besides God as Lord and supporter.

1989.english: You can never escape, and you have none besides GOD as Master and Helper.

verses.arabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن آياته الجوار في البحر كالأعلام
verses.transliterated: wamin āyātihi l-jawāri fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlām
verses.english: Among His proofs are the ships that sail the sea with sails like flags.

1981.english: Among His signs are the ships that roam the sea like flags.

1989.english: Among His signs are the ships that sail the ocean like flags.

verses.arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن يشأ يسكن الريح فيظللن رواكد على ظهره ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور
