1989.english: We have sent it down in a blessed night, in order to warn.

verses.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فيها يفرق كل أمر حكيم
verses.transliterated: fīhā yuf'raqu kullu amrin ḥakīmi
verses.english: In it (the scripture), every matter of wisdom is clarified.

1981.english: In it, every matter of wisdom is explained.

1989.english: In it, every matter of wisdom is clear.

verses.arabic: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أمرا من عندنا ۚ إنا كنا مرسلين
verses.transliterated: amran min ʿindinā innā kunnā mur'silīn
verses.english: It is a predetermined command from us that we send messengers.

1981.english: This is our decision; we are to send messengers.

1989.english: It is a predetermined command from us; we send messengers.

verses.arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: رحمة من ربك ۚ إنه هو السميع العليم
verses.transliterated: raḥmatan min rabbika innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: This is a mercy from your Lord. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.

1981.english: This is mercy from your Lord; He is the hearer, the omniscient.

1989.english: A mercy from your Lord. He is the H ^ rer ihp Omnisrient

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما ۖ إن كنتم موقنين
verses.transliterated: rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīn
verses.english: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. If only you could be certain!

1981.english: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, if you only believe.

1989.english: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; Have you attained certainty?

verses.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: لا إله إلا هو يحيي ويميت ۖ ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين
verses.transliterated: lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīn
verses.english: There is no other god beside Him. He controls life and death; your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors.

1981.english: There is no god except He; the one who controls life and death; your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors.

1989.english: There is no other god besides Him. He controls life and death. Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل هم في شك يلعبون
verses.transliterated: bal hum fī shakkin yalʿabūn
verses.english: Indeed, they are doubtful, heedless.

1981.english: Indeed, they are doubtful, heedless.

1989.english: Indeed, they are doubtful, heedless.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فارتقب يوم تأتي السماء بدخان مبين
verses.transliterated: fa-ir'taqib yawma tatī l-samāu bidukhānin mubīni
verses.english: Therefore, watch for the day when the sky brings a profound smoke.
verses.subtitle: The Smoke: A Major Prophecy
verses.footnote: Only two signs are yet to be fulfilled, this smoke and Gog and Magog (Appendix 25).

1981.english: Watch for the day when the sky brings overwhelming smoke.
1981.subtitle: Before The End Of The World
1981.footnote: This is one of the signs that must be fulfilled before the end of the world. The other signs include the appearance of a creature who will exhort the people to believe (27:82), the splitting of the moon (54:1), and the discovery of Quran's secret numerical code (74:30-37), and the invasion by Gog and Magog (18:94-99 & 21:96). Three of these signs appear to have been fulfilled, namely, the decoding of the Quran's secret, the violation of the moon in 1969, and the appearance of the "creature," i.e., the computer (see footnote 27:82).

1989.english: Therefore, watch for the day when the sky brings a profound smoke.*
1989.subtitle: A Major Prophecy
1989.footnote: This prophecy takes place after the advent of God’s Messenger of the Covenant

verses.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يغشى الناس ۖ هذا عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yaghshā l-nāsa hādhā ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: It will envelop the people; this is a painful retribution.

1981.english: It will envelope all the people and will be painful.
1981.footnote: The famous Haley's comet drags a tail of cyanogen gas that is about 3 million miles long. If this tail passes close enough to the earth's gravity, it can easily envelope the whole earth with cyanogen gas. Our next close encounter with Haley's comet will take place in mid-1986, then every 75 years thereafter.

1989.english: It will envelop the people; this is a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ربنا اكشف عنا العذاب إنا مؤمنون
verses.transliterated: rabbanā ik'shif ʿannā l-ʿadhāba innā mu'minūn
verses.english: "Our Lord, relieve this retribution for us; we are believers."

1981.english: Our Lord, remove this suffering from us; we now believe.

1989.english: “Our Lord, relieve this retribution for us; we are believers.”

verses.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أنى لهم الذكرى وقد جاءهم رسول مبين
verses.transliterated: annā lahumu l-dhik'rā waqad jāahum rasūlun mubīnu
verses.english: Now that it is too late, they remember! An enlightening messenger had come to them.
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: The sum of sura and verse numbers (44+13) is 57, 19x3, and this Quranic code was proclaimed by God's Messenger of the Covenant (Appendices 1, 2, & 26).

1981.english: How come they remember now, when an honest messenger had come to them?

1989.english: Now they remember! A manifest messenger had come to them.*
1989.footnote: For the specific identity of this messenger see Appendix 2.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.arabicClean: ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون
verses.transliterated: thumma tawallaw ʿanhu waqālū muʿallamun majnūnu
verses.english: But they turned away from him, saying, "Well educated, but crazy!"

1981.english: But they ignored him and said, "He is well educated, but crazy."

1989.english: But they turned away from him, saying, “Well educated, but crazy!”

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا كاشفو العذاب قليلا ۚ إنكم عائدون
verses.transliterated: innā kāshifū l-ʿadhābi qalīlan innakum ʿāidūn
verses.english: We will relieve the retribution for awhile; you will soon revert.

1981.english: We will relieve the retribution a little bit, but soon after you will revert.

1989.english: We will relieve the retribution for awhile; you will then revert.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم نبطش البطشة الكبرى إنا منتقمون
verses.transliterated: yawma nabṭishu l-baṭshata l-kub'rā innā muntaqimūn
verses.english: The day we strike the big stroke, we will avenge.

1981.english: However, on the day we strike the final stroke, we will effect retribution.

1989.english: The day we strike the big stroke, we will avenge.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد فتنا قبلهم قوم فرعون وجاءهم رسول كريم
verses.transliterated: walaqad fatannā qablahum qawma fir'ʿawna wajāahum rasūlun karīmu
verses.english: We have tested before them the people of Pharaoh; an honorable messenger went to them.

1981.english: In the past, we tested the Pharaoh's people by sending an honorable messenger to them.

1989.english: We have tested before them the people of Pharaoh; an honorable messenger went to them.

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أن أدوا إلي عباد الله ۖ إني لكم رسول أمين
verses.transliterated: an addū ilayya ʿibāda l-lahi innī lakum rasūlun amīnu
verses.english: Proclaiming: "Listen to me, servants of GOD. I am an honest messenger to you."

1981.english: (He said,) "You shall heed Me, O servants of God. I am an honest messenger to you.

1989.english: Proclaiming: “Listen to me, servants of GOD. I am an honest messenger to you.”

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأن لا تعلوا على الله ۖ إني آتيكم بسلطان مبين
verses.transliterated: wa-an lā taʿlū ʿalā l-lahi innī ātīkum bisul'ṭānin mubīni
verses.english: And, "Do not transgress against GOD. I bring to you powerful proofs.

1981.english: "Do not be too arrogant to worship God. I bring to you profound miracles.

1989.english: And, “Do not rise up against GOD. I bring to you powerful proofs.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وإني عذت بربي وربكم أن ترجمون
verses.transliterated: wa-innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum an tarjumūn
verses.english: "I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, if you oppose me.

1981.english: "I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

1989.english: “I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

verses.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وإن لم تؤمنوا لي فاعتزلون
verses.transliterated: wa-in lam tu'minū lī fa-iʿ'tazilūn
verses.english: "If you do not wish to believe, then simply leave me alone."

1981.english: "If you do not wish to believe, then just leave me alone."

1989.english: “If you do not wish to believe, then leave me alone.”

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فدعا ربه أن هؤلاء قوم مجرمون
verses.transliterated: fadaʿā rabbahu anna hāulāi qawmun muj'rimūn
verses.english: Subsequently, he implored his Lord: "These are wicked people."

1981.english: He then prayed to his Lord that, "These are evil people."

1989.english: He then implored his Lord, “These are wicked people.”

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأسر بعبادي ليلا إنكم متبعون
verses.transliterated: fa-asri biʿibādī laylan innakum muttabaʿūn
verses.english: (GOD said,) "Travel with My servants during the night; you will be pursued.

1981.english: (He was told,) "Then move during the night, together with My servants. You will be pursued.

1989.english: Subsequently: “Travel with My servants during the night; you will be pursued.

verses.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واترك البحر رهوا ۖ إنهم جند مغرقون
verses.transliterated: wa-ut'ruki l-baḥra rahwan innahum jundun mugh'raqūn
verses.english: "Cross the sea quickly; their troops will be drowned."

1981.english: "You will cross the sea in a hurry, while their troops will drown."

1989.english: “And cross the sea quickly; their troops will be drowned.”

verses.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: كم تركوا من جنات وعيون
verses.transliterated: kam tarakū min jannātin waʿuyūni
verses.english: Thus, they left behind many gardens and springs.

1981.english: Thus, the Pharaoh's people left gardens and springs.

1989.english: They had to leave behind many gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وزروع ومقام كريم
verses.transliterated: wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmi
verses.english: Crops and a luxurious life.

1981.english: And crops and nice homes.

1989.english: And crops and an honorable position

verses.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ونعمة كانوا فيها فاكهين
verses.transliterated: wanaʿmatin kānū fīhā fākihīn
verses.english: Blessings that they enjoyed.

1981.english: And blessings that they enjoyed.

1989.english: And blessings that they enjoyed.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك ۖ وأورثناها قوما آخرين
verses.transliterated: kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīn
verses.english: All these we caused to be inherited by other people.

1981.english: We made other people inherit them.

1989.english: All were inherited by other people.

verses.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما بكت عليهم السماء والأرض وما كانوا منظرين
verses.transliterated: famā bakat ʿalayhimu l-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīn
verses.english: Neither the heaven, nor the earth wept over them, and they were not respited.

1981.english: Neither the heaven nor the earth wept for them; they were no longer respited.

1989.english: The heaven and the earth did not weep over them, and they were not respited.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد نجينا بني إسرائيل من العذاب المهين
verses.transliterated: walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīn
verses.english: Meanwhile, we saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating persecution.

1981.english: We thus delivered the children of Israel from the humiliating persecution.

1989.english: Meanwhile, we saved the Children of Israel from humiliating persecution.

verses.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: من فرعون ۚ إنه كان عاليا من المسرفين
verses.transliterated: min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyan mina l-mus'rifīn
verses.english: From Pharaoh; he was a tyrant.

1981.english: From Pharaoh, the oppressive tyrant.

1989.english: From Pharaoh; he was an oppressive tyrant.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد اخترناهم على علم على العالمين
verses.transliterated: walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: We have chosen them from among all the people, knowingly.

1981.english: We chose them knowingly from among the people.

1989.english: We chose them from among all the people, knowingly.

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وآتيناهم من الآيات ما فيه بلاء مبين
verses.transliterated: waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāon mubīnu
verses.english: We showed them so many proofs, which constituted a great test.

1981.english: We showed them many miracles, thus making the test more exacting for them.

1989.english: And we showed them so many miracles, it was indeed a great test.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هؤلاء ليقولون
verses.transliterated: inna hāulāi layaqūlūn
verses.english: The present generations say,
verses.subtitle: Expect The Same Consequences

1981.english: These people say,
1981.subtitle: Resurrection Will Come

1989.english: The present generations say,
1989.subtitle: Expect The Same Consequences

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هي إلا موتتنا الأولى وما نحن بمنشرين
verses.transliterated: in hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīn
verses.english: "We only die the first death; we will never be resurrected!

1981.english: "There is only one death, and we never rise.

1989.english: “We only die once; we will never be resurrected!

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأتوا بآبائنا إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: fatū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: "Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful."

1981.english: "Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful."

1989.english: “Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أهم خير أم قوم تبع والذين من قبلهم ۚ أهلكناهم ۖ إنهم كانوا مجرمين
verses.transliterated: ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿin wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīn
verses.english: Are they better than the people of Tubba' and others before them? We annihilated them for their crimes.

1981.english: Are they better than the people of Tubba', and others before them? We destroyed them for their sins.

1989.english: Are they better than the people of Tubba‘ and others before them? We annihilated them for their crimes.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما لاعبين
verses.transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn
verses.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, just to play.

1981.english: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in vain.

1989.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, just to play.

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما خلقناهما إلا بالحق ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: We created them for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know.

1981.english: We created them for a specific purpose,* but most people do not know.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 6.

1989.english: We created them for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن يوم الفصل ميقاتهم أجمعين
verses.transliterated: inna yawma l-faṣli mīqātuhum ajmaʿīn
verses.english: The Day of Decision awaits them all.

1981.english: The day of decision awaits them all.

1989.english: The Day of Decision awaits them all.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم لا يغني مولى عن مولى شيئا ولا هم ينصرون
verses.transliterated: yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿan mawlan shayan walā hum yunṣarūn
verses.english: That is the day when no friend can help his friend in any way; no one can be helped.

1981.english: On that day, no friend will avail his friend in any way; no one can be helped.

1989.english: That is the day when no friend can help his friend in any way; no one can be helped.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: إلا من رحم الله ۚ إنه هو العزيز الرحيم
verses.transliterated: illā man raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīm
verses.english: Only those who attain mercy from GOD. He is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Only those who have attained mercy from God; for He is the almighty, most merciful.

1989.english: Only those who attain mercy from GOD. He is the Almighty, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.arabicClean: إن شجرت الزقوم
verses.transliterated: inna shajarata l-zaqūm
verses.english: Surely, the tree of bitterness—
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: The tree of bitterness.

1989.english: Surely, the tree of bitterness—

verses.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: طعام الأثيم
verses.transliterated: ṭaʿāmu l-athīm
verses.english: will provide the food for the sinful.

1981.english: Will provide food for the sinner.

1989.english: will provide the food for the sinful.

verses.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.arabicClean: كالمهل يغلي في البطون
verses.transliterated: kal-muh'li yaghlī fī l-buṭūn
verses.english: Like lye, it will boil in the stomachs.

1981.english: Like molten rocks, it will boil in their bellies.

1989.english: Like lye, it will boil in the stomachs.

verses.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: كغلي الحميم
verses.transliterated: kaghalyi l-ḥamīm
verses.english: Like the boiling of hellish drinks.

1981.english: Like bubbling lava.

1989.english: Like the boiling of hellish drinks.

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: خذوه فاعتلوه إلى سواء الجحيم
verses.transliterated: khudhūhu fa-iʿ'tilūhu ilā sawāi l-jaḥīm
verses.english: Take him and throw him into the center of Hell.

1981.english: Take him and throw him into the depth of hell.

1989.english: Take him and throw him into the center of Hell.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ثم صبوا فوق رأسه من عذاب الحميم
verses.transliterated: thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīm
verses.english: Then pour upon his head the retribution of the Inferno.

1981.english: Then pour upon his head the painful lava.

1989.english: Then pour upon his head the retribution of the Inferno.

verses.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: ذق إنك أنت العزيز الكريم
verses.transliterated: dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīm
verses.english: "Taste this; you were so powerful, so honorable."

1981.english: Suffer; you used to be so haughty and so honored.

1989.english: “Taste this; you were so powerful, so honorable.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا ما كنتم به تمترون
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūn
verses.english: This is what you used to doubt.

1981.english: This is what you doubted.

1989.english: This is what you used to doubt.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن المتقين في مقام أمين
verses.transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīni
verses.english: The righteous will be in a secure position.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous

1981.english: As for the righteous, they will be in a secure abode.

1989.english: The righteous will be in a secure position.
1989.subtitle: The Righteous

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: في جنات وعيون
verses.transliterated: fī jannātin waʿuyūni
verses.english: Enjoying gardens and springs.

1981.english: In gardens and springs.

1989.english: Enjoying gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يلبسون من سندس وإستبرق متقابلين
verses.transliterated: yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīn
verses.english: Wearing velvet and satin; close to each other.

1981.english: They wear silk and velvet, and will be neighbors.

1989.english: Wearing velvet and satin; close to each other.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك وزوجناهم بحور عين
verses.transliterated: kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīni
verses.english: We grant them wonderful spouses.

1981.english: We will join them with magnificent spouses.

1989.english: We grant them beautiful spouses.

verses.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يدعون فيها بكل فاكهة آمنين
verses.transliterated: yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīn
verses.english: They enjoy in it all kinds of fruits, in perfect peace.

1981.english: They will enjoy every kind of fruit; they will be safe and secure.

1989.english: They receive therein all kinds of fruits, in perfect peace.

verses.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: لا يذوقون فيها الموت إلا الموتة الأولى ۖ ووقاهم عذاب الجحيم
verses.transliterated: lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verses.english: They do not taste death therein— beyond the first death—and He has spared them the retribution of Hell.
verses.subtitle: The Righteous Do Not Really Die
verses.footnote: As detailed in Appendix 17, the righteous do not really die; they move on directly to the same Paradise where Adam and Eve once lived. Compare this statement with the disbelievers' statement in 40:11.

1981.english: Never again will they taste death, after the first death, and God protects them from the agony of hell.
1981.footnote: The inhabitants of heaven will be able to visit their friends and relatives in hell, without suffering any harm. See 37:51-59.

1989.english: They never taste death therein, beyond the first death. He has spared them the retribution of Hell.

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: فضلا من ربك ۚ ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: Such is the blessing from your Lord. Such is the great triumph.

1981.english: This is the blessing from your Lord; this is the great triumph.

1989.english: Such is the blessing from your Lord. Such is the great triumph.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فإنما يسرناه بلسانك لعلهم يتذكرون
verses.transliterated: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūn
verses.english: We have thus clarified it in your language, that they may take heed.

1981.english: We made this Quran easy to understand through your tongue, that they may take heed.
1981.footnote: See 41:44 and Appendix 3.

1989.english: We have thus clarified it in your language, that they may take heed.

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فارتقب إنهم مرتقبون
verses.transliterated: fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūn
verses.english: Therefore, wait; they too will have to wait.

1981.english: Then wait in anticipation; they too will wait.

1989.english: Therefore, wait; they too are waiting.

verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم حم
verses.transliterated: hha-meem
verses.english: H. M.

1981.english: H. M.

1989.english: H. M.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
verses.english: The revelation of this scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: The revelation of this scripture is from God, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: The revelation of this scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن في السماوات والأرض لآيات للمؤمنين
verses.transliterated: inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīn
verses.english: The heavens and the earth are full of proofs for the believers.

1981.english: Throughout the heavens and the earth, there are signs for the believers.

1989.english: The heavens and the earth are full of signs for the believers.

verses.arabic: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وفي خلقكم وما يبث من دابة آيات لقوم يوقنون
verses.transliterated: wafī khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbatin āyātun liqawmin yūqinūn
verses.english: Also in your creation, and the creation of all the animals, there are proofs for people who are certain.

1981.english: And in your creation, and the creatures He produces, there are signs for those who are certain.

1989.english: Also in your creation, and the creation of all the animals, there are signs for people who are certain.

verses.arabic: وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واختلاف الليل والنهار وما أنزل الله من السماء من رزق فأحيا به الأرض بعد موتها وتصريف الرياح آيات لقوم يعقلون
verses.transliterated: wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min riz'qin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi āyātun liqawmin yaʿqilūn
verses.english: Also, the alternation of the night and the day, and the provisions that GOD sends down from the sky to revive dead lands, and the manipulation of the winds; all these are proofs for people who understand.

1981.english: Also, the alternation of night and day, the provisions that God sends down from the sky to revive dead land, and the manipulation of the winds; all these are signs for people who understand.

1989.english: Also, the alternation of the night and the day, and the provision that GOD sends down from the sky to revive dead lands, and the manipulation of the winds; all these are signs for people who understand.

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: تلك آيات الله نتلوها عليك بالحق ۖ فبأي حديث بعد الله وآياته يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿda l-lahi waāyātihi yu'minūn
verses.english: These are GOD's revelations that we recite to you truthfully. In which Hadith other than GOD and His revelations do they believe?
verses.subtitle: Which Hadith?
verses.footnote: God condemns "Hadith" by name, and informs us that it is a blasphemous fabrication.

1981.english: These are God's revelations that we recite for you with the truth; which **hadith**,* besides the revelations of God, do they believe?
1981.subtitle: The Inventors and Followers Of "Hadith" Doomed
1981.footnote: See footnote 39:23. "**Hadith**" is no more than inventions by enemies of the prophet, as stated in 6:112-116, 25:30-31, and 45:7, aimed at repelling the people from God's way and from the Quran (see 31:6).

1989.english: These are GOD’s revelations that we recite to you truthfully. In which Hadith other than GOD and His revelations do they believe?
1989.subtitle: Which Hadith?

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: ويل لكل أفاك أثيم
verses.transliterated: waylun likulli affākin athīmi
verses.english: Woe to every fabricator, guilty.

1981.english: Woe to every inventor, guilty.

1989.english: Woe to every fabricator, guilty.

verses.arabic: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: يسمع آيات الله تتلى عليه ثم يصر مستكبرا كأن لم يسمعها ۖ فبشره بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yasmaʿu āyāti l-lahi tut'lā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: The one who hears GOD's revelations recited to him, then insists arrogantly on his way, as if he never heard them. Promise him a painful retribution.

1981.english: He hears God's revelations recited to him, then insists on his way arrogantly, as if he never heard them.* Promise him painful retribution.
1981.footnote: God teaches us throughout the Quran that the Quran is complete, fully detailed, and shall be the only source of law. But those who advocate **hadith** and **sunna** refuse to accept these verses; they have failed the test and proved to be false muslims (see 6:112-116, 25:30-31, and Appendix 15).

1989.english: The one who hears GOD’s revelations recited to him, then insists arrogantly on his way, as if he never heard them. Promise him a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا علم من آياتنا شيئا اتخذها هزوا ۚ أولئك لهم عذاب مهين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayan ittakhadhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnu
verses.english: When he learns anything about our revelations, he mocks them. These have incurred a shameful retribution.

1981.english: When he hears our verses, he takes them in vain. These have deserved humiliating retribution.

1989.english: When he learns anything from our revelations, he mocks them. These have incurred a shameful retribution.

verses.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: من ورائهم جهنم ۖ ولا يغني عنهم ما كسبوا شيئا ولا ما اتخذوا من دون الله أولياء ۖ ولهم عذاب عظيم
verses.transliterated: min warāihim jahannamu walā yugh'nī ʿanhum mā kasabū shayan walā mā ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Awaiting them is Gehenna. Their earnings will not help them, nor the idols they had set up beside GOD. They have incurred a terrible retribution.

1981.english: Hell awaits them. Nothing they possess will help them, nor will the idols they set up besides God. They have deserved terrible retribution.

1989.english: Awaiting them is Gehenna. Their earnings will not help them, nor the idols they set up besides GOD. They have incurred a terrible retribution.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا هُدًى وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: هذا هدى ۖ والذين كفروا بآيات ربهم لهم عذاب من رجز أليم
verses.transliterated: hādhā hudan wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmu
verses.english: This is a beacon, and those who disbelieve in these revelations of their Lord have incurred condemnation and a painful retribution.

1981.english: This is the guidance, and those who reject the revelations of their Lord have deserved the retribution of a painful curse.

1989.english: This is a beacon, and those who disbelieve in these revelations of their Lord have incurred condemnation and a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي سخر لكم البحر لتجري الفلك فيه بأمره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī sakhara lakumu l-baḥra litajriya l-ful'ku fīhi bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūn
verses.english: GOD is the One who committed the sea in your service, so that the ships can roam it in accordance with His laws. You thus seek His provisions, that you may be appreciative.

1981.english: God is the one who subdued the sea for you, that the ships may roam therein by His commandment and seek His bounties; you should be appreciative.

1989.english: GOD is the One who committed the sea in your service. The ships roam it in accordance with His command, that you may seek His bounties and become appreciative.

verses.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وسخر لكم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض جميعا منه ۚ إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون
verses.transliterated: wasakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan min'hu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūn
verses.english: He committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth; all from Him. These are proofs for people who reflect.

1981.english: He subjugated for you everything in the heavens and on earth, all from Him. These are signs for people who reflect.

1989.english: He committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth; all from Him. These are signs for people who reflect.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل للذين آمنوا يغفروا للذين لا يرجون أيام الله ليجزي قوما بما كانوا يكسبون
verses.transliterated: qul lilladhīna āmanū yaghfirū lilladhīna lā yarjūna ayyāma l-lahi liyajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūn
verses.english: Tell those who believed to forgive those who do not expect the days of GOD. He will fully pay everyone for whatever they have earned.

1981.english: Ask the believers to forgive those who do not expect the days of God. He is the one who judges the people for whatever they do.

1989.english: Tell those who believed to forgive those who do not expect the days of GOD. For He will fully pay the people for whatever they earn.

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: من عمل صالحا فلنفسه ۖ ومن أساء فعليها ۖ ثم إلى ربكم ترجعون
verses.transliterated: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūn
verses.english: Whoever works righteousness does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. To your Lord you will be returned.

1981.english: Whoever works righteousness does so for his own good; and whoever commits evil does so against his own soul. Ultimately, you will be returned to your Lord.

1989.english: Whoever works righteousness does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. To your Lord you will be returned.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد آتينا بني إسرائيل الكتاب والحكم والنبوة ورزقناهم من الطيبات وفضلناهم على العالمين
verses.transliterated: walaqad ātaynā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: We have given the Children of Israel the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood, and provided them with good provisions; we bestowed upon them more blessings than any other people.

1981.english: We have given the children of Israel the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood, and we endowed them with good provisions, and we set them apart from all the people.

1989.english: We have given the Children of Israel the scripture, wisdom, and prophethood, and provided them with good provisions, and we preferred them over all the oth<ir

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وآتيناهم بينات من الأمر ۖ فما اختلفوا إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم بغيا بينهم ۚ إن ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
verses.transliterated: waātaynāhum bayyinātin mina l-amri famā ikh'talafū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
verses.english: We have given them herein clear commandments. Ironically, they did not dispute this until the knowledge had come to them. This is due to jealousy on their part. Surely, your Lord will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they have disputed.

1981.english: We gave them clear commandments, but they disputed after the knowledge had come to them, out of sheer jealousy among themselves.

1989.english: And we gave them clear commandments. Ironically, they did not dispute until the knowledge came to them, due to jealousy amongst them. Surely, your Lord will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they disputed.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم جعلناك على شريعة من الأمر فاتبعها ولا تتبع أهواء الذين لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿatin mina l-amri fa-ittabiʿ'hā walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: We then appointed you to establish the correct laws; you shall follow this, and do not follow the wishes of those who do not know.

1981.english: Then we decreed the commandments for you. You shall follow this, and not the opinions of those who do not know.

1989.english: Then we appointed you to establish the law; you shall follow it, and do not follow the wishes of those who do not know.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنهم لن يغنوا عنك من الله شيئا ۚ وإن الظالمين بعضهم أولياء بعض ۖ والله ولي المتقين
verses.transliterated: innahum lan yugh'nū ʿanka mina l-lahi shayan wa-inna l-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wal-lahu waliyyu l-mutaqīn
verses.english: They cannot help you at all against GOD. It is the transgressors who ally themselves with one another, while GOD is the Lord of the righteous.

1981.english: They can never help you against God's will. The wicked are allies for each other, while God befriends the righteous.

1989.english: They cannot help you at all against GOD. It is the transgressors who befriend one another, while GOD is the friend of the righteous.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هذا بصائر للناس وهدى ورحمة لقوم يوقنون
verses.transliterated: hādhā baṣāiru lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yūqinūn
verses.english: This provides enlightenments for the people, and guidance, and mercy for those who are certain.

1981.english: This (Quran) provides the people with enlightenment, guidance, and mercy for those who attain certainty.

1989.english: These are enlightenments for the people, and guidance, and mercy for those who are certain.

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم حسب الذين اجترحوا السيئات أن نجعلهم كالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات سواء محياهم ومماتهم ۚ ساء ما يحكمون
verses.transliterated: am ḥasiba alladhīna ij'taraḥū l-sayiāti an najʿalahum ka-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sawāan maḥyāhum wamamātuhum sāa mā yaḥkumūn
verses.english: Do those who work evil expect that we will treat them in the same manner as those who believe and lead a righteous life? Can their life and their death be the same? Wrong indeed is their judgment.
verses.footnote: We now realize that the righteous do not really die—they go straight to Heaven (16:32)—while the unrighteous are beaten up by the angels of death (8:50 & 47:27).

1981.english: Do the people who work evil expect to be treated like those who believe and work righteousness? Could they be the same in life and death? Wrong indeed is their expectation.

1989.english: Do those who worked evil expect that we will treat them in the same manner as those who believed and led a righteous life? Will their life and their death be the same? Wrong indeed is their judgment.

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وخلق الله السماوات والأرض بالحق ولتجزى كل نفس بما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: wakhalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi walituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: GOD created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose, in order to pay each soul for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.
verses.footnote: God granted us this life as a precious chance to redeem ourselves, denounce our ancient alliance with Satan, and rejoin God's kingdom. See Introduction & Appendix 7.

1981.english: God created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose, to repay every soul for whatever it did, without the least injustice.

1989.english: GOD created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose, in order to pay each soul for whatever it earned, without the least injustice.*
1989.footnote: God granted us this life as a precious chance to redeem ourselves, denounce our ancient alliance with Satan, and rejoin God’s kingdom. See Introduction & Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أفرأيت من اتخذ إلهه هواه وأضله الله على علم وختم على سمعه وقلبه وجعل على بصره غشاوة فمن يهديه من بعد الله ۚ أفلا تذكرون
verses.transliterated: afara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu l-lahu ʿalā ʿil'min wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwatan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi l-lahi afalā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: Have you noted the one whose god is his ego? Consequently, GOD sends him astray, despite his knowledge, seals his hearing and his mind, and places a veil on his eyes. Who then can guide him, after such a decision by GOD? Would you not take heed?
verses.subtitle: Common Form of Idolatry: The Ego As A god

1981.english: What do you think of one who idolizes his own ego? God sends him astray, seals his hearing and his heart, and places a veil on his eyes. Who can guide him thereafter? Would you not take heed?

1989.english: Have you noted the one whose god is his ego? Consequently, GOD sends him astray, knowingly, and seals his hearing and his mind, and places a veil on his eyes. Who then can guide him, after such a decision by GOD? Would you not take heed?

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا ما هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما يهلكنا إلا الدهر ۚ وما لهم بذلك من علم ۖ إن هم إلا يظنون
verses.transliterated: waqālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuh'likunā illā l-dahru wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yaẓunnūn
verses.english: They said, "We only live this life; we live and die and only time causes our death!" They have no sure knowledge about this; they only conjecture.

1981.english: They said, "There will be only this life; we live and die, and only time causes our death." They have no basis for saying this; they only conjecture.

1989.english: They say, “We only live this life; we live and die and only time causes our death!” They have no sure knowledge about this; they only conjecture.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات ما كان حجتهم إلا أن قالوا ائتوا بآبائنا إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālū i'tū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, their only argument is to say, "Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful."

1981.english: When our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is, "Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful."

1989.english: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل الله يحييكم ثم يميتكم ثم يجمعكم إلى يوم القيامة لا ريب فيه ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: quli l-lahu yuḥ'yīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Say, "GOD has granted you life, then He puts you to death, then He will summon you to the Day of Resurrection, which is inevitable. But most people do not know."

1981.english: Say, "God grants you life, then He puts you to death, and He will gather you on the day of resurrection." There is no doubt about it, but most people do not know.

1989.english: Say, “GOD grants you life, then puts you to death, then He will summon you to the Day of Resurrection, which is inevitable. But most people do not know.”

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولله ملك السماوات والأرض ۚ ويوم تقوم الساعة يومئذ يخسر المبطلون
verses.transliterated: walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yakhsaru l-mub'ṭilūn
verses.english: To GOD belongs all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. The day the Hour (Judgment) comes to pass, that is when the falsifiers lose.

1981.english: To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. On the day resurrection takes place, the advocates of falsehood will be the losers.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. On the day when the Hour comes to pass, that is when the falsifiers lose.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وترى كل أمة جاثية ۚ كل أمة تدعى إلى كتابها اليوم تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: watarā kulla ummatin jāthiyatan kullu ummatin tud'ʿā ilā kitābihā l-yawma tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: You will see every community kneeling. Every community will be called to view their record. Today, you get paid for everything you have done.
verses.subtitle: Kneeling

1981.english: You will see every congregation humbled; every congregation will be invited to view its record.* Today you get paid for everything you did.
1981.footnote: See footnote 41:20-21 and Appendix 10.

1989.english: And you will see every community kneeling. Every community will be called to witness their record. Today, you get paid for everything you had done.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هذا كتابنا ينطق عليكم بالحق ۚ إنا كنا نستنسخ ما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bil-ḥaqi innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: This is our record; it utters the truth about you. We have been recording everything you did.

1981.english: This is our record pronouncing the truth about you. We have recorded everything you did.

1989.english: This is our record; it utters the truth about you. For we were recording everything you did.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: فأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فيدخلهم ربهم في رحمته ۚ ذلك هو الفوز المبين
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayud'khiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-mubīn
verses.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. This is the great triumph.

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. This is the greatest triumph.

1989.english: As for those who believed and work righteousness, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. This is the great triumph.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وأما الذين كفروا أفلم تكن آياتي تتلى عليكم فاستكبرتم وكنتم قوما مجرمين
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū afalam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fa-is'takbartum wakuntum qawman muj'rimīn
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve: "Were not My revelations recited to you, but you turned arrogant and were wicked people?"

1981.english: Those who disbelieved will be told, "Did you not hear My revelations recited to you, and you turned arrogant and guilty?

1989.english: As for those who disbelieved: “Were not My revelations recited to you, but you turned arrogant and were wicked people?”

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل إن وعد الله حق والساعة لا ريب فيها قلتم ما ندري ما الساعة إن نظن إلا ظنا وما نحن بمستيقنين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wal-sāʿatu lā rayba fīhā qul'tum mā nadrī mā l-sāʿatu in naẓunnu illā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimus'tayqinīn
verses.english: When it is proclaimed that GOD's promise is the truth and that the Hour (of Judgment) is inevitable, you said, "We do not know what the Hour is! We are full of conjecture about it; we are not certain."

1981.english: "When you were told that God's promise is truth, and that there is no doubt about resurrection, you said, 'We have no idea what resurrection is. We can only conjecture; we are not sure.'"

1989.english: And when it is proclaimed that GOD’s promise is the truth and the Hour is inevitable, you said, “We do not know what the Hour is! We are full of doubts about it; we have no certainty.”

verses.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وبدا لهم سيئات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: The evils of their works will become evident to them, and the very things they mocked will come back and haunt them.

1981.english: The wickedness of their work will become evident to them, and the very thing they mocked will cause their doom.

1989.english: The evils of their works will become obvious to them, and the very things they mocked will come back to haunt them.

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقيل اليوم ننساكم كما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا ومأواكم النار وما لكم من ناصرين
verses.transliterated: waqīla l-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīn
verses.english: It will be proclaimed: "Today we forget you, just as you forgot the meeting of this day. Your abode is the hellfire, and you will have no helpers.

1981.english: They will be told, "Today we forget you, just as you forgot this day. Your abode is hell, and no one can help you.

1989.english: It will be proclaimed: “Today we forget you, just as you forgot the meeting of this day. Your abode is the hellfire, and you will have no helpers.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذلكم بأنكم اتخذتم آيات الله هزوا وغرتكم الحياة الدنيا ۚ فاليوم لا يخرجون منها ولا هم يستعتبون
verses.transliterated: dhālikum bi-annakumu ittakhadhtum āyāti l-lahi huzuwan wagharratkumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma lā yukh'rajūna min'hā walā hum yus'taʿtabūn
verses.english: "This is because you took GOD's revelations in vain, and were preoccupied with the first life." Consequently, they will never exit therefrom, nor will they be excused.

1981.english: "This is because you had taken God's revelations in vain, and you were distracted by the first life." There will be no way out for them, nor will they be excused.

1989.english: “This is because you mocked and ridiculed GOD’s revelations, and were preoccupied with the first life.” Consequently, they will never exit therefrom, nor will they be excused.

verses.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلله الحمد رب السماوات ورب الأرض رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: falillahi l-ḥamdu rabbi l-samāwāti warabbi l-arḍi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: To GOD belongs all praise; Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of the universe.

1981.english: To God belongs all praise; Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth; Lord of the universe.

1989.english: To GOD belongs all praise; Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: وله الكبرياء في السماوات والأرض ۖ وهو العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: walahu l-kib'riyāu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: To Him belongs all majesty in the heavens and the earth; He is the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم حم
verses.transliterated: hha-meem
verses.english: H. M.

1981.english: H. M.

1989.english: H. M.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
verses.english: The revelation of this scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: (These letters prove that) this scripture comes from God, the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: The revelation of this scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, the Wise.

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إلا بالحق وأجل مسمى ۚ والذين كفروا عما أنذروا معرضون
verses.transliterated: mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūn
verses.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them except for a specific purpose, and for a finite interim. Those who disbelieve are totally oblivious to the warnings given to them.

1981.english: We have not created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose, and for a specific life span. The disbelievers are heedless of all the warnings.

1989.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them except for a specific purpose, and for a finite interim. Those who disbelieved are totally oblivious to the warnings.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَٰرَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم ما تدعون من دون الله أروني ماذا خلقوا من الأرض أم لهم شرك في السماوات ۖ ائتوني بكتاب من قبل هذا أو أثارة من علم إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti i'tūnī bikitābin min qabli hādhā aw athāratin min ʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Say, "Consider the idols you have set up beside GOD. Show me what on earth did they create. Do they own part of the heavens? Show me any other scripture before this one, or any piece of established knowledge that supports your idolatry, if you are truthful."

1981.english: Say, "You set up idols besides God; show me what on earth did they create. Do they own any part of the heavens? Show me any previous scripture or established knowledge (that supports idol worship), if you are truthful."

1989.english: Say, “Consider the idols you set up besides GOD. Show me what on earth did they create. Do they own part of the heavens? Show me any other scripture, or any piece of knowledge that supports your idolatry, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن أضل ممن يدعو من دون الله من لا يستجيب له إلى يوم القيامة وهم عن دعائهم غافلون
verses.transliterated: waman aḍallu mimman yadʿū min dūni l-lahi man lā yastajību lahu ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wahum ʿan duʿāihim ghāfilūn
verses.english: Who is farther astray than those who idolize beside GOD idols that can never respond to them until the Day of Resurrection, and are totally unaware of their worship?
verses.subtitle: The Idols Totally Unaware

1981.english: Who is farther astray than those who idolize, besides God, people who cannot respond to them until the day of resurrection and are completely unaware of their idolization?
1981.subtitle: The Righteous Idols
1981.footnote: Such as Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, the saints, and the righteous imams. See also 16:86.

1989.english: Who is farther astray than those who idolize besides GOD idols that can never respond to them, until the Day of Resurrection, and are totally unaware of their worship?
1989.subtitle: The Idols Totally Unaware

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا حشر الناس كانوا لهم أعداء وكانوا بعبادتهم كافرين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ḥushira l-nāsu kānū lahum aʿdāan wakānū biʿibādatihim kāfirīn
verses.english: And when the people are summoned (on the Day of Judgment), their idols will become their enemies, and will denounce their idolatry.
verses.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Worshipers
verses.footnote: See also Matthew 7:21-23: Jesus clearly disowns those who call him "Lord."

1981.english: When the people are gathered (on the day of resurrection), they will become their enemies and will disown their idol worship.

1989.english: And when the people are summoned (on the Day of Judgment), their idols will become their enemies, and will denounce their idolatry.*
1989.subtitle: The Idols Disown Their Worshipers
1989.footnote: See also Matthew 7:21-23. Jesus clearly disowns those who call him “Lord. ”

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات قال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم هذا سحر مبين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum hādhā siḥ'run mubīnu
verses.english: When our revelations were recited to them, perfectly clear, those who disbelieved said of the truth that came to them, "This is obviously magic!"

1981.english: When our clear revelations are recited for them, the disbelievers say about the truth, "This is obviously magic."

1989.english: When our revelations were recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieved said of the truth that came to them, “This is obviously magic!”

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: أم يقولون افتراه ۖ قل إن افتريته فلا تملكون لي من الله شيئا ۖ هو أعلم بما تفيضون فيه ۖ كفى به شهيدا بيني وبينكم ۖ وهو الغفور الرحيم
verses.transliterated: am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu falā tamlikūna lī mina l-lahi shayan huwa aʿlamu bimā tufīḍūna fīhi kafā bihi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīm
verses.english: When they say, "He fabricated this," say, "If I fabricated this, then you cannot protect me from GOD. He is fully aware of everything you scheme. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful."

1981.english: Otherwise, they would say, "He made it up." Say, "If I made it up, then you cannot protect me from God. He is fully aware of everything you scheme. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is the forgiver, the merciful."

1989.english: When they say, “He fabricated this,” say, “If I fabricated this, then you cannot protect me from GOD. He is fully aware of everything you scheme. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل ما كنت بدعا من الرسل وما أدري ما يفعل بي ولا بكم ۖ إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي وما أنا إلا نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: qul mā kuntu bid'ʿan mina l-rusuli wamā adrī mā yuf'ʿalu bī walā bikum in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya wamā anā illā nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: Say, "I am not different from other messengers. I have no idea what will happen to me or to you. I only follow what is revealed to me. I am no more than a profound warner."

1981.english: Say, "I do not bring anything new; I bring the same message as previous messengers. I have no idea what will happen to me or to you. I only follow the inspirations given to me. I am no more than a manifest warner."
1981.subtitle: Muhammad Only Human

1989.english: Say, “I am not different from other messengers. I have no idea what will happen to me or to you. I only follow what is revealed to me. I am no more than a profound warner.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن كان من عند الله وكفرتم به وشهد شاهد من بني إسرائيل على مثله فآمن واستكبرتم ۖ إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi wakafartum bihi washahida shāhidun min banī is'rāīla ʿalā mith'lihi faāmana wa-is'takbartum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: Say, "What if it is from GOD and you disbelieved in it? A witness from the Children of Israel has borne witness to a similar phenomenon, and he has believed, while you have turned arrogant. Surely, GOD does not guide the wicked people."
verses.subtitle: Rabbi Judah the Pious
verses.footnote: This witness is Rabbi Judah the Pious (11th Century A.D.), who discovered the same 19-based mathematical code in intact fragments of the scripture (see Appendix 1).

1981.english: Say, "What if this is from God, and you reject it?" A witness from the children of Israel has testified that it has been expected, and while he believed, you turned arrogant. God never guides the wicked people.

1989.english: Say, “What if it is from GOD and you disbelieved in it? A witness from the Children of Israel has borne witness to a similar phenomenon,* and he has believed, while you have turned arrogant. Surely, GOD does not guide the wicked people.”
1989.footnote: This witness is Rabbi Judah the Pious (11th Century A.D.), who discovered tht same 19-based mathematical code in intact fragments of the scripture (see Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقال الذين كفروا للذين آمنوا لو كان خيرا ما سبقونا إليه ۚ وإذ لم يهتدوا به فسيقولون هذا إفك قديم
verses.transliterated: waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū law kāna khayran mā sabaqūnā ilayhi wa-idh lam yahtadū bihi fasayaqūlūna hādhā if'kun qadīmu
verses.english: Those who disbelieved said about those who believed, "If it were anything good, they would not have accepted it before us." Because they were not guided to it, they said, "This is an old fabrication!"

1981.english: The disbelievers said of the believers, "If this message were any good, they would not have accepted it before us." Because they are not guided therewith, they say, "These are ancient fabrications."

1989.english: Those who disbelieved said about those who believed, “If it were anything good, they would not have pre ceded us to it.” Because they were not guided thereby, they said, “This is an old fabrication!”

verses.arabic: وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن قبله كتاب موسى إماما ورحمة ۚ وهذا كتاب مصدق لسانا عربيا لينذر الذين ظلموا وبشرى للمحسنين
verses.transliterated: wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan wahādhā kitābun muṣaddiqun lisānan ʿarabiyyan liyundhira alladhīna ẓalamū wabush'rā lil'muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: Before this, the book of Moses provided guidance and mercy. This too is a scripture that confirms, in Arabic, to warn those who transgressed, and to give good news to the righteous.

1981.english: Previously, the scripture of Moses was revealed as a guide and mercy, and this scripture confirms all previous scriptures. It is revealed in Arabic,* to warn the wicked and to give good news to the pious.
1981.footnote: See footnote 41:44.

1989.english: Before this, the book of Moses provided guidance and mercy. And this is a confirming Arabic scripture, to warn those who transgress, and to give good news to the righteous.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقاموا فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
verses.english: Surely, those who say, "Our Lord is GOD," then lead a righteous life, will have no fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.subtitle: Good News

1981.english: Those who say, "Our Lord is God," then maintain righteousness, have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.

1989.english: Surely, those who said, “Our Lord is GOD,” then led a righteous life, will have no fear, nor will they grieve.
1989.subtitle: Good News

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك أصحاب الجنة خالدين فيها جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
verses.transliterated: ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati khālidīna fīhā jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūn
verses.english: They have deserved Paradise, where they abide forever; a reward for their works.

1981.english: They have deserved Paradise, wherein they abide forever, as a reward for their work.

1989.english: They have deserved Paradise, where they abide forever; a reward for their works

verses.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَٰنًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه إحسانا ۖ حملته أمه كرها ووضعته كرها ۖ وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون شهرا ۚ حتى إذا بلغ أشده وبلغ أربعين سنة قال رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك التي أنعمت علي وعلى والدي وأن أعمل صالحا ترضاه وأصلح لي في ذريتي ۖ إني تبت إليك وإني من المسلمين
verses.transliterated: wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi iḥ'sānan ḥamalathu ummuhu kur'han wawaḍaʿathu kur'han waḥamluhu wafiṣāluhu thalāthūna shahran ḥattā idhā balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaʿīna sanatan qāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tub'tu ilayka wa-innī mina l-mus'limīn
verses.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him arduously, gave birth to him arduously, and took intimate care of him for thirty months. When he reaches maturity, and reaches the age of forty, he should say, "My Lord, direct me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do the righteous works that please You. Let my children be righteous as well. I have repented to You; I am a submitter."
verses.subtitle: 40: The Age of Decision
verses.footnote: God knows full well who deserves to go to Heaven and who deserves to go to Hell. It is His law that whomever He puts to death before the age of 40 shall go to Heaven. God's immense mercy is reflected in the fact that most people have difficulty accepting this divine mercy; they argue: "Put them in Hell!" See Appendix 32.

1981.english: We have enjoined man to honor his parents; his mother carried him arduously, gave birth to him arduously, then cared for him thirty months prior to weaning. By the time he grows up and reaches the age of forty, he should say, "My Lord, direct me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and my parents, and to work righteousness that pleases You, and grant righteousness to my children. I have repented, and I totally submit to you."
1981.subtitle: The Crucial Age Of Forty

1989.english: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him arduously, gave birth to him arduously, and took intimate care of him for thirty months. When he reaches maturity, and reaches the age of forty,* he should say, “My Lord, direct me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to work righteousness that pleases You. Let my children be righteous as well. I have repented to You; I am now a submitter (Muslim).”
1989.subtitle: 40: The Age of Decision
1989.footnote: God knows full well who deserves to go to Heaven and who deserves to go to Hell. It is His law that whomever He puts to death before the age of 40 shall go to Heaven. God’s immense mercy is reflected in the fact that most people have difficulty accepting this divine mercy; they argue: “Put them all in Hell!” See Appendix 32.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين نتقبل عنهم أحسن ما عملوا ونتجاوز عن سيئاتهم في أصحاب الجنة ۖ وعد الصدق الذي كانوا يوعدون
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna nataqabbalu ʿanhum aḥsana mā ʿamilū wanatajāwazu ʿan sayyiātihim fī aṣḥābi l-janati waʿda l-ṣid'qi alladhī kānū yūʿadūn
verses.english: It is from these that we accept the righteous works, and overlook their sins. They have deserved Paradise. This is the truthful promise that is promised to them.

1981.english: It is from these that we accept the righteous works and overlook their sins. They have deserved Paradise; this is the truthful promise that is offered to them.

1989.english: It is from these that we accept the righteous works, and overlook their sins. They have deserved Paradise. This is the truthful promise that is promised to them.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: والذي قال لوالديه أف لكما أتعدانني أن أخرج وقد خلت القرون من قبلي وهما يستغيثان الله ويلك آمن إن وعد الله حق فيقول ما هذا إلا أساطير الأولين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhī qāla liwālidayhi uffin lakumā ataʿidāninī an ukh'raja waqad khalati l-qurūnu min qablī wahumā yastaghīthāni l-laha waylaka āmin inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fayaqūlu mā hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.english: Then there is the one who says to his parents, "Woe to you; are you telling me that (after death) I will come back to life? How come those who died before us never come back?" The parents would cry for GOD's help and say, "Woe to you; please believe! GOD's promise is the truth." He would say, "Tales from the past!"

1981.english: Then there is the one who defies his parents saying, "You mean to tell me that I will come back to life? What about those previous generations?" His parents plead to him in the name of God, "Woe to you, if you do not believe. God's promise is truth." But he insists, and says, "These are old tales."

1989.english: On the other hand, there is the one who says to his parents, “Woe to you; are you telling me that I will come back to life? How come all those before us never come back?” The parents cry for GOD’s help and say, “Woe to you; please believe! GOD’s promise is the truth.” He then says, “These are tales from the past.”

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين حق عليهم القول في أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والإنس ۖ إنهم كانوا خاسرين
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīn
verses.english: Such are the ones stamped as disbelievers among every generation of jinns and humans; they are losers.

1981.english: It is these who are condemned to doom, along with others like them from the past generations of jinns and humans; these are the losers.

1989.english: Such are the ones who are stamped as disbelievers in every generation of jinns and humans. They are losers.

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولكل درجات مما عملوا ۖ وليوفيهم أعمالهم وهم لا يظلمون
verses.transliterated: walikullin darajātun mimmā ʿamilū waliyuwaffiyahum aʿmālahum wahum lā yuẓ'lamūn
verses.english: They all attain the ranks they have deserved, in accordance with their works. He will pay them for their works, without the least injustice.

1981.english: Each will be assigned ranks in accordance with their works; no one will suffer injustice.

1989.english: They all attain the ranks they have deserved, in accordance with their works. He will pay them for their works, without the least injustice.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار أذهبتم طيباتكم في حياتكم الدنيا واستمتعتم بها فاليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تستكبرون في الأرض بغير الحق وبما كنتم تفسقون
verses.transliterated: wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri adhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī ḥayātikumu l-dun'yā wa-is'tamtaʿtum bihā fal-yawma tuj'zawna ʿadhāba l-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tafsuqūn
verses.english: The day will come when those who disbelieved will be introduced to the hellfire: "You have wasted the good chances given to you during your worldly life, and you rejoiced in them. Consequently, today you incur a shameful retribution as a requital for the arrogance you committed on earth without any basis, and for your evil works."

1981.english: The day will come when the disbelievers will be presented to hell, "You have wasted your material things in the first life and enjoyed them. Today you suffer humiliating retribution, since you were arrogant on earth, without justification, and you were wicked.

1989.english: The day will come when those who disbelieved will be introduced to the hellfire: “You have wasted the good things given to you during your first life, and you rejoiced in them. Consequently, today you receive a shameful retribution as a requital for the arrogance you committed on earth without any basis, and for your evil works.”

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُۥ بِٱلْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: واذكر أخا عاد إذ أنذر قومه بالأحقاف وقد خلت النذر من بين يديه ومن خلفه ألا تعبدوا إلا الله إني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kur akhā ʿādin idh andhara qawmahu bil-aḥqāfi waqad khalati l-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: Recall that the brother of 'Ãd warned his people at the dunes—numerous warnings were also delivered before him and after him: "You shall not worship except GOD. I fear for you the retribution of a great day."
verses.subtitle: Hûd

1981.english: Remember the brother of Aad; he warned his people at the dunes, the same warnings given to those before him and after him, "You shall not worship except God. I fear for you the retribution of a horrible day."
1981.subtitle: You Shall Not Worship Except God
1981.footnote: As it turns out, the commandment, "You shall worship God," is not enough, since people can worship God and still go to hell. See footnote 41:14.

1989.english: Recall that the brother of ‘Aad warned his people at the dunes, the same warning delivered before him and after him: “You shall not worship except GOD. I fear for you the retribution of a great day.”
