verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا أجئتنا لتأفكنا عن آلهتنا فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين
verses.transliterated: qālū aji'tanā litafikanā ʿan ālihatinā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They said, "Did you come to divert us from our gods? We challenge you to bring (the retribution) you threaten, if you are truthful."

1981.english: They said, "Did you come to divert us from our idols? Show us the doom you threaten, if you are truthful."

1989.english: They said, “Did you come to divert us from our gods? We challenge you to bring (the retribution) you threaten, if you are truthful.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال إنما العلم عند الله وأبلغكم ما أرسلت به ولكني أراكم قوما تجهلون
verses.transliterated: qāla innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-uballighukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūn
verses.english: He said, "The knowledge about this is with GOD; I only deliver to you what I was sent to deliver. However, I see that you people are ignorant."

1981.english: He said, "Only God knows (when His judgment comes); I simply deliver the message entrusted to me. But I see that you are ignorant people."

1989.english: He said, “The knowledge (about retribution) is with GOD. I only deliver to you what I was sent to deliver. However, I see that you people are unaware.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأوه عارضا مستقبل أوديتهم قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا ۚ بل هو ما استعجلتم به ۖ ريح فيها عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: falammā ra-awhu ʿāriḍan mus'taqbila awdiyatihim qālū hādhā ʿāriḍun mum'ṭirunā bal huwa mā is'taʿjaltum bihi rīḥun fīhā ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: When they saw the storm heading their way, they said, "This storm will bring to us much needed rain." Instead, this is what you challenged (Hûd) to bring; violent wind wherein there is painful retribution.

1981.english: When they saw the tornado heading towards their valley, they said, "This will bring us rain." Indeed, it is the punishment you asked for; violent wind with disasterous retribution.

1989.english: When they saw the storm heading their way, they said, “This storm will bring to us much needed rain.” No, this is what you (challenged Hood to bring) -, violent wind wherein there is painful retribution.

verses.arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تدمر كل شيء بأمر ربها فأصبحوا لا يرى إلا مساكنهم ۚ كذلك نجزي القوم المجرمين
verses.transliterated: tudammiru kulla shayin bi-amri rabbihā fa-aṣbaḥū lā yurā illā masākinuhum kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīn
verses.english: It destroyed everything, as commanded by its Lord. By morning, nothing was standing except their homes. We thus requite the guilty people.

1981.english: It destroyed everything as commanded by its Lord. By morning, only their lifeless homes were seen. We thus punish the guilty people.

1989.english: It destroyed everything, as commanded by its Lord. By morning, nothing was seen standing except their homes We thus requite the guilty people.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَٰرًا وَأَفْـِٔدَةً فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ أَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا۟ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد مكناهم فيما إن مكناكم فيه وجعلنا لهم سمعا وأبصارا وأفئدة فما أغنى عنهم سمعهم ولا أبصارهم ولا أفئدتهم من شيء إذ كانوا يجحدون بآيات الله وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
verses.transliterated: walaqad makkannāhum fīmā in makkannākum fīhi wajaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afidatan famā aghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum walā abṣāruhum walā afidatuhum min shayin idh kānū yajḥadūna biāyāti l-lahi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.english: We had established them in the same way as we established you, and provided them with hearing, eyes, and minds. But their hearing, eyes, and minds did not help them at all. This is because they decided to disregard GOD's revelations. Thus, the prophecies and warnings that they ridiculed have caused their doom.
verses.subtitle: They Ridiculed the Messenger's Warnings

1981.english: We had established them in the same way as we established you, and we gave them hearing, eyes, and minds. But their hearing, their eyes, and their minds did not help them, as a consequence of ignoring the revelations of God. The very thing they ridiculed was the cause of their doom.

1989.english: We had established them in the same way as we established you, and provided them with hearing, eyes, and minds. But their hearing, eyes, and minds did not help them at all. This is because they decided to disregard GOD’s revelations, and the very things they ridiculed caused their doom.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد أهلكنا ما حولكم من القرى وصرفنا الآيات لعلهم يرجعون
verses.transliterated: walaqad ahlaknā mā ḥawlakum mina l-qurā waṣarrafnā l-āyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.english: We have annihilated many communities around you, after we had explained the proofs, that they might repent.

1981.english: We have annihilated many a community around you, after showing them signs, that they may repent.

1989.english: We have annihilated many communities around you. We had explained the signs for them, that they might repent.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلولا نصرهم الذين اتخذوا من دون الله قربانا آلهة ۖ بل ضلوا عنهم ۚ وذلك إفكهم وما كانوا يفترون
verses.transliterated: falawlā naṣarahumu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi qur'bānan ālihatan bal ḍallū ʿanhum wadhālika if'kuhum wamā kānū yaftarūn
verses.english: Why then did the idols they set up to bring them closer to GOD fail to help them? Instead, they abandoned them. Such were the false gods they idolized; such were the innovations they fabricated.

1981.english: How come the idols they had set up "to bring them closer to God" did not help them? In fact, they abandoned them. It was pure invention on their part.

1989.english: Why then did the idols they set up to bring them closer to GOD fail to help them? Indeed, they abandoned them. Such were their false gods; such was their own fabrication.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ صرفنا إليك نفرا من الجن يستمعون القرآن فلما حضروه قالوا أنصتوا ۖ فلما قضي ولوا إلى قومهم منذرين
verses.transliterated: wa-idh ṣarafnā ilayka nafaran mina l-jini yastamiʿūna l-qur'āna falammā ḥaḍarūhu qālū anṣitū falammā quḍiya wallaw ilā qawmihim mundhirīn
verses.english: Recall that we directed a number of jinns to you, in order to let them hear the Quran. When they got there, they said, "Listen." As soon as it was over, they rushed to their people, warning.
verses.subtitle: Believers Among the Jinns
verses.footnote: Jinns are the creatures who fully agreed with Satan when he initiated his famous blasphemy billions of years ago. They are brought into this world as descendants of Satan. One jinn is born every time a human being is born. The newly born jinn is assigned to the same body as the newly born human, and constantly pushes Satan's point of view (Appendix 7).

1981.english: We summoned a group of jinns to you, to hear the Quran. When they came they said, "Listen," and when it was finished, they went to their people with the warning.
1981.subtitle: Quran Is The Whole Message
1981.footnote: If there were anything else that the prophet preached besides Quran, the jinns would have reported it to their people. The Quran constitutes God's message, the whole message, and nothing but the message. See Appendix 15.

1989.english: We directed a number of jinns to you, in order to hear the Quran. When they got there, they said, “Listen.” And when it was over, they rushed to their people, warning.*
1989.subtitle: Believers Among the Jinns
1989.footnote: Jinns are the creatures who fully agreed with Satan when he initiated his famous blasphemy billions of years ago. They are brought into this world as descendants of Satan. One jinn is born every time a human being is born. The newly born jinn is assigned to the same body as the newly born human, and constantly pushes Satan’s point of view. When the human dies, the jinn companion is freed (Appendix 7).

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا قومنا إنا سمعنا كتابا أنزل من بعد موسى مصدقا لما بين يديه يهدي إلى الحق وإلى طريق مستقيم
verses.transliterated: qālū yāqawmanā innā samiʿ'nā kitāban unzila min baʿdi mūsā muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi wa-ilā ṭarīqin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: They said, "O our people, we have heard a book that was revealed after Moses, and confirms the previous scriptures. It guides to the truth; to the right path.

1981.english: They said, "O our people, we heard a scripture that came down after Moses, confirming the previous scriptures. It guides to the truth and a straight path.
1981.footnote: If there were anything else that the prophet preached besides Quran, the jinns would have reported it to their people. The Quran constitutes God's message, the whole message, and nothing but the message. See Appendix 15.

1989.english: They said, “O our people, we have heard a book, revealed after Moses, that confirms all previous scriptures. It guides to the truth, and to a straight path.

verses.arabic: يَٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: يا قومنا أجيبوا داعي الله وآمنوا به يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويجركم من عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: yāqawmanā ajībū dāʿiya l-lahi waāminū bihi yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayujir'kum min ʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: O our people, respond to the call of GOD, and believe in Him. He will then forgive your sins, and spare you a painful retribution.

1981.english: "O our people, you shall respond to God's call, and believe in Him. He will then forgive your sins and protect you from painful retribution."
1981.footnote: If there were anything else that the prophet preached besides Quran, the jinns would have reported it to their people. The Quran constitutes God's message, the whole message, and nothing but the message. See Appendix 15.

1989.english: “O our people, respond to the call of GOD, and believe in Him. He will then forgive your sins, and will spare you painful retribution.”

verses.arabic: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ومن لا يجب داعي الله فليس بمعجز في الأرض وليس له من دونه أولياء ۚ أولئك في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: waman lā yujib dāʿiya l-lahi falaysa bimuʿ'jizin fī l-arḍi walaysa lahu min dūnihi awliyāu ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Those who fail to respond to GOD's call cannot escape, and will have no Lord other than Him; they have gone far astray.

1981.english: Anyone who fails to respond to God's message will never escape. Nor will he have friends to help him against God. These are totally astray.
1981.footnote: If there were anything else that the prophet preached besides Quran, the jinns would have reported it to their people. The Quran constitutes God's message, the whole message, and nothing but the message. See Appendix 15.

1989.english: Whoever fails to respond to GOD’s call cannot escape, and will find no help against Him. They are far astray.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا أن الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض ولم يعي بخلقهن بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى ۚ بلى إنه على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa walam yaʿya bikhalqihinna biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā balā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Do they not realize that GOD, who created the heavens and the earth without the least effort is able to revive the dead? Yes indeed; He is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Do they not realize that God, who created the heavens and the earth without getting tired, is able to resurrect the dead? Yes indeed; He is omnipotent.

1989.english: Do they not realize that GOD, who created the heavens and the earth and was never burdened by such creation, is able to revive the dead? Yes indeed. He is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار أليس هذا بالحق ۖ قالوا بلى وربنا ۚ قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
verses.transliterated: wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn
verses.english: The day the disbelievers are introduced to the Hellfire, they will be asked, "Is this not the truth?" They will answer, "Yes indeed, by our Lord." He will say, "Then suffer the retribution for your disbelief."

1981.english: The day will come when the disbelievers will be shown the hellfire; "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes indeed, by our Lord." He will then say, "This is what you deserve for disbelieving."

1989.english: The day the disbelievers are introduced to the Hellfire, they will be asked, “Is this not the truth?” They will answer, “Yes indeed, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then suffer the retribution for your disbelief.”

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ بَلَٰغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر كما صبر أولو العزم من الرسل ولا تستعجل لهم ۚ كأنهم يوم يرون ما يوعدون لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من نهار ۚ بلاغ ۚ فهل يهلك إلا القوم الفاسقون
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir kamā ṣabara ulū l-ʿazmi mina l-rusuli walā tastaʿjil lahum ka-annahum yawma yarawna mā yūʿadūna lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan min nahārin balāghun fahal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-fāsiqūn
verses.english: Therefore, be patient like the messengers before you who possessed strength and resorted to patience. Do not be in a hurry to see the retribution that will inevitably come to them. The day they see it, it will seem as if they lasted one hour of the day. This is a proclamation: Is it not the wicked who are consistently annihilated?
verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant
verses.footnote: Quranic and mathematical evidence proves that the messenger addressed here is Rashad Khalifa. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the sura number (46), plus the verse number (35), we get 1311, or 19x69. This conforms with the Quran's code (App 2).

1981.english: Therefore, be patient, like all the messengers who possessed strength, and do not be eager to see their punishment. When the appointed day comes, and they see the retribution promised to them, it will seem as if they lasted one hour of the day. This is a declaration; is it not the wicked who are doomed?

1989.english: Therefore, be patient like the messengers who possessed strength and practiced patience, and do not be in a hurry (to see the retribution coming) to them. The day they see it, it will seem as if they lasted one hour of the day. This is a proclamation: Is it not the wicked who are annihilated?

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله أضل أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi aḍalla aʿmālahu
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, He nullifies their works.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve and repel others from the path of God, God nullifies their work.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved and repelled from the path of GOD, He nullifies their works.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وآمنوا بما نزل على محمد وهو الحق من ربهم ۙ كفر عنهم سيئاتهم وأصلح بالهم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyiātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bālahu
verses.english: Those who believe and work righteousness, and believe in what was sent down to Muhammad—which is the truth from their Lord—He remits their sins, and blesses them with contentment.

1981.english: But those who believe, work righteousness, and believe in what was revealed through Muhammad, which is the truth from their Lord; God will remit their sins and restore their contentment.

1989.english: While those who believed and worked righteousness, and believed in what was sent down to Muhammad—which is the truth from their Lord— He remits their sins, and blesses them with contentment.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الذين كفروا اتبعوا الباطل وأن الذين آمنوا اتبعوا الحق من ربهم ۚ كذلك يضرب الله للناس أمثالهم
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna alladhīna kafarū ittabaʿū l-bāṭila wa-anna alladhīna āmanū ittabaʿū l-ḥaqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu lilnnāsi amthālahu
verses.english: This is because those who disbelieve are following falsehood, while those who believe are following the truth from their Lord. GOD thus cites for the people, their examples.

1981.english: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, while those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. God thus cites the examples for the people.

1989.english: This is because those who disbelieved are following falsehood, while those who believed are following the truth from their Lord. GOD thus cites the examples for the people.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَضَرْبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا۟ ٱلْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَا۟ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا لقيتم الذين كفروا فضرب الرقاب حتى إذا أثخنتموهم فشدوا الوثاق فإما منا بعد وإما فداء حتى تضع الحرب أوزارها ۚ ذلك ولو يشاء الله لانتصر منهم ولكن ليبلو بعضكم ببعض ۗ والذين قتلوا في سبيل الله فلن يضل أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū faḍarba l-riqābi ḥattā idhā athkhantumūhum fashuddū l-wathāqa fa-immā mannan baʿdu wa-immā fidāan ḥattā taḍaʿa l-ḥarbu awzārahā dhālika walaw yashāu l-lahu la-intaṣara min'hum walākin liyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin wa-alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi falan yuḍilla aʿmālahu
verses.english: If you encounter (in war) those who disbelieve, you may strike the necks. If you take them as captives you may set them free or ransom them, until the war ends. Had GOD willed, He could have granted you victory, without war. But He thus tests you by one another. As for those who get killed in the cause of GOD, He will never put their sacrifice to waste.

1981.english: Therefore, when you encounter in war those who disbelieve,* you shall strike their necks. Once you defeat them, you shall hold them captive until released amicably or ransomed at the end of war. Had God willed, He could have stopped them Himself. But He puts you to the test; those who readily strive for the cause of God, He will never waste their works.
1981.footnote: See the laws of war in 2:190.

1989.english: Therefore, if you encounter (in war) those who disbelieved, you may strike their necks. If you take them as war captives you may set them free, or ransom them, until the war ends. Had GOD willed, He could have spared you such a war, and granted you victory. But He thus puts you to the test. As for those who get killed in the cause of GOD, He will not put their sacrifice to waste.

verses.arabic: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: سيهديهم ويصلح بالهم
verses.transliterated: sayahdīhim wayuṣ'liḥu bālahu
verses.english: He will guide them, and bless them with contentment.

1981.english: He will guide them and restore their contentment.

1989.english: He will guide them, and bless them with contentment.

verses.arabic: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ويدخلهم الجنة عرفها لهم
verses.transliterated: wayud'khiluhumu l-janata ʿarrafahā lahu
verses.english: He will admit them into Paradise, that He described to them.

1981.english: He will admit them into Paradise, just as He promised them.

1989.english: And will admit them into Paradise, that He made known to them.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن تنصروا الله ينصركم ويثبت أقدامكم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tanṣurū l-laha yanṣur'kum wayuthabbit aqdāmaku
verses.english: O you who believe, if you support GOD, He will support you, and strengthen your foothold.

1981.english: O you who believe, if you support God, He will support you and strengthen your foothold.

1989.english: O you who believe, if you support GOD, He will support you, and strengthen your foothold.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا فتعسا لهم وأضل أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū fataʿsan lahum wa-aḍalla aʿmālahu
verses.english: Those who disbelieve incur misery; He causes their works to be utterly in vain.

1981.english: As for those who disbelieve, they have deserved misery, and God will nullify their works.

1989.english: As for those who disbelieve, they incur misery; He causes their works to be utterly in vain.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم كرهوا ما أنزل الله فأحبط أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahum karihū mā anzala l-lahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahu
verses.english: That is because they hated what GOD revealed and consequently, He nullifies their works.

1981.english: This is because they hated what God had revealed, and consequently, He neutralized their works.

1989.english: This is because they hated what GOD revealed and, consequently, He nullifies their works.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْثَٰلُهَا
verses.arabicClean: أفلم يسيروا في الأرض فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم ۚ دمر الله عليهم ۖ وللكافرين أمثالها
verses.transliterated: afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim dammara l-lahu ʿalayhim walil'kāfirīna amthāluh
verses.english: Did they not roam the earth and see the consequences for those before them? GOD destroyed their works; all disbelievers will suffer the same fate.

1981.english: Did they not travel the earth and see the consequences for those before them? God destroyed them, and all disbelievers will suffer the same fate.

1989.english: Did they not roam the earth and see the consequences for those before them? GOD destroyed them, and the disbelievers will suffer a similar fate.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأن الله مولى الذين آمنوا وأن الكافرين لا مولى لهم
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-anna l-laha mawlā alladhīna āmanū wa-anna l-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahu
verses.english: This is because GOD is the Lord of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no lord.

1981.english: This is because God is the Lord of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no lord.

1989.english: This is because GOD is the Lord of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no lord.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار ۖ والذين كفروا يتمتعون ويأكلون كما تأكل الأنعام والنار مثوى لهم
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wa-alladhīna kafarū yatamattaʿūna wayakulūna kamā takulu l-anʿāmu wal-nāru mathwan lahu
verses.english: GOD admits those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who disbelieve, they live and eat like the animals eat, then end up in the hellfire.

1981.english: God will admit those who believe and work righteousness into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who disbelieve, they temporarily enjoy and eat like animals, then hell is their ultimate destiny.

1989.english: GOD admits those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who disbelieve, they live and eat like the animals eat, then end up in the hellfire.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: وكأين من قرية هي أشد قوة من قريتك التي أخرجتك أهلكناهم فلا ناصر لهم
verses.transliterated: waka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatī akhrajatka ahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahu
verses.english: Many a community was much stronger than the community that evicted you from your town; when we annihilated them, no one could help them.

1981.english: Many a town was stronger than the town that banished you (O Muhammad), but we destroyed them; they had no one to help them.

1989.english: Many a community was much stronger than the community that banished you; when we annihilated them, they had no helper.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم
verses.arabicClean: أفمن كان على بينة من ربه كمن زين له سوء عمله واتبعوا أهواءهم
verses.transliterated: afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahu
verses.english: Are those enlightened by their Lord the same as those whose evil works are adorned in their eyes, and they follow their own opinions?

1981.english: Is one who follows a proof from his Lord the same as one whose evil work is adorned in his eyes? These people are following their own opinions.

1989.english: Are those enlightened by their Lord the same as those whose evil works are adorned in their eyes, and they follow their own opinions?

verses.arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ فِيهَآ أَنْهَٰرٌ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَٰرٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَٰرٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَٰلِدٌ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: مثل الجنة التي وعد المتقون ۖ فيها أنهار من ماء غير آسن وأنهار من لبن لم يتغير طعمه وأنهار من خمر لذة للشاربين وأنهار من عسل مصفى ۖ ولهم فيها من كل الثمرات ومغفرة من ربهم ۖ كمن هو خالد في النار وسقوا ماء حميما فقطع أمعاءهم
verses.transliterated: mathalu l-janati allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna fīhā anhārun min māin ghayri āsinin wa-anhārun min labanin lam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu wa-anhārun min khamrin ladhatin lilshāribīna wa-anhārun min ʿasalin muṣaffan walahum fīhā min kulli l-thamarāti wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khālidun fī l-nāri wasuqū māan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa amʿāahu
verses.english: The allegory of Paradise that is promised for the righteous is this: it has rivers of unpolluted water, and rivers of fresh milk, and rivers of wine— delicious for the drinkers—and rivers of strained honey. They have all kinds of fruits therein, and forgiveness from their Lord. (Are they better) or those who abide forever in the hellfire, and drink hellish water that tears up their intestines?

1981.english: The allegory of Paradise that is promised for the righteous is one with rivers of unpolluted water, rivers of unchanged milk, rivers of delicious intoxicants, and rivers of filtered honey. They will have all kinds of fruits therein, as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Is this better, or those who last in hell forever, drinking molten lava that dissolves their intestines?

1989.english: The allegory of Paradise that is promised for the righteous is that it has rivers of unpolluted water, and rivers of milk whose taste never changes, and rivers of intoxicants—delicious for the drinkers—and rivers of strained honey. They have all kinds of fruits therein, and forgiveness from their Lord. (Are they better) or those who abide forever in the hellfire, and drink hellish water that tears up their intestines?

verses.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ومنهم من يستمع إليك حتى إذا خرجوا من عندك قالوا للذين أوتوا العلم ماذا قال آنفا ۚ أولئك الذين طبع الله على قلوبهم واتبعوا أهواءهم
verses.transliterated: wamin'hum man yastamiʿu ilayka ḥattā idhā kharajū min ʿindika qālū lilladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma mādhā qāla ānifan ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahu
verses.english: Some of them listen to you, then as soon as they leave they ask those who were enlightened, "What did he just say?" GOD thus seals their hearts and, consequently, they follow only their opinions.

1981.english: Some of them listen to you, but when they leave, they ask those who are knowledgeable, "What did he say?" God has sealed their hearts, and thus, they follow their own opinions.

1989.english: Some of them listen to you, then as soon as they leave they ask those who were enlightened, “What did he just say?” GOD thus seals their hearts and, consequently, they follow only their opinions.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: والذين اهتدوا زادهم هدى وآتاهم تقواهم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna ih'tadaw zādahum hudan waātāhum taqwāhu
verses.english: As for those who are guided, He augments their guidance, and grants them their righteousness.

1981.english: As for those who are guided, God augments their guidance and grants them their righteousness.

1989.english: As for those who are guided, He augments their guidance, and grants them their righteousness.

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فهل ينظرون إلا الساعة أن تأتيهم بغتة ۖ فقد جاء أشراطها ۚ فأنى لهم إذا جاءتهم ذكراهم
verses.transliterated: fahal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jāa ashrāṭuhā fa-annā lahum idhā jāathum dhik'rāhu
verses.english: Are they waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? All the signs thereof have already come. Once the Hour comes to them, how will they benefit from their message?
verses.subtitle: End of the World
verses.footnote: The Quran, being the Final Testament, provides all the signs needed to pinpoint the end of the world; AD 2280. See Appendix 25 for the details.

1981.english: Are they waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? Its signs and conditions have already come.* What will they do about this reminder as it comes to them?
1981.footnote: See footnote 44:10.

1989.english: Are they waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? All the signs thereof have already come.* Once the Hour comes to them, how will they benefit from their message?
1989.subtitle: End of the World
1989.footnote: The Quran, being the Final Testament provides all the signs needed to inform us that this world will come to an end in AD 2280. See Appendix 25 for the details.

verses.arabic: فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فاعلم أنه لا إله إلا الله واستغفر لذنبك وللمؤمنين والمؤمنات ۗ والله يعلم متقلبكم ومثواكم
verses.transliterated: fa-iʿ'lam annahu lā ilāha illā l-lahu wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-lahu yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwāku
verses.english: You shall know that: "There is no other god beside GOD," and ask forgiveness of your sins and the sins of all believing men and women. GOD is fully aware of your decisions and your ultimate destiny.
verses.subtitle: Lã Elãha Ellã Allãh: First Commandment
verses.footnote: Significantly, the "First Pillar" of religion is stated in the sura entitled Muhammad, and is utterly devoted to God alone. Muhammad's name was added by his idolizers, against his will.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall recognize no god except the one God, and ask forgiveness for your sins and for the believing men and women. God is fully aware of your course and your ultimate destiny.

1989.english: You shall know that there is no other god besides GOD, and ask forgiveness of your sins, and the sins of all believing men and women. GOD is fully aware of your decisions and your ultimate destiny.

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلْقِتَالُ رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ ٱلْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ويقول الذين آمنوا لولا نزلت سورة ۖ فإذا أنزلت سورة محكمة وذكر فيها القتال ۙ رأيت الذين في قلوبهم مرض ينظرون إليك نظر المغشي عليه من الموت ۖ فأولى لهم
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlu alladhīna āmanū lawlā nuzzilat sūratun fa-idhā unzilat sūratun muḥ'kamatun wadhukira fīhā l-qitālu ra-ayta alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yanẓurūna ilayka naẓara l-maghshiyi ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-awlā lahu
verses.english: Those who believed said: "When will a new sura be revealed?" But when a straightforward sura was revealed, wherein fighting was mentioned, you would see those who harbored doubts in their hearts looking at you, as if death had already come to them. They were thus exposed.
verses.subtitle: Exposing the Hypocrites

1981.english: Those who believe look forward to the revelation of any sura. But when a straight forward sura is revealed, wherein fighting is decreed, you see those with doubtful hearts looking at you as if they were dying. They have deserved to be exposed.

1989.english: Those who believed looked forward to any new revelation: “When will a new sura be revealed?” But when a straightforward sura was revealed, wherein fighting was mentioned, you would see those with doubts in their hearts looking as if death had already come to them. They were thus exposed.
1989.subtitle: Exposing the Hypocrites

verses.arabic: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: طاعة وقول معروف ۚ فإذا عزم الأمر فلو صدقوا الله لكان خيرا لهم
verses.transliterated: ṭāʿatun waqawlun maʿrūfun fa-idhā ʿazama l-amru falaw ṣadaqū l-laha lakāna khayran lahu
verses.english: Obedience and righteous utterances are expected of them. If only they showed confidence in GOD, when mobilization was called for, it would have been better for them.
verses.subtitle: Proof of Faith During Muhammad's Era

1981.english: Obedience and righteous utterances are expected of them. Thus, when a decision is made, if they show faithfulness towards God, it will be better for them.

1989.english: Obedience and righteous utterances are expected of them. Thus, if mobilization is ever required, and they show their confidence in GOD, it will be better for them.

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓا۟ أَرْحَامَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فهل عسيتم إن توليتم أن تفسدوا في الأرض وتقطعوا أرحامكم
verses.transliterated: fahal ʿasaytum in tawallaytum an tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi watuqaṭṭiʿū arḥāmaku
verses.english: Is it also your intention that as soon as you leave you will commit evil and mistreat your relatives?

1981.english: Is it your intention that as soon as you leave, you will corrupt the earth and mistreat your relatives?

1989.english: Is it your intention that as soon as you leave you will commit evil and mistreat your relatives?

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك الذين لعنهم الله فأصمهم وأعمى أبصارهم
verses.transliterated: ulāika alladhīna laʿanahumu l-lahu fa-aṣammahum wa-aʿmā abṣārahu
verses.english: It is those who incurred a curse from GOD, whereby He rendered them deaf and blind.

1981.english: It is these whom God curses by deafening their ears and blinding their eyes.

1989.english: It is these who incur a curse from GOD; He renders them deaf and blind.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَآ
verses.arabicClean: أفلا يتدبرون القرآن أم على قلوب أقفالها
verses.transliterated: afalā yatadabbarūna l-qur'āna am ʿalā qulūbin aqfāluh
verses.english: Why do they not study the Quran carefully? Do they have locks on their minds?
verses.subtitle: Study the Quran

1981.english: Why do they not study and heed the Quran? Are their hearts locked up?

1989.english: Why do they not study the Quran carefully? Are their minds blocked?
1989.subtitle: Study the Quran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين ارتدوا على أدبارهم من بعد ما تبين لهم الهدى ۙ الشيطان سول لهم وأملى لهم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ir'taddū ʿalā adbārihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā l-shayṭānu sawwala lahum wa-amlā lahu
verses.english: Surely, those who slide back, after the guidance has been manifested to them, the devil has enticed them and led them on.

1981.english: Those who turned back and fled, after the guidance had been pointed out to them, the devil has duped them and enticed them.

1989.english: Surely, those who slide back, after the guidance has been manifested to them, the devil has enticed them, and has misled them.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا۟ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِى بَعْضِ ٱلْأَمْرِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم قالوا للذين كرهوا ما نزل الله سنطيعكم في بعض الأمر ۖ والله يعلم إسرارهم
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahum qālū lilladhīna karihū mā nazzala l-lahu sanuṭīʿukum fī baʿḍi l-amri wal-lahu yaʿlamu is'rārahu
verses.english: This is because they said to those who hated what GOD has sent down, "We will obey you in certain matters." GOD fully knows their secret conspiracies.

1981.english: They had said to those who dislike God's message, "We will obey you in some instances." God is fully aware of their secrets.

1989.english: This is because they said to those who hated GOD’s revelations, “We agree with some of the things you say.” GOD fully knows their secret conspiracies.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَٰرَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فكيف إذا توفتهم الملائكة يضربون وجوههم وأدبارهم
verses.transliterated: fakayfa idhā tawaffathumu l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahu
verses.english: How will it be for them when the angels put them to death? They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends.

1981.english: This is why when the angels put them to death, they will beat them on the faces and the rear ends.

1989.english: How will it be for them when the angels put them to death? They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَآ أَسْخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنهم اتبعوا ما أسخط الله وكرهوا رضوانه فأحبط أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahumu ittabaʿū mā askhaṭa l-laha wakarihū riḍ'wānahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahu
verses.english: This is because they followed what angered GOD and hated the things that please Him. Consequently, He has nullified their works.

1981.english: They had followed what angers God and disliked to please Him. Consequently, He nullifies their works.

1989.english: This is because they followed what angered GOD and hated to please Him. Consequently, He has nullified their works.

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضْغَٰنَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: أم حسب الذين في قلوبهم مرض أن لن يخرج الله أضغانهم
verses.transliterated: am ḥasiba alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun an lan yukh'rija l-lahu aḍghānahu
verses.english: Did those who harbor doubts in their hearts think that GOD will not bring out their evil thoughts?

1981.english: Did those with doubtful hearts expect that God will never expose their hatefulness?

1989.english: Did those with doubts in their hearts think that GOD will not bring out their evil thoughts?

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيْنَٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمْ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِى لَحْنِ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ولو نشاء لأريناكهم فلعرفتهم بسيماهم ۚ ولتعرفنهم في لحن القول ۚ والله يعلم أعمالكم
verses.transliterated: walaw nashāu la-araynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum walataʿrifannahum fī laḥni l-qawli wal-lahu yaʿlamu aʿmālaku
verses.english: If we will, we can expose them for you, so that you can recognize them just by looking at them. However, you can recognize them by the way they talk. GOD is fully aware of all your works.

1981.english: If we will, we can show them to you, and let you recognize them by their marks. You can recognize them by the way they talk. God is fully aware of all your works.

1989.english: Had we willed, we could have exposed them for you, and you would have recognized them by certain marks. You can recognize them by their twisted utterances. GOD is fully aware of all your works.
1989.subtitle: Warning to the Arabs

verses.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: ولنبلونكم حتى نعلم المجاهدين منكم والصابرين ونبلو أخباركم
verses.transliterated: walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum wal-ṣābirīna wanabluwā akhbāraku
verses.english: We will certainly put you to the test, in order to distinguish those among you who strive, and steadfastly persevere. We must expose your true qualities.

1981.english: We will certainly put you to the test until we distinguish the strivers among you who remain steadfast, and to test your behavior.
1981.subtitle: We Must Be Put To The Test

1989.english: We will certainly put you to the test, in order to distinguish the strivers among you, and those who steadfastly persevere. We must expose your true qualities.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله وشاقوا الرسول من بعد ما تبين لهم الهدى لن يضروا الله شيئا وسيحبط أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi washāqqū l-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan wasayuḥ'biṭu aʿmālahu
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, and oppose the messenger after the guidance has been manifested for them, will never hurt GOD in the least. Instead, He nullifies their works.

1981.english: Those who disbelieved, repelled from the path of God, and opposed the messenger after the guidance had been clarified for them, never harm God in the least; He will nullify their works.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved and repelled from the path of GOD, and opposed the messenger after the guidance has been manifested for them, will never hurt GOD in the least. Instead, He nullifies their works.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوٓا۟ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول ولا تبطلوا أعمالكم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla walā tub'ṭilū aʿmālaku
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and obey the messenger. Otherwise, all your works will be in vain.

1981.english: O you who believe, obey God, and obey the messenger,* and do not nullify your works.
1981.footnote: To obey God and the messenger is to uphold the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. The invention of **hadith** and/or **sunna** to distort and even supersede the Quran represents the height of disobience to God and the messenger. See 6:112-116, 25:30-31, and Appendix 11.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and obey the messenger. Otherwise, all your works will be in vain.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا وصدوا عن سبيل الله ثم ماتوا وهم كفار فلن يغفر الله لهم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi thumma mātū wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira l-lahu lahu
verses.english: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, then die as disbelievers, GOD will never forgive them.
verses.subtitle: The Great Disaster

1981.english: Those who disbelieved, repelled from the path of God, and died as disbelievers, God will never forgive them.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved and repelled from the path of GOD, then died as disbelievers, GOD will never forgive them.
1989.subtitle: The Great Disaster

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَٰلَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تهنوا وتدعوا إلى السلم وأنتم الأعلون والله معكم ولن يتركم أعمالكم
verses.transliterated: falā tahinū watadʿū ilā l-salmi wa-antumu l-aʿlawna wal-lahu maʿakum walan yatirakum aʿmālaku
verses.english: Therefore, you shall not waver and surrender in pursuit of peace, for you are guaranteed victory, and GOD is with you. He will never waste your efforts.

1981.english: You shall never waver nor surrender, for you will be victorious; God is with you and will never fail to reward you for your works.

1989.english: Therefore, do not waver and surrender in pursuit of peace. You are guaranteed victory, for GOD is with you, and will never waste your efforts.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْـَٔلْكُمْ أَمْوَٰلَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إنما الحياة الدنيا لعب ولهو ۚ وإن تؤمنوا وتتقوا يؤتكم أجوركم ولا يسألكم أموالكم
verses.transliterated: innamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wa-in tu'minū watattaqū yu'tikum ujūrakum walā yasalkum amwālaku
verses.english: This worldly life is no more than play and vanity. But if you believe and lead a righteous life, He will reward you, without asking you for any money.

1981.english: This life is no more than play and vanity. If you believe and work righteousness, God will give you your rewards, instead of asking you for money.

1989.english: This worldly life is no more than vanity and play. But if you believe and lead a righteous life, He will pay you, and not ask you for any money.

verses.arabic: إِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا۟ وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَٰنَكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إن يسألكموها فيحفكم تبخلوا ويخرج أضغانكم
verses.transliterated: in yasalkumūhā fayuḥ'fikum tabkhalū wayukh'rij aḍghānaku
verses.english: If He asked you for money, to the extent of creating a hardship for you, you might have become stingy, and your hidden evil might be exposed.

1981.english: If He asks you to donate in excessive amounts, you may turn stingy, and hatred may prevail among you.

1989.english: If He asked you for money, to the extent of creating a hardship for you, you might have become stingy, and your hidden evil would have been exposed.

verses.arabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْغَنِىُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓا۟ أَمْثَٰلَكُم
verses.arabicClean: ها أنتم هؤلاء تدعون لتنفقوا في سبيل الله فمنكم من يبخل ۖ ومن يبخل فإنما يبخل عن نفسه ۚ والله الغني وأنتم الفقراء ۚ وإن تتولوا يستبدل قوما غيركم ثم لا يكونوا أمثالكم
verses.transliterated: hāantum hāulāi tud'ʿawna litunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fa-innamā yabkhalu ʿan nafsihi wal-lahu l-ghaniyu wa-antumu l-fuqarāu wa-in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnū amthālaku
verses.english: You are invited to spend in the cause of GOD, but some of you turn stingy. The stingy are stingy towards their own souls. GOD is Rich, while you are poor.  If you turn away, He will substitute other people in your place, and they will not be like you.
verses.subtitle: Warning to the Arabs
verses.footnote: The Quran was given to the Arabs, in their language, for 1400 years, but they clearly rejected it and refused to believe that it is complete; they fabricated Hadith & Sunna.

1981.english: Here you are being exhorted to spend in the cause of God, and some of you turn stingy. Those who turn stingy are stingy against their souls. God is rich, while you are poor. IF YOU TURN AWAY, GOD WILL SUBSTITUTE OTHER PEOPLE IN YOUR PLACE, AND THEY WILL NOT BE LIKE YOU.
1981.footnote: The so-called muslims throughout the "Muslim world" have abandoned the Quran **en masse** and failed the **hadith** test (see 6:112, 116 and 25:30-31). It seems that a process of substitution is taking place now according to this statement. Islam is being reestablished in the English-speaking world, after being restored to its pristine purity.

1989.english: You are invited to spend in the cause of GOD, but some of you turn stingy. The stingy are stingy towards their own souls. GOD is Rich, while you are poor. If you turn away, He will substitute other people in your place, and they will not be like you.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إنا فتحنا لك فتحا مبينا
verses.transliterated: innā fataḥnā laka fatḥan mubīna
verses.english: We have bestowed upon you (O Messenger) a great victory.
verses.footnote: This profound statement consists of 19 letters, indicating that our generation is the generation of victory for God's purified, unified, and consolidated religion—Submission (3:19, 85). It is our generation that witnessed the revelations of God's great miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1).

1981.english: We have endowed you with a great bounty.

1989.english: We granted you (O Messenger) a great victory.

verses.arabic: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ليغفر لك الله ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تأخر ويتم نعمته عليك ويهديك صراطا مستقيما
verses.transliterated: liyaghfira laka l-lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbika wamā ta-akhara wayutimma niʿ'matahu ʿalayka wayahdiyaka ṣirāṭan mus'taqīma
verses.english: Whereby GOD forgives your past sins, as well as future sins, and perfects His blessings upon you, and guides you in a straight path.

1981.english: Whereby God forgives your past and future sins, completes His blessings upon you, and guides you in a straight path.

1989.english: For GOD has forgiven your past sins, as well as future sins, has perfected His blessings upon you, and has guided you in a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
verses.arabicClean: وينصرك الله نصرا عزيزا
verses.transliterated: wayanṣuraka l-lahu naṣran ʿazīza
verses.english: Additionally, GOD will support you with an unwavering support.

1981.english: And God will grant you a great victory.

1989.english: And GOD has supported you with profound support.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي أنزل السكينة في قلوب المؤمنين ليزدادوا إيمانا مع إيمانهم ۗ ولله جنود السماوات والأرض ۚ وكان الله عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī anzala l-sakīnata fī qulūbi l-mu'minīna liyazdādū īmānan maʿa īmānihim walillahi junūdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: He is the One who places contentment into the hearts of believers to augment more faith, in addition to their faith. To GOD belongs all forces of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: He is the one who placed calm into the hearts of the believers, in order to strengthen their faith. To God belongs all the forces in the heavens and the earth. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: He is the One who placed contentment into the hearts of the believers, to augment more faith, in addition to their faith. To GOD belongs the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ليدخل المؤمنين والمؤمنات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها ويكفر عنهم سيئاتهم ۚ وكان ذلك عند الله فوزا عظيما
verses.transliterated: liyud'khila l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wayukaffira ʿanhum sayyiātihim wakāna dhālika ʿinda l-lahi fawzan ʿaẓīma
verses.english: He will certainly admit the believing men and women into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. He will remit their sins. This is, in the sight of GOD, a great triumph.

1981.english: Whereby, God admits the believing men and women into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. And He remits their sins. This is the great triumph from God.

1989.english: He will surely admit the believing men and women into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever, and will remit their sins. This is, in the sight of GOD, a great triumph.

verses.arabic: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ويعذب المنافقين والمنافقات والمشركين والمشركات الظانين بالله ظن السوء ۚ عليهم دائرة السوء ۖ وغضب الله عليهم ولعنهم وأعد لهم جهنم ۖ وساءت مصيرا
verses.transliterated: wayuʿadhiba l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-mush'rikīna wal-mush'rikāti l-ẓānīna bil-lahi ẓanna l-sawi ʿalayhim dāiratu l-sawi waghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim walaʿanahum wa-aʿadda lahum jahannama wasāat maṣīra
verses.english: And He will requite the hypocrite men and women and the idol worshiping men and women, for they have harbored evil thoughts about GOD. Their evil will backfire against them. For GOD is angry with them, condemns them, and has prepared for them Gehenna. What a miserable destiny!

1981.english: He will punish the hypocrite men and women, and the idol worshipping men and women, for they harbor evil thoughts about God. Evil will backfire against them; God is angry with them, curses them, and has prepared for them hell; a miserable destiny.

1989.english: And He will requite the hypocrite men and women and the idol worshiping men and women, for they have harbored evil thoughts about GOD. Evil will backfire against them. GOD is angry with them, condemns them, and has prepared for them Gehenna; a miserable destiny.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولله جنود السماوات والأرض ۚ وكان الله عزيزا حكيما
verses.transliterated: walillahi junūdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakāna l-lahu ʿazīzan ḥakīma
verses.english: To GOD belongs all the forces in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: To God belong all the forces of the heavens and the earth; God is almighty, wise.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ شَٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا أرسلناك شاهدا ومبشرا ونذيرا
verses.transliterated: innā arsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīra
verses.english: We have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.

1981.english: We have sent you (Muhammad) as a witness, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner.

1989.english: We have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.

verses.arabic: لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: لتؤمنوا بالله ورسوله وتعزروه وتوقروه وتسبحوه بكرة وأصيلا
verses.transliterated: litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watuʿazzirūhu watuwaqqirūhu watusabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīla
verses.english: That you people may believe in GOD and His messenger, and reverence Him, and observe Him, and glorify Him, day and night.

1981.english: In order that you (people) believe in God and His messenger, and honor God, reverence God, and glorify Him day and night.

1989.english: That you people may believe in GOD and His messenger, and reverence Him, and observe Him, and glorify Him, day and night.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يبايعونك إنما يبايعون الله يد الله فوق أيديهم ۚ فمن نكث فإنما ينكث على نفسه ۖ ومن أوفى بما عاهد عليه الله فسيؤتيه أجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yubāyiʿūnaka innamā yubāyiʿūna l-laha yadu l-lahi fawqa aydīhim faman nakatha fa-innamā yankuthu ʿalā nafsihi waman awfā bimā ʿāhada ʿalayhu l-laha fasayu'tīhi ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Surely, those who pledge allegiance to you, are pledging allegiance to GOD. GOD approves their pledge; He places His hand above their hands. Those who violate such a pledge, commit the violation to their own detriment. As for those who fulfill their pledge with GOD, He will grant them a great recompense.
verses.subtitle: You Shall Support God's Messenger

1981.english: Those who make a vow with you are making a vow with God; God's hand is over their hands. Therefore, anyone who violates his vow, does so to his own detriment, and anyone who fulfills his vow to God, God will grant him a great recompense.

1989.english: Surely, those who pledge allegiance to you, are pledging allegiance to GOD. GOD’s hand is above their hands. As for those who violate their pledge, they do so to their own detriment, and those who fulfill their pledge with GOD, He will grant them a great recompense.
1989.subtitle: You Shall Support God’s Messenger

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا
verses.arabicClean: سيقول لك المخلفون من الأعراب شغلتنا أموالنا وأهلونا فاستغفر لنا ۚ يقولون بألسنتهم ما ليس في قلوبهم ۚ قل فمن يملك لكم من الله شيئا إن أراد بكم ضرا أو أراد بكم نفعا ۚ بل كان الله بما تعملون خبيرا
verses.transliterated: sayaqūlu laka l-mukhalafūna mina l-aʿrābi shaghalatnā amwālunā wa-ahlūnā fa-is'taghfir lanā yaqūlūna bi-alsinatihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina l-lahi shayan in arāda bikum ḍarran aw arāda bikum nafʿan bal kāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīra
verses.english: The sedentary Arabs who stay behind will say, "We have been preoccupied with our money and our families, so ask forgiveness for us!" They utter with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, "Who can protect you from GOD, if He willed any adversity for you, or if He willed any blessing for you?" GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

1981.english: Those bedouins who stay behind (when you mobilize for war) would say, "We were preoccupied with our business and our families, so forgive us." They utter with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, "Who can prevent God, if He wanted to harm you or benefit you?" Indeed, God is fully cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: The Arabs who stay behind will say, “We have been preoccupied with our money and our families, so ask forgiveness for us!” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Who will protect you from GOD, if He willed any adversity for you, pr if He willed any blessing for you?” Indeed, GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

verses.arabic: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
verses.arabicClean: بل ظننتم أن لن ينقلب الرسول والمؤمنون إلى أهليهم أبدا وزين ذلك في قلوبكم وظننتم ظن السوء وكنتم قوما بورا
verses.transliterated: bal ẓanantum an lan yanqaliba l-rasūlu wal-mu'minūna ilā ahlīhim abadan wazuyyina dhālika fī qulūbikum waẓanantum ẓanna l-sawi wakuntum qawman būra
verses.english: You secretly believed that the messenger and the believers will be defeated and never come back to their families, and this was firmly established in your hearts. You harbored evil thoughts and turned into wicked people.

1981.english: You had expected that the messenger and the believers would never return to their families, and this was affirmed into your hearts. You had harbored bad thoughts, and you did so maliciously.

1989.english: You secretly believed that the messenger and the believers will never come back to their families, and this was affirmed into your hearts. You harbored evil thoughts, and turned into evil people.

verses.arabic: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن لم يؤمن بالله ورسوله فإنا أعتدنا للكافرين سعيرا
verses.transliterated: waman lam yu'min bil-lahi warasūlihi fa-innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna saʿīra
verses.english: Anyone who refuses to believe in GOD and His messenger, we have prepared for the disbelievers a hellfire.

1981.english: If anyone refuses to believe in God and His messenger, we have prepared for the disbelievers hell.

1989.english: If anyone refuses to believe in GOD and His messenger, we have prepared for the disbelievers a hellfire.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولله ملك السماوات والأرض ۚ يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء ۚ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
verses.transliterated: walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīma
verses.english: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills and punishes whomever He wills. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: To GOD belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: سيقول المخلفون إذا انطلقتم إلى مغانم لتأخذوها ذرونا نتبعكم ۖ يريدون أن يبدلوا كلام الله ۚ قل لن تتبعونا كذلكم قال الله من قبل ۖ فسيقولون بل تحسدوننا ۚ بل كانوا لا يفقهون إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: sayaqūlu l-mukhalafūna idhā inṭalaqtum ilā maghānima litakhudhūhā dharūnā nattabiʿ'kum yurīdūna an yubaddilū kalāma l-lahi qul lan tattabiʿūnā kadhālikum qāla l-lahu min qablu fasayaqūlūna bal taḥsudūnanā bal kānū lā yafqahūna illā qalīla
verses.english: The sedentary who stay behind will say, when you are expected to collect spoils of war, "Let us follow you to share in this!" They thus wish to alter GOD's words. Say, "You will not follow us. This is GOD's decision." They will then say, "You must be envious of us (for staying behind)." Indeed, they rarely understood anything.

1981.english: Those who stayed behind would say, when you reap the spoils of war, "Let us join you," seeking to change the words of God. Say, "You cannot join us, for this is what God had said." Then they might say, "You must have been envious of us." Indeed, they hardly understand.

1989.english: Those who stay behind will say, when you are expected to collect spoils of war, “Let us follow you to share in this!” They wish to alter GOD’s commands. Say, “You will not follow us. This is GOD’s decision.” They will then say, “You must be envious of us (for staying behind).” Indeed, they rarely understood anything.

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: قل للمخلفين من الأعراب ستدعون إلى قوم أولي بأس شديد تقاتلونهم أو يسلمون ۖ فإن تطيعوا يؤتكم الله أجرا حسنا ۖ وإن تتولوا كما توليتم من قبل يعذبكم عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: qul lil'mukhallafīna mina l-aʿrābi satud'ʿawna ilā qawmin ulī basin shadīdin tuqātilūnahum aw yus'limūna fa-in tuṭīʿū yu'tikumu l-lahu ajran ḥasanan wa-in tatawallaw kamā tawallaytum min qablu yuʿadhib'kum ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: Say to the sedentary Arabs who stay behind, "You will be invited to face powerful people and to fight them, unless they submit. If you obey, GOD will reward you with a generous recompense. But if you turn away again, as you did in the past, He will requite you with a painful retribution."
verses.subtitle: The Test for Early Generations

1981.english: Say to the bedouins who stay behind, "You will be asked to fight people who are very powerful until you win or they embrace Islam. If you obey, God will grant you a good reward. But if you refuse as you did previously, then God will punish you a painful punishment."

1989.english: Say to the Arabs who stay behind, “You will be invited to face powerful people and fight them until they submit. If you obey, GOD will reward you with a generous recompense. But if you turn away as you did in the past, He will requite you with a painful retribution.”

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ليس على الأعمى حرج ولا على الأعرج حرج ولا على المريض حرج ۗ ومن يطع الله ورسوله يدخله جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار ۖ ومن يتول يعذبه عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: laysa ʿalā l-aʿmā ḥarajun walā ʿalā l-aʿraji ḥarajun walā ʿalā l-marīḍi ḥarajun waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waman yatawalla yuʿadhib'hu ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: The blind is not to be blamed, the crippled is not to be blamed, and the sick is not to be blamed. Those who obey GOD and His messenger, He will admit them into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who turn away, He will requite them with a painful retribution.

1981.english: The blind is not to be blamed; the handicapped is not to be blamed; and the ill is not to be blamed. Anyone who obeys God and His messenger, God will admit him into gardens with flowing streams, and anyone who refuses, God will commit him to painful retribution.

1989.english: The blind is not to be blamed, the crippled is not to be blamed, and the sick is not to be blamed. Whoever obeys GOD and His messenger, He will admit him into gardens with flowing streams. As for the one who turns away, He will requite him with a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: لقد رضي الله عن المؤمنين إذ يبايعونك تحت الشجرة فعلم ما في قلوبهم فأنزل السكينة عليهم وأثابهم فتحا قريبا
verses.transliterated: laqad raḍiya l-lahu ʿani l-mu'minīna idh yubāyiʿūnaka taḥta l-shajarati faʿalima mā fī qulūbihim fa-anzala l-sakīnata ʿalayhim wa-athābahum fatḥan qarība
verses.english: GOD is pleased with the believers who pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts and, consequently, He blessed them with contentment, and rewarded them with an immediate victory.

1981.english: God was pleased with the believers as they made a vow with you under the tree. He thus confirmed what was in their hearts. Consequently, He sent down calm upon them and rewarded them victory to be attained.

1989.english: GOD is pleased with the believers who pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts and, consequently, He blessed them with contentment, and rewarded them with an immediate victory.

verses.arabic: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ومغانم كثيرة يأخذونها ۗ وكان الله عزيزا حكيما
verses.transliterated: wamaghānima kathīratan yakhudhūnahā wakāna l-lahu ʿazīzan ḥakīma
verses.english: Additionally, they gained many spoils. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: Also, many spoils to be earned; God is almighty, wise.

1989.english: Additionally, they gained many spoils GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وعدكم الله مغانم كثيرة تأخذونها فعجل لكم هذه وكف أيدي الناس عنكم ولتكون آية للمؤمنين ويهديكم صراطا مستقيما
verses.transliterated: waʿadakumu l-lahu maghānima kathīratan takhudhūnahā faʿajjala lakum hādhihi wakaffa aydiya l-nāsi ʿankum walitakūna āyatan lil'mu'minīna wayahdiyakum ṣirāṭan mus'taqīma
verses.english: GOD has promised you many spoils that you will gain. He thus advanced some benefits for you in this life, and He has withheld the people's hands of aggression against you, and has rendered this a sign for the believers. He thus guides you in a straight path.

1981.english: God promised you many spoils that you will earn; God withheld the people's hands from harming you, and made this a sign of support for the believers. God guides in a straight path.

1989.english: GOD has promised you many spoils that you will gain. Thus, He hastened such benefits for you in this life, withheld the people’s aggression against you, and rendered this a sign for the believers, in order to guide you in a straight path.

verses.arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وأخرى لم تقدروا عليها قد أحاط الله بها ۚ وكان الله على كل شيء قديرا
verses.transliterated: wa-ukh'rā lam taqdirū ʿalayhā qad aḥāṭa l-lahu bihā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīra
verses.english: As for the group that you could not possibly defeat, GOD took care of them; GOD is Omnipotent.

1981.english: As for the other group that you could not defeat, God neutralized them. God is omnipotent.

1989.english: As for the group that you could not defeat, GOD took care of them; GOD is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ولو قاتلكم الذين كفروا لولوا الأدبار ثم لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا
verses.transliterated: walaw qātalakumu alladhīna kafarū lawallawū l-adbāra thumma lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīra
verses.english: If the disbelievers ever fought you, they would turn around and flee. They have no Lord and Master; they have no helper.
verses.subtitle: Victory Guaranteed for the Believers

1981.english: If the disbelievers ever fight you, they will turn around and flee; they will find no ally or supporter.

1989.english: Indeed, if the disbelievers fought you, they would turn around and flee. They will have no Lord, nor a helper.

verses.arabic: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: سنة الله التي قد خلت من قبل ۖ ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا
verses.transliterated: sunnata l-lahi allatī qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīla
verses.english: Such is GOD's system throughout history, and you will find that GOD's system is unchangeable.

1981.english: This is God's system that has always prevailed. God's system is never changeable.

1989.english: Such is GOD’s system throughout the past, and you will find that GOD’s system is never changeable.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وهو الذي كف أيديهم عنكم وأيديكم عنهم ببطن مكة من بعد أن أظفركم عليهم ۚ وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا
verses.transliterated: wahuwa alladhī kaffa aydiyahum ʿankum wa-aydiyakum ʿanhum bibaṭni makkata min baʿdi an aẓfarakum ʿalayhim wakāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīra
verses.english: He is the One who withheld their hands of aggression against you, and withheld your hands of aggression against them in the valley of Mecca, after He had granted you victory over them. GOD is Seer of everything you do.

1981.english: He is the one who kept their hands off of you and kept your hands off of them in the valley of Mecca, after granting you victory over them. God is seer of everything you do.

1989.english: He is the One who withheld their aggression against you, and withheld your aggression against them in the valley of Mecca, after He had granted you victory over them. GOD is fully Seer of everything you do.

verses.arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: هم الذين كفروا وصدوكم عن المسجد الحرام والهدي معكوفا أن يبلغ محله ۚ ولولا رجال مؤمنون ونساء مؤمنات لم تعلموهم أن تطئوهم فتصيبكم منهم معرة بغير علم ۖ ليدخل الله في رحمته من يشاء ۚ لو تزيلوا لعذبنا الذين كفروا منهم عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: humu alladhīna kafarū waṣaddūkum ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wal-hadya maʿkūfan an yablugha maḥillahu walawlā rijālun mu'minūna wanisāon mu'minātun lam taʿlamūhum an taṭaūhum fatuṣībakum min'hum maʿarratun bighayri ʿil'min liyud'khila l-lahu fī raḥmatihi man yashāu law tazayyalū laʿadhabnā alladhīna kafarū min'hum ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: It is they who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Masjid, and even prevented your offerings from reaching their destination. There were believing men and women (within the enemy camp) whom you did not know, and you were about to hurt them, unknowingly. GOD thus admits into His mercy whomever He wills. If they persist, He will requite those among them who disbelieve with a painful retribution.

1981.english: It is they who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque and prevented your offerings from reaching their destination. If it were not for believing men and women you did not even know, you would have assaulted them, then regretted such action. God admits into His mercy whomever He wills. Had they reverted, we would have punished the disbelievers among them a painful punishment.

1989.english: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and even prevented your offerings from reaching their destination. There were believing men and women (within the enemy camp) whom you did not know, and you were about to hurt them. GOD thus admits into His mercy whomever He wills, and requites those who disbelieve among them with a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: إذ جعل الذين كفروا في قلوبهم الحمية حمية الجاهلية فأنزل الله سكينته على رسوله وعلى المؤمنين وألزمهم كلمة التقوى وكانوا أحق بها وأهلها ۚ وكان الله بكل شيء عليما
verses.transliterated: idh jaʿala alladhīna kafarū fī qulūbihimu l-ḥamiyata ḥamiyyata l-jāhiliyati fa-anzala l-lahu sakīnatahu ʿalā rasūlihi waʿalā l-mu'minīna wa-alzamahum kalimata l-taqwā wakānū aḥaqqa bihā wa-ahlahā wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīma
verses.english: While those who disbelieved were enraged, and their hearts were filled with the pride of the days of ignorance, GOD blessed His messenger and the believers with peaceful contentment, and directed them to uphold the word of righteousness. This is what they well deserved. GOD is fully aware of all things.

1981.english: While the disbelievers stirred up their old fanaticism; fanaticism of the days of ignorance; God sent down calm upon His messenger and the believers, and He blessed them with righteousness, as they rightly deserved. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: While those who disbelieved were enraged, and their hearts were filled with the pride of the days of ignorance, GOD blessed His messenger and the believers with peaceful contentment, and directed them to uphold the word of righteousness. This is what they well deserved. GOD is fully aware of all things.
