verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: لقد صدق الله رسوله الرؤيا بالحق ۖ لتدخلن المسجد الحرام إن شاء الله آمنين محلقين رءوسكم ومقصرين لا تخافون ۖ فعلم ما لم تعلموا فجعل من دون ذلك فتحا قريبا
verses.transliterated: laqad ṣadaqa l-lahu rasūlahu l-ru'yā bil-ḥaqi latadkhulunna l-masjida l-ḥarāma in shāa l-lahu āminīna muḥalliqīna ruūsakum wamuqaṣṣirīna lā takhāfūna faʿalima mā lam taʿlamū fajaʿala min dūni dhālika fatḥan qarība
verses.english: GOD has fulfilled His messenger's truthful vision: "You will enter the Sacred Masjid, GOD willing, perfectly secure, and you will cut your hair or shorten it (as you fulfill the pilgrimage rituals) there. You will not have any fear. Since He knew what you did not know, He has coupled this with an immediate victory."

1981.english: God fulfilled the vision of His messenger saying, "You will enter the Sacred Mosque by God's leave, and you will cut your hair (as you observe the rituals of pilgrimage). You will have no more fear. He knows what you never knew, and thus, He now grants you a great victory soon to be attained."

1989.english: GOD has fulfilled His messenger’s truthful vision: “You will enter the Sacred Mosque, GOD willing, perfectly secure and you will cut your hair or shorten it (as you fulfill your pilgrimage rituals) there. You will not have any fear. Since He knew what you did not know, He has pre ceded this with an immediate victory.’

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ۚ وكفى بالله شهيدا
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī arsala rasūlahu bil-hudā wadīni l-ḥaqi liyuẓ'hirahu ʿalā l-dīni kullihi wakafā bil-lahi shahīda
verses.english: He is the One who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all other religions. GOD suffices as a witness.
verses.subtitle: The Great Prophecy
verses.footnote: This important prophecy informs us that Submission will inevitably dominate the whole world. This, together with Verses 9:33, 41:53, and 61:9 leave no doubt that God's mathematical miracle of the Quran will play a major role in this prophecy. Solid Quranic mathematical evidence points to God's Messenger of the Covenant as fulfilling this prophecy. See Appendices 2 & 26 for the evidence and specific details.

1981.english: He is the one who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religions. God suffices as witness.
1981.subtitle: Islam Will Prevail

1989.english: He is the One who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all other religions. GOD suffices as a witness.*
1989.subtitle: The Great Prophecy
1989.footnote: This important prophecy informs us that Islam will inevitably dominate the whole world. This, together with Verses 9:33, 41:53, and 61:9 leave no doubt that God’s mathematical miracle of the Quran will play a major role in this prophecy. Solid Quranic mathematical evidence points to God’s Messenger of the Covenant as fulfilling this prophecy. See Appendices 2 & 26 for the evidence and specific details.

verses.arabic: مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا
verses.arabicClean: محمد رسول الله ۚ والذين معه أشداء على الكفار رحماء بينهم ۖ تراهم ركعا سجدا يبتغون فضلا من الله ورضوانا ۖ سيماهم في وجوههم من أثر السجود ۚ ذلك مثلهم في التوراة ۚ ومثلهم في الإنجيل كزرع أخرج شطأه فآزره فاستغلظ فاستوى على سوقه يعجب الزراع ليغيظ بهم الكفار ۗ وعد الله الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات منهم مغفرة وأجرا عظيما
verses.transliterated: muḥammadun rasūlu l-lahi wa-alladhīna maʿahu ashiddāu ʿalā l-kufāri ruḥamāu baynahum tarāhum rukkaʿan sujjadan yabtaghūna faḍlan mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānan sīmāhum fī wujūhihim min athari l-sujūdi dhālika mathaluhum fī l-tawrāti wamathaluhum fī l-injīli kazarʿin akhraja shaṭahu faāzarahu fa-is'taghlaẓa fa-is'tawā ʿalā sūqihi yuʿ'jibu l-zurāʿa liyaghīẓa bihimu l-kufāra waʿada l-lahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti min'hum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīma
verses.english: Muhammad—the messenger of GOD—and those with him are harsh and stern against the disbelievers, but kind and compassionate amongst themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating, as they seek GOD's blessings and approval. Their marks are on their faces, because of prostrating. This is the same example as in the Torah. Their example in the Gospel is like plants that grow taller and stronger, and please the farmers. He thus enrages the disbelievers. GOD promises those among them who believe and lead a righteous life forgiveness and a great recompense.
verses.subtitle: Qualities of the Believers

1981.english: Muhammad is a messenger of God; those who truly follow him are stern against the disbelievers, but compassionate among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating, seeking grace from God and His pleasure. Their marks are on their faces from prostration. Such is their description in the Torah, while their allegory in the Injeel (the Gospel) is like a plant that germinates, grows stronger, then becomes erect and pleases the farmer. God thus enrages the disbelievers. God promises the believers who work righteousness forgiveness and a great recompense.

1989.english: Muhammad, the messenger of GOD, and those with him are harsh and stern against the disbelievers, but kind and merciful amongst themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating, seeking blessings from GOD and approval. Their marks are in their faces, because of prostrating. This is their example in the Torah. Their example in the Gospel is like plants that grow taller and stronger, and please the farmers. He thus enrages the disbelievers. GOD promises those who believe and lead a righteous life forgiveness and a great recompense.
1989.subtitle: Qualities of the Believers

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تقدموا بين يدي الله ورسوله ۖ واتقوا الله ۚ إن الله سميع عليم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuqaddimū bayna yadayi l-lahi warasūlihi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, do not place your opinion above that of GOD and His messenger. You shall reverence GOD. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not take God and His messenger for granted; beware of God; God is hearer, omniscient.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not place your opinion above that of GOD and His messenger. You shall reverence GOD. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا ترفعوا أصواتكم فوق صوت النبي ولا تجهروا له بالقول كجهر بعضكم لبعض أن تحبط أعمالكم وأنتم لا تشعرون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tarfaʿū aṣwātakum fawqa ṣawti l-nabiyi walā tajharū lahu bil-qawli kajahri baʿḍikum libaʿḍin an taḥbaṭa aʿmālukum wa-antum lā tashʿurūn
verses.english: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the prophet, nor shall you shout at him as you shout at each other, lest your works become nullified while you do not perceive.
verses.footnote: Whenever the word "prophet" (Nabi) is used in reference to Muhammad, it invariably refers to him during his life, not after his death. Obviously, we cannot possibly raise our voices above Muhammad's voice, now that he is dead. See also 33:56.

1981.english: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the prophet,* nor shall you shout at him as you shout at one another, lest you nullify your works without perceiving.
1981.subtitle: Etiquette
1981.footnote: In order for the student to benefit from the teacher, the student must respectfully pay attention and observe certain etiquette. See the student/teacher behavior of Moses and his teacher in 18:66-82.

1989.english: O you who believe, do not raise your voice above the voice of the prophet,* nor shall you shout at him as you shout at each other, lest your works become nullified while you do not perceive.
1989.footnote: Whenever the word “prophet” (Nabi) is used in reference to Muhammad, it invariably refers to him during his life, not after his death. Obviously, we cannot possibly raise our voices above Muhammad’s voice, now that he is dead. See also 33:56.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يغضون أصواتهم عند رسول الله أولئك الذين امتحن الله قلوبهم للتقوى ۚ لهم مغفرة وأجر عظيم
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yaghuḍḍūna aṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ulāika alladhīna im'taḥana l-lahu qulūbahum lilttaqwā lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Surely, those who lower their voices at the messenger of GOD are the ones whose hearts are prepared by GOD to become righteous. They have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.
verses.footnote: Respecting the messenger helps outsiders and visitors in coming to God's message.

1981.english: Those who lower their voices at the messenger of God are the ones whose hearts are rendered righteous by God. They have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.

1989.english: Surely, those who lower their voices at the messenger of GOD are the ones whose hearts are prepared by GOD to become righteous. They deserve forgiveness and a great recompense.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين ينادونك من وراء الحجرات أكثرهم لا يعقلون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yunādūnaka min warāi l-ḥujurāti aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūn
verses.english: As for those who call on you from outside the walls, most of them do not understand.

1981.english: As for those who call you from outside your dwelling, most of them do not understand.

1989.english: As for those who call on you from outside the walls, most of them do not understand.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولو أنهم صبروا حتى تخرج إليهم لكان خيرا لهم ۚ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: walaw annahum ṣabarū ḥattā takhruja ilayhim lakāna khayran lahum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: Had they been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Had they waited until you came out, it would have been better for them. God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: Had they been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن جاءكم فاسق بنبإ فتبينوا أن تصيبوا قوما بجهالة فتصبحوا على ما فعلتم نادمين
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in jāakum fāsiqun binaba-in fatabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bijahālatin fatuṣ'biḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīn
verses.english: O you who believe, if a wicked person brings any news to you, you shall first investigate, lest you commit injustice towards some people, out of ignorance, then become sorry and remorseful for what you have done.
verses.subtitle: Investigate Rumors Before Believing Them

1981.english: O you who believe, when a wicked person brings you any news, you shall investigate, lest you hurt others through ignorance, then regret what you have done.
1981.subtitle: Investigate Rumors

1989.english: O you who believe, if a wicked person brings news to you, you shall first investigate, lest you commit injustice towards some people, out of ignorance, then become sorry for what you have done.
1989.subtitle: Investigate Rumors Before Believing Them

verses.arabic: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: واعلموا أن فيكم رسول الله ۚ لو يطيعكم في كثير من الأمر لعنتم ولكن الله حبب إليكم الإيمان وزينه في قلوبكم وكره إليكم الكفر والفسوق والعصيان ۚ أولئك هم الراشدون
verses.transliterated: wa-iʿ'lamū anna fīkum rasūla l-lahi law yuṭīʿukum fī kathīrin mina l-amri laʿanittum walākinna l-laha ḥabbaba ilaykumu l-īmāna wazayyanahu fī qulūbikum wakarraha ilaykumu l-kuf'ra wal-fusūqa wal-ʿiṣ'yāna ulāika humu l-rāshidūn
verses.english: And know that GOD's messenger has come in your midst. Had he listened to you in many things, you would have made things difficult for yourselves. But GOD made you love faith and adorned it in your hearts, and He made you abhor disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience. These are the guided ones.

1981.english: And know that God's messenger is among you;* if he obeyed you in many things, you would have made things too difficult for yourselves.* But God inspired you to love belief and beautified it in your hearts. And He inspired you to abhor disbelief, wickedness, and rebellion. These are the rightly directed ones.
1981.footnote: There is a human tendency, with help from satan, to impose more hardship as a sign of piety. Thus, some people invariably go too far in prohibiting foods that are perfectly lawful (see Appendix 13), or imposing additional duties that were never decreed. The Quran teaches that such practices are tantamount to idol worship.

1989.english: And know that when GOD’s messenger is in your midst, if he obeys you in many things, you will make everything more difficult for yourselves. But GOD made you love faith and adorned it in your hearts, and He made you abhor disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience. These are the guided ones.

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فضلا من الله ونعمة ۚ والله عليم حكيم
verses.transliterated: faḍlan mina l-lahi waniʿ'matan wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmu
verses.english: Such is grace from GOD and His blessings. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: This is grace from God, and a blessing. God is omniscient, wise.

1989.english: Such is grace and blessings from GOD. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإن طائفتان من المؤمنين اقتتلوا فأصلحوا بينهما ۖ فإن بغت إحداهما على الأخرى فقاتلوا التي تبغي حتى تفيء إلى أمر الله ۚ فإن فاءت فأصلحوا بينهما بالعدل وأقسطوا ۖ إن الله يحب المقسطين
verses.transliterated: wa-in ṭāifatāni mina l-mu'minīna iq'tatalū fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā fa-in baghat iḥ'dāhumā ʿalā l-ukh'rā faqātilū allatī tabghī ḥattā tafīa ilā amri l-lahi fa-in fāat fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā bil-ʿadli wa-aqsiṭū inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīn
verses.english: If two groups of believers fought with each other, you shall reconcile them. If one group aggresses against the other, you shall fight the aggressing group until they submit to GOD's command. Once they submit, you shall reconcile the two groups equitably. You shall maintain justice; GOD loves those who are just.
verses.subtitle: Reconcile The Believers

1981.english: If two groups of believers fight each other, you shall reconcile them. If one of them aggresses, then you shall fight the group that aggresses until it returns to God's law. Once they return, you shall reconcile them equitably and be just. God loves those who are just.

1989.english: If two groups of believers fought with each other, you shall reconcile them. If one group aggresses, you shall fight the aggressing group until they submit to GOD’s command. Once they submit, you shall reconcile the two groups equitably. You shall maintain justice; GOD loves those who are just.
1989.subtitle: Reconcile The Believers

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما المؤمنون إخوة فأصلحوا بين أخويكم ۚ واتقوا الله لعلكم ترحمون
verses.transliterated: innamā l-mu'minūna ikh'watun fa-aṣliḥū bayna akhawaykum wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verses.english: The believers are members of one family; you shall keep the peace within your family and reverence GOD, that you may attain mercy.
verses.subtitle: The Real Family

1981.english: The believers are brothers, and you shall reconcile between your brothers. You shall observe God, that you may attain mercy.

1989.english: The believers are brethren. You shall reconcile your brethren, and reverence GOD, that you may attain mercy.
1989.subtitle: The Real Family

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا يسخر قوم من قوم عسى أن يكونوا خيرا منهم ولا نساء من نساء عسى أن يكن خيرا منهن ۖ ولا تلمزوا أنفسكم ولا تنابزوا بالألقاب ۖ بئس الاسم الفسوق بعد الإيمان ۚ ومن لم يتب فأولئك هم الظالمون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā yaskhar qawmun min qawmin ʿasā an yakūnū khayran min'hum walā nisāon min nisāin ʿasā an yakunna khayran min'hunna walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqābi bi'sa l-s'mu l-fusūqu baʿda l-īmāni waman lam yatub fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūn
verses.english: O you who believe, no people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you mock one another, or make fun of your names. Evil indeed is the reversion to wickedness after attaining faith. Anyone who does not repent after this, these are the transgressors.
verses.subtitle: Believers Set the Example

1981.english: O you who believe, no people shall mock other people, for they may be better than they; nor shall women mock other women, for they may be better than they. Do not defame each other, nor ridicule any names. It is repugnant to practice wickedness after acquiring faith. Those who refuse to repent are wicked.

1989.english: 0 you who believe, no people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you mock one another, or make fun of your names. Evil indeed is the reversion to wickedness after attaining faith. Anyone who does not repent after this, these are the transgressors.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اجتنبوا كثيرا من الظن إن بعض الظن إثم ۖ ولا تجسسوا ولا يغتب بعضكم بعضا ۚ أيحب أحدكم أن يأكل لحم أخيه ميتا فكرهتموه ۚ واتقوا الله ۚ إن الله تواب رحيم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ij'tanibū kathīran mina l-ẓani inna baʿḍa l-ẓani ith'mun walā tajassasū walā yaghtab baʿḍukum baʿḍan ayuḥibbu aḥadukum an yakula laḥma akhīhi maytan fakarih'tumūhu wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha tawwābun raḥīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall avoid any suspicion, for even a little bit of suspicion is sinful. You shall not spy on one another, nor shall you backbite one another; this is as abominable as eating the flesh of your dead brother. You certainly abhor this. You shall observe GOD. GOD is Redeemer, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Suspicion Is Sinful

1981.english: O you who believe, you shall avoid suspicions; even a little bit of suspicion is sinful. You shall not spy, nor shall you backbite each other. Does any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You certainly abhor this. You shall observe God, for God is redeemer, merciful.

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall avoid any suspicion, for even a little bit of suspicion is sinful. You shall not spy, nor shall you backbite one another; this is as abominable as eating the flesh of your dead brother. You certainly abhor this. You shall observe GOD. GOD is Redeemer, Most Merciful.
1989.subtitle: Suspicion Is Sinful

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الناس إنا خلقناكم من ذكر وأنثى وجعلناكم شعوبا وقبائل لتعارفوا ۚ إن أكرمكم عند الله أتقاكم ۚ إن الله عليم خبير
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nāsu innā khalaqnākum min dhakarin wa-unthā wajaʿalnākum shuʿūban waqabāila litaʿārafū inna akramakum ʿinda l-lahi atqākum inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīru
verses.english: O people, we created you from the same male and female, and rendered you distinct peoples and tribes, that you may recognize one another. The best among you in the sight of GOD is the most righteous. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant.
verses.subtitle: The Only Criterion For Distinguishing Among The People

1981.english: O people, we created all of you from the same male and female (Adam and Eve), and we made you into nations and tribes in order to recognize each other. The best among you is the most righteous.* God is omniscient, cognizant.
1981.footnote: The only criterion that renders any person better than another is righteousness. Color, knowledge, wealth, physical appearance, social status, family lineage, etc. do not necessarily make any person better than another.

1989.english: O people, we created you from the same male and female, and rendered you distinct peoples and tribes, that you may recognize one another. The best among you in the sight of GOD is the most righteous. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant.
1989.subtitle: The Only Criterion For Distinguishing Among The People

verses.arabic: قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قالت الأعراب آمنا ۖ قل لم تؤمنوا ولكن قولوا أسلمنا ولما يدخل الإيمان في قلوبكم ۖ وإن تطيعوا الله ورسوله لا يلتكم من أعمالكم شيئا ۚ إن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: qālati l-aʿrābu āmannā qul lam tu'minū walākin qūlū aslamnā walammā yadkhuli l-īmānu fī qulūbikum wa-in tuṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu lā yalit'kum min aʿmālikum shayan inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: The Arabs said, "We are Mu'mens (believers)." Say, "You have not believed; what you should say is, 'We are Muslims (submitters),' until belief is established in your hearts." If you obey GOD and His messenger, He will not put any of your works to waste. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
verses.subtitle: Muslim vs Mu'men

1981.english: The nomads said, "We are **Mu'mins** (believers)." Say, "You are not **Mu'mins** yet; rather, you should say that you are Muslims, until **Iman** (faith) enters your hearts." If you obey God and His messenger, God will never fail to recompense you. God is forgiver, merciful.
1981.subtitle: Islam versus Iman
1981.footnote: A person who believes in God and His messenger, in accordance with this Quran, is a Muslim for as long as he harbors occasional doubts and questions. Once he gets rid of all doubts in his heart, then he is a **Mu'min** (believer). Therefore, a **Mu'min** is higher in rank than a Muslim.

1989.english: The Arabs said, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not believed; what you should say is, ‘We have submitted,’ until belief enters your hearts.” If you obey GOD and His messenger, He will not put any of your works to waste. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إنما المؤمنون الذين آمنوا بالله ورسوله ثم لم يرتابوا وجاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم في سبيل الله ۚ أولئك هم الصادقون
verses.transliterated: innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warasūlihi thumma lam yartābū wajāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi ulāika humu l-ṣādiqūn
verses.english: Mu'mens (believers) are those who believe in GOD and His messenger, then attain the status of having no doubt whatsoever, and strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. These are the truthful ones.

1981.english: The **Mu'mins** (believers) are those who believe in God and His messenger, and harbor no doubts whatsoever. They strive with their monies and their lives in the cause of God. These are the truthful.
1981.subtitle: Definition of Mu'min

1989.english: Mu’mens (believers) are those who believed in GOD and His messenger then attained the status of having no doubts, and strove with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. These are the truthful ones.

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل أتعلمون الله بدينكم والله يعلم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ والله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: qul atuʿallimūna l-laha bidīnikum wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: Say, "Are you informing GOD about your religion? GOD knows everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient."

1981.english: Say, "Are you informing God about your religion; when God knows everything in the heavens and the earth? God is fully aware of all things."

1989.english: Say, “Are you informing GOD about your religion? GOD knows everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient.”

verses.arabic: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: يمنون عليك أن أسلموا ۖ قل لا تمنوا علي إسلامكم ۖ بل الله يمن عليكم أن هداكم للإيمان إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: yamunnūna ʿalayka an aslamū qul lā tamunnū ʿalayya is'lāmakum bali l-lahu yamunnu ʿalaykum an hadākum lil'īmāni in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They act as if they are doing you a favor by embracing Submission! Say, "You are not doing me any favors by embracing Submission. GOD is the One who is doing you a great favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere."
verses.subtitle: Who Is Doing Whom A Favor?

1981.english: They act as if they are doing you a favor by embracing Islam; say, "You are not doing me any favor by embracing Islam. God is the one who did you a great favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere."

1989.english: They act as if they are doing you a favor by embracing Islam! Say, “You are not doing me any favors by embracing Islam. Instead, GOD is the One who is doing you a great favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere.”
1989.subtitle: Who Is Doing Whom A Favor?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الله يعلم غيب السماوات والأرض ۚ والله بصير بما تعملون
verses.transliterated: inna l-laha yaʿlamu ghayba l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā taʿmalūn
verses.english: GOD knows all the secrets in the heavens and the earth; GOD is Seer of everything you do.

1981.english: God knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth. God is seer of everything you do.

1989.english: GOD knows all the secrets in the heavens and the earth, and GOD is Seer of everything you do.

verses.arabic: قٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ق ۚ والقرآن المجيد
verses.transliterated: qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīd
verses.english: Q., and the glorious Quran.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the awesome miracles connected with the Initial Q (ق).

1981.english: Q,* and the glorious Quran.
1981.footnote: See footnote 42:1 and Appendix 1.

1989.english: Q., and the glorious Quran.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the awesome miracles connected with the Initial “Q. ”

verses.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.arabicClean: بل عجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم فقال الكافرون هذا شيء عجيب
verses.transliterated: bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajību
verses.english: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, "This is really strange.

1981.english: Yet, they are still doubtful that a warner should come to them who is one of them.* The disbelievers say, "This is really strange.
1981.footnote: Despite the miracle imbedded in the letter Q and throughout the glorious Quran, they are still doubtful.

1989.english: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, “This is really strange.

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا ۖ ذلك رجع بعيد
verses.transliterated: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdu
verses.english: "After we die and become dust; this is impossible."

1981.english: "After we die and turn to dust? This is impossible."

1989.english: “After we die and become dust; this is impossible.”

verses.arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: قد علمنا ما تنقص الأرض منهم ۖ وعندنا كتاب حفيظ
verses.transliterated: qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓu
verses.english: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.

1981.english: We are fully aware when the earth consumes any of them; for we keep an accurate record.

1989.english: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.

verses.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.arabicClean: بل كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم فهم في أمر مريج
verses.transliterated: bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marīji
verses.english: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.

1981.english: Indeed, they rejected the truth when it came to them. Consequently, they are afflicted with confusion.

1989.english: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
verses.arabicClean: أفلم ينظروا إلى السماء فوقهم كيف بنيناها وزيناها وما لها من فروج
verses.transliterated: afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūji
verses.english: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?

1981.english: Do they not see the sky above them; how we constructed it and beautified it, without any flaw?

1989.english: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verses.arabicClean: والأرض مددناها وألقينا فيها رواسي وأنبتنا فيها من كل زوج بهيج
verses.transliterated: wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahīji
verses.english: And we created the earth, and scattered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.

1981.english: And we constructed the earth, distributed stabilizers therein, and we grew all kinds of beautiful plants.

1989.english: And we created the earth, and scattered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.

verses.arabic: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: تبصرة وذكرى لكل عبد منيب
verses.transliterated: tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībi
verses.english: This is an enlightenment, and a reminder for every pious worshiper.

1981.english: This is to enlighten and remind every obedient person.

1989.english: This is an enlightenment, and a reminder for every pious worshiper.

verses.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ونزلنا من السماء ماء مباركا فأنبتنا به جنات وحب الحصيد
verses.transliterated: wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīd
verses.english: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.

1981.english: We send down from the sky blessed water, to produce gardens and food grains.

1989.english: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: والنخل باسقات لها طلع نضيد
verses.transliterated: wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdu
verses.english: Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.

1981.english: And tall palms with clustered fruits.

1989.english: Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.

verses.arabic: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.arabicClean: رزقا للعباد ۖ وأحيينا به بلدة ميتا ۚ كذلك الخروج
verses.transliterated: riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūj
verses.english: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.

1981.english: To provide for the people. And we revive with it dead land. Thus will be the resurrection.

1989.english: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.arabicClean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وأصحاب الرس وثمود
verses.transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūd
verses.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamûd.

1981.english: Rebelling before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Rass, and Thamood.
1981.subtitle: Miraculous Numerical Code

1989.english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamoud.

verses.arabic: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
verses.arabicClean: وعاد وفرعون وإخوان لوط
verses.transliterated: waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭi
verses.english: And 'Ãd, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.

1981.english: Also, Aad, Pharaoh, and the brethren* of Lot.
1981.footnote: The people who disbelieved Lot are mentioned in the Quran 12 times, namely in 7:80; 11:70, 74, 89; 22:43; 26:160; 27:54,56; 29:28; 38:13; 50:13, and 54:33. Consistently, these people are called "Qawm," with a single exception. In this sura (Q), the people who disbelieved in Lot are called "Ikhwan." The reader can easily see that if the word "Qawm" was used here, as is customary throughout the Quran, the frequency of occurrence of the letter "Q" in this sura would become 58. The number 58 is not divisible by 19, it will not equal the 57 "Q's" in the other Q-initiated sura (sura 42), and the total number of "Q's" in the two suras would not equal the number of suras in the Quran (114). In other words, the whole numerical system collapses if the word "Qawm" is used instead of "Ikhwan." This demonstrates the fact that every word, indeed every letter, in Quran is divinely designed beyond human ability.

1989.english: And Aad, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: وأصحاب الأيكة وقوم تبع ۚ كل كذب الرسل فحق وعيد
verses.transliterated: wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīd
verses.english: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba'. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.

1981.english: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba'. They all disbelieved the messengers, and therefore, My retribution was inevitable.

1989.english: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba‘. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.

verses.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: أفعيينا بالخلق الأول ۚ بل هم في لبس من خلق جديد
verses.transliterated: afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdi
verses.english: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?

1981.english: Was creating you the first time too difficult for us? Is this why they doubt resurrection?

1989.english: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد خلقنا الإنسان ونعلم ما توسوس به نفسه ۖ ونحن أقرب إليه من حبل الوريد
verses.transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīd
verses.english: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

1981.english: Since we created the human being, we are fully aware of his innermost thoughts. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

1989.english: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: إذ يتلقى المتلقيان عن اليمين وعن الشمال قعيد
verses.transliterated: idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdu
verses.english: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.

1981.english: The two angels, at right and at left, record everything he does.

1989.english: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.

verses.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما يلفظ من قول إلا لديه رقيب عتيد
verses.transliterated: mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdu
verses.english: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.

1981.english: Not a single utterance he utters without a vigilant watcher.

1989.english: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: وجاءت سكرة الموت بالحق ۖ ذلك ما كنت منه تحيد
verses.transliterated: wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīd
verses.english: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.

1981.english: Then the intoxication of death finally comes. This is what you tried to evade.

1989.english: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ونفخ في الصور ۚ ذلك يوم الوعيد
verses.transliterated: wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīd
verses.english: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.

1981.english: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.
1981.subtitle: The Day of Judgment
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: وجاءت كل نفس معها سائق وشهيد
verses.transliterated: wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdu
verses.english: Every soul comes with a herder and a witness.

1981.english: Every soul came, along with a herder and a witness.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: Every soul comes with a herder and a witness.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: لقد كنت في غفلة من هذا فكشفنا عنك غطاءك فبصرك اليوم حديد
verses.transliterated: laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdu
verses.english: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.

1981.english: You used to be mindless of this; but today we removed your veil, and thus, your memory is (as strong as) steel.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: وقال قرينه هذا ما لدي عتيد
verses.transliterated: waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdu
verses.english: The companion said, "Here is my formidable testimony."
verses.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

1981.english: His companion said, "Here is his detailed record."
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: The companion said, “Here is my formidable testimony.”*
1989.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألقيا في جهنم كل كفار عنيد
verses.transliterated: alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdi
verses.english: Throw into Gehenna every stubborn disbeliever.

1981.english: Throw into hell every stubborn disbeliever.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: Throw into Gehenna every stubborn disbeliever.
1989.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: مناع للخير معتد مريب
verses.transliterated: mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībi
verses.english: Forbidder of charity, aggressor, full of doubt.

1981.english: He was an opponent of righteousness; transgressor, and doubtful.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: Forbidder of charity, aggressor, full of doubt.
1989.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: الذي جعل مع الله إلها آخر فألقياه في العذاب الشديد
verses.transliterated: alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīd
verses.english: He set up besides GOD another god. Throw him into severe retribution.

1981.english: He set up besides God another god. Therefore, throw him into severe retribution.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: He set up besides GOD another god Throw him into severe retribution.
1989.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته ولكن كان في ضلال بعيد
verses.transliterated: qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdi
verses.english: His companion said, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray."

1981.english: His companion said, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he is the one who went astray."
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: His companion said, “Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray.”
1989.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: قال لا تختصموا لدي وقد قدمت إليكم بالوعيد
verses.transliterated: qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīd
verses.english: He said, "Do not feud in front of Me; I have sufficiently warned you.

1981.english: God said, "Do not feud in front of Me; I have already advanced sufficient warnings to you.
1981.footnote: These verses are written in the past tense because they are actual happenings that took place on the day of judgment. Since the day of judgment is future as far as we are concerned, it is described to us as witnessed by God.

1989.english: He said, “Do not feud in front of Me I have sufficiently warned you.
1989.footnote: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.

verses.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: ما يبدل القول لدي وما أنا بظلام للعبيد
verses.transliterated: mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīd
verses.english: "Nothing can be changed now. I am never unjust towards the people."

1981.english: "Nothing can be changed now;* I am never unjust towards the people."
1981.footnote: Our condition at resurrection is irreversible. We end our life here with a soul that is strong, well fed, and well developed (as a result of heeding God's message), or a soul that is weak, shrunk, and undeveloped (as a result of disregarding God's message). God is never unjust, since he left our spiritual growth and development completely up to us. See Appendix 10.

1989.english: “Nothing can be changed now. I am never unjust towards the people.”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: يوم نقول لجهنم هل امتلأت وتقول هل من مزيد
verses.transliterated: yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdi
verses.english: That is the day when we ask Hell, "Have you had enough?" It will say, "Give me more."

1981.english: On that day, we will ask hell, "Did you have enough?" and it will say, "Can I have more?"

1989.english: That is the day when we ask Hell, “Have you had enough?” It will say, “Give me more.”

verses.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأزلفت الجنة للمتقين غير بعيد
verses.transliterated: wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdi
verses.english: Paradise will be offered to the righteous, readily.

1981.english: Paradise will be presented to the righteous, very close.

1989.english: Paradise will be offered to the righteous, readily.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
verses.arabicClean: هذا ما توعدون لكل أواب حفيظ
verses.transliterated: hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓi
verses.english: This is what was promised to every repenter, steadfast.

1981.english: This is what has been promised for every steadfast submitter.

1989.english: This is what was promised to every repenter, steadfast.

verses.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: من خشي الرحمن بالغيب وجاء بقلب منيب
verses.transliterated: man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībi
verses.english: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.

1981.english: They have reverenced God most gracious in their privacy, and submitted to Him wholeheartedly.

1989.english: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.arabicClean: ادخلوها بسلام ۖ ذلك يوم الخلود
verses.transliterated: ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūd
verses.english: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.

1981.english: Enter it in peace; this is the day of eternity.

1989.english: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.

verses.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: لهم ما يشاءون فيها ولدينا مزيد
verses.transliterated: lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdu
verses.english: They get anything they wish therein, and we have even more.

1981.english: They have deserved whatever they wish therein, and we have even more.

1989.english: They get anything they wish therein, and we have even more.

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.arabicClean: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم أشد منهم بطشا فنقبوا في البلاد هل من محيص
verses.transliterated: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣi
verses.english: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?

1981.english: We annihilated generations before them who were stronger and more civilized. Could they escape?
1981.subtitle: We Should Learn From The Past

1989.english: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لذكرى لمن كان له قلب أو ألقى السمع وهو شهيد
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdu
verses.english: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.

1981.english: This should be a lesson for anyone with a heart or one who listens and bears witness.

1989.english: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما في ستة أيام وما مسنا من لغوب
verses.transliterated: walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbi
verses.english: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.

1981.english: We have created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue ever touched us.

1989.english: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل الغروب
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūb
verses.english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.

1981.english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise the glory of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.

1989.english: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن الليل فسبحه وأدبار السجود
verses.transliterated: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūd
verses.english: During the night you shall meditate on His name, and after prostrating.

1981.english: Glorify Him during the night, and in prostration.

1989.english: During the night you shall meditate on His name, and after prostrating.

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: واستمع يوم يناد المناد من مكان قريب
verses.transliterated: wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībi
verses.english: Prepare for the day when the caller calls from a place that is near.

1981.english: Beware of the day when the caller calls from a near place.

1989.english: Prepare for the day when the caller calls from a place that is near.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يسمعون الصيحة بالحق ۚ ذلك يوم الخروج
verses.transliterated: yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūj
verses.english: When they hear the inevitable cry; that is the day you come out.

1981.english: When they hear the truthful blow; this is the day of resurrection.

1989.english: When they hear the inevitable cry; that is the day you come out.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: إنا نحن نحيي ونميت وإلينا المصير
verses.transliterated: innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīr
verses.english: We are the ones who control life and death; to us is the final destiny.

1981.english: It is we who give life and death, and to us is the ultimate destiny.

1989.english: We are the ones who control life and death; to us is the final destiny.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تشقق الأرض عنهم سراعا ۚ ذلك حشر علينا يسير
verses.transliterated: yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīru
verses.english: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.

1981.english: On that day, the earth will crack everywhere and give rise to them. This gathering is easy for us to do.

1989.english: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: نحن أعلم بما يقولون ۖ وما أنت عليهم بجبار ۖ فذكر بالقرآن من يخاف وعيد
verses.transliterated: naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīd
verses.english: We are fully aware of everything they utter, while you have no power over them. Therefore, remind with this Quran, those who reverence My warnings.

1981.english: We are fully aware of what they say, while you can never force them. Therefore, remind with the Quran* those who reverence My warning.
1981.footnote: The prophet's message is the Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but the Quran. (See also 6:19.)

1989.english: We are fully aware of everything they utter, while you have no power over them. Therefore, remind with this Quran, those who reverence My warnings. (

verses.arabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والذاريات ذروا
verses.transliterated: wal-dhāriyāti dharwa
verses.english: The blowing winds.

1981.english: By the blowing winds,

1989.english: The blowing winds.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.arabicClean: فالحاملات وقرا
verses.transliterated: fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ra
verses.english: Bearing rain.

1981.english: carrying clouds,

1989.english: Bearing rain.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.arabicClean: فالجاريات يسرا
verses.transliterated: fal-jāriyāti yus'ra
verses.english: Bringing provisions.

1981.english: and bringing bounties,

1989.english: Bringing provisions.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.arabicClean: فالمقسمات أمرا
verses.transliterated: fal-muqasimāti amra
verses.english: Distributing them as commanded.

1981.english: to be distributed by command.

1989.english: Distributing them as commanded.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنما توعدون لصادق
verses.transliterated: innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqu
verses.english: What is promised to you will surely come to pass.

1981.english: What is promised to you is truth.

1989.english: What is promised to you will surely come to pass.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن الدين لواقع
verses.transliterated: wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿu
verses.english: The Day of Judgment is inevitable.

1981.english: Judgment is sure to come.

1989.english: The Day of Judgment is inevitable.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.arabicClean: والسماء ذات الحبك
verses.transliterated: wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuk
verses.english: Despite the perfectly created sky.

1981.english: Despite the perfectly created sky,

1989.english: Despite the perfectly created sky.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.arabicClean: إنكم لفي قول مختلف
verses.transliterated: innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifi
verses.english: You continue to dispute the truth.

1981.english: you dispute the truth.

1989.english: You continue to dispute the truth.

verses.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.arabicClean: يؤفك عنه من أفك
verses.transliterated: yu'faku ʿanhu man ufik
verses.english: Deviating therefrom are the deviators.

1981.english: However, deviating are those who are supposed to deviate.

1989.english: Deviating therefrom are the deviators.

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قتل الخراصون
verses.transliterated: qutila l-kharāṣūn
verses.english: Woe to the falsifiers.

1981.english: Woe to the falsifiers.

1989.english: Woe to the falsifiers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين هم في غمرة ساهون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūn
verses.english: In their blundering, they are totally heedless.

1981.english: Who are heedless in their blunders.

1989.english: In their blundering, they are totally heedless.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.arabicClean: يسألون أيان يوم الدين
verses.transliterated: yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīn
verses.english: They question the Day of Judgment.

1981.english: They ask, "When is the day of judgment?"

1989.english: They question the Day of Judgment.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم هم على النار يفتنون
verses.transliterated: yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūn
verses.english: The day they are presented to the fire.

1981.english: That is the day when they suffer in hell.

1989.english: The day they are presented to the fire.

verses.arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا الذي كنتم به تستعجلون
verses.transliterated: dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūn
verses.english: Taste the retribution; this is what you used to challenge.

1981.english: Taste your retribution; this is what you defiantly challenged.

1989.english: Taste the retribution; this what you used to challenge.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن المتقين في جنات وعيون
verses.transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūni
verses.english: The righteous have deserved gardens and springs.

1981.english: As for the righteous, they have deserved gardens and springs.

1989.english: The righteous have deserved gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: آخذين ما آتاهم ربهم ۚ إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين
verses.transliterated: ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīn
verses.english: They receive their Lord's rewards, for they used to be pious.

1981.english: They receive their Lord's blessing, in return for their works.

1989.english: They receive their Lord’s rewards, for they used to be pious.

verses.arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كانوا قليلا من الليل ما يهجعون
verses.transliterated: kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūn
verses.english: Rarely did they sleep the whole night.

1981.english: Rarely did they sleep the whole night.

1989.english: Rarely did they sleep the whole night

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وبالأسحار هم يستغفرون
verses.transliterated: wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūn
verses.english: At dawn, they prayed for forgiveness.

1981.english: At dawn, they used to implore for forgiveness.

1989.english: At dawn, they prayed for forgiveness.

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.arabicClean: وفي أموالهم حق للسائل والمحروم
verses.transliterated: wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūm
verses.english: A portion of their money was set aside for the beggar and the needy.

1981.english: A portion of their monies was set aside for the needy and deprived.

1989.english: A portion of their money was set aside for the beggar and the needy.

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وفي الأرض آيات للموقنين
verses.transliterated: wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīn
verses.english: The earth is full of signs for those who are certain.

1981.english: In the earth there are signs for those who are certain.

1989.english: The earth is full of signs for those who are certain.

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وفي أنفسكم ۚ أفلا تبصرون
verses.transliterated: wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūn
verses.english: And within yourselves; can you see?

1981.english: Even within yourselves; do you not see?

1989.english: And within yourselves; can you see?

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وفي السماء رزقكم وما توعدون
verses.transliterated: wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūn
verses.english: In the heaven is your provision, and everything that is promised to you.

1981.english: In the heaven is your provisions and everything that is promised to you.

1989.english: In the heaven is your provision, and everything that is promised to you.

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فورب السماء والأرض إنه لحق مثل ما أنكم تنطقون
verses.transliterated: fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūn
verses.english: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is as true as the fact that you speak.

1981.english: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is as real as the fact that you speak.

1989.english: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is as true as the fact that you speak.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هل أتاك حديث ضيف إبراهيم المكرمين
verses.transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīn
verses.english: Have you noted the history of Abraham's honorable guests?

1981.english: Have you noted the narration about Abraham's honorable guests?
1981.subtitle:
Lessons From The Past
Abraham

1989.english: Have you noted the history of Abraham’s honorable guests?

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلاما ۖ قال سلام قوم منكرون
verses.transliterated: idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūn
verses.english: They visited him, saying, "Peace." He said, "Peace to you, strangers!"

1981.english: When they entered, they said, "Peace," and he said, "Peace to you strangers."

1989.english: They visited him, saying, “Peace.” He said, “Peace to you, strangers!”

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فراغ إلى أهله فجاء بعجل سمين
verses.transliterated: farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīni
verses.english: He asked his family to prepare a fat calf.

1981.english: He then asked his family to prepare a fattened calf.

1989.english: He asked his family to prepare a fat calf.

verses.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فقربه إليهم قال ألا تأكلون
verses.transliterated: faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūn
verses.english: When he offered it to them, he remarked, "Do you not eat?"

1981.english: He offered it to them, but they did not eat.

1989.english: When he offered it to them, he remarked, “Do you not eat?”

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فأوجس منهم خيفة ۖ قالوا لا تخف ۖ وبشروه بغلام عليم
verses.transliterated: fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmi
verses.english: He harbored fear of them. They said, "Have no fear," and they gave good news of a knowledgeable son.

1981.english: He became wary of them. They said, "Do not be afraid," and they gave him good news of a knowledgeable son.

1989.english: He harbored fear of them. They said, “Have no fear,” and they gave good news of a knowledgeable son.

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فأقبلت امرأته في صرة فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم
verses.transliterated: fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmu
verses.english: His wife was astonished. Noting her wrinkled face: "I am a sterile old woman."

1981.english: His wife came in astonishment, pointing at her face and saying, "I am a sterile old woman."

1989.english: His wife was astonished. Noting her wrinkled face: “I am a sterile old woman.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا كذلك قال ربك ۖ إنه هو الحكيم العليم
verses.transliterated: qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīm
verses.english: They said, "Thus said your Lord. He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient."

1981.english: They said, "Your Lord said thus. He is the most wise, the omniscient."

1989.english: They said, “Thus said your Lord. He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون
verses.transliterated: qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūn
verses.english: He said, "What are you up to, O messengers?"

1981.english: Abraham said, "Where are you going, O messengers?"
1981.subtitle: Sodom And Gomorrah

1989.english: He said, “What are you up to, O messengers?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين
verses.transliterated: qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīn
verses.english: They said, "We have been dispatched to criminal people.

1981.english: They said, "We are being dispatched to guilty people.

1989.english: They said, “We have been dispatched to criminal people.

verses.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: لنرسل عليهم حجارة من طين
verses.transliterated: linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīni
verses.english: "We will shower them with rocks of clay.

1981.english: "We are to shower them with stones of clay.

1989.english: “We will shower them with rocks of clay.

verses.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.arabicClean: مسومة عند ربك للمسرفين
verses.transliterated: musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīn
verses.english: "Marked by your Lord for the transgressors."

1981.english: "Marked at your Lord for the transgressors."

1989.english: “Marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فأخرجنا من كان فيها من المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīn
verses.english: We then delivered all the believers.

1981.english: We then delivered all the believers.

1989.english: We then delivered all the believers.

verses.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من المسلمين
verses.transliterated: famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīn
verses.english: We did not find in it except one house of submitters.

1981.english: We found only one house of muslims (submitters) therein.

1989.english: We did not find in it except one house of Muslims.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: وتركنا فيها آية للذين يخافون العذاب الأليم
verses.transliterated: wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.english: We set it up as a lesson for those who fear the painful retribution.

1981.english: We set it up as a lesson for anyone who fears the painful retribution.

1989.english: We set it up as a lesson for those who fear the painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وفي موسى إذ أرسلناه إلى فرعون بسلطان مبين
verses.transliterated: wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīni
verses.english: In Moses (there is a lesson). We sent him to Pharaoh with manifest signs.

1981.english: There are lessons to be learned from Moses. We sent him to Pharaoh with manifest authority.
1981.subtitle: Moses

1989.english: In Moses (there is a lesson). We sent him to Pharaoh with manifest signs.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.arabicClean: فتولى بركنه وقال ساحر أو مجنون
verses.transliterated: fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnu
verses.english: But he turned away, in arrogance, and said, "Magician, or crazy."

1981.english: But he turned away arrogantly and said, "Either a magician or a crazy man."

1989.english: But he turned away, in arrogance, and said, “Magician, or crazy.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذناه وجنوده فنبذناهم في اليم وهو مليم
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmu
verses.english: Consequently, we punished him and his troops. We threw them into the sea, and he is the one to blame.

1981.english: Consequently, we took him and his troops and threw them into the sea, even though he was apologizing.

1989.english: Consequently, we punished him and his troops. We threw them into the sea, and he is the one to blame.

verses.arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: وفي عاد إذ أرسلنا عليهم الريح العقيم
verses.transliterated: wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīm
verses.english: In 'Ãd (there is a lesson). We sent upon them disastrous wind.

1981.english: There are also lessons to be learned from 'Aad. We sent upon them disasterous winds.
1981.subtitle: 'Aad And Thamood

1989.english: In ‘Aad (there is a lesson). We sent upon them disastrous wind.

verses.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ما تذر من شيء أتت عليه إلا جعلته كالرميم
verses.transliterated: mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīm
verses.english: Anything that it came upon was utterly destroyed.

1981.english: Whatever it passed by was left as dead as an old corpse.

1989.english: Anything that it came upon was utterly destroyed.

verses.arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: وفي ثمود إذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتى حين
verses.transliterated: wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīni
verses.english: In Thamûd (there is a lesson). They were told, "Enjoy temporarily."

1981.english: Also, Thamood were told, "Enjoy yourselves for awhile."

1989.english: In Thamoud (there is a lesson). They were told, “Enjoy temporarily.”

verses.arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فعتوا عن أمر ربهم فأخذتهم الصاعقة وهم ينظرون
verses.transliterated: faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūn
verses.english: They rebelled against the command of their Lord. Consequently, the lightning struck them as they looked.

1981.english: They rebelled against the command of their Lord. Consequently, the lightning struck them as they looked.

1989.english: They rebelled against the command of their Lord. Consequently, the lightning struck them as they looked.

verses.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما استطاعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين
verses.transliterated: famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīn
verses.english: They could never get up, nor were they helped.

1981.english: They never got up thereafter, and there was nothing to protect them.

1989.english: They could never get up, nor were they helped.

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وقوم نوح من قبل ۖ إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين
verses.transliterated: waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verses.english: And the people of Noah before that; they were wicked people.

1981.english: Before them, the people of Noah were wicked.

1989.english: And the people of Noah before that; they were wicked people.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والسماء بنيناها بأيد وإنا لموسعون
verses.transliterated: wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūn
verses.english: We constructed the sky with our hands, and we will continue to expand it.
verses.subtitle: "Expansion of the Universe Theory" Confirmed

1981.english: We constructed the heaven with our hands, and we keep expanding it.
1981.subtitle: Humans And Jinns Created To Worship God Alone

1989.english: We constructed the sky with our hands, and we will continue to expand it.
1989.subtitle: “Expansion of the Universe Theory” Confirmed

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والأرض فرشناها فنعم الماهدون
verses.transliterated: wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūn
verses.english: And we made the earth habitable; a perfect design.

1981.english: We spread the earth, and we are the best pavers.

1989.english: And we made the earth habitable; a perfect design.

verses.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن كل شيء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون
verses.transliterated: wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.english: We created a pair (male and female) of everything, that you may take heed.

1981.english: Of everything, we created a pair, that you may take heed.

1989.english: We created a pair (male and female) of everything, that you may take heed.

verses.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ففروا إلى الله ۖ إني لكم منه نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: You shall escape to GOD. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall flee to God; I am sent to you by Him as a manifest warner.

1989.english: You shall escape to GOD. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تجعلوا مع الله إلها آخر ۖ إني لكم منه نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: Do not set up besides GOD any other god. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.

1981.english: You shall not set up another god besides God; I am sent to you by Him as a manifest warner.

1989.english: Do not set up besides GOD any other god. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك ما أتى الذين من قبلهم من رسول إلا قالوا ساحر أو مجنون
verses.transliterated: kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnu
verses.english: Consistently, when a messenger went to the previous generations, they said, "Magician," or, "Crazy."

1981.english: Consistently, when a messenger went to the previous generations they said, "Magician or crazy."

1989.english: Consistently, when a messenger went to the previous generations, they said, “Magician,” or, “Crazy.”

verses.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أتواصوا به ۚ بل هم قوم طاغون
verses.transliterated: atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verses.english: Did they make an agreement with each other? Indeed, they are transgressors.

1981.english: Do they inherit this behavior from their ancestors? Indeed, they are transgressors.

1989.english: Did they make an agreement with each other? Indeed, they are transgressors.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.arabicClean: فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم
verses.transliterated: fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmi
verses.english: You may disregard them; you cannot be blamed.

1981.english: If you turn away from them, you will not be blamed.

1989.english: You may disregard them; you cannot be blamed.

verses.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين
verses.transliterated: wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīn
verses.english: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.

1981.english: You shall continue to remind them; for the reminder benefits the believers.

1989.english: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.arabicClean: وما خلقت الجن والإنس إلا ليعبدون
verses.transliterated: wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūn
verses.english: I did not create the jinns and the humans except to worship Me alone.
verses.subtitle: The Purpose of Our Existence
