verses.transliterated: alam yatikum naba-u alladhīna kafarū min qablu fadhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: Have you noted those who disbelieved in the past, then suffered the consequences of their decision? They incurred a painful retribution.

1981.english: Did you not receive the history of those who disbelieved in the past? They suffered the consequences of their decision and deserved painful retribution.

1989.english: Have you noted those who disbelieved in the past, then suffered the consequences of their decision? They incurred a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: ذلك بأنه كانت تأتيهم رسلهم بالبينات فقالوا أبشر يهدوننا فكفروا وتولوا ۚ واستغنى الله ۚ والله غني حميد
verses.transliterated: dhālika bi-annahu kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti faqālū abasharun yahdūnanā fakafarū watawallaw wa-is'taghnā l-lahu wal-lahu ghaniyyun ḥamīdu
verses.english: This is because their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they said, "Shall we follow humans like us?" They disbelieved and turned away. GOD does not need them; GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.

1981.english: This is because their messengers went to them with clear revelations, but they said, "Human beings to guide us?" Thus, they disbelieved and turned away. God does not need them; God is in no need, worthy of all praise.

1989.english: This is because their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they said, “Shall we follow humans like us?” They disbelieved and turned away. GOD does not need them; GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: زعم الذين كفروا أن لن يبعثوا ۚ قل بلى وربي لتبعثن ثم لتنبؤن بما عملتم ۚ وذلك على الله يسير
verses.transliterated: zaʿama alladhīna kafarū an lan yub'ʿathū qul balā warabbī latub'ʿathunna thumma latunabba-unna bimā ʿamil'tum wadhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīru
verses.english: Those who disbelieved claim that they will not be resurrected! Yes indeed, by my Lord, you will be resurrected, and you will be held accountable for everything you have done. This is easy for GOD to do.

1981.english: The disbelievers claim that they will not be raised. Say, "Yes indeed, by my Lord, you will be resurrected and informed of everything you had done." This is easy for God.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved claim that they will not be resurrected! Yes indeed, by my Lord, you will be resurrected, and you will be held accountable for everything you have done. This is easy for GOD to do.

verses.arabic: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: فآمنوا بالله ورسوله والنور الذي أنزلنا ۚ والله بما تعملون خبير
verses.transliterated: faāminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wal-nūri alladhī anzalnā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīru
verses.english: Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messenger, and the light that we have revealed herein. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall believe in God and His messenger, and the light that we sent down (Quran). God is cognizant of everything you do.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messenger, and the light that we have revealed herein. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يجمعكم ليوم الجمع ۖ ذلك يوم التغابن ۗ ومن يؤمن بالله ويعمل صالحا يكفر عنه سيئاته ويدخله جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا ۚ ذلك الفوز العظيم
verses.transliterated: yawma yajmaʿukum liyawmi l-jamʿi dhālika yawmu l-taghābuni waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan dhālika l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: The day will come when He summons you to the Day of Summoning. That is the Day of Mutual Blaming. Anyone who believes in GOD and leads a righteous life, He will remit his sins, and will admit him into gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. This is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: The day will come when He gathers you on the day of gathering; that is the day of mutual blaming. Anyone who believes in God and works righteousness, God will remit his sins and admit him into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. This is the great triumph.
1981.subtitle: The Day of Mutual Blaming

1989.english: The day will come when He summons you to the Day of Summoning. That is the Day of Mutual Blaming. Anyone who believes in GOD and leads a righteous life, He will remit his sins, and will admit him into gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. This is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا أولئك أصحاب النار خالدين فيها ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri khālidīna fīhā wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: As for those who disbelieve and reject our revelations, they are the dwellers of the Hellfire; they abide therein forever. What a miserable destiny!

1981.english: As for those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations, they have deserved hell as their abode. What a miserable destiny!

1989.english: As for those who disbelieve and reject our revelations, they are the dwellers of the Hellfire; they abide therein forever. What a miserable destiny!

verses.arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: ما أصاب من مصيبة إلا بإذن الله ۗ ومن يؤمن بالله يهد قلبه ۚ والله بكل شيء عليم
verses.transliterated: mā aṣāba min muṣībatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waman yu'min bil-lahi yahdi qalbahu wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmu
verses.english: Nothing happens to you except in accordance with GOD's will. Anyone who believes in GOD, He will guide his heart. GOD is fully aware of all things.
verses.subtitle: Divine Law

1981.english: No disaster strikes except in accordance with God's will. Anyone who believes, God will guide his heart. God is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: Nothing happens to you except in accordance with GOD’s will. Anyone who believes in GOD, He will guide his heart. GOD is fully aware of all things.
1989.subtitle: Divine Law

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.arabicClean: وأطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول ۚ فإن توليتم فإنما على رسولنا البلاغ المبين
verses.transliterated: wa-aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla fa-in tawallaytum fa-innamā ʿalā rasūlinā l-balāghu l-mubīn
verses.english: You shall obey GOD and you shall obey the messenger. If you turn away, then the sole mission of our messenger is to deliver the message.

1981.english: You shall obey God and obey the messenger.* If you turn away, then our messenger's only duty is to deliver (the message).
1981.footnote: The enemies of the prophet took advantage of this commandment and flagrantly abused it (see 6:112 and 25:30-31). Thus, they invented a whole set of religious teachings that suit their traditions and desires and attributed them to the prophet, then demanded that everyone follow them instead of, or besides, the Quran (see Appendices 11, 15, and 16).

1989.english: You shall obey GOD and you shall obey the messenger. If you turn away, then the sole mission of our messenger is to deliver the message.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الله لا إله إلا هو ۚ وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون
verses.transliterated: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūn
verses.english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. In GOD the believers shall trust.

1981.english: God; there is no god except He; in God the believers shall trust.

1989.english: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. In GOD the believers shall trust.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن من أزواجكم وأولادكم عدوا لكم فاحذروهم ۚ وإن تعفوا وتصفحوا وتغفروا فإن الله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū inna min azwājikum wa-awlādikum ʿaduwwan lakum fa-iḥ'dharūhum wa-in taʿfū wataṣfaḥū wataghfirū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: O you who believe, your spouses and your children can be your enemies; beware. If you pardon, forget, and forgive, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: O you who believe, your spouses and your children could be enemies of yours; beware of them. If you pardon, forget, and forgive, then God is forgiver, merciful.
1981.subtitle: Your Monies And Families Are A Test

1989.english: O you who believe, your spouses and your children can be your enemies; beware. If you pardon, forget, and forgive, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنما أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة ۚ والله عنده أجر عظيم
verses.transliterated: innamā amwālukum wa-awlādukum fit'natun wal-lahu ʿindahu ajrun ʿaẓīmu
verses.english: Your money and children are a test, and GOD possesses a great recompense.

1981.english: Your monies and children constitute a test, and God possesses a great recompense.

1989.english: Your money and children are a test, and GOD possesses a great recompense.

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاتقوا الله ما استطعتم واسمعوا وأطيعوا وأنفقوا خيرا لأنفسكم ۗ ومن يوق شح نفسه فأولئك هم المفلحون
verses.transliterated: fa-ittaqū l-laha mā is'taṭaʿtum wa-is'maʿū wa-aṭīʿū wa-anfiqū khayran li-anfusikum waman yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūn
verses.english: Therefore, you shall reverence GOD as much as you can, and listen, and obey, and give (to charity) for your own good. Anyone who is protected from his own stinginess, these are the successful ones.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall observe righteousness towards God as much as you can. You shall hearken, obey, and spend (in charity) for your own good. Those who overcome their natural stinginess are the winners.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall reverence GOD as much as you can, and listen, and obey, and give (to charity) for your own good. Anyone who is protected from his own stinginess, these are the successful ones.

verses.arabic: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن تقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا يضاعفه لكم ويغفر لكم ۚ والله شكور حليم
verses.transliterated: in tuq'riḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿif'hu lakum wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu shakūrun ḥalīmu
verses.english: If you lend GOD a loan of righteousness, He will multiply the reward for you manifold, and forgive you. GOD is Appreciative, Clement.

1981.english: If you lend God a loan of righteousness, He will multiply it for you manyfold and forgive you. God is appreciative, clement.

1989.english: If you lend GOD a loan of righteousness, He will multiply the reward for you manifold, and forgive you. GOD is Appreciative, Clement.

verses.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: عالم الغيب والشهادة العزيز الحكيم
verses.transliterated: ālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Almighty, Most Wise.

1981.english: He is the knower of secrets and declarations; the almighty, the wise.

1989.english: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Almighty, Most Wise. >

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا أيها النبي إذا طلقتم النساء فطلقوهن لعدتهن وأحصوا العدة ۖ واتقوا الله ربكم ۖ لا تخرجوهن من بيوتهن ولا يخرجن إلا أن يأتين بفاحشة مبينة ۚ وتلك حدود الله ۚ ومن يتعد حدود الله فقد ظلم نفسه ۚ لا تدري لعل الله يحدث بعد ذلك أمرا
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu idhā ṭallaqtumu l-nisāa faṭalliqūhunna liʿiddatihinna wa-aḥṣū l-ʿidata wa-ittaqū l-laha rabbakum lā tukh'rijūhunna min buyūtihinna walā yakhruj'na illā an yatīna bifāḥishatin mubayyinatin watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi waman yataʿadda ḥudūda l-lahi faqad ẓalama nafsahu lā tadrī laʿalla l-laha yuḥ'dithu baʿda dhālika amra
verses.english: O you prophet, when you people divorce the women, you shall ensure that a divorce interim is fulfilled. You shall measure such an interim precisely. You shall reverence GOD your Lord. Do not evict them from their homes, nor shall you make life miserable for them, to force them to leave on their own, unless they commit a proven adultery. These are GOD's laws. Anyone who transgresses GOD's laws commits an injustice against himself. You never know; maybe GOD wills something good to come out of this.
verses.footnote: The divorcee's interim, before becoming eligible for remarriage, is a waiting period of three menstruations. This ensures that the divorcee was not pregnant (2:228).

1981.english: O prophet, when you divorce the women, you shall observe their divorce interim, and count the interim.* Beware of God, your Lord, and do not evict them from their homes, nor shall they leave on their accord (during the interim), unless they commit a proven adultery. These are God's laws. Anyone who transgresses God's laws commits injustice against his own self. You never know, God may allow certain things to happen.
1981.footnote: The divorce interim is three menstruations. Thereafter, the divorcee may remarry (see 2:228).

1989.english: O you prophet, when you people divorce the women, you shall ensure that a divorce interim is fulfilled. You shall measure such an interim precisely.* You shall reverence GOD your Lord. Do not evict them from their homes, nor shall you make life miserable for them, to force them to leave on their own, unless they commit a proven adultery. These are GOD’s laws. Anyone who transgresses GOD’s laws commits an injustice against himself. You never know; maybe GOD wills something good to come out of this.
1989.footnote: The divorcee’s interim, before becoming eligible for remarriage, is a waiting period of three menstruations. This ensures that the divorcee was not pregnant (2:228).

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا
verses.arabicClean: فإذا بلغن أجلهن فأمسكوهن بمعروف أو فارقوهن بمعروف وأشهدوا ذوي عدل منكم وأقيموا الشهادة لله ۚ ذلكم يوعظ به من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر ۚ ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin aw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin wa-ashhidū dhaway ʿadlin minkum wa-aqīmū l-shahādata lillahi dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yu'minu bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu makhraja
verses.english: Once the interim is fulfilled, you may reconcile with them equitably, or go through with the separation equitably. You shall have two equitable witnesses witness the divorce before GOD. This is to enlighten those who believe in GOD and the Last Day. Anyone who reverences GOD, He will create an exit for him.

1981.english: Once they fulfill their interim, then you may allow them to stay in your household amicably,* or let them depart amicably. You shall have two equitable witnesses among you witness the divorce agreement, and monitor such agreement as witnessed. This shall be heeded by those who truly believe in God and the last day. Whoever observes righteousness towards God, He will create an exit for him,
1981.footnote: A divorcee may choose to stay within the ex-husband's household to take care of her children, or because she has no other place to go.

1989.english: Once the interim is fulfilled, you may reconcile with them equitably, or go through with the separation equitably. You shall have two equitable witnesses witness the divorce before GOD. This is to enlighten those who believe in GOD and the Last Day. Anyone who reverences GOD, He will create an exit for him.

verses.arabic: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
verses.arabicClean: ويرزقه من حيث لا يحتسب ۚ ومن يتوكل على الله فهو حسبه ۚ إن الله بالغ أمره ۚ قد جعل الله لكل شيء قدرا
verses.transliterated: wayarzuq'hu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu waman yatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi fahuwa ḥasbuhu inna l-laha bālighu amrihi qad jaʿala l-lahu likulli shayin qadra
verses.english: And will provide for him whence he never expected. Anyone who trusts in GOD, He suffices him. GOD's commands are done. GOD has decreed for everything its fate.

1981.english: and provide for him whence he never expects. Anyone who trusts in God, God will suffice him. God always carries out His decisions. God has laid down the plans for everything.

1989.english: And will provide for him whence he never expected. Anyone who trusts in GOD, He suffices him. GOD’s commands are done. GOD has decreed for everything its fate.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًا
verses.arabicClean: واللائي يئسن من المحيض من نسائكم إن ارتبتم فعدتهن ثلاثة أشهر واللائي لم يحضن ۚ وأولات الأحمال أجلهن أن يضعن حملهن ۚ ومن يتق الله يجعل له من أمره يسرا
verses.transliterated: wa-allāī ya-is'na mina l-maḥīḍi min nisāikum ini ir'tabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthatu ashhurin wa-allāī lam yaḥiḍ'na wa-ulātu l-aḥmāli ajaluhunna an yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna waman yattaqi l-laha yajʿal lahu min amrihi yus'ra
verses.english: As for the women who have reached menopause, if you have any doubts, their interim shall be three months. As for those who do not menstruate, and discover that they are pregnant, their interim ends upon giving birth. Anyone who reverences GOD, He makes everything easy for him.

1981.english: As for the women who have reached menopause, if you have any doubts, their interim shall be three months. As for those who do not menstruate because of pregnancy, their interim lasts until they give birth. Whoever observes righteousness towards God, God will make everything easy for him.

1989.english: As for the women who have reached menopause, if you have any doubts, their interim shall be three months. As for those who do not menstruate, and discover that they are pregnant, their interim ends upon giving birth. Anyone who reverences GOD, He makes everything easy for him.

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
verses.arabicClean: ذلك أمر الله أنزله إليكم ۚ ومن يتق الله يكفر عنه سيئاته ويعظم له أجرا
verses.transliterated: dhālika amru l-lahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi l-laha yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiātihi wayuʿ'ẓim lahu ajra
verses.english: This is GOD's command that He sends down to you. Anyone who reverences GOD, He remits his sins, and rewards him generously.

1981.english: This is God's command that He sent down to you. Anyone who reverences God, God will remit his sins and multiply his recompense.

1989.english: This is GOD’s command that He sends down to you. Anyone who reverences GOD, He remits his sins, and rewards him generously.

verses.arabic: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَٰتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: أسكنوهن من حيث سكنتم من وجدكم ولا تضاروهن لتضيقوا عليهن ۚ وإن كن أولات حمل فأنفقوا عليهن حتى يضعن حملهن ۚ فإن أرضعن لكم فآتوهن أجورهن ۖ وأتمروا بينكم بمعروف ۖ وإن تعاسرتم فسترضع له أخرى
verses.transliterated: askinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum min wuj'dikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqū ʿalayhinna wa-in kunna ulāti ḥamlin fa-anfiqū ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna fa-in arḍaʿna lakum faātūhunna ujūrahunna watamirū baynakum bimaʿrūfin wa-in taʿāsartum fasatur'ḍiʿu lahu ukh'r
verses.english: You shall allow them to live in the same home in which they lived with you, and do not make life so miserable for them that they leave on their own. If they are pregnant, you shall spend on them until they give birth. If they nurse the infant, you shall pay them for this service. You shall maintain the amicable relations among you. If you disagree, you may hire another woman to nurse the child.

1981.english: You shall continue to provide the same housing for the divorcees as you would provide for yourselves. You shall not harass them by reducing their housing privileges. If they are pregnant, you shall provide for them until they give birth. If they nurse the infant for you, you shall pay them. You shall maintain the amicable relations among you. If you disagree, you may hire a nursing mother.

1989.english: You shall allow them to live in the same home in which they lived with you, and do not make life so miserable for them that they leave on their own. If they are pregnant, you shall spend on them until they give birth. If they nurse the infant, you shall pay them for this service. You shall maintain the amicable relations among you. If you disagree, you may hire another woman to nurse the child.

verses.arabic: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
verses.arabicClean: لينفق ذو سعة من سعته ۖ ومن قدر عليه رزقه فلينفق مما آتاه الله ۚ لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا ما آتاها ۚ سيجعل الله بعد عسر يسرا
verses.transliterated: liyunfiq dhū saʿatin min saʿatihi waman qudira ʿalayhi riz'quhu falyunfiq mimmā ātāhu l-lahu lā yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illā mā ātāhā sayajʿalu l-lahu baʿda ʿus'rin yus'ra
verses.english: The rich husband shall provide support in accordance with his means, and the poor shall provide according to the means that GOD bestowed upon him. GOD does not impose on any soul more than He has given it. GOD will provide ease after difficulty.

1981.english: The rich shall spend from his bounties, and the poor shall spend in accordance with what God has given him. God never burdens anyone beyond what He has given him. God may substitute wealth in place of poverty

1989.english: The rich husband shall provide support in accordance with his means, and the poor shall provide according to the means that GOD bestowed upon him. GOD does not impose on any soul more than He has given it. GOD will provide ease after difficulty.

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
verses.arabicClean: وكأين من قرية عتت عن أمر ربها ورسله فحاسبناها حسابا شديدا وعذبناها عذابا نكرا
verses.transliterated: waka-ayyin min qaryatin ʿatat ʿan amri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhabnāhā ʿadhāban nuk'ra
verses.english: Many a community rebelled against the commands of its Lord and against His messengers. Consequently, we held them strictly accountable, and requited them a terrible requital.

1981.english: Many a community rebelled against God's law and against His messengers. Consequently, we held them strictly responsible and afflicted them with a terrible retribution.
1981.subtitle: You Shall Heed God's Law

1989.english: Many a community rebelled against the commands of its Lord and against His messengers. Consequently, we held them strictly accountable, and requited them a terrible requital.

verses.arabic: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
verses.arabicClean: فذاقت وبال أمرها وكان عاقبة أمرها خسرا
verses.transliterated: fadhāqat wabāla amrihā wakāna ʿāqibatu amrihā khus'ra
verses.english: They suffered the consequences of their decisions; a profound loss.

1981.english: Thus, they suffered the consequences of their decision, and their final end was disasterous.

1989.english: They suffered the consequences of their decisions; a profound loss.

verses.arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا
verses.arabicClean: أعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا ۖ فاتقوا الله يا أولي الألباب الذين آمنوا ۚ قد أنزل الله إليكم ذكرا
verses.transliterated: aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan fa-ittaqū l-laha yāulī l-albābi alladhīna āmanū qad anzala l-lahu ilaykum dhik'ra
verses.english: GOD has prepared for them severe retribution. Therefore, you shall reverence GOD, O you who possess intelligence and believed. GOD has sent down to you a message—
verses.footnote: The "Messenger" here is clearly the Quran. Verse 10 talks about "sending down a message," and this points to the Quran as the messenger in 65:11 (App. 20).

1981.english: God has prepared for them severe retribution. Therefore, you shall observe righteousness, O you who showed intelligence and believed. God has sent this message for you.

1989.english: GOD has prepared for them severe retribution. Therefore, you shall reverence GOD, O you who possess intelligence and believed. GOD has sent down to you a message—
1989.footnote: The “Messenger” here is clearly the Quran. Verse 10 talks about “sending down a message, ” and this points to the Quran as the messenger in 65:11 (App. 20).

verses.arabic: رَّسُولًا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
verses.arabicClean: رسولا يتلو عليكم آيات الله مبينات ليخرج الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات من الظلمات إلى النور ۚ ومن يؤمن بالله ويعمل صالحا يدخله جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا ۖ قد أحسن الله له رزقا
verses.transliterated: rasūlan yatlū ʿalaykum āyāti l-lahi mubayyinātin liyukh'rija alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri waman yu'min bil-lahi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan qad aḥsana l-lahu lahu riz'qa
verses.english: a messenger who recites to you GOD's revelations, clearly, to lead those who believe and work righteousness out of the darkness into the light. Anyone who believes in GOD and leads a righteous life, He will admit him into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. GOD will generously reward him.

1981.english: He has sent a messenger to recite for you God's profound revelations. Thereby, He leads those who believe and work righteousness out of the darkness into the light. Anyone who believes in God and works righteousness, God will admit him into gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever. God showers him with the best blessings.

1989.english: a messenger* who recites to you GOD’s revelations, clearly, to lead those who believe and work righteousness out of the darkness into the light. Anyone who believes in GOD and leads a righteous life, He will admit him into gardens with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. GOD will generously reward him. Seven Universes And Seven Earths*
1989.footnote: The “Messenger” here is clearly the Quran. Verse 10 talks about “sending down a message, ” and this points to the Quran as the messenger in 65:11 (App. 20).

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
verses.arabicClean: الله الذي خلق سبع سماوات ومن الأرض مثلهن يتنزل الأمر بينهن لتعلموا أن الله على كل شيء قدير وأن الله قد أحاط بكل شيء علما
verses.transliterated: al-lahu alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina l-arḍi mith'lahunna yatanazzalu l-amru baynahunna litaʿlamū anna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun wa-anna l-laha qad aḥāṭa bikulli shayin ʿil'ma
verses.english: GOD created seven universes and the same number of earths. The commands flow among them. This is to let you know that GOD is Omnipotent, and that GOD is fully aware of all things.
verses.subtitle: Seven Universes And Seven Earths
verses.footnote: Although God created six other planets that are identical to our Earth, there is life only on our planet. Thus, the evolutionists will be shown on the Day of Judgment that life did not just "evolve" on the planet because of its particular circumstances.

1981.english: God is the one who created seven heavens and the same of the earth. The decisions flow between them. You shall know that God is omnipotent and that He is fully aware of all things.

1989.english: GOD created seven universes and the same number of earths. The commands flow among them. This is to let you know that GOD is Omnipotent, and that GOD is fully aware of all things.
1989.footnote: Although God created six other planets that are identical to our Earth, there ii life only on our planet. Thus, the evolutionists will be shown on the Day of Judgment that life did not just “evolve” on the planet because of its particular circumstances.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم يا أيها النبي لم تحرم ما أحل الله لك ۖ تبتغي مرضات أزواجك ۚ والله غفور رحيم
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu lima tuḥarrimu mā aḥalla l-lahu laka tabtaghī marḍāta azwājika wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmu
verses.english: O you prophet, why do you prohibit what GOD has made lawful for you, just to please your wives? GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.
verses.footnote: Mohammedans around the world believe that Muhammad was infallible. This verse teaches us that he was indeed a fallible human being (18:110, 33:37, 40:66, 80:1).

1981.english: O prophet, why do you prohibit what God had permitted for you, just to please your wives? God is forgiver, merciful.

1989.english: O you prophet, why do you prohibit what GOD has made lawful for you, just to please your wives? GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.*
1989.footnote: Mohammedans around the world believe that Muhammad was infallible. This verse teaches us that he was indeed a fallible human being (18:110, 33:37, 40:66, 80:1).

verses.arabic: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.arabicClean: قد فرض الله لكم تحلة أيمانكم ۚ والله مولاكم ۖ وهو العليم الحكيم
verses.transliterated: qad faraḍa l-lahu lakum taḥillata aymānikum wal-lahu mawlākum wahuwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīm
verses.english: GOD has decreed for you the laws dealing with your oaths. GOD is your Lord, and He is the Omniscient, Most Wise.

1981.english: God has decreed for you the laws dealing with your oaths. God is your Lord; He is the omniscient, most wise.

1989.english: GOD has decreed for you the laws dealing with your oaths. GOD is your Lord, and He is the Omniscient, Most Wise.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وإذ أسر النبي إلى بعض أزواجه حديثا فلما نبأت به وأظهره الله عليه عرف بعضه وأعرض عن بعض ۖ فلما نبأها به قالت من أنبأك هذا ۖ قال نبأني العليم الخبير
verses.transliterated: wa-idh asarra l-nabiyu ilā baʿḍi azwājihi ḥadīthan falammā nabba-at bihi wa-aẓharahu l-lahu ʿalayhi ʿarrafa baʿḍahu wa-aʿraḍa ʿan baʿḍin falammā nabba-ahā bihi qālat man anba-aka hādhā qāla nabba-aniya l-ʿalīmu l-khabīr
verses.english: The prophet had trusted some of his wives with a certain statement, then one of them spread it, and GOD let him know about it. He then informed his wife of part of the issue, and disregarded part. She asked him, "Who informed you of this?" He said, "I was informed by the Omniscient, Most Cognizant."

1981.english: The prophet entrusted some of his wives with a secret, but one of them divulged it, and God informed the prophet thereof. He then told her part of the information, and disregarded part. She said, "Who informed you?" He said, "I was informed by the knower, the cognizant."

1989.english: The prophet had trusted some of his wives with a certain statement, then one of them spread it, and GOD let him know about it. He then informed his wife of part of the issue, and disregarded part. She asked him, “Who informed you of this?” He said, “I was informed by the Omniscient, Most Cognizant.”

verses.arabic: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن تتوبا إلى الله فقد صغت قلوبكما ۖ وإن تظاهرا عليه فإن الله هو مولاه وجبريل وصالح المؤمنين ۖ والملائكة بعد ذلك ظهير
verses.transliterated: in tatūbā ilā l-lahi faqad ṣaghat qulūbukumā wa-in taẓāharā ʿalayhi fa-inna l-laha huwa mawlāhu wajib'rīlu waṣāliḥu l-mu'minīna wal-malāikatu baʿda dhālika ẓahīru
verses.english: If the two of you repent to GOD, then your hearts have listened. But if you band together against him, then GOD is his ally, and so is Gabriel and the righteous believers. Also, the angels are his helpers.

1981.english: If the two of you repent to God, then your hearts have hearkened; but if you band together against the prophet, then God is his ally, and so is Gabriel, and the righteous believers; even the angels are his allies.

1989.english: If the two of you repent to GOD, then your hearts have listened. But if you band together against him, then GOD is his ally, and so is Gabriel and the righteous believers. Also, the angels are his helpers.

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍ قَٰنِتَٰتٍ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍ ثَيِّبَٰتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا
verses.arabicClean: عسى ربه إن طلقكن أن يبدله أزواجا خيرا منكن مسلمات مؤمنات قانتات تائبات عابدات سائحات ثيبات وأبكارا
verses.transliterated: Aasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunnaan yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatinmu/minatin qanitatin ta-ibatinAAabidatin sa-ihatin thayyibatinwaabkaran
verses.english: If he divorces you, his Lord will substitute other wives in your place who are better than you; submitters (Muslims), believers (Mu'mins), obedient, repentant, worshipers, pious, either previously married, or virgins.

1981.english: If he divorces you, then his Lord may substitute wives who are better than you; muslims, faithful, obedient, repentant, worshipping, devoted, be they virgin or previously married.

1989.english: If he divorces you, his Lord will substitute other wives in your place who are better than you; submitters (Muslims), believers (Mu’mins), obedient, repentant, worshipers, pious, either previously married, or virgins.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا وقودها الناس والحجارة عليها ملائكة غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā l-nāsu wal-ḥijāratu ʿalayhā malāikatun ghilāẓun shidādun lā yaʿṣūna l-laha mā amarahum wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūn
verses.english: O you who believe, protect yourselves and your families from the Hellfire whose fuel is people and rocks. Guarding it are stern and powerful angels who never disobey GOD; they do whatever they are commanded to do.

1981.english: O you who believe, spare yourselves and your families the hellfire, whose fuel is people and rocks. Guarding it are angels who are stern and powerful. They never disobey any order from God; they do whatever they are commanded to do.

1989.english: O you who believe, protect yourselves and your families from the Hellfire whose fuel is people and rocks. Guarding it are stern and powerful angels who never disobey GOD; they do whatever they are commanded to do.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين كفروا لا تعتذروا اليوم ۖ إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna kafarū lā taʿtadhirū l-yawma innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.english: O you who disbelieved, do not apologize today. You are being requited only for what you did.

1981.english: O you who disbelieve, do not apologize today. You are punished only for what you did.

1989.english: O you who disbelieved, do not apologize today. You are being requited only for what you did.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الذين آمنوا توبوا إلى الله توبة نصوحا عسى ربكم أن يكفر عنكم سيئاتكم ويدخلكم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار يوم لا يخزي الله النبي والذين آمنوا معه ۖ نورهم يسعى بين أيديهم وبأيمانهم يقولون ربنا أتمم لنا نورنا واغفر لنا ۖ إنك على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū tūbū ilā l-lahi tawbatan naṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum an yukaffira ʿankum sayyiātikum wayud'khilakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yawma lā yukh'zī l-lahu l-nabiya wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu nūruhum yasʿā bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-igh'fir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: O you who believe, you shall repent to GOD a firm repentance. Your Lord will then remit your sins and admit you into gardens with flowing streams. On that day, GOD will not disappoint the prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will radiate in front of them and to their right. They will say, "Our Lord, perfect our light for us, and forgive us; You are Omnipotent."
verses.subtitle: The Believers Repent

1981.english: O you who believe, repent to God a sincere repentance. Your Lord will then remit your sins and admit you into gardens with flowing streams. The day will come when God will not forsake the prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will flow ahead of them and to their right. They will say, "Our Lord, perfect our light for us, and forgive us; You are omnipotent."

1989.english: O you who believe, you shall repent to GOD a firm repentance. Your Lord will then remit your sins and admit you into gardens with flowing streams. On that day, GOD will not disappoint the prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will radiate in front of them and to their right. They will say, “Our Lord, perfect our light for us, and forgive us; You are Omnipotent.”
1989.subtitle: The Believers Repent

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها النبي جاهد الكفار والمنافقين واغلظ عليهم ۚ ومأواهم جهنم ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: O prophet, struggle against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be stern with them. Their abode is Gehenna, and a miserable destiny.

1981.english: O prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern against them. Their abode is hell; what a miserable destiny!

1989.english: O prophet, struggle against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be stern with them. Their abode is Gehenna, and a miserable destiny.

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ضرب الله مثلا للذين كفروا امرأت نوح وامرأت لوط ۖ كانتا تحت عبدين من عبادنا صالحين فخانتاهما فلم يغنيا عنهما من الله شيئا وقيل ادخلا النار مع الداخلين
verses.transliterated: ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna kafarū im'ra-ata nūḥin wa-im'ra-ata lūṭin kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yugh'niyā ʿanhumā mina l-lahi shayan waqīla ud'khulā l-nāra maʿa l-dākhilīn
verses.english: GOD cites as examples of those who disbelieved the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were married to two of our righteous servants, but they betrayed them and, consequently, they could not help them at all against GOD. The two of them were told, "Enter the Hellfire with those who deserved it."
verses.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession Shattered

1981.english: God cites as examples of disbelievers the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of our righteous servants, but they betrayed them. Consequently, they could not protect their wives at all from God. The wives were told, "Enter the hellfire along with the others."
1981.subtitle: Spouses May Disagree

1989.english: GOD cites as examples of those who disbelieved the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were married to two of our righteous servants, but they betrayed them and, consequently, they could not help them at all against GOD. The two of them were told, “Enter the Hellfire with those who deserved it.”
1989.subtitle: The Myth of Intercession Shattered

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وضرب الله مثلا للذين آمنوا امرأت فرعون إذ قالت رب ابن لي عندك بيتا في الجنة ونجني من فرعون وعمله ونجني من القوم الظالمين
verses.transliterated: waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna āmanū im'ra-ata fir'ʿawna idh qālat rabbi ib'ni lī ʿindaka baytan fī l-janati wanajjinī min fir'ʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīn
verses.english: And GOD cites as an example of those who believed the wife of Pharaoh. She said, "My Lord, build a home for me at You in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works; save me from the transgressing people."
verses.subtitle: Examples of the Believers Pharaoh's Wife

1981.english: And God cites as an example of the believers the wife of Pharaoh. She said, "My Lord, build an abode for me in paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his evil work; save me from the wicked people."

1989.english: And GOD cites as an example of those who believed the wife of Pharaoh. She said, “My Lord, build a home for me at You in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works; save me from the transgressing people.”
1989.subtitle: Examples of the Believers Pharaoh's Wife

verses.arabic: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ومريم ابنت عمران التي أحصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيه من روحنا وصدقت بكلمات ربها وكتبه وكانت من القانتين
verses.transliterated: wamaryama ib'nata ʿim'rāna allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina l-qānitīn
verses.english: Also Mary, the Amramite. She maintained her chastity, then we blew into her from our spirit. She believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures; she was obedient.
verses.subtitle: Mary

1981.english: Also Mary, the daughter of Imran; she guarded her chastity, so we blew into her from our spirit. She upheld the commandments of her Lord and His scriptures, and she was obedient.

1989.english: Also Mary, the Amramite. She maintained her chastity, then we blew into her from our spirit. She believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures; she was obedient.
1989.subtitle: Mary

verses.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم تبارك الذي بيده الملك وهو على كل شيء قدير
verses.transliterated: tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīru
verses.english: Most exalted is the One in whose hands is all kingship, and He is Omnipotent.

1981.english: Most exalted is the one who possesses all kingship; He is omnipotent.

1989.english: Most exalted is the One in whose hands is all kingship, and He is Omnipotent.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.arabicClean: الذي خلق الموت والحياة ليبلوكم أيكم أحسن عملا ۚ وهو العزيز الغفور
verses.transliterated: alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūr
verses.english: The One who created death and life for the purpose of distinguishing those among you who would do better. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
verses.subtitle: The Purpose of Our Life
verses.footnote: See the Introduction and Appendix 7 for details of the purpose behind this world.

1981.english: He is the one who created death and life, in order to test you and distinguish the righteous among you; He is the almighty, the forgiver.
1981.subtitle: The Sole Purpose Of Creation
1981.footnote: See Appendix 6

1989.english: The One who created death and life for the purpose of distinguishing those among you who would do better.* He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
1989.subtitle: The Purpose of Our Life
1989.footnote: See the Introduction and Appendix 7 for details of the purpose behind this world.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: الذي خلق سبع سماوات طباقا ۖ ما ترى في خلق الرحمن من تفاوت ۖ فارجع البصر هل ترى من فطور
verses.transliterated: alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūri
verses.english: He created seven universes in layers. You do not see any imperfection in the creation by the Most Gracious. Keep looking; do you see any flaw?

1981.english: He is the one who created seven heavens in layers. You never see a flaw in the creation of God most gracious. Keep looking; do you see any flaw?

1989.english: He created seven universes in layers. You do not see any imperfection in the creation by the Most Gracious. Keep looking; do you see any flaw?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: ثم ارجع البصر كرتين ينقلب إليك البصر خاسئا وهو حسير
verses.transliterated: thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-an wahuwa ḥasīru
verses.english: Look again and again; your eyes will come back stumped and conquered.

1981.english: Then look again and again; your eyes will come back stumped and conquered.

1989.english: Look again and again; your eyes will come back stumped and conquered.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد زينا السماء الدنيا بمصابيح وجعلناها رجوما للشياطين ۖ وأعتدنا لهم عذاب السعير
verses.transliterated: walaqad zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba l-saʿīr
verses.english: We adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and guarded its borders with projectiles against the devils; we prepared for them a retribution in Hell.

1981.english: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps,* and we placed projectiles therein to shoot the devils; we prepared for them the retribution of burning.
1981.footnote: See Appendix 5.

1989.english: We adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and guarded its borders with projectiles against the devils; we prepared for them a retribution in Hell.

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: وللذين كفروا بربهم عذاب جهنم ۖ وبئس المصير
verses.transliterated: walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.english: For those who disbelieved in their Lord, the retribution of Gehenna. What a miserable destiny.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the retribution of hell; a miserable destiny.

1989.english: For those who disbelieved in their Lord, the retribution of Gehenna. What a miserable destiny.

verses.arabic: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verses.arabicClean: إذا ألقوا فيها سمعوا لها شهيقا وهي تفور
verses.transliterated: idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūr
verses.english: When they get thrown therein, they hear its furor as it fumes.

1981.english: When they are thrown therein, they will hear its furor as it fumes.

1989.english: When they get thrown therein, they hear its furor as it fumes.

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: تكاد تميز من الغيظ ۖ كلما ألقي فيها فوج سألهم خزنتها ألم يأتكم نذير
verses.transliterated: takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīru
verses.english: It almost explodes from rage. Whenever a group is thrown therein, its guards would ask them, "Did you not receive a warner?"

1981.english: It almost explodes from rage; whenever a group is thrown therein, the guardians will ask them, "Did you not receive a warner?"

1989.english: It almost explodes from rage. Whenever a group is thrown therein, its guards would ask them, “Did you not receive a warner?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا بلى قد جاءنا نذير فكذبنا وقلنا ما نزل الله من شيء إن أنتم إلا في ضلال كبير
verses.transliterated: qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīri
verses.english: They would answer, "Yes indeed; a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved and said, 'GOD did not reveal anything. You are totally astray.'"

1981.english: They will say, "Yes indeed, a warner had come to us, but we disbelieved and said, 'God did not reveal anything. You are totally astray.'"

1989.english: They would answer, “Yes indeed; a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved and said, GOD did not reveal anything. You are totally astray.’ ”

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لو كنا نسمع أو نعقل ما كنا في أصحاب السعير
verses.transliterated: waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi l-saʿīr
verses.english: They also say, "If we heard or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of Hell!"

1981.english: They also said, "Had we hearkened or understood, we would not have deserved hell."

1989.english: They also say, “If we heard or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of Hell!”

verses.arabic: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: فاعترفوا بذنبهم فسحقا لأصحاب السعير
verses.transliterated: fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qan li-aṣḥābi l-saʿīr
verses.english: Thus, they confessed their sins. Woe to the dwellers of Hell.

1981.english: They will thus confess their sins; woe to those who have deserved hell.

1989.english: Thus, they confessed their sins. Woe to the dwellers of Hell.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب لهم مغفرة وأجر كبير
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīru
verses.english: As for those who reverence their Lord, when alone in their privacy, they have attained forgiveness and a great recompense.

1981.english: Those who reverence their Lord in their privacy have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.

1989.english: As for those who reverence their Lord, when alone in their privacy, they have attained forgiveness and a great recompense.

verses.arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: وأسروا قولكم أو اجهروا به ۖ إنه عليم بذات الصدور
verses.transliterated: wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūr
verses.english: Whether you keep your utterances secret, or declare them, He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1981.english: Whether you conceal your utterances or declare them, God is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

1989.english: Whether you keep your utterances secret, or declare them, He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: ألا يعلم من خلق وهو اللطيف الخبير
verses.transliterated: alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīr
verses.english: Should He not know what He created? He is the Sublime, Most Cognizant.

1981.english: Should He not know, since He is the one who created? He is the benign, the cognizant.

1989.english: Should He not know what He created? He is the Sublime, Most Cognizant.

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.arabicClean: هو الذي جعل لكم الأرض ذلولا فامشوا في مناكبها وكلوا من رزقه ۖ وإليه النشور
verses.transliterated: huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū min riz'qihi wa-ilayhi l-nushūr
verses.english: He is the One who put the Earth at your service. Roam its corners, and eat from His provisions. To Him is the final summoning.

1981.english: He is the one who subdued the earth for you. Roam its corners and eat from His provisions. Before Him you will be ultimately gathered.

1989.english: He is the One who put the Earth at your service. Roam its corners, and eat from His provisions. To Him is the final summoning.

verses.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verses.arabicClean: أأمنتم من في السماء أن يخسف بكم الأرض فإذا هي تمور
verses.transliterated: a-amintum man fī l-samāi an yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūr
verses.english: Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not strike the earth and cause it to tumble?

1981.english: Did you guarantee that the one in heaven will not cause the earth to crush you as it quakes?

1989.english: Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not strike the earth and cause it to tumble?

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: أم أمنتم من في السماء أن يرسل عليكم حاصبا ۖ فستعلمون كيف نذير
verses.transliterated: am amintum man fī l-samāi an yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr
verses.english: Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not send upon you a violent storm? Will you then appreciate the value of My warning?

1981.english: Did you guarantee that the one in heaven will not send violent wind upon you? Is this not sufficient warning?

1989.english: Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not send upon you a violent storm? Will you then appreciate the value of My warning?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.arabicClean: ولقد كذب الذين من قبلهم فكيف كان نكير
verses.transliterated: walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr
verses.english: Others before them have disbelieved; how terrible was My requital!

1981.english: Others before them have disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!

1989.english: Others before them have disbelieved; how terrible was My requital!

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.arabicClean: أولم يروا إلى الطير فوقهم صافات ويقبضن ۚ ما يمسكهن إلا الرحمن ۚ إنه بكل شيء بصير
verses.transliterated: awalam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīru
verses.english: Have they not seen the birds above them lined up in columns and spreading their wings? The Most Gracious is the One who holds them in the air. He is Seer of all things.

1981.english: Do they not see the birds flying above them, none can stop them except God most gracious? He is the seer of all things.

1989.english: Have they not seen the birds above them lined up in columns and spreading their wings? The Most Gracious is the One who holds them in the air. He is Seer of all things.

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: أمن هذا الذي هو جند لكم ينصركم من دون الرحمن ۚ إن الكافرون إلا في غرور
verses.transliterated: amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni l-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūri
verses.english: Where are those soldiers who can help you against the Most Gracious? Indeed, the disbelievers are deceived.

1981.english: Where are those soldiers who can support you against God most gracious? The disbelievers are really deceived.

1989.english: Where are those soldiers who can help you against the Most Gracious? Indeed, the disbelievers are deceived.

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.arabicClean: أمن هذا الذي يرزقكم إن أمسك رزقه ۚ بل لجوا في عتو ونفور
verses.transliterated: amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūri
verses.english: Who is there to provide for you, if He withholds His provisions? Indeed, they have plunged deep into transgression and aversion.

1981.english: Where are those who can provide for you, if God withheld His provisions? Indeed, they have plunged deep into transgression and aversion.

1989.english: Who is there to provide for you, if He withholds His provisions? Indeed, they have plunged deep into transgression and aversion.

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: أفمن يمشي مكبا على وجهه أهدى أمن يمشي سويا على صراط مستقيم
verses.transliterated: afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmi
verses.english: Is one who walks while slumped over on his face better guided, or one who walks straight on the right path?

1981.english: Is one who walks forcibly humiliated better guided; or one who walks straight on the right path?

1989.english: Is one who walks while slumped over on his face better guided, or one who walks straight on the right path?

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هو الذي أنشأكم وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة ۖ قليلا ما تشكرون
verses.transliterated: qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
verses.english: Say, "He is the One who initiated you, and granted you the hearing, the eyes, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative."

1981.english: Say, "He is the one who initiated you and gave you the hearing, the eyes, and the brains; rarely are you appreciative."

1989.english: Say, “He is the One who initiated you, and granted you the hearing, the eyes, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قل هو الذي ذرأكم في الأرض وإليه تحشرون
verses.transliterated: qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.english: Say, "He is the One who placed you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned."

1981.english: Say, "He is the one who spread you through the earth, and before Him you will be gathered."

1989.english: Say, “He is the One who placed you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned.”

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صادقين
verses.transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.english: They challenge: "When will that prophecy come to pass, if you are truthful?"

1981.english: They say, "When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?"

1989.english: They challenge: “When will that prophecy come to pass, if you are truthful?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: قل إنما العلم عند الله وإنما أنا نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: Say, "Such knowledge is with GOD; I am no more than a manifest warner."

1981.english: Say, "The knowledge thereof is only with God. I am no more than a warner."

1989.english: Say, “Such knowledge is with GOD; I am no more than a manifest warner.”

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأوه زلفة سيئت وجوه الذين كفروا وقيل هذا الذي كنتم به تدعون
verses.transliterated: falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūn
verses.english: When they see it happening, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn miserable, and it will be proclaimed: "This is what you used to mock."

1981.english: When they see it coming, the faces of those who disbelieved will be miserable. They will be told, "This is what you asked for."

1989.english: When they see it happening, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn miserable, and it will be proclaimed: “This is what you used to mock.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن أهلكني الله ومن معي أو رحمنا فمن يجير الكافرين من عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: Say, "Whether GOD decides to annihilate me and those with me, or to shower us with His mercy, who is there to protect the disbelievers from a painful retribution?"

1981.english: Say, "What if God decided to destroy me and those who follow me, or to have mercy on us, who is there to protect the disbelievers from painful retribution?"

1989.english: Say, “Whether GOD decides to annihilate me and those with me, or to shower us with His mercy, who is there to protect the disbelievers from a painful retribution?”

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: قل هو الرحمن آمنا به وعليه توكلنا ۖ فستعلمون من هو في ضلال مبين
verses.transliterated: qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīni
verses.english: Say, "He is the Most Gracious; we believe in Him, and we trust in Him. You will surely find out who is really far astray."

1981.english: Say, "He is God most gracious; we believe in Him, and trust in Him. You will find out which of us is really wrong."

1989.english: Say, “He is the Most Gracious; we believe in Him, and we trust in Him. You will surely find out who is really far astray.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: قل أرأيتم إن أصبح ماؤكم غورا فمن يأتيكم بماء معين
verses.transliterated: qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīni
verses.english: Say, "What if your water sinks away, who will provide you with pure water?"

1981.english: Say, "What if your water sinks deeper and deeper; who can bring you fresh water?"

1989.english: Say, “What if your water sinks away, who will provide you with pure water?”

verses.arabic: نُونْ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ن ۚ والقلم وما يسطرون
verses.transliterated: noon wal-qalami wamā yasṭurūn
verses.english: NuN, the pen, and what they (the people) write.
verses.footnote: "NuN" is unique among the Quran's miraculous initials. See Appendix 1.

1981.english: N,* and the pen, and everything they write.
1981.footnote: This is the only N-initiated sura. This letter occurs in this sura 133 times, or 19 x 7. See Appendix 1 for details of the Arabic test of the Quran's miraculous numerical code.

1989.english: NuN,* the pen, and what they (the people) write.
1989.footnote: “NuN” is unique among the Quran’s miraculous initials. See Appendix 1.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: ما أنت بنعمة ربك بمجنون
verses.transliterated: mā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bimajnūni
verses.english: You have attained a great blessing from your Lord; you are not crazy.

1981.english: You (Muhammad) are not unappreciative of your Lord's blessings.

1989.english: You have attained a great blessing from your Lord; you are not crazy.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإن لك لأجرا غير ممنون
verses.transliterated: wa-inna laka la-ajran ghayra mamnūni
verses.english: You have attained a recompense that is well deserved.

1981.english: And you will receive a well deserved recompense.

1989.english: You have attained a recompense that is well deserved.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: وإنك لعلى خلق عظيم
verses.transliterated: wa-innaka laʿalā khuluqin ʿaẓīmi
verses.english: You are blessed with a great moral character.

1981.english: And you are endowed with a great character.

1989.english: You are blessed with a great moral character.

verses.arabic: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فستبصر ويبصرون
verses.transliterated: fasatub'ṣiru wayub'ṣirūn
verses.english: You will see, and they will see.

1981.english: You will see, and they will see,

1989.english: You will see, and they will see.

verses.arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
verses.arabicClean: بأييكم المفتون
verses.transliterated: bi-ayyikumu l-maftūn
verses.english: Which of you are condemned.

1981.english: which of you is deceived.

1989.english: Which of you are condemned.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو أعلم بالمهتدين
verses.transliterated: inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīn
verses.english: Your Lord is fully aware of those who strayed off His path, and He is fully aware of those who are guided.

1981.english: Your Lord is fully aware who is straying off His path and who is guided.

1989.english: Your Lord is fully aware of those who strayed off His path, and He is fully aware of those who are guided.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا تطع المكذبين
verses.transliterated: falā tuṭiʿi l-mukadhibīn
verses.english: Do not obey the rejectors.

1981.english: You shall not obey the rejectors.

1989.english: Do not obey the rejectors.

verses.arabic: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ودوا لو تدهن فيدهنون
verses.transliterated: waddū law tud'hinu fayud'hinūn
verses.english: They wish that you compromise, so they too can compromise.

1981.english: They wish that you deviate, so they can deviate.

1989.english: They wish that you compromise, so they too can compromise.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين
verses.transliterated: walā tuṭiʿ kulla ḥallāfin mahīni
verses.english: Do not obey every lowly swearer.

1981.english: Nor shall you obey any lowly swearer.

1989.english: Do not obey every lowly swearer.

verses.arabic: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: هماز مشاء بنميم
verses.transliterated: hammāzin mashāin binamīmi
verses.english: A slanderer, a backbiter.

1981.english: Who backbites and creates discord among the people.

1989.english: A slanderer, a backbiter.

verses.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: مناع للخير معتد أثيم
verses.transliterated: mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin athīmi
verses.english: Forbidder of charity, a transgressor, a sinner.

1981.english: A forbidder of charity; a transgressor, a sinner.

1989.english: Forbidder of charity, a transgressor, a sinner.

verses.arabic: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: عتل بعد ذلك زنيم
verses.transliterated: autullin baAAda thalika zaneemin
verses.english: Unappreciative, and greedy.

1981.english: Besides all this, he is greedy and unappreciative.

1989.english: Unappreciative, and greedy.

verses.arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أن كان ذا مال وبنين
verses.transliterated: an kāna dhā mālin wabanīn
verses.english: Even though he possessed enough money and children.

1981.english: Despite the blessings of money and children,

1989.english: Even though he possessed enough money and children.

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إذا تتلى عليه آياتنا قال أساطير الأولين
verses.transliterated: idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.english: When our revelations are recited to him, he says, "Tales from the past!"

1981.english: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, "Tales from the past."

1989.english: When our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Tales from the past!”

verses.arabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
verses.arabicClean: سنسمه على الخرطوم
verses.transliterated: sanasimuhu ʿalā l-khur'ṭūm
verses.english: We will mark his face.

1981.english: We will brand him on the nose.

1989.english: We will mark his face.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إنا بلوناهم كما بلونا أصحاب الجنة إذ أقسموا ليصرمنها مصبحين
verses.transliterated: innā balawnāhum kamā balawnā aṣḥāba l-janati idh aqsamū layaṣrimunnahā muṣ'biḥīn
verses.english: We have tested them like we tested the owners of the garden who swore that they will harvest it in the morning.

1981.english: We have put them to the test, the same as the owners of the garden who swore with certainty that they will harvest the next morning.

1989.english: We have tested them like we tested the owners of the garden who swore that they will harvest it in the morning.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يستثنون
verses.transliterated: walā yastathnūn
verses.english: They were so absolutely sure.

1981.english: They had no doubts.

1989.english: They were so absolutely sure.

verses.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون
verses.transliterated: faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāifun min rabbika wahum nāimūn
verses.english: A passing (storm) from your Lord passed by it while they were asleep.

1981.english: However, a tornado from your Lord wiped it out while they slept.

1989.english: A passing (storm) from your Lord passed by it while they were asleep.

verses.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فأصبحت كالصريم
verses.transliterated: fa-aṣbaḥat kal-ṣarīm
verses.english: By morning, it was barren.

1981.english: By morning, it was like empty sticks.

1989.english: By morning, it was barren.

verses.arabic: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فتنادوا مصبحين
verses.transliterated: fatanādaw muṣ'biḥīn
verses.english: They called on each other in the morning.

1981.english: When they got up, they called on each other;

1989.english: They called on each other in the morning.

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أن اغدوا على حرثكم إن كنتم صارمين
verses.transliterated: ani igh'dū ʿalā ḥarthikum in kuntum ṣārimīn
verses.english: "Let us harvest the crop."

1981.english: to go harvest their crop.

1989.english: “Let us harvest the crop.”

verses.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فانطلقوا وهم يتخافتون
verses.transliterated: fa-inṭalaqū wahum yatakhāfatūn
verses.english: On their way, they confided to each other.

1981.english: As they went, they thought,

1989.english: On their way, they confided to each other.

verses.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: أن لا يدخلنها اليوم عليكم مسكين
verses.transliterated: an lā yadkhulannahā l-yawma ʿalaykum mis'kīnu
verses.english: That from then on, none of them would be poor.

1981.english: "None of us will be poor as of today."

1989.english: That from then on, none of them woi,w ^ nr*™

verses.arabic: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَٰدِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وغدوا على حرد قادرين
verses.transliterated: waghadaw ʿalā ḥardin qādirīn
verses.english: They were so absolutely sure of their harvest.

1981.english: They were so sure.

1989.english: They were so absolutely sure of their harvest.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلما رأوها قالوا إنا لضالون
verses.transliterated: falammā ra-awhā qālū innā laḍāllūn
verses.english: But when they saw it, they said, "We were so wrong!

1981.english: But when they saw it, they said "We were wrong.

1989.english: But when they saw it, they said, “We were so wrong!

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل نحن محرومون
verses.transliterated: bal naḥnu maḥrūmūn
verses.english: "Now, we have nothing!"

1981.english: "We have been deprived."

1989.english: “Now, we have nothing!”

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.arabicClean: قال أوسطهم ألم أقل لكم لولا تسبحون
verses.transliterated: qāla awsaṭuhum alam aqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūn
verses.english: The righteous among them said, "If only you had glorified (GOD)!"
verses.subtitle: They Should Have Said: "God Willing."

1981.english: The most righteous among them said, "Did I not tell you to worship?"

1989.english: The righteous among them said, “If only you had glorified (God)!”
1989.subtitle: They Should Have Said: “God Willing. ”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا سبحان ربنا إنا كنا ظالمين
verses.transliterated: qālū sub'ḥāna rabbinā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.english: They said, "Glory be to our Lord. We have transgressed."

1981.english: They said, "Glory be to our Lord. We were really wrong."

1989.english: They said, “Glory be to our Lord. We have transgressed.”

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتلاومون
verses.transliterated: fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatalāwamūn
verses.english: They started to blame each other.

1981.english: They started to blame each other.

1989.english: They started to blame each other.

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا يا ويلنا إنا كنا طاغين
verses.transliterated: qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ṭāghīn
verses.english: They said, "Woe to us. We sinned.

1981.english: They said, "Woe to us, we were transgressors."

1989.english: They said, “Woe to us. We sinned.

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: عسى ربنا أن يبدلنا خيرا منها إنا إلى ربنا راغبون
verses.transliterated: aasa rabbuna an yubdilanakhayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona
verses.english: "May our Lord grant us a better one. We repent to our Lord."

1981.english: "Maybe our Lord will give us a better one. We now turn to our Lord."

1989.english: “May our Lord grant us a better one. We repent to our Lord.”

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك العذاب ۖ ولعذاب الآخرة أكبر ۚ لو كانوا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: kadhālika l-ʿadhābu walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Such was the requital. But the retribution of the Hereafter is far worse, if they only knew.

1981.english: Such was their punishment; and the retribution of the hereafter is far worse, if they only knew.

1989.english: Such was the requital. But the retribution of the Hereafter is far worse, if they only knew.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إن للمتقين عند ربهم جنات النعيم
verses.transliterated: inna lil'muttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti l-naʿīm
verses.english: The righteous have deserved, at their Lord, gardens of bliss.

1981.english: The righteous have deserved the gardens of bliss at the Lord.

1989.english: The righteous have deserved, at their Lord, gardens of bliss.

verses.arabic: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أفنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين
verses.transliterated: afanajʿalu l-mus'limīna kal-muj'rimīn
verses.english: Shall we treat the submitters like the criminals?

1981.english: Shall we treat the submitters like the guilty?

1989.english: Shall we treat the Muslims like the criminals?

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
verses.transliterated: mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūn
verses.english: What is wrong with your logic?

1981.english: What is wrong with you? How do you judge?

1989.english: What is wrong with your logic?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم لكم كتاب فيه تدرسون
verses.transliterated: am lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūn
verses.english: Do you have another book to uphold?

1981.english: Do you have another book that you apply?

1989.english: Do you have another book to uphold?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن لكم فيه لما تخيرون
verses.transliterated: inna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūn
