verses.english: In it, do you find anything you want?

1981.english: One that gives you anything you want?
1981.footnote: Those who blasphemed against the prophet by inventing "hadith," can find anything they want in "hadith." They strongly defend and uphold "hadith" because it conveniently fits their traditions and personal desires.

1989.english: In it, do you find anything you want?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم لكم أيمان علينا بالغة إلى يوم القيامة ۙ إن لكم لما تحكمون
verses.transliterated: am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūn
verses.english: Or, have you received solemn assurances from us that grant you whatever you wish on the Day of Resurrection?

1981.english: Did you take certain pledges from us to be fulfilled on the day of resurrection? This is your wishful thinking.

1989.english: Or, have you received solemn assurances from us that grant you whatever you wish on the Day of Resurrection?

verses.arabic: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: سلهم أيهم بذلك زعيم
verses.transliterated: salhum ayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmu
verses.english: Ask them, "Who guarantees this for you?"

1981.english: Ask them who guarantees anything for them.

1989.english: Ask them, “Who guarantees this for you?”

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: أم لهم شركاء فليأتوا بشركائهم إن كانوا صادقين
verses.transliterated: am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīn
verses.english: Do they have idols? Let their idols help them, if they are truthful.

1981.english: Do they have idols (who will help them)? Let them call their idols, if they are truthful.

1989.english: Do they have idols? Let their idols help them, if they are truthful.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يكشف عن ساق ويدعون إلى السجود فلا يستطيعون
verses.transliterated: yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūn
verses.english: The day will come when they will be exposed, and they will be required to fall prostrate, but they will be unable to.

1981.english: The day will come when everything will be exposed; they will be required to fall prostrate, but they will be unable.

1989.english: The day will come when they will be exposed, and they will be required to fall prostrate, but they will be unable to.

verses.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: خاشعة أبصارهم ترهقهم ذلة ۖ وقد كانوا يدعون إلى السجود وهم سالمون
verses.transliterated: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūn
verses.english: With their eyes subdued, humiliation will cover them. They were invited to fall prostrate when they were whole and able.

1981.english: Their eyes will be humbled and disgrace will envelope them. They had been asked to fall prostrate when they were able.

1989.english: With their eyes subdued, humiliation will cover them. They were invited to fall prostrate when they were whole and able.

verses.arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فذرني ومن يكذب بهذا الحديث ۖ سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون
verses.transliterated: fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Therefore, let Me deal with those who reject this Hadith; we will lead them on whence they never perceive.

1981.english: Let Me deal with the rejectors of this **hadith** (narration); we will lead them on without them ever realizing it.

1989.english: Therefore, let Me deal with those who reject this Hadith; we will lead them on whence they never perceive.

verses.arabic: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: وأملي لهم ۚ إن كيدي متين
verses.transliterated: wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnu
verses.english: I will give them enough rope; My scheming is formidable.

1981.english: I encourage them and lead them on. My scheme is formidable.

1989.english: I will give them enough rope; My scheming is formidable.

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم تسألهم أجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
verses.transliterated: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūn
verses.english: Are you asking them for money, so they are burdened by the fine?

1981.english: Are you asking them for a wage that burdens them?

1989.english: Are you asking them for money, so they are burdened by the fine?

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أم عندهم الغيب فهم يكتبون
verses.transliterated: am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūn
verses.english: Do they know the future? Do they have it recorded?

1981.english: Do they know the future and manipulate it?

1989.english: Do they know the future? Do they have it recorded?

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الحوت إذ نادى وهو مكظوم
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmu
verses.english: You shall steadfastly persevere in carrying out the commands of your Lord. Do not be like (Jonah) who called from inside the fish.

1981.english: You shall be steadfast in upholding your Lord's commandments, and do not be like the one who called from confinement inside the fish (Jonah).

1989.english: You shall steadfastly persevere in carrying out the commands of your Lord. Do not be like (Jonah) who called from inside the fish.

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
verses.arabicClean: لولا أن تداركه نعمة من ربه لنبذ بالعراء وهو مذموم
verses.transliterated: lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmu
verses.english: If it were not for his Lord's grace, he would have been ejected into the desert as a sinner.

1981.english: If it were not for a blessing from his Lord, he would have been ejected into the wilderness.

1989.english: If it were not for his Lord’s grace, he would have been ejected into the desert as a sinner.

verses.arabic: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فاجتباه ربه فجعله من الصالحين
verses.transliterated: fa-ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verses.english: But his Lord blessed him, and made him righteous.

1981.english: But his Lord redeemed him and counted him with the righteous.

1989.english: But his Lord blessed him, and made him righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإن يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بأبصارهم لما سمعوا الذكر ويقولون إنه لمجنون
verses.transliterated: wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnu
verses.english: Those who disbelieved show their ridicule in their eyes when they hear the message and say, "He is crazy!"

1981.english: Those who disbelieve show their ridicule when they look at you. As they hear the message, they say, "He is really crazy."

1989.english: Those who disbelieved show their ridicule in their eyes when they hear the message and say, “He is crazy!”

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما هو إلا ذكر للعالمين
verses.transliterated: wamā huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīn
verses.english: It is in fact a message to the world.

1981.english: Though it is truly a message for all the people.

1989.english: It is in fact a message to the world.

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحاقة
verses.transliterated: al-ḥāqat
verses.english: The incontestable (event).

1981.english: The reality.

1989.english: The incontestable (event).

verses.arabic: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.arabicClean: ما الحاقة
verses.transliterated: mā l-ḥāqat
verses.english: What an incontestable (event)!

1981.english: What a reality!

1989.english: What an incontestable (event)l

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما الحاقة
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-ḥāqat
verses.english: It is truly incontestable.

1981.english: Do you have any idea what the reality is?

1989.english: It is truly incontestable.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
verses.arabicClean: كذبت ثمود وعاد بالقارعة
verses.transliterated: kadhabat thamūdu waʿādun bil-qāriʿat
verses.english: Thamûd and 'Ãd disbelieved in the Shocker.

1981.english: Thamood and 'Aad disbelieved in the shocker.

1989.english: Thamoud and Aad disbelieved in the Shocker.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
verses.arabicClean: فأما ثمود فأهلكوا بالطاغية
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā thamūdu fa-uh'likū bil-ṭāghiyat
verses.english: As for Thamûd, they were annihilated by the devastating (quake).

1981.english: As for Thamood, they were destroyed by the overwhelming (quake).

1989.english: As for Thamoud, they were annihilated by the devastating (quake).

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: وأما عاد فأهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتية
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā ʿādun fa-uh'likū birīḥin ṣarṣarin ʿātiyati
verses.english: As for 'Ãd, they were annihilated by a persistent, violent storm.

1981.english: While 'Aad were destroyed by violent, miserable wind.

1989.english: As for Aad, they were annihilated by a persistent, violent storm.

verses.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: سخرها عليهم سبع ليال وثمانية أيام حسوما فترى القوم فيها صرعى كأنهم أعجاز نخل خاوية
verses.transliterated: sakharahā ʿalayhim sabʿa layālin wathamāniyata ayyāmin ḥusūman fatarā l-qawma fīhā ṣarʿā ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin khāwiyati
verses.english: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, violently. You could see the people tossed around like decayed palm trunks.

1981.english: God sent it upon them for seven nights and eight days, ceaselessly. You could see the people tossed around like decaying palm trunks.

1989.english: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, violently. You could see the people tossed around like decayed palm trunks.

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: فهل ترى لهم من باقية
verses.transliterated: fahal tarā lahum min bāqiyati
verses.english: Can you find any trace of them?

1981.english: Can you find any trace of them?

1989.english: Can you find any trace of them?

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.arabicClean: وجاء فرعون ومن قبله والمؤتفكات بالخاطئة
verses.transliterated: wajāa fir'ʿawnu waman qablahu wal-mu'tafikātu bil-khāṭi-at
verses.english: Pharaoh, others before him, and the sinners (of Sodom) were wicked.

1981.english: Pharaoh, others before him, and the communities (of Sodom and Gomorrah) committed evil.

1989.english: Pharaoh, others before him, and the sinners (of Sodom) were wicked.

verses.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.arabicClean: فعصوا رسول ربهم فأخذهم أخذة رابية
verses.transliterated: faʿaṣaw rasūla rabbihim fa-akhadhahum akhdhatan rābiyata
verses.english: They disobeyed the messenger of their Lord. Consequently, He requited them a devastating requital.

1981.english: They disobeyed the messenger of their Lord. Consequently, God afflicted them with a devastating retribution.

1989.english: They disobeyed the messenger of their Lord. Consequently, He requited them a devastating requital.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.arabicClean: إنا لما طغى الماء حملناكم في الجارية
verses.transliterated: innā lammā ṭaghā l-māu ḥamalnākum fī l-jāriyat
verses.english: The flood was devastating, so we carried you on the floating (ark).

1981.english: When the flood water rose, we carried you in the ark.

1989.english: The flood was devastating, so we carried you on the floating (Ark).

verses.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: لنجعلها لكم تذكرة وتعيها أذن واعية
verses.transliterated: linajʿalahā lakum tadhkiratan wataʿiyahā udhunun wāʿiyatu
verses.english: We rendered it a lesson for you, that any listening ear may understand.

1981.english: We made it a lesson for you, and every alert ear will hearken.

1989.english: We rendered it a lesson for you, that any listening ear may understand.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا نفخ في الصور نفخة واحدة
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri nafkhatun wāḥidatu
verses.english: When the horn is blown once.

1981.english: When the horn is blown once.
1981.subtitle: The Day Of Resurrection

1989.english: When the horn is blown once.

verses.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
verses.arabicClean: وحملت الأرض والجبال فدكتا دكة واحدة
verses.transliterated: waḥumilati l-arḍu wal-jibālu fadukkatā dakkatan wāḥidata
verses.english: The earth and the mountains will be carried off and crushed; utterly crushed.

1981.english: And the earth and the mountains are carried off and crushed in one blow.

1989.english: The earth and the mountains will be carried off and crushed; utterly crushed.

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verses.arabicClean: فيومئذ وقعت الواقعة
verses.transliterated: fayawma-idhin waqaʿati l-wāqiʿat
verses.english: That is the day when the inevitable event will come to pass.

1981.english: That is when the inevitable day will come to pass.

1989.english: That is the day when the inevitable event will come to pass.

verses.arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: وانشقت السماء فهي يومئذ واهية
verses.transliterated: wa-inshaqqati l-samāu fahiya yawma-idhin wāhiyatu
verses.english: The heaven will crack, and fall apart.

1981.english: The heaven will shatter into fragments.

1989.english: The heaven will crack, and fall apart.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: والملك على أرجائها ۚ ويحمل عرش ربك فوقهم يومئذ ثمانية
verses.transliterated: wal-malaku ʿalā arjāihā wayaḥmilu ʿarsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-idhin thamāniyatu
verses.english: The angels will be all around, and Your Lord's dominion will then encompass eight (universes).
verses.footnote: This earth is full of misery because of its physical distance from God, since it is in the seventh universe (7:143). In the Hereafter, an eighth universe will be created that will be even farther than our seventh universe; it will be called "Hell" (89:23).

1981.english: The angels will be all around. Above them, eight will carry the throne of your Lord.

1989.english: The angels will be all around, and Your Lord’s dominion will then encompass eight (universes) *
1989.footnote: This earth is full of misery because of its physical distance from God, since it is in the seventh universe (7:143). In the Hereafter, an eighth universe will be created that will be even farther than our seventh universe; it will be called “Hell” (89:23)

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: يومئذ تعرضون لا تخفى منكم خافية
verses.transliterated: yawma-idhin tuʿ'raḍūna lā takhfā minkum khāfiyatu
verses.english: On that day, you will be exposed, nothing of you can be hidden.

1981.english: On that day, you will be exposed; nothing will be hidden.

1989.english: On that day, you will be exposed, nothing of you can be hidden.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: فأما من أوتي كتابه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم اقرءوا كتابيه
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi fayaqūlu hāumu iq'raū kitābiya
verses.english: As for the one who receives his record with his right hand, he will say, "Come read my record.
verses.subtitle: The Believers

1981.english: As for the one who receives his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here is my record; read it.

1989.english: As for the one who receives his record with his right hand, he will say, “Come read my record.
1989.subtitle: The Believers

verses.arabic: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: إني ظننت أني ملاق حسابيه
verses.transliterated: innī ẓanantu annī mulāqin ḥisābiya
verses.english: "I did believe that I was going to be held accountable."

1981.english: "I expected to be held accountable."

1989.english: “I did believe that I was going to be held accountable.”

verses.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: فهو في عيشة راضية
verses.transliterated: fahuwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyati
verses.english: He has deserved a happy life.

1981.english: He has deserved a happy life.

1989.english: He has deserved a happy life.

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: في جنة عالية
verses.transliterated: fī jannatin ʿāliyati
verses.english: In an exalted Paradise.

1981.english: In an exalted garden.

1989.english: In an exalted Paradise.

verses.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: قطوفها دانية
verses.transliterated: quṭūfuhā dāniyatu
verses.english: Its fruits are within reach.

1981.english: Where the fruits are within reach.

1989.english: Its fruits are within reach.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.arabicClean: كلوا واشربوا هنيئا بما أسلفتم في الأيام الخالية
verses.transliterated: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā aslaftum fī l-ayāmi l-khāliyat
verses.english: Eat and drink happily in return for your works in days past.

1981.english: Eat and drink happily because of your works in the past days.

1989.english: Eat and drink happily in return for your works in days past.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: وأما من أوتي كتابه بشماله فيقول يا ليتني لم أوت كتابيه
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu bishimālihi fayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ūta kitābiya
verses.english: As for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I never received my record.
verses.subtitle: The Disbelievers

1981.english: As for the one who receives his record in the left hand, he will say, "I wish I never received my record;

1989.english: As for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, “Oh, I wish I never received my record.
1989.subtitle: The Disbelievers

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: ولم أدر ما حسابيه
verses.transliterated: walam adri mā ḥisābiya
verses.english: "I wish I never knew my account.

1981.english: "I wish I never found out.

1989.english: “I wish I never knew my account.

verses.arabic: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
verses.arabicClean: يا ليتها كانت القاضية
verses.transliterated: yālaytahā kānati l-qāḍiyat
verses.english: "I wish my death was eternal.

1981.english: "I wish my death was permanent.

1989.english: “I wish my death was eternal.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: ما أغنى عني ماليه ۜ
verses.transliterated: mā aghnā ʿannī māliya
verses.english: "My money cannot help me.

1981.english: "My money cannot help me now.

1989.english: “My money cannot help me.

verses.arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: هلك عني سلطانيه
verses.transliterated: halaka ʿannī sul'ṭāniya
verses.english: "All my power is gone."

1981.english: "All my power is gone."

1989.english: “All my power is gone.”

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
verses.arabicClean: خذوه فغلوه
verses.transliterated: khudhūhu faghullūh
verses.english: Take him and shackle him.

1981.english: Take him and tie him up.

1989.english: Take him and shackle him.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
verses.arabicClean: ثم الجحيم صلوه
verses.transliterated: thumma l-jaḥīma ṣallūh
verses.english: Burn him in Hell.

1981.english: Then burn him in hell.

1989.english: Burn him in Hell.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.arabicClean: ثم في سلسلة ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فاسلكوه
verses.transliterated: thumma fī sil'silatin dharʿuhā sabʿūna dhirāʿan fa-us'lukūh
verses.english: In a chain that is seventy arms long, tie him up.

1981.english: Then in a chain that is seventy arms long, wrap him up.

1989.english: In a chain that is seventy arms long, tie him up.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: إنه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم
verses.transliterated: innahu kāna lā yu'minu bil-lahi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: For he did not believe in GOD, Most Great.

1981.english: He refused to believe in God, the great.

1989.english: For he did not believe in GOD, Most Great.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحض على طعام المسكين
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīn
verses.english: Nor did he advocate the feeding of the poor.

1981.english: He did not advocate feeding the poor.

1989.english: Nor did he advocate the feeding of the poor.

verses.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: فليس له اليوم هاهنا حميم
verses.transliterated: falaysa lahu l-yawma hāhunā ḥamīmu
verses.english: Consequently, he has no friend here.

1981.english: Consequently, he has no ally.

1989.english: Consequently, he has no friend here.

verses.arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ولا طعام إلا من غسلين
verses.transliterated: walā ṭaʿāmun illā min ghis'līni
verses.english: Nor any food, except the bitter variety.

1981.english: And no food, except the bitter variety.

1989.english: Nor any food, except the bitter variety.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ
verses.arabicClean: لا يأكله إلا الخاطئون
verses.transliterated: lā yakuluhu illā l-khāṭiūn
verses.english: Food for the sinners.

1981.english: Only the sinners eat therefrom.

1989.english: Food for the sinners.

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا أقسم بما تبصرون
verses.transliterated: falā uq'simu bimā tub'ṣirūn
verses.english: I swear by what you see.

1981.english: I solemnly swear by the things you see.

1989.english: I swear by what you see.

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما لا تبصرون
verses.transliterated: wamā lā tub'ṣirūn
verses.english: And what you do not see.

1981.english: And the things you do not see.

1989.english: And what you do not see.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: إنه لقول رسول كريم
verses.transliterated: innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmi
verses.english: This is the utterance of an honorable messenger.

1981.english: This is the utterance of an honorable messenger.

1989.english: This is the utterance of an honorable messenger.

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وما هو بقول شاعر ۚ قليلا ما تؤمنون
verses.transliterated: wamā huwa biqawli shāʿirin qalīlan mā tu'minūn
verses.english: Not the utterance of a poet; rarely do you believe.

1981.english: It is not the utterance of a poet; however, rarely do you believe.

1989.english: Not the utterance of a poet; rarely do you believe.

verses.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا بقول كاهن ۚ قليلا ما تذكرون
verses.transliterated: walā biqawli kāhinin qalīlan mā tadhakkarūn
verses.english: Nor the utterance of a soothsayer; rarely do you take heed.

1981.english: Nor is it the utterance of a soothsayer; rarely do you take heed.

1989.english: Nor the utterance of soothsayer; rarely do you take heed.

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: تنزيل من رب العالمين
verses.transliterated: tanzīlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.english: A revelation from the Lord of the universe.

1981.english: It is a revelation from the Lord of the universe.

1989.english: A revelation from the Lord of the universe.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
verses.arabicClean: ولو تقول علينا بعض الأقاويل
verses.transliterated: walaw taqawwala ʿalaynā baʿḍa l-aqāwīl
verses.english: Had he uttered any other teachings.
verses.subtitle: Muhammad Forbidden from Issuing Any Religious Teachings

1981.english: If he ever made up any utterances and attributed them to us,

1989.english: Had he uttered any other teachings.
1989.subtitle: Muhammad Forbidden from Issuing Any Religious Teachings

verses.arabic: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.arabicClean: لأخذنا منه باليمين
verses.transliterated: la-akhadhnā min'hu bil-yamīn
verses.english: We would have punished him.

1981.english: we would immediately punish him,

1989.english: We would have punished him.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم لقطعنا منه الوتين
verses.transliterated: thumma laqaṭaʿnā min'hu l-watīn
verses.english: We would have stopped the revelations to him.

1981.english: and stop the revelation to him.

1989.english: We would have stopped the revelations to him.

verses.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فما منكم من أحد عنه حاجزين
verses.transliterated: famā minkum min aḥadin ʿanhu ḥājizīn
verses.english: None of you could have helped him.

1981.english: None of you can protect him then.

1989.english: None of you could have helped him.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه لتذكرة للمتقين
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu latadhkiratun lil'muttaqīn
verses.english: This is a reminder for the righteous.

1981.english: This is a reminder for the righteous.

1989.english: This is a reminder for the righteous.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنا لنعلم أن منكم مكذبين
verses.transliterated: wa-innā lanaʿlamu anna minkum mukadhibīn
verses.english: We know; some of you are rejectors.

1981.english: We fully realize that some of you are rejectors.

1989.english: We know; some of you are rejectors.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه لحسرة على الكافرين
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu laḥasratun ʿalā l-kāfirīn
verses.english: It is but sorrow for the disbelievers.

1981.english: It is but a curse that afflicts the disbelievers.

1989.english: It is but sorrow for the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه لحق اليقين
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu laḥaqqu l-yaqīn
verses.english: It is the absolute truth.

1981.english: This is the absolute truth.

1989.english: It is the absolute truth.

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
verses.transliterated: fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīm
verses.english: Therefore, you shall glorify the name of your Lord, Most Great.

1981.english: Therefore, you shall glorify the name of your Lord, the great.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall glorify the name of your Lord, Most Great.

verses.arabic: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سأل سائل بعذاب واقع
verses.transliterated: sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿi
verses.english: A questioner may question the inevitable retribution.

1981.english: A questioner questioned the inevitable retribution.

1989.english: A questioner may question the inevitable retribution.

verses.arabic: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
verses.arabicClean: للكافرين ليس له دافع
verses.transliterated: lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿu
verses.english: For the disbelievers, none can stop it.

1981.english: For the disbelievers, nothing can stop it.

1989.english: For the disbelievers, none can stop it.

verses.arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
verses.arabicClean: من الله ذي المعارج
verses.transliterated: mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿārij
verses.english: From GOD; Possessor of the highest Height.

1981.english: It will come from God, who possesses the highest heights.

1989.english: From GOD; Possessor of the highest Height.

verses.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: تعرج الملائكة والروح إليه في يوم كان مقداره خمسين ألف سنة
verses.transliterated: taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanati
verses.english: The angels and the Spirit, with their reports, climb to Him in a day that equals fifty thousand years.

1981.english: The angels and the spirit climb to Him in a day that equals fifty thousand years.

1989.english: The angels, with their reports, climb to Him in a day that equals Fifty thousand years.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر صبرا جميلا
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir ṣabran jamīla
verses.english: Therefore, you shall resort to a gracious patience.

1981.english: Therefore, be patient, a gracious patience.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall resort to a gracious patience.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا
verses.arabicClean: إنهم يرونه بعيدا
verses.transliterated: innahum yarawnahu baʿīda
verses.english: For they see it far away.

1981.english: They see it far away.

1989.english: For they see it far away.

verses.arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا
verses.arabicClean: ونراه قريبا
verses.transliterated: wanarāhu qarība
verses.english: While we see it very close.

1981.english: While we see it close.

1989.english: While we see it very close.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تكون السماء كالمهل
verses.transliterated: yawma takūnu l-samāu kal-muh'l
verses.english: The day will come when the sky will be like molten rocks.

1981.english: On that day, the heaven will be like lava.

1989.english: The day will come when the sky will be like molten rocks.

verses.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
verses.arabicClean: وتكون الجبال كالعهن
verses.transliterated: watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'n
verses.english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.

1981.english: The mountains will be like wool.

1989.english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: ولا يسأل حميم حميما
verses.transliterated: walā yasalu ḥamīmun ḥamīma
verses.english: No friend will care about his close friend.

1981.english: No friend will care about his friend.

1989.english: No friend will care about his close friend.

verses.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verses.arabicClean: يبصرونهم ۚ يود المجرم لو يفتدي من عذاب يومئذ ببنيه
verses.transliterated: yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīh
verses.english: When they see them, the guilty will wish he could give his own children as ransom, to spare him the retribution of that day.

1981.english: When they see each other, the guilty will wish to ransom himself with his own children.

1989.english: When they see them, the guilty will wish he could give his own children as ransom, to spare him the retribution of that day.

verses.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
verses.arabicClean: وصاحبته وأخيه
verses.transliterated: waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīh
verses.english: Also his spouse, and his brother.

1981.english: And his spouse and siblings.

1989.english: Also his spouse, and his brother.

verses.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
verses.arabicClean: وفصيلته التي تؤويه
verses.transliterated: wafaṣīlatihi allatī tu'wīh
verses.english: Even his whole tribe that raised him.

1981.english: And his tribe that raised him.

1989.english: Even his whole tribe that raised him.

verses.arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن في الأرض جميعا ثم ينجيه
verses.transliterated: waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīh
verses.english: Even all the people on earth, if it would save him.

1981.english: And all the people on earth, if it would save him.

1989.english: Even all the people on earth, if it would save him.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: كلا ۖ إنها لظى
verses.transliterated: kallā innahā laẓ
verses.english: No; it is aflame.

1981.english: No use; there will be hell.

1989.english: No; it is aflame.

verses.arabic: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: نزاعة للشوى
verses.transliterated: nazzāʿatan lilshaw
verses.english: Eager to burn.

1981.english: Eager to burn.

1989.english: Eager to burn.

verses.arabic: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: تدعو من أدبر وتولى
verses.transliterated: tadʿū man adbara watawall
verses.english: It calls on those who turned away.

1981.english: It will summon anyone who turned away and fled.

1989.english: It calls on those who turned away.

verses.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: وجمع فأوعى
verses.transliterated: wajamaʿa fa-awʿ
verses.english: Those who hoarded and counted.

1981.english: Those who hoarded and were stingy.

1989.english: Those who hoarded and counted.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الإنسان خلق هلوعا
verses.transliterated: inna l-insāna khuliqa halūʿa
verses.english: Indeed, the human being is anxious.

1981.english: The human being is naturally emotional.

1989.english: Indeed, the human being is anxious.

verses.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
verses.arabicClean: إذا مسه الشر جزوعا
verses.transliterated: idhā massahu l-sharu jazūʿa
verses.english: If touched by adversity, despondent.

1981.english: When adversity touches him, he becomes despondent.

1989.english: If touched by adversity, despondent.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا مسه الخير منوعا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā massahu l-khayru manūʿa
verses.english: If blessed by wealth, stingy.

1981.english: And when good fortune is his share, he becomes stingy.

1989.english: If blessed by wealth, stingy.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا المصلين
verses.transliterated: illā l-muṣalīn
verses.english: Except for the worshipers.

1981.english: Not so the worshipers, who observe the **salat** prayers.

1989.english: Except for the worshipers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين هم على صلاتهم دائمون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāimūn
verses.english: Who always observe their contact prayers (Salat).

1981.english: They continuously observe their **salat** prayers.

1989.english: Who always observe their contact prayers (Salat).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.arabicClean: والذين في أموالهم حق معلوم
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna fī amwālihim ḥaqqun maʿlūmu
verses.english: Part of their money is set aside.

1981.english: Part of their monies is an assigned right.

1989.english: Part of their money is set aside.

verses.arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.arabicClean: للسائل والمحروم
verses.transliterated: lilssāili wal-maḥrūm
verses.english: For the poor and the needy.

1981.english: For the needy and deprived.

1989.english: For the poor and the needy.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.arabicClean: والذين يصدقون بيوم الدين
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi l-dīn
verses.english: They believe in the Day of Judgment.

1981.english: They believe in the day of judgment.

1989.english: They believe in the Day of Judgment

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūn
verses.english: They reverence their Lord's requital.

1981.english: They are wary of their Lord's retribution.

1989.english: They reverence their Lord’s requital.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن عذاب ربهم غير مأمون
verses.transliterated: inna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru mamūni
verses.english: Their Lord's requital is not taken for granted.

1981.english: The retribution of their Lord is never taken for granted.

1989.english: Their Lord’s requital is not taken for granted.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم لفروجهم حافظون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn
verses.english: They keep their chastity.

1981.english: They maintain their chastity.

1989.english: They keep their chastity.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا على أزواجهم أو ما ملكت أيمانهم فإنهم غير ملومين
verses.transliterated: illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīn
verses.english: (They have relations) only with their spouses, or what is legally theirs—

1981.english: Only with their spouses, or what rightly belongs to them, they have intercourse.

1989.english: (They have relations) only with their spouses, or what is legally theirs—

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فمن ابتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم العادون
verses.transliterated: famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūn
verses.english: anyone who transgresses these limits is a sinner—

1981.english: Anyone who seeks anything beyond this, these are the transgressors.

1989.english: anyone who transgresses these limits is a sinner—

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم لأماناتهم وعهدهم راعون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūn
verses.english: And the believers keep their word; they are trustworthy.

1981.english: They keep their trust and fulfill their vows.

1989.english: And the believers keep their word; they are trustworthy.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم بشهاداتهم قائمون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum bishahādātihim qāimūn
verses.english: Their testimony is truthful.

1981.english: They are equitable when testifying as witnesses.

1989.english: Their testimony is truthful.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والذين هم على صلاتهم يحافظون
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūn
verses.english: They consistently observe their contact prayers (Salat), on time.

1981.english: They consistently observe their **salat** prayers.

1989.english: They consistently observe their contact prayers (Salat), on time.

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: أولئك في جنات مكرمون
verses.transliterated: ulāika fī jannātin muk'ramūn
verses.english: They have deserved a position of honor, in Paradise.

1981.english: They have deserved to be honored in Paradise.

1989.english: They have deserved a position of honor, in Paradise.

verses.arabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
verses.arabicClean: فمال الذين كفروا قبلك مهطعين
verses.transliterated: famāli alladhīna kafarū qibalaka muh'ṭiʿīn
verses.english: What is keeping those who disbelieved from joining you?

1981.english: Why do the disbelievers watch you from afar?

1989.english: What is keeping those who disbelieved from joining you?

verses.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
verses.arabicClean: عن اليمين وعن الشمال عزين
verses.transliterated: aani alyameeni waAAani alshshimaliAAizeena
verses.english: To the right, and to the left, they flee.

1981.english: Then flee to the right and to the left.

1989.english: To the right, and to the left, they flee.

verses.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: أيطمع كل امرئ منهم أن يدخل جنة نعيم
verses.transliterated: ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmi
verses.english: How can any of them expect to enter the blissful Paradise?

1981.english: How could any of them expect to enter the garden of bliss?

1989.english: How can any of them expect to enter the blissful Paradise?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كلا ۖ إنا خلقناهم مما يعلمون
verses.transliterated: kallā innā khalaqnāhum mimmā yaʿlamūn
verses.english: Never; we created them, and they know from what.

1981.english: Never; we created them and they know from what.

1989.english: Never; we created them, and they know from what.

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فلا أقسم برب المشارق والمغارب إنا لقادرون
verses.transliterated: falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūn
verses.english: I solemnly swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests; we are able—

1981.english: Being the Lord of the easts and the wests, we are able

1989.english: I solemnly swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests; we are able—

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.arabicClean: على أن نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين
verses.transliterated: aala an nubaddila khayran minhum wamanahnu bimasbooqeena
verses.english: to substitute better people in their place; we can never be defeated.

1981.english: to substitute better people in their place; we are never helpless.

1989.english: to substitute better people in your place; we can never be defeated.

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
verses.transliterated: fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūn
verses.english: Therefore, let them blunder and play, until they meet the day that is awaiting them.

1981.english: Thus, let them blunder and play, until they meet the day that awaits them.

1989.english: Therefore, let them blunder and play, until they meet the day that is awaiting them.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يخرجون من الأجداث سراعا كأنهم إلى نصب يوفضون
verses.transliterated: yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūn
verses.english: That is the day they come out of the graves in a hurry, as if herded to the (sacrificial) altars.

1981.english: That is the day when they come out of the graves in a hurry, as if rushing to the altars.

1989.english: That is the day they come out of the graves in a hurry, as if herded to the (sacrificial) altars.

verses.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: خاشعة أبصارهم ترهقهم ذلة ۚ ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون
verses.transliterated: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūn
verses.english: With their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. That is the day that is awaiting them.

1981.english: Their eyes will be disgraced, and humiliation will envelope them. This is the day that was promised to them.

1989.english: With their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. That is the day that is awaiting them.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إنا أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه أن أنذر قومك من قبل أن يأتيهم عذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmu
verses.english: We sent Noah to his people: "You shall warn your people before a painful retribution afflicts them."

1981.english: We sent Noah to his people: "You shall warn your people, before painful retribution comes to them."

1989.english: We sent Noah to his people: “You shall warn your people before a painful retribution afflicts them.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.arabicClean: قال يا قوم إني لكم نذير مبين
verses.transliterated: qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnu
verses.english: He said, "O my people, I am a manifest warner to you.

1981.english: He said, "O my people, I come to you as a warner.

1989.english: He said, “O my people, I am a manifest warner to you.

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.arabicClean: أن اعبدوا الله واتقوه وأطيعون
verses.transliterated: ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūn
verses.english: "To alert you that you shall worship GOD, reverence Him, and obey me.

1981.english: "You shall worship God, work righteousness, and obey me.

1989.english: “To alert you that you shall worship GOD, reverence Him, and obey me.

verses.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويؤخركم إلى أجل مسمى ۚ إن أجل الله إذا جاء لا يؤخر ۖ لو كنتم تعلمون
verses.transliterated: yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūn
verses.english: "He will then forgive you your sins and respite you for a predetermined period. Most assuredly, GOD's appointment can never be delayed, once it is due, if you only knew."

1981.english: "God will then forgive your sins and respite you for a predetermined life span. When the interim designated by God is complete, nothing can delay it, if you only knew."

1989.english: “He will then forgive you your sins and respite you for a predetermined period. Most assuredly, GOD’s appointment can never be delayed, once it is due, if you only knew.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
verses.arabicClean: قال رب إني دعوت قومي ليلا ونهارا
verses.transliterated: qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāra
verses.english: He said, "My Lord, I have invited my people night and day.

1981.english: He later said, "Lord, I have preached to my people night and day.

1989.english: He said, “My Lord, I have invited my people night and day.

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.arabicClean: فلم يزدهم دعائي إلا فرارا
verses.transliterated: falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāra
verses.english: "But my invitation only increased their aversion.

1981.english: "But my preaching only increased their fleeing.

1989.english: “But my invitation only increased their aversion.

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
verses.arabicClean: وإني كلما دعوتهم لتغفر لهم جعلوا أصابعهم في آذانهم واستغشوا ثيابهم وأصروا واستكبروا استكبارا
verses.transliterated: wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāra
verses.english: "Whenever I invited them to be forgiven by You, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, insisted, and turned arrogant.

1981.english: "Whenever I exhorted them to seek Your forgiveness, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, and insisted on their arrogance.

1989.english: “Whenever I invited them to be forgiven by You, they placed their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their clothes, insisted, and turned arrogant.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
verses.arabicClean: ثم إني دعوتهم جهارا
verses.transliterated: thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāra
verses.english: "Then I invited them publicly.

1981.english: "Then I preached to them loudly.

1989.english: “Then I invited them publicly.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
verses.arabicClean: ثم إني أعلنت لهم وأسررت لهم إسرارا
verses.transliterated: thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāra
verses.english: "Then I proclaimed to them loudly, and I spoke to them privately.

1981.english: "I preached to them publicly, and I preached to them privately.

1989.english: “Then I proclaimed to them loudly, and I spoke to them privately.

verses.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
verses.arabicClean: فقلت استغفروا ربكم إنه كان غفارا
verses.transliterated: faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāra
verses.english: "I said, 'Implore your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.

1981.english: "I said, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; He is forgiving.

1989.english: “I said, ‘Implore your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.

verses.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
verses.arabicClean: يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا
verses.transliterated: yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāra
verses.english: "'He will then shower you generously with rain.

1981.english: 'He will then shower you with generous rain.

1989.english: “ ‘He will then shower you generously with rain.

verses.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا
verses.arabicClean: ويمددكم بأموال وبنين ويجعل لكم جنات ويجعل لكم أنهارا
verses.transliterated: wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāra
verses.english: " 'And provide you with money and children, and orchards, and streams.' "

1981.english: 'And supply you with money and children; and grant you gardens and rivers.'"

1989.english: “ ‘And provide you with money and children, and orchards, and streams.’ ”

verses.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verses.arabicClean: ما لكم لا ترجون لله وقارا
verses.transliterated: mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāra
verses.english: Why should you not strive to reverence GOD?

1981.english: Why do you not wish to reverence God?

1989.english: Why should you not strive to reverence GOD?

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.arabicClean: وقد خلقكم أطوارا
verses.transliterated: waqad khalaqakum aṭwāra
verses.english: He is the One who created you in stages.

1981.english: He is the one who created you in stages.

1989.english: He is the One who created you in stages.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
verses.arabicClean: ألم تروا كيف خلق الله سبع سماوات طباقا
verses.transliterated: alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqa
verses.english: Do you not realize that GOD created seven universes in layers?

1981.english: Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers?

1989.english: Do you not realize that GOD created seven universes in layers?

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.arabicClean: وجعل القمر فيهن نورا وجعل الشمس سراجا
verses.transliterated: wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirāja
verses.english: He designed the moon therein to be a light, and placed the sun to be a lamp.

1981.english: He placed the moon therein as a light and the sun as a lamp.

1989.english: He designed the moon therein to be a light, and placed the sun to be a lamp.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
verses.arabicClean: والله أنبتكم من الأرض نباتا
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabāta
verses.english: And GOD germinated you from the earth like plants.

1981.english: God is the one who germinated you from the earth, just like plants.

1989.english: And GOD germinated you from the earth like plants.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
verses.arabicClean: ثم يعيدكم فيها ويخرجكم إخراجا
verses.transliterated: thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rāja
verses.english: Then He returns you into it, and He will surely bring you out.

1981.english: Then He will return you to it, then resurrect you.

1989.english: Then He returns you into it, and He will surely bring you out.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
verses.arabicClean: والله جعل لكم الأرض بساطا
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭa
verses.english: GOD made the earth habitable for you.

1981.english: God is the one who made the earth habitable for you.

1989.english: GOD made the earth habitable for you.

verses.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
verses.arabicClean: لتسلكوا منها سبلا فجاجا
verses.transliterated: litaslukū min'hā subulan fijāja
verses.english: That you may build roads therein.

1981.english: That you may establish roads therein.

1989.english: That you may build roads therein.

verses.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.arabicClean: قال نوح رب إنهم عصوني واتبعوا من لم يزده ماله وولده إلا خسارا
verses.transliterated: qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāra
verses.english: Noah said, "My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed those who were even more corrupted when blessed with money and children.

1981.english: Noah said, "Lord, they disobeyed me and followed one who is corrupted by his money and his children.

1989.english: Noah said, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed those who were even more corrupted when blessed with money and children.

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
verses.arabicClean: ومكروا مكرا كبارا
verses.transliterated: wamakarū makran kubbāra
verses.english: "They schemed terrible schemes.

1981.english: "They schemed evil schemes.

1989.english: “They schemed terrible schemes.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
verses.arabicClean: وقالوا لا تذرن آلهتكم ولا تذرن ودا ولا سواعا ولا يغوث ويعوق ونسرا
verses.transliterated: waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasra
verses.english: "They said, 'Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, Suwaa', Yaghouth, Ya'ooq, and Nasr.'

1981.english: "They said, 'Do not abandon your idols; do not abandon Wadd, or Suwa', or Yaghooth, or Ya'ooq, and Nasr.'

1989.english: “They said, ‘Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, Suwaa‘, Yaghouth, Ya‘ooq, and Nasr.’

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًا
verses.arabicClean: وقد أضلوا كثيرا ۖ ولا تزد الظالمين إلا ضلالا
verses.transliterated: waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalāla
verses.english: "They misled many. Therefore, let the wicked plunge deeper into loss."

1981.english: "They misguided many people. (My Lord,) do not increase the wicked except in straying."

1989.english: “They misled many. Therefore, let the wicked plunge deeper into loss.”

verses.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
verses.arabicClean: مما خطيئاتهم أغرقوا فأدخلوا نارا فلم يجدوا لهم من دون الله أنصارا
verses.transliterated: mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāra
verses.english: Because of their sins they were drowned and assigned to the hellfire. They found no helpers to protect them from GOD.

1981.english: Because of their transgressions, they were drowned and destined for hell. They had none to help them against God.

1989.english: Because of their sins they were drowned and assigned to the hellfire. They found no helpers to protect them from GOD.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.arabicClean: وقال نوح رب لا تذر على الأرض من الكافرين ديارا
verses.transliterated: waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāra
verses.english: Noah also said, "My Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.

1981.english: Noah said, "Lord, do not leave on earth a single disbeliever.

1989.english: Noah also said, “My Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.arabicClean: إنك إن تذرهم يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا إلا فاجرا كفارا
verses.transliterated: innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāra
verses.english: "For if you let them, they will only mislead your servants and give birth to nothing but wicked disbelievers.

1981.english: "If You leave any of them, they only mislead Your servants and give birth to evil disbelievers.

1989.english: “For if you let them, they will only mislead your servants and give birth to nothing but wicked disbelievers.

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

1989.english: If they remain on the right path, we will bless them with abundant water.
1989.footnote: The messenger here is named', mathematically, as “Rashad Khalifa,” to whom God revealed the end of the world (Appendix 25). The number of verses from 1:1 to 72:27, where the messenger is mentioned, is 5472, 19x72x4. The word “Rashada” occurs 4 times in Sura 72. The value of “Rashada” is 504, and 504+28 (verses of Sura 72) is 532, 19x28. The value of “Rashad Khalifa” (1230)+ 72+28=1330 =19x70. The digits of Sura 72 and its number of verses (28) add up to 7+2+2+8=19. Also, the crucial expression, “only to a messenger that He chooses” has a value of 361, 19x19.

verses.english: We will surely test them all. As for him who disregards the message of his Lord, He will direct him to ever increasing retribution.

1981.english: We thus test them. Anyone who disregards the message of his Lord commits him to lasting retribution.

1989.english: We will surely test them all. As for him who disregards the message of his Lord, He will direct him to ever increasing retribution.

verses.transliterated: wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥada

1981.english: The mosques belong to God; do not call on anyone else besides God.

verses.subtitle: God's Messenger of the Covenant

1989.english: When GOD’s servant* advocated Him alone, almost all of them banded together to oppose him.

1981.english: Say, (O Muhammad), "No one can protect me from God, nor can I find any refuge besides Him.

1989.english: Say, “No one can protect me from GOD, nor can I find any other refuge besides Him.

verses.arabicClean: إلا بلاغا من الله ورسالاته ۚ ومن يعص الله ورسوله فإن له نار جهنم خالدين فيها أبدا

1981.english: "My sole mission is to deliver the declaration from God and His messages." Anyone who disobeys God and His messenger has deserved the fire of hell, wherein they abide forever.

1989.english: “I deliver GODproclamations and messages.” Those who disobey GOD and His messenger incur the fire of Hell, wherein they abide forever.

1981.english: When they see what is promised to them, they will find out who is weaker in power and lesser in number.

1989.english: Once they see what is awaiting them, they will find out who is really weaker in power, and fewer in number.

verses.transliterated: qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amada

1981.english: Say, "I have no idea how soon or how far is that which is promised to you."

1989.english: Say, “I do not know if what is promised to you will happen soon, or if my Lord will delay it for awhile.”

verses.english: Only to a messenger that He chooses, does He reveal from the past and the future, specific news.

1981.english: Only the messengers that he chooses may be given certain information concerning the past or the future.
1981.footnote: For example, Joseph was told of some future events (12:15), and Moses' mother was told that her infant will be returned to her, and that he will be a messenger of God (28:7).

1981.english: This is to make sure that they have delivered the messages of their Lord. He is fully aware of what they accomplish, and He is in full control of all things.

verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-muzamil
verses.english: O you cloaked one.

1981.english: O you wrapped up.

1989.english: O you cloaked one.

verses.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: قم الليل إلا قليلا
verses.transliterated: qumi al-layla illā qalīla
verses.english: Meditate during the night, except rarely.

1981.english: Get up to worship during the night, except a little.

1989.english: Meditate during the night, except rarely.

verses.arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

verses.transliterated: niṣ'fahu awi unquṣ min'hu qalīla
verses.english: Half of it, or a little less.

1981.english: Half of it or a little less.

1989.english: Half of it, or a little less.

verses.transliterated: aw zid ʿalayhi warattili l-qur'āna tartīla

1981.english: Or a little more; and recite the Quran frequently.

1989.english: Or a little more. And read the Quran from cover to cover.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا

verses.transliterated: innā sanul'qī ʿalayka qawlan thaqīla
verses.english: We will give you a heavy message.

1981.english: We will deliver to you a heavy message.

1989.english: We will give you a heavy message.

1981.english: The meditation at night is more effective and more powerful.

1989.english: The meditation at night is more effective, and more righteous.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

1989.english: You have a lot of time during the day for other matters.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīla

1981.english: You shall commemorate the name of your Lord and come ever closer to Him.

1989.english: You shall commemorate the name of your Lord, to come ever closer and closer to Him.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا

verses.transliterated: rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-ittakhidh'hu wakīla
verses.english: Lord of the east and the west; there is no other god besides Him. You should choose Him as your advocate.

1981.english: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god except He; therefore, you shall trust in Him.

1989.english: Lord of the east and the west; there is no other god besides Him. You should choose Him as your advocate.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا

verses.transliterated: wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-uh'jur'hum hajran jamīla
verses.english: And remain steadfast in the face of their utterances, and disregard them in a nice manner.

verses.english: Your Lord knows that you meditate during two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, and so do some of those who believed with you. GOD has designed the night and the day, and He knows that you cannot always do this. He has pardoned you. Instead, you shall read what you can of the Quran. He knows that some of you may be ill, others may be traveling in pursuit of GOD's provisions, and others may be striving in the cause of GOD. You shall read what you can of it, and observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and lend GOD a loan of righteousness. Whatever good you send ahead on behalf of your souls, you will find it at GOD far better and generously rewarded. And implore GOD for forgiveness. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

1981.english: Your Lord knows well that you stay up close to two-thirds of the night, sometimes half of it, sometimes one-third of it. Also, some of those who follow you do the same. God has designed the night and the day, and He knows that you cannot do this every night. He pardons you; therefore, you shall recite what you can of the Quran. He knows that some of you may be ill; others may be traveling in search of God's bounties; others may be striving in the cause of God. Therefore, recite what you can of it, observe the **salat** prayers* and give the **zakat** charity, and lend God a loan of righteousness. Whatever good you advance on behalf of your souls, you will find it at God far better and multiplied manyfold. You shall ask God for forgiveness; God is forgiver, most merciful.

1989.english: Your Lord knows that you meditate during two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, and so do some of those who believed with you. GOD has designed the night and the day, and He knows that you cannot always do this. He has pardoned you. Instead, you shall read what you can of the Quran. He knows that some of you may be ill, others may be traveling in pursuit of GOD’s provisions, and others may be striving in the cause of GOD. You shall read what you can of it, and observe the contact prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and lend GOD a loan of righteousness. Whatever good you send ahead on behalf of your souls, you will find it at GOD far better and generously rewarded. And implore GOD for forgiveness. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verses.footnote: God's infinite wisdom willed to reveal the Quran through Muhammad, while the Quran's awesome 19-based mathematical miracle was revealed through God's Messenger of the Covenant 1406 lunar years after revelation of the Quran (1406=19x74 & 1974 AD was the Solar Year of discovery). In retrospect, we realize that the whole sura refers to the Quran's 19-based miracle (Appendices 1 & 2).

verses.english: We appointed angels to be guardians of Hell, and we assigned their number (19) (1) to disturb the disbelievers, (2) to convince the Christians and Jews (that this is a divine scripture), (3) to strengthen the faith of the faithful, (4) to remove all traces of doubt from the hearts of Christians, Jews, as well as the believers, and (5) to expose those who harbor doubt in their hearts, and the disbelievers; they will say, "What did GOD mean by this allegory?" GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is a reminder for the people.

1981.english: We appointed angels to be guardians of hell.* And we appointed this number (19) to serve as a punishment for the disbelievers; and to assure those who received previous scripture (that this is a divine book); and to strengthen the faith of the believers;* and to remove all traces of doubt from the hearts of those who received previous scripture, as well as the believers; and to expose the hypocrites and the disbelievers, for they will say, "What did God mean by this example?" God thus misleads whomever He wills and guides whomever He wills. No one knows the actual number of your Lord's soldiers except He. This is simply a reminder for the people.
1981.footnote: This expression provided the earlier generations with a temporary interpretation for the number 19 of verse 30. We are given here five functions of the 19-based code of Quran: (1) a rebuttal against the disbelievers; (2) to assure the Jews and Christians that Quran is God's message to them; (3) strengthen the faith of the believers (see 2:260); (4) remove all doubt from the hearts of the Jews, Christians, and Muslims; and (5) expose the doubters, the hypocrites, and disbelievers; they will say, "So what."

1989.english: We appointed angels to be guardians nf Hell. and we assigned their number (19 (1) to disturb the disbelievers, (2) to convince the Christians and Jews (that this is a divine scripture), (3) to strengthen the faith of the faithful, (4) to remove all traces of doubt from the hearts of Christians, Jews, as well as the believers, and (5) to expose those who harbor doubt in their hearts, and the disbelievers; they will say, “What did GOD mean by this allegory?” GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is a reminder for the people.
