1981.english: Realizing that they are doomed.

1989.english: Expecting the worst.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
verses.arabicClean: كلا إذا بلغت التراقي
verses.transliterated: kallā idhā balaghati l-tarāqiy
verses.english: Indeed, when (the soul) reaches the throat.

1981.english: Indeed, the time will come when it (the soul) reaches the throat.

1989.english: Indeed, when (the soul) reaches the throat.

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ
verses.arabicClean: وقيل من ۜ راق
verses.transliterated: waqīla man rāqi
verses.english: And it is ordered: "Let go!"

1981.english: It will be said, "Is there any reliever?"

1989.english: And it is ordered: “Let go!”

verses.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
verses.arabicClean: وظن أنه الفراق
verses.transliterated: waẓanna annahu l-firāq
verses.english: He knows it is the end.

1981.english: He will realize that the separation is imminent.

1989.english: He knows it is the end.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
verses.arabicClean: والتفت الساق بالساق
verses.transliterated: wal-tafati l-sāqu bil-sāq
verses.english: Each leg will lay motionless next to the other leg.

1981.english: One leg will lay next to the other leg.

1989.english: Each leg will lay motionless next to tb“

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
verses.arabicClean: إلى ربك يومئذ المساق
verses.transliterated: ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-masāq
verses.english: To your Lord, on that day, is the summoning.

1981.english: To your Lord, on that day, is the destination.

1989.english: To your Lord, on that day, is the summoning.

verses.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فلا صدق ولا صلى
verses.transliterated: falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣall
verses.english: For he observed neither the charity, nor the contact prayers (Salat).

1981.english: He was neither charitable, nor did he observe the **salat** prayers.

1989.english: For he observed neither the charity, nor the contact prayers (Salat).

verses.arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ولكن كذب وتولى
verses.transliterated: walākin kadhaba watawall
verses.english: But he disbelieved and turned away.

1981.english: He disbelieved and turned away.

1989.english: But he disbelieved and turned away.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: ثم ذهب إلى أهله يتمطى
verses.transliterated: thumma dhahaba ilā ahlihi yatamaṭṭ
verses.english: With his family, he acted arrogantly.

1981.english: He was arrogant among his people.

1989.english: With his family, he acted arrogantly.

verses.arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: أولى لك فأولى
verses.transliterated: awlā laka fa-awl
verses.english: You have deserved this.

1981.english: You should not have done that, you should not.

1989.english: You have deserved this.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أولى لك فأولى
verses.transliterated: thumma awlā laka fa-awl
verses.english: Indeed, you have deserved this.

1981.english: Indeed, you should not have done it, you should not.

1989.english: Indeed, you have deserved this.

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
verses.arabicClean: أيحسب الإنسان أن يترك سدى
verses.transliterated: ayaḥsabu l-insānu an yut'raka suda
verses.english: Does the human being think that he will go to nothing?

1981.english: Does the human being think that he will be left unaccountable?

1989.english: Does the human being think that he will go to nothing?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يك نطفة من مني يمنى
verses.transliterated: alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'n
verses.english: Was he not a drop of ejected semen?

1981.english: Was he not a drop of ejected semen?

1989.english: Was he not a drop of ejected semen?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ثم كان علقة فخلق فسوى
verses.transliterated: thumma kāna ʿalaqatan fakhalaqa fasaww
verses.english: Then He created an embryo out of it!

1981.english: Then he became a clot, and God created and perfected him?

1989.english: Then He created an embryo out of it!

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: فجعل منه الزوجين الذكر والأنثى
verses.transliterated: fajaʿala min'hu l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unth
verses.english: He made it into male or female!

1981.english: God created them in two kinds, male and female.

1989.english: He made it into male or female!

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى
verses.transliterated: alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawt
verses.english: Is He then unable to revive the dead?

1981.english: Is He not able to resurrect the dead?

1989.english: Is He then unable to revive the dead?

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هل أتى على الإنسان حين من الدهر لم يكن شيئا مذكورا
verses.transliterated: hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnun mina l-dahri lam yakun shayan madhkūra
verses.english: Is it not a fact that there was a time when the human being was nothing to be mentioned?

1981.english: Did the human being go through a period of time when he was nothing?

1989.english: Is it not a fact that there was a time when the human being was nothing to be mentioned?

verses.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا خلقنا الإنسان من نطفة أمشاج نبتليه فجعلناه سميعا بصيرا
verses.transliterated: innā khalaqnā l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin amshājin nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīra
verses.english: We created the human from a liquid mixture, from two parents, in order to test him. Thus, we made him a hearer and a seer.

1981.english: We have created the human from a drop, in stages, in order to put him to the test. We made him hearer and seer.

1989.english: We created the human from a liquid mixture, from two parents, in order to test him. Thus, we made him a hearer and a seer.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا هديناه السبيل إما شاكرا وإما كفورا
verses.transliterated: innā hadaynāhu l-sabīla immā shākiran wa-immā kafūra
verses.english: We showed him the two paths, then, he is either appreciative, or unappreciative.

1981.english: We showed him the path, then he is either appreciative or unappreciative.

1989.english: We showed him the two paths, then, he is either appreciative, or unappreciative.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا أعتدنا للكافرين سلاسل وأغلالا وسعيرا
verses.transliterated: innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālan wasaʿīra
verses.english: We prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Hell.

1981.english: We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, and shackles, and hell.

1989.english: We prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Hell.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إن الأبرار يشربون من كأس كان مزاجها كافورا
verses.transliterated: inna l-abrāra yashrabūna min kasin kāna mizājuhā kāfūra
verses.english: As for the virtuous, they will drink from cups spiced with nectar.

1981.english: As for the righteous, they will drink from cups wherein balm is mixed.

1989.english: As for the virtuous, they will drink from cups spiced with nectar.

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: عينا يشرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفجيرا
verses.transliterated: aaynan yashrabu biha 'aibaduAllahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
verses.english: A spring that is reserved for GOD's servants; it will gush out as they will.

1981.english: From a spring that the servants of God fully control.

1989.english: A spring that is reserved for GOD’s servants; it will gush out as they will.

verses.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: يوفون بالنذر ويخافون يوما كان شره مستطيرا
verses.transliterated: yūfūna bil-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mus'taṭīra
verses.english: They fulfill their pledges, and reverence a day that is extremely difficult.

1981.english: They fullfill their vows and reverence a day that is extremely difficult.

1989.english: They fulfill their pledges, and reverence a day that is extremely difficult.

verses.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ويطعمون الطعام على حبه مسكينا ويتيما وأسيرا
verses.transliterated: wayuṭ'ʿimūna l-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi mis'kīnan wayatīman wa-asīra
verses.english: They donate their favorite food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive.

1981.english: They donate the food, despite their love thereof, to the needy, the orphan, and the captive.

1989.english: They donate their favorite food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إنما نطعمكم لوجه الله لا نريد منكم جزاء ولا شكورا
verses.transliterated: innamā nuṭ'ʿimukum liwajhi l-lahi lā nurīdu minkum jazāan walā shukūra
verses.english: "We feed you for the sake of GOD; we expect no reward from you, nor thanks.

1981.english: We feed you only in obedience to God; we require no recompense or thanks.

1989.english: “We feed you for the sake of GOD; we expect no reward from you, nor thanks.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا نخاف من ربنا يوما عبوسا قمطريرا
verses.transliterated: innā nakhāfu min rabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīra
verses.english: "We fear from our Lord a day that is full of misery and trouble."

1981.english: We fear from our Lord a day that is full of trouble and misery.

1989.english: “We fear from our Lord a day that is full of misery and trouble.”

verses.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
verses.arabicClean: فوقاهم الله شر ذلك اليوم ولقاهم نضرة وسرورا
verses.transliterated: fawaqāhumu l-lahu sharra dhālika l-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍratan wasurūra
verses.english: Consequently, GOD protects them from the evils of that day, and rewards them with joy and contentment.

1981.english: God will spare them the misery of that day and will grant them happiness and joy.

1989.english: Consequently, GOD protects them from the evils of that day, and rewards them with joy and contentment.

verses.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وجزاهم بما صبروا جنة وحريرا
verses.transliterated: wajazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannatan waḥarīra
verses.english: He rewards them for their steadfastness with Paradise, and silk.

1981.english: He will reward them for their steadfastness; Paradise and silk.

1989.english: He rewards them for their steadfastness with Paradise, and silk.

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: متكئين فيها على الأرائك ۖ لا يرون فيها شمسا ولا زمهريرا
verses.transliterated: muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki lā yarawna fīhā shamsan walā zamharīra
verses.english: They relax therein on luxurious furnishings. They suffer neither the heat of the sun, nor any cold.

1981.english: Relaxing on the furnishings therein, they do not see any sun heat or bitter cold.

1989.english: They relax therein on luxurious furnishings. They suffer neither the heat of the sun, nor any cold.

verses.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ودانية عليهم ظلالها وذللت قطوفها تذليلا
verses.transliterated: wadāniyatan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīla
verses.english: The shade covers them therein, and the fruits are brought within reach.

1981.english: The shade will cover them and the fruits within reach.

1989.english: The shade covers them therein, and the fruits are brought within reach.

verses.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.arabicClean: ويطاف عليهم بآنية من فضة وأكواب كانت قواريرا
verses.transliterated: wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim biāniyatin min fiḍḍatin wa-akwābin kānat qawārīr
verses.english: They are served drinks in silver containers and cups that are translucent.

1981.english: Passing among them will be silver bowls and translucent cups.

1989.english: They are served drinks in silver containers and cups that are translucent.

verses.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: قوارير من فضة قدروها تقديرا
verses.transliterated: qawārīrā min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīra
verses.english: Translucent cups, though made of silver; they rightly deserved all this.

1981.english: Translucent, though made of silver. They rightly deserved them.

1989.english: Translucent cups, though made of silver; they rightly deserved all this.

verses.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ويسقون فيها كأسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا
verses.transliterated: wayus'qawna fīhā kasan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīla
verses.english: They enjoy drinks of delicious flavors.

1981.english: They enjoy drinks wherein spices are mixed.

1989.english: They enjoy drinks of delicious flavors

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: عينا فيها تسمى سلسبيلا
verses.transliterated: aaynan feeha tusammasalsabeelan
verses.english: From a spring therein known as "Salsabeel."

1981.english: From a spring therein named "Salsabeel."

1989.english: From a spring therein known as “Salsabeel.”

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
verses.arabicClean: ويطوف عليهم ولدان مخلدون إذا رأيتهم حسبتهم لؤلؤا منثورا
verses.transliterated: wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna idhā ra-aytahum ḥasib'tahum lu'lu-an manthūra
verses.english: Serving them will be immortal servants. When you see them, they will look like scattered pearls.

1981.english: Serving them will be immortal servants; when you see them, you will think they are scattered pearls.

1989.english: Serving them will be immortal servants. When you see them, they will look like scattered pearls.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: وإذا رأيت ثم رأيت نعيما وملكا كبيرا
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ra-ayta thamma ra-ayta naʿīman wamul'kan kabīra
verses.english: Wherever you look, you will see bliss, and a wonderful dominion.

1981.english: And when you see, you will see ecstacy and a great dominion.

1989.english: Wherever you look, you will see bliss and a wonderful dominion.

verses.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
verses.arabicClean: عاليهم ثياب سندس خضر وإستبرق ۖ وحلوا أساور من فضة وسقاهم ربهم شرابا طهورا
verses.transliterated: aaliyahum thiyabu sundusinkhudrun wa-istabraqun wahulloo asawira minfiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
verses.english: On them will be clothes of green velvet, satin, and silver ornaments. Their Lord will provide them with pure drinks.

1981.english: Their garments will be of green velvet and silk; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will grant them pure drinks.

1989.english: On them will be clothes of green velvet, satin, and silver ornaments. Their Lord will provide them with pure drinks.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا كان لكم جزاء وكان سعيكم مشكورا
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā kāna lakum jazāan wakāna saʿyukum mashkūra
verses.english: This is the reward that awaits you, for your efforts have been appreciated.

1981.english: This is the recompense you have deserved; for your works are appreciated.

1989.english: This is the reward that awaits you, for your efforts have been appreciated.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إنا نحن نزلنا عليك القرآن تنزيلا
verses.transliterated: innā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna tanzīla
verses.english: We have revealed to you this Quran; a special revelation from us.

1981.english: We have revealed to you this Quran; a revelation from us.

1989.english: We have revealed to you this Quran; a special revelation from us.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
verses.arabicClean: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا
verses.transliterated: fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ min'hum āthiman aw kafūra
verses.english: You shall steadfastly carry out your Lord's commandments, and do not obey any sinful disbeliever among them.

1981.english: You shall steadfastly uphold the laws of your Lord, and do not obey any guilty one or disbeliever among them.

1989.english: You shall steadfastly carry out your Lord’s commandments, and do not obey any sinful disbeliever among them.

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: واذكر اسم ربك بكرة وأصيلا
verses.transliterated: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika buk'ratan wa-aṣīla
verses.english: And commemorate the name of your Lord day and night.

1981.english: You shall commemorate the name of your Lord, day and night.

1989.english: And commemorate the name of your Lord day and night.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: ومن الليل فاسجد له وسبحه ليلا طويلا
verses.transliterated: wamina al-layli fa-us'jud lahu wasabbiḥ'hu laylan ṭawīla
verses.english: During the night, fall prostrate before Him, and glorify Him many a long night.

1981.english: During the night, fall prostrate before Him. Glorify Him throughout many nights.

1989.english: During the night, fall prostrate before Him, and glorify Him many a long night.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إن هؤلاء يحبون العاجلة ويذرون وراءهم يوما ثقيلا
verses.transliterated: inna hāulāi yuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata wayadharūna warāahum yawman thaqīla
verses.english: These people are preoccupied with this fleeting life, while disregarding—just ahead of them—a heavy day.

1981.english: These people love the fleeting life and ignore a heavy day that awaits them.

1989.english: These people are preoccupied with this fleeting life, while disregarding—just ahead of them—a heavy day.

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: نحن خلقناهم وشددنا أسرهم ۖ وإذا شئنا بدلنا أمثالهم تبديلا
verses.transliterated: naḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā asrahum wa-idhā shi'nā baddalnā amthālahum tabdīla
verses.english: We created them, and established them, and, whenever we will, we can substitute others in their place.

1981.english: We created them, gave them strength, and, if we will, we can substitute others in their place.

1989.english: We created them, and established them, and, whenever we will, we can substitute others in their place.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.arabicClean: إن هذه تذكرة ۖ فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا
verses.transliterated: inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīla
verses.english: This is a reminder: whoever wills shall choose the path to his Lord.

1981.english: This is a reminder; whoever wills shall follow a path to his Lord.

1989.english: This is a reminder: whoever wills shall choose the path to his Lord.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.arabicClean: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله ۚ إن الله كان عليما حكيما
verses.transliterated: wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīma
verses.english: Whatever you will is in accordance with GOD's will. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.

1981.english: Whatever you will is in accordance with God's will. God is omniscient, most wise.

1989.english: Whatever you will is in accordance with GOD’s will. GOD is Omniscient, Wise

verses.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.arabicClean: يدخل من يشاء في رحمته ۚ والظالمين أعد لهم عذابا أليما
verses.transliterated: yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimīna aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban alīma
verses.english: He admits whomever He wills into His mercy. As for the transgressors, He has prepared for them a painful retribution.

1981.english: He admits whomever He wills into His mercy. As for the wicked, He has prepared for them a painful retribution.

1989.english: He admits whomever He wills into His mercy. As for the transgressors, He has prepared for them a painful retribution.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والمرسلات عرفا
verses.transliterated: wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fa
verses.english: (Angels) dispatched in succession.

1981.english: By the dispatched (angels), in succession.

1989.english: (Angels) dispatched in succession.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًا
verses.arabicClean: فالعاصفات عصفا
verses.transliterated: fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfa
verses.english: To drive the wind.

1981.english: Who stir up violent winds.

1989.english: To drive the wind.

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
verses.arabicClean: والناشرات نشرا
verses.transliterated: wal-nāshirāti nashra
verses.english: Stir up clouds.

1981.english: And spread clouds everywhere.

1989.english: Stir up clouds.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًا
verses.arabicClean: فالفارقات فرقا
verses.transliterated: fal-fāriqāti farqa
verses.english: Distribute the provisions.

1981.english: And distribute the rain.

1989.english: Distribute the provisions.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verses.arabicClean: فالملقيات ذكرا
verses.transliterated: fal-mul'qiyāti dhik'ra
verses.english: Deliver messages.

1981.english: And deliver messages.

1989.english: Deliver messages.

verses.arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
verses.arabicClean: عذرا أو نذرا
verses.transliterated: authran aw nuthran
verses.english: Good news, as well as warnings.

1981.english: Good news as well as warnings.

1989.english: Good news, as well as warnings.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنما توعدون لواقع
verses.transliterated: innamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿu
verses.english: What is promised will come to pass.

1981.english: What is promised to you will come to pass.

1989.english: What is promised will come to pass.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا النجوم طمست
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā l-nujūmu ṭumisa
verses.english: Thus, when the stars are put out.

1981.english: The stars will be turned off.

1989.english: Thus, when the stars are put out.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا السماء فرجت
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā l-samāu furija
verses.english: The sky is opened up.

1981.english: The heaven will be torn.

1989.english: The sky is opened up.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا الجبال نسفت
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā l-jibālu nusifa
verses.english: The mountains are blown up.

1981.english: The mountains will be wiped out.

1989.english: The mountains are blown up.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا الرسل أقتت
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā l-rusulu uqqita
verses.english: The messengers are summoned.

1981.english: The messengers will be summoned.

1989.english: The messengers are summoned.

verses.arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
verses.arabicClean: لأي يوم أجلت
verses.transliterated: li-ayyi yawmin ujjila
verses.english: That is the appointed day.

1981.english: On the specific day.

1989.english: That is the appointed day.

verses.arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verses.arabicClean: ليوم الفصل
verses.transliterated: liyawmi l-faṣl
verses.english: The Day of Decision.

1981.english: That is the day of judgment.

1989.english: The Day of Decision.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما يوم الفصل
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-faṣl
verses.english: What a Day of Decision!

1981.english: Do you have any idea what the day of judgment is?

1989.english: What a Day of Decision!

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
verses.transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ألم نهلك الأولين
verses.transliterated: alam nuh'liki l-awalīn
verses.english: Did we not annihilate the earlier generations?

1981.english: Did we not eliminate the ancestors?

1989.english: Did we not annihilate the earlier generations?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم نتبعهم الآخرين
verses.transliterated: thumma nut'biʿuhumu l-ākhirīn
verses.english: Then we made others follow them?

1981.english: Then we made others follow them?

1989.english: Then we made others follow them?

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.arabicClean: كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين
verses.transliterated: kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīn
verses.english: This is what we do to the criminals.

1981.english: This is what we do to the guilty.

1989.english: This is what we do to the criminals.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
verses.transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين
verses.transliterated: alam nakhluqkkum min māin mahīni
verses.english: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?
verses.footnote: According to Langman's Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): "In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization." Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).

1981.english: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?

1989.english: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?*
1989.footnote: According to Langman’s Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): “In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization. ” Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.arabicClean: فجعلناه في قرار مكين
verses.transliterated: fajaʿalnāhu fī qarārin makīni
verses.english: Then we placed it in a well-protected repository.

1981.english: Then we placed it in a protected repository.

1989.english: Then we placed it in a well-protected repository.
1989.footnote: According to Langman’s Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): “In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization. ” Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.arabicClean: إلى قدر معلوم
verses.transliterated: ilā qadarin maʿlūmi
verses.english: For a specific period.

1981.english: For a specific period.

1989.english: For a specific period.
1989.footnote: According to Langman’s Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): “In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization. ” Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فقدرنا فنعم القادرون
verses.transliterated: faqadarnā faniʿ'ma l-qādirūn
verses.english: We measured it precisely. We are the best designers.

1981.english: We designed everything; we are the best designers.

1989.english: We measured it precisely.* We are the best designers.
1989.footnote: According to Langman’s Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): “In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization. ” Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
verses.transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
verses.arabicClean: ألم نجعل الأرض كفاتا
verses.transliterated: alam najʿali l-arḍa kifāta
verses.english: Did we not make the earth an abode?

1981.english: Did we not make the earth habitable?

1989.english: Did we not make the earth an abode?

verses.arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا
verses.arabicClean: أحياء وأمواتا
verses.transliterated: aḥyāan wa-amwāta
verses.english: For the living and the dead?

1981.english: Accommodating both the living and the dead.

1989.english: For the living and the dead?

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا فيها رواسي شامخات وأسقيناكم ماء فراتا
verses.transliterated: wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsiya shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum māan furāta
verses.english: We placed on it high mountains, and provided you with fresh water to drink.

1981.english: We placed huge stabilizers therein, and we gave you fresh water to drink.

1989.english: We placed on it high mountains, and provided you with fresh water to drink.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
verses.transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: انطلقوا إلى ما كنتم به تكذبون
verses.transliterated: inṭaliqū ilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūn
verses.english: Go to what you used to disbelieve in.

1981.english: Go to what you used to deny.

1989.english: Go to what you used to disbelieve in.

verses.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍ
verses.arabicClean: انطلقوا إلى ظل ذي ثلاث شعب
verses.transliterated: inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿabi
verses.english: Go to a shade of three different densities.

1981.english: Go to a shade with three layers.

1989.english: Go to a shade of three different densities.

verses.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.arabicClean: لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب
verses.transliterated: lā ẓalīlin walā yugh'nī mina l-lahab
verses.english: Yet, it provides neither coolness, nor protection from the heat.

1981.english: It provides no coolness, nor does it spare you any heat.

1989.english: Yet, it provides neither coolness, nor protection from the heat.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
verses.arabicClean: إنها ترمي بشرر كالقصر
verses.transliterated: innahā tarmī bishararin kal-qaṣr
verses.english: It throws sparks as big as mansions.

1981.english: The sparks it emits are as big as mansions.

1989.english: It throws sparks as big as mansions.

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
verses.arabicClean: كأنه جمالت صفر
verses.transliterated: ka-annahu jimālatun ṣuf'ru
verses.english: As yellow as the color of camels.

1981.english: They will look as yellow as the camels.

1989.english: As yellow as the color of camels.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
verses.transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هذا يوم لا ينطقون
verses.transliterated: hādhā yawmu lā yanṭiqūn
verses.english: That is the day they do not speak.

1981.english: That is the day when they need not speak.

1989.english: That is the day they do not speak.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون
verses.transliterated: walā yu'dhanu lahum fayaʿtadhirūn
verses.english: Nor are they given permission to apologize.

1981.english: No permission will be given to them to even apologize.

1989.english: Nor are they given permission to apologize.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
verses.transliterated: waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.arabicClean: هذا يوم الفصل ۖ جمعناكم والأولين
verses.transliterated: hādhā yawmu l-faṣli jamaʿnākum wal-awalīn
verses.english: This is the Day of Decision. We have summoned you and the previous generations.

1981.english: This is the day of judgment; we have gathered you together with the previous generations.

1989.english: This is the Day of Decision. We have summoned you and the previous generations.

verses.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
verses.arabicClean: فإن كان لكم كيد فكيدون
verses.transliterated: fa-in kāna lakum kaydun fakīdūn
verses.english: If you have any schemes, go ahead and scheme.

1981.english: If you have any power to do anything, then show Me your power.

1989.english: If you have any schemes, go ahead and scheme.

1989.english: And fruits that they desire.

1989.english: Eat and drink happily in return for your works.

1989.english: We thus reward the virtuous.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

1989.english: Eat and enjoy temporarily; you are guilty.

verses.arabicClean: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين

verses.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1981.english: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قيل لهم اركعوا لا يركعون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ir'kaʿū lā yarkaʿūn

1989.english: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

1989.english: Which Hadith, other than this, do they uphold?

verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم عم يتساءلون
verses.transliterated: aamma yatasaaloona

1981.english: What are they questioning?

1989.english: What are they questioning?

verses.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

verses.transliterated: aani alnnaba-i alAAatheemi

1989.english: The great event.

1989.english: Most assuredly, they will find out.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًا

1989.english: We made the night a cover.

verses.arabicClean: وجعلنا النهار معاشا

1989.english: And the day to seek provisions.

1989.english: We created a bright lamp.

1989.english: We send down from the clouds pouring water.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verses.arabicClean: إنا أنذرناكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر المرء ما قدمت يداه ويقول الكافر يا ليتني كنت ترابا
verses.transliterated: innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāba
verses.english: We have sufficiently warned you about an imminent retribution. That is the day when everyone will examine what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish I were dust."

1981.english: We have warned you of imminent retribution. The day will come when every person sees what his hands had advanced, and the disbelievers will say, "I wish I were dust."

1989.english: We have sufficiently warned you about an imminent retribution. That is the day when everyone will examine what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish I were dust.”

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والنازعات غرقا
verses.transliterated: wal-nāziʿāti gharqa
verses.english: The (angels who) snatch (the souls of the disbelievers) forcibly.

1981.english: By those (angels) who snatch (the souls of the guilty).

1989.english: The (angels who) snatch (the souls of the disbelievers) forcibly.

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًا
verses.arabicClean: والناشطات نشطا
verses.transliterated: wal-nāshiṭāti nashṭa
verses.english: And those who gently take (the souls of the believers) joyfully.

1981.english: By those (angels) who gently seize (the souls of the righteous).

1989.english: And those who gently take (the souls of the believers) joyfully.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًا
verses.arabicClean: والسابحات سبحا
verses.transliterated: wal-sābiḥāti sabḥa
verses.english: And those floating everywhere.

1981.english: By those (angels) who float downward.

1989.english: And those floating everywhere.

verses.arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًا
verses.arabicClean: فالسابقات سبقا
verses.transliterated: fal-sābiqāti sabqa
verses.english: Eagerly racing with one another—

1981.english: By those (angels) who are ever eager.

1989.english: Eagerly racing with one another—

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.arabicClean: فالمدبرات أمرا
verses.transliterated: fal-mudabirāti amra
verses.english: to carry out various commands.

1981.english: To carry out the commands.

1989.english: to carry out various commands.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
verses.arabicClean: يوم ترجف الراجفة
verses.transliterated: yawma tarjufu l-rājifat
verses.english: The day the quake quakes.

1981.english: The day will come when the quake will quake.

1989.english: The day the quake quakes.

verses.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
verses.arabicClean: تتبعها الرادفة
verses.transliterated: tatbaʿuhā l-rādifat
verses.english: Followed by the second blow.

1981.english: Followed by the inevitable.

1989.english: Followed by the second blow.

verses.arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: قلوب يومئذ واجفة
verses.transliterated: qulūbun yawma-idhin wājifatu
verses.english: Certain minds will be terrified.

1981.english: Some hearts, on that day, will be terrified.

1989.english: Certain minds will be terrified.

verses.arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: أبصارها خاشعة
verses.transliterated: abṣāruhā khāshiʿatu
verses.english: Their eyes will be subdued.

1981.english: Their eyes will be disgraced.

1989.english: Their eyes will be subdued.

verses.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
verses.arabicClean: يقولون أإنا لمردودون في الحافرة
verses.transliterated: yaqūlūna a-innā lamardūdūna fī l-ḥāfirat
verses.english: They will say, "We have been recreated from the grave!

1981.english: They used to say, "Do we get recreated from the grave?

1989.english: They will say, “We have been recreated from the grave!

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
verses.arabicClean: أإذا كنا عظاما نخرة
verses.transliterated: a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman nakhirata
verses.english: "How did this happen after we had turned into rotten bones?"

1981.english: "After becoming rotten bones?"

1989.english: “How did this happen after we had turned into rotten bones?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: قالوا تلك إذا كرة خاسرة
verses.transliterated: qālū til'ka idhan karratun khāsiratu
verses.english: They had said, "This is an impossible recurrence."

1981.english: They said, "This is an impossible recurrence."

1989.english: They had said, “This is an impossible recurrence.”

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: فإنما هي زجرة واحدة
verses.transliterated: fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatu
verses.english: All it takes is one nudge.

1981.english: But it will take only one call.

1989.english: All it takes is one nudge.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا هم بالساهرة
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā hum bil-sāhirat
verses.english: Whereupon they get up.

1981.english: Whereupon they rise.

1989.english: Whereupon they get up.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: هل أتاك حديث موسى
verses.transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu mūs
verses.english: Have you known about the history of Moses?

1981.english: Have you received the history of Moses?

1989.english: Have you known about the history of Moses?

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.arabicClean: إذ ناداه ربه بالواد المقدس طوى
verses.transliterated: idh nādāhu rabbuhu bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwa
verses.english: His Lord called him at the holy valley of Tuwaa.

1981.english: His Lord called him in the sacred valley Tuwa.

1989.english: His Lord called him at the holy valley of Tuwaa.

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى
verses.transliterated: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭagh
verses.english: "Go to Pharaoh; he has transgressed."

1981.english: Go to Pharaoh; for he has transgressed.

1989.english: “Go to Pharaoh; he has transgressed.”

verses.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فقل هل لك إلى أن تزكى
verses.transliterated: faqul hal laka ilā an tazakk
verses.english: Tell him, "Would you not reform?

1981.english: Tell him, "Would you not purify yourself?

1989.english: Tell him, “Would you not reform?

verses.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وأهديك إلى ربك فتخشى
verses.transliterated: wa-ahdiyaka ilā rabbika fatakhsh
verses.english: "Let me guide you to your Lord, that you may turn reverent."

1981.english: "Let me guide you to your Lord. You shall be humble."

1989.english: “Let me guide you to your Lord, that you may turn reverent?”

verses.arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فأراه الآية الكبرى
verses.transliterated: fa-arāhu l-āyata l-kub'r
verses.english: He then showed him the great miracle.

1981.english: He then showed him the great miracle.

1989.english: He then showed him the great miracle.

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فكذب وعصى
verses.transliterated: fakadhaba waʿaṣ
verses.english: But he disbelieved and rebelled.

1981.english: But he disbelieved and rebelled.

1989.english: But he disbelieved and rebelled.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ثم أدبر يسعى
verses.transliterated: thumma adbara yasʿ
verses.english: Then he turned away in a hurry.

1981.english: He turned around in a hurry.

1989.english: Then he turned away in a hurry.

verses.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فحشر فنادى
verses.transliterated: faḥashara fanād
verses.english: He summoned and proclaimed.

1981.english: And sent announcers to summon (the magicians).

1989.english: He summoned and proclaimed.

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فقال أنا ربكم الأعلى
verses.transliterated: faqāla anā rabbukumu l-aʿl
verses.english: He said, "I am your Lord; most high."

1981.english: He said, "I am your supreme Lord."

1989.english: He said, “I am your Lord; most high.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: فأخذه الله نكال الآخرة والأولى
verses.transliterated: fa-akhadhahu l-lahu nakāla l-ākhirati wal-ūl
verses.english: Consequently, GOD committed him to the retribution in the Hereafter, as well as in the first life.

1981.english: Consequently, God committed him to retribution in the hereafter, as well as in the first life.

1989.english: Consequently, GOD committed him as well as in the first life.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: إن في ذلك لعبرة لمن يخشى
verses.transliterated: inna fī dhālika laʿib'ratan liman yakhsh
verses.english: This is a lesson for the reverent.

1981.english: This is a lesson for the reverent.

1989.english: This is a lesson for the reverent.

verses.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بَنَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: أأنتم أشد خلقا أم السماء ۚ بناها
verses.transliterated: a-antum ashaddu khalqan ami l-samāu banāh
verses.english: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven? He constructed it.

1981.english: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven that He built?

1989.english: Are you more difficult to create than the heaven? He constructed it.

verses.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: رفع سمكها فسواها
verses.transliterated: rafaʿa samkahā fasawwāh
verses.english: He raised its masses, and perfected it.

1981.english: He raised its masses and perfected it.

1989.english: He raised its masses, and perfected it.

verses.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: وأغطش ليلها وأخرج ضحاها
verses.transliterated: wa-aghṭasha laylahā wa-akhraja ḍuḥāh
verses.english: He made its night dark, and brightened its morn.

1981.english: He made its night dark and its morning visible.

1989.english: He made its night dark, and brightened its morn.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
verses.arabicClean: والأرض بعد ذلك دحاها
verses.transliterated: wal-arḍa baʿda dhālika daḥāh
verses.english: He made the earth egg-shaped.
verses.footnote: The Arabic word "dahhaahaa" is derived from "Dahhyah" which means "egg."

1981.english: Thereafter, He made the earth egg-shaped.

1989.english: He made the earth egg-shaped.*
1989.footnote: The Arabic word “dahhaahaa”is derived from “Dahhyah” which means “egg.”.

verses.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: أخرج منها ماءها ومرعاها
verses.transliterated: akhraja min'hā māahā wamarʿāh
verses.english: From it, He produced its own water and pasture.

1981.english: He produced therefrom its water and its pasture.

1989.english: From it, He produced its own water and pasture.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: والجبال أرساها
verses.transliterated: wal-jibāla arsāh
verses.english: He established the mountains.

1981.english: And He placed the mountains.

1989.english: He established the mountains.

verses.arabic: مَتَٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
verses.arabicClean: متاعا لكم ولأنعامكم
verses.transliterated: matāʿan lakum wali-anʿāmiku
verses.english: All this to provide life support for you and your animals.

1981.english: And provisions for you and your animals.

1989.english: All this to provide life support for you and your animals.

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فإذا جاءت الطامة الكبرى
verses.transliterated: fa-idhā jāati l-ṭāmatu l-kub'r
verses.english: Then, when the great blow comes.

1981.english: Then, when the great event comes to pass.

1989.english: Then, when the great blow comes.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يتذكر الإنسان ما سعى
verses.transliterated: yawma yatadhakkaru l-insānu mā saʿ
verses.english: That is the day when the human will remember everything he did.

1981.english: The human being will remember everything he had done.

1989.english: That is the day when the human will remember everything he did.

verses.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وبرزت الجحيم لمن يرى
verses.transliterated: waburrizati l-jaḥīmu liman yar
verses.english: Hell will be brought into existence.

1981.english: Hell will be shown to everyone who sees.

1989.english: Hell will be brought into existence.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فأما من طغى
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā man ṭagh
verses.english: As for the one who transgressed.

1981.english: For the transgressor.

1989.english: As for the one who transgressed.

verses.arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.arabicClean: وآثر الحياة الدنيا
verses.transliterated: waāthara l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verses.english: Who was preoccupied with this life.

1981.english: Who preferred the first life.

1989.english: Who was preoccupied with this life.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فإن الجحيم هي المأوى
verses.transliterated: fa-inna l-jaḥīma hiya l-maw
verses.english: Hell will be the abode.

1981.english: Hell will be the abode.

1989.english: Hell will be the abode.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وأما من خاف مقام ربه ونهى النفس عن الهوى
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā man khāfa maqāma rabbihi wanahā l-nafsa ʿani l-haw
verses.english: As for the one who reverenced the majesty of his Lord, and enjoined the self from sinful lusts.

1981.english: For the one who appreciated the greatness of his Lord and controlled his lusts.

1989.english: As for the one who reverenced the majesty of his Lord, and enjoined the self from sinful lusts.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فإن الجنة هي المأوى
verses.transliterated: fa-inna l-janata hiya l-maw
verses.english: Paradise will be the abode.

1981.english: Heaven will be the abode.

1989.english: Paradise will be the abode.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: يسألونك عن الساعة أيان مرساها
verses.transliterated: yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāh
verses.english: They ask you about the Hour, and when it will take place!

1981.english: They ask you about the Hour.

1989.english: They ask you about the Hour, and when it will take place!

verses.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
verses.arabicClean: فيم أنت من ذكراها
verses.transliterated: fīma anta min dhik'rāh
verses.english: It is not you (Muhammad) who is destined to announce its time.

1981.english: You have no way of knowing it.

1989.english: It is not you (Muhammad) who is destined to announce its time.

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
verses.arabicClean: إلى ربك منتهاها
verses.transliterated: ilā rabbika muntahāh
verses.english: Your Lord decides its fate.

1981.english: Only your Lord controls its destiny.

1989.english: Your Lord decides its fate.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: إنما أنت منذر من يخشاها
verses.transliterated: innamā anta mundhiru man yakhshāh
verses.english: Your mission is to warn those who expect it.

1981.english: You only warn those who appreciate it.

1989.english: Your mission is to warn those who expect it.

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.arabicClean: كأنهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا إلا عشية أو ضحاها
verses.transliterated: ka-annahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathū illā ʿashiyyatan aw ḍuḥāh
verses.english: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one evening or half a day.

1981.english: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one night or one day (in this life).

1989.english: The day they see it, they will feel as if they lasted one evening or half a day.

verses.arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم عبس وتولى
verses.transliterated: abasa watawalla
verses.english: He (Muhammad) frowned and turned away.

1981.english: He (Muhammad) frowned and turned away.

1989.english: He (Muhammad) frowned and turned away.

verses.arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: أن جاءه الأعمى
verses.transliterated: an jāahu l-aʿm
verses.english: When the blind man came to him.

1981.english: When the blind man came to him.

1989.english: When the blind man came to him.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: وما يدريك لعله يزكى
verses.transliterated: wamā yud'rīka laʿallahu yazzakk
verses.english: How do you know? He may purify himself.

1981.english: How do you know? He may attain salvation.

1989.english: How do you know? He may purify himself.

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: أو يذكر فتنفعه الذكرى
verses.transliterated: aw yadhakkaru fatanfaʿahu l-dhik'r
verses.english: Or he may take heed, and benefit from the message.

1981.english: Or he may take heed and benefit from heeding.

1989.english: Or he may take heed, and benefit from the message.

1989.english: Your friend (Rashad) is not crazy.

1981.english: This is a message for all the people.

1989.english: This is a message to all the people.

1989.english: O you human being, what diverted yc from your Lord, Most Honorable?

verses.transliterated: alladhī khalaqaka fasawwāka faʿadalak

verses.arabicClean: كتاب مرقوم
verses.transliterated: kitābun marqūmu
verses.english: A numerically structured book.

1981.english: It is a numbered record.

1989.english: A numerically structured book.

verses.transliterated: inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmi
