verses.arabicClean: على الأرائك ينظرون
verses.transliterated: ala al-ara-iki yanthuroona
verses.english: On luxurious furnishings they watch.

1981.english: Watching, as they relax on furnishings.

1989.english: On luxurious furnishings they watch.

verses.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: تعرف في وجوههم نضرة النعيم
verses.transliterated: taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrata l-naʿīm
verses.english: You recognize in their faces the joy of bliss.

1981.english: You recognize in their faces the radiance of happiness.

1989.english: You recognize in their faces the joy of bliss.

verses.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
verses.arabicClean: يسقون من رحيق مختوم
verses.transliterated: yus'qawna min raḥīqin makhtūmi
verses.english: Their drinks will be spiced with nectar.

1981.english: They will be given drinks of pure nectar.

1989.english: Their drinks will be spiced with nectar.

verses.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ختامه مسك ۚ وفي ذلك فليتنافس المتنافسون
verses.transliterated: khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūn
verses.english: Its spice is like musk. This is what the competitors should compete for.

1981.english: Sealed with musk. This is what any competitors should compete for.

1989.english: Its spice is like musk. This is what the competitors should compete for.

verses.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: ومزاجه من تسنيم
verses.transliterated: wamizājuhu min tasnīmi
verses.english: Mixed into it will be special flavors.

1981.english: Mixed in it will be perfume.

1989.english: Mixed into it will be special flavors.

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: عينا يشرب بها المقربون
verses.transliterated: aynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona
verses.english: From a spring that is reserved for those close to Me.

1981.english: From a spring exclusively reserved for those close to Me.

1989.english: From a spring that is reserved for those close to Me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين أجرموا كانوا من الذين آمنوا يضحكون
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūn
verses.english: The wicked used to laugh at those who believed.

1981.english: The guilty used to laugh at those who believed.
1981.subtitle: The Believers Ridiculed

1989.english: The wicked used to laugh at those who believed.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا مروا بهم يتغامزون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā marrū bihim yataghāmazūn
verses.english: When they passed by them, they used to poke fun.

1981.english: When they passed by them, they poked each other.

1989.english: When they passed by them, they used to poke fun.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا انقلبوا إلى أهلهم انقلبوا فكهين
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā inqalabū ilā ahlihimu inqalabū fakihīn
verses.english: When they got together with their people, they used to joke.

1981.english: When they talked with each other, they mocked them.

1989.english: When they got together with their people, they used to joke.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا رأوهم قالوا إن هؤلاء لضالون
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā ra-awhum qālū inna hāulāi laḍāllūn
verses.english: Whenever they saw them, they said, "These people are far astray!

1981.english: Whenever they saw them, they said, "These people are way off.

1989.english: Whenever they saw them, they said, “These people are far astray!

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
verses.arabicClean: وما أرسلوا عليهم حافظين
verses.transliterated: wamā ur'silū ʿalayhim ḥāfiẓīn
verses.english: "They have no such thing as (invisible) guards."

1981.english: "No angels are assigned to accompany them."

1989.english: “They have no such thing as (invisible) guards.”

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فاليوم الذين آمنوا من الكفار يضحكون
verses.transliterated: fal-yawma alladhīna āmanū mina l-kufāri yaḍḥakūn
verses.english: Today, those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers.

1981.english: Today, those who believed will be laughing at the disbelievers.

1989.english: Today, those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers.

verses.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.arabicClean: على الأرائك ينظرون
verses.transliterated: ala al-ara-iki yanthuroona
verses.english: On luxurious furnishings they watch.

1981.english: As they relax on furnishings, they will watch.

1989.english: On luxurious furnishings they watch.

verses.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.arabicClean: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
verses.transliterated: hal thuwwiba l-kufāru mā kānū yafʿalūn
verses.english: Most assuredly, the disbelievers are requited for what they did.

1981.english: Are the disbelievers paying for what they did?

1989.english: Most assuredly, the disbelievers are requited for what they did.

verses.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا السماء انشقت
verses.transliterated: idhā l-samāu inshaqqa
verses.english: The time will come when the sky is ruptured.

1981.english: The time will come when the sky is split asunder.

1989.english: The time will come when the sky is ruptured.

verses.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verses.arabicClean: وأذنت لربها وحقت
verses.transliterated: wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqa
verses.english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.

1981.english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.

1989.english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا الأرض مدت
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā l-arḍu mudda
verses.english: The earth will be leveled.

1981.english: The earth will be leveled.

1989.english: The earth will be leveled.

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
verses.arabicClean: وألقت ما فيها وتخلت
verses.transliterated: wa-alqat mā fīhā watakhalla
verses.english: It will eject its contents, as it erupts.

1981.english: It will throw its contents, as it erupts.

1989.english: It will eject its contents, as it erupts.

verses.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verses.arabicClean: وأذنت لربها وحقت
verses.transliterated: wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqa
verses.english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.

1981.english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.

1989.english: It will submit to its Lord and expire.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيها الإنسان إنك كادح إلى ربك كدحا فملاقيه
verses.transliterated: yāayyuhā l-insānu innaka kādiḥun ilā rabbika kadḥan famulāqīh
verses.english: O humans, you are irreversibly heading for a meeting with your Lord.

1981.english: O you human being, you are irreversibly moving towards your Lord, until you meet Him.

1989.english: O humans, you are irreversibly heading for a meeting with your Lord.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
verses.arabicClean: فأما من أوتي كتابه بيمينه
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnih
verses.english: As for the one who receives his record in his right hand,

1981.english: As for the one who receives his record in his right hand.

1989.english: As for the one who receives his record in his right hand,

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: فسوف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا
verses.transliterated: fasawfa yuḥāsabu ḥisāban yasīra
verses.english: His reckoning will be easy.

1981.english: His reckoning will be easy.

1989.english: His reckoning will be easy.

verses.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verses.arabicClean: وينقلب إلى أهله مسرورا
verses.transliterated: wayanqalibu ilā ahlihi masrūra
verses.english: He will return to his people joyfully.

1981.english: He will return to his people in joy.

1989.english: He will return to his people joyfully.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
verses.arabicClean: وأما من أوتي كتابه وراء ظهره
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu warāa ẓahrih
verses.english: As for the one who receives his record behind his back,

1981.english: As for the one who receives his record behind his back.

1989.english: As for the one who receives his record behind his back,

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
verses.arabicClean: فسوف يدعو ثبورا
verses.transliterated: fasawfa yadʿū thubūra
verses.english: He will be ridden with remorse.

1981.english: He will declare remorse.

1989.english: He will be ridden with remorse.

verses.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: ويصلى سعيرا
verses.transliterated: wayaṣlā saʿīra
verses.english: And will burn in Hell.

1981.english: He will burn in hell.

1989.english: And will burn in Hell.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verses.arabicClean: إنه كان في أهله مسرورا
verses.transliterated: innahu kāna fī ahlihi masrūra
verses.english: He used to act arrogantly among his people.

1981.english: He used to be proud among his people.

1989.english: He used to act arrogantly among his people.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
verses.arabicClean: إنه ظن أن لن يحور
verses.transliterated: innahu ẓanna an lan yaḥūr
verses.english: He thought that he will never be called to account.

1981.english: He thought that he is never held accountable.

1989.english: He thought that he will never be called to account.

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verses.arabicClean: بلى إن ربه كان به بصيرا
verses.transliterated: balā inna rabbahu kāna bihi baṣīra
verses.english: Yes indeed, his Lord was Seer of him.

1981.english: Yes indeed, his Lord sees him.

1989.english: Yes indeed, his Lord was Seer of him

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
verses.arabicClean: فلا أقسم بالشفق
verses.transliterated: falā uq'simu bil-shafaq
verses.english: I solemnly swear by the rosy dusk.

1981.english: By the token of the glowing sunset clouds.

1989.english: 1 solemnly swear by the rosy dusk.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
verses.arabicClean: والليل وما وسق
verses.transliterated: wa-al-layli wamā wasaq
verses.english: And the night as it spreads.

1981.english: By the night as it spreads.

1989.english: And the night as it spreads.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
verses.arabicClean: والقمر إذا اتسق
verses.transliterated: wal-qamari idhā ittasaq
verses.english: And the moon and its phases.

1981.english: By the moon as it rises.

1989.english: And the moon and its phases.

verses.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
verses.arabicClean: لتركبن طبقا عن طبق
verses.transliterated: latarkabunna ṭabaqan ʿan ṭabaqi
verses.english: You will move from stage to stage.

1981.english: You pass from stage to stage.

1989.english: You will move from stage to stage.

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.arabicClean: فما لهم لا يؤمنون
verses.transliterated: famā lahum lā yu'minūn
verses.english: Why do they not believe?

1981.english: Why then do they not believe?

1989.english: Why do they not believe?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ
verses.arabicClean: وإذا قرئ عليهم القرآن لا يسجدون ۩
verses.transliterated: wa-idhā quri-a ʿalayhimu l-qur'ānu lā yasjudūn
verses.english: And when the Quran is recited to them, they do not fall prostrate.

1981.english: When the Quran is recited to them, they do not submit.

1989.english: And when the Quran is recited to them, they do not fall prostrate.

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.arabicClean: بل الذين كفروا يكذبون
verses.transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū yukadhibūn
verses.english: This is because those who disbelieved are rejecting (the Quran).

1981.english: The disbelievers are those who reject it.

1989.english: This is because those who disbelieved are rejecting (the Quran).

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: والله أعلم بما يوعون
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yūʿūn
verses.english: GOD is fully aware of their innermost thoughts.

1981.english: God is fully aware of what they think.

1989.english: GOD is fully aware of their innermost thoughts.

verses.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.arabicClean: فبشرهم بعذاب أليم
verses.transliterated: fabashir'hum biʿadhābin alīmi
verses.english: Promise them painful retribution.

1981.english: Promise them painful retribution.

1989.english: Promise them painful retribution.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير ممنون
verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūni
verses.english: As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they receive a recompense that is well deserved.

1981.english: As for those who believe and work righteousness, they receive a well deserved recompense.

1989.english: As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they receive a recompense that is well deserved.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والسماء ذات البروج
verses.transliterated: wal-samāi dhāti l-burūj
verses.english: The sky and its galaxies.

1981.english: By the sky with its constellations.

1989.english: The sky and its galaxies.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
verses.arabicClean: واليوم الموعود
verses.transliterated: wal-yawmi l-mawʿūd
verses.english: The promised day.

1981.english: By the promised day.

1989.english: The promised day.

verses.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
verses.arabicClean: وشاهد ومشهود
verses.transliterated: washāhidin wamashhūdi
verses.english: The witness and the witnessed.

1981.english: By the witness and the witnessed.

1989.english: The witness and the witnessed.

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
verses.arabicClean: قتل أصحاب الأخدود
verses.transliterated: qutila aṣḥābu l-ukh'dūd
verses.english: Woe to the people of the canyon.

1981.english: The people of the canyon were doomed.

1989.english: Woe to the people of the canyon.

verses.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
verses.arabicClean: النار ذات الوقود
verses.transliterated: al-nāri dhāti l-waqūd
verses.english: They ignited a blazing fire.

1981.english: They set up a flaming fire.

1989.english: They ignited a blazing fire.

verses.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
verses.arabicClean: إذ هم عليها قعود
verses.transliterated: idh hum ʿalayhā quʿūdu
verses.english: Then sat around it.

1981.english: They sat around it.

1989.english: Then sat around it.

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
verses.arabicClean: وهم على ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود
verses.transliterated: wahum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bil-mu'minīna shuhūdu
verses.english: To watch the burning of the believers.

1981.english: Watching the believers burn.

1989.english: To watch the burning of the believers

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.arabicClean: وما نقموا منهم إلا أن يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد
verses.transliterated: wamā naqamū min'hum illā an yu'minū bil-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīd
verses.english: They hated them for no other reason than believing in GOD, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

1981.english: They persecuted them simply because they believed in God, the almighty, the praiseworthy.

1989.english: They hated them for no other reason than believing in GOD, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض ۚ والله على كل شيء شهيد
verses.transliterated: alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdu
verses.english: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. And GOD witnesses all things.

1981.english: To Him belong the heavens and the earth; and God witnesses all things.

1989.english: To Him belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. And GOD witnesses all things.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنات ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna fatanū l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti thumma lam yatūbū falahum ʿadhābu jahannama walahum ʿadhābu l-ḥarīq
verses.english: Surely, those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have incurred the retribution of Gehenna; they have incurred the retribution of burning.

1981.english: Those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have deserved the retribution of hell; they have deserved the agony of burning.

1989.english: Surely, those who persecute the believing men and women, then fail to repent, have incurred the retribution of Gehenna; they have incurred the retribution of burning.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار ۚ ذلك الفوز الكبير
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru dhālika l-fawzu l-kabīr
verses.english: Surely, those who believed and led a righteous life, have deserved gardens with flowing streams. This is the greatest triumph.

1981.english: Those who believe and work righteousness have deserved gardens with flowing streams; this is the great triumph.

1989.english: Surely, those who believed and led a righteous life, have deserved gardens with flowing streams. This is the greatest triumph.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن بطش ربك لشديد
verses.transliterated: inna baṭsha rabbika lashadīdu
verses.english: Indeed, your Lord's blow is severe.

1981.english: The blow of your Lord is severe.

1989.english: Indeed, your Lord’s blow is severe.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: إنه هو يبدئ ويعيد
verses.transliterated: innahu huwa yub'di-u wayuʿīd
verses.english: He is the One who initiates and repeats.

1981.english: He is the one who initiates and resurrects.

1989.english: He is the One who initiates and repeats.

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
verses.arabicClean: وهو الغفور الودود
verses.transliterated: wahuwa l-ghafūru l-wadūd
verses.english: And He is the Forgiving, Most Kind.

1981.english: He is the forgiver, the compassionate.

1989.english: And He is the Forgiving, Most Kind.

verses.arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: ذو العرش المجيد
verses.transliterated: dhū l-ʿarshi l-majīd
verses.english: Possessor of the glorious throne.

1981.english: Possessor of the glorious throne.

1989.english: Possessor of the glorious throne.

verses.arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verses.arabicClean: فعال لما يريد
verses.transliterated: faʿʿālun limā yurīd
verses.english: Doer of whatever He wills.

1981.english: Doer of anything He wills.

1989.english: Doer of whatever He wills.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
verses.arabicClean: هل أتاك حديث الجنود
verses.transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu l-junūd
verses.english: Did you note the history of the troops?

1981.english: Did you receive the history of the troops?

1989.english: Did you note the history of the troops?

verses.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
verses.arabicClean: فرعون وثمود
verses.transliterated: fir'ʿawna wathamūd
verses.english: Pharaoh and Thamûd?

1981.english: Pharaoh and Thamood?

1989.english: Pharaoh and Thamoud?

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
verses.arabicClean: بل الذين كفروا في تكذيب
verses.transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū fī takdhībi
verses.english: Those who disbelieve are plagued with denial.

1981.english: Those who disbelieve are rejecting (the truth).

1989.english: Those who disbelieve are plagued with denial.

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: والله من ورائهم محيط
verses.transliterated: wal-lahu min warāihim muḥīṭu
verses.english: GOD is fully aware of them.

1981.english: God is completely surrounding them.

1989.english: GOD is fully aware of them.

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: بل هو قرآن مجيد
verses.transliterated: bal huwa qur'ānun majīdu
verses.english: Indeed, it is a glorious Quran.

1981.english: Indeed, this is a glorious Quran.

1989.english: Indeed, it is a glorious Quran.

verses.arabic: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: في لوح محفوظ
verses.transliterated: fī lawḥin maḥfūẓi
verses.english: In a preserved master tablet.

1981.english: In a protected record.

1989.english: In a preserved master tablet.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والسماء والطارق
verses.transliterated: wal-samāi wal-ṭāriq
verses.english: By the sky and Al-Taareq.

1981.english: By the token of the sky and Al-Taariq.

1989.english: By the sky and Al-Taareq.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما الطارق
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriq
verses.english: Do you know what Al-Taareq is?

1981.english: Do you know what Al-Taariq is?

1989.english: Do you know what Al-Taareq is?

verses.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
verses.arabicClean: النجم الثاقب
verses.transliterated: al-najmu l-thāqib
verses.english: The bright star.

1981.english: The bright star.

1989.english: The bright star.

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
verses.transliterated: in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓu
verses.english: Absolutely, everyone is well guarded.

1981.english: Every person is well guarded.

1989.english: Absolutely, everyone is well guarded.

verses.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
verses.arabicClean: فلينظر الإنسان مم خلق
verses.transliterated: falyanẓuri l-insānu mimma khuliq
verses.english: Let the human reflect on his creation.

1981.english: The human being should reflect on his own creation.

1989.english: Let the human reflect on his creation.

verses.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
verses.arabicClean: خلق من ماء دافق
verses.transliterated: khuliqa min māin dāfiqi
verses.english: He was created from ejected liquid.

1981.english: He was created from ejaculated liquid.

1989.english: He was created from ejected liquid.

verses.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
verses.arabicClean: يخرج من بين الصلب والترائب
verses.transliterated: yakhruju min bayni l-ṣul'bi wal-tarāib
verses.english: From between the spine and the viscera.

1981.english: Issuing from between the spine and the viscera.

1989.english: From between the spine and the viscera.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنه على رجعه لقادر
verses.transliterated: innahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādiru
verses.english: He is certainly able to resurrect him.

1981.english: Certainly, God is able to resurrect him.

1989.english: He is certainly able to resurrect him.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
verses.arabicClean: يوم تبلى السرائر
verses.transliterated: yawma tub'lā l-sarāir
verses.english: The day all secrets become known.

1981.english: The day will come when all secrets become known.

1989.english: The day all secrets become known.

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
verses.arabicClean: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
verses.transliterated: famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣiri
verses.english: He will have no power, nor a helper.

1981.english: No one will have any power or helpers.

1989.english: He will have no power, nor a helper.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
verses.arabicClean: والسماء ذات الرجع
verses.transliterated: wal-samāi dhāti l-rajʿ
verses.english: By the sky that returns (the water).

1981.english: By the sky that returns the water.

1989.english: By the sky that returns (the water).

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
verses.arabicClean: والأرض ذات الصدع
verses.transliterated: wal-arḍi dhāti l-ṣadʿ
verses.english: By the earth that cracks (to grow plants).

1981.english: By the earth that cracks (to produce plants).

1989.english: By the earth that cracks (to grow plants).

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنه لقول فصل
verses.transliterated: innahu laqawlun faṣlu
verses.english: This is a serious narration.

1981.english: This is a decisive message.

1989.english: This is a serious narration.

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
verses.arabicClean: وما هو بالهزل
verses.transliterated: wamā huwa bil-hazl
verses.english: Not to be taken lightly.

1981.english: It is not vain talk.

1989.english: Not to be taken lightly.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
verses.arabicClean: إنهم يكيدون كيدا
verses.transliterated: innahum yakīdūna kayda
verses.english: They plot and scheme.

1981.english: They plot and scheme.

1989.english: They plot and scheme.

verses.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
verses.arabicClean: وأكيد كيدا
verses.transliterated: wa-akīdu kayda
verses.english: But so do I.

1981.english: But so do I.

1989.english: But so do I.

verses.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
verses.arabicClean: فمهل الكافرين أمهلهم رويدا
verses.transliterated: famahhili l-kāfirīna amhil'hum ruwayda
verses.english: Just respite the disbelievers a short respite.

1981.english: Therefore, disregard the disbelievers for a short while.

1989.english: Just respite the disbelievers a short respite.

verses.arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سبح اسم ربك الأعلى
verses.transliterated: sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿl
verses.english: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.

1981.english: Glorify the name of your Lord, the most high.

1989.english: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: الذي خلق فسوى
verses.transliterated: alladhī khalaqa fasaww
verses.english: He creates and shapes.

1981.english: He created and perfected.

1989.english: He creates and shapes.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: والذي قدر فهدى
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhī qaddara fahad
verses.english: He designs and guides.

1981.english: He designed and guided.

1989.english: He designs and guides.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: والذي أخرج المرعى
verses.transliterated: wa-alladhī akhraja l-marʿ
verses.english: He produces the pasture.

1981.english: He produces the pasture.

1989.english: He produces the pasture.

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فجعله غثاء أحوى
verses.transliterated: fajaʿalahu ghuthāan aḥw
verses.english: Then turns it into light hay.

1981.english: Then He turns it into light hay.

1989.english: Then turns it into light hay.

verses.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: سنقرئك فلا تنسى
verses.transliterated: sanuq'ri-uka falā tans
verses.english: We will recite to you; do not forget.

1981.english: We will recite for you, so do not forget.

1989.english: We will recite to you; do not forget.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إلا ما شاء الله ۚ إنه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى
verses.transliterated: illā mā shāa l-lahu innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra wamā yakhf
verses.english: Everything is in accordance with GOD's will; He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.

1981.english: Everything is in accordance with God's will. He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

1989.english: Everything is in accordance with GOD’s will; He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.

verses.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ونيسرك لليسرى
verses.transliterated: wanuyassiruka lil'yus'r
verses.english: We will direct you to the easiest path.

1981.english: We will make things easy for you.

1989.english: We will direct you to the easiest path.

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: فذكر إن نفعت الذكرى
verses.transliterated: fadhakkir in nafaʿati l-dhik'r
verses.english: Therefore, you shall remind; perhaps the reminder will benefit.

1981.english: So remind; the reminder may be useful.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall remind; perhaps the reminder will benefit.

verses.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: سيذكر من يخشى
verses.transliterated: sayadhakkaru man yakhsh
verses.english: The reverent will take heed.

1981.english: The reverent will take heed.

1989.english: The reverent will take heed.

verses.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
verses.arabicClean: ويتجنبها الأشقى
verses.transliterated: wayatajannabuhā l-ashq
verses.english: The wicked will avoid it.

1981.english: But the wicked will evade it.

1989.english: The wicked will avoid it.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: الذي يصلى النار الكبرى
verses.transliterated: alladhī yaṣlā l-nāra l-kub'r
verses.english: Consequently, he will suffer the great Hellfire.

1981.english: He will burn in the great fire.

1989.english: Consequently, he will suffer the great Hellfire.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى
verses.transliterated: thumma lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥy
verses.english: Wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.

1981.english: He will neither die therein nor stay alive.

1989.english: Wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.

verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: قد أفلح من تزكى
verses.transliterated: qad aflaḥa man tazakk
verses.english: Successful indeed is the one who redeems his soul.

1981.english: Winner is the one who turns righteous.

1989.english: Successful indeed is the one who redeems his soul.

verses.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وذكر اسم ربه فصلى
verses.transliterated: wadhakara is'ma rabbihi faṣall
verses.english: By remembering the name of his Lord, and observing the contact prayers (Salat).

1981.english: Who commemorates the name of his Lord by observing the **salat** prayers.

1989.english: By remembering the name of his Lord, and observing the contact prayers (Salat)

verses.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.arabicClean: بل تؤثرون الحياة الدنيا
verses.transliterated: bal tu'thirūna l-ḥayata l-dun'y
verses.english: Indeed, you are preoccupied with this first life.

1981.english: Indeed, the people give priority to this life.

1989.english: Indeed, you are preoccupied with this first life.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.arabicClean: والآخرة خير وأبقى
verses.transliterated: wal-ākhiratu khayrun wa-abq
verses.english: Even though the Hereafter is far better and everlasting.

1981.english: While the hereafter is far better and everlasting.

1989.english: Even though the Hereafter is far better and everlasting.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: إن هذا لفي الصحف الأولى
verses.transliterated: inna hādhā lafī l-ṣuḥufi l-ūl
verses.english: This is recorded in the earlier teachings.

1981.english: This is the same as in the previous scriptures.

1989.english: This is recorded in the earlier teachings.

verses.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: صحف إبراهيم وموسى
verses.transliterated: ṣuḥufi ib'rāhīma wamūs
verses.english: The teachings of Abraham and Moses.

1981.english: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

1989.english: The teachings of Abraham and Moses.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هل أتاك حديث الغاشية
verses.transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu l-ghāshiyat
verses.english: Are you aware of the Overwhelming?

1981.english: Did you receive a description of the overwhelming?

1989.english: Are you aware of the Overwhelming?

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: وجوه يومئذ خاشعة
verses.transliterated: wujūhun yawma-idhin khāshiʿatu
verses.english: Faces on that day will be shamed.

1981.english: Some faces, on that day, will be humiliated.

1989.english: Faces on that day will be shamed.

verses.arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: عاملة ناصبة
verses.transliterated: aamilatun nasibatun
verses.english: Laboring and exhausted.

1981.english: Laboring and exhausted.

1989.english: Laboring and exhausted.

verses.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
verses.arabicClean: تصلى نارا حامية
verses.transliterated: taṣlā nāran ḥāmiyata
verses.english: Suffering in a blazing Hellfire.

1981.english: Burning in a blazing fire.

1989.english: Suffering in a blazing Hellfire.

verses.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: تسقى من عين آنية
verses.transliterated: tus'qā min ʿaynin āniyati
verses.english: Drinking from a flaming spring.

1981.english: Drinking from a boiling spring.

1989.english: Drinking from a flaming spring.

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
verses.arabicClean: ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع
verses.transliterated: laysa lahum ṭaʿāmun illā min ḍarīʿi
verses.english: They will have no food except the useless variety.

1981.english: They will have no food, except from one source.

1989.english: They will have no food except the useless variety.

verses.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
verses.arabicClean: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
verses.transliterated: lā yus'minu walā yugh'nī min jūʿi
verses.english: It never nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.

1981.english: That never fills, nor satisfies any hunger.

1989.english: It never nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة
verses.transliterated: wujūhun yawma-idhin nāʿimatu
verses.english: Other faces on that day will be full of joy.

1981.english: Other faces, on that day, will be happy.

1989.english: Other faces on that day will be full of joy.

verses.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: لسعيها راضية
verses.transliterated: lisaʿyihā rāḍiyatu
verses.english: Satisfied with their work.

1981.english: Satisfied with their works.

1989.english: Satisfied with their work.

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: في جنة عالية
verses.transliterated: fī jannatin ʿāliyati
verses.english: In an exalted Paradise.

1981.english: In exalted Paradise.

1989.english: In an exalted Paradise.

verses.arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةً
verses.arabicClean: لا تسمع فيها لاغية
verses.transliterated: lā tasmaʿu fīhā lāghiyata
verses.english: In it, no nonsense is heard.

1981.english: You never hear in it any nonsense.

1989.english: In it, no nonsense is heard.

verses.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: فيها عين جارية
verses.transliterated: fīhā ʿaynun jāriyatu
verses.english: In it, a spring flows.

1981.english: In it, a flowing spring.

1989.english: In it, a spring flows.

verses.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: فيها سرر مرفوعة
verses.transliterated: fīhā sururun marfūʿatu
verses.english: In it, there are luxurious furnishings.

1981.english: In it, exalted furnishings.

1989.english: In it, there are luxurious furnishings.

verses.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: وأكواب موضوعة
verses.transliterated: wa-akwābun mawḍūʿatu
verses.english: And drinks made available.

1981.english: And drinks within reach.

1989.english: And drinks made available.

verses.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: ونمارق مصفوفة
verses.transliterated: wanamāriqu maṣfūfatu
verses.english: And pitchers in rows.

1981.english: And cushions in rows.

1989.english: And pitchers in rows.

verses.arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: وزرابي مبثوثة
verses.transliterated: wazarābiyyu mabthūthatu
verses.english: And carpets throughout.

1981.english: And vast carpets.

1989.english: And carpets throughout.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

verses.transliterated: afalā yanẓurūna ilā l-ibili kayfa khuliqa
verses.english: Why do they not reflect on the camels and how they are created?

1981.english: Do they not reflect on the camels; how they were created?

1989.english: Why do they not reflect on the camels and how they are created?

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى السماء كيف رفعت
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā l-samāi kayfa rufiʿa
verses.english: And the sky and how it is raised.

1981.english: And the sky; how it was raised?

1989.english: And the sky and how it is raised.

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى الجبال كيف نصبت
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā l-jibāli kayfa nuṣiba
verses.english: And the mountains and how they are constructed.

1981.english: And the mountains; how they were constructed?

1989.english: And the mountains and how they are constructed.

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
verses.arabicClean: وإلى الأرض كيف سطحت
verses.transliterated: wa-ilā l-arḍi kayfa suṭiḥa
verses.english: And the earth and how it is built.

1981.english: And the earth; how it was spread?

1989.english: And the earth and how it is built.

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
verses.arabicClean: فذكر إنما أنت مذكر
verses.transliterated: fadhakkir innamā anta mudhakkiru
verses.english: You shall remind, for your mission is to deliver this reminder.

1981.english: You shall remind. You are no more than a reminder.

1989.english: You shall remind, for your mission is to deliver this reminder.

verses.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
verses.arabicClean: لست عليهم بمصيطر
verses.transliterated: lasta ʿalayhim bimuṣayṭiri
verses.english: You have no power over them.

1981.english: You have no power over them.

1989.english: You have no power over them.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
verses.arabicClean: إلا من تولى وكفر
verses.transliterated: illā man tawallā wakafar
verses.english: As for those who turn away and disbelieve.

1981.english: As for the one who turns away and disbelieves.

1989.english: As for those who turn away and disbelieve.

verses.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
verses.arabicClean: فيعذبه الله العذاب الأكبر
verses.transliterated: fayuʿadhibuhu l-lahu l-ʿadhāba l-akbar
verses.english: GOD will commit them to the great retribution.

1981.english: God will commit him to terrible retribution.

1989.english: GOD will commit them to the great retribution.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: إن إلينا إيابهم
verses.transliterated: inna ilaynā iyābahu
verses.english: To us is their ultimate destiny.

1981.english: To us is their ultimate return.

1989.english: To us is their ultimate destiny.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
verses.arabicClean: ثم إن علينا حسابهم
verses.transliterated: thumma inna ʿalaynā ḥisābahu
verses.english: Then we will call them to account.

1981.english: Then we will hold them accountable.

1989.english: Then we will call them to account.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والفجر
verses.transliterated: wal-fajr
verses.english: By the dawn.

1981.english: By the dawn.

1989.english: By the dawn.

verses.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
verses.arabicClean: وليال عشر
verses.transliterated: walayālin ʿashri
verses.english: And the ten nights.
verses.footnote: Last ten nights of Ramadan, wherein many believers retreat to the masjids (2:187).

1981.english: By the ten nights.

1989.english: And the ten nights.*
1989.footnote: Last ten nights of Ramadan, wherein many believers retreat to mosques (2:187).

verses.arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
verses.arabicClean: والشفع والوتر
verses.transliterated: wal-shafʿi wal-watr
verses.english: By the even and the odd.
verses.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the role of the even numbers and the odd numbers.

1981.english: By the even and the odd.

1989.english: By the even and the odd.*
1989.footnote: See Appendix 1 for the role of the even numbers and the odd numbers. 268(

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
verses.arabicClean: والليل إذا يسر
verses.transliterated: wa-al-layli idhā yasr
verses.english: By the night as it passes.

1981.english: By the night as it moves on.

1989.english: By the night as it passes.

verses.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
verses.arabicClean: هل في ذلك قسم لذي حجر
verses.transliterated: hal fī dhālika qasamun lidhī ḥij'ri
verses.english: A profound oath, for one who possesses intelligence.

1981.english: This is a formidable oath, for those who understand.

1989.english: A profound oath, for one who possesses intelligence.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
verses.transliterated: alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿādi
verses.english: Have you noted what your Lord did to 'Ãd?

1981.english: Do you not see what your Lord did to 'Aad?

1989.english: Have you noted what your Lord did to Aad?

verses.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
verses.arabicClean: إرم ذات العماد
verses.transliterated: irama dhāti l-ʿimād
verses.english: Erum; the town with tall buildings.

1981.english: Iram, the city with pillars.

1989.english: Erum; the town with tall buildings.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verses.arabicClean: التي لم يخلق مثلها في البلاد
verses.transliterated: allatī lam yukh'laq mith'luhā fī l-bilād
verses.english: There was nothing like it anywhere.

1981.english: There was nothing like it anywhere.

1989.english: There was nothing like it anywhere.

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
verses.arabicClean: وثمود الذين جابوا الصخر بالواد
verses.transliterated: wathamūda alladhīna jābū l-ṣakhra bil-wād
verses.english: Also Thamûd, who carved the rocks in their valley.

1981.english: Also Thamood, who carved rocks in the valley.

1989.english: Also Thamoud, who carved the rocks in their valley.

verses.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.arabicClean: وفرعون ذي الأوتاد
verses.transliterated: wafir'ʿawna dhī l-awtād
verses.english: And Pharaoh who possessed might.

1981.english: And Pharaoh with the troops.

1989.english: And Pharaoh who possessed might.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
verses.arabicClean: الذين طغوا في البلاد
verses.transliterated: alladhīna ṭaghaw fī l-bilād
verses.english: They all transgressed in the land.

1981.english: They all transgressed in the land.

1989.english: They all transgressed in the land.

verses.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
verses.arabicClean: فأكثروا فيها الفساد
verses.transliterated: fa-aktharū fīhā l-fasād
verses.english: They spread evil throughout.

1981.english: They spread corruption.

1989.english: They spread evil throughout.

verses.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
verses.arabicClean: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب
verses.transliterated: faṣabba ʿalayhim rabbuka sawṭa ʿadhābi
verses.english: Consequently, your Lord poured upon them a whipping retribution.

1981.english: Consequently, your Lord poured upon them terrible retribution.

1989.english: Consequently, your Lord poured upon them a whipping retribution.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربك لبالمرصاد
verses.transliterated: inna rabbaka labil-mir'ṣād
verses.english: Your Lord is ever watchful.

1981.english: Your Lord is ever watchful.

1989.english: Your Lord is ever watchful.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
verses.arabicClean: فأما الإنسان إذا ما ابتلاه ربه فأكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربي أكرمن
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā l-insānu idhā mā ib'talāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbī akraman
verses.english: When the human being is tested by his Lord, through blessings and joy, he says, "My Lord is generous towards me."

1981.english: Consider the human being; when his Lord puts him to the test by endowing him and blessing him, he says, "My Lord has endowed me."

1989.english: When the human being is tested by his Lord, through blessings and joy, he says, “My Lord is generous towards me.”

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
verses.arabicClean: وأما إذا ما ابتلاه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي أهانن
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā idhā mā ib'talāhu faqadara ʿalayhi riz'qahu fayaqūlu rabbī ahānan
verses.english: But if He tests him through reduction in provisions, he says, "My Lord is humiliating me!"

1981.english: But when He puts him to the test by reducing his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

1989.english: But if He tests him through reduction in provisions, he says, “My Lord is humiliating me!”

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: كلا ۖ بل لا تكرمون اليتيم
verses.transliterated: kallā bal lā tuk'rimūna l-yatīm
verses.english: Wrong! It is you who brought it on yourselves by not regarding the orphan.

1981.english: No; (it is not your Lord who humiliates you.) It is you who do not regard the orphan.

1989.english: Wrong! It is you who brought it on yourselves by not regarding the orphan.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.arabicClean: ولا تحاضون على طعام المسكين
verses.transliterated: walā taḥāḍḍūna ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīn
verses.english: And not advocating charity towards the poor.

1981.english: Nor do you exhort each other to feed the poor.

1989.english: And not advocating charity towards the poor.

verses.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
verses.arabicClean: وتأكلون التراث أكلا لما
verses.transliterated: watakulūna l-turātha aklan lamma
verses.english: And consuming the inheritance of helpless orphans.

1981.english: You unlawfully consume the (orphan's) inheritance.

1989.english: And consuming the inheritance of helpless orphans.

verses.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
verses.arabicClean: وتحبون المال حبا جما
verses.transliterated: watuḥibbūna l-māla ḥubban jamma
verses.english: And loving the money too much.

1981.english: You love money too much.

1989.english: And loving the money too much.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
verses.arabicClean: كلا إذا دكت الأرض دكا دكا
verses.transliterated: kallā idhā dukkati l-arḍu dakkan dakka
verses.english: Indeed, when the earth is crushed, utterly crushed.

1981.english: Indeed, the earth will be demolished; totally crushed.

1989.english: Indeed, when the earth is crushed, utterly crushed.

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
verses.arabicClean: وجاء ربك والملك صفا صفا
verses.transliterated: wajāa rabbuka wal-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffa
verses.english: And your Lord comes, together with the angels in row after row.

1981.english: As your Lord comes,* together with the angels in row after row.

1989.english: And your Lord comes, together with the angels in row after row.

verses.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.arabicClean: وجيء يومئذ بجهنم ۚ يومئذ يتذكر الإنسان وأنى له الذكرى
verses.transliterated: wajīa yawma-idhin bijahannama yawma-idhin yatadhakkaru l-insānu wa-annā lahu l-dhik'r
verses.english: On that day, Gehenna will be brought forth. On that day, the human being will remember—but what a remembrance—it will be too late.

1981.english: Hell will be brought forth on that day. The human being will then remember, and what a remembrance!

1989.english: On that day, Gehenna will be brought forth. On that day, the human being will remember—but what a remembrance—it will be too late.

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
verses.arabicClean: يقول يا ليتني قدمت لحياتي
verses.transliterated: yaqūlu yālaytanī qaddamtu liḥayāt
verses.english: He will say, "Oh, I wish I prepared for my (eternal) life."

1981.english: He will say, "Oh I wish I had prepared for my (eternal) life."

1989.english: He will say, “Oh, I wish I prepared for my (eternal) life.”

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.arabicClean: فيومئذ لا يعذب عذابه أحد
verses.transliterated: fayawma-idhin lā yuʿadhibu ʿadhābahu aḥadu
verses.english: On that day, no retribution could be worse than His retribution.

1981.english: On that day, the retribution is worst.

1989.english: On that day, no retribution could be worse than His retribution.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يوثق وثاقه أحد
verses.transliterated: walā yūthiqu wathāqahu aḥadu
verses.english: And no confinement is as effective as His confinement.

1981.english: The confinement is absolute.

1989.english: And no confinement is as effective as His confinement.

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
verses.arabicClean: يا أيتها النفس المطمئنة
verses.transliterated: yāayyatuhā l-nafsu l-muṭ'ma-inat
verses.english: As for you, O content soul.

1981.english: As for you, secure and content soul.

1989.english: As for you, O content soul.

verses.arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
verses.arabicClean: ارجعي إلى ربك راضية مرضية
verses.transliterated: ir'jiʿī ilā rabbiki rāḍiyatan marḍiyyata
verses.english: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing.

1981.english: Come back to your Lord, satisfied and satisfying.

1989.english: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing.

verses.arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
verses.arabicClean: فادخلي في عبادي
verses.transliterated: fa-ud'khulī fī ʿibād
verses.english: Welcome into My servants.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب
verses.arabicClean: كلا لا تطعه واسجد واقترب ۩
verses.transliterated: kallā lā tuṭiʿ'hu wa-us'jud wa-iq'tari
verses.english: You shall not obey him; you shall fall prostrate and draw nearer.

1981.english: You shall not obey such a person. Instead, you shall fall prostrate and come closer.

1989.english: You shall not obey him; you shall fall prostrate and draw nearer.
1989.footnote: From 96 to 114 is 19 suras. The first revelation (96:1-5) is 19 Arabic words, 76 letters (19x4). The sura consists of 19 verses and 304 Arabic letters (App. 1 & 23).

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إنا أنزلناه في ليلة القدر
verses.transliterated: innā anzalnāhu fī laylati l-qadr
verses.english: We revealed it in the Night of Destiny.
verses.footnote: The Quran was placed into Muhammad's soul on the 27th night of Ramadan, 13 B.H. (Before Hijrah). See also 17:1, 44:3, 53:1-18, and Appendix 28.

1981.english: We have revealed this Quran in the night of power.
1981.footnote: See footnote 17:1.

1989.english: We revealed it in the Night of Destiny.*
1989.footnote: The Quran was placed into Muhammad’s soul on the 27th night of Ramadan, 13 B.H. (Before Hijrah). See also 17:1, 44:3, 53:1-18, and Appendix 28.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما ليلة القدر
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā laylatu l-qadr
verses.english: How awesome is the Night of Destiny!

1981.english: Do you know what the night of power is?

1989.english: How awesome is the Night of Destiny!

verses.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.arabicClean: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر
verses.transliterated: laylatu l-qadri khayrun min alfi shahri
verses.english: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.

1981.english: The night of power is better than a thousand months.

1989.english: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.arabicClean: تنزل الملائكة والروح فيها بإذن ربهم من كل أمر
verses.transliterated: tanazzalu l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu fīhā bi-idh'ni rabbihim min kulli amri
verses.english: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by their Lord's leave, to carry out every command.

1981.english: The angels and the spirit (Gabriel) descend therein, with permission from their Lord, to carry out every command.
1981.footnote: Every believer who sincerely fasts during the month of Ramadan and observes a perfect month of righteousness and devotion witnesses the "night of power" by the end of Ramadan. The angels visit such a person and fulfill his or her dearest wishes (see 2:186).

1989.english: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by their Lord’s leave, to carry out every command.

verses.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
verses.arabicClean: سلام هي حتى مطلع الفجر
verses.transliterated: salāmun hiya ḥattā maṭlaʿi l-fajr
verses.english: Peaceful it is until the advent of the dawn.

1981.english: Peaceful it is, until the rising of the dawn.

1989.english: Peaceful it is until the advent of the dawn

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لم يكن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب والمشركين منفكين حتى تأتيهم البينة
verses.transliterated: lam yakuni alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna munfakkīna ḥattā tatiyahumu l-bayinat
verses.english: Those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture, as well as the idol worshipers, insist on their ways, despite the proof given to them.
verses.footnote: The proof is the Quran's mathematical code (Appendix 1) and the messenger is Rashad Khalifa. The No. of sura (98), plus the verse No. (2), plus the numerical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230) add up to 1330 (19x70), the same total as in 81:19 (App. 2).

1981.english: Those who disbelieved among the followers of previous scriptures, as well as the idol worshipers, will never believe, even after the proof has come to them.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture, as well as the idol worshipers, insist on their ways, despite the proof given to them.*
1989.footnote: The proof is the Quran’s mathematical code (Appendix 1) and the messenger is Rashad Khalifa. The No. of sura (98), plus the verse No. (2), plus the numerical value of “Rashad Khalifa” (1230), add up to 1330 (19x70), the same total as in 81:19 (App. 2). 2692,

verses.arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
verses.arabicClean: رسول من الله يتلو صحفا مطهرة
verses.transliterated: rasūlun mina l-lahi yatlū ṣuḥufan muṭahharata
verses.english: A messenger from GOD is reciting to them sacred instructions.

1981.english: A messenger from God, reciting sacred scripture.

1989.english: A messenger from GOD is reciting to them sacred instructions.*
1989.footnote: The proof is the Quran’s mathematical code (Appendix 1) and the messenger is Rashad Khalifa. The No. of sura (98), plus the verse No. (2), plus the numerical value of “Rashad Khalifa” (1230), add up to 1330 (19x70), the same total as in 81:19 (App. 2). 2692,

verses.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: فيها كتب قيمة
verses.transliterated: fīhā kutubun qayyimatu
verses.english: In them there are valuable teachings.

1981.english: Wherein there are valuable commandments.

1989.english: In them there are valuable teachings.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.arabicClean: وما تفرق الذين أوتوا الكتاب إلا من بعد ما جاءتهم البينة
verses.transliterated: wamā tafarraqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba illā min baʿdi mā jāathumu l-bayinat
verses.english: In fact, those who received the scripture did not dispute until the proof was given to them.

1981.english: Those who received previous scripture became divided after the proof did come to them.

1989.english: In fact, those who received the scripture did not dispute until the proof was given to them.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
verses.arabicClean: وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين حنفاء ويقيموا الصلاة ويؤتوا الزكاة ۚ وذلك دين القيمة
verses.transliterated: wamā umirū illā liyaʿbudū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna ḥunafāa wayuqīmū l-ṣalata wayu'tū l-zakata wadhālika dīnu l-qayimat
verses.english: All that was asked of them was to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). Such is the perfect religion.

1981.english: All that is enjoined upon them is to believe in God, to devote the worship to Him alone, and to observe the **salat** prayers and **zakat** charity. This is the perfect religion.

1989.english: All that was asked of them was to worship GOD, devoting the religion absolutely to Him alone, observe the contact prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat). Such is the perfect religion.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب والمشركين في نار جهنم خالدين فيها ۚ أولئك هم شر البرية
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna fī nāri jahannama khālidīna fīhā ulāika hum sharru l-bariyat
verses.english: Those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture, and the idol worshipers have incurred the fire of Gehenna forever. They are the worst creatures.

1981.english: Those who disbelieved among the followers of previous scripture, as well as the idol worshipers, will abide in hell forever. They are the worst creatures.

1989.english: Those who disbelieved among the people of the scripture, and the idol worshipers have incurred the fire of Gehenna forever. They are the worst creatures.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.arabicClean: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات أولئك هم خير البرية
verses.transliterated: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika hum khayru l-bariyat
verses.english: Those who believed and led a righteous life are the best creatures.

1981.english: Those who believe and work righteousness are the best creatures.

1989.english: Those who believed and led a righteous life are the best creatures.

verses.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: جزاؤهم عند ربهم جنات عدن تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا ۖ رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ۚ ذلك لمن خشي ربه
verses.transliterated: jazāuhum ʿinda rabbihim jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu dhālika liman khashiya rabbah
verses.english: Their reward at their Lord is the gardens of Eden with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. Such is the reward for those who reverence their Lord.

1981.english: Their recompense is with their Lord; gardens of Eden with flowing streams; they abide therein forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. This is the reward for those who reverence their Lord.

1989.english: Their reward at their Lord is the gardens of Eden with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. Such is the reward for those who reverence their Lord.

verses.arabic: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا زلزلت الأرض زلزالها
verses.transliterated: idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālah
verses.english: When the earth is severely quaked.

1981.english: When the earth is quaked by its (final) quake.

1989.english: When the earth is severely quaked.

verses.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
verses.arabicClean: وأخرجت الأرض أثقالها
verses.transliterated: wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālah
verses.english: And the earth ejects its loads.

1981.english: When the earth erupts and issues its loads.

1989.english: And the earth ejects its loads.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
verses.arabicClean: وقال الإنسان ما لها
verses.transliterated: waqāla l-insānu mā lah
verses.english: The human will wonder: "What is happening?"

1981.english: The human being will then say, "What is happening?"

1989.english: The human will wonder: “What is happening?”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
verses.arabicClean: يومئذ تحدث أخبارها
verses.transliterated: yawma-idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārah
verses.english: On that day, it will tell its news.

1981.english: On that day, it will explain.

1989.english: On that day, it will tell its news.

verses.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
verses.arabicClean: بأن ربك أوحى لها
verses.transliterated: bi-anna rabbaka awḥā lah
verses.english: That your Lord has commanded it.

1981.english: That the Lord had commanded it.

1989.english: That your Lord has commanded it.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
verses.arabicClean: يومئذ يصدر الناس أشتاتا ليروا أعمالهم
verses.transliterated: yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahu
verses.english: On that day, the people will issue from every direction, to be shown their works.

1981.english: On that day, the people will come out in throngs, to be shown their works.

1989.english: On that day, the people will issue from every direction, to be shown their works.

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره
verses.transliterated: faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarah
verses.english: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.

1981.english: Whoever does an atom's weight of righteousness will see it.

1989.english: Whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره
verses.transliterated: waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarah
verses.english: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

1981.english: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

1989.english: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًا
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والعاديات ضبحا
verses.transliterated: wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥa
verses.english: By the fast gallopers.

1981.english: By the speedy runners.

1989.english: By the fast gallopers.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًا
verses.arabicClean: فالموريات قدحا
verses.transliterated: fal-mūriyāti qadḥa
verses.english: Igniting sparks.

1981.english: Who ignite sparks.

1989.english: Igniting sparks.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
verses.arabicClean: فالمغيرات صبحا
verses.transliterated: fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥa
verses.english: Invading (the enemy) by morning.

1981.english: And invade at morning.

1989.english: Invading (the enemy) by morning.

verses.arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
verses.arabicClean: فأثرن به نقعا
verses.transliterated: fa-atharna bihi naqʿa
verses.english: Striking terror therein.

1981.english: Spreading terror into the enemy.

1989.english: Striking terror therein.

verses.arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
verses.arabicClean: فوسطن به جمعا
verses.transliterated: fawasaṭna bihi jamʿa
verses.english: Penetrating to the heart of their territory.

1981.english: Invading the heart of their land.

1989.english: Penetrating to the heart of their territory.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
verses.arabicClean: إن الإنسان لربه لكنود
verses.transliterated: inna l-insāna lirabbihi lakanūdu
verses.english: The human being is unappreciative of his Lord.

1981.english: The human being is unappreciative of his Lord.

1989.english: The human being is unappreciative of his Lord.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه على ذلك لشهيد
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdu
verses.english: He bears witness to this fact.

1981.english: He bears witness to that.

1989.english: He bears witness to this fact.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.arabicClean: وإنه لحب الخير لشديد
verses.transliterated: wa-innahu liḥubbi l-khayri lashadīdu
verses.english: He loves material things excessively.

1981.english: He loves material wealth too much.

1989.english: He loves material things excessively.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.arabicClean: أفلا يعلم إذا بعثر ما في القبور
verses.transliterated: afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūr
verses.english: Does he not realize that the day will come when the graves are opened?

1981.english: Does he not realize that those in the graves will be revived?

1989.english: Does he not realize that the day will come when the graves are opened?

verses.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.arabicClean: وحصل ما في الصدور
verses.transliterated: waḥuṣṣila mā fī l-ṣudūr
verses.english: And all secrets are brought out.

1981.english: And the innermost secrets will be declared?

1989.english: And all secrets are brought out.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: إن ربهم بهم يومئذ لخبير
verses.transliterated: inna rabbahum bihim yawma-idhin lakhabīru
verses.english: They will find out, on that day, that their Lord has been fully Cognizant of them.

1981.english: Their Lord is fully cognizant of everything they do.

1989.english: They will find out, on that day, that their Lord has been fully Cognizant of them

verses.arabic: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم القارعة
verses.transliterated: al-qāriʿat
verses.english: The Shocker.

1981.english: The shocker.

1989.english: The Shocker.

verses.arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verses.arabicClean: ما القارعة
verses.transliterated: mā l-qāriʿat
verses.english: What a shocker!

1981.english: What a shocker!

1989.english: What a shocker!

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما القارعة
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-qāriʿat
verses.english: Do you have any idea what the Shocker is?

1981.english: Do you have any idea what the shocker is?

1989.english: Do you have any idea what the Shocker is?

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
verses.arabicClean: يوم يكون الناس كالفراش المبثوث
verses.transliterated: yawma yakūnu l-nāsu kal-farāshi l-mabthūth
verses.english: That is the day when the people come out like swarms of butterflies.

1981.english: That is the day when the people rise like multitudes of moths.

1989.english: That is the day when the people come out like swarms of butterflies.

verses.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
verses.arabicClean: وتكون الجبال كالعهن المنفوش
verses.transliterated: watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni l-manfūsh
verses.english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.

1981.english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.

1989.english: The mountains will be like fluffy wool.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: فأما من ثقلت موازينه
verses.transliterated: fa-ammā man thaqulat mawāzīnuh
verses.english: As for him whose weights are heavy.

1981.english: As for him whose weights are heavy.

1989.english: As for him whose weights are heavy.

verses.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: فهو في عيشة راضية
verses.transliterated: fahuwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyati
verses.english: He will lead a happy (eternal) life.

1981.english: He will live a happy life.

1989.english: He will lead a happy (eternal) life.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: وأما من خفت موازينه
verses.transliterated: wa-ammā man khaffat mawāzīnuh
verses.english: As for him whose weights are light.

1981.english: As for him whose weights are light.

1989.english: As for him whose weights are light.

verses.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: فأمه هاوية
verses.transliterated: fa-ummuhu hāwiyatu
verses.english: His destiny is lowly.

1981.english: His destiny is lowly.

1989.english: His destiny is lowly.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما هيه
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā hiya
verses.english: Do you know what it is?

1981.english: Do you know what it is?

1989.english: Do you know what it is?

verses.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: نار حامية
verses.transliterated: nārun ḥāmiyatu
verses.english: The blazing Hellfire.

1981.english: The burning hell.

1989.english: The blazing Hellfire.

verses.arabic: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ألهاكم التكاثر
verses.transliterated: alhākumu l-takāthur
verses.english: You remain preoccupied with hoarding.

1981.english: You remain preoccupied with hoarding.

1989.english: You remain preoccupied with hoarding.

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
verses.arabicClean: حتى زرتم المقابر
verses.transliterated: ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābir
verses.english: Until you go to the graves.

1981.english: Until you go to the graves.

1989.english: Until you go to the graves.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: كلا سوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: kallā sawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Indeed, you will find out.

1981.english: Indeed, you will find out.

1989.english: Indeed, you will find out.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون
verses.transliterated: thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūn
verses.english: Most assuredly, you will find out.

1981.english: Yes indeed, you will find out.

1989.english: Most assuredly, you will find out.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.arabicClean: كلا لو تعلمون علم اليقين

verses.english: If only you could find out for certain.

1981.english: If you could only find out now.

1989.english: If only you could find out for certain.

verses.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: لترون الجحيم
verses.transliterated: latarawunna l-jaḥīm
verses.english: You would envision Hell.

1981.english: You would envision hell.

1989.english: You would envision Hell.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.arabicClean: ثم لترونها عين اليقين
verses.transliterated: thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna l-yaqīn
verses.english: Then you would see it with the eye of certainty.

1981.english: You would envision it with the eye of certainty.

1989.english: Then you would see it with the eye of certainty.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.arabicClean: ثم لتسألن يومئذ عن النعيم
verses.transliterated: thumma latus'alunna yawma-idhin ʿani l-naʿīm
verses.english: Then you will be questioned, on that day, about the blessings you had enjoyed.

1981.english: You will be asked about your hoarding.

1989.english: Then you will be questioned, on that day, about the blessings you had enjoyed.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والعصر
verses.transliterated: wal-ʿaṣr
verses.english: By the afternoon.

1981.english: By the token of the afternoon.

1989.english: By the afternoon.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
verses.arabicClean: إن الإنسان لفي خسر
verses.transliterated: inna l-insāna lafī khus'ri
verses.english: The human being is utterly lost.

1981.english: The human being is in total loss.

1989.english: The human being is utterly lost.

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

verses.transliterated: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣaw bil-ḥaqi watawāṣaw bil-ṣabr
verses.english: Except those who believe and lead a righteous life, and exhort one another to uphold the truth, and exhort one another to be steadfast.

1981.english: Except those who believe and lead a righteous life, and exhort each other to uphold the truth, and exhort each other to be steadfast.

1989.english: Except those who believe and lead a righteous life, and exhort one another to uphold the truth, and exhort one another to be steadfast.

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ويل لكل همزة لمزة
verses.transliterated: waylun likulli humazatin lumazati
verses.english: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer.

1981.english: Woe to the backbiter, the slanderer.

1989.english: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: الذي جمع مالا وعدده
verses.transliterated: alladhī jamaʿa mālan waʿaddadah
verses.english: He hoards money and counts it.

1981.english: Who collects money (in this way),* and hoards it.

1989.english: He hoards money and counts it.

verses.arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
verses.arabicClean: يحسب أن ماله أخلده
verses.transliterated: yaḥsabu anna mālahu akhladah
verses.english: As if his money will make him immortal.

1981.english: As if his money will make him immortal.

1989.english: As if his money will make him immortal.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
verses.arabicClean: كلا ۖ لينبذن في الحطمة
verses.transliterated: kallā layunbadhanna fī l-ḥuṭamat
verses.english: Never; he will be thrown into the Devastator.

1981.english: Indeed, he will be thrown into devastating doom.

1989.english: Never; he will be thrown into the Devastator.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
verses.arabicClean: وما أدراك ما الحطمة
verses.transliterated: wamā adrāka mā l-ḥuṭamat
verses.english: Do you know what the Devastator is?

1981.english: Do you know what devastating doom?

1989.english: Do you know what the Devastator is'

verses.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
verses.arabicClean: نار الله الموقدة
verses.transliterated: nāru l-lahi l-mūqadat
verses.english: GOD's blazing Hellfire.

1981.english: God's flaming hellfire.

1989.english: GOD’s blazing Hellfire.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
verses.arabicClean: التي تطلع على الأفئدة
verses.transliterated: allatī taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā l-afidat
verses.english: It burns them inside out.

1981.english: It burns them inside out.

1989.english: It burns them inside out.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ
verses.arabicClean: إنها عليهم مؤصدة
verses.transliterated: innahā ʿalayhim mu'ṣadatu
verses.english: They will be confined therein.

1981.english: They will be confined therein.

1989.english: They will be confined therein.

verses.arabic: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: في عمد ممددة
verses.transliterated: fī ʿamadin mumaddadati
verses.english: In extended columns.

1981.english: In long rows.

1989.english: In extended columns.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

verses.transliterated: alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi l-fīl
verses.english: Have you noted what your Lord did to the people of the elephant?

1981.english: Have you noted what your Lord did to the people of the elephant?

1989.english: Have you noted what your Lord did to the people of the elephant?

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: ألم يجعل كيدهم في تضليل
verses.transliterated: alam yajʿal kaydahum fī taḍlīli
verses.english: Did He not cause their schemes to backfire?

1981.english: Did He not frustrate their plans?

1989.english: Did He not cause their schemes to backfire?

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

verses.transliterated: wa-arsala ʿalayhim ṭayran bAbyl#(

1981.english: He sent upon them airborne multitudes.

1989.english: He sent upon them swarms of birds.

verses.arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.arabicClean: ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل

1981.english: Showering them with sandstone rocks.

1989.english: That showered them with hard stones.

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: فجعلهم كعصف مأكول
verses.transliterated: fajaʿalahum kaʿaṣfin makūli
verses.english: He made them like chewed up hay.

1981.english: He made them like chewed up hay.

1989.english: He made them like chewed up hay. X

verses.arabic: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لإيلاف قريش
verses.transliterated: liīlāfi qurayshi
verses.english: This should be cherished by Quraish.

1981.english: Quraish should have cherished (this message).

1989.english: This should be cherished by Quraish.

verses.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

verses.english: The way they cherish the caravans of the winter and the summer.

1981.english: The way they cherished the journeys of the winter and the summer.

1989.english: The way they cherish the caravans of the winter and the summer.

verses.arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

verses.english: They shall worship the Lord of this shrine.

1981.english: They shall worship the Lord of this shrine.

1989.english: They shall worship the Lord of this shrine.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

verses.english: For He is the One who fed them after hunger, and provided them with security after fear.

1981.english: The one who fed them after hunger, and gave them security after fear.

1989.english: For He is the One who fed them after hunger, and provided them with security after fear.
