verses.english: Do you know who really rejects the faith?

1981.english: Do you know who is the rejector of faith?

1989.english: Do you know who really rejects the faith?

verses.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
verses.arabicClean: فذلك الذي يدع اليتيم
verses.transliterated: fadhālika alladhī yaduʿʿu l-yatīm
verses.english: That is the one who mistreats the orphans.

1981.english: The one who neglects the orphan.

1989.english: That is the one who mistreats the orphans.

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.arabicClean: ولا يحض على طعام المسكين
verses.transliterated: walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīn
verses.english: And does not advocate the feeding of the poor.

1981.english: And never advocates the feeding of the poor.

1989.english: And does not advocate the feeding of the poor.

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.arabicClean: فويل للمصلين
verses.transliterated: fawaylun lil'muṣallīn
verses.english: And woe to those who observe the contact prayers (Salat)—

1981.english: Therefore, woe to those who observe the **salat** prayers.

1989.english: And woe to those who observe the contact prayers (Salat)—

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna hum ʿan ṣalātihim sāhūn
verses.english: who are totally heedless of their prayers.

1981.english: While heedless of their **salat**.

1989.english: who are totally heedless of their prayers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
verses.arabicClean: الذين هم يراءون
verses.transliterated: alladhīna hum yurāūn
verses.english: They only show off.

1981.english: They only show off.

1989.english: They only show off.

verses.arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
verses.arabicClean: ويمنعون الماعون
verses.transliterated: wayamnaʿūna l-māʿūn
verses.english: And they forbid charity.

1981.english: And are averse to charity.

1989.english: And they forbid charity.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إنا أعطيناك الكوثر

verses.english: We have blessed you with many a bounty.

1981.english: We have given you many bounties.

1989.english: We have blessed you with many a bounty.

verses.transliterated: faṣalli lirabbika wa-in'ḥa
verses.english: Therefore, you shall pray to your Lord (Salat), and give to charity.

1981.english: In appreciation, you shall worship your Lord, and be charitable.

1989.english: Therefore, you shall pray to your Lord (Salat), and give to charity.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
verses.arabicClean: إن شانئك هو الأبتر
verses.transliterated: inna shāni-aka huwa l-abtar
verses.english: Your opponent will be the loser.

1989.english: Your opponent will be the loser.

verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل يا أيها الكافرون
verses.transliterated: qul yāayyuhā l-kāfirūn
verses.english: Say, "O you disbelievers.

1981.english: Say, "O you disbelievers.

1989.english: Say, “O you disbelievers.

verses.arabicClean: لا أعبد ما تعبدون
verses.transliterated: lā aʿbudu mā taʿbudūn
verses.english: "I do not worship what you worship.

1981.english: "I do not worship what you worship.

1989.english: “I do not worship what you worship.

1989.english: “Nor do you worship what I worship.

verses.transliterated: walā anā ʿābidun mā ʿabadttu
verses.english: "Nor will I ever worship what you worship.

1981.english: "Nor will I ever worship what you worship.

1989.english: “Nor will I ever worship what you worship.

verses.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
verses.arabicClean: ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد
verses.transliterated: walā antum ʿābidūna mā aʿbud
verses.english: "Nor will you ever worship what I worship.

1981.english: "Nor will you ever worship what I worship.

1989.english: “Nor will you ever worship what I worship.

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

verses.transliterated: lakum dīnukum waliya dīn
verses.english: "To you is your religion, and to me is my religion."

1981.english: "To you is your religion, and to me is my religion."

1989.english: “To you is your religion, and to me is my religion.”

verses.arabic: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح
verses.transliterated: idhā jāa naṣru l-lahi wal-fatḥ
verses.english: When triumph comes from GOD, and victory.
verses.footnote: This last sura, chronologically, consists of 19 Arabic words (see 96:1), and the first verse consists of 19 letters. This indicates that this generation of believers shall attain the promised victory. Submission (true Islam) will prevail throughout the world (48:28).

1981.english: When God's support comes and victory.
1981.subtitle: Last Sura Ever Revealed

1989.english: When triumph comes from GOD, and victory.
1989.subtitle: (Al-Nassr) ^ [Last Sura Revealed]
1989.footnote: This last sura, chronologically, consists of 19 Arabic words (see 96:1), and the first verse consists of 19 letters. This indicates that this generation of believers shall attain the promised victory. The true Islam will prevail throughout the world (48:28).

verses.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.arabicClean: ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجا
verses.transliterated: wara-ayta l-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwāja
verses.english: You will see the people embracing GOD's religion in throngs.

1981.english: You will see the people embracing God's religion in great numbers.

1989.english: You will see the people embracing GOD’s religion in throngs.
1989.footnote: This last sura, chronologically, consists of 19 Arabic words (see 96:1), and the first verse consists of 19 letters. This indicates that this generation of believers shall attain the promised victory. The true Islam will prevail throughout the world (48:28).

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
verses.arabicClean: فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره ۚ إنه كان توابا
verses.transliterated: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāba
verses.english: You shall glorify and praise your Lord, and implore Him for forgiveness. He is the Redeemer.

1981.english: You shall praise the glory of your Lord, and ask Him forgiveness; He is the redeemer.

1989.english: You shall glorify and praise your Lord, and implore Him for forgiveness. He is the Redeemer.
1989.footnote: This last sura, chronologically, consists of 19 Arabic words (see 96:1), and the first verse consists of 19 letters. This indicates that this generation of believers shall attain the promised victory. The true Islam will prevail throughout the world (48:28).

verses.arabic: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم تبت يدا أبي لهب وتب
verses.transliterated: tabbat yadā abī lahabin watabb
verses.english: Condemned are the works of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned.
verses.footnote: Abee Lahab was Muhammad's uncle and the leader of the opposition. His wife carried out a campaign of persecution against Muhammad and the believers. Like all descriptions of Heaven and Hell, the rope of thorns is an allegory.

1981.english: Doomed are the schemes of Abee-Lahab,* and he is doomed.

1989.english: Condemned are the works of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned.*
1989.footnote: Abee Lahab was Muhammad’s uncle and the leader of opposition. His wife carried out a campaign of persecution against Muhammad and the believers. Like all descriptions of Heaven and Hell, the rope of thorns is an allegory.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.arabicClean: ما أغنى عنه ماله وما كسب
verses.transliterated: mā aghnā ʿanhu māluhu wamā kasab
verses.english: His money and whatever he has accomplished will never help him.

1981.english: His money and his material accomplishments will never help him.

1989.english: His money and whatever he has accomplished will never help him.

verses.arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ
verses.arabicClean: سيصلى نارا ذات لهب
verses.transliterated: sayaṣlā nāran dhāta lahabi
verses.english: He has incurred the blazing Hell.

1981.english: He will burn in the flaming hellfire.

1989.english: He has incurred the blazing Hell.

verses.arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
verses.arabicClean: وامرأته حمالة الحطب
verses.transliterated: wa-im'ra-atuhu ḥammālata l-ḥaṭab
verses.english: Also his wife, who led the persecution.

1981.english: And his wife, the evil bearer.

1989.english: Also his wife, who led the persecution.

verses.arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
verses.arabicClean: في جيدها حبل من مسد
verses.transliterated: fī jīdihā ḥablun min masadi
verses.english: She will be (resurrected) with a rope of thorns around her neck.

1981.english: Will have a rope of thorns around her neck.

1989.english: She will be (resurrected) with a rope of thorns around her neck.

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل هو الله أحد
verses.transliterated: qul huwa l-lahu aḥadu
verses.english: Proclaim, "He is the One and only GOD.

1981.english: Say, "He is God; the only one.

1989.english: Proclaim, “He is the One and only GOD.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
verses.arabicClean: الله الصمد
verses.transliterated: al-lahu l-ṣamad
verses.english: "The Absolute GOD.

1981.english: "The absolute God.

1989.english: “The Absolute GOD.

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
verses.arabicClean: لم يلد ولم يولد
verses.transliterated: lam yalid walam yūla
verses.english: "Never did He beget. Nor was He begotten.

1981.english: "He never begets, nor was He ever begotten.

1989.english: “Never did He beget. Nor was He begotten.

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
verses.arabicClean: ولم يكن له كفوا أحد
verses.transliterated: walam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥadu
verses.english: "None equals Him."

1981.english: "There is none that equals Him."

1989.english: “None equals Him.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل أعوذ برب الفلق
verses.transliterated: qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaq
verses.english: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.

1981.english: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.

1989.english: Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.

verses.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
verses.arabicClean: من شر ما خلق
verses.transliterated: min sharri mā khalaq
verses.english: "From the evils among His creations.

1981.english: "From the evils among His creation.

1989.english: “From the evils among His creations.

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب
verses.transliterated: wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab
verses.english: "From the evils of darkness as it falls.

1981.english: "From the evils of darkness as it falls.

1989.english: “From the evils of darkness as it falls.

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
verses.arabicClean: ومن شر النفاثات في العقد
verses.transliterated: wamin sharri l-nafāthāti fī l-ʿuqad
verses.english: "From the evils of the troublemakers.

1981.english: "From the evils of the troublemakers.

1989.english: “From the evils of the troublemakers.

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
verses.arabicClean: ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد
verses.transliterated: wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad
verses.english: "From the evils of the envious when they envy."

1981.english: "And from the envious who envies."

1989.english: “From the evils of the envious when they envy.”

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.arabicClean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل أعوذ برب الناس
verses.transliterated: qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-nās
verses.english: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of the people.

1981.english: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of the people.

1989.english: Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of the people.

verses.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.arabicClean: ملك الناس
verses.transliterated: maliki l-nās
verses.english: "The King of the people.

1981.english: "The King of the people.

1989.english: “The King of the people.

verses.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.arabicClean: إله الناس
verses.transliterated: ilāhi l-nās
verses.english: "The god of the people.

1981.english: "The God of the people.

1989.english: “The god of the people.

verses.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
verses.arabicClean: من شر الوسواس الخناس
verses.transliterated: min sharri l-waswāsi l-khanās
verses.english: "From the evils of sneaky whisperers.

1981.english: "From the evils of the sneaky whisperer.

1989.english: “From the evils of sneaky whisperers.

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.arabicClean: الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس
verses.transliterated: alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri l-nās
verses.english: "Who whisper into the chests of the people.

1981.english: "Who whispers into the hearts of the people.

1989.english: “Who whisper into the chests of the people.

verses.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
verses.arabicClean: من الجنة والناس
verses.transliterated: mina l-jinati wal-nās
verses.english: "Be they of the jinns, or the people."
verses.footnote: Thus, the total occurrence of the crucial word "God" (Allah) throughout the Quran is 2698, 19x142. The reader can ascertain the accuracy of this total by randomly checking the numbers of the word "God" at the bottom of any pages in this book. Additionally, if one adds the verse numbers wherever the word "God" occurs, the total comes to 118123, also a multiple of 19 (118123 = 19x6217). Details of the Quran's unique mathematical composition are given in Appendices 1, 2, 24, 25, 26, and 29.

1981.english: "Be he of the jinn kind or the humankind."

1989.english: “Be they of the jinns, or the people.”
